name: Secret Value
description:
Secret Value is an encrypted vault built for developers. Keep the API keys, tokens, .env files, certificates, notes and links of every project in one place: on your devices and in your own iCloud, never in chat threads or sticky notes.

ENCRYPTED BEFORE IT LEAVES YOUR HANDS
• Every value is sealed with AES-256-GCM on your device before it syncs.
• The vault key lives in your iCloud Keychain, so nobody else, the developer included, can read your vault.
• Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode. The app switcher never shows your secrets.
• Copied values clear themselves after the interval you choose.

VERSIONED LIKE CODE
• Every edit is a commit. Rotate a key, rename a project or delete a file, and it is recorded.
• Undo instantly, or restore a whole project or a single field from any point in time.
• Edits made on two devices merge field by field, so nothing is lost.

EVERYTHING A PROJECT NEEDS
• Secrets, with a generator for alphanumeric, symbol, hex, base64url and UUID values that shows their entropy.
• Copy a project's secrets as .env, or paste a .env file and import it in one step.
• Links, GitHub repositories, tags and a cover image for every project.
• App Store links are recognised and get their own icon.
• Search across every project at once.

NOTES BUILT FOR DEVELOPERS
• Titles, headings, checklists, tables, quotes and code blocks with a copy button.
• Photos, document scans and sketches, encrypted with the note.
• Stored as Markdown, so notes sync and merge like everything else.

LOOK INSIDE ANY FILE
• Certificates show their subject, validity and fingerprints; .p12 identities open with their password.
• .p8 keys show their algorithm and Key ID; provisioning profiles list their team, devices, expiry and entitlements.
• PDFs, Office and iWork documents, images, audio and video, JSON, property lists, CSV, SQLite databases and fonts.
• ZIP, IPA, TAR and GZ archives list their contents without unpacking.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account to create, no developer servers, no tracking and no analytics.
• Sync runs through your own private iCloud database.

Built for iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape.

name: 777: Wish & Manifest
description:
777 is a calm space where you symbolically release your wishes and manifestations into the sky.

Write your wish in the present tense, as if it's already true. Tap send and watch a balloon carry your message upward.

• Write in your own words or pick from 365 ready manifests in 8 categories
• A daily affirmation that never repeats within a year
• Most sent: see which ready manifests people sent most this week
• Sky: a calm, anonymous stream of ready manifests rising right now. No names, no profiles, and wishes in your own words never appear
• Send with a balloon, rocket, lantern or dove
• Dusk, Dawn and Cosmos sky themes
• Sign in with Apple or Google to keep your history and the dates you sent each wish
• Use as a guest, with nothing saved
• Home screen widget for today's affirmation
• Optional daily reminder, scheduled on your device
• Turkish and English, set automatically from your device language

Free, with no ads and no tracking. You can delete your account and all history from Settings at any time.

777 is built on kindness: it asks you to send only messages that wish well for yourself and others. 777 is a symbolic ritual; it does not guarantee any outcome.

name: 7handy
description:
Find independent service providers near you with 7handy. Browse the map or see listings sorted by distance, then filter by the service you need, from cooking and driving to car washing, electrical work, AC maintenance, and moving help.

Open a profile to see the provider’s services, hourly rate in AED, and work area. Call the provider directly to agree on the job, availability, and payment.

Offer local services? Tap Register as Handy to add your photo, services, hourly rate, and work area. We review your listing before it appears in the directory. You can pause, update, or delete your listing in the app.

name: AiMotor
description:
AiMotor is the AI driving coach and race engineer for sim racers.

Drive F1®, Assetto Corsa or Forza on your console or PC and AiMotor talks you through every lap: where to brake, which gear to use, where you lose time against a reference lap — live, by voice, while you drive.

• Live voice coaching corner by corner, from the telemetry your game sends
• Lap reports: speed, braking and racing line compared with a faster reference lap
• An AI coach you can ask anything about your laps, setups and strategy
• Race engineer radio: ask about tyres, fuel, gaps and the pit window
• Race strategist for F1: tyre plan and pit stops that follow the race
• Setups, leaderboards and a team section to work with your teammates
• 22 languages

Your phone becomes your pit wall: put it on its stand, connect your game in a few steps and drive.
The same account works on the AiMotor desktop app and at aimotor.eu.

Requires an AiMotor Pro account.

name: Al Nawras Logistics
description:
Al Nawras Trading and Logistics, based in Sohar, Oman, brings customs clearance, road transport and logistics into one app for the people who work with us.

The app is for existing Al Nawras customers, clearing agents, operations staff and drivers. Accounts are created and provided by Al Nawras; there is no self sign-up. If you do not have an account yet, use "Request an account" on the sign-in screen or contact our office.

FOR CUSTOMERS
- Follow every shipment with its status, route map and documents
- View invoices, payment requests and your statement
- Pay online or send a bank transfer slip from your phone
- Review quotations and accept or decline them
- Chat with the team, open support tickets and send documents
- Start a new shipment request

FOR CLEARING AGENTS AND OPERATIONS
- See today's files and the stage each one is in
- Create and manage job files, charges, invoices and documents
- Update checklists and move files to the next stage
- Take photos or attach documents straight from your phone

FOR DRIVERS
- See your containers and trips
- Confirm each step with a swipe
- Add photos and notes, and capture a signed proof of delivery

FOR EVERYONE
- Arabic and English, with full right-to-left support
- Push notifications for payments, documents, stages and messages
- Optional Face ID or screen-lock protection for the app
- Light and dark appearance
- A clear message when you are offline

Al Nawras Trading and Logistics, Al Reem Building, Falaj Al Qabail, Sohar, Oman. Phone +968 7755 7089, mohammad@alnawras-intl.com.

name: Aloqa Hub
description:
Aloqa Hub помогает подключить домашний интернет в Узбекистане и купить мобильный интернет для поездок за границу.

ДОМАШНИЙ ИНТЕРНЕТ
- Укажите адрес или отметьте дом на карте: покажем, какие провайдеры подключают ваш дом.
- Сравните тарифы по скорости и цене. Цены такие же, как у провайдера.
- Оставьте заявку: провайдер позвонит, договорится о времени и пришлёт мастера.
- Следите за заявкой в приложении: статусы приходят уведомлениями.
- Оценки и отзывы абонентов о провайдерах, тест скорости.

ESIM ДЛЯ ПОЕЗДОК
- Мобильный интернет в 150+ странах без SIM-карты и без роуминга вашего оператора.
- Выберите страну и тариф, оплатите картой — QR-код для установки придёт сразу.
- Тариф начинается, когда телефон впервые подключится к сети за границей.
- Остаток трафика и срок видны в приложении. Закончился трафик — докупите на ту же eSIM, в приложении со скидкой 5 %.

Не знаете, что выбрать? Оставьте телефон — оператор Aloqa Hub подберёт тариф бесплатно.

Приложение на узбекском и русском языках.

name: AMALFI VIBES
description:
YOUR WORLD. YOUR VIBES.

Welcome to AMALFI VIBES, your personal travel companion for exploring the Amalfi Coast.

Discover extraordinary destinations, plan your ideal holiday and find unforgettable experiences, all in one app.

DISCOVER THE AMALFI COAST

Explore Amalfi, Positano, Ravello, Praiano, Furore, Maiori and Sorrento. Find inspiration, discover beautiful places and create memories that last a lifetime.

CREATE YOUR VIBES

Build your personalized travel itinerary based on your dates, destinations and interests. Organize your days, explore suggested activities and make the most of your holiday.

UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCES

Explore and book local experiences, including:
- Vespa and scooter rentals
- Private boat experiences
- Amalfi Coast tours
- Other selected local activities

YOUR TRIP, ALL IN ONE PLACE

Discover available experiences, view prices and availability, and manage supported bookings directly from the app.

TRAVEL SMARTER

Explore destinations on the map, check available weather forecasts and add activities to your calendar.

AMALFI IS JUST THE BEGINNING

AMALFI VIBES is the first destination in our vision for VIBES WORLD.

Your World. Your Vibes.

Start exploring the Amalfi Coast today!

name: Antiplagiat.tj
description:
Antiplagiat.tj checks student and research papers for text borrowing for universities in Tajikistan. Upload a work from your phone, follow the check and get a certificate with the result.

WHAT THE APP DOES
• Checks DOCX and PDF files up to 100 MB: term papers, bachelor's and master's theses, dissertations, articles and books.
• Three clear scores: originality, similarity and citations.
• A list of matches with the source, the type (verbatim, paraphrase, citation) and the confidence.
• Live check status, step by step.
• A certificate with a number and a QR code. Anyone can verify a certificate by its number.
• All your works and their versions in one list.
• Interface in Tajik, Russian and English.

CITATIONS AND COMMON PHRASES
Properly marked citations are counted separately and do not lower originality. Set phrases — names of universities and laws, standard wording — are shown in the report but are not counted as borrowing.

DATA AND PRIVACY
A work enters the comparison database only with your consent, and you can withdraw it. Works without consent are not added to the database and are deleted 90 days after the check. The app has no ads and no third-party analytics. Texts of works are never sent to translation or artificial intelligence services.

ACCOUNT
Sign-in requires an Antiplagiat.tj account, created on the antiplagiat.tj website. The full report with the text, password changes and two-step verification are also on the website; the app opens the right page. You can delete your account in the app: Profile → Delete account.

name: Ari: Learn Korean
description:
Ari is an app for learning Korean in Ukrainian or in English: pick the language of the meanings, translations and notes in Profile. The interface is in both languages too.

What is inside
• A course of the 2000 most common words in 21 topics, from pronouns and verbs to food, travel and work.
• 177 grammar patterns: particles, endings, polite forms, exceptions, each with examples and a translation.
• Basics for beginners: the Hangul alphabet and first words by topic.
• A plan for every day: new words, grammar and reviews, counted for you. You pick the pace, from a few words a day to dozens.
• Spaced repetition: a word comes back just as you are about to forget it.
• Different exercises: pick the translation, type in Korean, mixed rounds. Words and sentences are read by recorded voices, a female or a male one, as you choose.
• Your own words and notes: add what you meet yourself and study it with the course.
• A day streak, rest days and a picture of your progress to share.
• Reminders that know you have already studied today.
• Dark mode.

Free
The first 500 words and 44 grammar patterns, Basics, your own words, notes and the backup. Whatever you have started is always reviewed.

Ari Plus
Opens the rest of the course. A monthly or yearly subscription (the year with a free week) or a purchase for good. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; a subscription renews by itself unless it is cancelled at least a day before the period ends, in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

Privacy
Without an account your progress stays on your phone. Signing in with Google or Apple is only for the backup. No ads, no tracking.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Até Lá: Countdown & Reminders
description:
Até Lá is the simple way to keep track of the dates that matter: a trip, a birthday, a wedding, a bill, a goal.

Add the moment, see how many days are left in a big, easy-to-read number and get a reminder before the date. No account, no sign-in and no internet needed: everything stays on your device.

WHAT YOU GET
• A clear countdown: "27 days", "Tomorrow", "Today", "Yesterday", "12 days ago". Never "0 days".
• Reminders your way: 30, 14, 7, 3 or 1 day before, on the day, or a custom time. Multiple reminders per event.
• Events that repeat every year, perfect for birthdays and anniversaries. Handles February 29 too.
• Categories with an icon and color: birthday, relationship, travel, event, work, payment, goal and other.
• Optional time, description and a custom color for each event.
• Search by title, filter by category and Upcoming, Today and Past tabs to browse your history.
• Home-screen widgets, small and medium, so you can see the countdown without opening the app.
• Light, dark or automatic theme, adjustable text size and screen-reader support.
• Available in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your events stay only on your device. Até Lá has no sign-up, no servers of its own and never sends the content of your events to anyone. We don't ask for your location, contacts, camera, microphone or access to your calendar.

FREE, WITH DISCREET ADS
The app is free and shows Google AdMob ads on a few screens. Ads never appear in widgets or notifications. Where the law requires it, we ask for your consent before showing personalized ads.

Reminders depend on your device's notification and battery settings. For critical commitments, don't rely on the app as your only alert.

name: AWERO: Wake-Up Alarm
description:
AWERO is an alarm clock for people who switch alarms off in their sleep. To silence it you complete a short task: solve a math problem, walk, do squats or take a photo of a spot in another room. By then you’re awake.

WAKE-UP TASKS

Math — mental arithmetic, three difficulty levels
Memory — repeat the order of the cells that light up
Typing — retype the phrase on the screen
Pairs — open the cards and find every pair
Shake — shake the phone hard
Steps — walk 30 steps
Squats — 10, 15 or 20 squats counted by the motion sensor
Camera push-ups and squats — the camera counts the reps
Smile, open eyes, fingers — front-camera tasks
QR or barcode — scan the barcode on your toothpaste or coffee in another room
Photo — photograph your sink or coffee maker
Sequence — three tasks in a row
Dance — dance in front of the camera; time only runs while you move
Find an object — each morning a random object: sink, fridge, toilet or stove. Find it and show it to the camera

NO GOING BACK TO SLEEP

Tapped Stop half-asleep? The alarm rings again until the task is done
“Are you up?” check a few minutes after you get up
Emergency stop is always available

MORNING AND SLEEP

Morning screen: weather, how long you slept, goal for the day
Sleep sounds with a timer: rain, ocean, noise
Sleep statistics and a bedtime reminder
Wake-up streak and weekly progress
Next-alarm widget
Wake-up buddy: a friend sees when you got up

RELIABLE

Rings without internet and after a phone restart
Loud melodies, your own sounds, gradual volume
No sign-up, no ads
11 languages, light and dark appearance

FREE AND PRO
Free: one alarm with the Math task.
AWERO Pro: all tasks, unlimited alarms, sleep features, “Are you up?” check, widgets and wake-up buddy. 7-day free trial for new subscribers, then yearly or monthly. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://awero.co/legal/en/terms.html
Privacy: https://awero.co/legal/en/privacy.html
Support: support@awero.co

name: BatchPDF – Offline PDF Tool
description:
BatchPDF is a simple, offline PDF utility that runs entirely on your iPhone and iPad.
No internet connection required, your PDF documents never leave your device.

Combine multiple PDFs into one file
Split a large PDF into separate documents
Preview PDF thumbnails
Drag to reorder pages
Rotate or delete single PDF pages
Export processed PDF to Files app

No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads.
One-time purchase for full access.

name: BatchTimeZone
description:
BatchTimeZone is a lightweight offline time tool for iPhone and iPad.
All calculations run locally on your device — no internet required.

Unix timestamp converter (seconds & milliseconds)
One-tap copy current timestamp
Compare multiple global time zones side by side
Add or remove custom time zones
Date picker to look up past or future timestamps
Calculate time difference between two moments
Switch between 12h / 24h time format

No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads.
One-time purchase for full access.

name: BatchVideo – Video Compressor
description:
BatchVid is a fully offline bulk video compressor built for creators and sellers.
Every video is processed locally on your iPhone — your videos never get uploaded to any server. No account required, no cloud sync.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Compress multiple videos at once with a quality / bitrate slider
• Lower resolution: Original, 1080p, 720p or 480p
• Choose frame rate: Original, 30fps or 24fps
• Convert to MP4 (H.264) or MP4 (H.265 / HEVC)
• Preview before saving, compare file size before and after
• Export processed videos to a new album in your Photos library

Perfect for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Etsy and Amazon sellers, and anyone who needs smaller videos for messages, email and uploads.

No subscriptions, no hidden fees, no in-app purchases.
Pay once to download, unlock all features forever.

Works offline. Your privacy stays protected.

name: Begun for Experts
description:
Begun is the app for experts who work with us: your opportunities, your tasks and your pay, on your phone.

Opportunities. See the projects open to you and the ones you are already on.

Tasks. Open a task, do the work and send it in from your phone.

Pay. Follow each payment from the moment it is due to the moment it lands.

Notifications. When a project you work on posts an update, or a payment changes status, Begun tells you. Tap the notification and it opens the right page, even if the app was closed.

Read-aloud tasks. Record with a recorder made for the job. The take keeps going when you lock the screen or switch apps, stays on your phone until you save it, and is offered again if you come back to the task.

You sign in with your Begun account. Everything on the website is here too.

Your life’s work has only just Begun.

name: Block Order — Calm Puzzle
description:
Block Order is a calm block puzzle for iPhone. No ads, no timer, no purchases, no internet needed — just you, an 8×8 board and three pieces at a time.

Drag pieces from the tray onto the board. Fill a whole row or column and it clears with a satisfying wave. Clear lines on consecutive moves to build a streak and score more. Every new set of three pieces is checked to fit the board when it is dealt, so the game is about planning, not luck.

Made a move you regret? Undo it — up to 20 moves, free. The game ends only when none of your pieces fits anywhere, and then you chase your best score again.

FEATURES
• Classic 8×8 block puzzle with three pieces at a time
• Rows and columns clear together; streaks multiply your score
• Forgiving drag and drop that snaps to the nearest free spot
• Free undo, up to 20 moves
• No timer and no pressure — play at your own pace
• Soft sounds and haptics, with a reduce-motion option
• Your game is saved automatically
• Interface in 19 languages

NOTHING EXTRA
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no sign-up
• No tracking, works fully offline

Made by Neverland Playworks, a small independent studio.

name: BravoGo: Food & Deliveries
description:
BravoGo is your trusted delivery companion across Nigeria. Discover restaurants and stores, order food and everyday essentials, pay securely, and track your deliveries from checkout to your doorstep.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Discover restaurants, stores, and local vendors near you.

Browse categories, search products, and build your cart.

Place orders and pay securely using your wallet, card, or other supported payment methods.

Track orders and packages in real time.

Save your favourite vendors and delivery addresses.

Manage your wallet, rewards, and referral bonuses.

Get assistance through in-app support and FAQs.

BravoGo makes ordering and delivery easier, faster, and more convenient, connecting customers with vendors and reliable delivery services across Nigeria.

Questions? Visit bravogodeliveries.com or contact support@bravogodeliveries.com.

name: BSM12-1B
description:

name: Café Twin: Coffee Recipes
description:
Your favorite café drink, made at home — tuned to the exact coffee machine you own.

Café Twin turns iced lattes, shaken espressos, cold foam drinks and seasonal specials into step-by-step recipes for your gear: espresso machine, bean-to-cup machine, capsule machine, moka pot or French press. No guessing, no wasted beans.

SNAP ANY CAFÉ DRINK
Take a photo of a drink you loved at a café. Café Twin recognizes it and shows you how to make it on your own machine.

RECIPES THAT FIT YOUR GEAR
Tell us what you have once. Every recipe adjusts doses, grind, milk and timing to your machine, grinder and milk frother.

GUIDED BREWING
Follow each step with a built-in timer, from the espresso shot to the last drizzle. Stronger, lighter, sweeter or iced — every drink has variations.

SAVE REAL MONEY
See how much you save compared to café prices. Most people save over $1,000 a year.

CHALLENGES AND AWARDS
Weekly challenges, streaks, levels and 15 awards keep you trying new drinks. Every new level unlocks a drink from the secret menu. Share your awards and your own drink photos.

CAFÉ TWIN PRO
• 30+ café drinks plus seasonal menus and new trending drinks (dirty matcha, protein cold foam and more)
• Unlimited snap-to-recipe
• Recipes tuned to your exact gear
• Remembers how you like each drink

Subscriptions: Café Twin Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless you cancel before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://cafetwin.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://cafetwin.app/privacy.html

name: CB KITL HD
description: At the end of each month, consolidate your key financial figures into a single summary sheet: calculate the actual net outflow, determine the proportion of income spent on daily expenses, and identify any pending deductions that require verification. When recording income and expenditures, specify the amount, the account used, and the purpose of the transaction; if a single payment covers multiple purposes, you can break it down into individual line items while ensuring the total remains accurate. By clicking on the figures in the summary sheet, you can trace every transaction—whether it was included, deducted, or excluded. For refunds that span across months, you can view them based on the date they were received or attribute them back to the month the original expense occurred. Before applying changes to formulas, you can compare the new results against the previous ones and select specific months for recalculation. Items that are not yet clear can be added to a "to-do" queue for later review, allowing you to preview how these adjustments will affect your final totals before saving.

name: Cheerstar设备升级工具
seller_name: Shenzhen Changda Communication Technology Co., Ltd.

设备升级工具可通过蓝牙搜索受支持的设备。连接设备后，可查看设备型号、蓝牙名称和当前固件版本，并查询该型号是否有可用的固件更新。

name: Clipy: Screen Recorder
description:
Clipy is the AI-native screen recorder. Record your screen or camera and talk, share one link, and anyone can watch it with no signup. The same recording works for your AI agents: they get the transcript, summary and key moments, so you can show them what you mean instead of typing it out.

RECORD
- Record your iPhone or iPad screen from the app or Control Center, with your voice
- Record yourself with the front or back camera
- Import a video from Photos or Files
- Trim the start and end, rename it, and export an MP4 or save it to Photos

SHARE
- Upload to your Clipy library and get a share link at clipy.online
- Anyone with the link can watch in a browser, no signup needed
- Copy the link, open the watch page, or send it from the share sheet

UNDERSTAND
- Every uploaded recording gets a transcript, a summary and key moments
- Ask a question about a recording and get an answer with the moments it came from
- Paste the link into ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or another AI assistant and it reads the recording for you

ORGANIZE
- Your whole Clipy library on your phone, with search and filters
- Folders and tags that stay in sync with the web
- Rename, describe, move or delete recordings from anywhere

Use it for bug reports, product feedback, quick walkthroughs, support answers, onboarding and anything else you would rather show than write.

Clipy is free to start. Sign in with Google or email. Your recordings are also in your Clipy library on the web and on your computer.

Privacy policy: https://clipy.online/privacy
Terms: https://clipy.online/terms

name: Concrete Calculator - Offline
description:
Concrete Calculator - Offline

Calculate concrete volume, estimate cement and material quantities, and plan construction projects with Concrete Calculator - Offline. A powerful construction calculator designed for builders, contractors, engineers, students, and DIY users.

Whether you are calculating a concrete slab, foundation, footing, column, beam, or masonry project, get quick and convenient construction estimates without an internet connection.

   POWERFUL CONCRETE CALCULATORS

Calculate the quantities you need for different construction projects:

- Concrete Volume Calculator
- Concrete Slab Calculator
- Foundation Calculator
- Footing Calculator
- Column Calculator
- Beam Calculator
- Concrete Block and Masonry Calculator
- Cement, Sand and Aggregate Calculator
- Reinforcement and Rebar Calculator
- Construction Material Calculator
- Concrete Cost Estimator

   ACCURATE MATERIAL ESTIMATES

Estimate the required quantities of:
- Cement
- Sand
- Gravel and Aggregate
- Concrete Mix
- Reinforcement Steel
- Construction Materials

Customize concrete mix ratios and calculate material requirements according to your project dimensions.

   CONSTRUCTION COST ESTIMATION

Plan your construction budget with convenient cost estimation tools. Calculate estimated material costs and review project quantities before starting work.

   MORE USEFUL FEATURES

- Works completely offline
- Metric and Imperial measurement units
- Multiple concrete calculation tools
- Custom concrete mix ratios
- PDF calculation reports
- Calculation history
- Save favorite calculations
- Easy-to-use interface
- Light and Dark themes
- Quick and convenient results

   WHO CAN USE THIS APP?

Concrete Calculator - Offline is useful for:

- Civil Engineers
- Construction Contractors
- Builders and Architects
- Construction Workers
- Quantity Surveyors
- Engineering Students
- Homeowners and DIY Users

   CALCULATE ANYTIME, ANYWHERE

No internet connection is required. Calculate concrete volume, estimate cement, sand, gravel, reinforcement, and construction costs wherever your work takes you.

Download Concrete Calculator - Offline and make your construction calculations easier.

name: Condense: Free Up Storage
description:
iPhone storage full? Condense compresses your videos and photos to free up gigabytes, without deleting a single memory.

A video compressor built for your whole library: Condense finds the videos that take up the most space, makes a smaller copy of each one with the same resolution, smoothness and sound, and keeps its date, location, favorite status and albums. Then you free up the space in one tap, and it's back on your iPhone as soon as Recently Deleted is emptied. Everything happens on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded, no account, no ads.

FREE UP STORAGE IN MINUTES
• Scan your photo library and see how much space you can get back.
• Biggest videos first: 4K and long clips are usually where your storage went.
• Pick the videos you want, or compress everything in one tap with the full version.
• See the space you will get back, video by video, before you start.

SAME QUALITY, LESS SPACE
• Modern HEVC (H.265) compression for videos, and HEIC for JPEG and PNG photos (screenshots, saved images), done by your iPhone's own hardware.
• Same resolution, same frame rate, HDR and spatial audio kept.
• Compare before and after on the same frame, zoomed in.

NOTHING LOST
• Date, location, favorites and albums carry over to every compressed copy.
• Each copy is checked before anything is removed.
• Originals stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.
• Slo-mo, Cinematic mode, ProRes, Live Photos and Portrait photos are left untouched.

ICLOUD STORAGE FULL?
Videos stored in iCloud are compressed over Wi‑Fi, so they take less of your iCloud plan too.

EVERY NIGHT, AUTOMATICALLY
With the full version, turn on overnight compression: new videos are compressed while your iPhone charges. The Home Screen widget, free for everyone, shows how much space you have left.

VIDEO TOO BIG TO SEND?
Shrink a video to send it by email or message, with no watermark. The original stays in your library.

FREE TO START
The scan is free, and you can compress up to 2 GB a week for free. To compress more, all at once, and to turn on overnight compression, unlock the full version with a one-time purchase or a yearly subscription (Family Sharing for up to 6 people).

Privacy: Condense never uploads your photos or videos and collects no data.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://getcondense.com/privacy.html

name: ConsoleDub: Game Translator
description:
Play the latest games in Turkish, and hear them dubbed live.

Put your iPhone next to your console or TV and tap start. ConsoleDub listens to the game's English dialogue, translates it into Turkish on the fly and speaks it to you in a natural voice, so you never have to read subtitles or pause to look up a word.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT
• Instant dubbing: lines are translated and spoken within moments, while the scene is still playing
• Male and female voices: pick the voice you like, or let Auto match each line to its speaker
• Remembers context: it keeps the last lines in mind so names, pronouns and slang stay consistent (on devices that support Apple Intelligence)
• Works with any game that has English voice acting, on any console, PC or TV
• Private by design: speech recognition, translation and voices all run on your device. Nothing is uploaded, recorded or stored
• Simple: no account, no setup, one big button

HOW IT WORKS
1. Place your iPhone near the speakers or TV
2. Choose a voice: female, male or auto
3. Tap start and play

TIP: Headphones (wired or Bluetooth) work best. You keep the game's original sound and hear the dub privately. For a more natural voice, download an Enhanced or Premium Turkish voice in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices.

PRICING
Try it free for 3 minutes. Unlock ConsoleDub forever with a single one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads.

NOTES
Translations are generated automatically on your device and may not always be perfect. The first time you use the app, iOS downloads the Turkish language pack. Requires iOS 26 or later.

ConsoleDub is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any game publisher or console maker.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://inappto.com.tr/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://inappto.com.tr/privacy.html

name: Crowd Math
description:
Crowd Math is a fast crowd runner made for Apple TV.

Lead a running crowd down a floating track and pick the right gate every few seconds: multiply your crowd, add to it or take the smaller loss. Outnumber the red crowds that charge at you, squeeze past spinning rollers, saws, stampers and swinging hammers, cross narrow bridges and ride lifts that break under too many people. At the finish your crowd builds a human pyramid: the taller it grows, the more stars it earns.

Travel through five worlds, from tropical islands and an autumn forest to snowy islands, a desert canyon and a volcano at night. Every world has its own giant bosses, and every fifth level ends with a boss battle.

FEATURES
- Levels that grow harder step by step across five worlds
- Quick choices: the numbers appear just ahead, and the better gate depends on the crowd you have
- Red crowds, lane gates, lifts with a weight limit and eight kinds of traps
- A human pyramid finish worth up to 3 stars
- Giant bosses: a boss battle every fifth level
- A level map that shows the worlds still to come
- 12 crowd skins
- Colorful 3D graphics made for the big screen
- Upbeat music and punchy sound effects
- Your progress, stars and skins are saved

EASY TO PLAY
Your crowd runs on its own. Swipe left or right on the Siri Remote, or press the left and right edges of its clickpad, to move the crowd sideways and steer it into the gate you want. Press Play/Pause or Back to pause the game.

name: CSVHarbor: Table Inspector
description:
Inspect delimited text on your device. Parse quoted CSV, browse rows and columns, find uneven rows, select columns, and export a normalized table or save a local snapshot.

• Parse quoted fields, embedded newlines and escaped double quotes.
• See row widths and identify uneven records.
• Browse each row with its original field values.
• Count filled, empty and unique column values.
• Choose columns for normalized CSV export and keep local snapshots.

Up to 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, 500 rows, 40 columns and 4,000 characters per cell. Choose comma, semicolon or tab explicitly. The first row labels columns. Uneven rows are identified; selected-column export fills missing fields with empty text. Formulas are not executed here. Spreadsheet software may interpret cells starting with =, +, - or @ as formulas; inspect untrusted exports before opening them there.

No sign-in, advertising or analytics SDK is included. Records remain on this device. Copy and system sharing occur when you choose them.

name: DAMKA — Offline Checkers
description:
DAMKA is calm, classic checkers for iPhone and iPad. There are no accounts, no ads and no purchases. The game works completely offline, and your progress stays on your device.

Pick your rules. In Russian checkers, men capture backwards too and kings fly across the board. In English checkers, also known as American checkers, men capture forwards only and kings move one square at a time. Both are played on an 8×8 board, and capturing is always mandatory.

Play the computer on Easy, Medium or Hard, or pass the device to a friend for a two-player game. Want something quick? Turn on the optional clock: three minutes each, plus two seconds per move.

Sharpen your tactics with 115 puzzles played under Russian rules: forced captures, backward jumps, flying kings and long capture chains. A daily puzzle waits for you on the home screen.

Made a mistake? Undo it. Stuck? Ask for a hint, and the game highlights the piece and its route on the board. Finished games go to your history, where you can replay them move by move.

FEATURES
• Russian and English checkers on an 8×8 board
• Play the computer: Easy, Medium and Hard
• Two players on one device
• Optional 3 + 2 clock
• 115 tactical puzzles in three difficulty levels, plus a daily puzzle
• Three board styles: Classic, Jade and Graphite
• On-device profile: games, wins, draws and XP
• History of your last 30 games with move-by-move review
• Undo and hints
• Wooden piece sounds and light haptics, both optional
• Portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad
• Languages: English, Russian and Uzbek

NOTHING EXTRA
• No sign-up, no accounts
• No ads, no in-app purchases
• No analytics, no tracking
• Fully offline

DAMKA is made by Neverland Playworks, a small independent studio. If you enjoy it, a review on the App Store helps a lot.

name: DhandazOne
description:
DhandazOne brings your accounts on Parkify (Canada) and Parkify Global (US), Rentol, Taskal, CarLinx and Homezo into one app. One sign-in, one inbox, one list of your listings.

Sign in with your e-mail and a 6-digit code. No password to remember.

ONE INBOX
• Conversations from all five sites, newest first
• Reply from anywhere
• Alerts when someone writes to you

BROWSE EVERY SITE
• Parking in Canada and the US
• Rentals, local pros, cars and homes in Canada
• Search near you or by city, filter, and see results on a map
• Message an owner right from the listing

YOUR LISTINGS
• All your ads in one list
• Hide, show, bump or renew in a tap
• Open your site pages already signed in

TRUST AND SAFETY
• Verify your phone with a text code
• Share your area (about 1 km) to message more people
• Verified members get a badge

PRIVACY
No tracking. Your e-mail and location are never shown to other members.

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign out on one phone or all of them
• Delete your account in the app

DhandazOne is for members of our five sites. New here? Sign up on any of them, then sign in.

name: Dnevco
description:
Dnevco is an application that helps you record, organize and learn about food-related content.

You can create your own food notes, save recipes, ingredients, cooking steps, photos and insights; browse the public recipes and cooking courses on the platform, learn different cooking methods step by step; add the dishes you are interested in to your wish list and record the process from planning to completion.

Dnevco turns scattered food inspirations into an easily accessible and sustainable personal database, helping you more conveniently review your favorite flavors, organize your cooking experiences, and gradually build your own cooking records.
Privacy Policy Link
https://telegra.ph/Dnevco-Privacy-Policy-11-19
Terms Of Service Link
https://telegra.ph/Dnevco-Terms-of-Service-11-19
EULA Link
https://telegra.ph/Dnevco-End-User-License-Agreement-11-19

name: Don't Mix Up Letters b d p
description:
Does your child mix up b and d, p and b, or m and n? Letters that look alike are easy to confuse at the start of school.

Don't Mix Up the Letters! helps children tell them apart through play: 9 pairs of letters (b-d, p-b, m-n, f-t, u-n, a-ă, c-e, i-l, s-ș), 12 short games for each, with a friendly Romanian voice. The app and its voice are in Romanian.

How it works
Every game has three short exercises:
1. Circle every b (or d, or the other letter of the pair) among many look-alikes.
2. Fill in the missing letter of a word.
3. Pick the words that contain the asked letter.

A friendly owl explains everything and praises the child. Earned stars add up for every pair.

What children get
- 9 pairs of letters that are easy to mix up
- 108 games with pictures, words and syllables
- Romanian voice, praise and calm music
- works offline

For parents
- settings and progress are in a parents area that opens only after a small sum
- no accounts, no data collection, no ads

Made for children aged 5-8. Questions or ideas? Write to us, we read everything.

name: Dr Silver Equine
description:
Dr Silver brings everyday horse care and the full Dr Silver supplement range together in one simple app. Made by a UK, family-run, BETA-member equine company.

YOUR YARD TODAY
• Live local weather for your yard, with wind in mph
• Personal rug guide for day and night, stable and turnout
• Turnout planner showing the best hours to go out
• Field going meter, from frozen to heavy
• Frost, grass-sugar and seasonal alerts, such as sycamore and acorns

MY HORSES
• A profile for each horse, with a personal rugging profile
• Health passport with vet and emergency contacts
• Stable-door QR card so anyone at the yard can see key details
• Share a horse with your yard team and keep track of daily tasks

FEEDING MADE SIMPLE
• Feeding calculator using official Dr Silver feeding rates
• Supplement finder to explore products by area of support

SHOP DR SILVER
• The full Dr Silver range with secure checkout
• Earn loyalty points on every order
• Sign in with your existing Dr Silver website account

Dr Silver products support general equine wellbeing as part of a balanced management plan. They do not diagnose, treat or cure any medical condition. Always consult your vet where required.

name: DSH Teamwork
description:
DSH Teamwork is a remote for the DSH agent running on your own computer. Start work at your desk, walk away, and decide from your phone when the agent needs you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See every session on your computer, sorted by what needs you
- Allow or refuse an action and answer the agent's questions, right from the list
- Follow a session as it works: its steps, and its replies as they are written
- Start a new session in a folder on your computer, with your team's presets and models, and attach files
- Get a notification only when a session waits on you
- Switch between your computers, or a shared DSH your team runs

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your phone talks to your computer end to end encrypted. The relay in between passes the traffic along and cannot read it.
- You pair each computer once: scan the code it shows, then match a safety code on both screens.
- Your computer can ask for a PIN before the phone sees anything.
- No model provider key ever reaches your phone.

WHAT YOU NEED
- DSH on your computer, with the DSH Teamwork plugin
- A DSH Teamwork account in a team: join with an invitation, or create a team in the app

Your team can use the hosted service at dshteamwork.com or run its own server; the app signs in to either.

name: EldumiFarneth
description: Palletising calculator: boxes, pattern, capacity, input and pallet price.

name: Enjazy
description:
Task management as it should be.

Tasks, subtasks, lists and projects, reshaped around the way you create, update and follow things through, from a two-minute to-do to a multi-step project.

• Plan your day: Upcoming and Calendar bring the work ahead into view.
• Find your perspective: Board, Timeline and the Priority matrix help you organize your next move.
• Know what comes next: reminders and smart lists show the work that needs your attention.
• Make room for focused work: track time on a task, or give it a focus session.
• Offline first: work without an internet connection or an account. Your tasks stay on your device.
• Back up and move on: export and restore backups.
• Privacy without tracking: no telemetry. PIN-locked lists add a privacy gate.
• English and Arabic, with right-to-left support, light and dark themes.
• Same app, you choose where it lives: keep it on your phone, connect to Enjazy Online, or to your own Enjazy Server.
• Share lists and projects with owner, editor and viewer roles.

name: Ercan
description:
Ercan, ailenizin konumunu ve güvenliğini tek yerden takip etmeniz için ebeveyn uygulamasıdır. Çocuğunuzun Apple Watch'undaki Ercan Saat ile birlikte çalışır.

• Harita: Ailenizi canlı haritada (standart veya uydu) görün; dokununca pil, ne zamandır orada olduğu ve hızı.
• Yerler: Ev, okul gibi yerler ekleyin; varış ve ayrılışta bildirim alın. Yere süre sınırı koyun.
• Acil durum: Çocuğunuz SOS'a basınca anında uyarı ve konum.
• Mesajlar: Saate yazılı ve sesli mesaj gönderin, cevapları görün.
• Çaldır: Kaybolan saati ya da telefonu uzaktan çaldırın.
• Telefonla paylaşım: Saati olmayan aile üyeleri konumunu iPhone'dan paylaşabilir.
• Geçmiş: Günlük rota, olaylar ve pil istatistikleri.

Veriler yalnız ailenizin özel sunucusunda tutulur; reklam ve izleme yoktur.

name: Ertegiler: ертегі оқу, тыңдау
description:
Ертегілер — сказки для детей на казахском и русском. Читайте вместе с ребёнком или включите аудиосказку на ночь.

СКАЗКИ НА НОЧЬ
• Режим сна: спокойные сказки и приглушённый экран вечером
• Таймер сна: 10 или 20 минут или до конца сказки
• Сказки включаются одна за другой
• Аудио играет и при выключенном экране

БИБЛИОТЕКА
• 340+ казахских сказок, 280+ из них с озвучкой
• Более 200 сказок на русском, народные и авторские
• «Сказки народов мира» — 162 сказки
• Подбор по возрасту (2–12 лет) и по времени: 5, 10 или 15 минут
• Крупный шрифт, белый, сепия и ночной фон
• Продолжение с того места, где остановились

ТРИ ЯЗЫКА
• Приложение на казахском, русском и английском
• Переведённую сказку можно открыть на другом языке прямо в читалке
• «Волшебные слова» в казахских сказках: перевод и значение помогают учить казахский

АНА ТІЛІ
• Уроки казахского для детей: буквы для малышей, язык через сказки для детей постарше
• 5 минут в день, в форме игры

ИНТЕРЕС К ЧТЕНИЮ
• Звёзды за каждую дочитанную сказку
• Серия дней чтения и награды

ДЛЯ РОДИТЕЛЕЙ
• Отдельный профиль для каждого ребёнка
• Недельный отчёт о чтении
• Родительский раздел закрыт кодом

ПРЕМИУМ
• Сказки, где герой — ваш ребёнок: 3 новые сказки в месяц с его портретом на обложке
• Дикторский голос: сказки читает профессиональный диктор
• Все уроки Ана тілі, включая новые
Без подписки доступны 3 сказки в день, обычная озвучка и бесплатные уроки.

ИМЕННАЯ КНИГА
Книга из нескольких сказок, где героем становится ваш ребёнок, с его портретом на страницах. PDF можно распечатать. Это разовая покупка, не подписка.

Ертегілер — официальное приложение сайта ertegiler.kz. Войдите через Apple или Google, чтобы видеть сохранённые сказки и книги с сайта.

ПОДПИСКА
Премиум оформляется на 1 месяц или на 1 год. Оплата списывается с Apple ID при подтверждении покупки. Подписка продлевается автоматически, если не отменить её минимум за 24 часа до конца периода. Управлять подпиской и отменить её можно в настройках Apple ID.

Условия использования: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Политика конфиденциальности: https://ertegiler.kz/privacy

Вопросы и предложения: business.ertegiler@gmail.com

name: Ferma — lauku sēta
description:
Ferma is a Latvian farm game. The game itself is in Latvian.

You start with a small farmstead, a few beds and a dog, and step by step grow the farm you want.

WHAT YOU DO
• Sow and harvest: carrots, potatoes, wheat, rye, flax, strawberries, pumpkins, sunflowers and dozens more crops.
• Tend animals: hens, geese, cows, sheep, rabbits, goats and Latvian breeds — the Latvian Brown and Blue cows, the Latvian Darkheaded sheep.
• Build and furnish: houses, barns, a windmill, a sauna, a bakery, a dairy, a smokehouse, an apiary and hundreds of decorations.
• Make country goods in workshops: bread, cheese, honey, juice, smoked goods and more, by recipe.
• Fill your neighbours' orders, gather collections and achievements, and climb the levels.

THE MAP OF LATVIA
Choose a place for your farmstead on a real map of Latvia — in the county and parish close to your heart. The map shows rivers, lakes and well-known places. It shows no owners' names, addresses or cadastral numbers.

A FARMSTEAD TO YOUR TASTE
Fences, gates, paths, flower beds, an orchard, a forest, a pond. Rearrange the farm as often as you like.

FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Visit neighbours, help them and get help back. Family or friends can run one farm together as a household.

RADIO
Listen to the game's own radio stations while you work on the farm.

SEASONS AND FEASTS
The seasons change, and the farm celebrates Midsummer, Christmas and other feasts.

NO ADS
There are no ads in the game. Supernauda, the game's special currency, is earned in play; adults can also buy it in the app through the App Store. Supernauda buys looks, comforts and a helper's work day. It never buys land, speed or experience. Only an adult with a confirmed e-mail can buy, for at most 30 € in 30 days.

ONE FARM ON EVERY DEVICE
Open the same farm on a phone, a tablet and in a computer's browser — with a restore code or by adding the device.

AGE
The app is for 13 and over. On the first run the game asks your age; to someone under 13 it suggests playing Ferma in a browser together with a parent. Teenagers cannot buy. Playing needs no date of birth, e-mail or phone number.

ACCOUNT AND DATA
You can delete your account in the game: Profile → Account → «Delete account…» (in Latvian: Profils → Konts → «Dzēst kontu…»). More: https://fermadraugiem.lv/konta-dzesana/
Privacy policy (in Latvian): https://fermadraugiem.lv/privatums/

The game needs an internet connection.

Ferma is made and run by Brain Club SIA, Liepāja, Latvia. Questions and ideas: info@fermadraugiem.lv

name: Finny's Ocean Odyssey
description:
Explore the sea with Finny and take on turn-based encounters along the way.

The first biome and the first ten floors of the Blue Hole are free. A one-time purchase unlocks the remaining biomes, more companions, and higher floors. There is no gacha and no advertising. The purchase is family-shareable.

Character and scenery art is AI-assisted, not hand-painted. Some floor and log names are generated by the game.

Landscape only, for iPhone. The app includes Traditional and Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish and Russian.

Support: lunagamesitw@gmail.com

name: Fitlog - az edzőtermi szoftver
description:
A Fitlog az edzőtermed digitális bérletkezelője. Ha a termed Fitlogot használ, az appban mindent egy helyen intézel:

• Bérlet: látod, meddig érvényes, hány alkalmad maradt, és egy koppintással megújíthatod.
• Órafoglalás: nézd meg a heti órarendet, foglalj vagy mondj le helyet, és állj be a várólistára.
• Belépés QR-kóddal: a recepción csak felmutatod a telefonod.
• Edzésnapló és rekordok: jegyezd fel az eredményeidet, és lásd, hogyan fejlődsz.
• Szokáskövetés: heti célok, sorozatok, szintek és jelvények, hogy a rendszeresség is számítson.
• Értesítések: szólunk, ha lejár a bérleted, felszabadult egy hely, vagy üzenetet kaptál a termedtől.

Az első indításkor keresd meg a termedet név alapján, és jelentkezz be a termedtől kapott fiókkal.
A Fitlog termeknek szól: ha a termed még nem használja, írj nekünk a hello@fitlog.hu címre.

name: Flip Clock Online
description:
Flip Clock Online is a stylish flip clock with smooth realistic page-turn animation.
It works on your device, showing local system time.

Realistic paper flip animation
12-hour / 24-hour format with AM / PM
Toggle seconds display on or off
Full-screen immersive desk clock
Multiple custom color themes
Keep screen awake option
Works on iPhone & iPad

No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads.
One-time purchase for full access.

name: Gentian – Swiss Alps
description:
Gentian is an independent, English-language companion for exploring the Swiss Alps without a car. Start with an editorial Top 100 of remarkable lakes, peaks, villages, gorges and scenic railways, read a practical guide for each place, and plan a day trip on the Swiss public transport timetable.

TOP 100 MUST-SEE
• 100 hand-picked Alpine destinations, ranked by the Gentian editorial team
• Search and filter by category, region, season, difficulty, time available, accessibility and transport preference
• Coordinates, elevations and timetable stops checked against official sources

DESTINATION GUIDES
• What makes each place special, highlights and things to do
• How to get there step by step, best season, typical duration and difficulty
• Accessibility notes and family or dog suitability, marked as official, editorial or unknown
• Links to official operators for tickets, timetables and opening information

CAR-FREE TRIP PLANNER
• Plan a day trip from major hubs or any Swiss stop, with train, bus, cog railway, funicular, cable car and walking legs
• Connections come from the Swiss open-data timetable; walking times and time on site are clearly labelled estimates
• Save, share and refresh trips, with notes on season, weather, families and dogs

MAPS & GPS
• swisstopo topographic, grey and aerial maps with hiking, mountain-bike and cycling layers
• Your position on the map, GPX import and export, route drawing and elevation profiles
• Basic route following that shows distance and deviation (not turn-by-turn navigation)

MOUNTAIN CONDITIONS
• Forecast at the destination's altitude, simple forecast-based cautions and a link to official MeteoSwiss warnings
• The SLF avalanche bulletin for the destination's region
• Official trail closures and diversions on the SwitzerlandMobility network

LIVE WEBCAMS
• Links to official operator webcams for many Top 100 destinations, with summit and valley views where available
• Webcam pages open in your browser; availability and image freshness depend on each operator

SAVED & OFFLINE
• Bucket list, completed places and saved trips, stored on your device
• Destination guides and photos are built into the app; optional offline packs keep a dated conditions snapshot. Maps and live data need an internet connection.

SAFETY
• SOS screen with Swiss emergency numbers (112, Rega 1414, 144, 117, 118) and confirmation before dialling
• Your coordinates in WGS84, degrees-minutes-seconds and Swiss LV95, ready to copy or share
• Calls use your phone's own network; Gentian does not contact rescue services automatically and cannot guarantee mobile coverage

PRIVACY
No account, no advertising, no analytics. Your saved places and trips stay on your device.

Gentian is an independent product and is not affiliated with SBB, swisstopo, MeteoSwiss, SLF, Rega, Switzerland Tourism or any operator. Live information can be delayed, incomplete or wrong. Always check official sources and operator notices on the day, and make your own decisions in the mountains.

name: GLPalooza
description:
GLPalooza is a simple GLP-1 tracker for your everyday routine. Open the app to see when your next injection is due, log what you took, or check how your day is going.

Keep your injections organized
Log your medication, dose, date, and injection site. See your last injection and your next scheduled one at a glance. Turn on optional reminders for your injection schedule.

Track weight and blood glucose
Log readings manually or connect Apple Health to bring in the weight and blood glucose data you choose to share. Review your entries over time.

Log nutrition, hydration, and wellbeing
Track water, calories, protein, carbs, fat, and fiber. See how your daily totals compare with the goals you set, and use quick wellbeing check-ins to record how you feel.

See how logged doses may carry over
The Residual Medication chart uses your injection history and a simplified half-life model to illustrate how earlier doses may carry over. Follow your healthcare professional’s instructions for medication and dosing decisions.

Keep your records on your device
Review and edit past entries, and save a backup copy whenever you choose. GLPalooza stores your tracking data on your device. Pants Optional Studios does not collect it.

Free to download and use. No in-app purchases.

Made by Pants Optional Studios.  We ship our apps.  Never our pants!

name: GLUM – Espace membres
description:
GLUM est l'application officielle réservée aux membres de la Grande Loge Unie du Maroc.

Retrouvez toute la vie de votre Loge dans votre poche :

• Prochaine Tenue : date, heure et lieu, avec un compte à rebours.
• Présence en un geste : indiquez si vous serez présent ou excusé.
• Planning : toutes les Tenues à venir et passées, avec le suivi des présences.
• Ordre du jour : téléchargez-le directement depuis l'application.
• Annuaire : retrouvez les Frères de votre Loge et contactez-les.
• Documents : planches, 5 minutes de symbolisme et rituels, selon votre grade.
• Notifications : soyez prévenu des nouvelles convocations et des rappels.

Plusieurs Loges ? Passez de l'une à l'autre en un instant.

Accès réservé : les comptes sont créés par l'administration de votre Loge. Il n'y a pas d'inscription publique. Si vous êtes membre et n'avez pas encore vos identifiants, rapprochez-vous du secrétariat de votre Loge.

name: Golden Abyss: Dig Down
description:
Grab your pickaxe and dig down into the Golden Abyss.

Rudi the miner and his firefly Lumo go deeper with every run. The mine gets darker the lower you go, and only Lumo's light shows the way.

DIG, FIGHT, GROW
• Dig through 8 biomes and reach the Abyss at the bottom
• Collect ore, gems and rare treasures
• On every level-up pick 1 of 3 weapons or spells and combine them into evolutions
• Chain explosions, gas pockets and falling rocks
• Beat the bosses that guard each depth

BUILD YOUR BASE
• Sell your ore and upgrade the Forge, Workshop and more
• Craft gear, train pets and fill the Museum with finds
• Daily Mine: a new challenge every day

PLAY YOUR WAY
• One-thumb controls: joystick or tap, left-handed mode
• Auto-dig, large text, colour-blind mode, fewer flashes
• Works offline, progress in iCloud
• 24 Game Center achievements and leaderboards

COMPLETELY FREE
No ads, no in-app purchases, no energy, no timers. The whole game is open from the first minute.

Questions or ideas: vmyaros@gmail.com

name: HachiAlarm
description:
Arrivi sempre "solo cinque minuti" in ritardo? Ci pensa Hachi.

HachiAlarm è la sveglia per chi fa tardi. Non ti chiede a che ora vuoi svegliarti: ti chiede a che ora devi essere lì. Poi fa i conti all'indietro e ti dice quando suonare e quando uscire di casa.

IL PIANO ANTI-RITARDO
Dimmi l'ora dell'appuntamento, quanto dura il tragitto e quanto ti serve per prepararti. Hachi calcola la sveglia giusta e ti mostra la giornata passo per passo: sveglia, scarpe e chiavi, esci di casa, arrivo. Se i tempi non tornano, te lo dice prima che sia troppo tardi.

IL MARGINE DI HACHI
Qualche minuto di riserva per gli imprevisti: traffico, bus perso, parcheggio, chiavi da cercare. Non è tempo di tragitto né di preparazione. Se va tutto liscio, sono minuti in più per te.

UNA SVEGLIA VERA
Le sveglie di HachiAlarm sono sveglie di sistema: suonano anche con l'iPhone in silenzioso e sulla schermata bloccata, con l'abbaio di Hachi.

RINVII CON GIUDIZIO
Scegli quanti rinvii concederti. Hachi ti mostra quanto ritardo ti costa ognuno, e l'ultimo arriva senza il tasto "Rimanda". Dopo la sveglia ti ricorda quando è ora di uscire e ti chiede se sei uscito davvero.

GLI IMPEGNI, IN UNA FRASE
Scrivi "Dentista domani alle 9:30 @Via Roma p1" e Hachi capisce giorno, ora, luogo e priorità. Ogni impegno può avere la sua sveglia anti-ritardo, che suona solo quel giorno.
• Vista per giorno, settimana o mese
• Priorità da P1 a P4: per gli impegni più importanti Hachi aggiunge margine extra
• Note, luogo e tempi per ogni impegno
• Puoi vedere anche gli eventi del Calendario di iPhone

LO SGUARDO DI HACHI
Mentre scegli l'orario, Hachi sta al centro del quadrante e segue la lancetta con gli occhi. E se con quell'orario arriveresti in ritardo, si arrabbia.

SCEGLI IL TUO CANE
Hachi, Choco, Macchia o Notte: quattro bassotti e quattro stili, compreso un tema scuro per la sera.

PRIVACY
Nessun account, nessuna registrazione. Sveglie e impegni restano sul tuo iPhone.

Richiede iOS 26.1 o successivo.

name: Hana 4D
description: The Hana 4D Chairs mobile app delivers a revolutionary interface for wireless connection with your massage chair. You can adjust massage settings and play music via Bluetooth.

name: Hanbit: Learn Hangul & Korean
description:
Learn Hangul, the Korean alphabet, in a weekend. Then read real Korean: K-pop names, menus, street signs and drama lines. All 40 letters are free. No account, no ads, works offline. Pro is one payment, never a subscription.

Hanbit does what most alphabet apps stop short of. You learn the letters, build them into blocks, and keep going until you can actually read.

LEARN THE 40 LETTERS
- 19 consonants and 21 vowels in 11 short units, starting with four letters and your first blocks in under a minute
- Write each letter stroke by stroke with your finger or Apple Pencil. Stroke order and direction are checked
- Hear every letter, block and word. The voice is computer-made and checked against the reading
- Pairs that sound alike or look alike get extra practice: ㅏ and ㅓ, ㅗ and ㅜ, or ㄱ, ㅋ and ㄲ
- Already know some letters? Mark them and skip ahead

BUILD BLOCKS
- Hangul letters stack into syllable blocks. Drag the pieces into place and see 한 appear from ㅎ + ㅏ + ㄴ
- Learn the 7 final sounds (batchim) and double finals

SOUND RULES
- Why is 먹어 said like 머거? A short course explains the 7 rules that change how Korean is spoken: liaison, nasalization, tensification, ㅎ rules, palatalization, ㄹ rules and double finals
- Rule 1 (liaison) is free. Rules 2 to 7 are in Pro

READ REAL WORDS
- Free every day: 5 reading words made only of letters you already know
- Free: 20 K-pop and idol names to read the way fans write them
- Pro unlocks unlimited reading and all five packs: K-pop and idol names, Food and menu, Places and signs, K-drama lines, and Konglish (English words written in Hangul)
- Type what you read, or read aloud and reveal the answer. See which words you read easily

LISTEN AND TYPE
- Listening pairs train your ear on plain, aspirated and tense sounds (ㄱ, ㅋ, ㄲ), ㅐ and ㅔ, ㅗ and ㅓ, ㅜ and ㅡ
- Use the built-in Korean keyboard to answer, so typing comments and searching in Korean feels normal
- The typing trainer builds speed and accuracy with real words (Pro)

REVIEWS THAT STICK
- Spaced reviews bring each letter back just before you would forget it (FSRS)
- Two buttons: Again and Good. Time never counts against you
- Stats show accuracy per letter, your history and the reviews coming up (Pro)
- Days practiced never resets to zero, and streak freezes are automatic
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show what to review today

FREE, FAIR AND PRIVATE
- All 40 letters, block building, lessons, reviews, writing practice, the keyboard, widgets and Sound Rule 1 are free forever
- Pro is a one-time payment. No subscription, no trial that ends, never taken away. The price is shown in the app before you buy
- No account. No ads. No tracking. Works offline
- Export your progress to a file and import it on a new phone
- Light and dark mode. iPhone and iPad. Interface in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Japanese and Traditional Chinese

Hanbit is made by one independent developer. Questions or ideas: support@gethanbit.com

Audio: MeloTTS (MIT), computer-made voice.

name: Handsfree AI
description:
Handsfree AI는 폰을 노트북 AI의 무선 마이크로 만들어 줍니다.
Published by Seoul Factory · 서울에서 만든 앱이에요.

[폰에 말하면 노트북 AI에 바로 입력]
마이크 버튼을 누른 채 말하고 보내기를 누르면, 같은 Wi-Fi의 노트북에서 고른 AI의 입력창에 글이 들어가고 전송까지 됩니다. 키보드 앞에 앉지 않아도 AI에게 일을 시킬 수 있어요.
· Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, Copilot, DeepSeek, Slack 지원
· 노트북에 Mac 앱이 있으면 앱에, 없으면 브라우저의 사이트에 입력
· 한 번 연결한 노트북은 같은 Wi-Fi에서 자동으로 다시 연결
(무료 Mac 도우미 필요: steverse-code.github.io/handsfree_ai)

[Dot 버튼]
누르면 노트북 ChatGPT에서 미리 정해 둔 채팅이 열리고 입력창에 커서가 놓입니다. 자주 쓰는 대화로 바로 말을 보낼 수 있어요.

[편한 입력]
손 떼면 바로 보내기, 보내면 자동 전송(Enter), 전체 지우기와 백스페이스 버튼. 말하다 잠깐 멈췄다가 이어서 말해도 앞의 내용이 그대로 남아요.

[화면을 꺼도 계속되는 녹음]
회의·강의·인터뷰를 주머니 속에서 녹음하세요. 잠금화면과 다이내믹 아일랜드에서 녹음 시간 확인, 별표 하이라이트, 정지까지 할 수 있습니다.

[앱을 열지 않고 녹음 시작]
제어 센터, 잠금화면 버튼, 액션 버튼, Siri(“Handsfree AI 녹음”)로 바로 녹음을 시작하고 멈출 수 있습니다.

[AI 회의록]
회의·강의·인터뷰·통화·아이디어 템플릿으로 한 줄 요약, 결정 사항, 담당자별 액션 아이템을 정리합니다. 화자 구분, 번역, 노트에 질문하기, 모든 기록에서 찾기도 됩니다.

[개인정보]
녹음과 노트는 기기에만 저장됩니다. AI 기능을 처음 쓸 때 어떤 데이터가 어느 회사로 가는지 알려 드리고 동의를 받습니다. 언제든 동의를 철회하거나 모든 데이터를 삭제할 수 있습니다.

※ AI 회의록·요약 기능은 Anthropic(Claude) 또는 OpenAI API 키가 필요합니다.
※ 노트북으로 보내기는 Mac용 ‘Handsfree AI 도우미’가 필요합니다.
※ Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Meta AI, Grok, Perplexity, Copilot, DeepSeek, Slack은 각 회사의 상표이며 Handsfree AI는 이 회사들과 제휴하지 않은 독립 앱입니다.
※ 다른 사람의 말을 녹음할 때는 미리 동의를 받으세요.

Published by Seoul Factory

name: HexFoundry: Integer Tools
description:
Convert unsigned integers between binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal. Inspect and toggle bits, calculate AND, OR and XOR, shift values within a chosen width, and save readable results.

• Convert binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal integers.
• Inspect a width-padded binary representation.
• Toggle individual bits with explicit least-significant bit indices.
• Calculate AND, OR, XOR, bounded NOT and logical shifts.
• Save, rename, share and delete readable calculation summaries.

Unsigned integers only, at 8, 16 or 32 bits. Enter digits without prefixes, signs, fractions or internal whitespace. Out-of-range inputs are rejected. NOT is masked to the selected width. Left shifts discard high bits; right shifts fill with zeros. This app does not perform signed arithmetic or execute code.

No sign-in, advertising or analytics SDK is included. Records remain on this device. Copy and system sharing occur when you choose them.

name: HooLang: čti a uč se slovíčka
description:
Uč se cizí jazyk na textech, které tě opravdu zajímají. V HooLangu čteš články v angličtině, němčině nebo španělštině, a když narazíš na neznámé slovo, stačí na něj klepnout. Hned uvidíš český význam i výslovnost. Slovíčka, která si uložíš, pak procvičíš na kartičkách.

Čti, co tě baví
• Začít můžeš hned: v knihovně najdeš devět krátkých textů v angličtině, němčině a španělštině.
• Vlož vlastní text nebo odkaz na článek. HooLang z webové stránky vybere nadpis a odstavce a uloží je do knihovny.
• U každého textu se uloží místo, kde čteš, a příště pokračuješ přesně od něj.
• Velikost písma si upravíš podle sebe. Aplikace má světlý i tmavý vzhled.

Klepni na slovo
• Offline slovník ukáže český význam, další možné významy a výslovnost v zápisu IPA. U angličtiny je výslovnost americká.
• Slovo si poslechneš v normálním tempu i zpomaleně. Pomalé tempo si vybereš: 0,25×, 0,5× nebo 0,75×. Pokud chceš, zazní výslovnost hned po klepnutí.
• Když význam ze slovníku nesedí, vyber jiný nebo napiš vlastní překlad. Na kartičce se pak objeví ten tvůj.

Procvičuj slovíčka
• Kartičky v obou směrech: z cizího jazyka do češtiny i naopak.
• Klepnutím kartičku otočíš. Tahem doprava dáš Vím, doleva Nevím. Totéž zvládneš tlačítky.
• Výběr správného významu ze čtyř možností.
• Chytré opakování podle Leitnerova systému: slovíčka, která umíš, se vracejí s čím dál delším odstupem, a ta, která neumíš, zopakuješ ještě dnes.
• Po otočení kartičky může slovo rovnou zaznít.
• Přehled pokroku ukáže, kolik dní v řadě procvičuješ, kolik slovíček máš uložených a naučených a jaká je tvoje úspěšnost za posledních 7 dní.

Tři jazyky, české významy
Anglicko-český, německo-český a španělsko-český slovník jsou přímo v aplikaci. Celá aplikace je v češtině a významy slov jsou vždy české.

Telefon i tablet
Na iPadu a tabletu se rozložení přizpůsobí šířce: překlad se otevírá vedle textu a slovíčka mají seznam s detailem.

Funguje offline
Čtení, význam slov i procvičování fungují i bez připojení. Internet potřebuješ jen k načtení článku z odkazu.

Bez účtu a bez reklam
HooLang je zdarma, nemá reklamy ani předplatné a nevyžaduje registraci. Texty, slovíčka i výsledky procvičování zůstávají ve tvém zařízení. Zprávy o pádech můžeš v Nastavení vypnout. Statistiky používání jsou vypnuté, dokud je nezapneš, a nikdy neobsahují texty, slova ani odkazy.

Pro koho je HooLang
Pro studenty, samouky i ty, kdo si chtějí jazyk oprášit. A pro každého, koho učebnicová slovíčka nebaví a radši čte to, co ho zajímá.

Při prvním spuštění tě provede krátký průvodce. Kdykoli ho spustíš znovu v Nastavení.

Výslovnost přehrává hlas, který máš v telefonu. Pro němčinu a španělštinu může být potřeba hlas doinstalovat v nastavení systému.

Slovníková data: FreeDict (dicts.info, WikDict). Výslovnost: ipa-dict, CMU Pronouncing Dictionary. Licence a podpora: https://hoolang.app/support/

name: HushboltAI
description:
Private AI. No monthly fees.

Draft a difficult email, organize your notes, or ask a follow-up question. HushboltAI writes its answers on your device, even offline. The models are included: there’s no account to create and no model to choose. Search past conversations by a word you remember.

Each device gets 10 new replies from the included models per day. The allowance resets at local midnight. Cached replies and Apple’s on-device system model, when available, do not count. Buy HushboltAI Plus once for unlimited replies from the included models and Markdown export in this edition. There’s no renewal.

Your device writes the replies. Your messages never go to an AI server. Conversations sync to your private iCloud only if you turn that on.

name: IETA Workspace
description: IETA Workspace brings attendance, sales follow-ups and team conversations into one company workspace. Staff can clock in, take breaks, clock out and manage assigned leads. During an active shift, staff can choose to share their device location with authorized owners and managers. Sharing pauses during breaks and ends at clock-out. Owners can invite staff and review attendance, company plans and invoices.

name: IFuture App
description:
IFuture is your organization's own app, for the people who work there and the customers who find you.

Talk in channels and forums, in direct and group conversations, with replies, reactions, polls, files and voice messages. Meet by voice and video, share your screen, record meetings and keep their minutes. Keep files in Drive, write and draw in Notes, and plan with Calendar, all in one place.

Your organization runs it on its own server and decides who joins.

name: Imalá CRM
description:
Imalá CRM es el sistema de gestión para agentes y equipos inmobiliarios. Te dice qué hacer ahora, a quién escribirle y cómo vas, y te deja anotar todo en segundos desde el iPhone o el iPad.

Esta app es para quienes ya tienen cuenta en Imalá CRM: entrás con tu correo y tu contraseña, o con Google o Apple.

TU DÍA, UNA COSA A LA VEZ
• Hoy: lo que te toca ahora, tus tareas, tus citas y tus seguimientos, en una sola pantalla.
• Semana: tu semana ideal y lo que ya hiciste.
• Avisos para que no se te pase nadie.

CONTALE A IMALÁ
• Escribí o decí lo que pasó ("la llamo el jueves", "mañana a las 9 reunión") y queda como tarea o nota en la persona.
• Usa inteligencia artificial solo si vos lo permitís, y lo podés retirar cuando quieras.

TUS PERSONAS
• Contactos, compradores y vendedores con su historial, notas y seguimiento.
• Importá tus contactos desde un archivo.
• Búsquedas de compradores con propuestas y paso a paso.

TUS PROPIEDADES Y CAPTACIONES
• Cargá tus propiedades y subí el archivo con tu cartera.
• Captaciones con su plan de comercialización, prelisting y tasación.
• Tasaciones con comparables y un informe hoja por hoja para tu cliente.

TUS NÚMEROS
• Mis números: cómo vas en captaciones, reuniones, operaciones y comisiones.
• Equipo: si dirigís un equipo, ves cómo viene cada agente.

Hecho en Argentina por Imalá.

name: IPI São Manuel
description: Conheça o App da Igreja Presbiteriana Independente de São Manuel. Saiba os horários dos cultos, leia notícias, bíblia, inscreva-se em eventos, participe de grupos e muito mais.

name: Koli Karibu
description:
Koli Karibu met en relation les personnes qui envoient un colis et les voyageurs (GP) qui ont des kilos libres dans leurs valises.

Trajets : France, Comores, Mayotte, La Réunion, Madagascar et Sénégal, dans les deux sens.

J'ENVOIE UN COLIS • Je vois les prochains départs, triés par date ou par prix. • Le prix s'affiche en euros, en FCFA ou en KMF. • Je vois les colis déjà livrés par le voyageur et le badge « Vérifié par Koli ». • « Combien ça coûte ? » : Koli m'indique le prix habituel sur mon trajet. • Je choisis le destinataire dans mes contacts. • Je suis mon colis étape par étape, jusqu'à la remise avec un code secret.

JE VOYAGE (GP) • Je publie mes kilos libres en une minute. • Je vois les colis qui attendent un voyageur sur mon trajet. • Koli me prévient quand un colis m'attend. • Koli fabrique mon affiche pour le statut WhatsApp : 4 modèles au choix, à partager ou à enregistrer dans Photos. • Pour mon prochain voyage, je republie mon trajet en un geste.

PENSÉE POUR L'IPHONE • Elle s'ouvre même sans internet. • Notifications : nouvelles de mes colis, nouveaux départs vers mes pays. • Widget « Prochains départs » sur l'écran d'accueil et l'écran verrouillé. • Raccourcis : appui long sur l'icône. • Mode clair ou sombre.

CONFIANCE • « Signaler » et « Bloquer » sous chaque annonce. • Chaque colis se montre ouvert avant d'être fermé. • Koli ne transporte rien et ne touche jamais ton argent : tout se règle directement avec le voyageur.

Gratuit, sans publicité. 
Conçu par MMBT · 
contact@mmbt.fr

name: Kor30
description:
Kor30 is the community app for Persian-speaking residents, students and expats in Japan.

• Community feed — ask questions, share tips, post news in Persian, English or Japanese, with built-in translation.
• Events — find and join meetups across Japan, comment and reply.
• Chat — private messages and group rooms with reactions, replies, photos and video.
• Emergency help — SOS requests, volunteers and trusted emergency cards.
• Deals and jobs — local offers and listings from the community.
• Safe by design — report content, block people, delete your account any time.

name: Kyb: Mechanical Keyboard
description:
Turn your iPhone keyboard into a mechanical one.

Kyb gives every key a real switch sound, a real feel and a real keycap. Pick a switch, pick a set, and every message you type clicks, thocks or clacks like a keyboard on your desk.

SWITCHES YOU CAN HEAR
13 switches recorded from real keyboards: linear, tactile and clicky, from a soft creamy thock to a buckling spring. Tune the volume and the haptics until it feels right.

KEYCAPS THAT LOOK REAL
Image keycap sets made to be touched: Butter Cookie, Blueberry Cheesecake, Pistachio, Pearl and Onyx, Frosted Ice, Peach Jelly, Caramel Latte, River Pebble, Lemon Sorbet, Daydream Cloud, Sea Glass, Strawberry Milk, Walnut and Golden Mooncake. Or build your own from keycap profiles and finishes: SA, DSA, XDA, OEM, Cherry and low profile, in PBT, ABS, jelly, glaze, pudding, metal, wood, knit and fleece.

ARTISAN KEYCAPS
Put a sleepy cat on your space bar or a frog on shift. Or make an artisan from your own photo.

EVERY LANGUAGE
Kyb types in your layout: QWERTY, AZERTY, QWERTZ, Spanish, Nordic, Turkish, Russian, Ukrainian, Greek, Hebrew and Arabic, plus Colemak and Dvorak. It picks the one that matches your iPhone language, and you can change it in Settings. Hold a letter for its accents: é, ü, ñ, ø and more.

THEME WORKSHOP
Change every colour, the legend font, the case and the backlight, then save your own themes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Kyb never sees what you type. The keyboard has no network code and sends nothing anywhere. Full Access is only used to play sounds and read the theme you picked in the app.

KYB PRO
Kyb is free to download and set up, and the Kyb keyboard types for free in a plain look. Kyb Pro puts everything you set up on the keyboard: every switch sound, haptics, theme, keycap set and artisan keycap, plus everything added later. name: LeadGap
description:
Compare two screw threads, see how small lead differences accumulate, and keep the inputs behind each result.

LeadGap is a local workbench for restoration, model making and mechanical teaching. Compare ideal axial displacement at the same revolution count, explore measurement limits, and check target differences against available travel.

A complete workflow
1. Enter threads A and B
Use pitch, threads per inch, a length measured across pitch intervals, or displacement over known revolutions. Add the number of starts, names and source notes. See pitch and lead separately. Each input method keeps its own draft without reinterpreting numbers when you switch methods.
2. Set revolutions and watch the difference
Use the slider, step buttons or numeric input, including fractional turns. The two rulers share a zero and scale. Difference always means B minus A, and swapping the threads reverses its sign. Switch between millimetres and inches, explore the difference curve, or magnify a small gap without changing the calculation.
3. Add measurement evidence
Enter lower and upper limits, or record several revolution counts and position readings in a measurement notebook. Retain a common zero, enter a justified reading bound, and inspect the fitted offset, lead estimate and admissible interval. Choosing the interval midpoint as a reference is explicit.
4. Work back from a target
Enter a difference magnitude to reach or exceed. View continuous revolutions, the first whole turn, the calculated signed difference and overshoot. With parameter ranges, compare the earliest possible count with the count that guarantees the target within those ranges. Zero-containing ranges can show that no finite count is guaranteed.
5. Check travel before turning
Enter a bound on each measured displacement and the available travel. Find whole-turn counts that could or would separate the difference from zero, check whether target counts fit, and apply feasible counts to the workbench.
6. Compare and preserve versions
Save a scheme, duplicate it and change a parameter. Compare candidates using common revolutions and the same difference direction. Inspect interval bars, changes from the current reference, target coverage and sources. Earlier versions retain their original inputs and observations.
7. Export and return later
Preview and share a PDF report or export CSV details. Include original values, conversions, displacements, ranges, target results, assumptions, versions and notes. Recover drafts, search or archive projects, and create or restore a complete local backup.

A simple comparison

Single-start pitches of 1.25 mm and 1.27 mm produce ideal travel of 12.50 mm and 12.70 mm after 10 revolutions: a B-minus-A difference of +0.20 mm.

Editable worked studies explore near-equal leads, multiple starts and overlapping measurement ranges while keeping your personal draft separate.

Calculations, drafts, versions and exports are created locally. No account is required. Choose where to save or send files through the system share sheet.

Results model ideal geometry. Ranges propagate from the entered limits under an independent-variation assumption; they do not certify assembly accuracy or include backlash, elastic deformation or wear.
