name: MoovExpress
description:
MoovExpress è il gestionale delle spedizioni per aziende, negozi online e rivenditori. Con l'app hai il tuo account MoovExpress sempre in tasca.

• Crea spedizioni e confronta le tariffe dei corrieri
• Scarica, condividi e stampa le lettere di vettura
• Segui tracking, giacenze e contrassegni
• Gestisci clienti, ritiri e distinte
• Per gli autisti: le consegne del giorno, la lettura del codice a barre e l'esito in un tocco

L'app è riservata a chi ha già un account MoovExpress, attivato dalla propria azienda o dal proprio rivenditore.

name: Movie Night Shuffle
description:
Movie Night Shuffle ends the endless scrolling. Tell it which streaming services you have, and it deals you films and series you can actually watch tonight.

SWIPE THROUGH A SHUFFLED DECK
• Want it, seen it or pass — one gesture per title
• Filters for genre, year, runtime, rating, language and country of origin
• Ratings from IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic and Letterboxd at a glance
• Trailers, cast and similar titles in one tap

PICK TOGETHER
• Open a room, share the code or QR, and everyone swipes the same deck
• When you agree, you get a match — no more "I don't mind, you choose"
• Schedule a room for later and let friends vote when they have time

FRIENDS AND LISTS
• Add friends with a code, link or e-mail
• Send a title to a friend with a short note
• Your watchlist and seen list stay in sync across devices

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Start without an account; sign in with e-mail when you want to sync
• No ads of our own, no tracking
• Delete your data or your account any time from Settings

Available in English, Romanian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Russian and Ukrainian.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

name: Mukkio
description:
Lift with a gorilla in your corner.
Mukkio is a workout log made for the gym floor: quick to open, quick to fill in.

Log between sets
- Enter weight and reps; copy the last set in one tap
- Log warm-up sets too; they stay out of your totals and 1RM
- Bodyweight exercises take one button

See your progress
- Estimated 1RM and max weight on a chart for every exercise
- Every training day on a calendar

Share and back up
- Turn a session or a whole month into an image
- Export and import all your records as a file

Nothing extra
No ads, no account, no network. Your log lives only on your iPhone.

name: Nibscale
description: Nibscale हे तुमच्या iPhone वर थेट चालणारे स्थानिक संख्या रूपांतरण साधन आहे. द्वि, अष्ट, दश, षोडश व २–३६ या कोणत्याही पायाचे रूपांतर, बिट क्रिया, गटबद्ध प्रदर्शन, रोमन अंक, चीनी मोठी लिपी आणि रूपांतरण इतिहास — सर्व माहिती फक्त तुमच्या डिव्हाइसवर राहते. इंटरनेट नाही, डेटा अपलोड नाही.

name: Oak Remote: TV Remote for Roku
description:
Oak Remote turns your iPhone or iPad into a remote for your Roku TV or Roku streaming player. It works over your own Wi-Fi, finds your TV automatically and needs no account.

FREE, FOR ONE TV
• The full remote: D-pad, OK, Back, Home, Options, instant replay, rewind, play/pause and fast-forward. Hold to repeat.
• Swipe touchpad: swipe to move, tap for OK, without looking down
• Volume, mute and power, plus input switching on TVs with HDMI and antenna inputs
• Phone keyboard: type searches and passwords on the TV instead of hunting on the on-screen grid
• Channel launcher: open any channel installed on your TV with one tap, and see what's on now
• Finds your TV on Wi-Fi and reconnects if its address changes
• No ads, no account and no time limit

OAK REMOTE PRO: PAY ONCE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
• Every TV in the house: save the living room, bedroom and more, and switch with one tap
• Voice search: speech is turned into text on your device and sent only to your TV
• Favorites row for the channels you open most
• Interactive Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Control Center controls for power, play/pause and mute (iOS 18 or later)
• Siri and Shortcuts, including the Action button

Oak Remote Pro is a single $4.99 purchase (US price), not a subscription. Family Sharing is supported, and Restore Purchase brings it back on a new device.

GETTING CONNECTED
Put your iPhone or iPad on the same Wi-Fi as your TV, open Oak Remote and allow the Local Network prompt. If buttons say "blocked", on the TV go to Settings > System > Advanced system settings > Control by mobile apps and set Network access to Permissive. Turning the TV on from the app needs Fast TV start turned on in the TV's power settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Oak Remote talks only to your TV over your local network. Nothing is sent to us.

Oak Remote is an independent app made by Oakline Media. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Roku, Inc. Roku is a trademark of Roku, Inc.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://oaklinemediaapps.com/oak-remote-privacy.html

name: OhCanada – Citizenship Test
description:
OhCanada helps you prepare for the Canadian citizenship test using 400 questions based solely on the official "Discover Canada" study guide — no trivia, no questions the guide doesn't cover.

The real test is in English or French. OhCanada's questions and interface are available in English, Ukrainian, French, Spanish, Punjabi and Simplified Chinese, so you can learn in the language that helps you understand the material best.

How it works:
• One simple Learn button: answer as many questions as you like, stop whenever you like, and continue later from where you left off.
• A question counts as learned after two correct answers in a row — mistakes bring it back until it sticks.
• A knowledge map shows your progress chapter by chapter, so you can see your weak topics at a glance.
• After you learn the full question bank, the mock test unlocks — a fresh random set of 20 questions every time, 45 minutes, pass mark 15/20, just like the real IRCC test.

Everything works offline. No account, no ads, no analytics — your progress stays only on your device.

OhCanada is an unofficial study aid and is not affiliated with IRCC or the Government of Canada. The source of truth is always the official "Discover Canada" guide.

name: One Follower
description:
You have a gallery full of your own life, and you spend your evenings watching everyone else's.

One Follower turns your camera roll into a full-screen feed. Swipe up, and there is your dog as a puppy. Swipe again: a beach from six years ago. Then a video you forgot you took. Same thumb, same swipe, your own life.

- An endless feed of your photos and videos, mixed and paced to keep moving
- "On this day": what you were doing one, three, eight years ago today
- Tap the day button to see everything else from that day
- Double tap to keep what you love
- Write a private note on any memory; it becomes its caption
- Share to a messaging app, or through your phone's own share sheet
- Hide what you would rather not see, or delete what you no longer want
- An optional daily reminder that tells you when today has memories

Private by design:
- No account and no sign-up
- No uploads: your photos and videos are shown straight from your gallery
- No tracking and no analytics
- Your loves and notes are saved on your phone, not on a server

One Follower notices what you love, linger on, skip and write about, and uses that to choose what comes next. That happens on your phone, not on a server.

name: OrbitLoop Chat
description:
OrbitLoop Chat requires an active OrbitLoop subscription. Sign in with your OrbitLoop account to use the app.

OrbitLoop Chat brings your OrbitLoop workspace's conversations to iPhone and iPad.

- Every conversation you can open in OrbitLoop: direct messages, groups, team and client channels, and task, project and client discussions.
- Threads, replies, reactions, formatting, file and photo sharing, and search.
- Voice and video calls from any conversation, with screen sharing, front or back camera, and speaker or earpiece. A call keeps going with the screen locked.
- Notifications with quick Reply, unread counts and an app-icon badge.
- iPad: split view with a details inspector.

OrbitLoop Chat requires an OrbitLoop account. Sign in with the account your team uses on orbitloop.com.

name: OthmiraPazuki
description: Switchboard calculator: load, fault current, protection, enclosure sizes and costs.

name: Ozires
description:
Keep an eye on your business wherever you are. Ozires brings your sales, ad campaigns, and live traffic together on your phone.

Build a dashboard around the metrics you use every day. Choose a reporting period, follow revenue and ad spend, and hide amounts when you share your screen.

Explore ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, and ads. Choose the columns that matter, compare results, and manage campaigns with the permissions granted to your account.

Open a sale to see its payment details and tracking information. Follow visitors in Live to see where your traffic is coming from.

Sign in with your Ozires account. Available data and actions depend on your organization's integrations and your access permissions.

name: ÖZÜ İHA
description:
ÖZÜ İHA, Özyeğin Üniversitesi İnsansız Hava Araçları Kulübü üyelerinin projeleri, görevleri ve toplantıları tek yerden takip etmesini sağlar.

• Projelere, sorumlulara ve görevlerin teslim tarihlerine ulaş.
• Toplantıları, yoklamaları ve kulüp duyurularını takip et.
• Sana atanan eğitimleri ve paylaşılan kaynakları görüntüle.
• Yetkine göre satın alma taleplerini, envanteri ve sponsorluk kayıtlarını yönet.

Kulüp yöneticin tarafından oluşturulan üyelik hesabıyla giriş yap.

name: PawPrint: Cat Mood Receipts
description:
PawPrint is a tiny mood receipt printer run by cats. Pick today's inner weather, tick a few little moments, and your cat clerk prints a cute receipt stamped with a red paw.

MOOD RECEIPT PRINTER
• 16 everyday moments in categories like Work Survival, Cozy Joys, Mood Detox and Late Snacks
• 5 inner weathers, 6 paper rolls and 6 stamps
• Add one line about your day and save it as a shareable card
• A different guest drops by each day with a small request that pays fish coins

MAKE-CHANGE CHALLENGE
Be the cashier cat! A customer pays, and you hand back the exact change with the fewest coins.
• 5 chapters, 100 levels, 5 customers per level
• Starts with 1, 5 and 10 coins, then adds 50 and 100 coins, discounts, a coin box that runs low, and customers who add extra coins
• Every round has a definite best answer; count carefully for 3 stars

YOUR SHOP AND CAT CLERKS
• Spend fish coins on decorations and level up your little shop
• 8 cat clerks, each with their own personality and lines; give treats to raise their bond and unlock cat diaries

RECEIPT ARCHIVE
• Every receipt you print is kept on your phone to look back on
• Optional daily reminder (local notification)

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Free: the receipt printer, levels 1–20, 2 cat clerks, 2 paper rolls and 8 decorations.
The Full Version is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks levels 21–100, all 8 cat clerks (bond Lv.10 and full diaries), all 6 paper rolls, all 16 decorations, custom stamp text, and pays out the fish coins saved in your piggy bank. Use Restore Purchases in the app on a new device.

PRIVACY
No account needed. No personal data is collected; your records stay on your device, and it works offline.

Mood receipts are for fun and reflection, not medical or financial advice.
Support: lunagamesitw@gmail.com

name: PDF Convertor Pro
description:
Need to convert or edit a file on your phone? PDF Convertor Pro puts everything in one simple app.

CONVERT
• PDF to Word (DOCX)
• PDF to Images
• PDF to ZIP
• Word to PDF (DOC, DOCX)
• Image to PDF
• GIF to PNG
• JPG to PNG

PDF TOOLS
• Merge multiple PDFs into one
• Split a PDF into separate files
• Rotate pages
• Delete unwanted pages
• Extract selected pages
• Add a watermark
• Add page numbers

SIMPLE AND FAST
• Clean, easy interface with quick access to your most-used tools
• Search tools instantly
• My Files: find, share, star and delete your converted files
• No account or sign-up required

Perfect for students, professionals and anyone who works with documents on the go.

name: PENTAFOTO
description:
La realtà. Da un'altra prospettiva.

PENTAFOTO è un'esperienza visiva interattiva che unisce fotografia, cinema, riprese aeree e nuove forme di espressione creativa.

Un viaggio attraverso immagini e storie, dove ogni progetto racconta un modo diverso di osservare il mondo.

ESPLORA CON IL SONAR

Un'interfaccia interattiva per scoprire sette universi creativi: fotografia, video, Cinematic FPV, droni, backstage, progetti con intelligenza artificiale e time lapse.

FOTOGRAFIA DA VIVERE

Entra in una galleria fotografica immersiva, scopri i dettagli delle immagini ed esplora una selezione di lavori fotografici.

PRE/POST — PRIMA E DOPO

Scopri come una fotografia può trasformarsi attraverso la post-produzione. Trascina il cursore e osserva il passaggio dallo scatto originale all'immagine finale.

FOV — IL TUO SCATTO, IL MIO FILTRO

Scatta una fotografia o importala dalla tua libreria. Applica il filtro fotografico d'autore PENTAFOTO, regola l'intensità, confronta originale e risultato e salva la tua interpretazione.

IL CINEMA SEMPRE CON TE

Esplora produzioni video, riprese aeree e sperimentazioni visive. Riproduci i filmati all'interno dell'app e continua la navigazione grazie al mini-player flottante.

DIETRO LE IMMAGINI

Scopri il percorso, la visione e il lavoro di Dario Marzi, fotografo, filmmaker e pilota drone.

PENTAFOTO non è soltanto un insieme di immagini. È un invito a guardare ciò che ci circonda con occhi diversi.

name: Petite Voix - Affirmations
description:
Tu regardes ton téléphone des dizaines de fois par jour. Petite Voix en profite pour te glisser les bons mots.

Tu choisis tes thèmes, tu choisis le ton, et une phrase s'affiche sur ton écran verrouillé. Rien à ouvrir, rien à retenir.

CE QUE FAIT PETITE VOIX
• Une phrase sur ton écran verrouillé et sur ton écran d'accueil, grâce au widget
• Des phrases écrites en français, pas traduites
• Deux tons au choix : tout en douceur, ou franc et direct
• Des phrases accordées au féminin, au masculin ou sans genre
• Des notifications dans la journée, à ton rythme
• Tes phrases favorites, et la phrase que tu écris toi-même
• Partage une phrase en image, en un geste
• Ta série de jours, pour garder le rythme

HUIT THÈMES
Confiance en soi, amour-propre, calme, discipline, après une rupture, manifestation, élan, gratitude.

SANS COMPTE
Pas d'email, pas de mot de passe. Tes réponses et tes favoris restent sur ton téléphone.

PETITE VOIX COMPLÈTE
La version gratuite donne accès au thème Confiance en soi, avec une phrase par jour sur ton écran.
L'abonnement ouvre tous les thèmes et tous les fonds. Tu choisis la phrase qui reste sur ton écran, ou le rythme auquel elles changent, jusqu'à une par heure. Tes phrases favorites passent en premier, et tu peux ne recevoir qu'elles en notification.

Abonnement annuel avec 7 jours d'essai, ou abonnement mensuel. Le paiement est débité sur ton compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat, ou à la fin de l'essai. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf si tu l'arrêtes au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Tu le gères et tu l'arrêtes dans les réglages de ton compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://pytmind.com/petitevoix/confidentialite/

name: PhotoSynth: Picture Synth
description:
What does a sunset sound like? Your dog? Your coffee?

PhotoSynth turns any photo into music. Snap something, and a play-header sweeps across the image, turning what it sees into a melody, with chords and bass underneath, all in a key and tempo the photo picks for itself. Every photo sounds different, because the photo builds the synth too: its colours, light and texture shape the wavetable, the tone and the space.

It's a happy accident machine. Wonder what something sounds like, take the picture, find out.

A REAL SYNTH, NOT AI
• Wavetable synth built from your photo, from warm and mellow to big and anthemic
• Separate LEAD, CHORDS and BASS, each with its own oscillator, filter and envelope
• Polyphony, mono and legato, glide, unison, shared chorus, delay and reverb
• Save your favourite sounds as patches and put them on any photo

MAKE IT YOURS
• Change the key, scale, tempo and length, or let the photo decide
• Roll the die for a new take on the same photo
• Edit every note in the MIDI map: add, move, stretch, change velocity, pinch to zoom
• Watch the dots and lines draw the melody right on your photo

TAKE IT ANYWHERE
• Export WAV, AIFF or FLAC, up to 96 kHz, as a full mix or separate stems
• Export MIDI to keep writing in your DAW
• Share .photosynth project files

MADE THE GHOSTKICK WAY
• Portrait and landscape, light and dark mode
• Every project saved automatically
• One price. No subscription, no ads, no accounts, no data collected.

From GhostKick Audio, the makers of GLIMR and TINKR.

name: Piano: Screen, Table & Air
description:
No companion Phone needed. Play familiar melodies right on your watch.
Three ways to play: tap the screen, tap a tabletop, or tap in the air.

THREE WAYS TO ENJOY PLAYING
Tap the screen, gently tap a tabletop with the fingertips of the hand wearing your watch, or make light downward tapping motions in the air. Each tap or detected movement plays the next note. You control the timing, without needing to read sheet music.

FAMILIAR MELODIES, YOUR OWN RHYTHM
Explore 20 short, simplified arrangements of classic themes. Start with “Two Tigers,” or choose themes from “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star,” “Ode to Joy,” “Für Elise” and more. Play a little faster or slower and hear familiar melodies take on your rhythm.

LISTEN BACK AND KEEP YOUR FAVORITES
After completing a performance, listen back and choose whether to save or discard it. Reopen saved performances, adjust the gaps between notes and compare your timing with the original rhythm.

Want to make a melody of your own? Fill eight slots with notes, then play, edit and save your short tune.
The app works independently on your watch, with no companion Phone required. Core features work offline.

Motion play detects wrist movement, not individual fingers. If you pause for more than 8 seconds during a classic theme, a complete rhythm record cannot be saved for that round. Theme sources and licenses are available in the app’s settings.

name: Postpolish
description:
Get your photos and videos ready to post, at the best quality the platform allows.

Social apps squeeze every upload. Postpolish prepares your photo or video first: the right shape and size, sharp edges, rich color and clean encoding, so there is as much picture as possible left after the app compresses it. Pick a photo or video, and it is prepared right away. Then change anything you like.

SEE THE DIFFERENCE Slide between before and after, and zoom in with a loupe to check the detail.

PHOTOS

Feed shapes: 4:5, 3:4, square and landscape, plus Story and Reel cover sizes
Smart framing: crops around the main subject, or fits the whole picture with a blurred fill
Sharpening and Color pop: Auto, Custom with a slider, or Off
Noise reduction, RAW and HEIC support, large photos handled with care
VIDEO

Keeps your iPhone HDR video as HDR (10-bit HLG), or converts it to standard range
Reels up to 2K, Stories, and a Reel cover picker
Landscape clips stay whole: fit with a blurred fill, or keep the original shape
Correct orientation for every way a phone can record, including rotated and mirrored clips
Keeps your frame rate, up to 60 fps, and tidy, high-bitrate encoding
Keeps working when you leave the app, and picks up where it stopped
SAVE AND SHARE

Saves to Photos in a Postpolish album, so you can always find what you made
Share, save to Files, or open it straight in your favorite app
Posting tips: a short checklist for the best result
PRIVATE BY DESIGN Everything happens on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking, and nothing is uploaded.

GOOD TO KNOW Postpolish cannot stop a social app from compressing your upload. It gives that app a better picture to start from. Postpolish is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta Platforms or Instagram.

name: Posy Garden: Flower Puzzle
description:
Sort the flowers, tie the bouquets, and bring Grandma's botanical garden back to life!

Tap a bunch to lift the flowers on top, then tap another bunch to move them. Gather four of the same flower in one paper-wrapped bunch to tie it into a bouquet. Every level you clear earns a star — spend your stars to restore the abandoned garden, one bench, fountain and rose bed at a time.

• Hundreds of relaxing sort puzzles, from gentle warm-ups to tricky hard levels
• Every flower has its own shape, not just its own color — easy on the eyes
• New twists as you go: closed buds, vines, frost, locks, order cards and limited-move levels
• 50 kinds of flowers to discover and collect in your Flower Book
• A Weekend Flower Fair every Saturday and Sunday
• Restore the Entrance Plaza, the Rose Garden and the Greenhouse and watch them bloom again step by step
• A new Daily Flower every day — the same board for everyone, with stars for fewer moves
• Seasonal events every month with exclusive garden decorations
• Grow flowers in pots, finish your starter missions, and fill the Flower Jar
• Meet Hana, Old Moss and Lily as the garden blooms again
• Undo, Add Bunch and Shuffle boosters when you're stuck
• Play offline, any time

name: PremiFoot Management
description:
O PremiFoot Management é a plataforma interna da PremiFoot Players Agency. O acesso é exclusivo para membros autorizados da agência e dos seus parceiros.

• Atletas: ficha completa, documentos, fotografia e histórico de clubes.
• Clubes: dirigentes, contactos, necessidades por posição e sugestão automática de atletas compatíveis.
• Mandatos e contratos: validade, comissões, aditivos e alertas de vencimento a 180, 90, 60 e 30 dias.
• Negociações: pipeline por etapas, linha do tempo e receita prevista.
• Finanças: receitas, despesas, parcelas, várias moedas e fluxo de caixa.
• Agenda: compromissos e prazos automáticos de contratos, mandatos, finanças e negociações.
• Mercado e Scout: oportunidades, matching de perfis e PremiFoot Scout Rating.
• Segurança: perfis de acesso por função, registo de alterações e entrada com Face ID.

As contas são criadas pela administração da agência; não há registo aberto ao público.

name: PSD Viewer - thefrog
description:
No ads · No subscription · Plus is a one-time purchase · Files stay on your device

thefrog PSD Viewer opens PSD and PSB files on iPhone and iPad, no Photoshop needed. See the layer list with its groups, zoom into the full merged image and check document info. Large PSB files are supported too.

■ Key features
• Layer list — groups, hidden layers, opacity and layer types (text, smart object, adjustment). Long-press text on the document or a text layer to view and copy its wording, fonts, sizes and colors (3 free tries, then Plus)
• Search layer names; ⋮ → "Text & fonts" lists text layers and fonts (full text: free trial, then Plus)
• Full image view — pinch to zoom, pinch down to 50% of fit to see the whole picture, double-tap to switch between zoom and fit; when you stop, the visible part is re-read for sharpness
• Panels stay on screen — zoom the image with the layer panel open; half or full height; side panel on wide screens such as iPad
• Document info — size (px), DPI, print size, color mode (RGB, CMYK, Grayscale), bit depth, color profile, layer count and file size
• CMYK color — matched using the embedded color profile; files without one use a regional standard print profile
• "Folder" tab — opens the system file picker to find a file
• Open from the Files app or Photos with "Open in" or "Share" — these files also appear in the "Received" tab
• "Recent" tab — recent files; select several to delete (undo)
• Swipe left or right in "Recent" or "Received" to move between files
• 13 app languages, including Thai and Bengali

■ If the image is blank (Maximize Compatibility)
Photoshop stores the merged image only when "Maximize Compatibility" is on. When it is off, a notice appears instead; the layer list and document info remain available. Re-save the file with the setting on to view the image. Multichannel, Duotone, or certain formats may not show the merged image.

■ Free and Plus
You can view up to 5 different PSD/PSB files for free (opening the same file again doesn't count). "Plus" (a one-time purchase, not a subscription) adds:
• Turn layers on and off (RGB and Grayscale, 8/16-bit) and save a single layer as a full-resolution PNG
• Try new layer colors — tap the image to pick a layer, change it with a solid color or hue shift, then save or share as PNG (the original file is never changed)
• Replace same color — tap a color to change every matching area at once (adjustable tolerance, keep shading), then save or share as PNG
• Markup eyedropper — pick a color from the image for pen, text or shapes
• Unlimited PSD and PSB viewing
• Save the merged image up to full resolution: PNG goes to your photo library, PDF (one page at print size) to a location you choose
• Content previews while swiping between files
• Unlimited markup — draw on the image with pen, shapes and text, then save or share as PNG
Markup is free 3 times without purchase (each markup session counts once, when you first draw).
Layer effects and adjustment layers are not applied when toggling layers, so results may differ from Photoshop (unsupported count shown).
Purchases are handled by the App Store. Use "Restore purchase" after reinstalling.

■ Also views images
JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, HEIC and HEIF images can also be viewed and zoomed (animated GIF/WebP show the first frame only). The layer list and PNG/PDF saving are for PSD and PSB files only.

■ Privacy
Your files are processed on your device and are not sent anywhere unless you choose Share. No ads and no analytics SDKs. No account or sign-in. Purchases are processed by Apple through the App Store, and the app sends no purchase information to us. Viewing works without an internet connection.

thefrog PSD Viewer is an independent viewer for the PSD and PSB file formats. It is not an Adobe app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Adobe. Adobe and Photoshop are trademarks of Adobe Inc.

name: Qubesnap: 2 Games in 1
description:
TWO GAMES IN ONE, FOR ONE PRICE. OPTIMIZED FOR iPHONE DUO. NO INTERNET NEEDED.
Qubesnap packs two complete block-puzzle games into a single app: Stick, played in 3D, and Flick, played in 2D. Buy once and play both, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

OPTIMIZED FOR iPHONE DUO
Unfold your iPhone Duo and Qubesnap fills the whole inner display, edge to edge, for a bigger 3D shape and a roomier board. Fold it and the game carries on on the outer screen. It also plays great in landscape on every other iPhone and iPad.

NO INTERNET? NO PROBLEM. MADE FOR TRAVEL
Everything is inside the app: no Wi-Fi, no cellular data, no account and no downloads after install. Play in airplane mode on a flight, on a road trip, on the train or anywhere without a signal.

STICK (3D)
A shape turns in the middle of the screen with gaps to fill. Pieces are fed in from both sides: tap one to fire it into its glowing slot, or drag it exactly where you want. Tilt your phone or drag to turn the shape. Fill the outline before time runs out. Every block buys you time and every whole piece buys more. Complete the shape and a new one rolls in for the next level.

FLICK (2D)
Slide every block off the board through a door of its own colour. Blocks glide around corners but can't pass through each other, and a door has to be at least as wide as the block. Beat the clock for more stars, with a free smash and a free freeze on every level.

ONE STORE FOR BOTH
Points you earn in either game go into one wallet. Spend them on animated themes (Ocean, Sunset, Forest, Neon Night, Galaxy and more), seasonal looks, block styles and effects.

• 2 full games for one price
• Optimized for iPhone Duo: full screen when unfolded
• Plays 100% offline: perfect for flights and travel
• Pay once: no ads, no in-app purchases, no lives, no waiting
• No account, no tracking, no data collected
• Spoken how-to-play and optional voice hints

name: Rechen-Detektiv
description:
Mit dem Rechen-Detektiv lernen Kinder in der Grundschule das schriftliche Rechnen: Plus, Minus, Mal und Geteilt. Das Monster Bommel führt Schritt für Schritt durch jede Aufgabe, erklärt, was zu tun ist, und hilft, wenn etwas schiefgeht.

So funktioniert es
• Geführt: Bommel nennt jeden Schritt. Das Kind schreibt die Ziffern in ein Rechengitter wie im Heft.
• Selbst rechnen: Das Kind rechnet allein und drückt auf „Prüfen“. Bommel sucht dann nach Fehlerspuren und zeigt die Stelle.
• Fehler-Detektiv: Fehler sind keine Mängel, sondern Spuren. Die App erklärt, wie ein Fehler entstanden sein kann und wie man ihn findet.
• Übertrag verstehen: Bei jedem Übertrag gibt Bommel einen klaren Auftrag, auf Wunsch mit Sprachausgabe. Beim Malnehmen erklärt eine Info zur Merkzahl, was zu tun ist.

Für Kinder
• Alle vier Grundrechenarten, bei Minus mit Ergänzungs- oder Abziehverfahren
• Sterne und 29 Abzeichen, gestaffelt erreichbar
• Eigenes Detektivbuch: Das kann ich schon, und woran ich gerade übe
• Überträge werden so notiert, wie es im Unterricht üblich ist

Für Lehrkräfte und Eltern
• Lernstände je Kind, kompetenzorientiert: Was gelingt schon, wo hilft mehr Übung
• Rückmeldung in Worten für Eltern und für das Kind, als Textvorschlag zum Anpassen und Weitergeben
• Klassen und Kinder einfach verwalten, auch per Drag-and-drop
• Einstellungen je Kind: Rechenart, Modus und Schwierigkeit

Datenschutz
Alle Daten bleiben auf dem Gerät. Es gibt keine Werbung, kein Konto und keine Datenübertragung an Server.

Einmaliger Kauf, alle Rechenarten enthalten. Keine In-App-Käufe, keine Abos.

name: ReminisLink
description:
ReminisLink turns your iPhone into the companion of your retro handheld. Open ReminisLink on the handheld, manage everything from your phone over your home Wi-Fi, close it and play.

BRING YOUR OWN FILES
ReminisLink lists the games found on the SD card of your handheld, but provides no game, no catalog and no source of games. You add the games, saves, patches and cheat files you already own, from the Files app or from the share sheet of any app.

YOUR LIBRARY
• Every game on the SD card in one list, with search and filters by system
• For each game: size, save, save states, cheats and box art; tap the art to change it
• Download any file of a game to your iPhone

SAVES AND SAVE STATES
• Download, replace, back up and restore saves; the current save is always copied first
• See every save state slot with its thumbnail, and lock a state: if it is overwritten or deleted, ReminisLink puts the locked copy back the next time it starts

CHEATS AND PATCHES
• Turn cheats on or off, edit and reorder them, import .cht files
• Apply IPS, BPS and UPS patches (translations, fixes) to a game you own, into a new file by default

APPS ON THE HANDHELD
• See the tools and emulators installed on the handheld
• Install one from a zip in Files or on the SD card, or remove one

NOTHING IS LOST
Deleted games and games patched in place go to the trash of the handheld, until they reach 30 days of counted age (purged at launch) or you empty it; a replaced save is first copied to the backups.

SAVES ON YOUR IPHONE
• Copy the saves of the handheld to your own iCloud Drive, with one tap or each time it connects
• Up to 10 versions of each save, in the ReminisLink folder of the Files app

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
The app refreshes on its own when the SD card changes, shows transfers and battery live, and goes back to your list when you close ReminisLink on the handheld.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• Pair in one scan of the QR code shown on the handheld; your other Apple devices get the pairing through iCloud Keychain
• Encrypted connection, checked against the handheld's own certificate
• No account, no server, no analytics, no ads: the app talks only to your handheld on your local network

REQUIREMENTS
The free ReminisLink tool must be installed on the handheld: see the installation guide on reminis.link. Version 1.0 works with the TrimUI Brick running NextUI. The iPhone and the handheld must be on the same Wi-Fi network.

ReminisLink is an independent project. TrimUI and NextUI are the names of their respective owners, who are not affiliated with ReminisLink.

name: Resonanswer Hark
description:
Beneath the roof of an old house on Lantern Hill, it’s so dark you can’t even see your own wings, though somewhere nearby, a window stands wide open. In Resonanswer Hark, you’re a tiny bat lost in the attic, and your only lantern is your own voice. Let out a cry, and the attic answers for a moment, revealing glowing outlines of beams, trunks, and clotheslines. Then the lines fade, and you have to remember the way to the exit. But the walls aren’t the only ones listening. A nocturnal bird dozes in the rafters, a whiskered neighbor curls up on a shelf, and little gray creatures lurk in the corners. A short click reveals only a small patch around you, while a long cry illuminates the entire attic and wakes everyone within earshot.

Key Features

- Glass and mirrors create false reflections, showing a double where there’s nothing at all.
- The nocturnal bird flies toward sounds, not toward you, and a button tossed into a corner can lure it away.
- A sheet swaying in the draft keeps moving, even though your memory holds it exactly where you last saw it.
- When the tower clock strikes, you can cry out at full volume without waking a soul.
- Lost baby bats follow you in a little chain, each squeaking in its own rhythm.
- In the One-Cry Challenge, you must find your entire way to the window using a single call.
- Sixteen antique keepsakes piece together the story of a family that lived in the house for half a century.

The darkness isn’t going anywhere, and the window is still somewhere nearby. Beyond the glass, the sky slowly grows lighter, and if you take too long, your little bat will simply fall asleep wherever dawn finds it. Twelve nights lead you from dusty rafters to the very top of the bell tower, and with each passing night, the house grows trickier. Every call is a question, and everyone sleeping nearby can hear the answer. See if you can make your way through the darkness without disturbing a single sleeper in the house.

name: Rhypeline
description: రైప్లైన్ మీ ఫోన్‌లో గాలి ఉష్ణోగ్రత మరియు సాపేక్ష తేమ ఆధారంగా డ్యూ పాయింట్‌ను వెంటనే లెక్కిస్తుంది. కిటికీలు, పైప్‌లు లేదా గోడల ఉపరితల ఉష్ణోగ్రతను చేర్చి, ముడి ఉండే వాతావరణంతో పోల్చి ఘనీభవన ముందుగా గుర్తించవచ్చు. అనేక చోట్ల కొలతలను ఒక్కటిగా పోల్చవచ్చు; లెక్కలు మరియు చరిత్ర ఈ పరికరంలోనే సేవ్ అవుతాయి. సెల్సియస్, ఫారెన్‌హైట్, కెల్విన్ మార్పిడి మద్దతు ఉంది. కాలన్ చేయడానికి అంతర్జాలం అవసరం లేదు.

name: RuzhikoPlavem
description: Paint booth calculator: surface area, airflow, filtration, drying and unit cost.

name: ScanZero: PDF Scanner No Ads
description:
ScanZero turns paper into a clean PDF. Open it, scan, share. That is the whole app.

ZERO ADS. ZERO SIGN-UPS. ZERO COST.
We needed to scan one document. Every app we tried wanted an account, a subscription or a cloud connection, or made us watch ads. Several put a watermark on the result. So we made the scanner we wanted to use.

• No ads, anywhere
• No account, no email, no login
• No watermark on your PDFs
• Free. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no "pro" version
• Private. Your scans stay on your phone

SCAN
• Point the camera at a page. Edges are found and the page is captured for you
• Scan many pages into one document
• Or add photos you already have, and the page corners are found automatically
• Drag any corner to fine-tune, with a magnifier so you can place it exactly

CLEAN UP
• Pages are straightened and cropped
• Four looks: Original, Auto, Gray, and a crisp Black & White that handles shadows
• Rotate, re-crop or retake any page. The original is always kept, so every edit can be undone
• Sideways pages are turned upright for you
• A gentle heads-up if a page looks blurry or blank

ORGANISE
• Hold and drag to reorder pages
• Scans name themselves from the heading on the page, like "Electricity Bill - Nov 2026"
• Keep things tidy with folders
• Search finds words inside your scans, not only their names

SAVE AND SHARE
• Export to PDF in A4, Letter or the page's own shape. Scans are fitted, never stretched
• Pick Small for forms and portals with an upload limit, and see the file size before you save
• Searchable PDFs: select, copy and search the text
• Share to any app, or save to Files

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your phone: edge detection, clean-up and text recognition. There is no cloud and no server that could receive your documents. The only thing the app can send is an anonymous usage count (for example "a PDF was saved"), never your scans, file names or text, and you can turn it off in Settings.

GOOD FOR
Bills and receipts, ID cards and KYC forms, rent agreements, marksheets and certificates, notes and whiteboards, anything you need as a PDF today.

Light and dark mode. Works offline.

Questions or ideas: https://scanzero.makingitlegendary.com/support

name: Scrap Closet
description:
Your whole wardrobe, in your pocket, into a scrapbook

Take a photo of an item and the app removes the background on your phone, turning it into a clean die-cut sticker. Sort it into Tops, Outerwear, Bottoms, Shoes or Accessories, add a type, a brand and notes, and your closet builds itself.

Photo tip: lay each item flat or hang it against a background that contrasts with it (a light item on a dark surface, a dark item on a light one) in soft, even light.

MIX
Swipe through a row for each kind of item and dress up in seconds. Shuffle finds combinations whose colours go together. Save the ones you like as looks.

LOOKS
Arrange your items on a mood board: drag, pinch, turn, flip and layer them. Arrange lays them out for you. The board picks up a soft colour from your outfit, in light or dark mode. Count how often you wear each look.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photos and closet never leave your phone; the app works fully offline. Back up and restore your closet from More whenever you like.

name: ShadeHop
description:
ShadeHop shows where the shade is, hour by hour, on the walkways of the parks you visit, and finds the shadiest way to  walk between two places.

  WHERE IS THE SHADE RIGHT NOW?
  Teal paths are in shade and amber paths are in the sun at the time on the slider. Press play to watch the shade move
  through the day, or pick any date. Shade is calculated from public USGS LiDAR tree and building heights.

  SHADY ROUTES
  Search a ride, show or restaurant and ShadeHop compares the shortest walk with the shadiest one. Switch to rain cover
  to stay under roofs, or turn on stroller mode to avoid stairs.

  A COOLER DAY PLAN
  Pick what you want to do. My day puts outdoor rides in the cooler hours, indoor shows and air-conditioned rides in the  midday heat, and uses live wait times where they are available.

  WEATHER-AWARE
  Live weather and UV for the park. When it is overcast the map tells you, and when rain is coming the map switches to
  show covered paths.

  TAP ANY PLACE
  See its shade forecast for the day and the nearest water fountain, restroom and air conditioning.

  MORE TOOLS
  • Storm shelter: the nearest indoor place when lightning rolls in
  • Sunscreen timer with a reminder
  • Photo light: the best time for front-lit landmark photos
  • Parade curbs: which side of the street stays in shade
  • AI helper: ask for routes, waits or a plan in plain words

  PARKS
  Walt Disney World and Universal Orlando theme parks, SeaWorld Orlando, Disneyland Resort, Universal Studios Hollywood,  and New York's Central Park.

  Available in English, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese and Japanese. Free, no account needed.

  ShadeHop is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any park operator. Park names
  are used only to identify locations. Wait times are provided by Queue-Times.com.

name: Shoot UP! Arcade Basketball
description:
Shoot UP! is a fast, single-player arcade basketball game about finding the right angle, building a rhythm, and making one more shot.

PULL, AIM, RELEASE
Pull back from anywhere on the court to aim. A live trajectory guide and power meter show exactly where the ball will fly, so every shot is about touch, not luck. New players get a quick hands-on tutorial on their first level.

20 HANDCRAFTED LEVELS
The challenge builds as you go. Hoops slide sideways, rise and fall, or trace figure eights. Wind gusts push your shots off line. In later levels the trajectory guide gets shorter, so you have to trust your arc.

MORE THAN JUST BASKETS
Some levels ask for a set number of baskets. Others want a perfect swish, or a hot streak without a miss.

SCORE BIG
- Swishes earn bonus points
- Bank shots off the backboard earn a bonus
- Make baskets in a row to build a combo of up to 3x
- Earn up to three stars per level for accuracy and shots to spare

MADE FOR QUICK SESSIONS
- Short rounds and close finishes
- Plays fully offline, with no account, ads or tracking
- Progress saves on your device, so you can pick up where you left off
- Original music and sound effects, with optional haptic feedback
- Left-handed mode
- Designed for iPhone and iPad, including iPad multitasking

Find your perfect arc.

name: Shots - Talk Without Internet
description:
Shots shows you who is around you and open to a conversation.

It works phone to phone over Bluetooth, in a cafe or anywhere else people have Shots open. There is no account to create, no phone number to give and no feed to scroll. You pick a nickname, an avatar and up to three interests, and that is all anyone sees.

A WAVE COMES FIRST
Nobody can message you until you wave back. A wave you ignore stays ignored, and the other person is never told.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Chats are encrypted between the two phones. Nobody else can read them, including us.

GONE WHEN YOU GO
End a chat at any time and it is cleared from both phones. Leaving the room clears everyone and everything from that visit.

YOU CHOOSE HOW VISIBLE YOU ARE
Open to chat, heads down, or invisible. You can change it whenever you like.

NO INTERNET NEEDED
Messages travel between phones over Bluetooth and can hop through other phones in the room to reach someone further away.

SAFETY
Block anyone instantly, without them knowing. Report harassment, hate or spam from a person's card or from the chat, and Shots staff review it. Leave quietly or erase everything Shots has stored with one tap.

Shots is for adults aged 18 and over. It needs Bluetooth, and it shows people only while they are within Bluetooth reach of you.

name: Skyline Aegis
description:
100% FREE 1.0 LAUNCH — ZERO ADS, ZERO IN-APP PURCHASES, ZERO SUBSCRIPTIONS.

Hold the last fortified skyline against an endless alien armada. Skyline Aegis is an offline-ready sci-fi turret defense roguelite built for iPhone and iPad, featuring 3D-rendered turrets, a sculpted armored Bastion, and deep mid-run weapon forging.

FORGE 10 TURRETS INTO 17 HYBRID & APEX FUSIONS
• 10 Distinct Turret Chassis: Deploy immediately with 3 Starters (Autocannon, Cryo Condenser, Missile Battery) and earn 7 more strictly through skill milestones — Arc Relay, Solar Lance, Spore Foundry, Flak Scattergun, Plasma Mortar, Gauss Railgun, and Rift Projector.
• Side Forge Bays & Live Merging: Every wave awards tactical blueprints that weld automatically in your Side Forge Bays. Push a bay to Level 3, tap to merge it into your Main Turret, and unlock 17 transformative Hybrid Fusions — from Storm Battery and Shatter Salvo to Event Horizon and Hellfire Vortex.
• 3-Turret Omega Core: Push deep into an Endless run to forge the ultimate Apex Fusion, unleashing orbital rail beams and chain lightning across every lane.
• Sculpted Bastion & Command Skills: Fortify your wall with 4 Bastion Defenses (Aegis Shield Wall, Reactive Armor, Repair Nanites, Point-Defense Grid) and trigger 8 cooldown Command Skills plus each chassis Signature ability.

5 ROTATING ALIEN SECTORS · 44 THREATS · 8 ENDLESS BOSSES
• Battle through 5 escalating alien biomes — Shell Colony, Scattered Hunt, Veil Sector, Bulwark Front, and Swarm Citadel — before looping into high-intensity Endless sectors.
• Outsmart 44 painterly alien threats with distinct counters, including cloaked stalkers, shield wardens, subterranean burrowers, phase blinkers, and void leeches.
• Confront 8 towering Endless Bosses, from the Carapace Matriarch and Veil Sovereign to the Citadel Leviathan and Singularity Weaver.

UTC DAILY SEED CHALLENGE & GAME CENTER
• One Shared Seed Every Day: At 00:00 UTC, every commander faces the exact same preset chassis, wave seed, and 1 of 6 Daily Modifiers (Fast Forge, Overcharged, Boss Surge, Glass Bastion, Heavy Armor, or Double Socket).
• Fair Ranked Competition: Your first completed run each UTC day locks your Official Score on the Game Center Daily Seed leaderboard and extends your daily streak, with unlimited practice runs afterward.
• Native Apple Game Center: Compete on 2 global leaderboards (Endless Best Wave & Daily Seed Wave) and earn 10 Game Center Achievements worth 1,000 points.

BUILT FOR FAIR, UNINTERRUPTED PLAY
• 100% Free in 1.0.0: Every turret, fusion, sector, boss, and daily challenge is earned through gameplay — no ads, no stamina timers, no loot boxes, and no pay-to-win.
• Full Offline Play & Private iCloud Sync: Play anywhere with zero account or login required, with optional private iCloud save synchronization across iPhone and iPad.
• Thoughtful Controls & Accessibility: Includes a live 3-step Run-1 Guide (replayable anytime in Settings), Quick Training, haptics, Less Motion, and Larger Text support.

name: SnowDay: Snow Alerts
description:
SnowDay tells you when it snowed overnight at your ski hill, before you're out of bed.

Pick your mountains and how much new snow is worth waking up for. Each morning SnowDay reads the resort's own snow report (and the nearest SNOTEL snow sensor if the resort hasn't posted yet) and sends one alert when it's a powder day by your standard.

• Your mountains, your threshold: anywhere from 1″ to 24″, set per mountain.
• Alerts when you want them: as soon as the report is in, from 4 a.m., or at a time you pick.
• Evening alerts: when it snows hard during the day, you hear about it at dinner, in time to plan tomorrow.
• SnowDays: fresh snow and a sunny forecast (or a foot of it) earns a SnowDay banner and a one-tap way to rally your friends.
• Charts: this season's snow depth and snow water against normal, from the mountain's SNOTEL station.
• Themes: Powder Day, Blizzard, Bluebird, Night Groomer, Northern Lights and more. Automatic picks one from today's snow, the time of day and the holidays, with app icons to match.

Mountains: Bogus Basin, Brundage, Tamarack and Sun Valley in Idaho; Big Sky and Whitefish in Montana. Missing yours? Suggest it in the app; the more people ask, the sooner it's added.

SnowDay is invite-only for now: ask a friend who uses it for an invite link.

No ads, no tracking and no account: just a first name, so friends can see who joined.

name: Soul: Время намаза и Кибла
description:
Soul (Мусулман Жолдомосу) — надежный исламский спутник для мусульман Центральной Азии (Кыргызстан, Казахстан, Узбекистан). Приложение работает на 100% автономно без необходимости постоянного подключения к интернету.
Расчет времени намаза строго соответствует каноническим правилам Ханафитского мазхаба (Аср 2, точные астрономические координаты Meeus).
Ключевые возможности:
1. Точное время намаза (100% Офлайн)
• Расписание для более чем 30 городов Кыргызстана, Казахстана и Узбекистана.
• Автономный расчет без интернета с учетом часовых поясов (UTC+5 и UTC+6).
• Виджет экрана «Домой» и экрана блокировки с обратным отсчетом до следующей молитвы.
2. Высокоточный компас Киблы
• Определение направления на Священную Каабу с плавной фильтрацией сенсора и индикатором точного наведения.
3. Режим «Мечеть-Таймер» (OLED)
• Минималистичный экран для дома или мечети с крупным контрастным шрифтом на чистом черном фоне.
4. Интерактивное обучение намазу и омовению
• Пошаговое руководство для мужчин и женщин (вуду и намаз) с иллюстрациями и аудио.
• Сборник дуа с арабским текстом, транскрипцией, переводом и озвучкой.
• Электронный тасбих, калькулятор каза и календарь Рамадана.
5. Полная приватность
• Никакой рекламы, трекеров и обязательной регистрации.
• Опциональная анонимная синхронизация через 12-словный бумажный ключ с клиентским шифрованием.

name: Splidex
description: Splidex એ તમારા iPhone પર ઓફલાઇન ચાલતું UUID બેચ જનરેટર છે. તમે વર્ઝન 4 (રેન્ડમ) અથવા વર્ઝન 1 (સમય આધારિત) પસંદ કરી શકો, એક વખતે 1 થી 50 સુધી ઓળખાંકો બનાવી શકો, અને અપર/લોઅર કેસ, હાઇફન, બ્રેસ અથવા urn:uuid ફોર્મેટ સેટ કરી શકો. દરેક લાઇન અથવા સંપૂર્ણ યાદી નકલ કરો, ટેક્સ્ટ/JSON તરીકે નિકાસ કરો, અને બેચોની ઇતિહાસ આ ડિવાઇસ પર સાચવાય છે — એપ બંધ કરીને ફરી ખોલો તો પણ રહે છે. ડેટા તમારા ફોનમાં જ રહે છે; સામાન્ય કાર્ય માટે ઇન્ટરનેટ જરૂરી નથી.

name: Spottello: Spot the Difference
description:
Spottello is a calm spot-the-difference game. Two pictures, a handful of small changes — find them all, at your own pace.

NO RUSH, NO PRESSURE
• No timer and no lives. A miss never ends a level; it only costs a star.
• Stuck? Use a hint, or pinch to zoom in on the tiny details.

PLENTY TO FIND
• 130+ hand-tuned levels in 11 themed packs: meadows, space, a cozy library, a pet club, a garage, a festive New Year and more.
• A new Daily Challenge every day, with a calendar to track your streak and a trophy for every full month.

FAIR DIFFERENCES
Every difference is checked to be visible to players with red-green color blindness, so you won't hunt for a shade you can't see.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Five color themes: Sky, Mint, Peach, Lavender and Lemon.
• Calm background music, sounds and vibration, each with its own switch.
• Plays on iPhone and iPad, with Apple Pencil hover on iPad.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Spottello plays offline, and your progress stays on your device.

Spottello is free with a small banner below the pictures. A one-time purchase removes ads and adds 10 hints.

name: StepRoute: Procedure Lists
description:
Build reusable procedures with ordered steps and optional notes. Start a local run, check steps one by one, keep progress when you leave, and review or restart a run without changing the original procedure.

• Write reusable procedures with ordered steps and notes.
• Edit and reorder steps before saving a template.
• Start independent runs that preserve the original step snapshot.
• Check and uncheck steps with progress saved locally.
• Review, share, reset or delete a run without changing its template.

Keep up to 100 procedures and 100 runs. Each procedure has 1–50 steps. Procedure names allow 1–80 characters and notes up to 2,000; step names allow 1–120 characters and notes up to 500. Runs retain independent step snapshots and checkmarks. This personal planning tool does not automate system actions or validate safety-critical instructions.

No sign-in, advertising or analytics SDK is included. Records remain on this device. Copy and system sharing occur when you choose them.

name: Sunnylist: Grocery List
description:
Sunnylist is the cheerful shopping list for everyone who shops together.

ONE LIST FOR THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD
Invite your partner, family or roommates via iCloud. Everyone sees the same list – add, check off or delete items and the change appears on every iPhone within seconds. No account, no sign-up.

TYPE LESS, SHOP FASTER
• Write "6 eggs" or "500 g flour" – amounts are detected automatically
• Every item gets a fitting emoji, so you spot it at a glance
• Smart suggestions from what you bought before
• Sort by aisle – produce, bakery, dairy, frozen … in the order of your store
• Add notes like "the organic one" or "large pack"

HANDY EXTRAS
• Scan a handwritten shopping list with your camera
• Recognize products from a photo or barcode
• Attach photos so nobody buys the wrong brand
• Ask Siri: "Add something to Sunnylist"
• Send your list as text to anyone – even without the app
• Save and restore backups
• Undo, drag to reorder, light and dark mode
• Available in 35 languages

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Your list is stored on your iPhone. When you share it, it lives in your own iCloud – we never see it. No tracking, no analytics.

Happy shopping!

name: SwingLab - Golf Swing Drills
description:
SwingLab is a golf swing trainer by TeeLab. One drill at a time, a better swing over time.

No range, no filming, no swing analyzer. Practice at home or in the office with just a little space. Spend 3–5 minutes a day following one animated drill, and build the fundamentals of a good swing over 28 days.

HOW IT WORKS
• Watch: every drill has a looping animation you can pause or slow to 0.5×, with 3–5 key steps and common mistakes
• Practice: an optional counter tracks reps and rest between sets, or just tap Finish when you're done
• Log: rate the difficulty, add a note, and your plan moves forward a day

THE 28-DAY PLAN
• Week 1 Balance & Rotation: no club needed
• Week 2 Posture & Alignment: set up well and keep your tilt as you turn
• Week 3 Weight Shift & Sequence: shift, then turn, without standing up early
• Week 4 Adding the Club: grip, tempo, half swings and arm extension
The plan moves forward each time you complete a day, not by the calendar. Do several days at once or take a break; missed days never count against you. Review days on days 7, 14, 21 and 28 help you compare how it feels.

19 ANIMATED DRILLS
Feet-together swings, hip and shoulder turns, head-to-wall turn, hip hinge with a club on your spine, hip bump, pump drill, hanger drill and more. Face-on, side and top-down views.
• Right- or left-handed: animations are mirrored and left/right in the instructions switch to match
• Simple props only: most drills need nothing, and drills that use a club, towel, chair, wall or hanger always have a no-equipment alternative
• Filter the library by category, equipment, space and length, and keep favorites at the top

PROGRESS
• 28-day plan grid: redo any day you've completed
• Session history with difficulty and notes; add missed sessions, and deleting one never changes your progress

Completely free. No ads, no account, and all your data stays on your phone. Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

SwingLab offers basic drill guidance. It does not diagnose your swing and is not a medical or rehabilitation product. Stop if you feel pain or discomfort.

name: SY3D Hub: 3D Print Marketplace
description:
SY3D Hub is a local 3D-printing marketplace in Aleppo, Syria. We connect you with registered printing stores and coordinate your order between you, the store and the delivery company.

3D Printing, Made Simple.
You don't need to know anything about 3D printing: pick a ready-made product, upload your file, or describe your idea with photos and words.

What you can do

• Buy ready-made products
Browse 3D-printed products from stores in Aleppo: home decor, office, gifts and figures, spare parts and tools, phone accessories, toys and learning. Every product shows its price. Buy from several stores at once and each store gets its own order, all confirmed with one tap.

• See it in 3D first
Open a product's model, or your own file, and turn it and zoom in with your fingers before you order. The app reads STL, 3MF and OBJ files.

• Order a custom print from a store you choose
Upload your file, or photograph the part you want copied, and add a short description. The store sends you an offer with the price, material and ready date, or asks you about a missing detail. Choose the material if you know it, or let the store suggest the best one.

• Ask every store for a quotation
Send your request once to every suitable store, then compare the quotations: each one comes from a named store, with its rating, price, ready date and notes. Choose the one that suits you, or message a store before you decide.

• Follow your order step by step
From the store's confirmation through printing and preparation to the delivery company and your door, with a notification at every update.

• Message the store in the app
Messages and photos stay in the order's conversation, so our team can refer to them if there's ever a problem.

• Pay the way that suits you
Cash on delivery or your in-app wallet. For a custom order, the app shows what you pay now and what you pay on delivery before you accept the offer, and nothing is taken without your agreement.

• Earn SY3D Rewards points
Earn points for completed orders, reviews and inviting friends, and exchange them for products and discount coupons. Points have no cash value.

Choosing a store
• Reviews are written by customers who completed their orders, and can include their photos.
• The "Verified store" badge means SY3D Hub's team visited the store and reviewed its equipment and the way it works. It isn't a guarantee for every product or order.
• If something goes wrong with an order, report it from the order's page; our team reviews it and tells you the decision.

Support close by
For a problem with the app, open a support ticket from your account, or call or WhatsApp us from the support page.

Browse products and stores without an account, and sign up with your phone number when you want to order.
In Arabic and English, with prices in Syrian pounds and an option to show them in US dollars.

From idea to your hands.

name: Syllascope
description:
Syllascope என்பது எடை கொண்ட மதிப்பெண் கணிப்புக் கருவி. பாடப்பிரிவுகளின் விகிதம் மற்றும் மதிப்பெண்ணை உள்ளிட்டால், மொத்த மதிப்பெண், ஒவ்வொரு பிரிவின் பங்கு, எஞ்சிய பகுதிக்கு தேவையான மதிப்பெண் ஆகியவை உடனே காணப்படும்.

பல பாடத் திட்டங்களைச் சேமித்து மாற்றலாம்; கணிப்பு படிகளை விரித்துப் பார்க்கலாம்; முடிவுகளை சாதனத்தில் பதிவு செய்யலாம். இணையம் தேவையில்லை; உங்கள் தரவு இந்தத் தொலைபேசியில் மட்டுமே இருக்கும். கிடைமட்ட மற்றும் செங்குத்து திரைகளுக்கு ஏற்ப வடிவமைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

name: Tap-it
description:
tap-it brengt je café of bar naar de telefoon van je gasten. Ze tikken met hun telefoon op een tap-it kaartje op tafel of scannen de QR-code, en zien meteen jouw pagina. Ze hoeven niets te downloaden.

Met deze app beheer je alles zelf, waar je ook bent.

MENUKAART
• Maak foto's van je menukaart en tap-it zet hem voor je online
• Pas gerechten, prijzen en beschrijvingen aan met één tik
• Laat met kleine symbolen zien waar gluten, melk, noten, ei of soja in zit

STEMPELKAART IN WALLET
• Gasten bewaren je stempelkaart in Apple Wallet of Google Wallet
• Jij kiest het aantal stempels, de beloning en de kleur van de kaart
• Je personeel geeft stempels met de telefoon

BERICHTEN AAN JE GASTEN
• Stuur een bericht naar iedereen met je stempelkaart, bijvoorbeeld over een actie of een nieuw seizoensbier
• Gasten krijgen een herinnering als ze in de buurt van je zaak zijn

VOOR AAN TAFEL
• Spelletjes om samen te spelen
• Wifi met één tik
• Gasten kunnen anoniem feedback geven, zonder een review te schrijven

INZICHT
• Zie hoe vaak er getikt wordt, hoeveel stempelkaarten er zijn en wat gasten van je zaak vinden

IN DE TAAL VAN JE GAST
• Je pagina wordt automatisch vertaald in de taal van de telefoon van je gast

Je hebt een tap-it account voor je zaak nodig om deze app te gebruiken. Kijk op tap-it.cards voor meer informatie.

name: TaraLok: Kundli & Rashifal
description:
TaraLok works out your real birth chart from your exact birth date, time and town, then explains it in plain words.

Seedhi Baat mode is on by default: everyday sentences instead of planet and house jargon. Switch it off any time if you like to read a chart your own way.

WHAT YOU GET
• My Kundli: rising sign, Moon sign and birth star, planets and houses, life phases (dasha), doshas and yogas, divisional charts, Ashtakavarga, KP and Lal Kitab. Every section explains its own terms.
• Other systems side by side: a Western chart, Chinese four pillars and numerology, all from the same birth details.
• Daily Rashifal: today, tomorrow and this week, by Moon sign, Sun sign or birth star.
• Panchang: tithi, nakshatra, sunrise, Rahu kaal and a best time for your day, for your town.
• Kundli Milan: the traditional 36-point match, explained plainly, for a couple or for friends.
• Muhurat: good dates for a wedding, a house move, a vehicle or a new shop.
• Ask Dhruv, your reader: ask about your own chart and get an answer written from it, in English or Hindi.
• Tarot, I Ching, runes, dreams, Mayan and Celtic signs, and love compatibility by sign, Chinese year and numbers.
• An optional 7 am reminder on your phone with your best time for the day.

BUILT FOR CLARITY
Charts are calculated by our own code from published formulas, with planet positions from an open astronomy library, so the same birth details always give the same chart. Choose your ayanamsa (Lahiri, Raman or KP) and North or South Indian chart style.

English and Hindi throughout. Sign in with an email code, no password. Your saved charts are private to your account, and you can delete your account inside the app.

Readings are there to think with, not promises.

name: TembariOsveth
description: Wind tunnel calculator: speed, dynamic pressure, power, Reynolds and forces.

name: thanxday
description:
thanxday is a quiet place to notice the good in each day.

Write a short gratitude entry, add a photo or a voice note, and check in with how you feel. Drafts wait for you until you are ready, then become part of a calm, date-by-date diary.

• A gentle daily mood check-in
• Text, photos, and voice together in one diary entry
• Drafts you can preview, choose, and turn into an entry
• A mood calendar that remembers how each day felt
• A 4-digit privacy lock with a recovery code
• Everything stays on your device — no account, no cloud, no ads

One-time purchase. No subscription. Take a moment for yourself; your days deserve to be remembered.

name: The Code : Séduction & Drague
description:
Séduis la fille qui te plaît. Deviens le mec qui plaît.

The Code réunit toutes les techniques de séduction de nos coachs dans un seul endroit : le Playbook. Chaque Move est une méthode concrète, testée sur le terrain, que tu peux utiliser dès ce soir.

CE QUE TU TROUVES DANS L'APP
• Le Playbook : des centaines de Moves classés par thème (aborder, conversation, textos, premier rendez-vous, confiance en soi, style, langage corporel).
• Les coachs : pose ta question à Yohan, Martial, Eddie ou Samuel et reçois une réponse adaptée à ta situation, avec le bon Move à lire. Réponses assistées par IA.
• Le coaching privé : réserve une séance d'1 h avec un coach.
• Ta série : termine un Move ou écris aux coachs chaque jour et gagne des crédits.
• Lecture hors ligne, favoris et notifications.

DÉBLOQUE LE GAME
Ton premier Move est offert. Invite un ami et débloquez chacun un Move gratuit. Les crédits permettent de débloquer les autres Moves.

RESPECT AVANT TOUT
The Code enseigne la confiance, la communication et le respect. Aucune manipulation, aucune pression : le consentement est la base de tout.

13K+ hommes apprennent déjà. À ton tour.

name: TheRocfellr
description: Import account transactions when reconciling accounts at the end of the month.TheRocfellrFirst, check how many transactions remain to be processed, then verify which payments have already been recorded. A single venue charge can be linked to two separate sports-related expenses. Once you’ve identified any missed items—such as transportation fares or service fees—review the new expenses alongside the projected ending balance before recording them all. Funds transferred to a savings account should be matched as a distinct pair, with the actual transaction date preserved for each side. You can also log daily expenses on the go, and save the summaries of verified transactions as categorization rules. In the account ledger, you can view details by either the date of the transaction or the date it was recorded, making it easy to track items that span across months. If you discover an incorrect match, you can undo that specific pairing.

name: Trade Made Tools
description:
Trade Made Tools is made by contractors, for contractors. It keeps what you do on site (photos, video, scans and notes) on the right job, and in step with your company's office on trademadetools.com.

ON THE JOB
- Photos and video: take as many as you like. Each one goes on the job with its time and place. No signal? They wait on the phone and send when you're back in range.
- Before & After: before and after photos of the work, side by side.
- Scan rooms: walk a room with your phone and get the floor plan and measurements, with photos, video, 360s and notes pinned to it.
- Not filed yet: take a photo with no job open and add it to the right job or customer later.

DESIGN STUDIO
Show a customer their own house with new siding, a roof, gutters or a deck. Your prices stay private.

HANDS NEEDED
Companies post work and pick who gets it. Workers join free.

PHONE AND WEB, ONE ACCOUNT
What you take on the phone shows in your company's office on the web, and the other way around. Customers, jobs, estimates, invoices and scheduling live in the office.

FOR REFERENCE ONLY
Measurements, scans and anything the app works out are for reference only and may not be 100% accurate. Check them before you buy, build, quote or file anything.

Company accounts are set up at trademadetools.com. Workers join Hands Needed free.

name: TripPeta｜旅行記録・旅のしおり・旅行日記
description:
旅先で撮った写真と、食べたものと、行った場所が、旅ごとに1冊にまとまる旅行記録のアプリです。国内の47都道府県と海外を合わせて453の土地、1,812品の名物を収めたごはん図鑑があり、旅先で名物を食べて記録するたびに、図鑑のお皿が1枚ずつ埋まっていきます。いっしょに行った人とファイルを送り合えば、相手が撮った写真と記録も同じ旅に加わるので、ふたりの旅がそのまま1冊になります。

旅のあとに「あの店、なんて名前だったっけ」「あの景色はどこだったっけ」と思っても、料理や店の名前、感想のことばで探せば、すぐに見つかります。旅行日記をつけるのが続かなかった人でも、写真を選んでひと言添えるだけで、旅の思い出が残っていきます。


■ ふたりで1冊

・旅を1つのファイルにして、AirDrop やメッセージでいっしょに行った人へ渡せます
・相手が TripPeta で開くと、同じ旅が相手の iPhone に入ります
・相手が記録を足して送り返すと、相手の記録と写真があなたの旅に加わり、相手の名前が付きます
・足されるのは相手だけが持っている記録・予定・持ち物で、あなたの記録は書きかわりません
・アカウント登録はいりません。写真はファイルに入れて直接渡すので、開発者のサーバーは通りません
・カップルや夫婦、家族、友だちとの旅の思い出を、それぞれの iPhone で同じ1冊にできます


■ 写真とひと言で、旅の記録

・ごはん・景色・体験・宿・おみやげ・チケットの種類を選んで、写真と場所と感想を残せます
・味の評価、値段、「また行きたい」の印も付けられるので、食べ歩きの記録帳としても使えます
・写真をまとめて選ぶと、撮った日と場所ごとに記録を分けます


■ 行った場所が、消印とごはん図鑑に

・記録した土地に、その土地らしい絵柄の消印が押されます。47都道府県と、海外の国と地域にも対応しています
・日本地図とアメリカの地図で、行った県や州が色で埋まっていくので、都道府県の制覇を目で追えます
・その土地の名物を食べて記録すると、ごはん図鑑のお皿が埋まります。つぎの旅で食べたい名物も、図鑑から探せます
・旅の記録は地図の上でも見られます


■ 旅の前は、しおりに

・日ごとの予定と持ち物を書いて、旅のしおりを作れます。持ち物は前の旅から写せます
・お使いの AI に作ってもらった予定表を貼り付けると、しおりに読み取ります（TripPeta から AI へ文を送ることはありません）
・しおりは PDF にしたり、印刷したり、TripPeta を使う人へファイルで渡したりできます
・旅が終わると、しおりの予定と記録が同じ1冊に並びます


■ みかえす

・料理や店、場所、感想のことばで、過去の記録を探せます
・たべもの帖で、食べたものを写真で一覧できます
・何年か前の同じ日の旅が出てきます


■ 記録は iPhone の中に

・アカウント登録も広告もありません
・旅・記録・写真はこの iPhone の中に保存し、開発者のサーバーへは送りません
・通信がなくても記録や見返しができます
・すべての旅と写真を1つのファイルにまとめるバックアップで、機種変更のときも戻せます


■ プレミアム（任意）

記録・ふたりで1冊・消印・地図・ごはん図鑑・しおり・みかえす・バックアップは、無料で件数の制限なく使えますが、1件の記録につけられる写真は無料では5枚までで、プレミアムでは次の機能が加わります。

・1件の記録に写真を10枚まで
・旅のアルバムを PDF に
・旅のまとめ画像

月額・年額の自動更新サブスクリプションと、買い切りから選べます。サブスクリプションは、期間が終わる24時間以上前に解約しない限り自動で更新されます。解約は、iPhone の「設定」→ 自分の名前 →「サブスクリプション」からできます。

利用規約（EULA）: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
プライバシーポリシー: https://wishcode-apps.pages.dev/trippeta/privacy

name: Trouvaille: Antiquités, Valeur
description:
Ce vase au fond du placard, cette pendule héritée, ce tableau chiné dimanche : qu'est-ce que c'est, et combien ça vaut ?

Prenez une photo. Trouvaille identifie l'objet et vous donne une fourchette de prix réaliste, en euros, en quelques secondes.

CE QUE VOUS OBTENEZ POUR CHAQUE OBJET
• Son nom, son époque, son origine, son style, ses matériaux
• Une fourchette de prix de revente entre particuliers en France
• Son histoire, en quelques lignes
• Ce qui fait monter ou baisser son prix
• Les détails à vérifier pour affiner : signature, poinçon, dessous
• Où le vendre, et des recherches toutes prêtes sur eBay et Leboncoin

POSEZ VOS QUESTIONS
Comment savoir s'il est authentique ? Comment le nettoyer sans l'abîmer ? Faut-il le faire expertiser ? Demandez, Trouvaille répond à partir de la fiche de votre objet. Vous avez lu une signature ou le bon modèle ? Dites-le : l'estimation est refaite.

VOS COLLECTIONS
Chaque objet estimé est gardé avec sa photo et sa valeur. Créez vos collections (« Maison de mamie », « À vendre »), rangez-y vos objets et voyez d'un coup d'œil ce que vaut chacune.

APPRENDRE
60 articles courts pour chiner sans se tromper : reconnaître un faux, lire un poinçon, dater un meuble, ne pas nettoyer ce qu'il ne faut pas. Faïence, verrerie, argenterie, mobilier, bijoux, montres, pièces, livres, tableaux.

POUR QUI ?
• Vous videz un grenier, une cave ou la maison d'un proche
• Vous chinez en brocante et en vide-grenier
• Vous vendez sur Leboncoin, Vinted ou eBay et vous voulez fixer le bon prix
• Vous êtes simplement curieux de ce que vous possédez

Tout type d'objet : faïence et porcelaine, verrerie, argenterie, meubles, tableaux et gravures, pendules et montres, bijoux, jouets anciens, livres, luminaires, objets de décoration.

UNE ESTIMATION, PAS UNE EXPERTISE
Les estimations sont indicatives. Elles sont établies par intelligence artificielle à partir d'une photo et ne remplacent pas l'avis d'un commissaire-priseur. Pour un objet qui pourrait avoir de la valeur, Trouvaille vous le signale et vous conseille de le faire confirmer.

VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
Pas de compte à créer. Votre collection reste sur votre iPhone. Seule la photo à analyser est envoyée, le temps de l'estimation.

ABONNEMENT TROUVAILLE PRO
Les 3 premières estimations sont offertes. Ensuite, Trouvaille Pro donne accès aux estimations illimitées :
• Annuel, avec 3 jours d'essai gratuit
• Hebdomadaire
Le paiement est prélevé sur votre compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat ou à la fin de l'essai. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf annulation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Vous gérez et annulez votre abonnement dans les réglages de votre compte App Store.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://trouvaille.upsilon-development.com/confidentialite

name: Twinkle Kitchen Play
description:
Welcome to Twinkle Kitchen Play! Gather, wash, and prepare ingredients to make a meal for an animal friend.

All 15 recipes are free. Stretch noodles, roll gimbap, fold dumplings, and make pizza, pancakes, waffles and more.

Share your finished dish one bite at a time. The first shared bite creates a memory card in the friends album on your device.

Adjust voice guidance, music, effects and vibration, or choose button controls. Supports Korean, English, Japanese and German. No registration, advertising or third-party tracking.

This is pretend cooking on a screen. Adults should handle real knives, heat and hot cooking tools.

name: Umoja Asso
description:
Umoja Asso réunit tout ce dont une association a besoin, au même endroit.
Membres : liste à jour, rôles du bureau, import depuis Excel, cartes de membre.
Cotisations et collectes : qui a payé, reçus, rappels.
Caisse : entrées et sorties, bilan clair.
Agenda et votes : événements, réponses, assemblées générales, élections.
Annonces et documents partagés avec les membres. 
Espace privé et fermé pour chaque association, accessible avec un code. Français, anglais et arabe. Fonctionne même avec une connexion faible. 

Conçue par MMBT.

name: Vigilfolio
description: Vigilfolio ഒരു ലഘുവായ മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് രജിസ്റ്ററാണ്. ഓരോ അപകടസാധ്യതയും ഒരു ചീട്ടായി സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നു: വിവരണം, സാധ്യതയും പ്രഭാവവും, നിവാരണ നടപടികൾ, ഉത്തരവാദിത്തം, നില മാറ്റം, വീണ്ടുവിചാരണ ഓർമ്മപ്പെടുത്തലുകൾ, കയറ്റുമതി. എല്ലാ രേഖകളും ഈ ഫോണിൽ തന്നെ സൂക്ഷിക്കുന്നു; ആപ്പ് അടച്ചിട്ട് തിരിച്ച് തുറന്നാലും നിങ്ങളുടെ രേഖകൾ അവിടെ തന്നെയിരിക്കും. റിവ്യൂ ഡെസ്ക്കിൽ താപനില ഗ്രിഡും കാലക്രമേണ അവലോകനത്തിനുള്ള പട്ടികയും കാണാം.

name: Voice Chrono
description:
Voice Chrono is a large stopwatch that speaks the elapsed time.

Start, pause, resume, and reset. The digits follow the system clock, so leaving the app does not make the timer drift by adding up ticks.

Spoken time:
• English or 中文, following the language you pick
• Every 1, 5, 10, 30, or 60 seconds, or a custom interval from 1 to 3600 seconds
• If the previous phrase is still playing, it is replaced by the latest time

Voice Chrono is a paid app. The price is $1 in the United States. Other storefronts use Apple’s equivalent price. There is no account, no advertising, and no data collection. Speech uses the voice already on your device.

name: WaxUp
description:
WaxUp is the premier live audio platform for practicing and mastering oral English through engaging debates.

Speak Up. Debate. Improve.

Whether you are preparing for international exams, job interviews, or just want to speak English fluently and naturally, WaxUp connects you to real voice rooms with passionate English speakers around the world.

KEY FEATURES:
• Live Voice Debates: Join the "For" or "Against" stage or listen in as an audience member.
• Turn Timer: Fair speaking turns with an active countdown timer for structured arguments.
• Audience Verdict: Cast your vote at the end of each debate for the most convincing side.
• Community Feed: Share 30-second voice reflections, photos, and insights with learners worldwide.
• Daily Speaking Challenge: A new prompt every day to keep your practice streak alive.
• Vocabulary Notebook: Save idioms and expressions you discover during live debates.
• Background Audio (Picture-in-Picture): Keep listening to live debates while exploring the community.
• Zero-Tolerance Safe Community: English-only respectful environment with strict moderation.

Powered by Sylla English Academy.

name: WeBook AI
description:
WeBook is your personal library for e-books and audiobooks. Add the files you already have, read or listen to them in one place, and keep your highlights and notes together with your books.

ALL YOUR BOOKS IN ONE LIBRARY
• Opens PDF, EPUB, FB2 (including .fb2.zip), TXT and Word (DOCX) books
• Plays audiobooks in MP3, M4B, M4A, AAC, WAV, FLAC, OGG and Opus
• Pick several audio parts at once, or a ZIP archive, and they become one audiobook with chapters
• Add books from the Files app or straight from other apps with Share
• Books are copied into the app, so they stay even if you delete the original file
• Sort books into your own categories, add favorites and pin the ones you are reading now
• Convert a book to PDF for printing or sharing

COMFORTABLE READING
• Turn pages or scroll continuously
• White, sepia and black page backgrounds, plus dark mode
• Choose the font, text size, line spacing, margins and alignment
• Keep the screen on while you read
• See how much time is left in the chapter and in the whole book
• Search the full text of any book

HIGHLIGHTS AND NOTES
• Highlight passages in six colors
• Select any text and save it as a Note
• See all your Notes in one place and jump back to the exact spot in the book
• Export Notes to PDF, or to Markdown for Obsidian, Notion and other apps

LISTEN
• Read aloud: have any e-book read to you sentence by sentence with the system voice, at the speed you like
• Audiobook player with playback speed, 30-second skip, chapters and bookmarks with comments
• Sleep timer: stop at the end of the chapter or after a set number of minutes
• Keeps playing in the background, with controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center

READING GOALS AND STATISTICS
• Set a daily goal in minutes for reading or listening
• Get an optional daily reminder on days you haven't reached your goal
• Follow your streak, the last 7 days, this month's total and your most-read books

AI ASSISTANT (OPTIONAL)
• Select a passage and ask AI a question about it, then keep the conversation going
• Translate selected text
• Ask your question by voice
AI features work with your own OpenAI (ChatGPT) or Google Gemini API key. Keys are stored only on your device, and usage is billed to your account with that provider. The text you send to AI goes to the provider you chose. Without a key, everything else in WeBook works as usual.

BACKUP AND RESTORE
• Save all books, audiobooks, Notes, highlights, categories, reading positions and statistics to a single file
• Keep the file wherever you like and restore it on a new device
• Restoring never creates duplicates: Notes and highlights are merged

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-up
• No ads
• Your library stays on your device. WeBook connects to the internet only for the AI features you set up yourself.

The app is available in English, Uzbek, Russian, Arabic, Turkish and Chinese.

WeBook does not include or sell books. It opens the files you add yourself.

name: Wild Wiki: Animal Family Quiz
description:
Who is heavier, a polar bear or a tiger? Who is faster, an ostrich or a wolf? Everybody guesses. Then the answer plays out on a seesaw, a race track or a ruler, and somebody in the back seat shouts "I knew it!"

Wild Wiki is an animal quiz the whole family plays together, on one phone or tablet. It is made for road trips, waiting rooms, rainy Sundays and every "are we there yet".

HOW IT WORKS
• Two animals, one question. Who is heavier, faster, longer, taller? Who can live longer? Whose baby is heavier at birth?
• Everyone guesses in turn, then 3, 2, 1 and the answer shows.
• 235 animals and more than 50,000 different questions, so no two games are the same.
• Five levels. On level 1 one animal is far ahead. On level 5 even the grown-ups are guessing.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Family game: up to 6 players pass the phone around. With three or more players, the only one who gets it right is the lone wolf and scores double.
• Play alone: build the longest run of right answers. Questions you miss come back later until you know them.
• Pick the question: choose any two animals yourself and settle the argument.
• Showdown: one pair, every fact we have, a guess before each round.

KIDS LEARN WITHOUT NOTICING
• Every number is real and comes from a published source. Nothing is made up.
• A small line for grown-ups under each answer says exactly what was compared, for example a grown male African lion and a grown male Bengal tiger.
• Right answers earn animal stickers. Each sticker opens a card with the animal's numbers, where it lives and fun facts.
• "Do they ever meet?" shows on a map whether the two animals even live in the same part of the world.
• No trophies for just showing up. The leaderboard is real, and so is the pride.

WHAT PARENTS LIKE
• No ads. No accounts. No chat. No links that lead out of the game.
• Nothing about your child is collected. Names, scores and stickers stay on your device.
• Works offline, so it works in the car, on a plane and at the cabin.
• In 74 languages. Metric or imperial units, your choice.
• Cut-paper pictures of every animal, made to look majestic, not cute.

FREE AND FAIR
The free version has the 50 best known animals, 2 players, 10 questions per game and the middle level. One purchase unlocks all 235 animals, up to 6 players, longer games and all five levels. Paid once. No subscription. Buying sits behind a grown-up check or your own PIN.

Made in Estonia by a dad whose son keeps asking who is heavier, a bear or a lion.
