Plan your weekend, discover your favourite artists and enjoy every moment on the dance floor.

Everything you need to navigate your festival experience in one convenient app.

name: XTXMTS
description: XTXMTSEach bill’s payment and individual share are itemized, ensuring that even when expenses involve multiple payers, fixed costs, or equal splits, every amount can be reconciled down to the cent. Once all parties reach an agreement, the selected expenses are consolidated into a net settlement statement. Partial payments can be recorded on an individual’s ledger page or linked to existing bank transactions; a single incoming payment can even be allocated across different billing periods. Original settlement statements are retained for end-of-month review, while refunds and corrections are tracked as separate adjustments, with any disputed items set aside pending clarification. Routine wages, personal expenditures, and inter-account transfers can be logged separately, allowing for real-time visibility into individual spending, actual account disbursements, and outstanding amounts yet to be recovered.

name: Yazz
description:
Yazz vous permet de suivre vos véhicules en temps réel, où que vous soyez.

Associée à un traceur GPS Yazz installé dans votre véhicule, l'application vous montre sa position exacte, sa vitesse et l'état du contact, et vous prévient au moindre événement.

SUIVI EN TEMPS RÉEL
• Position précise sur la carte, mise à jour en continu
• Vitesse, contact, alimentation et batterie du véhicule

HISTORIQUE DES TRAJETS
• Chaque trajet retracé : départs, arrêts, distances et durées
• Le résumé de votre journée en un coup d'œil

ALERTES
• Excès de vitesse, entrée et sortie de zone, démarrage du moteur
• Capteur déconnecté, batterie faible

MODE PARKING
• Le moindre mouvement de votre véhicule garé vous est signalé

ZONES DE SÉCURITÉ
• Maison, bureau… soyez prévenu à chaque entrée et sortie

EN CAS DE VOL
• Signalement sécurisé en quelques secondes
• Coupure du moteur à distance (selon l'installation)

PARTAGE
• Donnez l'accès à votre famille, votre chauffeur ou votre entreprise, en gardant le contrôle

Yazz nécessite un traceur GPS Yazz installé dans le véhicule.

name: Σπασίκλας – Κουίζ Γνώσεων
description:
Σπασίκλας: το κουίζ γνώσεων που σε μαθαίνει κάτι καινούργιο σε κάθε ερώτηση. Πάνω από 24.000 ερωτήσεις σε 40 κατηγορίες, κουίζ για τον τόπο σου και 1.765 ελληνικές παροιμίες, με σύντομη εξήγηση μετά από κάθε απάντηση. Παίζει ολόκληρο ακόμη και χωρίς internet, χωρίς εγγραφή· κι όταν είσαι online, ανεβαίνεις στις κατατάξεις με το δικό σου όνομα παίκτη.

ΠΩΣ ΠΑΙΖΕΤΑΙ
• Διάλεξε κατηγορία και επίπεδο: Εύκολο, Μέτριο, Δύσκολο ή Μικτό
• 10 ερωτήσεις σε κάθε γύρο, 4 επιλογές, 20 δευτερόλεπτα για την καθεμία
• Σωστή απάντηση: 100 πόντοι, συν έως 100 πόντους μπόνους ταχύτητας. Όσο πιο γρήγορα απαντάς, τόσο περισσότερους κερδίζεις
• Στο τέλος του γύρου, το σκορ σου και ανασκόπηση όλων των απαντήσεων

ΜΑΘΑΙΝΕΙΣ ΠΑΙΖΟΝΤΑΣ
• Μετά από κάθε απάντηση, σωστή ή λάθος, μια σύντομη εξήγηση σού λέει το γιατί
• Το παιχνίδι προτιμά ερωτήσεις που δεν έχεις ξαναδεί, για να έχει κάθε γύρος κάτι καινούργιο

ΑΣΤΡΑΠΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΕΡΙ
• Αστραπή: 60 δευτερόλεπτα, όσες περισσότερες σωστές μπορείς. Κάθε λάθος κοστίζει 3 δευτερόλεπτα και οι ερωτήσεις δυσκολεύουν όσο προχωράς
• Σερί: μία-μία ερώτηση από όλες τις κατηγορίες, μέχρι το πρώτο λάθος. Πόσο μακριά θα φτάσεις;
• Ρεκόρ ημέρας και κατάταξη ημέρας για το καθένα

Ο ΤΟΠΟΣ ΜΟΥ
• Πάνω από 1.500 ερωτήσεις για τις 13 περιφέρειες της Ελλάδας: διάλεξε τη δική σου από τον χάρτη
• 8 θεματικές: Γεωγραφία, Ιστορία, Πολιτισμός, Έθιμα, Γεύσεις, Αθλητισμός, Πρόσωπα, Αξιοθέατα

ΠΑΡΟΙΜΙΕΣ
• 1.765 ελληνικές παροιμίες: συμπλήρωσε τη λέξη που λείπει και μάθε τι σημαίνει η καθεμία
• Παροιμίες της ημέρας, με δικό τους σερί
• Η συλλογή σου: όσες έχεις βρει, με τη σημασία τους, αναζήτηση και αγαπημένες

ΚΟΥΙΖ ΤΗΣ ΗΜΕΡΑΣ
• Κάθε μέρα 10 ερωτήσεις από όλες τις κατηγορίες, ίδιες για όλους
• Παίξε μία φορά τη μέρα και χτίσε το σερί σου

ΚΑΤΑΤΑΞΕΙΣ
• Παίξε και ανέβα στην κατάταξη ημέρας/εβδομάδας/συνόλου με το δικό σου όνομα παίκτη
• Κατατάξεις και για κάθε κατηγορία, τις παροιμίες, την Αστραπή και το Σερί, με τη θέση σου τονισμένη
• Το παιχνίδι παίζει κανονικά offline· τα σκορ σου στέλνονται για την κατάταξη μόλις βρεθείς online
• Προαιρετικό: αν δεν θέλεις κατάταξη, απλώς παίζεις. Το προφίλ κατάταξης διαγράφεται όποτε θέλεις από τις Ρυθμίσεις

40 ΚΑΤΗΓΟΡΙΕΣ
Ιστορία, Αρχαία Ελλάδα, Γεωγραφία, Νησιά της Ελλάδας, Χώρες & πρωτεύουσες, Σημαίες & χώρες, Μνημεία του κόσμου, Μυθολογία, Θρησκείες & Αγία Γραφή, Πολιτική & θεσμοί, Αθλητισμός, Ποδόσφαιρο, Μπάσκετ, Ολυμπιακοί Αγώνες, Επιστήμη, Χημεία & Φυσική, Εφευρέσεις & εφευρέτες, Τεχνολογία & internet, Μαθηματικά, Διάστημα & αστρονομία, Ανθρώπινο σώμα, Ζώα & φύση, Τέχνες & πολιτισμός, Έθιμα & παραδόσεις, Λογοτεχνία, Ποιος το είπε;, Φιλοσοφία, Ελληνική γλώσσα, Ελληνική ορθογραφία, Αγγλικά, Κινηματογράφος & TV, Ελληνικός κινηματογράφος, Ελληνικές σειρές, Μουσική, Ελληνικό τραγούδι, Μαγειρική, Αυτοκίνητα, Οικονομία, Γενικές γνώσεις, Παιδικά & κινούμενα σχέδια.

ΣΤΑΤΙΣΤΙΚΑ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΤΕΥΓΜΑΤΑ
• Η πρόοδός σου σε κάθε κατηγορία, με μια ματιά στην αρχική οθόνη
• Ακρίβεια ανά κατηγορία, καλύτερα σκορ και το σερί σου
• Επιτεύγματα που ξεκλειδώνεις παίζοντας

ΜΟΙΡΑΣΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΛΕΣΕ ΦΙΛΟΥΣ
• «Μοιράσου»: κάρτα με το σκορ σου, έτοιμη για Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp και όπου αλλού θέλεις
• «Κάλεσε φίλους»: στείλε τον σύνδεσμο από την εφαρμογή μηνυμάτων σου ή δείξε τον κωδικό QR

ΠΑΙΖΕΙ ΠΑΝΤΟΥ, ΧΩΡΙΣ ΕΓΓΡΑΦΗ
• Όλες οι ερωτήσεις είναι μέσα στην εφαρμογή: παίζεις στο μετρό, στο αεροπλάνο, στο χωριό, χωρίς σύνδεση
• Χωρίς εγγραφή και χωρίς κωδικό: ανοίγεις και παίζεις. Για την κατάταξη αρκεί ένα όνομα παίκτη
• Η πρόοδος και τα στατιστικά σου μένουν στη συσκευή σου

ΚΑΙ ΑΚΟΜΗ
• Για iPhone και iPad, σε κατακόρυφο ή οριζόντιο προσανατολισμό
• Φωτεινό ή σκούρο θέμα, ή αυτόματα όπως το σύστημα
• Απτική απόκριση στις απαντήσεις και επιλογή για λιγότερη κίνηση
• Μόνο ένα μικρό banner στο κάτω μέρος της οθόνης: καμία διαφήμιση πλήρους οθόνης δεν διακόπτει το παιχνίδι

Σπασίκλας, από τη MINOANDESIGN.

name: עטרת גלריות
description:
עטרת גלריות היא מערכת בעברית לצלמי אירועים. יוצרים גלריה לכל אירוע, שולחים ללקוח קישור אחד, והוא צופה בתמונות ושומר אותן באייפון.

• הורדת תמונות באיכות מלאה ושמירה ישירה לאפליקציית התמונות
• זיהוי פנים: כל אורח מוצא את התמונות שלו

• נתוני צפיות והורדות לכל גלריה

name: التحقيق
description:
Run your own private detective agency. Your first case begins with a disputed will and a family that can’t agree on what happened. Follow the evidence and decide whose story holds up.

• Investigate a disputed inheritance, a suspicious jewelry theft, and a smuggling operation at the port.
• Interview witnesses, inspect locations, and analyze documents. Use evidence to challenge statements and uncover contradictions.
• Connect clues to suspects on your evidence board, then submit your final report.
• Plan visits around opening hours and character schedules. Upgrade your skills, buy investigation tools, and grow your agency.

Play in Arabic or English.

name: حِرفي - Herafi
description:
حِرفي هو تطبيق يسهّل التواصل بين الأشخاص الباحثين عن خدمات الصيانة والأعمال الحرفية وبين الحرفيين المناسبين.

بدل البحث والسؤال عن حرفي، يمكنك نشر طلبك وتوضيح نوع الخدمة والمشكلة وموقعها، ثم استقبال عروض الأسعار من الحرفيين المتخصصين ومتابعة الطلب بسهولة من داخل التطبيق.

يوفر حِرفي خدمات متعددة تشمل:
• السباكة والمواسير
• الكهرباء المنزلية
• النجارة والفك والتركيب
• الحدادة والأعمال المعدنية
• الألمنيوم والزجاج
• الدهان والديكورات
• صيانة الأجهزة الكهربائية
• التبريد والتكييف

من خلال التطبيق يمكنك:
• إنشاء طلب صيانة أو خدمة بسهولة.
• إضافة تفاصيل المشكلة وإرفاق صورة عند الحاجة.
• استقبال عروض أسعار من الحرفيين.
• اختيار الحرفي المناسب للطلب.
• التواصل مع الحرفي من خلال المحادثة داخل التطبيق.
• متابعة حالة الطلب حتى اكتمال الخدمة.
• تقييم الحرفي بعد انتهاء العمل.

أما الحرفيون، فيمكنهم إنشاء حساب مهني، الاطلاع على الطلبات المناسبة لمجال عملهم، تقديم عروض الأسعار، وإدارة الطلبات الجارية من لوحة التحكم الخاصة بهم.

هدف حِرفي هو جعل الوصول إلى خدمات الصيانة والحرف أكثر سهولة وتنظيمًا للطرفين.

name: رفيق الحج والعمرة
description:
«رفيق الحاج والمعتمر» دليلك الكامل في رحلة العمرة والحج، يعمل بدون إنترنت، بالعربية والإنجليزية والأردية والفارسية.

 المناسك خطوة بخطوة
• العمرة مصوّرة من الإحرام إلى التحلل.
• أنواع الحج الثلاثة (التمتع والقِران والإفراد) يوماً بيوم من الثامن إلى أيام التشريق.
• أحكام العمرة والحج: التعريف والشروط والأركان والواجبات والسنن.
• المواقيت، الإحرام ومحظوراته، أحكام خاصة بالمرأة.

 عداد الطواف والسعي
• عدّ الأشواط السبعة بلمسة، مع رسم يوضّح موضعك ودعاء لكل شوط.

 الأدعية والأذكار
• أدعية الحج والعمرة من القرآن والسنة.
• حصن المسلم كاملاً.
• كتاب «الدعاء من الكتاب والسنة».
• دعاء اليوم، والمفضلة، والمسبحة.
• عند اختيار لغة أخرى يبقى الدعاء بالعربية وتظهر ترجمته تحته.

 المصحف الشريف
• القرآن الكريم كاملاً مع حفظ موضع القراءة وتكبير الخط.

 أوقات الصلاة والقبلة
• مواقيت دقيقة لمكة المكرمة والمدينة المنورة وأغلب مدن العالم بطرق الحساب الرسمية (أم القرى وغيرها).
• تحديد موقعك تلقائياً، وتعديل الدقائق لكل صلاة.

 وأكثر
• الأماكن المقدسة والمزارات في مكة والمدينة.
• حالة الزحام عبر الخريطة الرسمية للهيئة العامة للعناية بشؤون المسجد الحرام والمسجد النبوي، ورابط تطبيق نسك.
• حقيبة الحاج (قائمة تجهيز)، آداب وتوجيهات، محوّل العملات.
• الوضع الداكن والفاتح، وتكبير الخط، وصفحة «تواصل معنا».

name: مُلازَمَة | حفظ القرآن
description:
تطبيق مُلازَمَة يُعينك على حفظ القرآن الكريم وتثبيته ومراجعته بطريقة متقنة ومنظمة.

مميزات مُلازَمَة: 
• وردك اليومي: مسار واضح يُبيّن لك ما عليك إنجازه اليوم من حفظ وتكرار ومراجعة.
• الحفظ الجديد: حفظ متقن للوجه مع عداد للتكرار يُعينك على الثبات.
• تكرار الأمس والربط: تثبيت المحفوظ القريب وربطه بما سبقه ليبقى حاضرًا في صدرك. 
• المراجعة المستمرة: مراجعة دورية للمحفوظ لضمان عدم تفلّته. 
• المصحف الشريف: قراءة سلسة ومريحة خالية من أي مشتتات. • رفيق التسميع: مجالس صوتية تفاعلية تعينك على التسميع والمدارسة.

name: واحة الأذكار
description:
تطبيق "واحة الأذكار" هو رفيقك الإسلامي اليومي المتكامل، صُمم بعناية فائقة وتصميم عصري هادئ ليعينك على ذكر الله وأداء عباداتك اليومية بكل يسر وسهولة، ويجمع لك كل ما تحتاجه في تطبيق واحد يعمل بسلاسة دون الحاجة إلى اتصال دائم بالإنترنت.

 أبرز ميزات ووظائف واحة الأذكار:

1. القرآن الكريم كاملاً:  قراءة ممتعة وتفاعلية بالرسم العثماني المعتمد وخطوط واضحة ومريحة للعين.  استماع لتلاوات خاشعة بأصوات نخبة من كبار القراء في العالم الإسلامي.  ميزة التسميع الصوتي الذكي لمساعدتك على مراجعة وحفظ الآيات.  سهولة التنقل بين السور والأجزاء، والبحث السريع، مع حفظ الفواصل والعلامات المرجعية.

2. الأذكار وحصن المسلم:  أذكار الصباح والمساء، أذكار النوم والاستيقاظ، وأذكار ما بعد الصلاة.  موسوعة شاملة لأدعية وأذكار "حصن المسلم" مصنفة حسب المناسبات اليومية.  عدّاد تسبيح ذكي مع اهتزازات تفاعلية لتسهيل الذكر دون الحاجة للنظر للشاشة.  نظام إحصائيات لمتابعة وردك اليومي ومدى محافظتك على الأذكار.

3. مواقيت الصلاة والأذان:  حساب فلكي دقيق لمواقيت الصلاة بناءً على موقعك الجغرافي بأدق المعايير المعتمدة عالمياً.  تنبيهات الأذان بأصوات متعددة لأشهر المؤذنين (الحرم المكي، المسجد النبوي، الأقصى، ومؤذني العالم الإسلامي).  ميزة التنبيه المسبق قبل الأذان بوقت محدد للاستعداد والتهيؤ للصلاة.  خيارات عرض مرنة: شاشة مبسطة سريعة، وشاشة تقويم تفصيلية.

4. بوصلة القبلة الدقيقة:  تحديد مباشر وفائق الدقة لاتجاه الكعبة المشرفة مدعوم بحساسات الهاتف المدمجة مع توجيه دقيق واهتزاز عند المحاذاة.

5. التقويم الهجري والميلادي:  عرض متزامن للتاريخ الهجري والميلادي مع إمكانية ضبط الفروق يدوياً حسب الرؤية الشرعية.  التذكير بأيام صيام السنن (صيام الإثنين والخميس، والأيام البيض) والمناسبات الدينية طوال العام.

6. كنوز إسلامية إضافية:  أسماء الله الحسنى: استعراض أسماء الله الحسنى الـ 99 مع معانيها وشرحها وفضل الدعاء بها.  كنوز السنة النبوية: مكتبة منتقاة من الأحاديث النبوية الصحيحة مع الشرح والفوائد.  المسبحة الرقمية: مسبحة إلكترونية متطورة لحفظ عدد التسبيحات والأوراد الخاصة.

7. ويدجت الشاشة الرئيسية:  ويدجات أنيقة ومتنوعة لشاشة القفل والشاشة الرئيسية لعرض الصلاة القادمة والوقت المتبقي لها، والتاريخ الهجري والميلادي دون الحاجة لفتح التطبيق.

8. مظهر عصري وتخصيص كامل:  10 سمات وألوان مريحة للعين (بما فيها الوضع الليلي الداكن المريح للقراءة الليلية والموفر للبطارية).  تحكم كامل بحجم ونوع الخط العربي ليناسب راحة عينيك.  تجربة نقية وهادئة صُممت لتعينك على الخشوع والتركيز.

name: 어제의 내가 최종 보스
description:
내가 남긴 움직임이 나를 추격한다.

구역을 탈출할 때마다 방금의 내 경로가 잔상이 되어 다음 구역에 다시 나타납니다. 잔상은 최대 5명까지 쌓이고, 기록이 끝나면 그 자리에 멈춰 섭니다. 과거의 나와 부딪히지 않게 길을 짜고, 코어를 모아 출구로 나가세요.

- 16개 구역 캠페인과 시간 균열 모드
- 다음 구역의 출발점·코어·출구를 게임판에 미리 표시
- 최소 에너지 기록에 도전하고 유저 랭킹에서 겨루기
- 되돌리기와 힌트 제공, 한국어·영어 지원

name: イントロQ
description:
曲の出だしの数秒を聴いて、4つの選択肢から曲名を当てる音楽クイズです。
早く答えるほど高得点。帰省や飲み会、学校のレクで、1台のスマホを囲んで早押し対決もできます。

■ 遊び方
・ひとりで遊ぶ: 1問ずつ再生して4択で回答。早いほど高得点、連続正解でボーナス
・みんなで早押し: 2〜4人が画面の自分の色を早押し。押した人が5秒以内に回答、外れたらその問題は押せなくなり、再生は続きから
・今日の1曲: 毎日みんな同じ5問。結果を絵文字の表でシェア
・もう少し聴く: 1秒→3秒→5秒と聴く長さを伸ばせるヒント（伸ばすほど得点の上限が下がる駆け引き）

■ 出題
・J-POP、90年代、アニソン・ゲーム、洋楽、演歌・歌謡など
・難易度は4段階（かんたん〜鬼）、問題数も選べます

■ 曲との出会い
・毎問の答え合わせで曲名・アーティストを表示し、「Apple Music で聴く」からすぐに聴けます
・外した曲・知らなかった曲は「出会った曲」に残ります
・記録画面で自己ベストと年代別の正答率を確認

■ 音源について
・Apple Music 加入者は、Apple Music に接続すると曲の頭から再生する「イントロモード」で遊べます
・未加入でも、Apple Music の試聴音源（プレビュー）で無料で遊べます（試聴音源は曲の頭から始まるとは限りません）
・曲の音源はアプリに含まず、端末にも保存しません。再生にはインターネット接続が必要です
・このアプリは楽曲の販売促進と宣伝のために提供されています

■ その他
・広告が表示されます。アプリ内課金「広告を消す」（買い切り）で非表示にできます
・アカウント登録は不要です

name: ダイホン - 台本読み上げ・台詞暗記
description:
お手持ちの台本を取り込んで、ひとりで稽古するためのアプリです。
自分の役を選ぶと、相手役の台詞やト書きをアプリが読み上げ、自分の台詞の番で止まります。キッカケ練習や暗記モードで、台詞を体で覚えましょう。

■ 4つの稽古モード
・通し読み：全部の台詞を読み上げ
・自分の台詞だけ：相手役を声で聞き、自分の行はタップで進む
・暗記：自分の台詞をぼかして隠す
・キッカケ練習：前の台詞（キッカケ）を聞いて、自分の台詞を言ってから答え合わせ

■ 台本の取り込み
・テキスト（「役名：台詞」の簡単な書き方）、文字データのある PDF、JSON に対応
・取り込み前に、役の統合・群読・ト書きと台詞の入れ替え・場面の区切りを確認して直せます
・取り込んだあとも、行の分割・結合・被せ（重ねて読む）・しおり・メモを編集できます

■ 声と読み方
・役ごとに声・速さ・高さを設定（端末の読み上げ音声を使います）
・読み方辞書で、難しい読みや人名を正しく読ませられます
・音声つきの台本ファイル（.daihon）なら、録音した音声で再生できます

■ 進み具合
・覚えた行に印をつけて、場面ごとに何割覚えたかを表示
・前回の続きから再開

■ 安心して使える
・台本・進み具合はすべて端末の中だけに保存。アカウント登録・データの送信はありません
・すぐ試せるサンプル台本つき

※ 台本は作者の著作物です。取り込んだ台本は、稽古のための個人利用の範囲でお使いください。

name: 一念成符
description:
把心里的一句话，画成一张可以保存的符图。

在「创作」中静下来，从平安、财富、学业、事业、和合、静心、顺遂中选一份所求。可以只在心里默念，也可以写下或说出心愿。落笔之后，跟随笔画和念词，看符图慢慢成形。

想知道某一笔为什么这样画？点开作品详情，沿着标记查看符头、敕令、符胆和符脚等部位的解释。也可以到「灵感」翻看图鉴与文献，区分参考图中的画法与作品的原创组合。

在「历史」中重看创作，调整笔色、背景和大小，再保存为壁纸或通过系统分享。

name: 九九練習 ぴーちゃんの九九のおへや
description:
小学2年生の九九の練習を、ぴーちゃんといっしょに。
「九九のおへや」は、カードと声でかけ算九九をおぼえて、練習するほど集まる貝がらで、ぴーちゃんのへやを自由にかざれる九九アプリです。

■ カードで おぼえる
九九を1枚ずつめくって、声で聞いておぼえます。めくるたびに「にいちが に」と読み上げます。じどうでめくることもでき、速さも変えられます。
「すうじ」と「おさかな」を切りかえると、7×3が「7ひきずつ 3つぶん」の魚で見えます。

■ もんだいを とく
答えを数字ボタンで入れる練習です。わからない時は、おさかなのヒントで考えられます。まちがえた式は「もういちど」に自動で集まります。

■ マスけいさん・九九チャレンジ
タイムをはかって、自分の記録にちょうせん。九九チャレンジは、まちがえずに9問。20秒までに答えられると金の星、60秒までなら銀の星がもらえます。

■ 九九ひょう・九九あわせ
九九の表をさわって、読み方と答えを確かめられます。九九あわせは、同じ答えのカードを2枚見つけるゲームです。

■ ぴーちゃんの へや
練習すると貝がらがもらえます。貝がらはおみせで、ベッドやソファ、くじらのすべりだいなど42このアイテムと交換できます。指で動かして、自分だけのへやを作れます。

■ 無料で使えるところ
・1・2・5の段の練習（カード・問題・マスけいさん・九九チャレンジ）
・九九ひょう・九九あわせ・ぴーちゃんのへや

■ ぜんぶの段をひらく（アプリ内課金・買い切り）
1回の購入で、1〜9の段すべての練習が使えるようになります。月額ではありません。購入は保護者の確認を通った画面からだけ行えます。

■ 保護者の方へ
・広告はありません。アクセス解析や個人情報の収集もしません。
・練習の記録は端末の中だけに保存します。
・インターネットにつながっていなくても使えます（購入の時をのぞく）。

音声：VOICEVOX：ずんだもん

name: 古书守卫
description:
《古书守卫》是一款竖屏棋盘塔防游戏。你将在原创古书页地图上放置字灵守卫，观察墨影路线，调整防线节奏，守住书心并修复残页。

游戏包含 3 章 30 个关卡、每日挑战入口、图鉴、成就、音乐与音效设置，以及本地进度保存。无需登录，无需联网，打开即可游玩。

每一关都有不同路线、塔位和波次压力。你可以在战斗中继续补充守卫，切换倍速，开启自动下一波，也可以随时暂停和重来。

name: 星潮航路
description:
Tide of Stars is a helm-and-voyage game. You steer a sailing craft through contracts on twelve seas: survey, rescue, escort, salvage, beacons and relay. It is not an island-life game, and it is not a swimming adventure in which you play a little shark.

Free to play:
• The three classic chapters, where you learn the helm, forked channels and making port
• The first expedition sea, Wisteria Port: 10 contracts and 60 voyage legs

Full Edition (one-time purchase):
• Unlocks the remaining eleven seas, 110 contracts, 660 legs, and the logbook pages for those seas
• Not a subscription. Restore Purchases is in the ship's log and the expedition journal

How you play:
• Steer with port, starboard and a ship skill, follow waypoints, and keep clear of rocks and foul currents
• Legs may fork; you can choose among three rigs; arrivals leave a rating and a record
• Twelve seas, 720 legs in all. Stars are single-player goals, not player-versus-player contests

Progress stays on your device. We do not collect personal data, and there is no account.
Copyright 2026 Yuci Wang. Support: lunagamesitw@gmail.com

name: 霧線末班車
description:
Mistline Last Train is a mountain-railway simulation and night-print game. You carry an empty envelope from a child at Cedar Depot up to Stargazer Summit. Along the way you set signals, take platform photographs, and develop night-print postcards in the darkroom. You can also sit in the cab and drive the last train over Echo Gorge yourself.

This is not island life, a cat-care game, a light-refraction puzzle, or an ocean adventure. You are a mountain-line conductor moving between three misty stations.

THE THREE STOPS
• Cedar Depot: read the last-train sheet, set three signals, and look for the blue paper and half-tickets
• Echo Gorge: read the repair book and connect the track toward the observatory
• Stargazer Summit: aim the summit star-finder and deliver the envelope to the person on night watch

DRIVING AND DUTY
• The bridge approach and two mountain-line runs, using traction, coasting, dynamic braking and air brakes
• Driving-school lessons and practice cards
• A ten-day duty career, from the depot shuttle and the night relief train to the glass-plate special and the rain-line patrol

NIGHT PRINTS AND SIDE WORK
• Frame a shot on the platform, choose paper and exposure, and develop a night-print postcard
• Trackside recordings, letters, the timetable and review

FREE AND FULL EDITION
The download is free. You can finish Cedar Depot (three clues, the signal board, a platform photo, a night print and listening), drive the Echo Gorge approach (with assist, or as a passenger), take the first three driving-school lessons, replay the approach, and complete duty career day 1.
The Full Edition is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks the clues, instruments, driving, photography and night prints at Echo Gorge and Stargazer Summit, the two answering bells at the end, the stationmaster’s desk and letters, the remaining lessons and exam, and duty career days 2–10. On a new device, restore purchases from the conductor’s notes.

LANGUAGES
Menus and buttons are available in eight languages. The story and station text are in Traditional Chinese.

PRIVACY
No account is required. The app does not collect personal data. Progress stays on your device and can be played offline.
Copyright 2026 Yuci Wang
Support: lunagamesitw@gmail.com

name: Chimnora
description:
Chimnora is a Christmas physics puzzle game about one simple mission: deliver every gift into the right chimney.

On a snowy Christmas night, rooftops are blocked, ice is slippery, springs bounce wildly, and some chimneys even move. Study the scene, pull back to aim, control your power, and launch. Watch the gift arc through the air, bounce across platforms, and land a clean delivery.

HOW TO PLAY
• Hold the gift and drag backward to aim
• Release to launch along the predicted path
• Use gravity, bounce pads, ice, and springs
• Get the gift inside the chimney to clear the level
• Earn up to 3 stars by finishing with fewer throws

FEATURES
• 50 handcrafted physics puzzle levels
• Slingshot-style aiming with trajectory preview
• Springs, ice, moving platforms, and bounce challenges
• Star ratings, chapter progress, and local save
• Cozy Christmas art, music, and haptics
• Fully offline — no account, no ads, no internet required

Relax, retry, and master every rooftop toss. Can you three-star the whole town of Chimnora?

name: Replai: AI Texting Assistant
description:
Never get left on read again.

Replai reads your conversation and writes the perfect reply in seconds. Just upload a screenshot of any chat (iMessage, Instagram, dating apps and more) and get 4 replies that match the vibe, the details and the way you actually text.

REPLIES FROM ANY SCREENSHOT
Get four options every time, from sweet to spicy:
• Flirty: playful and confident
• Smooth: calm, a little mysterious
• Sweet: genuine and warm
• Spicy: bold, teasing, builds tension
Want something specific? Add a hint like "ask her out" or "keep it light" and get new replies.

CHAT ANALYSIS
Get the full read on your conversation:
• Interest level for you and them
• Who texts more
• Red flags and green flags
• Attachment style and compatibility
• Your best next move

ASK ANYTHING ABOUT THE CHAT
"Is she into me?" "Should I text first?" Ask any question about the conversation and get an honest answer, like a friend who read every message.

PICK-UP LINES
Hundreds of lines in 6 styles: cheesy, smooth, funny, nerdy, cute and bold.

TYPE IT OUT
No screenshot? Type the chat bubble by bubble and get replies anyway.

YOUR HISTORY, ON YOUR PHONE
Your past replies and analyses are saved only on your device, so you can open them again anytime.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads. Your screenshots are used only to write your answer and are never stored on our servers.

REPLAI PRO
Start with a 3-day free trial, then $6.99/week. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://replaiapp.netlify.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://replaiapp.netlify.app/privacy/

name: OOPS! Cat Chaos
description:
One swat. Total chaos.

Biscuit the cat has one job: knock things off shelves. Drag to aim, let go, and watch one tiny swat turn into a room-wide chain reaction of falling mugs, plates, cakes and wobbly stacks. Then act innocent. Someone is about to ask who did it.

A FUNNY CAT PHYSICS PUZZLE
Every room is a pile of breakable things and wobbly stacks. You get a few swats to knock down every sparkling target. Aim well and one swat can bring the whole room down.

HOW TO PLAY
• Touch Biscuit, drag to aim, let go to swat. A longer drag is a harder swat
• Knock every target off before you run out of swats
• Chain breaks together for big combos
• Earn up to 3 stars in every room and hunt for the golden paw bonus goal
• Tap the shelf to walk Biscuit to a new spot
• Stuck? Retry is one tap

50 ROOMS IN 5 WORLDS
• Grandma's Kitchen
• Cozy Living Room
• Home Office
• Smart Home
• Space Station Meow-1
Along the way: robot vacuums, delivery drones, magnets, gravity flips, low gravity and an airlock.

NEW CAT TRICKS AS YOU GO
• Pounce to a new shelf
• Tail Sweep a whole row
• Zoomies across the room
• Purr Pulse

SHH, DON'T WAKE THEM

name: 2 of Me
description:
Keep an up-to-date view of everyone you know, what matters to them and what's changing in their lives, so you can show up for them at the right moment. The iPhone app is for the hour around a conversation.

Walk into your next meeting knowing how you know each person, what you last talked about and what's still open between you.

Record a meeting in person and put the phone down, even locked. A minute after you stop, you have the summary on each person's profile.

Call someone from the app and record both sides, with their OK. The summary lands on their profile the same way.

After a coffee, say a note out loud. The new job, the child's name or what you promised to send is on their profile for next time.

When you have a minute, do one thing for someone: congratulate a new job, answer someone who's waiting on you, check in with someone close who's gone quiet.

Look anyone up, and see who lives or works near where you are.

It works with your 2 of Me account.

name: 2 Stroke Cal: Fuel Mix & Ratio
description:
Mix 2-stroke fuel with confidence using 2 Stroke Cal. Enter your fuel amount and your equipment’s recommended ratio to see how much oil to add. Check that the finished mix fits your gas can, then log the batch so you know when it was made.

Whether you’re mixing fuel for a chainsaw, string trimmer, dirt bike, go-kart, or outboard motor, 2 Stroke Cal keeps your ratios, container capacities, and latest mixes in one place.

Key Features

- Fuel-to-Oil Calculator — Choose 32:1, 40:1, 50:1, or 60:1, or enter a custom ratio. See the oil amount in fluid ounces and milliliters.
- US and UK Gallons — Measure fuel in US gallons, UK gallons, or liters. US gallons are the default.
- Gas Can Capacity Check — See whether the fuel and oil will fit together. If the batch is too large, use the suggested maximum fuel amount that fits.
- Container Profiles — Save each can’s name, capacity, equipment type, and target ratio so it’s ready for your next mix.
- Batch Logging — Log the latest mix for each container and see its freshness based on a 30-, 60-, or 90-day expiration window.
- Fuel Mixing Guide — Find practical tips on choosing a ratio, measuring oil, labeling containers, and storing mixed fuel.
- Lifetime Pro — Unlock unlimited container profiles, optional mix expiration reminders, and iCloud sync across iPhone and iPad.

Download 2 Stroke Cal and take the guesswork out of your next fuel mix.

The calculator, guide, and one container profile are free. Pro Lifetime is a one-time in-app purchase with no subscription.

name: 365钱包
description:
Ecoriz is a household sorting guide for everyday waste when it is not obvious where an item should go. Packaging symbols can be confusing. A clean bottle, a greasy pizza box, a broken jar, and a mixed snack wrapper do not belong in the same place. Food residue, mixed materials, and local rules often change the answer. Putting the wrong item in recycling can contaminate a whole load and send useful material to landfill.

Open Ecoriz on this iPhone. No account is required. From Home you can start a sort, open the item library, or go to your space. Browse or search more than 50 common household items by name, material, or category, including paper, cardboard, plastics, glass, metal, organics, textiles, electronics, and household chemicals. Each item shows a suggested stream such as recyclable, compostable, general waste, or special disposal. You also get preparation steps, contamination notes, reuse ideas, and a reminder that local facilities decide what they accept.

The Sort tab is the main tool. Choose an item, answer only the condition questions that apply, such as empty, clean, broken, oily, or mixed material, then read a cautious suggestion. Results explain why the destination changed and warn when acceptance may vary by town. Ecoriz does not scan photos or barcodes and does not promise that every facility will take an item.

In My Space you can save favorites, log what you sorted, keep personal household bins, and set optional local reminders. Bins are your home containers, not official municipal categories. Reminders stay on this device and are used only if you turn them on. The library and your records work offline.

Ecoriz is for households, roommates, students, families, and anyone who wants a private, practical sorting companion at home. Use it before you take out the trash, when you unpack groceries, or when you are unsure about a leftover container. It is a guide, not a collection service, not a live city schedule, and not a camera identifier.

name: 3D-Raumplaner
description:
3D-Raumplaner turns a LiDAR scan into a site survey you can keep working with: a dimensioned floor plan to DIN 1356, PDF and DXF, and a 3D model to walk through and measure.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan the room: move the camera slowly through the room, across the ceiling too.
2. Walk on: go through a door into the next room. The scanner notices, keeps the room and goes on scanning. The rooms come out in their right places.
3. Check: the app shows where the scan is uncertain and offers a fix.
4. Share: the floor plan as PDF, DXF for your CAD program, the 3D model as USDZ or OBJ.

WHAT THE SCAN FINDS
• Walls, doors, windows and doorways with their sizes
• Inner wall thickness from the neighbouring rooms
• Ceiling height, roof slopes with knee walls, beams, lowered ceilings and columns from the point cloud
• Furniture and appliances: over 60 kinds, recognised from photos on the device, with sizes and plan symbols
• Stairs, several storeys above each other

THE DRAWING
• Floor plan with dimension chains, opening sizes, room stamp with area, perimeter and clear height
• Storey plan with a room list and the total area
• Scale 1:25 to 1:200 automatic, A4 or A3
• Title block with project, your name and your company
• PDF printable at true size, DXF with layers at 1:1

SCAN CHECK
• Missing corners are marked red while you scan
• After the scan: walls beside the point cloud, missed windows, small notches and weak walls, each with an explanation and a fix
• Type a wall length by hand, move a wall, flip a door, everything can be undone

3D AND AR
• Overview to turn round, walk-through at eye height, measuring with two taps
• View the model at true size in the room (AR)

GOOD TO KNOW
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no network connection. Scans, photos and drawings stay on your device until you share them.
• Languages: German, English, Turkish
• Sample project to try the app without scanning
• Scanning needs a device with a LiDAR scanner: iPhone Pro (iPhone 12 Pro or later) or iPad Pro (2020 or later). On other devices you can open the sample project and scan files.

ACCURACY
LiDAR can be off by a few centimetres. Check measurements that matter for fabrication with a laser distance meter and enter them by hand.

Developed by Mauersegler Ingenieurbüro for its own work on ventilation and kitchen exhaust systems.

name: 4-7-8 Breathing Timer
description:
4-7-8 Breathing Timer does one thing: it walks you through the 4-7-8 breath, beautifully, every time.

Breathe in for 4. Hold for 7. Breathe out for 8. That's it. No library of fifty exercises to scroll through, no coach, no feed. Just open it and breathe.

PACED THREE WAYS
• A soft circle fills as you breathe in, rests while you hold, and empties as you breathe out
• Gentle haptic taps mark every second, so you can close your eyes
• Optional calm tones rise, hold and fall with your breath

A SESSION THAT ENDS GENTLY
Four cycles by default, about a minute and a half. When you finish, everything fades out quietly. No alarm, no jolt. Then an optional "How do you feel?" check-in.

SLEEP MODE (one-time unlock)
Lying in bed? Start sleep mode and put your phone down. The screen goes dark, and tones guide each breath: rising, breathe in; steady, hold; falling, breathe out. Each cycle is a little softer than the last, and the session ends in silence. You can lock your phone; the tones keep going.

WIDGETS (one-time unlock)
Start a session in one tap from your Home Screen or Lock Screen.

YOUR STREAK, YOUR PHONE
Every session is logged so you can see your streak build. No account, no sign-in, no cloud. Your history never leaves your phone.

FAIR PRICING
Basic sessions are free and unlimited, forever. Sleep mode and widgets are a single one-time purchase, shared with your family. No subscription, ever.

—
4-7-8 breathing is a relaxation exercise, not medical treatment. If you feel lightheaded, stop and breathe normally.

name: 4Per DoMiNo
description:
4PeR DoMiNo brings strategic tile-melding and classic domino chaining together on a realistic 3D felt table with a smart two-tier wooden rack.

TWO DISTINCT GAME MODES IN ONE APP:

1. 4PeR DoMiNo (2-Player Classic Strategy)
• Played with 112 tiles featuring suited numbers 1–6 and 8 Star Jokers.
• Your smart two-tier rack keeps waiting tiles on the upper tier and automatically highlights playable melds for open river branches on the lower tier.
• Open with a 3-tile run or group, then build a cascading domino chain flowing horizontally right and vertically down.
• If no meld is available, draw up to 3 tiles from the deck. Reaching 14 tiles with no meld adds a +14 penalty and deals 7 fresh tiles.
• Play 1 to 10 rounds; the player with the lowest total penalty wins the match.

2. 4PeR Modern Domino (4-Player Okey Domino)
• Uses 106 Okey-style tiles (two 4-suit decks numbered 1–13 plus 2 Star Jokers).
• Build mixed-suit sequential runs (e.g., 9-10-11 or 11-12-13-1) or 3–4 tile multi-suit groups with no opening tile limit.
• Pure Spades runs earn 2x points!
• Every tile played to the river awards its face value in (+ points), and emptying your hand grants a +100 finish bonus.
• Reaching 14 tiles with no meld deducts your hand's value and resets the river with 7 fresh tiles. Highest cumulative Net Score wins.

KEY FEATURES:
• Crisp 3D tiles, dual-tier wooden rack, and velvet domino river
• 3 table themes: Standard, Spring, and Daylight
• Customizable match length from 1 to 10 rounds
• Full English and Turkish language support
• Smooth offline gameplay against AI opponents anytime

name: 7R कैसीनो: स्लॉट और ताश
description:
7R कैसीनो में आपका स्वागत है: एक शाही सोशल कैसीनो, पूरी तरह हिंदी में। चार अनोखे स्लॉट, ब्लैकजैक, रूलेट और भाग्य चक्र, सब एक ही लॉबी में। स्वागत में 2,50,000 सिक्के मिलते हैं और हर गेम पहले दिन से खुला है।

चार स्लॉट, चार अलग अंदाज़
• महाराजा का ख़ज़ाना: ताज पूरी रील पर फैल जाता है। फ़्री स्पिन में फैली रीलें जमी रहती हैं और हर जीत दोगुनी होती है।
• बाघ का जैकपॉट: छह सोने के सिक्के जुटाइए और होल्ड एंड विन शुरू। मिनी, माइनर, मेजर और ग्रैंड जैकपॉट।
• दिवाली धमाका: जीतने वाले चिह्न फूटते हैं, नए गिरते हैं और गुणक x10 तक चढ़ता है। जीतने के 243 तरीक़े।
• रेगिस्तान का कारवाँ: हर ऊँट एक रीस्पिन देता है और रील दर रील बाईं ओर चलता है। फ़्री स्पिन में जीत तिगुनी।

टेबल गेम
• शाही ब्लैकजैक: छह गड्डियाँ, स्प्लिट और डबल, ब्लैकजैक पर 3:2 भुगतान। एक ही सूट के बादशाह और बेगम पर शाही जोड़ी का दांव 25:1 देता है।
• ताज रूलेट: क्लासिक यूरोपीय चक्र। हर स्पिन से पहले ताज प्रहार कुछ नंबरों पर x50 से x500 तक का गुणक लगाता है।

रोज़ के इनाम
• घंटे का बोनस: हर घंटे नए सिक्के।
• भाग्य चक्र: हर चार घंटे में मुफ़्त दोहरा चक्र, लगातार सात दिन तक बढ़ता बोनस।
• आज के मिशन: रोज़ तीन नए मिशन।
• शाही तिजोरी: हर दांव का 2% इसमें जमा होता है।
• स्तर: हर नया स्तर सिक्के, रत्न और बड़े दांव देता है।

और भी
• पूरा गेम हिंदी में, रकम भारतीय अंदाज़ में: लाख और करोड़।
• खाता या लॉगिन नहीं। बिना इंटरनेट के चलता है।
• कोई ख़रीदारी नहीं और कोई विज्ञापन नहीं।

ज़रूरी जानकारी
7R कैसीनो 18 साल या उससे बड़े लोगों के मनोरंजन के लिए है। इसमें असली पैसों का जुआ नहीं है और असली पैसे या इनाम जीतने का कोई मौका नहीं मिलता। सिक्के और रत्न वर्चुअल हैं और इनका कोई नकद मूल्य नहीं है। सोशल कैसीनो गेम में अभ्यास या सफलता का मतलब असली पैसों के जुए में आगे की सफलता नहीं है।

name: 8051 Projects PRO
description:
Explore the world of embedded systems and microcontroller programming with 8051 Projects PRO, a practical project collection featuring more than 60 hands-on projects based on the AT89C51 microcontroller.

Whether you are a student, hobbyist, electronics enthusiast, or embedded systems developer, this app provides practical examples to help you understand 8051 microcontroller programming and hardware interfacing.

Learn Through Practical Projects

Explore projects covering a wide range of topics, from basic input/output operations to advanced peripheral interfacing.

Project Categories:
(1) LEDs, Push Buttons & Interrupts: Learn digital input/output operations, LED blinking, push-button control, and external interrupts.
(2) 7-Segment Displays: Explore single-digit displays, multiplexing, counters, and dedicated display driver ICs.
(3) Timers & Counters: Understand 8051 timer modes, timer interrupts, and counter programming.
(4) UART Serial Communication: Practice serial data transmission, reception, and serial interrupts.
(5) LCD & Keypad Interfacing: Work with 4-bit and 8-bit LCD modes, custom characters, and matrix keypads.
(6) ADC & Sensor Interfacing: Interface with analog-to-digital converters, temperature sensors, light sensors, and various measurement modules.
(7) Motor Control: Control servo motors, stepper motors, and DC motors.
(8) Memory & Communication Interfaces: Explore I2C, SPI-like serial communication, EEPROMs, and I/O expanders.
(9) Advanced Sensor Modules: Work with ultrasonic sensors, RFID readers, IMUs, motion detectors, environmental sensors, and more.
(10) Display & Peripheral Drivers: Interface with popular ICs such as MAX7219, TM1637, 74HC595, and PCF8574.

name: A Home Arcade

A Home Arcade puts ten quick, friendly games right where you’ll actually see them — your Home Screen, StandBy, and the new HomeView.

GAMES

BUILT FOR HOMEVIEW & SHARED PLAY

No accounts. No tracking. No data leaves your device.

name: açık takvim
description:
her güne bir yaprak. açık takvim; bugünü, ayı ve randevularını sade bir dille gösteren yaprak takvim ve gün planlayıcısı.

bugün
yaprak takvimde günün tarihi, ayın evresi ve gökyüzünden tek cümlelik bir not. bugünün randevuları ve notların aynı ekranda.

randevular
telefonunun takvimiyle çalışır: iş görüşmeni, doktorunu, buluşmanı ekle; hatırlatması telefonundan gelir. randevuların telefonunda kalır.

bu ay
ayın tamamı tek bakışta; bir güne dokun, o günün randevuları ve notları açılsın. ayın öne çıkan gökyüzü olayları (yeni ay, dolunay, tutulmalar) kısa ve açılır notlarla.

ne zaman yapsam? (plus)

• Record work-from-home or field attendance when away from the office

name: ACTCOINESEOPT
description:
ACTCOINESEOPT is a private desk.

Home shows what came in, what went out, and the spending ratio. Pay is already on the book. The open month also projects what will be left if the current pace holds. Past months show the actual net.

Each week has a sitting. Read the items on the table, mark them keep, ease, or later, and close the sitting when you want the minutes kept.

Proposals are plans with a price. Approve, reject, or reopen one. Approving a plan does not spend the money. File a prepared slip when the money actually moves.

Rate the other seat’s expenses: bad, so-so, or good. The rating is a signal, not a score you chase. Coffee, dining, groceries, and sometimes travel have a ceiling you can ease or tighten by five dollars.

The sample months are generated on the phone, so the desk is full the first time you open it. Ratings, decisions, caps, slips, and minutes stay in a file on this device.

name: ADAMANT Fight Club
description:
ADAMANT Fight Club — официальное приложение клуба единоборств в Алматы.

• Абонементы. Посмотрите актуальные абонементы и цены для школьников, студентов и взрослых, выберите подходящий и оформите его онлайн. Срок действия и прогресс вашего абонемента всегда перед глазами.

• Тренеры. Знакомьтесь с командой клуба: фото, достижения и регалии тренеров — чемпионов и призёров соревнований.

• Отметка в зале по QR-коду. Просто отсканируйте код на входе или на ресепшене — посещение учтётся автоматически.

• История посещений. Все подтверждённые визиты в одном месте.

• Адрес и контакты клуба. Карта и информация о филиале: Алматы, ул. Розыбакиева 289, блок 3/1, цокольный этаж, вход в левую арку.

• Уведомления. Напоминания об окончании абонемента и важные новости клуба.

• Тёмная и светлая тема оформления.


ADAMANT — тренируйся как боец.

name: Ads Manager Planner
description:
Ads Manager Planner helps you check whether a retail promotion can cover its costs and whether you have enough stock to run it. Plan offers, compare pricing scenarios, and track the products and orders that inform your decisions on iPhone and iPad.

In Ad Planning, set a campaign window, link products, and enter forecast quantities, costs, and a budget. Review projected margin and break-even units. Shared Stock Check compares demand from overlapping campaigns against stock available after order reservations. Open the affected products and campaigns directly from the check.

Use Promotion Studio to model percentage discounts, fixed discounts, and bundles. In Budget Planner, compare a baseline with two alternatives. Change the price, discount, expected volume, or expenses and see how the estimated margin, break-even quantity, and stock gap change. Save a scenario for later and apply it when you are ready.

Maintain a catalog with product photos, record stock movements, and link orders to customer profiles. Confirm orders to reserve stock, fulfill them to deduct units, and record returns to restock the items. Review sales and gross profit, open product details from Top Products, and export PDF or CSV reports for the dates you select.

Choose Explore Demo to start with 12 sample products with photos, along with sample orders and campaigns. Create a separate workspace for your own records. Both workspaces are stored on your device, and you can back up and restore records and photos using JSON. The app works offline without a login, in-app purchases, or a subscription. Wide layouts let you browse a list and inspect its details side by side.

Key Features

- Forecast campaign margin and check sellable stock across overlapping promotions.
- Compare a baseline and two pricing scenarios before applying changes to a product or campaign.
- Model percentage discounts, fixed discounts, and bundle offers.
- Track products, customers, order reservations, fulfillment, returns, and stock movements.
- Review sales, gross profit, and top products, then export PDF or CSV reports.
- Explore a separate Demo workspace and back up or restore local data and photos with JSON.

name: Ads Manаger Retail Ledger
description:
Run your shop with a clear view of what’s in stock, what sold, and how much gross profit you earned.

Ads Manager: Retail Ledger brings your product catalog, sales, and reports together on iPhone and iPad. Open the app, add your first product, and start recording sales. No account or subscription required.

Know what’s in stock
Organize products by category and track prices, unit costs, and quantities for each variant. Search by product name, variant, or SKU. See which items are running low right from Home.

Record sales and keep stock current
Add multiple items to an order, apply a discount, and complete the sale. Inventory updates automatically. Each completed order keeps its original sale prices and unit costs, so later catalog changes preserve your sales history.

See how your shop is doing
Review net sales, gross profit, and completed orders for today, the last 7 days, or the last 30 days. See sales by hour or day and compare units sold across categories.

Work offline and keep your records on your device
Manage products, record sales, and view reports without an internet connection. Export a backup to Files and restore it when needed.

Built for small shops, market vendors, and independent sellers who want a simple way to stay on top of stock and sales.

name: Ads Primary Manager

Ads Primary Manager brings a product storefront and store management tools together in Cart & Co. Browse the catalog, save favorite items, and use the seller tools to manage inventory, plan campaigns, and review store performance.

• Shop and Saved — Search products or browse by category. Tap the heart on an item to find it later in Saved.
• Manage — Add products, check stock levels by item, and view local orders.
• Ads — Draft product campaigns offline, set planned budgets, and export campaign creative for use outside the app.
• Insights — Review sales trends and sales by category over the last 7 or 30 days. Manually record ad results to track ad spend and return on ad spend (ROAS).

name: Advanced RL: Policyridge
description:
Advanced RL: Policyridge is a graduate course in deep reinforcement learning that you can hold in one hand. Each of eight units begins with a real situation, then hands you a picture you can bend with sliders, and only then reveals the equation that describes what you just saw.

Watch a cafe owner nudge her menu odds and see a policy gradient. Grade a trainee driver stretch by stretch and watch advantages blend and a trust region clip. Ask two cautious advisers about a robot arm to see why twin critics tame overestimation. Fly a slightly wrong simulator until its errors compound. Learn to drive from dashcam logs alone and feel distribution shift. Let two people negotiate a doorway while both are still learning. Explore a new city with a curiosity bonus, then get trapped by a noisy television. Judge a restaurant from ten visits and learn why one seed is not a result.

What you can do
- Eight units: policy gradient theory, advantage estimation and trust regions, actor-critic and continuous control, model-based RL, offline RL, multi-agent RL, exploration, and evaluation and reproducibility.
- Eight on-device labs. Every number on screen comes from the actual formula, so changing a slider changes the world and the equation together.
- Tap any symbol to light up what it is in the picture.
- Lab questions are computed from the settings you chose, and every answer has a worked reason.
- Short sessions of three to eight minutes, gentle replay of misses, and a clear good place to stop.
- Large text from 85 to 200 percent, calm motion, and labels for screen readers.
- Works offline. No account.

Sources you can open
Every claim is tied to primary papers and course pages such as trust region and proximal policy optimization, deep Q-networks, soft actor-critic, DDPG and TD3, Dyna, MuZero and Dreamer, conservative Q-learning and the offline RL tutorial, QMIX and MADDPG, random network distillation, and statistical reporting for RL. Tap a source to read it in a page that covers most of the screen, then go back to exactly where you were. Each source was opened and checked on 2026-11-17.

Free to use, with ads at natural breaks only, never during a lab or a quiz. Watch a short video to earn credits that skip break ads, or subscribe monthly to remove ads, with a 7-day free trial and cancellation at any time.

This course is original work and is not affiliated with any university whose public course pages are cited.

name: Adventik: 31 уютный вечер
description:
Adventik — 31 вечер новогоднего настроения для всей семьи.

Каждый день декабря в полночь открывается новая дверца календаря. Внутри — фильм для уютного вечера и рецепт блюда. Приложение помогает выбрать кино, приготовить ужин и создать свою семейную традицию.

• В будни — быстрые блюда из доступных продуктов и семейное кино после работы.
• В выходные — выпечка, праздничные блюда и кулинарные проекты для совместной готовки.
• Необязательный опрос помогает подобрать фильмы под вашу семью.
• Режим готовки с крупными шагами и таймерами — удобно на кухне.
• Список покупок из рецептов: отмечайте продукты, меняйте количество, копируйте и делитесь списком.
• «Как проведём вечер?» — приготовьте сами, купите ингредиенты или найдите похожее готовое блюдо в службе доставки.
• «Собери свой уют» — наряжайте виртуальную ёлку и узнавайте новогодние традиции разных стран.
• Делитесь открытыми вечерами: на красивой карточке будут фильм и блюдо.
• Включите напоминания о новых дверцах в удобное время.

До 1 декабря работает демо-режим: попробуйте карточки, рецепты и приготовление, не раскрывая будущие вечера.

Без регистрации, рекламы и встроенных покупок. Имя, телефон и e-mail для использования приложения не нужны. Фильмы внутри приложения не воспроизводятся: смотрите их на легальных платформах или в домашней коллекции.

name: AeroStudy Pilot
description:
Study for your FAA knowledge test in the time you actually have.

AeroStudy Pilot puts the full question bank — private, instrument, commercial, flight instructor, ATP and more — in your pocket, with every figure you need to answer them. No account, no subscription, no connection required. Open it at the airport, in the hold short line, on a layover.

TEN MINUTES IS ENOUGH
Start a quick quiz and get ten questions with instant feedback. Leave it half finished and it picks up where you left off.

THE FIGURES, FULL SCREEN
Performance charts, sectionals and approach plates come straight from the FAA's own testing supplements. Tap one to open it full screen: pinch to zoom, drag to pan, and turn a sideways chart upright with one button — no twisting the phone.

KNOW WHY, NOT JUST WHAT
Every answer comes with an explanation drawn from the FAA handbooks and regulations, with the source named, so you learn the concept instead of memorizing a letter.

PRACTICE THE WAY YOU THINK
• Topic quiz — one subject at a time
• Practice exam — real question counts and the clock
• Voice tutor — answer out loud; your phone transcribes and compares, nothing is recorded or uploaded
• Focus practice — a set built from the questions you keep missing

TURN A REAL TEST RESULT INTO A PLAN
Import a photo or PDF of your knowledge test report. The app reads the codes on your device and builds practice for exactly those gaps.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Questions, figures and your progress ship inside the app. No sign-in, no analytics, no tracking, nothing sent anywhere. It works in airplane mode and it will keep working years from now.

TRY IT FIRST
The first 50 questions of every subject are free. One payment unlocks the rest — forever, on every device signed in to your Apple Account. No subscription.

Practice material only. AeroStudy is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FAA, and it does not replace your instructor or the current regulations.

name: Aerqor Vision
description:
Aerqor Vision puts your drone deteciton picture in your pocket. The app connects to the Aerqor Vision console your agency operates and shows, in real time, every drone its sensors are tracking: position, altitude, speed, heading, the pilot's location when Remote ID broadcasts it, and the make, model and serial where they can be identified.

LIVE MAP
See every track on a map of your county, with restricted zones, sensor-node coverage and the controller's position. Tap a drone for its full identification and flight details, follow it as it moves, and open its replay in the console.

ALERTS ON YOUR PHONE
When a drone enters a restricted zone, matches a watchlist serial, or breaks a rule your agency set, the server pages your phone. High and critical alerts are time-sensitive, so they can reach you through Focus. Acknowledge straight from the notification, snooze, or dismiss false alarms; every action is logged in the console's audit trail.

SENSOR HEALTH
Check that each sensor node is online, see its temperature, load and the reports it refused, and send a test drone through the whole pipeline to prove the alert path end to end.

BUILT FOR AGENCIES
Sign in with the account your administrator issued, including authenticator codes where required. Roles decide what you can do: viewers watch, operators act, administrators manage. Nothing is collected beyond your username, and no data is sold or shared.

Aerqor Vision is detection and identification only. It does not interfere with, disable or take control of any aircraft.

An Aerqor Vision console operated by your agency or commercial facility is required. Visit aerqor.vision to learn more.

name: Afterimage: The Echoes of Time
description:
You wake beneath the arches of a moonlit cathedral. There’s a door ahead and another body standing on the ceiling. It has your face. It hasn’t opened its eyes. You step onto a stone plate. Somewhere overhead, a mechanism stirs. The instant you step off, it falls silent. To find out what you’ve opened, you’ll have to leave your body right where it stands. Above you, the other body opens its eyes.

The cathedral turns.

In Afterimage: Echoes of Time, you play one soul that can pass between bodies called Echoes. Each sees the world from a different side. The ledge you couldn’t reach a moment ago is now beneath your feet. A lift you need might only move while another Echo holds it in place. Before you change bodies, look closely at what you’re leaving behind. It might be the only thing keeping your next route open.

Beyond the cathedral, the Glassworks glows amber. Farther on, the Tidal Archive and the Storm Citadel ask you to read unfamiliar spaces before you make your move. Some rooms give you time to stand still and listen. In others, you’ll learn the rhythm of a creature’s patrol and jump in the instant it turns away. Across six worlds, finding a route is only half the puzzle. You still have to get there.

Then there are the Memories. You’ll catch their light around a corner or on the far side of a passage you thought led nowhere. Follow it and an old room may have something new to show you. Find every Memory in a world and a hidden chamber opens. You won’t always leave a room in the body you entered it with.

Sometimes the only way forward is to leave yourself behind.

name: AgeGrid: Life in Weeks
description:
AgeGrid turns your life into a simple grid of weeks, so you can see your time clearly and spend it on what matters.

Enter your date of birth and choose a lifespan. AgeGrid shows every week of your life as a square: the weeks you have lived, the week you are in now, and the weeks still ahead.

WHAT YOU GET
• Life calendar – every week of your life on one interactive grid
• Exact age – years, months and days, plus total days and weeks lived
• Birthday countdown – days until your next birthday and the age you will turn
• Year progress – how much of this year has already passed
• Milestones – mark the moments that shaped you and see them on your grid
• Goals – set target dates for what you want to make time for
• Gentle reminders – optional daily, weekly, monthly, birthday and New Year nudges
• Light and dark themes, large-text friendly, tablet layout

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. No internet needed. Your data never leaves your device.

ACCURATE DATES
Real calendar maths: leap years, February 29 birthdays and month ends are handled correctly.

The lifespan you choose is a personal perspective, not a medical prediction.

name: AirMon by Ramen
description:
AirMon is the field app for networks built and run with Ramen: private Cellular access points, point-to-point radios and Ramen Rescuer boxes. Installers and engineers use it on site to set up equipment, check that it works, and fix problems before they leave.

You need an AirMon account from Ramen or your network provider to sign in.

AT THE SITE

• A map of the site with every device on it
• Checks for each pole: names, addresses and links, with fixes you can apply there and then

INSTALL AND SET UP

• Step-by-step help installing a new access point, from power-on to on air

CHECK AND FIX

• Ask questions about your sites in plain words
• Raise a support ticket with your connection details and position attached

STAY ON TOP
• Alerts when access points at your sites go down
• A short summary of your sites each morning
• Unlock with Face ID

name: Alarm Chain: Wake Up Alarm
description:
Can't get up with a single alarm? Tired of setting ten alarms in a row and turning them off one by one every morning?

Alarm Chain is made for that. Instead of one alarm, you set a short chain of backup alarms a few minutes apart. The moment you tap "I'm up", the rest of that morning's alarms are cancelled. Next morning, the chain is ready again on its own.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick your first alarm time, how many backups you want, and the gap between them (1 to 15 minutes).
• When the alarm rings: "I'm up" or "Sleep a bit more". If you sleep a bit more, the next alarm in the chain wakes you again.
• Once you're up, the remaining alarms for that morning stay silent. The chain is rebuilt for the next day.

WAKE UP YOUR WAY
• Choose from five calm alarm sounds or use your own sound file.
• Gentle start: the first alarm of the chain starts softly and gets louder; the backups ring at full volume.
• A different time for each day: sleep in on Fridays without a second chain.
• Optional wake-up task: solve a few quick math questions before your morning counts.

STREAKS, POINTS AND A WIDGET
• The earlier you get up, the more points you earn: every alarm you skip counts.
• The days you woke up link together on a calendar, so your chain keeps growing.
• Home screen and Lock Screen widget: your next alarm and your streak at a glance.
• Bedtime reminder: get a nudge to go to bed in time for the sleep you want.

YOUR ROUTINE
• Separate chains for weekdays and weekends.
• Day off? "Skip tomorrow" turns off just that one morning.
• Rings even when your phone is on silent (built on iOS AlarmKit).

12 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Hindi. The app follows your phone's language.

PRIVACY
No account, no server, no ads, no tracking. All data stays on your phone.

Requires iOS 26 or later.

description:
Di «hola». Suena «aloh».

MODO LIBRE

HECHO CON CARIÑO

Perfecto para cenas, viajes, fiestas y sobremesas. Descarga Aloh y descubre quién de tus amigos habla mejor al revés.

name: Âm Lịch - Lunar Calendar
description:
The lunar calendar, read from the moon.

Âm Lịch is a Vietnamese lunar calendar for iPhone and iPad. Open it and see today's lunar date, whether the moon is waxing or full, and how long until your family's next death anniversary.

TWO CALENDARS, ONE SCREEN
• Today: the moon in its real phase; turn the dial to move through the days.
• Month: every day shows both the solar and the lunar date; the 1st, the full moon and holidays are marked.
• Year: the whole year on two rings, solar and lunar, leap months included.

YOUR FAMILY'S DAYS, REMEMBERED

• Grouped as Our family, Dad's side and Mom's side, with a countdown.
• Up to two reminders per date, for example 7 days and 1 day before, at the time you choose.

AND THE SMALL THINGS
• Widgets: six for the home screen and four for the lock screen (iOS 17 or later).
• Vietnamese holidays: lunar festivals, public holidays with the Tết break, commemoration days. Turn them on or off.
• English and Vietnamese, for the whole family, including relatives abroad.
• Light and dark, three accent colours: Vermilion, Indigo and Turmeric.
• Layouts made for iPhone, iPad portrait and iPad landscape.

ACCURATE AND HONEST
• Lunar dates follow Vietnam time (UTC+7), like the wall calendar at home, even when you live abroad.
• Ho Ngoc Duc's algorithm, leap months included; the first day of every lunar month is checked from 1900 to 2100.
• No ads, no horoscopes, no lucky hours, no good or bad days. The year's can chi is just a name.
• Your data stays on your device. No account, no server sync, no data collected.

name: Amoghkti Vault
description:
Amoghkti Vault is a real file manager and an encrypted vault in one app — built for people who keep their whole life on their phone.

FILES, THE WAY A FILE MANAGER SHOULD WORK
• Copy, cut, paste, move, rename, select all, folders, recents and a recycle bin.
• Everything in the Files tab is also visible in the iOS Files app.
• Images and Videos open your iPhone library first, with a switch to the files kept in the app.
• Link folders from iCloud Drive, On My iPhone, Google Drive or a USB drive and copy from them in one tap.
• "Save to Amoghkti Vault" appears in the share sheet of WhatsApp, Mail, Safari and Files.

YOUR PHOTOS, LIVE FROM THE LIBRARY
• Your whole iPhone library — iCloud Photos included — as a live timeline, albums and a Places map, straight from Photos; nothing is copied until you save it.
• Your albums inside the app with WhatsApp, Telegram and Camera on top.
• Multi-select and save to the vault or Files; remove the originals from Photos only when you confirm.

THE VAULT
• AES-256-GCM encryption, keys in the iOS Keychain, PIN or Face ID / Touch ID.
• Face ID that fails twice switches to PIN only — nothing opens without you.
• Locks the moment you leave: Control Center, App Switcher, incoming calls, a shake of the phone.
• Secret Camera and document scanner save straight into the vault — never into Photos.
• Privacy shield hides the app in the App Switcher; screen recording is detected.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR PHONE
• No user accounts, no analytics, no advertising SDKs, no server of ours.
• The only cloud is your own Google Drive (Pro), where files arrive already encrypted with random names.

AMOGHKTI VAULT PRO (in-app purchase)
Everything above is free, forever. Pro adds:
• Encrypted Google Drive backup — a new iPhone restores on its own through iCloud Keychain, no key typing (Recovery Key as fallback).
• Auto-collect — new WhatsApp, Telegram and camera media lands in the vault automatically, and watched Files-app folders (iCloud Drive, On My iPhone, a USB drive) import new files the same way, sub-folders kept.
• Private Search — on-device OCR finds photos, scans and PDFs by the text inside them.
• Decoy vault — a second PIN opens a harmless fake vault if you are ever forced to unlock.
• Intruder alerts — a quiet front-camera photo of anyone who fails the PIN or Face ID.
• Stealth icons and Secure Share (send files as a locked bundle with a one-time code).

Pro is a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or a one-time Lifetime purchase; current prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions are charged to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage them in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Restoring an existing backup never requires Pro.

Made in Odisha, India by Amoghkti Consultancy.

name: Anchor Cards: AI Flashcards
description:
Anchor Cards is a spaced repetition app you work through with an AI assistant. The assistant writes the material; you review it; the app does nothing but quiz you. It ships with no built-in cards.

Your cards are Markdown files, kept in your own GitHub repository. The app reads them, quizzes you, and writes back only your study log. Cards never live inside the app, so you can always edit them in your usual editor or AI assistant.

■ It teaches, you review

Just tell your AI assistant what you want to study, and it writes the cards on the spot and puts them where you keep them. The app has no screen for creating cards, so there is nothing in it to break.

Material is never finished when it is written. Spot a wrong explanation while reviewing, have the assistant fix it, and go back to reviewing the corrected card. That loop runs without ever closing the app.

■ Your Markdown is the source of truth

Write two lines at the top of a Markdown file — `id` and `deck` — and it becomes reviewable. Put the file anywhere, name it anything.

No export feature is needed: the files were already Markdown. Uninstall the app and your cards stay where they were.

■ Stop copying the same definition onto ten cards

Copy one definition onto ten cards, and every change means ten edits — one of which always stays stale.

Here the full text lives on a single definition card, and other cards reference it with `[[id]]`. At review time the app inlines the referenced card's back, so it still reads as one card. The stored text never changes; you only ever edit the one definition card.

■ Hand a card straight to your AI assistant

Mid-review, if an explanation looks off, copy the card's stable ID with one tap — that alone lets your assistant find it. Copy up to ten difficult cards at once, or hand over everything you struggled with right after a session.

Place your AI assistant beside the app in Split View on iPad or Mac, and just paste. The app never writes cards itself.

■ Read the fix inside the app

When your assistant proposes the fix as a pull request, the Changes tab renders that card **exactly as it will be quizzed** — not a diff, but the corrected text itself, so you can decide whether to merge right there.

Leave it open and it updates as new commits arrive, and a definition added in the same pull request is expanded too.

Every sync also writes a ranking of your weak cards back, so your AI assistant can see what you're struggling with.

■ Review intervals from FSRS

Reviews are scheduled with FSRS (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler): cards you know well come back less often, shaky ones sooner. Read-aloud for both faces can be turned on in Settings (off by default).

■ Getting started

On first launch it runs on three bundled sample cards — enough to try the whole flow.

Keep your own cards in a GitHub repository: tap "Connect to GitHub," sign in, pick a repository. Your Git history becomes your study history. An AI agent that can read and write the repository can take it from writing the cards all the way to committing them.

No account required.

■ Your keys, your privacy

Your GitHub token and Anchor Cloud key are stored only in the device's Keychain. Cards sync only to the GitHub repository or Anchor Cloud you chose. If you sign in with email, we never store the address itself — only a hash used to match it. The app talks to the App Store and our billing backend (RevenueCat) only to process an Anchor Pro purchase, and it does not track your behavior.

■ Anchor Pro (optional, one-time purchase)

Every feature works for free. The only difference is how many new cards you can start per day (20 for free). Anchor Pro removes that limit instantly — a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

■ What you need

・A place for your cards: a GitHub repository (private is fine)
・One card per file (put it anywhere, name it anything)
・iPhone or iPad (supports iPadOS Split View)

name: Angle Cut Guide
description:
For cutting gutters, curbs, blocks and timber at an angle.
Measure the cut angle and read the cut length.

■ Two ways to measure
・Camera: shoot the material and line up the guide
・Touch (hold to measure): just hold the phone against the material. It does not use a compass, so rebar and steel do not affect it
・You can measure both ways and compare the difference

■ How to use (follow the numbers on the screen)
① Choose the cut (join two pieces / join to a surface)
② Enter the material width (mm or inches)
③ Choose how to measure (Camera / Touch)
④–⑥ Measure the angle by following the numbers at the top left of the drawing
・Camera: ④ tap “Camera” → ⑤ put the vertex on the corner and tap “Freeze” → ⑥ match the lines to the edges
・Touch: ④ hold on one side of the angle and tap “Set base” → ⑤ hold on the other side and tap “Set” → ⑥ read the cut length

■ Tools
・Frames & polygons: miter angles for 4, 6, 8 sides and cutting from stock
・Curves: the opening angle and cut length when joining straight pieces along a curve. No radius needed — enter the span and the bulge
・Joints: the joint gaps (outer and inner) and how many pieces fit when setting along a curve without cutting
・Setting check: verify each piece against the string, one by one

■ Also
・Automatic offset for chamfers and a narrower bottom face
・Full screen and pinch zoom for fine alignment
・A round level shows the phone tilt; freeze the screen to line things up slowly
・Readable in sunlight (brightness control, high contrast and mono)
・Save the materials you use often
・Save measurements with a note; export to CSV or a backup
・Measure from a photo you already took
・Lock the screen orientation

■ On site
・Works even where there is no signal
・6 languages (Japanese, English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Portuguese, Filipino)

■ About ads
A one-time “Remove ads” purchase hides the ads.

■ Please note
・Leave a few mm of margin when marking, and adjust with the joints after cutting
・Angles have some error (how the camera sees it, the phone tilt, drift over time). Confirm anything critical on the material itself

name: Antimony Opie
description:
Antimony Opie is a polyphonic virtual analog synthesizer for Mac and iPad. Play it as an app, or open it as an Audio Unit inside Logic Pro, GarageBand and other hosts.

Every voice has two oscillators, two filters, four envelopes and three LFOs, and the whole instrument fits on one screen. The signal path is drawn as it sounds: click any block to edit it, and watch envelopes, LFOs and filter curves move as you play.

THE VOICE
• Two oscillators with saw, triangle and pulse, hard sync, ring modulation and FM
• A 4-pole ladder lowpass and a 2-pole multimode filter, in parallel or series
• Up to twelve voices in Poly, Rotate, Unison or Stack, with analog drift between them

MODULATION YOU CAN SEE
• Four envelopes and three LFOs, each drawn live
• A twelve-slot matrix: drag a card onto a block to make it move

PERFORMANCE
• Arpeggiator with five patterns over up to four octaves, gate and latch
• Stereo ensemble chorus and a tempo-synced delay with ping-pong
• Part B layers a second sound, or splits the keyboard for a bass under a lead
• Follows Logic's tempo, or MIDI clock from outside gear

SOUNDS
• 70 factory sounds: basses, brass, keys, leads, pads, strings, bells, drums, motion and effects
• Level-matched and searchable; save your own, and find them in the app and the plug-in alike

PRIVACY
Antimony Opie collects nothing and makes no network connections.

One purchase gives you Antimony Opie on both Mac and iPad.

name: App Ẩm Thực
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
App Ẩm Thực là ứng dụng đi kèm phần mềm quản lý quán app.am-thuc.com, dành cho chủ quán, quản lý và nhân viên của các quán ăn, nhà hàng, quán cà phê đang dùng phần mềm.

ĐƠN KHÁCH CHỜ SOÁT
Khách quét mã QR tại bàn gọi món hoặc đặt mang về: đơn hiện ngay ở đầu màn hình chính để nhân viên soát và gửi bếp. Có thông báo đẩy khi có đơn mới.

HÔM NAY CỦA QUÁN
Doanh thu đã thu, số đơn đang phục vụ, món bếp đang làm, đặt bàn hôm nay, nguyên liệu sắp hết — chạm vào là mở danh sách chi tiết. Mất mạng vẫn xem được bản lưu gần nhất.

MÁY BÁN HÀNG VÀ MÀN BẾP
Mở máy bán hàng (POS), màn hình bếp, sổ đặt bàn, kho, báo cáo ngay trong app theo đúng quyền của từng người.

BÁO CÁO CUỐI NGÀY
Gửi số liệu trong ngày cho chủ quán qua Zalo, Messenger bằng bảng chia sẻ của iPhone.

Tài khoản do quán cấp. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong app: Tôi → Xoá tài khoản.

name: App GPS: rastreo vehicular
description:
App GPS te muestra en el mapa dónde están tus vehículos, en tiempo real, desde el teléfono o el computador. Funciona con los equipos GPS instalados en carros, motos, camionetas, camiones y maquinaria.

EN EL MAPA
• Cada vehículo con su propio ícono y color, su velocidad y si está encendido o apagado.
• Toca uno y el mapa lo sigue, con la línea de lo que ha recorrido hoy.
• Abre su ubicación en Google Maps o Waze con un toque.
• Elige el tipo de mapa: oscuro, calles o satélite.

RECORRIDOS
• Mira el recorrido de hoy, de ayer o de cualquier fecha y reprodúcelo como un video.
• Ve dónde paró, cuánto tiempo y la dirección del lugar.
• Compara el recorrido de dos vehículos en el mismo mapa.

ALERTAS EN TU TELÉFONO
• Exceso de velocidad, con el límite que tú pongas para cada vehículo.
• Encendido fuera de horario, por ejemplo en la noche.
• Equipo GPS desconectado o batería del carro baja.
• Llegada o salida de tus lugares guardados, como la casa o el trabajo.
• Pico y placa: la noche anterior te avisamos si tu vehículo no puede circular mañana.

TUS VEHÍCULOS
• Foto, placa, documentos y fechas de vencimiento como SOAT y revisión técnico-mecánica.
• Recordatorios de mantenimiento.
• Tanqueadas y gastos, con el costo por kilómetro de cada vehículo.
• Resumen semanal: kilómetros, horas en movimiento, paradas y excesos de velocidad.

COMPARTIR
• Comparte un vehículo con tu familia o tu equipo de trabajo y decide qué puede hacer cada persona.
• Envía un enlace de ubicación que vence solo, en 1 hora o 1 día, para que alguien sin la app vea por dónde viene el vehículo.
• Los administradores invitan personas por WhatsApp con un enlace.

VIAJES EN GRUPO
• Crea un viaje, comparte el código y vean todos dónde va cada uno en el mismo mapa.
• Escribe al grupo o envía notas de voz.
• Tu ubicación se comparte solo durante el viaje y solo mientras tú lo decides.

PRIVACIDAD
La app solo usa la ubicación de tu teléfono cuando tú lo pides: para guardar un lugar o para compartirla en un viaje en grupo. No hay publicidad. Puedes eliminar tu cuenta y tus datos cuando quieras desde tu perfil.

App GPS es un servicio de Code4bi. Para usarla necesitas una cuenta; los vehículos aparecen cuando tienen un equipo GPS compatible asignado o cuando alguien los comparte contigo.

Disponible para iPhone, iPad y Mac. Las notificaciones del teléfono y la ubicación en segundo plano dependen de los permisos y del dispositivo. La versión de Mac integra navegación, archivos y descargas; no usa ubicación del equipo en segundo plano.

Debes ser mayor de 18 años según los términos del servicio.

name: App Quản Lý
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
App Quản Lý là ứng dụng đi kèm phần mềm quản lý cửa hàng my.appquanly.com, dành cho chủ cửa hàng và nhân viên của các cửa hàng đang dùng phần mềm: spa, salon, phòng khám, trung tâm học thêm, cửa hàng bán lẻ, garage, nhà trọ, xưởng nhỏ…

HÔM NAY TRÊN MỘT MÀN HÌNH
Mở app là thấy doanh thu, số đơn, thu – chi trong ngày, khách đang nợ, hàng sắp hết, lịch hẹn và việc được giao cho bạn. Mỗi con số chạm vào là mở ra danh sách làm nên nó. Mất mạng vẫn xem được bản lưu gần nhất.

BÁN HÀNG, LỊCH HẸN, THU CHI
Tạo đơn bán, ghi công nợ, đặt lịch cho khách, ghi phiếu thu chi ngay trên điện thoại. Sổ sách tự ghi theo từng nghiệp vụ.

THÔNG BÁO KỊP LÚC
Bật thông báo để biết ngay khi khách tự đặt lịch trên trang cửa hàng, khi được giao việc mới, hay khi sắp tới giờ hẹn.

GỬI BÁO CÁO MỘT CHẠM
Gửi báo cáo trong ngày qua Zalo, Messenger, Tin nhắn bằng bảng chia sẻ của iPhone.

ĐÚNG VAI, ĐÚNG QUYỀN
Mỗi nhân viên chỉ thấy phần được chủ cửa hàng mở quyền. Một người làm ở nhiều cửa hàng có thể đổi cửa hàng ngay trong app.
