name: AppBell: App Sales & Revenue
description:
AppBell rings for every in-app purchase and subscription of your apps, the moment Apple records it. A minimal dashboard and widgets show how your day is going.

NO SDK. NO CODE. NO ACCOUNT.
• Paste one URL in App Store Connect (App Information › App Store Server Notifications). That's the whole setup.
• Works right away for every app, including versions already live. Nothing to integrate, no update to ship, no API key to hand over.
• Purchases, new subscriptions, renewals, cancellations, billing issues, refunds, Family Sharing and offer codes.

SEE HOW YOUR DAY IS GOING
• Today, 7 days and 30 days: customer prices including tax, refunds deducted, converted to your currency.
• Touch the chart to read any day. 90 days and a full year of history with Pro.
• Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.

YOU CHOOSE WHAT RINGS
• Turn each event type on or off, include Sandbox test purchases or not, show the amount in notifications, pick the "Ka-ching" sound.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your sales pass through the AppBell server without being stored, and nothing is linked to you. All the data stays on your iPhone.

FREE FOR ONE APP
AppBell Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks every app, the full history, chart widgets, the currency of your choice and product renaming. Shared with your family.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Apple sends these notifications for in-app purchases and subscriptions. Paid-app downloads and free downloads are not included.
• Amounts are what customers paid, before Apple's commission and taxes.
• Apple allows one notification URL per app. If a service such as a subscription platform already uses it, AppBell would replace it.

name: ApplyMyResume - Job Search
description:
ApplyMyResume applies to jobs for you.

Upload your resume and tell us the jobs you want and where you want to work. Our team finds matching U.S. openings and submits the applications on employer sites. Employers reply straight to your email, and the app shows every place we applied.

HOW IT WORKS
• Upload your resume (PDF or Word). We suggest job titles and places from it.
• Add the cities you want, or choose remote.
• Set how you like to work: commute distance, job type, pay and companies you'd like or want to avoid.
• Claim your 5 free applications, choose how many to send, and we start applying for you.

YOU'RE IN CONTROL
Start sending, send more or stop at any time. Applications you haven't sent stay saved for later.

GET MORE APPLICATIONS
Buy a pack of 50, 150 or 500 applications. Each pack is a one-time purchase with no subscription. Have an offer code? Redeem it from your account.

IN THE APP
• How many applications are sent, on the way and saved
• Every company and role we applied to, with a link to the posting
• Your job titles, places, preferences and resume, which you can change any time
• Optional Sign in with Apple or Google to keep your account on a new phone

ApplyMyResume is for job seekers who live in the United States and applies to U.S. roles.

Terms: https://applymyresume.com/terms
Privacy: https://applymyresume.com/privacy

name: Apron Buddy
description:
Your Complete Kitchen Companion
Every recipe, synced across iPhone, iPad, Mac & Watch.

Keep family favorites, web finds, and weeknight staples together in a searchable recipe library. Apron Buddy helps you bring recipes in, make them your own, plan what to cook, and follow each step in the kitchen.

Scan Any Cookbook Page
Turn printed pages and magazines into digital recipes in seconds.
Capture one page or several with your camera. Apron Buddy reads the recipe so you can review and edit the ingredients and instructions before saving.

Clip From the Web & PDFs
Skip the clutter—save just the ingredients and steps.
Import a recipe from a website, PDF, text document, or recipe image. Batch import a folder of files, then review each recipe as it is added.

Cook Hands-Free
Follow steps and run timers right from your Apple Watch.
Use step-by-step cooking mode on iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Start recipe timers from the instructions and continue cooking with the paired Apple Watch.

Plan Meals in Minutes
Build your weekly menu and auto-generate your grocery list.
Make a meal plan around your schedule, special occasions, and food preferences. Start with your own recipes, choose how many people are eating, and plan for leftovers. Generate a grocery list grouped by category, keep it in Apron Buddy, or add items to a Reminders list.

MAKE YOUR RECIPE LIBRARY YOURS
Create cookbooks, search and filter recipes, and add recipes to a cookbook from the recipe card. Rate and favorite dishes, write personal notes, save photos of the finished meal, and print recipes when you want a paper copy. Share a recipe or cookbook with others through iCloud.

ADJUST AS YOU COOK
Scale ingredient amounts when servings change and convert between measurement units. Edit imported recipes so the saved version matches the way you cook.

YOUR APPLE DEVICES, IN SYNC
Use Apron Buddy on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. With iCloud enabled, your recipes and cookbooks stay in sync across your devices, ready for planning or cooking.

name: Aqua Breeder: Axolotl Tank
description:
A breeder's day that starts with one tiny aquarium in your hand.
Aqua Breeder is a cozy breeding game where you raise axolotls, dwarf shrimp and guppies, breed them, and collect varieties and patterns.

A Dex of 60 varieties
19 axolotls, 20 shrimp and 21 guppies — from leucistic and golden albino to blue dream and full platinum. Start with common ones and reach the rarest varieties through breeding alone.

Every one has its own pattern
Even within one variety, each pattern is one of 10,000 numbers. When a juvenile's pattern appears, keep it on its certificate. Glow stamps in different colors and rare gem patterns are waiting too.

Parents you choose, the next generation
Read even the hidden genes, pick a pair, and watch the fry grow in the brood tank. The gene helper and Punnett square show which varieties can appear.

Every plant and stone, placed your way
Drag 60 decorations — plants, driftwood, stones and caves — anywhere on the floor. Place a cave and your axolotl slips inside to rest. Choose backdrops, substrates and lighting too.

Take a closer look
Follow one up close, choose a companion, and hand-feed it with tweezers. Feed and change the water, and everyone grows up healthy.

Lock Screen brood tank
Each brood tank's countdown and picture, right on your Lock Screen

Link an account to keep raising the same tank on another device.

name: Aquarium Manager: Tank Control
description:
Aquarium Manager controls your aquarium lights, dosing pumps, heater and magnetic stirrer directly over Bluetooth. No account, no cloud, no hub: your phone talks to your equipment.

LIGHTS
• Scenes with sunrise and sunset ramps, up to seven periods with their own weekdays
• Manual levels with live sliders: the light follows your finger
• Fan, overheat protection and indicator light on supported models
• Schedules are stored on the light and keep running without your phone

DOSING
• Per-head schedules with weekdays and daily totals
• Built-in safety limits per dose, per day and for manual doses
• Calibration wizard with a test dose
• Container tracking: enter the volume when you refill, and see what's left and how many days it will last
• Low and empty container alerts
• A log of every manual dose

HEATER
• Target temperature and an overheat cut-off stored on the heater itself
• Live temperature and chart
• Failsafe: if the water stays too hot, the app drops the target and keeps it there until you check the tank
• Heater alarms, display unit, backlight and sensor calibration

STIRRER
• Timed stir runs per channel with speed, pre-stir and weekdays
• Stir now with a timer

ALERTS
Notifications for a heater that's too hot or too cold, stops reporting, or raises an alarm, and for dosing containers running low.

Edits go to your equipment automatically, and anything changed while you're out of range is sent the next time you're back.

Try the built-in demo to explore every screen without equipment.

Works with Chihiros-compatible Bluetooth lights (WRGB II, WRGB II Pro and Slim, Universal WRGB, VIVID series, A II, C II, Commander and more), dosing pumps, Heater Pro and magnetic stirrers. Aquarium Manager is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Chihiros.

name: Arbor Key
description:
Stopwork records one winding of a clock barrel.

Name the clock and how many turns that barrel takes from slack to the stopwork. Drag the key onto the square. Then drag the bow toward the reading end, once for each turn. At the count you wrote, the stopwork rises and the pin blocks another drag. Keep that winding on this iPhone. Open it later to see the clock name, the turns, and the time you kept it.

The list starts empty. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account and no file to share. What you keep stays on this phone.

name: Arrose la serre
description:
Tourne les tuyaux pour amener l’eau du robinet à chaque plante sans perdre une goutte. Quand le circuit est prêt, la serre fleurit.

Commence avec un robinet et un pot. Au fil des 100 niveaux, apprends à régler les vannes, à contourner les tuyaux fissurés et à faire passer deux conduites au même croisement. Les plus grands réseaux alimentent jusqu’à sept plantes à partir de trois robinets.

Certains niveaux te donnent un nombre limité de coups. Dans d’autres, le chrono tourne pendant que tu cherches le bon chemin. Rejoue les niveaux débloqués et affine tes solutions pour récolter les 300 étoiles de la campagne.

Fonctionnalités

- 100 niveaux répartis dans 11 zones de la serre.
- Tuyaux rotatifs, vannes, conduites fissurées et croisements.
- Défis limités en coups ou au chronomètre.
- 300 étoiles à gagner au fil de la campagne.

name: Arrow Cascade: Color Puzzle
description:
Tap one arrow. Watch the whole color fly.

Arrow Cascade is a cozy arrow-escape puzzle with a twist. Tap an arrow and it slides out of the board like a ribbon being pulled. If it is a colored arrow, every other arrow of the same color that has a clear path follows it out, one after another. Tap the wrong one and it bumps into something and you lose a heart. Clear the board to win.

EASY TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO PLAY
• Gray arrows fly one at a time. Colored arrows pull their color along. Arrows that are still blocked stay where they are.
• Which color do you tap first? Plan your taps to clear the board in the fewest moves and earn three stars.
• Later levels add double-headed arrows, locks and keys, and big silhouette boards shaped like hearts, cats and stars.
• Every level can be solved: they are generated and checked by a solver.

1000 LEVELS, NO TIMER
• 20 chapters of 50 levels, from tiny 4-arrow boards to big boards you can clear in one long chain.
• A new Daily Challenge every day, the same board for everyone.
• Think as long as you like. Plays offline.
• Color-blind friendly: each color has its own arrow-tip shape, and a high-contrast mode is in Settings.

HINTS WHEN YOU WANT THEM
• Stuck? A hint highlights the arrows you can tap right now and points to a good one.
• Boosters (hint, scissors, rainbow) are optional helpers. You never have to buy anything to play.

FREE TO PLAY
Arrow Cascade is free, with optional ads. You can watch a short ad to continue after losing your hearts or to earn a booster. In-app purchases are optional: a coin pouch, a one-time starter pack and Remove Ads (removes the ads between levels; ads you choose to watch for rewards stay available). Nothing in the game requires a purchase to finish.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: Arrow Duel
description:
This is not another calm, pleasant little puzzle game.

Arrow Duel is a race. Two players. One board. Every arrow belongs to whoever gets to it first.

IT WAKES YOU UP
Tap an arrow and it shoots off the board, as long as its path is clear. Simple. Now do it while someone else is hunting the very same arrows, on the very same board, at the very same second. You will sit up straighter. You will stop blinking. This is the game you open when you want to feel sharp, fresh and wide awake.

ONE BOARD, SHARED LIVE
You are not racing on separate copies. You are both staring at the same glowing board. See an opening? So did your rival. Hesitate for half a second and the arrow you wanted is gone, with a flash of "Taken!" to rub it in.

NEXT TO YOU OR MILES AWAY
Play the person on the couch beside you, or a friend on the other side of the planet. The excitement, the tension and the trash talk are exactly the same. Send a link, they tap it, and you are in a game. Or hit "Find an opponent" and take on whoever is ready right now.

FAST IS NOT ENOUGH
Tap an arrow that is blocked and you take a strike. Three strikes and you are out. Speed wins the duel, but only if you can still think clearly while your heart is pounding.

EVERY RIVALRY KEEPS SCORE
Arrow Duel remembers your record against each player you meet. Win, and they will want a rematch. Lose, and so will you.

TRAIN BETWEEN DUELS
Warm up against Robo, the practice opponent, at five levels from gentle to merciless. Then lose yourself in an endless solo campaign that travels through world after world, with boards that grow bigger and trickier the further you go.

A BOARD YOU WANT TO TOUCH
Neon arrows that glow on dark glass. Colours that shift from world to world. Crisp sounds and haptics on every tap. Arrow Duel is built to look as good as it feels.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
Play on the outer screen with the phone closed, or unfold it and play on the big one. Open it in the middle of a duel and the game carries on without missing a tap. Arrow Duel also plays on iPad and on Mac.

FAIR TO THE LAST ARROW
Every board is checked to be solvable before you ever see it. And if your connection drops or a call comes in mid-duel, you have 30 seconds to jump back in right where you left off.

One board. Two players. Go.

name: Arrow Maze Puzzle: Yarn Lines
description:
ARROW MAZE PUZZLE — FOLLOW THE THREAD, REVEAL THE ART!
A maze of colorful arrows. A world of soft yarn. A beautiful picture waiting to be revealed!
Welcome to Arrow Maze Puzzle, a charming casual puzzle game that brings together clever arrow challenges, cozy yarn crafts, and satisfying picture-making fun.
Follow the directions, untangle tricky paths, and discover the joy of turning every puzzle into a lovely stitched creation!

FIND THE PERFECT WAY OUT
Every arrow has its own direction, but not every path is clear!
Take a closer look at the board, find the arrows that can move freely, and tap them in the right order.
Watch out for blocked paths and tangled routes. One smart move can open the way for another!

TURN PUZZLES INTO STITCHED ART
There's more to every level than clearing arrows!
As you progress through each puzzle, discover beautiful patterns inspired by colorful yarn, knitting, and embroidery.
Enjoy the satisfying feeling of bringing charming handmade designs to life, one puzzle at a time.

RELAX YOUR MIND, CHALLENGE YOUR LOGIC
Easy to learn, fun to master!
Each level introduces interesting arrow arrangements that encourage you to observe, think ahead, and find creative solutions.
Whether you're taking a quick break or enjoying a longer session, every puzzle offers a relaxing and rewarding challenge.

DISCOVER YOUR COLLECTION
Complete puzzles and unlock delightful stitched pictures!
Explore colorful designs, grow your collection, and enjoy the cozy world of yarn-inspired artwork.
Every finished creation brings a fresh sense of accomplishment.

GAME FEATURES
• Creative arrow and yarn puzzle gameplay
• Simple, intuitive tap controls
• Colorful paths and clever maze challenges
• Satisfying puzzle-solving mechanics
• Beautiful knitted and embroidered art styles
• Charming pictures to unlock and collect
• Relaxing visuals and cozy atmosphere
• Engaging levels that challenge your thinking

A LITTLE PUZZLE, A LOT OF JOY!
Step into a soft and colorful world where every arrow leads to a new discovery.
Observe carefully, plan your moves, and enjoy the magic of turning tangled paths into beautiful stitched art.

READY TO UNRAVEL THE FUN?
Download Arrow Maze Puzzle today and start your cozy yarn puzzle adventure!

name: Art-ı Sanat
description:
Art-ı Sanat; şiirleri, şairleri, hikâyeleri ve kelime kökenlerini imece usulüyle bir araya getiren dijital edebiyat arşividir.

• Binlerce şiir ve hikâyeyi oku, beğen, kaydet
• Kendi şiirini ve yazını paylaş, kapak görseli ekle
• Kelimelerin kökenini keşfet, günün kelimesini sahiplen
• Zihin haritalarıyla edebiyatı görsel olarak takip et
• Günlük bülten: her gün bir şiir, kelime ve hikâye
• Yazarları takip et, yorum yap, bildirim al

Google veya Apple hesabınla saniyeler içinde giriş yap.

name: Ashes of Thornfield
description:
Ashes of Thornfield is a dark fantasy isometric action RPG in the spirit of the classic hack-and-slash games: fast combat, deep loot, and a long endgame. No account, no energy timers, no ads, nothing to buy. Play offline, or team up with friends online.

FOUR CLASSES, MANY BUILDS
• Warrior: sword and shield. Charge in, block, whirl and leap into the crowd.
• Mage: master one of four schools, Fire, Cold, Lightning or Poison. Each one plays like a different class.
• Necromancer: raise a skeleton army, detonate corpses and curse your enemies.
• Fighter: a martial artist who unleashes dragon spirits with every fist.

SKILLS THAT GROW AS YOU FIGHT
Skills level up only by hitting real monsters. Every 5 levels a skill reaches a new tier that changes how it looks and plays. Put any unlocked skill on any button.

A DARK WORLD AND A LONG ENDGAME
Fight from the village of Thornfield across a cursed desert into the drowned swamps of Velmire. More than 25 bosses, each with its own attacks and phases. Beat the story on Normal, then return on Nightmare and Hell. Conquer Hell to unlock the Ashen Reach, five endgame zones built for your strongest builds.

LOOT WORTH HUNTING
Normal, Magic, Rare, Set and Unique items. Boss-only uniques, full item sets with set bonuses, gems and sockets, a stash, and a collection book of every unique you have found. Magic Find really matters: stack it to find more uniques and sets.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Up to 8 players in one room, online with a room code.
• Share the whole adventure: monsters, quests, XP and loot. Doors and Town Portals take the whole party.
• Optional PvP: fight in the open world or in the Arena with a kill / death scoreboard.

BUILT FOR PHONES AND TABLETS
Touch controls made for one-handed fights, a Low / Medium / High graphics setting, and full offline play. Available in English and Vietnamese.

name: ASM CHAMBOURCY
description:
Une application très complète, qui va vous permettre de :
- Réserver dans votre club,
- Accéder aux informations principales,
- Remplir votre Wallet avec les cartes prépayées,
- Obtenir l'information en direct,
- Suivre vos compétitions.

Et plein d'autres fonctionnalités !

name: Asoo
description:
Asoo ist dein Ort zum Chatten, Reden und Abhängen – mit Freunden und mit deiner Community.

• Server und Kanäle: Erstelle eigene Server mit Kategorien, Rollen und privaten Kanälen oder tritt per Einladung bei.
• Direktnachrichten: Schreib Freunden, schick Bilder und reagiere mit Emojis.
• Sprachräume und Anrufe: Rede live mit deinen Leuten, auf Wunsch mit Kamera.
• 3D-Räume: Betritt mit deinem Anime-Avatar eine Skylounge, einen Strand oder ein Kino. Tanzt zusammen, setzt euch hin und schaut gemeinsam Videos.
• Profil mit Stil: animierte Profilrahmen, Banner und eigener Status.
• Mitteilungen, wenn dir jemand schreibt oder dich erwähnt.

Sicher unterwegs: Melden und Blockieren direkt in der App, Moderation durch die Mods jedes Servers und Konto-Löschung jederzeit in den Einstellungen.

Asoo ist kostenlos und ohne Werbung. Nutzung ab 16 Jahren.

name: ASVAB Community by ASVABIFY
description:
The Study Hall is where people preparing for the ASVAB study together. Ask a question, share your practice scores, and follow complete written courses for every test on the ASVAB.

THE COMMUNITY
• Post your questions in #questions and get answers from members.
• The ASVABIFY Coach, an AI that is always labeled as AI, works problems step by step and links the lesson that teaches them. Our team reviews its answers.
• Share practice scores in #scores with the full breakdown, test by test.
• Celebrate every step: passed the ASVAB, signed, shipped to basic, graduated.
• Ranks from Recruit to Sergeant Major that grow as you take part and study.

THE CLASSROOM
• Written courses for all nine ASVAB tests, in order and from zero: Arithmetic Reasoning, Mathematics Knowledge, Word Knowledge, Paragraph Comprehension and the technical tests.
• Every lesson: what you'll learn, the full explanation, worked examples, the traps the test sets, practice and a 5-question checkpoint.
• Start Here and the first four lessons of every course are free with a free account.

STUDY HALL PLUS
Study Hall Plus opens every lesson in full, all the practice, the checkpoints and the timed practice tests.
• $4.99 per month, billed to your Apple ID.
• The subscription renews automatically each month unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
• Already have ASVABIFY Pro or the ASVABIFY book? Sign in with the same account.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
Every post and comment is checked by an AI model and our team. You can report any post or comment and block any member.

Terms of Use: https://asvabcommunity.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://asvabcommunity.com/privacy

description:
Score higher on the ASVAB and get the job you want.

ASVAB Practice Test 2027 was built by a U.S. Army Retired veteran to help you raise your AFQT score and qualify for the jobs you want. Study every section with clear lessons, exam-style questions with step-by-step explanations, and flashcards.

From Winslow Homes Publishing.

AFQT CORE
- 20 lessons and 600 questions on the four sections that set your AFQT score: Arithmetic Reasoning, Math Knowledge, Word Knowledge and Paragraph Comprehension
- Every math answer explained step by step
- Test-day strategy for the computer adaptive test (CAT-ASVAB)

TECHNICAL SECTIONS
- 10 lessons and 300 questions: General Science, Electronics Information, Auto and Shop Information, Mechanical Comprehension and Assembling Objects
- Line scores matter for many military jobs. Prepare for all of them.

STUDY TOOLS
- Full timed practice exams
- Weak spot drills that target the topics you miss
- Readiness score, daily goal and study streak
- Flashcards and a must-know cheat sheet
- Day and night mode

FOR VETERANS AND SERVICE MEMBERS
Thank you for serving. When you are ready to buy a home, VA loans offer $0 down. Find VA loan help in the Profile tab.

Try 2 lessons and 25 questions free. Unlock the full course with a subscription.

name: Atlanta Stories
description:
Explore Atlanta's places and neighborhoods through a browsable collection of 295 history and directory cards. Search by name, choose a distance range, save bookmarks and listen to text using your iPhone's narration voice.

The collection distinguishes 72 written histories, 83 Wikipedia summaries and 140 directory records whose fuller histories are still pending. Each card identifies its coverage and sources, so an unfinished entry is never presented as a completed historical account.

Read source notes, follow references in your browser and explore six research collections. Optional phone location helps you find nearby entries and estimate distances; you can also browse without location by choosing Any distance.

The main collection is bundled for offline reading. Source websites and optional Wikipedia discovery require internet. Location-based discovery sends rounded coordinates only when requested. Bookmarks stay on your device.

No account, advertising, subscription or in-app purchase is required. Historical topics may include war, racial violence and other difficult events, presented as educational text rather than graphic imagery.

name: Atwebtech: Social Scheduler
description:
atwebtech is a social media workspace for small businesses, creators and agencies. Plan your posts, schedule them once, and let them go out on time on every channel you connect.

PLAN AND PUBLISH
- One queue for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, Bluesky and Mastodon
- Write a post once and send it to several channels
- Photos, videos and carousels, with each network's limits shown as you type
- Drafts, repeating posts, and evergreen posts that are recycled for you
- See what failed and why, and retry in one tap

WRITE FASTER
- An AI assistant that drafts a post from a short brief
- AI-suggested replies and saved replies for common questions

ANSWER YOUR COMMUNITY
- One inbox for comments from your connected channels
- Reply, mark as done, and keep track of what still needs an answer

WORK AS A TEAM
- Send posts for approval, approve them or ask for changes
- Switch between your own workspace and client workspaces
- Notifications when a post fails, a channel needs reconnecting or a post is waiting for you

KNOW WHAT WORKS
- Followers, views, reactions, comments and shares in one place
- Your best times to post and how your hashtags perform

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
- Light and dark themes
- A media library to reuse your photos and videos
- Automations that turn your blog into posts and plan next week for you

atwebtech is free for up to 3 channels. Paid plans add more channels and features and are managed on atwebtech.us.

You can delete your account and all of its data at any time from More, then Account.

name: Audio Cutter and Exporter
description:
You recorded the whole show. Now turn it into songs.

Audio Cutter and Exporter splits a long recording, like a concert, rehearsal or gig captured in Voice Memos, into individual tracks. It works with recordings of any length without slowing down, so a full set is no problem.

AUTOMATIC CUT SUGGESTIONS
The app listens for applause and suggests a cut at the end of each burst, so the next song starts cleanly. Too many cuts or too few? Switch between Strict, Normal and Sensitive, or place and adjust every cut by hand.

PRECISE EDITING
• Scrub through the whole recording on a zoomable waveform
• Pinch to zoom in on a single moment
• Add a cut at the playhead, play from any cut, and nudge cuts by a second or a tenth of a second
• Undo any change

SECTIONS
• Name each song
• Mark talking, tuning or dead air as Discard, and it's dimmed on the waveform and left out of the export
• Preview any section before you commit

EXPORT
• Save as Apple Lossless, AAC or WAV
• Files are numbered in order: "01 - Song Name", "02 - Song Name"
• Add artist, album artist and album, plus automatic track numbers, so your songs group together as one album in Apple Music
• Save individual files, or one zip file, straight to the Files app

MULTIPLE PROJECTS
Keep several recordings in progress at once. Your cuts and names are saved automatically, so you can close the app at any time and pick up where you left off. Delete a project to free up space.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your device. Your recordings are never uploaded, and the app collects no data.

Made by a working jazz pianist and music teacher who got tired of cutting up concert recordings by hand.

name: Aum: Breath & Sound
description:
Aum is a sound and breathing app for relaxation. Every session layers three things: a tone, a gentle rhythm, and a visual breathing guide. The sound swells as you breathe in and settles as you breathe out.

ONE PAYMENT. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Unlock the whole app once and it stays yours. No yearly renewal, no trial that turns into a bill.

40 GUIDED SOUND SESSIONS
Pick a program and press play. Each one shapes its tone, rhythm and breathing over time, from a 3-minute reset to a 90-minute descent that ends in silence.
• Sleep: Descent, Quick Nap, Back Under, Deep Rest
• Night: tone sequences for later listening
• Meditate: long, unbroken sits, including Om
• Calm: breath-paced sessions
• Focus: gamma and beta work blocks
• Lift and Elevate: rising sessions, and sessions built on 963 Hz
• Binaural: one beat rate held for the whole session (headphones required)
• Reset: short sessions for the gap between two other things

23 TONES, PLAYED AS LONG AS YOU LIKE
Solfeggio tones from 174 Hz to 963 Hz, 432 Hz and 440 Hz, Om (136.1 Hz) and more. Every tone is synthesised live on your device at its own frequency, never stretched from a recording.

BREATHING THAT SHAPES THE SOUND
10 patterns, including Coherent, Double Inhale, 4-7-8, Box, Extended Exhale, Triangle, Alternate Nostril and a Descending pace, plus your own custom pattern. Holds get a clear countdown so you never lose your place.

AMBIENCE WITHOUT AN OBVIOUS LOOP
Ocean, wind, birdsong, white noise and brown noise. Your device makes them live from layers of different lengths, so a repeat is difficult to hear. Play them under a tone or on their own with Just Ambience.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Presence: move the tone from Distant to Direct across five steps
• Pulse: the tone swells at the session's rhythm, for speakers or headphones
• Binaural beats when you wear headphones
• Vibration: optional haptics move in time with your breath (availability depends on your device)
• Bell: singing bowl, bell, chime or gong, at the start, at the end or on an interval, tuned to the session's tone
• Continuous Play, and “use these settings, always”
• Four themes: Dark, Dusk, Warm and Rise

BUILT TO KEEP PLAYING
Sessions keep playing with the screen off and the device locked, with media controls on your Lock Screen and in Control Center. Everything works in airplane mode, except buying or restoring.

EVERY FREQUENCY, EXPLAINED
Each tone has a plain description in the app: what it sounds like, and where its number comes from. Tone frequencies are sound settings, not treatments. No particular outcome is promised.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. No ads and no tracking. Your sessions, settings and practice history stay on your device. Aum goes online for one thing, the store: it checks for your purchase when it opens, and when you buy or restore. Purchases are processed by the App Store and RevenueCat.

TRY IT FREE
Five short sessions are free to use for as long as you like. Every new install also gets a trial of the full app: five full sessions, to use within 30 days of installing. In the trial, a single tone or a Just Ambience session plays for 10 minutes, and Continuous Play is not included. When you're ready, one in-app purchase unlocks everything, and Restore brings it back on a new device with the same Apple ID.

Headphones are recommended, and required for binaural beats.

Please note: Aum is a relaxation and meditation sound experience. It is not a medical device and is not a substitute for professional care. If you have epilepsy or a seizure disorder, talk to a doctor before using rhythmic audio. Do not use Aum while driving or doing anything that needs your full attention.

name: Aureo Sales
description:
Aureo Sales is the mobile companion for teams that use Aureo. Sign in with the company code and account provided by your organization to work with the customers, products and sales information assigned to you.

• View customer details and sales history within your permissions.
• Browse the product catalog and available inventory.
• Create and follow up on orders.
• Keep track of reminders and work that needs attention.

Features and data depend on your organization’s Aureo configuration and your assigned role. An existing Aureo account is required. The app is a free add-on for Aureo clients and contains no advertising or in-app purchases.

name: AutoMontage
description:
Pick your clips, get one video with music.

AutoMontage turns a batch of phone videos and photos into one short film you can share: a title, music, a caption for each moment, and an end card. Made for parents and anyone with a camera roll full of good moments, not for video editors.

Everything happens on your iPhone. Your photos and videos are never uploaded. There is no account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking.

MAKE IT FOR ME
Choose 10 to 20 photos and videos and tap Make it for me. AutoMontage puts them in the order you filmed them, picks the music, writes the title and makes the video. One tap, and you are watching it.

OR MAKE IT YOURS
The settings are right below the preview. Change anything:
• Reorder, trim or leave out clips, and edit each caption
• Choose the length (3, 4 or 5 minutes, or full length). Long clips are shortened to their most talkative part
• 10 title styles, from Classic and Storybook to Poster and Petal
• 6 transitions between clips
• 14 music tracks included, or use your own song. Music gets quieter when people talk
• Portrait or widescreen, 1080p or 4K
• Watch a live preview before you export

CAPTIONS THAT WRITE THEMSELVES
Each clip gets a caption like "July 2026 · Golden Gate Park" from the date and place your phone saved with it. Place names are looked up from tables inside the app, so even that never goes online.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save the finished video to Photos, or share it straight to Messages, email or anywhere else.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Picking photos uses the system Photos picker. AutoMontage only sees the items you choose, and only asks permission to add the finished video to your library
• Keep the app open while your video is being made
• All included music is free to share (CC0 or public domain)

name: Ave: Rosary & Catholic Prayers
description:
Pray the Holy Rosary every day with Ave, the Catholic prayer companion built for a real prayer habit. Guided audio rosary, daily Mass readings, novenas, the Divine Mercy Chaplet and beautiful home-screen widgets keep you close to Jesus and Mary from morning to night.

Whether you are new to the rosary or have prayed it for decades, Ave helps you pray with focus, peace and devotion, anywhere and anytime.

INTERACTIVE HOLY ROSARY
• Tap bead by bead on a beautiful rosary that tracks every Hail Mary for you
• Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious and Luminous Mysteries, set for each day of the week
• Short meditations and scripture for each mystery
• Pray the full rosary, a single decade or the 54 Day Rosary Novena

 AUDIO ROSARY & CATHOLIC PRAYERS
• Guided audio rosary with calm narration and soft music
• Pray along while driving, walking or before sleep
• Offline audio so you can pray without internet

CATHOLIC PRAYER LIBRARY
• Divine Mercy Chaplet with a 3 PM Hour of Mercy reminder
• Angelus, Regina Caeli, Memorare, Hail Holy Queen and the Act of Contrition
• Chaplet of St. Michael, Seven Sorrows Rosary and Litanies
• Morning prayers, night prayers and prayers before meals
• Examination of Conscience to prepare for Confession

NOVENAS
• Popular novenas to the Sacred Heart, Our Lady, St. Joseph, St. Jude and more
• Day-by-day reminders so you never miss a day of your novena
• Add your own prayer intentions

DAILY MASS READINGS & CATHOLIC BIBLE
• Daily Mass readings and Gospel reflections from the liturgical calendar
• Catholic Bible translations, including the Douay-Rheims
• Save and highlight your favorite verses

SAINT OF THE DAY
• Discover a new saint every day with their story and a short prayer
• Feast days and solemnities of the Catholic Church

⏰ PRAYER REMINDERS & STREAKS
• Reminders for the rosary, the Angelus and the Hour of Mercy
• Prayer streaks and a journal to grow a daily habit with God

 DESIGNED FOR PEACEFUL PRAYER
• Clean, distraction-free design with dark mode
• Large text option for easy reading

WHY AVE?
Ave is made by Catholics, for Catholics. Every prayer follows the tradition and teaching of the Catholic Church, so you can pray with confidence. Ave is the simple, beautiful way to pray the rosary daily and grow closer to God through Mary.

"Ave Maria, gratia plena." Start praying the Holy Rosary today.

name: Avtomap — usta tap
description:
Avtomap.az brings car mechanics and auto services in Azerbaijan together in one place. Find a mechanic by service and city, check ratings and reviews, and call with one tap.

FIND A MECHANIC FAST
• 41 service types: engine, diagnostics, auto electrics, air conditioning, gearbox, suspension, tyres, body repair and paint, tow trucks, EV and hybrid specialists and more
• Search across 75 cities and districts
• Nearby mechanics on the map with an "Open now" filter
• Ratings, real customer reviews and photos

DIRECT CONTACT
• Call, WhatsApp or get directions in Waze — with one tap
• Working hours, address and prices of each service
• Save the mechanics you like to Favorites

ONLINE BOOKING
• Pick a free time slot and book right in the app
• Get notified when the mechanic confirms

MY CAR
• Reminders for oil changes, compulsory insurance and technical inspection
• We send an SMS a few days before the due date

FOR MECHANICS AND AUTO SERVICES
• Post your listing for free — drivers find you by service and city
• Service profile: banner, logo, prices, working hours and all your listings on one page
• Online bookings and statistics: views, calls, WhatsApp taps and directions
• VIP listings appear first in search results

SAFE
• Sign in with your phone number and an SMS code — no password needed
• Report inappropriate listings and reviews, block users
• Delete your account anytime, right in the app

The app is available in Azerbaijani, Russian and English.

name: Awl Return
description:
Awl Return keeps each seam on this iPhone.

A stitch locks only when the awl sits on the mark and the thread comes back through that same hole. In the flesh, or off the edge, the awl springs back. Through the next hole the thread crosses and is pulled back. A stitch that has already passed stays put.

Name a seam, rename it, search the list, delete one, and share the sentence.

Seams stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not stitch the leather for you.

name: Axle Collar
description:
Axle Collar keeps a cart honest.

The collar faces out. Drop that peg into the next empty hole and it stays. Drop a peg that faces in, and it pops back. Drop a peg into a later hole while an earlier one is empty, and that try is skipped.

The cart rolls only when both pegs stay seated. You can rename the cart and the holes, delete a cart, and share a four-line summary.

Carts stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not turn a real axle.

name: Axle: Car Insights
description:
Axle keeps track of what your car costs and how much it uses. At every fill-up, enter the odometer reading, the litres and the amount, and Axle works out the rest.

**Fill-ups in a few taps**
Date, odometer, litres and total cost: that's all. Axle calculates the price per litre itself. Only filled part of the tank? Turn the switch off; consumption is then calculated at the next full tank, so it stays accurate.

**See what it costs you**
The overview shows your average consumption, what you spent, the price per litre and the cost per kilometre, for the last three months, the last year or everything. Below are charts of your consumption, your cost per month and the price per litre. Drag your finger across a chart to see the details of each fill-up.

**Multiple cars**
Add as many cars as you like, each with its own colour. You see the car you're working with on every screen, and Axle remembers the one you chose last. Cars you no longer use go to history: their data stays saved.

**Import**
Already have a list in Excel or Numbers? Import your fill-ups from a CSV file. Axle first shows what is coming in and skips duplicate lines.

**Yours**
- No account, no ads, no analytics.
- Your data is stored on your phone and, if you're signed in to iCloud, in your own iCloud too.
- Dutch and English.

Coming soon: logging trips (for example to claim them back) and maintenance.

name: AZ PERFUMES
description:
**Welcome to AZ PERFUMES – Discover Your Signature Scent.**

Step into the world of AZ PERFUMES, where fragrance meets elegance, creativity, and individuality.

Established in the UAE, AZ PERFUMES brings you a distinctive collection of fragrances designed to express your personality and leave a lasting impression. From exclusive signature blends to luxurious inspired perfumes, discover scents for every mood, occasion, and style.

**EXPLORE OUR COLLECTIONS**

• **Our Blends:** Discover unique fragrance creations and exclusive blends crafted with carefully selected notes.

• **Inspired Perfumes:** Explore fragrances inspired by some of the world's most renowned luxury perfume houses.

• **Oud Sticks:** Experience the rich and captivating aroma of traditional oud.

• **Bakhoor & Oud:** Discover luxurious bakhoor and oud selections that bring warmth and elegance to your surroundings.

• **Fresheners:** Enjoy refreshing fragrances designed to keep you feeling fresh throughout the day.

**WHY SHOP WITH AZ PERFUMES?**

• A wide selection of distinctive fragrances.
• Exclusive collections and signature creations.
• Discover scents for different tastes and occasions.
• Easy and convenient online shopping.
• Secure and simple checkout.
• Stay updated with our latest arrivals, collections, and special offers.
• Shop your favourite fragrances anytime, anywhere.

**YOUR FRAGRANCE JOURNEY STARTS HERE**

Whether you love fresh, floral, woody, oriental, or intense fragrances, AZ PERFUMES invites you to discover something that feels uniquely yours.

Download the AZ PERFUMES app today and explore a world of fragrance.

**AZ PERFUMES – Make Every Scent a Signature.**

Website: www.az-pr.ae

name: Azadly
description:
Azadly — private communication. Your freedom.

Azadly is a messaging app built around one idea: your conversations belong to you, and no one else.

No phone number. No SIM card.
Sign up with an email address and choose your username. You get your own Azadly ID to share with the people you trust — nothing about you is tied to a phone number.

End-to-end encrypted, for real.
Every message, voice message, photo, and file is locked (encrypted) on your phone before it is sent, and it can only be unlocked on the phones of the people in your conversation. The keys that unlock your messages are created on your device and never leave it. Our servers carry only locked messages they cannot open — so we can't read your chats, and neither can anyone else.

Everything you need to stay in touch:
- One-to-one chats and group chats
- Voice messages
- Photos and files, sent encrypted
- Add contacts by username, Azadly ID, or QR code
- A 12-word recovery phrase that lets you get your account back — guarded by you alone
- Disappearing messages and message reactions
- Block and report tools, and full account deletion inside the app

Honest by design.
Azadly is a messaging app. It does not offer voice or video calling — it focuses on doing private messaging properly. There are no ads, no trackers, and your data is never sold.

If you believe a conversation should stay between the people having it, Azadly was made for you.

name: Baba Doner
description:
BABA Doner puts the full menu of BABA Doner in Lipjan on your phone. Order in a few taps, pick it up or get it delivered, and see exactly where your food is.

ORDER IN SECONDS
• Browse the whole menu: doner, burgers, sides and drinks
• Choose the size, sauces and extras for every item
• See every price and the total before you order

PICK UP OR DELIVERY
• Collect your order at the restaurant or have it delivered in Lipjan
• Pay cash or card when you receive your order. The app never asks for card details
• Save your home and work addresses, or drop a pin on the map

FOLLOW YOUR ORDER LIVE
• Get a notification when your order status changes
• Follow the driver on the map and see how many minutes are left

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Order as a guest, or create an account to keep your addresses and order history
• Repeat a previous order with one tap
• Delete your account at any time from the Account tab

The app is in Albanian.

name: Baba Doner Staff
description:
BABA Doner Staff is the internal app for the team of BABA Doner in Lipjan. It works only with a staff account created by the restaurant; there is no public sign-up.

Each team member sees only the screens that match their role.

POS
• Take walk-in orders at the counter, for takeaway or eat-in
• Cash or card, with the receipt shown on screen
• Accept or reject incoming online orders

KITCHEN DISPLAY
• New and in-progress tickets with a timer for each order
• Items, sauces, extras and notes clearly visible
• Mark orders as preparing and ready with one tap

DISPATCH
• See which orders are ready and which drivers are free
• Assign a driver with one tap

DRIVER
• Go available or unavailable
• See the customer's address, the order and the route on the map
• While the driver screen is open, the location is shared so the customer can follow the delivery

REPORTS AND ADMIN
• Today's sales: net, cash, card, by order type and top products
• Daily expenses, cash book and wages for managers

The app is in Albanian.

name: BabylonV
description:
BabylonV перетворює голоси на м’який нерозбірливий гомін — як у людній кав’ярні. Зробіть гомін із власного голосу: люди поруч чують розмову, але не розбирають слів.

ЧОМУ ГОЛОСИ Мозок легко стежить за одним голосом, але губиться, коли одночасно звучить багато схожих голосів. Тому шум голосів маскує мовлення краще за білий шум — і за меншої гучності.

ВЛАСНИЙ ГОЛОС • Запишіть до трьох голосів — свій і співрозмовника — або імпортуйте записи з «Файлів» і «Диктофона». • Записи обробляються на iPhone і зберігаються лише всередині застосунку. • Що більше гомін схожий на ваш голос, то важче виокремити з нього ваші слова.

ЗАПУСК ОДНИМ НАТИСКАННЯМ • Пресети «Кав’ярня», «Розмова», «Натовп». • Точне налаштування: кількість голосів, довжина фрагментів, розкид висоти, фрагменти задом наперед, тембр — кожну зміну чути одразу. • BabylonV запам’ятовує налаштування: наступного разу досить натиснути Play.

ЗАВЖДИ ПІД РУКОЮ • Грає у фоні та на заблокованому екрані. • Live Activity на екрані блокування і в Dynamic Island з кнопками Play/Пауза і «Стоп». • AirPlay на колонки й телевізор: кілька колонок у різних місцях кімнати маскують краще за одну. • Жива візуалізація доріжок голосів. • Оптимізовано для iPhone Duo в усіх позах: закритий, відкритий, напіввідкритий і Split View.

ПРИВАТНІСТЬ Без акаунта, реклами, аналітики та інтернету. Ваші записи не залишають iPhone.

ВАЖЛИВО BabylonV знижує розбірливість мовлення для оточення, але не гарантує повної конфіденційності й не захищає від технічних засобів прослуховування.

name: Backtalk - Reverse Audio Game
description:
Backtalk is a game for a room full of people. One person says a word and Backtalk plays it backwards. Then someone tries to say that backwards sound, and Backtalk plays their try forwards. If it sounds like the original word, they nailed it. Everyone listening decides, and there is no score.

How a round goes:
- Tap the big button, say a word, and tap again to stop.
- Hear the word backwards right away. Replay it as often as you like.
- Tap Say it backwards and copy what you heard.
- Tap Play both to hear the original, then the try flipped back.
- Tap New word to start over. Tap Share if you want to keep the flipped try as an audio file.

Everything happens on your device. Backtalk has no account, no ads, no analytics, and no network connection, so your recordings are never uploaded. It asks for the microphone only so you can record a word.

Requires iOS 17 or later.

name: Balanced Bites
description:
Pull the treats. Keep the tower standing. Eat your way around the world!

Balanced Bites is a cosy tower-pulling puzzle game. Hungry customers line up with their orders, and you pull the right sweets from a wobbling tower of treats without letting it topple. Serve them fast for tips and combos, but one careless pull and it all comes crashing down!

A WORLD TOUR OF 3,000 LEVELS
Travel through 120 countries on a hand-painted map, from British Battenberg and French macarons to Japanese taiyaki and Brazilian brigadeiros. Every country has its own foods, its own landmarks and a boss level at the end.

EASY TO PICK UP, HARD TO MASTER
• Pull, tap and balance with real physics
• Crane levels, fragile treats, glazed sweets, wind, heat waves and earthquakes
• Special and boss levels keep every country fresh
• Boosts like Hint, Steady and Rewind for the tricky moments

MORE TO DO
• Collect 600 recipe cards and fill your Recipe Book
• Decorate your very own café
• Daily Tower and a daily prize wheel
• Stamp your passport in every country you visit
• Climb the leaderboards and play in weekly leagues
• Snap your snack: take a photo of your food and turn it into a playable tower

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Relaxed mode with no timer when you just want to unwind
• Adaptive difficulty that quietly helps when a level is giving you trouble
• Colour-blind symbols and a left-handed layout
• Customers who say hello in their own language
• Your progress saves to iCloud and comes back on a new iPhone

Balanced Bites is free to play. It contains optional in-app purchases (coins, unlimited lives, a season pass and an option to remove in-between adverts) and adverts. Reward adverts are always optional.

name: BalloonDash
description:
Balloon Dash
A sunset arcade runner built with Unity: jump crates and spikes, slide under hanging signs, double-jump stacks and rolling barrels, collect coins, and grab a balloon to float over the track between bombs. The track speeds up the further you run; one hit ends the run.

name: BandAnalysis
description:
BandAnalysis gives you an estimated band score for your IELTS Writing Task 1 (Academic) and Task 2 answers, with a clear explanation for every criterion, and lets you ask a real teacher to re-mark your answer.

AI SCORE
• Type, paste or photograph your answer, including handwritten answers
• For Task 1, add a photo of the chart, graph, table, map or diagram
• Get an overall band and a band for each criterion: Task Achievement / Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range and Accuracy
• Every point is explained in plain English, with the words from your answer
• See a translation in your own language next to the English explanation (26 languages)

TEACHER REVIEW
• Re-marked by teachers from an IELTS school with 13 years' experience

name: Bar Back Pro
description:
Beer Count makes inventory counts quick and accurate for bars and restaurants.

Track every beer variety in one place. Each line has simple plus and minus controls for 24-case, 6-pack, and single-unit counts, and the app keeps a running total for each beer. Switch between dates and AM or PM counts, and move between Keg Room, Bar, Delivered, and Sales.

Count as a team. Set up your business on one phone, then add the other phones with your master code. Everyone counts into the same shared sheet, and changes sync automatically between phones.

Counting works offline. Your counts save on the phone as you enter them and upload when you're back online, so nothing is lost if you put the phone down mid-count or lose signal in the keg room.

When you're done, share the full report as a clean, editable Excel spreadsheet. The sheet includes formulas, so totals update if you adjust a number.

No personal information is collected and there are no ads or tracking. Your beer list and counts are synced over an encrypted connection so your team's phones stay in step, and you can delete your business and all its data from the app at any time.

name: Barazilia
description:
Barazilia is a fast, polished Buraco card game. Play against the computer or online with real players.

How to play
Draw from the stock or take the discard pile, then lay down your melds: sequences of the same suit, or sets of the same rank. Build a canasta (7+ cards), take the pot, and be the first to go out and close the round.

Features
• Play vs. the computer at three levels: easy, normal, hard.

Your privacy

For entertainment only. No gambling and no real-money rewards.

Download Barazilia and start your first table now.

name: Bare Page: Ad Blocker
description:
Blocks ads and trackers in Safari.

Bare Page gives Safari three content blockers: one for ads, one for trackers, and one for your own rules. Turn them on once in the Settings app, under Apps, Safari, Extensions. Safari then applies the rules itself; the blockers never see the pages you visit.

WHAT IT BLOCKS
- Ads, with EasyList.
- Trackers, with EasyPrivacy.
- Works in Safari and in apps that open web pages with Safari.
- It does not block ads inside other apps or games, or in other browsers.

HOW THE LISTS WORK
- Your phone downloads both lists from easylist.to and converts them into Safari rules on the phone.
- The lists update by themselves when their own update time has passed and you open the app. Update now is always there.
- A download that fails or looks cut short is dropped, and the last good copy stays in use.
- Lines Safari cannot read are skipped and counted, so a blocker is never refused.
- A small starter list works before the first download, even offline.

SITES
Turn blocking off on any site that does not work with it, or one you want to support. It applies to all three blockers.

OWN RULES (PLAN)
Block a domain on every site, or hide a part of a page on one site with a CSS selector.

FREE AND PAID
Free: both lists, list updates and the site list, with no limit. A plan adds your own rules. Choose a yearly subscription or one lifetime payment. The price is shown in the app before you buy. The subscription renews until you cancel it in your Apple account settings. Restore purchases on the Plan screen. No free trial, no weekly plan. If a plan ends, your rules are kept and stop being applied until a plan is active again.

PRIVACY
No account and no sign-in. Your sites, rules and settings stay on your device and in your own phone backup. No analytics and no ads. The app downloads the two lists from easylist.to, contacts the App Store for purchases, and checks one server for app updates. It sends none of your sites or rules to any of them.

Encrypted backup files, daily copies and Delete everything are under More.

name: BarVision: CA Bar Exam Prep
description:
BarVision is a study companion for the California Bar Exam. It turns the 13 tested subjects into a day-by-day plan and gives you one clear thing to do next.

A PLAN THAT FITS YOUR LIFE
Tell BarVision when you are working and when you can study full time. It builds a calendar to exam day, counts down the days, and folds missed work into the days ahead so nothing piles up. Rest days never break your streak.

VISUAL LESSONS
Flagship lessons break big topics into flowcharts you tap through, with exceptions, short fictional hypotheticals, memory stories, and a quick application check. Study notes cover 65 topics across all 13 subjects, with California rules marked separately from the general (MBE) rule.

MBE-STYLE PRACTICE
More than 340 original multiple-choice questions in MBE style across the seven MBE subjects. Every question explains why each option is right or wrong and shows the reasoning path. Build untimed sets by subject or sit a full timed simulation.

SPACED REVIEW
606 flashcards unlock as you finish lessons. Scheduling uses FSRS-5, a published spaced-repetition algorithm that targets 90% recall at review time, with a daily cap so reviews stay manageable.

ESSAYS AND PERFORMANCE TESTS
Practice California essays with an interactive IRAC guide and 60-minute prompts across the essay subjects, plus 90-minute Performance Tests in four formats.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account required. Your plan and progress stay on your device. BarVision does not collect, sell, or track your data.

IMPORTANT
BarVision is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the State Bar of California or the National Conference of Bar Examiners. All questions, scenarios, and performance tests are original and fictional; none are official exam questions. Content is still being reviewed by licensed attorneys, and each lesson shows its review status. Nothing in the app is legal advice, and no study tool can guarantee an exam result. Always check official exam information at calbar.ca.gov.

name: BasedPulse
description: BasedPulse is a fidget and sensory toy for your phone. Use haptic pulses and calm, tactile feedback to take a moment, settle your hands, and refocus. Simple to pick up, with no account needed. BasedPulse is a fidget and sensory toy, not a medical device, and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

name: Basketball Draft Game: 82-0
description:
Draft 7 stars from 47 seasons of pro basketball, then WATCH your team play – possession by possession – and coach it through the playoffs. Can you go 82-0?

WATCH YOUR GAMES: THE GAMECAST
• A live top-down court with a shot chart: green made, red missed, every three-point arc
• Quarter clock, team fouls, runs ("12-2 run") and a play-by-play naming your stars
• Dunk, buzzer-beater, clutch-3 and game-winner moments, overtime drama
• 1x, 2x, 4x or skip – jump to the next big game of the season

COACH THE PLAYOFFS
• Best-of-7 series view, game by game, with an animated bracket
• Coach calls: timeout to stop a run, foul or defend late, go for 3 or 2 on the last shot – the odds are on screen
• A call that works gives your team momentum in the next game
• Win the title, collect the confetti – and the LED "82-0" stamp for a perfect season

A REASON TO COME BACK
• Daily draft: the same spins for everyone, worldwide leaderboard, streaks and freezes
• Daily Clutch: three coach calls in one fourth quarter, 60 seconds a day
• Weekly Cup: one draft for everyone all week, 3 tries, climb the league from Rookie to Legend
• Champions album: collect a card for every title team, a reward for every decade
• Daily missions with a mission chest, coach levels with decade jerseys, prestige stars
• Share a poster of your season, challenge friends with a code that shows your result

FROM DRAFT TO BANNER
1. Spin a random team from a random season, 1979–80 to 2025–26
2. Fill your starting five (PG, SG, SF, PF, C) and two bench spots from the roster you land on
3. Watch 82 games on the hardwood, then fight through four best-of-7 rounds for the trophy

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• All-time franchise, Era mode and Salary cap mode
• Draft IQ: see which picks were best at each spot

OPTIONAL ONE-TIME PURCHASES (no ads, no subscription)
• Style Pack: 5 court themes and 3 jerseys
• Premium: scout every roster, unlimited jokers, every franchise and era, the daily archive
• Dynasty Pass: adds the Dynasty parquet court, 3 Dynasty jerseys, double album rewards, a gold crown and every future season update (Premium and Style Pack owners keep what they have)
The daily draft and the leaderboards stay free and fair for everyone.

Unofficial fan game. Not affiliated with, endorsed or licensed by any league, team, players association or player. Player stats and team records: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0); player list: Wikidata (CC0). Player ratings are calculated by the app.

name: Batten Fair
description:
Batten Fair keeps each boat's waterlines on this iPhone. Half-breadths sit on equally spaced stations. Third differences name the one station to ease, and Ease moves that station by at most one inch. The stem and the transom stay put.

Dory's sheer asks for station 4, one inch inboard. Ease it twice and the batten lies. Skiff already lies. Canoe needs more stations before it can be judged. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: BavariaDiag Free
description:
BavariaDiag Free ti permette di testare gratuitamente la connessione tra il tuo adattatore OBD-II Bluetooth Low Energy (UniCarScan UCSI-2000/2100, OBDLink CX) e la tua motocicletta BMW Motorrad (Serie R, S, K, F, G, C).

COSA INCLUDE LA VERSIONE FREE:
• Riconoscimento Automatico del Modello: lettura automatica del VIN / Typ-Schlüssel tramite OBD2 e identificazione immediata della moto collegata.
• Connessione e Lettura Errori DTC del Quadro Strumenti (KOMBI / TFT): connessione reale via protocollo UDS o KWP2000 al quadro strumenti di tutti i modelli BMW supportati, con lettura dei codici guasto memorizzati e dei dati identificativi hardware/software (SGBD, data produzione, I-Stufe).
• Test Compatibilità Adattatore BLE: scansione con filtro intelligente dei soli dongle compatibili e verifica del supporto al protocollo CAN Extended BMW (ATCEA).

Per sbloccare la connessione a tutte le altre centraline della moto (Motore DME/BMS, ABS, ZFE/BCO, ESA, RDC, DWA), la cancellazione dei codici guasto DTC, lo streaming Live Data, il test attuatori, il Service Reset e le codifiche, puoi scaricare la versione completa BavariaDiag Pro direttamente dall'App Store.

name: BBG Hymns
description:
BBG Hymns helps song leaders plan the congregational singing for church services.

Pick hymns from the hymnal, see at a glance when each hymn was last sung, and save the plan for the next service. Every plan is shared with all song leaders, so the whole team works from the same history.

PLAN IN MINUTES
• Start a new plan, choose the date and add hymns by number or title
• Reorder or remove hymns before saving
• Your name is filled in as song leader automatically

SUGGESTIONS
• Proven hymns the congregation knows well
• Hymns worth rediscovering that have not been sung in a long time
• Hymns to learn, clearly marked
• Filter suggestions by topic

THE WHOLE HYMNAL
• Search all hymns by number or title
• See for every hymn how often and when it was sung
• Filter by known, new to learn or topic

HISTORY
• All past and upcoming plans, grouped by year
• An overview of the hymnal that shows which hymns are sung and which are forgotten

An account provided by your congregation is required. The app is in German.

name: Beacon Relay
description:
Guide a lighthouse beam along the coast and light every target harbor at the same time. Each puzzle gives you a limited number of turns, so every change in direction matters.

Drag a lighthouse up, down, left, or right to preview the full beam route before you commit. Relay towers send light onward only when a beam reaches them. Set an unlit relay's direction in advance, route beams around reefs, and look for ways to keep multiple harbors lit together.

Choose any of the 36 puzzles from the Harbor Chart. Take your time, undo your last move, or restart the puzzle. Completed levels display a checkmark and your best move count, so you can revisit them and try a shorter solution.

name: Beadway - Zen Ring Puzzle
description:
Beadway is a calm, turn-based puzzle about beads on rings. Slide a bead along its ring, line up three or more of a colour, and watch the chains unfold. Every move costs a little of your budget, so each one counts.

HOW IT WORKS
• Drag a bead along its ring. Each bead you pass costs one from your budget.
• Three or more alike in a row are cleared, and the beads behind them slide in. New rows can form on their own – that is a chain.
• Where rings cross, a bead belongs to both, so one move can set off rows on two rings.
• Four alike makes a silver bead and five makes gold: jokers that fit any colour and pay back into your budget when used.

LEVELS WITH A TWIST
• Target beads that take several hits, minus beads to clear away, locked rings that turn as one, and crossings that change everything.
• Every level is marked Easy, Medium or Tricky. Tricky means the obvious move is rarely the right one.
• Earn up to three stars on each level by finishing with budget to spare.

DAILY AND WEEKLY ZEN
• A new Daily Zen every day and a Weekly Zen every week: the same board for everyone, no clock.
• Play as many times as you like. Your best score counts on the leaderboard.
• Every score is replayed on our server before it is listed.

BADGES
• Long chains, big sweeps, gold rushes and daily streaks – collect badges as you master the rings.

TRY IT FREE
• All of World 1, the first level of Collector and of Missions, and a new Daily Zen every day.
• One purchase unlocks the rest, including the Weekly Zen. No ads, no subscription, and buying never improves your place on the leaderboards.

MADE FOR UNHURRIED PLAY
• No timers in the main game. Plays offline. No account needed.
• Optional sign-in with Google Play Games for the leaderboards.

name: BeatboxStage
description:
Beatbox Stage — музыкальная сцена для детей и всей семьи. Положите карточку на магнитную доску — камера телефона узнает её, и персонаж запоёт свою партию. Добавляйте биты, мелодии, эффекты и голоса и собирайте свой трек вместе.

ЧТО ВНУТРИ
• 6 стилей музыки: хип-хоп, техно, джаз, детская музыка, котики и синтезаторный — у каждого свои звуки.
• «На экране» — играйте пальцем, без доски и камеры.
• «Собери оркестр» — сова расскажет о произведении и инструментах, а ребёнок по заданиям соберёт настоящий симфонический оркестр.
• «Ноты» — нотный стан с подписями: найди ноту, собери известную мелодию или сочини свою.
• «Мой голос» — запишите смешной звук или песенку, и она зазвучит на карточке.
• Игра «Замри-отомри» — танцуйте под музыку, камера следит, кто шевельнулся.
• Громкость, темп и эффекты — магнитными фишками прямо на доске.

ДЛЯ РОДИТЕЛЕЙ
• Без рекламы и без встроенных покупок.
• Приложение не собирает данные: камера обрабатывает изображение только на устройстве, записи голоса остаются на телефоне.
• Настройки — за родительским замком.

Для игры с камерой нужен набор Genzai Beatbox Stage: магнитная доска и карточки. Режимы «На экране», «Оркестр», «Ноты», «Мой голос» и игра «Замри» работают и без набора.

name: BeatSync: Synced Lyrics
description:
BeatSync shows the lyrics of the song you're listening to, synced line by line, on your iPhone, your Lock Screen and the CarPlay Dashboard.

Play a song in Apple Music or Spotify and BeatSync picks it up on its own. It finds the synced lyrics and follows the music, even with the app in the background.

IN YOUR CAR

• Starts automatically when CarPlay connects, if you turn it on.
• Audio offset for Bluetooth and CarPlay: nudge the lyrics earlier or later until they match what you hear.

SIMPLE

• Manual search when lyrics are missing or wrong.
• Lyrics are saved on your device so they don't download again.

FREE WITH ADS

The subscription renews automatically every month until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before renewal.

Lyrics on CarPlay are meant for passengers or for use while parked. Keep your eyes on the road.

description:
Beauty Way is your shop for beauty and personal care in Iraq. Browse more than 1,500 original products from over 100 brands and have them delivered to your door.

name: Bee Gift

description:
Bee Gift — we make your moments.

Pick a gift and send it in seconds: fresh flowers, cakes and curated gift boxes for every occasion — birthdays, anniversaries, a new baby, an apology, a thank-you, or just to make someone smile.

name: Beecorder: Hive Voice Log
description:
Smoker in one hand, hive tool in the other, a frame of brood in front of you. You spot the queen, and you have no hand free to write it down.

Beecorder is the hive diary for beekeepers. Press the big button and say what you see: "Queen seen, eggs on three frames, a bit defensive, check for swarm cells next week." Beecorder turns it into text and files it under that hive, with the date and time.

Built for the apiary, not the desk:
- Works with no signal. Your voice note is saved on your phone right away and becomes text when you are back online.
- One hive, one story. Open a hive and see what you found last time and what you told yourself to do.
- Quick buttons for what you check every visit: Queen seen, Eggs seen, Temperament, Follow-up.
- A short list of the hives that need you first. Mark a hive Follow-up and it goes to the top.
- A reminder for the next inspection. 10 days by default, and you can change it for each hive.
- All your apiaries in one place: the backyard, the orchard, the farm on the hill.

Made for beekeepers with a handful of hives who still keep records on paper, in a spreadsheet, or in voice memos they never listen to again.

Free plan: 3 hives and 15 voice notes turned into text. Your notes stay on your phone. You can read, edit, and listen to old notes, and you keep getting reminders, even after the free notes run out.

Premium: unlimited voice notes and unlimited hives, for $39.99 per year or $5.99 per month. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Prices may differ in your country.

Beecorder is in English. Voice notes are sent to ElevenLabs, our speech-to-text service, to become text. ElevenLabs may keep them for a time. We do not store your audio on our servers.

Questions or ideas? Write to us from Settings, Contact support.

name: Beetplaner: Garden Planner
description:
Beetplaner plans your vegetable beds season by season. It's made for northern-hemisphere gardens with a frost season: frost dates are looked up automatically for places in Germany, and you enter them yourself anywhere else. Sizes are in centimetres and temperatures in °C.

DRAW YOUR GARDEN
Lay out beds to scale, rectangular or any shape, raised, covered or in half shade. Place each crop on the whole bed or a part of it, and Beetplaner works out how many plants fit.

KNOW WHAT GROWS WELL TOGETHER
Every planting is checked against companion planting, crop rotation over the years, light and timing. Each warning and tip names its sources, mostly German horticultural institutes.

A DATE FOR EVERY TASK
From your frost dates, Beetplaner turns each planting into dates for sowing indoors, sowing in place, planting out and harvesting. This week shows what is due; the months and the season show what is coming. Reminders and weather warnings come as notifications.

A JOURNAL FOR EVERY BED
Note what happened, with photos and harvest amounts, for the garden, a bed or a single planting.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Gardens stay on your device and in your own iCloud. Share a garden with family or neighbours through iCloud. No account, no tracking, no ads. Export a garden as a file whenever you like.

FREE AND ONE-TIME UNLOCK
One garden with one bed is free, with every warning, the calendar, reminders, the journal and export. Beetplaner Pro, a one-time purchase, unlocks unlimited gardens and beds plus sharing, for your whole family through Family Sharing. No subscription.

name: Beit Midrash - Torah Study
description:
Beit Midrash is a place to study Torah on your phone, in Hebrew.

Ask: write or say a question in your own words and get an answer with the sources themselves, from Tanakh, Mishnah, Talmud, halacha and mussar.

Chavruta: study a topic as a conversation. Your study partner brings sources, asks and challenges, and when a question is unclear it asks what you meant.

Today: the daily learning, the weekly parasha, daily halacha, daily mussar and short five or ten minute lessons. Continue where you stopped.

Shnayim mikra ve'echad targum for the weekly parasha.

Library: read and search the foundational books.

Calendar: the coming holidays and dates.

A daily study reminder as a phone notification, at the time you choose.

An account is required. Answers and the chavruta are written with AI (Anthropic's Claude, with OpenAI's ChatGPT as a backup when Claude is unavailable) from the sources found, and only after you agree to it.

Beit Midrash is a study aid and not a halachic ruling. For practical halacha, ask a qualified rabbi.

name: Bellstitch--Timetable Rail
description:
Bellstitch on viihtyisä puinen junarata-aiheinen aikataulupulmapeli.

Valitse asemakirja ja suunnittele sitten jokaisen junan reitti. Kiinnitä liittimet lyhyelle pääradalle tai rakenna pidempi oma ohitusreitti. Siirrä rei'itetty lähtölippu aikajanan kohdissa 0–12 ja soita aseman kelloa nähdäksesi junien matkat käytännössä.

Yhteisen sillan toimivuus riippuu varattujen aikavälien yhteensopivuudesta, ei pelkästään raiteiden visuaalisesta etäisyydestä. Tutki aikataulutaulukkoa, säädä junien nopeuksia ja varmista, että kaikki saapumiset osuvat oikeisiin aikaikkunoihin. Kerää tähtiä ja avaa uusia näyttelyalueita Meadow'ssa, Riverbendissä, Maple Valleyssa ja Snow Window'ssa.

Vihjeiden avulla ratkaistut tehtävät merkitään avustetuiksi, mutta itsenäisesti ansaitsemasi tähdet säilyvät. Rauhallinen, miellyttävän tuntuiseksi suunniteltu ja keskittymistä tukeva pelikokemus tarjoaa 24 erilaista aikataulupulmaa.

name: Bent: Deco Planner
description:
Bent plans decompression dives and keeps your log. It is free, with no subscription, no account and no ads.

THE PLAN
• Bühlmann ZH-L16 with gradient factors (B or C tables), VPM-B, and VPM-B with a gradient factor surfacing limit
• Open circuit and closed-circuit rebreather, with the bailout ascent planned beside the loop
• Air, nitrox and trimix, any number of deco or bailout gases, switch depths from your PO2 limits
• Multi-level dives, repetitive dives with surface intervals, dives at altitude and after driving up to altitude
• Air breaks, minimum stop time on a gas switch, last stop at 10 or 20 ft (3 or 6 m)
• Feet or metres, psi or bar, cubic feet or litres

WHAT IT COSTS YOU
• Gas needed from every cylinder, against what you carry, with thirds, half or a reserve you set
• Turn pressure, and the longest bottom time your gas allows
• Lost gas: the ascent with each deco or bailout gas missing in turn
• Deeper or longer: the same dive a little past the plan, in one table
• CNS and OTU, gas density, narcotic depth, with warnings you can tap to jump to

THE SAME DIVE, THREE WAYS
Compare gradient factors, VPM-B and VPM-B/GFS on one profile and one table of stops.

TOOLS
• MOD, equivalent narcotic depth, equivalent air depth, density
• Best mix for a depth
• Blending nitrox and trimix with real-gas compressibility, top-ups, and what a cylinder holds

THE LOG
• Log a plan as dived, or write a dive down afterwards
• Search, filter and totals; import and export UDDF and CSV
• A logged dive opens as a plan again, and counts toward the next dive's tissues
• Plans and log follow you through your own iCloud, or stay on the phone

THREE LOOKS
Slate, a wrist slate with marker on the gas switches; Deep; and Chart, after a paper chart. Each in light and dark.

PRIVATE
No account, no analytics, no tracking. Nothing leaves your phone except to your own iCloud, if you use it.

DECOMPRESSION IS NOT A SOLVED PROBLEM
No planner can guarantee you will not get bent. Bent's numbers are checked against the published reference programs, but it is not a substitute for training, for a dive computer, or for your own judgement. Check every plan against a second source before you dive it.

name: BeridHub
description:
BeridHub is a terminal and courier app for the field teams of parcel and delivery companies. Branches, hubs, couriers and drivers work in one system, each with their own permissions.

• Handover: Scan the parcels at your branch or hub every morning; unscanned parcels are reported as possibly missing.
• Trip loading and unloading: Load and unload vehicles, record seals and the transport waybill.
• Fast scanning: Scan with the camera or a Bluetooth barcode scanner, with sound and haptic feedback.
• Wrong barcode alerts: Cancelled, already delivered or misrouted parcels raise an instant alert and are reported to management.
• Couriers: Daily delivery list, delivery, cash collection and failed delivery records, with location for the delivery point.
• Proof of delivery: Add a parcel photo or document at delivery.

Available on iPhone, iPad and Mac computers with Apple silicon.

Try Now: Without signing up, explore a sample courier company as a manager. No SMS, WhatsApp or email is ever sent from the demo.

The app interface is currently in Turkish.

To use the app with your own company, you need an account at a courier company that uses BeridHub. For setup: beridhub.com

name: Besedka - tell your story
description:
Besedka keeps oral histories about people and places. Open a story to read its text, listen to an interview and visit the author's profile. Choose a city or place manually, or use location to find nearby stories.

Start a story with a voice recording, imported audio or text. Add photographs, a place and narrator attribution in the editor. Private drafts automatically back up to your account when online. Selected drafts can use an archive password and optional biometric unlock. Protected backups are encrypted and require the archive password to restore.

Preview the exact version and confirm narrator consent before publishing. Publish transfers and verifies that version before making it public. Authors can withdraw or delete their stories; a changed version needs new consent. A published story is public even if its original draft was protected.

Plan an interview with a date, time zone, place and private notes. Send an invitation through system sharing, export the meeting to Calendar or create a local reminder. These personal plans do not sync as stories.

Download available stories for offline listening. Publishing, new downloads and account operations need a connection. System sharing sends the text of the selected public story.

Report another person's story or photograph and block an author. Settings includes permission controls, sign-out and account deletion. The interface supports Russian and English; stories keep their original language. Phone and password sign-in is required and registration is open. There are no purchases, subscriptions or ads.

name: Best Soundboard Ever, Probably
description:
You know the exact sound the moment calls for. By the time you find it, the moment is gone.

This soundboard keeps your sounds one tap away. Record anything your device is playing, trim away the dead air, and drop it on a pad. Next time, just tap.

RECORD WHAT'S PLAYING
• Start a recording, switch to any app, play the sound, then come back and stop
• Silence at the start and end is trimmed for you automatically
• Or load audio from Files, including the sound from a video

A WALL OF PADS
• An 8 × 8 board of big, colorful pads, with as many on screen as your device fits
• Every pad shows its own waveform so you can spot it at a glance
• Give pads a name, a color, an emoji or your own picture
• Several boards for different occasions, with search to jump straight to a sound

PLAY IT YOUR WAY
• One-shot: tap to play to the end
• Hold: plays only while your finger is down
• Loop: tap to start, tap again to stop
• Choke pads that cut every other sound, adjustable fade-outs, and a Stop All button
• Sounds start the instant you touch a pad, play with the silent switch on, and mix with your music

A REAL EDITOR
• Zoomable waveform with drag handles for the start and end
• Volume with one-tap normalize, fade in and fade out
• Change pitch without changing length, change speed without changing pitch, or play it backwards
• Split one long recording into separate pads automatically
• Deleted or swapped the wrong pad? Undo it with one tap

YOURS, AND ONLY YOURS
• Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking, no servers
• Export a whole board as a single file to back it up or move it to another device
• On iPad, assign keyboard keys to pads and trigger them from a hardware keyboard

Recording uses the system screen broadcast feature. Only audio is saved; the screen is never recorded. Some apps block their audio from being captured.

name: Bet West Lucky Mine
description:
