Run a Wild West mining railroad, one timed ride at a time.

Bet West Lucky Mine puts you in charge of a narrow-gauge line out of Lucky Gulch, a boomtown on the edge of the Copperhead Territory. Every stop is a short ride against the clock. Switch lanes to grab gold nuggets and timber, dodge boulders and fallen beams, and bring the cart home in one piece to bank the haul.

Build the town as you go. Spend what you haul on upgrades for eight buildings, from the Rail Depot that opens new territories to the Water Tower that stretches every run. Each upgrade makes the next ride longer, richer or tougher.

Explore four wild territories, each with four stops and three star targets to beat. Find relics in satchels along the line, complete the relic sets and unlock cosmetic carts and portraits to show off your progress. Keep busy with daily orders and longer contracts, and climb seven conductor ranks from Greenhorn to Territory Legend.

Made for short sessions and steady progress:
- Quick timed rides with one-finger controls: tap a side of the track or swipe
- Four territories to explore, with stops that unlock as you go
- Town upgrades, daily orders and standing contracts
- Relic sets and cosmetic carts and portraits to collect
- Progress saved on your device, with no account needed

No ads, no in-app purchases and no real-money play. Just the rails, the ore and the next stop down the line.

name: Betiled
description:
A little magic. One more match.

Clear beautifully layered boards by collecting three matching tiles. Your tray has seven spaces, so every choice matters as you uncover the tiles beneath.

Find your pace with 1,000 puzzles across Easy, Medium, Hard, and Extra Hard. Each category has 250 puzzles, arranged in chapters of 25.

Complete chapters to earn power-ups and surprise tile collections. Start with the Original tiles and unlock 40 additional sets as you explore the game.

Finish all 250 puzzles in a difficulty to unlock its Endless chapter, where new puzzles keep the challenge going.

Use Undos, Magnets, and Shuffles when you want a helping hand. Your power-ups stay with you between puzzles, and daily login rewards give you more on the days you play.

Enjoy illustrated storybook menus, cheerful tile artwork, music, and optional haptic feedback on supported devices. Betiled is designed for portrait play on iPhone and iPad.

Betiled includes optional in-app purchases and advertisements. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns off automatic ads.

name: Better Wish
description:
Keep the things you actually hope for in one warm little list, and hand it to the people who ask what you want.

Add a gift by pasting a shop link. The title, photo and price fill themselves in, and you can tidy whatever you like after.

Then share one private link. Whoever opens it can browse without making an account, and claim a gift quietly. The gift stays on the list with a small red stamp, so nobody buys the kettle twice. You always see that a gift is spoken for. You never see who took it.

WHAT YOU GET

One private link per list, ready to paste into any group chat
Gift details filled in from the shop link you paste
Quiet claims with a stamp, so there are no doubles
Price watches: tap the bell on a gift and the shop is checked every day
A private giving history of everything you have claimed
Secret Santa: one link, one draw, no group-chat scramble
Gift guides for the way you actually live

WHAT IT IS NOT

No public profiles. No follower counts. No ads dressed up as recommendations. Just your list, your people, and a small red stamp when something has been taken care of.

Some shop links are affiliate links. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases. Picks are chosen before any commission is considered.

name: BICSI Events
description: At BICSI, the global ICT community comes together to understand what’s changing, translate possibility into real-world infrastructure, and prepare to lead what comes next.

name: Big Timer: Giant Countdown
description:
A clear countdown you can read at a glance.

Save your go-to timers, tap to start, and keep counting after time runs out. Big Timer fills the screen with your time in portrait or landscape.

Included free:
• Three saved timers
• Countdown and overtime display
• Horizontal or stacked portrait layouts
• Optional screen wake
• Soft chime or silent alerts
• Local timer notifications

Upgrade once to Big Timer Pro for unlimited saved timers, every time font and alert tone, repeating reminders with your choice of interval, and white timer mode.

No account. No ads. No subscription.

Notification sounds follow your device settings. Background repeating reminders are queued for the limited window shown in Settings.

name: Big Year: Plans at a Glance
description:
Big Year is your whole year on one screen: the trips, concerts, getaways, birthdays, anniversaries and plans with family and friends you're looking forward to. It isn't an agenda. There are no hours and no meetings, on purpose: every plan takes whole days, so you see the year at a glance and where there's room for the next one.

PLAN IN ONE GESTURE
• Touch and hold a day and drag across the days: that's your trip. Give it a name, and you're done.
• Or tap + and pick the dates in one go.
• Pick what kind of plan it is (a trip, a getaway, a concert, a birthday, an anniversary, family, friends) and it gets its own icon and colour. When two plans overlap, they sit side by side, so nothing hides.
• Birthdays and anniversaries come back every year on their own: add them once.

SEE THE WHOLE YEAR
• A day list that scrolls month by month, with every plan drawn across its days.
• A quarter view: three months side by side, swipe to move through the year.
• Jump to today in one tap, and move between years with the arrows.

SHARE IT, PRINT IT
• Turn your year into an image for your stories or a post, in light or dark.
• Save it as a crisp A4 or Letter PDF, or print it straight away with AirPrint, for the fridge or the office wall.

PRIVATE FOR REAL
No account. No ads. No analytics. No servers: your plans stay on your iPhone. Export a backup file whenever you want and import it on another iPhone. The only things that go online are a purchase and a request to rate the app, through the App Store.

PRICE
Your first five plans are free. After that, pay once and keep it for good, or subscribe weekly. The subscription renews every week until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings. There are no ads and no servers, so this is how the app pays for itself.

Made for iOS with Liquid Glass, light and dark, in English and Spanish.

Made by one developer, not a company. If something doesn't work, write to hi@victorfalcon.es and I'll look into it.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Bikash Academy
description:
Bikash Academy is the student app of Bikash Academy, Itachhen, Bhaktapur-2, Nepal. Sign in with your mobile number to study the academy's courses on your iPhone or iPad.

What you can do in the app:

• Browse the academy's courses and see what each one includes.
• Watch recorded class videos and read notes and resources.
• Take quizzes and practice tests and see your results.
• Join live classes with one tap, using the integrated Zoom meeting screen, when your teacher has a class scheduled.
• Read the syllabus, meet the teachers and read success stories from other students.
• Get notifications from the academy. You can turn them off in the app.
• Manage your profile and delete your account at any time from Profile.

Free and paid courses
Some courses are free. Paid courses are bought inside the app with your Apple ID as a one-time in-app purchase for each course.

Please note
Bikash Academy is a small and growing institute, so the number of courses and live classes is limited and will change over time. Live classes appear only when the academy has a class scheduled.

name: Bike Zoomar
description:
Bike Zoomar keeps track of every part on your bike and tells you when it needs attention, before it fails on a ride.

Connect Strava and your kilometres sync automatically. Bike Zoomar works out how worn each part is and alerts you when it's time to check or replace it.

TRACK EVERY PART
• Chains, cassettes, chainrings, tyres, brake pads, rotors, bearings and more
• See the wear on each part as a percentage, with kilometres remaining
• Keep a full service history with costs, dates and who did the work

ALERTS THAT COME TO YOU
• Push notifications when a part needs checking or replacing
• One Alerts list for every bike, with a count on the app icon
• Mark a part as replaced, or snooze it if you've checked it
• Tyre sealant, e-bike battery and chain rotation reminders

STRAVA SYNC
• Link each Bike Zoomar bike to your Strava bike
• Distances update automatically after every ride

WORKS WITH YOUR BIKE SHOP
• Give your local shop access to your bike
• Services they log appear in your history straight away

FREE AND PRO
Bike Zoomar is free to use for one bike. Bike Zoomar Pro unlocks unlimited bikes, Strava sync, wear alerts and more, as a monthly or annual subscription.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://bikezoomar.com/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bikezoomar.com/legal/privacy

name: BinDot
description:
Which bin goes out this week? BinDot tells you at a glance, and reminds you before bin day.

Set up in two questions: your collection day, and which bin goes out next. Add every bin you have, name it, give it a colour, and choose whether it goes out every week or every 2 weeks. If you have a blue week and a green week, BinDot keeps track of whose turn it is.

WHAT YOU GET
- A clear Home screen that shows the bins going out today and the next collection days
- A reminder before bin day, 1 to 3 days ahead or on the day, at the time you pick
- A small Home Screen widget that shows a dot for the next bin and fills with the bin's colour on collection day
- Up to 8 bins, with 8 colours to pick from or your own custom colour
- A picture guide for each bin of what goes in and what stays out, which you can edit to match your local rules
- Optional location: turn it on to find your collection area on your phone. In the Central Okanagan, BC, BinDot suggests the five curbside bins and shows that area's rules. Your location is not stored or sent anywhere
- Works in light and dark appearance

NO ACCOUNT, NO AD TRACKING
There is nothing to sign up for. Your bins and schedule stay on your phone. BinDot has no ads and no analytics tools of its own.

TRY IT FREE, THEN SUBSCRIBE
BinDot is free for 14 days. The trial starts in the app and takes no payment details. After that, a subscription keeps BinDot going: US$2.99 a month or US$28.49 a year (CA$3.99 a month or CA$38.00 a year in Canada). The yearly plan costs about 20% less than twelve months at the monthly price.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. Cancelling stops the next renewal, and you keep BinDot until the end of the period you have paid for.

Terms of Use: https://bindot.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bindot.app/privacy
Questions: info@bindot.app

Collection rules vary by area and change over time. Check your local authority for the current rules.

name: Bisa English by Miels
description:
Learn English the way Indonesian speakers need it.

EASY PRONUNCIATION
English spelling often doesn't match the sound. Every word in Bisa English has its international pronunciation (IPA) and a pronunciation guide in Indonesian spelling with the stressed syllable marked: journey → JER-ni, computer → kem-PYU-ter, thank → théngk.

DAILY PRACTICE
• Daily quiz: 10 questions from the words you have learned. Missed words come back more often.
• Speaking practice: say the word and your iPhone checks it. Bisa English never records or stores your voice.
• A streak counter keeps you going.
• Play all: listen to a whole level like a podcast.

EVERY WORD
• IPA and an Indonesian-style pronunciation guide
• Indonesian meaning and word type
• An everyday example sentence with translation
• Listen to the pronunciation, also in slow mode

CONTENT
• The 6000 most-used English words, from basic to advanced, in 20 levels plus 1500 sentence cards
• Example sentences about everyday life: family, school, work, shopping, travel and working abroad
• Levels 1–5 (1500 words) free; one purchase unlocks levels 6–20, no subscription

ALSO
• Large, easy-to-read lock screen and home screen widgets, with a new word every 15 minutes to once a day
• Mark words Hard / OK / Easy; hard words come back more often
• No account, no ads, works offline

Bisa English is made by Miels, makers of natural handmade soap. Visit miels.id.

name: BiteBike: Food Delivery
description:
BiteBike is a cheerful 3D arcade game about a food courier on a bicycle. The bike rides on its own through colourful streets lined with front gardens, restaurants and customers' homes. One swipe switches lanes, a swipe up sends the order flying straight to the customer's door. Every delivery pays in coins – the faster the food arrives, the bigger the tip.

ORDERS AND DISHES
• Pick orders before every shift – the basket holds three deliveries
• Burgers, pizza, salad, sushi, noodle soup and ice cream – every dish has its own time limit
• Sushi and soup are delicate: too many bumps and the delivery is ruined
• Ice cream melts faster in the sun
• Restaurants remember good work: high loyalty brings better orders

DODGE AND RIDE SMART
• Pedestrians, cats, dogs, opening car doors, potholes and broken glass
• On the road, cars, buses and trucks honk – with oncoming traffic it gets tight
• The bell scares people and animals out of the way
• Crashes damage the bike – repair it in the workshop with coins
• Hold to brake, swipe to change lanes – playable with one hand
• Four shifts: quiet morning, lunch rush, evening rush and the dark late shift

100 LEVELS, ONE YEAR IN TOWN
• 10 districts with 10 levels each, new dishes and obstacles join step by step
• Spring, summer, autumn and winter change the look and the ride
• A big catering order waits at the end of every district
• Up to 3 stars per level, new districts unlock with stars
• Gear like an e-bike, a thermal box or puncture-proof tyres can only be earned in the game

PLAYED FAIR
• Try for free: levels 1 to 3 are free, the full version unlocks all 100 levels with a one-time purchase
• No ads, no subscription, no in-game currency for real money
• No account, no tracking, no analytics
• Progress stays on the device
• Plays without an internet connection (only buying the full version needs the App Store)
• Languages: German, English, Spanish, French and Italian

Terms of use: https://studio48.ai/spiele-agb-ios.html#english
Licence agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Provider and legal notice: https://studio48.ai/ios.html#impressum

name: Blau Visión
seller_name: TECH FOR GOOD S.A.P.I. DE C.V.
description:
Blau Visión es la app para los dueños de las empresas de recolección que operan con Blau. En 10 segundos sabes cómo va tu empresa; en un minuto, qué atender.

• Tu Score de la semana: un número de 0 a 100 con cinco rubros (operación, unidades, facturación, cobranza y clientes), cómo cambió contra la semana pasada y cómo te comparas contra otras recolectoras, sin nombres.
• Lo que hay que atender: hasta tres temas ordenados por dinero en juego, cada uno con el botón para resolverlo.
• Facturación y cobranza: lo hecho y sin facturar, lo vencido por antigüedad y quién te debe más.
• Clientes: quién está bien atendido, quién está en riesgo y por qué.
• Camiones en vivo: dónde va cada camión, cuántos servicios lleva y a qué hora llega al siguiente cliente.
• Agrega un servicio o muévelo de ruta desde el teléfono, con la ruta sugerida y sin confundir «sólo esta vez» con «siempre».
• Utilidad: cuánto deja cada ruta, camión y cliente.
• Ventas: cotiza en el momento, también dictándola con la voz, y manda la liga al cliente.
• Cámaras de tus camiones dentro de la app.
• Un asistente que contesta tus preguntas con los datos de tu empresa y te dice de dónde sale cada cifra.

Entras con un código que te llega por WhatsApp, SMS o correo la primera vez y después sólo con Face ID o tu huella. Cada empresa ve únicamente su información.

Blau Visión requiere una cuenta de administrador de una empresa que use la plataforma Blau.

name: Blazegale: Run & Gun
description:
Blazegale is an original side-scrolling run-and-gun. Fight your way from a desert outpost to the heart of an enemy fortress: run, jump, go prone, aim in eight directions and never stop shooting.

20 STAGES, EASY TO HARD
Deserts, harbor docks, a speeding freight train, vertical mine shafts, a storm-lashed city, a foundry full of molten steel, a sky armada and the core fortress. The first stages teach you the ropes. Later ones add moving platforms, conveyor belts, crushers, laser gates, gusts of wind and far more enemy fire.

A BOSS AT THE END OF EVERY STAGE
Eight kinds of bosses, including a heavy tank, a gunship, a gunboat, a jumping mech and a reactor core. They return tougher in later stages, and the music speeds up when they are nearly down.

7 WEAPONS, 5 POWER-UPS
Rifle, rapid fire, spread shot, laser, blast shells, homing shots and a flamethrower. Supply crates and cargo drones drop a shield, speed boost, support drone, screen-clearing bomb or extra life.

8 HERO SKINS
Start with three and unlock five more by clearing stages, all the way to the golden soldier for beating stage 20.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose 3, 5, 10, 30 or unlimited lives per run. On iPhone and iPad you get a floating stick and two buttons. On Mac you can play with a keyboard or a gamepad, remap every key, and team up in two-player co-op on one keyboard.

LEARN IN TWO MINUTES
A ten-step tutorial covers moving, jumping, aiming, going prone and picking up weapons before your first real stage.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
Smooth vector characters, pixel-style explosions, glowing bullets, fireworks and confetti when you clear a stage, and an original chiptune soundtrack.

NO ADS. NO PURCHASES. NO INTERNET.
Everything is in the app. Nothing is collected, and your progress stays on your device.

Languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, German, French and Spanish. Simplified Chinese can also be selected in the game.

name: Blind Ranking: Party Challenge
description:
Rank it before you know what's coming.
Pick a category, and items show up one at a time. Put each one in a slot and lock it: no moving it later, even when something better appears.
Finish in under a minute, then share your ranking as an image.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a category and 5 or 10 items. Slot 1 always says what it means: favorite, best, most annoying.
2. An item is revealed. Tap an empty slot, then Lock In.
3. Keep going until every slot is full, then share the result.

PLAY TOGETHER ON ONE PHONE
- Pass the phone: everyone ranks the same items in the same order
- Nobody sees another board until the last player finishes
- Then reveal all the boards together and argue about the pineapple

MADE FOR GAME NIGHT
- 12 starter categories, free: pizza toppings, comfort foods, snacks, breakfast, weekend plans, lazy days, travel moments, road trips, chores, small comforts, little annoyances and tiny dilemmas
- Every category and item was written for this app and checked to be family friendly
- Big, readable cards, a two-step tutorial and a five-item sample round to start
- Unfinished rounds are saved after every pick, so you can stop and pick up later
- Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver

FREE
All 12 starter categories, unlimited rounds, pass-and-play, every board revealed, image sharing, a demo private list to try, up to 10 results in Saved Results, and a free JSON backup.

PRO
- 22 more packs, from superpowers and space to desserts and dinosaurs
- Unlimited private lists: write your own and play them blind
- Compare mode: how closely each pair agrees, with the math explained, and one group image
- Saved Results keeps every result

If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Your lists and results stay readable and exportable.

JUST FOR FUN
Rankings are opinions. There is no public vote, no world average and no score for being right. Comparisons only cover the people on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Lists, nicknames and results are stored on your iPhone. Images are made on the device and shared only where you send them.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/blind-ranking/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/blind-ranking/terms

name: Block Crash: Color Sort
description:
Move blocks from tower to tower. A block can only land on the same color or in an empty tower. Stack four of one color and they crash and vanish. Clear the whole box in the fewest moves to earn three stars.

Block Crash is a calm sorting puzzle that takes seconds to learn. Every box can be solved, and the target shows the smallest number of moves it takes.

• Tap two towers, or slide from one to the other
• Combos when one move sets off several crashes
• 80 levels and a daily puzzle, the same for everyone
• Free hints whenever you are stuck, and undo for every move
• Every color also has a symbol, so it is colorblind-friendly
• No timer, plays offline, no account, no ads
• Available in 70 languages

name: Block Section
description:
Block Section keeps a model railway honest.

The staff rides with the train. Drag the staff onto the section the train occupies, and the staff is aboard. Drag the staff onto another section, and it rests there.

The train moves only into the next section, and only while the staff is aboard. Both move together. A drag into a section that is not next door is skipped. A drag into the next section without the staff is refused, and the train stays. Letting go in the same section does not count.

Each line keeps four enamel sections. You can rename the line and the sections, delete a line, and share a four-line summary.

Lines stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not control a real railway.

name: Block Tango
description:
Block Tango is a calm, beautiful block puzzle that grows with you. Drag pieces onto the board, clear rows and columns, and build combos as the colors, tiles and music shift around you. There are no time limits and no ads, just you, the board and your next move.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No timers and no ads.
• Works offline, so you can play anywhere.
• Turn sound effects, music and vibration on or off in Settings.
• Respects Reduce Motion, and the symbol tiles make colors easy to tell apart.
• Works in any orientation and adapts to every screen, including both displays on iPhone Duo: play on the cover screen, or unfold for a roomy side-by-side layout.

RELAX AND UNWIND
• Take your time: there's no clock counting down.
• Think through every move at your own pace, or play on autopilot and let the rhythm carry you.
• Soothing colors and smooth animations.
• Laid-back original music that keeps you in the flow, or switch it off for quiet play.
• Play for a minute or an hour. Every round is as long or as short as you want it to be.
• Perfect for winding down before bed, a quiet break between tasks or a few mindful minutes on the go.

COMBOS AND BIG SCORES
• Clear lines on back-to-back drops to build a combo and earn big bonus points. 
• Clearing several lines at once to scores more than clearing them one at a time.
• Empty the whole board for a 300-point Board Clear bonus.
• Top your high score!

A GAME THAT CHANGES AS YOU PLAY
Each new stage feels like a fresh game, and reaching the next one is its own reward.

ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACKS
Unlock original electronic tracks, from bright and bouncy to deep and moody to fast and driving, crossfading smoothly into the next as you reach new stages. 

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO PUT DOWN
• A gentle start helps new players land their first clears and combos quickly.
• The challenge ramps up steadily as your score grows, so experienced players stay engaged.
• Play a quick round in a spare minute or settle in for a long run.

Clear your mind, then clear the board. Download Block Tango and find your rhythm.

name: Blockhammer
description:
Blockhammer is a modern voxel editor for low-poly 3D models. You build by clicking blocks into place, then push their corners in to make slopes, wedges and points. It stays fast from a single prop to a whole city.

BUILD LIKE AN IMAGE EDITOR
• Work in layers. Hide one and everything underneath is still there.
• Everything you build is a named object you can pick, hide, lock or position exactly.
• Effects you can take back off: round the edges of a layer or rough up its surface, then change your mind later.
• Cut one shape out of another, and the hole moves when the cutter does.
• Everything undoes, and your work saves itself as you go.

VOXELS YOU CAN RESHAPE
• Take any block by a face, an edge or a corner and push it in.
• A roof is a row of blocks and one drag. There is no catalogue of shapes to learn.
• Neighboring blocks move together, so a slope runs clean across them.

PAINT ON THE MODEL
• Every side of every block is its own small canvas, sixteen times finer than the blocks.
• Add wood grain, rust, warning stripes and lettering without adding a single block.
• Brushes follow the surface around corners and over steps.
• Glass, metal and glowing paint can sit side by side on the same face.

BUILT FOR BIG SCENES
• Far-off parts of a scene are drawn simpler and sharpen as you come closer.
• Moving the camera never rebuilds anything.
• Tested on scenes of more than a hundred million blocks.

BRING MODELS IN, SHIP THEM OUT
• Opens MagicaVoxel .vox files, colours and all.
• Exports .glb with paint included, .obj, .vox and Minecraft .schem.
• Renders stills and turntable GIFs.
• Models arrive in Unity, Unreal, Godot and Blender at the right size.

Everything you make stays on your device. No account needed.

name: Bloom: Paint Mix Puzzle
description:
Bloom is a calm paint-mixing puzzle. You get three paints: red, yellow and blue. Drop them on the canvas, watch them spread and blend, and match the target picture.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap a paint, then tap the canvas to drop it.
- Where two paints meet they mix: red and yellow make orange, yellow and blue make green, blue and red make purple.
- Match the target picture closely enough to finish the level.
- Use fewer drops than par to earn all three stars.

WHAT YOU GET
- Hand-checked levels that grow from small canvases to large ones.
- A ghost view that shows the target over your canvas.
- A hint that suggests the next drop when you are stuck.
- Undo and restart at any time. No timers and no lives.
- A 1970s screen-print look with soft, slow animations.
- Letters on every paint, so the game does not depend on color vision alone.
- Works offline. No account. No ads.

PRICE
Levels 1 to 15 are free. A single one-time purchase unlocks every level after that. There are no subscriptions and no consumable purchases.

name: Blue Dot, Red Dot: Dots Game
description:
Remember the back pages of a school notebook? Two pens, blue and red, taking turns on squared paper, and that small thrill when your loop closed around the other side's dots. Blue Dot, Red Dot brings the game back, every line drawn in ballpoint ink.

How it plays
Take turns putting a dot on a crossing of the grid. Close a loop of your own dots around the other color's dots and they are captured, with the space inside. Whoever captures more wins. You learn it in a minute and it keeps surprising you for years.

What is inside
- A brain training journey: 36 sheets with goals, ink blots, holes in the paper and stars to catch
- Quick games against the computer on 3 levels and 4 sheet sizes, including a sheet with no end
- Two players on one phone, sitting face to face
- A game with a friend by a link, phone to phone, no account needed
- A tournament twice a week with 5 leagues and lists of 30 players
- A wardrobe for your dot with 12 things to wear
- 6 papers to play on: notebook, blueprint, chalkboard, kraft, night and journal
- Calm music made from your own moves
- House rules: a capture can give one more move, quick and friend games can have blots and holes
- No wifi needed against the computer or on one phone

New to the game?
The first sheets teach it one idea at a time: your first loop, two captures with one dot, why the edge of the page is safe. A few sheets later you are ready for the red pen.

For two
Pass the phone across the table, or send a link to a friend in another city and play phone to phone. No sign up, no waiting room, just the two of you and a fresh page.

The tournament
Twice a week everyone gets the same sheet and the same red pen. Play your best try, see where you land among 30 players and climb through 5 leagues.

A little friend on every page
A round blue dot with two eyes, scribbled by a pen, keeps you company on every sheet. Dress it up from the wardrobe and take it along to the tournament.

Calm on purpose
Soft pen sounds, music that grows out of your moves, and papers for daytime and late evenings.

Grab a pen. The page is waiting.

name: Blue Hour: Gentle Alarm Clock
description:
Blue Hour is a gentle alarm clock with one screen: a place worth waking up to, under the real sun, moon and weather for where you are. Drag the sky to the hour you want and your alarm is set. One alarm at a time, up to a day ahead. No lists, no settings, no ads, no subscription.

DRAG THE SKY TO SET YOUR ALARM
• Slide right for later, left for earlier. Flick to roll through the hours.
• The sky moves with your finger: sunset, stars, moonrise, first light.
• Stop at the hour you want to wake up. Tap Set alarm. Done.
• Tomorrow, set the same time again with one tap.

A SKY THAT IS TRUE
• The sun and the moon stand where they really stand for you, minute by minute.
• The moon shows tonight's real phase.
• Clouds, rain, snow and fog follow the forecast for where you are.
• Slide to 6:30 and you see the morning you will actually get, with the temperature.

THREE PLACES TO WAKE UP
• Mount Fuji across a still lake, with mist drifting in at sunrise.
• A lighthouse on a granite island off the Swedish west coast.
• A hut on stilts in a South Pacific lagoon.
Every place in every light: night, dawn, sunrise, day, golden hour and dusk.

A SOUND FOR EVERY PLACE, NOT A BEEP
• Mount Fuji wakes you with morning birdsong. The lighthouse with waves and gulls. The lagoon with surf and a dove.
• If steady rain is forecast for the minute your alarm rings, you wake up to rain.
• Every sound starts quietly and rises over about twelve seconds.
• Tap play to hear exactly what will ring.

AN ALARM YOU CAN TRUST
• A real system alarm: it rings when your iPhone is locked, on silent or in a Focus.
• "I'm up" stops it. "A little longer" gives you nine more minutes, with a countdown on the Lock Screen.
• Home Screen widgets show your next alarm in the light it will ring in.

FOR ANY HOUR
A night shift, an afternoon nap, a 4 a.m. flight: Blue Hour never assumes it is morning. The sky shows what is really out there at the hour you wake up, and the greeting follows the clock.

SIMPLE ON PURPOSE
• One alarm at a time, up to 24 hours ahead. No alarm lists, no repeat schedules, no settings screen.
• Free. No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription, nothing to buy.
• Location is optional. It is only used to get your sky and your forecast right. Without it, the sky follows your clock.

Wake up somewhere else. Under your own sky.

Weather data from Apple Weather.

Privacy Policy: https://www.ensh.se/bluehour/privacy

name: BMBOX.pl - Boksy Magazynowe
seller_name: SPRYTKI PL SP Z O O
description:
BMBOX.pl – Twój magazyn w telefonie

Zyskaj dodatkową przestrzeń na swoje rzeczy i korzystaj z własnego boksu magazynowego w Gorzowie Wielkopolskim. BMBOX.pl to samoobsługowe boksy magazynowe, które pozwalają wygodnie przechowywać rzeczy prywatne i firmowe. Wybierz przestrzeń dla siebie i korzystaj z niej wtedy, kiedy potrzebujesz.
Dzięki aplikacji możesz wygodnie zarządzać swoim wynajmem i korzystać z najważniejszych funkcji bezpośrednio ze smartfona.

Wynajmij boks online
Wybierz odpowiednią przestrzeń i przejdź przez proces wynajmu online. Załatw formalności wygodnie, bez konieczności wizyty w biurze.

Zarządzaj swoim wynajmem
Sprawdzaj informacje dotyczące wynajmu, płatności i swojego boksu. Wszystko, czego potrzebujesz, znajdziesz w jednym miejscu.

Dostęp do boksu 24/7
Korzystaj ze swojego boksu przez całą dobę, 7 dni w tygodniu. Aplikacja umożliwia korzystanie z funkcji dostępu do obiektu bezpośrednio ze smartfona.

Przestrzeń dopasowana do Twoich potrzeb
Potrzebujesz dodatkowego miejsca podczas przeprowadzki, remontu lub porządkowania mieszkania? A może szukasz przestrzeni do przechowywania wyposażenia firmy, materiałów lub zapasów towaru?
W BMBOX.pl oferujemy samodzielne boksy magazynowe o powierzchni 30 m² przy ul. Piłkarskiej 29 w Gorzowie Wielkopolskim. Możesz przechowywać w nich m.in. meble, rzeczy sezonowe, rowery, opony, sprzęt firmowy, materiały i zapasy towaru.

Wygoda i dodatkowe miejsce
Uporządkuj swoją przestrzeń w domu lub firmie i przechowuj rzeczy w jednym miejscu. BMBOX.pl to wygodne rozwiązanie zarówno dla osób prywatnych, jak i przedsiębiorców, którzy potrzebują dodatkowej powierzchni magazynowej.

Pobierz aplikację BMBOX.pl i zarządzaj swoim boksem magazynowym wygodnie z poziomu telefonu.

name: BO NexEv
description:
BO NexEv is the official mobile app for NexEv field teams, providing technicians, civil, and electrical teams with easy access to their daily work operations.

Manage assigned tasks, track support tickets, monitor escalations, and stay connected with your field operations directly from your mobile device.

KEY FEATURES

• Ticket Management – View assigned tickets and update their status.
• Escalation Tracking – Monitor and manage high-priority escalated tickets.
• Work Updates – Add remarks and updates to assigned tickets.
• Field Operations – Access essential work information while on-site.
• Secure Login – Access your authorized NexEv business account.

BO NexEv helps NexEv technicians and field teams manage their daily responsibilities with a simple and convenient mobile experience.

Note: An active NexEv account is required. Access is available only to authorized technician, civil, and electrical team members.

name: Boat Checkout
description: Settle crewed and bareboat charters with clear numbers. Track APA and expenses, log fuel and deposits, manage people and checklists, then share a clean end-of-trip statement—all offline on your phone.

name: BoliKeys: Phonetic Keyboard
description:
BoliKeys is a keyboard for iPhone and iPad that turns phonetic typing in Latin letters into Tamil, Bangla (Bengali) and Punjabi in the Gurmukhi script.

Type the sound of a word on a familiar QWERTY layout. BoliKeys shows the word in your chosen script above the keys. Press space to insert the highlighted suggestion, or tap another spelling.

• vanakkam → வணக்கம் (Tamil)
• ami → আমি (Bangla)
• punjabi → ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (Punjabi, Gurmukhi)

TYPE THE WAY YOU ALREADY SPELL
• Common alternative spellings lead to the same word: vanakam, vannakkam, valo, bhalo, panjabi.
• Handles long and short vowels, vowel signs, conjuncts, pulli, hasanta, tippi, bindi and addak.
• Keep Latin is always one tap away, for names, English words, e-mail addresses and links in mixed sentences.
• Switch language mid-sentence with one key. Touch and hold it for the full list.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works without Full Access, so iOS keeps the keyboard away from the network.
• Rules and word lists are built in, so it works offline and in Airplane Mode from the first use.
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no typing history.

INCLUDES
• The BoliKeys keyboard extension for any app that allows third-party keyboards.
• A setup guide, a Try BoliKeys practice area and typing tips in the app.
• Light and Dark Mode, iPhone and iPad layouts, VoiceOver labels.

One purchase includes all three languages. iOS uses its own keyboard for passwords, phone-number fields and in apps that don't allow third-party keyboards.

name: Bomber di Like
description:
Bomber di Like è il podcast di Max Sardella per chi ama il mondo del calcio. Campioni, allenatori, giornalisti e protagonisti dei social si raccontano senza filtri: carriere, cadute, ripartenze e tutto quello che non si vede in campo.

Con l'app puoi: 
• guardare le puntate in video o ascoltarle in solo audio, anche con lo schermo spento 
• saltare subito al momento che ti interessa con i capitoli 
• riprendere da dove avevi lasciato, anche su un altro dispositivo 
• salvare le puntate preferite e ritrovarle in un tocco 
• guardare le anteprime e i momenti migliori delle puntate 
• cercare per ospite o argomento 
• commentare le puntate e fare domande al prossimo ospite 
• segnalare una storia da bomber alla redazione 
• scoprire il libro Bomber di Like

Nuove puntate ogni settimana. Entra nello spogliatoio di Bomber di Like!

name: Book Reading Timer
description:
Open Book Reading Timer to see exactly where you left off in your paper book. Start with one tap, then log your ending page when you finish.

• Keep a separate bookmark for each book you read.
• The timer keeps running while your phone is locked. Pause whenever you need a break.
• Add a past session, edit your history, or export your log as CSV.
• Share a weekly card or a reading milestone. Weekly cards hide book titles by default, and you can show them on a card you choose to share.
• Apply a friend’s weekly reading goal with a short code.

Past-week summaries and the ability to create, edit and share goals are available for a 30-day trial and a one-time unlock. Timing, bookmarks, history, CSV and cards stay free. No subscription, ads or account. Your reading data stays on your device.

name: Book to AI
description:
Put your iPhone on a stand or tripod above an open book. Press Start, turn a page, take your hand away. Book to AI shoots each page, splits the spread into two pages, evens out the light and keeps the order.

No book at hand? Tap “Try it with a sample book” on the first screen and watch a sample spread being cut into pages and turned into text.

When you have the whole book:
• Hand it to an AI app. Share a PDF or a text file with page markers, plus a ready-made prompt (such as a summary, five key claims or things to do tomorrow), to the Claude or ChatGPT app you already use. No key, no setup.
• Export a PDF with a searchable text layer, Markdown with page markers, an EPUB to read in a books app, or plain text, one file per page. The page photos are also in the Files app, one folder per book.

Shooting that stays out of your way
• Three ways to shoot: every few seconds (Rhythm), when the page holds still, or by hand.
• A level indicator and a short note tell you when the phone is tilted or the book is too small in the frame.
• Spots to check: pages that may be missing, a repeated page number, a page with no readable text. Retake a single shot without redoing the book.
• Works with left-to-right and right-to-left books, including vertical Japanese text.
• Already have page photos? Import them from Photos or Files into a new book.

Your photos stay on your iPhone. There is no account, no ads and no tracking. Nothing leaves the phone unless you share it. Scanning, PDF, Markdown, text export and handing the book to another app all work without any key.

Advanced, optional: if you have your own Anthropic (Claude) API key, you can also re-read pages and ask questions about the book inside the app, with answers that cite their pages like [p.12]. The key stays in this iPhone's Keychain, photos or text go to Anthropic only when you tap, and the cost is billed to your Anthropic account.

Use it for books you own, for your own reading and study. Please respect copyright.

Pay once: no subscription, no in-app purchases and no page limits.

Early adopter price: Book to AI is offered at its launch price for a while, as a thank-you to early users. We plan to double the price later.

Languages: 14 (English, 日本語, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, 한국어, Português (Brasil), 简体中文, 繁體中文, हिन्दी, Русский, العربية, עברית).

name: Bookling: Read the Classics
description:
Read the classics, and ask when you get lost.

Bookling is a library of classic books you can open and start reading right away. Pride and Prejudice, Hamlet, Journey to the West, Dream of the Red Chamber and many more. No account, nothing to buy.

Ask the book
Tap "Ask" on any page, or select a sentence and ask about it. Bookling answers only from the part you have read, so nothing is spoiled unless you say you want spoilers. Every answer shows where it comes from, like "Ch. 3, ¶12". Tap it to jump back to that line in the book.

Explain a passage
Select a paragraph and tap Explain. Old English becomes plain modern English. An English book can be explained in Chinese. Classical Chinese becomes everyday language.

Side by side
Switch an English classic to a paragraph-by-paragraph Chinese translation. Switch classical Chinese to a plain-language version. Flip back to the original any time.

Pick up where you left off
Come back the next day and a short recap opens the book: what happened so far, and who has appeared. Tap a name to open the character list and see the passages they are in. Nothing past your place is revealed.

Two libraries, one app
English and Chinese, switch whenever you like. Browse by category or search by title or author. For Chinese books, choose Simplified or Traditional.

Made for reading
Font, text size, line spacing and page color (white, sepia, dark). Look up any word with the built-in dictionary. Share a favorite line as a card with the original and its translation. A gentle daily reminder is optional.

Your reading stays on your phone. To answer a question, the selected text and your question are sent through our server to a third-party AI model (DeepSeek); answers are AI-generated and can be wrong. You can delete your data in Settings.

Open the app, tap "Start reading," and you are on page one.

name: Books Down
description:
Books Down helps actors learn their lines.

Load a script from a PDF or a photo, pick your character, and rehearse your scenes with every other part read aloud — each character in their own voice. When it's your turn, Books Down leaves a gap the length of your line for you to say it, or reads it for you while you're still learning.

Run through any scene, beat or marked section, and loop the bit you keep getting wrong
Hide your own lines to test yourself, or have them read first while you learn
Record real voices for other characters — or your own lines — and play them back in rehearsal
Rehearse hands-free: say "play", "stop", "back" or "next"
Choose whether stage directions are read, and how fast everything plays
Add notes to any line
Share scripts and recordings with your cast through a private, PIN-protected library

Books down, lines learned

name: Boomeroo Lend
description:
A book you lent to a friend, a charger a colleague took home, or a tool that's been gone for ages and you can't remember who's holding it. Sometimes, borrowed items are the easiest to forget.

This app helps you remember all these little things. Just add the item, select the person holding it, and track its status until it's returned. Everything is in one neat list, no more remembering who you lent it to or which items are still missing.

You can also review your lending habits through a 12-week chart: how many items are currently out there, who usually returns them on time, which items are borrowed most often, and how long each loan typically lasts.

When you want to find an old item, view the return history by month, search, or sort the list as you wish. All data can also be exported as a CSV file for storage and use when needed.

You can try out the app with sample items in the Settings section before you start recording your belongings.

Managing borrowed items is simple, so you always know where they are and when they can be returned.

name: BornYoUnited: Sports Manager
description:
BornYoUnited brings together three anime-style sports managers from the athleticasyn Gaming studio: Pitchborn (football), Courtborn (basketball) and Netborn (volleyball). Choose your sport in the start menu and switch at any time; every club has its own save.

The heart of it: the live transfer market. You buy and sell players with real people, not the computer. Every transfer is a deal with another manager.

Found your own club in the lowest league and lead it to the top:

• Club founding with your own crest, kit and president
• Anime-style squad: every player with their own personality, strengths and morale
• Rules for each sport: positions, systems, substitutions, sets and quarters
• Contract talks with agents: wage, length, signing fee, role
• Press conferences whose answers end up in the club magazine
• Build mode: place grounds, stands, floodlights and food stalls yourself
• Follow matches live with team talks and instructions, or simulate them
• Season goals, daily and weekly tasks, milestones and a hall of fame
• Online: buy and sell players on the market, friends league with your people

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
Full screen in landscape, on iPad even in split windows, on the Mac as a native app with menu bar and windows.

PLAY WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Your career needs no account. A free athleticasyn Gaming account is only needed for the transfer market, the friends league and backing up your save. You can delete your account in the app.

FAIR PRICE
Play every sport free for 4 hours. Then unlock it with a single purchase, one sport or all three together. No ads, no subscription, nothing more to buy within a sport once it is unlocked. A purchase works on iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account.

name: Both Roofs: Co-Parenting Log
description:
Both Roofs is a log for a parent who shares custody. You keep your own log on your phone. The other parent keeps theirs. You swap logs as a locked file whenever you choose.

This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or representing any government agency.

WHAT YOU CAN RECORD
- Notes
- Handoffs: date, time, who took the children
- Shared expenses: what, how much, and the part you ask the other parent to pay
- Answers to the other parent's expenses: agreed, declined or paid
- Corrections that point at an earlier record
No money moves through the app.

RECORDS THAT ARE NOT CHANGED
Each record is saved once. It cannot be edited or deleted. Each one holds the hash of the record before it and is signed with a key made on your phone. If a record is changed, removed, added or moved later, the check fails and the app says where.

SWAP LOGS WITH THE OTHER PARENT
Send your log as a file locked with a passphrase you both agree on, by any app in the share sheet. Open theirs the same way. The first time, compare the key fingerprint with the other parent. After that the app takes in only files signed with that key, and refuses a file that drops or changes a record you already took in. Their records are kept apart from yours.

CUSTODY CALENDAR
Alternating weeks, 2-2-3, 2-2-5-5 or every other weekend, with a start date and an exchange time. See the next four weeks and the exchange days.

PDF AND RAW LOG
Make a PDF of both logs for a date range, with every record's time and hash, the key fingerprints, the expenses and answers, and a page on how to check the records. Share the raw log file with every field, for anyone you choose.

THE RECORD IS YOURS
The app does not certify your records, and no court, lawyer or agency has reviewed it. Whether anyone accepts a record from it is up to them. This is not legal advice.

NO ACCOUNT, NO SERVER
There is no sign-in and no server that holds your records. Your log is on your phone and in your phone's own backup when that is on. You can also make an encrypted backup file.

FREE AND PAID
Free, with no time limit: notes, handoffs, the calendar, answers, swapping files, the raw log, backup and restore, 5 expense records a month and PDFs of the last 30 days. The other parent can use the app free.
A plan on your phone adds expense records with no limit and PDFs of any date range. Choose a yearly subscription or a one time lifetime purchase. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

If you are in danger, call 911 or the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233.

Not affiliated with or approved by any court, government agency or other co-parenting service.

SOURCES
Hash on every record, NIST FIPS 180-4 (SHA-256): https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/180-4/upd1/final
Signature on every record, IETF RFC 8032 (Ed25519): https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8032
Passphrase lock on files and backups, NIST SP 800-132 (PBKDF2): https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/132/final
Why the PDF shows how records are made, Federal Rules of Evidence, Rule 902: https://www.uscourts.gov/forms-rules/current-rules-practice-procedure/federal-rules-evidence
Safety line phone number, National Domestic Violence Hotline: https://www.thehotline.org/

Privacy policy: https://blueprintsyndicate.com/privacy-policy/
Support: contact@blueprintsyndicate.com

name: Bothell Temple
description:
Bothell Temple is a humble offering of seva, created by a devotee for the benefit of our temple community. Developed independently in personal time, this app is a labor of devotion with one simple goal: to make it easier for devotees to stay connected with the temple and its activities, wherever they are.

What the App Offers
A thoughtfully designed iPhone experience that brings essential temple information right to your fingertips.
- Puja Schedules: Explore upcoming pujas, religious services, and temple activities.
- Events & Festivals: Stay informed about festivals, celebrations, and community gatherings.
- Timely Reminders: Receive notifications so you don't miss important pujas, events, and special occasions.
-  Easy Access: Get one-tap directions to the temple, send an email, or make a phone call.
- Stay Connected: Keep up with temple activities and remain engaged with our spiritual community.

A Small Effort, Offered with Devotion
This app is an independent initiative created as a personal contribution to the Bothell Temple community. It is not an official app developed, operated, or endorsed by the temple unless otherwise stated.

name: BotyPlus
description:
حوّل محادثات عملائك إلى فرص بيع مع BotyPlus، منصة لإدارة الرسائل والتعليقات والمبيعات والتسويق، مع أدوات ذكاء اصطناعي تساعدك على خدمة العملاء وتنظيم أعمالك من مكان واحد.

سواء كنت تدير متجرًا إلكترونيًا أو نشاطًا تجاريًا أو فريق خدمة عملاء، يساعدك BotyPlus على متابعة المحادثات، وتنظيم بيانات العملاء، وإدارة الطلبات، وتبسيط المهام اليومية.

كل محادثاتك في مكان واحد

إدارة محادثات القنوات المرتبطة بحسابك من صندوق وارد موحّد.

إرسال الرسائل والصور والملفات ومتابعة المحادثات.

توزيع المحادثات على أعضاء الفريق.

استخدام الردود المحفوظة وتنظيم المتابعات.

الذكاء الاصطناعي والردود التلقائية

إعداد قواعد للرد التلقائي على التعليقات.

استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي للمساعدة في صياغة الردود.

تجهيز قاعدة معرفة بمعلومات نشاطك التجاري والأسئلة الشائعة.

مساعدة العملاء وجمع بياناتهم وتحويل المحادثات إلى فرص بيع.

إدارة العملاء والمبيعات

تنظيم جهات الاتصال والعملاء المحتملين.

تسجيل بيانات العملاء والوسوم ومراحل المتابعة.

إدارة الطلبات والمنتجات والخدمات والمخزون.

متابعة المواعيد والتذكيرات وسجل أنشطة العملاء.

التسويق والمحتوى

تخطيط وجدولة المنشورات.

إعداد أفكار المحتوى بمساعدة الذكاء الاصطناعي.

إدارة التعليقات والردود التلقائية.

استخدام أدوات الإعلانات والحملات المتاحة لحسابك.

فريقك وأعمالك

دعوة أعضاء الفريق وإدارة صلاحياتهم.

تنظيم العمل عبر مساحات عمل متعددة.

متابعة تقارير المحادثات والمبيعات وأداء الموظف الذكي.

إدارة إعدادات النشاط التجاري والفواتير والاشتراك.

مصمم لأعمالك اليومية

إعدادات للإشعارات والحساب والأمان.

ابدأ بتنظيم محادثاتك، وامنح فريقك الأدوات اللازمة لخدمة العملاء ومتابعة فرص البيع بكفاءة أكبر.

تختلف الميزات المتاحة حسب القناة المرتبطة، وصلاحيات الحساب، والخطة المستخدمة.

name: BoxHarbor
description: Keep your move organized with a searchable box inventory. Name each box, assign its destination room, list the contents and mark fragile items. Track packing, packed, arrived and unpacked states. Browse a room at a time, search for an item and share a box summary. Progress counts come directly from your own records. Keep valuables and essential documents with you.\n\nFree, without ads, purchases or an account. Your records are saved locally. Choose from eight app languages and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample data is fictional and optional.

name: BrainVault-Your Second Brain
description:
BrainVault is a private vault for everything worth keeping: notes, web pages, photos, PDFs, Word documents and voice notes. Find anything in seconds, and ask a personal AI assistant that answers from what you've saved.

SAVE FROM ANYWHERE
• Share links, text, photos and files from any app straight into a collection, with a note on why you saved it
• Save just the passage you highlighted in Safari, with a link back to the page
• Import PDFs, Word (.docx), XML, Markdown, text and HTML files
• Take a photo or scan documents, receipts and whiteboards
• Record voice notes that are transcribed into searchable text
• Drop files into the BrainVault folder in iCloud Drive on your Mac or PC

YOUR ORIGINALS, KEPT SAFE
BrainVault keeps the real file, not just a summary. Open, share or save any original back to Files whenever you need it.

FIND ANYTHING
• Search titles, notes, tags and the text inside PDFs, documents and photos
• Search by voice
• Organize with collections and custom icons, pin favorites, and move or delete many notes at once
• Link notes with [[Note Title]] and see backlinks and related notes
• Browse people, companies, products and ideas found across your notes in Topics
• Find notes from iPhone search, save with Siri and Shortcuts, and see recent notes in widgets

A PERSONAL AI THAT KNOWS YOUR VAULT
• Ask questions like "When does my furnace warranty end?" or "List all my serial numbers" and get answers from your own documents, with sources you can tap
• Ask About This Note: summarize a document, pull out key points, or find dates and deadlines
• Voice chat: talk to your second brain and hear the answers read aloud
• Briefings on what you've been saving, research reports, and duplicate notes you can merge in one tap
• Resume Builder: keep your work history, education and certifications in a Career Profile and draft a tailored resume
• Runs on Apple Intelligence on your device by default. Optionally connect your own Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok API key.

REMEMBER WHAT MATTERS
Turn on review for notes you want to remember, with spaced-repetition reminders and a weekly digest of what you saved.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
• Your vault lives on your devices and in your own iCloud, synced across iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Lock BrainVault with Face ID or Touch ID
• Export everything, including original files, as an Obsidian-compatible .zip, and restore in one step
• Deleted notes stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days

FREE AND PRO
BrainVault is free for up to 20 notes, with every feature included. BrainVault Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited notes on all your devices. No subscription.

The AI Assistant requires a device that supports Apple Intelligence, or your own API key for a supported cloud AI provider.

Support: https://hxtom.github.io/brainvault-site/support.html
Privacy Policy: https://hxtom.github.io/brainvault-site/privacy.html

name: Bravo 44: War Action Shooter
description:
Lead Bravo Squad. Win the war.

1944, in a fictional war. The Free Coalition pushes against the Grey Legion, from the Iron Coast to the last fortress in the mountains. ACE, IVY and BRIGGS fight together — and you switch soldiers mid-mission.

TACTICAL SQUAD ACTION
• Three soldiers, three roles: ACE assault with grenades, IVY recon who MARKS targets, BRIGGS support with a machine gun and a steel shield
• Switch soldiers anytime; whoever falls leaves the mission and the next one takes over
• Real cover: get behind the sandbags and lean out to shoot
• Suppression: bursts on their cover keep the enemy pinned down

CALL IN THE ARTILLERY
• IVY marks the Legion in sight; the radio calls a barrage on the marked targets
• Man mounted machine guns, drive the jeep in chases and pilot the squad's tank

16 MISSIONS, 4 OPERATIONS, 6 BOSSES
• Iron Coast, Grey Road, Ruined City and Final Offensive
• Convoy escort, rescue, sabotage, documents, holding the extraction, cells, relays, a blizzard with wind
• Coastal cannon, armored tank, assault vehicle, turret platform, grounded bomber and armored train — each with telegraphed attacks, an attack window and phases

HD PIXEL ART
• Deep scenery, planes and bombing runs in the background, impact on every shot
• Squad voices, original music and sound
• Comfort settings: reduce shake, flashes and particles; button size and transparency; aim assist

PLAY OFFLINE
• Every mission works offline, no login and no account
• Ads only between missions (never during a mission, the pause or a boss); "Remove ads" is a one-time purchase
• In English, Spanish and Portuguese

Fictional war and factions, no blood and no real symbols.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bravo44.filisoft.com.br/privacidade.php?lang=en

name: Breezski
description: Breezski makes ski gear rental simple so you can travel light and ride freely. Browse today’s picks and a full mountain rack—helmets, skis, boots, pants, jackets, poles, and bindings—then filter by category or search in the shop to find the right kit fast. Every item shows a clear daily rate, rating, and short description so you know what you’re booking before you commit. Checkout is built for peace of mind with cash on delivery and free shipping. Track rentals in your order history, save favorites for the next trip, and manage your cabin profile in one place. Built-in tools help you prepare: Gear Fit Checker gives quick sizing cues from height and skill, Slope Day Planner sketches a rental budget for your days on snow, and Powder Pack Estimator helps crews plan haul weight before departure. Whether you’re a first-timer or a weekend regular, Breezski keeps gear hassle low and slope time high. Download Breezski—rent gear, ride freely.

name: Brevete Perú: Examen de Reglas
description:
App no oficial: no está vinculada al Ministerio de Transportes y Comunicaciones (MTC), a la Municipalidad de Lima ni a ninguna entidad del Estado, y no los representa. Las preguntas provienen del balotario oficial de la licencia clase A categoría I, aprobado por la R.D. N.° 5980-2017-MTC/15 y publicado por el MTC: https://portal.mtc.gob.pe/transportes/terrestre/licencias/evaluacion-de-conocimientos.html

Prepárate para el examen de reglas de tránsito y saca tu brevete A-I a la primera.

SIMULACRO COMO EL EXAMEN REAL
• 40 preguntas al azar del balotario, 40 minutos
• Apruebas con 35 respuestas correctas, igual que en el examen
• Puedes saltar una pregunta y volver a ella
• Al terminar ves tus errores con la respuesta correcta

TODO EL BALOTARIO A-I
• Las 200 preguntas oficiales con sus alternativas y respuestas
• Las 67 señales y gráficos del balotario
• 4 temas: señales y marcas, reglas de circulación, licencias y sanciones, seguridad

APRENDE SIN ESTRÉS
• Las preguntas que fallas vuelven hasta que las aprendas
• «Difíciles para ti»: las preguntas que más confundes
• Buscar: encuentra una pregunta por palabra o número y ve la respuesta al instante

FUNCIONA SIN INTERNET
• Todo el balotario está en tu teléfono
• Sin registro

Gratis: 10 preguntas de cada tema y un simulacro al día, con anuncios. Puedes quitar los anuncios con un pago único. El acceso completo (todas las preguntas, sin anuncios) también es un pago único, sin renovación automática: 7 días, 30 días o para siempre.

La app sirve solo para estudiar por tu cuenta y como información. No reemplaza a la escuela de manejo ni al Reglamento Nacional de Tránsito.

name: Briar Park: Seek & Find
description:
Briar Park is a calm, cosy seek-and-find game. Every level is a busy, hand-drawn corner of the park, full of people. Look at the card, then find that one person in the crowd.

• 40 levels on one long park trail, from small and quiet to big and busy
• Each level has three steps: find one friend, then two more, then beat the clock
• Twins, look-alikes, lost teddies and "everyone in a red cap" keep it fresh
• Stuck? A hint shows where to look, closer each time
• Open a treasure chest every five levels and fill your picture album
• New daily goals and a daily gift when you come back
• No sign-in. Play offline. Your progress stays on your phone.

name: Brignex
description:
Brignex helps cleaning, snow-removal and landscaping companies coordinate their crews, all year round.

DAY TO DAY
• Today's route: visits, stop order and itinerary.
• Check-in and check-out at the site, with geofencing (only during the shift).
• Tasks and proof-of-work photos, only when you take them.
• Report an incident, a breakdown or fuel, with a photo if needed.
• Client portal: “How's my service going?”, history and invoices.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works offline: actions are sent as soon as the network is back.
• French, English and Spanish.

PRIVACY
• Location is used only during an open shift and at check-in / check-out, never in the background. It is deleted after the chosen retention period.
• Data hosted in Canada. No ads, no tracking. AI features are turned off.

A demo with entirely fictional data is included: no account, no password. On the first screen, pick a demo company and a role, then tap “Enter”.

name: Briki
description:
Briki is the staff app for businesses that run ride-on car play zones in malls and family
entertainment centres. Start a ride from your phone, let the timer run, collect Cash or UPI, and
close the day with a daybook that adds itself up.

Briki is for operators and their staff. Accounts are created by your organization's admin; there
is no public sign-up.

START RIDES IN SECONDS
• Pick a car and a ride package, and Briki unlocks the car over Bluetooth.
• Timed rides show a live countdown and lock the car when time is up.
• Rounds rides show elapsed time with an End ride button.
• If the app closes mid-ride, the ride is recovered when you reopen it.

COLLECT PAYMENT, EVERY TIME
• Every finished ride asks for payment before it's done.
• Record Cash or UPI; the price comes from the package, so nobody keys in amounts.
• Unpaid rides stay on screen until they're settled.

A DAYBOOK THAT ADDS ITSELF UP
• See any day's takings with the Cash and UPI split and every ride listed.
• Admins can correct a payment or void a ride, with a reason, and every change is logged.

EXPENSES AND ATTENDANCE
• Record money going out (maintenance, supplies, staff, utilities) with an optional receipt photo.
• Staff clock in and out; admins see who's on duty.

FOR OWNERS AND ADMINS
• One dashboard across all your locations, or switch to a single location.
• Revenue by day, week or month, with rankings by location, car and staff.
• Manage staff accounts, locations and ride packages from the app.
• An event log of rides, payments, expenses and pricing changes.

FOR INSTALLERS
• Pair a new car's Briki controller over Bluetooth in a few steps.
• Device diagnostics shows nearby controllers and their signal strength.

Briki needs a Briki controller fitted to each car to unlock rides. Contact us to set one up for
your play zone.

name: Brilliant Hadith
description:
موسوعة الحديث السريع مرجع إسلامي عربي متكامل يعمل بالكامل بدون اتصال بالإنترنت وبدون إعلانات، صُمِّم ليمنحك وصولاً فورياً وموثوقاً إلى أمهات كتب السنة النبوية في أي وقت — سواء في المواصلات أو في المسجد أو أثناء المجالس والمذاكرة — مع خط واضح ومريح لكبار السن والباحثين.

أقسام التطبيق الخمسة:

1- البحث الفوري الموحّد (عمود واحد واضح):
- بحث متزامن وسريع في ثلاثة دواوين رئيسية: صحيح البخاري (7,277 حديثاً)، صحيح مسلم (7,459 حديثاً)، ورياض الصالحين (1,896 حديثاً).
- عرض المتون والأسانيد بالتشكيل الكامل (الشكل) في الصحيحين مع تظليل الكلمات المطابقة للبحث.
- تصميم بعمود واحد مريح لقراءة الهواتف مع أمثلة بحث سريعة ونسخ الحديث مع تخريجه بنقرة واحدة، واختصارات سريعة للبحث على الأجهزة الكبيرة.

2- الكتب والفهارس الكاملة:
- فهرسة دقيقة لأبواب وكتب كل مصنّف وفق الترتيب العلمي المعتمد (بما في ذلك المقدمة في صحيح مسلم وكتاب المقدمات في رياض الصالحين).
- ربط مباشر لأكثر من 1,150 حديثاً من رياض الصالحين بأصولها المسندة المشكولة في صحيحي البخاري ومسلم.

3- شجرة السند وتراجم الرواة:
- أكثر من 14,674 شجرة إسناد بيانية مرسومة مسبقاً وتفاعلية قابلة للتكبير والتصغير، تعرض طبقات الرواة من النبي (ص) إلى المصنّف.
- جدول وبحث شامل لأكثر من 2,586 راوياً يعرض الكنية والطبقة وسنة الوفاة والبلد ودرجة الجرح والتعديل والشيوخ والتلاميذ وجميع مرويات كل راوٍ.

4- المعجم وغريب الحديث:
- معجمان كلاسيكيان موثوقان مدمجان بالكامل: «النهاية في غريب الحديث والأثر» للإمام ابن الأثير الجزري، و«مختار الصحاح» للإمام الرازي (7,776 مادة لغوية).
- تصفح بالفهرس الهجائي أو بحث ذكي يتجاوز السوابق العربية مع إمكانية البحث في المعجم مباشرة من داخل أي حديث.

5- دليل كتب السنة والطبعات والناشرين:
- دليل تعريفي مستقل يجمع أهم دواوين السنة النبوية وتراجم مصنّفيها وطبعاتها المحققة وأسعارها التقريبية وروابط دور النشر والموزعين الرسميين تشجيعاً للكتاب الورقي الموثوق.

راحة القراءة واحترام الخصوصية:
- خط أميري العربي الكلاسيكي عالي الوضوح، مع أزرار (أ+ / أ-) لتكبير الخط من 16 إلى 34 نقطة ليناسب كبار السن وضعاف البصر.
- ثلاثة مظاهر مريحة للعين: المظهر الورقي الدافئ، المظهر الفاتح، والمظهر الداكن.
- جميع النصوص المدمجة في التطبيق من المصادر الكلاسيكية الواقعة في الملك العام فقط.
- تطبيق مجاني بالكامل: لا إعلانات، لا اشتراكات، لا يتطلب تسجيل حساب أو اتصالاً بالإنترنت، ولا يجمع أي بيانات شخصية.

name: Brisa - Daily
description:
Brisa brings everyday aquarium care and the moments worth keeping into one personal journal. For first-time fish keepers, planted-tank enthusiasts and hobbyists with multiple aquariums, it keeps each tank's story together.
KEEP DAILY CARE IN VIEW
Log water tests, water changes and feeding in a dated timeline. Record temperature, pH, total ammonia nitrogen (TAN), nitrite and nitrate, with the latest value and test date shown for each parameter. Filter by record type or date to revisit past care.
CAPTURE MORE THAN NUMBERS
Add written notes, a care photo or a voice note of up to two minutes to a care record. Keep fish and plant profiles, organize individual fish or groups, and browse fish photos by profile or favorites.
TURN RECORDS INTO CHAPTERS
Create a snapshot with the last 7 days, 30 days or all of your timeline, alongside current livestock, latest measurements and favorite photos. Saved chapters stay as created when original entries change. Copy a text summary or share a PDF to keep a readable record or give another keeper context.
MADE FOR YOUR OWN ROUTINE
Manage freshwater, saltwater and other tanks separately. No account is required, and core journaling works offline. Your care records, photos and recordings are stored on your device.
Brisa records the measurements you enter. Voice notes stay with care records and are excluded from snapshots and PDFs. Removing the app may remove local data; shared PDFs are for reading, not restoring the journal.
A little closer to your aquarium.

name: Brivox
description:
Brivox is a single-player, turn-based strategy game set in a woodland camp. Play as Mimo and watch what each monster is preparing. Borrow an incoming move to stop it, then save it for a later turn or use it right away. You can borrow one move and use one stored move each turn, in either order. Sometimes the best play is to use what you’re holding first to make room for the move you need.
Brivox is for players who enjoy puzzles with room to experiment. Read the next move, try a different order, and see how a small decision changes the fight. Take your time planning a turn, play a single Trial, or settle in for a longer expedition.
• Lessons and Trials. Learn the basics in three lessons, then take on 40 Trials and earn stars along the way.
• Free Expeditions. Explore 20 stages with changing enemy lineups. Choose runes or upgrade moves between battles. Replay the same lineup to try a different approach, or start with a new one.
• Daily Challenge. Try a different battle lineup each day and see how it compares with your previous results.
• Companions and outfits. Befriend the monsters you meet, build bonds, and bring a companion on expeditions. Dress Mimo in any of eight outfits as you unlock them. Outfits are cosmetic.
Core gameplay works offline and requires no account. Progress is saved on your device and can be exported or imported as a JSON file.

name: Brixplode: Stack & Blast
description:
Brixplode combines two game ideas in one: first you stack blocks, then you blast the stack with balls. Played in portrait mode with one hand – perfect for a quick break.

STACK, CHARGE, BLAST
• Shapes of two, three or five blocks drop into a field nine columns wide
• A full row does not disappear – it glows golden and charges a ball
• With three charged balls the blast phase begins: the paddle slides in and the balls smash the blocks
• A glowing row bursts completely on the first hit and gives bonus points; the stack above slides down
• Then it is back to building – and with every round the shapes fall faster
• If the stack reaches the top, the game is over

LEVELS WITH THREE STAGES
• Every level has three stages: fill one, two and three rows, then blast the field clear
• Up to three stars per level, depending on how few shapes were needed
• Each level is a little faster than the one before
• From level 25 on, every block needs two hits
• Plus an endless mode with high score

EASY TO CONTROL
• Drag sideways: move the shape
• Tap: rotate the shape
• Swipe down quickly: drop the shape
• In the blast phase the thumb steers the paddle, a tap fires the next ball
• A short tutorial explains everything on first launch

PLEASANT TO PLAY
• English and German, sound can be switched off
• Own graphics and sounds
• No ads, no subscription, no account, no tracking
• No internet needed, progress stays on the iPhone

TRY IT FOR FREE
• Level 1 is free
• The full version unlocks all further levels and the endless mode with a one-time purchase
• Purchases can be restored in the settings

Terms of use: https://studio48.ai/spiele-agb-ios.html#english
Licence agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Provider and legal notice: https://studio48.ai/ios.html#impressum

name: Brunt: Easy Workout Tracker
description:
The easiest workout tracker.

Most people stop tracking their workouts after a few weeks. They still train, it's just a hassle to type every set into an app while you're resting. So the logging stops and you lose track of how much you're actually doing.

Brunt makes it easy. Take a photo of the bar, the dumbbells or the machine and Brunt reads the weight for you. Tap the reps and you're done.

EVERY KG COUNTED
Every set turns into weight moved: the weight times the reps, all added up. You see your total for the workout, the week and all time. Seeing that number go up is what keeps you coming back, and it's a better picture of your progress than one heavy set.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take a photo of your weights, or upload one from your camera roll
2. Brunt reads the weight, you pick the reps
3. Your kg moved adds up toward your weekly goal

Already logged in your notes? Upload a screenshot and Brunt pulls the sets out of it.

GROUPS, IF YOU WANT
Train with friends? Make a group and send the code. Every day the group shows who trained and how much they moved, and every week there's a recap with the top 3. When someone hits their weekly goal, everyone sees it, and you can react with an emoji. Nobody types, it's just the numbers.

PRIVACY
No account, no email. Your workouts stay on your phone. Groups only see your name and your daily totals.

SUBSCRIPTION
Brunt is a subscription with a 3-day free trial. Pick monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when the trial ends. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://www.lancio.be/brunt/privacy

name: Bulbrack
description:
Every evening the marquee changes. The old bill comes down, the new one goes up вЂ” letter by letter, by hand, from a ladder that reaches only three cells at a time.

Bulbrack is that job turned into a word puzzle about planning.

THE RULES ARE SHORT
вЂў Moving the ladder one cell is one move.
вЂў Taking a letter down into your tray is one move. The tray holds four.
вЂў Hanging a letter is one move вЂ” and a cell takes only the letter it needs in the new bill.
вЂў A box of spare letters stands by the left end of the sign. Putting a letter in or taking one out is a move, and only from the first ladder position.
вЂў On two-row signs, carrying the ladder to the other row costs two moves.

The bill is up when every cell matches and your tray is empty.

WHY IT IS HARD
Letters you need are already on the sign, just in the wrong places. Take too many and the tray is full far from the box. Take too few and you walk the ladder back and forth. The obvious left-to-right approach always works and is never the best one.

A PROVEN MINIMUM FOR EVERY SIGN
Each of the 120 bills was solved by an exhaustive search over every ladder position, sign state and tray content. The app knows the true minimum, so a three-star finish means you matched a number nobody can beat. Two stars allow four moves more; any finished bill earns one.

FOUR THEATERS
Palace and Rialto are free: 60 bills, from short notices to longer titles on two rows. Orpheum and Starlite bring wider marquees and fuller boxes. Every text on the signs is an invented session title or house notice.

TODAY'S MATINEE
One bill a day for everyone, picked by the date. Finish it for a coin bonus.

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT
Coins come from finishing bills. Spend them on Next move, which asks the solver for the best next step from exactly where you stand, or on Show minimum. You can also dress the marquee: neon tubes or white light instead of warm bulbs, three letter styles, three facades. Bills are never unlocked with coins.

BULBRACK PRO
One purchase, no subscription: the Orpheum and Starlite theaters, a step-by-step replay of the optimal run for every bill, and a sign log of everything you changed.

Built for iPhone, with layouts for narrow screens, landscape and large text. Bulbrack works offline, has no account and no ads, and collects no data.

name: Bulix Runner
description:
Wer mehr als ein Paar Laufschuhe besitzt, kennt das Problem: Nach ein paar Monaten weiß niemand mehr genau, wie viele Kilometer welches Paar schon hinter sich hat. Ein Schuh wird ständig getragen, der andere verstaubt im Schrank – und wann die Dämpfung nachlässt, merkt man oft erst zu spät. Bulix Runner nimmt dir diese Rechnung ab und zeigt sie übersichtlich auf dem Bildschirm.

Jeder Lauf wird einem bestimmten Paar zugeordnet. Du wählst den Schuh, mit dem du unterwegs warst, und trägst die gelaufene Strecke ein. So entsteht für jedes Paar eine eigene Historie, die mit jedem Eintrag wächst.

Die Kilometerstände aller Paare stehen direkt nebeneinander. Ein Blick genügt, um zu sehen, welches Paar schon viele Kilometer auf dem Buckel hat und welches noch frisch ist. Damit triffst du zwei Entscheidungen, die sonst reine Gefühlssache wären: welcher Schuh langsam in den Ruhestand gehört und welcher als Nächstes an der Reihe ist.

Die App hat einen klaren Zweck. Sie protokolliert deine Läufe und zeigt dir, wie sich die Strecke auf deine Schuhe verteilt. Mehr verspricht sie nicht – und genau darin liegt ihre Stärke: Die Zahlen sind da, wenn du sie brauchst, und halten sich zurück, wenn du einfach nur laufen willst.

Bulix Runner ist für Läuferinnen und Läufer gemacht, die ihre Schuhe nicht nach Bauchgefühl wechseln möchten, sondern auf Basis der tatsächlich gelaufenen Kilometer. Wer rotiert, schont seine Paare. Wer den Überblick behält, tauscht rechtzeitig aus – bevor ein Schuh an Dämpfung und Halt verliert.

name: Bunco Prize Calculator
description:
Bunco Prize Calculator makes organizing Bunco game prizes simple, fast, and fun!

Whether you're hosting a Bunco night with friends or organizing a regular Bunco group, this easy-to-use calculator takes the guesswork out of distributing prize money.

FEATURES

• Supports 12 to 24 players.
