name: CamEase
description:
Plan a hand-cranked toy's rhythm before fitting its cams.

CamEase gives makers, automata builders and teachers an offline workbench on iPhone and iPad. Arrange lifting parts on one shared shaft, inspect gravity-equivalent torque through a full turn, and export your chosen setup as an assembly angle sheet.

1. Start with a mechanism
Create a project or open an editable study. Give Rabbit, Bird and Bear their own cues, or choose a flower, star or flag. Set names, colors and measurements to make the mechanism yours.

2. Build a complete motion cycle
Enter each follower's total moving mass and lift travel. Define rise, high dwell, fall and low dwell over 360 degrees. Use grams or kilograms, millimeters or centimeters, and choose separate simple harmonic, cycloidal or quintic polynomial curves for rise and fall.

3. Inspect one full turn
Scrub the angle dial, enter an angle or play the motion. Watch the cutaway paper-box schematic alongside displacement, positive lift and negative gravity-return contributions, and net torque. Tap a chart or peak to synchronize the model and readings. Set a forward-net-torque threshold to inspect the angles above it.

4. Keep the lead on cue
Lock the lead character's rise phase, then drag other motion bars or use numerical input and step buttons. For up to 16 followers, the phase workshop explores candidate arrangements while preserving locked phases. The search range and grid are shown.

5. Change a mass and compare
Preview a mass change at the current shaft angle, then save a new arrangement while keeping the original. Compare forward, reverse and absolute net-torque peaks, threshold intervals, phase changes and parameter differences. Both views share one shaft angle and chart scale. Read torque in N·m or mN·m.

6. Take the plan to your workbench
Preview and share a PDF or CSV assembly sheet with viewing direction, part parameters, rise phases, start-of-rise mark mounting angles, key loads, version and notes. Track installation progress and preserve projects and arrangement history with local backup and restore.

Three editable studies invite you to compare simultaneous and staggered lifts, build a six-follower wave, and explore ideal phase cancellation. Search, duplicate and archive projects, and keep feedback as a local draft.

No account or ads. Calculations, project editing and report generation happen on your device. Sharing is initiated by you.

Calculation scope: CamEase uses an ideal slow-speed gravity model with continuous follower contact and gravity returned to the shaft during descent. Friction, springs, inertia and contact separation are excluded. Results compare gravity-equivalent loads; the search does not establish a global optimum, and the motion schematic does not generate machinable cam profiles.

name: Camp Fire
description:
Kamp Ateşi, küçük ekipler için ortak bir görev defteri. Bir kamp kur, 6 haneli kamp kodunu yol arkadaşlarınla paylaş ve hepiniz aynı listeleri, aynı duyuru panosunu anında görün.

GÖREV LİSTELERİ
• Alışveriş, ev işleri, yapılacaklar… istediğin kadar liste aç.
• Bir görevi tamamladığında herkesin ekranında hemen işaretlenir.
• Kimin eklediği her görevin altında yazar; görevlere emoji mühürü basabilirsin.
• Aynı anda birkaç kişi düzenlese bile hiçbir değişiklik kaybolmaz.

DUYURU PANOSU
• "Cumartesi 8'de otoparktayız" gibi duyuruları panoya as.
• Yoldaşların duyurulara mühürlerle karşılık versin.

KAMP
• Kamp en fazla 5 kişilik ve yalnızca davet koduyla katılınabilir; içerik sadece kamp üyelerine görünür.
• Kamp lideri üyeleri yönetebilir, dilediğin zaman kamptan ayrılabilirsin.
• Yeni görev veya duyuru eklendiğinde diğer üyelere bildirim gider.

GİZLİLİK
• Reklam yok, takip yok, analitik yok.
• Hesabını ve verilerini uygulamanın içinden tek dokunuşla silebilirsin.

Arkadaşlarla kamp, ev arkadaşlarıyla ortak alışveriş, aile içi işler ya da küçük bir ekip planı… Ateşi yak, yoldaşlarını çağır.

name: Camyy
description:
Camyy turns your iPhone into a film camera. Pick a roll, point and shoot, and the film look is developed right into the photo. No filters to fiddle with, no editing afterwards.

FILMS
• MOTIF: teal-green shadows, heavy glow and coarse grain, like a 35mm compact.
• NOIRÉ: black and white with deep blacks, crisp detail and fine grain.
• CHROMA: muted colour, hard shadows and soft highlights. A documentary look.
• SOLARA: dusty blue-grey shadows, cyan-leaning greens and soft highlights.
• FUJORA: warm lifted blacks and a plastic lens that smears at the edges, like a disposable.

SHOOT LIKE FILM
• See each film live on the preview before you shoot
• The orange date stamp in the corner, like an old point-and-shoot
• Warmth, brightness and zoom are one tap away
• Your photos stay on your phone and are never uploaded

CAMYY PRO
Camyy is free to use with MOTIF, NOIRÉ, CHROMA, VERANO, GRIT and AZURA. Camyy Pro adds:
• Every Pro film, and every new film we add
• Developing photos from your library
• Double exposure
• Self-timer and burst

Camyy Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, yearly (with a 1-week free trial) or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://camy-web.vercel.app/privacy

name: Candle Batch & Cost
description:
Twelve 200 g candles at 10% fragrance of the wax? 2,181.8 g wax and 218.2 g fragrance oil, worked out as you type.
Enter the finished fill weight per container, the number of containers and your fragrance load. Add what you paid for materials and see the cost per candle.
No account and no setup. The app opens on an editable example, so your first answer takes seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Type the fill weight per container in g, kg or oz.
2. Enter how many containers you are pouring.
3. Enter the fragrance load and choose what it is a percentage of.
Wax and fragrance totals appear at once, with the amount for each container underneath.

FRAGRANCE LOAD, SPELLED OUT
- Choose "% of wax" (the default) or "% of total", and the choice is shown next to every result. The app never switches it for you.
- 10% of the wax in 200 g is 181.8 g wax plus 18.2 g fragrance. 10% of the total is 180 g wax plus 20 g fragrance.
- Ounces always mean ounces by weight (28.35 g), never fluid ounces. Jar labels often state volume, so you enter the fill weight you want.

KNOW YOUR COST PER CANDLE
- Save what you pay for wax, fragrance oil, containers, wicks, labels and packaging.
- Every cost line shows its quantity, unit price and total, and per-container items are multiplied by your count.
- A cost you haven't entered is marked "Not priced", never counted as zero, and the estimate is labelled incomplete until everything is in.
- Add a target retail price to see the gross margin per candle.
- One currency per recipe, with no automatic exchange rates.

SCALE WITHOUT GUESSWORK
Change the number of containers and the totals update while each candle stays the same. Preview any saved recipe at 48 candles without changing it.

FREE
- Unlimited wax, fragrance and cost calculations
- Batch scaling, g / kg / oz
- Up to three saved recipes
- JSON backup export and import, Delete All Data

PRO
- Unlimited saved recipes and one-tap duplication
- Batch log: each pour saved with its quantities and the prices of that day, so later price changes never rewrite it
- Printable PDF batch sheets
If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Your recipes and logged batches stay readable and are included in your backup.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Recipes, prices and batches are stored on your iPhone. Export a JSON backup any time, for free.

The app does the arithmetic for the numbers you enter. It doesn't recommend fragrance loads, wicks or recipes. Follow your wax and fragrance suppliers' specifications. Cost figures are estimates, not pricing or business advice.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/candle-batch-cost/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/candle-batch-cost/terms

name: Canwell: Home Canning Timer
description:
How long, and at what pressure? Canwell shows the processing time for 35 canning recipes from the USDA Complete Guide to Home Canning (2015), for pressure canning and water bath canning, set for your altitude. Then a canning timer walks you through each step and keeps going until the jars come out, even if you close the app.

Made for canning day: your first batch of tomatoes, green beans from the garden, or stock from the holiday turkey.

TIMES FOR YOUR ALTITUDE
• Enter your altitude once and every recipe shows the time and pressure for your elevation
• Water bath canners, dial gauge and weighted gauge pressure canners
• 35 recipes from the USDA guide: tomatoes, vegetables, meat and stock, fruit, pickles and jams
• Every time, pressure and instruction is copied unchanged from the guide, with the guide and page number and a link to the source PDF
• Where the guide gives no safe process for your altitude, the recipe says so instead of guessing

A CANNER TIMER THAT KEEPS RUNNING
• Guided steps for pressure canners (venting, coming up to pressure, processing, letting the pressure drop) and for water bath canners
• Keeps counting when you close the app, switch apps or lock your phone
• An alert when each step ends, even with the phone locked
• Never any ads on the timer screen

AFTER THE CANNER
• A seal check reminder 12 hours later, with the guide's three ways to test a seal
• Log jars with a photo and see your shelf at a glance
• "Eat first" order, and a flag for jars older than a year
• Monthly missions and badges for good canning habits, and a jar card to share

CANWELL PRO: ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Run up to four timers at once
• Print jar and gift labels (round or square, US Letter sheets) or share them as a PDF
• Canning day planner: pounds to jars, canner loads and lids, with a shopping list (for recipes where the guide gives yields)
• Lid and jar count with a low supply reminder
• No ads

Free with ads. No account, no sign-in. Your records and photos stay on your phone.

Canwell is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by the USDA or the National Center for Home Food Preservation. Always follow the source guide exactly, and when in doubt ask your local Cooperative Extension office.

name: Captionify: Notes
description:
Captionify is a lightweight app for adding customizable text notes and captions to your photos and screenshots.
Adjust fonts, colors, sizes, and text backgrounds to highlight details on screenshots or label your photos in seconds.
• Ad-free.
• Takes up very little storage space.
• Works completely offline.

name: Capy Crown: Tower Defense
description:
The eclipse is coming, and the predators of the jungle are marching on the Great Marsh.

King Barnaby Mudcrown and his capybara soldiers are all that stand between the herd and the army of Lord Umbrax, a jaguar touched by shadow. Raise towers along the roads, lead the King into the fight and hold the gatehouse through twelve battles.

TWELVE BATTLEFIELDS
Meadows, marshes, hot springs, jungle, a moonlit lagoon, snowy cliffs, an ashen thicket and the Eclipse throne. Every map has its own landmarks, weather and wildlife, with forking roads, bridges, fords and tunnels to defend.

FOUR TOWERS, FOUR TIERS EACH
• Reed Archers: fast arrows that reach flyers, with critical hits
• Burrow Barracks: capybara guards who block the road wherever you rally them
• Hot Spring Shrine: water, wind, fire and lightning magic that ignores armor
• Melon Catapult: splash damage for the thickest packs
The fourth tier of each tower is an elite form with its own special ability.

LEAD KING BARNABY
Drag the King anywhere along the road. He fights with a three-blow greatsword combo and learns five sword arts over the campaign, from Crescent Slash to Thousand Cuts.

THREE SUPPORT POWERS
Drop Reinforcements on the road, call down the Citrus Comet, and turn the tide with the Royal Roar.

ELEVEN PREDATORS, THREE BOSSES
Caimans with armored plates, ocelots that spring away from arrows, eagles that fold a wing against volleys, shamans that heal the pack, and the bosses Old Ironjaw, Coilmother and Lord Umbrax himself.

THREE DIFFICULTIES
Easy, Medium and Hard, with stars kept for each. Hard brings bigger packs, more fruit and potions, and foes carrying bounty purses.

MADE TO PICK UP AND PLAY
• Every battle takes under three minutes
• Double speed and pause at any time
• Fruit and potions drop from fallen foes: grab them before the foxes do
• An original soundtrack whose battle music grows heavier as the fight does

NO STRINGS ATTACHED
• Plays fully offline
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking
• Your progress is saved on your device

Every character, map and tune is original to Capy Crown: Siege of the Eclipse.

name: Car Maintenance Log: Plainwork
description:
Keep every service, repair, fill-up and part for your car in one place, and let your phone read the paperwork for you. No ads, no account, and no free trial that turns into a charge.

SNAP IT INSTEAD OF TYPING IT
Photograph a shop bill and the date, miles, cost and work done fill in. Snap the odometer to update the miles, the pump to log a fill-up, the VIN to fill in the year, make and model, or a part box or tire sticker to save the exact part number or tire size.

REMINDERS THAT KNOW HOW MUCH YOU DRIVE
Set each service by miles or by date, whichever comes first. Car Log learns how much you drive and estimates when each one will be due, then reminds you.

SAFETY RECALLS
Checks the federal recall list for your vehicle and shows any open recalls.

PARTS LIST (FULL VERSION)
Your exact oil filter, air filter, battery, wipers, bulbs and tire size for each vehicle, ready at the parts counter. Send it as a text.

ASK OUT LOUD (FULL VERSION)
Ask about any car and hear the answer from your own log: what's due, what you spent, which oil filter it takes.

MORE IN THE FULL VERSION
A warranty tracker with receipts, cost reports by year and kind of work, sharing a car with another phone (encrypted), and unlimited vehicles.

FREE
Logging, reminders, recall alerts, fuel tracking, backup and a printout for your mechanic stay free for good, for two vehicles, with 10 photo reads a month. Your records are never locked.

FULL VERSION
Up to 20 photo reads a day, the parts list, ask out loud, the warranty tracker, cost reports, sharing and unlimited vehicles. Choose monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase. Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically until you cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No free trial.

PRIVATE
Your records stay on your phone. Photos and spoken questions are sent to our server only to be read, then deleted.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://plainworkgroups.duckdns.org/privacy/carlog

name: CardsReflex
description:
CardsReflex is a fast, simple card reflex game. How quickly can you clear the whole deck?

The clock starts at zero and keeps climbing. A card appears in the center of the screen: tap the matching suit as fast as you can (spades, hearts, clubs or diamonds). Finish all the cards in the shortest time possible. Be quick, but be careful: wrong taps cost you hearts!

FEATURES
• 4 difficulty levels: Easy, Middle, Hard and Super Hard
• Race the stopwatch and beat your best time
• Hearts system: every mistake counts
• Compete on Game Center leaderboards for each level
• Beautiful card themes and color styles
• Available in English, Arabic and Chinese
• No account needed, no data collected

Optional one-time purchase: Remove Ads, Infinite Hearts, More Themes, Move Buttons and Extra Sounds.

Simple to learn. Hard to master. How fast can you finish?

name: Carrier Log
description:
Carrier Log helps rural and city mail carriers keep personal work records in one place.

RECORD YOUR WORK
Keep route time, evaluated hours, actual hours, unpaid lunch, and additional work organized. Reuse saved route profiles for faster entry and review your daily worked hours.

PLAN YOUR SCHEDULE
Plan upcoming shifts and review postal holidays by your selected two-week pay period. Scheduled shifts stay separate from completed work.

REVIEW PAY ESTIMATES
Enter your carrier type and hourly base rate to see estimated before-tax pay, with supported overtime, RCA evaluated-versus-actual comparisons, and confirmed holiday leave. Review estimates by week or pay period.

TRACK MILEAGE
Keep personal mileage records and review estimated reimbursements separately from wages.

YOUR RECORDS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
No account is required. Work records and settings are stored locally. Optional one-time tips support development and do not unlock features.

Carrier Log is an independent personal recordkeeping tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the United States Postal Service. It does not submit official USPS forms or calculate final payroll. Pay and reimbursement figures are estimates; verify applicable rules, eligibility, rates, and amounts with your employer and official pay statement.

name: CarTube: Video & Navigation
description:
CarTube brings personal media, route planning and GPS dials together on iPhone and iPad, with a CarPlay navigation experience.

MEDIA
Choose your own videos from Photos or Files, import audio files and audiobooks, or open supported video, HLS and M3U playlist URLs. Keep favorites and return to recent media. AirPlay requires a compatible receiver. CarTube does not supply channels or media subscriptions.

CARPLAY AND ROUTES
Connect a compatible CarPlay vehicle to open Driving, Dials, Media, Nearby, Weather and Drive Summary. Search for a destination, preview a driving route and follow visual route instructions. This version does not include spoken turn-by-turn instructions, automatic rerouting or live traffic updates. Map and route availability depends on your region and provider. You can also continue navigation in Apple Maps.

DRIVING TOOLS
Save your parking location, find nearby places and charging stations, and request a weather forecast. Station records do not indicate live availability. Keep your latest 40 drive summaries locally on your device.

YOUR DIAL STYLE
Classic and Neon are free. Preview Orbit, Pulse, Sport, Runway and Minimal. Additional styles require Premium. Some rings change color with GPS speed; colors are decorative and do not indicate speed limits.

PREMIUM
Remove app ads and unlock all dial styles with a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription, or a lifetime one-time purchase. Prices and billing periods appear before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage subscriptions in your Apple account. Restore Purchases is available in the paywall.

Available in English, Turkish, Arabic, Spanish and French, with Arabic right-to-left support.

COMPATIBILITY
CarPlay requires a compatible vehicle and iPhone. Full iPhone screen mirroring and full-screen video playback on CarPlay are not provided. GPS readings and weather are informational; they do not replace vehicle instruments, road signs or driving judgment. Use video and setup controls only while parked. Only access media you are authorized to use.

Privacy policy: https://legal.ronailabs.com/privacy-cartube
Terms of use: https://legal.ronailabs.com/terms-cartube
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Cat Hero Toy Planets
description:
Climb into the saucer, Cat Hero! The galaxy is full of giant toy planets: a donut with sprinkles, a Rubik cube, a teddy bear, a robot, a gold bar and many more. Each one hides a glowing energy core under its shells.

BREAK THE TOY, PLATE BY PLATE
Every planet is the toy itself, split along its own seams into plates. Shoot them apart one by one, clear the monsters guarding them and drop into the next shell, each one a new bright colour.

BEAT THE BOSS, BLOW UP THE CORE
At the bottom a giant boss guards the energy core. Take it down and the core goes up in one huge explosion.

100 TOY PLANETS, 10 THEMES
Toys, food, treasure, pets, jungle, sea, household things, vehicles, ice and monsters: ten systems of ten planets, each named after the object it is shaped like.

FROM ONE ROCKET TO A STORM OF FIRE
Upgrade six weapons, rockets, cluster bombs, cannon, mortar, drill and plasma, and unlock new ships in the garage.

EXTRA FUN
Spin the lucky wheel for rapid fire, shields and MEGA mode, try the pet slot machine, drop screen-clearing bombs and switch on the autopilot.

Short sessions, big explosions, one cute cat. Play now!

name: Cat Patch: Sudoku Logic Puzzle
seller_name: Appn Yazilim ve Danismanlik Limited Sirketi
description:
Find the cats hiding on the quilt. Every row, every column and every colour hides exactly one cat, and cats never touch, not even at a corner. Three simple rules, endless calm puzzles.

No guessing, ever. Every board has one solution you can reach by reasoning alone.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a square to cross it out, tap it again to clear it.
• Tap twice quickly to place a cat.
• Drag across the board to cross out several squares at once.
• Find every cat before your three hearts run out.

A HINT THAT TEACHES
Stuck? Hint never just places a cat for you. It shows the next step and tells you why it works, so every board makes you a little sharper. A wrong cat explains itself too, so mistakes become lessons.

A DAILY PUZZLE AND A STREAK
A new board of your own each day, a calendar of the days you solved, and a streak to keep. Missed yesterday? You can make it up once a week.

120 CATS TO MEET
New cats join your boards as you solve: tabbies, tuxedos, calicos, gingers and more, each with a name and its own little face. Tarçın, the ginger cat, keeps you company.

MADE FOR CALM MINDS
• Endless levels, from very easy to very hard
• No timer pressure (turn the clock on in Settings if you like it)
• Patterns for colour-blind players, light and dark themes
• Plays offline, including the daily puzzle
• Phones and tablets, in English and Turkish

FAIR AND QUIET
Ads never interrupt a puzzle. One purchase removes them for good. There is no subscription.

Grab a cup of tea, and go find the cats.

Privacy: https://catpatch.appn.app/privacy
Terms: https://catpatch.appn.app/terms

name: Cat Timer - Meowing Countdown
description:
A timer where a cat meows to tell you time's up.

Cup noodles, pasta, a quick nap. Pick a time and the cat in the room waits right beside you. When time's up, the cat meows to let you know — tap anywhere on the screen to stop it.

■ Rings even in Silent mode
It uses the iOS alarm system, so the cat's voice reaches you even in Silent mode or when the app is closed.

■ One tap to stop
Tap anywhere on the ringing screen to stop it. Afterwards, your cat says a few kind words.

■ Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
The time left and your cat appear on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, where you can also pause, resume, or stop.

■ Widgets, Siri and Apple Watch
Start a timer from a Home Screen widget or with Siri without opening the app. Check the time left on your Apple Watch, too.

■ Become friends with the cats
The more you use timers, the closer your cat gets — and new cats join the family. The Cat Book fills up with a diary of the times you waited together.

■ A pixel-art room
While you wait, your cat plays, lounges by the window, and dozes off. You can pet it or toss it a ball of yarn.

■ Pricing
All the core features are free. There are no ads, and no user data is collected. You can buy cat food and furniture with in-app purchases, but you can meet every cat without buying anything.

name: Catch the AI Cheaters!
description:
Click! Catch the cheaters red-handed — the moment the evidence shows.

AI glasses, pen cameras, micro earbuds, smartwatches, pencil-case holograms, even micro drones…
Today's students cheat with cutting-edge AI gadgets. You're the rookie proctor!
Tap a student right when the light blinks or the answer glows, and bust them on the spot.

■ How it plays
• 100 exams: from a cram-school pop quiz to college entrance exams, licensing tests, a ninja village, a wizard guild, even a space station
• Exam rooms grow from 4 to 100 students
• 15 cheating gadgets, plus old-school cheaters who turn around, peek over shoulders, or unroll crib notes
• Innocent students who just fix their glasses or scratch an ear are traps! Wrong accusations bring parent complaints — three and you're replaced
• Watch out for bluffers who fake the move without any evidence
• Your secret tools: a pointed "Ahem!" and an RF detector
• Every bust snaps an evidence photo with your phone camera
• Results come out as the front page of The Exam Room Times — go for 3 stars
• Play in English, 한국어, 日本語 or 繁體中文

■ You'll like it if you enjoy
• Quick reflex and observation games
• Spot-the-difference and hidden-object puzzles
• Memories of exam day (on either side of the desk…)

No sign-up needed. Your progress is saved only on your device.

name: CatsHub
description:
宠物猫大全 —— 按毛色与花色认猫

宠物猫大全，36 个猫品种、11 种花色，每个都配一张真实照片。

【怎么用】

• 识猫：按分类胶囊与搜索逐层缩小范围，找出是哪一种猫
• 猫库：按毛色系、花色、体重筛 36 个品种
• 图解：体型、毛长、掉毛的横向对照
• 养猫：幼猫期、成猫期、老年期三个阶段该做什么
• 我的：收藏与最近看过的品种

【毛色系与花色是两回事】

同一只猫身上，「它属于哪一群」和「它长什么图案」是两个不同的维度，
所以这里把它们分开讲：

毛色系分纯色系、虎斑系、重点色系、长毛系、卷毛系、三花异色、无尾与东方体；
花色分纯色、鲭鱼纹、经典虎斑、斑点纹、渐层、重点色、玳瑁、三花、黑白花、卷毛、异色瞳。

【识猫怎么用】

先在「猫库」页按毛色系、花色、体重筛，再用「识猫」页顶部的搜索框按名字、产地或花纹缩小范围。
不用一次背下所有品种，点开任意一张卡片就是该品种的完整资料。

【每个品种写什么】

一张真实照片，外加：长什么样、多重、体型多大、性格倾向、怎么打理、
容易出什么毛病、适合什么样的家庭。

【照片】

36 张品种照片与 11 张花色照片全部是真实实拍，来自 Wikimedia Commons 的开放版权图库。
每一张的作者与许可协议，在「我的 → 设置 → 照片来源与授权」里逐条列出。
照片随 App 一起打包，不从网络下载。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。收藏、足迹与外观偏好只存在你自己的手机里，
卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

除首启一条安装来源统计外完全离线：没有广告，没有用户画像，不接入任何第三方 SDK。

唯一会联网的动作：启动时向 apinstall.com 发一条安装来源统计，内容只有一个随机设备标识、一组设备参数
（机型 / 系统 / 屏幕 / 语言地区 / 时区 / CPU 核数）、剪贴板里是否存在邮件地址格式（有 / 无，不读取内容），
以及服务器记录的来源 IP。这些数据不含姓名、邮箱、电话、地址、位置与照片，只发给这一个单位，
不与任何第三方共享，也不用于追踪。

除此之外，唯一会离开这台设备的，是你自己在「意见反馈」里写下的那段文字 —— 由本应用随反馈通道发往 apinstall.com。

name: CDL Permit Test 2027
description:
Pass your CDL permit test the first time.

CDL Permit Test 2027 gets you ready for the commercial driver's license knowledge tests in your state. Pick your test and your state, then study with lessons, exam-style questions and flashcards built from the official CDL manual topics.

From Winslow Homes Publishing.

EVERY CDL KNOWLEDGE TEST
- General Knowledge: 20 lessons, 600 questions. Inspection, vehicle control, speed and space, hazards, night and winter driving, mountain driving, emergencies, cargo, hours of service, disqualifications
- Air Brakes: 10 lessons, 300 questions. Every part, the air brake check, gauges, spring brakes, dual systems, stopping distance
- Combination Vehicles: 10 lessons, 300 questions. Rollover, jackknifes, trailer air brakes, coupling and uncoupling
- Endorsements: 20 lessons, 600 questions. Hazmat (H), Tanker (N), Doubles and Triples (T), Passenger (P) and School Bus (S)
- Flashcards and a must-know cheat sheet for every test

EVERY STATE
All 50 states and Washington DC. Your state's CDL steps: who issues the license, CLP rules, medical card, Entry-Level Driver Training, fees, how to schedule your knowledge and skills tests, and what the skills test covers.

STUDY TOOLS
- Full timed practice exams
- Weak spot drills that target the topics you miss
- Pass readiness score, daily goal and study streak
- Day and night mode

FREE TO START
Try 2 lessons and 25 questions free. Unlock every test with a subscription.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
- Monthly: $14.99
- 3 months: $29.99
- 6 months: $39.99
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

name: CDR Viewer: Open CDR Files
description:
Open CDR files right on your iPhone or iPad, with no internet connection. CDR Viewer reads CorelDRAW drawings (.cdr) and Corel Presentation Exchange files (.cmx) on the device itself: your files are never uploaded to a server, and you don't need an account.

WHY CDR VIEWER
• Fully offline: the drawing is read on your iPhone or iPad, so it opens on a plane, at a print shop or anywhere without signal
• Private: nothing is uploaded, and the app never connects to the internet
• No account and no sign-up
• Opens big files, up to 128 MB

OPEN A DRAWING YOUR WAY
• Tap Open a drawing and pick a .cdr or .cmx file in Files: on your iPhone or iPad, in iCloud Drive or in another cloud drive you use with Files
• Or share it from Files, Mail or WhatsApp and choose CDR Viewer
• The drawings you opened wait in Recent, each with a picture of the page you were on. Tap one to pick up where you left off

VIEW EVERY PAGE
• Swipe between the pages of a multi-page drawing, or jump to any page from the page strip
• Pinch or double-tap to zoom in on fine detail: logos, labels, packaging, business cards, signs, banners and print layouts
• Tap the info button to see a drawing's pages, page size, file size and what it holds
• While a big drawing opens, you see the preview image saved inside the file

WHAT IT DRAWS
CDR Viewer draws shapes, outlines, colour fills, gradients, pictures and text. When a drawing uses fonts your device doesn't have, it draws the text with similar open fonts.

A few effects aren't drawn yet, such as blends, mesh fills and drop shadows. We're adding them. If a drawing doesn't look right, email support@zestroot.ai and tell us which version of CorelDRAW saved it.

A SIMPLE CDR FILE OPENER
CDR Viewer is a reader for designers, printers, sign makers, students and anyone who gets a .cdr file and needs to see it without a computer. It doesn't edit or convert drawings.

Support: support@zestroot.ai
Privacy policy: https://zestroot.ai/cdr-viewer/privacy

The drawings in the screenshots are shared under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0): "Cute Penguin sign laser cut" by UOW_Makerspace (thingiverse.com/thing:3567374), "Present box, arabic pattern, lasercut" by akosboda (thingiverse.com/thing:3827427) and "Astrolabe" by EwanP (thingiverse.com/thing:3271).

CorelDRAW and Corel are trademarks or registered trademarks of Corel Corporation. CDR Viewer is made by ZestRoot Inc. and isn't affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Corel.

name: Cedar Point Church Claremore
description:
The Cedar Point Church app keeps you connected all week, from Sunday's message to Wednesday's Life Group. Cedar Point is a non-denominational church in Claremore, Oklahoma.

WATCH AND LISTEN
• Every message from Sundays, Students (J-HI and Varsity) and Recovery, in one place
• Listen to the podcasts on the go

MESSAGE NOTES
• Follow along with the outline and fill in the blanks during the message
• Add your own thoughts and come back to them later

DAILY
• A verse of the day from the New Living Translation
• A short guided prayer to pray at your own pace
• A personal prayer list and journal, kept private to you

PRAYER
• Send a prayer request to our prayer team. No account needed, and your name is optional.

FIND YOUR PEOPLE
• Browse Life Groups by day and see how to join
• Ministry pages for Preschool, Kids, Buddies and Students, with a "For Parents" section for lessons, camps and events

ASK A QUESTION
• Get quick answers about service times, kids, groups and next steps, drawn from Cedar Point's website

SHOP AND GIVE
• Browse Cedar Point merch and check out securely
• Give online through the church's giving page

YOUR PRIVACY
Watching, listening, the shop and prayer requests work without an account. Sign in with your Planning Center account (the same one you use for Church Center) to keep your notes, prayer list and journal on every phone. No ads, no tracking, and we never sell your information.

name: Celebrio
description:
Celebrio keeps the dates that matter — birthdays, anniversaries and special occasions — on one beautiful ring of twelve months. Open the app and your whole year is right there: every occasion is a dot of confetti on the ring, and the centre counts down to the next one.

No account. No sign-in. No internet needed. Celebrio opens straight into your year and keeps everything on your iPhone.

YOUR YEAR ON A RING
• Twelve months in a ring with every occasion placed on its day
• Drag around the ring to explore any part of the year
• A rolling countdown shows how many days are left — and how old someone is turning

OCCASIONS
• Birthdays (age turning computed for you), anniversaries (years together) and any special day
• Your own categories — Family, Friends, Work or anything you like
• Search, filter by kind or category, and sort by soonest, name, calendar order or recently added
• Notes for each occasion

REMINDERS
• Several reminders per occasion: on the day, 1, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days before
• Choose the time; reminders repeat every year
• Local notifications only — nothing is sent anywhere

GIFTS AND BUDGETS
• Capture gift ideas per person and occasion
• Track each gift from idea to planned, bought, wrapped and given
• Set a budget per occasion and an annual gift budget, with live meters
• See spending per person at a glance

PEOPLE
• Add people by name, or pick one with the iOS contact picker — Celebrio never reads your address book and saves only the name
• See each person's dates and gift ideas together

CELEBRATION HISTORY
• Log how you celebrated, who was there and how it went
• Add your own photos from the library or camera
• Browse celebrations by year

THEMES
• Give every occasion its own colour and pattern — confetti, stripes, polka, stars or waves

YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE
• Full backup to Files (with or without photos) and import with replace or merge
• Automatic daily recovery snapshots, plus snapshots before imports and clearing
• CSV exports of occasions, gifts and history, and a PDF year report
• Light and dark appearance, haptics and currency settings

Celebrio collects no data at all: no account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking and no network connections.

name: Celia - Clean Reveal
description:
A team conversation can contain everything you need for a client update, along with details that should stay internal. Celia helps you turn selected messages into a clear update for the client room.

Select the messages you’ll use and review the suggested draft. Edit the client copy and check which names, internal notes and unconfirmed details you’re leaving out.

Send the draft to reviewers and see who approved the current version. If you edit the copy, send the revised version for a fresh review.

Preview the exact text and destination before publishing. Clients see the published update in their room and can reply there. When you prepare a revision, the previous published version stays visible until you publish its replacement.

Celia is for agencies, support leads and client-service teams that share progress with people outside their working thread.

name: Chain Crew
description:
Chain Crew is a companion for anyone watching a football game live.

Open it and see the game unfold as the plays are scored: the ball moving up and down the field, the down and distance, the clock and the score, with every play named as it happens and the players on it called out by number.

What you get:

- A live field with the ball, the line to gain and the drive's direction
- The score and the line score by quarter, kept current as plays post
- Every drive of the game, newest first, with how each one ended
- A box score with team totals and the players on each play
- Replay, to watch the most recent finished game play back, so there is something to see even when no game is on
- A catch-up that brings you current in one step when you come back to the app

Chain Crew has no ads, no accounts and no tracking, and it collects nothing about you.

Play data comes from the school's public SIDEARM Sports live stats feed and is credited in the app. Chain Crew is an unofficial app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any school, conference, the NCAA or SIDEARM Sports.

name: Chaizi – Hanzi Memory Tricks
description:
Chaizi helps you remember Chinese characters by breaking each one into its components and tying them together with a short story. Instead of copying characters over and over, you understand why a character is written the way it is – and it sticks.

Vocabulary and texts follow the new HSK 3.0 textbooks closely. The app is written for Vietnamese speakers: meanings, explanations and translations are in Vietnamese, with Sino-Vietnamese readings.

VOCABULARY THAT FOLLOWS THE HSK 3.0 TEXTBOOKS
• Nearly 1,900 HSK words, in the same lessons and order as the textbooks
• Every word has pinyin, Sino-Vietnamese reading, meaning, usage notes and example sentences
• Character breakdowns as simple sums, like 讠 + 青 = 请, with a memory trick
• Stroke order: watch each character being written stroke by stroke, pause or step through
• Search by character, pinyin or meaning
• Mark words as learned and track progress per lesson

FLASHCARDS AT THE RIGHT TIME
• Spaced repetition: hard words come back sooner, words you know well come back later
• Type pinyin, meaning or the character to test yourself

TEXTS FROM THE HSK 3.0 TEXTBOOKS
• Over 250 dialogues and passages following each lesson, with pinyin right above the characters
• Toggle pinyin and Vietnamese translation
• Listen to a whole text or tap a sentence to replay it, with the current sentence highlighted
• Retype the text and get an automatic score

GRAMMAR
• 228 grammar points, each with a summary, patterns, examples and notes
• Multiple-choice and sentence-ordering exercises with instant feedback

ĐÔNG HỒ DESIGN
• Inspired by Vietnamese Đông Hồ woodblock prints, with the Teacher Cat mascot
• Chinese characters in a clear Kai (regular script) font
• Dark mode

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

PREMIUM (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
Vocabulary, grammar and texts are free. Premium unlocks the memory tricks for HSK 3–4 and the audio for texts (HSK 2 from lesson 6, HSK 3–4 from lesson 3). Pay once, no subscription. Works offline; audio needs a connection the first time it plays.

name: Chấm Điểm Văn: Sổ Điểm Ngữ Văn
description:
Chấm Điểm Văn là sổ chấm bài nghị luận cho giáo viên Ngữ văn trên iPhone và iPad: ghi chuyên cần, điểm và những lỗi học sinh mắc phải theo từng phần của bài văn – mở bài, thân bài, kết bài – rồi xem các em tiến bộ qua từng tháng.

BẢNG CHẤM NHƯ SỔ ĐIỂM
• Mỗi bài kiểm tra là một trang sổ: STT · Họ tên · Chuyên cần · Điểm · Lỗi.
• Ba chấm ở cột Lỗi cho biết ngay bài yếu ở mở bài, thân bài hay kết bài.
• Thấy ngay đã chấm bao nhiêu bài, điểm trung bình, số em vắng và không nộp.

CHẤM TỪNG BÀI THẬT NHANH
• Chọn Có làm / Vắng / Không nộp.
• Kéo thước chấm điểm bước 0,25, rung nhẹ theo từng nấc.
• Đánh dấu lỗi, ghi nhận xét rồi sang học sinh tiếp theo ngay trên cùng màn hình.
• Lỗi mà bài trước của em cũng mắc được gắn nhãn “Lần trước”.

DANH MỤC LỖI BÀI NGHỊ LUẬN
• 11 lỗi có sẵn: chưa giới thiệu vấn đề, dẫn dắt chưa liên kết, thiếu giải thích, bàn luận chưa sâu, lệch trọng tâm, dẫn chứng chưa cụ thể, chưa phân tích dẫn chứng, phản đề sơ sài, bài học chưa sáng tạo, chưa đánh giá lại vấn đề, chưa rút ra thông điệp.
• Thêm lỗi của riêng thầy cô hoặc ẩn lỗi không dùng – thống kê cũ vẫn được giữ.

HÀNH TRÌNH LỖI CỦA TỪNG EM
• Lần 1, Lần 2, … mỗi lỗi được gắn nhãn Mới, Lặp lại ×n, Tái phạm hoặc Đã sửa.
• Biểu đồ điểm qua các bài và phần bài còn yếu nhất của em.

THỐNG KÊ THEO THÁNG
• Một câu tóm tắt lỗi nổi bật nhất của lớp trong tháng.
• Điểm trung bình và chuyên cần so với tháng trước.
• Biểu đồ lỗi thường gặp và danh sách học sinh lặp lại lỗi của bài liền trước.
• Bảng tần suất lỗi × tháng: lỗi nào giảm, lỗi nào còn – nhìn là thấy.

ĐIỂM TRUNG BÌNH LINH HOẠT
• Theo lớp và từng học sinh: tháng này, 3 tháng, học kỳ I, học kỳ II, năm học, tất cả hoặc tuỳ chọn.
• Bài vắng không bị tính; có thể chọn tính bài không nộp là 0 điểm.

TIỆN LỢI MỖI NGÀY
• Nhiều lớp, chuyển lớp chỉ một chạm.
• Dán cả danh sách học sinh một lần.
• Xuất bảng điểm CSV, mở được bằng Excel.
• Lớp mẫu để xem thử mọi tính năng trước khi nhập lớp thật.
• Chế độ tối, cỡ chữ động và VoiceOver.
• Âm thanh, rung phản hồi nhẹ nhàng – có thể tắt.

RIÊNG TƯ
• Không quảng cáo, không cần tài khoản, không cần mạng.
• Mọi dữ liệu chỉ lưu trên máy của thầy cô.

Góp ý và hỗ trợ: minhthang281198@gmail.com

name: Champion Tooth
description:
Champion Tooth keeps the set of one saw on this iPhone.

A group is a left cutter, a right cutter, and a raker. Bend a left cutter left and it stays. Bend a right cutter right and it stays. Bend a cutter to the wrong side and it springs back. Bend a raker and it springs straight. The saw clears only when every raker is straight and every cutter is on its own side.

Rename a saw, start another, delete one, and share four lines: the name, Clears or Holds, the cutter count, and the note count.

Saws stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not file a real tooth.

name: Changing Lines
description:
Changing Lines gives I Ching readings in the traditional way, on your phone.

Type a question, then cast six lines with three coins. Shake your phone to rattle the coins and let them fall, or tap the button, and watch the hexagram build from the bottom up. You can also let the app cast all six lines at once. If you would rather toss your own coins, choose My own cast and enter the six lines yourself.

The reading shows:
• The hexagram you cast, with its Chinese name and the two trigrams it is made of
• The original Chinese text of the judgment, the image and each changing line
• Each changing line, and whether it turns from yin to yang or yang to yin
• The hexagram those lines turn it into, which shows where things are heading
• If you want one, a reading written for your question

WRITTEN READINGS
If you turn them on, the app sends your question and your cast to our server, where an AI model reads the original Chinese text of the judgment and your changing lines, then writes what each changing line says and a reading for your question in plain English. You can ask up to three follow-up questions about a reading. The app asks before it sends anything the first time, and you can turn written readings off in Settings. Readings are written by AI and can be wrong; each one has a Report link.

ALL 64 HEXAGRAMS, IN CHINESE AND ENGLISH
Browse every hexagram in the traditional King Wen order. Each one has its judgment, its image, the commentary on the judgment and all six lines in the original Chinese, with an English translation under every passage. Swipe left and right to move from one hexagram to the next.

YOUR COINS
Choose the coins you toss in Settings: a plain coin, a Kangxi cash coin or a US quarter. The coins ring as they spin and land, and the sound follows your phone's silent switch.

JOURNAL
Save the readings worth returning to. The journal is stored on your phone only, with search across your questions and hexagrams.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO TRACKING
There is nothing to sign up for. Without written readings turned on, everything stays on your phone.

Casting uses your phone's secure random source, with the real odds of three coins: each changing line has a 1 in 8 chance.

The I Ching is a text for reflection. Readings are not medical, legal or financial advice.

name: Charades QC: Quebec Party Game
description:
The charades game made in Québec. Put the phone on your forehead and let your friends make you guess before time runs out.

91 decks and 7,676 cards: Canadian music, stars, sports, food and places, Québec culture, world pop culture, kids' decks and hits from the 60s to today.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pick a deck and hold the phone on your forehead, screen facing your friends.
• Your friends describe, act out or hum what's on the card.
• Got it? Tilt your head down. Passing? Tilt up.
• At the end of the round, see your score and every card.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Describe: the others give clues.
• Act it out: no words, just gestures.
• Hum: the others hum the song, no lyrics.
• Imitate: voices and accents.

THE DECKS
• Canada: 18 bilingual decks (music artists, hits by decade, stars, sports, food, brands, places, history, the Olympics).
• World: TV shows, stars, superheroes, video games, cartoons, countries, wonders, outer space.
• Kids: 13 decks kids can play (animals, jobs, emotions, superheroes, video games, act-it-out).
• Québec: stars, comedians, expressions, Montréal slang, food, towns, history and more.
• 18+: swearing and crude humour from Québec. Hidden by default.

In English, 45 decks are fully translated, including every Canada and world deck. The Québec decks keep their cards in French, the way they're said here.

FOR YOUR PARTIES
• Play in up to 4 teams, with each team's score.
• Mix several decks together.
• Make your own decks: inside jokes, family, coworkers.
• General or Hard level, and the round length you want.
• Replays: the front camera films your friends during the round. Videos stay on your phone.
• On-screen buttons if you'd rather not tilt your head.
• In English or French.

FREE, FOR REAL
No ads, no account, no subscription. The app works offline and collects no data.

A card to fix or a deck idea? Write to us: charadesqc.jcedrik.com/en/support

name: Charge Up Engineer
description:
Charge Up Engineer is the app Charge Up Installations' own engineers use on
site. It is not for customers and there is nothing in it to sign up for.

WHAT IS IN IT

Today. Every job you are on today, in the order you are doing them, with the
address, the customer's name, the gate code if there is one and a number to
ring. One tap for directions.

Your diary. The week and the month ahead, so you know what is coming without
ringing the office.

The job. Everything about it in one place: what the work is, what has been
agreed, what has already been done and anything the office has added since.

The report. The end of job report, filled in on the phone, with the
photographs it asks for taken as you go, signed by you and by the customer on
the screen, and sent to the office when you are finished.

Forms. Troubleshoot, survey and declaration, each one its own form, for the
visits that are not a full installation.

The guides. How Charge Up does things, kept where you are working rather than
in an email from last March.

Messages. Tell the office something about a job while you are standing in
front of it. If there is no signal it waits and goes when there is.

Time off. Ask for days and see where the request got to.

NO SIGNAL

The jobs you have already opened stay readable. Anything you write or
photograph while you have no signal is held and sent when the phone finds a
connection, so you can finish in a basement and walk out knowing it has gone.

YOUR PHONE AND WHERE IT IS

While you are on a job the app records where the phone is, from setting off to
finishing, so the office can tell a customer how far away you are. It stops
when you finish and it stops when the phone locks. Nothing is recorded before
you set off or after the job is done.

GETTING IN

The office sets up your account. You sign in with your email address and your
password. There is nothing to sign up for and no way to create an account
yourself.

name: Chartacea
description:
Turn your photos into a paper collage you want to keep.

Pick a photo and tap the dog, the jacket, or the coffee cup. Chartacea finds the edge and cuts it out on your phone. If it misses a strap or a paw, brush over that part once, and the cut snaps to the edge.

Drop your cutouts on a board. Pinch, turn, and stack them until the layout feels right. If you want a quick start, tap a layout: Grid, Scatter, Editorial, Zine, or Stickers. Undo works for every step.

Give the board a paper. Choose kraft, cork, cardboard, linen, watercolor, or a plain color, and add soft shadows under each piece.

Add a title in one of eight typefaces. Draw an arrow from a note to the thing it is about. Give a cutout a white sticker edge, or a dashed line in any color.

When you finish, share the board as an image for your story or your wall. You can also print it as a PDF with bleed and crop marks, or as a sheet of stickers on a transparent page.

Your photos stay on your phone. Chartacea has no account, no cloud, no ads, and no tracking. It works offline.

You pay once. There is no subscription and nothing to unlock.

name: Cheat Guide GTA 6
description:
Find GTA VI story-mode cheat inputs in an independent offline guide for iPhone and iPad.

Choose PS5 or Xbox Series X|S, find a code and follow its inputs one button at a time. Save favorites for your next session without creating an account.

• Instant search and categories.
• Sequences visible in the list, with PS5 DualSense and Xbox Series controller labels.
• Large inputs and step-by-step reading at your own pace.
• Favorites, recent entries and a personal challenge checklist.
• Unlock requirements, source dates and publisher links.
• English and French interfaces.
• Catalog and details side by side on wider screens.
• Pink and purple coastal backgrounds with contrasting cards for readable controls.
• Free, with no advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

This version contains 61 entries: 16 published sequences available in the reader, 3 entries with conflicting reports and 42 with no published input sequence. All 61 entries are visible on launch, with their status. Turn off “Include unconfirmed codes” to show only the 16 published sequences. Information comes from editorial sources cited in the app; Cheat Guide has not tested the sequences in the game. The catalog is bundled with the downloaded app version.

Cheats require the relevant in-game conditions. Reviewed guides report that cheats disable saving and achievements for the session, so save your game before trying them. The app helps you read controller inputs; it does not modify the game or connect to your console.

Cheat Guide is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and associated trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: Chimney Teeter
description:
A rooftop Christmas, one tap at a time. Tilt the snowy slates to guide presents into clear chimneys. Watch out for the smoke.

Father Christmas arrives every fifth delivery and earns five times the positive points. Finish 30 deliveries before five smoky landings end the round.

- One tap tilts every roof
- Short rounds and a best score to beat
- Illustrated winter rooftops and Christmas music
- Separate switches for music, sound effects and haptics
- Pause whenever you need a break
- Works offline

The whole game is free. No adverts, no purchases, no account and no tracking.

From Westsmith, the makers of Defuse, Nine, Patience and Cozyjong.

name: ChoiceCairn
description:
Compare personal project alternatives using your own priorities. Create criteria with weights from 1 to 10, add options and rate each criterion from 0 to 5. See normalized scores and a ranked comparison.

Edit priorities or ratings to explore how the ranking changes. Search saved decisions, remove criteria and options, and share a text summary. Higher ratings always mean better; scores summarize your judgment rather than giving professional advice.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: Chord Live
description:
Chord Live listens through the microphone and shows the chords of the music that's playing in real time – big, easy to read, on a black background. Perfect for jumping in and playing along, even without sheet music.

IT'S THAT SIMPLE
Put your iPhone or iPad next to you, let the music play – from the radio, a speaker or live – and play along. The current chord fills the whole screen, in portrait or landscape.

FOUR LEVELS
• Simple: major and minor only
• Standard: adds 7, m7, maj7, sus2 and sus4
• Extended: adds 6, m6, add9, diminished and augmented
• Pro: every chord, including bass notes (e.g. C/E)

FOR GUITAR OR PIANO
In guitar mode, Chord Live shows easy-to-play variants such as Bm7 instead of Bm or Fmaj7 instead of F. They fit the music and need no barre.

WHAT'S NEXT?
The chords most likely to come next appear on the right – the brighter, the more likely. The prediction knows the harmony of the key and learns the song's progressions as it goes: when the chorus comes back, Chord Live knows what's coming.

KEY
The detected key of the song is shown at the top right.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• Talking and noise don't count as music
• A new song starts automatically after a short pause
• Optional German notation (H instead of B)
• The screen stays on while the app is running

PRIVATE
The music is analyzed only on your device. Nothing is recorded, stored or sent anywhere. No account, no ads, no data collection.

Chord Live is free.

name: Chordical - Sheet Music
description:
Chordical Sheet Music is a library of more than 10,000 pieces that listens while you play. Open a piece, play along on a MIDI keyboard, a guitar or your voice, and the app checks every note as you play it. It can wait for you on each note, or keep time and show you what you missed.

PIANO
• Connect a MIDI keyboard over Bluetooth, USB or a network MIDI session. Bluetooth keyboards such as the Roland FP-90 connect inside the app, with no extra BLE MIDI app needed.
• The app remembers your keyboard and connects to it again by itself the next time.
• No keyboard? Play on the keyboard on screen.
• Every note is judged as you play, or the music waits for you until you play the right one.

GUITAR
• Tab and standard notation side by side.
• Play along through the microphone or on the fretboard on screen.
• A tuner is built in.

VOICE
• Songs, art songs, chorales and exercises with lyrics and accompaniment.
• Sing into the microphone and see your pitch traced over the notes.

DRUMS
• Grooves, fills, rudiments and real performances in drum notation.
• Play along on an electronic kit or on the kit on screen, and every hit is scored.

THE LIBRARY
• Classical piano and chamber music from the Baroque to the early twentieth century, studies and etudes, art songs, choral music, hymns, folk tunes and more.
• Search by title, composer or style, and filter by instrument and difficulty from beginner to virtuoso.
• Open your own MusicXML files.
• The score is engraved for the screen and reflows for a phone held either way up, or an iPad on the music stand.

PLAYBACK
• Hear the piece played on a sampled grand piano, with tempo control and a count in.
• Follow the cursor through the score while it plays.

No account is needed. Your keyboard, microphone and practice stay on your device.

name: Chorvajon
description:
Chorvajon is a livestock marketplace for Uzbekistan — buy and sell animals directly from farmers, without middlemen.

POST A LISTING IN MINUTES
• Add photos and a short video, breed, age, weight and price
• Your listing is visible across your region and the whole country

FIND THE RIGHT ANIMAL
• Cattle, sheep, goats, horses, poultry, feed and equipment
• Filter by region, breed, price, age and gender
• Save a search and get notified when new listings appear

TALK TO SELLERS DIRECTLY
• Chat in the app or call the seller with one tap
• Seller ratings and reviews help you choose with confidence

KNOW THE MARKET
• Price index: median prices by breed and region, updated daily
• Livestock bazaar calendar: which market is open on which day, with reminders
• Live-weight estimation from body measurements

FOR FARMS AND STORES
• Create a shop page for your farm, feed store or vet pharmacy
• Keep track of stock, sales and expenses
• Listing statistics: views, calls and messages

SERVICES
• Find veterinarians, transporters, butchers and other specialists near you

Available in Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic) and Russian.

name: ChowPung
description:
Seven tiles. Three to cast. A whole reef to defend.

Turn mahjong-inspired sets into island-saving spells. Pick three tiles from your hand: a suited run fires a Chow Bolt at the nearest invader, while three identical tiles unleash a Pung Storm across the battlefield. Use wild Dragon tiles and chain casts to build your damage.

• Explore 15 island stages and face Whale Bosses in Endless Tide.
• Slow enemies with Bamboo, splash nearby foes with Shell, or hit harder with Star.
• Explore your options with the Move Advisor and choose from three game speeds.
• Earn level stars, unlock achievements, and beat your own endless wave record.

Play solo, fully offline, with no account or ads. Progress stays on your device

name: ChronoLens: 4D Time Scrub
description:
Step into the past. Right where you're standing.

Every day, we take photos that get buried and forgotten inside a flat camera roll. ChronoLens changes how memories live—turning your iPhone into a time-scrubbing camera for your home.

Using ARKit, ChronoLens anchors historical photos to a Space you create in a room. Come back later, hold up your iPhone, and let the app restore that Space so you can spin the tactile Chrono Dial and compare then and now.

KEY FEATURES

• The Interactive Glass Blade: Drag a glowing optical glass divider across your screen to slice the view in half—today on one side, an earlier moment on the other.
• Tactile Chrono Dial: Scrub across captured moments with inertial momentum, mechanical click haptics, and procedural clockwork audio.
• Ghost Align: When you want a new comparison shot, turn on Ghost Align. Spatial crosshairs guide your steps and snap bright green when you match the original camera angle.
• Hidden AR Voice Time Capsules: Record a voice note and anchor it in a Space, locked until a date you choose. When that date arrives, tap the glowing orb to listen.
• On-device Vision Photo Matcher: On-device Vision compares your camera roll with the room in front of you. If the Space has a saved location, the search prefers photos taken nearby. Nothing is uploaded.
• 60fps Vertical Videos & 3D USDZ: Export a smooth vertical transformation video you can share, or export framed moments as a 3D USDZ file to open in Quick Look.

BUILT FOR TRUST — ZERO SUBSCRIPTIONS, ZERO TRACKING

• Pay Once. Own Forever: One-time purchase. No monthly bills, no weekly trials, no paywalls.
• Private & On-Device: Your room maps, photos, and voice notes stay on your iPhone unless you choose to share an export. No accounts, no cloud uploads, no analytics, and no data collection.

name: Chu & Han: Learn Xiangqi
description:
Ever wondered why the middle of a Chinese chess board reads "Chu River · Han Border"? It remembers a real war — and this game teaches you xiangqi through it.

LEARN IN FIVE MINUTES
Know chess? You're most of the way there. Meet the seven pieces one at a time, each with a short animated story that explains why it moves the way it does:
• The cannon was a catapult — so it must fire over something to hit.
• The horse runs along the ground — block its first step and it trips.
• Soldiers never retreat — Xiang Yu sank his own boats.
• The elephant never crosses the river — like Liu Bang's chancellor, it guards the home front.

PLAY THROUGH THE CHU–HAN WAR
206 BC. The Qin empire has fallen, and two men fight over what is left. Follow Liu Bang and Xiang Yu from the race to Xianyang to the Feast at Hong Gate, the secret road through Chencang and the last stand at Gaixia. Every scene ends in a checkmate puzzle.

FIVE COMPUTER OPPONENTS
From Militia, who you can beat on your first day, to the Hegemon-King himself. Or play a friend on one phone.

HONEST HISTORY
Legends are labelled as legends. History is told as history.

• Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
• Works completely offline
• No accounts, no tracking, no data collected
• Pictogram pieces for beginners, or traditional characters when you're ready
• English and Chinese

name: Cinderhelm
description:
Cinderhelm is a turn-based helm circuit played on a five-by-five rooftop.

Loose cinders are still burning on the shingles. You wear the helm. Each turn gives three steps. Spend them, or end the turn, and the roof flares on its own.

Step onto a neighboring shingle. Walls block the way. A cracked wall can be broken. Walking into flame costs a helm plate.

Quench aims the hose one square. A flame of intensity 1, 2, or 3 needs that many quenches. Quenching a clear shingle leaves a wet line for one roof turn.

The quench tank holds six units. Stand on a cistern and tap it to refill. A cask gives three units, then disappears. The daily quench drop adds one free quench to the next new watch.

Bank a cinder by tapping it when the helm is beside it. If flame is on or beside that shingle, quench it first or spend a bank line.

Five charges open as the route climbs. Fan quench covers a cone. Seal coats one shingle for three turns. Break opens a cracked wall. Chill lowers every flame by one. Each charge is limited for that watch.

After your turn, strong flame can spread. Wind steers it. Smoke grows around intense fire. Cracking shingles count down. A cinder loses safety while flame crowds it.

The watch ends if the helm plates reach zero, a cinder's safety reaches zero, the roof stability reaches zero, or the turn limit closes before the shield gate.

Score is 500 per banked cinder, 100 per quenched flame level, 250 per helm plate left, 100 per unused turn, 300 for careful quench use, and 1000 for a Perfect Seal.

Thirty watches run across Spark Eaves, Brass Flues, Ash Stacks, Gale Spires, and Helm Citadel. The Helm Ledger keeps scores, badges, and gear on this device.

It does not use an account, ads, or a network connection. Progress stays on the phone.

name: CircuitPlex Duo
description:
CircuitPlex Duo is a dig-and-dodge puzzle game with the look and sound of a 90s PC game: chunky pixels, dithered colours and chiptune music.

You are a small repair robot inside a circuit board. Dig through the solder paste, collect enough LEDs to open the exit socket, and think before you dig: whatever was resting on that paste is now coming down.

SHAREWARE, LIKE IT USED TO BE
The first 8 boards are free. A single in-app purchase registers the full version: all 30 boards in three worlds, plus every board added later. No ads, no subscription.

EVERYTHING ON THE BOARD DOES SOMETHING
• Capacitors and LEDs fall when you dig under them, and roll off anything round.
• Push capacitors sideways to plug a gap or clear the way.
• Bugs and sparks crawl along the walls. Keep away, or drop something on them.
• Polarity switches flip which way everything falls.
• Diodes let you through one way only.
• Batteries blow a hole in the board when they land, and one sets off the next.

THREE WORLDS
• BREADBOARD — learn the rules, one at a time.
• MAINBOARD — tight boards where one wrong push ends the run.
• POWER SUPPLY — big scrolling boards, floor after floor, with no way back up.

MADE FOR FOLDABLES, GOOD EVERYWHERE
On a foldable iPhone, stand the phone half-open like a laptop for workbench mode: the board on the top half, and on the bottom half a plan of the whole board that doubles as your control pad. Fold it just a little to underclock the game and take a hard section slowly. Fully open, a corner map shows the whole board. On every other iPhone and on iPad it plays the same, in any orientation.

• Drag to move, tap a neighbouring cell to grab or dig it without stepping in.
• Three stars per board: finish it, collect every LED, and beat the par time.
• WORLD RANKING — best total time, free for everyone (Game Center).

No ads. No sign-up. We collect no data.

name: Citamía · Agenda de citas
description:
Citamía es la agenda de citas para barberías, salones de uñas, estéticas, spas y consultorios.

Crea tu página de reservas en 3 minutos: pon tus servicios con su duración y precio, tu horario y tu logo. Compartes el enlace o el código QR y tus clientes eligen servicio, día y hora desde el celular, sin llamadas ni mensajes de ida y vuelta. Tú lo ves todo en tu agenda.

TU AGENDA, SIEMPRE AL DÍA
• Citas del día y de la semana, con el nombre, el servicio y el teléfono de cada cliente.
• Agrega citas a mano (la del cliente que llama o pasa por el local).
• Bloquea horas para comer, un trámite o tus vacaciones.
• Marca cada cita como confirmada, atendida o «no vino», y ve quién suele faltar.
• Nunca dos clientes en la misma hora: Citamía evita los choques de horario.

RECORDATORIOS POR WHATSAPP
• Un toque y se abre tu WhatsApp con el recordatorio ya escrito.
• Cada cliente recibe su propio enlace para confirmar, cambiar o cancelar su cita, respetando tus condiciones.

TU PÁGINA DE RESERVAS
• Con tu logo, tus colores, tu dirección y tus servicios.
• Varios servicios en una misma cita (corte + barba, uñas + pestañas): el tiempo se suma solo.
• Comparte tu página con el menú del teléfono, por WhatsApp o imprime tu QR para el mostrador.

EN LA APP
• Avisos de citas nuevas en tu iPhone cuando un cliente reserva.
• Tu enlace y tu código QR siempre a mano para compartirlos.
• Ayudas con IA: arma tu lista de servicios a partir de una foto de tus precios y escribe la descripción de tu negocio.

GRATIS PARA EMPEZAR
Gratis con 1 profesional y citas ilimitadas. Si tu equipo crece, el plan Pro (más profesionales y recordatorios automáticos) se contrata en citamia.app.

Privacidad: solo guardamos lo necesario para gestionar las citas. No vendemos datos y la app no usa rastreo publicitario. Puedes eliminar tu cuenta y todos tus datos cuando quieras desde la app.

name: Citizen Ready: Civics Lab
description:
Who pays when a roommate breaks the TV? What is hiding in the fine print of a lease? What do you have to do in a traffic stop, and what can you politely decline? Would you vote "guilty" if the evidence only looks bad?

Citizen Ready puts students in the middle of those moments. It was created by a classroom teacher and brings six hands-on civics and rights lessons together in one app, with one home screen and one nickname, and each lesson saves its own progress.

THE SIX LESSONS
• Roommate Court (free): put on the robe and settle five roommate disputes using receipts, testimony and a written roommate agreement, even when the studio audience wants drama.
• Sign Here: scan a ten-clause lease with a flashlight before time runs out, flag the traps, then negotiate with the landlord before you sign or walk away.
• The Paper Chase: spend a day at the civic center getting through six windows: a license renewal, a lost ID card, voter registration, a car title, a jury summons and a passport.
• Pulled Over: a graphic-novel story about a traffic stop, store security and a knock at the door. Practice staying calm, what you generally must do, and what you can calmly decline.
• Juror #7: sit in the jury room with eleven fictional strangers. Weigh the evidence across 60 cases and only vote guilty if it is truly proven.
• Crossroads County: four years of local elections in a small town. Read the ballot measures, cast your votes and watch the town square change with every result.

HOW IT WORKS
• Realistic choices with feedback that explains why, not just right or wrong.
• Most lessons end with a result or report students can share with their teacher using the share sheet.
• Do the lessons in order or jump to any unlocked one. The home screen shows progress for each lesson.
• Resetting one lesson never touches the others.

FREE LESSON AND IN-APP PURCHASES
• Roommate Court is free to play in full.
• Unlock any other lesson with a one-time purchase, or get all five with Unlock All for less.
• No subscriptions and no ads. Restore Purchases is on the home screen and in About.

BUILT FOR THE CLASSROOM
• Students enter a nickname only. No accounts, no email, no sign-in.
• Lessons work offline. No ads, no tracking, no data collection.
• Classmates sharing a device can each keep their own progress under their own nickname.

For educational purposes only. This app is not legal advice. Laws and procedures vary by state, county and city, and they change over time. All people, cases, landlords, offices, officers, towns and ballot measures are fictional, nothing refers to a real party or candidate, and documents and dollar amounts are simplified examples.

name: Citizenship Test 2027 Prep
description:
Pass your U.S. citizenship test.

Citizenship Test 2027 prepares you for the naturalization interview: the 2025 civics test, the English reading and writing test, and the N-400 questions the officer asks. Study in your language, then practice the English questions and answers you will hear at your interview.

From Winslow Homes Publishing.

6 LANGUAGES
English, Español, 中文, Tiếng Việt, Tagalog and العربية. Lessons and practice questions are in your language. Flashcards show the English question and answer with your language below, so you learn the exact English words.

THE 2025 CIVICS TEST
- All 128 official civics questions and answers
- How the test works: the officer asks up to 20 questions and you need 12 correct
- Notes for applicants who filed before October 20, 2025 and take the 2008 test
- Answers that change, like the President and Speaker of the House, are marked so you check them before your interview

THE ENGLISH TEST AND YOUR INTERVIEW
- Reading and writing vocabulary with practice sentences
- Common N-400 interview questions and how to answer them
- What to bring on interview day

STUDY TOOLS
- 16 lessons and 400 practice questions in each language
- Flashcards for every civics question
- Timed practice tests and weak spot drills
- Must-know answers cheat sheet
- Day and night mode

FREE TO START
Try 2 lessons and 25 questions free. Unlock the full course with a subscription.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
- Monthly: $14.99
- 3 months: $29.99
- 6 months: $39.99
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) or any government agency. This app is a study aid and does not give legal advice. Civics questions are from the public USCIS 2025 civics test.

name: Clack: Retro Typewriter
description:
Rediscover the beauty of writing with Clack: Retro Typewriter, a charming digital writing space inspired by classic typewriters.

Turn everyday thoughts into meaningful letters, personal notes, and creative messages. Choose your favorite writing style, customize your stationery, and enjoy a nostalgic typing experience right on your iPhone.

KEY FEATURES

CLASSIC TYPEWRITER EXPERIENCE
Enjoy the nostalgic feeling of typing on a vintage-inspired typewriter. Create letters and notes with distinctive typography, colorful ink ribbons, and a timeless writing style.

COLORFUL INK RIBBONS
Bring your words to life with a variety of ink ribbon colors. Switch between different shades to match your mood and give every letter a unique touch.

PERSONALIZED LETTERS & STATIONERY
Make your words stand out with beautiful paper designs and writing styles. Choose stationery that complements your message and adds a personal touch to every letter.

MULTI-PAGE LETTERS
Have more to say? Write longer letters across multiple pages and keep your thoughts flowing without limits. Perfect for heartfelt messages, personal stories, and meaningful memories.

POSTCARDS & NOTES
Express yourself in different ways with postcards and note formats. Create quick messages, thoughtful greetings, or personalized postcards for any occasion.

PHOTO DECORATION WITH WASHI TAPE
Make your letters more memorable by adding your favorite photos. Decorate them with charming washi tape to create beautiful, scrapbook-inspired stationery.

ENVELOPES, WAX SEALS & STAMPS
Complete your letters with decorative envelopes, classic wax seals, and charming stamps. Add the finishing touches that make every message feel special.

DRAW & ADD YOUR SIGNATURE
Make your writing uniquely yours. Add handwritten signatures, playful doodles, or small illustrations directly to your letters.

RELAXING WRITING ATMOSPHERE
Settle into a peaceful writing experience inspired by cozy surroundings. Take a moment to slow down, gather your thoughts, and enjoy the simple pleasure of writing.

WRITE FOR EVERY OCCASION
- Birthday wishes and greeting cards
- Thank-you letters and personal messages
- Love notes and meaningful memories
- Daily thoughts and creative writing
- Friendly greetings and special occasions

SEND & RECEIVE LETTERS VIA ICLOUD
Bring the joy of exchanging letters into the digital world. Send and receive personal letters through iCloud, making it easy to share thoughtful messages and stay connected with the people who matter.

WHY CHOOSE CLACK: RETRO TYPEWRITER?
Rediscover a classic way to express yourself through writing. Combining vintage aesthetics with modern convenience, Clack: Retro Typewriter makes creating personalized letters, postcards, and notes simple, relaxing, and enjoyable.

Make every message memorable, one letter at a time.

*** Upgrade to Premium to unlock unlimited access to all features. ***
You can choose:
- yearly subscription
- weekly subscription with 3 day free trial

– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase (After free trial period if offered).
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
