name: Clair.
description:
Clair gathers art exhibitions from museums, galleries and festivals around the world: what is on now, what opens soon and what has closed.

• Now: the shows on view in your city, closing soon and opening soon.
• Map: every venue on one map, near you or anywhere.
• Search: by artist, venue, city, genre and dates; open now or late.
• Day planner: pick a few shows and Clair lays out the route, with walking and transit times and a break for lunch.
• Poster scanner: point the camera at an openings poster and save the shows on it.
• Friends: plan visits together, see who is going, pass a show to a phone beside you.
• Saved: your shows, reminders and calendar.

Readers can add a show or an artist; every entry is checked by a moderator.

No ads, no tracking. An account is optional.

name: Classic Sudoku: Daily Puzzles
description:
Classic Sudoku, done properly: a clean 9×9 board, puzzles with exactly one solution, and everything you need to enjoy a quiet few minutes or a long, tough session.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• The Daily Challenge gives every player the same puzzle each day, with a weekly rhythm: a gentle start to the week and a tougher Sunday.
• Missed a day? Open the calendar and play it later.
• Each finished day earns a star. Collect every star in a month to win that month's trophy.
• Win a puzzle each day to keep your streak growing.

SIX LEVELS, FROM EASY TO EXTREME
Easy and Medium are open from the start. Hard opens after 2 Medium wins, Expert after 4 Hard wins, Master after 10 Expert wins, and Extreme after 14 Master wins. Every puzzle is freshly generated, so there is always another one waiting.

TOOLS THAT HELP YOU THINK
• Notes: jot down candidates in any cell. When you place a digit, matching notes in its row, column and box clear automatically.
• Undo and Erase: take back moves without a fuss.
• Highlights: the selected row, column and box are tinted, and matching digits light up so you can spot patterns quickly.
• Hint: every game includes one hint that points to a cell and, whenever there is a clear logical step, explains it, so you learn the technique instead of just getting the answer.
• The number pad dims digits you have already placed nine times.

FAIR AND FOCUSED
Wrong digits turn red straight away. Three mistakes end the game, but you get one Second Chance per puzzle that forgives a mistake and lets you carry on. Pause hides the board while you are away, and your game saves automatically, so you can pick up exactly where you left off.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Statistics: wins, win rate, current and best streaks, plus best and average times for every level.
• A calendar that shows every daily puzzle you have completed.
• 17 awards to collect, from your first win to a flawless solve or a perfect month of daily puzzles.

COMFORTABLE TO PLAY
• Designed for both iPhone and iPad, with a roomy side panel on iPad in landscape.
• Light and Dark appearance that follows your device.
• Show or hide the timer, turn matching-digit highlights on or off, and switch haptics off if you prefer.
• Works with VoiceOver and larger text sizes.
• A short glow when you finish a 3×3 block and a small celebration when you solve the puzzle, both toned down if you use Reduce Motion.
• No sign-up and no account. Open the app and play.

Classic Sudoku: Daily Puzzles is for anyone who likes number puzzles, logic and brain training: beginners learning the rules, daily solvers, and experts chasing the hardest grids.

PRIVACY POLICY
https://eebconsultancy.github.io/sudoku-legal/privacy.html

TERMS OF USE
https://eebconsultancy.github.io/sudoku-legal/terms.html

name: Clean Focus: Eisenhower
description:
Clean Focus is an Eisenhower Matrix to-do list, plus a second way to sort the same tasks. You decide what matters, then you see only that.

Eisenhower Matrix
Sort by urgent and important.
Now: do it yourself.
Later: schedule it.
Delegate: hand it on.
Drop: let it go.

Clean Focus
Sort the day, not only the urgency.
Now: highest priority.
Goals: what you are working toward.
Waiting: what depends on someone else.
Habits: what should happen again.

The switch sits in settings. Each mode can keep its own tasks, or share one list.

A task is a name. Add a due date or one dependency, such as a client, when you need it. Today turns yellow. Overdue turns red. Finished tasks fade.

One reminder a day, at a local time you choose, for everything due that day. It runs on the device.

No account. No ads. No subscription. The to-do list stays on the phone, offline.

German and English. The app follows the language of the device.

name: Cleaning Quote & Profit
description:
Know your price before you say it. Enter the hours, your own hourly cost, supplies, travel and the margin you want, and see the suggested price, your profit and what you really earn per hour.
Built for solo cleaners and small cleaning businesses who quote homes and offices.
Turn the estimate into a tidy PDF quote and share it your way.

PRICE FROM YOUR OWN NUMBERS
• Suggested price = your total cost ÷ (1 − margin), so a 25% margin really keeps 25% of the price
• Your own labor is counted as a cost first, so profit is what's left after paying yourself
• See profit, margin and effective hourly earnings update as you type
• Set your own price instead, and see the margin it gives you
• A clearly labeled example to start from. It is not a market rate; replace it with your numbers

QUOTES CLIENTS CAN READ
• Add a client, scope of work, hourly or fixed-price services, a discount and notes
• Optional simple tax percentage on top, kept separate from profit
• Preview the exact PDF before sharing: business name and contact, quote number and date, client, services, subtotal, discount, tax, total and validity date
• Share through Mail, Messages, Files or Print. Nothing is sent automatically
• Mark quotes Draft, Sent, Accepted or Completed for your own records. Sent quotes keep the client and business details they were issued with

LEARN FROM EVERY JOB
• Record the hours and expenses a job really took
• Compare quoted and actual hours, cost and profit side by side

YOUR RATE CARD
• Save your usual hourly cost, margin, supplies, travel, overhead and tax rate once
• Start any estimate from them; saved quotes never change when your rates do

FREE
• Unlimited estimates, your rate card, and up to three saved quotes with PDF sharing
• Estimated vs. actual on each quote
• Backup export (JSON), CSV export of quotes, and Delete All Data

PRO
• Unlimited saved quotes and clients
• Reusable service templates
• Text branding on PDFs: tagline, footer note and heading color
• Estimated vs. actual reports across all your jobs

Quotes you saved stay readable and exportable if Pro ends.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your business details, clients and quotes are stored on your iPhone, not on our servers. The app asks for no permissions.

Results are estimates based on the numbers you enter. They are not accounting, tax or legal advice, and they don't promise a profit. Tax is one simple percentage; jurisdiction-specific tax rules aren't supported.

Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/cleaning-quote-profit/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/cleaning-quote-profit/terms

name: Clip Shear: Trim & Crop Video
description:
Clip Shear tidies up short videos saved on your iPhone. Pick a video and it finds the end card or fade at the end and cuts it off, crops away the black bars, and saves a clean copy to Photos.

• Trims the ending: end cards, fades to black and logo endings
• Crops black bars at the top, bottom and sides, keeping the picture's own shape
• Remove sound: save the video silent, and save the sound on its own as an audio file
• Share a video to Clip Shear from Photos, or choose one in the app
• Delete the original after the clean copy is saved, if you want to

Everything happens on your iPhone. Videos are never uploaded, there is no account, and the app makes no network connections.

Free, with no limits and no in-app purchases.

Use Clip Shear on videos you made or have the right to edit.

name: ClipLearn: Vocabulary Cards
description:
Remember words from the things you read.

Paste a word, enter a phrase or select an expression from a sentence. ClipLearn creates a vocabulary card with translations, explanations and examples in your chosen translation language.

• Keep up to three vocabulary decks, one per language you learn.
• Add context from your reading to understand the right meaning.
• Review explanations, synonyms and examples.
• Lock Screen widget: a word from your cards appears on your Lock Screen and changes on your schedule, from every 15 minutes to once a day, so you review without opening the app.
• Practise recalling words from their meanings.
• Get a daily English lesson at your level, A1 to C2, with Russian translations.
• Open an external dictionary for further reference.
• Review saved cards and downloaded lessons offline.

ClipLearn is free, with up to 30 AI card generations per day. There is no account, subscription or in-app purchase.

AI card generation requires internet access and your permission to send the word, optional sentence and selected languages to OpenAI through our server. AI can make mistakes. Avoid entering sensitive information. You can revoke permission and delete saved learning data in Settings.

Dictionary links open independent third-party websites. ClipLearn is not affiliated with Oxford University Press.

name: Clock Drop Puzzle
description:
Clock Drop Puzzle is a falling-piece puzzle played with clocks.

Round clocks fall from the top of a 6×10 board. Drop them, line up their hands, and connect them into a loop. When a loop closes, it disappears, together with every clock caught inside.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the lowest empty cell in a column to drop the clock there.
• Tap a higher cell to slide the clock sideways.
• Tap the falling clock to turn it 90°.

HOW THE HANDS LINK
• A long hand links to the neighboring clock it points at.
• Short hands link when two short hands face each other.
• Close the links into a loop to clear it. Bigger loops score more.

TIME KEEPS MOVING
Each time you drop a clock, every clock on the board moves ahead 1 hour 30 minutes. A layout that does not connect now may connect a few drops later. Read ahead and set up your loops.

CHAIN REACTIONS
When the remaining clocks fall after a clear and close another loop, that is a chain. Chains multiply your score.

FEATURES
• Simple one-finger controls
• Clocks fall faster as your level rises
• Plays in portrait
• Works offline, with no account needed
• English, Japanese, Spanish, Korean, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)

The game ends when the clocks pile up to the top. How far can you go?

name: CloserOne
seller_name: CLOSER ONE YAPAY ZEKA TEKNOLOJILERI ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
CloserOne, satış ekibinin cebindeki CRM'dir. Müşterilerinden gelen bütün mesajları görür, hızlı yanıt verir, satışlarını takip edersin.

Gelen Kutusu
• WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger ve web sohbeti tek listede
• Yeni mesajlar ve teslim durumları anında güncellenir
• Fotoğraf, video ve belge gönder, hazır yanıtları kullan
• 24 saat penceresi kapandığında onaylı WhatsApp şablonu gönder
• Konuşmayı ekip arkadaşına ata

Bugün
• Yanıt bekleyen müşteriler, bekleme süresine göre renkli
• Bugünkü görüşmeler, takip zamanı gelen ve takılan anlaşmalar

Satış
• Pano ve aşamalar, liste görünümü, sıralama ve süzgeçler
• Anlaşma detayı, zaman çizelgesi ve notlar
• Aşama taşı; kaybedilen anlaşmada nedenini kaydet

Kişiler ve Takvim
• Kartviziti çek, bilgiler otomatik dolsun

Kampanyalar ve Otomasyonlar

name: Cloud-Gatherer
description:
Fly through the skies as Zeus, collect points and dodge lightning.

Unlock legendary weather names, discover their stories and beat your personal records.

Enjoy a simple sky adventure with colorful visuals and fun challenges.

name: CloudyEmployee
description:
CloudyEmployee puts your company's HR in your pocket. Check in, ask for time off, follow your requests and see your payslips, all from one simple app. Managers approve requests and keep an eye on their team in seconds.

For employees:
• Check in and out with one tap, with your hours for today and this week
• Location-based check-in when your company uses approved work locations
• Request leave (full or half days, or a few hours) and overtime
• See your leave balances and the status of every request
• View your payslips and work schedule
• Submit expenses, scan receipts and documents with the camera
• Help desk tickets, company mail and notifications

For managers:
• "Team today": who is present, on leave or absent
• Approve or refuse leave, overtime and other requests
• Attendance log, employees, departments and contracts
• Overtime rules, leave types and balances
• Dashboard and reports for your team

Arabic and English, right-to-left ready.

CloudyEmployee works with your company's CloudyEmployee account. Your employer creates your login.

name: CodePeacock Books
description:
CodePeacock Books is a calm, beautiful reader and notebook in one app.

READ LIKE A REAL BOOK
• Turn pages with a tap or swipe, or scroll if you prefer
• Day, Sepia and Night themes, text size, fonts (incl. an easy-read font), line spacing and margins
• Contents, search inside the book, bookmarks and progress that follows you to every device
• Read offline: books are saved on your iPhone or iPad
• Read aloud: listen to any page with your device's voice

HIGHLIGHT AND WRITE
• Highlight text in four colours and add notes
• Write directly on the page with your finger or Apple Pencil — pressure-sensitive ink, highlighter and eraser
• Share a favourite quote

A NOTEBOOK FOR YOUR IDEAS
• Create as many notebooks as you like, on blank, lined, grid or dotted paper
• Handwriting with palm rejection, highlighter, eraser, lasso to select and move, undo/redo
• Type text anywhere on the page
• Everything syncs to your account

YOUR OWN FILES
• Add your own EPUB, PDF, MOBI/AZW3, FB2 or CBZ files and read them with the same tools

YOUR LIBRARY
• Books you already own from CodePeacock appear in your library automatically after you sign in.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no trackers. Your notes and files are private to your account, and you can delete your account and all data at any time from the app.

name: Codex Nights: Vampire Hordes
description:
São Paulo, 2001. The night belongs to the hungry ones. Survive until dawn.

Codex Nights is a one-thumb survival action game. You only move: your weapons attack on their own. Every level up you choose a new weapon or upgrade, and in a few minutes the screen is a storm of thorns, lightning, blood orbs and razors against hundreds of enemies.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag anywhere to walk. No buttons to mash.
• Collect crystals, level up and build your arsenal: 12 weapons and 7 passives.
• Max out a weapon with its partner passive and open a chest: it EVOLVES into a stronger form.
• Face the Masked Hunter and, at the end of the night, the Regent himself.

4 HEROES, 4 STYLES
• Dulce, the Survivor: mangrove roots and thorns, health that never stops regenerating.
• Sid, the Newly Awakened: a shadow that hurts whoever steps on it, and a knack for dodging.
• Yana, the Dynastic Memory: golden runes that chase your enemies.
• Leo Okano, the Blade of the Waves: wave-shaped cuts and critical hits.

KEEP GETTING STRONGER
Gold from every night buys permanent upgrades and unlocks heroes. Each run you go further.

A STORY TO PIECE TOGETHER
Find the 7 fragments of the Heart Stone and uncover what happened the night Senescal Varella died, in the world of the novel Codex da Grande São Paulo.

• Short runs, perfect on the go. Plays offline.
• No account, no energy timers.
• Free to play. Optional rewarded ads; the one-time Night Pact gives their rewards without ads.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://summitviewland.com/codexnights/privacy.html

name: CoffeeGo UAE
description:
CoffeeGo is the customer app for businesses served by CoffeeGo in the UAE: offices, residences, gyms and clinics with CoffeeGo coffee machines.

ORDER SUPPLIES IN A FEW TAPS
Coffee beans, milk powder, chocolate, cups and other consumables for your machines. Repeat a previous order or build a new one from your price list.

TRACK EVERY ORDER
See the status of each order from confirmation to delivery, with delivery notes and documents.

INVOICES AND PAYMENTS
All your quotations, invoices and receipts in one place. Download PDFs and pay invoices securely by card.

SUBSCRIPTION AND SERVICE
View your coffee machine subscription plan, request service or report an issue with a machine, and send feedback to our team.

BONUSES
Collect bonus points on orders and see your balance and history in the wallet.

NOTIFICATIONS
Get notified when your order status changes, when an invoice is issued or paid, and when bonuses are credited.

The app is available in English, Arabic and Russian.

An account is created by CoffeeGo for your company, or you can sign up in the app with your phone number or email.

name: Collaged
description:
Collaged makes clean photo collages in seconds, and nothing else.

Pick 1 to 9 photos and they land in an even grid. Drag any line to resize the cells; the photos underneath stay put. Drag a photo to reposition it in its frame, or pinch to zoom.

• 1 to 9 photos, each with a sensible even layout
• Drag dividers and crosshairs to reshape the grid
• Shapes for every post: 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 4:3, 2:3 and Letter
• Borders: any width and any color, including see-through
• Rotate a photo, or tap a divider and flip its split
• Lock a photo so it stays exactly where you put it
• Swap a photo or delete it, and the grid re-fits
• Save a high-resolution image to Photos or share it anywhere

Keep it simple: no filters, stickers, or text. No accounts, ads, or tracking. Your photos never leave your iPhone.

name: Color Volley
description:
The belt is moving. Your shooters are lined up. The picture is pure neon.
Send a shooter round the conveyor and it lasers every block of its color it can see. Clear the picture before the bench fills up.
301 levels, a 1980s synthwave look and soundtrack, no ads.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap the front shooter of a lane to launch it onto the belt
• It fires at the first block it sees in each row and column, if that block is its color
• Shooters with shots left park on the bench, and two of one color stack into one. Fill the bench and you lose the level
• Some shooters stay hidden until they reach the front
• No luck, ever: the same taps always give the same result

301 PICTURES
• Every picture is different, and they grow bigger as you go
• Hard and Super Hard levels test your planning, and every one can be won without boosters
• Replay any level you've beaten

WHEN IT GETS TIGHT
• Extra Slot: one more bench slot for this attempt
• Grab: pull any waiting shooter to the front, even a hidden one
• Merge: fuse every waiting shooter of one color into one
• Bench full? Continue with one more slot and play on

THE VOLLEY PASS
• A new pass every month from level 35: wins earn points, and points claim coins, boosters and unlimited lives
• The premium track adds more rewards and a sixth life for the month
• Win 3 or 5 in a row and start the next level with free boosters

BRING A FRIEND
• Invite friends from the shop (needs iCloud)
• They get 1,000 coins to start
• When they win 10 levels, you get 1,000 coins and an hour of unlimited lives (up to 5 friends)

PURE 1980s
• Neon tubes, chrome letters and a sunset grid
• An original synthwave soundtrack
• Every color has its own symbol: switch them on in Settings

FAIR AND FREE
• Free to download, and every level is free
• Up to five lives. One comes back every 30 minutes, and a win costs none
• Coins, boosters and your progress follow you to your other devices through iCloud
• Plays offline
• Optional coin packs, bundles and the Volley Pass
• No ads. No accounts. No tracking. No data collected.

name: Combo Buddy
description:
Combo Buddy is a pocket notebook for controller combos. Write down every move the way you really press it, and find it again in a second: before a match, during practice, or when you come back to a game months later.

DRAW IT LIKE YOU PLAY IT
• Tap the buttons in the order you press them: face buttons, shoulders, triggers, the d-pad and both sticks.
• Draw stick moves with your finger (quarter circles, half circles, rolls, flicks) and Combo Buddy recognises the move.
• Tap or Hold, Repeat, Mash, timed holds, pauses and buttons pressed Together.
• Generic moves: "in any direction", or "this way or its mirror" for moves that work both ways.

YOUR CONTROLLER, YOUR SYMBOLS
Pick the layout you play on, shapes or letters, and every combo is drawn with the symbols on your own pad. Change it any time: your combos follow.

FIND ANY COMBO IN A SECOND
• One list per game, with folders inside.
• Search by name. Sort by name, recently edited or recently added.
• Swipe right to file a combo in a folder, left to delete it.

SHARE AS AN IMAGE
Turn one combo or a whole list into a clean image and send it to a friend, a group chat or your team.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your combos stay on your iPhone.

FREE, OR PRO ONCE
The free version holds 2 games of your own, 5 combos per game and one image export. Combo Buddy Pro removes every limit with a single payment. No subscription.

Combo Buddy works with any game. It is an independent app, not affiliated with any game publisher or console maker.

name: comfort zone | your routes
description:
comfort zone shows the routes you run, ride or walk again and again. the app reads your workouts from apple health, recognises identical routes by their gps track and groups them.

for every route you see how often you have done it, when you last did it and what has changed.

YOUR ROUTES
• identical routes are recognised automatically, in either direction
• every route gets its shape as a small symbol
• your latest and your most frequent routes at a glance
• name routes, merge them or hide them

THE PAGE OF A ROUTE
• all rounds overlaid: the usual route drawn clearly, deviations as fine lines
• one line per year: when the route was part of your life and when it rested
• most common day, most common start time, season and temperature
• duration and pace, descriptive: usual value, range, last round
• first, fastest and longest round

SUGGESTIONS AND EVENTS
• suggestions for today: what you have done often lately and what you haven't done for a while
• special events: a new route, here for the 100th time, back after months

QUIET
• no goals, no streaks, no badges
• no comparison with others, no feed
• routes as a line on an empty surface, without a map
• light and dark, four colours

PRIVATE
• your data stays on your iphone
• no account, no server, no ads, no tracking
• comfort zone only reads your workouts and changes nothing in health
• the only outside connections: apple's place search for name suggestions and, when you name a route, apple's map

GOOD TO KNOW
• the app needs workouts with a recorded route in apple health, for example from an apple watch
• a route appears from its third repetition
• on first launch the app reads all your routes, which can take a few minutes
• kilometres or miles, °C or °F: as set on your iphone

comfort zone is free.

name: Compress Photo to KB
description:
Select a photo or file, enter the upload limit and save a JPEG copy. Choose 100, 200 or 500 KB, or enter a whole number from 1 to 10,000 KB. See measured bytes and dimensions before exporting.

Open local HEIC, JPEG and PNG photos. PNG transparency becomes white in the copy. Save to Photos or share the file. Use a short code or .kbrule file to share a limit. Compress up to 10 photos in a batch and export those that pass.

Processing stays on your iPhone. No account, ads or analytics.

Single-photo compression is free. Batch compression and creating or editing named rules are available in the 30-day trial and with a one-time purchase. No subscription or automatic charge.

name: Concrete Cylinder Log
description:
Concrete Cylinder Log keeps pour sets and cylinder breaks on this iPhone.

The calendar shows ASTM windows. Acceptance shows the sliding average and how high the next test must be.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: ContentsKeeper: Home Inventory
description:
Ready for an insurance claim in minutes.

ContentsKeeper is a private home inventory for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Snap a room and on-device AI lists what it sees. It reads receipts and serial numbers too. You check every item and value before it counts, and your claim PDF and CSV are ready when you need them.

PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI • Item detection, receipt reading and serial-number scanning run on your device. • No account. Your inventory stays on your devices and syncs through your own iCloud. • No ads, no tracking. • Optional App Lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.

READY FOR A CLAIM • Room-by-room inventory with photos, receipts, serial numbers and purchase dates. • Claim readiness shows which items still need a photo, value or receipt. • Claim PDF and insurer-style CSV with replacement cost and estimated actual cash value (Premium). • Flag items over your policy's per-item limits.

AI ESTIMATES YOU CONTROL • On supported devices, the app can suggest a value. It's always labelled "Estimate" and is not an appraisal or insurance advice. • Estimates never go into a claim export until you confirm or edit them.

PLANS • Free: 1 place and up to 20 items, with a watermarked claim preview. • Premium: unlimited items and places, claim PDF and CSV export, and room PDFs on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Choose Premium Yearly (auto-renewing subscription) or Premium Lifetime (one payment, never renews). Family Sharing on both. • Yearly renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple ID account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

ContentsKeeper helps you document what you own. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any insurer, and it does not guarantee that a claim will be accepted.

name: Contractors Islands
description:
Prepare for contractor licensing exams in South Carolina and North Carolina with Contractors Islands. Choose your state, then explore Residential Builder and Business & Law topics one house at a time.

Practice with rotating questions, review explanations and missed questions, and track your readiness by topic. When you’re ready, try a timed Exam Day practice session. Start with a free sample house on each island. Optional one-time in-app purchases unlock additional study content and Exam Day; purchases apply across supported SC and NC content.

Contractors Islands is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by SC LLR, the North Carolina Licensing Board for General Contractors, or PSI. The app does not guarantee a passing score. Check current exam requirements and code references against official sources.

name: Cookheart
description:
Your own cookbook on your iPhone: write down the recipes you love, plan what to cook this week, and get one shopping list for everything you need.

YOUR RECIPES
- Photo, description, servings and cooking time for every recipe, and a photo for every step
- Groups such as Breakfast, Dinner or New Year; a recipe can be in several
- Choose which part of a photo shows; nothing is cropped
- Sort by name, time, newest, or drag recipes into your own order

PLAN AND SHOP
- Plan a dish for a day and time, with a reminder to cook
- One shopping list for all planned dishes, sorted by shop department
- A shopping reminder that lists what is still to buy, once or every week

RECIPE CATALOG
- 200+ recipes from different cuisines and homemade drinks, with 40+ breakfast ideas
- Add any of them to your recipes with one tap and change it as you like

EASY TO USE
- Search forgives typos, different word endings and the wrong keyboard layout
- Favorites with one tap
- Four designs: Default, Rose Cookbook, Fresh Greens and Minimal, in light and dark mode. You can select your favorite theme

PRIVATE
No account and no sign-in. Your recipes stay on your iPhone: no ads, no tracking, no data collected.

name: coquest: Side Quests
description:
coquest gives you and your friends something specific to go do, plus a small game that makes it worth doing.

Each quest is a real place around the University of Minnesota, with a twist: roll dice on the Green Line and eat where you land, blind-taste boba from three shops on Eat Street, race to find the hidden icons at Union Depot. Every quest says how to get there, what it costs, how long it takes and who wins.

Swipe through quests and save the ones you like, or browse them all with filters for vibe, time of day and season. Make a squad, plan a quest together and see who's in. When you go, post a photo and a score for your friends to see.

Earn XP for every quest you finish and climb the ranks with your squad. Make your own quests for others to find.

Made by UMN students. Free, with no ads.

name: CORE by Chameleon Collective
description:
CORE is Chameleon Collective's operating platform, now on your phone. It is built for Collective staff and members who sign in with their Chameleon Google account.

CHAT
• Every Google Chat space, direct message and thread you belong to, with Unreads, Mentions, Threads and DMs one tap away.
• Reply in threads, react, @mention people, and share photos and files.
• Start a Google Meet and post its link to the conversation so everyone can join.
• Write with no signal: messages wait and send themselves when you're back online.
• Friendly tips when a Slack habit (like /remind or /giphy) works differently in Google Chat.

CORE ON THE GO
• The CORE pages you use on the web, sized for your phone, with Chat in the tab bar.
• CORE cards in Chat for the approvals and requests that need you.

NOTIFICATIONS AND SECURITY
• Push notifications for new messages and @mentions.
• Optional Face ID lock when you come back to the app.
• Access ends the moment a Collective account is switched off.

CORE requires a Chameleon Collective account.

name: Corfu Planner
description:
Corfu Planner este ghidul tău offline-ready pentru vacanța pe Corfu.

Ce găsești în aplicație:
• Hartă cu plaje, taverne, peisaje și puncte utile
• Rute România → Corfu și pe insulă
• Stații PECO și alerte de drum (Smart Radar BG)
• Traducere documente / meniuri cu camera
• Chat comunitate și anunțuri utile
• Radio și instrumente de călătorie

Aplicația este gratuită în App Store. Accesul complet se deblochează cu adresa de email a licenței cumpărate pe greciaplanner.ro. Fără reclame și fără abonament.

Politica de confidențialitate: https://greciaplanner.ro/confidentialitate
Suport: contact@greciaplanner.ro

name: Corner Kick Master
description:
Corner Master is a 3D football corner-kick game built around aiming, power control, and team finishing. Choose a training mode, adjust your settings, and hold the kick button to charge power. Release to send the ball into play.

Explore four modes with different objectives:

FREE TRAINING
Choose a kick position on the half pitch and adjust direction and curve. Use the position selector to practice from a corner or another available location. There is no attempt limit in this mode, so you can repeat kicks and explore different settings at your own pace.

PRECISION PASSING
Select a near, central, or far target zone. Adjust your passing direction and control power with the hold-and-release button. The ball's landing point determines whether the pass reaches the target. Each session includes five passes, with hit counts, accuracy, and points shown during play. Passes closer to the target center earn more points.

CORNER ASSISTS
Choose a near-post, central, or far-post receiving tactic. Aim your cross toward the receiving zone and use the power guide to help set up the delivery. When the ball reaches the zone, a teammate runs in, receives the pass, and shoots. A cross outside the receiving zone does not count as a successful assist. Each session includes five corners.

GOAL CHALLENGE
Work through five levels with different targets inside the goal. Targets progress from a central finish to low shots and upper-corner finishes. Each level allows three attempts. Direction controls the finishing aim, while power affects shot height. Your teammate receives the corner and takes the shot using your settings. Hit the required target to earn the level reward and continue. Scoring elsewhere in the goal does not clear the target challenge.

SIMPLE KICK CONTROLS
Hold the kick button to build power and release when you are ready. The power meter shows the charge level, and target guides display suggested settings. Direction and curve controls are available in the relevant modes. A third-person view follows the corner-kick setup and the action on the pitch.

TRAINING STATS
View corner attempts, passing accuracy, assist rate, and goals scored. Check weekly, monthly, and all-time totals, along with a weekly activity chart and recent training records. New users start with zero training data. Results accumulate as you play.

POINTS AND DAILY TASKS
Earn points from training results and completed daily tasks. Claim available task rewards and follow your level progress. Levels increase with accumulated points, with one level gained for every 200 points.

LANGUAGE AND PREFERENCES
Choose Simplified Chinese or English from the home screen. Sound and haptic feedback preferences can be adjusted in training settings. Haptic feedback depends on device support.

You can open your stats from a training session and return to the pitch to continue with the same mode, round, score, and settings. Progress and preferences are saved locally on your device.

Corner Master offers a football game experience for practicing its in-game controls and completing corner-kick challenges.

name: Couch Codes: Cheats for GTA 6
description:
Every GTA 6 cheat as a row of big controller buttons. Prop your iPhone by the TV and enter codes without squinting at a guide.

COUCH MODE
Tap Play and the code goes one button at a time, huge and readable from the sofa. Set the speed, or let a voice read the buttons out loud. Works in landscape on the coffee table.

YOUR CONTROLLER
Pick PS5 or Xbox Series X|S once. The phone shortcut and shoulder buttons switch to yours on every screen.

CHECKED CODES ONLY
61 cheats with their effect and how to unlock them. A code goes in only when at least two independent guides print the same buttons. Every cheat lists its sources and the date we last checked. Cheats without a confirmed code say so instead of guessing.

ALSO
• Search by what you want: car, plane, wanted level, money
• Favorites for the cheats you use every night
• Step-by-step guide to opening the cheat input
• Works offline

FREE, NO CATCH
No ads, no account, no purchases, no tracking.

Cheats work in story mode only, never online. Using one stops saving and trophies for that session.

Unofficial fan app. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of their owners. PlayStation and Xbox are trademarks of Sony Interactive Entertainment and Microsoft.

name: Count4Me
description:
Count4Me counts for you while you work out, do physical therapy or repeat any movement. Put your phone down, say the numbers out loud or clap: the count appears in large numbers you can read from two meters away.

THREE WAYS TO COUNT
• Numbers by voice: say "one, two, three…" and the app follows along. A repeated number isn't counted twice, and if the app misses a number it simply carries on from the next one you say.
• Claps: every clap is an event. With the divisor you choose how many claps make one rep, for example two.
• Custom sound: record 3 to 5 examples of your own sound, like a finger snap or a tap on the table, test the recognition and adjust the sensitivity.

SETS
Set the reps per set: when a set is complete the app closes it and starts again from one. You see the total and the progress of the current set together.

INTERVAL TIMER
Choose the duration and the interval alerts, at a regular pace or at times you pick. Eight built-in tones, from Tibetan bowl to gong, with preview. The timer rings even with the screen locked.

MADE TO BE READ FROM A DISTANCE
The number fills half the screen, and colors show the state from across the room: yellow while listening, grey when paused, orange if audio is interrupted. The screen stays on during a session. Pause, corrections with − and +, Reset and End session are always within reach.

PRESETS
Save your favorite settings and start a session with one tap.

PRIVACY
Voice and sound recognition runs entirely on your phone, even without a connection. Audio is never saved or sent. No account, no ads, no data collected.

Available in English and Italian.

name: Countable Plate
description:
Countable Plate is for reading a dilution series of agar plates. Photograph each plate or pick its photo, then tap the colonies. On a crowded plate, count a half, quarter or eighth sector and the app multiplies it out.

The counting rule then looks at the whole series, not one plate. It follows the plate count calculation in ISO 7218: the weighted mean of two dilutions in range, the 334 and 8 confidence limits when one dilution is over and the next is under, estimated counts below the lower limit, and a plain Repeat the test when no dilution can be reported. A bracket marks the dilutions it keeps, and the result is given to two significant figures, like 1.7 × 10⁴ CFU/mL.

Open the result to walk through every step, with the formula filled in. Mark a plate as too many to count or as a spreader and the kept pair moves. Add your own limits, such as 15 to 150. Share a report card with the ladder, the result and the rule.

Samples, photos and counts stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. A qualified analyst should check every result before it is released.

name: Countless Vaults
description:
Countless Vaults is a private, encrypted vault for your photos, videos, notes and files. Draw a pattern on a 25-dot grid and your vault opens. Draw a different pattern and you open a different vault.

There's no wrong pattern. A new drawing opens an empty vault; your drawing reopens what you saved. The app never lists your vaults and never shows how many exist, so no one can tell what you keep or where. Create as many as you like, one for each part of your life.

THE PATTERN WIDGET
• Put the grid on your Home Screen: 5×5 in the large widget or 3×3 in the medium one.
• Tap the dots in your pattern's order, tap Open, and the app opens straight into that vault.
• The widget never shows your content or vault names, and the drawing fades after a few seconds.
• Tapping Open clears the drawing before the app opens, and your pattern never travels in a link.
• When your iPhone is locked, iOS itself disables the widget's buttons.

HOW IT WORKS
• Draw a pattern of at least 6 dots to open a vault.
• Write notes, add photos, videos and files, then tap Lock.
• Leave the app and your vault locks automatically. Come back and draw your pattern again.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything is encrypted on your iPhone with XChaCha20-Poly1305. Keys are derived from your pattern with Argon2id and tied to a device secret protected by the Secure Enclave.
• Your vaults stay on your phone, work offline and are excluded from iCloud backup. No cloud, no sync.
• No account, email or sign-up. No ads. We don't sell your data.
• The app is covered in the app switcher, and its content hides while the screen is recorded or mirrored.
• The internet is used only to show plans and process purchases through the App Store. Your content, file names and the number of vaults are never sent.

WHAT YOU CAN KEEP
• Private photos and videos
• Notes and text
• Documents, PDFs, audio and other files

Photos, videos and PDFs open in a built-in preview without leaving the app. You choose what goes in with the system picker; the app can't see the rest of your library. After a photo or video is safely saved, you can delete the original, and iOS asks you to confirm.

FREE AND PRO
• Everything is unlocked for the first 7 days, so you can try it at your own pace.
• After that, the free plan includes unlimited text and up to 10 photos per vault.
• Pro unlocks unlimited photos, videos, documents and audio, plus batch import. Choose monthly, yearly or lifetime.
• Limits apply per vault, never to the number of vaults. Anything you've already saved stays readable and exportable, even on the free plan.

PLEASE NOTE
Your pattern is never stored or sent, and no one has a copy of it, not even us. In the widget, your taps stay on the iPhone, encrypted by the system, only until you confirm or the drawing fades. If you forget your pattern, that vault can't be recovered. Vaults stay on the device where they were created; there is no cloud backup or sync.

COUNTLESS VAULTS PRO
Monthly and yearly plans are auto-renewable subscriptions; lifetime is a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://countlessvaults.app/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://countlessvaults.app/support/

name: Court Creep
description:
Mount. Aim. Play. Review.

Set up your iPhone, then get back to your game. Court Creep records court play and sports practice in local video clips so you can review your session afterward without holding the camera.

Choose portrait or landscape, aim with the front or back camera, and select a sport or add your own. Optional Tennis and Pickleball alignment marks and Padel framing instructions help you set the view. Guides stay out of your saved video; custom sports can be recorded without a guide.

Record 1080p video at 30 fps with audio. Choose 1, 3, 5, 10, 15 or 30-minute clips before starting; 5 minutes is recommended. Recording continues across clips until you stop the session or an interruption ends it.

Tap Mark highlight during recording to remember a great rally, a shot to review or any moment you choose. Highlights are timestamped bookmarks, not automatically edited videos. Later, open a highlight to play its clip at that moment, add notes or remove the bookmark while keeping the footage.

An optional paired Apple Watch helps you aim the camera, start recording, mark highlights and check the frame from your wrist. Recording opens a scrollable Quick actions page, with separate Stop and Preview/options pages. Stop asks for confirmation on both devices. Previews start hidden to save battery: Check shows the frame for 10 seconds, and iPhone also offers continuous Show.

Name your sessions and find them by date, sport and highlight count. Each clip thumbnail comes from that clip's midpoint; session artwork uses its first remaining readable clip. Optional clip names make footage easier to identify. Tap the session timeline to jump to clips, use the compact timeline while scrolling, or return to the top. Play and scrub with native video controls. Copy individual clips or a whole session to Photos, or export through the share sheet. Photos access is optional; originals remain in Court Creep.

Open the menu at the top right of Home for Info and Settings. Choose System, Light or Dark appearance on iPhone; System is the default and your choice is saved. The Apple Watch status button is in Home’s camera setup card.

No account, subscription, advertising, analytics or app server. Videos, highlights and notes stay on your iPhone until you choose to copy or share them. Apple Watch and an internet connection are not required for recording and review. Export footage you want to keep before removing the app.

Keep Court Creep open and your iPhone unlocked, with enough battery and storage for your session. Locking, backgrounding or interruptions can stop recording. The app attempts to finish the current clip and keeps completed clips; abrupt termination may lose unfinished footage. Recording does not restart automatically.

Requires iOS 17 or later. The optional Apple Watch companion requires watchOS 10 or later.

name: CourtONN
seller_name: LAICOS BILISIM YAZILIM VE BILGI SISTEMLERI ITHALAT IHRACAT LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
CourtONN is a practice management and hearing preparation platform for lawyers and law firms practicing in Türkiye. This app is your firm account in your pocket: in the courthouse, at the courtroom door and on the move, it shows what you need, clearly and quickly.

TODAY
The day's hearings in time order, like the cause list posted outside the courtroom. Deadlines about to expire sit at the top, each stamped with what is left: due today, due tomorrow, missed. Complete tasks with a single tap.

CASES
Search by case number, court or client name. The case header, parties, next hearing, case history and documents on one screen. Call your client straight from the case.

AFTER THE HEARING
Record the outcome as soon as you leave the courtroom: adjourned or not, the new date, the interim decision. The resulting task and deadline land on your firm's desk right away.

DOCUMENTS AND SCANNING
Scan documents with the camera, receive files from the share menu and attach them to the right case. Documents are kept in your firm's encrypted document vault.

DEADLINE CALCULATOR
Calculate statutory deadlines from the date of service under Turkish procedural law. The calculation uses the same engine as the CourtONN web app and shows the article it relies on next to the result.

NOTIFICATIONS
Deadline and hearing reminders. Client names and case details never appear on the lock screen; the details load when you open the app.

SECURITY
Your session key is stored in the device's secure storage. If a phone is lost, you can sign it out from the devices screen on the web. No ads and no tracking.

WHO IT IS FOR
The app works with an existing CourtONN firm account. Light and dark themes; Turkish, English, German, French and Russian interface.

IMPORTANT
CourtONN does not provide legal advice. Reminders and calculations are there to support the lawyer's own review; always verify the result yourself. The final decision and responsibility remain with the lawyer.

name: Cozy Cup Café: Cafe Tycoon
description:
Open the doors of your very own café and turn it into the coziest spot in town! Brew coffee, steep tea, bake croissants and cakes, blend smoothies and scoop gelato for a stream of hungry customers.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a station to make what your customers order before they run out of patience.
• Customers pay at once, and many sit down and leave a tip on the table.
• Upgrade your stations to sell for more and serve faster.
• Unlock new recipes: coffee, tea, croissants, smoothies, cakes and ice cream.
• Add tables, upgrade the furniture and decorate with plants, rugs, art, a neon sign and more.
• Hire baristas who make orders by themselves and a waiter who collects the tips.

MINI-GAMES
VIP customers want something special. Play a quick mini-game for a big tip:
• Perfect Pour: let go of the milk inside the green band.
• Bean Catch: catch coffee beans and avoid the burnt ones.
• Order Memory: remember the order and repeat it.
• Perfect Bake: stop the needle in the green zone.

FEATURES
• Charming low-poly 3D café with lively customers
• Idle progress: your staff keeps earning while you are away
• Rush Hour and free gifts
• Short, relaxing sessions and play offline
• English and Turkish

Cozy Cup Café is free to play and supported by ads. Optional purchases add coins or remove ads.

name: Cozy Isles: Hashi Bridges
description:
Draw bridges between islands until they are all joined into one. That's Hashi, also called Hashiwokakero or Bridges: a Japanese logic puzzle you learn in a minute and keep playing for months.

HOW IT WORKS
• Each island shows a number: that's how many bridges it needs.
• Bridges run straight, across or up and down, and they never cross.
• Two islands can share one bridge or two, never more.
• When every number is met, all the islands must be linked into one group.
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution, and logic always gets you there. No guessing.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Hundreds of levels, from small 5×5 boards to big 10×14 ones, and they never run out
• An archipelago that grows as you play: finish a chapter and a new island rises from the sea, linked to yours by a bridge
• Island friends to meet: a sea otter pup, a puffin, a sea turtle, a hermit crab, a flamingo, an octopus, a macaw and a seal pup
• A daily puzzle with a streak calendar and a trophy for every full month. Miss a day? One rest day a week keeps your streak.
• Hints that explain themselves: each one shows a bridge and says why it has to be there, or points out one that doesn't belong
• A short tutorial to get you started

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No timers, no lives, no energy
• A free hint every day, and the ones you don't use are kept
• Undo any move or start a board over
• Music and sound effects, each with its own switch. Vibration and animations can be turned off too.
• Plays offline

Cozy Isles is free. Videos play only when you choose to watch one for a reward, never during a puzzle. Shell packs and a one-time Isle Supporter are optional.

name: Crate: Offline Music & Video
description:
Crate plays the music and videos you save. Add supported audio and video files, organize your collection, and pick up where you left off.

• Play supported MP3, 24-bit WAV, and MP4 files offline.
• Browse songs, albums, artists, folders, playlists, and videos.
• Keep separate playback positions in multiple queues.
• Adjust bass, mids, and treble with the three-band equalizer.
• Transfer files from a computer on the same Wi-Fi network.
• Make a complete library backup or export metadata and settings through Files.

name: CreaSquadre
description:
CreaSquadre draws random teams for the end-of-practice scrimmage, and for any game in the gym, and keeps the season standings. The random (but not too random) team generator.

How it works:
• Build your roster: names and numbers by hand, or import them from a file (.sq, .dvw, .json). Add photos if you like.
• In Sfide (matches) tap who is here today and press Sorteggia (draw): the cards shuffle and the court is ready, one team on the left, one on the right, the bench below.
• When the numbers don't split evenly, the app picks at random which team gets one extra player.
• After the game tap the winner: the result goes into the standings.

The standings:
• by points, by win percentage or by index: a weighted score that accounts for attendance, so a player with few games doesn't jump to the top after one lucky win;
• choose the scoring: simple (win and loss) or weighted (full or partial win);
• a PDF sheet with podium, table and match history, ready to print or share.

Also: fair draw turns, rematch with the same teams, a bench that stays when you reshuffle, average strength of each team. Coach several groups? Each team has its own archive and standings.

Everything stays on your device: no account, no ads, no data collected. Works in airplane mode.

The app's interface is in Italian. CreaSquadre is part of the Vertea family.

name: Crentito: Daily Bible Games
description:
Every day, 4 new Bible challenges. Play, keep your streak going and learn the Bible while having fun.

THE 4 DAILY CHALLENGES
• Verse Hunt: read the verse and find the book and chapter. The Bible bookshelf shows you how close you are.
• Cronos: put 5 Bible events in the right order.
• Four by Four: find the 4 hidden groups of 4 words in the grid.
• Parable: guess the person, place or object from the clues.

STREAK AND LEADERBOARD
Play every day to grow your streak. Score up to 40 points a day, climb the weekly leaderboard and replay past days.

DUELS
Challenge your friends with Bible questions, one on one, at your own pace.

BIBLE READING TOGETHER
Join your church's, small group's or family's reading plan, check off today's reading and see who has already read.

TOGETHER
Games to play as a group: Spectrum and Radar online, each person on their own phone, plus Impostor, Charades, Forbidden Words and Fruit Salad with just one phone.

WIDGETS
See your streak, today's challenges and today's reading right on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

APPLE WATCH
Play the 4 daily challenges on your watch and follow your streak and today's reading in complications.

CRENTITO BRO
Playing is free. Anyone who wants to support the project can become a Crentito Bro (or Sis): no ads, a gold tag on your photo, a Rest Day for your streak, 7 lives in Duels and themes in Together. Leaderboards and points are the same for everyone.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Crentito Bro (monthly or yearly) and Verified Leader (yearly) are optional auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and the subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://crentito.com/en/termos/
Privacy: https://crentito.com/en/privacidade/

Bible verses from the King James Version (public domain).

name: Cribbo
description:
Cribbo is a simple, private fridge, freezer, and pantry expiry tracker built to help you use groceries before they spoil.

Stop discovering forgotten vegetables, dairy, or leftovers at the back of the fridge. Add items in under 10 seconds and let Cribbo give you one calm daily reminder before they reach their expiry date.

KEY FEATURES
• Quick Add in Under 10 Seconds: Enter a food name, tap +3 days, +1 week, +1 month, or choose a custom expiry date. Scan barcodes to fill product names automatically via Open Food Facts, or enter items manually offline.
• Expiring Soon Dashboard: See your kitchen at a glance grouped into Expired, Today, This week, and Later, with color-coded freshness rings on every card.
• Smart Daily Alerts: Receive one combined summary notification 2 days before and on the expiry date at your preferred time — never noisy spam.
• Storage Spots & Freezing: Organize food across Fridge, Freezer, Pantry, or custom storage spots. Move an item to the freezer with one tap to update its expiry date.
• Money Saved & Waste Stats: Mark items as Used or Wasted to track real monthly totals of money saved, money wasted, and your waste rate.
• Kitchen Shopping List: Automatically add finished groceries to your shopping list, check items off as you shop, and share your list using the system share sheet.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline with no account, no subscription, and no tracking.
• All food items, photos, and history stay on your device.
• Export your full kitchen data as JSON or delete all data anytime in Settings.

NOTE ON FOOD SAFETY
Expiry dates in Cribbo are entered by you. Cribbo is a reminder tool and does not judge food safety. Always inspect food before eating.

name: Crônicas: Personagens Bíblicos
seller_name: OUTIN SOLUCOES EM PROCESSAMENTO DE DADOS LTDA
description:
Converse com quem já passou por isso.

Medo do que vem pela frente, a vontade de recomeçar depois de um erro, conflito na família, aperto no dinheiro, a saudade de quem partiu, a fé abalada. A Bíblia está cheia de gente que passou por algo parecido. No Crônicas, você conversa com esses personagens no momento em que viveram: eles contam o que passaram e o que está escrito, com a referência bíblica para você abrir na sua Bíblia.

PARA O SEU DIA A DIA
• Errou e quer recomeçar: Pedro prometeu fidelidade, negou três vezes e foi restaurado à beira do mar (Lucas 22; João 21).
• Medo, ansiedade e culpa: Davi teve medo na fuga e carregou o peso de um erro grave (1 Samuel 21; Salmo 51).
• Pressão e coragem: Ester precisou decidir se entraria sem ser chamada diante do rei (Ester 4).
• Família, injustiça e dinheiro: José do Egito foi vendido pelos irmãos, preso sem culpa e, nos anos de fartura, guardou trigo para os anos de fome (Gênesis 37 a 41).
• Perda e recomeço: Maria Madalena chorou junto ao túmulo, de madrugada (João 20).
• Luto e fé com medo: Rute e Noemi atravessaram o luto juntas; Moisés perguntou "quem sou eu?" antes de aceitar o chamado (Rute 1; Êxodo 3 e 4).

O personagem não decide por você nem promete resultado: a proposta é contar o que viveu, mostrar o que está escrito e devolver uma pergunta para você pensar. O Crônicas não substitui a sua igreja, o seu pastor nem a ajuda de um profissional.

ESTUDO BÍBLICO POR DENTRO DAS HISTÓRIAS
Escolha um personagem, entre em um momento da vida dele e faça as suas perguntas: como foi deixar as redes no mar da Galileia, enfrentar Golias ou guardar trigo para sete anos de fome. Quando a resposta se apoia em uma passagem, a referência aparece logo abaixo, no rodapé "Baseado em".

PERSONAGENS DO ANTIGO E DO NOVO TESTAMENTO
Cerca de 50 personagens bíblicos: Abraão, Moisés, Rute, Davi, Ester, Elias, Daniel, José do Egito, Maria (mãe de Jesus), Maria Madalena, João Batista, Pedro, João, Paulo, os doze apóstolos e muitos outros.

O MESMO PERSONAGEM EM CADA FASE DA VIDA
Pedro pescador, discípulo, na Paixão, depois da Ressurreição e na igreja primitiva. Em cada momento histórico, o personagem fala a partir do que viveu até ali, e isso ajuda a ler cada passagem no seu contexto.

JORNADAS DE 7 DIAS
Jornadas guiadas, uma etapa por dia: uma abertura que situa a cena, perguntas sugeridas e uma conversa com o personagem. Comece por "7 dias com Pedro", do chamado na Galileia à igreja primitiva. Um complemento para o seu devocional.

PARA GRUPOS, CÉLULAS E ESCOLA BÍBLICA
Façam a mesma jornada na mesma semana e levem as perguntas para o encontro da célula, a escola bíblica dominical ou o discipulado.

SUA CRÔNICA
Uma área pessoal com as conversas para retomar, os personagens e eventos descobertos e os dias seguidos de estudo.

COMECE POR AQUI
Abra o app e explore personagens e jornadas na hora, sem cadastro, e veja uma conversa de exemplo. Pedro, Davi, Ester, José do Egito e Maria Madalena já estão abertos para conversar, junto com a jornada "7 dias com Pedro", com um limite diário e mensal de mensagens. Para conversar, é só informar seu nome e confirmar o celular com um código por SMS, sem senha.

APOIE O PROJETO
Se o Crônicas fizer sentido para você, contribua com o projeto. A contribuição mensal mantém o conteúdo e a tecnologia e libera todos os personagens, momentos e jornadas, como Moisés, Rute e Elias. É uma assinatura mensal com renovação automática, cobrada na sua conta Apple na confirmação da compra. A renovação acontece a cada mês, a menos que seja desativada pelo menos 24 horas antes do fim do período. Gerencie ou cancele quando quiser em Ajustes > [seu nome] > Assinaturas.

TRANSPARÊNCIA
As conversas são dramatizações para estudo, não o personagem real. Se algo parecer errado, toque em "Algo errado?" abaixo da fala. O Crônicas não substitui a leitura da Bíblia: a proposta é levar você de volta ao texto bíblico.

Termos de uso: https://www.cronicasapp.com.br/termos

name: Cronora
description:
Cronora è l'assistente di turno per chi guida per lavoro: camion, bus e pullman, auto e van NCC.

TACHIGRAFO IN TASCA
• Guida, Lavoro e Pausa cambiano da soli con il GPS: quando parti è Guida, quando ti fermi è Lavoro, la pausa la scegli con un tocco.
• Disco della velocità che gira come un vero tachigrafo, con i picchi orari e l'allarme oltre i 100 km/h per i bus e gli 80 km/h per i camion.
• Strumenti per la guida continua e la guida di oggi, con zone verde, gialla e rossa.
• Pannello dei limiti: guida settimanale e di due settimane, giornate da 10 ore, riposi ridotti, ore da recuperare, prossima pausa e prossimo riposo (Reg. CE 561/2006).
• Avvisi prima delle scadenze, anche a schermo spento.

ORE E PAGA
• Inizio e fine turno con un tocco, km contati dal GPS.
• Straordinari, notturni, festivi e paga netta stimata in tempo reale, partendo dal tuo netto mensile.
• Ti sei dimenticato di iniziare o finire? Correggi o aggiungi il turno in pochi secondi.

RIEPILOGO AL DATORE
• Una volta al mese invii il riepilogo via WhatsApp, email o SMS, con PDF e percorso GPS facoltativo.
• Spunte di lettura: vedi quando il datore apre il riepilogo e ne conferma la presa visione.

PRIVACY
• Turni, posizioni e velocità restano sul tuo telefono. Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento.
• Disponibile in 9 lingue: italiano, inglese, tedesco, francese, spagnolo, portoghese, polacco, rumeno, olandese.

IMPORTANTE: Cronora non è un tachigrafo omologato e non sostituisce il tachigrafo del veicolo né la carta del conducente. È un aiuto per tenere sotto controllo la tua attività; per i controlli vale solo il tachigrafo ufficiale. Non usare il telefono con le mani mentre guidi.

name: Crumb: Daily Fortune Cookie
description:
A fortune cookie made just for you. Crack it, read the line inside, and take a small moment for yourself.

Crumb is a little ritual: a hand-modelled 3D cookie that you crack with a tap, a shake or a pinch, and a short line chosen from your own answers and today's mood. Keep the ones you love in your jar, share them as a card, and come back for the next one.

YOUR COOKIE
• One free cookie a week, or one every day with Crumb Plus, ready at the time you choose
• Crack it with a tap, a shake or a pinch, with sound and haptics
• Inside: a short line, a lucky number, a lucky color and one tiny action for the day
• An optional one-tap mood check-in keeps hard days gentle

YOUR JAR
• Every line you open is kept in your jar
• Mark favorites, search and look back
• Share a line as a card for stories and messages

MORE WAYS TO CRACK ONE
• Question Cookie: ask what is on your mind and crack an answer to think about
• Journeys: themed series of 7 to 21 days
• A cookie for two: each person gets half a line, and you complete it together
• Send a cookie to a friend with your own message inside
• Home screen and lock screen widgets

PRIVACY
• No account needed; everything stays on your device
• Sign in with Apple only if you want your jar on more than one device
• No ads and no tracking

One cookie a week is free, along with one Question Cookie a week, your first Journey and one pair. Crumb Plus is an optional paid subscription. It adds a cookie every day, unlimited Question Cookies, an evening cookie, every cookie shell, your whole jar with its calendar and monthly recap, every Journey, the Year Cookie and five pairs.

Crumb Plus is available as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://canknbr.github.io/crumb-legal/privacy.html

Crumb is for entertainment and inspiration only. Its lines are prompts for reflection, not predictions or advice.

name: CrystalChorus--Cave chord run
description:
Laskeudu luolaan, jossa kiteet pitävät aikaa yllä.

Seuraa, kuinka jokainen hiljainen syke kulkee rivin läpi, ja toista sama järjestys tarkoin ajoitetuin tauoin. Viimeistele syvyys vaihtamalla kristallipintoja, kunnes sävelsointu asettuu kohdalleen.

Etene kahdentoista syvyystason läpi, avaa harvinaisia kristallilajeja ja harjoittele resonanssia säätösalissa, jossa energia siirtyy viereisiin kiteisiin ja vähitellen vaimenee. Täydellinen ajoitus vahvistaa jälkikaikua, kun taas väärään aikaan tehdyt painallukset kutsuvat kuuntelemaan uudelleen.

FacetChorus on keskittynyt rytmipulmapeli elävässä luolassa – yhdistelmä järjestystä, ajoitusta ja sointujen muistamista rauhallisessa pelikokemuksessa.

name: Cube: Scan & Solve
description:
Scan your puzzle, review its colors, and follow a solution one move at a time.

Support for 2×2, 3×3, 4×4, Pyraminx and Skewb. Choose individual face photos or the two-photo workflow where offered. Edit sticker colors and retake photos before solving.

Practice moves with interactive puzzle views, explore guided training and algorithms, or time your solves.

Image color reading and puzzle solving run on your device. No account is required.

name: Cubora
description:
Το Cubora είναι ένα εργαστηριακό εργαλείο για κύβους σκυροδέματος στο εργοτάξιο.

Τι κάνει
Καταγράφει την παρτίδα χύτευσης, τους κύβους, τα ορόσημα συντήρησης (1 / 3 / 7 / 28 ημέρες) και τις δοκιμές θλίψης. Από το φορτίο αιχμής (kN) και την πλευρά (mm) υπολογίζει την αντοχή σε MPa και την συγκρίνει με τον στόχο της κατηγορίας (π.χ. C25/30, C30/37): Αποδεκτό, Οριακό ή Απόρριψη.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείτε

Παρτίδες — νέα χύτευση: εργοτάξιο, κατηγορία, στόχος MPa, ημερομηνία.
Κύβοι — ετικέτα, καλούπι, πλευρά (συνήθως 150 mm). Το ημερολόγιο 1/3/7/28 δημιουργείται μόνο του.
Επισκόπηση — δείτε ληξιπρόθεσμα και προσεχή· πατήστε έναν κύβο για να ανοίξει.
Δοκιμές — ηλικία και φορτίο kN. Η αντοχή και η κρίση εμφανίζονται αμέσως.
Ευρήματα — συμμόρφωση, μέση αντοχή, εύρος· κοινοποιήστε περίληψη εργαστηρίου.
Τα δεδομένα μένουν στη συσκευή. Δεν χρειάζεται λογαριασμός ούτε δίκτυο. Στην επάνω δεξιά γωνία της Επισκόπησης μπορείτε να στείλετε παρατηρήσεις.

name: Cucinella
description:
Cucinella transforma o seu robô de cozinha em um chef que fala com você.

São mais de 1.000 receitas guiadas passo a passo, cada uma com o tempo, a temperatura e a velocidade de cada etapa. É só seguir a tela: o Cucinella diz o que colocar, quando ligar e quanto esperar, com cronômetro em cada passo.

RECEITAS PARA TODO DIA
• Risotos, massas, molhos, sopas e cremes, carnes, peixes, pães, sobremesas, geleias, bebidas e muito mais
• Receitas inspiradas nos grandes clássicos da cozinha e adaptadas para o robô
• Filtros por dieta: vegetariano, vegano, sem glúten e sem lactose
• Favoritos para encontrar rápido o que você mais gosta

FEITO PARA A SUA COZINHA
• Medidas no sistema métrico ou imperial, como você preferir
• Calculadora culinária para converter gramas, xícaras, onças e colheres
• Lista de compras que soma os ingredientes de várias receitas e se copia pronta para o WhatsApp
• Despensa básica para montar a lista de uma vez
• Funciona offline: as receitas ficam no aparelho
• Em português, inglês, espanhol, italiano, francês e alemão

COMPATÍVEL COM A MAIORIA DOS ROBÔS DE COZINHA
As receitas indicam tempo, temperatura e velocidade em valores padrão, que funcionam nos principais robôs multifuncionais do mercado.

CUCINELLA COMPLETO (ASSINATURA)
O plano gratuito já traz centenas de receitas. A assinatura libera todas as receitas premium e o assistente de cozinha por voz, que tira dúvidas enquanto você cozinha. Planos mensal e anual, com renovação automática; cancele quando quiser nas configurações da sua conta da App Store.

ESCOLA CUCINELLA
Cursos completos de vinho (Sommelier Essencial, Introdução à Enologia e Harmonização e Gastronomia), vendidos à parte, em compra única: o curso é seu para sempre.

Termos de uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacidade: https://lab.4dview.com.br/cucinella/privacidade.html

name: Cue Desk
description:
One chicken, two counts: six then seven. Tap to start after Warming up the gloves. Skip or Next through the lesson, then Let's cluck. The Play readout is CLUCKS. A frenzy hits x6.7 with MAX. Helpers keep swinging when the thumb rests.

Shop is upgrades, helpers, boosts and skins. Worlds have a bonus or a level gate. Daily gift: claim it or come back tomorrow. The 67 Beat unlocks at a level; afterward tracks, home, play again, best and stars. Album: tap to open a sticker chest, later, opening, page complete.

Me is the coop: trophies, worlds, rebirth, records. Lucky egg can wait with Not now. A level-up says Keep clucking. Reset progress asks Reset or Keep playing. How to play replays the two intro cards. No account. It stays on this iPhone.

name: Cuplore
description:
咖啡日记（Cuplore）是一本陪你记录每一包豆子与每一杯咖啡的纯本机手账。

主要功能：
• 豆仓与赏味期管理：录入咖啡豆、咖啡粉、挂耳、胶囊或速溶；自动跟踪养豆期、赏味期与剩余克数，每记一杯自动扣减库存。
• 拍袋与订单图本机识别：对着包装袋拍照，或导入电商订单截图与口令，系统端侧 Vision 离线提取豆名、烘焙商、产区与克重，并自动抠出豆袋贴纸。
• 每一杯的纸面手账：记下冲煮方式、饮品、评分与随手拍；在日历热力图、票根与月度账单里回顾这个月喝过的风味。
• 咖啡店地图与探店档案：记录去过的咖啡店与想去清单，搜索附近门店并查看探店记录。
• 发现好豆与咖啡笔记：按你的口味偏好浏览精选豆卡，闲暇时翻一页轻量的咖啡知识笔记。
• 像递出一袋豆子一样分享：把喜欢的豆子打包成 .coffeebean 卡片或把咖啡店打包成 .coffeecafe 发给朋友，对方点开即可收藏。
• 主屏小组件：在桌面直接查看今日最该先喝的那支豆子，点一下记一杯。

纯本机，保护隐私：
你的豆仓、冲煮记录、探店笔记与照片只保存在你自己的 iPhone 与 iPad 上。无需注册账号，不上传个人数据，支持随时导出 JSON 全量备份与无损恢复。

name: CW Socials
description:
CW Socials is the app for CageWatchr's in-person socials: relaxed meet-ups for the community. Keyholders, the locked, the curious and partners are all welcome. You don't need a cage, an app or any checks to come along.

Find a social
• Every upcoming social in one list, with clear dates, times and venues
• Follow your city and hear when a new social is announced
• See how far away each venue is, worked out on your phone

Say you're going
• Going, Interested or Not going in one tap
• Reminders the day before and on the morning
• Add a social, or a calendar of every social, to your phone's calendar

Walk in already knowing a face
• Who's going shows the door names and photos of people who choose to be seen
• Add an optional face photo and a short bio. Each one is checked before anyone sees it
• Your real name is never shown to other guests

Your CW Socials card
• One membership card in Apple Wallet with your door name, photo and next social
• A membership QR that hosts scan to check you in at any social
• Tap I'm here at the venue to check yourself in

Stay in touch afterwards
• Connect with people you've met to swap WhatsApp or Telegram, only when both of you agree
• Join a social's Telegram chat in one tap

Safe by design
• Report or block anyone, any time
• Choose who sees your photo, and whether you appear at all
• Your location stays on your phone and is never sent to us

For hosts
• Door list with photos, check-in by name or QR, walk-ins and offline check-ins
• Send updates, edit times and venues, and get a daily summary

CW Socials is for adults aged 18 and over.

name: CyberSnap
description:
The CyberSnap app is a companion for existing CyberSnap customers. It mirrors the monitoring of your CyberSnap protection, in the cloud or on-premises, and lets you take basic actions from your phone.

Important: the app does not work on its own. You first need a CyberSnap account with protection already set up (assets connected and policies created) in the CyberSnap web portal or in your on-premises CyberSnap system. The app then shows that protection and lets you act on it.

• Instant alerts: a push notification the moment a serious threat is found.
• Clear status: see at a glance whether you are protected, what needs attention, and why.
• Clean vs infected snapshots: find the last clean point for every server.
• Act fast: run or pause a scan and start recovery to the cleanest snapshot.
• Ask AI: get a plain-language explanation of any finding and what to do next.
• Cloud and on-premises in one view.
• Face ID lock keeps your security dashboard private.
• Lock screen and Dynamic Island: a live banner follows an attack as it happens.
• Widgets for the home and lock screen show your protection status at a glance.
• Apple Watch: status on your wrist, alerts with action buttons, and watch-face complications.
• Siri and Shortcuts: "What's my CyberSnap status?"

Sign in with your existing CyberSnap account (email, Apple or GitHub). Not a customer yet? Tap "Try the demo" to see the app with sample data, and visit cybersnap.io to get started.

name: Czech Driving Test 2027
description:
Czech driving theory test 2027: every current exam question from the Ministry of Transport bulletin (Věstník dopravy) for categories A, B, C and D, with pictures, traffic situation videos and a mock exam that follows the real rules.

This is an unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent the Czech Ministry of Transport, municipal authorities or any other government body. Questions come from the public exam tests of the Ministry of Transport (eTesty, Věstník dopravy): https://etesty.md.gov.cz/ro/Bulletin

The exam in the Czech Republic is taken in Czech, so the whole app is in Czech, questions and menus alike, just like the exam. This page is in English only for convenience.

AN EXAM LIKE THE REAL ONE
• 25 questions in the same mix: 10 on traffic rules, 4 on safe driving, 3 on signs, 3 traffic situations, 2 on vehicle requirements, 2 on related regulations and 1 on first aid
• Questions worth 1, 2 or 4 points, 50 in total; pass mark 43
• 30 minutes; skip questions and come back to them

EVERY QUESTION
• 1136 current questions from the bulletin (updated 8 October 2026)
• For category B, only the questions that apply to it
• Pictures, signs and traffic situation videos from the official tests, including the new dynamic questions

LEARN WITHOUT STRESS
• Questions you got wrong come back until they stick
• "Hard for you" — the questions you miss most often
• Search — find any question by a word or code and see the answer straight away

OFFLINE, NO ADS
• Questions and pictures are on your phone; videos download with one tap
• No sign-up, no ads, no analytics

Free: 10 questions in every section and one mock exam a day. Full access is a one-time purchase with no auto-renewal: 7 days, 30 days or lifetime.

The app is meant for self-study and information only. It does not replace driving school or the road traffic regulations.

name: Dab Card
description:
Dab Card is a mixing table for three shut cans: madder, lemon, and cobalt.

Slide a lid aside to open a can, then drag the knife into the open mouth. Each drop is one scoop, and a can holds six. When two colors have a scoop, the table shows the mixed puddle. The phone adds the scoops, names the leading color, and mixes a weighted color from the three paints.

Open the puddle to name the dab. Read the count for the total and for each pigment. Press the blank card up into the puddle to keep it. The card hangs on the nail with its name, formula, and the time it was pressed.

Nothing leaves this iPhone. There is no account, no upload, and no share sheet. A mix that has not been pressed stays only on the table.

name: Dabtly Food – Se faire livrer
description:
Dabtly Food : les snacks et restaurants de votre ville, au même endroit.

TOUS LES SNACKS ET RESTAURANTS DANS UNE APPLICATION
Tacos, pizza, panini, burger, pasticcio… Choisissez votre ville et parcourez les menus avec photos et prix.

LIVRÉ CHEZ VOUS
Commandez en quelques secondes : votre prénom, votre numéro et votre adresse, et le livreur vous apporte la commande. Ou passez la récupérer.

PAIEMENT À LA LIVRAISON
Sans compte, sans carte bancaire, sans inscription.

SUIVEZ VOTRE COMMANDE EN DIRECT
En préparation, prête, en route… Vous savez à tout moment où en est votre commande, et vous pouvez appeler le livreur ou le snack.

RECOMMANDEZ EN UN APPUI
L'application retient votre ville, votre dernière commande et vos coordonnées.

CARTES DE FIDÉLITÉ
Chez les snacks et restaurants participants : un tampon par commande et un cadeau quand la carte est pleine.

De nouvelles villes arrivent régulièrement.
Vous avez un snack ou un restaurant ? Rejoignez Dabtly Food : WhatsApp 06 52 93 37 50

name: Daily Kanji: JLPT Words
description:
Daily Kanji teaches Japanese kanji the way you meet them in real life: inside words.

Every card is a whole word, like 旅行, 行く or 新しい, with its reading, its meaning and a natural example sentence. Every word and every sentence is read aloud by a natural Japanese voice, so you learn how it sounds as well as how it looks.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose one or more JLPT levels, N5 to N1.
• New words come from your levels, most common first, so you learn what you will actually see and hear.
• Flashcards use spaced repetition. Tap Again, Good or Easy at any time, even before flipping the card, and the app schedules the next review for you.
• Furigana whenever you want it, and hidden when you want to test yourself.

HEAR IT
• Tap the speaker to hear the word, and again for the example sentence.
• Open any kanji to see its on'yomi and kun'yomi readings. Tap a reading to hear it, and tap a word below it to jump to that word in the Library.
• Voice recorded in advance and stored in the app, so it works with no internet.

WORDS THAT MIX KANJI AND KANA
Not just 銀行 and 学校. The deck includes words like 食べる, 好き and 美しい, the way Japanese is really written.

LIBRARY
• Browse all words by level, search by word, reading or meaning, and sort your way.
• See at a glance how many words you are Reviewing, have Mastered, or have not started (New), and tap to filter.
• Add any word to your deck with one tap.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN AND HOME SCREEN
Add the Daily Kanji widget in small, medium and lock screen sizes: the word on its own, or the word with an example sentence. The word changes on the schedule you choose.

IN THE DYNAMIC ISLAND (PRO)
• Streak saver: in the evening, see the time left to keep your streak, with one gentle reminder at 8 pm.
• Mastered moment: a short celebration when a word becomes Mastered.
• Both also appear on the lock screen, and each one can be turned off in Settings.

BUILT TO FEEL GOOD
• Soft pastel design with real Japanese typography.
• A gentle ding and a small vibration when you grade a card (you can turn this off).
• Optional daily reminder with the word of the day.
• Text follows your iPhone's text size.
• Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• About 7,800 words across N5 to N1, each with a reading, a meaning, an example sentence and recorded audio.
• About 2,000 kanji with readings, meanings and audio for each reading.
• Words ranked from most to least common, so a very common N3 word comes before a rare N5 word if you study both.

DAILY KANJI PRO
Free: 5 new cards a day, plus the whole Library. Pro unlocks unlimited cards, the home and lock screen widgets, and the Dynamic Island streak saver and Mastered moment.
Pro is 150 baht a month, or 900 baht a year (save 50%) with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. The trial converts to 900 baht a year, charged to your Apple ID at the end of the trial unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.dailykanji.ink/privacy

The JLPT (Japanese-Language Proficiency Test) is run by the Japan Foundation and Japan Educational Exchanges and Services. Daily Kanji is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Levels are estimates, because no official word list exists.

Dictionary data from JMdict and KANJIDIC2 © the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group, CC BY-SA 4.0. Voice recordings are synthesized.

name: Daily Reps: Simple Workout Log
description:
A simple workout log for your daily reps, sets, and timed exercises.
