Save your exercises, swipe to log a set, and see your workout take shape. Track repetitions, durations, optional weights, and target sets with a clear daily view.

Included free:
• Up to five saved exercises
• The latest 30 calendar days of history
• Week, month, and recent custom-range stats
• Weekday exercise schedules
• Completed-workout recaps
• Six workout sharing designs

Upgrade once to Daily Reps Pro for unlimited exercises, full stored history, longer-range stats, extra accent colors, and alternate app icons.

No account. No ads. No subscription. Workout data stays on your device unless you choose to share it. Device backups may be managed by Apple.

Older workout data is retained when free access limits what you can browse.

name: Dart Tracker: Scoreboard & 501
description:
Dart Tracker is a darts scoreboard and practice log in one. Keep score with a tap, write down what you noticed, and see your progress on a chart.

KEEP SCORE
- Count-Up, X01 (301, 501 and more) and Cricket: tap the board to score every dart
- X01 shows checkout suggestions
- Play with friends. Scores go straight into that day's log

PRACTICE LOG
- Note how it felt and what you noticed, in a line or two
- Add one thing to focus on next time. When you write your next note, you check in: did it work?
- Save your league or bar stats too (rating, PPD, MPR)

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
- See your Count-Up average and rating over time
- See which way you miss the bull, how often you hit your focus, and how many hat tricks, ton 80s and more you've thrown

MY DARTS
- Save your barrel, shaft, flight and tip. Changes are logged automatically

PREMIUM
- Before/after stats when you change darts, your miss pattern, practice drills and monthly/yearly stats. Removes ads
- Choose monthly, yearly or a one-time purchase. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial
- Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period. Cancel in your account settings at least 24 hours before renewal. Cancel during the trial and you won't be charged

YOUR DATA
- Notes and scores are stored only on your device. No sign-in needed

TERMS & PRIVACY
- Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Terms of Service: https://dart-tracker-app.web.app/en/terms/
- Privacy Policy: https://dart-tracker-app.web.app/en/privacy/
- Support: https://dart-tracker-app.web.app/en/

By elle.dev

name: Data Payload Workbench
description: Data Payload Workbench is a focused studio for working with structured data on iPhone and iPad. Open the editor to format, validate, and inspect JSON, XML, and YAML with syntax highlighting and adjustable indentation. Generate realistic test payloads from examples, JSON Schema, field lists, or your own templates, with optional batch counts and reproducible seeds. Compare two documents line by line or with a structured tree diff that highlights paths and summaries so you can spot drift quickly. Save work in a local library, organize templates, and export results when you are ready to share. The Tools area includes a JSON Path explorer on the current document, Base64 encode and decode, and CSV helpers for quick conversions during API and integration work. Settings let you tune validation debounce, compare defaults, and appearance without leaving the flow. Designed for developers, QA engineers, and technical writers who need dependable payload editing away from a desktop IDE.

name: DataTap: Custom Forms
description:
DataTap lets you collect data on your iPhone or iPad and send it directly to your API using configurable forms. Use it for inspections, inventory, field reports, and other workflows where your team already has an API.

Import a profile from a .datatap file, an HTTPS link, or a QR code. Each profile defines the fields, destination, and authentication required by the API. Review the destination before confirming the import.

Forms support text, numbers, dates, choices, and photos. Scan QR codes and barcodes to fill text fields, or attach photos to a record. DataTap confirms when the destination accepts a submission.

DataTap is free and requires no DataTap account. To submit records, use a compatible profile and a reachable HTTPS API. The interface is available in English and Spanish.

name: Dawn Chorus Lab
description:
Learn to pick out bird calls in real field recordings. Dawn Chorus Lab gives you 18 five-minute listening exercises from Powdermill Nature Reserve in Pennsylvania, recorded across four mornings.

Choose a lesson by date or focus species. Set and loop a listening interval, then mark calls as you hear them. When you’re ready, reveal the researchers’ annotations and replay individual calls. Keep uncertain observations as notes and compare repeat attempts in your notebook.

Export observations as CSV or save a JSON backup to restore later. The lessons and recordings are included with the app and work offline. No account or purchase is required.

name: Dayem: Digital Loyalty Card
description:
Dayem turns your paper punch card into a digital stamp card in one minute, and gives your customers one place for all their loyalty cards.
Customers show a QR code, you scan it, and the stamp lands on their phone in a second.

A simple loyalty program for coffee shops, restaurants, bakeries, barbers, salons, car washes and every small business that wants its regulars back.

For shops
• Create your stamp card in a minute from a ready template for your trade: café, restaurant, bakery, sweets, barber, beauty salon, car wash, laundry, gym, pharmacy and more.
• Or photograph your paper card or logo, and your card is filled in automatically: title, reward, number of stamps and colours.
• Give every new customer a welcome gift stamp.
• Scan the customer's code to add a stamp or give the reward. Undo in one tap, with a warning if the same customer is stamped again too soon.
• Busy counter? Show a stamp code and let the customer scan your screen.
• Points cards by amount spent (Pro).
• Print an A4 QR poster for your counter and share your card link on WhatsApp and Instagram. Customers scan it with their phone camera.
• Customer list with search and filters: new, close to a reward, not seen in 3 weeks.
• Insights: visits per day, new customers, rewards used, returning customers, and the regulars you are losing, with a win-back offer button.
• Send offers as notifications to all customers or a chosen group (Pro).
• Your team scans from their own phones, as staff or manager.
• Several shops in one account, and CSV export of your customers (Pro).

For customers
• All your loyalty cards in one place. No sign-up, no password.
• Your personal QR code changes every 30 seconds, so a screenshot is useless to anyone else.
• Watch each stamp land with a small celebration and see how close your reward is.
• Offers from your shops arrive as notifications.
• Find shops that use Dayem by name or city.
• New phone? Bring your cards back with your recovery key or a transfer QR code.

Plans for shops
• Free: 1 card, up to 100 customers, 1 scanning phone.
• Pro: unlimited customers, up to 3 cards including points cards, 3 scanning phones, 4 offers a month, a poster without the Dayem mark, customer export.
• Business: everything in Pro, up to 10 cards, 25 scanning phones, 30 offers a month, priority support.
Monthly or yearly subscriptions, with the first month free for new subscribers. Always free for customers. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your store account settings.

In Arabic and English, with light and dark mode.

Terms of use: https://mahmoudhssn.com/dayem/en/terms/
Privacy policy: https://mahmoudhssn.com/dayem/en/privacy/

name: Dayroute: Route Planner
description:
Dayroute is a route planner for small field crews: lawn care, pool service, cleaning, pest control and window washing.

Add each customer once with their day and how often you go. Every morning Dayroute lines up the day's stops in a short order, opens each stop in Apple Maps, and lets you send an "on my way" text with one tap.

- Customers set up once: weekly, every 2 weeks, monthly or one-time
- Today and Week views with the stops in order
- Optional shop address so the route loops back to the shop
- Done, skipped and earned tracked for each day
- Your stops and routes stay on your iPhone. No account to make

Drive times are estimates based on straight-line distance, and are labeled that way in the app.

Dayroute Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription that renews automatically; yearly starts with a free trial.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://dayroute.coldpress.dev/privacy

name: Days Ahead: Countdown Cards
description:
Save the dates you care about: exams, deadlines, trips and anniversaries. Open DayCount to see how many days are left or how many have passed.

• Count down to a date or count up from a day you want to remember.
• See a date on the small Home Screen widget. It follows your first card, or you can choose another.
• Turn on a same-day reminder for 9 a.m. local time.
• Share a countdown image or send a .datecard file or import code so friends can add the same date.

Pro includes up to three pins, early reminders and batch export. Try Pro for 30 days from your first launch, then unlock it with one purchase. Your dates, existing pins and reminders stay available when the trial ends. There is no subscription or automatic charge.

Dates and settings stay on your device. No account, ads or analytics.

name: Days that count
description:
A won day is a day you did what you promised yourself.

Days that count keeps you going: pick your daily tasks, check them off, and watch your streak grow. A flame counts your days in a row, like in language apps, but for your own life.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
· Pick your tasks: reading, walking, water, prayer, gratitude, or your own
· Repeat them daily, on chosen weekdays, every few days or monthly
· Raise a target each time a task comes back (e.g. 10 pages, then 15, then 20)
· Add a task just for today or for a specific date
· Take a progress photo and jot down your thoughts of the day

A FAIR STREAK
· A day with nothing scheduled is a rest day: it doesn't break your streak
· A monthly calendar shows your won days and what you did each day
· A celebration for every won day, and a reward at 7, 30 and 100-day milestones

APPLE HEALTH AND CALENDAR
· Your steps and workouts check off your tasks automatically
· Your tasks and won days can be added to the calendar of your choice

MAKE IT YOURS
· Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your day's progress and steps
· Dark mode and 7 accent colors
· English, French and Spanish
· iPhone and iPad

Your data stays on your device. No account, no ads.

name: DCalculatorPlus
description:
DCalculator – Private Calculator Vault

Keep your personal photos, videos, notes, and contacts protected inside a discreet calculator interface.

DCalculator combines a functional calculator with a private encrypted vault, protected by your master passcode and optional biometric authentication.

Features:
- Private Photos & Videos
- Secure Notes
- Confidential Contacts
- Encrypted Storage
- Master Passcode Protection
- Face ID / Touch ID Support

100% Free. No Ads. No Subscriptions.

name: dCode: Cipher Solver & Decoder
description:
Cipherloom brings a fast collection of cipher, code and puzzle-solving tools to your phone. Paste a coded message, choose a decoder, and copy or share the result in seconds. No account required.

START SOLVING FOR FREE
Use Caesar with a chosen shift, Morse code and ROT13. Encode your own messages or decode escape-room clues, geocaching puzzles and secret notes. Supported transformations run locally and work offline after installation.

UNLOCK CIPHERLOOM LIFETIME PRO
One purchase unlocks:
• All 26 Caesar shift candidates
• Atbash and A1Z26 letter-number conversion
• Base64, hexadecimal and binary UTF-8 text conversion
• Vigenère with an explicit alphabetic key
• Rail Fence and Affine ciphers
• Lightweight possible-format suggestions
• Letter-frequency analysis and index of coincidence
• Up to 50 saved solving sessions stored on your device

Clear tool explanations, examples and recoverable validation errors help you use the right alphabet, separators and keys. Format suggestions are heuristics. Cipherloom does not promise to identify every cipher or automatically crack an unknown key. Classical puzzle ciphers are not secure modern encryption.

LIFETIME PRO
$6.99 USD base price, paid once. The actual localized price and any applicable taxes are shown by your app store before purchase. This is a non-consumable unlock with no subscription, trial or recurring renewal. Restore Purchases is available in Pro. Apple and Google purchases are separate.

Independently developed by Starter Studio, Inc. Not affiliated with or endorsed by dCode.fr.

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Cipherloom Terms: https://dcodecipher.netlify.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://dcodecipher.netlify.app/privacy
Support: https://dcodecipher.netlify.app/support

name: Dealrax
description:
Dealrax is a community of shoppers sharing the best deals, coupons and promo codes. Every deal is posted, voted on and discussed by real people, so the best prices rise to the top and expired offers don't.

HOT DEALS, RANKED BY THE COMMUNITY
• Browse deals by category, or sort them by hottest, newest or top rated
• Upvote great finds and comment to share tips
• See price checks and a quick verdict on whether a deal is worth it
• Save deals to come back to later

LIGHTNING DEALS & BEST SELLERS
• Time-limited Lightning Deals with live countdowns
• Best Sellers lists so you can see what other people are buying
• Prices and availability updated throughout the day

COUPONS & PROMO CODES
• Copy coupon codes with one tap
• Find coupons for stores near you with Near Me
• Browse coupons by retailer

RETAILERS, COLLECTIONS & PARTNERS
• Every deal and coupon from your favorite stores in one place
• Curated Collections: shopping lists for holidays, back to school, home upgrades and more
• Exclusive offers from Dealrax partners

NEVER MISS A PRICE DROP
• Set search alerts for the products you want
• Get notified when someone replies to you or your deal heats up
• Get "For You" picks based on what you like

SHARE AND EARN
• Post deals and coupons you find
• Climb the community leaderboard
• Join rewards and giveaways

Dealrax is free to use. Browsing is open to everyone. Create a free account to vote, comment, post and set alerts.

Affiliate disclosure: Some links in Dealrax are affiliate links. We may earn a commission when you make a qualifying purchase, at no extra cost to you.

name: Deals.mn
description:
Deals.mn бол Монголын үйлчилгээний газруудын онцгой санал, хямдралыг нэг дороос олох аппликэйшн.
Ресторан, кафе, спа, гоо сайхан, фитнес, зочид буудал, амралтын газрын ваучерыг 50% хүртэл
хямдралтай аваад, утсан дахь QR кодоороо шууд ашиглана.

ЮУ ХИЙЖ БОЛОХ ВЭ

• Хямдрал хайх
Ангилал, байршил, үнийн дүнгээр шүүж, хэрэгтэй саналаа хурдан олно. Хайлтаа эрэмбэлж, их
хямдралтай эсвэл их борлуулалттай саналуудыг эхэнд нь харж болно.

• Ойролцоох саналууд
Байршлаа хуваалцсан тохиолдолд танд хамгийн ойр байгаа газруудын саналыг зайн хамт харуулна.

• Үнэ, нөхцөлөө урьдчилан мэдэх
Хэд хэмнэж байгаа, ваучер хэдий хүртэл хүчинтэй, буцаан олголттой эсэх, нэг хүн хэд авч болох —
бүгд худалдан авахаас өмнө тодорхой.

• QPay-ээр төлөх
Банкны аппаараа хормын дотор төлнө. Төлбөр баталгаажмагц ваучер таны бүртгэлд шууд үүснэ.

• Ваучераа утсандаа авч явах
Үйлчилгээ авахдаа QR кодоо ажилтанд уншуулахад л болоо. Нэг удаа нээсэн ваучер интернэтгүй үед
ч харагдана.

• Бүх ваучер нэг дор
Идэвхтэй болон ашигласан ваучер, хүчинтэй хугацаа, захиалгын түүх, буцаалтын хүсэлт — бүгд
"Ваучер" таб дотор.

• Үнэлгээ, сэтгэгдэл

уншина.

ХЭРХЭН АЖИЛЛАДАГ ВЭ

1. Санал сонгоно
