Нууцлалын бодлого: https://deal.mn/privacy

name: Deck Folio - Let’s Play Cards
description:
Pull up a chair. Deck Folio brings three card games to a table full of Malaysian stories.

In The Stray, find pairs and pass the odd card along. In Table Rush, turn cards and be first to call a match. In Family Quest, ask for missing cards and complete your families.

Choose an illustrated deck, set your table and space, and play against a changing cast of opponents. Discover characters, places, and everyday moments inspired by life in Malaysia, from kampung afternoons to bustling city streets.

Win rounds to earn points and unlock collectible stickers. Preview the artwork in your decks and see how you rank on the scoreboard.

Pick a game. Gather your cards. See where the next round takes you.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Deckloom
description:
Deckloom is a card culture and puzzle app built around the 52-card deck — without betting, chips, odds, loot boxes, or simulated gambling.

Play three distinct card games:
• HandCraft — identify the hand and sharpen your pattern recognition across ten questions.
• Suit Stride — follow a growing rhythm of suits and train your working memory.
• Rankline — swap cards into a perfect sequence, from ace low to king high.

Explore a growing card library:
• Ten bilingual field notes on suits, court cards, cardistry, etiquette, design, and the history of play.
• The complete 52-card atlas, with a closer look at every rank and suit.
• Nine classic hand rankings explained in plain language.
• A pocket glossary of card terms and traditions.

Make the table your own:
• Complete a fresh Daily Five challenge each day.
• Build streaks, track accuracy, and earn six small achievements.
• Unlock four original deck patterns as your card knowledge grows.
• Choose the deck that appears in your collection.
• Use a daily reminder, tactile feedback, and gentle motion settings.

Designed for iPhone and available in English and Greek, Deckloom works fully offline. Your progress stays on your device. There are no accounts, no ads, no analytics, and no tracking.

name: Decola - 写真デコ・推し活・コラージュ
description:
写真をもっとかわいく、もっと自分らしく。

Decola（デコラ）は、推し活や思い出の写真を自由にデコレーションできる写真加工・コラージュアプリです。

お気に入りの写真に、かわいいフレーム、キラキラのスタンプ、好きな言葉を組み合わせて、世界にひとつだけの作品を作ろう！

【かわいいテンプレートがいっぱい】

リボン、ハート、ジュエル、ゆめかわ、推し活デザインなど、個性豊かなテンプレートを用意。

写真を選ぶだけで、かわいいデザインを簡単に楽しめます。

【白紙から自由にデザイン】

オリジナル作成では、背景から自由にカスタマイズ。

複数の写真、文字、スタンプを好きな場所に配置して、自分だけのコラージュを作れます。

縦長・正方形など、用途に合わせたキャンバスサイズにも対応。

【写真も文字も自由に編集】

・写真の追加、差し替え、拡大縮小、回転
・好きな言葉や名前を入れる文字編集
・かわいいスタンプを自由に配置
・レイヤーの重なり順を変更
・背景色やグラデーションをカスタマイズ

【作った作品を保存・再編集】

お気に入りの作品はアプリ内に保存。

あとから写真や文字を変更して、何度でもデザインを楽しめます。

完成した作品はPNG画像として保存・共有できます。

【こんな人におすすめ】

・推しの写真をかわいく飾りたい
・推し活用の画像を作りたい
・友達との思い出をコラージュしたい
・SNS用のかわいい画像を作りたい
・ハートやリボン、キラキラのデザインが好き
・自分だけのオリジナル画像を作りたい

あなたの「好き」を、もっとかわいく。

Decolaで、写真デコを楽しもう！

name: DeepSky Tonight
description:
DeepSky Tonight shows which deep-sky objects are worth imaging tonight from where you are. It works out what is up, how high it gets and when, so you can plan a night of astrophotography in a minute.

Developed by an astrophotographer, for astrophotographers. DeepSky Tonight is free and will always be free: no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases.

TONIGHT AT A GLANCE
• Sunset, sunrise, astronomical darkness and the Moon's phase, rise and set
• A ranked list of targets above your chosen altitude, with magnitude, size and transit time
• Targets that cross the meridian near the middle of the night, so they stay well placed for hours
• Filter by altitude, magnitude, size, object type and transit timing, or show only popular or currently visible targets
• Step forward to preview future nights

EVERY OBJECT IN DETAIL
• A sky survey image of the object
• An altitude curve for the night, the usable imaging window, and its separation from the Moon
• Sky View: where the object sits in the sky through the night, in alt-az or equatorial view, with constellation lines and a time slider

CATALOGS
• Messier (110) and Caldwell (109)
• Herschel 400
• NGC (8,098) and IC (5,506)
• Sharpless (313) and RCW (181) emission nebulae, ideal for narrowband
• Lynds (1,787) and Barnard (343) dark nebulae
• Named objects: every object with a common name, A to Z
• Monthly highlights: popular targets that are well placed this month

FOR THE FIELD
• Red night mode protects your dark adaptation
• Save favorites and keep an imaging log of what you have shot
• Save observing sites, or enter coordinates by hand
• Export a backup or your imaging log as CSV
• Works offline: the catalogs and images are built into the app

PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your location is used only on your iPhone or iPad to work out what is visible, and is never sent anywhere.

Questions? Email support@jmpar.com.

name: Delos Beauty
description:
Book your beauty appointment in seconds with the Delos Beauty Etiler app.

• Online booking: choose your service, your specialist and a time that suits you.
• Gel polish colour card: tap a colour and see the finished work done with it.
• Our specialists: meet the team, their specialities and customer ratings.
• Chat with the salon: write to us directly with your questions.
• Notifications: appointment reminders and changes on your phone right away.
• Your booking history and details in one place.

Delos Beauty in Etiler, Istanbul offers nail, brow and lash, skin and permanent makeup services. Message us from the app with any questions.

name: Demac Loyalty
description:
Build Better Get Rewarded. Earn points every time you choose our premium plywood.
Turn every interaction into rewards with our Loyalty Rewards App — the smarter and faster way to earn points and enjoy exclusive benefits.
Simply scan a QR code during each purchase and instantly collect loyalty points. No cards to carry, no hassle — just seamless rewards at your fingertips. As your points grow and reach the reward threshold, you can redeem exciting offers, discounts, and perks directly from the app.
Key Features:
1. Quick QR Code Scanning to earn points instantly.
2. Real-time Points Tracking with a clear reward progress view.
3. Easy Redemption once your points reach the required threshold.
4. Secure & User-Friendly Interface for a smooth experience.
5. Paperless & Convenient — all your rewards in one place.

name: Denza - joyful
description:
Denza is a single-player castle defense game where gathering, merging, and real-time command come together. The satisfaction comes from watching a plan take shape: workers sustain your resources, defenders hold the line, and timely adjustments help your formation withstand the next wave.
Every stage asks you to balance growth with protection. Spending wood on another worker can strengthen your economy, while recruiting a guard can keep approaching enemies away from the castle. Choosing when to build, merge, or reposition gives each defense its own rhythm.
Across four chapters and twelve stages, different routes and enemy combinations give you reasons to rethink your approach. Guards, slingers, rangers, and star mages serve different roles against fast attackers, armored beasts, and magic-resistant enemies. Merge matching units up to tier three, direct your troops toward selected targets, and aim meteors where they can make a difference.
A separate training mode introduces the controls through hands-on practice, while the unit collection explains your allies and enemies. Replaying stages lets you try different formations and work toward keeping more castle health or finishing in less time.
Denza offers a focused strategy experience for players who enjoy building a team, understanding how its parts work together, and adapting during battle. You can pause and resume an unfinished campaign battle, with progress saved on your device.
The campaign and training are playable offline. The game supports nine languages and includes haptic feedback and reduced-motion options. No account is required, and there are no ads or in-app purchases.

name: deOne: Resultados en vivo
description:
deOne es la app de los clientes de deOne Marketing. Reúne en un solo lugar los resultados de tu marca y los muestra en vivo, sin esperar al reporte de fin de mes.

QUÉ VES EN LA APP
• Ventas de tu tienda en línea: ventas, pedidos, ticket promedio, conversión y los productos que más se venden.
• Pauta: cuánto se invierte en Meta y Google, qué compras trae y el retorno real, cruzado con las ventas que confirma tu tienda.
• Redes sociales: seguidores, alcance, las publicaciones que mejor funcionan y el historial de tus historias de Instagram.
• Clientes: quiénes vuelven a comprar y quiénes se están alejando.
• Lecturas claras: "lo que está funcionando" y "dónde hay espacio para crecer", escritas por tu agencia, no solo cifras sueltas.

AVISOS EN TU TELÉFONO
Recibe un aviso cuando algo necesita tu atención, como un cliente que pide hablar con una persona o un pago que no entró. Tú eliges si los activas.

FECHAS A TU MEDIDA
Hoy, ayer, este mes, el mes pasado, los últimos 7 o 30 días, el año o las fechas exactas que elijas. Compara con las mismas fechas del año pasado o con el periodo anterior, con un solo toque, y ve siempre la cifra exacta contra la que se compara.

PREGÚNTALE A DEONE
Escribe una pregunta sobre lo que estás viendo ("¿qué pieza vendió más este mes?") y recibe una respuesta con las cifras de tu propio panel.

PRIVADA Y SEGURA
Entras con el usuario y la contraseña que te entrega deOne, y en el iPhone puedes proteger la app con Face ID. Cada usuario solo ve los negocios que tiene asignados, y la app no muestra datos personales de tus clientes.

La app es para clientes de deOne Marketing. Si quieres el panel para tu marca, escríbenos a hola@deonemarketing.com o visita deonemarketing.com.

name: DersDers Kariyer
description:
DersDers Kariyer, eğitim sektörüne özel ücretsiz iş ilanı panosudur. Okullar, kurslar ve etüt merkezleri öğretmen arıyor; öğretmenler iş arıyor — hepsi tek yerde.

Öğretmenler için
• Branşına, iline ve çalışma şekline göre öğretmen iş ilanlarını ara
• Tek dokunuşla başvur, başvurunun durumunu takip et (incelendi, görüşmeye çağrıldı…)
• Özgeçmişini oluştur, "iş arıyorum" ilanı ver
• Kurumların profil bilgisi isteklerini onayla ya da reddet — kimin neyi gördüğüne sen karar ver

Kurumlar için
• Öğretmen arama ilanı ver, gelen başvuruları tek listede gör
• Başvuru durumunu güncelle; aday anında haberdar olsun

Bildirimler
• Yeni başvuru, başvuru durumu, ilan süresinin dolması ve profil bilgisi istekleri telefonuna anında gelir.
• Bildirimleri telefonunun ayarlarından istediğin zaman kapatabilirsin.

Güvenli kullanım
• Kurallara aykırı bir ilanı ya da özgeçmişi tek dokunuşla bildir; DersDers ekibi inceler.
• İstemediğin bir kişiyi engelle: ilanları sana görünmez, ilanına başvuramaz.

Hesap telefon numarası ve SMS koduyla açılır; tek hesap Özel Ders panosunda da geçerlidir. DersDers Kariyer 18 yaş ve üzeri kullanıcılar içindir.

name: DersDers Özel Ders
description:
DersDers Özel Ders, özel ders veren öğretmenlerle öğrenci ve velileri buluşturan ücretsiz ilan panosudur.

Özel ders arayanlar için
• Branşa, seviyeye (ilkokul, LGS, YKS…), ile ve ders şekline (yüz yüze / çevrim içi) göre öğretmen bul
• Öğretmenin ilanını, verdiği dersleri ve uygun günlerini incele

Öğretmenler için
• Ücretsiz özel ders ilanı ver, ilanını istediğin zaman güncelle ya da yayından kaldır
• İlanının yayın süresi dolmadan bildirim al, tek dokunuşla uzat

Güvenli kullanım
• Kurallara aykırı bir ilanı tek dokunuşla bildir; DersDers ekibi inceler.
• İstemediğin bir kişiyi engelle: ilanları artık sana görünmez.

Hesap telefon numarası ve SMS koduyla açılır; tek hesap Kariyer panosunda da geçerlidir. DersDers Özel Ders 18 yaş ve üzeri kullanıcılar içindir; öğrenciler ilanları velileriyle birlikte incelemelidir.

name: Desk by ADADÒ
description:
ADADÒ Desk è la console di assistenza ospiti per le aziende che gestiscono case vacanza, affitti brevi e strutture ricettive. ADADÒ la usa ogni giorno con i propri operatori e la offre come servizio ad altri gestori.

Con ADADÒ Desk la squadra lavora da iPhone:
• Assistenza: richieste degli ospiti ordinate per attesa, presa in carico, risposte e chiusura, con la sintesi dell’assistente virtuale.
• Chat tradotta: l’operatore scrive in italiano, l’ospite legge nella sua lingua (facoltativa, con consenso).
• Oggi: arrivi, ospiti in casa, partenze e solo le eccezioni da sbloccare.
• Prenotazioni: il percorso di ogni ospite, dal link di benvenuto all’accesso in casa.
• Documenti: i documenti di identità da controllare.
• Squadra: turni, passaggio al collega, carico di lavoro, richieste di manutenzione e pulizia.
• Notifiche facoltative senza dati degli ospiti sulla schermata di blocco.

ADADÒ Desk è per chi lavora nell’accoglienza, non per chi soggiorna: gli ospiti usano l’app che indica il gestore.

Per usarla serve un account fornito dalla propria azienda. Le aziende che vogliono attivare il servizio scrivono a info@adado.it: creiamo noi l’account aziendale e quelli degli operatori. Senza account si può provare la dimostrazione inclusa, con dati inventati.

name: Destello Quiz
description:
Destello convierte cualquier clase, capacitación o evento en un concurso en vivo.

Tú proyectas las preguntas en la pantalla grande y todos responden desde su celular: entran con un PIN o escaneando el código QR, sin descargar nada ni crear cuenta. Al final de cada pregunta ven la respuesta correcta y por qué, y al terminar, el podio.

PARA DOCENTES Y FORMADORES
• Crea quizzes a mano en minutos: preguntas con 2 a 4 respuestas, imagen y tiempo.
• Ranking en vivo, rachas y podio final.
• Si a alguien se le corta el internet, vuelve a entrar sin perder sus puntos.
• Funciona en cualquier pantalla: proyector, tele o computadora.
• Encuestas en vivo para charlas y reuniones: votaciones, nube de palabras y preguntas del público.

CON INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL (cuentas Pro)
• Crea un quiz completo en segundos a partir de un tema, un texto, un enlace, un PDF o una foto de tus apuntes.
• Escribe la explicación de cada respuesta.
• Haz el quiz más fácil o más difícil con un toque.

EN LA APP
• Escanea el QR de la pantalla para unirte al instante.
• Vibración al responder.
• Español, inglés y portugués.

GRATIS PARA EMPEZAR
Quizzes ilimitados y hasta 30 jugadores por partida.

Privacidad: los jugadores solo dan un apodo y las partidas se borran a las pocas horas. Puedes eliminar tu cuenta cuando quieras desde la app.

name: DevNote - code notebook
description:
DevNote is a notebook for the code snippets, commands, and useful examples you want to keep close. Save your code with a title and a short description, then find it again with search, tags, and language filters.

SAVE AND ORGANIZE
• Create, edit, and delete snippet notes.
• Add up to five tags to each snippet.
• Mark frequently used snippets as favorites.
• Search your notebook and filter by programming language.
• Sort snippets by recently updated, recently created, or title.

READ AND REUSE
• Read code with syntax highlighting and language icons.
• Copy a snippet’s code to the clipboard.
• Keep one file attachment per snippet, up to 6 MB.
• Export attachments using the system share sheet.
• Start with four editable example snippets.

LOCAL BY DESIGN
Your snippets and attachments are stored on your device. No account or backend service is required. Each installation has its own notebook; cross-device sync is not included. DevNote stores and displays code—it does not execute it.

Available in English and Spanish. Free to use, with no ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.

name: DewStroll
description:
Dew Stroll is a glass pastime about a walk on dew. Every pane holds beads, a beetle, and a leaf. You shade the glass, and the dew steps into the shade.

A beetle on the pane is waiting for the leaf. Shade grows dew by one step, into a dry cell that already touches dew, and only in the shaded columns. The new dew stays where it lands. Heat dries a circle after the dew grows: the heater's cell and every cell up to two steps away, across or down. On some panes a number sits above the glass, and the wet cells stay within it. When the beetle and the leaf share one wet path, the pane is settled.

Shade covers one column or two. Tap a column, then 1 column or 2 columns. Shade extends to the right and stops at the frame. Tap a cell to place a heater, and tap that cell again to lift it. Wipe returns the shade and the heater to the table. Settle presses the glass, the dew travels to its resting cells, and a sentence names the result.

First Bead is waiting. A settled pane opens the following one, and the finished panes stay on this iPhone. The visit is portrait, on one glass wall, from the cover to the last settling.

No ads. No accounts. No data collected.

name: DFang GaiP
description:
One carefully timed pulse can reshape a fictional organism's journey.
DFang GaiP turns connected organs into a living strategy puzzle.

PULSE CONTROL | CHOOSE THE SIGNAL
Set chemical pulse strength for your next move.
Adjust receptor sensitivity and select signal pathways.
Watch connected organs respond through interactive simulations.
Plan around signals that take time to arrive.

RECEPTOR FATIGUE | THINK BEYOND ONE TURN
Account for receptor fatigue as the challenge develops.
Balance immediate action with longer-term recovery.
Compare how different choices affect organ responses.

ENERGY & MIGRATION | PROTECT THE BALANCE
Manage energy reserves while the organism advances.
Consider stress before choosing the next action.
Navigate migration challenges without neglecting growth.
Keep the fictional organ network in balance.

CALCULATE | PLAN THE NEXT PULSE
Estimate pulse arrival with in-game strategy calculators.
Compare possible actions before committing to a route.
Use timing and available energy to guide decisions.

MAKE EACH JOURNEY YOUR OWN
Customize scenarios to explore different challenges.
Follow your progress as the organism develops.
Use checkpoints and recovery planning to continue the journey.
DFang GaiP rewards thoughtful moves in an imaginative biological world.

name: DFT Senegal
description: Decouvrez DFT, l application incontournable pour acheter, vendre et trouver un emploi ou un logement au Senegal, en toute simplicite et securite. Que vous soyez a Dakar, Pikine, Rufisque, Thies, Touba ou dans n importe quelle region du Senegal, DFT vous connecte instantanement avec les meilleures opportunites de votre quartier : boutiques locales, restaurants, livraison rapide, taxis et motos, location immobiliere et importation directe depuis la Chine.

name: Dhikree
description:
Dhikree helps you keep up your daily remembrance of Allah, at your own pace and without losing count.

Built by a father who found it hard to help his sons stay focused on their daily adhkar, Dhikree keeps the words, the count and your place for you, so you can concentrate on the remembrance itself.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Morning and evening adhkar in one simple list: Qur'an, praise, protection and tasbeeh
• Supplications for daily life: waking, sleep, home, prayer, travel, food, family, sickness, funerals, weather, fasting, Hajj, Umrah, and more
• Arabic text with clear vowel marks, with optional transliteration
• The hadith reference for each supplication
• A tap counter that remembers how many times you have said each dhikr and moves to the next one when you finish
• Tasbeeh counter
• Prayer times calculated on your phone, with the common calculation methods
• Qibla compass
• Search across all adhkar, in Arabic or English
• Save your favourite adhkar
• 11 Arabic fonts, adjustable text size, light and dark themes and decorative frames

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• No data is collected or sent anywhere; your settings stay on your phone
• Location is optional and only used on the phone for prayer times and the Qibla

May Allah make it beneficial for everyone who uses it.

Questions or suggestions: jsharief12@gmail.com

name: Dictate — Voice to Text
description:
Dictation App turns speech into text — fast, in 12 languages.

DICTATE LIVE
Tap Dictate and talk. Go hands-free with the spoken wake word "Dictate" and stop with "Stop". On iPhone, live dictation runs on Apple's speech recognition, built for long sessions.

TRANSCRIBE RECORDINGS (Pro)
Upload audio or video — MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV and more, up to 25 MB / 30 minutes — and get a transcript, with speaker labels if you want them.

TRANSLATE, SUMMARIZE, LISTEN
Translate any transcript into 12 languages (English to Korean by default). Pull a summary with the main points, decisions and action items. Hear it back with natural read-aloud voices, and download your notes as text, Word, SRT subtitles or MP3.

PLANS
Free: 300 live-dictation minutes a month, notes kept 30 days. Pro and Team add uploads, speaker labels, summaries, all voices and 1,800 minutes a month. Plans are bought and managed on the web — the app shows "Manage your plan on the web" and sells nothing in-app. A 7-day Pro trial is available on the web, no card required.

No account sign-up is needed to start: the app works straight away.

name: Did I Lock It? Door Check
description:
Ever get to the car and wonder if you locked the front door? Or spend the whole morning unsure whether you turned off the stove?

Did I Lock It? fixes that in one tap. Snap a photo of the door, the stove, the iron or anything else as you leave. When the doubt hits later, open the app and see it, with the exact time.

• One tap, one photo: each checkpoint has a big Snap button
• See exactly when: every photo shows the day and time it was taken
• Your checkpoints: front door, back door, stove, oven, iron, windows, garage, car…
• Automatic cleanup: old photos delete themselves after 1, 3, 7 or 30 days
• Private by design: photos stay inside the app on your iPhone, never in your camera roll and never uploaded
• No account, no ads, no tracking

FREE: 2 checkpoints, all features.
LIFETIME UNLOCK: unlimited checkpoints. One payment, yours forever. No subscription. Shared with Family Sharing.

name: Diesel Ready: Marine Diesel
description:
Diesel Ready is a free, independent study guide for leisure boaters who want to understand and look after a small marine diesel engine.

Work through short, plain-English lessons, test yourself with quizzes, tick off your engine checks before and after starting, and use the Fault finder when something is not right. Everything works offline, so it is there when you need it, in harbour or at sea.

LEARN
• 8 modules and 35 short lessons, from how a diesel works to finding faults
• Fuel systems, filters, water in fuel and bleeding out air
• Cooling: seacocks, strainers, impellers, heat exchangers and thermostats
• Lubrication, oil checks and what the oil pressure warning means
• Batteries, charging, starter motors and glow plugs
• Drive belts, gearbox, stern gland, shaft and propeller
• Daily checks, servicing, winter lay-up and spares to carry
• Simple diagrams of the four-stroke cycle, the fuel path and the cooling circuits

TEST YOURSELF
• Check your knowledge at the end of each lesson
• Quizzes for each module, a 10-question quick quiz and a 30-question mock test
• Instant feedback with an explanation for every answer
• Review the questions you missed and retry them
• Over 150 original questions

CHECKLISTS
• Pre-start checks with the engine off, built on the widely used WOBBLE memory aid: water, oil, belts, bilges, leaks and levels
• Post-start checks with the engine running: water from the exhaust, warning lights, temperature, noise and smoke, observing only
• Tick items off as you go and reset for next time; ticks are never saved or sent anywhere
• Every check links to the lesson that explains it

FAULT FINDER
Stop cards come first, with what to do at once for low oil pressure, overheating, water coming in, suspected water in the engine, fuel spray, smoke or fire, and a leaking shaft seal. Then pick a symptom (exhaust smoke, won't start, overheating, stops suddenly, low oil pressure or not charging) to see the possible causes, what to check first, and links to the lessons that explain more.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in
• No adverts, analytics or tracking
• Your progress stays on your device; deleting the app removes it
• Works fully offline

UNOFFICIAL AND INDEPENDENT
Diesel Ready is an independent revision aid. It is not an official course and does not award any certificate. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any training organisation, sailing association or engine manufacturer. The content is general guidance for typical small marine diesels: always follow your engine manufacturer's handbook, and ask a qualified marine engineer if you are unsure.

OPEN SOURCE
The app's code and content are open source. The lessons and questions are original, written for the app, and shared under a Creative Commons licence so others can learn from them.

Made by Meltemi Apps, an independent app studio.

name: DIFT Bike
description:
DIFT Bike is the app for DIFT operators who run bike challenges at events: set up the connected bikes, start the rounds, follow them live and host the show, from a phone or a tablet.

The app is for DIFT teams and their partners: accounts are created by your organisation's administrator, there is no sign-up in the app.

LIVE CHALLENGES
• All your challenges on one screen: status, venue, bikes online and each bike's speed in real time.
• Start a round with a synchronised start on every bike, pause, resume or stop it.
• Timer, distance, speed and ranking follow the server's referee, to the second.

PRESENTER REMOTE
• Drive the public screen: rounds, podium, ranking, media and soundpad.
• Follow the event's fundraising total and the current round's ranking.
• Share the public screen link in one tap.

TEAMS AND BIKES
• Create teams, pick their colours and give each one a bike.
• Pair a new bike with the camera: the app recognises the point cloud shown on the handlebar screen, then finishes over Bluetooth.
• Each bike's sheet: speed, distance, battery, network, firmware version and handlebar settings.
• Firmware updates are started by the operator, never automatically.

GETTING STARTED
• An illustrated tutorial explains pairing, the start and the settings.
• Built-in help and FAQ, the same as in the DIFT console.

Bluetooth is used to pair and set up the bikes; the camera is only used to recognise the handlebar screen, and the image is never stored or sent. The app is in French.

name: Dime Dinner: Cheap Meal Plans
description:
Know what dinner costs before you shop.

Dime Dinner plans a week of dinners for your household and prices the whole shopping list at your own store, to the cent. Not a national average. Not the half onion the recipe uses. The whole bag, at today's shelf price, the way the register rings it up.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your store from the ones near your ZIP code.
2. Tell us how many people you feed, how many dinners you want and your weekly budget.
3. Get a week of dinners with one checkout total, and a shopping list sorted by aisle.

WHY THE TOTAL IS RIGHT
- Whole packages. If a recipe needs 1 cup of rice, you pay for the bag, and the app shows what is left over for next week.
- Your store, today. Prices are checked at the store you picked, including this week's sale prices with the store's free loyalty card.
- One list for the week. Ingredients shared by several dinners are bought once.
- Compare your receipt. Type in your receipt total after you shop and see how close the plan was.

REAL RECIPES
Every recipe comes from tested public sources: USDA MyPlate Kitchen, the Department of Veterans Affairs and the National Institutes of Health. No AI-written recipes and no AI food photos. Ingredients and steps scale to your household.

MADE FOR A BUDGET
- A weekly budget you set; the plan stays under it.
- Each dinner shows its share of the bill and its cost per serving.
- Swap any dinner and see what the swap does to the total before you choose.
- Check off food you already have at home and it comes off your total.
- Diet and allergy choices are hard filters, not suggestions.
- Cook mode keeps the screen awake and the steps large.

HONEST PRICING
Your first week is free, with no card and no account. If you want a new plan every week, Dime Dinner is $5.99 a month or $39.99 a year, each with a 7-day free trial and an optional reminder 2 days before the trial ends. Cancel any time in Settings, Apple Account, Subscriptions.

WHERE IT WORKS
Dime Dinner prices plans at Kroger and its family of stores in the US, including Ralphs, Fred Meyer, King Soopers, Fry's, Smith's, QFC, Harris Teeter, Dillons and more. Enter your ZIP code to see the stores near you.

GOOD TO KNOW
Prices are for the store you picked on the day they were checked, and can change. Sale prices need the store's free loyalty card. Meat and produce sold by weight can ring up slightly differently.

Dime Dinner is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Kroger or any store named above. Store names are used only to say where a price was checked.

Terms: https://dimedinner.com/terms
Privacy: https://dimedinner.com/privacy

name: Ditto Miles
description:
Ditto Miles keeps a clean record of your business miles, so you don't have to reconstruct them later.

Track trips your way:
• Start and end a trip with GPS. The app measures the miles while you drive, even with the screen off.
• Add a trip manually by typing the start and end addresses.
• Navigate and log: enter a destination, open your maps app, and log the trip when you arrive.
• Set up recurring trips for your regular routes.

Stay organized:
• Categorize trips as Business, Personal, Commute, Charity or Medical.
• Track more than one vehicle and business with a subscription.
• Swipe a trip to duplicate it.
• Review your Trip Log whenever you need it.

Export reports:
• Export mileage reports as Excel or PDF and share them by email.

Try Ditto Miles free for 7 days. No card is needed to start. After the trial, keep full access with a monthly or yearly subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://dittomiles.flutterflow.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://dittomiles.flutterflow.app/terms

name: Divemark
description:
Divemark is a calm, tidy logbook for scuba divers. Write down every dive in a minute after you surface, and Divemark sketches the profile, works out your gas consumption and keeps your records — all in one quiet, dark, underwater-themed app.

LOG EVERY DIVE
Each entry holds the date, site, entry and exit time (bottom time is calculated for you), max and average depth, water temperature, visibility, gas (air or nitrox with your O2 percentage), tank size, start and end pressure, weight, suit, buddy, conditions (current, surge, shore or boat entry), a 1–5 rating, sightings and notes. Dive numbers count up automatically and stay editable.

SEE THE SHAPE OF THE DIVE
Every dive gets a simplified descent, bottom and ascent profile drawn from your depths and time, with depth labels on the dive page. A small version sits on every logbook row so you can recognise a dive at a glance.

GAS MATHS DONE FOR YOU
Divemark computes your SAC rate and RMV from tank size, pressures, time and average depth (salt or fresh water), plus the ppO2 you breathed at your deepest point.

A SITE BOOK
Save the places you return to with region or country, salt or fresh water and typical max depth. See how many times you have dived each site and when you were last there.

STATS THAT MEAN SOMETHING
Total dives and bottom time, deepest and longest dive, a depth histogram, your SAC trend over time, dives per year and dives per site. Set a new deepest or longest dive and Divemark lets you know.

YOUR CARDS AND YOUR KIT
Keep your certification cards (agency, level, number, date) in the wallet, and list your gear with service-due dates so you know what needs servicing before the next trip.

NAVIGATE BY DEPTH
A depth gauge on the right edge is the whole map: Log at the surface, Sites at 10 m, Stats at 20 m and the Deck at 30 m. Tap a stop and the diver sinks to it.

METRIC OR IMPERIAL
Metres, bar, litres and °C, or feet, psi, cubic feet and °F — switch any time.

YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY
Create an account with email and password to keep your logbook safe across devices, or simply explore as a guest. Guests can save their logbook to an account later. The logbook works offline and syncs when you are back online. You can delete your account and every dive from the Deck at any time.

No ads. No tracking. No analytics.

Divemark is a logbook only. It is not a dive planner, decompression tool or dive computer — always dive within your training.

name: DJ-T
description:
DJ-T is a private radio client for your own self-hosted DJ-T music server. It is not a music service and does not include a music library.

Connect to the server address you control, sign in, and choose a station. DJ-T streams your server's music with album artwork, track metadata, Up Next, pause/resume, skip and previous controls, and lock-screen/Now Playing controls. Playback continues in the background.

DJ-T is designed for personal and self-hosted music servers. You need an existing DJ-T server and an account provisioned by its operator. No ads, analytics, tracking, or in-app purchases.

name: DMV Permit Test 2027
description:
Pass your driver's permit test the first time.

DMV Permit Test 2027 gets you ready for your state's learner permit knowledge test, for a car or a motorcycle. Pick your state and study with lessons, exam-style questions and flashcards.

From Winslow Homes Publishing.

CAR PERMIT
- 20 lessons and 600 questions: road signs, signals and pavement markings, right of way, turns and lane use, speed and following distance, parking, freeway driving, sharing the road, alcohol and impaired driving, distracted driving, night and bad weather, emergencies, crashes and insurance
- 2 full practice tests and a must-know cheat sheet

MOTORCYCLE PERMIT
- 10 lessons and 300 questions: gear, controls and the pre-ride check, turning, lane position, seeing and being seen, crash avoidance, passengers and group riding

EVERY STATE
All 50 states and Washington DC. Your state's permit steps: age rules, driver education, graduated license rules, supervised driving hours, fees, how the knowledge test works, how to book your road test, and the state traffic laws new drivers must know.

STUDY TOOLS
- Full timed practice tests
- Weak spot drills that target the topics you miss
- Pass readiness score, daily goal and study streak
- Flashcards
- Day and night mode

FREE TO START
Try 2 lessons and 25 questions free. Unlock everything with a subscription.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
- Monthly: $14.99
- 3 months: $29.99
- 6 months: $39.99
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Not affiliated with any DMV or government agency. Laws change; always check your state driver handbook.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.winslowhomesllc.com/pages/exam-prep-app-privacy

name: DMV Practice Test: EN & ES
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent any state Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) or other government agency. We wrote the questions ourselves from the facts in each state's official driver handbook; road signs come from the federal MUTCD. Find your state's official agency at https://www.usa.gov/state-motor-vehicle-services

Get ready for your driver's permit knowledge test in English, in Spanish, or both.

PRACTICE TEST IN YOUR STATE'S FORMAT
• Number of questions and pass mark as in your state's test
• Separate parts where your state has them, like Georgia's road signs and road rules sections
• Road signs test: 20 sign questions, pass with 15

WRITTEN FROM YOUR STATE'S HANDBOOK
• California, New York, Georgia and Massachusetts, over 430 questions each
• Every answer explained, with the handbook pages it is based on
• Diagrams of real road situations and all the main road signs
• Your state's key numbers in one place: speed limits, alcohol, permit and teen-driver rules

ENGLISH AND SPANISH
• Every question in both languages
• Switch a question to the other language with one tap
• Search by word in English or Spanish

LEARN WITHOUT STRESS
• Questions you miss come back until you get them right
• Exam readiness score and your weak topics
• Works offline, no sign-up, no ads

Free: 10 questions in every topic, 1 practice test and 1 road signs test for your state. Full access is a one-time purchase with no auto-renewal: 7 days, 30 days or lifetime.

More states are on the way. The app is for self-study and information only and does not replace your state's driver handbook.

---

name: DocScan - Scanner & OCR
description:
Free. No account. No ads. No subscription. DocScan turns paper into clean, searchable PDFs, and your documents stay on your iPhone.

SCAN
• Receipts, invoices, contracts, class handouts: scan one page or many.
• Use the iOS document scanner, or import photos you already have.
• Adjust edges, rotate, and pick a filter: Original, Auto, B&W, Grayscale or No shadow.
• Pages save as you go. Deleted by mistake? Undo it.

SCAN ALMOST ANY PAPER
• Receipts, invoices, contracts, tax forms, business cards
• Slides, whiteboards, notes, books, resumes
• Passports, ID cards, driver licenses, certificates
• Memos, letters, maps
• Travel brochures, artwork, work plans, manuscripts
Scanned as ordinary pages. Sensitive papers stay on your iPhone.

FIND
• Text is recognized on your device, in many languages. Choose the language in Settings.
• Search by document name or by the words inside your documents.
• View and copy the recognized text.

SHARE
• Export a PDF with selectable, searchable text, JPG images, or plain text.
• Choose a file size, then share through the iOS Share Sheet or save to Files. From there, send it to apps you already use, like iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or Evernote (when installed on your iPhone), and more.

KEEP IT SIMPLE
• Folders to stay organized.
• Light and dark appearance that follows your iPhone.
• Text recognition works without an internet connection.

Text recognition is automatic and may contain mistakes — please check important documents.

name: Dogged: Habit & Streak Tracker
description:
One payment of $4.99, yours forever. No subscription, no account, no data collected.

Most habit trackers send one reminder at 9am and give up. Dogged keeps after you. A gentle nudge at your reminder time, then follow-ups that come faster as the day runs out, then one last call before bed — and then it stops. A missed day is over at midnight, so Dogged never drags yesterday's guilt into tomorrow.

CHASED, NOT NAGGED
• Escalating follow-ups that tighten as the day drains, never closer than 20 minutes apart
• Per-habit insistence, from a single gentle nudge to relentless
• Quiet hours and a last-call hour you set; nothing arrives after it
• Every follow-up says something new instead of repeating itself
• Miss a habit five scheduled days running (two weeks, for a times-per-week habit) and Dogged backs off to one calm message offering to shrink it, move it, or drop it — louder reminders at that point only make you avoid the app

DO IT WITH SOMEONE
Share a habit with a partner, a friend, or the whole household through iCloud. Keep one shared streak that only survives if everyone shows up, or keep separate streaks side by side. Sharing goes from your iCloud account to theirs; it never passes through a server of ours.

STREAKS THAT ARE FAIR
• Daily, chosen weekdays, or a number of times per week
• Today never breaks your streak while there's still time to do it
• A day the habit isn't scheduled can't break it either
• "Not today" lets you answer a reminder honestly and silence the rest of the day

FREE, AND WHAT THE UNLOCK ADDS
Free: unlimited habits, full tracking and streak history, an opening reminder on every habit, and full escalation on three of them. The one-time $4.99 unlock adds escalation on every habit and shared habits. Your history is never locked behind the purchase, and you can export all of it as a file at any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your habits live on your device. No account, no analytics, no ads, nothing uploaded to us.

Questions: dev@vibesoftllc.com

name: DogWise - Dog Training & Care
description:
What should you do when your dog offers a paw? Where should your hand go when you ask for a sit? DogWise lets you see the timing before you try it together.

Watch animated lessons with on-screen guidance for you. In the three interactive rehearsals, choose your next move and see why it matters. When you practice with your dog, log what happened, what helped and what you want to try next. Save the words and gestures your household uses so everyone can give the same cue.

Keep the everyday details together, including feeding, photos, weight history, vaccines and reminders. Log a walk by hand or record its route with your phone's GPS. Your dog's profile, lessons and core records are available on the device. Online maps and purchases can require an internet connection.

Start without an account and keep the free plan for as long as you like. It includes one dog profile and three repeatable lessons: Sit, Indoor Recall and Give Paw. DogWise Lifetime is an optional one-time purchase that unlocks the 120-lesson library, additional dog profiles and expanded care and walk records.

Available in 6 languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, French, German and Italian.

name: Dono: Hinglish Keyboard
description:
Dono is a keyboard for people who write English and Hindi in Latin letters, often in the same sentence. "kal office mein meeting hai, will be late" stays exactly as you typed it.

WRITE THE WAY YOU TALK
• Suggestions in English and Hinglish that follow the language you are typing.
• Gentle autocorrect: it fixes clear English typos such as "teh" and "dont", never your Hindi words.
• Dono learns your words, names and email addresses, and offers them again.
• After your first name, it suggests your last name.

FAST AND FRIENDLY
• Glide typing: slide across the letters to write a word.
• A number row on top, and symbols on a long press instead of accented letters.
• Rs or $ on the symbols page, by your region.
• A light tap on every key, like Apple's keyboard. Key sound if you want it.
• Light, dark, or the same as your iPhone.

SMART, ON YOUR IPHONE
• Your email, phone and address, offered in the fields that ask for them.
• Names and emails from the contacts you choose.
• Email fields offer @ and .com.
• Type 45*12= and the answer shows in the suggestion bar.
• Emoji suggestions in English and Hinglish, and your most used emoji.
• GIF search, with your recent GIFs and an India category.
• A list of the texts you copied.

PRIVATE
Nothing you type is sent to us. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your learned words sync through your own iCloud, and you can turn that off. GIF searches go to KLIPY, which powers GIF search.

WHAT NO APP STORE KEYBOARD CAN DO
iOS sets the same rules for every keyboard from the App Store:
• Password and phone-number fields always use Apple's keyboard, and some apps turn other keyboards off.
• GIFs are copied for you to paste. No keyboard can put an image into a message.
• The light tap, key sound, GIF search, the clipboard list and sync need Full Access. Typing never does.
• Voice typing is Apple's microphone key, below the keyboard.
• A keyboard sees only about a sentence around the cursor, so Dono learns from what you type, not from what is already written.

PRICE
Free to download, with 30 free days of everything. Then one payment unlocks Dono for good. Without it, Dono keeps typing: every key, numbers, symbols, the emoji grid and GIF search keep working. Suggestions, autocorrect, glide typing, learning and autofill wait for the unlock.

SET UP
Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards › Add New Keyboard › Dono. Then tap the globe key to switch keyboards.

name: Donutello 2
description:
Donutello je kobliha s růžovou polevou a zimní čepicí. A má problém: skončil hluboko pod hradem, v hladomorně plné hovínek, pavouků a páchnoucího kalu. Kutálej se, skákej a dostaň ho ven!

Donutello 2 je plošinovka z boku postavená celá z kostiček. Každá úroveň je ručně malovaný svět ve voxel artu, který se rozpadá, houpe, svítí a kape.

PŘÍBĚH
• Hladomorna – sudy, bedny a první skoky v hradním sklepení.
• Roura – divoký sjezd potrubím stoky.
• Pochod – temná hala, kde svítí jen lampy a hlídkují stráže.
• Klec – žalář s pavouky, navijákem a pákou.
• Krysákova cesta – parťák krysák prolézá rourami a otevírá ti vrata.
Další úrovně přibývají s každou verzí.

ARÉNA
Hra po síti až pro osm hráčů v pěti mapách. Když nikdo není po ruce, zaskočí boti.

CO-OP
Dva hráči ve stejné Wi-Fi projdou úroveň společně.

CO TĚ ČEKÁ
• Ovládání na dva palce: jízda a skok, nic víc.
• Drolivé plošiny, houpačky, výtahy, jeřáby a kal, do kterého nechceš spadnout.
• Sbírání posypek do sklenice.
• Žádné reklamy, žádné nákupy, žádné sbírání dat.

name: DORNWALD: Wurzelthron
description:
A lost compass. A forest under another's rule. And Ebu, fighting alongside his little tiger toward the Throne of Roots.

DORNWALD is an action adventure for iPhone and iPad. Explore ten connected chapters, complete their objectives and unlock the path to the Thorn King, one trial at a time.

TEN CHAPTERS, DIFFERENT OBJECTIVES
Recover the Forest Compass, light path lanterns, repair water pumps and protect a vulnerable forest spirit. Find an Ember Core in the ice, earn a key in the Root Depths and defend a cooling core in the Ash Forge. Forests, hedge gardens, sunken ruins and a royal fortress lead to your final battle.

MAKE EVERY ATTACK COUNT
Choose the Warden's Sword, Thorn Claw or Rune Spear. Dodge telegraphed attacks, equip an ability and charge your special attack. Healing potions are limited. Your tiger fights alongside you, retaliates against your attackers and provides limited emergency healing.

READ THE THORN KING
The final boss has three phases. Watch his attack patterns and armor cues: after his heavy root strike, a brief opening lets you deal damage. Attack too early or stay too long and you risk taking the next hit.

CONTROLS THAT FIT
Move Ebu with a stick and six action buttons within the game view. Adjust button size, left-handed layout, stick behavior and aim assistance. The pause button at the top right opens settings and control help. Switch between English and German in the game.

KEEP IMPROVING
Complete chapters to unlock the next challenge, then revisit unlocked areas for practice. After a regular campaign victory, the time of your successful Thorn King attempt is recorded in your local best times. With Game Center, compare that best time worldwide in the in-game leaderboard. Lower times rank higher; practice attempts do not count.

Free to play, with no ads or in-app purchases. The campaign is playable offline. Worldwide ranking requires internet access and Game Center sign-in, and displays your Apple player name. Progress, settings and local best times stay on your device.

name: Dot It: Habit Tracker
description:
Your habits, one dot at a time.

Dot It is a habit tracker inspired by the colorful dot stickers used in paper planners.

Workouts, reading, sleep, moods, or anything else you'd like to track. Create a habit, then mark each day with a little colored dot.

Just tap a date to place a dot, complete with a soft sticker sound. Keep it simple with Done / Not Done, or create multiple check-in options to track different moods, sleep patterns, and more.

Make your dots your own.
There's plenty to play with when it comes to colors and textures:

· From solid colors, polka dots, and stripes to crayon, watercolor, and Riso-inspired textures
· Curated color palettes that bring a little variety to every check-in
· Background themes to give your habit pages a look you love

From your phone to your paper planner.
If you enjoy keeping a paper planner, you can print your habit tracking pages and add them to it.

Dot It supports a variety of planner sizes, including A5, A6, A7, M5, and Half Letter. You can also arrange pages on A4 or US Letter paper for printing. Loose-leaf pages leave room for binder holes.

Just print, trim, and add the pages to your planner.

A few more things you can do:

· Switch between calendar and compact dot layouts
· Look back at a whole year of habit tracking
· Check your habits and mark them done from Home Screen widgets
· Set reminders for your daily check-ins
· Export a local backup to take your records with you when switching phones

No account needed. Your records are stored on your device by default.

Habit tracking, basic dot colors and backgrounds, yearly overviews, Home Screen widgets, and all printing features are free. You can create as many habits as you like.

If you'd like more ways to customize your dots, Dot It Pro unlocks additional textures, curated color palettes, and more background themes.

Pro is a one-time purchase, with no subscription. It supports Family Sharing, includes future Pro styles at no extra cost, and automatically backs up your records to iCloud Drive.

We hope you enjoy this little way of tracking everyday life. There's something satisfying about watching a page slowly fill with dots, one day at a time.

name: Double Surprise: Shared Stage
description:
Two surprises. One shared stage.

Double Surprise is a stage-preparation puzzle for two people taking turns on one iPhone. One player might plan a film night, the other a dinner or a different surprise. Read your private notebook, pass the phone behind the curtain, and make room for both ideas in the same world.

Each shared round resolves both actions from the same starting arrangement. If an object, slot or power supply is needed by both plans, decide together again: conflicts never spend a round. Carrying, placing, starting a job, waiting, connecting power and reserving a presentation slot have different consequences. Time advances only after both plans are locked. There is no real-time limit.

16 base scenes, four stage families and alternative arrangements are included. Classic uses 8 rounds. In the free 9-round Encore mode, each player must record their ready arrangement in their own presentation slot. Between-round reveals show the actions you actually took, and the final curtain opens on the stage you really prepared.

Optional local player names, free hints, jointly approved undo, a local shared album and anonymous scene-image sharing. Turkish and English; separate music and object-sound levels, gentler motion and object/action controls as alternatives to direct tapping and dragging.

The base game works offline without a game account. No ads, subscriptions, energy system or paid hints. Online play across separate phones is not included.

Stage Wardrobe is an optional one-time purchase for 8 additional outfits and 6 curtain palettes. It changes appearance only, without affecting rounds, scene access, hints or solutions. Preview every look for free. Apple purchases and restoration require an internet connection.

name: DoubleCrossClub
description:
Trust no one. Not even at dinner.

Double Cross Club is a spy and social deduction game that runs quietly in the background of your real week. Instead of trapping you on your screen for hours, it drops two short contracts on your lock screen each day, then lets you get back to life. Every night at 9:00 PM, the Tribunal begins.

HOW A SEASON WORKS
• The Briefing: start a season and receive a secret Cover Alias (Vesper, Rook, Cipher, Kestrel and more) plus a hidden role.
• Daily Drops at 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM: 60 to 90 second contracts. Crack a cipher, memorize a surveillance scene, split a vault code, solve a logic trap, or complete a real-world task like a stealth photo of an everyday object or a trigger word.
• The Black Market: spend the Intel you earn on Background Checks, Signal Jammers, Dead Man's Switches and Safe Houses.
• The 9:00 PM Tribunal: five minutes, a haptic heartbeat countdown, and one secret vote to Burn a suspected traitor.
• The Final Heist on Day 4: survivors choose in secret to split the Vault or steal it. Then share your After-Action Report crowning the Mastermind, the Coldest Liar and the Most Paranoid.

THE GAME SCALES TO YOUR LOBBY
• Black Ops (solo): a spy thriller against The Handler, a rogue AI, with timed ciphers, doctored surveillance stills, real-world scavenges and a nightly interrogation.
• Spy vs. Spy (2): a duel where you Expose your rival's secret mission to steal their points, or a Co-Op Heist where each side holds half the code.
• Small Cell (3 to 5): one hidden Mole. Votes put agents Under Surveillance instead of knocking them out, so the paranoia never lets up.
• Full Syndicate (6 to 20): Field Agents, Double Agents and The Broker, a wildcard who plays both sides. Burned agents become Ghosts who see every role and bet Intel on who survives.

In this version, Practice Lobbies fill every seat with AI agents, so you can play every mode on your own iPhone, from a 2-player duel to a 20-agent Full Syndicate.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Contracts take about a minute, then you're done.
• Local notifications for every drop and the Tribunal, plus a 5-minute warning.
• Field Test Mode lets you jump to any drop or the Tribunal when you want to play right now.
• Stealth photos stay on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.

FAIR PRICING
Double Cross Club is free to download, and every mode is unlocked for your first 7 days. After your free week, a one-time in-app purchase of $2.99 keeps the full game forever. No subscription. Family Sharing is supported. Intel is earned by playing and can never be bought with real money. Restore Purchases is always available on the unlock screen and in the Dossier tab.

PLAY IT SAFE
Only photograph everyday objects, never people without their consent, and never play while driving.

Terms of Use: https://double-cross-club.atlasapps83.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://double-cross-club.atlasapps83.workers.dev/privacy

name: Dovetail Draw
description:
Dovetail Draw keeps each drawer and its four pins on this iPhone.

A pin draws only when both cheeks narrow toward the neck and the end does not stand past the socket. A cheek that flares pushes the tail out. A square cheek leaves a gap. A long end stays proud until you pare it. A drawn pin keeps its cheeks.

Name a drawer, rename it, search the list, delete one, and share the name with the sentence.

Drawers stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not cut a wooden drawer.

name: Downthrust
description:
Bring a falling rocket booster home.

Downthrust is a one-thumb physics game about the hardest part of a rocket flight: landing the booster on a ship at sea. Hold anywhere to fire the engine, tilt your phone (or use the on-screen arrows) to lean, and touch down slowly, upright, and dead center before the fuel runs out.

REAL-FEELING PHYSICS
• Thrust, gravity, drag, and momentum. Lean only pushes you sideways while the engine burns.
• Wind that drifts and gusts, with an indicator that warns you before a gust hits.
• A drone ship deck that sways with the swell. Time your touchdown.

A LADDER THAT STAYS CHALLENGING
• The first two drops ease you in. After that the wind gets meaner, the fuel gets tighter, and the deck gets harder to hit.
• Every landing is scored on softness, accuracy, fuel left, and time, for 1 to 3 stars.
• Crashed? Retry is instant. See exactly why: descent speed, drift, and tilt against the limits.

MADE FOR QUICK ROUNDS
• Each drop takes about 30 seconds.
• Haptics and engine sound you can feel.
• Plays offline.

FAIR, OPTIONAL EXTRAS
• Free to play. Ads never interrupt a descent and never stand between you and Retry.
• Watch an optional ad for extra fuel on your next try.
• Remove Ads with a single purchase.
• Three original booster skins — Ember, Aurora, and Glacier — that change the look only, never the physics.

All vehicles and vessels in Downthrust are fictional. Downthrust is not affiliated with any aerospace company.

Designed by humans, built by bots. A Botbizbuilder game.

name: Dr Frank
description:
Mix the pills. Cure the germs. Mind the moustache.

Dr Frank runs the fuzziest pharmacy in New York. He never says a word, he only babbles, but he knows exactly what his patients need. The mixing is up to you.

Swipe a pill onto its twin to make a capsule. Slide it beside a germ of its own color and the germ is cured. Blend red, blue and yellow pills into purple, orange and green capsules for the germs plain ones can't touch. Germs that touch are cured together, so one good move can clear a whole clump.

But germs don't wait. Every move runs down the clock, and when it runs out they spread, each ailment in its own way:
• Colds are quick.
• Coughs jump a space.
• Headaches hide in shells that have to be cracked first.
• Spilled syrup holds pills where they sit.
And some days end with something much bigger on the tray.

FEATURES
• A puzzle you can learn in a minute, with a short training from Dr Frank himself
• Five days that each bring something new, then fresh patients every day after
• Eight fuzzy regulars to cure, and a sticker to collect for each
• Earn cash for cures and spend it on helpers, or on a neon sign, a fern, a radio and a shop cat for the counter
• Made for one thumb, in portrait, on iPhone and iPad
• No ads, no purchases, no accounts, and it works offline

Dr Frank is a game. It is not medical advice, and no real medicine works this way.

name: Dr Yippy Mobile
description:
Dr Yippy is built to beat the yips.

You know your stroke. You've made it a thousand times. But standing over the ball, your mind won't stop analyzing, and the freeze sets in. Dr Yippy gives your mind something else to do.

Start a session, slip your phone into your pocket, and Dr Yippy pulses on a steady, repeating rhythm. Follow the rhythm instead of your thoughts, and let the stroke you've practiced take over.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap START. Your phone buzzes, pauses, then buzzes again, on a steady beat until you stop.
• Focus on the rhythm as you set up and make your stroke.
• Keeps going with the screen locked, so your phone can stay in your pocket on the green or the range.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Buzz length: 1–5 seconds
• Pause between buzzes: 1–5 seconds
• Start delay: 3, 5 or 10 seconds to step into your stance
• Vibration style: Ringer (a strong, pulsing buzz like an incoming call) or Smooth (a constant, more subtle buzz)
• Optional sound: a 500 Hz tone, white noise or a chime. Plays through your earbuds when they're connected

DISCREET ON THE COURSE
• Vibration only by default: no beeps, so nobody else knows it's running
• Press and hold STOP, so your pocket can't end a session by accident
• Sounds pause automatically if your earbuds disconnect, and vibration keeps going
• Optionally saves each session to Apple Health as a Golf workout (iOS 26 or later)

DR YIPPY PRO
Unlimited practice sessions require a Dr Yippy Pro subscription.
• Dr Yippy Pro (monthly): $4.99 per month (U.S. price; prices vary by country)
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription any time in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://dryippy.com/privacy-policy-v3
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Dragon Atlas
description:
Unfold an original offline puzzle adventure. Plan one continuous route, gather Sun, Moon and Star glyphs in order, then reach a guardian dragon's lair.

- Six mountain regions with 36 guaranteed-solvable trails.
- Tap or drag across illustrated terrain with visible energy costs.
- Camps, optional relic detours and exact backtracking.
- Safe-route hints, next-step forecasts and automatic saving.
- Six original guardian dragons, collectible lore and a local expedition journal.
- A repeatable daily trail, best scores and bronze/silver/gold medals.

No account required. No ads or in-app purchases. Progress stays on your device.

name: Draw Pin
description:
Draw Pin shows what a peg does to one joint.

Offset the hole toward the shoulder and drive the pin. The shoulder draws home and the pin stays. Offset the hole away from the shoulder and the pin pushes the joint open, then pops back. With no offset the pin only passes through. An offset larger than the tenon misses the hole. Driving again while the pin is already in does not add another note. Pull the pin out and the shoulder stays where it is.

Rename a joint, start another, delete one, and share a four-line summary.

Joints stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not drive a real pin.

name: DreadMate
description:
Sixty-four squares. One rule: the pawn goes first. Until one day, one pawn refused to move.

DreadMate is a fast, explosive action roguelite set in a dark fairy-tale chess kingdom. You are a lone ivory pawn, sentenced to the dungeons beneath the board. Fight your way back up, room by room, floor by floor, and make the Ivory King answer for it.

EVERY DEATH IS ANOTHER MOVE
• Five cursed dungeon floors, each with its own champion and chess-piece warden
• Every run is different: rooms, enemies, rewards and gambits change each time
• Fall, return to the hub, grow stronger and try again

BECOME THE PIECE
• Defeat the wardens and take their forms: Knight, Bishop, Rook and Queen
• Each form brings its own attacks, dash and power
• Rise from humble pawn to queen and duel the Ivory King

BUILD YOUR GAMBIT
• 10 weapons: sword, spear, hammer, dagger, crossbow, staff, axe, rapier, scythe and greatsword
• 60 gambits from rival patrons, including duo gambits that combine two powers
• Permanent upgrades between runs

A VISUAL FEAST
• Big, colourful, explosive skills that make every hit land
• Hordes of creatures, screen-filling bosses and stained-glass gothic style
• Responsive touch controls built for phone and tablet

• Pay once: no ads, no in-app purchases
• Plays offline; optional Game Center sign-in keeps your cloud save on every device
• English and Turkish

name: Dream Voyages
description:
Create a quiet place to unwind with Dream Voyages. Choose a starship cabin, rainy cottage or moonlit shore, then build your own mix of rain, waves, wind, fireplace, birds, frogs, distant train, cabin hum and music.

Explore illustrated dream worlds and a calendar-based field guide. Daily visits reveal or revisit included discoveries; they do not measure sleep or penalize missed days.

Read three classic stories or listen to bundled human narration: The Tale of Peter Rabbit, Johnny Crow's Garden and The Velveteen Rabbit. Story-reader and recording credits are included in the app. The optional wind-down guide uses your device's system voice.

Choose a playback timer, adjust individual sound levels and enable gradual settling. A dim night sanctuary offers a gentle place to pause when you are awake.

Core audio, story text and illustrations are bundled for offline use. No account, advertising, subscription, in-app purchase or wearable is required. Dream Voyages does not track your sleep, diagnose conditions or provide medical treatment.

name: DressClan: AI Wardrobe Planner
description:
DressClan turns the clothes you already own into outfits. Photograph your wardrobe once — DressClan finds each garment in the photo, names it, and builds a closet you can search, plan and pack from.

BUILD YOUR WARDROBE IN MINUTES
• Import from the camera or your photo library, up to 3 photos at a time. DressClan finds each garment in the photo, fills in the type, colour and season, and asks you to check before saving.
• Duplicates are spotted and merged — never deleted on their own.
• Add clothes you bought online by pasting or sharing the order-confirmation email.
• A wardrobe for each adult in your household, one tap to switch.

PLAN WHAT TO WEAR
• "Plan my week" builds outfits from the clothes you have, with no repeats close together, around the weather — and, with Premium, the events in your calendar.
• Two looks on a busy day — the office, then dinner.
• Thumbs up or down, "too formal", "too warm" — suggestions learn from you.
• Packing lists for trips, built from your planned outfits and the forecast (Premium).

SEE WHAT YOU REALLY WEAR
• Most-worn and forgotten pieces, cost per wear, colour harmony and wardrobe gaps.
• Declutter suggestions for pieces you haven't worn in 60 days.
• A laundry basket that fills itself as you wear things (Premium).

SHOP ONLY WHAT'S MISSING
• Snap to shop: photograph an outfit you like — DressClan tells you what you already own and searches your favourite shops for the rest.
• Wardrobe gaps link straight to a search in your size.
DressClan may earn a commission when you buy through a partner link, at no cost to you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your wardrobe stays on your phone. When you add clothes, the photo is analysed on our secure server to identify each garment, then discarded — never stored and never used to train AI. No selling of data, no tracking.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: up to 150 items and 2 people. Premium: unlimited items, everyone at home, all insights, calendar-aware planning, a 6-month planner, packing lists, the laundry basket and more photo scans every day. Premium is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription with a 14-day free trial; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

DressClan is for adults (18+).

Terms of Use: https://dressclan.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://dressclan.com/privacy.html
Questions: hello@dressclan.com

name: Drink Tracker: Daily Journal
description:
Keep a simple alcohol journal on your iPhone.

• Log a standard drink in one tap, or choose a common drink and adjust the serving size and strength.
• See a year at a glance, jump to any month, and drag across past dates to mark them drink-free.
• See current and longest drink-free streaks, along with weekly and monthly totals.
• Check monthly totals, compare months, or look up your longest drink-free streak in Ask history.
• Connect Apple Health, set weekend reminders, or export your journal as CSV.
• Optionally review possible bar visits. A suggestion never logs a drink on its own.

No account is required. For other questions about your journal, Ask history uses Apple Intelligence on compatible devices running iOS 26 or later. Drink estimates use U.S. standard drinks.

name: DriveIn 行程记录
seller_name: Xinfeng Rongchuang Technology Information Consulting Service Department (IndividuallyOwned Business)
description:
上车就开始记，停车就有结果。DriveIn 自动记下你开过的每一趟：走了哪条路、开了多远、开得稳不稳。不用注册账号，没有广告，所有行程只存在你的 iPhone 上。

【自动记录，不用点开始】
• 识别到你在开车就自动开始记录，停车后自动结束
• 也可以随时手动开始、结束
• 锁屏和灵动岛实时显示里程和时长
• 每趟结束推送一条小结：评分、里程、新点亮的领地

【驾驶评分】
• 每趟 0–100 分，看看这次开得稳不稳
• 统计急刹车、急加速、急转弯次数
• 路线按车速着色，哪段快、哪段堵一眼看清
• 自动识别起点、终点地名，时间线按天整理
• 本周里程、时长、平均分一目了然

【逐向导航】
• 搜索目的地，查看路线和到达时间
• 转弯提示 + 语音播报，锁屏后也能听到
• 开导航的同时照常记录这一趟

【领地地图】
• 开过的地方会被点亮成格子，越开地盘越大
• 统计已点亮面积和本周新开拓的格子
• 一键生成领地分享图

【分享行程海报】
• 把一趟行程做成好看的海报：路线、里程、评分、用时
• 一键发给朋友，或者发到社交平台

【整理行程】
• 中途下车加油、买咖啡？30 分钟内的两趟可以合并成一趟
• 不想要的行程随时删除

【隐私】
• 不需要注册登录，不收集任何个人数据
• 行程只保存在本机，不上传服务器

【DriveIn Pro（可选）】
核心功能永久免费。Pro 解锁：
• 事件回看：逐条查看每次急刹车、急加速发生在哪里
• 导出 GPX 轨迹
• 分享图去掉水印，并解锁浅色样式
订阅方式：Pro 年订阅（含 7 天免费试用）或 Pro 终身版（一次购买）。年订阅确认购买后从 Apple ID 账户扣款；除非在当前周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续订，否则会自动续订并扣款。可在「设置 › Apple ID › 订阅」中管理或取消。

使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
隐私政策：https://kawhi-z.github.io/drivein/privacy.html

开车时请专注路况，不要操作手机。持续在后台使用定位会增加耗电。

name: DriverSpa Admin: CRM автомойки
description:
DriverSpa — облачная CRM-система для автомоек

Управляйте автомойкой с компьютера или телефона из любой точки мира. DriverSpa объединяет кассу, заказы, зарплаты сотрудников, клиентскую базу и аналитику в одном удобном приложении.

Возможности DriverSpa:

• Касса и финансы
Контролируйте наличные и безналичные платежи, доходы и расходы автомойки в одном месте.

• Приём заказов
Оформляйте заказы за считанные секунды. Услуги, бокс, автомобиль и итоговая сумма рассчитываются автоматически.

• Зарплата сотрудников
Автоматический расчёт выработки и заработной платы мойщиков по выполненным заказам.

• Депозиты, бонусы и скидки
Настраивайте программы лояльности для клиентов. Организации могут пополнять депозиты и отправлять автомобили на мойку без дополнительных оплат.

• Клиенты и автомобили
Храните историю заказов, данные автомобилей и государственные номера в единой базе.

• Аналитика и отчёты
Получайте информацию о выручке, загрузке боксов, популярных услугах и эффективности работы автомойки в режиме реального времени.

Преимущества DriverSpa:

• Запуск за 1 день
• Облачное хранение данных
• Работа на iPhone, iPad и компьютере
• Полный функционал без ограничений
• Поддержка и обучение сотрудников
• Удобный интерфейс для владельцев и администраторов автомоек

DriverSpa помогает автоматизировать процессы, сократить ошибки, повысить контроль над финансами и увеличить эффективность бизнеса.

Скачайте DriverSpa и управляйте автомойкой современно и удобно.

name: DriverSpa мойка машин, запись
description:
Driverspa - удобный казахстанский сервис по поиску свободных автомоек и мгновенной записи.

Теперь Вам не нужно заранее планировать посещение и подстраиваться под график автомойки. Запустите приложение, выберите автомойку поблизости, подтвердите визит у администратора и следуйте на выбранную мойку – Вас там уже ждут! Процесс займет пару кликов. Приложение подскажет короткий маршрут.

А так же это мобильное приложение для бронирования ближайших к вам автомоек с лучшим качеством обслуживания. Больше никаких очередей! Вы всегда сможете найти ближайшую свободную мойку и забронировать удобное время. И всё это — совершенно бесплатно для автомобилистов!

Сравнивайте цены автомоек и их рейтинг по отзывам других пользователей Driverspa. Мы тщательно следим за качеством оказания услуг нашим пользователям. В случае жалобы на качество работы персонала мы рассматриваем её совместно с руководством мойки и принимаем необходимые меры, чтобы подобные случаи не повторялись. При многочисленных жалобах на автомойку мы удаляем её из нашей базы.

Ваши отзывы очень помогут нам для развития и распространения Driverspa. Мы будем очень благодарны вам за отзыв в App Store.

Автомойки Казахстана, запись, цены. Driverspa, мойка. Займи мойку.

name: DroneSeen
description:
Saw a drone? Drop a pin where you saw it, or search for an address. Record the time and describe what you saw. If you can estimate the height above ground, choose the corresponding range. You can also take a photo or record a short silent clip with the camera. Submitted media is screened automatically before publication.

The map opens on launch and shows approved sightings with approximate locations and times. “Reported by multiple devices” means that at least three separate device accounts submitted observations at similar times and locations. It does not confirm a drone or a threat.

Set alerts for up to ten fixed places and one zone that follows you. With notifications enabled, you can hear about a newly approved sighting even when the app is closed. The moving zone updates its centre while DroneSeen is open.

Share an approved sighting in the Feed. Others can comment, mark it helpful or use “I saw it too” to add their own observation. The count shows how many additional observations are linked to the post.

In Map modes, turn on official drone zones where data is available. Tap a marked area for details and its source.

Find the sighting list and free statistics in the side menu. In Settings you can view or delete your own reports. All features are free. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.

name: DrownedLibrary
description:
**Drowned Library**

Beneath the ocean lies a forgotten library filled with mysterious books, hidden chambers, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

In Drowned Library, explore an enchanting underwater world where discovering a book can change the entire architecture of the library. Rooms rearrange, pathways shift, doors appear, and familiar spaces transform as you uncover forgotten stories.

Every book holds a different power. Some change the layout of rooms, while others introduce new rules that affect how you explore and solve puzzles.

**Features:**
- Explore a mysterious underwater library.
- Discover magical books with unique abilities.
- Watch rooms rearrange as you uncover new stories.
- Solve environmental puzzles using changing architecture.
- Unlock hidden passages and forgotten chambers.
- Experience increasingly complex puzzles across multiple levels.
- Enjoy a colourful underwater atmosphere with immersive visuals.

**Every book changes the library. Every discovery changes your journey.**

Can you uncover the secrets hidden beneath the waves?

name: Druckhilfe
description:
Druckhilfe ermöglicht Druckprofile für AirPrint-Drucker: Du stellst einmal ein, wie du drucken möchtest, speicherst es als Profil – und druckst danach mit einem Tipp, ohne bei jedem Druck durch Dialoge zu klicken.

DRUCKEN AUS JEDER APP
Tippe in Safari, Fotos, Dateien oder Mail auf „Teilen“ und wähle „Druckhilfe“. Dort wählst du ein Profil und startest den Druck direkt, ohne die App zu öffnen.

DRUCKPROFILE
• Eigene Profile speichern, zum Beispiel „Schwarzweiß, 2 auf 1, beidseitig“ oder „Foto 10 x 15“
• Profile umbenennen, sortieren, überschreiben und für einen bestimmten Drucker festlegen
• Deine Profile gleichen sich über den iCloud-Schlüsselbund zwischen iPhone, iPad und Mac ab

EINSTELLUNGEN
• Schwarzweiß oder Farbe
• 1, 2 oder 4 Seiten pro Blatt, optional mit Rahmen um jede Seite
• Beidseitig drucken (lange oder kurze Kante)
• Papierformat wählen
• Entwurf zum Tintensparen
• Nur bestimmte Seiten drucken, zum Beispiel 1-3, 5
• Kopien einstellen

PDF, BILDER UND WEBSEITEN
• Dateien aus „Dateien“ öffnen
• Webseiten als PDF drucken, auf Wunsch nur der Hauptinhalt ohne Menüs
• Vorschau des fertigen Blatts, bevor etwas gedruckt wird

DEIN DRUCKER
• Funktioniert mit AirPrint-Druckern im selben WLAN
• Zeigt Tintenstand und Zustand des Druckers an, wenn er ihn meldet
• Mehrere Drucker möglich

DATENSCHUTZ
Druckhilfe sammelt keine Daten, hat keine Werbung und kein Tracking. Deine Dateien gehen nur an deinen Drucker.

Hinweis: Druckhilfe braucht einen AirPrint-fähigen Drucker im selben WLAN. Es gibt keine Scan- und keine Kopierfunktion.

name: Drumeo Pocket-Batería en mano
description: Drumeo Pocket es tu estudio de batería en el bolsillo para entrenar el ritmo cada día desde cualquier lugar. Practica con un metrónomo visual preciso, domina los rudimentos esenciales, explora grooves interactivos y utiliza la guía de afinación para mejorar el sonido de tu set acústico o electrónico. Lleva un seguimiento diario de tus minutos de ensayo, supera tus metas de velocidad y mantén viva tu racha musical. Además puedes descubrir instructores especializados y reservar sesiones presenciales en cabina de forma rápida y sencilla. Lleva tu técnica de percusión al siguiente nivel con Drumeo Pocket.

name: Dualwise
description:
Dualwise is a roster and endorsement tool for flight instructors. See where every student is, what they need next, and which endorsements are about to expire.

Log each session with time, landings and the ACS tasks you covered. Dualwise follows each student through their course, the ACS and the Part 61 hour minimums, and words every endorsement from AC 61-65K for you.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• All 96 AC 61-65K Appendix A endorsements, worded and dated, with expiry watched and optional reminders
• ACS task tracking for Private, Instrument, Commercial, Flight Instructor and ATP
• Part 61 hour minimums, cited to the regulation, tallied from the sessions you log
• Session logging: time, landings, ACS tasks and notes
• Training record PDFs, checkride packets and study handouts to share with your student
• Document scans for certificates, medicals and other papers
• Student transfer files and full backups through the share sheet

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. Your records stay on your device and work fully in airplane mode. The app collects no data about you or your students.

FREE AND UNLIMITED
Dualwise is free for up to 3 active students. Dualwise Unlimited removes the limit: $5.99 a month or $49.99 a year.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

The endorsement is still the one in your student's logbook, with your signature. Dualwise gives you the correct wording and a record of what you gave.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://jackda10.github.io/privacy/dualwise/

name: duito: Ders Sayacı & Pomodoro
seller_name: ROX GROUP YAZILIM HAVACILIK UZAY VE SAVUNMA SANAYI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
duito; ders çalışma sayacı, pomodoro zamanlayıcı, planlayıcı ve deneme takibini tek uygulamada toplar. YKS, LGS, KPSS ya da okul sınavlarına hazırlanırken her derse ne kadar çalıştığını gör, hedefine kaç net kaldığını takip et ve arkadaşlarınla birlikte çalış. Hesap açmak, e-posta ya da şifre gerekmez.

DERS ÇALIŞMA SAYACI VE POMODORO
• Ders bazında kronometre, geri sayım zamanlayıcısı ve pomodoro modu
• Kilit ekranında ve Dynamic Island'da çalışan canlı sayaç
• Odaklandıkça büyüyen ağaç ya da uykuya dalan kedi
• Süre dolunca ve mola bitince bildirim

PLANLAYICI VE SINAV GERİ SAYIMI
• Günlük görevler ve haftanın günlerine göre tekrarlayan görevler
• Haftalık ders programı
• D-Day: sınavına kaç gün kaldığını ana ekranda gör

DENEME TAKİBİ
• TYT, AYT, LGS, KPSS ve diğer sınavlar için deneme sonuçlarını ders ders kaydet
• Hedef netlerini gir, her derste hedefe kaç net kaldığını gör
• Deneme zorluğunu not et, gelişimini takip et

İSTATİSTİKLER
• Günlük, haftalık ve aylık çalışma süresi; derslere göre dağılım
• En uzun odak, oturum sayısı, molalar ve çalışma serisi

• Uygunsuz ifadeler otomatik engellenir; mesajları ve kişileri bildirebilir, engelleyebilirsin

WİDGET

TELEFON VE BİLGİSAYAR
