name: Duo Bible: KJV & Journal
description:
Designed for iPhone Duo. Works on every iPhone.

A Bible that looks and feels like a real one.

Closed, it is a well-loved black leather Bible. Open it, and the King James text sits on one page with your journal beside it.

MADE FOR THE IPHONE DUO
Open the phone like a book. Scripture on the left page, your notes on the right. Close it and the leather cover is back. On any other iPhone it reads one page at a time, with the journal a tap away.

READ
• The complete King James Version, all 66 books
• Set like a printed Bible, with a red initial at the start of every chapter
• Real page turns. Keep turning from one chapter into the next
• Go to any chapter in two taps from the contents
• Make the words bigger or smaller with a pinch

MARK
• Tap a verse to mark it in gold
• Every marked verse is copied onto that chapter's journal page

JOURNAL
• A journal page for every chapter
• Write what the chapter is saying to you today
• The contents shows a small gold dot on every chapter you have written in

CANDLELIGHT
• A warm, dark page for reading at night

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• Pay once. No subscription and no ads
• No account. Works offline
• Your journal stays on your phone. Nothing is collected

name: Dusk Tales: Werewolves Mafia
description:
One phone, no moderator, and nobody gives themselves away. Dusk Tales is a narrated werewolf and mafia game for 4 to 12 players around one phone. Nobody has to sit out to run the game: the phone deals the roles, guides every night and tells the story of the village.

A NARRATOR, NOT A MODERATOR
A recorded narrator tells one continuous tale of the village of Lipka: a prologue while the roles are dealt, nights told in three acts, a story for every death and every banishment, and an epilogue when one side wins. A second voice, the guide, says only what to do next. You get a story you remember, not a list of instructions.

SECRETS THAT STAY SECRET
- Hold the screen to see your role card. Let go and it hides again.
- At night the phone goes round the circle and visits every living player.
- Every turn takes the same time, whatever your role, so a quick villager gives nothing away.
- The seer, the healer and the werewolves make their choices privately on the phone. Villagers read a short dream and pass the phone on.
- By day, the village argues and votes by show of hands. The phone holder taps who leaves the village, or no one.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Type the names of 4 to 12 players (best with 6 or more).
2. Pass the phone round: everyone sees their secret role.
3. Night falls. Each player in turn takes the phone, does what their screen says, and passes it on.
4. Morning: the narrator tells who did not survive the night, and how.
5. Discuss with a timer, then vote someone out of the village.
6. The village wins when every werewolf is gone. The werewolves win when they match the rest in number.

ROLES
- Werewolf: hunts at night with the pack and blends in by day.
- Seer: looks at one player each night and learns their side: village or werewolf.
- Healer: protects one player from the wolves each night.
- Villager: has no power but their voice. Talk, suspect, and find the wolves.

A VILLAGE FULL OF CHARACTERS
Every player also gets a public village character: the baker, the blacksmith, the midwife, the gravedigger, the bell-ringer and more. 24 characters, each with their own story and illustration. When one of them falls, the village hears their tale.

MADE FOR THE TABLE
- Linocut-style folk-tale art in four inks on cream: role cards, night and dawn scenes, a picture for every fallen character.
- Three narration lengths: Full for the whole story, Shorter, and Minimal for groups who know the game.
- Option to hide the roles of the fallen until the end of the game.
- Narrator subtitles for players who are hard of hearing.
- An illustrated rules book inside the app.
- English and Polish, in voice and text.
- No account and no internet connection needed. Works offline.
- No ads and no in-app purchases.
- Optional: start with the day, so the first vote comes before the first night.

GOOD FOR
- Game nights with friends and family
- Groups who all want to play, with no one left out as host
- Anyone who has played mafia or werewolf at camp or school, and anyone trying a social deduction game for the first time

Gather your group, pass the phone, and let the village fall asleep.

name: Duskling: Dark Mode
description:
Duskling is a Safari extension that gives every website a dark theme on iPhone and iPad. It builds the dark version from each page's own colors instead of inverting them, and leaves sites that already have a dark theme alone.

Pick Dark, Midnight or Dim, and dim bright images if you like. If a site looks wrong, turn Duskling off for that site with one tap from Safari's menu.

Duskling is open source under the MIT license. It has no ads, no accounts and no tracking.

name: DuuCard
description:
Lascia a casa il portafoglio pieno di tessere: con Tessere hai tutte le tue carte fedeltà sull’iPhone, pronte da mostrare alla cassa.

AGGIUNGI UNA TESSERA IN POCHI SECONDI
• Scegli il negozio da un elenco di marchi popolari, oppure crea una tessera personalizzata
• Inquadra il codice a barre con la fotocamera: viene letto da solo
• Hai la tessera solo in un’app o in un’email? Carica uno screenshot e il codice viene riconosciuto automaticamente
• Puoi sempre scrivere il numero a mano: l’app controlla che sia corretto

PRONTA ALLA CASSA
• Codice a barre grande e nitido, sempre nero su bianco per una lettura affidabile
• Luminosità al massimo automatica, che torna normale quando chiudi la tessera
• Lo schermo resta acceso mentre mostri il codice
• Numero della tessera ben leggibile, da dettare al cassiere se serve

FORMATI SUPPORTATI
Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-E e QR Code: i formati usati dalla maggior parte delle tessere fedeltà.

TUTTO IN ORDINE
• Griglia elegante con colori e icone a tua scelta
• Aggiungi un’immagine di copertina personale a ogni tessera
• Note per PIN, scadenze o promemoria
• Cerca per nome o negozio
• Ordina per uso recente, nome o data di aggiunta
• Modifica o elimina le tessere quando vuoi

PRIVATA PER DAVVERO
• Nessun account, nessuna registrazione
• Nessun dato raccolto, nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento
• Le tue tessere restano solo sul tuo iPhone, in uno spazio protetto
• La fotocamera serve solo a leggere il codice: nessuna immagine viene inviata

PENSATA PER TUTTI
• Interfaccia in italiano, semplice e pulita
• Modalità scura
• Supporto per VoiceOver e testo dinamico

Nota: Tessere non è affiliata né sponsorizzata dai negozi e dai marchi citati. I nomi dei marchi servono solo a riconoscere le tue tessere. Alcune tessere con codici che cambiano a ogni utilizzo, generati dalle app dei negozi, potrebbero non funzionare.

name: Dynamia
description:
Dynamia helps you lose weight, build muscle or stay steady, without guilt. Log what you eat and what you burn, and the app simply shows you whether you're moving toward your goal.

YOUR MEALS IN SECONDS 
• A database of more than 3,000 foods (French Ciqual table from Anses), available offline, with usual portions.
• Barcode scanning for branded products (Open Food Facts).
• Free entry when you've weighed it or read the label.
• Grams always stay editable: calories, protein, fat, carbs and sugars update instantly.

YOUR BALANCE, CLEARLY
• Today's balance: eaten minus burned, using your basal metabolic rate and active energy.
• Your water, protein and calorie goal, calculated for you or set by you.
• Your weight trend in kg per week and an estimated date to reach your goal.
• Weekly statistics: weight, calories, sleep, treats.

APPLE HEALTH
If you allow it, Dynamia reads your active energy, steps, weight and sleep. This data stays on your iPhone.

HABITS THAT COUNT
• Points, levels and badges that reward consistency, never the size of a deficit.
• Logging a treat always earns points.
• Weekly leagues: compete with up to 19 other players and climb from Bronze to Diamond.
• Gentle reminders for meals, water and weigh-ins, if you want them.

YOUR PRIVACY
Your meals, weight and sleep stay on your iPhone. No ads, no data sold. Sign in with Apple only, and you can delete your account at any time from the app.

Dynamia gives estimates to help you follow your habits. It is not medical advice: if in doubt, pregnant or dealing with a health condition, talk to a healthcare professional.

name: E-Scooter Rules & Safety
description:
Learn the rules of the road for e-scooter riders in Ireland, and how to ride safely, with short lessons, practice questions and timed mock tests.

UPDATED FOR THE 2026 RULES
The e-scooter rules changed three times in 2026, and every lesson and question reflects them:
• Helmet and high-visibility clothing are compulsory (since 4 September 2026)
• You must be 18 or over to ride (since 2 October 2026)
• The on-the-spot fine is €100, and riding without a helmet or hi-vis is now a fixed-charge offence (since 18 November 2026)

TWELVE SECTIONS
Who may ride · A road-legal e-scooter · Where you may and may not ride · Signs, signals and road markings · Junctions and roundabouts · Sharing the road · Helmet, hi-vis and lights · Bad weather and riding at night · Alcohol, drugs, phones and distraction · Collisions and emergencies · Maintenance, batteries and charging · Penalties and Garda seizure

LEARN, REVISE, TEST YOURSELF
• Read a short lesson, then practise what it covered
• Every question explains why the answer is right, and the trap in the wrong ones
• Questions you get wrong come back until you get them right twice in a row
• Timed mock tests of 30 questions in 30 minutes, in the app's own format
• A Road Readiness score shows how well you know the rules across every section
• Road signs you will meet, with what each one means for a rider

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Switch the app, the lessons and the questions into English, Ukrainian, Arabic, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish or Romanian. Translations are clearly marked until a native speaker has checked them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no adverts and no tracking. Your progress stays on your phone and works offline.

FULL ACCESS
The first section and one mock test are included. A one-time purchase unlocks every section and unlimited mock tests, for good. No subscription.

PLEASE NOTE
E-Scooter Rules & Safety is an independent learning aid. It is not affiliated with the Road Safety Authority, An Garda Síochána, any e-scooter operator or any government body. No official e-scooter test exists in Ireland today; the mock tests use the app's own format. The questions are written from Irish law and the Rules of the Road. Always check the latest official guidance.

name: e-Track Pro
description: eTrack Pro lets you monitor your fleet in real time. View live vehicle locations, speed and status, replay past trips, receive instant alerts, set geo-fences, and send remote commands. Built-in dashcam and SD card video support.

name: E6B Pilot: Flight Calculator
description:
E6B Pilot is a fast, clean flight computer for student pilots, renters and owners. It works offline and has no ads.

WIND TRIANGLE
Enter true course, true airspeed and the winds aloft. Get true heading, ground speed and wind correction angle at a glance, or solve the reverse problem and find the wind from heading and ground speed.

CROSSWIND
Pick the runway and the reported wind. See the crosswind and headwind or tailwind components, with a warning when you are close to your personal crosswind limit.

DENSITY ALTITUDE
Field elevation, altimeter setting and temperature give pressure altitude, density altitude and true airspeed.

METAR DECODED
Type an airport and get the latest METAR in plain English with the flight category (VFR, MVFR, IFR, LIFR). The last report is saved for when you are offline. You can also paste any METAR.

WEIGHT AND BALANCE
A C172S sample is ready to edit. Enter your own empty weight and arm, station arms and CG envelope. See the takeoff CG on the envelope chart and drag the fuel-burn slider to check the landing CG.

E6B PILOT PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
- Time, speed, distance and fuel planner with reserve check
- Unlimited aircraft profiles
- TAF timeline with flight categories for each change group
- Saved airports

Weather data comes from the NOAA Aviation Weather Center (aviationweather.gov).

E6B Pilot is a training and planning aid. It is not for primary navigation. Always verify results against your POH and official sources.

Pro is a one-time in-app purchase. It is not a subscription.

Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/e6bpilot-privacy-policy

name: EAIMAI
seller_name: Shenzhen Chuangxiang Yunqi Technology Co., Ltd.
description: EAIMAI is an intelligent application featuring "immersive listening + intelligent assistant", which can translate while speaking in the call scene to reduce communication costs. Real-time bidirectional translation can be realized in face-to-face communication. Foreign pictures and documents can also be quickly recognized and translated. Whether it is travel agency, international communication or daily use, EAIMAI can make connections smoother, translation more timely and communication more natural.

name: EARTHUS
description:
EARTHUS 는 지금의 지구를 사실 그대로 보여 주는 3D 지구본입니다.

앱을 열면 시계와 날짜, 내 위치, 그 자리의 날씨가 살아 있는 지구 위에 바로 나옵니다. 위성 구름, 바람, 기온, 비와 눈, 바다 수온과 파도, 대기질, 지진·태풍·화산 같은 재난 소식을 지구 위에서 한 번에 봅니다.

내 위치의 기관 자료를 먼저 보여 줍니다.
• 한국: 기상청 관측과 동네예보
• 일본: 일본 기상청 발표
• 미국: 미국 국립기상청(NWS)
• 그 밖의 나라: Open-Meteo 수치모델 값

모든 값에는 어느 기관의 자료인지와 언제 관측·발표했는지가 함께 적혀 있습니다. 기관 발표와 수치모델 값은 구분해서 표시합니다. EARTHUS 가 스스로 예보나 특보를 만들지 않습니다. 재난 판단은 각 기관의 공식 안내를 따르세요.

• 지구를 돌리고 확대해 보고 싶은 곳을 봅니다
• 메뉴에서 위성·날씨·대기·바다·육지·재난·한국 자료를 고릅니다
• 지금 보는 지구를 이름과 메모로 저장하고 공유합니다
• 애플워치에서 내 위치의 기온·바람·하늘 상태와 지구를 봅니다
• 지구 화면과 기본 지도는 앱 안에 들어 있어 인터넷이 느려도 지구가 뜹니다

광고와 구독이 없는 무료 앱이고 로그인이 필요 없습니다. 위치는 동의한 경우에만 앱을 쓰는 동안 받고 배경에서는 받지 않으며, EARTHUS 서버에 저장하지 않습니다. 허용하지 않으면 서울을 기본 위치로 씁니다. 앱 설정에서 위치 사용을 끄거나 잠시 멈출 수 있습니다. 구름·날씨·재난 같은 실시간 자료를 받으려면 인터넷 연결이 필요합니다.

지구 밖 하늘과 우주를 배우고 싶다면 같은 개발자의 별도 앱 AETHERUS(에테르어스)가 있습니다.

문의: dalur@kakao.com · 지원: https://earthus.net/support.html

name: EasyPOS KSA
description:
EasyPOS KSA is a point-of-sale app for restaurants, cafés and retail shops in Saudi Arabia, with ZATCA e-invoicing built in.

Everything runs on your iPhone or iPad. Your sales, products and customers are stored on the device, and selling works without internet.

SELL QUICKLY
• Product grid with categories and search
• Dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders, with tables
• Cash and card payments, split payments, discounts and notes
• Hold bills and resume them later
• Token numbers for collection

ZATCA E-INVOICING
• Phase 1: simplified tax invoices with the ZATCA QR code
• Phase 2: invoices signed and reported to ZATCA (Fatoora) after you onboard with your OTP
• VAT 15% inclusive or exclusive pricing, VAT return summary
• Invoices page with ZATCA status for every sale

RECEIPTS AND INVOICES
• Print receipts with AirPrint or to network (Wi-Fi/LAN) thermal printers
• A4 tax invoices and quotations as PDF to share by WhatsApp, email or Files
• Arabic and English receipts with the new Saudi Riyal symbol

RUN YOUR BUSINESS
• Dashboard with sales, payment methods, categories and busy hours
• Products with units, barcodes, images and Excel import/export
• Inventory, purchases, suppliers, stock counts and reorder list
• Customers and customer credit
• Staff accounts with roles and PINs, shifts and day closing
• Expenses and close history

YOUR DATA
• Stored on your device, no account with us needed
• Back up to Files and restore at any time

Arabic and English interface. Designed for iPhone and iPad.

name: Easytv Play
description:
Easytv Play is a simple player for your own M3U or Xtream Codes list. Live TV, movies and series in one place. No ads, no tracking.

YOUR LIST
• Add an Xtream Codes login or an M3U / M3U8 link
• Live TV, movies and series in their own sections
• Search your library and save favorites
• Resume where you left off
• Download movies and series to your phone
• See the program guide (EPG) on live TV
• Choose subtitles
• Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID
• Sign in with Apple to sync favorites and history across your devices

Easytv Play is a media player. It does not provide channels, subscriptions or content. Add only a source you are allowed to watch. EPG, subtitles and stream quality depend on your provider.

name: Eat This Dessert First
description:
For twelve years we've filled cheesecake jars in Tampa Bay the same way: by hand, in small batches, with every layer showing through the glass. Now the whole counter fits in your pocket.

ORDER AHEAD
Pick your jars, cannoli, Cannoli Affogato or shake, choose a pickup day and time, and it's boxed and waiting when you walk in at 2533 Central Ave, inside Sunshine City Popcorn in St. Pete. Pay in the app, or pay at the counter with cash or card. You can order without an account.

EARN SPOONS
Every dollar earns a spoon. A hundred spoons is a regular jar on the house, and sixty is a Cannoli Affogato. You get ten spoons for signing up, and your first order counts double. Staff scan your member code at the counter, so in-store purchases count too.

GIFT A JAR
Send a gift card by email in about a minute. It comes with a QR code we scan at the counter, and it never expires.

CHEESECAKE OF THE MONTH CLUB
One jar a month, picked up when it suits you. Prepay six or twelve months and it becomes a gift that keeps showing up.

A LITTLE EXTRA
• A free Cannoli Affogato or latte in your birthday month
• Bring a friend: you both get 20 spoons when their first order goes through
• Offers saved in the app, ready to use at the counter or on your next order
• A notification when your order is ready
• Live hours, holiday closures and what's sold out today

We built this app ourselves, on our own server, with no middleman between you and the kitchen. The money you spend on a jar goes into the jar.

Pull up a chair.

name: EchoStealth
description:
Echo Stealth is a stealth game you play with your ears and your hands, not your eyes.

The screen stays almost completely black. You find your way through dark cellars, foggy mills and old catacombs using 3D spatial audio and small vibrations from your iPhone's Taptic Engine. The guards are blind too. They hunt by sound alone, so every step you take is a risk.

LISTEN
• Footsteps, creaking floorboards and guards' breathing come from exactly where they are around you
• Follow the low, warm hum of the exit to escape
• A grunt means a guard heard something. A snarl means it's coming for you.
• Tap to click your tongue and hear echoes bounce back from the walls

FEEL
• Your heartbeat pulses in your hand and speeds up as a guard gets closer
• A strong first beat means danger on your left, a strong second beat means your right
• Crisp ticks warn you before you walk into a wall
• Every footstep is a tiny tap. The faster you move, the harder it hits, and the louder you are.

ONE THUMB
• Slide up to creep forward. Slide further to go faster, and louder.
• Slide left or right to turn
• Touch and hold still to muffle your steps, then slide to sneak silently
• Quick tap to click and listen for echoes

FEATURES
• A spoken tutorial that teaches you to move by sound and touch
• Five handcrafted levels, each with smarter, sharper-eared guards
• Guards that patrol, investigate noises, chase you and search when they lose you
• Loose floorboards, walls that muffle sound, and noise that depends on how fast you move
• Every sound is generated live on your device
• Menus work with VoiceOver, and spoken hints guide you through the tutorial
• Optional faint fog visuals, plus adjustable volume and vibration strength

HEADPHONES RECOMMENDED
Echo Stealth is built around 3D audio. Wear headphones or earbuds so you can tell left from right and near from far. Haptic feedback needs an iPhone with a Taptic Engine.

NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ACCOUNTS.
Pay once and the whole game is yours. No in-app purchases and no ads. Echo Stealth collects no data and doesn't need an internet connection.

Turn off the lights, put on your headphones, and listen.

name: ECR ONE
seller_name: ECR ETKINLIK BILGISAYAR TEKNOLOJILERI ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
ECR ONE is the event app for participants invited by organisers. Create your account once with your phone number; every event you join opens with its own logo, colours and menu.

JOIN AN EVENT
• Enter the event code from the organiser
• Scan the event QR code in the app
• Tap the personal invitation link sent to you

WHAT'S INSIDE AN EVENT
The organiser decides which sections are shown:
• Programme: daily schedule, sessions, programmes for your group
• Stay: hotel information, restaurants and bars
• Activities and workshops
• Announcements and push notifications
• Polls
• Photo gallery and documents
• Weather
• Light show: at concerts and galas thousands of phone screens light up in the same colour at the same time

ACTIVE AND PAST EVENTS
Your ongoing and upcoming events and the content of past events in one list.

PRIVACY
Each event's data is kept separate; an organiser only sees the participants of their own event. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

The light show contains flashing lights; it shows a warning every time it opens and offers a reduced-flash option.

name: Edios FireFlow
description:
FireFlow is a 100% offline, glove-friendly fireground reference, hydraulic calculator, and training companion built for company officers, pump operators, and crews operating across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.

REQUIRED FIRE FLOW & PUMP HYDRAULICS
• Calculates National Fire Academy (NFA) area-based Required Fire Flow ((Length × Width) / 3 × Involvement × Floors + Exposure allowances) alongside Iowa volume cross-checks.
• Computes IFSTA hose friction loss (FL = C × (Q / 100)² × (L / 100)), elevation pressure, Pump Discharge Pressure (PDP), and nozzle reaction force (lbf).
• Flags under-flow thermal risks (steam flash-back & incomplete knockdown) and over-flow dead-weight collapse margins (~8.34 lb/gal).
• Includes 6 one-tap pre-incident scenario presets and oversized glove-friendly +/- steppers with an instant Night-Ops True-Black OLED display mode.

NFPA 1500 1.5× STRUCTURAL COLLAPSE & WIND MAP
• High-contrast tactical diagram mapping structure dimensions, mandatory 1.5 × Height structural collapse safety perimeter, wind origin arrow, and downwind convective spread cone.
• Evaluates ICS Sides A, B, C, and D to highlight Optimal Upwind Attack and Downwind Exhaust Hazard sectors plus construction-class collapse reminders (including lightweight truss warnings).

SCBA AIR MANAGEMENT & THERMAL FLASHOVER CUES
• Rule-of-Air working-time estimator for 30, 45, and 60-minute SCBA cylinders across Moderate, Heavy, and Extreme workloads relative to NFPA 1981 33% low-air EOSTI reserves.
• Quick reference cards for thermal layering, rollover cues, ~1,100 °F flashover threshold, and vent-limited backdraft indicators.

STANDALONE APPLE WATCH PAR COMPANION & SIRI INTENTS
• True-black watchOS companion runs standalone PAR countdown timers (10 / 15 / 20 min) with wrist haptic 2-minute and PAR DUE alerts—even if your iPhone remains in the apparatus cab.
• Syncs active Required GPM, attack line, pump PDP, 1.5× standoff, and upwind side over WatchConnectivity, plus a standalone Digital Crown 1.5× Standoff dial.
• Hands-free Siri & Shortcuts support ("Start PAR check in FireFlow", "Read standoff distance in FireFlow", "Confirm PAR check in FireFlow").

PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DESIGN
• 100% offline local computation—zero accounts, zero cloud sync, zero ads, and Data Not Collected.
• Reference & Training Notice: FireFlow is a reference and training support tool and does not replace official departmental SOPs, Incident Command directives, pump charts, or certified life-safety equipment.

name: Edios Steady Read
description:
SteadyRead makes dense text calmer and easier to decode—100% offline on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Paste any article, email, school notice, study guide, lease, or care sheet—or open a built-in starter passage—and tailor the page to your eyes in seconds.

DESIGNED FOR DYSLEXIA, ADHD & VISUAL COMFORT
• Fixation Anchors: Adjustable bold-start word anchors (35%–50%) guide your eyes smoothly from word to word.
• Gentle Syllable Guides: Break long words into readable syllable chunks while keeping equations, code, prices, and measurements intact.
• Calm Paper Tints (WCAG AAA): Choose Warm Cream, Soft Sage, Powder Blue, or Midnight Dusk with customizable font size, line height, letter spacing, and line width.
• 1-Tap Comfort Profiles: Switch instantly between Dyslexia Relief, ADHD Spotlight (focus band + gentle surrounding dim), and Night Calm.

UNDERSTAND & LISTEN AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Focus Sentence Band & Word Helper: Step sentence by sentence with taps or arrow keys. Tap any unfamiliar word to view its syllables, plain meaning, and hear it pronounced offline.
• Plain-English Clarity & Quick Check: Break complex wording into clear step-by-step takeaways while automatically verifying that 100% of numbers, dates, dosages, and dollar amounts stay untouched.
• Visual Concept Map & Phonetic Glossary: Explore how ideas connect in an interactive map and review key terms with everyday analogies.
• Offline Read-Aloud: Listen hands-free with on-device Apple speech voices from 0.75× to 1.4× pace and live word-by-word highlighting.

100% PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Zero accounts, zero ads, zero tracking, and zero internet required—everything runs locally on your device.

name: EdiosSleep
description:
Drift off to seamless, non-repeating ocean waves, steady bedroom rain, crackling hearth embers, and warm musical sleep beds engineered to play all night with zero loop seams, zero ads, and zero data collection.

15 MIXABLE SOUNDSCAPES & MUSICAL SLEEP BEDS
Blend multiple layers independently with automatic soft-limiting headroom:
• Ocean Waves: Rolling Swell, Gentle Cove Tide, Deep Night Shore
• Rain & Storm: Windowpane Rain, Warm Leaves Rain, Soft Distant Rolling Thunder
• Night & Hearth: Crackling Hearth, Soft Night Crickets, Warm Sleep Noise (Brown, Pink, or Green)
• Warm Musical Beds: Warm Felt Piano, Ambient Chord Pad, Cello Harmonic Drone, 432 Hz Warm Harmonic Bed, 528 Hz Calm Resonance Bed, and Theta-to-Delta Wind-Down

DESIGNED FOR REAL BEDROOMS AT NIGHT
• 0.0-nit OLED Bedside Mode: Automatically fades controls to pure #000000 black after 15 seconds idle while keeping audio playing (tap anywhere to gently wake).
• Gentle Bedtime Timer: Play all night or set a 15–120 minute timer with a smooth raised-cosine fade-out tail.
• Save Local Presets: Store up to 12 custom sound blends privately on your device.

APPLE WATCH, BREATHING & ON-DEVICE APPLE HEALTH
• Apple Watch Bedside Remote: Pause, adjust volume with the Digital Crown, or switch curated mixes without lighting up your iPhone.
• Silent Wrist & Phone Breathing Pacer: Follow 4-7-8 Sleep, 4-6 Slow Exhale, or 4-4-4-4 Box cadences with gentle haptic cues.
• Optional On-Device Apple Health: When enabled by you, reads resting heart rate, HRV, and sleep stage strictly in RAM to gently taper soundscapes after you drift off, and logs completed wind-down sessions (2+ min) locally into Apple Health.
• Siri & Shortcuts: Hands-free voice shortcuts to start mixes, set fade timers, pause audio, or launch breathing.

Edios Sleep is designed purely for relaxation, ambient sleep soundscapes, mindful breathing, and bedtime wind-down. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition.

name: EdT365 Brain Workout
description:
EdT365 Brain Workout is a short daily workout of 13 mini-games, each about a minute long, for practice, fun and keeping your mind flexible. Designed by Edtech365 in Vietnam, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline.

TODAY'S WORKOUT
- Four games from four different skills every day, about five minutes. The plan rotates so each week covers all five skills.
- A training streak and a monthly calendar help you keep the habit.
- The Games library lets you play any game at any time.

FIVE SKILLS, 13 GAMES
- Memory: Block Memory (remember the order blocks light up), Pairs with hand-drawn Vietnamese icons (conical hat, lotus, bronze drum, lantern, phin coffee and more), Shape N-Back.
- Attention: Schulte Table (1 to 25, letters and the Vietnamese alphabet), Odd One Out, Flash Count.
- Speed: Speed Match, Quick Maths.
- Flexibility: Color Word, Rule Switch (sort by color, then by shape).
- Language (Vietnamese content): Word Builder (compound and reduplicative words), Hook or Tilde (pick the right spelling), and a Vietnamese Word Search with every accent.

DIFFICULTY THAT ADAPTS
- Every game has 10 levels. Play well and you move up; have a hard round and you step back to build up.
- The first time you play a game, a short animated guide shows you how.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
- Skill points from 0 to 1000 after every round.
- A five-skill profile, a 30-day chart per skill and personal bests for every game.
Skill points only reflect your results in these games so you can follow your own practice; they are not a test and not a medical tool.

COMFORTABLE TO USE
- Light, dark or automatic appearance; gentle haptics and sounds you can turn off.
- A layout made for iPad.
- English and Vietnamese interface.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: EdT365 Code Logic
description:
EdT365 Code Logic is a puzzle game that trains algorithmic thinking for beginners, in the spirit of primary and lower-secondary computing classes. Every level is a puzzle: guide a friendly robot to collect stars, light lamps and reach the flag by stacking command blocks and pressing Run. No typing, no account, and it works fully offline.

PUZZLES SOLVED WITH COMMAND BLOCKS
- Tap or drag Move, Turn left, Turn right and Light blocks into your program.
- Press Run: the robot follows each command and the running block lights up, so you can see how the program works.
- Run fast, run slow or go step by step to find the mistake.

60 LEVELS, 6 CHAPTERS, ONE STEP AT A TIME
- Chapter 1, Sequences: give commands in the right order.
- Chapter 2, Loops: repeat a group of commands, loops inside loops.
- Chapter 3, Functions: name a group of commands F1 and F2, reuse them, even recursion.
- Chapter 4, Conditions: "If the path ahead is blocked… else…", "If on a coloured tile…".
- Chapter 5, Repeat until: repeat until the flag, write your own algorithm to escape a maze.
- Chapter 6, Debugging: fix an almost-right program with as few edits as possible.

FIND THE SHORTEST SOLUTION
- Every level has a block limit and a shortest solution. Fewer blocks earn more stars.
- Every level is automatically verified to be solvable.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
- A concept card opens each chapter and explains algorithms, loops, functions, conditions and debugging in plain words, with an animated example.
- Stuck? After two unsuccessful runs a hint appears, revealing one more block each time.
- When you solve a level, read your program written as text and see how real programming languages are built.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
- A cute hand-drawn robot, smooth animation, sounds and haptics (both optional).
- Light and dark appearance. On iPad, the board sits on the left and the blocks on the right.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. English and Vietnamese interface.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: Ego Pop! Deflate the Show-Offs
description:
Every week has them: the coworker who explains your own idea back to you, the date who talks crypto for an hour, the gym expert nobody asked. Tap a puffed-up head, she tosses a hairpin, and his ego pops. He zooms off the other way and pops every big head he bumps into. Ahhh. Peace and quiet.

Ego Pop! is a light-hearted chain-reaction puzzle. One tap aims, the room does the rest, and every level is a small plan: who goes first, which way he flies and who he lands on. Nobody gets hurt. Egos just lose a little air.

HOW IT PLAYS
● Tap a big head. She throws a hairpin and the air rushes out of his ego.
● Where you tap decides the flight: tap his right side and he flies left, tap from below and he flies up.
● Every inflated head he bumps into pops too, and so does anyone he falls on.
● Clear the room with the hairpins you have. New show-offs walk in, wave after wave.
● Out of hairpins? Take +1 hairpin or start the level over.

A WEEK OF BIG EGOS
Your week is a map, one stop at a time:
● Monday: an office meeting that could have been an email.
● Tuesday: a first date with a crypto expert.
● Wednesday: the gym, where nobody asked how much he lifts.
● Thursday: book club, where he hasn't read the book but explains it anyway.
● Friday: karaoke night, and he brought his own hype man.
● Saturday: a backyard BBQ where everyone is a grill master.
● Sunday: his brand-new podcast, then a gala to close the week.
Each day ends with a boss: the biggest ego in the room.

NEW TWISTS, ONE AT A TIME
● Big egos need two pins.
● Gym balls bounce him back, faster.
● Armchair experts never fly, so the chain stops at them.
● The hype man pumps a popped ego back up after every move. Pop him first.
● Grill lids block hits from one side.
● Mega egos go boom and pop everyone nearby.
● Stage lights drop on the heads below.

35 LEVELS
● A short tutorial shows the basics in a few taps.
● Each new twist arrives in its own level with a short hint.
● After Sunday the week starts again from Monday.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
● No timer: the room waits for your next tap.
● Different heads, different directions, different chains.

NOTHING IN YOUR WAY
● No ads, no purchases, no account.
● Plays in English or Turkish, following your device language.
● Sound and vibration can each be turned off.

name: Einbürgerungstest-Schweiz.ch
description:
Bereite dich auf den Einbürgerungstest vor: mit Fragen zur Schweiz und zu deinem Kanton, kurzen Erklärungen und einer Quelle zu jeder Antwort.

KANTONE
Aargau, Zürich, Bern, Luzern, St. Gallen und Basel-Stadt, dazu 120 Fragen zum Bund, die überall gelten.

SO LERNST DU
• Nach Thema: Demokratie und Föderalismus, Geschichte, Geografie, Sozialstaat, Kultur und Alltag
• Gemischt üben: Fragen, die du noch nicht sicher kannst, kommen zuerst
• Fehler wiederholen, bis sie sitzen
• Fortschritt je Thema auf einen Blick
• Funktioniert offline, ohne Konto und ohne Werbung

GRATIS UND VOLLVERSION
Gratis übst du mit einem Drittel der Fragen. Die Vollversion schaltet einmalig alle Fragen aller Kantone und die Prüfungssimulation mit Zeit und Auswertung frei. Kein Abo.

WICHTIG
Die Lernfragen sind eigene Formulierungen auf Grundlage amtlicher Quellen und keine offiziellen Prüfungsfragen. Diese App ist kein Angebot einer Behörde. Wie der Test bei dir abläuft, erfährst du bei deiner Gemeinde und deinem Kanton.

name: Elevate Daily Report
description:
Elevate Daily Report is the daily job report and work mileage tool for the crew of Elevate Building & Construction LLC, a decorative and polished concrete company.

At the end of the day the lead on a job sends in what got done. Anyone who drove for work puts in their miles.

How it works:
- Sign in with the 4 digit code the company gives you.
- Tap Daily report. Pick the job, put in the times you got there and left, who helped, the type of work, the steps done, the diamonds or tooling and the chemicals or sealer used.
- Label the area done today and add a photo of the plans with that area circled. Do the same for tomorrow's area.
- Give your best guess on the finish dates and say whether the job is cleared and ready for tomorrow.
- Add at least 3 job photos.
- Tap Miles only to put in work miles without a report.
- Tap Send to management.

The camera and your photos open only when you tap an Add photos button. The app does not track your location. No ads.

Reports and miles go to the company's management. The job part of a daily report, never the miles, is also sent to the flooring contractor the job is for.

Elevate Daily Report is only for the crew of Elevate Building & Construction. You need a sign in code from the company to use it.

name: ELP Ready: English Test Prep
description:
Practice the English check truck drivers face at a roadside inspection or weigh station.

Officers in the US check that drivers can speak and read English well enough to answer questions and read road signs. ELP Ready lets you practice that check in about 5 minutes a day.

FREE EVERY DAY
- Hear an officer question, then choose the best answer
- Learn a good answer you can say, with a tip in Spanish, Punjabi or Russian
- Read road signs with words on them and choose what they mean
- See your results and what to practice next
- A new practice check every day

THE PASS (PAY ONCE, NO MONTHLY BILL)
- Mock inspections you answer out loud
- The app listens and shows which key facts it heard and which were missing
- A new inspection every time you practice
- Works in the truck without internet

Your voice stays on your phone. No account needed.

Built for drivers: big text, big buttons, and adjustable speaking speed.

This is practice only. It cannot promise the result of a real inspection.

An independent practice tool, not run or approved by FMCSA, the US Department of Transportation or CVSA.

name: Embertap
description:
Το Embertap είναι εργαλείο βάρδιας για τον μετατροπέα LD. Πριν κοπεί το οξυγόνο, με χυτοσίδηρο, σκραπ, άσβεστο και όγκο οξυγόνου, υπολογίζει τον τελικό άνθρακα και τη θερμοκρασία εκροής. Μετά το δείγμα γράφετε την υπολόγχη ή το εργαστήριο· το συστηματικό σφάλμα πηγαίνει στην επόμενη χύτευση, μέσα σε όριο.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείτε

Διαλέγετε ποιότητα και συμπληρώνετε ανάλυση χυτοσιδήρου και συλλιπάσματα.
Συνταγή: στόχος C και °C, βγαίνουν οξυγόνο και ψυκτικά. Πρόγνωση: δίνετε τον όγκο οξυγόνου, βγαίνουν C και θερμοκρασία.
Βλέπετε βασικότητα, χρόνο εμφύσησης, προειδοποιήσεις. Την πρόταση ασβέστου ή σκραπ την εφαρμόζετε μόνο αν την πατήσετε, και ξαναϋπολογίζει αμέσως.
Αποθηκεύετε τη χύτευση. Όταν έρθει μέτρηση, γράφετε άνθρακα και θερμοκρασία. Το σφάλμα κοιτά εκείνη την πρόγνωση.
Στην αρχή και στην τάση βλέπετε ευστοχία και μνήμη. Η επόμενη χύτευση κουβαλά τη διόρθωση μόνη της.
Οκτώ παράθυρα: DC04, DC01, DD11, S235JR, S355J2, S420MC, C45, 16MnCr5. Υπερθέρμανση, ψυχρή φόρτιση, υπεροξείδωση, βασικότητα, επαναφορά φωσφόρου, θείο και υπερφόρτωση επισημαίνονται.

Στατική συμβουλή. Δεν αντικαθιστά τη δειγματοληψία. Χωρίς λογαριασμό, χωρίς δίκτυο. Όλα στη συσκευή.

name: Embervault: Gem Forge
description:
Deep beneath the mountain, an ancient forge is waiting for its first spark.

MATCH GEMS AND RELIGHT THE FORGE
Swap neighboring gems to line up three or more. Gather enough Amber before your moves run out. Falling gems can trigger cascades and carry you through three stages of the foundry.

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
Earn Embers and Sigils as you play. Spend Embers to clear a stubborn gem with the Forge Hammer, and spend Sigils on the decorative Jade Crest or three forge skins with new match symbols: Glacier Sanctum, Verdant Archive, and Astral Vault.

VISIT THE BONUS ARCADE
Take a break with Prism Wheel and Gem Slots. Each offers one free play per UTC day. Line up three gems in Gem Slots for a BINGO celebration.

Play offline without an account. All currencies and rewards stay in the game and have no cash value. The game has no real-money betting, cash prizes or withdrawals.

name: Encore Track
description:
Encore Track is a concert diary for people who love live music. Log every show you've been to, pull in the real setlist, and watch your stats grow.

ADD A SHOW IN SECONDS
• Search any artist and pick the night. The setlist, venue, tour and album artwork fill themselves in.
• Search by venue or city instead, or tap the location button to see venues near you.
• Festivals: pick one act, then tick everyone else you saw.
• Small gigs, comedy and theatre can be added by hand.

BRING IN YEARS OF SHOWS AT ONCE
• Say them: "I saw Arctic Monkeys at Qudos Bank Arena in 2019."
• Paste or type a list, one show per line.
• Import from screenshots of tickets, emails or order lists.
• Find shows in your photos and your calendar.

YOUR STATS
• Shows, artists, venues, cities, countries and songs heard live.
• Most-seen artists, top venues and the songs you've heard the most.
• A map of every venue you've been to.
• Shows per year, and a "Year in Concerts" story with music from your year, ready to share.
• Badges to earn as your collection grows.

EVERY NIGHT, REMEMBERED
• Rate the show, note who you went with, your seat and what you paid.
• Add your photos from the night. Encore suggests the ones you took there.
• Upcoming shows count down on your home screen.
• Tap any song in a setlist to hear a preview, or open it in Apple Music or Spotify.

SHARE WITH FRIENDS
• Send a show to the people you went with. If they have Encore Track, they add it with one tap, setlist and all. Your rating, notes and photos stay private.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your shows sync across your devices with your own iCloud account.
• Export a full backup or a spreadsheet any time.

Works with Siri and Shortcuts: "Add a show in Encore".

Setlists courtesy of setlist.fm. Album artwork and song previews from Apple's iTunes Search API.

name: Enroute Taxi
description:
Getting around Belize is simpler with EnRoute Taxi. Whether you live here or are visiting, EnRoute makes it easy to arrange reliable transportation in just a few taps.

Request a ride, get matched with a nearby local driver, and travel with confidence. Our dispatch team monitors every request to help keep your trip on track.

WHY RIDERS CHOOSE ENROUTE

• Fixed fares: See your price before you book. No meter, no surprises.
• Fast matching: Request a ride and connect with nearby drivers.
• Schedule ahead: Book pickups days in advance, ideal for early flights.
• Airport and water taxi options: Quick access to airport transfers and water taxi services.
• Exact pickup and drop-off pins: Share precise locations and open directions in Apple Maps or Google Maps.
• Chat and call your driver: Use quick replies to coordinate easy pickups.
• Ride code: Confirm you're getting into the right vehicle.
• Rate every ride: Your feedback helps keep Belize rides top quality.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Enter your destination.
2. Review your fixed fare and choose your ride.
3. Get matched with a nearby driver.
4. Enjoy your ride and rate your trip.

Your journey starts here. Download EnRoute Taxi today and make your next trip around Belize easier.

name: Eras Puzzle
description:
Build history, piece by piece.

Travel from Stonehenge to the cities of the future and raise 44 buildings with your own hands: a step pyramid, a Doric temple, a Roman triumphal arch, the Temple of the Three Windows at Machu Picchu, a Gothic cathedral, St Basil's in Moscow, an iron tower like the Eiffel, a glass skyscraper... and a floating train station of the future.

HOW TO PLAY
• Memorize the plan before it rolls up.
• Drag every stone to its place. The faster you are, the more coins you earn.
• Set the keystone, knock out the scaffolding... and watch the crowd celebrate.

FEATURES
• 11 eras and 44 buildings, each era with its own music, coins and builders.
• Calm, tactile 3D puzzles: turn and zoom around every building.
• Up to 3 stars per building. Can you finish them all without a mistake?
• Game Center achievements and leaderboards.
• 15 languages. Plays offline.
• No ads. No data collected.

The first four eras (Prehistory, Ancient Egypt, Classical Greece and Ancient Rome) are free. A single one-time purchase unlocks the other seven eras forever.
