name: Escala: Team Generator
description:
Escala picks fair teams for your weekly pickup game — football, soccer, futsal or five-a-side — in seconds.

PASTE THE GROUP LIST
Copy the attendance list from WhatsApp, Messenger or any chat and paste it. Escala reads numbered lines, ticks, emojis, headers and the waiting list, recognises players already in your roster (even by first name or with a typo), marks goalkeepers (GK) and adds “+1” guests.

BALANCED TEAMS, NOT JUST RANDOM
Give each player a level from 1 to 5 — only you see it. Escala tries thousands of combinations and picks teams with the closest total level, one goalkeeper per team, and a different mix from last week. Choose the number of teams or the players per team; extras go to “next up”. Prefer pure luck? Switch to random.

SHARE WITH THE GROUP
Send the teams as a clean picture in bib colours, or as text with colour emojis, ready for the chat. Tap two players to swap them by hand before sharing.

WINNER STAYS ON
With three or more teams, tap the winner and Escala shows who plays next. Set how many wins in a row before the winner leaves and what happens on a draw. Built-in match timer and a table of wins.

ESCALA PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Several groups (Tuesday futsal, Saturday football)
• Levels updated automatically from results
• Together / apart rules (brothers together, the two best apart)
• Dues: monthly members and per-game players, and the list of who still owes
• Each player's record: days, matches, wins, win rate
• Share without the Escala credit
No subscription. No ads. No account. Your players stay on your phone.

In English, Português, Español, Italiano, Français, Deutsch and 日本語.

name: Escape Game: Four Seasons
description:
An escape game where you change the season to solve puzzles.

■ Change the season, change the room
Use the buttons at the bottom to choose spring, summer, autumn or winter whenever you like.
Cherry blossoms bloom, the sun grows strong, leaves turn red, and snow piles up.
Every time you change the season, things in the room change too.

■ Time only moves forward
You can't go back from summer to spring. You pass through autumn and winter to reach next year's spring.
Prepare something and wait for the right season. Think about what happens in the seasons you pass.
The order of the seasons is itself part of the puzzle.

■ 5 stages, 5 rooms
The Sunny Sitting Room, the Pantry Kitchen, the Water Pavilion, the Sunlit Attic, and the Hall of Four Seasons.
Dial locks, combining items, clues from each season...
Search one room carefully and escape. The game is all about the puzzles.

■ Stuck? Use a hint
Hints go step by step, from "where to look" to the answer.
You can read hints you've seen as often as you like, so anyone can reach the end.

■ Recommended for
• Fans of escape games and puzzles
• Players who want puzzles more than story
• Anyone who likes the calm mood of a 3D Japanese house
• Playing a little at a time (progress is saved automatically)

■ Other info
• Free to play to the end (contains ads)
• Buy "Remove Ads" (one-time purchase) to turn off ads and see hints without videos
• No background music. Sound effects and vibration can be turned on or off in Settings
• Japanese and English (change in Settings)

name: Esports Scores
description:
Esports Scores is a clean, fast way to follow esports: scores, schedules, stats and brackets for the teams and leagues you care about.

SCORES
• Past, Today and Upcoming matches, grouped the way tournaments actually play out
• Your teams first, with league cards for everything else
• Works offline with the last scores you loaded

MATCH DETAILS
• Game-by-game results: maps, modes, picks and bans
• Player stats like KDA, CS and items, plus objectives and a gold lead chart where the game has them
• Series stats that sum up the whole match

TOURNAMENTS
• Full bracket graphs that show who plays who next
• Standings with qualification spots
• A short "How It Works" guide for each format

ALERTS
• Notifications when your teams' matches start and finish
• Live Activities on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, with per-team switches

Free, no ads, no accounts, no tracking.

Covers League of Legends, VALORANT and Brawl Stars today, with more games to come.

Esports Scores is unofficial and is not endorsed by Riot Games or Supercell. League of Legends and VALORANT are trademarks of Riot Games, Inc. Brawl Stars is a trademark of Supercell Oy. Some match details come from Liquipedia under CC BY-SA 3.0.

name: Essay Humanizer: Writo
description:
Writo checks whether text reads like AI and helps you rewrite it so it sounds like you.

CHECK FOR AI
• Paste, import or scan text and get a clear AI score in seconds
• See which sentences read like AI, and why: stock phrases, flat sentence rhythm, missing personal voice
• Check for matching sources in academic papers and Wikipedia

MAKE IT SOUND HUMAN
• Humanize text in four styles: Natural, Casual, Academic and Simple
• Compare the score before and after, then fix only the sentences that still sound robotic
• My Voice: add a few samples of your own writing so rewrites match your style

EDIT AND POLISH
• Make text shorter or longer, more formal or friendlier
• Fix grammar and spelling in one tap
• Listen: hear your text read aloud

SPEAK TO WRITE
• Say your ideas out loud and Writo turns them into clean, structured text

FITS HOW YOU WORK
• Import PDF and Word files, scan printed pages, or share text from any app
• Copy, share or export to PDF
• History stays on your iPhone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign in, no ads, no tracking
• Text is sent for processing only when you tap, then discarded. It is never stored or used to train AI
• Turn AI processing off anytime and Check text runs on your iPhone

AI detection is an estimate, not proof. Never use a single score to accuse someone of cheating.

Privacy Policy: https://clefy-frontend.vercel.app/writo/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Eva Vault
description:
Eva Vault keeps the passwords, sign-in codes and passkeys you use for work in one place, on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

It is part of Eva Suite, so your IT team can look after it with you:
• Passwords your IT team resets land straight in your vault, ready to use.
• Logins your team shares appear under Shared with me. Your IT team can let you use a login without seeing its password.
• One-time codes for two-step sign-in sit alongside the password, so you are not tied to one phone. Scan a website's set-up QR code with your camera, or read it straight from your Mac's screen.
• Passkeys you save in Eva Vault work on your other devices too.

Fills in for you
Turn on Eva Vault in AutoFill & Passwords and it offers your passwords, codes and passkeys in Safari and in apps. Face ID or Touch ID is asked for every time.

Private and secure
Everything is encrypted on your devices and on Eva Suite's servers, and Eva Vault locks itself when you step away. If a device is lost, your IT team can remove it and it clears its copy the next time it connects.

Eva Vault is for organisations that use Eva Suite. Ask your IT team to set you up.

name: EventMatic Check-in
description:
EventMatic Check-in is the door app for events run on EventMatic, the event management platform. Staff sign in with the account their organiser gave them, pick the event and the entrance, and check people in.

• Scan the QR code on a guest's pass, ticket or Wallet card with the iPhone or iPad camera
• Find a guest by name or email when they have no pass with them
• Entrances and exits, per entrance or per session
• Clear answers at the door: allowed, already inside, no access to this entrance, outside opening hours…
• Keeps working when the connection drops: scans are saved on the device and sent as soon as the network is back
• Italian, English and Slovenian

The app needs an EventMatic account; it has no public sign-up. Organisers manage events, guests and staff accounts at portal.eventmatic.app.

name: EVocab: English Flashcards
description:
Learn English vocabulary that sticks: flashcards with pictures and native audio, smart reviews, quizzes and a new word on your Lock Screen every hour.

EVocab helps you learn the words you need, at your level. Pick a topic or your CEFR level (A1–C2), study with flashcards, and EVocab brings each word back right before you forget it. Meanings are shown in your own language, so you always know exactly what a word means.

8,000+ WORDS BY TOPIC AND LEVEL
- Everyday topics and every CEFR level from A1 to C2
- A picture for each word, UK and US pronunciation (IPA + audio) and a real example sentence
- Meanings in your language: Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Russian, Arabic, Indonesian and Thai
- Each meaning of a word is its own card, so "bank" (money) and "bank" (river) never get mixed up

FLASHCARDS & SPACED REPETITION
- Flip a card, swipe if you knew it
- Reviews come back after 1, 2, 4, 7, 15 and 30 days, so words move into long-term memory
- Quizzes: multiple choice, true or false, spelling, find the word and a mixed test
- Words you get wrong go to "Review mistakes" automatically, so you practice them again

ENGLISH DICTIONARY & LOOK-UP
- Search an English word, or type a meaning in your language to find the English word
- Tap any word in a definition or example to look it up too
- Every meaning with its CEFR level, so you know which words to learn first

READ & LISTEN
- Read classic books and English news, tap any word for its meaning
- Translate a whole sentence on your iPhone, then save the word with the sentence you found it in
- Listening lessons with transcripts and adjustable speed (0.5x–2x)

LEARN WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
- Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets: a new word every hour, tap to flip and check yourself
- Phrase of the hour: 240 everyday idioms from A2 to C1
- Word of the Day at your level, every morning at 8:00
- Study reminders at the times you choose

STAY MOTIVATED
- Daily goal, streak and statistics
- Streak freezes protect your streak on a busy day, earned by studying
- 6 color themes and a wallpaper of today's word for your Lock Screen

MORE
- Import your Anki decks (.apkg) and study them with spaced repetition
- No account needed: your progress stays on your iPhone
- The app is available in 13 languages

Whether you are a beginner or preparing for an exam, studying for school or for work, EVocab makes learning English vocabulary a few minutes a day.

Privacy policy: https://nhtstudio.com/evoca-privacy-policy.html
Terms of use: https://nhtstudio.com/evoca-terms.html

name: EZ-Fold & Settle
description:
Bring a connected ribbon of metal into a beautifully fitted case. Hold two links, fold around a ruby hinge, brace an angle and release the end fixture when you need more room. Every plate must settle inside before the case can close.

Discover 32 cases, 12 Tight Fits and a free-folding Link Studio. Learn with a real moving chain in Grip School and the Clamp Room. Keep your finished folds in the cabinet and replay your own physical movements in Fold Notes.

name: eZscan Pro
description:
eZscan Pro prints and scans directly with the printers and scanners on your network. No drivers, no vendor app, no account.

FIND YOUR DEVICES
• Finds AirPrint, IPP Everywhere, AirScan (eSCL) and port 9100 printers on your Wi-Fi automatically
• Add a printer or scanner on another subnet by IP address or DNS name
• Search an address range, such as 10.1.2.0/24, to find devices behind routers – up to 1,024 addresses
• Keeps only the devices you use

SCAN
• Scan from the glass or the document feeder, one side or both
• Colour, greyscale or black and white, with your choice of resolution and paper size
• Reorder or remove pages before saving
• Save as PDF or JPEG, share, or print straight away
• No scanner nearby? Scan documents with the camera
• Scans you haven't saved are never lost – they go to Photos when you leave the app

PRINT
• Print PDFs, images and photos
• Speaks the printer's own language: PDF, PWG raster (IPP Everywhere), Apple raster (AirPrint), JPEG, or PCL for older laser printers
• Copies, colour and two-sided printing
• Follows each job until it's printed
• Shows ink and toner levels

YOUR FILES
• Every saved scan is in the Documents tab and in the Files app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
eZscan Pro talks only to the printers and scanners on your network. No account, no tracking, no ads. Your documents stay on your iPhone or iPad unless you print or share them.

Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: Facet Rally
description:
Facet Rally turns classic match-3 play into a focused fantasy adventure. Journey across eight distinct regions, recover the shattered Heartstone, and face the forces of the Hollow King through 57 handcrafted fights.

Every gem serves a purpose. Match rubies to attack, sapphires to build your shield, clovers to recover health, topaz to earn gold, and amethysts to charge your skill. Enemies strike after a set number of moves, making each swap a meaningful tactical choice.

Features:

A complete campaign spanning eight regions

57 encounters, including formidable boss battles

Five gem types with distinct combat effects

Skills to charge and use at decisive moments

A forge for supporting your journey

Guided opening fights and an accessible handbook

Elegant, colorful, and strategic, Facet Rally brings adventure and match-3 combat together in one polished experience.

name: Fairtally
description:
Fairtally is a golf scorecard and stats book that adds up fairly. Score hole by hole for up to four players, see gross, net, Stableford points and the match update as you go, then watch your own numbers improve round after round.

HOLE-BY-HOLE SCORECARD
Big plus and minus steppers for strokes and putts, made for a quick tap between shots. Mark the fairway left, hit or right (hidden on par 3s), add penalties and sand saves. Greens in regulation are worked out for you. A yardage ladder down the left edge shows every hole: played holes fill in, the current hole glows.

EVERY FORMAT AT ONCE
Enter each player's playing handicap and Fairtally allots the strokes by stroke index. Gross, net and Stableford points update live, and match play between the first two players reads like the clubhouse board: "2 UP thru 7", "DORMIE 2", "wins 3&2".

YOUR COURSES
Build any 9 or 18 hole course with par 3 to 6, stroke index 1 to 18 (checked for duplicates) and optional lengths in yards or metres. Rounds keep their own copy of the card, so editing a course never rewrites history.

ROUND SUMMARY
Front and back nine grids with the classic marks: a circle for a birdie, a square for a bogey. Totals, putts, greens and the match result. Share the card as plain text, reopen it to correct a hole, or delete it.

STATS BOOK
For every player, over the last 5 or 10 rounds, 90 days or all time: scoring average, putts per round, fairways hit, greens in regulation, scrambling, scoring distribution from eagles to doubles, par 3, 4 and 5 averages and a trend line. Honest numbers from your own cards. Fairtally is not an official handicap system.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
A crisp club tock on each stroke, a ball rattling into the cup when a hole is saved, a chirp for birdies. Sound and haptics can be switched off. Two dark themes: Fairway Black and Dusk Links.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Play as a guest with no sign-up, or create an account with email and password to keep your card across devices. Guests can save their card to an account later. Works offline and syncs when you're back in signal. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Delete your account and all of your data at any time from the Clubhouse.

name: Family Lineage
description:
Lineage keeps your family's story in one place, and lets the whole family help write it.

SEE THE WHOLE TREE
Your tree starts from its oldest ancestor and grows left to right, one generation per column. Every branch opens and closes with a tap, so a family of hundreds stays easy to read on a phone. Pinch to zoom out and see everyone at once.

FIND ANYONE IN SECONDS
Search by name, place, or year. Lineage opens just the line down to that person and highlights them, so you always see how they fit.

KNOW HOW YOU'RE RELATED
Tell Lineage which person is you, and every page says how you're related: great-great-grandmother, second cousin once removed, half-brother, son-in-law, step-daughter.

THE FAMILY RECORD
- A page for every person: dates, places, parents, brothers and sisters, partners, children, notes, and photos
- The descendants outline: every descendant in order, generation by generation, like a typed family record
- The hourglass chart: anyone's ancestors above and descendants below
- Dates the way genealogy needs them: "about 1890", "June 2006", "before 1920"
- Data checks catch impossible dates, like a death before a birth or a parent who was eight years old

SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY
Invite relatives through iCloud. Owners decide who can edit and who can only look. Everyone sees changes as they happen, and the tree works offline: edits upload when you're back online.

BRING YOUR RESEARCH
Import a GEDCOM file from any family tree program or website, with a preview of what will come in before anything changes. Export your tree as GEDCOM at any time, with the option to hide details of living people.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your tree lives in your own iCloud account and is shared only with the people you invite. No ads, no tracking, no accounts to create.

name: FamilyPet Health
description:
FamilyPet keeps a multi-pet household's health records in one place.

When is the next vaccine due? When was the last deworming? Which medicine did the vet prescribe in March? FamilyPet holds all of it: profiles, schedules, weight and medical records, visible on the first screen.

CORE FEATURES
· Pet profiles - breed, birthday, neutered status, photo
· Vaccine and deworming schedules - a local reminder when something is due, and the next date scheduled automatically once you mark one done
· Weight tracking - every weigh-in kept, trends at a glance
· Medical records - visits, medication and photos on one timeline
· Multi-pet - one profile per pet, no limit, switch anytime
· Multi-role - several family members can keep separate profiles on the same phone

LOCAL FIRST
No account, no sign-up, no server of ours. Health data lives only on your phone, in a local database. Nothing is uploaded.

EXPORT AND BACKUP
Export to CSV or JSON, or make a local backup. The file is created on your device and you decide where it goes.

FREE
Every feature is free in this version. No ads, no in-app purchases.

Privacy policy: https://beyondouyuan.github.io/privacy/familypet-en.html

name: Farmácia Soberana - Loji
description:
Faça suas compras na Farmácia Soberana, em Caratinga/MG, sem sair de casa.

No app você:
• Navega pelas categorias: perfumaria, dermocosméticos, higiene, alimentos e muito mais
• Busca produtos e monta o carrinho com os preços atualizados da loja
• Finaliza o pedido e acompanha suas compras
• Recebe notificações com ofertas e avisos da loja
• Fala com a farmácia pelo WhatsApp direto do app

Sua conta pode ser excluída a qualquer momento, em Conta > Segurança.

name: Fast Ticket
description:
Fast Ticket คือแอปซื้อขายบัตรคอนเสิร์ตต่อกันระหว่างแฟนเพลง ทั้งที่หน้างานและล่วงหน้า ทุกการจ่ายเงินผ่านบัญชีกลางของแอปเท่านั้น

ซื้อบัตรหน้างานได้ไว
- เห็นคนขายบัตรที่อยู่หน้างาน เรียงจากคนที่ใกล้คุณที่สุด พร้อมจุดนัดรับและระยะห่าง
- เลือกซื้อเฉพาะคนที่อยู่หน้างานตอนนี้ หรือซื้อล่วงหน้าก่อนวันงาน

ดูที่นั่งก่อนซื้อ
- ผังที่นั่งของสถานที่จัดคอนเสิร์ตหลัก เช่น ราชมังคลากีฬาสถาน อิมแพ็ค อารีน่า ธันเดอร์โดม สเตเดียม สนามศุภชลาศัย และอีกกว่า 60 แห่ง
- ผังของแต่ละคอนเสิร์ตตามที่ผู้จัดประกาศ พร้อมราคาแต่ละโซน
- บอกว่าคุณจะได้นั่งตรงไหน ระยะถึงเวที และวิวจากที่นั่ง

ปลอดภัยทุกการซื้อ
- จ่ายเข้าบัญชีกลางด้วย QR พร้อมเพย์ บัตร Visa หรือ Mastercard หรือ Alipay ระบบยืนยันให้อัตโนมัติ
- เงินพักไว้จนคุณได้รับบัตร ผู้ขายต้องส่งมอบภายใน 2 วัน ไม่งั้นคืนเงินเต็มจำนวน
- ผู้ขายทุกคนยืนยันบัตรประชาชนและบัญชีรับเงิน
- ถ่ายรูปบัตรทั้งตอนส่งมอบและตอนรับเพื่อเป็นหลักฐาน
- แชทกับผู้ขายได้หลังชำระเงิน และติดตามสถานะการส่งมอบบนหน้าจอล็อกและ Dynamic Island
- ผู้ซื้อและผู้ขายรีวิวกันได้ทุกครั้ง พร้อมโปรไฟล์ที่แชร์ให้คนอื่นดูได้

ขายบัตรง่าย
- ถ่ายรูปหน้าและหลังบัตร เลือกโซน ประเภทบัตร และราคา แล้วลงขายได้ทันที
- เห็นค่าธรรมเนียมและยอดที่จะได้รับก่อนลงขาย
- แชร์ลิงก์บัตรที่ขายให้เพื่อนมาซื้อได้

อื่นๆ
- ธีมสว่าง ธีมมืด และธีมตามสภาพอากาศ
- 9 ภาษา: ไทย อังกฤษ จีน เกาหลี ญี่ปุ่น ฮินดี พม่า ลาว และเวียดนาม

ติดต่อ: Fast_ticket@outlook.com

name: Fastays
description:
Fastays – Flight Booking, Hotels & Holiday Packages

Plan and book your next trip with Fastays, an all-in-one travel booking app from an IATA-accredited travel agency. Book domestic and international flights, hotels, holiday packages and bus tickets, and add trip protection, visa assistance, international eSIMs and cruises – all in one place. Ideal for business trips, family vacations, honeymoons, pilgrimages and international holidays.

FLIGHT BOOKING – DOMESTIC & INTERNATIONAL
• Book flight tickets on domestic and international routes
• Compare airfares across airlines for one-way and round-trip flights
• Find low fares for your travel dates
• Check flight schedules, baggage allowance and fare rules before you book
• Student, senior citizen and armed forces fares, where available
• View and manage your air ticket bookings in the app

HOTEL BOOKING – DOMESTIC & INTERNATIONAL
• Book hotels across India and abroad
• Compare budget hotels, premium stays, resorts and luxury hotels
• Search by destination, dates and guests
• Review room categories, amenities and booking conditions before you book
• Stays for business travel, family holidays and weekend getaways

HOLIDAY & TOUR PACKAGES
• Domestic and international tour packages
• Family holiday and honeymoon packages
• Spiritual tours and pilgrimage packages
• Adventure, nature and group tours
• Review itineraries, inclusions and accommodation details
• Customisable holidays based on your travel preferences

BUS TICKET BOOKING
• Book bus tickets between cities across India
• Compare AC, non-AC, sleeper and seater buses
• Choose your seat, boarding point and dropping point

TRIP PROTECTION
• Add trip protection to eligible bookings. Review the coverage, benefits, terms and conditions before selecting a plan.

VISA ASSISTANCE
• Tourist visa assistance for international destinations
• Check visa requirements, documents and application steps
Visa decisions and processing times are determined by the relevant embassy, consulate and immigration authorities.

INTERNATIONAL eSIM
• Travel eSIM data plans for supported destinations
• Check data, validity and device compatibility before you buy
• Stay connected abroad without roaming hassles

CRUISE BOOKING
• Cruise holidays and itineraries
• Compare sailing dates and cabin categories

WHY BOOK WITH FASTAYS?
• Flights, hotels, holidays, buses, visas, eSIMs and cruises in one app
• IATA-accredited travel agency
• Clear fare details, with cancellation and refund policies shown before you pay
• Domestic and international travel options for every budget

Download Fastays and book your next trip – flights, hotels and holiday packages in one place.

name: FaveBridge: Personalized AAC
description:
My Words is a picture-based communication board for nonspeaking children, including children with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Its 123 English picture cards can also be used alongside speech. 

When your child taps “I,” who do they see? With Fave Bridge, it can be a character who looks like them. Choose their skin tone, hairstyle and favorite outfit together. Now the child pointing to themselves on “I” and reaching out on “WANT” has the same face and clothes. Change the look once and it follows them across personalized cards, even in a phrase they’ve already built.

name: Feira Organizada
description:
Bem-vindo à feira! Tomate, cenoura, banana, uva, abacaxi, melancia e muito mais chegaram todos misturados. Sua missão é deixar cada caixote com um tipo só.

COMO SE JOGA
• Toque num caixote para pegar os itens iguais de cima
• Toque em outro caixote: eles vão para lá se estiver vazio ou com o mesmo item no topo
• Cada caixote guarda até 4 itens. Caixote completo fecha com tampa
• Arrume todos os caixotes para concluir a fase

SEM VIDAS E SEM RELÓGIO
Jogue no seu ritmo. Toda fase tem solução, e o botão de reiniciar está sempre à mão.

CENTENAS DE FASES
Começa bem tranquilo e vai ganhando mais frutas e legumes. Fases difíceis com um caixote vazio só e fases com lona, em que os itens do fundo ficam escondidos até chegarem ao topo.

DESAFIO DO DIA
Uma banca nova todo dia, igual para todo mundo. Faça dias seguidos, mantenha a sequência e ganhe reforços.

MODO ZEN
Bancas sem fim, com reforços livres e música calma, para relaxar sem pensar em fase.

REFORÇOS
• Desfazer: volta a última jogada
• Dica: mostra o próximo movimento
• +Caixote: um caixote vazio a mais quando apertar

VISUAL DE FEIRA
Toldo listrado, bandeirinhas, caixotes de madeira e frutas desenhadas à mão, com sons e música de feira que podem ser desligados.

O jogo é gratuito, com anúncios. Uma compra única remove os anúncios e libera reforços extras sem vídeo. Funciona sem internet.

name: FellowHaven
description:
Churches were never meant to stand alone. FellowHaven connects the churches of your city so they can share what they have and help carry what others need, whether that's chairs for an outreach, volunteers for a food drive, or a van for youth camp.

HOW IT WORKS
• Post a need. Tell other churches what you need, like supplies, volunteers, a musician or equipment, and by when.
• Other churches respond. Churches nearby see your need on the Needs Board and send a short response offering to help.
• Connect directly. You get each other's contact info and work out the details together, by email or phone.

BUILT FOR CHURCHES
• Browse the Needs Board without an account.
• A free church account lets you post needs and keep track of every response in one place.
• See who responded and reach them with one tap.
• "My responses" keeps the needs you offered to help with, along with the church's contact info.
• Report any post that doesn't belong.
• Light and dark mode, and support for larger text.

FREE AND PRIVATE
FellowHaven is free for churches. There are no ads, no tracking, and we never sell your information. You can delete your account anytime in Settings.

Connect with local churches in your city. FellowHaven is made by Theos Preparation LLC.

Questions or ideas? Email office@theospreparation.com or visit fellowhaven.com.

name: fernFM
description:
fernFM brings radio from around the world to your iPhone. Calmly designed, no account, no ads, no tracking.

DISCOVER
Spin the globe and hear what is on in Lisbon, Lagos or Tokyo right now. Zap through stations like on an old radio, or see stations near you.

SEARCH
Find stations by name, genre, country and language. Broken streams are filtered out, station names cleaned up.

YOUR LIBRARY
Collect favorites, sort them the way you like and build station playlists. Skip moves on to the next station in the list.

SONG HISTORY AND RECOGNITION
fernFM remembers the songs you heard. If the stream has no title, ShazamKit recognizes the song at the tap of a button.

LISTEN ANYWHERE
AirPlay, lock screen and Control Center controls, background playback. If a stream drops, fernFM reconnects.

FERNFM PLUS
A one-time purchase, no subscription, with Family Sharing:
• CarPlay with favorites, playlists, discover and history
• Save songs, sort them into collections and export them as an Apple Music playlist
• iCloud sync between your devices
• Home screen widgets

PRIVATE
Your data stays on your device and in your own iCloud account. fernFM has no server of its own.

Station data comes from Radio Browser, an open database maintained by volunteers.

name: FESK: Global Study Desk
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
FESK is a study desk for students and researchers worldwide.

LIVE 1:1 SESSIONS WITH ACADEMIC EXPERTS
Book a private video session with a vetted human expert — professors, PhD supervisors, journal reviewers. Get help with your thesis plan, research design, statistics, manuscript structure, journal selection, or graduate and scholarship applications. Sessions run as a video call right inside the app, no Zoom or Meet needed. Send your questions and documents to the expert before the session.

PRACTICAL GUIDES, WRITTEN FOR REAL RESEARCH
More than 200 guides across 10 topics: research methods, academic writing, statistics and data, publishing and peer review, graduate school, study abroad and scholarships, learning science, academic careers, research integrity and open science, and responsible use of AI in research.

READ OFFLINE
Save any guide with one tap and it stays on your iPhone — read it on the train, in the library or on a flight. Adjust the text size for comfortable long reading, and share guides with classmates or your supervisor from the share sheet.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in to manage your sessions and academic profile. You can delete your account at any time from the Account tab.

FESK does not sell digital content in the app. Live sessions are a person-to-person service between you and one human expert.

name: Festéjala · Invitaciones
description:
Festéjala crea la invitación digital de tu boda, XV años, bautizo o cumpleaños en 5 minutos.

Cuéntale tu fiesta en dos líneas (quién festeja, cuándo y dónde) y la IA arma los textos, el itinerario y los colores. O hazla paso a paso. Tus invitados la abren desde WhatsApp en el navegador del celular, sin descargar nada, y confirman con un toque.

TU INVITACIÓN, A TU GUSTO
• 12 diseños propios para cada fiesta: cambias colores, letras y fotos.
• Enciende o apaga cada parte: mensaje, itinerario, vestimenta, hospedaje, notas, galería y libro de firmas.
• Mapa para llegar y cuenta atrás hasta el gran día.
• Se abre como un sobre y se guarda sola con cada cambio: nunca pierdes nada.

TUS INVITADOS, EN VIVO
• Cada invitado confirma cuántos adultos y niños van, si tiene alergias o comida especial, y te deja un mensaje.
• Libro de firmas con sus buenos deseos; ocultas los mensajes que no quieras mostrar.
• La invitación se ve las veces que haga falta: vistas ilimitadas, también en el plan gratis.

CON INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL
• Arma la invitación completa a partir de dos líneas.
• Reescribe cualquier texto con el tono que elijas.
• Escribe el mensaje para mandarla por WhatsApp.
• Saca la paleta de colores de una foto.

PLAN PREMIUM (por evento)
• Pases por familia con su nombre y sus lugares, y confirmaciones sin límite.
• Lista de invitados: quién la abrió, quién viene y quién falta.
• Recordatorio por WhatsApp en un toque.
• Mesa de regalos y lluvia de sobres.
• Música (tu canción o una melodía de cajita musical) y galería de 30 fotos.
• Entrada con código QR el día de la fiesta.
• Lista en Excel, 30 ayudas de la IA y sin marca.
• En línea hasta un año después de la fiesta.

EN LA APP
• Tus invitaciones, crear una nueva y tu cuenta, siempre a mano.
• En la puerta, escanea con la cámara los pases QR de tus invitados o búscalos por su nombre.
• Manda cada invitación por WhatsApp o copia su enlace en un toque.

GRATIS PARA EMPEZAR
Invitación completa con cualquier diseño, vistas ilimitadas, hasta 25 confirmaciones en línea, 3 fotos, mapa, cuenta atrás, itinerario, libro de firmas y 2 ayudas de la IA. Lleva la marca «Hecha con Festéjala». Sin anuncios.

Privacidad: para tu cuenta solo pedimos correo y contraseña. No vendemos datos ni los usamos para publicidad. Puedes borrar una invitación o tu cuenta entera cuando quieras.

name: Fiafia: Imposter Game Night
description:
Imposter is the party game where everyone gets the same secret word – except one player. Pass one phone around the table, tap to see your word, then talk, bluff and vote. Did you find the imposter, or did they fool the whole group?

HOW TO PLAY
• Add 3 to 20 players and pick the categories.
• Pass the phone: each player taps the card to see it in private, then taps again to pass.
• Everyone has the secret word. The imposter does not, and has to fake it.
• Take turns saying one word or clue, then vote.
• Catch the imposter and they get one last chance: guess the word and they still win. Miss them and the imposter wins.

WHY GROUPS LIKE IT
• One phone, no internet, no account, no ads. It works on a plane or at the cabin.
• Fair draws: nobody is the imposter over and over, and the first player is never the imposter unless you want it.
• No repeats: words don't come back until you have played them all.
• Written by people, not machine-translated: every word has a similar word and hints that make sense.

MODES AND OPTIONS
• Classic: the imposter sees "You're the impostor" and the category.
• Look-alike word: the imposter gets a close word and doesn't know it.
• One or more imposters, an optional hint, a timer and points round after round.
• Questions (premium): everyone answers the same question, the imposter gets a different one.
• My categories (premium): write your own words, perfect for inside jokes.

FREE FOREVER
Four full categories (Food, Animals, Around the House, Places – 320 words) with every basic mode. No time limit, no trial that turns into a charge.

ALL CATEGORIES
Unlock 10 more categories (Jobs, Sports and Games, Soccer, Travel and Vacations, Holidays and Parties, School and Office, Nature and Weather, Music and Shows, Tech and Internet, Tricky Words), Questions and My categories. Choose Weekly or a one-time Forever purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The weekly subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; you can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. "How to cancel" is always one tap away in the app.

Terms: https://www.fiafia.games/en/termini/
Privacy: https://www.fiafia.games/en/privacy/
Help: support@fiafia.games

name: Fibble: Daily Number Path
description:
Tap a tile, then a neighbor. Those two are your seed. From there, every next tile must be a neighbor equal to the sum of the two before it. 2, 3, 5, 8, 13. How far can your chain go?

One new board a day, the same for everyone. Each board hides a chain as long as par, and a longer one beyond it for the players who look harder. Boards get tougher through the week: par 6 on Monday, par 8 by the weekend.

The tiles you can tap next are marked, and the number you need is shown, so the puzzle is finding the route, not doing the math.

Every tap plays the next note of a melody built from the Fibonacci sequence. Reach par and your chain plays back.

Share your result as a card that shows how far you got without giving the board away.

Your stats and streak stay on your phone. No account, no ads.

Fibble is free. One optional purchase, Archive and Unlimited, opens every past daily board and unlimited new boards at Easy, Medium or Hard.

Support: pursuitlabs.ai/fibble

name: Fieldwork: Minesweeper
description:
Make a little room to think. Fieldwork is a calm take on Minesweeper for iPhone, where clearing safe squares brings a small landscape to life.

Follow a journey through 100 fields and 12 chapters. Learn the classic neighboring numbers first, then use outlined regions to find new deductions. Each new board is checked for a logical solution, and your first move opens a safe area.

• Reveal safe squares and mark suspected mines with separate Reveal and Flag controls.
• Ask for a next step when you get stuck. Fieldwork explains the deduction before you decide whether to apply it.
• Play in Meadow, Coast, or Moonlight. Your current board and journey carry across appearances.
• Return at your own pace. The app saves your board, flags, and progress on your iPhone.
• Adjust touch feedback and motion in Settings. Fieldwork also respects the iPhone's Reduce Motion setting.

Play fields 1–9 free. A one-time Full Journey purchase opens fields 10–100 as you progress. No game account is needed. Gameplay works offline.

name: Fify: Unfollowers & Insights
description:
Fify is a followers analyzer built on two circles: people who follow you and people you follow. The overlap is your mutual follows; outside it are the accounts not following back and your fans. Fify sorts every difference into lists and shows what changes over time.

NO PASSWORD, NO LOGIN
Pick the official data file (ZIP) you downloaded from Instagram and Fify reads it on your iPhone. Only your username is asked; your password never is.

LISTS
• Not following back, fans and mutual follows
• Who unfollowed you and new followers (two files compared)
• Accounts you unfollowed
• From your file: pending and recent follow requests, blocked, restricted, close friends, hashtags you follow
Search, sort and open any profile with one tap.

BULK UNFOLLOW HELPER
Select accounts not following back. Fify opens their profiles one by one; you tap "Unfollow" yourself and the next person is ready when you return. Fify never acts on your account: it does not follow, unfollow or like anyone.

POST INSIGHTS AND ACCOUNT STATS
• Likes, comments, saves and reach for each post
• Best post, average likes, engagement rate
• Gained followers chart; reach, age and gender when included in your file
• Your own likes and recent searches

ILLUSTRATED GUIDE
A 16-step guide shows how to request your data file. Add a new file a few days later and Fify compares the two.

LOGIN ACTIVITY
Logins in your file are listed with date, device and city; new devices and cities are marked.

PRIVACY
• Your password never reaches Fify.
• Your file is read on your iPhone; your lists and history stay on your device.
• No ads are shown in the app.

ALSO
File history, several accounts, dark theme, 76 languages, iPad layout.

FIFY PRO
Unlocks every list in full, stats details, unlimited comparisons, full history and several accounts. Weekly, monthly or yearly subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period unless cancelled; payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://psikolograndevu.org/fify/privacy.html

Fify is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.

name: FileSignatures
description: FileSignatures helps you fingerprint files, compare checksums, and verify downloads on iPhone and iPad. Pick a document from Files or share a file into the app, then generate SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-1, or MD5 digests in seconds. Hashing runs locally on your device, so file bytes never leave your phone or tablet. Compare two files side by side or check a file against a reference hash you trust. Save fingerprints to a personal library, filter by algorithm, export results, and review a timestamped history of every operation. A clear dashboard keeps Calculate, Compare, Library, and History one tap away, with a thoughtful layout on iPad. Built for installers, archivists, developers, and anyone who needs quick integrity checks before sharing or storing files. Legacy algorithms stay available when you need them, with in-app guidance about when stronger hashes are preferable. Preferences, saved fingerprints, and history live in Application Support on device. Export options help when you want a text record you control. FileSignatures turns checksum work into a calm, focused routine—whether you are validating one download or maintaining a library of trusted digests.

name: FileStudio: Cleaner & Player
description:
FileStudio shows exactly what's filling up your iPhone and helps you get the space back — safely, in a few taps. Plus a full movie player for everything you keep.

SEE WHAT'S USING SPACE
• A clear storage chart of photos, videos, screenshots, apps & system and free space
• Your biggest files, sorted by size
• Storage health at a glance

ONE-TAP SAFE CLEANUP
• Finds similar and duplicate photos and keeps the best shot
• Old screenshots: expired tickets, receipts and web grabs
• Large videos over 100 MB
• Nothing is deleted without your review — everything goes to Recently Deleted for 30 days

SHRINK VIDEOS INSTEAD OF DELETING THEM
• Compress videos to 1080p, 720p or 540p and see how much you'll save before you save it
• Trim videos to keep just the moment you love
• Keeps the original date and location

POWERFUL SEARCH
• Search by what's in your photos — "dog", "beach", "food"
• Find screenshots by the text inside them
• Smart filters: "videos > 500 mb", "last month", "favorites 2024"
• Smart Search runs entirely on your iPhone

A REAL MOVIE PLAYER
• Resume where you left off, with Continue Watching
• Auto-play next with "Up Next", Skip Intro and episode list
• Subtitles (.srt and built-in), audio tracks and subtitle size
• Gestures: double-tap to skip, swipe for brightness, volume and seeking, pinch to fill
• Playback speed, sleep timer, screen lock, Picture in Picture and AirPlay
• Add your own movies from the Files app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• All analysis happens on your device
• No accounts, no tracking, no data collected

Available in English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Indonesian — switch instantly inside the app.

name: Filldo: To-Do & Habits
description:
Filldo keeps the day's tasks and the habits you want to stick with in one place. Every check fills a ring, and the days behind you stack up neatly on a timeline.

■ To-Do
Sort tasks into Today, Upcoming and Someday. Repeat them daily, on weekdays, weekly, monthly or yearly — and anything you didn't finish rolls over to the next day.

■ Habits
Pick the days each habit repeats and check it off. See your current and best streaks, your 30-day completion rate and which weekdays you're most consistent on.

■ Timeline
Look back day by day at what you got done and how well you kept your habits this month.

■ Reminders
Get a reminder at the time you choose for any task or habit, plus an optional evening nudge when something is still left for today.

■ Home Screen Widget
Check off today's tasks and habits right from your Home Screen, without opening the app.

■ Your Own Pen Color
Choose the color your checkmarks are drawn in, or mix your own. Calm tones in both light and dark mode.

■ No Account, No Server
Start right away with no sign-up. Your tasks and habits are stored only on your device and are never sent to anyone, including us. No ads, no trackers. Moving to a new phone? Take everything with you in a backup file.

name: Find 5 - Play More
description:
Find 5 makes organising and finding 5-a-side football games easy.

ORGANISE A GAME IN A MINUTE
Add the venue, kick-off time, surface, cost per player and what's there: showers, a bar, changing rooms, parking, bibs or floodlights.

FILL YOUR LINE-UP
Add players who are usually free that day. When the line-up is full, extra players wait on standby and step in if someone drops out.

FIND PLAYERS NEARBY
Short of players? See who lives close by and usually plays that day, and send them an invitation they can accept or decline. Or publish your game so anyone nearby can take an open space.

JOIN A GAME
Browse published games near you, see the cost, surface and facilities, and grab a space in a tap.

STAY IN THE LOOP
Get alerts when you're invited, added to a line-up, or when a game changes or is cancelled. Organisers can share a WhatsApp link with the players in their game.

Free for everyone during the launch.

name: Find Claudia
description:
Claudia is hiding, and she thinks you'll never find her.

Each board is split into colored regions. Your job: find every Claudia using the rules alone.

• One Claudia in every row
• One in every column
• One in every color
• No two Claudias touch, not even diagonally

Tap a tile to cross it out. Double-tap to check if Claudia is there. Every puzzle can be solved with logic alone, no guessing ever needed.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Easy: no hearts, no clock, and unlimited hints that explain each step
• Normal: three hearts, and you're on your own
• Hard: one wrong guess and it's over. Race the clock for a spot on the Game Center leaderboards

FEATURES
• Boards from 6×6 to 10×10
• A short tutorial that teaches you how to think like a solver
• Hints that explain the reasoning, not just the answer
• Drag to cross out many tiles at once
• Soft, satisfying wooden sounds
• Fully offline: no ads, no accounts, no tracking
• English and Portuguese

Claudia has opinions about how you play. Win flawlessly and she'll pretend she isn't impressed.

name: Find the Spy - Party Game
description:
There are spies at your table. Can you catch them in time?

Find the Spy is a party game for 3 to 12 players on a single phone that gets passed around the table. No account, no internet, no ads. Open the app and you are in your first round in under a minute.

HOW IT WORKS
Each player holds a finger on the screen to see their secret word. Lift the finger and the word disappears, so nobody else sees it. A "pass the phone to..." screen appears before every secret, so nobody peeks by accident.

Then, in turns, everyone says something about their word without saying it. Say too much and you hand the game to the spies. Say too little and you start to look like one.

The vote is spoken, the way it should be at a real table: accuse, defend, argue and agree out loud. Then someone taps the chosen name on the phone. If a finger slipped, undo the accusation.

TWO MODES
Classic: civilians share one secret word. Spies get no word at all and know they are spies, so they have to bluff from what they hear.
Sleeper Agent: everyone gets a word, but the spies get a similar one, and nobody knows their own role. Careful what you say: you might be the one with the wrong word.

SIMPLE RULES
- Pick how many spies there are, from 1 up to a minority of the group. The app suggests a number.
- The group gets exactly one accusation per spy.
- The accused stays at the table but has to stay silent. Whether you were right is only revealed at the end of the round.
- Spies win if time runs out or if an accusation misses.
- Round timer from 1 to 10 minutes, or none. It pauses while you decide who to accuse.
- Ticking in the last 10 seconds and an alarm you can hear in a noisy room.
- Points after every round and a scoreboard for the whole evening. Player names are remembered.

WORDS
Words are places, events and situations you can describe by what is around them: what you see, what you hear, what happens there. 6 packs with nearly 900 word pairs: Standard, Party 18+, Film & TV, Music, Sport and Food. A word does not repeat until a pack is used up, not across separate games and not after you close the app.
All packs are unlocked and free in this version.

NEW TO IT?
A 3-screen intro on first launch, which you can skip.

AN ADULT GAME
The Party 18+ pack is explicit: sex, drugs (only as words to guess) and vulgar language. You can only play it after confirming that everyone is over 18. There are also optional end-of-round penalties, plus an 18+ option with spicier dares between players. All of them are off by default. Turn them on only if everyone wants them. The game works just as well without.

PRIVATE
No account and no personal data collected. When something breaks, the app sends only an anonymous error report so we can fix it.

The app is available in English and Romanian, switchable in Settings.

Gather your friends, pass the phone around and find out who lies best.

name: Fire safety shop wholesaler
description:
Fire Safety Shop Wholesaler is a management application designed for wholesalers and distributors of fire safety products.

The app helps wholesalers manage their products, organize inventory, handle bulk orders, and streamline daily business operations through one convenient platform.

Key Features:

- Manage fire safety products and product details.
- Organize and update product inventory.
- Receive and manage wholesale orders.
- Connect with retailers and business customers.
- Track order details and manage business activities.
- Enjoy a simple and user-friendly interface.

Fire Safety Shop Wholesaler makes it easier to manage wholesale operations and keep your fire safety product business organized.

Manage your wholesale business efficiently with Fire Safety Shop Wholesaler.

name: FirmusLimen
description: FirmusLimen es un producto de preparación para viajar al Festival del Tomate de Buñol.. Organiza tus preparativos en siete controles: entrada y pulsera, protección personal, objetos prohibidos, ida y regreso, punto de reunión, enjuague y cambio de ropa, y tiempo y suelo. Consulta tu progreso, identifica lo pendiente, guarda una ficha de emergencia, genera una lista para la víspera y anota lo aprendido después del regreso. Tus datos permanecen en el dispositivo y no necesitas crear una cuenta. Es una herramienta independiente de preparación: no vende entradas ni ofrece información meteorológica o de transporte en tiempo real. Prevalecen siempre los avisos oficiales de la organización.

name: Fischerprüfung Sachsen-Anhalt
description:
Üben für die Fischerprüfung in Sachsen-Anhalt mit den Fragen des amtlichen Katalogs: unverändert, mit Quellenangabe bei jeder Frage.

Gratis
- 157 Fragen, jede vierte Frage in jedem Fachgebiet
- Prüfung 1: 60 Fragen, 15 je Fachgebiet, aufgebaut wie die offizielle Prüfungssimulation, beliebig oft wiederholbar
- Fehler wiederholen und Lernfortschritt je Fachgebiet

Pro (einmaliger In-App-Kauf)
- Alle 619 Fragen aus Fischkunde, Gewässerkunde, Gesetzeskunde und Gerätekunde
- Unbegrenzt neue Prüfungen mit zufällig gewählten Fragen
- Verlauf der Prüfungen

Datenschutz
Keine Daten, kein Konto, keine Werbung. Die App arbeitet ohne Internetverbindung, der Lernfortschritt bleibt auf dem iPhone.

Quelle
Fragen: Fragenkatalog zur Fischerprüfung, Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Tourismus, Landwirtschaft und Forsten des Landes Sachsen-Anhalt (Stand 28.04.2022). Weiterverwendung nach § 5 Abs. 2 UrhG; unverändert übernommen.

Unabhängige App. Nicht verbunden mit dem Land Sachsen-Anhalt oder einer Fischereibehörde.

Keine Garantie für das Bestehen der Prüfung.

Fehler gefunden? Bei jeder Frage gibt es die Funktion "Fehler melden".

name: FixArc
description:
Το FixArc είναι το βιβλίο συνεργείου για συσκευές, οδηγούς και μετρητές. Κρατάει κάθε εργαλείο από τον σχεδιασμό ως την απόσυρση, χωρίς λογιστικά φύλλα.
﻿
Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς
﻿
Αρχική
Βλέπεις πάγια σε λειτουργία, εκκρεμή PM, λήξεις βαθμονόμησης και ανοιχτές εντολές. Πάνω δεξιά στέλνεις ένα σχόλιο και επιστρέφεις στην αρχική.
﻿
Πάγια
Νέο πάγιο: κωδικός, όνομα, τύπος, σταθμός, υπεύθυνος, ημερομηνία αγοράς, διάρκεια ζωής. Αναζήτηση και φίλτρα (ενεργά, ειδοποίηση, αποσυρμένα). Στην καρτέλα δανείζεις ή επιστρέφεις (κάθε δανεισμός +1 κύκλο· κοντά στο όριο ζωής εμφανίζεται υπόδειξη αντικατάστασης), προσθέτεις πιστοποιητικό, ή προωθείς / επιστρέφεις στα επτά στάδια — σχεδιασμός, προμήθεια, σε λειτουργία, βαθμονόμηση, συντήρηση, δεσμευμένο, αποσυρμένο — με σημείωση. Τα αποσυρμένα δεν δανείζονται.
﻿
Έργα
Τα PM που έληξαν μπαίνουν σε ουρά. Ανοίγεις διορθωτική εντολή (σύμπτωμα, παύση, ανταλλακτικά, ώρες). Την ξεκινάς και την κλείνεις. Το κλείσιμο γράφει την τελευταία συντήρηση και το επόμενο PM.
﻿
Έλεγχος
Πίνακας πράσινο / κίτρινο / κόκκινο για τις λήξεις. Επεξεργάζεσαι αριθμό πιστοποιητικού, εργαστήριο, αβεβαιότητα και ημερομηνία.
﻿
Άλλα
Πίνακας κύκλου ζωής, ή εξαγωγή CSV (πάγια, ανοιχτές εντολές, λήξεις 30 ημερών) με το φύλλο κοινοποίησης του iOS.

name: Fiyat Gör: Raf ve Ürün Okuyucu

description:
Fiyat Gör, mağazanızın fiyat sorgulama noktasıdır. Tableti ya da telefonu rafa, kasaya veya mağaza girişine koyun; müşteri ve personel ürünün güncel fiyatını kendisi görsün.

OKUTMA

ÜRÜN KÜNYESİ

TimTicari, İşletmenizin Ticaret Timi.

name: Flaretech Technician
description:
Flaretech Technician is the work app for Flare Technical Services LLC's gas maintenance technicians in the UAE. It is for Flaretech employees only. Accounts are created by the Flaretech office, and there is no public sign-up.

With the app, technicians can:
• See the service visits and call-outs assigned to them, with customer, site and equipment details
• Start a job and record arrival and completion
• Work through the safety checklist for each visit (regulators, hoses, leak tests, shut-off valves, detectors)
• Take photos of installations and attach them to the service report
• Capture the customer's signature on the phone
• Keep working without signal: jobs are saved on the phone and synced to the office automatically when back online

The office team schedules work and follows progress in the Flaretech Service web portal, and customers receive a service report for each visit.

name: FlashChat
description:
Com o Flash Chat, você acompanha as conversas, as oportunidades e a agenda da sua equipe pelo celular. Entre com sua conta de trabalho e escolha o espaço de atendimento da sua empresa.

Encontre conversas usando a busca, os filtros e as pastas. Responda com texto, fotos, áudios ou documentos e receba notificações de novas mensagens. No menu da conversa, você pode consultar os dados do contato, gerenciar tags, pesquisar no histórico, assumir, transferir ou resolver um atendimento.

O indicador de IA mostra quando o assistente está atendendo e quando está pausado. Ao retomar a IA, você pode esperar pela próxima mensagem do cliente ou fornecer contexto para a conversa. As ligações com e sem IA estão disponíveis nas conexões que têm o adicional de chamadas habilitado.

Em Pipelines, selecione uma etapa para consultar as oportunidades e atualizar o andamento de uma negociação. Na Agenda, alterne entre o dia e o mês para consultar horários, criar compromissos ou remarcar um agendamento.

O download é gratuito. Para usar o Flash Chat, entre com uma conta de trabalho vinculada a uma assinatura ativa da plataforma. Sua empresa define os espaços, os canais e as permissões disponíveis para cada pessoa.

name: Flight Chat - Trip Messenger
description:
Chat with your travel group and share photos over Bluetooth, with no internet or data. It works on a plane in airplane mode and abroad without a data plan.

When your parents post in the family chat what they need, you can ask the crew for them. Decide together where to go first after landing or which in-flight meal to pick, and share a photo of the clouds outside.

When the trip ends, the chat disappears by itself. A chat lasts 7 days; if the trip runs long, extend it 7 days at a time, up to 30 days. Make as many group chats and 1:1 chats as you need.

Install the app and join by QR with your group before you board. Anyone in the group can show the invite QR to bring in someone else, and see who has joined right under the code. No sign-up, no login and no server.

Flight Chat is a one-time purchase with no in-app purchases.

Chats stay on your phone and the phones of your group. Nearby phones may temporarily store and relay messages to work without internet. Bluetooth can be slow or drop, so delivery is not guaranteed. There is no end-to-end encryption yet: use it with people you trust and do not send sensitive information. Use another means for emergencies.

name: FlipDash: Gravity Runner
description:
Tap to flip gravity. Dodge the spikes. Beat your best.

FlipDash is a one-tap endless runner made for quick, addictive runs. Your neon cube dashes between the floor and the ceiling — tap to flip gravity and land on the other side before you hit a spike. Double tap mid-flip to change your mind and snap back.

It starts easy. Then it gets fast. Every 100 meters the speed climbs and the colors change. How far can you go?

ONE TAP, ENDLESS SKILL
• Simple to learn: one finger, tap to flip
• Double tap to reverse a flip mid-air
• Every run is different, and every level can be beaten
• Near misses pay off: "CLOSE!" calls give bonus coins
• Short runs, perfect for a quick break

COMPETE EVERY WEEK
• Weekly Game Center leaderboard that resets every Monday
• All-time best leaderboard
• See your rank and the next friend to beat after every run

UNLOCK AND COLLECT
• 12 neon skins: squares, rounded cubes and orbs
• Earn coins in every run
• New daily missions every day
• Daily login streak bonus, up to 140 coins

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Works offline
• Haptics and punchy sound effects
• Free to play with ads. Remove ads between runs with a single one-time purchase.

Flip. Dash. Repeat.

name: FloePost--Slide to Dock
description:
FloePost muuttaa jäisen postipihan harkintaa vaativaksi liukupalapeliksi.

Jokainen pingviini liukuu suoraan, kunnes sen pysäyttää lunta, jäätä tai toinen lintu. Laatikot eivät pysäytä liikettä, joten sinun on asetettava jääpalikoita koukulla ja luotava uusia pysähtymiskohtia ennen kuin jokainen toimitus lukittuu paikoilleen.

Suunnittele siirtojen järjestys huolellisesti. Toimitetut pingviinit jäävät pelialueelle ja voivat auttaa seuraavalla reitillä tai estää sen. Aukot pysäyttävät koko liikkeen, ja selkeät ennakkonäkymät näyttävät, mihin liuku todella päättyy.

Pelaa neljässä jäisessä postipihassa ja tutustu 24 huolella suunniteltuun tasoon. Kerää leimoja, kertaa pelisäännöt ja kehitä mahdollisimman lyhyitä reittejä rauhallisella, vaakasuuntaisella jääkentällä, joka kannustaa keskittymään ja ratkaisemaan pulmia.

name: FlopCop: Product Fit Scanner
description:
FlopCop shows how well a cosmetic product fits your skin.

HOW IT WORKS
• Photograph the front of the product and its ingredient list.
• AI reads the ingredient list from your photos.
• Answer two short screens about your skin and your preferences.
• FlopCop scores the product against your profile, on your phone.

THE RESULT
• A score out of 100, split between the formula and your profile
• The formula’s ingredients, explained in plain language
• When to use the product
• How it compares with other products scored the same way

MY SHELF
• Products you check are saved to one list, grouped by type and ranked by fit.
• Mark the products you own.
• Choose ingredients to avoid. When FlopCop finds one on a label, the product scores Very Low.

BARCODES
• Products already in FlopCop’s library load from their barcode in seconds.

PRIVACY
• No account required.
• Your profile and product list are stored on your phone and are not sent to us.
• Photograph product packaging only, not people.
• We keep submitted photos to improve our label reading, build our product library, comparisons and recommendations, and research products and markets, including for our own products. We may license product information derived from them, but not the photos.

PRICE
• Free, with a daily scan limit.

FlopCop provides cosmetic product information based on product labels and your answers. It does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition and is not a medical device. Always check the product label.

name: Flow Twin: Lucky Rhythm
description:
What flows with you today?

Welcome to Flow Twin: Lucky Rhythm, a magical world of living crystal cards, charming characters, and daily moments of discovery.

Every day brings a new rhythm, a new possibility, and a new reason to shine.

Explore a universe filled with sparkling crystals, cosmic light, and beautiful animated characters.

3 FREE DAILY DRAWS

Enjoy up to three free crystal card draws every day.

Each draw reveals a character, a luck tier, and a personal Buff message designed to bring a little inspiration to your day.

What will your next draw reveal?

7 LUCK TIERS

Discover seven distinct luck tiers: X, C, B, A, S, SS, and SSS.

Each tier features its own visual identity, crystal effects, and atmosphere. From gentle crystal glows to spectacular golden radiance, every tier has something special to offer.

72 UNIQUE CHARACTERS

Meet 72 beautifully designed characters across five distinct families.

Discover their personalities, explore their Buff messages, and enjoy a collection of magical companions.

LIVING CRYSTAL CARDS

Experience cards that feel alive.

Floating characters, shimmering particles, glowing crystal frames, and dreamy cosmic backgrounds bring every reveal to life.

YOUR DAILY LUCKY BUFF

Every character carries a unique message and a gentle suggestion for your next step.

A small spark of inspiration can make an ordinary day feel extraordinary.

CHARACTER COLLECTION AND HISTORY

Browse the character gallery and revisit your previous draws.

Your history is saved locally on your device, so your crystal memories stay with you.

FEATURES

3 free draws every day
72 unique characters
7 luck tiers
Beautiful animated crystal cards
Personalized Buff messages
Character gallery and draw history
No account or login required
On-device experience
Five supported languages
No real-money prizes, betting, or paid rerolls

Your day. Your rhythm. Your crystal.

Flow Twin - Let your lucky rhythm shine.

Flow Twin is an entertainment and lifestyle experience. Luck tiers and messages do not predict future events or guarantee real-world outcomes.

name: Flowire
description:
Flowire est l'application des élèves des studios de yoga et de Pilates qui travaillent avec Flowire. Connectez-vous avec le compte ouvert par votre studio : vous y retrouvez son planning, vos réservations, vos carnets et vos abonnements.

Réserver un cours
• Le planning du studio, cours par cours, avec les places disponibles.
• Réservation et annulation en un geste, dans les délais fixés par le studio.
• Liste d'attente : quand une place se libère, une notification vous prévient.
• Réservation des machines en pratique libre, si votre studio en propose.

Carnets et abonnements
• Achat d'un carnet de cours ou d'un abonnement, avec paiement en ligne sécurisé.
• Le nombre de cours restants sur vos carnets et le suivi de vos abonnements.
• Vos factures, à consulter et à télécharger.

Notifications
• Confirmation de réservation et rappel avant le cours, selon les réglages de votre studio.
• Place libérée en liste d'attente.
• Messages de votre studio.
• Vos préférences de notification se règlent depuis votre profil.

Pensée pour le téléphone
• Les liens de votre espace élève reçus par e-mail s'ouvrent directement dans l'application.
• Vos réservations s'affichent dans l'agenda de votre téléphone, par abonnement de calendrier.
• Si votre studio suit la régularité de ses élèves, partagez votre série de semaines en story depuis la feuille de partage du téléphone.

Votre compte
• Profil, coordonnées et moyens de paiement.
• Suppression du compte depuis l'application, à tout moment.

Flowire fonctionne avec les studios abonnés à Flowire. Si votre studio ne vous a pas encore ouvert de compte, demandez-lui l'accès.

name: FlowSeat: Seated Tai Chi
description:
FlowSeat turns a few minutes in an ordinary office chair into a calm, clearly guided movement break inspired by Tai Chi.

Pick a length from 2 to 30 minutes and follow along. Every movement is shown step by step, with what to do and why it is taught that way.

GUIDED FLOWS
• Five ready-made flows: 2, 5, 10, 18 and 30 minutes
• Six movements: Opening & Closing, Cloud Hands, Holding the Ball, Parting the Wild Horse's Mane, Repulse Monkey, and a gentle spine and ankle sequence
• A player with captions, optional voice, a slower pace, mirrored pictures and a supported variation with smaller, lower movements
• A "Pause if uncomfortable" button on every session

MADE FOR OFFICE CHAIRS
• Tell FlowSeat what you are sitting on and it adapts
• On a chair that can roll, movements that could shift it are swapped or reduced
• Fixed armrests and tight spaces are handled too

HONEST PROGRESS
• Rings, streaks and a 30-day calendar built only from sessions you actually did
• Skipped time never counts as practice
• Unfinished sessions are saved as partial, never as completed

MEAL IDEAS
• A week of lunch and dinner suggestions in balanced, vegetarian and vegan styles, with approximate protein
• Optional: enter your height, weight, age and activity for an estimated protein range and daily energy needs
• Suggestions only. Nothing you eat is tracked.

LEARN
• Short notes on Tai Chi principles and where each movement comes from
• A science library that says plainly what research on seated Tai Chi does and does not show

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything stays on your iPhone
• No camera, microphone or health permissions

IMPORTANT
FlowSeat is a gentle movement practice, not medical advice or treatment, and seated practice is not the same as standing Tai Chi or rehabilitation. Stop if you feel pain, tingling, numbness, dizziness, unusual breathlessness or unsteadiness. Meal and nutrition figures are general estimates, not a diet plan made for you. Character images are AI-generated illustrations.

name: FlywayDo
description: Flyway is a nature-inspired migration strategy puzzle where every decision shapes the journey of a living flock. Plan safe routes between wetlands, manage limited flight energy, choose the right formation, and adapt to headwinds, night travel, city lights, and changing habitat conditions.

name: Fogón: Learn to Cook
description:
Recipes are forgotten. Technique isn't.

Fogón is a course that teaches you to cook from scratch, in the order a chef learns: the knife and mise en place first, then heat, stocks, the five mother sauces, doneness for meat, fish and eggs, rice, doughs and the oven. Every technique comes with illustrated, animated steps, the mistakes almost everyone makes, and a recipe to practise it that same evening.

• 12 modules and 42 techniques: dicing an onion, sautéing without stewing, clear stock, béchamel, hollandaise, risotto, a steak cooked just right, crisp fish skin, bread, shortcrust, roast chicken and more.
• Every step drawn and animated: the knife cutting, the boil coming down, the steak changing colour inside. No videos to pause with messy hands.
• The usual mistakes and how to avoid them, for every technique: why mayonnaise splits or chicken breast dries out.
• 42 recipes to practise, with timers inside each step and servings that rescale by themselves.
• Cooking mode: big steps and the screen kept on.
• A weekly menu and a shopping list by aisle that writes itself from the servings. And you can share it.
• On iPhone and iPad, right there on the worktop.

The first module is free and complete: the knife, mise en place and the classic cuts, with their recipes. The rest unlocks with a single payment: no subscription, no ads, shared with Family Sharing.

Fogón collects no data. Your progress and your list stay on your device.

name: Foldbook
description:
Foldbook is a quiet notebook for Texas Hold'em decisions—practice tables, study partners, and guided hand notes.

Open polished tables with classic card motion and a calm, book-inspired look. Drill against fourteen study partners, each with a distinct decision style, so you can test lines at your own pace.

Run solo drills or join practice tables and study-circle rooms. In-hand notes offer move-by-move guidance, and Hand notes let you replay choices on past streets.

Join the daily four-set drill, climb an ELO-style progress rating, unlock trophies, and see where you stand on the leaderboard. Track hands played, win rate, and drill completions on your profile.

All marks, ratings, and trophies are virtual. Foldbook is for entertainment and education only—no real-money gambling.

name: Food Recalls: Pantry Alert
description:
Pantry Alert tells you when a food recall may affect you.

Pick your state and, if you like, the stores where you shop. Pantry Alert checks for new recalls from the FDA and the USDA every few hours. It alerts you when one reaches your area or names one of your stores.

SCAN WHAT YOU BUY
Scan the barcode on a product and Pantry Alert saves it on your phone. If a recall lists that exact barcode, the app tells you to check the label right away. Scanned items show their product name when it can be found, and you can type your own name for anything it cannot find.

CLEAR, COLOR CODED ALERTS
• Red or amber: recalls that match something you scanned
• Blue: recalls that name one of your stores
• Gray: other recent recalls in your state
• Green: nothing found in your scans

YOU CHOOSE HOW MANY ALERTS
Turn on an extra alert for every Class I recall in your state. Class I recalls carry the highest risk of harm.

DON'T SEE YOUR STORE?
That is fine. Picking stores is optional. You still see every recall in your state, and everything you scan is still checked.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY
Your scans, purchases, and receipt photos stay on your phone. Pantry Alert has no accounts, no ads, and no tracking. Our server only knows your state, your stores, and the address Apple uses to send you notifications.

DATA SOURCES
Recall notices come from the FDA (openFDA) and the USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service. Product names come from USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts (openfoodfacts.org), which is available under the Open Database License.

IMPORTANT
Pantry Alert shows recall notices that government agencies publish. It can miss a recall or misread one. A match is a reason to check the label and the official notice, not proof that your product is affected. Pantry Alert is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA or the USDA.

name: Food-Collab
description:
Food Collab met en relation les restaurants et les créateurs de contenu.

CRÉATEURS
• Découvrez les restaurants près de chez vous sur la carte et leurs offres de collaboration.
• Proposez-vous en un geste : repas offert ou réduction selon l'offre.
• Discutez avec le restaurant dans la messagerie, photos comprises.
• Signez le contrat de collaboration dans l'app, présentez votre QR code sur place, puis envoyez la preuve de votre publication.

RESTAURANTS
• Créez votre fiche : photos, adresse, menu.
• Publiez des offres : ce que vous offrez et le contenu attendu (story, reel ou post).
• Choisissez les créateurs qui vous correspondent, validez leur visite en scannant leur QR code et vérifiez leur publication.
• Suivez les vues de votre fiche et de vos offres.

SANS ENGAGEMENT
Explorez l'app sans créer de compte, puis créez-le avec Apple ou Google quand vous voulez : tout ce que vous avez fait est gardé.

UNE COMMUNAUTÉ SÛRE
Chaque profil et chaque conversation peut être signalé ou bloqué, et les signalements sont examinés sous 24 heures.

Food Collab est réservé aux personnes de 18 ans et plus. Les contenus publiés dans le cadre d'une collaboration doivent être signalés comme tels, conformément à la loi.

name: FoodFate
description:
Can't decide where to eat? Let fate pick.

Search any city or use your location, choose what you're craving (pizza, sushi, tacos, BBQ and more) and spin. FoodFate picks one spot and shows you the actual storefront, so you know exactly where you're headed.

• One tap, one pick. Take the guesswork out of eating.
• Real storefront photos and restaurant logos
• Group mode: friends join with a room code, everyone adds picks, fate decides
• Explore every spot on the map and find new places to eat
• Save favorites to lists, then spin a list
• Directions, call, website or the full Apple Maps place card in one tap
• Light and dark themes, VoiceOver and Larger Text support
• Works on iPhone and iPad

No account. No ads. Your lists stay on your device.

name: Football Tactics Academy
description:
Read the pitch. Choose the next move. Understand why it works.

Football Tactics Academy helps players, coaches and managers learn football tactics, from the first principles of space and support to professional match planning.

271 teaching lessons and 720 match situations cover attacking, defending, pressing, transitions, formations, goalkeeping, set pieces, small-sided football and futsal. Every question includes a pitch diagram and three answers.

LEARN STEP BY STEP
Follow a clear tactics tree through six levels. Start with player roles and passing angles, then work towards game models, opposition analysis, defensive coordination and training design. Open the extra detail when you want the full explanation.

WATCH THE MOVE
995 moving diagrams across 988 lessons and situations show passes, runs, pressing and defensive cover. Play, pause, replay, slow the move down or step through each phase. A white ring marks the ball carrier, and the ball stays visible during passes. Enlarge the pitch for a closer look.

SEE THE DECISION
Every question starts with a still pitch picture. Choose an answer, then see what changes and why the other options cause problems.

WORK THROUGH YOUR MISTAKES
Finish a unit by revisiting the answers you missed. Correct answers return after longer gaps, while mistakes return sooner. Try five match situations whenever you have a few minutes.

KEEP A USEFUL REFERENCE
Search the course, browse the football glossary, bookmark lessons and save your own notes. Optional coaching tools include a tactics board, formation presets and a substitution planner.

LEARN OFFLINE
The full course is included in the app. Progress is saved on your device, and you can export a backup to move it elsewhere. There is no account, advertising, subscription or in-app purchase. External references need an internet connection.

Written in UK football language. These are teaching examples, with links to published coaching references. Team instructions and competition rules can vary.

name: Foothills Forest School
description:
The phone app for Foothills Forest School's director and staff. Sign in with your school email and see what needs doing:

• Needs you: the school's to-dos and checklist, with one-tap Done and Undo.
• Numbers: this week against last week (money in from the books, website visits, posts), each with its source.
• Promote: approve teachers' photo posts and make new posts for the school's Facebook and Instagram.
• Alerts: choose which notifications this phone gets.

Everything stays on the school's own system, not on the phone. Sign-in is by a 6-digit code emailed to an address on the school's staff list. The app is built for Foothills Forest School on Studio Bolster.

Not on staff? Tap "Try the demo" on the sign-in screen to look around with sample data.

name: ForceMe
description:
ForceMe sıradan bir hatırlatıcı değil: seni gerçekten yaptırana kadar peşini bırakmayan bir antrenör.

RASTGELE SAATTE HATIRLATMA
Görevine bir zaman aralığı ver (örneğin 09:00-12:00). ForceMe her gün bu aralıkta farklı bir saatte hatırlatır; alışıp görmezden gelemezsin. Genelde hep aynı saatlerde yapıyorsan (örneğin 11:00-11:30), hatırlatmaları otomatik olarak o saatlere daraltır.

CEZA SİSTEMİ
"Bugün yapamam" dedin ya da kaçırdın mı? Ertesi gün görev ikonunun etrafında kırmızı halka belirir ve hedefin katlanır: 10 şınav, x2, 20 şınav. Cezalıyken hatırlatmalar daha sık gelir. Yaptığın anda ceza silinir.

GÜN İÇİNDE TEKRAR EDEN GÖREVLER
"08:00-18:00 arası 25 dakikada bir 1 dk yürüyüş" gibi görevler kur. Her turda bildirimden Yaptım, Yapamadım, kısa erteleme ya da "Bugün daha fazla hatırlatma" seç. Turların en az yarısını yaparsan gün kurtarılmış sayılır.

ERTELE AMA KAÇAMAZSIN
Ertelediğin görev kilit ekranında ve Dynamic Island'da geri sayıma dönüşür: "20 sayfa için son 04:59". Süre dolunca tekrar hatırlatılırsın.

GÜNLÜK, HAFTALIK, AYLIK
Tek seferlik (yapılana kadar her gün sorar), her gün, haftanın belirli günleri, ayın belirli günü ya da N günde bir.

SAMİMİ GERİ BİLDİRİM
Her başarıda "Helal olsun!" gibi tebrikler, her sabah "Dün 4/5 görev başardın, aynı performansı bekliyorum!" özeti.

İKONLU VE SESLİ BİLDİRİMLER
Her göreve ikon ve renk seç. Bildirimler görev ikonuyla gelir; aşağı çektiğinde ilerleme ve geri sayımı gösteren kompakt bir kart açılır.

HER CİHAZDA
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch ve Mac. Görevlerin iCloud ile eşitlenir; Mac'te menü çubuğundan bekleyen görevlerini gör.

GİZLİLİK
Hesap yok, reklam yok, takip yok. Verilerin cihazında ve kendi iCloud hesabında kalır.

name: Forever Grid
description:
Forever Grid is a journal and notebook built around one simple idea: every day gets a page, and every page lives on a grid you can see at a glance.

WRITE EACH DAY
Open the app and today's page is waiting. Jot thoughts, plans and to-dos. Checklists carry forward until they're done, so nothing slips through the cracks.

SEE YOUR WHOLE YEAR
Zoom out to the month or the whole year and see which days you wrote, what you finished and what's still open.

NOTES THAT CONNECT
Keep longer notes alongside your days. Type >> to link to any note or day, and tap a link to jump straight there.

FORMATTING THAT FEELS FAMILIAR
• Titles, headings, bullet, dashed and numbered lists, quotes
• Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough and five highlight colours
• Tables that fit the screen
• Photos from your library or camera, in small, medium or large

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your journal is stored on your device and syncs through your own iCloud — we never see it.

Forever Grid is free.

name: Fortline Merge: Tower Defense
description:
Fortline Merge is a merge tower defense strategy game. Summon soldiers, merge identical units into stronger ones and defend your castle wall against wave after wave of the Crimson Legion.

Summon and merge
Spend supplies to summon a random unit from your deck onto a 3x5 battlefield. Drag two identical units with the same stars together to merge them, up to 7 stars. Every star makes a unit much stronger.

Hold every lane
Enemies march down three lanes and stop at the first soldier in their way. The front row hits 40% harder but takes more damage, so where you place a unit matters as much as what you merge. Leave a lane empty and the enemy walks straight to your wall.

20 units, 6 roles
Militia, bowmen, knights, catapults, field medics, alchemists, drummers, the King's Champion and more: infantry, ranged, cavalry, siege, support and magic. Build a 5-unit deck and level up your army with cards.

6 generals
Lead with a hero general and unleash their ability at the right moment: a rally cry, an artillery barrage, a rain of arrows, a cavalry charge, a holy shield or a frost storm.

War orders and wall weapons
After waves 5, 10 and 15, choose 1 of 3 war orders from a set of 16, so every tower defense match plays out differently. Raise your wall cannon and ballista with supplies in the middle of battle.

Campaign, Daily Siege and Endless Defense
Fight through a 120-stage campaign across 6 regions, each with its own boss. Take on a new Daily Siege with fixed rules every day, and see how many waves you can hold in Endless Defense on the Game Center leaderboard.

Chests, cards and castle upgrades
Win chests, open them for unit cards and gold, and grow your card collection from common soldiers to legendary heroes. Upgrade your castle for good: thicker walls, more starting supplies and stronger wall weapons. The Campaign Pass, daily and weekly quests and achievements always give you a new goal.

Offline play
Battles and the campaign work without an internet connection. Rewarded ads and purchases need a connection.

A cute tower defense and castle defense game for all ages, in 20 languages.

The game contains optional in-app purchases and optional rewarded ads.

Terms (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://patpatgames.com/fortlinemerge/privacy.html

name: Fortune Horoscope
description:
Tap the glowing orb, watch it burst into stars, and read your horoscope for the day.

Fortune Horoscope gives you a fresh reading every day, plus a reading for the month and the whole year ahead. Tell it your name and birthday once, and it finds your zodiac sign and writes every reading just for you.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Today's horoscope, hidden inside a crystal orb until you tap to reveal it
