• This month's and this year's readings, always one tap away
• Star ratings for love, career, money and health, with a few words on each
• Your lucky number, lucky colour and best time of day
• Power days for the month and best months of the year
• Your personal numerology number for the month and the year
• A piece of advice to carry with you each day
• Tomorrow's sneak peek: watch a short video to see tomorrow's headline and star ratings tonight
• Share any reading with friends and family
• All 12 zodiac signs, from Aries to Pisces, with their element and ruling planet
• A soft chime and vibration when the orb bursts (you can turn them off)
• An optional morning reminder when your new horoscope is ready

PERSONAL AND PRIVATE
No account, no sign-up. Your name, birthday and readings stay on your iPhone and are only used to personalise your horoscope.

Fortune Horoscope is free and supported by ads. A one-time purchase removes all ads and makes tomorrow's sneak peek free.

Horoscopes are for entertainment and reflection only.

name: FOTO LLUM ESTUDI
description:
Tus momentos más especiales, en un solo lugar. Con la app de FOTO LLUM ESTUDI podrás acceder a la galería de tu sesión y elegir tus fotografías favoritas cómodamente desde tu móvil.
Descubre nuestras sesiones de familia, embarazo y cumpleaños, y conserva un recuerdo de cada etapa.
Desde la app podrás:
Acceder a tu galería de fotos.
Seleccionar las fotografías incluidas en tu pack.
Elegir fotografías digitales adicionales o la galería completa.
Descubrir opciones de impresión en papel y álbumes.
Revive tus sonrisas, abrazos y celebraciones con FOTO LLUM ESTUDI.

name: Fovea Speed Reader
description:
Fovea brings the words to you. One word at a time, held on its pivot letter, so your eyes stop jumping across the page.

WRITTEN FOR YOU
Type a topic, a question, or the title of a book you never finished, and an AI writer composes a short piece for the way you read: as long as you have time for, with sentences as long as your recall can carry. Paste a long article and it can be tightened to the part worth reading.

LEARNS WHAT YOU READ
For you suggests new pieces from what you finish, what you leave, and the interests you add. Each one is written when you tap it.

ANY TEXT
Paste a link and Fovea keeps only the words. Paste text, open an EPUB or a PDF, or share a page straight from Safari with Read in Fovea.

FIVE WAYS TO READ
Pivot, Type, Flow, Scan and Depth, with typefaces made for reading and a highlight colour of your choice. Drag the ribbon to move back through a sentence.

FIND YOUR SPEED
A two-minute test measures how fast you read a normal page. Sprints and short recall questions draw your speed curve: the pace where you keep the most.

NINE GAMES
Flash, Span, Hunt and Pace train the eye on single words and sentences. Grid widens your field of view, Scan finds one word on a page, Twins and Odd sharpen what you see and what it means, and Sprint runs whole passages. Each starts easy and follows your level, so the speed comes with practice.

YOUR READING, IN GRAPHS
Insights charts your speed piece by piece, how much you keep at each speed, fifteen weeks of reading, the days and hours you read, and your level in every game. All of it is worked out on your iPhone.

A HABIT THAT HOLDS
A daily goal of 1,000 words and a streak that forgives: rest days cover the days you miss. Milestones mark the words, pieces and days behind you, and every finished piece shows the time you saved. A daily reminder, if you want one, comes once a day at the time you pick and never on a day you have already read.

THREE LOOKS
Blue is glass over a living field of colour, and the field can turn blue, violet, teal, ember or rose, or drift round the wheel on its own. Arcade is a neon road at night in the manner of a racing game: lamps stream past and the road runs faster the faster you read. Highway is built like road signs on an open road. While you read, the day's goal fills in one corner and a timer counts how long you have gone without stopping.

Fovea is free.

Terms of Use: https://fovea-api.maxmohammadi.workers.dev/terms
Privacy: https://fovea-api.maxmohammadi.workers.dev/privacy

name: FramePop
description: Turn a moment in your video into a photo. Choose a video, play to the moment you want, and tap Right here! FramePop looks just before and after your tap and suggests up to three frames. Compare them, save your favorite to Photos, or find another moment in the same video. Try the built-in sunset clip first. Video processing takes place on your iPhone. Available in English and Spanish.

name: Frema HQ
description:
Frema keeps your shelf labels in step with your Clover prices.

Connect your Clover account in the Frema back office, and Frema keeps your items and prices in sync. On your iPhone you can:
• See every item whose price changed and print new labels in one go
• Scan a barcode with the camera to find an item and print its label
• Print to Bluetooth label printers. The Zebra ZQ610 and XPrinter XP-P323B are supported.
• Use the label designs you set up in the back office
• Check what was printed, and when, in Print history

Frema is free. Create your account at getfrema.com, connect Clover, then sign in on your phone.

name: Freq Lab
description:
Freq Lab plays tones you can shape. Binaural beats, isochronic pulses, pure tones, seven noise colors, and nature beds are generated on the phone. Nothing streams.

Left ear, right ear, and the beat stay on screen. Sleep, Focus, Calm, and Nature are free. The rest of the library is Freq Lab Pro.

What you can play
- Binaural, isochronic, and custom left/right tones from 1 Hz to 22,000 Hz
- Presets across delta, theta, alpha, beta, and gamma
- Solfeggio tones from 111 Hz through 999 Hz, plus 432 Hz and 528 Hz
- Schumann 7.83 Hz
- Sine, triangle, square, and saw waveforms
- White, pink, brown, grey, blue, violet, and green noise
- Rain, thunder, ocean, fire, forest, wind, and a stream, plus a soft pad
- A mixer with a volume and mute on each layer
- A sleep timer with a fade, and an optional soft wake
- Play under podcasts or music
- Favorites, recents, and a daily streak

Freq Lab Pro
- Yearly: $24.99 per year after a 3-day free trial.
- Monthly: $2.99 per month after a 3-day free trial.
- Lifetime: $49.99 once. It does not renew.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. A subscription renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://freqlab-app.deed.page/privacy.html

Freq Lab plays tones for relaxation, focus, and quiet listening. It is not professional advice.

Headphones matter for binaural beats. Isochronic tones, noise, and nature sounds also play on a speaker.

name: Fret Rocker
description:
Fret Rocker keeps each neck and its fret heights on this iPhone.

Seat the rocker on three frets. It names the one high fret. File only that fret, one step at a time. A stroke that would fall below both neighbors stays put. When every window sits, the neck is dressed.

Name a neck, rename it, delete one, and share the name and the sentence.

Necks stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not dress a real guitar.

name: Friends That Meet
description:
Find people who enjoy the same things you do. Whether you want a walking buddy, an online gaming friend, or someone to join you at a neighborhood event, Friends That Meet gives you a place to start. For adults 18 and older.

Choose an illustrated avatar, add your interests, and tell people how you like to spend time together. Browse by neighborhood, availability, or activity. When someone catches your eye, send a Hi about an interest you share. If they accept, you can chat and suggest a public place to meet.

Find a community event, RSVP to join its group chat, and keep your saved events and upcoming plans in one place. In Help, ask a neighbor for a hand or offer one yourself.

You choose what to share. Your email stays private, and first names appear in a direct chat only after both people agree. You can pause discovery, decline invitations, block a member, or report a profile, post, or message.

name: Froe Cheek
description:
Froe Cheek keeps each billet on this iPhone.

Drag the froe across the end grain, then drive it along the ray. The middle third stays on the ray and reaches the far end. An outer quarter runs out the side. Between those bands the split wanders.

If the run-out is still in the last quarter, back the froe and twist the other way. The mark becomes Brought back. If it left earlier, the twist is refused and the mark becomes Too far.

Rename a billet, start another, delete one, and share four lines: the name, the entry, the mark, and the note.

Billets stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not split real wood.

name: FrontHouse KDS
description:
FrontHouse KDS is the kitchen display for a FrontHouse stand. Pair an iPad with a code from your dashboard and leave it on the line.

New orders appear as tickets, with the order number, the pickup name, each item, its modifiers, and any note. A chime sounds when a ticket comes in. Tap Start when you begin it, Ready when it is done, and Picked up when the customer takes it. Tickets that have been waiting are marked so the line can see them.

Open or close ordering from the iPad. Mark an item unavailable when you sell out, and turn it back on when you can make it again. The screen stays awake through service.

FrontHouse KDS is for the kitchen. Customers order on FrontHouse Kiosk.

name: FrostWheel
description:
he northern stations are waiting for light. Take the dispatch wheel and plan a careful path through a world of frozen harbors, silver bridges and luminous glass gardens.

Every landing matters. Rotate one, two or three sectors to gather supplies, then deliver the station's manifest. Your cargo hold has just four spaces. Power is limited, boosts build heat, and each delivery shifts the pointer. Look ahead, recycle with purpose and keep the next station in mind.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTE
Complete 30 expedition routes across five illustrated regions. Pick a Courier, Capacitor or Radiator kit to shape your plan. Preview every landing at the Forecast Desk, undo a decision, or ask for advice calculated from your current position.

CONNECT TWO BEACONS
Aurora Relay brings a different challenge: two coupled wheels and three ordered signal pairs. Each drive affects both gates. Use your limited clutches to isolate a wheel and transmit the right combination before the beats run out.

BUILD YOUR NORTHERN ARCHIVE
Earn five station models, discover the four supply specimens and improve your personal records. Completion, efficient play and finishing without advice each contribute a star.

LEARN BY DOING
Four interactive field-guide lessons explain movement, cargo, power and the relay connection. Clear previews and action feedback help you understand the consequence of every choice.

The best route is the one you planned.

name: Fruiswirl
description: Fruiswirl is a fruit puzzle game. Twist concentric rings until one lane matches the target pattern, then replay glowing fruit sequences from memory. A new daily orbit arrives each day, and the Lucky Swirl can grant juice and hints. Sign in with Apple or Google, or continue as a guest. Stars, streaks, and progress stay on your device.

name: Fruit green
description:
DRAG. LOOP. SORT.

A premium puzzle game of careful observation and satisfying order. Arrange translucent resin rings on a brushed metal rod by size — largest to smallest, or smallest to largest — in a calm toy atelier setting.

Drag each ring, slip it onto the rod, and fine-tune the sequence. Rings can be inserted, removed, and rearranged freely until the order feels right. Tap Check to confirm; mistakes keep your layout so you can adjust, and a perfect sort unlocks the next challenge.

Features

Smooth drag-and-drop with real loop-on-rod feedback
120 handcrafted levels across four chapters
Clear size-order goals with rising difficulty
Star ratings, gallery unlocks, and achievements
Soft studio visuals, sound, and haptics

name: FruitSlice
description: Fruit Slice – це швидка та соковита гра-екшн зі ковзанням. Розрізайте літаючі фрукти, запускайте комбо, ухиляйтеся від бомб і навіть заморожуйте час за допомогою крижаних блоків! У грі 10 рівнів, кожен з яких має максимальний рейтинг 3 зірки. Збирайте різноманітні фрукти в «Фруктовій енциклопедії» та киньте собі виклик, щоб отримати найвищий бал у «Нескінченному режимі». Гра може похвалитися яскравими кольорами, її легко освоїти, і вона неймовірно захоплююча. Це освіжаюча та знімальна гра з нарізанням фруктів. Проводьте пальцем, щоб розрізати літаючі фрукти, накопичуйте комбо для очок, ухиляйтеся від бомб і уповільнюйте час за допомогою крижаних блоків. Отримайте три зірки на всіх 10 рівнях, зберіть усі фрукти в Фруктовій енциклопедії та побийте свій власний рекорд у Нескінченному режимі.

name: FS WOO 2027
description:
Welcome to the WOO Dreams Macao Beach Experience!

Get ready for an unforgettable getaway in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. The official WOO 2027 mobile app is your personal guide to everything happening during your stay at Dreams Macao Beach.

Whether you're planning your travels, exploring the resort, or getting ready for the next WOO experience, everything you need is right here.

Make the Most of Your WOO Experience:
Your WOO Guide: Find essential travel information, arrival details, packing tips, weather updates, and everything you need to prepare for your trip.

Resort Life: Explore restaurants, bars, pools, beach amenities, resort activities, and spa experiences.

Adventure Awaits: Discover exciting excursions and experiences available throughout your stay.

What's Happening: Stay up to date with the WOO itinerary, scheduled activities, special events, and important announcements.

Stay Connected: Receive real-time notifications, connect with fellow attendees, and share photos and memories.

Need a Hand? Find helpful contacts and important information whenever you need assistance.

From arrival to departure, the WOO 2027 app keeps your experience organized, connected, and easy to navigate.

Download the app, get acquainted, and get ready for your WOO Dreams Macao Beach Experience!

App access is intended for registered WOO 2027 attendees.

name: Fumidori: Aozora Bunko Reader
description:
Fumidori is a reader for Aozora Bunko, the free library of Japanese literature. Vertical text, ruby (furigana) and rare characters are set cleanly, like a printed book.

VERTICAL TEXT, LIKE PAPER
- Vertical writing, ruby and gaiji support
- Adjust the font, text size and line spacing
- Paper colors: White and Cream, plus Night and Sumi for dark rooms

OFFLINE ONCE DOWNLOADED
- Search Aozora Bunko and add works to your shelf
- Downloaded books open without a connection
- 4 classics by Natsume Soseki and others are already inside

BOOKMARKS, MARKERS, NOTES
- Your place is remembered; continue from the shelf in one tap
- Leave bookmarks, markers and notes on favorite passages

A READING HABIT THAT STICKS
- See today's minutes and your streak on the home screen and widget
- Set rest days per week so the streak is realistic
- Time left to finish a book, based on your own reading speed

PRICE
The core reading features are free. Fumidori Pro (one-time purchase, 800 yen) adds 4 fonts, 3 paper colors, unlimited markers and notes, and a 12-week reading calendar. Not a subscription.

NOTES
This is not an official Aozora Bunko app. Works are the texts published by Aozora Bunko (https://www.aozora.gr.jp/).
Outside Japan, works by authors who died in 1946 or later are hidden to respect US copyright terms.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fumidori.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy

name: Fusión Radio
description:
Fusión Radio 96.2 FM es la radio de la Axarquía. Con la app oficial puedes escuchar la emisión en directo y estar al día de todo lo que pasa en la comarca, estés donde estés.

RADIO EN DIRECTO
• Escucha Fusión Radio 96.2 FM con un solo toque.
• Sigue sonando con la pantalla bloqueada o mientras usas otras apps, con controles en la pantalla de bloqueo y en el Centro de control.
• Si la conexión se corta un momento, la app vuelve a conectar sola.

NOTICIAS DE TU PUEBLO
• Las últimas noticias de Fusión Radio, ordenadas por municipios de la Axarquía.
• Lee cada noticia completa dentro de la app.

ENTREVISTAS
• Escucha las entrevistas de nuestros programas cuando quieras.

AGENDA DE EVENTOS
• Conciertos, fiestas, ferias y actividades de la comarca, con filtros y orden por fecha.
• Amplía los carteles y guárdalos en tu galería.

FARMACIAS DE GUARDIA
• Consulta las farmacias de guardia de cada zona y llama directamente desde la app.

Sin registros, sin publicidad y sin recoger datos personales.

name: Future Hope
description:
What does the Bible really say about the future? Future Hope gives students, youth leaders and families clear, Scripture-rooted answers about the end times, so you can face what's ahead with purpose, boldness and hope instead of fear.

100 TOP QUESTIONS, ANSWERED
Browse the 100 most-asked questions about Bible prophecy from the book by Todd Hampson and Dr. Jeff Kinley. Swipe through them as cards or scan the full list. Every answer comes in two lengths: Quick for the short version, Expanded when you want to go deeper. Tap any Scripture reference to read the passage right there, in the NIV, NKJV, NASB or World English Bible.

DAILY DEVOTIONALS
Work through devotional series at your own pace. The app keeps track of where you left off, and an optional daily reminder helps you build the habit.

FUTURE HOPE EVENTS
At a Future Hope event? Enter your event code or scan the QR code to unlock your event's own home:
• Agenda with what's happening now and next
• Live updates from the event team
• Live polls you can vote in from your seat
• Session videos and downloadable resources
• Venue info, times and help
• Invite friends with your own QR code

POLLS
Vote in live event polls and in open polls for everyone, and watch the results come in.

NOTIFICATIONS YOUR WAY
Choose which reminders you get: event updates, new content, polls and your daily devotional.

ABOUT FUTURE HOPE
Future Hope is a youth discipleship ministry teaching Bible prophecy. Our teachers are Dr. Jeff Kinley (best-selling author of more than 40 books and host of The King Is Coming), Todd Hampson (author, illustrator and co-host of the Prophecy Pros Podcast) and Dr. Dann Spader (co-founder, and founder of Sonlife Ministries). Future Hope is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Little Rock, Arkansas.

Free to download. No ads.

name: FX3 Zoom
description:
定点カメラの画角を、引きから寄りへ。FX3 Zoomは、ソニーのILME-FX3をUSBでつないで使うiPhone用リモコンです。

全画素超解像ズームを本体表示の1.0×と1.5×に合わせ、それぞれアプリに登録します。［開始］を押すと、カメラが返す倍率を読みながら往復します。［停止］で止めるまで画面は自動ロックされません。

複数台の撮影準備には、撮影プリセットが使えます。接続中のFX3から設定を保存し、次のカメラに接続したら差分を確認。適用したい項目だけを選べます。露出やホワイトバランス、プロキシー記録などは個別にも設定できます。

収録ファイル名には、カメラごとの「1c」「2c」や共通タイトルを指定できます。対応する本体ではタイトルを書き込み、読み戻して反映を確認します。日付の有無はFX3本体の［ファイル名形式］で設定してください。

対応機材はILME-FX3と、カメラのUSB-C端子またはマルチ端子につながるデータ通信対応ケーブルです。本体をPCリモートに設定してください。使用できる項目は本体のファームウェア、レンズ、撮影モードによって変わります。

本アプリは独立した開発者による製品です。

このアプリで操作したカメラなどの対象機器は、ソニーのメーカー保証の対象外となります。初回起動時に内容をご確認ください。

name: Gabriel Diaz Cake Designer
description:
The official app for confirmed candidates in Gabriel Díaz Cake Designer's classes. From the moment your seat is confirmed to the day you get your certificate, everything you need is here.

YOUR ENTRY PASS
Your check-in QR code, saved on your phone so it opens even without a signal. Add it to Apple Wallet and it shows up on your screen on class day.

THE SCHEDULE
The days, the times and what you will work on in each block, plus the list of what to bring. Add the dates to your calendar in one tap.

YOUR PAYMENTS
Your balance, installments and receipts, always up to date.

ASK THE TEAM
A direct chat with Gabriel Díaz's team. Replies appear as they are sent, and a notification lets you know when the app is closed.

DOCUMENTS
Sign the waiver, the photo release and the cancellation policy right in the app.

PHOTOS AND MATERIALS
Photos from each class day to save to your library, and the course material to review at home.

YOUR CERTIFICATE
When the class ends, your certificate is in the app, ready to download and share.

The app is for candidates with a confirmed seat. Sign in with the email you applied with: we send you a one-time code, no password needed.

name: Gambler: Chance Sequencer
description:
Gambler is a step sequencer that rolls the dice for you. Set the odds, pick a scale, and let it improvise MIDI patterns that surprise you but always stay musical.

Gambler doesn’t make sound on its own: it plays your synths. Load it as an AUv3 MIDI plugin in your favourite host, or run it standalone and send MIDI to other apps and hardware.

HOW IT WORKS
• Up to 64 steps, each holding up to 8 notes that cycle every time the step comes round
• An 8×8 chance grid decides how likely each step is to play
• Roll swaps in fresh random notes from your range whenever you want a new idea
• Scale lock keeps everything in key: choose any of the 12 notes and a note range
• Play a chord into it to set the notes on the fly, with or without Latch
• Melody view to see and edit the whole line at once
• Shuffle, nudge, duplicate and undo

MADE FOR PLAYING LIVE
• Internal clock, host sync, or external MIDI clock
• MIDI Learn: map controls to the knobs, pads and keys on your controller
• Presets to save and recall your patterns
• Export your sequence as a MIDI file

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no tracking. The full source code is on GitHub: https://github.com/regulus33/Gambler

FOUND A BUG? HAVE AN IDEA?
Gambler is actively developed and every report helps. Tap ⋯ → Report a bug in the app, or open an issue on GitHub, and I’ll take a look.

name: GameYard: Naija Games
description:
GameYard brings Naija game night to your phone. Gather your paddies, share a room code and play the games we grew up with, together, wherever everybody dey.

SIX GAMES, ONE YARD
• Whot – the classic card game. Pick two, hold on, general market, suspension and the shout of "Check up!" (2-6 players)
• Ludo – roll the dice, cut your friends' seeds and race home first (2-4 players)
• Ayo – the Yoruba seed-sowing game. Plan your moves and capture the most seeds (2 players)
• Chess – full chess with timers, checkmate and all (2 players)
• 8-Ball – aim, set your power and pot your group before you sink the 8 (2 players)
• Wahala Words – build words on the board and score big with the bonus squares (2-4 players)

PLAY WITH YOUR PEOPLE
• Start a room and share the 4-letter code or invite link on WhatsApp
• Jump into a friend's game in seconds, no account needed
• Talk live with voice chat while you play
• Throw reactions at the table when someone does you strong thing
• Watch a game in progress and ask the host for a seat
• Short of players? Fill the empty seats with bots

YOUR YARD, YOUR RULES
• Choose house rules before you start
• Whot and Ludo knockout: play round after round until one champion is left standing
• Play again with one tap once everybody is ready

SHOW THEM WHO IS BOSS
• Create a free account to keep your wins
• Climb the leaderboard for every game
• Add friends and see when they are online
• Pick an avatar for your profile
• Share a win card to your status after you beat everybody

Play on your phone or at gameyard.africa. Everyone plays in the same rooms, whichever one they use.

Gather your paddies. Game night don start!

name: GANS NORMAL
description:
Der Park ist friedlich. Das ändern wir.

Du bist eine freche Gans mit einem Plan: schnell ans Buffet. Schnapp dir Snacks, baue Kombos auf und halte die Parkaufsicht mit einem kräftigen HONK auf Abstand. Schnattern und Sprinten bringen Tonnen, Kisten und andere Requisiten in Bewegung. Mit etwas Timing löst du eine ganze Kettenreaktion aus.

Spiele im Picknick-Park, auf dem Wochenmarkt oder im Disco-Park. Jag in „90 Sek. Chaos“ nach Punkten, sammle in „Gans gemütlich“ ohne Herzverlust oder halte im Endlos-Chaos möglichst lange durch.

In der Tagespost vom Parkamt warten jeden Tag zwei neue Aufgaben. Sammle Stempel für abgeschlossene Aufträge und stell dich Stempelbert: Weiche seinem Stempelkreis aus und schnattere, wenn er im Papierstau steckt.

Wähle Fähigkeiten für deine Runde, schalte Outfits frei und tausch Challenge-Codes mit Freunden. Der Bewegungsjoystick lässt sich von rechts nach links umstellen. Die iPhone-App ist offline spielbar und speichert deinen Fortschritt auf dem Gerät.

name: Gapp: Give what you don't use
description:
Gapp is the free way to give away things you don't use, and to choose exactly who gets them.

That cot your child has outgrown, the sewing machine in the corner, the desk you replaced: someone out there needs it. On Gapp you post it in a minute, people tell you why they need it, and you pick who gets it.

HOW IT WORKS
• Post an item with a few photos. It's free, and it always will be.
• People pitch for it with a short note or a voice note about why they need it.
• You read or listen, then choose. Nobody can buy it, bid on it or jump the queue.
• Arrange the pickup in the Gapp chat. At hand-over the receiver shows a 4-digit code and you confirm it.
• Get a thank-you, and see where your things ended up.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
• No selling, no haggling, no payment, ever.
• Your phone number is never shown. Chats, voice and video calls happen inside Gapp.
• A feed that feels familiar: follow givers you like, like and comment, and share items to your other social pages.
• Drops: give several things at a set time and watch your followers pitch.
• Churches, mosques, schools and NGOs can verify their organisation and pitch for the people they serve.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Posts, pitches and photos are checked against Gapp's rules.
• Report or block anyone from their profile or a message.
• Pickups are confirmed with a code, and you choose where to meet.

Gapp is for people aged 18 and over.

Questions? Email support@getgapp.app
Terms of use: getgapp.app/terms
Privacy policy: getgapp.app/privacy

name: Garantia Facil
description:
Transforme cada serviço prestado em novas vendas e fidelize seus clientes com profissionalismo.

O Garantia Fácil é o aplicativo ideal para técnicos, prestadores de serviços, oficinas, instaladores e autônomos que querem emitir Certificados de Garantia em PDF em segundos e nunca mais perder o momento certo da revisão preventiva.

PRINCIPAIS FUNCIONALIDADES:

• Emissão de Garantia em 15 Segundos
Cadastre o serviço rapidamente usando chips de atuações personalizadas do seu ramo (Climatização, Mecânica, Informática, Elétrica, Solar e muito mais), valor cobrado, prazo de garantia e intervalo para a próxima revisão preventiva.

• Certificado de Garantia em PDF Profissional
Gere na hora um certificado elegante em PDF com os dados da sua empresa, selo do período de garantia, condição de validade, data da próxima manutenção recomendada e código de autenticidade verificável. Compartilhe diretamente pelo WhatsApp ou por qualquer aplicativo de mensagens.

• Radar de Retornos (Pós-Venda Inteligente)
Acompanhe na tela inicial os atendimentos com garantia ativa ou revisão próxima do vencimento. Com um toque, entre em contato com o cliente pelo WhatsApp para agendar o retorno e aumentar seu faturamento recorrente.

• Gestão Completa de Clientes
Cadastre, edite, consulte o histórico de serviços de cada cliente ou importe contatos diretamente da agenda do celular ao criar uma nova garantia.

• Histórico de Garantias e Serviços
Visualize todos os certificados emitidos, edite informações, renove garantias, reemita o PDF ou cancele serviços com praticidade.

• Perfil Profissional e Atuações Personalizadas
Configure o nome comercial, telefone/WhatsApp, CPF/CNPJ, ramo de atuação e lista de serviços frequentes para agilizar seus próximos lançamentos.

• Tour Interativo Integrado
Aprenda passo a passo onde clicar logo no primeiro acesso ou revise o guia sempre que desejar pela tela de Perfil.

Feito para quem trabalha em campo e precisa de agilidade, organização e credibilidade na palma da mão.

Suporte: suporte@pmsystem.com.br

name: Garden of Love – Daily Verse
description:
Garden of Love is a quiet place for every day: meet God's Word, give thanks, and watch something beautiful grow.

Each day brings a new Bible verse. Read it slowly, think about a gentle question and, if you like, write down what you are thankful for – and the seed you plant that day sprouts, buds and blooms. Day by day your plants fill a living garden that is entirely your own.

A DAILY QUIET TIME • A verse for every day of the year, with a theme for every month • A gentle question to reflect on, and room for your own words • Gratitude tags: family, friends, health, work, nature, faith… • Gentle garden sounds: rain, breeze or crickets • A daily reminder at the time you choose • Share the day's verse as a beautiful picture – for stories or chats – with your own plants

A GARDEN THAT GROWS WITH YOU • Plants of the Bible – from the lily, the mustard seed and the vine to the cedar, the olive, the myrtle and frankincense – with real pictures and their story in Scripture • New seeds unlock as you keep going • Plant every seed in your own garden bed, which grows with your garden • Flowers bloom within days, trees grow for weeks • Walk along the garden or look at it from above; pinch to zoom, touch a plant and it sways • The sky follows the sun: morning light, sunsets, the stars and the real phase of the Moon • Gentle seasons, a passing shower of rain, birds and butterflies

CARE AND GRACE • A moment in the garden each day keeps it watered; plants left alone begin to wither, and after a few days weeds come up • Revive a withering plant by reading a short devotional from C. H. Spurgeon, Ellen G. White, Andrew Murray, Hannah Whitall Smith, E. M. Bounds or Thomas à Kempis • Your streak shows how many days in a row you have tended your garden • A weekly day of rest (Sabbath or Sunday): the garden rests too, with its own verse

YOUR JOURNAL • Every day's verse and your words in a calendar, easy to search – and hidden with one touch when you want • Gratitude stones for the days you want to remember • Time capsules: write a letter to yourself and open it after 30 days, half a year or a year • A record of every plant you have ever grown • A prayer garden: every prayer grows as a flower that blooms when you mark it answered • A memory verse each week to learn by heart, and a grove of the verses you know • A short reading every day from C. H. Spurgeon or Ellen G. White • In December, your year in the garden as a picture to keep or share

FRIENDS, GENTLY (OPTIONAL) • Add friends with a QR code or an invite link – no public profiles, no chat • Visit their gardens, water them on the days they need it and send a plant with a verse to encourage them • Group gardens for youth groups and clubs: everyone's plants side by side

A NEW PHONE? NO PROBLEM • Move your garden to a new phone with a QR code, save a backup file locked with a PIN, or keep a recovery code – always encrypted on your phone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN • No account, no e-mail, no ads, no tracking • Lock your journal and prayers with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode • Works offline – your journal never leaves your phone unencrypted

In English, Hungarian, Romanian, German, Italian and Spanish. Bible texts: King James Version, Károli Bible, Cornilescu Bible, Elberfelder (1905), Riveduta (1927), Reina-Valera (1909).

name: Gathered: Church Check-In
description:
Gathered makes Sunday check-in simple for churches of every size. Attendees check in on their own phone in seconds, and your leaders get a clear report of who came, who served, and who's new.

FOR ATTENDEES
- Scan your church's QR code or enter its 6-character code once. After that, Gathered opens straight to your church.
- Type your name once and your phone remembers it.
- Pick the service you attended and any team you served on.
- Tell your church if you're new, a regular, or a member, and see a welcome message written just for you.
- Leave a prayer request, ask about membership, or say you'd like to serve.

FOR CHURCH LEADERS
- Register your church in minutes: add service times and volunteer teams.
- Share your code or QR code from the bulletin, slides, or welcome table.
- Write your own welcome messages for first-time guests, regulars, and members.
- Get a Sunday report in the app and by email, with a spreadsheet attached: totals, first-time guests with contact info, prayer requests, follow-ups, and volunteers by team.
- Invite other leaders to see the same reports.

PLANS
Gathered is free for churches with up to 25 check-ins a week. Larger churches can subscribe:
- Small Church: up to 100 check-ins a week
- Medium Church: up to 300 check-ins a week
- Large Church: up to 750 check-ins a week
- Unlimited: no limit
Each plan is available monthly or yearly. The first 25 churches can lock in the Founding Church rate on the Small plan for as long as they stay subscribed.

Check-ins never stop when a church goes over its plan. Weeks over the limit show totals only until the church upgrades.

Subscriptions are billed to your Apple ID and renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.canvaseasy.org/gatheredprivacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: GBIT Inbox
description:
GBIT Inbox es la herramienta de trabajo para los equipos de atención al cliente de las empresas que usan los servicios de mensajería de GBIT. Reúne en el teléfono los chats de WhatsApp de los clientes de tu empresa, para que los atiendas desde cualquier lugar.

Qué puedes hacer:
• Ver y contestar tus chats en vivo, con fotos, videos, notas de voz, ubicaciones y contactos.
• Responder citando un mensaje, como en WhatsApp.
• Ver cuántos chats están sin responder y quedarte solo con esos.
• Tomar los chats que esperan en la cola y marcarte como disponible para recibir los nuevos.
• Llevar el estado de cada pedido (en proceso, por enviar, enviada, entregada) y guardar con qué courier y qué guía salió.
• Enviar en un toque los videos y frases del catálogo de tu tienda, buscándolos con «@».
• Recibir un aviso cuando un cliente te escribe en uno de tus chats o cuando te asignan uno nuevo.

Los mensajes que escribes con mala señal no se pierden ni se envían dos veces: la app los guarda y los manda cuando vuelve la conexión.

Para entrar necesitas el código de tu empresa y el usuario que ella te asigna. No hay registro abierto al público. La app sigue el modo claro u oscuro de tu teléfono.

name: GBTCOINESEMKT
description:
GBTCOINESEMKT is a private money desk for the month you are actually in.

Open it and the Pulse is already there. See what left the till this month, what came in, and which days carried the weight. File a slip when money moves: spent, earned, or moved between pockets. Envelopes hold the plan. Jars in the vault hold what you set aside. Retainers mark what repeats. Bills wait until you settle them. Obligations climb a ladder you can read in months, not in fine print.

When the month is done, file a close. The shelf keeps earlier months. Drift tells you whether this month is running ahead of the one before it. The sum is the cash you can still spend after unpaid bills, retainers still due, and debt minimums. The envelopes are a different question, and they are allowed to disagree.

name: GDG Benha
description:
Connect • Learn • Grow

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Discover events – browse upcoming workshops, talks and community meetups, including DevFest 2026.
• RSVP in a tap – register for events and see how many seats are left.
• Build your own agenda – bookmark the sessions you care about and switch between the full Agenda and My Agenda.
• Follow the timeline – sessions are organised by day and time, with speaker, room and venue details.
• Quick check-in – open your digital pass and show the QR code at the check-in desk.
• Choose your track – Flutter, Android, Web, AI & ML, UI/UX or General.
• Arabic and English – the whole app works in both languages, including full right-to-left support.
• Dark, comfortable design built for long event days.

Not ready to sign up? Tap "Browse as guest" to explore events and the agenda without an account.

GDG Benha is a community-led group. This app is not an official Google product.

name: Gece & Gündüz
description:
Köye karanlık çöktü. Aranızda vampirler var.

Gece & Gündüz, 7–10 kişiyle oynanan gizli rol ve sohbet oyunudur. Herkes rolünü gizlice öğrenir: Gözcü, Şifacı, Bekçi, Avcı, Muhtar, Rahip... ya da vampir.

• Oda kur, 6 haneli kodu arkadaşlarına gönder, herkes kendi telefonundan katılsın.
• Gece: Vampirler kurbanını seçer, köylüler rollerinin gücünü kullanır.
• Gündüz: Köy meydanında tartışın, şüpheliyi mahkemeye çıkarın, kararı verin.
• Her gece değişen olaylar: Dolunay, Sis, Kan Ayı, Kilise Çanı ve daha fazlası.
• Ölünce oyun bitmez: Hayalet olur, yaşayanlara işaret bırakır, ölülerle sohbet edersin.
• Vasiyet: Ölünce notun herkese açılır.
• Oyun sonunda "Gerçekte ne oldu?" ile kimin kimi kandırdığını görün.
• Arkadaş yok mu? Akıllı botlarla tek başına oyna. Botlar sohbete katılır, şüphelenir, blöf yapar.
• 3D köy meydanı, gece-gündüz döngüsü, atmosferik müzik ve sesler.
• Hesap yok, reklam yok, veri satışı yok. Roller ve gizli hamleler şifrelidir.

name: Geek Event – Tickets & Votes
description:
Geek Event brings together the events of the African diaspora: concerts, galas, parties, conferences, Miss and Master pageants. You find an event, book your tickets in two clicks, and then vote live for your candidates. Are you an organiser? Then you also manage your tickets, guests, check-in and contests from your phone.

FIND AN EVENT
• Search for an event, a city or an artist
• Filter by category and by city
• Save an event to your favourites and get an email reminder the day before
• Follow your favourite organisers: an email tells you about their next event

BOOK IN TWO CLICKS
First, you choose your tickets and add-ons, for example drinks or a meal. Then you enter your details and pay with Mobile Money (Orange Money, MTN MoMo), by card or with PayPal, depending on the organiser. You do not need an account.
• One ticket and one QR code for the whole family or group
• VIP tables and tiered prices, when the organiser offers them
• Your tickets arrive by email, with the PDF and a calendar invitation
• You also find them in “My tickets”

VOTE LIVE
Miss, Master, Awards: support your candidates and follow the ranking live. To vote, you need a free account. It takes 30 seconds, with a code sent by email and no password. Depending on the contest, your account gives you one free vote, and the organiser can offer you voting credits. The public only sees the totals: never your name, and never your choice.

FOR ORGANISERS
• Create your event in a few minutes: title, date, venue, flyers
• Offer tickets per person, in tiers or as a package (VIP tables), with add-ons and promo codes
• Follow your orders and participants live
• Add your guests, then send them their ticket
• Export the participant list as CSV, and the QR codes
• Write to your participants, then read their reviews and the guestbook

CHECK-IN WITH THE SCANNER
On the day, your team scans the QR codes with the phone camera. One ticket lets in one person or a whole group. Several doors can scan at the same time, and the scanner also works offline. With the “Check-in” role, your staff scan without seeing money or settings.

CONTESTS AND VOTES
Add your candidates and their photos, or open applications with a form. Then follow the votes live. On the night of the final, show the ranking on a big screen.

THREE LANGUAGES, TWO THEMES
Geek Event is available in English, French and German, in light or dark mode.

YOUR DATA
You can delete your account at any time in the app (Profile → My account).

Geek Event is published by Geek Institut. The app is free.

name: GeekOS
description:
GeekOS brings the management of your organisation — business, school, training centre — together in one app: staff and payroll, timetables and attendance, assessments, courses and enrolments, clients and appointments, invoices and transactions, shop, forms and more, depending on your organisation's modules.

To start, enter your organisation's address or scan its QR code (Profile → Security on the website). The app checks that it is a genuine GeekOS workspace, then shows your organisation's colours and logo.

• Several organisations in one app, and one tap to switch between them.
• Your organisation stays saved: just sign in again.
• Sign in with e-mail, with Google, or with “Sign in with Apple” on iPhone.
• Documents, invoices and exports saved or shared from your phone.
• Light or dark, in French or English.

GeekOS is for members of the organisations that use it: an account is required.

name: Gembaly
description:
Gembaly helps supervisors and team leads coordinate every shift: who does what, what's urgent and what's blocked.

DAY TO DAY
• SQCDP board (safety, quality, cost, delivery, people) for the morning huddle.
• Shift execution: checklists, procedures and inspections step by step.
• Report an injury, near miss, quality or equipment issue in seconds, with a photo.
• My actions: track corrective actions until they're closed.
• Deliveries and carriers, documents and training, sanitation.

BUILT FOR THE FLOOR
• Works offline: reports are sent as soon as the network is back.
• Scan location and equipment QR codes.
• French, English and Spanish.

PRIVACY
• Employees are identified by a code; names are kept in a separate table.
• Data hosted in Canada. No ads, no tracking. AI features are turned off.

Gembaly pairs with your organization's website by QR code. A demo with entirely fictional data is included: tap "Try the demo".

name: Gennaro’s Famous Pizza Chelten
description:
Gennaro's Famous Pizza has served Germantown from 210 W Chelten Ave for over 30 years. Now the whole menu is in one fast app: hand-tossed pizza, Philly cheesesteaks, strombolis, wings and more, ready for pickup or delivery.

ORDER IN A FEW TAPS
- Browse the full menu with photos and prices
- Search any dish, category or special
- Pick your size and add toppings to any pizza
- Pickup or delivery, now or scheduled for later
- Secure online checkout

PIZZA, MADE FRESH
- Hand-tossed pizza in three sizes
- White pizzas: broccoli, spinach, primavera, chicken florentine and more
- Gourmet pies: Gennaro's Special, Meat Lovers, Margherita, Hawaiian, Chicken Bacon Ranch, Chicken Alfredo, Shrimp Alfredo, Steak and Onions and more
- 16 kinds of stromboli and 6 calzones

CHEESESTEAKS AND SANDWICHES
- Philly cheesesteaks and chicken cheesesteaks
- Hoagies and toasted oven grinders
- Cold sandwiches, clubs, Kaiser specialties, paninis and wraps
- Gyros, quesadillas and gourmet sandwiches

WINGS, CHICKEN AND MORE
- Buffalo wings and fried chicken
- Burgers cooked to order
- Seafood platters: shrimp, flounder, scallops and combos
- Pastas, from spaghetti and meatballs to alfredo
- Salads, sides, kids meals and desserts

CATERING
- Catering trays for parties, offices and game day

ORDER UPDATES
Follow your order from the kitchen to pickup or to your door, and reorder your favorites in seconds.

Gennaro's Famous Pizza
210 W Chelten Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19144
(215) 848-7160

name: Gennies Nation
description:
Your Generals community, together on iPhone.

Gennies Nation brings Washington and Lee athletics, university news, campus events, videos and the university store into one native app.

• Follow your teams. See recent scores and open full current-season results and schedules. Favorite teams without creating an account.
• Stay connected. Read headlines from The Columns and watch the university’s latest YouTube uploads.
• Plan your day. Browse public campus events and upcoming athletics, then add individual events to your calendar.
• Shop the university store. Browse merchandise, choose available options and manage your bag. Checkout, payment and fulfillment are handled by the university store.

Favorite teams stay on your device. Cached feeds keep recent content available when the network is unavailable; videos, shopping and linked pages require a connection.

An independent companion for the Generals community. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Washington and Lee University.

name: Genytri
description:
Genytri réunit les outils de votre organisation dans une seule app : Mail, Chat, Meet et Agenda, reliés entre eux et accessibles avec un seul compte.

MAIL
• Boîtes personnelles et boîtes partagées, dossiers et libellés
• Pièces jointes : aperçu, partage et enregistrement sur le téléphone
• Rédaction avec mise en forme, envoi programmé et lien de visio en un geste
• Liens suspects signalés et bloqués avant l'ouverture

CHAT
• Canaux par équipe ou par projet, messages directs et mentions
• Notifications pour ce qui vous concerne vraiment

MEET
• Réunions en visio avec vos collègues, clients et partenaires
• Rejoindre une réunion par son lien ou son code, en démarrer une à tout moment

AGENDA
• Vos rendez-vous et échéances, en vue jour, 3 jours ou liste
• Invitations, réponses et rappels

SÉCURITÉ
• Verrouillage Face ID au choix
• Données chiffrées pendant le transfert et sur nos serveurs
• L'administrateur de l'organisation gère les accès

Genytri s'utilise avec le compte que votre organisation vous a ouvert.

name: Geobuddy - Location Sharing
description:
Geobuddy shows you on a map where your friends are right now, and shows your friends where you are. You decide how precisely, for each friend separately.

FOUR LEVELS, PER FRIEND
• Exact: your precise position, for close friends
• City: approximate, shown as a cloud on the map
• Country: only the country you are in
• Off: this friend sees nothing

Each direction is separate. You can show someone your city even if they show you their exact place.

PRIVACY BUILT IN
• No location history. There is only ever your latest position.
• Your location is encrypted on your iPhone. Our server cannot read it.
• One switch, “Share My Location”: turn it off for today or completely. Your position is deleted at once.
• You can delete your account and all data in the app at any time.

MEET UP
• Meet-up mode: share your exact place with one friend for 1 or 4 hours.
• Meeting point: long-press the map and share the spot.
• A notice when a friend arrives in your city.

PLANS
Enter where you will be soon. Geobuddy shows who is in the same place at the same time.

FIND FRIENDS
By address book, QR code, link or username. Names and pictures come from your own address book, which is not stored.

Geobuddy has no chat of its own. From a friend's card you go straight to iMessage, WhatsApp, Signal or Telegram.

You need a phone number to sign up.

name: GetUp: QR Alarm Clock
description:
Don't just wake up. Get up.

GetUp is an alarm clock that gets you out of bed. When it rings, you can't just tap it off and roll over: you complete a short wake-up task, walk to a code you placed away from your bed, and scan it. Five minutes later, a quick check makes sure you stayed up.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set your alarm and choose a wake-up task: a few quick questions, or retype two or three short lines.
• Register a wake-up code away from your bed: print a GetUp QR code, or use the barcode or QR code on something you already own, like toothpaste or a coffee jar.
• When the alarm rings, do the task, walk to your code and scan it.
• If you stop the alarm without finishing, GetUp rings again a minute later.
• Five minutes after your scan, GetUp checks in once more. Answer one quick question and your morning counts as a full routine.

BUILT TO BE RELIABLE
• Uses iOS alarms, so GetUp rings on time even in Silent mode or a Focus, and with the app closed.
• An emergency stop (hold for 5 seconds) is always there, and is recorded honestly.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline. No account, no ads, no analytics.
• Your alarms, codes and history never leave your iPhone. A wake-up code leaves your phone only if you choose to print or share it.
• The camera is used only to read codes, on your iPhone. No photos are saved.

HONEST HISTORY
See which mornings were a full routine, when you only did the physical mission, and how long it took you to get from the alarm to your code.

Requires iOS 26.1 or later.

name: Gezinkt: Sechs am Stück
description:
Du hast einen Würfel. Er ist gezinkt. Gegen dich.

Am Anfang zeigt er nur in 5 % der Würfe eine Sechs. Dein Ziel: sechs Sechsen in Folge. Klingt unmöglich? Ist es am Anfang auch: Die Chance liegt bei 1 zu 64 Millionen.

Also tippst du. Jeder Wurf bringt ein paar Taler, jede Sechs mehr. Mit dem Geld feilst du am Würfel, bis er dir ein bisschen mehr gehorcht. Du wirst schneller, dein Einsatz steigt, Serien zahlen sich aus. Und irgendwann stehen da fünf Sechsen. Und dann eine Eins.

WAS DICH ERWARTET
• Ein Knopf, ein Würfel, sehr viel Spannung
• Echter 3D-Würfel, der jedes Mal anders über den Tisch springt
• Die Fast-Sechs: Manchmal bleibt er auf der Sechs stehen ... und kippt doch noch um
• Ehrlicher Zufall: Die angezeigte Chance ist genau die, mit der gewürfelt wird
• Vier Upgrades: Feile, Handgelenk, Einsatz, Serienbonus
• Pech-Statistik mit deinem bittersten Abbruch
• Nach dem Sieg: noch einmal mit einem noch härteren Würfel
• Ein goldener Würfel für deine erste Vierer-Serie
• Auf Deutsch und Englisch, ohne Konto, ohne Internetzwang

KOSTENLOS SPIELEN
Gezinkt ist kostenlos und zeigt ab und zu eine Vollbild-Werbung, aber nie mitten in einer Serie. Mit „Werbefrei" ist die Werbung für immer weg. Das kleine Design-Paket bringt drei Würfel (Holz, Knochen, Neon) und drei Tische (Casino-Filz, Küchentisch, Marmor). Es ist reine Optik und gibt keinen Spielvorteil.

Ein Durchlauf dauert etwa eine Stunde. Wie lange genau, entscheidet der Würfel.

name: Gifted & Talented Hub
description:
Every child is gifted… and deserves a chance.

Gifted & Talented Hub is a calm, practical guide for mothers in the UAE. In about 5 minutes, it helps you notice what lights your child up, then shows you where to grow it.

DISCOVER THEIR TALENTS
Answer what you've noticed, then ask your child a few fun questions. See their strongest talent areas, from sport and gymnastics to art, building, words, maths and more.

CAMPS, CLASSES & COMPETITIONS FOR YOUR CHILD
Right after the guide, see the camps, classes and competitions that match your child's talents, age and emirate, with the top picks happening now.

GIFTED & TALENTED FAST TRACK
Browse 300+ classes, camps, competitions, home teachers, libraries and kids' events across all seven emirates. Filter by emirate, age and talent, add dates to your calendar and set reminders before deadlines.

LEARNING DIFFERENCES & GIFTED CHECKS
Short activities you do together, matched to your child's age: reading, attention, maths, movement and speech. For advanced children, above-age challenges in maths, spelling, writing and Arabic, with competitions and a reading plan to match. These checks are not a diagnosis; they show when a closer look is worth it.

MY CHILDREN
Save each child's results, growth plan, certificates and achievements, and get the best opportunities for each focus.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your children's information stays on your phone.

In English and Arabic.

name: GIK ERP
description:
GIK ERP je interni poslovni sustav tvrtke GIK GRUPA d.o.o., namijenjen isključivo zaposlenicima i ovlaštenim suradnicima tvrtke.

Pristup imaju samo korisnici kojima je račun otvorio administrator tvrtke. Aplikacija ne prikazuje oglase i ne prati korisnike.

name: Gilded Caper
description:
Gilded Caper is a heist puzzle game about taking back what was stolen.

A ring of greedy collectors has quietly emptied the city's galleries. Paintings, sculptures, jewels and antiques now sit in private vaults behind alarms and steel bolts. You are the master thief nobody has ever seen: a faceless figure in a flowing cape who works by moonlight, leaves no trace and always returns the art.

Every case is a short job of ten levels. Cut the alarm circuits, open the vault, recover the piece and add it to your collection. Then the next file lands on your desk.

Two kinds of puzzle

Alarm circuits: tap a tile to rotate it and connect every wire to the power source. When the whole network glows gold, the alarm goes quiet. Every circuit has exactly one solution.

Vault locks: slide the steel bolts along their tracks to clear a path, then guide the golden key block out of the vault. Undo as often as you like.

Play at your own pace

There is no timer, no move limit and no way to lose. Finish a level in your own way, or plan ahead and earn up to three stars. When you are stuck, a hint points you in the right direction, and every level can be replayed to improve your score.

Features

• 400 levels across 40 cases, alternating between circuits and vaults
• A new daily heist every day, with a streak to keep alive
• 40 original works of art to recover and display in your collection
• A short wordless finale at the end of every case
• Difficulty that rises gently, from quick warm-ups to demanding vaults
• Stars for mastery, hints when you need them, unlimited undo in vaults
• Night-silhouette art in midnight blue and gold
• Portrait, one-handed play made for short sessions
• Plays fully offline, with no account needed; progress stays on your device
• Follows your device's reduce-motion setting; screen reader labels
• Available in 14 languages

Ads and purchases

The game shows ads. A single optional purchase removes banner and full-screen ads; reward ads that you choose to watch for extra coins remain available. Coins are earned only by playing or by watching an optional ad, and cannot be bought.

The galleries are waiting. Pick up your first case tonight.

name: Gilded Gem Trails
description:
In an ancient, dim temple, your task is to rotate gems to direct sunlight and moonlight toward their respective altars. *Gilded Gem Trails* is a single-player, light-path puzzle game that can be played offline. With no timers or move limits, it is perfect for those who enjoy logic puzzles and prefer to explore at their own pace.

How to Play

Tap "Enter the Temple" on the home screen to begin the first level, "First Light." Follow the on-screen highlights to locate the light sources and exits, then rotate the designated mirror gems—or feel free to skip the tutorial.
Tap gems on the board to alter the path of the light. Mirrors deflect beams at a 90-degree angle, while prisms allow a beam to pass straight through while simultaneously splitting off a second, deflected beam. Prisms are introduced in Level 9, and from Level 17 onward, you will need to manage both sunlight and moonlight.
Guide sunlight to the circular exits and moonlight to the diamond-shaped exits. All exits on a board must be illuminated simultaneously to unlock the next level.

Unlocking Levels and Collecting Relics

The game features 60 levels spread across six chapters. Completing a chapter restores a relic, which you can then view in the "Relic Gallery."
Earn a three-star rating by completing a level within the target number of moves without using hints. Exceeding the target by one or two moves earns two stars, while any other successful completion earns one star. If you use a hint, the maximum rating you can achieve for that level is two stars.
If you get stuck, you can use "Undo" to reverse your last move, "Restart" to reset the board, or "Hint" to highlight a gem that should be rotated. You can revisit previously completed levels via the "Temple Map" to try and improve your star rating.
The game saves your current progress, best star ratings, and settings locally on your device. You can pick up right where you left off by selecting "Resume Puzzle"—no registration or login required.

name: Glano: Photo & Video Cleaner
description:
A cleaner camera roll starts with a few simple swipes.

Glano helps you organize your iPhone photos and videos, find items you no longer need, and make more room for the moments that matter.

A SIMPLE WAY TO CLEAN

Review your media one item at a time. Swipe to keep what matters or remove what you no longer need. You stay in control of every decision.

FIND WHAT'S TAKING UP SPACE

• Duplicates – Find duplicate photos and review them before deleting.
• Similar Photos – Discover similar shots and choose which ones to keep.
• Screenshots – Quickly review and clear out screenshots.
• Large Videos – Find your biggest videos first, play them, and scrub through them before deciding what to remove.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU DELETE

See your progress as you go. Changed your mind? Use Undo to go back. Review your selected items before cleaning, and access deleted items through the dedicated Cleaned Items area.

YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS

Glano analyzes your photos and videos directly on your device. Glano does not upload your personal media to its servers.

FREE AND PRO FEATURES

Get started with essential cleanup tools. Unlock Similar Photos and Large Videos with Glano Pro.

Make your camera roll easier to manage, one swipe at a time.

Glano – Keep the good stuff.

name: Glidefuel
description:
Fuel requests for flight schools

Ask the FBO for fuel before the lesson

Glidefuel sends a fuel request from your school to the airport. You choose the gallons. You pay the FBO. Glidefuel does not sell fuel.

A suggested uplift is computed from the aircraft burn, the distance, a 45-minute reserve, and taxi fuel. It is not sent unless you enter gallons or choose full tanks.

Home base or cross-country

Keep a standing order at your home airport, or request fuel at a stop on the way.

The aircraft locks the fuel

Grade, usable gallons, and burn come from the aircraft profile. A request cannot change them.

The FBO taps once

Confirm, decline, or send an ETA from a link. No FBO account.

How it works

Five steps, then the FBO has the request

1. Keep the aircraft profile
Tail, type, fuel grade, usable gallons, and burn. Those three fuel numbers stay locked on every request.

2. Pick the airport
The home airport is already selected. Change it when the fuel is for a cross-country stop.

3. Read the suggestion, then enter the order
Glidefuel shows a suggested uplift. You enter gallons or choose full tanks. The suggestion is not the order.

4. The FBO replies without logging in
The link can confirm, decline, or give an ETA. It expires.

5. You pay the FBO
Glidefuel does not take the fuel money and does not resell fuel.

Does Glidefuel sell fuel?
No. The school pays the FBO for the fuel. Glidefuel does not resell fuel.

Will the suggested gallons be ordered for me?
No. The suggestion is a calculation. You enter gallons or choose full tanks before a request can be sent.

Does the FBO need an account?
No. The FBO uses a one-tap link to confirm, decline, or send an ETA.

Which airports are listed?
Public-use airports with fuel in all 50 states, from the FAA NASR cycle.

Is this AviBrief?
No. Glidefuel is a separate product from Glidepath Aviation.

Glidefuel is operated by Glidepath Aviation, LLC. It does not sell fuel. The school pays the FBO directly. Suggested gallons are only a suggestion. The pilot in command decides.

We store the school account, aircraft profiles, fuel requests, the parking location you enter, and the FBO email address you provide, so we can send that request. Sign-in uses an email link. We do not sell personal information.

Questions: support@glidefuel.net

name: Glidepad: Trackpad & Remote
description:
Glidepad turns your iPhone or iPad into a trackpad, keyboard, media remote and presenter for your Mac or Windows PC. It connects directly over your own Wi-Fi, encrypts everything end to end, and needs no account.

A TRACKPAD THAT FEELS RIGHT
• Speed-dependent acceleration, tap to click, two-finger tap for right click, tap and drag
• Two-finger scrolling with momentum, natural or classic
• Three- and four-finger gestures for switching desktops, showing the desktop and more, each one configurable
• Full-screen trackpad mode, a left-handed layout and haptic clicks

TYPE IN ANY LANGUAGE
• Uses your iPhone keyboard, so every language, dictation and emoji work
• Esc, Tab, arrows, Home/End, Page Up/Down, plus sticky Ctrl, Alt, Command and Shift for shortcuts
• Compose a message with autocorrect, then send it all at once. Save snippets and send them with one tap

MEDIA AND PRESENTATIONS
• Play/pause, next and previous track, volume and mute
• See what's playing on your Mac, with its artwork
• Presenter mode: next and previous slide, black screen and find-my-cursor
• Editing transport for video editors: J/K/L, edit points, marks and frame stepping

MORE
• Button decks for the shortcuts you use most
• Send photos and files to your computer, and share clipboard text
• Screen preview of your computer
• Light and dark mode

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every packet between your phone and your computer is authenticated and encrypted. You pair once by scanning a QR code, so keys never cross the network. There are no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and nothing you do is sent to us.

REQUIREMENTS
Install the free Glidepad agent on your Mac (macOS) or PC (Windows or Linux), and keep your phone and computer on the same network.

name: Glimi Fit
description:
Glimi keeps records for rectangular window screen replacement jobs, from site measurements to fabrication and refitting.

Organize jobs by room and window position. Give each screen an ID, record its viewing direction and top reference, and attach site photos. Enter dimensions in millimeters or decimal and fractional inches, with the original measurement text retained alongside converted values.

Create profile rules for finished sizes, frame bar adjustments, mesh allowances, spline adjustments and rounding. Review calculated dimensions separately from site measurements, with material specifications and rule versions recorded for each screen.

Use the Cut Queue to group matching specifications while retaining individual screen IDs. Follow fabrication checks, mark screens ready to fit, and record fitting results or reasons for rework. Version history keeps earlier measurements, calculations and outcomes available.

Generate PDF job reports, cut sheets and labels in US Letter or A4 format. Preview documents, share them or save them to Files.

Dictate English notes on devices that support on-device speech recognition, and read site dimensions or calculated finished sizes aloud.

Job records, photos and documents are stored locally. Export and restore workspace backups, search saved records, archive completed jobs, or clear all app data in Settings. No account is required.

Measurements, material choices and profile rules remain yours to check against the physical screen and installation.

name: Glimmers & Triggers
description:
Notice what calms you and what sets you off.

A glimmer is a small moment when your body relaxes: morning light, a friend's voice, a warm cup in your hands. A trigger is a moment when your body tenses, often before you've had time to think. Glimmers & Triggers helps you notice both and see what they say about you.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap Glimmer or Trigger. The time is saved instantly.
• Pick a word that describes the moment. Your earlier words come up as suggestions.
• If you like, note where you feel it in your body and add a short note.
• In a hurry? Just log it. You can add a note later.

SEE THE PATTERN
• Daily bars and your glimmer-to-trigger balance
• Word map: big bubbles are recurring words, colour shows whether they're more often glimmers or triggers
• In the body: where you feel safety and where you feel tension
• Weekly summary: the week's recurring words, times of day and one question to reflect on

LEARN ABOUT YOURSELF
In Learnings, every word gets its own space. What does this tell me about myself? What do I need in this situation? What helped me find this? Triggers often point to something unfinished; glimmers to what you truly long for.

LOG FROM THE LOCK SCREEN
Glimmer and Trigger buttons for Control Center, the Lock Screen and a Home Screen widget. One tap, no need to open the app.

PRIVATE
No account, no cloud, no tracking. Everything stays on your phone. Export and import a backup file whenever you like.

FREE AND PRO
Logging, quick logging and 7-day tracking are free. A one-time Pro purchase (no subscription) unlocks Learnings, the weekly summary, 30-day and all-time views, and backups.

Inspired by polyvagal theory. Not a substitute for therapy and not a medical device.

English and Finnish. Made by Embody Apps, embodyapps.fi.

name: GLO Law
description:
GLO Law is a free research tool for people handling a legal matter without a lawyer, and for the people helping them.

COURT CASES
About 10 million court cases from the Free Law Project's CourtListener data. Search by case name, by words in the opinion, or by citation (for example, 405 U.S. 56), then read the full opinion.

STATUTES
State statutes for all 50 states and DC, plus Kansas regulations. Look up a section by citation (for example, K.S.A. 58-2550) or search a state's statutes by words. Federal statutes open by citation. Each copy shows its snapshot date and a link to the publisher's copy.

AGENCY POLICIES
The posted policies of state corrections departments and the federal Bureau of Prisons, from each agency's own copy.

SAVE AND SHARE
Keep cases, statutes and policies in a Saved list on your device, and send a citation or link from the share sheet.

HOW GLO READ IT
Every answer shows GLO's note on where the record came from, what its copy covers and the snapshot date. Word search matches the exact words you type, so try other words too. A search that finds nothing isn't proof that nothing exists.

Free, with no ads and no account. GLO doesn't write your searches to any log or database.

GLO Law is run by Pencil Petition, Inc., a private nonprofit. It isn't a law firm or a government agency, doesn't give legal advice, and doesn't tell you whether a case is still good law. Court cases run through the collection's snapshot date (September 30, 2026 today), and statutes are dated copies, so check anything you rely on against the official source.

name: Global Size Converter
description:
Shopping abroad or ordering from an overseas store? See your clothing, shoe and ring size in every country at a glance.

■ Compare sizes on one screen
14 categories for women, men and kids — clothing, shoes, rings and bras. Pick a size and see the US, UK, EU, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean and other equivalents side by side.

■ Your countries first
Choose your home country and the countries you compare with. Search and add any of 174 countries and regions. Convert from any country's sizes — tap a country to switch.

■ Save sizes for the whole family
Keep clothing, shoe and ring sizes plus body measurements for each person. Open any saved size in one tap. Save a size in another country's system too — for example, shoes in US sizes.

■ Clear, honest results
When one size matches several sizes elsewhere, you see a range such as 4–6. When a country has no equivalent, the nearest size is shown and marked; with no basis at all, you see "—" instead of a guess.

■ Offline, no ads, one-time purchase
No internet connection needed — perfect while traveling. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device.

■ Categories
Women: pants, blouses, dresses, plus sizes (UK 18–34), shoes
Men: pants, dress shirts, jackets, shoes, T-shirts
Kids: baby & toddler clothing, kids' shoes
Other: rings, bras

Sizes are a general guide and can vary by brand and design. Please also check the brand's own size chart before you buy.

Privacy Policy: https://fillapps.com/privacy/world-size-converter/

name: Global Tech Weekend
description:
Welcome to Global Tech Weekend

Discover upcoming events, connect with the global GTW community, and find trusted business partners across industries and borders.

Explore GTW Events
Browse upcoming flagship events and community-led side events. View agendas, discover speakers, and stay up to date with the latest announcements.

Connect with the Community
Meet founders, investors, partners, and industry leaders. Discover who’s taking part in GTW events and make connections that can continue long after the event.

Discover the GTW Ecosystem
Explore a dedicated business network within the app. Browse trusted companies and service providers by sector, discover what they offer, and find partners for your next project or expansion into new markets.

Join the movement. Connect beyond borders.

Need help? Email us at welcome@gtwt.ge.
Learn more at https://gtwt.ge
