Terms of Use — https://alienlab.ge/GTW/admin/terms.html

name: Glossa: Catholic Bible Study
description:
The four Gospels, with the Church Fathers beside every verse.

Glossa sets the Douay-Rheims Gospels on a quiet page. Tap a verse with the red cross, or swipe any verse to the left, and a sheet rises with what the Fathers said about it: St Augustine, St John Chrysostom, St Jerome, St Gregory the Great, St Ambrose and many more, as St Thomas Aquinas gathered them in the Catena Aurea. The verse stays at the top of the sheet, so you always know what you are reading about.

Take Matthew 5:4, "Blessed are the meek: for they shall possess the land." St Augustine answers: "The meek are they who resist not wrongs, and give way to evil; but overcome evil of good." Every verse of Matthew, Mark, Luke and John has its commentary, more than twelve thousand passages in all, quoted in full from the 1841 Oxford translation and never paraphrased.

HOW IT HELPS
- Study a passage the way the Church has always read it, not alone.
- Prepare for Sunday Mass, a homily, a Bible study group or lectio divina.
- Tap a Father's name to learn who he was, in two lines.
- Hold a verse to share it as a picture, with a Father's words underneath.

A PAGE FOR READING
- The New York serif, sized for long reading, with Dynamic Type.
- One continuous scroll from Matthew 1 to John 21, and it remembers where you were.
- Two taps to any book, chapter and verse.
- The words of Christ in red.

THREE LIGHTS
Pull the lamp cord to change the light: Day on warm paper, Evening in sepia, and Night, red words on true black with no white light anywhere on the screen. Night can come on by itself at sunset.

GLOSSA+
The four Gospels, with the Fathers on every verse, in Day and Evening light, are free for good. Glossa+ adds Night and every other book of the Douay-Rheims Bible, from Genesis to the Apocalypse, with the Haydock commentary on every other book: £24.99 a year or £2.99 a month, with 3 days free first. Cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

A QUIET APP
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything is on your phone and works offline. At most two notifications a day: a Father's words on a verse at midday, and a word about Night in the evening.

The Douay-Rheims (Challoner) text and the 1841 translation of the Catena Aurea are in the public domain.

Terms of use: Apple's standard licence (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/), linked in the description and in the app.

name: Glottal: Singing Voice Synth
description:
Every sound in Glottal comes from air moving through a head you can see. Lungs push, vocal folds vibrate, the tongue and lips shape the tract, and a physical model turns that motion into a voice. There are no recordings inside: the head on screen is the instrument.

Speak
Type a sentence in one of ten languages, from English and Turkish to Spanish, Japanese and Korean. Glottal turns it into IPA, then the head says it while every sound lights up on the tongue, lips and folds.

Sing
Write melodies in the piano roll and give each voice its own head. Layer duets and small choirs, set pitch, vibrato and breath note by note.

Beatbox
Kicks, snares and hi-hats made by the same mouth that sings. Program a pattern as text or on a step grid and add swing.

Shape a voice
Tract length, fold mass, breathiness and vocal effort are sliders, not voicebanks. Save a voice as a character and reuse it in every project.

Learn how speech works
Tap any IPA symbol to see where the sound is made in a cutaway of the head and hear it on its own.

Mix and share
Every voice gets a channel with volume, pan, EQ and reverb. Export audio, or a video of the singing heads.

Headphones bring out breath and fricatives, and the speaker works too.

Glottal Pro adds up to eight voices per project, unlimited projects and full-quality export.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.cihat.dev/glottal/privacy-policy/

name: Glotto - Learn Languages
description:
Glotto is a language you play. No lessons to read: a feed of mini-games that take a few seconds each, and you really learn, at your level.

FOUR LANGUAGES
With explanations in English: Spanish, Italian and French. For French speakers: English, Spanish and Italian. Each language keeps its own progress, and you can switch whenever you like.

A FEED OF MINI-GAMES
One game per screen. Play, replay, or swipe to the next one: Pairs, Sort the sentence, Translate, True or false, The right word, Hidden words, Crosswords, Anagrams, Spot the mistake... Never the same game twice in a row.

COURSES AT YOUR LEVEL, FROM A1 TO B1
A map shows where you are, what is moving and your next milestone. A single sentence can train a tense, a rule and vocabulary: one right answer moves several chapters forward at once.

WHAT YOU FORGET COMES BACK AT THE RIGHT TIME
Each word and sentence comes back the next day, then 3, 7, 16 and 35 days later. A mistake brings the item back sooner. Your sentences are corrected word by word, with the rule in one sentence when you get it wrong.

BOSSES
To clear a chapter, beat a boss: translate three full sentences. Already know it? Beat the boss to clear the chapter in one go.

YOUR STREAK
Finish ten games in a day and your streak grows by one day. An alert at 10 pm warns you when it is at stake. Levels, badges, cards to collect.

FREE, AND GLOTTO+
Free: ten games a day, no ads. Glotto+: unlimited games, as a monthly subscription with a 7-day free trial. The subscription renews every month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, from your Apple account settings.

Terms of use: https://glottoapp.com/en/terms.html
Privacy: https://glottoapp.com/en/privacy.html

Glotto is published by Dyment Labs. Questions: hello@dymentlabs.com

name: Glow Super Admin
description:
Glow Super Admin هو تطبيق الإدارة التنفيذية والتحليلات الذكية لشبكة مراكز وعيادات التجميل والليزر على منصة Glow N Beauty Center.

يتيح التطبيق لمُلّاك مجموعات العيادات ومديري العمليات والأدمن الانضمام بسهولة عبر التسجيل المباشر داخل التطبيق («تسجيل أدمن جديد»)، حيث يصل طلب التسجيل فوراً إلى السوبر أدمن لمراجعة الصلاحيات وتفعيل الحساب.

المزايا الرئيسية:
• تسجيل أدمن جديد داخل التطبيق مع نظام اعتماد فوري من السوبر أدمن وإشعارات لحظية.
• بوابة المالك التنفيذي (تحليلات للقراءة فقط): متابعة الإيرادات اليومية والشهرية، نسب النمو، الحجوزات، وأداء العيادات والأطباء والمدن بالرسوم البيانية التفاعلية.
• بوابة السوبر أدمن (التحكم الكامل): مراجعة واعتماد طلبات تسجيل الأدمن والعيادات والأطباء والأجهزة، إدارة الحجوزات، متابعة فرق الميدان على الخريطة الحية، وإرسال التنبيهات الفورية.
• حماية متقدمة: دعم قفل التطبيق بالبصمة / Face ID، وإمكانية حذف الحساب نهائياً من داخل التطبيق في أي وقت.

name: Glowcomb
description:
Glowcomb is a portrait 3D stroll for a quiet hive. You walk Pip, a small green sprout, along a lane of warm stones. Bees orbit in glowing rings. A critter naps only when a bee brushes it while its paw mark is lit, and only at the right height. Nap every critter, then touch the hive before the amber in the jar runs out. Three sloshes spill the jar.

Clover Meadow teaches the step: wait on the center stones, step onto a glowing paw, and step back before the glow fades. Later groves change the brush. Stump Orchard lifts the ring for critters on stumps. Lead Brook lets only the bright lead bee finish a nap. Twin Canopy swaps an inner ring and an outer ring. Ember Dusk makes the jar heavy, so a dollop of nectar buys a faster step.

The Ring Bench holds four charms: a wider brush, a bigger amber sip, a longer glow, or slower bees. Seals remember how the walk felt. A Comb is a clean jar, a full streak, and a quick stroll. A Jar is a clean jar. A Spoon is one slosh. A Drip is any other clear. Nectar fills with each nap and dips when the jar sloshes.

Five groves, six lanes each, open in order. One clear in a grove opens the next. Dusk Seed builds one extra lane from the date on this device and keeps a local best seal for that day. Comb Atlas, the Critter Nook, and the Jar Ledger remember what you have brushed. Hollow holds chimes, buzzes, paw marks, the brush lesson, credits, and a short privacy note.

name: GO CRM - Get Organized
description:
GO CRM keeps a sales team and its projects organized, on the iPhone and on the web.

Sales
• Every deal in its pipeline stage, with its value, items and next follow-up
• Today: the follow-ups that are due, overdue and coming up
• Companies and people, with every email and note on the deal's timeline
• Follow-up emails planned for you, each one reviewed and approved before it is sent, stopping when they reply
• Emails sent from your company's own mailboxes

Projects
• Projects inside each client, started from a deal
• Tasks on a board, with due dates, checklists and comments
• Project chat and files for the team
• Project amounts: what was sold and what changed

Assistant
• Ask about your deals and tasks, and draft emails and to-dos, for people with AI switched on by their company

Private to your company
• Each company sees only its own data
• Face ID lock and notifications you choose
• Delete your account at any time in Settings

GO CRM is for companies that use GO. Sign in with your company code and your GO account.

name: Goal Titans: Soccer Cup 1v1
description:
Goal Titans is a 1v1 arcade soccer game about one minute of football at a time. Sixty seconds, one ball, two big heads, and three superpowers you chose before the whistle. Score more than the titan on the other side of the pitch, then do it again against someone harder.

SIXTY-SECOND MATCHES
• Three buttons: move, jump, kick
• Easy on the first match, still worth playing on the five hundredth
• One minute a game, so it fits a queue as well as an evening

TWELVE SUPERPOWERS, THREE SLOTS
• A fireball that leaves your boot at triple speed, trailing flame
• The ball frozen solid in mid-air
• Your rival sealed in a block of ice where they stand
• A shield across your own goal, a magnet, a grapple, a second ball
• You carry three, not twelve — choosing which three is half the game

LEAGUE SEASONS, SEVEN DIVISIONS
• Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Champion, Legend
• A real hundred-name table in each, with its own stadium and prize money
• Finish in the promotion places and go up
• The top division does not promote — it pays a prestige star for every season you survive in it

CUP TOURNAMENT
• Sixteen teams, four rounds, straight knockout
• Last sixteen, quarter-final, semi-final, final
• One tie, one match, no second leg
• Lose and the run is over, unless you buy your way back in once

TWELVE CHARACTERS TO COLLECT
• Common, rare, epic and legendary
• Each with their own speed, power, jump and kick, and ten levels
• Every face in the game is reachable by playing

POWER CARDS, CHESTS AND THE SEASON PASS
• Cards come out of chests, chests come out of the league and the cup
• Five levels per power, and each one changes what it does in a match
• A thirty-step pass over four weeks, earned by playing rather than handed over
• Free track for everyone; the paid one ends on an epic character

EVERY DAY THERE IS SOMETHING
• Three missions set every morning
• A seven-day login ladder that gets better the further in you are
• A free spin of the wheel
• Achievements that pay up to two hundred thousand coins

MAKE IT YOURS
• Name your player
• Dye your kit and boots, fly your flag
• Pick the effect that goes off behind the net when you score

PLAYS ANYWHERE
Goal Titans is a single player offline soccer game: no connection needed, on a plane, on the metro, in a lift. No login, no server to go down, nothing to wait for.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Because nobody is playing against somebody else's wallet, nothing in the shop needs to be exclusive to money: every character, every power and every coin is reachable by playing. Money shortens the road — it does not open a different one.

Ten league matches a day, and unlimited friendly matches whenever you want another game. No forced adverts between matches.

Arcade football, mini soccer, one on one — whatever you call it, it is one minute long and it is about to go to penalties in your head on the bus home.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://patpatgames.com/goaltitans/privacy

name: Gold Empire: Souq Tycoon
description:
Build your own gold souq!

Gold Empire: Souq Tycoon is a building and trading game for all ages, set in the classic gold souq of old Bahrain. Start with a tiny stall and a modest merchant's house, and grow your souq lot by lot into the finest market in the Gulf.

Features:
- Build and upgrade more than 10 buildings: the ring stall, earring shop, bangle forge, necklace house, brides' majlis, the Captain's treasure, the coffee house and the vault.
- Buy new land to expand your souq. Every building changes its look as it levels up.
- Customers come to your shops with orders: design the piece, then pour, hammer and polish it yourself.
- Haggle with customers for the best price.
- Dive with the pearl diver to gather oysters and pearls.
- A fictional gold exchange: buy when it's cheap, sell when it's high.
- Souq events: rush hour, a thief to catch, and dowry orders from the bride's mother.
- Daily missions, daily rewards, a monthly season and rare experts that multiply your profits.
- Music and sounds inspired by traditional Bahraini folk.
- Arabic and English.

Important:
- Gold prices in the game are fictional, not real market prices.
- The game is free to play and offers optional in-app purchases with real money, including gold bars currency, random chests (drop odds are shown in the game) and a VIP subscription.
- VIP renews automatically (weekly or monthly) unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
- The game shows optional rewarded video ads.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tjalgo.com/goldempire/privacy.html
Support: https://tjalgo.com/goldempire/support.html

name: Golden Pop Spin
description:
For users aged 18 and above only. This app does not include real-money gambling, cash payouts, withdrawals, or prizes with real-world monetary value. In-game coins are for virtual gameplay only.

Golden Pop Spin is a colorful tap-to-blast puzzle game. Tap adjacent tiles of the same color to clear them and complete level objectives within a limited number of moves. Put your observation and planning skills to the test with every board.

Use the Hammer, Magnet, Shuffle, and Cross Blast tools to overcome tricky puzzles. Progress through levels or enter Endless Mode to challenge your best score. Explore daily gifts, unlock achievements, and track your progress as you play.

Start with a simple tap and enjoy the excitement of chain reactions!

name: GoLive Co-Host
description:
GoLive Co-Host lets you join a live radio or online show as a co-host from wherever you are, using only your iPhone.

YOU NEED AN INVITE FROM A GOLIVE STATION
This app does not work on its own. The station running the show (the "studio") sends you a 6-digit join code or a join link. Open the link or type the code and you are in. No account, no sign-up, no password.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter the code, or tap the link the studio shared.
• Type your name. The studio sees it.
• Do a quick mic check and see whether your headphones are connected.
• Agree to the Co-Host rules and tap "Join the show". You hear the show and the studio hears you.
• The studio decides when you are live:
  - In cue: the studio hears you, the audience does not.
  - On air: you are live on the show. Speak naturally.
  - On hold: wait a moment, the studio will bring you back.
• The studio can talk to you off air (talkback).
• Mute and Leave are on the screen, and the call keeps running when the screen locks.
• If your connection drops, the app reconnects by itself.

PLEASE USE HEADPHONES
Wired headphones sound best. Without headphones the studio may hear an echo of the show, so keep the phone volume low. Bluetooth headphones work but add a little delay. A steady Wi-Fi or mobile connection gives the best result.

RESPECTFUL SHOWS
Every co-host agrees to the Co-Host rules: no harassment, hate, sexual content, threats, illegal content or spam. The studio runs its show live and can remove a co-host at any time. Tap "Report a problem" to tell us about abuse, and block a station so its shows can't be joined from your phone.

YOUR VOICE AND YOUR DATA
• Your voice goes live, through the GoLive media server, to the studio and the co-hosts of the show you joined. When the studio puts you On air, your voice is part of a public broadcast, and the station may record its show.
• The app itself never records your voice.
• The studio sees the name you enter. Our join service keeps a log of each join (the name, network address and time).
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
Privacy policy: https://live.radioworld.fm/privacy

FOR STATIONS
Co-hosting is an add-on for GoLive stations. The station runs the show from the GoLive Studio Console at live.radioworld.fm/cohost/studio. More at live.radioworld.fm.

Available in English, Français, Español, Português, العربية, Deutsch, हिन्दी, Bahasa Indonesia, Русский and 简体中文.

GoLive Co-Host is made by Nu World Entertainment, a Quadra Wave brand.
© 2026 Quadra Wave Media Limited (RC 9740539), Ibadan, Nigeria.

name: GolMinute
description:
The striker runs up, you wait, and as soon as the ball leaves his foot you swipe toward it. Get there in time and it's a save. After each shot the game shows how many milliseconds you needed.

There are five directions: left, right, straight up and the two top corners. The striker sometimes fakes the kick, and if you move too early it's a false start. A reaction under 100 ms counts as one too, because nobody reacts that fast without guessing.

Goalkeeper is an endless match with three lives. Shots get faster after every save, and a streak of saves raises your score multiplier.

Levels: 12 levels in four arenas, from a neighbourhood pitch to the grand final. Each level gives up to three stars, and the next one opens once you pass the current one.
Training gives you 20 shots without fakes or speed-ups. At the end you see your average, median and best time, and how accurate you were in each zone.
Records keeps your best score, combo and reaction time for each of the four difficulties.

Available in English and Brazilian Portuguese.

name: Gongly
description:
Gongly is an interval timer you can read from across the room. Pick a preset, press Start, and one huge ring counts down every work and rest.

Build your own rounds, ring a bell at every switch, and watch your weeks add up. No account, no ads, no clutter.

THE TIMER
• One big ring for the interval that is running, with the time left in huge numbers
• Round and set counters, and a "Next" card that shows what comes after
• Pause, Resume, Skip, or Stop (it always asks before it stops)
• A short bell and a haptic tap at every switch, each one switchable in Settings
• With the haptic tap on, a light tap in the last three seconds of every interval
• The screen stays awake while the timer runs
• Black and high contrast, with big numbers made for a quick glance

PRESETS
• Name it, pick a color, and set Warm-up, Work, Rest, Rounds, Sets, Rest between sets and Cool-down
• A total line shows how long the whole session takes
• Five presets to start from: Quick sweat, Plank ladder, Stretch break, Boxing rounds and Focus sprint
• Edit, Duplicate or Delete any preset, with an Undo
• Say what you will time (workouts, stretching, study sprints or boxing rounds) and the matching preset is on your timer from the first launch

HISTORY
• Every finished or stopped session, grouped by Today, Yesterday and the weekdays before
• Search by preset name
• Swipe left to remove a session, then Undo
• Each session shows how many rounds you did out of the rounds planned

INSIGHTS
• Switch between 4, 8 and 12 weeks
• Time trained, number of sessions, and the average per week
• A line chart of minutes per week
• Your weekly streak, current and best, based on your own weekly goal
• Your most used presets

HOME
• This week at a glance: sessions done out of your goal, seven day squares and your streak
• Recent sessions below the timer, and one card each for Presets, History, Insights and Settings

SETTINGS
• Weekly goal from 1 to 7 sessions
• Week starts on Monday, Sunday or Saturday
• Appearance: System, Light or Black
• Training reminder at the time you choose, on the days you choose
• Export your sessions as a CSV file
• Reset all data whenever you like

General fitness guidance, not medical advice.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. Gongly needs no account, makes no network requests, shows no ads and collects no data.

name: Goodnight Nightlight
description:
Is your child afraid of the dark and needs you to stay until they fall asleep? Goodnight Nightlight turns an iPhone into a thoughtful nightlight: it glows gently at bedtime, then slowly dims once your child is asleep.

A SOFT LIGHT THAT SLOWLY DIMS
• Five warm colors for your child to pick: Amber, Peach, Moonlight, Lavender and Firefly
• Glowing shapes drift slowly and “breathe” once every 8 seconds, so your child can breathe along
• Dims over 15 to 90 minutes, gradually shifting to the warm red that disturbs sleep the least

NOT SCARY TO WAKE UP
• Keep a faint red glow at the end, so the room is never pitch dark
• If your child wakes up, a tap on the screen gently brings the light back, then it dims again
• When it hears rolling over or talking, dimming pauses for a while

HEAR THE SLEEP TALK (optional, off by default)
• Records only when it hears speech, up to 1 minute per clip, without missing the first words
• Each clip is labeled as sleep talk, laughing, crying or snoring, so you can listen together the next day
• Recordings stay on this iPhone, are never uploaded or backed up to iCloud, and are deleted automatically

DESIGNED TO SAVE BATTERY
• The dimmer the light, the slower the screen refreshes
• Most of the time only loudness is measured; recording starts only when speech is heard
• Choose “Turn off completely” and the iPhone can auto-lock for the best battery life

FOR PARENTS
• No sign-up, no ads, no data collected
• Works with Guided Access, so the iPhone stays in Nightlight

The app follows your iPhone’s language: English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Tip: plug in the charger at bedtime and turn on Do Not Disturb.

name: Gouverne la France : le jeu
description:
Un seul fauteuil à Matignon. Six ministres autour de la table. Et chacun cache son jeu.

Gouverne la France est un jeu de fiction politique pour 2 à 6 joueurs, entre amis ou contre des bots. Chaque joueur incarne un ministre d'une coalition imaginaire, avec un objectif secret : finir Premier ministre, faire tomber le gouvernement, réussir des fuites dans la presse sans se faire prendre…

CRISES, VOTES ET TRAHISONS
• Grèves, krach boursier, canicule, scandale de la villa : une crise tombe à chaque chapitre.
• Le ministre concerné choisit le texte présenté à l'Assemblée.
• Dans les couloirs, achetez des soutiens… ou balancez une fuite au Petit Écho.
• Votez en glissant la carte : POUR à droite, CONTRE à gauche.
• Texte rejeté ? Le Premier ministre peut dégainer le 49.3. Attention à la motion de censure !
• Gouvernement renversé : la table désigne le prochain locataire de Matignon.
• À la fin, les objectifs secrets sont révélés. Qui a trahi qui ?

UN VRAI JEU, SUR LA DURÉE
• Campagne « Le mandat de ta vie » : 10 chapitres, un nouveau chaque jour.
• Défi du jour : la même partie pour tout le monde, un seul essai classé.
• Saisons mensuelles avec classement.
• Niveaux et expérience : débloquez 6 personnages, 3 scénarios (Tempête économique, L'été brûlant, Chaos total), des cadres de portrait et des thèmes de table.
• 22 succès, des titres à afficher, vos statistiques de carrière.

ENTRE AMIS EN 10 SECONDES
Créez un salon, partagez le code : vos amis rejoignent depuis l'application ou depuis un navigateur. Des bots complètent la table. Une partie express dure une dizaine de minutes.

SANS COMPTE, SANS PUB, SANS ACHAT
Aucune inscription, aucune publicité, aucun achat intégré. Votre progression est liée à votre appareil.

Partis, personnages et événements sont inventés : aucun responsable politique réel n'apparaît dans le jeu.

name: GPF Cubo

Shuffle the cube and try to bring every face back to a single colour. Drag a finger on a face to turn the layer you touched. Drag on empty space, or on the middle row, to rotate the cube and look at it from every side.

• 3D cube with animated layers
• Time and moves for every game
• Undo your last move, and a Hint that takes you back along the path already taken
• Records for each player, under your name
• The game in progress saves by itself, even if you close the app

• Built-in help and manual, in Italian and English
• No ads, no account

name: Gracepoints
description:
The family points chart that keeps itself up to date — for one small price, with no ads and no tracking.

ONE PRICE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
$2.99 a year covers every parent, every kid and every phone in your household. One parent subscribes and everyone's covered. Try everything free for 14 days, no card needed.

YOUR FAMILY'S DATA STAYS YOURS
No ads. No analytics or tracking tools. We never sell or share your data. Kids don't need accounts, and you can delete your family's data anytime, right in the app.

BOTH PARENTS, ANY PHONE, ALWAYS IN SYNC
Points one parent gives show up instantly on the other parent's phone, even if you use different kinds of phones. Works offline too.

HOW IT WORKS
• One tap to give points. Open the app, tap "Made your bed," done. Undo is right there.
• Kids spend their own points on rewards you choose. Kid Mode shows their balance and rewards, and a parent PIN keeps them from giving themselves points.
• Points only go up. Points are earned and spent, never taken away as punishment. Built for positive reinforcement, and easy to fit to the system your family or your child's therapist designed.
• The weekly math, done for you. Weekly totals, unspent points rolling into next week, and a full history of who gave what and when.
• Daily limits. "Once a day" tasks ask before counting twice; "up to 5 a day" tasks stop at 5.
• Multiple kids, each with their own chart.

Set up in two minutes: start with example tasks and rewards, change them to fit your family, and invite your partner with a code.

See what you can make with the supplies you already own.

Graph Workshop brings your projects, materials, tools and storage locations together in an interactive graph. Start with the sewing example or create your own workshop.

BUILD YOUR WORKSHOP
Add projects and supplies, record quantities, and connect the things that belong together. Attach a camera or library photo to any item, or choose a distinctive icon. Keep dimensions and material details in notes. Follow connections to find where supplies are stored.

EXPLORE YOUR GRAPH
Move items, zoom into a neighbourhood, search your notes, and edit connections directly. Switch to the list whenever you prefer. The layout adapts to iPhone and iPad.

See which projects are ready based on the requirements you recorded. Compare several projects to spot when they compete for the same materials. Confirm suitability yourself so quantity alone is never mistaken for a perfect match.

 Browse event listings and search by artist, venue or event name. Filter by date and category, view show details and open an external ticket search.

name: GridBlast: Block Puzzle
description:
GridBlast is a simple, satisfying block puzzle with no ads. No pop-ups, no videos, no waiting. Just you, the board and your next move.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag pieces from the tray onto the 8×8 board.
• Fill a full row or column to clear it.
• You get three pieces at a time. Place all three to get a new set.
• Pieces can't be rotated, so plan ahead.
• The game ends when none of your pieces fit.

SCORE BIG
• Clear several lines at once for a bigger bonus.
• Clear lines on back-to-back moves to build a combo multiplier.
• Wipe the whole board for an extra bonus.
• Chase your best score and beat it.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• Smooth drag-and-drop with a preview of exactly where each piece will land.
• Lines about to clear light up before you drop.
• Bright, colorful blocks and satisfying clear effects.
• Haptic feedback as you place and clear.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No ads.
• Works completely offline.
• Your game saves automatically, so you can pick up right where you left off.
• Designed for both iPhone and iPad.
• No accounts, no tracking, no data collected.

name: GridHinge
description:
GridHinge is sudoku played on all six faces of a cube. Rotate it, choose a cell, and enter a number. Edge and corner cells are shared, so a clue on one face can solve a cell on another.

Play a 4 × 4 or 9 × 9 grid with three difficulty levels. Keep several games in progress and return to any of them. Use notes, undo, and Check to work through the puzzle.

Play in English or Polish, offline and without an account.

description:
GrooveBox is a complete beat-making studio that fits in your pocket: twelve pads, a step sequencer, a sampler, a mixer and a song arranger on one screen.

PLAY
• 12 pads that fire the instant you touch them
• Drum, Keys, Chord and Chop modes, so any pad can become a playable instrument
• Note repeat, swing, metronome and tap tempo
• Pads-only view when you just want to play

SEQUENCE
• 16-step sequencer with per-step velocity and notes
• 8 patterns per project, each up to several bars
• Record live with quantize, or tap steps in by hand
• Undo and redo

SAMPLE ANYTHING
• Record from the microphone or import any audio file
• Trim, reverse and chop a sample across the pads
• Resample your own beat back onto a pad

23 BUILT-IN SOUNDS
• Drum kit, 808, bass, keys, lead, pluck, bell, pad and organ synths
• Recorded instruments: grand piano, electric piano, bass guitar, guitar, strings, brass and vibraphone

SHAPE AND MIX
• Volume, pan and tuning on every pad
• Filter, decay and note length
• Reverb and delay sends
• A mixer with a fader, mute and solo for every pad

FINISH THE SONG
• Chain patterns into a full arrangement in Song mode
• Export a stereo WAV, or a separate file for each pad (stems) to take into your DAW
• Play pads from a MIDI keyboard or controller

MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
• Fully open: sequencer, mixer and pads together on the big screen
• Half open: the sequencer stands up and the pads lie flat under your fingers
• Closed: the full app on the outer screen

FREE TO START
GrooveBox is free with 4 pads and 2 projects, and recording and importing your own sounds is included. A single one-time purchase, GrooveBox Pro, unlocks all 12 pads, chord pads, sample chopping, export and unlimited projects. No subscription, no ads, no account.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
GrooveBox collects no data. Your beats and recordings stay on your device.

name: Ground Zero Delivery
description:
Kindness delivers the bomb.

Welcome to Tsukiura, a fictional harbor town. You are a "wrecker" who demolishes only the hideouts of the Black Moon gang.

Your tool: magic powder made from shards of the moon.
Disguise it as a lost parcel and leave it somewhere in town.
Kind residents pick it up and pass it along—to the police box, the mailbox, the address on the label—
until it reaches your target.

HOW TO PLAY
- Choose how to deliver it (drop it, mail it, take it to the post office) and where
- Write a name or building on the label to steer where it ends up
- Set the amount of powder and the timer
- Destroy only the target hideout to succeed

STRICT RULES
- If any civilian dies or an innocent house is damaged, the mission FAILS
- Injuries lower your rating
- If a police officer picks it up, your plan is over
Minimum force, villains only. That's the wrecker's code.

CINEMATIC EXPLOSIONS
- A magic circle opens on detonation, followed by a three-stage blast in slow motion
- From a firecracker pop to wiping the whole town off the map
- Burning streets, ambulances, fire engines and police arrive

34 LANGUAGES
Play in English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish and 29 more.

This is a fantasy set in a fictional town. Rated 18+ for fantasy violence and blood.
One-time purchase. No ads, no in-app purchases.

name: Grumpy Lift: Elevator Puzzle
description:
Run one grumpy brass elevator through a 1970s apartment stairwell. Get everyone to their floor before the stops run out.

Grumpy Lift is a calm, turn-based elevator puzzle. Each level is one building with 3 to 5 floors and a stop budget. Residents, couriers, cats, dogs and a piano each show where they are going and how much room they take. You choose who boards and where to stop. Every stop costs one token, however far you travel. The trick is finding a clever delivery order.

TRY IT FREE, PAY ONCE
• The first 10 levels are free to play.
• One optional in-app purchase unlocks the full game: all 25 levels, plus any levels added in later updates.
• No ads. No subscription. No account.

FAIR, NOT FIDDLY
• Every level was checked by a solver that tries every possibility. Each one can be solved within its budget, and the bonus target is the proven minimum.
• No hidden rules and no randomness. What you see is what happens.
• Preview before you commit: see who boards, who gets off, who rides past their floor, and how many stops you will have left.
• Hints that explain: the first tap gives the reason, the second shows the move. Hints, undo and restart are free and unlimited.

CALM BY DESIGN
• No timers, no lives, no energy. Think as long as you like.
• Your progress is saved after every move, so you can stop and pick up later.
• Works completely offline. Portrait, one-handed play.

FIVE SHIFTS
Start at the bottom with simple rides. Then learn capacity, counting stops, a piano that takes three seats, and the grudge: the cat and the dog will not share the cabin. The upper floors combine everything, with up to six riders per building.

- View historical trends and estimated 4-week and 12-week progress ranges based on your training volume.

4. Universal iPhone & iPad Support + iCloud Sync
- Responsive layout crafted for both iPhone and iPad in portrait and landscape orientations.
- No account or login required: your workout data stays on your device in local SQLite storage.
- Optionally sync across your own iPhone and iPad using your personal iCloud Drive.

5. Apple Health (HealthKit) Workout Sync
- When enabled by you, completed workouts (activity type, start/end time, duration, cardio distance, and training volume summary) are saved directly to Apple Health.
- Write-only integration: the app does not read your private health records or send them to external servers.

6. Private & Offline by Design
- Zero ads, zero tracking, zero third-party analytics.
- Works 100% offline anywhere in the gym.

name: Habeas Fácil
description:
Habeas Fácil ayuda a las familias de personas detenidas por ICE a entender, en español y sin complicaciones, lo que está pasando.

• Dónde está: te guiamos paso a paso para buscar a tu familiar en el localizador oficial de ICE.
• Qué corte le toca: busca el centro de detención y la app te dice la corte federal, la división y la dirección exacta para enviar el habeas por correo.
• Cómo va el habeas: escribe el número de caso y mira cada movimiento del expediente explicado en español sencillo: si el juez pidió respuesta al gobierno, si hubo una decisión y qué significa.
• Glosario: las palabras del expediente en inglés, explicadas.

Sin cuentas, sin anuncios y sin pedir tus datos personales.

Aviso: esta app da información general y no es asesoría legal. Los datos de los expedientes vienen del archivo público CourtListener y puede faltar lo más reciente.

name: Habit Tracker: Gentle Streaks
description:
Habit Tracker helps you keep the habits that matter to you without guilt, red marks or noise. Tap once when you've done it. Miss a day? It shows you how quickly you usually bounce back.

ONE TAP A DAY
• Check in with a single tap, or set the number for counted habits: 5 prayers, 8 glasses of water, 10 pages.
• Schedules that fit real life: every day, chosen weekdays, or a number of times per week.
• Streaks and a 30-day history for every habit.
• Take a day off when you're ill or travelling and your streaks stay safe.
• Check in from your home-screen widget without opening the app.

STARTS WITH YOU
• More than 40 ready-made habits in categories: spiritual, physical, health, mind, money and more. Or create your own.
• Prayer reminders at the five prayer times for your city, worked out on your phone, with no location access.
• Ramadan habits that appear only during Ramadan.
• Habits that used to cost money (smoking, takeaway coffee) show how much you've kept.
• Notes on any day, reminders at the time you choose, and English, Arabic, French and Spanish.

FULL ANALYSIS (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• 90-day and 365-day heatmaps.
• A dashboard across all your habits for 7, 30 and 90 days.
• Insights worked out from your own history: how fast you recover, your strongest and softest weekdays, patterns in your notes.
• Reminder times suggested from when you actually check in.
• A monthly recap, plus weekly, monthly and yearly PDF reports to keep or share.
• Money kept per month and year, and more than one reminder per habit.
Insights appear only once there's enough history to say something true.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything is stored on your phone and never sent to us. Back up to a file whenever you like.

One purchase, yours to keep. No subscription.

name: Habolo: Habit Tracker & Goals
description:
Habolo is a calm habit tracker for people who are tired of subscriptions, onboarding quizzes and streaks that reset to zero.

STRENGTH INSTEAD OF A FRAGILE STREAK
Every habit has a strength ring from 0 to 100%. Doing the habit grows it. Missing a day lowers it a little, and it never drops back to zero. One rest day a week is forgiven automatically.

A HABIT IN ONE LINE
Type "Water 8 glasses every day at 9:00" or "Gym mon wed fri" and the habit is ready: amount, schedule and reminder included. No survey, no account, no paywall before your first habit.

REMINDERS THAT LISTEN
Each reminder has Did it, In 15 min and In 1 hour buttons, so you can answer without opening the app. Habolo does not remind you about a habit you have already marked, and it never sends promotional notifications.

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
- iPhone and iPad
- Apple Watch app: mark habits from your wrist
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that mark habits with one tap
- iCloud sync between your devices, through your own iCloud

BUILD AND QUIT
Track habits you want to keep (a checkmark or an amount such as pages, minutes or glasses) and habits you want to drop (count clean days).

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Export everything to JSON or CSV and import it back at any time, for free. There is no Habolo account and nothing is collected.

FREE
Unlimited habits, reminders, strength and streaks, calendar, small widget, Apple Watch app, iCloud sync, export and import.

HABOLO PRO - ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
- Strength chart for the last 90 days
- Map of the last 12 months
- Apple Health: steps, distance, exercise minutes, workouts, sleep, mindful minutes, active energy or water mark a habit for you. Habolo only reads the value you choose and never writes to Health.
- Medium and Lock Screen widgets
- Accent color for the whole app

name: Hagia Sophia 360 Guide
description:
Hagia Sophia 360 Guide helps you get to know Hagia Sophia on Istanbul's historic peninsula before and during your visit. This structure has a long history, from the Eastern Roman period through the Ottoman era to its present use as a mosque open for worship.

The free sections provide a general introduction to the building, a brief history, and information about its current use. The History section summarizes the process that begins with three churches and extends through the mosque and museum periods. The How to Get There section describes connections by tram, metro, ferry, Marmaray, and airport, along with walking options in the surrounding area.

A one-time purchase unlocks the full guide. The unlocked sections cover, in order, spaces such as the Byzantine-era mosaics, the dome and pendentives, the Imperial Gate, the omphalion, the mihrab and minbar, the upper gallery, and the south gallery. The timeline page shows step by step how the building changed in different periods.

The virtual tour section is also unlocked through a separate purchase. The tour lets you explore scenes such as the sanctuary, mihrab, minbar, mosaics, entrance, exit, baptistery, garden, and fountain.

Hagia Sophia is an active mosque. While using the guide, please be respectful: keep quiet, do not walk in front of people who are praying, do not photograph them, and do not use flash. Visiting arrangements may change according to prayer times, so please check current information before planning your visit.

name: Halal Food Checker & Scanner
description:
Is it halal? Scan the barcode and know in seconds.

Halal Food Checker reads a product's ingredients and tells you if it is Halal, Haram or Doubtful, then shows exactly which ingredient decided the verdict. No more reading tiny ingredient lists in the grocery aisle.

CATCH HIDDEN HARAM INGREDIENTS
Gelatin, lard, pork enzymes, carmine, L-cysteine, wine, rum and beer flavor, and alcohol-based vanilla extract: the app checks every ingredient on the list, not just the obvious ones.

DOUBTFUL? WE EXPLAIN WHY
Some ingredients depend on their source: mono and diglycerides, whey, enzymes, glycerin, "natural flavors". Instead of a vague "maybe", you see what needs verifying and what to look for on the package.

NO BARCODE? SNAP THE LABEL
Bakery items, imported snacks and products from the local halal store often have no barcode in any database. Take a photo of the ingredient list or type it in. Your label photos are not published anywhere.

LOOK UP ANY INGREDIENT OR E-NUMBER
Traveling or shopping imported brands? Search any ingredient or E-number (E471, E120, E441) and see whether it is halal, haram or depends on its source.

EVERY SCAN SAVED
Your history keeps every product you have checked. Save favorites to find your family's regular products in a tap.

MADE FOR EVERY MUSLIM
Use the app in English, Arabic, Urdu, Turkish, French, German, Malay or Indonesian.

GETS BETTER WITH YOU
Missing product? Add it with a photo of the label. Think a result is wrong? Report it and our team reviews it.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Scan for free every day. Premium removes the daily limit and all ads. Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, billed to your Apple Account and renewing unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://halalfoodcheck.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://halalfoodcheck.com/privacy

Important: results are based on the available ingredient data, which may be incomplete or out of date. The app is not a halal certificate and does not verify zabihah slaughter. Always check the package, and look for a recognized halal certification when it matters to you.

name: Halau Growth
description:
Halau Growth is the mobile companion to Hālau, the growth platform for nonprofits and mission-driven teams.

MY WORK — Your action items and personal priorities, one tap from done. Overdue work surfaces first, and completing something feels as good as it should (yes, there's confetti).

MEETING RUNNER — Run your team meeting from your phone or an iPad on the table. Work the agenda topic by topic, record decisions, spin off action items, and wrap up with everything captured — nothing lives on a whiteboard photo again.

HOME — A warm daily read: what needs your attention across commitments, surveys, and your team's numbers.

FOCUS — Your organization's mission, vision, values, and this season's priorities and critical numbers. The one-pager that keeps everyone rowing in the same direction.

HEARTBEATS — Answer your team's recurring check-in in under a minute and watch your own trend over time.

RECURRING TASKS — Confirm the obligations that come around on a schedule, with a photo or PDF as evidence when it is required.

POLICIES, PEOPLE, AND SEARCH — Read your organization's policies, find anyone on the org chart, and search across your work.

Halau Growth signs in with your existing Hālau account. Accounts are created by your organization on the web at halaugrowth.com.

name: Handflow
description:
Handflow is a practice app for learning massage steps efficiently, with voice and figures.
Instead of flipping through videos or books, follow each step by voice and figure. The app moves to the next step on its own, so you don't have to touch the screen.

WHEN IT HELPS
• Skim through a routine to check the steps
• Practice hand movements while listening
• Review the order in spare moments

FEATURES
■ Two ways to play
"Quick" reads out only the step names, one after another. "Detailed" walks through each movement on a set time.

■ Figures with markers
Markers on a head figure show where to touch. You can flip the figure left to right and pinch to zoom.

■ Review to remember the order
Recall "what comes after…?" at growing intervals. No scores, no streaks.

■ Voice-guided
Uses your device's built-in voice. You can set the reading speed and a "3, 2, 1" count at the end of each movement.

■ Japanese and English

THE CURRENT COURSE
Head care (18 steps, about 14 minutes). More body areas will be added over time.

PRICE
The first 3 steps are free. The rest can be used for good with a one-time purchase.

NOTES
• This app is learning material for memorizing steps. It is not medical treatment and makes no claims about health effects.
• If you have a health condition, please be careful and consult a doctor.
• On iPhone, the voice may not play when the silent switch is on.

Privacy Policy: https://chidosetsu-legal.chidosetsu.workers.dev/lp/handflow-privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Handily Pro
description:
Handily Pro is the field app for crews at home-service companies. The office schedules the work; Handily Pro puts it in your pocket.

YOUR DAY, ALREADY LOADED
Home shows what you're on now and what's next. Schedule opens the full day, week, or month. Tap a job for the address, the scope, and everything that's happened on it so far. The map shows today's jobs and the properties around them, with one-tap directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps, or Waze.

CLOCK IN WHERE THE WORK IS
Tap On my way, Clock in, and Clock out as the day goes. Your time card shows the week so far, and you can fix a bad punch yourself instead of calling the office. Request time off and set your work hours from Settings.

CAPTURE IT BEFORE YOU FORGET IT
Log photos, notes, checklist items, materials, receipts, permits, and equipment on the job, and they sync back to the office. When you add a cost, Handily Pro suggests items from your company's Price Book and from what you've used before.

QUOTE AND BILL ON SITE
Build an estimate or change order at the door and send it while you're still standing there. Open the invoice to take payment before you leave. Met someone new out on the job? Save the lead, or let them scan your referral QR code.

STAY IN THE LOOP
Text customers from the inbox and send them estimates, invoices, and change orders right in the thread. Team threads keep you in touch with the office and the rest of the crew.

FOR CREW LEADS
See your crew's schedules, approve their time, and add people to the team, all from your phone.

KEEPS WORKING WHEN SERVICE DOESN'T
Clock in, shoot photos, and write notes in a basement or out past the last tower. Handily Pro queues it all and sends it when you're back online.

LOCATION
Handily Pro uses your location only while the app is open. It records where you were when you tap On my way, Clock in, or Clock out, and it shows where you are on the map. It never tracks you in the background.

Handily Pro requires a Handily account set up by your employer. If your company doesn't use Handily yet, ask your office to invite you.

name: HarborMaster
description:
Ta befälet över kustens mest trafikerade hamn! Bogserbåtar, segelbåtar, fisketrålare, passagerarfärjor, containerfartyg och enorma oljetankers anländer från alla håll. Din uppgift är att styra in varje fartyg säkert till rätt kajplats.

Rita helt enkelt en rutt med fingret så följer fartyget efter. Se till att varje fartyg hamnar vid en kajplats i samma färg, håll farlederna fria och lägg till fartyg tätt intill varandra för att skapa stora kombinationer. En enda felmanöver och två fartyg krockar! Om du förlorar alla tre livbojar stänger hamnen!

Funktioner

Enkla och intuitiva kontroller – rita för att styra
20 handgjorda nivåer fördelade på 4 regioner: Lugna viken, Korallkusten, Stormsundet och Arktiska hamnen
Farliga korallrev, vassa klippor, stormar och drivande isflak
6 unika fartyg, alla med sin egen storlek, hastighet och sitt eget värde
Samla upp till 3 stjärnor per nivå och slå dina egna rekord
13 utmärkelser att låsa upp och en kaptensloggbok där du kan följa din rang
Kan spelas helt offline, helt utan reklam

name: Hare: Race Card for HYROX
description:
Pick the finish time you want for your HYROX race. A hare runs the race at that pace. Stay with it.

Hare turns your goal time into a race card for HYROX: all 8 runs (1 km each) and 8 stations, from the SkiErg to the wall balls, each with its own split and the clock time you should see when you leave it. On race day the Apple Watch app runs the card as a pacer. After the race, your line against the hare becomes a poster.

Free for your first race, card to poster. One payment after that. No account, no subscription.

THE CARD
• Drag the dial to your goal. All 16 splits re-pace under your thumb.
• Open or Pro: the station times shift with the division.
• Every run includes the walk-in, so each round adds up to the clock time you will see.
• Tune the hare to your strengths: faster on the sleds, slower on wall balls. The runs take up the difference.
• Raced before? Add your splits from a results screenshot (read on your iPhone) or type them, and see where you lost time.

THE PACER (APPLE WATCH)
• Tap Start at the start line. The hare runs on the clock; tap the screen or double tap at each change.
• One big number on every run and every station: the time left before the hare finishes that part, and how far ahead or behind you came in.
• Miss a press and the next one fills it in. Press by accident and hold to step back.
• The card lives on the watch, so it works with no phone and no signal.
• Saved to Apple Health as one workout with its parts marked, if you allow it.

THE POSTER
• Your line above the hare where you were ahead, below where it got away.
• Save it to Photos or share it as an image or a short video.

BETWEEN RACES
• Rehearse a round in any gym session: 1 km and one station, timed against the hare, on the watch or on your iPhone. Then go straight on to the next round.
• The Lock Screen widget counts down to race day with the time you are chasing.
• A printable wristband for any watch.

UNLOCK HARE (ONE PAYMENT)
Tune the hare to your strengths, every race after the first, the hare running your own last race, and more poster colours and sizes. Restore is on the paywall and in About.

Pacing comes from published third-party race averages, not official data. Hare is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by HYROX.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://amanukyan.github.io/hare/privacy.html

name: Hasp Wheel
description:
Hasp Wheel keeps a combination for a suitcase on this iPhone.

Name the case, then drag the left wheel, the middle wheel, and the right wheel. Each drag moves that digit from 0 through 9. When the three wheels are not all on zero, drag the hasp down onto them. The name, the three digits, and the time you kept them stay on this phone.

Open the side drawer to see cases kept here. Before you drop a hasp, the list is empty. After you drop it, the list shows the name and the code. Tap the name to open that case again.

Hasp Wheel does not open a physical lock, and it does not store website passwords. There is no account, no upload, and no iCloud. Removing the app, or moving to another phone, leaves the record behind.

name: Hasten Network
description:
Hasten Network is the official app for Hasten Network Private Limited broadband subscribers. Manage your internet connection anytime, right from your phone.

• Account at a glance – see your plan, expiry date, data left and connection status
• Quick recharge – choose a plan and pay online, or recharge with a PIN
• Expiry reminder – get notified before your plan runs out
• Usage tracking – check daily and total download and upload usage
• Bills – view invoices, ledger and payment history
• Internet Check – find out why your internet isn't working and raise a complaint
• Support – raise and track support tickets
• Wi-Fi settings – manage your Wi-Fi name and password (supported routers)
• KYC – complete e-KYC with Aadhaar or upload your documents
• Secure login – username and password or OTP, with fingerprint or face lock

Privacy policy: https://account.hastenindia.com/privacy_policy

An active Hasten Network broadband connection is required. For help, contact Hasten Network customer support.

name: HD Player נגן מוזיקה ווידאו
description:
HD Player מנגנת את המוזיקה והסרטונים שלכם במקום אחד נוח וברור, בעברית מלאה מימין לשמאל. מוסיפים קבצים מאפליקציית הקבצים, הם נשמרים באפליקציה וממשיכים לנגן גם כשהמסך כבוי, בלי חשבון ובלי פרסומות

הספרייה שלכם
• לשוניות לשירים, לסרטונים, לאלבומים, לאמנים ולפלייליסטים
• הוספה של כמה קבצים בבת אחת מאפליקציית הקבצים, גם מ-iCloud Drive
• חיפוש ומיון לפי שם, תאריך הוספה, אמן ואורך
• ניגון הכל וניגון אקראי בלחיצה אחת
• מועדפים ופלייליסטים משלכם
• שינוי שם, שיתוף ומחיקה של קבצים
• תור ניגון: נגן הבא, הוספה לתור, מעבר לפריט והסרה ממנו

ניגון ברקע ושליטה מבחוץ
• המוזיקה ממשיכה לנגן כשעוברים לאפליקציה אחרת או נועלים את המסך
• פקדי ניגון במסך הנעילה ובמרכז הבקרה, עם שם השיר ועטיפת האלבום
• שליטה מהאוזניות
• הניגון נעצר כשמנתקים את האוזניות

מסך הניגון
• מהירות ניגון מ-0.5x עד 2x
• דילוג של 10 שניות קדימה ואחורה
• ערבוב וחזרה על כל התור או על שיר אחד
• טיימר שינה שמנמיך את הקול בהדרגה לפני העצירה

נגן הסרטונים
• מסך מלא עם סיבוב לרוחב
• חלון צף (תמונה בתוך תמונה)
• הקול של הסרטון ממשיך כשנועלים את המסך
• המשך צפייה מהמקום שבו עצרתם

פתיחה מאפליקציות אחרות
• קובץ שמע או וידאו שפותחים ב-HD Player מאפליקציית הקבצים, מהדואר או מתפריט השיתוף מתנגן מיד ונשמר בספרייה

פורמטים
MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP4, M4V ו-MOV

פרטיות
בלי חשבון, בלי הרשמה, בלי פרסומות ובלי מעקב. האפליקציה לא ניגשת לאינטרנט, והקבצים שלכם לא עולים לשום שרת. הקבצים, הפלייליסטים, המועדפים ונקודות ההמשך נשמרים במכשיר בלבד

המוזיקה והסרטונים שלכם מתנגנים כמו שצריך ונשארים אצלכם

name: Heads or Tiles: Frontline
description:
Heads or Tiles: Frontline is a word game tug of war.

A glowing line runs across a board of letter tiles. Swipe touching letters to spell a word, and the line moves toward your rival's edge. Longer words pull harder. Pull the line all the way to their edge to win.

PLAY AGAINST PIP
Pip, the computer, plays on easy, normal or hard. Take too long and the line slips back toward you.

LEVELS
The Line, then Split Line, where every column has its own line, then Gold Rush, where gold tiles pull double. Earn up to three stars on each.

CLIMB AND DAILY CLIMB
Just you: push the line to the top to climb a floor, and see how high you can go. The Daily Climb has the same letters for everyone, one try a day, with a streak to keep.

CHALLENGE A FRIEND
Play a word, send a link, and your friend plays back on their own phone whenever they like, in the app or in their web browser. Or pass one phone between two players.

FOR NEW AND YOUNG PLAYERS
Turn on Helper in Settings and that player's words pull as if they were one letter longer. The turn timer can be relaxed or switched off.

NO ACCOUNT
No sign-up, no ads, nothing to buy. Everything except Challenge a friend plays offline, and your levels, stars and best floor stay on your phone. Privacy: https://headsortiles.com/privacy/

Words are checked against the public-domain ENABLE word list.

Terms: https://headsortiles.com/terms/

name: Healthy Meal Planner: Recipes
description:
Healthy Meal Planner makes eating well simple.

• 120+ healthy recipes with nutrition, ingredients and step-by-step cooking
• 7-day planner for breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks, with daily calories and macros
• Smart shopping list built automatically from your plan
• My Kitchen: find recipes you can cook with what you already have
• Create and save your own recipes
• Water tracker, streaks and gentle daily reminders
• Earn points for healthy habits and unlock partner coupons
• 10 languages: English, हिन्दी, ગુજરાતી, Español, Français, Deutsch, العربية, 中文, Português, 日本語

No ads. Use it as a guest or create a free account to keep your progress on every device. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

Nutrition values are estimates for general information only and are not medical advice. Consult a doctor or registered dietitian before changing your diet.

name: HearthNight
description:
Gather around the couch for HearthNight — a cozy, 100% offline Family Trivia & Fair-Turn Story Night built for living rooms, road trips, and holiday evenings together.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY TOGETHER (2–6 PLAYERS)
• Couch Trivia Blitz: 6 curated family trivia packs (48 questions) designed for kids and grownups alike. Choose Pass-and-Play with a 1-tap privacy shield (timer pauses while handing over the device) or Split-Screen Buzzer mode with color-coded pads and Rebound Buzz if someone misses. Pick your pace: Blitz (15s), Cozy (25s), or Untimed.
• Fireside Story Theater: 4 illustrated branching adventures (20 chapters and 8 cozy endings). Tap Read Aloud for built-in voice narration with Slow, Cozy, and Normal pacing. When couch votes tie, our Fair-Turn Tiebreaker automatically rotates the deciding vote to players who haven't won a tiebreak yet — keeping story night fair for everyone.

BUILT FOR THE LIVING ROOM
• TV Stage Mode enlarges typography, adds an AirPlay overscan safe zone, and lights up crisp focus halos for keyboard and couch play across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
• Quick 5-second roster setup with fun avatars and saved local presets.

PRIVATE & PEACEFUL BY DESIGN
• 100% offline — works without Wi-Fi or accounts.
• Zero ads, zero subscriptions, zero in-app purchases, and zero data collected.

name: Hearthvale: Cozy Merge Story
description:
Welcome to Hearthvale, a cozy merge game filled with heartwarming stories, charming villagers and a forgotten valley waiting to bloom again.

After the war, Ellie, a young healer, returns home with a handful of seeds and a dream of rebuilding her village. Merge items, complete orders, restore beautiful places and uncover the stories hidden beneath the ashes.

Merge, craft and discover
Tap producers like the stone oven, garden bed and beehive to create useful items. Combine two identical items to discover new creations, complete orders and unlock more possibilities. Explore 9 merge chains with 10 items each:
• Bakery • Garden • Healer
• Tea House • Tailor • Carpenter
• Smithy • Fisher • Honey
Merge your producers too and discover even more ways to craft!

Help villagers and build friendships
Meet Grandpa Otto the baker, Auntie Rosa from the tea house, Bruno the retired soldier, Greta the blacksmith, shy Theo the fisherman and Hazel the beekeeper. Complete their orders, earn stars and gold, and build friendships as each villager reveals their own heartwarming story.

Restore, decorate and customize your village
Bring the valley back to life through 200 restoration tasks across 8 regions:
• Village Square • Bakery Street
• Smithy Yard • Harbor
• Windmill Hill • Castle Courtyard
• Forest Edge • Hot Spring Path
Repair ruined buildings, transform forgotten corners and choose the style of wells, benches, lanterns and boats. Watch your village bloom again, one restoration at a time!

Uncover a story in every task
Every restoration task plays a short story scene. Every five tasks unlock a Hearth Memory from the days before the war. Who saved the last ember of the Great Hearth?

Celebrate seasonal festivals
Every two weeks a seasonal festival arrives with special orders, seasonal treats and a Festival Pass full of rewards.

Relax and play your way
A relaxing merge puzzle you can play offline, for a few minutes or a whole evening. Fill your album, finish daily quests, open calendar gifts and collect achievements. Cloud save with Game Center keeps your village safe.

Build, merge, decorate and uncover the secrets of Hearthvale. Your village is waiting!

Hearthvale includes optional in-app purchases. Rewarded ads are optional and only play when you choose to watch one.

Terms (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://patpatgames.com/hearthvale/privacy.html

name: Height Count: Growth Tracker
description:
Height Count helps parents keep a simple record of how their child is growing, using nothing but a phone and two marks on the wall.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Stick two markers on a wall once and enter the distance between them (for example, the long edge of an A4 sheet, 29.7 cm).
2. Have your child stand against the wall and take a photo.
3. The app suggests a head line and a floor line. Adjust them if needed and confirm.
4. The height is saved in cm or inches as an approximate estimate.

WHAT YOU GET
• Works on ordinary phones; no LiDAR or special hardware needed
• A weekly reminder so measuring becomes a habit
• A history of every entry in one place
• A graph of your child's height over time
• A photo timeline to look back on how far they have come
• Centimeters or inches, your choice

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Photos and measurements are stored on your phone and are never sent to us or to any server. If your phone's own backup is on, they may be included in that backup. No account, no ads, and no data collection.

TRY IT FREE
Start with a 14-day free trial. After that, a one-time lifetime purchase unlocks the app. No subscription.

Height Count gives approximate estimates for your own records. It is not a medical device; if you have concerns about your child's health or growth, please consult a doctor.

name: Heirloom Kitchen: Cooking Show
description:
Keep the recipe. Keep the person.

Heirloom Kitchen turns your family's recipes into little homemade cooking shows: the cook's own words and measurements, the stories behind the dish, short clips of how they do it, and how they know it's just right.

• Record each step on video, so "a handful" and "until it looks right" finally make sense
• Keep family measurements exactly as the cook says them
• Scan a handwritten recipe card and keep the original alongside the typed recipe
• Save the stories with story interviews, plus photos of the finished dish
• Cook along with Cook Mode: big steps, read-aloud and hands-free voice commands like "next step"
• Plan a holiday menu with a shopping list and a cooking timeline
• Make "My version" of a recipe without losing the original
• Make a keepsake book PDF, Then & Now movies and gift shows to share with the family
• Watch together on the TV with AirPlay

Private by design: no accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your recipes and recordings stay on your device. Speech recognition runs on the device, and nothing is shared unless you export a copy yourself.

name: HER Peptides
description:
HER Peptides is a no subscription, no ads, one-time purchase, private and local-only tracking app for organizing peptide inventory, reconstituted vials, hormone therapy (HRT) vials, scheduled dose tasks, injection logs, notes, and proposed peptide stacks.

Built for women who want one clean place to record their own values, HER Peptides helps calculate syringe draw units from user-entered vial, water, and dose information, show remaining vial supply, and keep daily protocol tasks easy to review.

Core features:
- Calculator: enter your vial, water and dose to see exactly what to draw, no setup needed
- Dry vial inventory tracking
- Reconstituted vial tracking with remaining supply
- HRT tracking for estradiol, progesterone and testosterone vials, with user-entered mg and units per dose
- Injection-site rotation on a female body map that suggests the site that has rested longest
- Weekly day scheduling and local reminders, with private reminders that keep names off your lock screen
- Dose calendar, daily tasks, and adherence streaks
- Injection site logging with date and time history
- Spending tracker: record what you paid per vial or per bundle, and see your monthly cost as vials are used
- Continue on a fresh vial: when a vial runs out mid-protocol, carry the same schedule onto a new one in one tap
- Reuse past protocols instead of rebuilding them
- Custom peptide names and stack planning
- Export your dose log as a spreadsheet to share with your doctor
- Optional Face ID lock and encrypted local backups

Privacy:
HER Peptides does not require an account, does not include ads, does not use analytics, and does not sync data to a backend. Your data stays on your device unless you choose to export or share it.

Important:
HER Peptides is a personal tracking and arithmetic tool. It is not medical advice, is not a medical device, and does not recommend substances, dosages, protocols, diagnoses, or treatment decisions. Users enter their own information and should consult a qualified healthcare professional before making health decisions.

name: Hestto: Xtream IPTV Player
description:
Hestto is laid out like a study notebook. Its first page is a contents page: Live, Films, Series, Highlights, Documents and Voice notes, each on its own dotted line with a count, and above them one Continue card that takes you back to the episode you were watching, the page you were reading or the note you recorded last.

WATCH YOUR OWN PLAYLIST
- Sign in with the Xtream Codes details your provider gave you, paste an M3U link, or choose an M3U file. Name each playlist; keep as many as you like.
- Live, Films and Series open on a line of subjects written across the page. Tap one, or open All subjects to search them, sort them and pin the ones you use.
- Films and series sit on index cards; a series page stacks every season and offers Continue on the episode you left.
- The player keeps the lineup on a ruled page under the picture: tap the next line to change channel. Skip 10 seconds in films and episodes, pick audio and subtitle tracks, and pick up where you stopped.
- Star channels, films and series to keep them on the Highlights page. Recent channels appear on Contents.

READ YOUR DOCUMENTS
- Open a PDF from Files and Hestto keeps a copy on this device.
- It reopens on the last page you read. Search in the text, bookmark pages and switch the page tint between Paper, Sepia and Night.
- On iPad, a document lies open as a two-page spread when you turn the iPad sideways.

RECORD YOUR LECTURES
- Tap Record, pause when the room goes quiet, drop a marker at the parts that matter, and stop to save.
- Give each recording a name and a coloured label such as Lectures or Summaries, then filter, search and sort them.
- Play back at 0.75x to 2x, jump to a marker, and save a recording to Files. You can also bring audio files in.

ON IPAD
Contents and your channels lie open side by side as a two-page spread, and Voice notes shows your recordings beside the one playing.

A PLAYER, NOTHING MORE
Hestto has no channels, films, series, documents or recordings of its own and sells no subscription. To watch, add a playlist from a provider you have a lawful subscription with. Your documents and recordings come from you.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
Hestto is free, with no ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking. Your playlists, documents and recordings stay on your device.

Terms of use (Apple's standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://hestto.pages.dev/privacy
Support: support@hestto.app

name: Hew: Goals Habits Tasks Period
description:
Goals, Habits, Tasks. Period.

Hew is one flat list of what to do today. Each item is a Habit, which repeats, or a Task, which is done once. Attach it to a Goal and it takes that Goal's color, so the list shows what each action is for.

HABITS AND TASKS
- Pull down to add a Habit or Task.
- Swipe right to complete it. Swipe left to edit, pause or delete it.
- Habits repeat daily, on weekdays, on weekends, or one to six times a week.
- Tasks can have a due date. Habits can have an end date.
- A progress bar shows one segment for each Habit or Task due that day.
- Completed ones turn dark, are struck through and drop to the bottom.

GOALS
- Open the orange tab to see your Goals.
- Give each Goal a color, a target date and a why.
- Each Goal shows how many of its Habits and Tasks are done today.
- Swipe right when a Goal is achieved. It folds away under ACHIEVED.

COLOR
- Fourteen areas of life, each with its own color and icon: Health, Wealth, Work, Business, Love, Family, Friends, Home, Spirituality, Mind, Play, Sport, Entertainment and Travel.
- Goals, Habits and Tasks are grouped by color.
- Press and hold a group to move it up or down. This needs iOS 18 or later.
- A Habit or Task with no color stays white, in its own Unassigned group.

CALENDAR
- Flip the whole app over to a calendar, three days across.
- It runs about six months back and six months ahead.
- Each day shows its Habits and Tasks as colored squares.
- Tap a day to open its list. Past days can be filled in. Future days cannot.

INSIGHTS
- Longest streak, Goals reached, Habit check-ins and Tasks done.
- A pie of your Goals, Habits and Tasks by color.
- Completions over time, streaks by Habit and totals by color.
- Seven time frames, from this week to all time.

DESIGN
- Flat, edge to edge and dark. No shadows and no gradients.
- Bold type and a palette of olives, browns and tans.
- Gestures in place of buttons.

PRIVATE
- No account and no sign-in.
- No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
- Everything you enter is stored on your iPhone. The app never sends it anywhere.
- This version has no sync between devices. Deleting the app deletes its data.

Hew is a tracking tool. It does not provide medical, financial or other professional advice.

name: Hex: voice dictation keyboard
description:
Hex is a keyboard you talk to. Tap the Hex key in any app, say what you mean, and your words land right where you're typing. No switching apps, no copy and paste.

Hex comes with Hex Keyboard, a custom keyboard you add in Settings, plus a Control Center control and an Action Button shortcut.

Free and on your iPhone
Hex uses Apple's on-device speech recognition. What you say is turned into text on your iPhone and never sent anywhere. There's no account, no subscription and no cloud.

Your music keeps playing
Hex records with the iPhone's built-in microphone alongside whatever is playing, so songs, podcasts and car audio don't stop while you dictate.

What you get
• Dictation right inside the keyboard, in every app
• Push to talk: hold the Hex key, talk, let go
• Styles for how it's written: Polished, Casual, Notes and Verbatim
• Every language Apple can transcribe on device, picked from your iPhone's languages or switched from the keyboard
• Dictate from the Action Button or Control Center, with a Live Activity while it records

Experiments
Some features are still experiments. They stay off until you turn them on in Hex, and all of them run on your iPhone:
• Full keyboard: a complete keyboard with autocorrect and a Hex key, with English, Norwegian, Spanish and German layouts
• Clean up what I say: drops ums, repeats and the words you corrected, so "Friday at 3pm, actually 4pm" becomes "Friday at 4pm"
• Clean up with Apple Intelligence: fixes misheard words on iPhones that support it
• Translate what I say: speak one language, insert another
• Custom vocabulary: names and terms spelled your way
• Learn how I type: learns from the fixes you make, never from what you write

About Full Access
Hex Keyboard asks for Full Access so it can record with the microphone you allowed for Hex and share your settings with the Hex app. Hex has no servers and no analytics. Nothing you type or say leaves your iPhone.

Requirements
iOS 18 or later. Dictating inside the keyboard, and languages other than English, need iOS 26 or later; on earlier versions Hex opens to record, then takes you back. Speech models download once, the first time you use a language.

name: Hexbrew: Idle Witch RPG
description:
A witch, a staff and a long road full of monsters.

Hexbrew is an idle RPG in pixel art. The witch walks on and casts her spells by herself, and she keeps fighting while you are away, for up to eight hours. Tap a spell to cast it at once, or leave it to her.

Your part is to make her stronger: train her, pick her spells, brew her potions and decide when she is ready for the next trial.

• Cross eight regions, from Whisperwood to the Eclipse Sanctum, and face 54 monsters and 24 bosses. After that the road goes on as Nightmare, harder each time.
• Collect 21 spells in six elements, from Ember Bolt to Starfall. Up to six are in use at once, and every region is weak to one element.
• Brew eight potions from the ingredients monsters drop. The cauldron keeps working while the game is closed.
• Find wands, hats, robes and charms. Four of a kind merge into a better one.
• Gather eight familiars. One fights at her side, and all of them give a bonus.
• Rise through the coven in rank trials, climb the endless Moon Tower and take on three dungeons with daily keys.
• Follow the guide quests, finish daily tasks and feats, and collect gifts on a seven-day calendar.

The summoning circles give random spells, relics and familiars. Each circle shows its chances before you summon. Moonstones, which pay for summoning, are earned by playing and also sold in the shop.

Free, with optional purchases and no ads. Plays offline. English and Portuguese.

name: heyRoamly: Trips with friends
description:
Plan a trip around your interests, budget and pace. heyRoamly turns a destination and a few details into a day-by-day itinerary you can edit, save and share.

PLAN IN A FEW TAPS
• Choose a city, country or region, your departure date, 1 to 10 days and up to 10 travelers
• Pick a travel style (Budget, Comfort or Luxury) and what you love: nature, food, culture, adventure, photography or relaxation
• Add your pace, your home city and any dietary, accessibility or family needs
• Watch your itinerary appear day by day as it's written
• Short on ideas? Browse destinations or open a sample three-day Kyoto itinerary

EVERY DAY, LAID OUT
• Activities with times, descriptions and a map link for each place
• Know before you go: highlights and things to plan around at your destination
• A rough cost estimate for your travel style, and packing cues for your kind of trip

MAKE IT YOURS
• Edit any activity, and move days and activities around
• Not feeling a day? Sign in and plan just that day again
• Save trips to My trips and reopen past searches from History
• Share a read-only link with friends. Your home city, travel dates and account details are left out, and you can revoke the link at any time.

TRAVEL TOGETHER
• Find trips other travelers are hosting from your city and ask to join with a short introduction
• Hosts approve who comes, and meeting details are shared only with approved travelers
• Get a notification when someone asks to join your trip or a host answers your request

ROAD TRIPS
• Plan a multi-day drive between towns anywhere in the world, one way or as a loop
• See each day's distance, drive time and overnight stop, with notes on what to confirm before you go

START YOUR WAY
• Plan as a guest, no account needed
• Sign in with Apple, Google or a one-time email code to save trips and keep your history
• Delete your account from the Account screen at any time

Good to know: itineraries are AI suggestions, not bookings. Prices, opening hours, weather and entry rules change, so check them before you travel. Hosts aren't verified, so use your own judgment before traveling with people you met online. heyRoamly doesn't sell flights, hotels or tours.

name: Hi Kifak
description: Lebanese is spoken far more than it is written, and when it is written it is usually typed in Latin letters and digits. Hi Kifak lets you say a message out loud and have it typed that way for you, in WhatsApp, Messages, or any other app.

name: Highline Construction Unlisted
description: For company communications between employees and administrators.  Provides easy contact options to any employee, and manage information being sent to the office all in one place.

name: Hippodrome Casino Horse Show
description:
Discover the elegance of royal equestrian tradition with Hippodrome Casino Horse Show, a visual guide to horse performances, breeds, and historical costumes.

Browse the show schedule and open each performance to read its time, venue, and highlights. Filter the list by day and find out what each show features before you plan your visit.

Meet the horses. The gallery introduces a selection of horses with their age, coat, specialization, and temperament, along with short stories and interesting facts. Explore the breeds that shaped European riding, from the Andalusian and the Friesian to the Lipizzaner and the Cleveland Bay.

Find your way around with the festival map. Tap any marker to see a location's activities, related shows, and services, from the entrance to the first aid point. The map works without an internet connection.

Step back in time with Costume History. Browse collections of ceremonial uniforms, horse equipment, and riding fashion. Each piece includes its period, materials, and historical background.

Plan your seats. Choose a performance, select up to ten guests, and create a reservation that is saved on your device, complete with a QR code you can view at any time. No account is needed, and no personal information is requested. Manage your reservations in My Bookings, and cancel any of them whenever your plans change.

Helpful tips appear the first time you use each feature, so you can get started right away.

Whether you are an admirer of equestrian art or discovering it for the first time, Hippodrome Casino Horse Show makes it easy to explore horses, history, and performances.

name: Hiseke
description:
Every stop tells part of the story. Hiseke is an offline motorcycle fuel log that helps you remember what you added, follow fuel use between full tanks, and keep a record of the road along the way.

KEEP EACH FILL-UP IN ONE PLACE
• Record odometer readings, fuel added, optional costs in U.S. dollars, date, station, road and weather conditions, and a note.
• Mark full or partial fill-ups so the next full-tank interval can include the fuel added in between.
• Add one receipt or stop photo and a voice note of up to 60 seconds to a fill-up.

MAKE SENSE OF YOUR MILEAGE
• Review fuel consumption when you have a qualifying interval between full tanks.
• See recorded fuel costs, cost per kilometer, and an estimated range based on your tank capacity and a 10% reserve.
