• Keep in mind that real-world fuel use and remaining range vary with traffic, weather, road conditions, and load. Estimates are references, not a promise of safe distance.

FIND AND TAKE YOUR RECORDS WITH YOU
• Search, filter, sort, and save entries in your logbook.
• Export your logbook as a CSV file or copy and share a text receipt.
• Photos and voice notes stay with their logbook entries and are not included in CSV exports or text receipts.

YOUR GARAGE, ON YOUR DEVICE
• Start without creating an account. Your entries, settings, photos, and voice notes are stored locally on your device.
• Choose a photo with the system photo picker, take a photo, or record a voice note when you need one.
• Clear your logbook or delete local data from Settings.
• No internet connection is needed for fuel calculations. Device backups follow your iOS settings.

Park safely before entering readings or using the app. Hiseke is a personal logbook, not a navigation, roadside assistance, mechanical diagnosis, or fuel-safety service.

name: HISTOIRE: History Lessons
description:
HISTOIRE brings history lessons to your phone in an app you play as much as you read. Free, no ads, no sign-in required.

A home screen you can play
A quick quiz and a true-or-false card are waiting as soon as you open the app: answer on the spot and read the explanation right away. Your guide, a young explorer, shares a new historical fact with every tap.

The thread of time
All of history on a single timeline, from prehistory to today. Swipe through it, tap an event and open the lesson behind it.

Full lessons
Every unit has a focus question, its own timeline, key terms, primary sources, maps and museum pictures, and a summary to remember.

20 exercises per unit
Document analysis, maps, timelines, vocabulary and short essays, just like in class, plus a document-based test for each unit.

Quizzes and true or false
A 10-question quiz and a true-or-false game for every unit, with an explanation after each answer. Score 8 out of 10 to earn a seal in your logbook.

Explorer challenges
Express expedition (10 timed questions), timeline shuffle and flashcards.

Two curricula
The English version follows the US history curriculum (Grade 6 to AP US History and AP World History). The French version follows the French national curriculum.

Answer keys and printable PDFs are on histoire-pdf.eu.

name: Hit Bears Catapult
description:
# Hit Bears Catapult

**Launch Cute Seals, Knock Out Bears, and Save the Winter Village!**

Get ready for a fun and exciting winter adventure in **Hit Bears Catapult**! The polar bears have stolen the village's precious winter fish, and it's up to a brave team of adorable seal to win them back!

Take control of the catapult, master your timing, and launch your fluffy little heroes across challenging icy arenas. Knock out the polar bears, smash their frozen fortresses, and prove that even the smallest heroes can make a big difference!

## READY FOR A WINTER ADVENTURE?

Load up the catapult, aim carefully, and send your brave little seals flying!

Help the village recover its stolen fish, defeat the polar bears, and become the ultimate winter hero!

**Play Hit Bears Catapult today!**

name: Hockey.com
description:
Hockey.com puts the NHL, AHL and PWHL in one app: scores, standings, stats, team and player pages, and news written by our own newsroom. Everything is free to read, with no ads and no account needed.

SCORES
Every game of the day across the three leagues, updated while games are on. Open an NHL game for scoring and penalties by period, the full box score, and the matchup preview before puck drop.

NEWS
Stories from the Hockey.com newsroom, newest first, set for reading on a phone. Save a story for later or share it.

MUST SEE
The biggest goals, hits, saves and fights of the night, picked by our desk, with the clip as it was posted.

STANDINGS AND STATS
Standings for all three leagues, and skater and goalie leaderboards you can sort.

TEAMS AND PLAYERS
A page for every club. Player pages carry the current season, a game-by-game log, career numbers by season, and the latest stories.

THE LAB
Our gear desk covers sticks, skates, helmets, gloves, goalie equipment and protective gear: new releases, buying guides, and the products we have reviewed.

FANTASY
Starting goalies, line combinations, lineups and injuries, and the week's schedule for NHL fantasy managers.

FOLLOW YOUR CLUBS
Sign in with Apple, Google or your email to follow clubs and players, keep your saved stories, and turn on the alerts you want: goals, final scores, puck drops, trades and signings, breaking news, and the best moments of the night. The same account works on hockey.com.

Questions or problems: apps@hockey.com
Privacy policy: https://www.hockey.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.hockey.com/terms

name: Hokusai Lens: Ukiyo-e Camera
description:
Stand where Hokusai stood, nearly 200 years later.

Hokusai Lens floats Katsushika Hokusai's Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji over your camera, so you can photograph the same view in today's Japan and see how much has changed.

LINE UP THE PRINT
- The print floats over the viewfinder as a faded image or as fine outlines
- Hold to see the print at full strength
- Pinch to zoom, and move or scale the print to fit the scene, because Hokusai bent the real view freely
- A match meter shows how close your framing is
- A compass arrow tells you which way to turn to face Mount Fuji

FIND ALL 46 VIEWS
- The original 36 views and the 10 later views, from Nihonbashi in Tokyo to Lake Suwa
- Sorted by distance from you, with a map and walking directions
- Each view is marked Spot known, Area known or Anywhere
- For views with no fixed spot, like The Great Wave, find the same shape anywhere and shoot it as a mitate

THEN AND NOW
- Swipe between the print and your photo
- Share a side-by-side image
- Make a short vertical video that wipes from the print to your photo

THE ALBUM
- Every view you photograph gets a vermilion seal: one for on site, one for a mitate
- Rise through titles as the album fills

ABOUT THE PRINTS
All 46 prints come from The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, released as public domain (CC0) through its Open Access program. Locations are best estimates; some places Hokusai drew are still debated.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your photos and location stay on your iPhone.

Seven views are open to start. The other 39 open with an in-app purchase.

name: Holiday's Restaurant
description:
Skip the fees. Skip the wait. Order Holiday's Restaurant straight from your phone.

Save More on Every Order
Order direct, pay less. No third-party markups or hidden fees. Get first access to exclusive deals, discounts, and coupons. The same great food, no extra fees.

Ordering Made Ridiculously Easy
Reorder your favorites in seconds, no scrolling, no hassle. Your order skips the line and goes straight to our kitchen. We use your location to find the right spot and get it there fast.

Built to Be Trusted
Real-time push notifications from confirmed to ready. Pickup and delivery windows you can actually count on. Secure checkout, every time.

Real Support for a Real Local Favorite
Every order goes straight to Holiday's Restaurant, not a delivery app, not a middleman.

Download the Holiday's Restaurant app now. Taste the difference. Support the local spot you love.

name: HomeHelp-Partner
description:
# HomeHelp Partner – Find Jobs & Grow Your Earnings
 
Welcome to **HomeHelp Partner**, a convenient platform designed for home service professionals. Discover new service opportunities, manage job requests, organise your work schedule, and track your earnings—all from one app.
 
Whether you provide home cleaning, bathroom cleaning, cooking support, laundry, home organisation, or other household services, HomeHelp Partner helps you manage your daily work more efficiently.
 
##  Key Features
 
**1. Find New Job Opportunities**
- Discover available service requests.
- Search for new jobs.
- View customer and service details.
- Check job location, date, time, and duration.
 
**2. Manage Job Requests**
- View new job requests.
- Accept available service assignments.
- Review job details before accepting.
- Track assigned, completed, and pending jobs.
 
**3. Track Your Earnings**
- View your earnings summary.
- Monitor your assigned jobs.
- Keep track of completed and pending tasks.
 
**4. Manage Your Work Schedule**
- View daily, weekly, and monthly schedules.
- Check upcoming service assignments.
- Plan your work efficiently.
 
**5. Online Availability**
- Manage your availability status.
- Stay updated with new job opportunities.
 
**6. Easy Profile Management**
- Access and manage your partner profile.
- Keep your account information updated.
 
## Service Opportunities
 
Explore opportunities across different household service categories, including:
- Home Cleaning
- Bathroom Cleaning
- Kitchen & Utensil Cleaning
- Cooking Support
- Washing & Ironing
- Home Organising
- Packers' Helpers
- Elder Care & Companion Services
 
## Why Choose HomeHelp Partner?
 
- Easy-to-use interface.
- Convenient job management.
- Quick access to new service requests.
- Organised work scheduling.
- Earnings and task summaries.
- Better visibility of assigned work.
 
# Get Started with HomeHelp Partner
 
Download the HomeHelp Partner app, register using your mobile number, access available service opportunities, and manage your work directly from your smartphone.
 
**HomeHelp Partner – Elevating Service Excellence.**
 
Join HomeHelp and take the next step in managing your service work!

name: Homlap Owner
description:
Homlap Owner is the app for property owners who rent out homes on Homlap.

List your apartment, studio, house, villa or PG, manage room-by-room availability, handle visit requests from interested tenants, and keep every tenancy, monthly bill and payment in one place.

LIST YOUR PROPERTY
• Create a listing with photos, rent, deposit, maintenance, rooms, furnishing, parking and amenities
• Pin the exact location on the map
• Save as draft and submit for review when ready; Homlap verifies every listing before it goes live
• Manage rooms floor by floor and see which are available or booked

VISITS AND TENANTS
• Get notified when a tenant requests a visit, and confirm or decline it
• See active tenancies with rent, deposit, check-in date and next rent due date
• Call your tenants directly from the app
• Review and approve move-out requests

MONTHLY BILLS AND PAYMENTS
• Generate monthly bills with rent, electricity (meter readings, units and rate), water, gas, maintenance and late fees
• Track paid and unpaid bills by bill, by tenant or by booking
• See booking payments and security deposits held
• View total earnings and recent transactions on your dashboard

Homlap Owner helps landlords fill rooms faster and manage rentals without paperwork. Tenants use the separate Homlap app to find homes, book visits and pay rent.

name: Honebook
description:
Honebook is a notebook for chisels, plane irons, knives, and other edges you already own. A tool stores a bevel, a kind, and an interval in days. A pass stores a date, a grit, minutes, a lubricant word, and an optional stone. The next hone date is the latest pass plus that interval. Tools with no pass sort first on the due rail. Overdue tools come next. An interval of zero turns the reminder off.

The home page is a vertical spine with a colored tick for each tool, not a plain table. The grit bench sorts numbers you type from smaller to larger and shows the jump between them. A smaller grit is coarser. The angle bench adds an extra number of degrees to a bevel. Neither bench is saved. This month adds only passes dated in the current calendar month.

Share builds a plain-text history and hands it to the system sheet. Honebook does not grind an edge, identify a stone from a photo, or replace the maker's instructions. The file stays on this phone. Restore sample replaces it with a due chisel, a recent plane iron, an unused knife, and three stones.

name: Honest IQ: IQ Test
description:
Take a real IQ test and see your score the moment you finish. No account, no trial, no subscription, and no paywall in front of your result.

Honest IQ gives you 26 original questions in about 18 minutes:
• Matrix puzzles: find the tile that completes the grid
• Number series: spot the rule and pick what comes next
• Spatial: rotate, mirror and fold shapes in your head
• Verbal: analogies and odd-one-out with everyday words
• Memory: hold a pattern for a few seconds, then recall it

Every question was written for Honest IQ. A gentle timer guides you but never cuts you off.

YOUR RESULT
• Your estimated IQ with an honest range, for example 114 (likely 107 to 121)
• How many you got right and roughly what share of people you scored above
• Your strongest area and your mind type
• Share cards sized for Stories and posts, plus a Versus card to challenge a friend

FULL REPORT (one-time purchase)
• Every question you missed, with the rule explained
• Five sub-scores: Logic & Pattern, Spatial, Verbal, Memory and Speed
• Radar chart, strengths and the area to train
• Retake history and a PDF you can save

DAILY BRAIN GAMES
Three quick games a day from six: Matrix Sprint, Number Chains, Rotate It, Memory Grid, Word Links and Quick Count. Keep a streak, beat your personal bests, and unlock a retake on a fresh set of questions after three game days. Games Unlimited (one-time) lets you replay any game, anytime.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

Honest IQ gives an estimated IQ for entertainment and self-reflection. It is not a clinical or diagnostic assessment.

name: HONEST PATTY'S ISLAND
description:
まちかどの小さなお店を、ハワイいちばんのお店に。

兵庫県川西市のカスタムショップ＆ハンバーガー屋「HONEST」が作った、ハワイが舞台のお店づくりゲームです。
料理を作ってカウンターに並べ、家具やお花でお店をかわいく飾ろう。お客さんが来るたびに、お店がどんどんにぎやかになります。

■ 料理を作ってお客さんに売ろう
ハンバーガー、ロコモコ、ポケ、かき氷…。料理は60種類以上。
キッチンで料理を作ってカウンターに並べると、お客さんが買いに来てくれます。

■ 自由にデコって、あなただけのお店に
テーブル、イス、お花、ネオン、床や壁紙。置き方も向きも自由です。
おしゃれ度が上がると、お客さんもどんどん増えていきます。

■ 本物のHONESTグッズも登場
ステッカー、Tシャツ、キャップなど、実在するHONESTのグッズがゲームの中のお店に並びます。

■ 友だちのお店に遊びに行こう
フレンドになると、おたがいのお店に遊びに行けます。気に入ったお店には「いいね」を送ろう。

■ ゲーム機でミニゲーム
レベル10になると、お店にネオンがピカピカのゲーム機を置けます。
ミニゲームで遊んで、コインをゲットしよう。

■ 機種変更しても安心
引き継ぎコードやHONESTの会員ログインで、新しいスマホでも続きから遊べます。

■ こんな人におすすめ
・お店屋さんごっこや経営ゲームが好きな人
・お部屋やお店をかわいく飾るのが好きな人
・ハワイやハンバーガーが好きな人
・すきま時間にのんびり遊べるゲームを探している人

ゲームの案内役は、HONESTのシズマ。ときどきお店に遊びに来るかも。

※基本プレイ無料です。

【お問い合わせ】
support@honest01.com

【開発・運営】
株式会社Honest（兵庫県川西市）

name: Honey PDF: Editor & Sign
description:
Honey PDF fixes a PDF on your phone, right when you need it.

Open a file, change what is wrong, and send it. No account, no uploading, no waiting. Everything happens on your device, so it works without a connection too.

EDIT
• Change text that is already in the PDF: a typo, a date, a number
• Add text, draw with a pen, erase
• Place a photo or an image

MARK UP
• Highlight, underline, strike out
• Shapes, arrows and notes

FILL AND SIGN
• Tap a form field and type
• Sign with your finger
• Check marks, crosses and today's date
• Black out what should not be seen

PAGES
• Move, rotate, delete
• Add a blank page, another PDF or photos
• Pull pages out into a new PDF, or split a PDF in two

CONVERT AND COMBINE
• Photos to one PDF, in the order you choose
• PDF to JPG or PNG, one picture per page
• Several PDFs into one

SEND
• Share the whole file or only some pages
• Make it smaller, lock it with a password, or flatten it so it cannot be changed
• Save it to Files or hand it to any app

YOUR FILES STAY WITH YOU
Your PDFs are kept on your iPhone or iPad. Honey PDF has no server to send them to, and there is nothing to sign up for.

A built-in example shows each tool on a real page: tap "See how it works" and try it yourself.

In English, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français, 日本語, 简体中文 and 한국어.

HONEY PDF PRO
Every tool is free to use, and the example is free to send. To send or save your own PDFs, choose Honey PDF Pro, weekly or yearly.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://honeypdf.honeyground.com/privacy

name: Hopwise: Network Tools
description:
Hopwise is a network toolkit for NOC engineers and network administrators. Ping, MTR, DNS, TLS, mail checks, SNMP, BGP and RPKI live together in one native app, so you can troubleshoot from your pocket instead of hunting for a laptop.

REACHABILITY
• Ping with live statistics: packet loss, fastest, average and slowest round-trip time, and every reply with its time and TTL
• TCP Ping for hosts that drop ICMP
• Traceroute and MTR with loss and latency per hop, updated every round
• Path MTU and MSS discovery
• Tunnel Monitor for IKE gateways and the hosts behind them
• NTP Test with offset, delay and stratum

DNS AND WEB
• Domain Report: DNS, mail, certificate, registration (RDAP) and routing for a domain in a single view
• DNS Lookup for all common record types
• DNS Propagation: asks every authoritative nameserver and eight public resolvers (Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS, AdGuard DNS, DNS.SB, Control D and CleanBrowsing), with serials and TTLs side by side
• DNS Ping over UDP, TCP, TLS and HTTPS, to compare resolvers
• TLS Inspector: protocol, cipher, trust, expiry and the full certificate chain
• Certificate Monitor with local reminders before a certificate expires

MAIL
• Email Report for a domain or address
• Email authentication checks: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI
• Blocklist Check for IP addresses and domains
• SMTP Diagnostics with every step of the conversation, including STARTTLS
• Header Analyzer that reads message headers on your device

LOCAL NETWORK
• Wi-Fi walk: walk your floor and get a heatmap of latency and packet loss to your router. ARKit follows where you walk, an arrow points to the next spot still unmeasured, and camera images stay on your device and are never saved. iOS gives apps no Wi-Fi signal readings, so Hopwise measures what you feel instead.
• SNMP Browser for v2c and v3
• Flow Collector for NetFlow, IPFIX and sFlow

INTERNET ROUTING
• IP and ASN Lookup: holder, origin AS, prefixes, RPKI status and abuse contacts
• Looking Glass and AS Neighbours from RIPEstat
• RPKI Validation for any prefix and origin
• BGP Live Stream of route updates
• IRR Prefix Lists from RADb and NTT
• BGP Communities helper
• PeeringDB for networks, exchanges and facilities

CALCULATORS
• Subnet Calculator for IPv4
• IPv6 Planner
• IDN and Punycode converter with homograph warnings

MADE FOR DAILY USE
• Sidebar with favorites, collapsible groups and search, so the tools you use most stay on top
• Saved hosts and watched certificates sync through your own private iCloud database
• Copy and share results
• Works with VoiceOver, Voice Control, Dynamic Type, the keyboard and dark mode, and never shows a status by color alone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Hopwise has no backend, no accounts, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. A tool only contacts the servers it needs when you use it, such as the host you test, nameservers and public resolvers, blocklist operators, RIPEstat, PeeringDB, IRR servers and the RDAP servers of registries. Passwords and SNMP communities are never stored in the app's data or in iCloud.

On the Mac, Hopwise also offers LAN Discovery, Wake-on-LAN, DHCP Discover and Wi-Fi signal heatmaps on your own floor plan.

Questions or ideas? Visit ingeniousmakers.com/hopwise/support.

name: Hora: Honest Timers
description:
Hora is a focus timer that makes time visible.

Start a timer from a colourful card, a quick start or Just 5 minutes. A disc shrinks as the minutes go, so you can see how much is left at a glance. When time runs out, Hora doesn't stop you: it counts honest overtime, so your log shows what really happened.

WHILE YOU FOCUS:
• Split a session into named parts as you move from one subtask to the next.
• Pause and, if you like, note why.
• Park a stray thought in the parking lot, by typing or dictating on your device.
• The running timer stays on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with Pause, Split and Finish.

AFTER:
• A summary of focus, pauses and overtime for every session.
• Save sessions to your calendar, or have them saved automatically.
• Insights by weekday, time of day, category and week, plus a month view of your focus.
• Hora learns how long your usual tasks really take and suggests a realistic length.

MADE TO FIT YOU 
• Your own timer cards, quick starts and categories. 
• Private timers keep the name off the Lock Screen, widgets, notifications and your calendar. 
• Optional: an alarm when time's up, routine suggestions at your usual times, places, a daily target, and a Focus filter.
• Widgets and controls for Home Screen, Lock Screen and Control Center; Siri and Shortcuts actions.
• iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Everything stays on your device. Turn on iCloud sync if you want your history on your other devices.

name: Horse Meet
description:
Horse Meet is where people from Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Mongolian and neighbouring steppe communities find each other: in Almaty, Bishkek and Ulaanbaatar, or in Seoul, Berlin, Istanbul and wherever life has taken you.

FIND YOUR PEOPLE
• Browse people from your community near you or anywhere in the world.
• Filter by your city, by who speaks Kazakh, or by who is online now.
• See the languages someone speaks, what they are into and the city they live in.

SAY HELLO
• Send a wave to break the ice, then chat.
• Send photos and voice messages, reply to a message and react to it.
• See when your message has been delivered and read.
• Meet up to 10 new people a day, so conversations stay real.

SHARE
• Post what you are up to, with photos. Like, reply and follow people.
• Know when someone stops by your profile.

DAILY 5
Five quick questions a day about our languages and the steppe. Each right answer sews a piece of a felt ram's-horn ornament, and five out of five finishes the pattern. The felt changes colour every day of the week. Share your result, keep your streak going and see how your friends did.

YOU DECIDE WHAT TO SHOW
• Pick the name you go by and any profile picture. A cartoon is fine.
• Your profile shows your city, never a map or your exact location.

SAFETY
• Adults only: 18+.
• Report or block anyone in one tap. Reports go to our moderators.
• Delete your account from the app whenever you like.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Horse Meet works in English, Russian, Kazakh and Mongolian, and follows your phone's language.

Horse Meet is new, and made by a small team for our communities. Tell us what you would like to see next.

name: HOSTAQUI - Authenticator
description:
HOSTAUTH – Sua segurança digital em um só lugar.

Proteja suas contas online com autenticação de dois fatores (2FA) de maneira simples, rápida e segura.

O HOSTAUTH é um aplicativo autenticador desenvolvido para facilitar o gerenciamento dos seus códigos de verificação em duas etapas. Tenha seus tokens organizados, protegidos e sempre acessíveis quando precisar.

AUTENTICAÇÃO EM DOIS FATORES

Gere códigos temporários de autenticação (TOTP) para adicionar uma camada extra de proteção às suas contas. Utilize seus códigos de segurança para acessar serviços compatíveis com aplicativos autenticadores.

SEGURANÇA E PRIVACIDADE

Sua segurança é prioridade:
• Proteção dos seus tokens.
• Opção de PIN para acessar o aplicativo.
• Ocultação dos códigos de autenticação.
• Gerenciamento seguro da área de transferência.
• Limpeza automática dos dados copiados.

BACKUP E SINCRONIZAÇÃO

Mantenha seus tokens protegidos com recursos de backup:
• Sincronização com armazenamento em nuvem.
• Backup com criptografia de ponta a ponta.
• Exportação de arquivos protegidos por senha.
• Restauração dos seus tokens.
• Transferência entre dispositivos por QR Code.

ORGANIZAÇÃO INTELIGENTE

Gerencie seus autenticadores da maneira que preferir:
• Crie categorias personalizadas.
• Marque seus tokens favoritos.
• Organize contas pessoais e profissionais.
• Pesquise rapidamente seus autenticadores.
• Escolha entre visualização em cards ou lista.

UMA EXPERIÊNCIA FEITA PARA VOCÊ

Interface moderna, navegação intuitiva e opções de personalização para tornar o gerenciamento dos seus códigos mais simples.

Com o HOSTAUTH, sua autenticação fica organizada em um único aplicativo.

HOSTAUTH – Sua segurança, suas contas, seu controle.

name: Hotel Das Seekarhaus
description:
Willkommen im Seekarhaus – dem Fünf-Sterne Mountain Active Spa Resort in Obertauern.

Die Seekarhaus-App ist Ihr persönlicher Begleiter während Ihres Aufenthalts:

• Room Service: Speisen und Getränke bequem aufs Zimmer bestellen
• Morgenpost: Tagesprogramm, Tipps und Neuigkeiten aus dem Haus
• Wetter & Pisten: 3-Tages-Prognose für Obertauern, geöffnete Lifte und Pisten, Webcams
• Spa & Wellness: Silberbad, Panoramasaunadorf, Beauty- und Massageangebote
• Restaurant & Kulinarik: Menüs und Angebote unserer Küche
• Gästeinformation von A bis Z: Shuttle-Zeiten, Gästewäsche, Skischule, Kinderland und mehr
• Kontakt: Rezeption mit einem Tipp anrufen oder schreiben, Route zum Hotel
• Mountain Heroes Club: exklusive Vorteile für Mitglieder, Anmeldung mit Face ID
• Benachrichtigungen: auf Wunsch Neuigkeiten und Angebote direkt aufs Handy

Die App gibt es auf Deutsch und Englisch. Wir freuen uns auf Sie!

name: Hounds of War
description:
701 BC. Assyria has bred a new weapon of war: colossal hounds of war. The ultimate war machine has four paws and fangs.

Hounds of War is a strategy card game based on the novel by James Eldridge. Build your deck, take the field and lead the war hounds through battles of the ancient world, or fight against them as the armies that stood in their way.

INSPIRED BY THE BOOK
• Eltekeh, 701 BC: the Assyrian horde against Egypt and its allies.
• The March on Memphis, the Fragile State, the Hunt for Taharqa and the Storm: the conquest and the rebellions of Egypt.
• Halicarnassus and Issus, 334–333 BC: Theron’s Molossians march with Alexander against Persia.
Each chapter has its own camp, its own armies and its own cards. Win one to open the next level, and collect, trade in and build decks with cards in varying levels of rarity.

GAMEPLAY
• Play units and orders across four lanes, one move at a time.
• Each unit strikes the card across from it. Leave a lane open and it hits the enemy Command Center directly.
• Spend your gold carefully. You can earn more each round by sending troops on orders to rebuild supplies (discarding).
• Bring the enemy Command Center from 20 down to 0 to win.

COLLECT AND BUILD
• Win battles to earn card packs.
• Over 240 cards, each in stone, bronze and gold, with rare woven tapestry cards and numbered cards stamped with the paw.
• Build your own 36-card decks, or let the game build one for you.
• A daily skirmish with its own twist, and stars to earn in every chapter.

THE WORLD OF THE BOOK
• Play either side: the hounds and their masters, or Egypt, Persia and the rebels.
• Card art in the style of ancient reliefs, painted vases, glazed brick and tapestry of the period.
• You'll play in a living camp: the great hounds lie by the fire, watch the battle and bark when you win.
• Lines from the novel are on the cards, and history tablets tell what really happened.

• There's a quick tutorial to get you playing fast.
• Plays fully offline. No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases.

name: HourbridgeX
description:
Hourbridge finds the meeting time that works for everyone, wherever they live. Line up the days of your remote team, your family abroad or friends in other cities against your own, see the hours you share at a glance, and send one clear invite that gives each person their own local time.

SEE EVERY DAY SIDE BY SIDE
Each person becomes a 24-hour strip aligned to your local day. Working hours are shaded, night is darker, and a white column marks the window you all share. Daylight saving time is handled for the exact date you pick, so a meeting in March or October lands where it should.

DRAG THE SLOT, WATCH THE TIMES
Drag the meeting slot across the strips. It snaps to quarter hours, stretches from 15 minutes to 4 hours, and shows everyone's local time as it moves. A soft click marks each quarter hour and a low tone tells you when the slot leaves someone's working hours.

BEST SLOTS, RANKED FOR YOU
Hourbridge ranks the best times of the day: first by how many people are inside their working hours, then by who would have to start early or stay late the least. Tap a suggestion to move the slot there, then book it.

PEOPLE AND GROUPS
Add a name, a city from the built-in offline list of more than 300 cities or any time zone, working hours, working days and a note. Each person shows their local time now and a mini strip of today. Gather people into groups such as a product team or family and pick them in one tap.

MEETINGS WITH A READY INVITE
Save the title, date, start, length and participants. Every meeting gets an invite text listing each person's local time, including the day it falls on for them. Copy it or share it in any app.

WORLD CLOCK
The Console starts with a live board of everyone's local time, whether they are at work, off work or asleep, and the offset from you.

MADE FOR YOU
Choose your home city and working day, 12- or 24-hour clock, sound and haptics, and a Midnight or Night Shift Navy theme. The clock face in the top corner turns the pages: Planner, People, Meetings and Console.

ACCOUNT, PRIVACY AND OFFLINE USE
Sign in with email and password, or plan as a guest without an account and keep your plans later by adding an email. Everything works offline and syncs when you are back online. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Delete your account and every saved person, group and meeting at any time from the Console.

name: How to Tie a Tie: Half Windsor
description:
Tie a Tie shows you how to tie a tie, one clear step at a time. Pick a knot, follow the pictures and tie it yourself, whether it is for a wedding, a job interview or just a regular day at the office.

What the app can do
- 16 necktie knots, each with a picture and a short text for every step
- Step by step mode: one page per step with a large picture, progress dots, Back and Next buttons, and swiping
- On a knot's guide page, tap a picture to enlarge it and zoom in on the details
- The screen stays on while a guide is open, so it will not go dark halfway through a knot
- Knot finder: answer three quick questions about your collar, your tie and your experience, and see which knots match
- Every knot shows its difficulty in words: easy to tie, intermediate or for experts
- Favorites: tap the heart on a knot to keep it, then filter the list to see only your favorites
- Recently used: the knots you opened last are one tap away on the home screen
- The guides work without internet, and there is no account or sign-up
- 82 languages for the app and all guides, with a language search in the settings
- A dark design for phone and tablet

The knots
Classic: Four in Hand, Single Windsor (also called Half Windsor), Double Windsor and Hanover.
Modern: Kent, Oriental, Plattsburgh, Manhattan, Cavendish, Grantchester and more.
Exotic: a handful of rare knots for the days you want something different.
Each guide opens with a short introduction and, for most knots, closes with tips. It also tells you which collars and ties the knot suits and what look it gives you.

Not sure which knot to choose?
The knot finder asks how far apart your collar points are (close, normal or wide), which tie you are wearing (slim, normal, or one that is wide or thickly lined) and how much experience you have. You can answer "Any" to every question. Matching knots show up right below, followed, depending on your experience, by a few that are a bit more demanding. Treat the suggestions as a starting point and trust your own eye, too.

Who is it for?
Anyone who has stood at the mirror with a tie in hand and no idea what comes next. Beginners can start with a knot rated easy to tie. Regulars can add a new knot to the routine, and enthusiasts can work their way up to the expert knots. The knots go with suits and dress shirts, for occasions such as weddings, interviews, graduation, the office or a night out.

How the guides work
Every guide breaks a knot into short steps. Each step has its own numbered picture and a short text. Open step by step mode and swipe to the next page when you are ready. At the end you get a "Done!" page with finishing tips for most knots and a Start over button.

Languages
The app and all 16 guides come in 82 languages, right-to-left languages included. The numbered pictures lead the way in every one of them.

The app contains ads.

Privacy policy: https://mfg-software.web.app/krawatten-privacy

Developed by SilentCoderZ

name: Hu Dandelion: Seed Journey
description:
Carry a dandelion seed through three chapters: Morning Seed, Rainy Afternoon, and Evening Breeze. Hold to rise and release to descend. Each stage has a different five-light route, three optional glimmers, a hanging cloth to pass beneath, and a flowerpot to land in. A short gust after landing grows the pot from sprout to bud to flower across the three stages. Then guide the returning breeze through three more lights to the original dandelion, where the waiting child opens the window.

Collect all nine glimmers for a perfect journey. Your best glimmer total and perfect journeys are saved, so you can replay to improve and share your result with a challenge link. Pause and resume your journey whenever you like. Watercolor illustrations, music, and nature sounds accompany the story. No ads, purchases, accounts, or timers.

After your first ending, try the optional daily route: the same three-stage journey with light positions determined by your device’s calendar date. Replay that day’s route, improve your daily best out of nine glimmers, and share its date code.

Microphone input is processed on your device only. You can play the full game without granting microphone access.

name: Hubb Portal
description:
Hubb Portal is the internal business tool of Hubb Group, the Dubai digital agency. It gives the Hubb Group team the company portal on iPhone, signed in with the account the company provides. There is no public sign-up.

PROSPECTS
See the sales pipeline, open a prospect for its contact details, notes, files and meetings, add notes and change status (won, lost, stalled) on the go. New website enquiries arrive as notifications.

CLIENTS
Every client in one place: status, account lead, services, projects, contacts and the documents filed under them.

REPORTS & TASKS
Recurring reports and tasks for each client and project, with due dates. Tick off what's done; overdue and due-today items are flagged every morning.

DOCUMENT STUDIO
Browse proposals, reports and contracts created in the portal, see versions and open the PDF.

NOTIFICATIONS
Get notified when a teammate updates a prospect or client, when a deadline is due, when a meeting is about to start, when your document is ready, and when an outreach lead engages.

Hubb Portal is for Hubb Group staff. Accounts are managed by the portal administrator.

name: Hue Drift: Color Flight
description:
Hue Drift is a calm one-thumb flight game. Your glider drifts through a tunnel of slow, flowing color. Each gate ahead has a color and a shape. Switch your glider to match before you reach it.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap a color on the strip at the bottom to switch your glider.
- The Next badge shows what the coming gate needs.
- Match gates in a row to build a combo and score more.
- Collect daisies. A full set gives you a shield that forgives one miss.
- The first gates wait for you, so you learn by playing.

WHAT YOU GET
- An endless run that speeds up gently.
- Milestones every 25 gates that shift the palette.
- A 1970s screen-print look with soft, slow motion and no flashing.
- A shape on every color, so the game does not depend on color vision alone.
- Reduce Motion support and a mute button.
- Works offline. No account. No ads.

PRICE
The whole game is free. An optional one-time supporter purchase adds extra glider and palette styles. There are no subscriptions and no consumable purchases.

name: HueSort: Color Sort Puzzle
description:
HueSort is a quiet color-sorting puzzle. Trays hold short stacks of pebbles. Tap one to lift the top run of a single color, then tap another to drop them. The destination must be empty or already that color, and it needs room.

Solve a level by gathering every color into its own tray. Undo as often as you like, restart without losing stars, or take a hint that shows one good next move. Stars compare your moves with the shortest solution.

Sixty levels ramp from three colors to twelve. A daily board, seeded by the date on your device, keeps a local streak. Every pebble also carries a distinct symbol for colorblind play, and the theme follows the system or a manual light or dark choice.

Hints start at five, with one more to claim each day and one more every five levels you clear. A pack of 15 hints is an optional consumable. Gameplay never waits on a purchase.

No account. No ads. No tracking. Progress stays on this device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://orcapodproductions.com/huesort/privacy

name: Hullbreaker: Warship Arena
description:
Hullbreaker is a 1v1 fighting game where warships are the fighters. Pick a ship, read your opponent and break their hull before they break yours.

FIGHT WITH COMBOS, NOT JUST CANNONS
Every ship has light, heavy, ram and special attacks, a tractor-beam throw and a Breaker super. Chain them into combos, guard against the counter attack and save your Overcharge for the finishing HULLBREAK.

TWO SHIPS, TWO STYLES
Vesper is a fast interceptor with long strings and a launcher that sets up air combos. Anvil is an armored dreadnought with heavy hits, an armored charge and a gravity beam that pulls you in.

MODES
- VS CPU: best of three against the computer, from easy to hard
- Practice: a training dummy with frame data and free Breakers
- Watch: CPU against CPU exhibition matches
- Move list: every move with its startup and block advantage

BUILT FOR TOUCH
A virtual stick and six attack buttons appear when you touch the screen. The whole game runs on your device: no account, no ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking.

Made in Sweden by YambaCode AB.

name: Human Override
description:
Zero took the world in one night. Bash was built to care. Bash won't let it stand.

Human Override is a pixel-art run-and-gun. Zero, a rogue AI, has chipped the animals, caged the humans and taken Dr X, the scientist who built Bash. Fight through scrapyards, forests, deserts, rivers, a mermaid kingdom and a hidden lab to get them back.

RUN, JUMP AND SHOOT
- Tight controls built for touch, plus full support for Bluetooth controllers
- 14 guns to find, from the spread and laser to the saw, frost and gatling
- Carry two guns and swap between them, throw bombs, and punch up close
- Three difficulty levels

FREE THEM, DON'T HURT THEM
Zero's chips have turned the animals against you. Break the chip and they walk free: monkeys, elephants, camels, scorpions, sharks and more. Rescue caged humans along the way and watch your shelter fill up.

BIG BOSSES
The Crusher, a chipped T-Rex, the Sand Queen and the Mother Spider, a giant shark, a sea witch, a robot swarm, an evil copy of Bash, and finally Zero itself.

A STORY TO FOLLOW
Short story films between worlds, and clues from Dr X at the end of each level.

TRY IT FREE
Levels 1 to 5 are free, including the first boss. One purchase unlocks the full game: every level, every boss and the ending. No ads, no subscription, no account.

name: Huppa
description:
Huppa is the member app for gyms, boxes and studios that run on Huppa. Log in and everything is right there: the schedule, your bookings and your membership. Choose the time that works for you and see instantly if there’s still a spot.

How it works:

Log in with the email address and password you use at your gym, studio or box. We’ll show you every gym connected to that email address. Train at more than one place? You’ll find all your gyms in the same app after logging in.

You can only log in if you already have an account at a gym that uses Huppa. Don’t have one yet? Ask your gym to get you started!

With the Huppa app you can:

- See all your gyms in one place
- View the schedule and upcoming classes
- Book your classes and see available spots
- Manage your bookings
- Manage or upgrade your membership
- Buy products from your gym
- Log your workouts and track your progress

Available features may vary per gym.

Log in, book your next class and see you at training.

name: HYDRATE, SOLDIER!
description:
STILLGESTANDEN. ZEIT FÜR DEINE TRINKROUTINE.

Sergeant Stone nimmt dein Wasser ernst. Sich selbst eher weniger. HYDRATE, SOLDIER! verbindet ein schnelles Trinktagebuch mit deutschem Ausbilderhumor, einer markanten synthetischen Drill-Stimme und einem eigenen Army-Look.

DEIN TAG, DEIN ZIEL
Lege dein persönliches Tagesziel fest und dokumentiere Getränke mit einem Fingertipp. Mengen und Uhrzeiten lassen sich nachträglich korrigieren oder löschen. Im Logbuch siehst du deinen Verlauf und kannst deine Einträge als CSV exportieren.

STONE MELDET SICH
Wähle zwischen drei Humormodi. Die optionale Sprachausgabe nutzt lokal gespeicherte Aufnahmen. Erinnerungsabstände und Ruhezeiten bestimmst du selbst. Widgets und Live-Aktivitäten halten deinen Tagesstand griffbereit.

REGELMÄSSIGKEIT WIRD BELOHNT
Verdiene XP, Dienstgrade und Orden. Tages- und Wochenmissionen belohnen dokumentierte Tage. Kostenlose Versorgungskisten enthalten kosmetische Looks. Trinkmenge und Trinktempo bringen keine Extra-XP. Es gibt keine käuflichen Zufallsbelohnungen.

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Tracking-Dienste. Das Logbuch liegt auf deinem Gerät. Apple Health ist freiwillig: Die App kann eigene Wasser-Einträge übertragen. Über die Einstellungen kannst du alle App-Daten zurücksetzen und auf Wunsch auch die von dieser App angelegten Health-Einträge löschen.

14 TAGE TESTEN. EINMAL FREISCHALTEN.
Starte den kostenlosen 14-Tage-Test bewusst in der App. Danach erhältst du die dauerhafte Vollversion zum einmaligen Preis, der im Kaufdialog angezeigt wird (1,99 € im deutschen App Store). Kein Abo, keine automatische Abbuchung. Gültige kostenlose Angebotscodes können die Vollversion ebenfalls dauerhaft freischalten. Käufe lassen sich wiederherstellen. Nach Testende bleiben vorhandene Daten einsehbar, korrigierbar, exportierbar und löschbar.

FÜR ERWACHSENE
Die App unterstützt deine Routine und ersetzt keine medizinische Beratung. Persönliche oder ärztliche Trinkvorgaben gehen vor. Über deinem Tagesziel gibt es keine zusätzlichen Belohnungen. Die Zielvorgabe ist keine individuelle medizinische Empfehlung.

name: Hyoji: Japanese for Daily Life
description:
Living in Japan means reading Japanese every day: trash calendars, train boards, medicine bags, forms at city hall and alerts on your phone.

Hyoji lets you practice with those real-life scenes before you face them. Each question puts you in a real situation: you just got medicine at the pharmacy, your train has stopped, a notice is in your mailbox. Read the sign and decide what to do.

PRACTICE WITH REAL-LIFE SCENES
160 signs drawn from daily life in Japan, in 8 scenes: Trash & Recycling, Trains & Stations, Medicine & Clinics, City Hall & Post, Workplace Safety, Shops & Food, Apartment Life, Disaster & Weather.

EVERY LINE, EXPLAINED
After each answer you get a short tip, a translation of every line on the sign, and the words worth remembering, with hiragana and romaji.

HEAR THE JAPANESE
Tap any word to hear it read aloud in Japanese.

ENGLISH, TIENG VIET, BAHASA INDONESIA
Explanations are available in three languages. Switch any time in Settings.

YOUR SIGN BOOK
Every sign you read correctly is saved in your Sign Book. Signs you missed come back in Review mistakes, so you can practice until you can read them.

Trash & Recycling and Trains & Stations are included. Unlock all scenes to add 120 more signs.

No account and no ads. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Ibiza Party Mood Travel Guide
description:
Discover your kind of Ibiza, from music by the sea to sunset terraces and nights on the dance floor. Ibiza Party Mood Travel Guide brings places, personal suggestions, maps and trivia together so you can spend less time deciding and more time enjoying the island.

Explore 15 selected places across Beach Clubs & Parties, Nightclubs & DJ Venues, and Sunset Bars & Lounges. Browse photos, read venue descriptions, compare guide scores and check coordinates before choosing your next stop. Let a surprise category help you discover somewhere new.

Choose Beach Energy, Night Madness, Sunset Chill, Luxury Vibes, Dance All Night or Romantic Evening. Adjust your preferred time, energy and atmosphere, then discover three suggestions with match percentages and reasons for each choice. Try another mood or let Surprise Me make the choice for you.

Plan an afternoon or evening with two, four, six or eight hours, two to five stops and a pace that suits you. Choose beach venues, clubs, sunset spots or a mix, then review the stop order, visit times and map. Replace or remove stops, generate another plan, save a favorite route or send it to your travel companions.

See places across Ibiza on an interactive map and filter them by category. Tap a marker to open a venue, save places you want to visit and return to your favorites whenever you need them. Your saved places and routes stay on your iPhone.

Get to know the culture behind the music with 80 questions about nightlife history, electronic music, famous clubs and beach traditions. Choose a topic or a mixed quiz, select five, ten or twenty questions, and pick Easy, Normal or Hard. Shuffled answers, immediate feedback and short explanations help you learn as you play.

Build your score with correct answers, keep your streak going and work toward Ibiza Legend. Review your answers, check your accuracy and follow your best score, total correct answers and most played category. Your completed quiz results stay on your iPhone, ready for the next round.

Whether you want a lively afternoon, a quieter sunset or a night of dancing, choose the places and pace that feel right for you. Venue hours and seasonal dates can change, so check with each venue before visiting. Route timing uses available road estimates or clearly marked planning buffers.

Shop your salon’s private collection of OVID hair tools at your partner prices. Explore each tool, choose the quantities your salon needs and place an order through secure checkout.

name: IDPMI RCS
description:
RCS Connect es el portal oficial de la Región Centro Sur de la Iglesia de Dios Pentecostal, Movimiento Internacional (IDPMI). Reúne en un solo lugar todo lo que ministros, pastores e iglesias necesitan para mantenerse conectados con la oficina regional.

PARA MINISTROS
• Credencial ministerial digital: lleva tu credencial en el teléfono, con código QR, descarga en PDF y opción de agregarla a tu billetera.
• Perfil ministerial: consulta y mantén al día tu información.
• Calendario y eventos: mira las actividades regionales, inscríbete en eventos y presenta tu QR al llegar.
• Comunicados regionales: recibe los anuncios de la oficina regional al instante.
• Biblia digital: lee y estudia la Palabra de Dios desde la app.

PARA IGLESIAS Y TESORERÍA
• Remesas e informes financieros: prepara y envía los informes de tu iglesia de forma sencilla y segura.
• Historial de envíos: consulta lo que ya enviaste cuando lo necesites.

RECURSOS Y FORMULARIOS
• Encuentra en un solo lugar los formularios, planes, reglamento, la revista RCS Mag y demás materiales de la región.

NOTIFICACIONES
• Recibe avisos de comunicados, eventos y fechas importantes para que no se te pase nada.

RCS Connect es para ministros y líderes de la IDPMI Región Centro Sur. El acceso se hace con la cuenta asignada por la Oficina Regional. Si necesitas ayuda, escríbenos a info@idpmircs.org.

Que Dios te bendiga y te acompañe en tu ministerio.

name: İftar Vakitleri
description:
İftar Vakitleri brings together daily Islamic prayer and iftar times, Quran reading with Turkish translations, categorized Hadith, and a private Qaza prayer tracker in one clean, ad-free Turkish-language app.

Key features:
• Prayer & Iftar Times: Daily Fajr (Imsak), Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib (Iftar), and Isha times based on Diyanet data, with a live countdown to the next prayer time.
• Location & City Picker: Detect the nearest city using GPS or select any country, city, and district manually.
• Hijri Calendar: Daily Hijri date and upcoming Islamic observances (Kandil) countdown.
• Quran (114 Surahs): Full Arabic text paired with Turkish translation options (Diyanet, Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır, Yaşar Nuri Öztürk).
• Hadith: Curated Hadith collections organized by category.
• Qaza Prayer Tracker: Track missed prayers (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Witr) stored privately on your device — no account or sign-in required.

Completely free, ad-free, and privacy-first.

name: IHK Abschlussprüfung Training
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zur IHK oder zur DIHK-Bildungs-gGmbH.

Die Abschlussprüfung entscheidet über deinen Berufsabschluss. Mit IHK Abschlussprüfung Training bereitest du dich gezielt auf die schriftliche Prüfung deines kaufmännischen Ausbildungsberufs vor und trainierst genau die Themen, die in der IHK Prüfung drankommen.

Diese Berufe findest du in der App:
- Kaufmann und Kauffrau für Büromanagement
- Industriekaufleute
- Kaufleute im Einzelhandel
- Kaufleute im Groß- und Außenhandelsmanagement
- Kaufleute im Gesundheitswesen
- Kaufleute für Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung
- Kaufleute für Dialogmarketing
- Bankkaufleute

Dazu kommen zwei Kurse, die in jeder kaufmännischen Abschlussprüfung zählen: Wirtschafts- und Sozialkunde (WiSo) und die Vorbereitung auf die mündliche Prüfung und das Fachgespräch.

So lernst du mit der App:
- Lektionen zu allen Prüfungsbereichen deines Berufs
- Tausende Übungsaufgaben mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests, die zeigen, wo du schon sicher bist und wo du nacharbeiten solltest
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Prüfungstermin
- Eine Community mit anderen Azubis, die sich auf dieselbe Prüfung vorbereiten

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs für deinen Beruf schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo. Jeder weitere Kurs kostet dich danach weniger.

Offizielle Informationen zu den IHK-Prüfungen findest du bei der DIHK-Bildungs-gGmbH: https://www.dihk-bildungs-gmbh.de/pruefungen/ihk-pruefungen

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Ilm Vaqti
description:
Ilm Vaqti — PDP University’ning rasmiy dars jadvali ilovasi. Guruhingiz, o‘qituvchingiz yoki xonangiz jadvalini bir marta tanlang — qolganini ilova o‘zi eslab qoladi.

HOZIR QAYSI DARS?
Bosh sahifada hozirgi yoki keyingi dars katta kartada: fan nomi, xona, o‘qituvchi va tugashiga qancha daqiqa qolgani jonli hisoblagich bilan ko‘rsatiladi. Kunning qolgan darslari esa vaqt chizig‘ida — tanaffuslar va bo‘sh “oynalar” bilan.

JADVAL O‘ZGARSA — DARHOL XABAR
Dars ko‘chirildimi yoki xona almashdimi? Guruhingiz yoki o‘qituvchingiz jadvali o‘zgarishi bilan push-bildirishnoma keladi.

TELEFON EKRANIDA WIDGET
Ilovani ochmasdan ham bugungi darslarni ko‘ring: kichik, o‘rta va katta widgetlar hozirgi darsni, qolgan vaqtni va keyingi xonani ko‘rsatadi.

BUTUN UNIVERSITET JADVALI
• Guruhlar — qabul yili bo‘yicha
• O‘qituvchilar — alifbo bo‘yicha
• Xonalar — bino qavatlari bo‘yicha
• Fanlar — kurslar bo‘yicha
Qidiruv, sevimlilar va haftalik setka ko‘rinishi bilan kerakli jadvalni soniyalarda topasiz.

QULAYLIKLAR
• Internet bo‘lmasa ham oxirgi saqlangan jadval ko‘rinadi
• O‘zbek, rus va ingliz tillari
• Yorug‘ va qorong‘i mavzu
• Ro‘yxatdan o‘tish shart emas

Ma’lumotlar manbai: ilmvaqti.uz — PDP University’ning rasmiy jadval tizimi.

description: Ilyvio is a quiet space for daily strategy and card puzzle solving, where you arrange numerical cards into compliant chains for four royal houses. Experience a five-minute daily challenge with fixed seed card orders and sudden event cards, designed for single-player puzzle enthusiasts. name: incrediDeals: Tech & Gadgets
description:

You will also find phones, tablets, laptops, audio and wearables.

FIND IT QUICKLY

• Browse collections, new arrivals and current offers from the Home screen.
• Photos, options, colours and full details on every product page.
• Read reviews from other customers and write your own.

SEE WHERE IT IS
• Check availability at our Dubai warehouse and at our branches in New Cairo and Sheikh Zayed.
• Sold out? Tap "Notify me when available" and we will tell you when it is back.

CHECK OUT YOUR WAY
UAE & GCC:
• A secure Shopify checkout with the payment methods offered in your country.
• Buy now, pay later with Tabby or Tamara in the UAE, and with Tabby in Saudi Arabia (subject to their approval).
Egypt:

• Save your addresses and drop a pin so the driver finds you.

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign in with Apple, Google, email or a code sent to your mobile.
• My orders: follow orders you placed online, in the app or at our branches.
• Wishlist: tap the heart to save products for later.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Chat with our team from the app, send photos, or ask us to find a product we do not list yet.

ARABIC AND ENGLISH
The whole app works in Arabic and English, in light and dark mode.

You can delete your account at any time in Account → Delete my account. Questions: info@incredideals.ae (UAE & GCC) or info@incredideals.co (Egypt).

name: Ingliz tilini o'rganish
description:

• Rasmli so'zlar - so'zlar rasm va talaffuz bilan, kartochkalar orqali yodlash

• Interaktiv hikoyalar - qahramonlar bilan suhbat va savollar

• Noto'g'ri fe'llar - 115 ta fe'l, uch zamonda misollar bilan

2. So'zlar bo'yicha testlar
3. Rasmli test
4. So'zlarni bog'lang
5. Ha yoki yo'q
6. So'zlarni yig'ing
7. Noto'g'ri fe'llar testi
8. 1000 ta so'z testi
9. Talaffuz mashqi - gapiring, ilova tekshiradi

Dasturchi bilan aloqa: yoqubdeveloper@gmail.com

name: InLine News
description:
InLine shows you the news the way a newsroom sees it: one story, and every outlet reporting it.

You open a headline and the article is locked. It happens all day. InLine tells you before you tap, and points you to the same story at outlets that publish it free. It never breaks a paywall. It finds you the open door.

ONE STORY, EVERY SOURCE
InLine reads thousands of news sites through an open index and groups their coverage. For each story you see who is reporting it, in which countries, and how each outlet frames it. You read the original article on the publisher's own site.

SEE IT SPREAD
The Emerging board works like the wall in a TV newsroom. Green means two or three outlets have a story. Yellow means four to nine. Red means ten or more. You see what is growing while it is still growing.

YOUR COUNTRIES, YOUR TOPICS
Follow the countries you care about, each with its own outlets in its own language: United States, United Kingdom, Ireland, Portugal, Spain, France, Germany, Italy, Brazil, Canada, Australia and India. Add world news, politics, technology, science, weather, film and television. Hide any outlet you would rather not see. Translate headlines on your iPhone when you want to.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No analytics. No tracking. No account needed. Your briefing is written on your iPhone, not on a server. Trackers are blocked in the reader for everyone.

WEATHER THAT SHOWS ITS WORK
The forecast for your town, from several weather services side by side, so you can see when they disagree. Reports for the airfields near you, as issued.

ON EVERY SCREEN
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV. Built for the folding iPhone, with the newsroom board on the inside screen.

INLINE PLUS
The news stays free. InLine Plus adds:
• A private reader that blocks ads and turns down cookie banners for you
• Alerts while a story is still spreading, on iPhone and Apple Watch
• The animated rain map for your country, and forecast sources compared
• Wider sources from across the web, merged into every section

InLine Plus is a monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://inline.gadamamo.workers.dev/terms
Privacy policy: https://inline.gadamamo.workers.dev/privacy

name: InmoIA: MLS inmobiliario
description:
InmoIA es la MLS de las inmobiliarias de España en tu móvil: una red gratuita donde las agencias comparten sus viviendas y cierran más operaciones a comisión compartida.

TODAS LAS VIVIENDAS DE TU PROVINCIA
Busca entre las viviendas de todas las agencias de la red, con fotos, precio, metros, precio por metro y la comisión que comparte cada una. Encuentra en segundos el piso que busca tu cliente.

DEMANDAS CON INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL
Escribe lo que busca tu cliente como se lo contarías a un compañero ("ático en el centro, 3 habitaciones, hasta 500.000 €"). La IA lo entiende, lo cruza con toda la red y te avisa en cuanto entra una vivienda que encaja.

TUS VIVIENDAS, EN TODA LA RED
Conecta la web de tu inmobiliaria y tus viviendas se suben solas al MLS y se actualizan cada noche. Tú decides cuáles compartes y con qué comisión.

GRUPOS DE WHATSAPP POR PROVINCIA
Más de 2.900 agentes en nuestros grupos de WhatsApp, donde se comparten viviendas y demandas al momento. La IA lee los mensajes y los convierte en demandas ordenadas.

COMPARTE CON TU CLIENTE EN UN TOQUE
Cada vivienda tiene su ficha con fotos y datos para enviársela a tu cliente, sin los datos de contacto de la otra agencia.

AVISOS AL MOMENTO
Te avisamos cuando hay un comprador para tus viviendas o una vivienda para tus demandas.

REGISTRO GRATIS EN 1 MINUTO
Solo con tu móvil: te llega un código por SMS y listo. Sin contraseñas.

InmoIA es para profesionales inmobiliarios (agencias y agentes). Gratis.

name: Inner Bloom 365
description:
Inner Bloom 365 is a gentle morning ritual for women who want to start the day with peace, gratitude and purpose, without pressure.

No streaks. No scores. No guilt. Just a quiet place that is yours, every morning you choose to show up.

YOUR GUIDED MORNING RITUAL
Declare, affirm, give thanks, sit in quiet, read a short passage and pick your 3 priorities. Choose the steps that fit your morning. Type, speak, record your voice, or write on paper and simply check it off.

TODAY
A calm page with a verse for the day, your ritual, your goal check-in, a daily love note and stickers to make the page yours. Close the day with a short evening reflection.

YOUR GARDEN
Every morning you write, a flower blooms in your calendar. Miss a day and nothing withers. Your garden simply waits for you. Look back at every page you wrote, kept safe.

LUNA, YOUR AI FRIEND
Luna is an AI companion who listens, encourages you and helps you find one small next step, day or night. Luna is not a therapist and does not give medical advice. If you are ever in crisis, Luna points you to real help: 988 or 911 in the US, CVV 188 in Brazil, or someone you trust.

GROW
- Goal Journey: 90 days toward a dream, one tiny step at a time
- Bloom Notes: thoughts, letting go and love tips
- Beliefs: what you are releasing and what you are choosing
- The woman I'm becoming, in your own "I am" words
- Letters to your future self and little notes to yourself

SISTERHOOD
Share a win, ask for prayer or encourage another woman in the community room, and message the sisters you meet. You can report or block anyone, any time.

PRIVATE AND SAFE
Your journal is private. Every word saves as you go, so you never lose a thought. Sign in with email or Apple and your pages follow you to your other devices. Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

PRICING
Your first 14 days are free, with no payment and no card needed. After that, keep everything with Inner Bloom 365 Premium: $9.99 per month or $69.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings. Your pages are never deleted if you stop paying.

Inner Bloom 365 is a journaling and self-reflection app. It is not a medical or mental health service.

Terms of Use: https://innerbloom365.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://innerbloom365.com/privacy

name: inPos — Kassa va Ijara
description:
inPos — касса, склад и финансы для торговли и проката. Управляйте магазином с телефона.

КАССА
• Быстрая продажа по штрих-коду, розничная и оптовая цена
• Наличные, карта и смешанная оплата, расчёт сдачи
• Продажа в долг и баланс клиента
• Отложенные чеки и печать чека

ПРОКАТ
• Почасовой, посуточный и помесячный тариф
• Бронь, залог и контроль срока возврата
• Просроченные аренды видны отдельно

СКЛАД
• Остатки по каждому магазину и филиалу
• В наличии, в прокате и списанные — отдельно

КЛИЕНТЫ
• Должники и переплаты
• История и баланс клиента

ОТЧЁТЫ
• Чистая прибыль, выручка от продаж и проката

Приложение работает с теми же данными, что и панель управления inPos: управляете с компьютера, продаёте с телефона.

Для работы нужен аккаунт inPos вашей компании. Доступ сотрудникам выдаёт владелец или администратор бизнеса.

name: Intro to AI: Heurix
description:
An undergraduate introduction to artificial intelligence for your phone. Eleven short units take you from agents and search to games, constraints, logic, planning, probability and decisions, finishing with how risk frameworks treat AI systems.

In every unit you build something small and watch it work: a vacuum-robot rulebook, a courier finding a route across a city map, a GPS with your own estimate, a cooling tour, a tic-tac-toe opponent with pruning, an exam timetable, a kitchen robot that reasons from clues, a dish-stacking planner, a diagnosis and weather reasoner, and a delivery robot on slippery roads. The equation appears afterwards as a description of what you just saw, and you can tap each symbol to find it in the picture. Questions are computed from the setup you made.

Every claim carries its sources (AIMA, Poole and Mackworth, Sutton and Barto, UC Berkeley CS 188, CMU 15-281, MIT 6.034, Cambridge, Harvard CS50 AI and the original papers) and each opens in a window inside the app. Numbers are recomputed by independent code. This course has not been expert reviewed.

Works offline, no account. Free with ads at natural breaks, never inside a lab or a question. Optional monthly ad-free subscription ($3.99, 7-day free trial, cancel anytime; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle). Text size A- and A+ up to 200 percent. Not affiliated with any university.

Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-heurix.html

name: IPRadar: DNS Leak & Speed Test
description:
IPRadar is a precision native iOS network audit, IP telemetry, and speed diagnostic instrument engineered for everyday Wi-Fi checks, remote work, and encrypted tunnel verification.
• 21 Global Languages & Instant Hot-Switch: Native localization across 21 languages (including full Arabic RTL mirroring) with live UI & widget hot-switching.

Core Privacy & Routing Radar:
• 4-Source Egress & Split-Tunnel Detection: Compare four independent public egress resolvers concurrently to classify Direct, Split-Tunnel, or Global Encrypted Tunnel routing, complete with ASN ISP/IDC/Cellular purity classification.
• Environment Camouflage Audit: Verify system HTTP/SOCKS proxy state, device locale region, and timezone offset against your public exit IP.
• 4-Way Recursive DNS Waterfall & WebRTC STUN: Probe randomized EDNS endpoints concurrently to expose upstream recursive DNS servers, plus an on-device WebRTC ICE STUN exposure test and IPv6 bypass check.
• Cloud, Streaming CDN & AI Endpoint Matrix: One-tap concurrency check across major global AI APIs, streaming CDNs, and real-time communication endpoints.

Pro-Grade Speedometer & Bufferbloat:
• 3-Stream Speed & Logarithmic Gauge: Multi-connection download/upload benchmarking paired with a precision 270° logarithmic dial and real-time smoothed curves.
• Loaded Latency & Bufferbloat Grade (A+–F): Measure unloaded RTT alongside download-loaded and upload-loaded latency plus packet loss.

Protocol Engineering Workbench:
• HTTPS 5-Stage Waterfall: Inspect DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB, and content transfer breakdowns with HTTP/2 or TLS 1.3 telemetry and X.509 certificate chains.
• Full DNS Records & RDAP/WHOIS: Query A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, and NS records via DoH, or inspect CIDR ranges, RIR registries, and lifecycle events via RDAP.
• Node PK Compare, Diagnostic Cards & Widgets: Compare nodes side-by-side, export masked high-resolution diagnostic cards, and track live IP/tunnel status from Home & Lock Screen widgets.

IPRadar Pro (Optional Subscription):
• Continuous oscilloscope Ping waveform monitor with jitter/loss telemetry and exportable logs.
• Multi-port TCP preset & custom port scanner with TLS chain validation.
• Full 20-record audit history archive and structured text export.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in Account Settings.

name: Iqra: Learn to Read Quran
description:
Iqra teaches you to read the Quran, step by step, the way a teacher would.

FROM THE FIRST LETTER
Learn the 28 letters in the order of the Noorani Qaida: by shape and by sound, with letters that look or sound alike practised side by side.

THEN JOINING AND VOWELS
See how each letter changes at the start, middle and end of a word, then read syllables with fatha, kasra, damma, tanween, sukun and shaddah.

REAL WORDS FROM THE QURAN
Read, hear and put in order the words of the short surahs of Juz 'Amma, recited word by word.

TAJWEED, ONE RULE AT A TIME
Each rule is taught before it's asked: listen to it, see when it happens, learn what to do, then its name. Find it in real verses, tell similar rules apart, and record yourself to compare with al-Husary's teaching recitation.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Each family member gets their own progress
• Short daily rounds with spaced review, so letters and rules stick
• Practise your mistakes in a short extra round
• Learn without sound when you can't listen
• Uthmani or IndoPak script
• English and Dutch
• Works offline once the recordings are downloaded
• Free: no ads, no purchases, no account

Iqra helps you practise every day, but it can't hear you: recite to a teacher whenever you can.

Quran data provided by Quran Foundation.

name: IRIS Mobile
Istiqama: Daily Adhkar & Dua
description:
Istiqama means steadfastness. "The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small." (Bukhari and Muslim)

Istiqama helps you pray on time and remember Allah through the whole day, with a design inspired by the sky and by zellige.

THE SKY OF THE MOMENT
The whole app takes the colour of the sky of the current prayer: dawn, morning, noon, Asr, Maghrib and night. You feel the time of day before you read it.

A REMINDER FOR EVERY MOMENT
77 reminders from the Quran and the Sunnah, chosen for each moment of the day: waking up for Fajr, effort and trust in the morning, patience at noon, the value of time at Asr, family at Maghrib, forgiveness at night. Each one comes with its meaning and a short affirmation to carry with you. Save them and share them as beautiful images.

ALL THE ADHKAR, WITH A COUNTER
The complete Hisn al-Muslim: morning and evening adhkar, after the prayer, before sleeping, on waking up, and for every situation (home, food, travel, worry, illness, rain…). A large counter for each repetition (×3, ×33, ×100), the source and virtue of each dhikr, and a gentle reminder after Fajr and after Asr.

PRAYER TIMES AND ADHAN
Accurate prayer times calculated on your iPhone, with your country's usual method chosen automatically (Umm al-Qura, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, France 12°, ISNA, Karachi, Turkey…) and the Hanafi Asr. A notification at each prayer, with a " I prayed" button to log it in one touch.

PRAYER TRACKER
Log each prayer on time, late or missed. A zellige star fills up petal by petal, the week shows as stars, and your streak keeps you steady.

QIBLA
A zellige compass points to the Kaaba and vibrates when you face it, with the distance to Makkah.

WIDGETS
The reminder of the moment and the next prayer with its countdown, on your home screen and lock screen.

IN ARABIC, FRENCH AND ENGLISH
The interface follows your iPhone's language, right to left in Arabic.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location is used on your iPhone only and never leaves it.

Quran text: Tanzil. Adhkar: Hisn al-Muslim. Times are calculated; check with your local mosque if they differ.

Support: https://getoffero.com/istiqama/
Privacy: https://getoffero.com/istiqama/privacy.html

name: Jamaa: Prayer Tracker
description:
Jamaa helps you keep your five daily prayers and pray more of them with the congregation.

• Today: the next prayer, a countdown to athan and then to iqama, and one tap to record each prayer as Jamaa or Alone.
• Earlier days: forgot to record? fill it in.
• Progress: your streak, the month as a calendar, and achievements to work towards.
• Read: a short ayah every day in Arabic and English, and a hadith from Sahih al-Bukhari in Arabic.
• Prayer times for Doha with iqama times you can adjust to your masjid.

No account, no ads and nothing collected: your records stay on your iPhone. Fully available in Arabic and English.

name: Javobchi: Comment Auto Reply
description:
Javobchi answers the people who comment on your Instagram posts and reels, so no buyer waits for a price.

You pick a post or reel and a keyword, for example PRICE. When someone comments that word, Javobchi posts your public reply under the comment and sends that person a private message with the details you wrote, plus link buttons such as Order or Catalog. You set it up once, and it keeps answering while you sleep, drive or serve other customers.

WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THE APP
- Create a campaign in four steps: choose the post (or "the next reel I publish"), add keywords, write the private message and its link buttons, then check and go live.
- Add several public reply variants so your answers under posts do not all look the same.
- Ask people to follow your account before they get the link, and send a follow-up message.
- Read and answer your Instagram direct messages in one inbox. The app shows how much of Instagram's 24-hour reply window is left.
- See today's replies, matched comments, link clicks and failed sends on the home screen.
- Check views, reach, saves and shares of your posts and reels, and your follower count over 7, 30 or 90 days.
- Open the delivery log to see every comment Javobchi acted on and what happened to it.
- Invite your team, connect more than one Instagram account and switch between them.
- Get notifications about new messages, replies that were not delivered and your plan.
- Lock the app with a passcode, Face ID or Touch ID.
- Use it in Uzbek, Russian or English, in light or dark mode.

WHAT YOU NEED
- An Instagram professional account (Business or Creator). Javobchi connects through Instagram's official API and Instagram login. We never ask for your Instagram password, and you can disconnect at any time.
- An email address. You sign in with a one-time code, so there is no password to remember.

Javobchi replies only to people who commented on your posts or wrote to you first. It does not send bulk or unsolicited messages.

SUBSCRIPTION
Automatic replies need an active Javobchi Pro subscription. You can sign in, connect Instagram and look around the app before you subscribe.

Javobchi Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, offered monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically for the same period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple ID settings (Settings > your name > Subscriptions). Deleting the app or your Javobchi account does not cancel it.

Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
