name: Jellyfish Surge
description:
Tap to pulse. That's the whole control scheme. Everything else is nerve.

Guide a glowing jellyfish down through the real zones of the ocean, from the sunlit shallows to Challenger Deep, 10,935 metres down. Thread the rock gates, and the closer you shave them, the faster your Surge bar fills. When it's full, you go rainbow, nearly double your speed, and smash straight through rock, eels and anglerfish for five glorious seconds.

SIX ZONES, EACH WITH ITS OWN TRICK
• Sunlight zone: learn the rhythm.
• Twilight zone: the gates start to move.
• Midnight zone: the lights go out. You see only what your own glow reaches.
• The abyss: vent updrafts shove you off course.
• The trenches: electric eels strike along a warning line.
• Challenger Deep: everything at once, and something enormous is watching.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• One-thumb play, instant restarts.
• A soundtrack that builds layer by layer as you sink, and goes double-time when you Surge.
• Bloom lighting, haptics, slow-motion close shaves and flying rock.
• Pearls build a bubble shield that saves you once.
• Each Surge raises your score multiplier, up to ×5.

FREE, AND IT STAYS OUT OF YOUR WAY
No forced ads, no timers, no energy. If you enjoy it, there's a tip jar: tip a dollar, or choose to watch one ad. Either one unlocks the Gilded jellyfish as a thank-you.

Unlock four more jellyfish by score alone. How deep can you get?

name: JestLMS
description:
JestLMS is the learning app used by schools and online classes. Students, parents, teachers and school administrators sign in to one app to learn, teach and follow progress, online and offline.

FOR STUDENTS
• See today's live classes and join your teacher with one tap
• Read lessons, write assignments and take quizzes, even with no internet. Your work sends itself when you are back online
• Follow your timetable, exam calendar, scores and report cards
• Message your teachers and join subject discussions

FOR PARENTS
• Link your children and follow attendance, progress and results
• Get school announcements and alerts

FOR TEACHERS
• Start and schedule live classes, and take attendance
• Create lessons, assignments, quizzes, tests and exams
• Mark work, enter class and exam scores, and see your students

FOR SCHOOL ADMINISTRATORS
• Manage classes, subjects, people and staff roles
• Class reports, teacher attendance and announcements in one place

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE JESTLMS
• Works on slow networks and keeps going when the signal drops
• Dark and light looks, easy on the eyes
• Secure sign-in, role-based access and encrypted connections
• Built in Ghana for Ghanaian schools

You need an account from your school or class provider. Already have one? Sign in with your phone number, email or admission number.

name: jetbuk
description:
Keep the places you go to in one list and book a time in a few taps, without calling or messaging.

• Add a place by scanning its QR code, pasting its jetbuk link or searching for it
• See each place's next free times at a glance
• Book, see your bookings and cancel when plans change
• Get a reminder before your appointment
• Add bookings to your calendar
• Is your favourite place not on jetbuk yet? Invite them in a message; we'll tell you when they join

jetbuk works with salons, barbers, clinics, dietitians, physiotherapists, restaurants, gyms and more. The business receives your booking with your name and phone number.

Free, with no ads.

name: jetbuk Business
description:
Run your jetbuk booking page from your phone.

• See today's bookings at a glance, with what's next and how much room is left
• A calendar with a column for each staff member, table or room
• Get a notification the moment a customer books or cancels
• Approve or decline booking requests, if you choose to confirm each booking yourself
• Close a person, a service or the whole business for a day or a holiday in two taps
• Your customers, their visits and notes, with one-tap call and WhatsApp
• The jetbuk assistant: ask "who's coming tomorrow?", add a booking, set up a weekly programme or change your hours in plain words

Use the account you use in the jetbuk panel; your business and bookings are all here. Don't have a booking page yet? Set one up free at jetbuk.com in a few minutes.

The booking page, unlimited bookings and customers, the calendar and the assistant are free. No card, no trial.

name: Jll Nanza!
description:
Meet your pocket-sized block of jelly. Poke it, slice it, stretch it and watch it wobble back with a happy little face.

Jll Nanza is a calm, playful space for those moments when you just want to squish something. Every touch makes the jelly bend, bounce and jiggle, with soft sounds and gentle vibrations that follow your fingers.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
Poke: tap or press the jelly and feel it squish and spring back. Tap quickly to build a combo.
Slice: swipe across the jelly to cut it into smaller blobs that keep bouncing around.
Mold: grab the edges with one or two fingers and stretch the jelly into new shapes.
Heat: hold your finger on the jelly to warm a spot until it softens and droops.

Start with Poke and Slice, and unlock Mold and Heat as you play and earn squish points.

PICK YOUR FLAVOR
Choose from five jelly presets: Strawberry Splat, Blueberry Blob, Lemon Drop, Grape Squish and Mint Jiggle. Each one has its own colors and shape, from a wobbly cube to a round blob or a little pyramid.

MIX COLORS
Pick two colors and watch them blend together the more you play with your jelly. Try pink and cyan for a surprise.

DAILY SQUISH CHALLENGE
A new playful goal every day, like slicing the jelly into exactly 10 pieces or stretching it as far as it can go. Turn on reminders if you would like a friendly nudge.

ZEN MODE
No goals and no score. Just you, a jiggly jelly and a gentle reminder to breathe in and breathe out.

JELLY STUDIO
Add a photo from your library or take a new one, then decorate it with wobbly jelly stickers and colorful splats. Move, resize and rotate them however you like, or build a collage from your saved jelly art.

YOUR GALLERY
Save your favorite jelly shapes and decorated photos, and share them with friends.

Squish. Stretch. Smile.

name: Job Quote Z: Invoice Maker
description:
Job Quote Z turns a few measurements into a professional estimate, sends it as a quote your client can sign on their own phone, and turns it into an invoice when the job is done. All from your iPhone.

ESTIMATE ANY JOB
• 38 built-in estimators: painting, accent walls, drywall, bathrooms, kitchens, floors, tile, decks, fences, roofing, concrete, landscaping, lawn care, snow removal, pool service, holiday lights, pressure washing, junk removal, house and window cleaning, carpet cleaning, TV mounting, moving, car detailing, birthday parties, party rentals, balloon décor, DJs, catering, photography, hair and makeup, pet grooming and pet sitting
• Enter a few numbers and get materials, labor and fees priced at your own rates
• Save what you actually pay in your Price Book and every future estimate uses it

QUOTES THAT WIN JOBS
• Good / Better / Best options, optional add-ons, rooms and sections
• Before and goal photos, your logo and your signature
• Payment schedules: deposit, progress payments and final payment
• Quick add by typing or dictating, like “14 2x4 at 4.50”

GET IT APPROVED
• Send a link: clients review the quote, pick an option and add-ons, and sign on their own phone or computer
• Or sign in person on your phone, upload a signed paper copy, or attach their “yes” from a text or email
• Every approval gets a signature certificate with the date, time and a fingerprint of the exact quote
• Signed quotes lock, and extra work goes on a change order

INVOICE AND GET PAID
• Turn an approved quote into an invoice in one tap, with deposits already subtracted
• Venmo, Cash App, PayPal and Zelle links and QR codes on every invoice
• Track payments, overdue reminders and recurring invoices

RUN YOUR BUSINESS
• Your Home screen shows who needs a follow-up, what was approved and what you're owed
• Job costs with receipt photos and your real profit on every job
• Reports and spreadsheet exports for your accountant
• Add clients from Contacts and jobs to your Calendar

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your jobs and clients are saved on your iPhone. A quote only goes online when you send it for signature, and that copy is deleted automatically.

TRY IT FREE
Every feature is free for 30 days. Then unlock it forever with one purchase. No subscription.

name: jobslog
description:
App Store Description

Jobslog – Your All-in-One Career & Job Search Companion

Take full control of your job search with Jobslog. Whether you are looking for your next career breakthrough or actively managing multiple job applications, Jobslog streamlines your entire journey—from job discovery to interview scheduling and offer management.

Never lose track of where you applied, who you spoke with, or what is coming next. With verified job listings, live application tracking, and an integrated interview calendar, Jobslog gives you the clarity and confidence to land your dream role.

Browse thousands of verified career opportunities across top industries and leading companies.

Save your favorite jobs and apply with a streamlined, mobile-friendly process.

Why Choose Jobslog?
All-in-One Clarity: No more messy spreadsheets or lost emails—manage your entire job search pipeline in one place.

Download Jobslog today and take the next confident step in your career!

name: Jolly Mahjong Nook
description:
Jolly Mahjong Nook is a cozy puzzle gallery built around miniature Mahjong tiles. Arrange tiny tile models in display cabinets, typeset their museum labels and audit mysterious cabinets with a magnifying lens. Three original ways to play, 150 puzzles, all offline.

MAHJONG DISPLAY — THE HEART OF THE NOOK
Every cabinet is a small spatial puzzle. Drag tiles onto the shelves, slide dividers to resize compartments, pull out ledges, stand tiles upright or lay them down, and feed one-way slots through their flaps. Each compartment wants something different: a run of Characters, a triplet of Circles, a row of winds, matching sets behind a glass partition. Tiles need something to rest on, dividers can't pass through them, and every arrangement is checked against real Mahjong groupings. Press Inspect and the cabinet shows you which compartments are happy.

MINIATURE LABEL
Every specimen deserves a tiny label. Pick the right wording, set the type size on a printer's ruler, dial in the letter spacing, choose where the line breaks, line up the baselines and press a seal clear of the screws. Text is measured glyph by glyph, so when a letter touches the edge, you'll know.

CABINET INVENTORY
Frosted glass, turned tiles, slatted doors and sealed drawers hide what's really inside. Sweep the lens across the shelves, then spend your limited looks wisely: a wide look reads the suit through frosted glass, a close look reads the rank. Compare catalogue plates and seal tags, balance the ledger and flag what's missing, extra or misfiled. Every cabinet has exactly one answer that fits the evidence.

YOUR OWN GALLERY
Finished chapters become exhibits, drawn from the cabinets you actually arranged, the labels you actually printed and the ledgers you actually balanced.

HANDY TOOLS
• Space Planner — try tile sizes in a compartment before you commit
• Group Reference — runs, triplets, quads, pairs and honors at a glance
• Mini Label Studio — design and share your own tile labels
• Inventory Counter — keep tallies of a real tile set

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• Designed for every iPhone size, with side-by-side panes on wide displays
• Gentle sounds and haptics, each with its own switch
• Respects Reduce Motion


HINTS
Every exhibit includes one hint and one search. A hint points toward a good next move. A search previews a compartment, reveals a label's safe area, or verifies a hidden stand. They belong to that exhibit and the puzzle can always be finished without them.

Jolly Mahjong Nook is a puzzle game about tile models and display design. It contains no gambling and no real-money wagering.

name: Jornal Coop
description:
Jornal Coop es el registro de jornada para cooperativas. Cada persona ficha la entrada y la salida desde su móvil con su PIN, o el encargado ficha a todo el equipo a la vez, aunque no haya cobertura.

FICHAR EN SEGUNDOS
Cada trabajador entra con su PIN y pulsa un botón. El encargado toca a las personas que entran, elige el puesto de trabajo y pulsa Entrada. Al terminar, «Todos los que están trabajando» y Salida.

SIN COBERTURA
Lo fichado se guarda en el móvil y se envía solo cuando vuelve la señal.

HORAS, JORNALES Y PAGOS
La app cuenta las horas y los jornales de cada persona, por periodo de pago y por puesto de trabajo, y calcula lo ganado, los adelantos y lo pendiente.

FIRMAS Y PARTE MENSUAL
Cada persona firma sus jornadas en su móvil o con el dedo en la pantalla del encargado. El parte mensual en PDF lleva las firmas.

EXPORTAR A EXCEL
Todo el registro en un archivo de Excel, para la gestoría o para la Inspección de Trabajo.

UN REGISTRO QUE NO SE PUEDE MANIPULAR SIN QUE SE NOTE
Cada fichaje lleva una huella encadenada que calcula el servidor. Las correcciones no borran nada: quedan anotadas con quién las hizo, cuándo y por qué.

PARA EL REGISTRO DE JORNADA OBLIGATORIO
Sirve para cumplir el artículo 34.9 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores: hora de inicio y de fin de cada jornada, conservada 4 años y a disposición de la plantilla y de la Inspección.

PARA COOPERATIVAS DADAS DE ALTA
Para entrar hace falta el enlace de tu cooperativa y tu PIN, que te da tu encargado.

Sin anuncios. Los datos de cada cooperativa están en un servidor en la Unión Europea y no se usan para nada más.

name: Jornal Encargados
description:
Jornal Encargados es el registro de jornada para el campo. El encargado ficha la entrada y la salida de toda la cuadrilla desde su propio móvil, en segundos y aunque no haya cobertura.

FICHAR A TODOS A LA VEZ
Toca a las personas que entran a trabajar, elige la finca y pulsa Entrada. Al terminar, «Todos los que están trabajando» y Salida. Cada fichaje guarda la hora y la ubicación de ese momento.

SIN COBERTURA
Todo se guarda en el móvil. No hace falta internet para fichar, ver el calendario ni calcular lo que se debe a cada uno.

HORAS, JORNALES Y LIQUIDACIÓN
La app cuenta las horas y los jornales de cada trabajador, por periodo de pago y por finca, y calcula lo que ha ganado, los adelantos y lo que queda pendiente. Se puede descargar en Excel.

FIRMA EN EL MÓVIL
Cada trabajador firma su jornada, sus adelantos y sus pagos con el dedo en la pantalla del encargado.

COPIA AUTOMÁTICA EN TU GOOGLE DRIVE
Cuando hay cobertura, la app guarda sola una hoja de cálculo con el registro completo y un archivo de copia en tu Google Drive. Si cambias de móvil, entras con tu cuenta de Google y lo recuperas.

UN REGISTRO QUE NO SE PUEDE MANIPULAR
Cada fichaje lleva una huella que demuestra que nadie ha tocado el registro después. Las correcciones no borran nada: quedan anotadas con quién las hizo y por qué.

PARA EL REGISTRO DE JORNADA OBLIGATORIO
Sirve para cumplir el artículo 34.9 del Estatuto de los Trabajadores: hora de inicio y de fin de cada jornada, conservada 4 años y a disposición del trabajador y de la Inspección.

VARIAS FINCAS Y EXPLOTACIONES
Da de alta las fincas en las que trabajáis y mira cuánto se ha trabajado en cada una. Lleva todas las explotaciones que quieras con la misma licencia, y pásale una a otro encargado con un archivo de copia.

LICENCIA
Para crear explotaciones hace falta una licencia de pago único (sin suscripción), ligada a tu cuenta de Google. Vale para siempre y en cualquier móvil en el que entres con esa cuenta.

Jornal Encargados no tiene anuncios ni comparte tus datos. El registro está en tu móvil y en tu Google Drive, no en nuestros servidores.

name: Juicy Jam: Candy Match 3
description:
Welcome to Juicy Jam, a sweet and relaxing match-3 puzzle full of glossy 3D candies! Swap jelly beans, lozenges, lemon drops, gummies, gems and gumdrops, line up three or more and watch them pop.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe a candy to swap it with its neighbour and match 3 or more of a kind.
• Complete each level's goal before you run out of moves: reach the score, collect candies, clear the jelly or break the chocolate.
• Earn up to 3 stars per level and travel across the candy-land map.

SPECIAL CANDIES
• Match 4 for a striped candy that clears a whole row or column.
• Match in an L or T shape for a wrapped candy that explodes.
• Match 5 for a colour bomb that clears every candy of one kind.
• Swap two specials together for giant combos!

FEATURES
• 300 hand-tuned levels with growing challenge
• Glossy 3D candies and a colourful candy land
• Cheerful music and juicy sound effects
• Helpful boosters: Hammer and Shuffle
• Short levels, perfect for a quick break
• Play offline, no Wi-Fi needed
• English and Turkish

Juicy Jam is free to play and supported by ads. Optional purchases add coins or remove ads.

name: Juliett Jets
description:
Plan a private flight around the people and places that matter to you. Start with two airports, or browse a one-way empty leg on an aircraft already scheduled to reposition.

Plan a charter. Choose your airports, travel dates and guests. Trace your route on the map and explore aircraft by published seating and range. Open Range Explorer with those details to compare whole-trip planning estimates on the Juliett Jets website.

Find an empty leg. Narrow the flight board by departure, arrival, travel date, seats or published price. Open a flight to see its travel window and when the listing was checked. Our team reconfirms aircraft, pricing and availability before booking.

Keep your plans close. Save favorite aircraft, flights and unfinished journeys on your iPhone. If you like, choose a usual departure airport and guest count for future plans. You can explore and send an enquiry as a guest.

Speak with the travel team. Add luggage, timing or other preferences to your enquiry and send it from the app. A receipt reference appears in Saved. You can call, text or email Juliett Jets to discuss the details.

Juliett Jets is a brand of WINGS AND WHEELS LLC, an air charter broker. Independent authorized carriers operate flights. A receipt acknowledges your enquiry. Reservations and final pricing are confirmed separately.

Screenshot photography by Chris Leipelt (Unsplash), © Raimond Spekking and Piemags Aviation (CC BY-SA 4.0), and Josh Beasley (CC BY 2.0). Photos are sized or cropped for display. The opening photo has its aircraft registration removed. Sources and licences appear under Photography at https://juliettjets.com/empty-legs.

name: June - Waiting Room
description:
June brings work conversations and requests into one place. Keep track of what you’re waiting on and the person responsible for each item.

Start in Requests to review waiting items and filter by status or approaching due dates. Each item connects to a named person and a source conversation, with the original wording available for context.

Open Rooms to review conversation updates. As work progresses, update request statuses and mark results as received.

name: Junior Dash 3D
description:
Junior missed the bus, and the school bell won’t wait. Run down five lanes of a Swedish city seen from behind Junior’s backpack. Watch the tram tracks ahead, sidestep oncoming cars and jump over cyclists. At the fork, take the quiet park path for a star sticker or brave the busy street for a shortcut.

There are 60 school mornings across twelve weeks. Spring blossoms give way to snowy pavements, and the traffic picks up as the year goes on. Each day has an optional errand. Find the lost homework pages, deliver a green lunchbox to a friend or collect the letters of a seasonal word. Finish the errand and reach school in time to earn its badge.

Fridays bring a different kind of rush. Race a scooter rival, catch the school-trip bus or weave through the market before the bell.

Swipe left or right to change lanes, tap to jump and swipe up to dash. Missed a pickup? Swipe down and hold to run back for it. You can also play with a game controller or turn on Assist for more time. The whole campaign plays offline, with local saves, instant retries and a soundtrack for the school week.

name: Juridata
description:
Juridata is AI legal research built for Moroccan lawyers.

Ask the assistant any legal question and get a reasoned answer grounded in Moroccan law, with its sources. It also drafts your memos and letters.

Search the Court of Cassation's decisions and Morocco's laws in your own words. Every decision comes with an AI summary, a French translation and an audio version.

Take a case through first instance, appeal and cassation with an AI strategy at each stage.

Run your office from your phone: clients, cases, hearings, tasks and invoices, with alerts when something happens in your cases at the court.

In Arabic, French, English and Spanish.

name: Kadeflow
description:
Kadeflow brings the daily work of a marketplace webshop into one place: orders, shipping labels, stock, returns, customer questions, prices and profit. The app gives your team the full Kadeflow workspace on phone and tablet. Built for sellers on bol.com.

ORDERS AND SHIPPING
• See new orders as they arrive and what must ship today
• Print shipping labels and picklists on any AirPrint or system printer, or share them as PDF
• Confirm shipments and follow every parcel

STOCK
• Check and correct stock across all your stores
• Count stock and look up products by scanning barcodes with the camera
• Containers, purchase costs and incoming stock in one place

RETURNS AND CUSTOMER SERVICE
• Handle returns and decide what goes back into stock
• Answer customer questions from one inbox

PRICES AND PROFIT
• Real profit per order after commission, shipping and costs
• Buy Box tracking and price suggestions

MADE FOR TEAMS
Everyone signs in with their own account and sees only what their role allows. Owners manage the team, roles and store access.

Kadeflow is business software. To sign in you need a Kadeflow account: ask the owner of your company's Kadeflow workspace to invite you.

name: Kaelith: Emberheart Frostheart
description:
A dark, magical role-playing game in the style of the classic monster-catching games. You are an apprentice mage, bind creatures with seals you draw yourself, and stand against the cult known as The Twilight, who want to break the ancient Ward Circle.

TWO VERSIONS IN ONE APP
Emberheart and Frostheart: two halves of the world with their own regions, creatures and story. Choose at the start and switch at any time through your save slots. Master both to witness the Union.

WHAT AWAITS YOU
• More than 400 creatures to catch, train, evolve and fuse
• 120 side missions across all twelve regions, with riddles, duels and secrets
• Seals you draw yourself to bind creatures
• Schools of magic, bosses, twelve shards and the Grand Championship
• Character editor, cauldron and recipes, fishing, boats, caves and flying
• Day and night, daily and weekly tasks, achievements and a chronicle of your journey
• Reputation with twelve schools of magic, cloaks and titles for your wardrobe
• Endless play after the credits: the Rift Depths, changing eras, rare color variants
• 16-bit style pixel art, chiptune music with a theme for every region
• Touch, keyboard or controller, playable offline (internet only for the bazaar and backups)
• English and German

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
The picture adapts to every screen size, from iPhone to the large iPad. On the Mac, Kaelith runs as a native Mac app with keyboard and controller. One purchase works on all three with the same Apple Account.

PLAY WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
You don't need an account to play. A free kaelith.de account is only needed for the trading bazaar with other players and for backing up your save. You can delete your account at any time; the way there is in the game under Account.

FAIR PRICE
The first 4 hours of play are free (free item "4-hour free trial"). After that, one single purchase unlocks the whole game, for both versions. No ads, no subscription, no gems.

Questions and help: kaelith.de

name: Kairo Worktime
description:
Kairo Worktime es el contador de horas de Kairo Frame: sabe en todo momento cuánto tiempo dedicas a cada cliente y a cada proyecto, con un toque y sin complicaciones.

PULSA PLAY Y A TRABAJAR
Crea un cliente y un proyecto, dale al play y el contador empieza a grabar, como el piloto rojo de una cámara. Solo hay un proyecto en marcha a la vez: si empiezas otro, el anterior se guarda solo.

SIEMPRE A LA VISTA
• El contador en la pantalla de bloqueo y en la Isla Dinámica.
• Widgets para la pantalla de inicio y de bloqueo, con play y pausa sin abrir la app.
• Un botón en el Centro de control.
• En el Mac, el contador en la barra de menús.
• Siri y Atajos: «Oye Siri, empieza a contar en Kairo Worktime».

TUS HORAS, ORDENADAS
• Proyectos agrupados por cliente, con el total en horas y en decimal.
• Añade tiempo a mano si se te olvidó darle al play.
• Cierra los proyectos terminados y reábrelos cuando quieras.
• Aviso si el contador lleva demasiadas horas en marcha.

INFORMES Y FACTURACIÓN
• Informes por semana, mes o año, con gráfico por días y clientes.
• Precio por hora opcional para saber cuánto vas a facturar.
• Exporta a CSV para Holded, Excel o Numbers, o un parte de horas en PDF para tu cliente.

PRIVADA DE VERDAD
Tus horas se guardan en tus dispositivos y se sincronizan por tu iCloud privado entre iPhone, iPad y Mac. Sin cuentas, sin anuncios y sin seguimiento. Además, puedes proteger la app con Face ID o Touch ID.

Gratis, en español y pensada para profesionales del audiovisual, freelance y cualquiera que cobre por horas.

name: Kakau Verdes - Loji
description:
Compre verduras, legumes, frutas e temperos fresquinhos da Kakau Verdes, em Caratinga/MG, sem sair de casa.

No app você:
• Navega pelas categorias: verduras, legumes, frutas, ervas, grãos, doces e ovos
• Busca produtos e monta o carrinho com os preços atualizados da loja
• Conta com a Kakau, assistente de compras, para achar produtos
• Finaliza o pedido e acompanha suas compras
• Recebe notificações com ofertas e avisos da loja
• Fala com a loja pelo WhatsApp direto do app

Sua conta pode ser excluída a qualquer momento, em Conta > Segurança.

name: Kalby: Family Calendar
description:
Who needs to be where, and when?

Kalby is the calendar for busy families. Every person gets their own color and their own lane, side by side, so you can see the whole family's day at a glance: who has practice, who needs a ride, and where the gaps are.

A LANE FOR EVERYONE
• Mom, Dad and each kid in their own color, side by side on the Day view
• Week and Month views that show everyone at once, color-coded
• See clashes right away: Kalby tells you when a new event overlaps with something already in that person's lane

MADE FOR REAL FAMILY LIFE
• Repeating events that stay right across daylight saving: soccer every Tuesday at 4:30 stays at 4:30
• Add from a photo: snap a team schedule or school flyer and Kalby reads the dates for you to check and add
• Link a school, team or work calendar and its events appear in the right person's lane, kept up to date
• Shared lists for groceries, packing and to-dos
• Birthdays show up every year in the right lane
• Undo when you delete something by mistake

EVERYONE STAYS IN SYNC
• Changes show up on everyone's phone in seconds
• Reminders before events, a 7 AM summary of the day, and a Sunday preview of the week ahead
• A Home Screen widget with today's plan
• Invite your partner, grandparents or a sitter with their own login
• Kids don't need a phone to have a lane; give older kids their own login when they're ready

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Only the people in your family can see or add events. No public profiles, no strangers, no ads
• Sign in with a 6-digit code sent to your email: no password to forget or steal
• Kalby never sells your information

ONE PRICE FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Try everything free for 14 days, no card needed. Then choose $3.99 a month or $29.99 a year, for your whole family, however many people are in it. Cancel anytime.

Great on the kitchen counter too: open Kalby on a spare iPad and it becomes your family's wall calendar.

Terms of Use: https://kalby.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kalby.app/privacy

name: KantLoop
description:
Το KantLoop είναι εργαλείο δειγματοληψίας για την ποιότητα ταινίας ακμής σε έπιπλα και πλακοπαραγωγή.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείτε
1. Σαρώστε τον κωδικό παρτίδας ή πληκτρολογήστε τον και επιλέξτε γραμμή και χειριστή.
2. Ελέγξτε τα έξι σημεία: κόλλα, υπερχείλιση, απολέπιση, χρώμα, πάχος, ακτίνα. Κάθε σημείο: επιτυχής / απόκλιση / κρίσιμο.
3. Κλείστε με απόφαση: έγκριση, επανεργασία ή απόρριψη. Σε μη συμμόρφωση ανοίγει NCR.
4. Αναθέστε διορθωτική ενέργεια (CAPA), εκτελέστε, επαληθεύστε και κλείστε τον κύκλο.

Η επισκόπηση δείχνει ποσόστωση ημέρας (προβλεπόμενα / ελήφθησαν / κενό), ποσοστό επιτυχίας και ανοιχτά NCR. Όλα αποθηκεύονται στη συσκευή και δουλεύουν χωρίς δίκτυο.

name: Kanvo Player
description:
Kanvo is a fast, simple player for the playlists you already have.

Kanvo contains no channels, films, series or playlists. You add your own playlist from a service you subscribe to, using an M3U link or a server login (server address, username and password).

How it works
• Open Kanvo and note the device code on screen.
• Scan the QR code with your phone and add your playlist to that code. No typing long links with the remote.
• Your playlist appears in the app within seconds.

Features
• Live channels from your playlist, with groups and search
• Programme guide, with reminders for upcoming programmes
• Films and series with resume and episode lists
• Favourites and recently watched
• Up to 5 playlists per device
• Up to 4 profiles, with PIN locks, hidden groups and kids profiles
• Audio track and subtitle choice where the stream provides them
• English, Dutch, German and French

Try Kanvo with the built-in demo, or start the 7-day free trial when you're ready. After the trial, unlock Kanvo for one year or for life with an in-app purchase. Your purchase also works on your other Apple devices signed in with the same Apple ID (up to 5 devices).

Kanvo doesn't provide or sell any media content. Use Kanvo only with content you have the right to watch.

name: Karavana
description:
A Karavana é o app de quem viaja em caravana. Carros antigos a caminho de um encontro, um clube atravessando o país, amigos numa road trip: todo mundo no mesmo mapa, com o roteiro e a conversa do grupo num lugar só.

NO MAPA, JUNTOS
• Veja onde cada carro do seu grupo está, ao vivo.
• Saiba quem está ao vivo, quem está sem sinal e quem pausou o GPS.
• Um botão liga e desliga o seu GPS a qualquer momento, em todas as telas.

O ROTEIRO À MÃO
• Partida, paradas oficiais, pernoites e chegada, dia a dia.
• A próxima parada aparece pela posição do líder ou pelo horário previsto.
• Abra qualquer parada no seu app de mapas para navegar.

CHAT DO GRUPO
• Texto, áudio e fotos, com prévia antes de enviar.
• Avisos de "Cheguei" e "Preciso de ajuda" com a sua posição.
• Sem sinal? As mensagens e as posições esperam no celular e saem quando a conexão volta.

PARA ORGANIZADORES
• Crie a caravana, convide as pessoas por código e designe líderes.
• Edite o roteiro, a imagem e os links do evento.
• Abra uma página pública para quem quer só acompanhar, com a rota e uma região aproximada do comboio, nunca a posição exata.

PRIVACIDADE EM PRIMEIRO LUGAR
• Só o seu grupo vê onde você está, e só enquanto o GPS está ligado.
• Guardamos apenas a última posição, nunca o histórico do trajeto.
• Denuncie mensagens, bloqueie pessoas e exclua a sua conta pelo próprio app.

Não use o celular enquanto dirige: a Karavana é para quem vai no banco do passageiro.

name: Kardizy
description:
Kardizy est une solution de fidélité digitale qui permet aux commerçants de créer et gérer facilement des cartes de fidélité dématérialisées.

Grâce à Kardizy, remplacez les cartes papier par une solution simple, moderne et accessible directement depuis le smartphone de vos clients.

**Les fonctionnalités de Kardizy :**
- Création et personnalisation de cartes de fidélité numériques.
- Gestion des points et des tampons.
- Suivi des clients et de leur fidélité.
- Gestion centralisée des programmes de fidélité.
- Consultation des statistiques et des performances.

Kardizy accompagne les commerces dans la fidélisation de leur clientèle et la modernisation de leur activité.

name: Karnex Chat
description:
Karnex Chat is a free, private messenger for chatting with friends, family and the businesses you deal with. Every message, photo, voice note and call is end-to-end encrypted, so only the people in the chat can read or hear it. Not even we can.

CHAT YOUR WAY
• One-to-one and group chats, with replies, reactions, mentions, edits and deletes
• Photos, videos, files, voice messages, stickers, GIFs, polls and contacts
• View-once photos and disappearing messages for things that shouldn't stay
• Star important messages and find anything with search
• Status updates that disappear after 24 hours
• Communities to keep related groups together

CALLS
• Voice and video calls, one-to-one or in groups
• Incoming calls show on your iPhone's own call screen

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• End-to-end encryption for every chat and call, always on
• Lock chats behind Face ID or your passcode, or lock the whole app
• Sign in with a passkey, no password to steal
• Encrypted chat backup, so a new phone gets your history back
• No ads, and no tracking across other apps and websites

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Use the same chats on your iPad and computer: link them by scanning a QR code with your phone

FOR BUSINESSES
• Businesses can talk with customers in group chats, with their support team in the same chat
• Kara, an optional AI assistant, answers customers' questions from what the business teaches it, and hands over to a person when needed. Kara is only ever in a business's groups, and the app asks for your OK before she reads anything.

Karnex Chat is free for everyone. Businesses can choose a plan for Kara and support features on our website.

Privacy policy: https://karnexchat.com/privacy
Terms: https://karnexchat.com/terms

name: Karnex Viewer
description:
Karnex Viewer by Karnytine Labs.

Support and manage your computers from anywhere. Karnex Viewer is the iPhone and iPad companion to the Karnex remote support and device management service: see a managed computer's screen, control it from your phone or tablet, run scripts and commands, and chat with the person at the machine, all end-to-end encrypted.

An account is required. Karnex Viewer signs in to an existing Karnex organization account. Computers appear in the app once they have the Karnex Agent installed.

REMOTE CONTROL
- Live view of the remote screen, with pinch-to-zoom and pan
- Virtual mouse: place the cursor by touch, then click, right-click and scroll from an on-screen control
- Full keyboard support, including Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Esc, Tab, arrow keys and F1-F12
- One-tap shortcuts: Ctrl+Alt+Del, Task Manager, Alt+Tab and the Windows key
- Full screen when you turn your phone sideways
- Switch between monitors, and choose Full, Reduced or Greyscale quality for slow connections

TOOLS
- Listen to the remote computer's audio
- Chat with the person using the computer
- Run your team's saved scripts with one tap
- Run commands and read the results, and keep notes on each machine

FIND MACHINES FAST
- Search by name, company or signed-in user
- Filter by group, with online machines listed first and live online or in-session status

SECURITY
- The screen, keystrokes, chat and audio of a session are end-to-end encrypted between the computer and your device
- Each machine's identity is checked against your Karnex account before you connect
- Sign in with Face ID or Touch ID, and two-factor authentication
- Your organization's roles and access rules apply
- Optionally block the remote user's keyboard and mouse, or blank their screen, during sensitive work. Both are released automatically when you disconnect.

Available in 24 languages.

Karnex Viewer is a business tool for IT administrators, support technicians and the organizations they serve.

name: Kartok
description:
Kartok is the classic card game of War – reimagined for your iPhone.

Everyone flips a card at the same time. The highest card wins them all. When two cards tie, it's a DUEL: three cards face down, one face up – and the winner takes the whole pot. Collect every card to win the game!

HOW TO PLAY
• Play against 1 to 3 computer opponents
• Ace is high, suits don't matter
• Ties trigger a duel – and duels can chain!
• Run out of cards and you're out

TACTICS MODE
Want more than pure luck? Switch on Tactics Mode: you hold three cards and choose which one to play each round. Save your aces, sacrifice your low cards and outsmart the bots.

FEATURES
• Classic mode and Tactics Mode
• 2, 3 or 4 players
• Four bot levels: Easy, Medium, Hard and Mixed
• Two decks: 52-card standard deck or 32-card short deck
• Smooth card animations and satisfying sound effects
• Auto-play and three game speeds
• Available in English, German, Spanish and French

PLAY WITH PEACE OF MIND
• Works completely offline
• No ads, no account, no in-app purchases
• No data collected – ever

Easy to learn in seconds, fun for all ages. Can you win every card?

name: Kassandra Planner
description:
Kassandra Planner este ghidul tău offline-ready pentru vacanța pe Kassandra.

Ce găsești în aplicație:
• Hartă cu plaje, taverne, peisaje și puncte utile
• Rute România → Kassandra și pe insulă
• Stații PECO și alerte de drum (Smart Radar BG)
• Traducere documente / meniuri cu camera
• Chat comunitate și anunțuri utile
• Radio și instrumente de călătorie

Aplicația este gratuită în App Store. Accesul complet se deblochează cu adresa de email a licenței cumpărate pe greciaplanner.ro. Fără reclame și fără abonament.

Politica de confidențialitate: https://greciaplanner.ro/confidentialitate
Suport: contact@greciaplanner.ro

name: Katkos.
description:
Puhelin soi kesken raportin kirjoittamisen, ja hetken päästä et enää muista, mitä olit tekemässä. Katkos on pieni ja rauhallinen muistikirja niihin hetkiin, kun ajatus katkeaa kesken työn.

Sovellus ei seuraa sinua taustalla eikä arvaile tekemisiäsi. Sinä itse päätät, milloin kirjaat keskeytyksen ja milloin palaat työn ääreen.

Näin Katkos toimii:

Kirjaa keskeytys: Kun huomiosi kääntyy muualle, napauta Kirjaa keskeytys.

Valitse syy ja jätä muistiinpano: Merkitse syy (esim. Viesti tai Puhelu) ja kirjoita lyhyesti, mitä olit tekemässä ja mikä on seuraava askel (esim. "Kirjoitan raporttia – jatka yhteenvetokappaleesta").

Palaa työhön: Kun keskeytys on ohi, kuittaa se päättyneeksi. Sovellus tallentaa kuluneen ajan ja näyttää jättämäsi paluunotin.

name: Kedidir Kedi: Cat Discovery
description:
Cats are our tour guides.

Kedidir Kedi is a travel guide that shows you Türkiye through the eyes of its street cats. Every cat has a story, and every cat is a guide to its neighbourhood. Meet the local cats, walk the routes they narrate and find the hidden corners of their streets.

MEET THE NEIGHBOURHOOD'S CATS
• Browse stories and photo albums of neighbourhood cats, photographed by the community.
• Add a photo of a cat you met; it goes live after an editor reviews it.
• A cat's exact location is never shown, only its neighbourhood. The cats' safety comes first.

WALKING ROUTES NARRATED BY CATS
• Walk from stop to stop in Galata, Balat and other neighbourhoods with a cat as your narrator.
• Each stop has a short fact and a note in the cat's own voice; listen to it aloud if you like.
• Start a route, check off the stops and earn a badge at the end.

EXPLORE PLACES
• Sights, food and drink, places to stay and shops, picked from the cats' neighbourhoods.
• See animal-friendly places and add your vote.

TRAVEL GUIDE
• Neighbourhood articles, lists and themed guides, in five languages.

CATDEX AND BADGES
• Add the cats you meet to your collection and earn badges as you explore.
• Your collection stays on your device.

HELP A CAT
• Emergency numbers and 24/7 vets on the map for when you find an injured or sick street cat.

No account needed. Sign in with email, Apple or Google if you like. No ads, no tracking.

Available in Turkish, English, German, French and Spanish.

name: Keelbook
description:
Keelbook is an outing log for kayaks, canoes, rowboats, and other small craft. Each outing stores minutes, a distance, the unit that distance was typed in, a water name, and a wind word you choose. Hours are minutes divided by 60. Season totals include only the current calendar year. Before distances are added, miles and nautical miles are turned into kilometers using 1.60934 and 1.852, then shown in the unit you pick. Changing that unit does not rewrite old rows.

The log is a stack of tickets. The date sits in a left gutter, separated by a dashed line. Craft totals include every year. A pace bench divides minutes by distance, and a unit bench shows one number three ways. Neither bench is saved. Wind is a tag you picked, not a forecast.

Share builds a plain-text year summary and hands it to the system sheet. Keelbook does not record a GPS track, predict weather, or file a float plan. The file stays on this phone. Restore sample replaces it with a kayak, a rowboat, and four outings dated from today.

name: Kefalonia Planner
description:
Kefalonia Planner este ghidul tău offline-ready pentru vacanța pe Kefalonia.

Ce găsești în aplicație:
• Hartă cu plaje, taverne, peisaje și puncte utile
• Rute România → Kefalonia și pe insulă
• Stații PECO și alerte de drum (Smart Radar BG)
• Traducere documente / meniuri cu camera
• Chat comunitate și anunțuri utile
• Radio și instrumente de călătorie

Aplicația este gratuită în App Store. Accesul complet se deblochează cu adresa de email a licenței cumpărate pe greciaplanner.ro. Fără reclame și fără abonament.

Politica de confidențialitate: https://greciaplanner.ro/confidentialitate
Suport: contact@greciaplanner.ro

name: Kelpmoor Puzzlo
description:
On the rocky shore of Kelpmoor Puzzlo, the tide pools are full of lost pearls, and every open clam is waiting for one. Pip, a young sea otter in a coral knitted scarf, can't carry them, but he can move the tide.

HOW IT WORKS
Tap Flood to raise the tide one notch, or Ebb to lower it. Each change sends everything afloat drifting one cell: up the shore on a flood, back toward the sea on an ebb. The trick is the seabed. Deep pools are always wet, sandbars only flood at tide 2 and pink rock shelves only at tide 3, so a pearl resting on dry rock stays put while the others drift past. Raise and lower the tide in the right order to guide every pearl into an open clam before the tide shells run out.

- Driftwood floats too. Use it to stop a pearl in just the right place.
- Swirls push whatever floats on them one cell sideways.
- Crabs scuttle one cell on every tide and turn at walls. Nothing floats through them.

15 HANDCRAFTED TIDE POOLS
Every pool was built and checked to be solvable, starting gently and growing into real head-scratchers. Seat every pearl within par tides for three starfish, collect them on the Tide Chart, and replay any pool to improve your best.

A STORYBOOK SHORE
Hand-illustrated scenes of a sunlit cove, a cliffside of rock pools and a sunset beach hung with shell bunting, with rope-framed driftwood cards, glass-float buttons, Pip cheering you on and a gentle marimba soundtrack.

CALM AND FAIR
- Plays fully offline; progress is saved on your device.
- Undo and Restart any time, with a How to play card one tap away.

name: Kent Logistics
description:
Kent Logistics – Manage Your Shipments, Orders & Invoices

Kent Logistics is a mobile application designed to help registered customers manage their logistics activities conveniently.

Track shipment progress, view order details, access invoices, review payments, and stay connected with your logistics team — all from one place.

KEY FEATURES

Shipment & Order Management
• View active, pending, and completed orders.
• Access order and container details.
• Track shipment progress and delivery status.
• Monitor important shipment information.

Mark Number Management
• Add mark numbers to your account.
• View recent mark number entries.
• Access mark number information when needed.

Invoice & Payment Management
• View invoices and billing details.
• Download invoice documents.
• Review payment and installment history.
• Check outstanding payment information.

Notifications
• Receive important notifications related to your account and logistics activities.
• Stay informed about relevant updates.

Customer Support & Communication
• Communicate through the in-app chat feature.
• Stay connected with the Kent Logistics team.

Customer Profile
• View your registered customer information.
• Access business and account details.
• Manage your logistics information conveniently.

Secure Login
• Sign in using your registered mobile number.
• Verify your identity through OTP authentication.

WHY KENT LOGISTICS?

Kent Logistics brings your essential logistics information together in one convenient mobile application.

Whether you need to check shipment progress, review an invoice, or access order information, the app helps you stay organized and informed.

IMPORTANT

Kent Logistics is intended for registered customers. A valid customer account is required to access the application's services.

name: Kerbloom
description:
Kerbloom is an offline fieldbook for walks you want to take again. Build a route from landmarks you can recognize, such as a painted gate, a footbridge, or the steps at the end of a lane. Write an instruction for each cue and another for the return trip. On the way, open one cue at a time, mark it reached, and pause whenever you need to. Your progress is ready when you come back.

Save field notes about path surfaces, access, timing, and useful finds. Revisit completed walks or share a plain-text field card with someone taking the same route. Your notebook lives on your device and works without a signal or an account.

name: KerfBench
seller_name: Hangzhou Jingdi Network Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
Plan rectangular pieces on sheets of one size, using millimetres.

Create an empty project for woodworking, rectangular craft sheets such as acrylic or foam, paper and cardboard, or same-size rectangular offcuts. Presets supply editable starting settings. Paper starts with zero cut gap and new-piece rotation off; offcuts start with one available sheet. Add your own pieces and quantities.

Set stock dimensions, cut gap or kerf, a uniform margin on all four sides, and an available quantity from 1 to 30 sheets. Control 90-degree rotation per piece. Plan up to 100 pieces and inspect each sheet, utilization, oversized pieces and pieces left out by the sheet limit.

Save material specifications as reusable templates, edit them, or confirm their use in the current project while keeping its name and pieces. Material specifications are not a live inventory and are not deducted by planning. Save, reopen, update or delete projects. Share SVG layouts and CSV coordinates measured from the physical sheet origin. Project and material libraries have separate JSON backup and recovery controls.

English, Russian and Chinese follow the preferred system/app language. English is the fallback. Projects, material specifications and preferences stay on the device. No account, ads or analytics. A configured catalog can replace the native screen with a remote page.

The deterministic rectangular-splitting heuristic may not find the best layout. Each project uses one sheet size. Arbitrary shapes and CNC toolpaths are unsupported. Verify dimensions, material direction and cutting conditions before working.

name: Kern Trace Bend
description:
A cable route is more than a line between two points.
KernTraceBend connects bend dimensions, cable identity and inspection observations.

START WITH THE SITE
Create a site record to organize its cable routes.
Keep each route associated with its specific cable details.
Enter the make, model, diameter and covering layers.

GIVE EVERY BEND ITS SHAPE
Record the radius and turn angle of each bend.
View the bend geometry and the space it requires.
Revisit the dimensions when a route changes.

KEEP THE MAKER'S LIMITS IN VIEW
Record manufacturer-stated limits for the exact cable.
Review installation conditions alongside the bend details.
Document how the bend radius was measured.
Keep missing or conflicting manufacturer information visible.

LET INSULATION HISTORY SPEAK
Note visible wear in the cable's insulation.
Keep cable measurements with the related findings.
Look back at earlier changes before using saved results.

ONE PASSPORT, OPEN QUESTIONS INCLUDED
Bring routes, bend records and inspection findings together.
Keep unresolved details available for further review.
Use the bend passport as a reference, not installation approval.
KernTraceBend makes cable bend planning easier to examine.

name: Kettle Catch
description:
Kettle Catch keeps each book and its locked signatures on this iPhone.

The needle enters the head, catches the previous kettle once, and leaves through the tail. Coming back out pulls the thread. Catching twice springs back. Skipping the middle is short. An open previous signature leaves this one loose. A sealed signature stays shut. The book is sewn when every signature is locked.

Name a book, rename it, delete one, and share the name and the sentence.

Books stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not sew a paper book.

name: Keyvow: Group Buy Orders
description:
Group buys can take months. Keyvow keeps your paid orders, original promises, partial shipments, evidence, and personal review dates together — privately, on your device.

CAPTURE THE ORIGINAL PROMISE
Create orders manually, share an HTTPS link into Keyvow, or scan receipts and confirmations with your camera. On-device OCR suggests details only after you choose an image. Every suggestion is reviewed by you before it enters an order.

FOLLOW EVERY PART OF THE ORDER
Track multiple items, quantities, partial deliveries, cancellations, refunds, and disputes without forcing every order into one rigid timeline. Keep the original listing, terms, receipts, communication, and shipping links as dated evidence.

KNOW WHEN TO CHECK IN
Save exact dates, ranges, months, quarters, seasons, or an unknown estimate. Keyvow explains why an order needs attention: an estimate ended, a check-in is due, a custom deadline is approaching, an order has not been updated, or only part of it arrived.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No Keyvow account is required. Orders and evidence stay on your device unless you deliberately export them. There are no ads, analytics SDKs, or developer servers. Camera access is requested only for scanning, and notifications are optional.

YOUR DATA REMAINS YOURS
Export CSV, restorable JSON, evidence ZIP archives, or PDF reports. Restore structured data and original evidence on another device. Delete orders and their imported attachments together.

FREE AND PRO
The free version includes up to three active orders. Keyvow Pro is an optional one-time, non-consumable upgrade with unlimited active orders. Export, backup, restore, and access to existing orders are never locked behind Pro.

Keyvow organizes your own records. It does not verify seller trustworthiness, determine payment-protection eligibility, file disputes, or guarantee recovery. Verify current rules with your payment provider.

name: Kids Thinking Skills & Logic
description:
GeniusKite helps children build real thinking skills: noticing patterns, reasoning step by step, and solving problems they have never seen before. Thinking skills for kids in the age of AI.

There are more than 60,000 practice questions and puzzles, from Pre-K through Grade 12, at every level. Questions adapt to your child, so practice feels like play rather than a test, and recently seen questions are skipped.

WHAT YOUR CHILD CAN DO
• Brain Games: short, colourful puzzles for memory, attention and spatial thinking.
• Reasoning: verbal, number and picture reasoning practice, in the style of school gifted and reasoning tests.
• Activities: games like Catch the AI (spot the computer's mistake) and Think First (work it out, then check).
• Daily puzzle: one fresh puzzle every day.
• Learn: friendly strategy lessons with worked examples that show how to think through a problem.
• Worksheets and Printables: pages to print for the car, the kitchen table or a rainy afternoon.
• Practice exams: timed, sectioned practice with a review at the end.
• Stickers: finishing games and puzzles earns stickers for a sticker book, where your child collects buddies and grows a garden on every day they play.

PIP THE OWL
Pip guides your child through every game, cheers them on and helps when they get stuck.

FOR PARENTS
The parent area shows what your child has practised, how they are doing in each activity, and what to try next. You can set a grade and a daily goal, print certificates, and manage or delete your child's data at any time. Opening the parent area, creating an account, or following a link out of the app asks a simple grown-up question first, so little fingers stay on the games.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
GeniusKite is a universal app. Layouts are sized for iPhone and iPad, including a 13-inch iPad. Haptics, an offline screen, and a tab bar built for thumbs are part of the app itself, not just the website.

PRIVACY FIRST
• No ads, and no third-party advertising or tracking inside the app.
• Accounts belong to parents. Children only need a nickname, a grade and an avatar: no child email, photo, birthday or real name.
• We never sell data.
• Parents can delete a child's history, a child profile, or the whole account at any time, from the account page in the app.

Privacy policy: https://geniuskite.com/privacy
Children's privacy notice: https://geniuskite.com/childrens-privacy
Questions? https://geniuskite.com/contact

name: Kike Taxi - conductor
description:
Kike Taxi Conductor es la aplicación para los conductores de Kike Taxi.

Con ella usted puede:
• Ponerse en línea y recibir solicitudes de servicio cerca de usted.
• Ver el origen y el destino del servicio, y ofrecer su tarifa o aceptar el valor propuesto.
• Seguir la ruta en el mapa hasta el pasajero y hasta el destino.
• Comunicarse con el pasajero mediante el chat y las llamadas dentro de la aplicación.
• Recargar su saldo y consultar sus ganancias del día.
• Recibir avisos de servicios nuevos, aunque la aplicación esté cerrada.

Para usar la aplicación debe registrarse como conductor y esperar la verificación de sus documentos. La aplicación usa su ubicación, incluso en segundo plano, para recibir servicios cercanos y compartir su posición con el pasajero durante el viaje.

Soporte: kiketaxiapp@gmail.com

name: Kiko FM
description:
Kiko FM turns your alarm into a little morning radio show, hosted by Kiko, a cheerful rooster with a microphone.

Set your alarm as usual. When it rings and you tap Stop, Kiko starts talking right away, even with your phone still locked:

• THE WEATHER: what it's like now, how warm it gets, and whether you'll need an umbrella.
• YOUR DAY: today's first event, birthdays and plans from your calendar, and the reminders that are due.
• THE NEWS: a short roundup of the topics you pick, such as tech, science, sports, business or world news.

Then your favorite Apple Music playlist starts playing, so you go straight from the news to music.

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• Made for you: Kiko greets you by name and knows your plans for the day.
• Hands-free mornings: stop the alarm and listen, no need to unlock or open the app.
• Sounds like radio: a jingle, a music bed and a sign-off, about two to three minutes long.
• A real alarm: built on Apple's alarm system, so it rings even in silent mode or Focus.
• Your settings: choose what goes into the show, pick up to three news topics, and give each alarm its own playlist.
• English and Spanish.

PRIVACY
No account or sign-up. Calendar, reminders and location are optional and only used to write your briefing. You can delete everything the server keeps for you from Settings at any time.

Good morning. You're listening to Kiko FM, the station with just one listener: you.

name: Kindlark
description:
A small choice. A little company.

Tap “Meat-free today” and enjoy a reply from an animal friend. Now and then, a tiny symbolic gift comes along too. Kindlark makes room for a little humor and a choice that matters to you. No writing or photo is required.

MEET YOUR THREE FRIENDS
Clover the cow, Pip the pig and Dot the chicken each bring their own personality. All three friends and their replies are free.

KEEP A LITTLE SOMETHING
Occasional gifts gather in little stacks, organized by month. Open a stack to revisit each gift, the friend who brought it and the day it arrived. Your calendar keeps every saved hello, with or without a gift. Come back at your own pace; missing a day does not punish your friends or take away existing gifts.

SHARE WHEN YOU FEEL LIKE IT
Turn a saved animal hello into a keepsake image, preview it, and choose its destination in the iPhone share sheet. Basic sharing is free. Kindlark never posts automatically.

YOUR LITTLE WORLD, ON YOUR DEVICE
Your saved meat-free days, animal replies and gifts stay in the app's local storage. No Kindlark account, advertising or in-app analytics. Export and import a backup in My corner. Apple device backups, your chosen file provider, and services you share to may hold copies under their own settings and terms. Kindlark does not provide live cloud sync. If you contact support, you choose what to send.

OPTIONAL KINDLARK PRO
Make this little world yours with extra scenery, accessories and keepsake presentation styles. Preview the looks before purchasing. Pro is a one-time purchase with no recurring subscription; Apple shows the price and handles payment. Eligible purchases can be restored through Apple.

Your animal friends, humor, occasional gifts, history, backups and basic sharing stay free. Pro changes the look, not the kindness.

Animal replies and gifts are fictional keepsakes. A saved meat-free day expresses your own choice; it does not verify your diet or represent a donation or proof that an animal was rescued.

name: Kinetic Elements Dance
description:
WELCOME TO KINETIC ELEMENTS DANCE STUDIO

The Kinetic Elements Dance app allows you to manage your account with ease, register for classes, and special events. You'll also receive important notifications about class changes, closings, registration openings, special announcements, and upcoming events.

The Kinetic Elements Dance app is an easy-to-use, on-the-go way to access everything Kinetic Elements Dance has to offer right from your smartphone.

name: KITCHENREADY: Food Safety Exam
description:
KITCHENREADY helps you prepare for your food protection manager certification exam with focused practice instead of endless reading.

WHAT YOU GET
- Practice questions with a clear explanation and the Food Code source for every answer
- Number Flashcards: the temperatures, times, and measurements you must know cold, with spaced repetition that brings back the ones you miss
- Readiness Score: one number that shows how prepared you are, based on questions and cards you have mastered
- Timed practice exam with a pass/fail result
- Review Mistakes: replay only the questions you got wrong
- Progress tracking for every topic

TOPICS COVERED
- Foodborne illness and the Big 6 pathogens
- Food allergens
- Time and temperature control: holding, cooking, reheating, cooling, thawing, date marking
- Receiving and thermometers
- Personal hygiene, handwashing, and employee health
- Cross-contamination and storage
- Cleaning, sanitizing, plumbing, and pest control
- HACCP and special processes

FREE AND PREMIUM
Start free with sample questions in every topic and the first number flashcards. Unlock everything once with Premium: all questions, the full flashcard deck, the practice exam, and Review Mistakes. One-time payment through your Apple Account. No subscription, no ads.

ABOUT THE CONTENT
All questions are original and written for study purposes, based on the publicly available FDA Food Code. Requirements can differ by state and local jurisdiction, so always check the rules that apply where you work.

KITCHENREADY is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any exam provider, certification body, or government agency. Using this app does not guarantee a passing score.

name: Kite - Saudi Rentals & Homes
description:
Kite brings Saudi Arabia's property listings together in one place — rentals and sales from more than 20 property sites, deduplicated, on a single map.

FIND IT ON THE MAP Pan and search anywhere. Prices sit right on the map, and the list follows as you move.

KNOW IF THE PRICE IS FAIR Every listing is compared against similar homes nearby: how it ranks against the neighborhood median, the price per square metre, the asking-price history, and the closest comparable listings.

FILTER THE WAY YOU THINK Price, bedrooms, bathrooms, area, furnished, neighborhood, property type — with a live price distribution so you can see where your budget lands.

SAVE AND GET TOLD Save homes to revisit, save a search, and get told when something new matches or a price drops.

NEW DEVELOPMENTS Browse off-plan and ready projects from developers, with their available units.

Kite is free. Every listing links back to the site it was posted on, and contact details are shown for licensed brokers. See something wrong? Report it from the listing.

name: KitHold
description:
KitHold is a local planner for apparel and bags. Before you cut, it shows whether a style is kit-ready, and lets you lock fabric and trims to that order so another job cannot take the same stock.

How to use

Open the app. The dashboard ring is overall kit completion. Colored cards are styles still short.
Tap the compass at the bottom right. Choose Inventory. Pick a material, then adjust free stock or add a lot.
Open Holds. Tap +. Choose a style, a material, a quantity, and an expiry. Lock. That quantity leaves free stock and sits on the order.
Open Kit. Open a style, read the gap list. If every line is covered, confirm the kit. If not, hold more stock or wait for inbound.
Open Suppliers. Confirm a purchase that is in transit. Stock increases. You can lock the new stock against the worst remaining gap.
Open Reports. Freeze today’s kit rate and hold history as a snapshot.
Holds that expire return to free stock. Sample data is already loaded so you can finish this loop on first launch. Nothing is sent to a server.

The compass replaces a tab bar. Inventory, Holds, Kit, Suppliers, and Reports are the five rooms. Feedback is the envelope at the top right of the home screen.

name: Kitted: AI Car Mods & Tuning
description:
Kitted shows your own car with the parts on, before you buy them.

Take a photo of your car or pick one from your library. Choose what changes: wheels, ride height, paint or wrap, body parts, lights and glass. A minute later you see the same car in the same photo with that change made, and you can drag a handle to compare it with stock.

BUILT FOR YOUR CAR, NOT A SHOWROOM ONE
• Your photo stays your photo: the same car, angle and background, with only the part you asked for changed
• A parts counter that speaks car: mesh, five-spoke, deep dish, turbofan, steelies, lowered, slammed, lifted, satin wrap, front lip, side skirts, tint
• Or write it in your own words: "roof wrapped in black, bronze wheels"
• Keep going from any result: add the next part on top and build the look step by step

THE PARTS LIST
Every picture comes with a parts list: what was fitted, a rough price range for each part, a rough total and what to check before you buy. Prices are shown in your currency.

YOUR GARAGE
Save each of your cars with its name and model. Every look you try is kept under that car, so you can come back, compare and carry on.

MADE TO BE HONEST
• Pictures are AI previews. A part shown may not exist for your model or may not fit without other work.
• The parts list is an AI estimate for planning, not a quote. Prices and fitment differ by car, brand and workshop, and rules on tint, lights, exhaust and ride height differ by place.
• Your garage stays on your phone. A photo is sent for processing only when you render a look, and only after you agree.

CREDITS
One picture costs 1 credit; its parts list is included. Your first credits come with the free trial of Kitted Weekly, a subscription that adds credits every week; unused credits carry over. Packs of credits are sold separately and do not expire. If a render fails, its credit comes back.

SUBSCRIPTION
Kitted Weekly renews automatically every week until cancelled. A free trial, where offered, converts to the paid subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://gateway-production-7724d21c.up.railway.app/legal/kitted/privacy

name: Kitty Fun: Games for Cats
description:
Turn your phone or iPad into a hunting ground for your cat. Kitty Fun has 14 worlds full of lifelike prey that dart, freeze, hide and flee from a paw. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions.

Lay your device flat on the floor, pick a world and let your cat do the rest.

PREY THAT ACTS LIKE PREY
• Koi glide and turn, mice dart between hiding spots, and a turtle ducks under a lily pad when a paw comes close
• A tap nearby startles an animal so it bolts or hides, just like the real thing
• Bodies bend as they swim, flippers paddle, feet patter and wings beat
• Animals squeak, chirp and quack when caught, and every world has its own soundscape: a quiet bay, forest birdsong, desert wind, rain, a winter storm or a beach

14 WORLDS, FROM GENTLE TO LIGHTNING-FAST
• Easy, for slow afternoons and older cats: fireflies in a crystal Grotto, paint-carrying ants in Watercolor, drifting bubbles in Bubble Pop and rolling Yarn Balls
• Medium, a steady pace with quick moments: Pond, Forest, Desert, Pantry, Bug Hunt and Feather Wand
• Hard, for fast dashes and sudden darts: Laser, Space, Arctic and Ocean

Every world hides a rare legendary catch, from the Golden Koi and the Mouse King to the Phoenix, the Yeti and a Mermaid.

MADE FOR CAT OWNERS
• A profile for every cat: add each cat's name and age. Kittens get quicker animals, and seniors get slower, gentler ones
• Play timer: 2, 5 or 10 minutes, or off. The last 20 seconds slow down, then a "Last catch!" leads to a "Great hunt, Luna!" summary
• Trophy shelf: catches, time played, favorite game and legendary tallies for each cat
• Paw paintings: in Watercolor, every catch splashes paint onto a picture you can save and share
• Cat-proof controls: in-game buttons need a press and hold, so paws can't quit by accident. The app also shows you how to lock the screen with Guided Access
• Sounds tab: eight sounds to get your cat's attention, including meowing, purring, a squeaky toy, bells, shaking treats and scurrying mice

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No ads, no in-app purchases and no subscriptions
• No account needed, and it works offline
• No data leaves your device
• Made for iPhone and iPad, with art drawn for each screen, in portrait or landscape on iPad

A FEW TIPS
Kitty Fun is a screen toy for supervised play. A screen protector keeps claws off the glass, and short sessions keep the hunt exciting.
