所有範本與功能免費版都能使用；免費版匯出的名片中央會有淺灰色 KKMaker 浮水印。一次買斷「完整版」即可去除浮水印，永久使用，沒有訂閱。

適合業務、自由工作者、小店老闆、醫師、律師、房仲、設計師、老師、美業工作者，以及任何需要名片的人。
現在就下載 KKMaker，做一張讓人記住你的名片！

name: KKRSE Max
description: 日々の収支を記録した後、銀行明細上の期末残高や、実際に手元で集計した金額を「照合ポイント」として登録することができます。 口座のタイムライン上で差異が生じている箇所をクリックすると、期首残高、取引履歴、および実残高を確認でき、重複した取引や二重計上、また日付をまたぐ資金移動などを絞り込んで調査することが可能です。 特定の日付の残高を確定させることで照合ポイントを設定し、調査対象を絞り込むことができます。 例えば、計上漏れしていた駐車料金や二重計上された通信費などを一つの修正案にまとめ、各期間の残高を照らし合わせた上で、一括して反映させることが可能です。 月次レポートには、照合済みの日付、期間ごとの証憑書類の不足分、残高調整額、および確認待ちの項目をそれぞれ分けて記載します。 たとえ月末時点の合計額が一致していたとしても、複数の取引が互いに相殺し合っているような誤りがないか、引き続き調査を行うことができます。

name: KNI Service Engineer
description:
KNI Service Engineer helps authorized KNI service engineers manage assigned
  commercial kitchen equipment service jobs.

  • View assigned work orders and service details.
  • Update job progress and document completed work with photos.
  • View service reports, parts inventory, and assigned service locations.

  An active KNI service engineer account is required to sign in.

name: Knot: Little Lists
description:
Knot is a small list app for the short things you need to remember: milk, a phone call, the plumber's number. Every line is short, so your lists stay light and easy to read.

EVERYTHING IS A TAP, A SWIPE OR A HOLD
• Tap the ring to finish a line
• Pull the list down to add a new one
• Swipe right to give it a time, swipe left to edit or delete
• Hold and drag to move a line, or tuck it inside another

LINES WITH A LITTLE CHARACTER
Tasks, notes, "someday" lines and headings. Mark the important ones and they stand out.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Give a line a time and Knot reminds you when it comes. In the evening, Close the day walks you through what is left: move it to tomorrow, let it go or keep it.

WIDGETS
Your list on the Home Screen, and on the Lock Screen on iPhone. Finish lines right from the widget.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your lists stay on your phone. Knot speaks 35 languages.

KNOT+
Knot is free and stays that way. A single one-time Knot+ purchase opens extra color palettes, typefaces and ring styles. No subscription. High contrast and an easy-to-read typeface are always free.

Made by Slow Things, a small studio that makes one app for one thing.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: KnottField
description:
KnottField is the field-service app for Knott Mechanical technicians. Sign in with your Knott account to see your schedule, open the work order you're assigned to, and work a ticket from start to finish on the phone.

• Your schedule and assignments, with the day's work orders
• Open a ticket and step through tasks, work performed, recommendations, equipment, materials and time
• Photograph equipment and job sites and attach the photos to assets, work orders and purchase orders
• Scan an asset tag to pull up the right equipment
• Capture a customer signature to close out a visit
• Review purchase orders and on-call rotations

KnottField is for Knott Mechanical staff. A Knott account is required; the app does not create accounts.

name: kokomemo: Location Reminders
description:
Ever get to the store and forget what you came for? kokomemo remembers for you.

Drop a memo on the map—"milk, eggs, plastic wrap" at the supermarket, "buy the local sweets" at a sightseeing spot—and kokomemo sends you a notification the moment you arrive.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap the map, search for a place, or use your current location
• Write your memo
• Choose an alert radius: 100 m, 300 m, or 500 m
• Arrive, and your memo pops up—no need to open the app

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Works in the background and even when the app isn't running
• No repeat alerts: the same memo won't notify you again within an hour
• Checklists in your memos: tap the checklist button to add checkbox items, then check them off right from the memo
• Attach up to 5 photos to a memo—they sync with your iCloud
• Delete memos when you're finished. Deleted memos stay in the Trash for 30 days, so you can restore them
• 100 icons, 12 colors, and categories (8 built-in plus your own) for free; any color you like with Premium
• Group your list by category, area, or distance, and sort by nearest, newest, or address
• More than 20 places? kokomemo keeps the nearest ones active automatically
• Battery-friendly: uses iOS region monitoring, not constant GPS

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking
• Your memos, photos, and locations never leave your device and your own iCloud
• Syncs across your devices with iCloud

FREE AND PREMIUM
• Free: up to 10 memos (memos in the Trash don't count), all 100 icons, 12 colors, and all categories, including ones you make yourself
• kokomemo Premium is a one-time purchase—no subscription—that unlocks:
  – Unlimited memos
  – Any color: beyond the 12 colors, make any color for your memos and categories

kokomemo needs "Always" location access to notify you when the app is closed. You can change this any time in the Settings app.

name: Komi POS
description: Komi es el punto de venta para restaurantes que se usa desde el celular. Tus meseros toman la orden en la mesa, la cocina y la barra la reciben al instante y la caja cobra en segundos.

name: Kona: Çalışma Mekânı Haritası
description:
Kona, laptopla çalışacak sakin bir köşe arayanlar için bir harita.

Bir kafeye gitmeden önce şunları görürsün: yer var mı, priz var mı, ortam ne kadar gürültülü, internet nasıl. Bilgiler tahminle değil, mekânda bulunan insanların verdiği raporlarla güncellenir.

NELER VAR

Canlı mekân durumu
Yer, priz ve gürültü durumu haritada bir bakışta. Raporlar yalnızca mekâna yakın olan kişilerden kabul edilir, bu yüzden bilgiler güvenilir kalır.

Şimdi nereye gideyim?
Saatine, konumuna ve mekânların güncel durumuna göre sana en uygun çalışma yerlerini önerir.

Kona'nın önerisi
Bir mekânın Google yorumlarını ve Kona notlarını yapay zekâ ile özetler. Tek dokunuşla kısa ve net bir öneri alırsın.

Wi‑Fi hız ölçümü
Mekânda internet hızını ölç. Mekânın değeri, ölçümlerin ortancasıdır; kişisel erişim noktası ölçümleri sayılmaz.

Çalışma oturumu
Mekânda ne kadar çalıştığını takip et. Günlük serini ve toplam süreni profilinde gör.

Kona notları
Mekâna kısa ipuçları bırak: "üst kattaki masa sessiz" gibi. Uygunsuz notlar bildirilebilir ve gizlenir.

Arkadaşını çağır
Beğendiğin mekâna arkadaşını tek dokunuşla davet et.

Favoriler ve bildirimler
Favori mekânlarının durumu değiştiğinde haberdar ol. Bildirimler isteğe bağlıdır.

GİZLİLİK
Konumun yalnızca uygulama açıkken, yakındaki mekânları göstermek ve rapor doğrulamak için kullanılır. Reklam yok, takip yok, satın alma yok. Hesabını uygulama içinden istediğin zaman silebilirsin.

Koyu ve açık tema, Türkçe ve İngilizce dil desteği.

Kona şu an İstanbul'da, Kadıköy ve Moda çevresinde başladı. Daha fazla mekân ve bölge yolda.

name: KongDaily
description:
Your everyday Hong Kong companion, all in one app.

KongDaily is a practical app designed to make everyday life in Hong Kong easier. From bus arrival estimates and local weather to nearby public facilities and places worth exploring, KongDaily brings useful information together in one convenient place.

**BUS ARRIVAL ESTIMATES**

Quickly search for bus routes and stops, check estimated arrival times, and plan your daily journeys with ease. Save your frequently used routes and stops for quick access.

**HONG KONG WEATHER**

Check current weather conditions, 9-day weather forecasts, and official weather warnings. Stay informed before commuting, heading outdoors, or planning your weekend.

**NEARBY PUBLIC FACILITIES**

Discover public toilets, parks, pet parks, and other useful facilities on an interactive map. View location details and open directions to your destination.

**EXPLORE HONG KONG**

Discover eight carefully selected places across Hong Kong, including hiking trails, waterfront areas, and beautiful parks.

Each place features real photos, highlights, transport tips, and links to official information, helping you decide where to go next.

**GLOBAL SEARCH**

Search bus routes, bus stops, public facilities, and curated places from one convenient search experience.

**SAVE YOUR FAVORITES**

Keep your frequently used routes, stops, and places close at hand, making everyday information easier to access.

**MADE FOR EVERYDAY LIFE**

- Traditional Chinese and English support
- Simple and easy-to-use interface
- Selected content available offline
- No account required

Live bus arrival estimates, weather updates, and online place searches require an internet connection.

Make everyday life in Hong Kong a little simpler.

KongDaily by Lenny Studio

name: Kothon – Bangla Voice Typing
description:
Kothon is a Bengali voice keyboard. Speak in Bengali and Kothon writes it in WhatsApp, Messenger, Mail, Notes or any other app.

Everything runs on your phone. Your voice and your text are never sent anywhere, and once a model is downloaded, Kothon works without internet.

• দ্রুত (fast): a small model that writes in a blink
• নিখুঁত (accurate): a larger model on the Neural Engine, with fewer mistakes
• Adds punctuation and removes fillers like "um"
• Full Bengali and English keyboards, with emoji
• No account, no data collected

Kothon is in beta and open source: github.com/Omnixima/kothon

name: Kotivox
description:
Kotivox ordena tu negocio inmobiliario en el celular: tus inmuebles, tus clientes, tu agenda y tus negocios, con Koti, tu asistente. Es el software inmobiliario y CRM inmobiliario con inteligencia artificial para inmobiliarias y asesores.

KOTI, TU ASISTENTE
• Mándale las fotos y cuéntale por escrito o en una nota de voz cómo es el inmueble: Koti crea la ficha por ti.
• Pídele que registre un contacto, que busque un cliente o un inmueble, o que te diga qué tienes pendiente.
• Si una respuesta de Koti no está bien, puedes reportarla desde el mismo chat.

AVISOS DE INTERESADOS AL INSTANTE
• Recibe una notificación cuando llega un interesado nuevo y ábrelo con un toque.
• En el Inicio ves cuántos interesados nuevos tienes, cuántos ya gestionaste y cuántos esperan respuesta.

TU AGENDA
• Agenda visitas, captaciones, firmas y reuniones con el cliente y el inmueble, y te avisa si se cruzan.
• En el Inicio ves tu semana; desde la cita llamas o escribes al cliente y abres la dirección en el mapa.

TUS INMUEBLES
• Crea y edita fichas con fotos, precio, ubicación y características.
• Cambia el estado (disponible, publicado, reservado…) y comparte el enlace de la ficha con tus clientes.

TUS CONTACTOS
• Propietarios, compradores, arrendatarios e interesados en un solo lugar, con su historial.
• Agrégalos con el formulario, con Koti o desde la agenda de tu celular.

TUS NEGOCIOS
• Ventas y arriendos, cada uno con su embudo: mueve cada negocio de etapa cuando avance.
• En arriendo, marca el resultado del estudio con un toque.

La app está en español e inglés. Para usarla necesitas una cuenta de Kotivox.

name: Krookiz - קרוקיז
description:
רואים מתכון שווה באינסטגרם, בטיקטוק או בפייסבוק? משתפים אותו לקרוקיז, בוחרים קטלוג, וזהו. קרוקיז מסדר את המתכון: מצרכים, הוראות הכנה, וכמויות שמשתנות לפי מספר המנות.

שומרים בשנייה
• בפוסט עצמו לוחצים שיתוף ובוחרים בקרוקיז, וקרוקיז שואל לאיזה קטלוג להכניס.
• עובד עם קישורים מאינסטגרם, טיקטוק, פייסבוק ואתרי מתכונים, עם טקסט שמדביקים ועם צילומי מסך.
• כרטיס הסרטון פותח את הפוסט המקורי באינסטגרם או בטיקטוק.

מתכון מסודר וקריא
• רשימת מצרכים לפי חלקים (לבצק, לרוטב), שאפשר לסמן תוך כדי.
• הוראות ממוספרות, עם טיימר לכל שלב שמחכה זמן.
• משנים את מספר המנות, או ×½ ×2 ×3, והכמויות מתעדכנות גם בתוך ההוראות.
• מצב בישול: שלב אחד גדול על המסך, בלי להתבלבל.
• בהוראות כתוב ליד כל מצרך כמה ממנו צריך, ונגיעה בו מראה את הפרטים.
• עריכה של כל מתכון: השם, הכמויות, המצרכים וההוראות.

קטלוגים בטעם שלכם
• לכל קטלוג צבע, רקע ואיור לבחירה מתוך יותר מ-250 איורים של מאכלים.
• מועדפים בלב, חיפוש לפי מתכון או מצרך, ומחיקה בהחלקה.

ביחד
• מזמינים איש קשר בקישור, והוא מצטרף בלחיצה: שניכם רואים את אותם קטלוגים ומתכונים.
• שולחים מתכון לחבר בוואטסאפ.
• מוציאים את כל המתכונים בלחיצה: קובץ וורד מסודר לפי קטלוגים, או טקסט ל-AI.

סידור חכם עם AI (אופציונלי)
עם מפתח חינמי של Google Gemini, קרוקיז מבין כל פוסט: מתרגם מתכונים מאנגלית, מפריד מצרכים מהוראות גם כשהכל כתוב ברצף, וקורא צילומי מסך. בלי מפתח, קרוקיז עושה סידור בסיסי.

פרטיות
בלי חשבון, בלי פרסומות ובלי מעקב. ספר המתכונים מוצפן לפני שהוא עולה ל-iCloud, ומפתח האפליקציה לא יכול לקרוא אותו.

name: Kuden Fit Exclusive
description: Bu uygulama ile spor salonuna giriş çıkışlarınızı kolayca yönetin. QR kod ile hızlıca giriş yapın, üyelik bilgilerinizi görüntüleyin ve güncel kalın. Spor salonu deneyiminizi bir üst seviyeye taşıyın!

name: Kumudu Desk
description:
Kumudu Desk is the field-staff app for Kumudu teams. It replaces paper registers and phone check-ins with a fast, reliable way to mark attendance and stay connected with your store while you're out in the field.

SIGN IN SECURELY
Log in with your registered mobile number and a one-time password (OTP). Your store, branch and role come from your existing Kumudu account, so there's nothing to set up.

SELFIE CHECK-IN AND CHECK-OUT
• Check in and out with a quick selfie from the front camera
• Each photo is stamped with the time, GPS location and address
• Face verification confirms the right person is checking in
• A simple head-turn step stops anyone from checking in with a photo of someone else

LOCATION ONLY WHILE ON DUTY
• While you're checked in, the app shares your location with your store about every 20 minutes
• Once you check out, location sharing stops completely
• Battery and network status are shared with each update so problems can be spotted early

FOR STORE HEADS AND MANAGERS
• See who's checked in right now and where they are on a map
• Review check-in selfies and attendance history
• Get alerts when a team member's phone stops sending updates during work hours
• Staff see only their own records. Managers see their branch or store.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Clean, simple screens that work well one-handed
• Clear messages when GPS, camera or network need attention
• Days you forgot to check out are closed automatically and marked so they're easy to find

PRIVACY
Your location is collected only between check-in and check-out. Face checks run on Kumudu's own servers, and face data is never shared with third parties.

Kumudu Desk is for employees of Kumudu stores and needs an active Kumudu account. Contact your Store Head if you need access.

name: Kuran Pusulası
description:
Kuran Pusulası, merak ettiğiniz soruyu Kur'an'a sormanızı ve cevabı dayandığı ayetlerle birlikte görmenizi sağlar. Kur'an'ı Arapça aslı, okunuşu ve mealiyle okuyun; namaz vakitlerini takip edin, kıble yönünü kolayca bulun.

KURAN'A SOR
"Kur'an'da faiz haram mı?", "Sabır hakkında ne diyor?", "Kur'an'da kaç ayet var?" gibi sorularınızı kendi cümlelerinizle yazın. Yapay zeka Kur'an'ın tamamını tarar ve kısa bir cevap verir. Her cevabın altında, cevabın dayandığı ayetler Arapça aslı, okunuşu ve mealiyle gösterilir; böylece cevabı kendiniz de kontrol edebilirsiniz.

KURAN OKU
• 114 surenin tamamı
• Arapça metin, Latin harfleriyle okunuş ve Türkçe meal bir arada
• Diyanet İşleri, Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır, Şaban Piriş ve diğer Türkçe mealler
• Ayetleri tek tek ya da surenin tamamını sesli dinleyin

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ
• Türkiye'nin 81 ili için günlük namaz vakitleri
• Sıradaki vakte kalan süre
• 7 günlük imsakiye
• Namaz vakti bildirimleri

KIBLE PUSULASI
Telefonunuzun pusulasıyla bulunduğunuz yerden Kâbe'nin yönünü gösterir.

GÜNÜN AYETİ
Her gün yeni bir ayet; isterseniz bildirim olarak da alın.

GİZLİLİĞİNİZE SAYGI
• Hesap açmanız gerekmez
• Reklam ve kullanıcı takibi yok
• Konumunuz yalnızca cihazınızda kullanılır, sunucuya gönderilmez

Not: Cevaplar yapay zeka tarafından, gösterilen ayetlere dayanarak üretilir. Fetva değildir; önemli konularda ayetleri bağlamıyla okumanızı ve bir din âlimine danışmanızı öneririz.

Web: https://kuranpusulasi.com

name: Kvoazclov
description:
Kvoazclov is a calm, offline mood ledger. Record how you feel as often as you like, optionally note energy, tag factors such as sleep or work, and add a short reflection.  

See today at a glance, browse a tinted month calendar, explore a simple seven-day chart, and review tag patterns from the last thirty days. Data is stored locally with Core Data—no cloud sync.  

No account, no ads, no iCloud sync, and no social features. Privacy opens only when you tap Privacy in More.

name: LAAV
description:
Enter your school’s address and sign in with the account you use on its website. Open a course your school has given you access to, choose a lesson and watch the video or read the lesson materials.

LAAV offers light and dark themes and an interface in English, Italian and Russian. Your school chooses the courses, materials and their languages. School management is available on the website.

name: LadeTavlen
description:
LadeTavlen er til foreninger og alle, der deler en fælles ladetavle, fx andelsforeninger, ejerforeninger, grundejerforeninger, boligforeninger og fælles carporte. Appen giver alle ét fælles overblik over ladestanderne, så I kan lade bilerne, uden at hovedsikringen springer.

• Se live, hvor meget strøm laderne bruger på hver fase, og hvor meget plads der er tilbage på ladetavlens hovedsikring.
• Se, hvor mange biler der kan komme på lige nu. Appen regner det selv ud fra hovedsikringen og ladernes effekt.
• Følg hver lader: ledig, lader, fuld eller venter på billig strøm.
• Stil dig i kø, og få besked, når der bliver plads.
• Book en lader, og se en prognose for belastningen de næste 48 timer.
• Få besked, når din bil er fuld, eller når belastningen bliver høj.
• Se elprisen alt inklusive (spotpris, nettarif, afgifter og moms) 48 timer frem, så I kan lade, når strømmen er billigst.
• Se i historikken, hvad ladningerne har kostet i kr. – i alt, pr. medlem og pr. lader.

Virker med Monta, Spirii og Easee
LadeTavlen henter data fra den ladeplatform, I allerede bruger: Monta (fx via NRGi), Spirii eller Easee.

Kom i gang
En administrator opretter foreningen i appen, vælger jeres ladeplatform og indtaster hovedsikringen og en admin-PIN. Alle andre logger ind med det fælles login eller ved at scanne QR-koden. Der er ingen personlige konti.

LadeTavlen læser kun data fra ladeplatformen og styrer ikke laderne.

name: Laffia Driver
description:
Laffia Driver is the app for drivers who carry Laffia Rides passengers: non-emergency medical transportation in New Jersey, starting with Union and Essex County. Dispatch adds you as a driver; you then sign in with the phone number or email they have on file.

• Today's trips and the days ahead, with pickup times worked out from each appointment.
• Step through every trip: driving to pickup, arrived, rider on board, dropped off.
• Turn-by-turn directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.
• Rider details that matter: mobility (walking, wheelchair, stretcher) and pickup notes.
• Call or text the rider, and chat with dispatch from any trip.
• Your location is shared with the rider and dispatch only while a trip is under way.
• See your earnings by week, if your fleet pays through Laffia.

name: Lagly Tactics
description:
Lagly Tactics is a quick, no-fuss tactics board for football coaches. Get players on the pitch, move them around, draw the move and share it — in seconds, without menus getting in the way.

TACTICS AND DRILLS
• Full pitch, half pitch, training area or blank board — in grass, dark or whiteboard style
• Home and away players, ball and equipment: cones, discs, poles, ladders, hurdles, mini goals and mannequins
• Draw runs, passes, dribbles, lines, freehand, areas and circles in any colour

ANIMATE AND SHARE
• Build a move step by step and play it back smoothly
• Export an image of a step or a video of the whole move — in landscape or portrait, ready for your coaching presentations

REAL LANDSCAPE ON IPAD
• Turn the iPad and the pitch turns with it, while player numbers stay upright

YOUR SQUAD
• Formations for 5v5, 7v7, 9v9 and 11v11
• Add your team with numbers and positions, and the names land on the pitch when you pick a formation

TRAINING SESSIONS
• Put drills together into a session with minutes per drill
• Run it on the pitch with a countdown timer
• Share the session plan as a PDF

Folders, search and undo are all there too.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.

name: Land Area: Acreage Calculator
description:
Measure a field, lot, or property outline directly on the map. Tap to place points, adjust the boundary, and see acreage and perimeter update as you work.

Use satellite imagery to trace a visible area, or switch to the standard map. Search for a place, center on your location when you choose, and refine your measurement by dragging, inserting, or deleting boundary points. Undo and redo make changes easy.

• Measure area in acres, hectares, square feet, and square meters.
• Measure open distances and see individual boundary lengths.
• Draw a rectangle from two opposite corners.
• Add a generic cost-per-foot rate to estimate boundary work.
• Save up to three measurements for free and reopen them later.
• Share a map or standard-map image with an optional title and measurements.

Upgrade once to Pro for unlimited saved measurements, higher-resolution images, PDF reports, notes and site photos, and side-by-side measurement comparisons. There is no subscription.

Measurements are estimates based on points you place. They are not legal property boundaries or a substitute for a professional survey. Map imagery and search require an internet connection. Location access is optional; you can measure any place manually.

name: Lane Judge: Derby Race Manager
description:
Lane Judge runs a gravity car race from the first heat to the trophy: pinewood cars, scout packs, church clubs, classrooms and living room tracks.

Build the heat chart in one tap
Add each car with its number and, if you like, its den or class. Lane Judge builds a chart where every car runs once in every lane, so a fast lane or a slow lane favours nobody. It works for 2 to 6 lanes, and a lane simply stays empty when there are fewer cars than lanes.

Run each heat
Open a heat and tap the cars in the order they cross the line. That is all the scoring you have to do. A result can be corrected at any time, and so can a car's name, number or group.

Let the camera call the finish
No electronic timer on your track? Hold the iPhone over the finish line, drag the coloured line across the lanes and tap Arm. The camera watches the line at up to 240 frames a second and reports the finishing order and the gap to the winner in milliseconds. Nothing is recorded.

Standings everyone can follow
Standings update after every heat: lowest average finishing place wins, then most heat wins. Mirror the iPhone to a TV and the whole room sees who is ahead.

Ties settled on the track
When two cars end level for a podium place, Lane Judge says so and sets up a tie-breaker heat between just those cars. No coin toss, no arguing at the trophy table.

Without paying
- One race with up to 8 cars
- Full heat chart with lane rotation
- Tap-to-score heats, live standings and tie-breaker heats
- Eight camera finishes: every heat of an 8-car race
- Results as text, to paste into a message
- A sample race to explore

Lane Judge Pro
- No limit on cars or on races kept: the whole pack on one chart, year after year
- The finish camera on every heat
- A finals round for the fastest cars, every finalist in every lane
- A podium for each den, class or age group
- Standings and heat chart as a PDF to print or send

Pro is one payment and it is yours to keep. There is no subscription and nothing renews.

There is no account and no sign-up. Your races stay on your iPhone.

Lane Judge is made by one developer and has no link to, and no approval from, the Boy Scouts of America or any other organization. Pinewood Derby is a registered trademark of the Boy Scouts of America.

name: Lantern Kitchen
description:
Open a tiny Vietnamese restaurant and grow it into the brightest place on the street.

You start alone: cook phở and bánh mì at the stations, carry the bowls to your guests and take their money at the till. Every coin goes into new tables, a coffee bar, a grill and more, until you can hire cashiers, waiters and cooks who keep the doors open even while you are away.

• 28 Vietnamese dishes to learn and master, from phở bò to chè ba màu
• Build the dining room, a terrace, a kitchen garden, a lotus deck and a lantern courtyard
• Fit out the kitchen with better gear and renovate the restaurant again and again
• Decorate every wall and table, and dress yourself and your staff
• A new festival every week: Tết, the Lantern Festival, Mid-Autumn and Street Food Week
• 24 regulars with their own stories, a daily food critic and tour groups
• A daily gift calendar and a restaurant album to fill
• Plays in English and Vietnamese

Ads are optional: watch one only when you want a reward. Lantern Kitchen is free to play, with optional in-app purchases.

name: Lao Help
description:
Lao Help is your roadside companion in Laos—fast SOS assistance when you’re stuck, and easy EV bike rentals when you need to move.

SOS ROADWAY HELP
Request help in a few taps when you break down or run into trouble:
• Towing for bikes and cars
• Battery jumpstart
• Emergency fuel delivery
• On-site mechanical help

Share your live location so our team can find you, see clear pricing with distance-based reach fees, and track your request from submit to dispatch.

EV BIKE RENTAL
Browse available electric bikes, pick a weekly, monthly, or annual plan, choose your schedule, and book in-app. Perfect for city trips and longer stays.

MEMBERSHIP
Unlock membership benefits that can cover reach fees within your plan’s included distance—so SOS help costs less when you need it most.

BUILT FOR REAL USE
• Guest booking without an account, or sign up to save your history
• WhatsApp-ready contact details for smooth follow-up
• Clear receipts and request history in your profile
• Privacy-friendly controls, including account deletion

Whether you’re a local rider or visiting Laos, Lao Help is here when the road doesn’t go to plan—and when you just need a reliable EV to get around.

Support: https://laohelp.com/contact
Website: https://laohelp.com

name: Laree - Journal
description:
Laree is a warm, private keepsake organizer that creates a visual archive for your cherished personal mementos and memories.

Easily capture meaningful photographs of letters, tickets, and small treasures, then attach personal notes and categorical tags. Everything stays securely on your local device as a quiet digital memory book.

name: Last Banner: Survival
description:
Hold the last banner and survive the endless waves of the Crimson Legion.

PLANT YOUR BANNER
Your commander can plant the royal banner at any moment. Inside its glow your attack speed rises; step outside it and you move faster instead — every second is a choice between standing your ground and running for the next kill.

CALL IN SUPPORT
Every two minutes, choose one of three battle orders — artillery support, a cavalry charge or a rain of arrows — and watch a spectacular wave of help crash into the enemy line.

FREE THE CAPTURED
Chained soldiers wait across the battlefield. Walk past them and they join your banner, following you into the next fight.

EVOLVE YOUR ARSENAL
Twelve weapons, twelve passive powers. Level a weapon to its peak and pair it with the right passive to forge a legendary evolved version — a storm sword, a five-barrel volley musket, a wall of shields and more.

TEN MINUTES, EVERYTHING ON THE LINE
Survive ten minutes of rising danger, break an elite wave at 2, 5 and 8 minutes, then face the chapter boss at the ten-minute mark. Chests drop upgrades; one more run always feels within reach.

BUILD YOUR COMMAND
Gear six slots in five rarities, train thirty skills in the barracks, and recruit four heroes, each built around a different way to fight. Send your army on patrol between runs for steady gold and scrolls.

SOMETHING NEW OFTEN
Daily and weekly missions, achievements, a seven-day login calendar and a 28-day Season Pass keep every week different.

FAIR TO PLAY
Free to play and finishable for free. Ads are optional rewarded videos only — never forced. Optional purchases speed things up.

Available in Turkish and English.

Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://patpatgames.com/lastbanner/privacy.html

name: LAST LIGHT: Keeper’s Watch
description:
Hold the light. Watch the edges.

LAST LIGHT is a one-thumb survival game built around a simple choice: burn approaching shades with your flashlight, or release it to recharge in the dark.

Follow a lost signal through four locations: the abandoned Relay, Drowned Hall, Root Cathedral, and the Meridian observatory. Survive twelve waves and face four guardians, each with its own attacks and exposed weak points.

Recover five flashlights with different play styles, from a wide rescue beam to a precision lamp and a twin lantern that shines behind you. Earn salvage, improve your equipment permanently, and build a different combination of upgrades during each expedition.

Use an emergency pulse when the dark gets close. Learn six enemy types, recover field records, and hold on until dawn. Complete the campaign to unlock Endless watch.

• Four locations with distinct scenery, ambient sound and environmental conditions
• Four guardian encounters with shielded and wounded phases
• Five flashlights and permanent workshop progression
• Saved wave checkpoints and local best scores
• Offline play with no account required
• No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases

Sound and haptics can be switched off. Reduced Motion is supported. Progress is saved on your device; cloud saves are not included.

name: Latidoku: Queens with Dogs
description:
Every dog needs its own yard! Latidoku is the Queens logic puzzle with cute dogs: a relaxing brain teaser you can play in a few minutes.

HOW TO PLAY
• Place exactly one dog in every row, every column and every colored yard.
• Dogs can't be side by side, not even diagonally, or they start barking!
• Tap once to mark X, twice to place a dog, and drag to mark several X.

PURE LOGIC, NO GUESSING
Every puzzle has a single solution you can reach by reasoning alone. Stuck? Hints show the next step and explain why.

COLLECT AND EVOLVE
Earn treats every game and adopt Caramelo, Sausage, Pug and Husky. Evolve your pups into guardian forms like Samurai Caramelo and Ice Husky.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new garden every day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going!

FEATURES
• 4 levels: Easy (6×6), Medium (7×7), Hard (8×8) and Expert (9×9)
• Unlimited puzzles
• Stats, best times and daily streaks
• Relaxing sounds and music
• Works offline
• In English, Portuguese and Spanish

Free to play with ads. A one-time purchase removes ads and unlocks unlimited hints.

Privacy: https://vonne.com.br/apps/latidoku/privacidade/

name: LaundryOS By Jest
description:
LaundryOS is the all-in-one app for laundries and dry cleaners. Owners, staff, riders and customers each get their own view in one app.
 
TAKE ORDERS IN SECONDS
• Tap your price list to build an order: per piece, per kg or per load
• Type the customer's phone and name right on the order page
• Express and same-day service, extras, discounts, coupons, rewards and wallet
• Hold an order and finish it later
• Print receipts and garment tags on a Bluetooth printer
 
TRACK EVERY GARMENT
• Every item gets a tag with a QR code
• Scan to move a piece to its next stage, or keep scanning in station mode
• Workboard: drag orders from Received to Washing, Ironing and Ready
• Set up your own stages to match how your laundry works
• Customers get a text message as their order moves
 
GET PAID FOR YOUR SERVICE
• Cash, mobile money and card, and split payments
• Unpaid orders, deposits and balances in one place
• Close the day: cash counted against what the system expects
• Expenses, rider cash and simple reports
 
PICKUPS AND DELIVERIES
• Riders see their stops in the best order
• Live location while on a run
• Call or WhatsApp the customer, open directions, mark it done
 
FOR YOUR CUSTOMERS
• Find laundries nearby and see their prices
• Book a pickup where the laundry offers it
• Follow each order from Received to Ready
• Pay the laundry for the cleaning and ask for delivery
 
RUN THE BUSINESS
• Today's money, orders and pieces at a glance, by day, week or month
• Team accounts with roles: owner, manager, staff and rider
• Clock in and out, machines, supplies and unclaimed items
• Sign in with a password or a code sent by text
 
WORKS OFFLINE
Lost the internet? Keep taking orders and payments. LaundryOS sends them when you are back online.
 
A LaundryOS account for your laundry is needed to sign in as staff. Customers can browse nearby laundries without an account.

name: LayerCalm
description:
Stop guessing at the bathroom mirror. LayerCalm helps you organize the skincare actives on your shelf, check ingredient compatibility in seconds, and build a gentle AM/PM and 7-day skin-cycling routine — 100% offline and private on your device.

INSTANT SKINCARE SHELF GUARD
Tap the products you already own — Retinol, Glycolic Acid (AHA), Salicylic Acid (BHA), Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic), Benzoyl Peroxide, Niacinamide, Azelaic Acid, Ceramides, Peptides, and Broad-Spectrum SPF — to see immediate, plain-English layering guidance:
• Red — Do Not Layer Together: Spots combinations like Retinol + AHA/BHA, Retinol + Benzoyl Peroxide, Vitamin C + Benzoyl Peroxide, or stacked AHA + BHA peels.
• Amber — Space Out: Separates complementary low-pH or alternating actives cleanly into morning vs. evening windows.
• Green — Pairs Well: Highlights barrier-supportive duos like Vitamin C + SPF, Retinol + Ceramides, and Azelaic Acid + Niacinamide.

AUTO-SPACED AM / PM & 7-DAY SKIN CYCLING
LayerCalm turns your active shelf into a conflict-free daily morning routine and a repeating Monday–Sunday evening skin-cycling schedule with built-in recovery nights. Export your plan locally as a Calendar (.ics) file or Markdown summary anytime.

ROUTINE SAFETY GUARDS
• Sensitive Barrier Rest Mode: Temporarily pauses exfoliating acids, retinoids, Vitamin C, and benzoyl peroxide while focusing on lipid-rich moisture support.
• Expecting & Nursing Mindful Mode: Sets aside Retinol and leave-on Salicylic Acid and highlights gentle cosmetic alternatives to review with your healthcare provider.

INCLUSIVE FITZPATRICK I–VI TONE CALIBRATION
Choose your tone preset across Fitzpatrick I–VI to view Individual Typology Angle (ITA°) guidance, tailored zero-white-cast sheer or iron-oxide SPF tips for deeper complexions, and subtle comfort-sensitivity check-ins.

4 / 8 / 12-WEEK BARRIER CHECK-IN JOURNAL
Log how hydrated, calm, smooth, and radiant your skin feels at Day 0, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12. Everything stays strictly on your device with local-only JSON export and automatic note scrubbing for accidental emails, phone numbers, or location tags.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• 100% Offline (Data Not Collected) — works in airplane mode, zero accounts, zero tracking, zero ads.

Cosmetic skincare ingredient compatibility and routine planning for everyday wellness — not medical advice. Consult a board-certified dermatologist for persistent skin concerns or changing pigmented spots.

name: Le Logis Breton
description: Bienvenue dans votre espace client, dédié au suivi de votre projet immobilier. Retrouvez toutes les informations, les documents et les étapes clés de votre acquisition, de la réservation jusqu’à la livraison de votre logement.

name: Learn Python Bangla
description: Learn Python in Bangla, step by step. This app gives you 9 modules and 75 lessons with clear explanations and code examples. Test yourself with quizzes after every lesson and a final quiz for each module. Track your progress and daily streak, bookmark lessons, search topics, and learn offline in light or dark mode.

name: Learn Tagalog Fast for Kids
description:
Learn Tagalog Fast for Kids helps children and teens talk with Lola, Lolo and the rest of the family in Tagalog.

Two ways to start:
• From the basics: greetings, po, food and family, in a natural Filipino voice.
• Speak it: for kids who understand Tagalog but can't speak it yet. They build real sentences from word tiles, and gentle hints catch the usual mistakes, like sa or ng, done or later, and the little joining words.

Each lesson takes about five minutes. New phrases come with a picture and a voice, then the child matches, builds and chats with a family member. Lessons take turns with Lola, Lolo, Tita, Tito, Mama and Papa.

Respect from the start: everything said to a grown-up includes po, and they learn when it isn't needed, with cousins and friends.

No lives to lose: a wrong answer is simply tried again. Stars for getting it right first time, stickers to collect and a streak.

For parents: the week at a glance, phrases to use at home, a daily time limit and an option to turn off the English. Teens setting it up for themselves get the same settings.

No ads. Nothing to buy. No account. Progress stays on the device.

From the makers of Learn Tagalog Fast.

name: Learnovae
description:
Learnovae is a playful notebook for the words you're learning. Keep one notebook per language, collect vocabulary in your own words, and play through a short daily session that brings every word back just before you'd forget it.

OPEN AND START
No account, no sign-up, no internet needed. Learnovae opens straight into your notebooks and everything stays on your iPhone.

A NOTEBOOK FOR EVERY LANGUAGE
• Switch languages with the round bubbles at the top
• Each word holds its meaning, part of speech, gender, category, notes and example sentences with translations
• Organise words into categories and star the ones that need extra love
• Search, filter by status, category or part of speech, and sort A–Z, newest, due soonest or weakest

HEAR IT, SAY IT
• Hear words and example sentences spoken with the voices installed on your iPhone, at normal or slow speed
• Record your own pronunciation (up to 15 seconds) and compare — recordings stay on your iPhone

TODAY'S SESSION
• One big Play button starts today's mix of due reviews and new words
• Flashcards that flip in 3D — swipe right if you knew it, left to see it again, or grade Again / Hard / Good / Easy
• Multiple choice and typing practice, with forgiving accent and typo checks (or strict mode)
• Quick practice for weak words, starred words or a single category

SPACED REPETITION
Every answer updates an SM-2-style schedule: correct answers push a word further out (1 day, 6 days, then growing intervals), mistakes bring it back tomorrow. Each grade button shows exactly when you'll see the card next.

GOALS AND PROGRESS
• Daily goal ring per language and a day streak
• 14-day activity chart and accuracy trend — tap any day to inspect it
• Mastery breakdown (New, Learning, Familiar, Mastered), progress by category and session history
• 7-day review forecast on the Review desk

REMINDERS
Turn on a daily local reminder at the time that suits you.

YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE
• Full backup to a single file (optionally with recordings), import with Replace or Merge
• Automatic daily recovery snapshots, plus snapshots before every import or clear
• Export words or review history as CSV and a progress report as PDF
• Clear everything at any time

Learnovae starts with sample Spanish, French and Japanese notebooks so you can try every feature — clear them with one tap when you're ready to begin your own.

Light and Dark appearance, Dynamic Type support and VoiceOver labels throughout.

name: Leaving Cert French 2027

Leaving Cert French Questions and Answers – Higher Level Flashcard Notes

10 years of past paper topics in your pocket. This app is based on what you need to know for Leaving Cert French Higher Level. Containing exam-focused questions covering the key topics, vocabulary and language skills you should know for the Leaving Cert French exam.

Flashcard design to help you test yourself on the go, anytime, anywhere.

The answers contain key French vocabulary, essential phrases, grammar rules, verb conjugations and useful expressions you need to know to achieve good marks in your Leaving Cert.

Everything you need to prepare for your best possible result in Leaving Cert French Higher Level.

The app is divided into the various sections of the Leaving Cert French syllabus, making it easy to revise individual topics, build your vocabulary, practise grammar, improve your written French and build confidence ahead of your exams.

name: Leaving Cert German 2027
description:
Leaving Cert German – Higher Level Questions, Answers & Flashcard Revision Notes

Get exam-ready with focused Leaving Cert German revision, all in one app. Covering 10 years of past paper topics, this app is designed to help you master the vocabulary, grammar and language skills needed to succeed in your Higher Level German exam.

Learn smarter with flashcards. Test yourself anytime, anywhere, strengthen your knowledge and track your progress as you prepare for your exams.

Everything you need to revise, practise and build confidence for Leaving Cert German Higher Level.

name: Led Live Banners
description:
Led Live Banners turns your phone into a bright scrolling LED sign for concerts, parties, sports games, airport pickups, events and live streams. Type your message, choose a style and hold up the screen.

Every feature is free to use. There is no subscription, no ads, no watermark and no sign-in, and the app works offline.

CREATE YOUR SIGN
• Any text in any language, with emoji
• 9 fonts, solid color, gradient or animated rainbow, outline and shadow
• Scroll left, right, up or down, or keep the text still, at the speed you want
• LED dot matrix with round, square or heart dots, adjustable size and spacing, and a neon glow
• Background in a solid color, a gradient or a photo from your gallery, plus animated neon frames
• Blink effect up to 3 times per second, with a photosensitivity warning
• Background music from your own audio files, played on a loop

SHOW IT
• Full screen in landscape or portrait
• Maximum brightness and the screen kept on while your sign is showing
• Touch lock against accidental taps: press and hold to unlock
• Mirror mode: read the sign in a reflection, for example on a car windshield

MORE
• Library with favorites and 12 ready-made templates: birthday, airport pickup with a name, search sign, team cheer, concert, song request, marriage proposal, New Year, party, live stream, thank you and open
• Playlists that show several signs in a row, each for as long as you choose
• Export your sign as an MP4 video or a GIF, created on your device, and share it anywhere
• Rhythm mode: the sign pulses to the beat of the music around you, using the microphone in real time

PRIVACY
Led Live Banners does not collect any data and nothing leaves your device. The microphone is used only if you turn on rhythm mode: it measures the sound level and never records it. Photos and music are chosen with the system picker and stay in the app.

name: Lên Khung - Khung ảnh đẹp

description:
Lên Khung giúp bạn đưa ảnh của mình lên khung đẹp trong vài giây: ảnh đại diện mừng sinh nhật, tri ân thầy cô 20/11, tốt nghiệp, cưới hỏi, Tết, cổ vũ thể thao, hưởng ứng chiến dịch của trường, công ty.

GHÉP ẢNH NGAY TRÊN MÁY
Chọn khung, chọn ảnh từ thư viện hoặc chụp mới. Kéo để đặt vị trí, hai ngón để phóng to và xoay, lật ảnh, đổi đen trắng. Ảnh của bạn được ghép ngay trên điện thoại, không gửi lên đâu cả.

LƯU VÀ CHIA SẺ
Một chạm lưu vào thư viện Ảnh, hoặc mở bảng chia sẻ để gửi qua Zalo, Messenger, Facebook kèm đường dẫn mời bạn bè cùng lên khung.

DÙNG ĐƯỢC KHI KHÔNG CÓ MẠNG
Khung nào đã mở đều tự cất trên máy, vào mục Đã lưu là lên khung được cả khi mất sóng.

THƯ VIỆN HƠN 800 KHUNG
Chia theo dịp: ngày lễ trong năm, sinh nhật, tốt nghiệp – trường học, tri ân thầy cô, cưới – tình yêu, em bé – gia đình, Tết, thể thao, doanh nghiệp, hưởng ứng chiến dịch. Khung mới được thêm thường xuyên.

KHUNG RIÊNG CHO LỚP, CÔNG TY, SỰ KIỆN
Mục Tạo khung nối sang Ghép Khung: thiết kế khung có chữ tiếng Việt chuẩn hoặc khoét vùng ảnh từ banner có sẵn. Xong là có đường dẫn để mọi người cùng lên khung — bấm đường dẫn trên Zalo, Facebook là mở thẳng ứng dụng.

Lên khung và tạo khung đều miễn phí. Khung do người dùng tạo có nút Báo cáo; xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

name: Letterday: Daily Letter
description:
10:30 p.m. You're already in bed, and there's a letter waiting.

"You took three photos of the sky today. The one at 5:08 was nine minutes before sunset."

The photos you took, how far you walked, when the sun went down, what the weather did. Your pocket-sized friend turns that into a short letter to you. Once a day, at a time you pick. You don't write anything.

It's signed "Your pocket-sized friend." You can rename the sender. A hedgehog mail carrier brings it.

A hello letter comes right after setup: "Hi, nice to meet you. Starting today, I'll write to you." That first one is always free to read.

WHEN IT ARRIVES
Pick dawn, morning, midday, or night. A morning letter looks back on yesterday. A night letter covers the whole day. The time you pick also changes the colors and drawings across the app. In winter there are mandarins and snow, and the hedgehog wears a scarf.

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN
- Widgets are free for everyone.
- The small one has the hedgehog and the mailbox. It says "Your letter comes at 7:30 AM," and then "A letter came."
- The medium one shows the letter's photo and its first line. There's a Lock Screen widget too. Tap any of them to open the letter.

FREE AND PAID
- A new letter comes every day, free. That doesn't end.
- Today's letter is always yours to read in full. Saving it as an image and sharing it is free too.
- Past letters keep their date and photo in the letter box and the calendar. The calendar is free too.
- A one-time purchase (not a subscription) adds two things: read every past letter again, and save or share past letters as images.
- Nothing is ever deleted.

IT STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
- No account. No server.
- Your photos, steps, sleep, and replies never leave your iPhone.
- For the weather, only an approximate location (about 10 km) is sent to Apple Weather.
- No tracking. No analytics.
- The on-device AI only smooths the wording. It's blocked from writing anything that isn't in the day's material.
- Allow only what you want. Even with no permissions, you still get a letter about the weather.

JUST FOR YOU
No mood check-ins, no chat. You never have to reply. On days you want to, tap "Thank you" or "See you next time" at the end of the letter, or jot one line on the back. Replies stay on your iPhone and are never sent anywhere. Once you've read a letter, it folds into the letter box on your Home screen. The letter is just for you. On a day you want to show someone, you can save it as an image and share it. Only when you choose to.

name: Lịch Vạn Niên – Lịch Âm Dương
description:
Lịch Vạn Niên đưa tờ lịch truyền thống lên điện thoại: mở ra là thấy ngày dương, ngày âm, can chi và giờ hoàng đạo hôm nay.

TỜ LỊCH MỖI NGÀY
• 5 kiểu tờ lịch: lịch bloc, lịch vạn sự, tối giản, kính, thủy mặc — vuốt để lật ngày.
• Ngày âm, can chi ngày/tháng/năm, tiết khí, Trực, 12 canh giờ với giờ hoàng đạo/hắc đạo.
• Lễ, Tết Việt Nam và các ngày nghỉ theo luật; ngày lễ truyền thống tính theo âm lịch.

LỊCH THÁNG VÀ NĂM
• Lưới tháng hiện cả dương lịch và âm lịch, ngày lễ, ngày nghỉ, tiết khí.
• Chọn ngày theo dương lịch hoặc âm lịch (kể cả tháng nhuận), xem cả năm trên một trang.
• Dữ liệu âm–dương 1900–2100, đối chiếu với nguồn công bố.

VIỆC VÀ LỜI NHẮC
• Thêm việc trong vài giây; lặp hằng năm theo dương lịch hoặc âm lịch (giỗ, sinh nhật âm), hằng tháng (mùng 1, rằm).
• Nhắc đúng giờ ngay trên máy, kể cả khi không có mạng; xử lý đúng múi giờ và giờ mùa hè.
• Kế hoạch theo chặng cho đám cưới, tân gia, khai trương: đếm ngược và danh sách việc.
• Xuất lịch ra tệp .ics.

THÔNG BÁO THÔNG MINH
• Lời chào buổi sáng: ngày âm, giờ hoàng đạo, việc hôm nay.
• Trước ngày lễ (Tết, Valentine, 8/3, Trung thu, 20/10, Noel…): gợi ý gửi lời chúc, lên lịch hẹn hò, họp mặt gia đình, cà phê cùng bạn bè.
• Mùng 1, Rằm và gợi ý cuối tuần. Tối đa 1 thông báo/ngày, tắt từng loại tùy ý.

WIDGET
• Widget nhỏ, vừa và lịch tháng lớn trên màn hình chính, theo tông màu của app.

KHÁM PHÁ
• Lễ, Tết trong năm · Soạn lời chúc, chia buồn theo dịp · Xem hướng bằng la bàn.

LỊCH THEO VÙNG, 10 NGÔN NGỮ
• Tiếng Việt, English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, 日本語, ไทย, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Монгол.
• Âm lịch Việt Nam, Trung Hoa, Hàn Quốc, Nhật Bản; âm lịch Thái + Phật lịch, Hijri, lịch Mông Cổ và các dòng lịch phụ.

GIAO DIỆN
• 7 tông màu và 5 giao diện hợp mệnh, chế độ sáng/tối, cỡ chữ lớn, hỗ trợ VoiceOver/TalkBack.

Lưu ý: nội dung giờ hoàng đạo, ngày tốt/xấu là tham khảo văn hóa dân gian.
Ứng dụng có quảng cáo. Lịch, lời nhắc hoạt động đầy đủ mà không cần đăng nhập.

name: LifeBook: Sổ tay cuộc sống
seller_name: GREEN TECHNOLOGY GROUP JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
LifeBook là cuốn sổ tay cho cả cuộc sống của bạn: ghi chú, công việc, nhắc nhở, nhật ký, ký ức, tài liệu và thói quen — gọn trong một ứng dụng, chạy mượt và riêng tư ngay trên iPhone.

GHI LẠI MỌI THỨ TRONG MỘT CHẠM
• Ghi chú văn bản, ảnh, tài liệu và ghi âm giọng nói — tự chép lời ngay trên máy
• Quét tài liệu, nhận dạng chữ (OCR) để tìm lại nội dung trong ảnh
• Ghi nhanh từ widget, Siri, Trung tâm điều khiển hoặc nút Chia sẻ ở mọi ứng dụng
• Ảnh và tệp được sao chép vào LifeBook — xoá ở app Ảnh hay Tệp cũng không mất

KHÔNG BỎ LỠ NGÀY QUAN TRỌNG
• Nhắc nhở một lần, hằng ngày, hằng tuần, hằng tháng, hằng năm
• Nhắc theo ÂM LỊCH: sinh nhật, ngày giỗ, lễ Tết

• Lịch tháng/tuần gộp công việc, nhắc nhở và sự kiện trong app Lịch

SỐNG CÓ MỤC TIÊU
• Mục tiêu với tiến độ rõ ràng, chia nhỏ thành việc cần làm
• Theo dõi thói quen, chuỗi ngày liên tiếp, nhắc mỗi ngày

KIẾN THỨC & CÔNG CỤ
• Bộ sưu tập, liên kết ghi chú [[như wiki]], thẻ ôn tập ghi nhớ

WIDGET ĐẸP, TIỆN
