8 NGÔN NGỮ
Tiếng Việt, English, 中文, Русский, 日本語, 한국어, ไทย, Español.

LifeBook miễn phí và có quảng cáo nhỏ, không làm gián đoạn khi bạn đang ghi chép.
Góp ý, báo lỗi: Zalo 0901 328 089 (ngay trong mục Cài đặt → Hỗ trợ & góp ý).

name: Light Map: Louisiana Lights
description:
Light Map is a community map of the best Christmas light displays across Louisiana, from New Orleans and Metairie to the Northshore and Baton Rouge. It's made for everyone who loves a night out to see the lights: families, couples, grandparents and friends.

FIND LIGHTS NEAR YOU
Search by town, ZIP code or address, or use your location. Every display shows up on the map with hours, photos and visitor tips.

SEE WHAT'S WORTH THE DRIVE
Filter for what you love: shows synced to music, drive-by friendly spots, walk-throughs, inflatables, classic white lights, Santa visits and more. Find free public displays and ticketed holiday events too.

READY-MADE ROUTES
Not sure where to start? Pick a featured route like Best Overall, Best of Metairie, Music Light Shows or Stay in the Car, already in an efficient driving order.

PLAN YOUR LIGHT TOUR
Save up to 10 stops, tap Fastest Order for the shortest drive, and open your tour in Apple Maps or Google Maps with one tap. Share your tour with family and friends.

PEOPLE'S CHOICE AWARDS
Vote for your favorite home, street, public display and holiday event, and watch the leaderboard all season.

SHARE THE GLOW
Spot a great house that's missing? Add it in seconds, with a photo. Every submission is reviewed before it goes on the map. Loved a display? Send the owners a twinkle.

FOR HOMEOWNERS
Print a free Light Map yard sign with a QR code so visitors can twinkle, vote and share your display.

BE A GOOD NEIGHBOR
Light Map only lists displays you can enjoy from the street. Homeowners can ask to be removed at any time.

Free, no account needed, no ads. Made in New Orleans by Shelby Lopinto (@shelbylopinto).

name: Limitless: Unlimited Storage
description:
Limitless backs up your photos and videos to your own Telegram account, so your
whole library is safe in the cloud without paying for storage.

Sign in with your Telegram account and Limitless keeps your backups in a private
channel that only you can see. Telegram has no total storage limit, so neither
does your backup.

• One gallery for everything: the photos on your phone and the ones already
  backed up, side by side, with what still needs backing up clearly marked.
• Back up now, or turn on Automatic Backup and new photos go up on their own.
• Albums and Memories to find your moments again.
• A Recycle Bin that keeps deleted items for 30 days, so nothing is lost by mistake.
• Light and dark themes.

Your photos go from your phone straight to your Telegram account. Limitless has
no servers of its own that store them.

Limitless is an independent app. It is not made by or affiliated with Telegram;
it works with the Telegram account you already have.

name: Lingua Latina (f3db75)
description:
What's in it:

Today: your streak, a featured story at your level, flashcards due, the next grammar drill, a word of the day you can hear and save, and a Continue list.

Read: 10 illustrated stories across all six levels. Beginner and elementary ones are written for the app; the harder ones are real texts: Caesar, Catullus 5, Cicero against Catiline, the opening of Vergil's Aeneid, Lucretius and Augustine.

Story reader: a slider sets how much help you get:

Full: the English meaning under every word, plus a translation of each sentence.
Gloss: the English meaning under every word.
Hints: the dictionary form under each word instead of its meaning.
Pure Latin: no help at all.
Tap any word to see its full grammar, hear it, and add it to your deck.

Words: your deck with search, a core word list for every level, and declension and conjugation tables.

Flashcards: tap to flip, swipe or grade Again / Hard / Good / Easy. Cards you know come back less often.

name: LingUp Stories: Read English
description:
Learn English by reading real books at your level, and by listening to them.

LingUp Stories retells 29 classic stories at A2, B1 and B2, next to the original text, so you can read a whole book in English and understand it. Tap any word to see what it means in your own language, hold a sentence to translate it, and listen to every sentence read aloud.

READ AT YOUR LEVEL
- 29 classics: The Gift of the Magi, Pride and Prejudice, Sherlock Holmes, Dracula, The Secret Garden, Alice in Wonderland, A Christmas Carol, Treasure Island and more
- Every book at A2, B1 and B2, plus the original text
- Move up a level inside the same book when you are ready

UNDERSTAND EVERY PAGE
- Tap a word for its meaning in your language, with US and UK pronunciation
- Hold a sentence to translate it
- Read the book alone, or each page with its translation below
- Or take it one sentence at a time

EVERY BOOK IS AN AUDIOBOOK TOO
- Every sentence read aloud, in a US or UK voice, at the speed you choose
- The sentence being read lights up, so you can follow along

REMEMBER WHAT YOU READ
- A quick check after every chapter
- Words you tap come back for a short review until they stick

A DAILY HABIT
- Choose how many minutes to read each day
- One reminder a day, at the time you pick
- On iPhone and iPad

Chapter 1 of every book is free. Stories Pro opens every chapter of every book at every level and lets you download books to read offline: yearly with a 3-day free trial, or monthly.

Terms of use: https://stories.lingup.academy/terms/
Privacy: https://stories.lingup.academy/privacy/

name: LinkIo: Link in Bio
description:
LinkIo gives you one link for everything you make. Share a single page with your portfolio, shop, videos, newsletter and socials, and manage it all from your phone.

MANAGE YOUR LINKS
Add, edit, hide and reorder links in seconds. Changes go live on your public page right away.

SEE WHO CLICKS
Track clicks and unique visitors over time. See your top links, where visitors come from, and which devices and countries they use.

YOUR PAGE, YOUR NAME
Claim linkio.site/yourname, add a photo and bio, and share one link in every bio.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Use email, Google or Sign in with Apple. Your account works the same on the web at linkio.site.

name: Liste HQ
description:
Liste puts your agency's workspace on your iPhone and iPad. See your day at a glance, act on whatever is waiting for you and keep every relationship warm, wherever the work takes you.

Your day, ready when you are
- Today: how many jobs are on, meetings to log, options about to lapse, your tasks and what the team has been doing
- The bell: mentions, approvals and anything waiting on you, in one place
- Home screen widgets for your next job, your next meeting and what is waiting

Contacts that stay warm
- Every contact and company, with how warm the relationship is and why
- Call, message, email or get directions in one tap
- Add someone in seconds: paste an email signature or scan a business card
- After each meeting, log it in a few taps and rate the venue

Places
- A map of your clients, venues and the team's favourite meeting spots
- Ratings and notes from your colleagues, and Near me when you travel

For artist agencies
- Bookings and options in a diary, with call times in each job's own time zone
- Every job in full: dates, people, location and the team's notes
- Shoot day: the call sheet offline, the crew a tap away and the weather on set
- Scan a receipt onto the job's costs, or a signed release into its folder
- Upcoming Work, RSVP pages with swipe to decide replies, and check-in at the door

For PR agencies
- Time: run a timer from Today
- Campaigns and coverage, with press clippings scanned straight onto the campaign
- Events: guest lists, door check-in that works without a signal, and the seating plan on iPad
- Gifting: stock, seeding and courier tracking with the barcode scanner

On iPad
- A sidebar with every part of Liste, jobs and contacts side by side, and analytics for your pipeline, workload, meetings and venues

Your workspace decides what is switched on, and you choose what sits in your tab bar. Text follows your iPhone's text size.

Requires a Liste workspace. Find out more at listehq.com.

name: Listing AI: Virtual Staging
description:
Listing marketing done in 60 seconds.

Listing AI writes your listing copy and virtually stages empty rooms. Enter the home's details, add a few photos, and get everything you need to market a new listing. Built by Winslow Homes Publishing for real estate agents.

WRITE MY LISTING
- MLS description, ready to paste, plus a 250 character version
- Listing headline and feature bullets
- Facebook, Instagram (with hashtags) and LinkedIn posts
- Just Listed text for your buyer list
- Open house post
- 45 second video walkthrough script
- Reads your listing photos to describe what buyers will see
- Fair housing safe: describes the property, never the people
- Choose a tone: Professional, Luxury, Warm, Investor or First-time buyer

VIRTUAL STAGING
- Turn an empty room photo into a furnished room in seconds
- 8 styles: Modern, Coastal, Farmhouse, Luxury, Mid-century, Scandinavian, Traditional and Industrial
- Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, dining rooms, offices, patios and more
- Optional: remove old furniture first
- Saved photos are labeled "Virtually Staged" to follow MLS rules
- Before and after view, save to Photos or share

EVERY PROJECT SAVED
Every listing and staged photo is saved in Projects so you can copy or share it again.

FREE TO START
Write 2 listings and stage 2 rooms free. Go unlimited with a subscription.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
- Monthly: $24.99
- 3 months: $59.99
- 6 months: $99.99
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

AI output can contain mistakes. Check every fact before you publish and follow your MLS rules for virtually staged photos.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.winslowhomesllc.com/pages/exam-prep-app-privacy

name: LIT - Lost In Translation
description:
LIT – Lost In Translation – helps you understand videos in a language you don't speak well: tutorials, demos, DIY, talks…

LIT listens to the voice in the video, transcribes it, translates it and reads the translation aloud with a synthetic voice, ideally in your AirPods. The original sound is lowered under the translated voice, and the video is slightly delayed so that picture and translation stay in sync.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Pick a video from Photos or Files
• Follow the transcription and translation sentence by sentence
• Go full screen with the translation as subtitles
• Save the original text and its translation

ON MAC
• Translate the sound of your other apps: a video in Safari, Chrome…
• Or play a YouTube video or a video file in the LIT window
• Adjust the original volume, choose a male or female voice
• Export transcription and translation as text
• Find your sessions in the history

LIT is designed for videos with a single speaker. For a film with several characters, one voice would read every line – it would sound like amateur dubbing!

The translation isn't perfect, but it is more than enough to get the meaning. That's what LIT is all about.

Free, no subscription.

name: Little Crate – Your Music
description:
Little Crate turns your Apple Music into a small corner for music: every song is a vinyl record, every playlist a sleeve in your collection.

LISTEN LIKE YOU'RE SPINNING A RECORD
• A Now Playing screen with a spinning record, tonearm and a waveform you can scrub
• A mini player that follows you everywhere
• Sleep timer

DISCOVER SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• Mixes made for you on Apple Music
• Picks for every mood: Relax, Focus, Happy, Sleep, Night chill…
• Radio stations around artists you love
• New releases, charts and music by decade

YOUR LIBRARY
• Browse and play your Apple Music library and playlists
• Create playlists and add songs to your library
• See your weekly listening time and your most-played artists

Requires an active Apple Music subscription.

Need help? Contact contact@stevetran.work

Apple and Apple Music are trademarks of Apple Inc.

name: Live Pooja
description:
Every other puja app does the puja for you. This one doesn't.

Live Pooja puts you in front of the deity and hands you the ritual. You pour the abhishek over the Shivling and watch the water run down the stone and gather in the basin. You scatter bel patra and flowers, and they fall, slide off the dome and come to rest where they would really lie. You drape the garland over Ganesha's shoulders, a real rope of marigolds that hangs the way a garland hangs. You circle the aarti flame seven times, clockwise, and it counts them.

Feel every bell. Each ring of the temple bell, each turn of the aarti and each offering you complete is felt in your hand through the iPhone's haptics.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Mahadev: pour the abhishek, offer bel patra, scatter flowers, circle the aarti
• Shree Ganesh: drape the marigold garland, light an agarbatti, offer the aarti
• Maa Durga: drape the red chunri, lay red hibiscus at her feet
• Shree Hanuman: smear the sindoor chola, offer a tulsi mala
• Maa Lakshmi: float lotus on the urli, offer batasha
• Bal Gopal: swing the jhula, offer makhan and a tulsi mala
• Maa Saraswati: offer the tilak and a jasmine mala
• Murugan: pour the milk abhishek, offer vibhuti

The sanctum has real depth: tilt your phone and the room moves around the murti while the deity holds still.

A DAILY PRACTICE

• Daily reminder at the time you choose. Each day of the week is kept for a deity (Somvar for Shiva, Shukravar for Lakshmi, Shanivar for Hanuman), so the reminder names that day's deity and opens their sanctum.
• Your streak: see how many days in a row you have offered your pooja, your best run and your week at a glance.
• Share your darshan with family when a pooja is complete.

WHAT IT RESPECTS

The offerings differ by deity because they differ in life. Tulsi is never offered to Shiva or Ganesha, and the app will not let you. Bel patra belongs to Mahadev. Red hibiscus belongs to Devi and Hanuman.

WHAT IT DOESN'T DO

No account. No sign-in. No advertising. No tracking. Your streak stays on your iPhone, and the whole app works without a connection.

Free, and free of the things that usually come with free.

name: LivePL
description:
LivePL to przeglądarka firmy Live Production. Programy firmy, otwarte karty i Twoje strony masz w jednym miejscu, tak jak w LivePL na komputerze.

START
• Programy firmy jednym stuknięciem: Poczta, Live Production, TVML i więcej.
• Pole „Adres albo szukaj”: wpisz adres strony albo to, czego szukasz.
• Moje strony: dodaj dowolne strony, a pojawią się na ekranie Start.

KARTY I PASEK
• Każdy program ma własną kartę, która pamięta, gdzie skończyłeś.
• Dolny pasek z ikonami programów i licznikiem kart.
• Karty wracają po ponownym uruchomieniu.

TŁUMACZ STRON
• Strony w obcych językach przetłumaczysz na polski jednym stuknięciem.
• Tłumaczy telefon (Apple Translation), więc tekst stron nie trafia do nikogo.
• „Pokaż oryginał” przywraca stronę.

BEZPIECZEŃSTWO
• Aplikacja zna certyfikaty urzędu LivePL dla stron firmy, niczego nie trzeba instalować.
• Telefon rejestruje się w urzędzie LivePL kluczem w Secure Enclave, którego nie da się skopiować.
• Bez reklam i bez śledzenia.

WYGODA
• Tryb dzień, noc albo automatycznie, jak telefon.
• Pobieranie plików, udostępnianie, znajdź na stronie, otwórz w Safari.
• Logowanie do poczty firmowej trzyma 90 dni.

Poczta firmowa jest też w osobnej aplikacji Poczta LivePL.

name: LivePL Connect
description:
LivePL Connect to zdalny pulpit Live Production. Z iPhone'a albo iPada połączysz się z komputerem, na którym działa program LivePL Connect: widzisz jego ekran i sterujesz nim jak na miejscu.

POŁĄCZENIE
• Wpisz ID i hasło, które pokazuje program LivePL Connect na tamtym komputerze, albo jego stałe hasło.
• Ostatnie połączenia masz pod ręką na ekranie startowym.
• Obraz i sterowanie płyną bezpośrednio między urządzeniami, szyfrowane (WebRTC, DTLS). Serwer LivePL tylko kojarzy urządzenia po ID.

STEROWANIE
• Tryb dotyku: stuknięcie to kliknięcie, przytrzymanie to prawy przycisk, przesunięcie jednym palcem przewija, dwa palce powiększają.
• Tryb myszy: ekran działa jak touchpad laptopa, wygodny przy drobnych elementach.
• Pisanie klawiaturą telefonu i pasek klawiszy: Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win, Esc, Tab, strzałki i F1–F12.
• „Dopasuj” pokazuje cały ekran komputera.

WYGODA
• Pełny ekran, w pionie i w poziomie.
• Telefon nie gaśnie w trakcie połączenia.
• Wibracja potwierdza przytrzymanie palca.
• Tryb dzień i noc, jak w telefonie.

BEZPIECZEŃSTWO
• Każde połączenie wymaga hasła z komputera, z którym się łączysz.
• Telefon rejestruje się w urzędzie LivePL kluczem w Secure Enclave, którego nie da się skopiować.
• Bez reklam i bez śledzenia.

Program LivePL Connect na komputer z Windows pobierzesz z app.livepl.eu.

name: LL Test Maharashtra: RTO Exam
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent the Motor Vehicle Department of Maharashtra, the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, Parivahan/Sarathi or any other government body. The questions come from the Learner Licence Test Question Bank of the Motor Vehicle Department, Government of Maharashtra: https://transport.maharashtra.gov.in/1162/Learning-License-Test-Question-Bank

Prepare for the learner's licence (LL) test at the RTO in Maharashtra with the state's own question bank, in English and Marathi.

ALL QUESTIONS OF THE STATE BANK
• 426 questions with correct answers
• 113 road signs: mandatory, cautionary and informatory
• 4 topics: road signs, rules of the road, safe driving and emergencies, law and documents

MOCK TEST LIKE THE REAL ONE
• 15 questions, 9 correct answers to pass
• Skip a question and come back to it
• Review your mistakes right after the test

ENGLISH AND MARATHI
• Every question in both languages, from the department's own files
• Switch the language with one tap or see the English next to the Marathi

LEARN WITHOUT STRESS
• Questions you get wrong come back until they stick
• "Hard for you" — the questions you mix up most
• Search — find a question by a word or number and see the answer at once

WORKS OFFLINE
• Everything is on your phone, no internet needed

Free: 10 questions in every topic and one mock test a day. Full access is a one-time purchase, no subscription.

The app is for self-study and does not replace a driving school or official materials. Book your LL test on the official portal: https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/

name: LMPadel
description:
Une application très complète, qui va vous permettre de :
- Réserver dans votre club,
- Accéder aux informations principales,
- Remplir votre Wallet avec les cartes prépayées,
- Obtenir l'information en direct,
- Suivre vos compétitions.

Et plein d'autres fonctionnalités !

name: LoadLoom
description:
Plan what goes in each bag. Add items with weight in kilograms and quantity, then mark each item packed. See total mass, packed mass and the remaining allowance against your chosen limit.

Save separate lists for trips and field kits. Search, edit and delete lists, adjust individual contents and share a text summary. Weights are estimates based on your entries; confirm the carrier’s current rules separately.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: LockPlay: Background Player
description:
LockPlay keeps your audio playing. Start a podcast, a radio stream, a lecture or a music mix on any website, then lock your phone or switch apps. The sound keeps going.

PLAY WITH YOUR SCREEN LOCKED
• Audio from web pages keeps playing in the background and with the screen off
• Play, pause and skip from the lock screen, Control Center and headphones
• Picture-in-picture for video

NO MORE ADS
• Built-in ad blocker removes ads and trackers on the sites you visit
• Pages load faster and use less data
• Allow ads on the sites you want to support, with one switch

BROWSE WHILE IT PLAYS
• Keep up to six sites open and jump between them instantly
• The player stays at the bottom of the screen wherever you go
• Shrink a video into a small bar and keep browsing

YOUR FAVORITES, ONE TAP AWAY
• A home screen of your favourite websites, laid out like apps
• Add any site, reorder or remove them
• Search with Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Bing, Yahoo or Ecosia

FALL ASLEEP TO IT
• Sleep timer from 5 minutes to 3 hours stops playback for you

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics
• Bookmarks, history and settings stay on your phone
• Private browsing: no history, and cookies are erased when you close it
• Move everything to a new phone with a one-time code

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light and dark themes, your own background photo
• Grayscale mode for a calmer, less distracting phone

LockPlay is an independent web browser and is not affiliated with any website you visit with it. Please respect the terms of the sites you use.

name: LokalBot
description:
Take your LokalBot work memory with you. The iPhone and iPad companion brings the meetings and workday information you choose to share from your Mac to your device.

• Browse meeting summaries, transcripts, notes, and action items.
• Revisit your Timeline and Day Digests, and find people and projects.
• Search your shared library on your device, even when offline.
• Ask your Mac questions about your shared work when it’s reachable.
• Record a meeting on your iPhone or iPad for your Mac to transcribe.

To use your own library, enable Phones & tablets in LokalBot on your Mac. Choose what to share, scan the one-time pairing code, and approve the connection on your Mac. The companion syncs directly over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, with end-to-end encryption.

You can explore the built-in sample library before pairing.

name: Lokführer Einstellungstest
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zur Deutschen Bahn, zu einem anderen Eisenbahnunternehmen oder zum Eisenbahn-Bundesamt.

Wer Lokführer, Fahrdienstleiter oder Fahrer bei U-Bahn, S-Bahn und Straßenbahn werden will, muss zuerst den Einstellungstest und den psychologischen Eignungstest bestehen. Mit Lokführer Einstellungstest bereitest du dich gezielt darauf vor.

Das trainierst du in der App:
- Konzentration und Aufmerksamkeit
- Logisches Denken und Rechnen
- Technisches Verständnis
- Allgemeinwissen und Deutsch
- Den psychologischen Eignungstest für den Bahnbetrieb
- Das Vorstellungsgespräch und das Assessment Center

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- Bahn Einstellungstest
- Fahrdienstleiter Vorbereitung
- Psychologischer Test im Bahnbetrieb
- U-Bahn und S-Bahn Einstellungstest
- Straßenbahnfahrer Einstellungstest
- Bahn Einstellungstest Österreich und Lokführer Österreich
- Eignungstest für Bahnberufe in der Schweiz

So lernst du mit der App:
- Tausende Übungsaufgaben mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests mit Zeitvorgabe wie im echten Auswahlverfahren
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Testtermin
- Eine Community mit anderen Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Offizielle Informationen zum Triebfahrzeugführerschein findest du beim Eisenbahn-Bundesamt: https://www.eba.bund.de

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Lolly
description:
Lolly makes finished, on-brand graphics from simple inputs.

Pick a tool, fill in a few fields and export. Each tool follows a design system of colours, fonts and logos, so what you make matches your brand without design skills. Choose one colour to start, or bring your organisation's design system.

WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
• Posters, social cards and slides in Design, with templates to start from
• Charts from a few rows of data: bars, lines, donuts, 3-D and more
• QR codes with your colours and logo
• Smooth colour gradients for backgrounds
• Voice recordings and audiograms
• Music from the built-in music generator
• Photo edits and filters in Darkroom and Filter

EXPORT WHAT YOU NEED
PNG, SVG, PDF, video and audio. Vector exports stay vector. Print sizes in millimetres or inches with real resolution.

UTILITIES FOR YOUR OWN FILES
Compress a PDF, remove hidden data before you share a file, compare two versions, and check where a file came from with Verify & Inspect. These run on your device; the file is not uploaded.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in
• No tracking and no advertising
• Making, previewing and exporting happen on your device
• Works offline once the tools are on the device
• Nothing leaves your device unless you ask, for example when you play internet radio or add a font from Google Fonts

YOUR BRAND, YOUR RULES
Start with one colour and Lolly builds a palette around it. Add your logo and fonts, or import a design system from design tokens. Every tool then uses them.

OPEN SOURCE
Lolly is open source under the MPL-2.0 licence. The same tools run on the web at lolly.tools, on the Mac and in the terminal, so a link to a design opens the same way everywhere.

No purchases, no subscription.

name: LonoText
description:
Copy on your Mac. Paste on your iPhone.

LonoText brings what you copy on your Mac to your iPhone. Copy text on your Mac, open LonoText on your iPhone, and your Mac's latest copy is on the clipboard, ready to paste.

It works with LonoText for Mac, voice typing for the Mac with a clipboard history. Get it at lonotext.com, then pair your iPhone.

Send from your iPhone in one tap
• Copy text in any app, open LonoText and tap "Send clipboard to Mac"
• Then press ⌘V on your Mac
iOS asks before LonoText reads your clipboard, and LonoText reads it only when you tap Send.

Set up in under a minute
1. On your Mac, open LonoText › Settings › Clipboard and choose Add Phone.
2. Open LonoText on your iPhone and tap "Scan the code on your Mac".
No account and no email.

Private by design
• End-to-end encrypted: LonoText's servers can't read what you copy.
• A copy waits on the server only until your iPhone or Mac picks it up, and never longer than 24 hours.
• Your Mac never sends passwords from password managers.
• Copies from your Mac stay on this iPhone: they don't go on to your other devices.

Also in the app
• Your last 20 copies, each one tap away (you can turn this off)
• Links open with one tap
• English and Arabic, light and dark

Requirements
• A Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later, with LonoText for Mac (lonotext.com)
• An iPhone with iOS 17 or later
• Text only for now, up to 100 KB per copy

name: LoomBids
description:
LoomBids helps you buy cars at auction with your eyes open. Before you bid, see what the car will really cost you: auction fees, transport to your address, the repairs it needs and the profit left at the end.

SEARCH LOTS YOUR WAY
• Browse upcoming auction lots with filters for make, model, year, damage, location and sale date.
• Search in plain words, like "white SUV under 50k miles with front damage".
• Damage AI looks at the photos and marks what is damaged, so you can keep only the repairs you know how to do.

THE REAL COST, LOT BY LOT
• Total cost with the current fee table, taxes and transport quoted to your ZIP code.
• Repairs estimated part by part. Real data shows in green; estimates in orange.
• What similar cars sold for, and a suggested max bid so you know where to stop.

KEEP WORKING AFTER THE SEARCH
• Favorites: follow the cars you like with your own max, and see the result after they sell.
• Alerts: save a search and get notified when a new lot matches.
• Auto-bid settings: set your max for each car; the LoomBids agent on your computer bids for you.

WON ONE? KEEP GOING
• My purchases: follow payment, pickup, transport and title in one place.
• Plan the repair, track parts and costs, and sell the parts you do not need.
• Parts catalog: find used parts offered by other LoomBids members.

BUILT FOR HOW YOU BUY
Resellers, repair shops, exporters and personal buyers. Create a free account and start searching.

Your account works the same on the web, the Chrome extension and this app.

LoomBids is an independent tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any auction company. All trademarks belong to their owners.

Help: support@loombids.com · https://loombids.com

name: LoopCairn: Crochet Markers
description:
Your crochet pattern calls for 24 stitches. You count 24, but the round still looks uneven. An extra stitch between one pair of markers can hide a missing stitch somewhere else.

LoopCairn lets you check the fabric a span at a time. Label three to eight markers in the order you crochet, enter the expected stitches between each pair, then record the stitches you find between those markers. Begin with the stitch holding the first marker and stop before the next marker. The map shows which counts match, which differ and which still need checking.

Try the Pebble basket example. Between B and C there are five stitches where four were expected. Between D and E there are three. Recount B–C, save your observation and leave D–E selected for when you return to the project.

If a marker slips, record which one moved. The two spans sharing that marker return to unchecked and the earlier observations stay in your history. On a wide iPad, the marker map and all six example spans stay visible while you enter a new count on the keypad beside them. Save a plain-text copy to Files with the expected counts, your observations and the spans you want to check next.

Pause with your next step, a hook or pattern note, and an optional swatch photo. A paired Apple Watch shows the selected span and its last count. Use the wrist tally as you work, then confirm your observation on iPhone.

Your rounds, history and text export work offline without an account.

name: Loopy Dot Beats
description:
A music toy you play by drawing loops.

Each dot on the stage is a sound: a kick, a snare, a hi-hat, a clap, a bass note, a chord, a bell. Draw a loop around a few of them and they settle onto a circle, a hand starts sweeping round like a clock, and every dot sounds as it passes. That is a beat. Draw another loop and it plays along, in time, in tune.

- Seven sounds, all made inside the app. Nothing can clash: everything is in one key.
- Up to six loops at once, all locked to the same beat.
- Drag a dot round its loop to move it to a different beat. Pull it out to remove it. Drop a new one in.
- Align snaps everything squarely onto the beat.
- Higher on the screen is a higher note.
- Change the tempo from slow and dreamy to quick.
- Your stage is kept as you leave it.

There is nothing to win and nothing to get wrong. Children can make something that sounds good in seconds, and so can you.

No ads. No purchases. No account. Nothing is collected.

name: Loopy Party Panic
description:
One phone. Two to eight people. A fuse that nobody can see the end of.

On your turn, draw loops around dots of one colour until your count hits zero, then press PASS and hand the phone to the next player. Whoever is holding it when the fuse runs out loses a life. Last one standing wins.

- One finger and ten seconds to learn. Works for kids, grandparents and everyone between.
- The fuse is hidden. It is longer with more players and only gives itself away in the last two seconds.
- Every turn asks for something different: loops of 2 or more, 3 or more, or 4 or more.
- Be devious. Once you are free to pass, every extra loop you make adds one to what the next player owes. It costs you time, and the fuse might catch you instead.
- Special dots reverse the order, skip a player, or slow the fuse for a few seconds.
- Type in everyone's names. The game keeps track of turns and lives.
- Share the winner with the group when it is over.

No accounts, no internet, no ads and no purchases. One phone or tablet is the whole game.

name: Loopy Santa
description:
It is Christmas night, and the presents are tumbling out of Santa's bag.

Draw a loop around presents in the same wrapping and they fly back to the sleigh. Each house below is wishing for one, and when Santa passes with it on board, down the chimney it goes and the window lights up.

- One finger. Draw a loop, that is all.
- Twenty-four towns in six snowy places: a village, a pine forest, a harbor, a big city, windy mountains and the North Pole.
- Keep the coal out of your loop. And the owls, the chimney smoke, the passing plane and one very naughty elf.
- Helpers drift down: a candy-cane magnet, a snow globe that stops time, Rudolph's nose and a big sack.
- Christmas Eve mode: one endless night that keeps getting faster.
- Earn stars to hang ornaments on your tree, and unlock new sleighs and reindeer.
- Carols all the way, with sleigh bells.
- Share your night with friends.

For all ages. No ads, no purchases, no account, and it works without the internet.

name: Loopy Words
description:
Draw a line through the letters to spell a word. That is the whole game.

Every day there is one puzzle, and it is the same for everyone in the world: sixty letters, sixteen on the table at a time. Use some and new ones arrive. Longer words score much more than short ones, so the question is always whether to take the easy word now or hold out for the big one.

- One finger. Slide from letter to letter and lift.
- No clock. Take as long as you like.
- A daily leaderboard on Game Center, with the same letters for everyone.
- Three tries a day at the same letters. Your best one counts.
- Share your score and your best word.
- Free play whenever you want more: endless letters, no limits.

The first try each day is free. A second and third try are each unlocked by a video you choose to watch, or you can buy the extra tries once and never see a video. Nothing ever interrupts a game.

No account needed.

name: Lotería de Navidad y del Niño
description:
Lotería de Navidad y del Niño te ayuda a guardar, organizar y comprobar todos tus décimos de forma sencilla.

• Añade tus números y el importe jugado.
• Organiza décimos personales y compartidos.
• Comprueba automáticamente si tienen premio.
• Consulta el listado de premios y terminaciones.
• Revisa estadísticas de tus números.
• Recibe avisos cuando se publiquen nuevos premios durante el sorteo.

Tus décimos se guardan en el dispositivo. La aplicación no está afiliada a SELAE. Los resultados se ofrecen con fines informativos; comprueba siempre el décimo en los canales oficiales.

name: LoudAndHoly
description:
Here it is with no bullets, no headers, and no colons. Just plain sentences:

```
Loud & Holy turns the music on your phone into a jukebox you can walk into.

Pick your cabinet. The Classic has glowing tubes, the Coffin has a stained-glass rose window, the Amp Stack has spikes and a soul meter, and the Cathedral has neon organ pipes. Thorned vines grow down its sides and pulse on every beat, and the cover of whatever's playing sits right in the heart of the jukebox.

Two dancers move beside it while your music plays. You can switch them off any time.

Turn the DOOM knob and it pulls only the heavy records, like metal, punk, hardcore, emo and goth. Turn the HEART knob and it plays the songs you keep coming back to.

Dig through the crate and flip through your albums like a real record store, cover by cover. Pull one out, drop the needle on any song, or shuffle the whole record. Your playlists are on the next shelf over.

Can't decide what to play? Tap Her pick and she chooses. There's a song of the day picked from your library, and a tonearm that rides the groove so you can drag the needle anywhere in a song. Shuffle and repeat sit right beside the knobs. Lock your phone and the music keeps going, with the song and controls on your lock screen.

Loud & Holy plays the songs in your music library, including Apple Music songs you've added. Everything stays on your phone. No accounts, no tracking, no ads.
```

name: Lucky O’Clock - 本命時刻
description:
Stop guessing whether your phone’s clock is right when tickets go on sale.

Lucky O’Clock is a ticketing clock for fans. It syncs with internet time servers, shows tenths of a second, and floats over the ticketing page so you can watch the time while you get ready to tap.

FLOATING CLOCK
Picture in picture over any app, down to a tenth of a second, with a bar for the last 10 seconds of each minute. Change the shape to a slim strip so it never covers the buy button.

YOUR BIAS’S PHOTO AND A CHEER MESSAGE
Put your bias’s photo on one side and a background on the clock side, each with its own drag and zoom, or use one photo across the whole clock. Six color presets and a message of your own.

DYNAMIC ISLAND CLOCK
Shows the time to the second in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, with a heart, your own text or a photo.

SALE COUNTDOWNS
Save each sale time, count down, and get a notification before it starts. Pick the venue’s time zone for overseas shows.

WORLD CLOCK
See the local date and time for overseas shows at a glance.

CHOOSE YOUR TIME SOURCE
Use Apple, Google or Cloudflare internet time, checked automatically, or your iPhone’s own clock. The clock always shows which time it is using.

PRIVACY
No account. Your photos and settings stay on your iPhone.

Free with a banner ad; a one-time purchase removes ads.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 17 or later. The Dynamic Island needs an iPhone with a Dynamic Island; other models show the clock on the Lock Screen.
Not affiliated with any ticketing service, and it never buys tickets for you. Internet time still has small network delays; always follow the ticketing service’s official sale time.

name: Lucky Pig Spot
description:
Lucky Pig Spot is a river crossing with the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac.

Hop from log to log. Step left or right to meet the timber. A lotus pad sinks after you land, so leave before it closes. The current never stops. Every twelfth lane the bank returns: the shore pays coins, and the next stretch of river runs faster.

Three ways to cross: • Relaxed — slower water, wider logs, lotus that waits • Classic — the river as the race is usually told • Wild — a fast current and narrow timber, with shores that pay more

The Rat is free. The other eleven animals are unlocked only with coins you earn on the river. Each one changes the crossing: slower logs, a wider landing, a longer lotus, a quicker hop, a look at the next lane, larger shore rewards, or one save from a fall.

Open the almanac to read the twelve animals, and chase achievements from the first shore to the far bank. Coins, animals, and progress stay on this device.

No account. No ads. No purchases.

name: LUMEN 35: Analog Film Camera
description:
LUMEN 35 is an analog film camera built like real hardware: a film-stock wheel, a lens turret, machined dials and a full darkroom, all running on your iPhone.

REAL 35MM OPTICS, PURE SENSOR
• Five lenses on the turret: 35mm Prime, 50mm Anamorphic, 28mm Swirl, ¼ Soft Mist and the gyro-driven PRISM tilt-shift.
• PURE RAW skips Smart HDR and Deep Fusion for an honest, unprocessed negative.
• Seven film stocks with real halation, grain and gate weave: TUNGSTEN 500T, GOLDEN 400, HALATION 800X, SILVER 400, CHROMA 50, DREAM '74 and FLASH '98.
• Depth-aware lens falloff from LiDAR or dual-camera depth where available, with on-device depth estimation everywhere else.

CHRONO-SLIT TIME DISPLACEMENT
A glowing scan line sweeps the frame for 1.5 seconds. Everything still stays sharp, while anything that moves stretches into ribbons of time. Choose Horizontal Wave, Vertical Scan or Radial Ripple.

3D WIGGLEGRAMS
Four-lens stereo loops with real depth: the subject stays locked while the world swings around it. Export MP4 for Reels and TikTok, or a GIF.

3D GEL RELIGHTING
In the Darkroom, switch on RELIGHT and drag a glowing gel orb across any photo. Light wraps around your subject while the background falls into shadow. Four gels: Tungsten Gold, Neon Crimson, Cyber Cyan and Moonlight Silver.

8MM, 16MM & DV '03
Shoot motion picture through 8mm or 16mm film gates, or on a 2003-style DV camcorder tape with sound. Turn on PULSE and the halation bloom and anamorphic flare breathe with the music around you.

LIVING CONTACT PRINTS
With Living Prints on, every photo also keeps the two seconds before the shutter as a grainy living film strip. Press and hold a frame in the Darkroom to play it, then export a Living Reel MP4.

THE DARKROOM
• Re-develop any frame with a different stock, lens or dial setting. The clean negative is always kept.
• Export the developed print, a print with a 35mm sprocket border, the clean negative or a Living Reel.
• '98-style date stamp, film recipes, an 8× loupe and a backlit light table.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything is processed on your iPhone. Photos, depth maps, motion data and audio never leave your device. No account, no ads, no trackers.

STUDIO PASS
LUMEN 35 is free to shoot with 3 signature film stocks: TUNGSTEN 500T, SILVER 400 and FLASH '98 ('98 Disposable Nostalgia). Studio Pass adds 4 pro stocks (GOLDEN 400, HALATION 800X, CHROMA 50 and DREAM '74) and every special optical mode: four more lenses, unlimited 3D Wigglegrams and Chrono-Slit, unlimited Cine reels and the print studio.
• Studio Pass Annual: $9.99 per year, auto-renewing subscription
• Studio Pass Lifetime: $19.99, one-time purchase
Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The annual subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://staticfiles.net/0rIZynugnVi4DCbDhX9rdEaJ8N85daMvBRKsmV1gwOs/p/n/privacy.html

name: Lumen Bible Reader
description:
Lumen Bible is a calm, distraction-free Bible reader designed for unhurried daily reading. Everything lives on your device—no internet connection, no accounts, no ads, and no tracking.

THREE COMPLETE TRANSLATIONS, FULLY OFFLINE
All 66 books (1,189 chapters) are bundled right inside the app so you can read anywhere, anytime:
• World English Bible (WEB) — clear, modern English
• King James Version (KJV) — the classic 1611 cadence
• American Standard Version (ASV) — the 1901 revision

DESIGNED FOR COMFORTABLE READING
• Editorial typography set in the Lora serif typeface
• Four appearance modes: Light, Sepia, Dark, or follow your device theme
• Adjustable text size to suit your eyes and screen
• Choose between flowing Paragraph view or One verse per line for study
• Automatically remembers your last reading position and preferences

EFFORTLESS NAVIGATION
• Swipe smoothly from chapter to chapter—including straight across books
• Jump to any book and chapter in two taps from the Old & New Testament picker

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works 100% offline—does not request internet permission
• Zero analytics, zero ads, zero sign-ups, and zero data collection
• All scripture texts are public domain

Whether you are reading a chapter before bed or studying offline on the go, Lumen Bible stays quiet and gets out of the way so you can focus on Scripture.

name: Lumen Spire
description:
The ancient Prismatic Spire has fractured, casting the world into eternal twilight. As a Keeper of the Sacred Flame, you must delve into subterranean crystal caverns, mend sunken elemental monoliths, and illuminate the perilous heights of the apex.

Lumen Spire is a tactical roguelike deckbuilding RPG built from the ground up for mobile landscape play. Designed with smooth gesture controls, rich visual feedback, and deep strategic synergies, every run challenges your planning, intuition, and adaptability.

==================================
◆ TACTICAL CHAIN & RETAIN COMBAT
==================================
• Intuitive Touch Controls: Swipe smoothly across your hand to inspect cards; drag upward to play cards instantly.
• Flexible Retain Mechanic: Tap to HOLD up to 2 key cards across turns to set up devastating multi-turn combos.
• Seamless Hand Refill: Your hand refills to 5 cards at the start of each turn. Surplus draws beyond the 7-card maximum queue safely into your reserve buffer for the following turn.
• Chain Bonus System: Weave action sequences strategically:
  - Skill into Attack triggers +3 Bonus Damage.
  - Attack into Skill generates +3 Extra Block.
  - Playing your first Power card each combat refunds 1 Energy and immediately draws 1 card.
• Half-Decay Shielding: 50% of your unspent Block carries over into your next turn, turning cautious defensive turns into launchpads for massive counterattacks.

==================================
◆ TIGHT DECKBUILDING & REPLACE RULES
==================================
No bloated 40-card piles! Lumen Spire prioritizes tactical precision over random clutter:
• Start your journey with a concise 10-card starter deck.
• Build up to 15 cards through rewarding combat victories.
• Once you reach the 15-card threshold, picking any new card enters REPLACE MODE—swap out obsolete foundation cards to keep your deck sharp and consistent (Hard cap: 20 cards).

==================================
◆ THREE DISTINCT KEEPERS & TERRARIUM VIALS
==================================
Choose your champion and tailor your strategy with expandable card pools:
• EMBER: Relentless aggression. Passive grant +2 flat damage on all Attacks. Unleash flame strikes that gain raw fury when backed into a corner.
• TIDE: Resilient fluid conversion. First Skill each battle grants +3 Block. Transition impenetrable armor directly into devastating crushing torrents.
• VERDANT: Patient organic growth. Power and Skill cards bestow permanent Strength stacks, scaling into unstoppable lategame titans.
• Expandable Vials: Unseal the Ember Vial and Tide Vial by toppling Act Bosses and completing story events, seamlessly incorporating 20 distinct tactical archetypes into your ascension pool.

==================================
◆ 4 VARIED GAME MODES
==================================
• Story Ascension: Explore 3 complete acts, 12 branching map nodes, elite monolith encounters, roaming merchants, and enigmatic sanctuary rest sites.
• Quick Delve (5-Minute Sprint): Jump straight into high-stakes mid-tier builds with a curated 3-choose-1 archetype package.
• Daily Prism Challenge: Face a globally synchronized seed featuring specialized daily gameplay mutators with worldwide competitive fairness.
• Endless Refraction: Ascend through infinite escalating loops, reforging powerful prismatic blessings at the end of every cycle.

==================================
◆ 100% OFFLINE & FAIR META-PROGRESSION
==================================
• Dispatch idle expeditions to gather Lumen and harvest rare Lamp Oil while away.
• Unlock cosmetic echo skins and browse the comprehensive 56-card Codex.
• Absolutely no third-party tracking, no forced advertisements, and no pay-to-win microtransactions. Your tactical brilliance alone dictates your ascension.

name: Lumo – Vokabeln lernen
description:
Lumo ist dein freundlicher Vokabeltrainer: Du lernst zuerst die Wörter, die du in deinem Leben wirklich brauchst – mit Beispielsätzen, Aussprache, Wiederholung zur richtigen Zeit und vielen Spielen.

ERZÄHL LUMO VON DIR
Erzähl kurz, was du machst, wofür du die Sprache lernst und was du gern tust – per Spracheingabe oder getippt. Lumo erkennt deine Themen (z. B. Reisen, Essen, Arbeit, Familie), und neue Wörter aus diesen Themen kommen zuerst. Lieber antippen? Dann beantwortest du vier kurze Fragen. Auf Geräten mit Apple Intelligence schlägt Lumo zusätzlich Wörter und Beispielsätze vor, die genau zu deinem Leben passen – ausgewertet direkt auf deinem Gerät.

SO LERNST DU
• Einstufen: Wörter, die du schon kannst, sortierst du gleich aus.
• Anschauen, zuordnen, ankreuzen, schreiben – jedes neue Wort in beide Richtungen.
• Beispielsätze und Aussprache zu jedem Wort.
• Wiederholen in Schubladen nach 1, 7 und 30 Tagen – fällige Wörter kommen von selbst wieder.
• Wackelkiste: Wörter, bei denen du dich zuletzt vertan hast.

VOKABELLISTEN FOTOGRAFIEREN
Vokabeltest aus der Schule oder Liste aus dem Kurs? Einfach scannen, ein Foto oder eine PDF wählen. Lumo liest die Liste auf deinem Gerät ein, dreht die Spalten richtig herum und schlägt passende Wörter aus der App vor – auch bei Tippfehlern. Danach lernst du deine Liste wie jedes Thema.

8 SPIELE
Schnell-Zuordnen, Memory, Wort-Monster, Blitzrunde, Stimmt das?, Satz-Lücke, Satz-Baustelle und Buchstabensalat – mit deinen gelernten Wörtern, der Wackelkiste oder ganzen Themen.

SPRACHEN
• Oberfläche Deutsch: Englisch, Italienisch oder Ukrainisch lernen
• Oberfläche Ukrainisch: Englisch oder Deutsch lernen
• Rund 4.600 Wörter von A1 bis C1 in 26 Themen

MOTIVATION
Tagesziel, Serie mit Serien-Retter, Level, Erfolge und dein Maskottchen Lumo.

DURCHDACHT
• Funktioniert komplett ohne Internet
• Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Datensammlung – dein Lernstand bleibt auf deinem Gerät
• Dunkles Neon-Design oder hell

Fehler gefunden oder einen Wunsch? Schreib uns über henzler.cc/apps – wir antworten schnell.

HINWEIS ZU KI
Beispielsätze und Übersetzungen wurden mit Unterstützung von KI erstellt, die Aussprache-Aufnahmen sind KI-Stimmen. Persönliche Wortvorschläge erstellt Apple Intelligence auf deinem Gerät; sie sind in der App als „KI-generiert“ gekennzeichnet.

Wortliste auf Grundlage der CEFR-J Wordlist (Tono Laboratory, TUFS) und des Octanove Vocabulary Profile C1/C2 (CC BY-SA 4.0).

name: LunaRoll
description:
Roll the moon home.

LunaRoll is a calm, clever puzzle game played on a hexagon board. Swipe the moon and it rolls in a straight line until something stops it. Your goal is to bring it to rest in the crater with the gold ring.

It sounds simple. It isn't. Every stone is a place the moon can stop, and every stop opens new paths. Plan a few rolls ahead, find the route, and drop the moon home.

PIECES THAT CHANGE EVERYTHING
• Stones never move, so they become your stopping points.
• Blue blocks slide along their grooves to build a stopper or clear a lane.
• Green rotors swing their arms open and shut.
• White pucks roll like the moon and can be parked where you need them.
• Sometimes the crater itself is hidden under a block. Find it.

LUNAR CYCLES
Craters come in Lunar Cycles of eight, each named for a phase of the moon, with hundreds of craters to play. Every crater has a par. Finish under par for an Eclipse, at par for a Full Moon, and earn credits as you go.

A NEW FEATURED CYCLE EVERY WEEK
Each Monday brings eight fresh craters, the same for every player, with a weekly leaderboard so newcomers start even.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Five quick lessons teach the basics in about a minute. Stuck? Use a hint, take a free nudge, or skip ahead and come back later. No timers, ever. Take all the time you like.

THE STAR LOG
Finish a whole cycle to earn a short, true fact about the Sun, the Moon, Earth and living things.

MADE WITH CARE
• Original ambient music and sound effects, with gentle vibration on iPhone
• Light and dark themes
• Plays offline
• No ads and no tracking

Play the lessons and all of Cycle 1 free, no account needed. A free account (just a username and password, no email) unlocks every cycle, the leaderboards and play across your devices.

name: Lunawolf
description:
Lunawolf is a quiet place to plan goals, keep habits and close each day.

Every goal becomes a trail across a painted canyon. Break it into stages and small steps. Each step you finish moves a lone wolf a little further along the path, from Redstone Pass to Starwatch Summit. The wolf only moves when you do.

Habits light stars in the evening sky. Miss a day and nothing is taken away: the stars you lit stay lit, and the trail waits for you.

Moon cycles give one trail 28 days of focus. Four weeks, one intention each, and a simple plan for every day.

In the evening, sit by the campfire. Three short questions: what went well, what was hard, and one step for tomorrow. That step leads tomorrow's list, and the canyon turns to night.

The Night Journal keeps your notes and moods. The Observatory shows how far you've walked, without scores or streak pressure.

name: Machine Learning: Lossmere
description:
Learn machine learning the way you would build it. Machine Learning: Lossmere is a university-level course on your phone: ten short units, ten hands-on labs and more than five hundred checked questions.

Every equation starts as something real. Roll a ball down a hillside, throw darts at a target, test a whole town for a condition, place delivery depots, sweep an airport scanner. Then the equation is revealed on top of what you just saw: tap any symbol to find it in the picture, and watch the numbers come from the formula itself. Turn a 3-D loss valley with your finger.

Drag a threshold and watch a confusion matrix change. Pull a line through points and see the squares add up. Turn a learning-rate dial until the ball overshoots. Shape a logistic curve, raise ridge lambda, vote with nearest neighbours, widen an SVM margin, slide a base rate, step k-means, sweep an ROC curve. Every lab ends with a question computed from what you just built.

What you cover: data and metrics, least squares, gradient descent, logistic regression, regularisation and bias-variance, k-NN and trees, support vector machines, Bayes and naive Bayes, clustering and PCA, cross-validation and ROC.

Made for short sessions: a few cards, one lab, a handful of questions, then a good place to stop. Questions you miss come back later, gently. A- and A+ buttons scale the text up to double size.

Works offline. No account. Free with ads at natural breaks, never during a question or lab. Earn credits by watching a short video, or subscribe monthly to remove ads ($3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial; cancel any time in your store account settings, and cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle).

Every claim carries sources you can open without leaving the app: textbook sections, university lectures and the original papers, each checked against the real page or record.

How it is checked: no expert has reviewed this app; it is source-checked. Every numeric answer is recomputed by independent code, and every concept cites at least two sources (ISLR, Elements of Statistical Learning, CMU and Berkeley lectures, original papers) at section or lecture level. Course syllabi from major universities were used to choose topics; all text, problems and figures are original. Not affiliated with any university. For learning only; no professional advice.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-lossmere.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-lossmere.html

Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-lossmere.html

name: Machine Vibration Check
description:
Machine Vibration Check keeps one machine point on this iPhone. RMS velocity maps to an ISO zone.

Measure again and the zone updates. Spectrum lets you drag the 1× speed mark.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: MachineShopCalculator
description:
What spindle speed do you need for a given cutter diameter? What table feed matches your feed per tooth? Machine Shop Calculator helps machinists, CNC operators and apprentices work through everyday machining calculations offline and save results with a job.

Six free tools cover spindle RPM, cutting speed, milling table feed, thread pitch and threads-per-inch conversions, and right-triangle geometry.

Machine Shop Pro unlocks all 48 calculators, including tools for turning, drilling, tapers, gears and indexing. Save your calculations and export a PDF report to keep with your setup notes.

The CNC workshop includes 14 English lessons and six editable examples. Step through supported Haas mill code line by line and see how each move changes the plotted toolpath. The checker is designed for learning and reviewing short code examples.

Pro also includes four English PDF workbooks covering workshop formulas, gears and indexing, setup and inspection, and CNC programming. Open them offline, print a reference sheet or save a copy.

Core navigation and calculator titles are available in 36 languages. The CNC lessons and full-length workbooks are in English.

Machine Shop Pro is an annual auto-renewing subscription. The App Store shows your local price and any free trial available to you before you subscribe. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA)
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Magistr OL
description:
Magistr OL — magistratura qəbul imtahanına hazırlaşan tələbələr üçün Magistr OL tədris mərkəzinin rəsmi tətbiqidir. Sınaqlar, video dərslər, quiz və nəticələriniz bir yerdədir.

SINAQLAR
• Onlayn sınaqlar: vaxt ölçümü, sual xəritəsi və qaralama
• Müxtəlif sual tipləri, o cümlədən sıralama (yerdəyişmə) sualları
• Sualın şəkli üzərində yazmaq və böyütmək
• Nəticələr, doğru cavablar və iştirakçılar arasında sıralama
• Müəllimin verdiyi parolla açılan sınaqlar

VİDEO DƏRSLƏR
• Mövzular üzrə video dərslər və izləmə irəliləyişi
• Sürətləndirmə, arxa fonda dinləmə
• İcazəli dərsləri 48 saatlıq offline baxış üçün yükləmək

QUIZ
• Fənn seçimi: Məntiq, İnformatika, İngilis dili, Rus dili
• 10, 20 və ya 30 sual, hər suala 1 dəqiqə
• "Səhvlərim" bölməsi və səhvlər üzrə təkrar quiz
• Hər doğru cavab üçün XP

SOSİAL VƏ ELANLAR
• Müəllimlərin elanları və yeni sınaqlar barədə telefon bildirişləri
• Müzakirələr, şərhlər və story-lər
• Şikayət və bloklama imkanı

KABİNET
• Şəxsi nəticələr və statistika
• Qrup və fənn məlumatları
• Email, Google və ya Apple ilə giriş
• İşıq və qaranlıq rejim

Kurs tələbələri əyani sınaq nəticələrini də kabinetdə görür. Hesabı istənilən vaxt tətbiqin içindən silmək olar.

name: Magnet Marble
description:
Hold a finger near a gold marble and it rolls towards you. Guide it into the cup. The game will have a few words about that.

Forty handmade boards take you across narrow bridges, soft felt and slippery glass. Brass walls give the marble a lively bounce. Each board has its own written compliment. On a particularly good day, you might even get “Yes. That will do.”

Play at your own pace. Your progress is saved on this device, and you can return to any board you’ve finished. All forty levels are included.

name: Magpie Local
description:
Magpie is the local influencer marketing platform. Local businesses book nearby creators, and creators are ranked by local reach: how many of their followers actually live in the business's city, shown before anyone books. Follower count is not the headline. Local reach is.

For businesses:
Browse creators in your market, ranked by the share of their audience that lives near you, with each creator's rate on their card. Book a comped visit (your meal, service, or experience, at your cost) or a paid booking at the creator's own listed rate. Every visit is tracked in the app in three steps: Checked in, Posts live, and Redeemed, so you can see who showed up, what was posted, and who came in from the post. To redeem a visit, the creator shows their code in the app and your staff scan or enter it at the counter.

For creators:
Join free. You never pay to join, to be listed, or to get booked. Set your own rate for paid bookings and keep 97% of it. The 3% on a paid booking is taken from the payout to cover money transaction fees, so payment is immediate. Comped visits carry no fee at all. Paid money is held until your post is live. Your profile shows businesses your local reach first, which is how smaller local followings get booked ahead of larger distant ones.

How a visit works:
A business posts an offer or books you directly. You visit, the business redeems your code, and you post honestly, with the goal of posting within 48 hours of the visit. Honest posts only: no business can require praise.

Founding, city by city:
Magpie is opening market by market. Founding creators and founding businesses join now in their city, and booking opens in each market as its roster is ready. Founding business plan details and prices are on magpielocal.com.

Sign in or apply from the first screen. You must be 18 or older to use Magpie.

name: Mahima Geethamuluu
description:
Mahima Geethamuluu is the official digital songbook of Mahima Ministries — made for worshipping God.

Find any song in seconds: search by number or by title, in Telugu script or in English letters — even if the spelling is not quite right.

• Telugu, English and Hindi worship songs, with the printed book numbering
• ABC mode: read every Telugu song in English letters, so anyone can sing along — even if you cannot read Telugu script
• Big, comfortable reading with adjustable text size; long songs scroll smoothly
• Your Sunday setlist, ready in the app for worship
• Save favourites on your phone — no sign-up, no account, works offline
• Share any song instantly through WhatsApp
• Pallavi repeats shown just like the printed book
• New songs added regularly

No ads. No tracking. No sign-up. Just the songs, for worshipping God.

Published by Mahima Ministries.
Contact: mahimaswaramu@gmail.com

name: Mahjong 3D!
description:
Play Mahjong Solitaire in 3D. Drag to turn a tile sculpture and spot matching pairs on its sides, top, and underside. Clear exposed tiles to uncover the layers underneath.

Take apart a gift box, a vintage camera, a stone bridge, and a lotus lantern, one pair at a time. Hold unmatched tiles in the four-slot tray while you look for their partners. Play at your own pace with no timer or ads.

name: MahjongShowHighvsLow
description:
## Description

Play one mahjong tile per round. The higher score wins, and every tile you use is gone for the rest of the match.

In Mahjong Duel, you and a computer rival each start with character tiles ranked 1 through 9. The computer commits to a move before your turn. Choose a tile, decide whether to pair it with a special tile, then reveal both moves.

Each player gets one of each special tile per match:

• Crown sets your score to 12.
• Copy matches your rival’s final score and forces a tie.
• Boost adds 2 points to your tile.

Pair Crown with a low tile to save your stronger tiles, use Copy when you suspect your rival has played high, or save Boost for a close round. Win more rounds than your rival over nine rounds to take the match. Tied rounds award neither player a win.

The in-game interface is in Simplified Chinese.

name: MahjongTileMemory
description:
Memorize a mahjong tile, watch it flip face down, then find it before time runs out.

Mahjong Memory is a single-player memory puzzle with 36 levels. Look closely at the tile while it’s face up. Once it flips, pick the matching tile from a lineup of decoys.

Each difficulty has 12 levels. Easy starts with 3 decoys, Advanced has 6, and Expert has 9. As you progress through each difficulty, you get less time to study the tile and less time to make your choice.

Pick the right tile to unlock the next level. If you choose the wrong tile or run out of time, you can retry right away. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can pick up where you left off or replay any unlocked level.

name: makeART Coloring Book
description:
Color something beautiful.

makeART Coloring Book is a calm, colorful place to make art on your iPhone and iPad. Pick a page, tap to fill, and watch it come together.

PAGES TO LOVE
Original pages drawn by makeART, from cozy rooms and gardens to critters, lettering, flash and zine art, mandalas, and patterns. Plus a museum shelf of classics set up for coloring, taken from public domain and openly licensed works in museum collections.

TAP TO FILL, BRUSH THE REST
Tap any shape and it fills. When you want a softer hand, switch to brush, pencil, marker, crayon, watercolor, or airbrush. Erase, undo, and zoom right in on the tiny details.

COLORS YOU ACTUALLY WANT
Spin the color wheel, start from a ready palette, or capture one from a photo or the camera. Make your own palette and keep it for the next page.

ANY PHOTO CAN BE A PAGE
Choose a photo and turn it into a coloring page. It is made right on your device.

GIVE IT A LOOK
Show a finished piece as Paper, Riso, Watercolor, Halftone, Museum, or Neon. Your work stays the same, and you can switch back to Original any time.

WATCH IT COME TOGETHER
Replay any piece as a timelapse and save it as a tall video for stories or a square one for posts. Share your finished piece anywhere.

A QUIET GALLERY
Everything you color lives in your Gallery. Sort it, change the layout, duplicate a piece to try another direction, or pick up where you left off from Home.

MADE FOR YOU
• Light and dark appearance
• Works offline
• Shortcuts support
• Optional gentle reminders, never more than one a day
• Made for iPhone and iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, and no subscription. Your art and photos stay on your device.

One purchase. Yours to keep.



Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
https://makeart-coloring-book.vercel.app/privacy

name: Makria
description:
Makria is an offline logbook app for pulled sugar and sugar art. Every record stays on your iPhone: no account, no cloud, no internet connection.

Record each piece with up to three photos, the syrup's working temperature, the recipe used (isomalt, glucose, or sucrose mix), the coloring method, room temperature and humidity, working time, and a difficulty and success rating from one to five stars.

For failed pieces, attach a failure analysis: pick the cause (temperature, humidity, technique, timing, equipment, or other), describe what happened, note what to try next time, and set the date.

Save a temperature note for each recipe: the ideal working temperature, the lowest and highest temperatures that worked for you, and conditions worth remembering. Check these notes before your next session.

The Stats page charts your records: total works, average success score, technique distribution, success rate trend, recipe usage, temperature versus success, and monthly frequency. A skill overview shows how many works and what average score each technique has reached.

Plan future projects in a wishlist with Next, Want, or Someday priority. Export all works as a CSV file: copy it, save it to Files, or share it.

Made for sugar art learners, pastry students, and baking hobbyists who want every attempt, temperature, and lesson kept in one organized place.

name: Mallang Brain: Offline Games
description:
Five quick brain games, one short course a day.

Mallang Brain puts together a 4-game course every day that takes about five minutes. No account, no internet, no subscription: open the app and play.

THE GAMES
• Quick Math: fill the missing number or sign in a short equation.
• Next Number: find the hidden rule and continue the series.
• Hidden Tiles: tiles light up for a moment; tap every one you saw.
• Number Hunt: tap the numbers in order as fast as you can.
• Odd One Out: every shape has a twin except one. Find it.

MADE TO COME BACK TO
• A new 4-game course every day, about 5 minutes
• Levels that adjust as you play: a few right answers in a row move you up, a few misses move you down
• A short demo and two practice questions before each new game
• Your own records: score, accuracy, reaction time, best results and a monthly calendar
• Daily streak and an optional reminder at the time you choose

COMFORTABLE FOR EVERYONE
• Large text option
• Relaxed mode with no timers
• Shapes and numbers only: nothing depends on colour or words
• Works fully offline; your records stay on your phone
• Export and restore your records as a file

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
The daily course is free forever. A one-time Pro purchase removes ads and unlocks unlimited practice. It is not a subscription.

Mallang Brain is a game. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Scores are records of how you did in each game.

name: Mangaliyam
description:
Mangaliyam is a Tamil matrimony app for people who are serious about finding a life partner. Every member is reviewed by our team before they can join, so you can meet people with confidence.

FIND A CONNECTION THAT LASTS
Set your partner preferences once, including religion, caste, country and who you would like to meet. Mangaliyam then suggests profiles that suit you. You can change your preferences at any time.

EVERY PROFILE PERSONALLY REVIEWED
Members register on the Mangaliyam website and are checked by our team before their account is approved. This keeps the community genuine and safe.

DISCOVER PROFILES YOUR WAY
• Browse suggested profiles chosen around your preferences
• Search by profession, country or city
• Filter by gender, religion, origin, age, height and country
• See detailed profiles: education, profession, hometown, raasi, natchathiram and more

YOUR PHOTOS, YOUR PRIVACY
You decide how your photos are shown. Free members see only a blurred version of your main photo, and clear photos are shown to Premium members.

LIKES AND MUTUAL MATCHES
Like a profile to show your interest. When you both like each other, it's a match, and you can start a conversation.

TALK WHEN YOU'RE BOTH READY
Conversations open only after a mutual match or an accepted chat request, so nobody can message you without your consent. Get notified about new messages, likes and matches.

SUCCESS STORIES
Read the stories of couples who met on Mangaliyam.

MANGALIYAM PREMIUM
Premium members can:
• See clear profile photos and full galleries
• See full names and caste details
• Like profiles and get mutual matches
• Send chat requests and message their matches
• Filter by caste
• View unlimited profiles

MADE FOR TAMIL FAMILIES
• Available in Tamil, English and French
• Light and dark mode
• Private and secure

Getting started: create your account on the Mangaliyam website at [WEBSITE URL]. Once your profile is approved, log in to the app with the same email and password.

Mangaliyam is for adults aged 18 and over who are looking for marriage.

Need help? Contact us at https://www.mangaliyam.com/en/terms-and-conditions#governing-law-and-contact.
Privacy policy: https://www.mangaliyam.com/en/privacy-policy

name: Manifold Studios
description:
WELCOME TO Manifold Studios 

The Manifold app allows you to manage your account with ease, register for classes, and special events. You'll also receive important notifications about class changes, closings, registration openings, special announcements, and upcoming events.

The Manifold Studios app is an easy-to-use, on-the-go way to access everything Manifold has to offer right from your smartphone.

name: Mantle Properties
description:
Mantle keeps the permanent record of your house. Every system, appliance, repair, warranty and document lives in one place, organized by the house instead of scattered across drawers, email and memory.

Know your home like you built it.

• Systems: track your furnace, water heater, roof, electrical panel and more, with ages, models and service history.
• Nameplate scanning: photograph an equipment label and Mantle fills in the brand, model and year.
• Guided walkthrough: walk your home room by room and capture what you find.
• Care reminders: seasonal tasks, with an email before things come due.
• Emergency: photos of your water shutoff, gas shutoff and electrical panel, plus printable shutoff tags.
• Ask Zach: answers about your house from Zach, Mantle's builder advisor, based on your home's actual systems and their ages.
• Documents and warranties: keep manuals, receipts and warranties together, and check your equipment for recalls.
• Reports: print a complete report of your home.
• Transfer at sale: when you sell, hand the record to the buyer so it stays with the house.

Your home data is private and belongs to you.

A Mantle account is required.

name: Mantra Sadhana: Japa Counter
description:
Mantra Sadhana is a calm, distraction-free japa counter for your daily mantra practice, made by Mantra Programming.

Close your eyes, chant, and simply tap the screen to count. No beads to hold, no buttons to find. Mantra Sadhana keeps your count while you stay in your sadhana.

TAP-TO-COUNT JAPA
- Tap anywhere on the screen to count each repetition
- Automatic mala rounds of 108
- Gentle haptic feedback so you never need to look

FOR ANY MANTRA
Om Namah Shivaya, Hare Krishna, Ram Naam, Radhe Radhe, Gayatri Mantra, Hanuman mantras, Om Shreem Mahalakshmiyei Namaha, or your own personal mantra and naam jap.

TRACK YOUR SADHANA
- See your daily japa count and total malas
- Build a daily streak and stay consistent
- Watch your practice grow day after day

BEAUTIFUL & PEACEFUL
- Dark, minimal design made for early mornings and night practice
- Soft golden aura that glows with your chanting

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your practice stays on your phone.

Whether you are starting with your first 108 or doing many malas a day, Mantra Sadhana helps you stay focused, devoted, and consistent.

Jai Shree Ram. Har Har Mahadev.

name: Many Paths: Recovery Meetings
description:
Many Paths puts recovery meetings from many fellowships in one list: Alcoholics Anonymous, Narcotics Anonymous, Refuge Recovery, Recovery Dharma, Crystal Meth Anonymous and local groups, including Wellbriety circles where they're listed.

Pick a city or use your location to see what's coming up today, tomorrow or any day this week. Every meeting shows its time, distance and directions.

• Every path in one list. Filter by fellowship or see them all together
• In-person, hybrid and online meetings, with join links
• Online meetings shown in your own time zone, with an English-only filter
• Meeting types explained: open or closed, men's or women's, wheelchair access and more
• Local phone lines (AA intergroups, NA helplines and peer centers) one tap away, plus 988
• Save the meetings you go to; they stay on your phone
• Home-screen widgets: meetings starting soon near you (each widget can show just the fellowships you go to) and your saved meetings
• Directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze
• Share a day's or a week's meetings as a text message. Handy for sponsors, counselors, drivers and anyone helping someone get to a meeting
• Links to the SMART Recovery, LifeRing and Celebrate Recovery meeting finders
• Light and dark appearance

WHERE THE MEETINGS COME FROM
Meetings come from each group's own public website and meeting database, and are refreshed daily. Every meeting links back to its live listing so you can check it before a first visit. Schedules do change, especially around holidays.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your saved meetings stay on your phone. Location is approximate and optional: you can type a city instead.

Many Paths is an independent, free project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Alcoholics Anonymous, Narcotics Anonymous or any other fellowship or organization. It is a meeting directory, not treatment or medical advice. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.

name: Maritime English Trainer
description:
Get ready for the English test that crewing agencies and shipping companies ask for.

Maritime English Trainer is practice for seafarers, cadets and cruise ship crew: deck, engine, galley and hotel staff.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• 5 full mock tests, 85 questions each: listening, grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, reading, time and numbers
• Every answer explained, with a translation into your language
• Practice by section and a quick refresh of your weak points
• 2,263 standard marine communication phrases (IMO SMCP) with recordings in different accents
• Speak check: say the phrase and see whether it was understood
• Maritime dictionary
• Works without internet: at sea, in port, in airplane mode

LANGUAGES
Explanations and menus in English, Russian, Ukrainian, Indonesian and Chinese. Tests and phrases are in English; the phrases can be shown with a translation.

FREE AND FULL VERSION
Mock test 1 is free, with no account and no ads. The full version is a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase. The subscription renews automatically every month until you cancel it in your Apple account settings; a one-time purchase never renews.

FOUND A MISTAKE?
Report it in the app. If we confirm it, you get a month of the full version.

Independent practice for Marlins-format English tests. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the owners of the Marlins tests. Practice only: this is not the test itself and does not guarantee a result.

Made by Corventi LLC.

Terms of use: https://maritime-english.pages.dev/terms
Privacy policy: https://maritime-english.pages.dev/privacy

name: Market GY
description:
Market GY puts shops, services and sellers from all over Guyana in one place. Find what you need, see real prices and photos, and order or message the shop straight from your phone.

FOR SHOPPERS
• Browse shops by area: Georgetown, the East Coast, East Bank, Berbice, Linden, Essequibo and more
• See prices, sizes and real photos before you go
• Order for delivery or pick-up, book appointments, and ask questions about any item
• Pay the shop the way they accept, such as MMG or cash
• Follow your favourite shops and see their new arrivals and specials in your feed
• Get alerts when something you want is back in stock or on sale
• Find it: can't find something? Post a request and shops and people who have it reply. Your number stays private until you choose who to message
• Events: fetes, church events, markets and sales happening around Guyana
• Cars, rims, rentals and spaces from private sellers, landlords and dealers

FOR BUSINESSES
• Open your own shop page in minutes and share one link on WhatsApp and Facebook
• Add items with photos, sizes, colours and prices; track your stock
• Take orders, bookings and deliveries, and record walk-in sales
• Daily and weekly sales reports, customers, reviews and what people are searching for
• Specials, weekly deals, loyalty stamps and posters for your WhatsApp status
• Add your team with their own logins

Market GY is made in Guyana, for Guyana. One People · One Nation · One Destiny.

Questions? Message Market GY from the Account tab in the app, or visit marketgy.org.

name: Marmaris Local Guide
description:
Marmaris Local Guide is the local's guide to Marmaris, İçmeler, Turunç and the bays around them. Everything a visitor or resident needs, in one simple app: where to eat and swim, what's on, how to get around and where to find help.

EXPLORE
• Restaurants, beaches, nightlife, shopping, culture and day trips, with an "Open now" filter
• Editor's picks and local tips instead of star ratings
• Beach details: Blue Flag, sand or pebbles, sunbeds, how to get there
• Day trips and driving routes: Cennet Adası, Bozburun, Selimiye, Knidos, Kaunos and more
• A map of every place, car park and marina

WHAT'S ON
• Events and festivals, weekly markets and sailing races
• "Remind me" sets a reminder on your phone; "Add to calendar" puts it in your calendar

USEFUL INFORMATION
• Tonight's on-duty pharmacies and the pharmacies open now, nearest first
• Hospitals and emergency numbers
• Taxi ranks, bus and dolmuş lines with the next departures, the Dalaman airport bus
• Rhodes ferry sailings and marinas
• Water and power cuts in your area
• Public holidays: when banks and offices are closed
• ATMs, banks, exchange offices and a currency converter with today's rates
• Public offices and consulates
