• Weather, forecast, sunrise and sunset

TURKISH PHRASEBOOK
40 everyday phrases with natural audio and a pronunciation guide.

MADE FOR VISITORS
• English, Turkish, German and Russian
• Works offline with the last downloaded information
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Spotted a mistake? Report it from the place's page and our team corrects it.

Marmaris Local Guide is an independent app and not an official app of the Marmaris Municipality or any other institution. Information from public bodies is shown with its source.

name: Marquee by Endev
description:
Marquee turns your movie diary into a wall of posters, with a score for every film you watch.

• Log films in seconds: search by title to pull in the poster, director, genre and runtime, then score it from 0.5 to 10 in half steps with a simple drag.
• Add the details that matter: the date you watched, whether you loved it, rewatches, and your own thoughts on the film.
• Visual-first library: your films appear as a poster grid with score badges. Films without artwork get a designed title card.
• Watchlist: save films for later and see how many hours you have queued up.
• Can't decide? Marquee picks tonight's film at random from your watchlist.
• Discover: get personalized movie suggestions based on the films you've scored, each with a short reason linking it to your favorites. Save any pick to your watchlist with one tap.
• Insights: see your film stats at a glance.
• Can't find a film? Add it by hand.

Marquee Pro unlocks every Discover mood (Hidden Gems, Mind-Bending, Classics, World Cinema and more), lets you describe exactly what you're in the mood for, adds More Like This for any film, and opens full Insights into your scoring habits, top genres, favorite directors and decades.

Your diary, scores and reviews are stored on your device.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kloh.ai/a/CCGKgitVRauo/privacy

name: Marquio
description:
Stop debating. Start your movie night.

Marquio turns “What should we watch?” into a movie tournament. Pick 8, 16 or 32 contenders, choose your favourite in each head-to-head matchup, and follow the bracket until one film takes the crown.

ONE BRACKET. ONE WINNER.
Make a tough choice one easy decision at a time. Watch your shortlist narrow through the rounds, open the full bracket whenever you like, and celebrate the film that wins the final.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Solo: settle on tonight’s film at your own pace, even without an internet connection. Undo your last pick or return to an unfinished tournament later.
• Nearby: gather on the same Wi-Fi network, join a friend’s room and vote together in real time. No internet connection is needed for local play.
• Online: friends can join from different places with a six-digit room code and vote on the same matchups. Share or copy the code to bring everyone in.

BUILD YOUR PERFECT SHORTLIST
Search a built-in catalogue of more than 3,000 films, from familiar favourites to discoveries from around the world. Read film facts and short Wikipedia-based descriptions, follow the source link, or add your own film title. Feeling spontaneous? Fill your bracket with random picks.

KEEP THE LISTS YOU LOVE
Save your film lists for another night, update them when plans change, and revisit past tournaments in History. Your next movie night can start with a shortlist you already love.

MAKE IT A GROUP OCCASION
See votes arrive as friends choose, track the tournament’s progress and follow every round together. When a matchup ends in a tie, the host can make the call or let chance decide. Share the final winner or the tournament bracket with your friends.

FIVE LANGUAGES, ONE ROOM
The interface supports English, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese. Friends can use their own device language while taking part in the same tournament.

No account registration is required. Online rooms need an internet connection; Nearby rooms need devices on the same Wi-Fi network.

Marquio helps you choose a film. Film playback and streaming are not included.

Privacy: https://gamemarquio.com/privacy/
Terms: https://gamemarquio.com/terms/

name: Marsa Bay®
description:
Drop anchor. Find everything.

Marsa Bay® (also known as Marsa® and Marsa-Bay®) brings the places and services people look for into one app, in English and Arabic. Seventeen marketplaces, all in one place.

Marsa Bay® is the flagship of Kenzie, SAUDI GULF HOSTiNG.

Find, compare and book:
- Hotels, with clear prices and easy booking
- Real estate: homes to buy or rent, with maps and local insight
- Vehicles: new cars, pre-owned cars and car rental
- Travel and flights
- Jobs, with simple applications
- Events and tickets
- Education: schools, universities and courses
- Health and wellbeing
- Dining, groceries and stores
- Local services, and a directory of businesses
- Weddings and occasions, flowers and gifts
- Compare options side by side before you decide

Sign in with Face ID or your fingerprint, plus your Authenticator code, to keep your account secure. Register your iPhone in seconds with the Marsa Bay® App Clip.

Need help? Email support@marsa-bay.com or visit marsa-bay.com.

name: Masters Upper Level
description: Nurture artistic growth and elevate dance technique with the Masters Upper Level Dance Studio app. Designed to simplify schedule management, this app makes organizing your dancer’s weekly routine completely effortless. Instantly view class timetables, register for recreational or competitive dance programs, and reserve spots in ballet, jazz, contemporary, tap, hip hop, and drill team technique classes. Easily handle tuition payments, track upcoming rehearsals, and receive important studio announcements directly on your phone. Download the app today to eliminate administrative friction and support your dancer's journey toward performance excellence.

name: Matably: Restaurant Manager
description:
Matably is the app for a restaurant's team during service: reservations, the floor plan, guest profiles and messages, on everyone's iPhone, updated with every arrival.

The app is for the teams of restaurants that use Matably. Your restaurant invites you, then you sign in. The app's interface is in French for now.

Tonight's service
Expected covers, arrivals, late guests and free tables, before, during and after service. On the lock screen, the service card: one tap on « Arrivé » (Arrived) opens the app and marks the guest as arrived. When you switch apps, the card stays in the Dynamic Island. The « Ce soir » (Tonight) widget keeps the service on your home screen.

Bookings and waitlist
Today's list, requests to confirm, walk-ins and the waitlist. A request can be confirmed from its notification, without opening the app.

Floor plan
Who's at which table, for how long, and who's waiting for theirs.

Guest profiles
Each guest's notes, visits and habits. Pinned notes come first, so an allergy is seen at once.

AI receptionist and copilot
If your restaurant has turned it on, the receptionist answers the phone, takes the reservation and leaves you the call's summary, recording and transcript. The copilot prepares a booking, a change or a message from what you say or type. Nothing changes until you approve.

Messages and reviews
The restaurant's WhatsApp messages and guest reviews in one place, with a reply suggested by the copilot.

No signal
In the cellar or on the terrace, the app keeps tonight's service. Your actions are sent as soon as the signal is back.

Security
Two-step sign-in, a Face ID app lock, and everyone sees only what their role allows.

Some features depend on your restaurant's plan.

name: Matahari Living
description:
Matahari Living adalah aplikasi resmi Matahari Property untuk mencari rumah dijual dan disewakan di Surabaya, Sidoarjo, dan Gresik.

CARI RUMAH LEBIH CEPAT
• Jelajahi properti pilihan dari agen Matahari Property
• Saring berdasarkan kota, wilayah, tipe (beli/sewa), dan harga
• Lihat foto, spesifikasi lengkap (luas tanah, luas bangunan, kamar tidur, kamar mandi), dan lokasi

REKOMENDASI UNTUK ANDA
• Atur preferensi wilayah, tipe, dan rentang harga sekali saja
• Halaman "Untuk Anda" hanya menampilkan rumah yang cocok
• Dapat notifikasi saat ada rumah baru sesuai kriteria Anda

KONSULTASI LANGSUNG
• Hubungi agen lewat WhatsApp langsung dari halaman properti

TITIP JUAL ATAU SEWA
• Punya properti untuk dijual atau disewakan? Isi data singkat, tim kami akan menghubungi Anda via WhatsApp

Akun Anda dapat dihapus kapan saja dari menu Akun.

name: Match Pulse
description:
Discover the most exciting comebacks in football and basketball with Match Pulse.

Explore historic matches, dramatic score changes and unforgettable moments that transformed the outcome of major sporting events.

MATCH ANALYSIS

Review match scores, key turning points and detailed timelines to understand how teams recovered from difficult situations.

COMEBACK HISTORY

Discover memorable football and basketball comebacks across different leagues and competitions.

WIN PROBABILITY

Explore how estimated win probabilities changed throughout each match and identify the moments that influenced the final result.

WHAT IF SCENARIOS

Experiment with alternative match situations and discover how different decisions or events could have changed the outcome.

LEAGUE ARCHIVES

Browse organized collections of historic matches and explore remarkable sporting achievements.

MATCH STATISTICS

Study score progression, important events and match details through clear visual summaries.

Match Pulse brings sports history, comeback analysis and interactive match exploration together in one engaging experience.

name: Matchday Guide
description:
Plan your soccer matchday on iPhone or iPad. Explore Wembley Stadium, Olympiastadion Berlin, and Stade de France with transit tips, stadium history, and orientation sketches. Use the sketch to get your bearings and check your ticket for your gate, section, row, and seat.

Add a home match by entering both teams, the stadium, and the local kickoff time. Choose how early you want to arrive and see your planned arrival time. Browse upcoming and past matches or filter your plans by date. You enter the matches yourself.

Use a reusable packing checklist and add your own items. Keep travel notes, matchday rituals, and fan song lyrics in a searchable journal. The stadium guide, match plans, checklist, and journal work offline.

Optional features include stadium weather, local notifications, Apple Calendar and Reminders exports, widgets, and a kickoff Live Activity on supported devices.

name: Matchlyn
description:
Matchlyn is een hulpmiddel op de verpakkingslijn. Voor je gaat vullen, etiketteren of in dozen zet, controleer je of de verpakkingscode en de inhoudscode een goedgekeurd paar zijn. Recepten, scans en geschiedenis blijven op dit toestel. Geen account. Geen netwerk.

Zo gebruik je het

1. Open Recepten en voeg een paar toe: verpakkingscode + inhoudscode. Zet het op Actief.
2. Open Controle. Scan of tik eerst de verpakkingscode, daarna de inhoudscode. Tik op Controleren.
3. Lees de stempel:
   • Goedgekeurd — dit paar staat in het boek. De lijn mag door.
   • Afwijking — de codes komen voor, maar niet als dit paar. Eerst stoppen.
   • Onbekend — dit paar staat nergens. Niet doorzetten.
4. Optioneel: zet geplande paren op de Ploeglijst. Een regel openen vult beide codes. Bij Goedgekeurd wordt de regel afgevinkt.
5. Het Logboek bewaart elke stempel met tijd en operator. Filteren kan bij de ploegbespreking.

Zet de operatornaam onder Instellingen. Je kunt een JSON-kopie delen of alles wissen. De camera is alleen voor barcodes; intypen kan altijd.

Bij de eerste start staan voorbeeldrecepten van een dranklijn klaar, zodat je meteen een controle kunt doen.

name: MATHEUS by ISOLIF
description:
MATHEUS by ISOLIF is the field app for ISOLIF's partners, installers and engineering firms, to insulate the equipment of plant rooms and district heating substations.

Survey: take a project on, create its zones, then survey each piece of equipment - valve, filter, check valve, meter, pump... - with its diameter, fluid, temperature, dimensions and photos. The app recommends the ISOLIF jacket that fits each piece of equipment.

Offline: plant rooms often have no signal. Everything can be entered offline, and your surveys and photos upload by themselves when the network returns. A project taken on with a phone is booked on that phone until it is sent: nobody else changes it in the meantime.

Fitting: once the jackets are delivered, find each piece of equipment by its marker and photo, and confirm the fitting with an after photo.

Back-office: your company finds its projects on the ISOLIF back-office, which produces the photo report, the jacket bill of materials and the energy savings summary.

Access: create your company's account from the app, or join it when its administrator invites you. Back-office access is granted by ISOLIF. Contact: contact@isolif.com.

name: MatRecord: Tournament Tracker
description:
MatRecord keeps a martial arts family's tournament season in one place: every result, every score sheet, every bracket, the points they add up to, and the photos and video that go with them.

Built for the people at the side of the ring. No account to make, nothing that has to be sent anywhere. Your data stays on your phone, and you decide what is shared and with whom.

ADD RESULTS IN SECONDS
Pick the tournament and who competed, then tap the place in each event. Points, standings and season totals update as you go.

SCORE A RING AS IT HAPPENS
Judged events with each judge's score and ties caught and broken the way your organization breaks them. Brackets for sparring and combat, built for the ring size, with winners carried forward. Or use Quick score: pick the event and start scoring, nothing to set up first.

FOLLOW THE STANDINGS
See where each competitor stands, how many points they need, and which results count. Compare the published standings with your own records and spot what is inaccurate or missing.

PHOTOS AND VIDEO WITH THE EVENT THEY BELONG TO
Film a form or a match, take a photo to commemorate the moment, and it is filed with the competitor, the tournament, and the score sheet. Save copies to your photo library whenever you like.

SHARE RESULTS THE WAY YOUR TEAM DOES
Send a clean picture of a day's results or a scored ring straight into a group chat, or send the words. Coaches and parents with MatRecord can import what you send.

FOR FAMILIES AND SCHOOLS
Track one competitor or a whole school: several locations, teams and their rosters, instructors, and a team overview of medals, points leaders and what needs attention.

STAGING SCHEDULES AND RING ASSIGNMENTS
Paste or open a posted schedule and MatRecord tells each of your competitors where to be and when. Reminders before a tournament and before registration closes.

A CHAMPION'S JOURNEY
A game built on your organization's rules. Compete in its events, earn belts, and chase a championship.

YOUR ORGANIZATION'S RULES
MatRecord comes with the ATA Martial Arts rules for the 2026-2027 season built in: divisions, belts, events, scoring and points, ready to use. Any other organization can be set up from scratch, and the rules can be adjusted to match your school.

ON YOUR COMPUTER TOO
Buying MatRecord includes a web version for entering a season with a keyboard and a big screen.

TRY IT FREE
Everything works for 30 days, counted from your first result. After that MatRecord is read-only until you unlock it with a single in-app purchase: nothing you entered is lost, and you can still look through it, export it, back it up and save your photos and videos. No subscription.

MatRecord is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ATA Martial Arts or any other martial arts organization.

name: MatthewMedia
description:
MatthewMedia plays video and games from a MatthewMedia Server that you or someone you know runs. The app contains no video or games of its own: you need a server name and a personal code from the person who runs the server.

WATCH
• Connect with the server name and the personal code you were given.
• Browse movies and TV shows, search, and pick up where you stopped.
• Choose audio tracks and subtitles. Subtitles are drawn large and easy to read.
• Skip Intro and Play Next when your server offers them.
• Live TV when your server has it.

PLAY
• MatthewArcade: play the games your server offers, in the arcade's own player or as web games.
• A world map for servers that host one (EverMatthewCraft ATLAS Map).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics, no crash reports sent to anyone.
• What you watch, search and play goes only to the server you signed in to.
• Nothing is shared with Siri, Spotlight, the lock screen or iCloud.
• Signing out removes this iPhone from the server and clears everything the app kept.

MatthewMedia is free. There is nothing to buy and no account to create in the app.

name: Mauersegler Acoustic
description:
Acoustic measures sound levels with your iPhone and shows how much of the sound comes from the ventilation system. Made for ventilation contractors, planners, property managers and anyone who needs to document noise from ducts and fans in a traceable way.

MEASURE
• Momentary level (LAF), equivalent continuous level (LAeq), maximum, minimum and LCeq
• 1/3-octave spectrum from 50 Hz to 8 kHz in real time
• Sound recording of the measurement as a WAV file
• Adjustment against a reference sound level meter with a correction value

VENTILATION MODE
• Guided measurement in two steps: system off, system on
• Share of the ventilation in the total sound, in percent
• Level of the ventilation alone, calculated from both measurements
• Hint when a single tone stands out, such as the hum of a fan
• The app marks results that can only be determined roughly

WITH CAMERA
• Readings are shown over the live image
• Photos and videos with level, date and measuring time shown in the picture
• Also in ventilation mode: one image each for “system off” and “system on”

PROJECTS AND REPORT
• Organise measurements by project, with project name and address
• PDF report with your own logo, company name and author
• Overview table, individual values, spectra and photos
• CSV export for further processing

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no analytics
• Measurements, recordings and photos stay on the device until you share them yourself

LANGUAGES
German, English and Turkish, switchable in the app.

IMPORTANT
The app provides indicative readings. The iPhone microphone does not replace a certified sound level meter; acceptance tests and expert reports require an approved measuring instrument.

name: Mauersegler AirTools
description:
AirTools is the pocket calculator for ventilation contractors, planners and installers. Eight tools cover the calculations you need every day on site and in the office – clearly laid out with technical sketches, offline and without an account.

THE TOOLS
• Duct sizing: diameter or rectangular size from airflow and velocity, with the next nominal size
• Pressure loss: friction (Colebrook) plus fittings (sum of ζ), per metre and in total
• Offset: overall length, centre distance and intermediate piece for an offset with two bends
• Insulation: insulation area and cutting width for round and rectangular ducts
• Airflow from k-factor: q = k · √Δp from the measured differential pressure, with step-by-step guide
• Heat output: heating or cooling capacity from airflow and temperature difference
• Hood airflow: quick estimate or detailed calculation according to VDI 2052 with an appliance list
• Air change: air change rate or required airflow for a room

KITCHEN VENTILATION
• Around 30 common kitchen appliances with stored values, plus your own appliances
• Wall, island and free-standing hoods
• Bill of materials of the selected appliances

YOUR OWN PRODUCTS
• Save grilles, valves and dampers with the k-factor from the manufacturer's data sheet
• Pick them straight from the list in the calculation

SETTINGS
• Airflow unit m³/h or l/s
• German, English and Turkish, switchable in the app
• iPhone and iPad

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your products and settings stay on your device.

NOTE
The results are intended for preliminary sizing and do not replace professional design.

name: Mazraatna: Desert Farm
description:
Mazraatna means "our farm". Grandpa Hamad has left you his land in the Najd desert: an old well, a few palms and a lot of sand. Bring it back to life.

• Clear the land and plant wheat, barley, tomatoes, watermelon, okra, mint and more
• Carry water from the well, dig channels and build water tanks; thirsty crops wilt if nobody waters them
• Plant date palms: Khalas, Barhi and Sukkari
• Raise sheep, goats, hens and camels, and make laban, butter, ghee and aqit
• Grind flour on the quern, bake bread and kleija in the clay oven, weave Sadu rugs and bishts on the loom
• Fill orders for the buyers at your gate, the passing caravan and the day's jobs
• Rain fills your tanks, sandstorms leave sand to sweep, and the sun moves with your phone's clock
• Add friends with a link: visit their farms, water their thirsty crops and buy from their stall
• Reminders when your crops are ripe or thirsty (you can turn them off)
• Plays without the internet; online, your farm is kept safe and moves with you to a new phone
• In Arabic and English

A calm game for short visits through the day. No ad ever cuts in: a video plays only when you pick one, for a little help.

name: Measuring Kit: Ruler & Level
description:
Measuring Kit puts five measuring tools in one app: AR tape with angles and areas, ruler, protractor, bubble level and live sensors. They share one calibration screen, so every tool can be tuned to your own iPhone or iPad and its case.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• AR that measures shapes, not just lines. Lines snap together into corners, and the app shows the angle at each corner and the area of each closed shape, all computed in 3D.
• One kit, one calibration. The ruler, level, protractor and AR tape all use the same device profile: your detected iPhone or iPad model, its screen density, LiDAR support and camera details, all visible in Settings.
• A ruler sized to your iPhone model. Tick spacing comes from a built-in table of iPhone screen densities. On iPad the scale is estimated, and on either you can check it against any bank card in seconds.
• Tools that work together. The protractor's plumb line uses the level's calibration, so angles read against true vertical.
• Honest about accuracy. Every tool can be calibrated, and the app tells you when a reading is estimated or when AR tracking is poor.

AR TAPE
Point the camera, tap + at the start and + at the end, and read the distance on screen. Aim near an existing point and the reticle snaps to it, so lines join cleanly into corners and closed shapes. Turn on Show angles to see the angle at every shared corner, and Show areas to shade each closed shape and label its area in m² or ft². Undo a point, clear all, and save a photo with the lines, angles and areas drawn on it. On iPhone and iPad models with LiDAR, points land directly on surfaces. On other models, the app measures only on surfaces it has actually detected, and keeps both points on the same wall plane to cut drift.

RULER
A full-screen yellow ruler that starts at the very top of your screen. Hold a small object against it, drag to its end, and read centimeters and inches at once.

PROTRACTOR & ANGLE FINDER
Drag two arms to read an angle on a 180° protractor, or open the full 360° circle. A gravity plumb line turns it into an inclinometer for slopes, ramps and roof pitch. Degrees, radians or arcminutes.

BUBBLE LEVEL
Lay your iPhone or iPad flat for a two-axis bubble, or stand it on its edge for a spirit-level tube. The app switches by itself. On iPhone, a haptic tap tells you when you're within 0.5°. Zero it on a surface you trust to cancel out your case or camera bump.

LIVE SENSORS
See what your iPhone or iPad feels: accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetic field, attitude with a live 3D preview, battery and thermal state. Great for students and the curious.

ALSO
• Metric or imperial, automatic by region
• No account, no ads, works fully offline
• English, Spanish and Portuguese

GOOD TO KNOW
Measuring Kit is made for quick everyday answers: will it fit, is it straight, what angle is it. It is not a certified instrument. AR results depend on light, surface texture and distance, and work best from about 20 cm to 5 m. The ruler measures objects up to the length of your screen.

name: mecate
description:
mecate is a 1970s Italian string machine, rebuilt circuit by circuit. Not sampled: modelled from the service manual's schematics and checked against a real unit, from the top-octave generator and the divider chain to the bucket-brigade lines of the ensemble.

Five voices per hand on a split keyboard: brass, piano, clavichord, cello and violin, and a bass on the bottom keys. Every key has its own circuit, so every key sounds at once, as on the hardware.

The panel is the hardware's panel:
- Left and right hand volume: a fader and an on/off tab for each voice
- Brass filter with a per-note envelope: attack, decay, emphasis and contour
- Man./Ped.: hand the brass sweep to a foot controller on CC 4
- Vibrato speed and depth, sustain length, string timbre from mellow to bright
- Main volume for strings and brass, bass and piano
- Split point, and a swell pedal on CC 11
- A sustain pedal on CC 64

Eight factory presets to start from, and your own on top: save, rename and delete them, import and export them as files.

Play it as a standalone app, with Bluetooth MIDI, or as an AUv3 instrument in GarageBand, Logic Pro for iPad, AUM, Cubasis, Loopy Pro and other hosts. Hide the on-screen keyboard when you play from a controller.

No account, no subscription, no tracking.

name: Mellow: Mood Tracker & Diary
description:
Mellow is a gentle mood diary. Tap how you feel on the mood gauge, add what you did that day, and optionally a note, a voice memo or photos. Mellow turns your entries into clear patterns you can actually use.

• Log a mood in seconds with an expressive gauge and faces
• Add activities (emotions, work, sleep, food, sports and more), notes, voice memos and photos
• See streaks, mood charts, mood count, stability and your best and worst days
• A monthly calendar and "Year in Pixels" show your whole year in colour
• Earn badges for staying consistent
• Make it yours: mood colours, emoji themes and your own activities
• Works offline: your entries are saved on your device and sync when you are online
• Daily reminder so you never forget

Your diary is private. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.

Mellow is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.

name: Meltimer: Cozy Wait Timer
description:
Waiting gets a little nicer.

Ground meat, fresh out of the freezer.
A pot of curry, bubbling away.
The washing machine, going round.

Meltimer is a timer for watching those waits go by.
The little ice cube melts bit by bit. The pot puffs out steam. And when it's time, they tell you: "thawed!" "simmered!"
Every number and every picture is drawn by hand, in a wobbly line. Just looking at it loosens you up a little.

■ Just tap
Tap one of "the usuals" on your shelf and it starts.
You only type in a time once.

■ As many as you like
Thaw the meat, simmer the curry, run the laundry.
The screen splits into bands of color, so you can see how far along each one is at a glance.

■ Not just thawing
Thaw, simmer, boil, bake, rest, laundry, bath, dry, focus, wait.
The drawing and the words change with what you pick.
"still rock hard" "smells good" "rinsing" "almost there"

■ It learns your kitchen
Added "5 more min" and it came out just right? Keep that time for next time.
The more you use it, the better it fits your freezer and your pot.

■ Quiet
No sign-in. No account. Everything stays on this iPhone.

――

Free to use (with ads)
・Up to 2 timers at once
・Up to 5 usuals
・Notifications

One purchase opens everything (pay once, not a subscription)
・As many timers and usuals as you like
・No more ads
・Time left on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
・Home Screen widget
・Themes (colors and buddies)
・A choice of sounds
・iCloud sync

Nicer than your usual timer? Then maybe it's worth keeping.

* Times shown are a guide only. Always check your food yourself.

name: Meme Mash: Photo & Grid Maker
description:
Meme Mash is a complete offline meme & collage studio for iPhone and iPad: stack photos on a freeform canvas, cut out faces cleanly, build 2- & 3-panel photo grids, add punchy meme captions, and export crisp HD PNGs — no account, no watermarks, no ads.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Full Meme Captioning (Canvas & Grids) — add classic outlined Impact (Anton), Modern (Rubik), or Comic (Bangers) captions with Outline, Dark Box, White Bar, or Pop Tag styles, Top + Bottom meme pair entry, color swatches, drag/pinch/rotate handles, and 1-tap snap to Top, Center, Bottom, or individual Grid Panels
• Smart Face Cutout & Face Crop — fuses on-device face segmentation, 36-point anatomical face contours, and color-guided edge matting for clean head stickers without background jitter (tap again to cycle through multiple faces in group photos)
• Photo Grids Builder — 10 curated 2-photo & 3-photo layouts with per-cell pinch/slider zoom, pan, photo swap, adjustable border width, rounded corners, border colors, and 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 4:3, and 16:9 aspect ratios
• Multi-Photo Import — pick one or multiple photos at once directly from your Photos library (supports HEIC, JPEG, PNG, and WebP with automatic orientation normalization)
• Move, Resize, Rotate & Flip — 1-finger drag, corner resize handles, rotation knob, Horizontal Flip, Vertical Flip, and 1-tap 180° inversion across Canvas, Grids, and Manual Crop
• Color & Layer Controls — adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, and opacity per layer, or send any grid (with live captions) directly to the Freeform Canvas

100% OFFLINE & PRIVATE
Meme Mash works completely offline on your device. No login or account is required, and your photos and facial cutout geometry are never uploaded to any cloud server.

name: Memora - Scrapbook & Memories
description:
Welcome to Memora - your personal digital scrapbook and vintage memory journal.

Capture the magic of life's moments with nostalgic, handcrafted aesthetics. Whether you are documenting your travel journeys, anniversaries, family milestones, or everyday reflections, Memora brings the tactile warmth of real scrapbooking to your iPhone.

KEY FEATURES

Classic Polaroid Frames
- Turn photos into authentic Polaroid-style prints with custom captions and dates.
- Move, rotate, scale, and layer pictures naturally on textured paper backgrounds.

Handwritten Sticky Notes and Thoughts
- Jot down personal reflections, quotes, and travel stories on pastel sticky notes.
- Choose from curated vintage typography and warm journal fonts.

Voice and Audio Keepsakes
- Record ambient sounds, voice notes, and laughter directly onto your pages.
- Relive the emotion of every memory with one-tap audio playback.

Retro Stickers and Washi Tape
- Decorate your scrapbook with retro stamps, wax seals, washi tape, and decorative pins.
- Intuitive drag-and-drop gestures for effortless collage composition.

High-Resolution PDF and Image Export
- Export complete scrapbook albums as printable, high-resolution PDFs.
- Save individual cards or spreads directly to your camera roll to share with loved ones.

100% Private by Design
- Your memories belong to you alone. All photos, voice clips, and notes are stored strictly on your local device. No accounts, no sign-ins, and no cloud surveillance.

Start preserving your stories today with Memora.

name: MendeGrid: Periodic Table
description:
Rebuild the periodic table by placing elements in their correct positions. Choose a round by period, group or block. Tap an element tile, then tap its place in the table.

Clues change with how you do in each round. Start with a symbol and atomic number, then work with a symbol or a name. At the hardest clue level, use neighbouring elements as guides. If you miss a placement, the element comes back during the round.

Browse all 118 elements in the reference table. Tap an element to see its symbol, name, atomic number, period, block and group where assigned. See how many rounds you've completed on the home screen. You can clear your progress in About.

Your practice progress is saved on this device. The app has no account requirement or ads.

name: Meowsic: AI Songs & Radio
description:
Turn one sentence into a whole song, then hear it on the radio.

Describe what your song is about, pick a genre and a mood, and choose vocals or instrumental. Meowsic writes the lyrics, produces the music and sings it in about a minute. Keep every song in your library and play it any time.

Share a song and it can play on Meowsic FM, where Miso, our cat DJ, introduces every track like a real radio host. Tune in to stations by genre, discover songs made by other listeners, and like the ones you love.

With Meowsic Plus you get 25 new songs every month and your own radio station, with your songs on air and Miso on the mic. Need more songs? Song packs never expire.

What you can do:
- Make songs from an idea, with vocals or instrumental, in 11 genres
- Read the lyrics while your song plays
- Share songs and put them on the radio
- Listen to Meowsic FM and genre stations, with a DJ between songs
- Run your own station with Meowsic Plus
- Sleep timer, likes and a full player

Meowsic Plus is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and it renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms: https://meowsic.io/terms
Privacy: https://meowsic.io/privacy

name: Mercado São Sebastião - Loji
description:
Faça suas compras no Mercado São Sebastião, em Caratinga/MG, sem sair de casa.

No app você:
• Navega pelas categorias e encontra mercearia, hortifrúti, limpeza, higiene, utilidades e muito mais
• Busca produtos e monta o carrinho com os preços atualizados da loja
• Conta com o assistente de compras para achar produtos e ofertas
• Finaliza o pedido e acompanha suas compras
• Recebe notificações com ofertas e avisos da loja
• Fala com a loja pelo WhatsApp direto do app

Sua conta pode ser excluída a qualquer momento, em Conta > Segurança.

name: Merci Maintenance
description:
Merci Maintenance met en relation les particuliers et professionnels en Algérie avec des artisans certifiés près de chez eux pour tous leurs travaux d'entretien, de réparation et de dépannage à domicile.

NOS 12 CATÉGORIES DE SERVICES :
• Plomberie, Électricité, Peinture, Plâtrerie
• Menuiserie, Maçonnerie, Placo, Sécurité
• Dressing, Maintenance Industrielle, Électroménager et Autres travaux

FONCTIONNALITÉS PRINCIPALES :
• Artisans certifiés : consultez les profils, spécialités et avis clients avant de confirmer votre demande.
• Nouvelle demande assistée : décrivez votre besoin au clavier ou par dictée vocale (FR / Arabe), joignez des photos et ajoutez un relevé de chantier indicatif en Réalité Augmentée (ARKit).
• Suivi et Chat en temps réel : recevez des notifications à chaque étape, ouvrez l'itinéraire dans Apple Plans ou Google Maps et échangez par texte, photo ou message vocal avec votre prestataire.
• Règlement de la mission à domicile : payez au choix en espèces directement au prestataire ou en ligne par carte nationale CIB / Edahabia via Chargily Pay.
• Application universelle iPhone et iPad disponible en Français, Arabe et Anglais.

name: Merkzettel – Einsprechen
description:
Merkzettel ist der schnellste Weg in Apple Erinnerungen: Tippe auf den Knopf, sprich frei – mit Pausen, mit „äh“ und „ähm“ – und tippe auf „Fertig“.

Merkzettel entfernt die Füllwörter, macht aus jedem Gedanken einen eigenen Eintrag und erkennt, was ein Einkauf ist und was eine Erinnerung.

EINKÄUFE IN LADENREIHENFOLGE
Milch, Äpfel und Spülmittel landen auf deiner Einkaufsliste, sortiert nach Bereich: Obst & Gemüse, Backwaren, Kühlregal, Fleisch & Fisch, Tiefkühl, Vorrat, Getränke, Drogerie, Haushalt. Die Reihenfolge stellst du so ein, wie du durch deinen Laden gehst.

TERMINE AUS DEM GESAGTEN
„Morgen um neun Mama anrufen“ wird eine Erinnerung für morgen, 09:00 Uhr.

SELBSTKORREKTUREN
„Butter, nein, Margarine“ – auf dem Zettel steht nur Margarine.

ERST PRÜFEN, DANN ÜBERNEHMEN
Du siehst alle Entwürfe, bevor etwas in Erinnerungen landet. Bearbeiten, Bereich ändern, Termin setzen oder löschen – dann „Übernehmen“.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE
Auf iPhones mit Apple Intelligence trennt Merkzettel die Einträge noch genauer. Ohne Apple Intelligence funktioniert alles genauso.

ACTION BUTTON UND SIRI
„Merkzettel aufnehmen“ startet die Aufnahme direkt – per Action Button, Kurzbefehl oder Siri.

PRIVAT
Die Spracherkennung läuft auf deinem iPhone, auch im Flugmodus. Kein Konto, keine Server, keine Analyse. Deine Einträge liegen nur in Apple Erinnerungen.

Merkzettel braucht iOS 26 und spricht Deutsch.

name: Merry Little Advent Calendar
description:
Twelve Advent calendars. 288 little reasons to look forward to December.

Merry Little Advent Calendar brings a whole collection of Christmas countdowns together in one beautifully illustrated place. Choose the calendars that feel like your kind of Christmas, then open a new surprise each day from 1–24 December.

Bake something festive, make a little mess with a craft, plan a family adventure or settle in for Christmas Movie Club, complete with a film, snack, drink and treat. There are party games, activities for kids, thoughtful traditions and quieter moments for the days when December feels a bit much.

• Choose from 12 individually designed calendars
• Discover 288 festive activities and surprises
• Find vegetarian-friendly recipes, family games and creative ideas
• Save your chosen calendars and revisit days you have opened
• Catch up on earlier days throughout December

One purchase includes the full collection. No subscriptions, ads or extra calendar fees.

A little Christmas magic, one door at a time.

name: MES Audio Editor & Recorder
description:
MES Audio records your voice and cleans it up with AI, right on your phone.

Tap Record, talk, and tap Stop. Recording keeps going with the screen off or while you use another app, so long talks, lectures and interviews are safe.

Then make it sound better:
• Remove noise: an AI made for speech (DeepFilterNet 3) takes out fans, air conditioning, traffic, hiss and room noise while keeping the voice natural. It runs on the phone, even without a connection.
• Enhance speech: one tap for noise removal, a low cut, voice clarity, a gentle compressor and podcast loudness.
• Compare: switch between Original, Cleaned and Noise only while it plays, and Undo any step.
• Trim: drag across the waveform, then keep that part or delete it.
• Save or share as M4A, MP3 or WAV: to Files, Messages, email, AirDrop or any app.

Need more? The full editor is one tap away: several tracks, fades, EQ, compressor, limiter, hum removal, de-click, loudness to -14 or -16 LUFS, markers and a spectrogram. It can also open the sound of a video.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing you record is uploaded.

Made by Math Easy Solutions (mes.fm). The same editor runs in any browser at mes.fm/audio.

name: MES Dim & Volume
description:
Do your volume buttons jump from too quiet to too loud? Is the lowest brightness still too bright in bed?

FINE VOLUME
• Change the media volume 1%, 2%, 3% or 5% per tap instead of the side buttons' big steps.
• Big − and + buttons (hold to repeat) and quick levels like 3%, 8% or 15%.
• The volume stays where you leave it when you go back to your music, podcast or video.

FINE BRIGHTNESS
• Set the screen brightness in small steps, or jump straight to the lowest level.

DARKER THAN DARK
• A short step-by-step guide to the iPhone's own Reduce White Point and Zoom Low Light filter, which make the screen far darker than its lowest brightness.
• Put them on a triple-click of the side button so you can turn them on and off in a second.
• Tick each step as you go.

PRIVATE
• No ads, no account, no tracking. Your settings stay on your iPhone.

On Android, MES Dim & Volume can also dim the screen over every app: see mes.fm/mobile-apps.

name: mevii: movie & tv tracker
description:
mevii is a new way to enjoy what you watch. Make your screentime count.

LOG EVERYTHING YOU WATCH
Rate movies and TV seasons from 1 to 10, note when and where you watched, and write a review. Reviews stay private unless you choose to share them, with your name or anonymously.

SPEND LESS TIME CHOOSING, MORE TIME WATCHING
See what's new in theaters and on the streaming services you actually have. Get picks based on what you love, and every poster tells you where it's streaming.

BUILD YOUR TASTE IN MINUTES
Swipe through "Have you watched this?", take the "What should I watch?" quiz, and check off the all-time 100, the best of every genre, and big franchises. Every title you mark fills your log and sharpens your recommendations.

RANK IT, FROM SUPERIOR TO SUCKY
Make tier lists for any franchise, studio, director, or actor. Drop each title into S, A, B, C, D, or F, then share your chart to your Instagram story.

MAKE EVERY WATCH AN EXPERIENCE
Take on monthly viewing challenges, earn tickets and badges, and climb the ranks from Popcorn Rookie to Pure Cinephile. Finish a challenge and get a story card to share.

WATCH WITH FRIENDS
Add friends by username, see what they're watching, and do challenges together. Their reviews show up first on every title, and every title shows the average mevii rating.

YOUR YEAR IN REVIEW
After a month of logging, Wrapped shows your top genres, favorite actors, hours watched, and more.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
No ads and no selling your data. Block or report anyone, and delete your account at any time from the app.

Movie and TV data from TMDB. Streaming availability from JustWatch.

name: Miasto Kłodzko
seller_name: Grzegorz Przewlocki Grzegorz Zielezny Slawomir Milewski Mateusz Chudy netkoncept com sp jawna
description:
Miasto Kłodzko to oficjalna aplikacja dla mieszkańców Gminy Miejskiej Kłodzko. W jednym miejscu znajdziesz najważniejsze informacje o życiu lokalnej społeczności, sprawdzisz terminy wywozu odpadów, zgłosisz sprawę do urzędu i będziesz na bieżąco z tym, co dzieje się w okolicy. Wszystko wygodnie, szybko i za darmo.

Co znajdziesz w aplikacji:
Kalendarz wydarzeń — bądź na bieżąco z lokalnymi wydarzeniami kulturalnymi, sportowymi i społecznymi. Sprawdzaj, co, gdzie i kiedy się dzieje.

Harmonogram wywozu odpadów — nigdy nie przegapisz terminu. Sprawdź daty odbioru odpadów dla swojego obszaru w kilka sekund.

Jakość powietrza — monitoruj stan powietrza w Twojej okolicy dzięki integracji z czujnikami pomiarowymi. Wiedz, kiedy warto ograniczyć aktywność na zewnątrz.

Zgłaszanie potrzeb — zauważyłeś dziurę w drodze, przepełniony kosz albo niesprawne oświetlenie? Zgłoś to bezpośrednio przez aplikację i śledź status sprawy.

Komunikaty RSO — otrzymuj ostrzeżenia Regionalnego Systemu Ostrzegania o zagrożeniach i sytuacjach kryzysowych w Twoim regionie.

Sondy i ankiety — miej realny wpływ na swoją okolicę. Wyrażaj opinię w konsultacjach i głosowaniach dotyczących lokalnych spraw.

Karta mieszkańca — korzystaj z ulg, zniżek i przywilejów dostępnych dla mieszkańców.

Firmy i partnerzy — odkrywaj lokalne firmy, punkty usługowe i partnerów programu.

Ulubione treści — zapisuj to, co najważniejsze, i wracaj do tego jednym kliknięciem.

Wyszukiwarka — szybko znajdź informacje, wydarzenia i usługi, których potrzebujesz.

Deklaracja dostępności aplikacji: https://karta.klodzko.pl/40/deklaracja-dostepnosci.html

name: Mîkât
description:
Miqat (Mîkât / ميقات) is a 100% offline, ad-free, and privacy-first prayer times application crafted for clarity, accuracy, and peace of mind.

Built natively with zero ads, zero tracking, and zero clutter, Miqat calculates accurate daily prayer times directly on your device using high-precision astronomical equations—anywhere on Earth, with or without an internet connection.

KEY FEATURES

• 100% Offline Astronomical Precision
Once you select your city or detect your GPS coordinates, Miqat calculates Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha completely offline. Perfect for travel, flights, and areas with limited connectivity.

• Global Calculation Authorities & Madhabs
Automatically selects the optimal authority for your region or lets you customize between Diyanet (Türkiye & Europe), Muslim World League (MWL), ISNA (North America), Umm al-Qura (Makkah), Egyptian General Authority, Karachi, Dubai/UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Singapore, and Moonsighting Committee. Supports both Standard (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali) and Hanafi Asr juristic calculations.

• Time-Sensitive Prayer Notifications
Never miss a prayer. Miqat delivers Time-Sensitive local notifications that break through Focus and Do Not Disturb modes when you need them. Configure up to 3 customizable reminders per prayer (at exact prayer time and 5 to 60 minutes before), anchored strictly to your tracked city's timezone.

• Dynamic Sky Gradients
Experience a living interface that shifts seamlessly across the day—from the deep indigo and warm amber of Fajr and Sunrise, through crisp midday blues for Dhuhr and Asr, fiery dusk tones at Maghrib, and a tranquil starlit night sky during Isha.

• Executive Desk Clock / StandBy Mode
Rotate your phone to landscape to unlock a dedicated 3-column Desk Clock dashboard displaying a large digital clock, Hijri and Gregorian dates, an interactive circular countdown ring, and all six daily prayer times at a glance.

• Home Screen Widgets
Stay connected to the current and upcoming prayer right from your Home Screen with small and medium widgets that automatically transition at each prayer boundary.

• Privacy-First: Zero Ads, Zero Tracking
Miqat respects your worship and your privacy. There are no banner ads, no pop-ups, no user accounts, and no personal data collection or ad tracking.

name: Mile Basis
description: Mile Basis helps you understand what each mile includes. Build an ownership estimate from energy, upkeep, fixed costs, vehicle value changes and financing interest. Keep cash budgets separate from ownership costs, compare the same annual mileage, and check a whole round trip. Review recorded expenses against a matching distance period, then revise future assumptions without rewriting earlier results. Your data is stored locally. Device backups may include it, and you choose when to export reports or backups.

name: Mileage Garage
description:
Mileage Garage keeps every leased car on its mileage allowance. See whether you're over or under today, what you'll be at turn-in, and what to do about it: which car to drive, how to share miles between cars, and the cheapest way to finish the lease.

See your pace at a glance
• Miles over or under your allowance as of your latest odometer reading
• Projected miles at turn-in and what the overage would cost
• A pace chart of actual miles, the allowance and the projection
• Drive Budget: how far you can drive this week, this month and per day and still finish on allowance
• What-if: pick a daily distance and see your odometer and any overage fees at lease end
• Alerts at 90%, 95% and 100% of each car's allowance
• Miles or kilometres, with each car kept in its own lease unit

Which car today?
Tell Mileage Garage how far you're driving. It picks the car that best fits each lease's remaining allowance, trip cost, EV range and today's forecast from Apple Weather, and on slick roads it favors AWD and 4WD. On supported devices, Apple Intelligence writes the explanation on your device, using only your own numbers.

Trip Check
Enter a distance or search a destination and see what the trip does to the lease: the change in over/under, the overage it adds and the fuel or charging cost. With Pro, it ranks every car and picks the one that absorbs the trip best.

Balance miles across cars (Pro)
Mileage Garage finds the cars headed for overage and the cars with allowance to spare, tells you how many miles to move between them this week, cheapest first, and how much that saves by turn-in.

Lease-end planner (Pro) and Return Prep
• Lease-end planner: compare paying overage at turn-in, buying extra miles now, or buying the car out against its market value
• Return Prep: a wear-and-tear checklist for tires, glass, each body panel, wheels, interior, keys and records, with dated photos on every item
• Return report PDF to take to the inspection (Pro)

Apple Watch
See every car's over/under at a glance, open a car for miles left, days left and the daily budget, and log an odometer reading with the Digital Crown. Complications show the car that needs attention on your watch face.

Widgets, Siri and Shortcuts
• Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets: allowance gauge, over/under and miles left for the car you choose
• Quick Log widget and a Control Center control that open the odometer log for a car
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Log odometer", "Miles left", "Which car today?". With a Shortcuts personal automation you can be asked for a reading whenever your iPhone disconnects from CarPlay or your car's Bluetooth

Records you can share
• CSV exports of readings and the service log, plus a full JSON backup (always free)
• A PDF mileage statement per car with lease terms, every reading, the pace chart, the projection and service history (Pro)

Maintenance that keeps up
Oil changes, tire rotations and replacements, brakes and state inspections. Due dates and mileage are estimated from how much you actually drive, and the service history keeps the costs.

Free, with a one-time Pro upgrade
Free: one vehicle with every single-car feature, including pace, Drive Budget, What-if, Trip Check for that car, Which car today?, Return Prep checklist and photos, maintenance, widgets, Siri and Apple Watch, plus CSV export and JSON backup.
Mileage Garage Pro (a one-time in-app purchase, not a subscription): unlimited vehicles, multi-car tools (fleet balancing, its factor in Which car today?, and Trip Check's car-by-car comparison), the lease-end planner, and PDF reports (the mileage statement and the Return Prep report). Pro features carry a PRO tag in the app. Cars you already have are never hidden.

Private by design
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device and syncs through your own iCloud account. The only thing that leaves your device is a rounded location, which goes to Apple Weather for the forecast.

name: Milo-
description:
Take a little break with Milo. Ease out of work mode, give yourself a moment between tasks, or put tomorrow’s to-dos aside before bed.
Follow a guided stretch
Choose a 30-second, 2-minute, or 5-minute routine. Preview each move before you start, then follow large photo demonstrations and simple instructions as you go.
Listen to ambient sounds
Choose from Rain, Breeze, Hush, Hearth, and Night. Set a timer and let the sound keep playing while your iPhone screen is locked.
Leave it for tomorrow
Jot down something you want to remember, attach a photo, or record a voice note up to 60 seconds long. Come back the next day to review it.
Save a break you’d take again
Add a stretch or listening session to Favorites so you can start it again with the same settings.
No account required. Notes and attachments are stored on your device. Milo includes five free visits. Starting a timed session or saving a new note uses one visit. Additional visits are available through in-app purchase.

name: Mindwire – Subliminals
description:
Mindwire turns the affirmations you choose into a calm subliminal session. A warm voice repeats your words softly under real nature sounds and a zen drone, so you can listen while you fall asleep, study or wind down.

PICK WHAT YOU NEED
• Deep sleep, stop procrastinating, focus, confidence or calm anxiety
• 25 affirmations per goal, as "I am…" or "You are…"
• Write your own lines too
• Or tap Say it and tell Mindwire what you need

CHOOSE HOW IT PLAYS
• Four warm narrators
• Whisper: soft but audible under the sound
• Quiet: just below the music
• Silent: moved to a high pitch you won't consciously hear
• Speed and layers for a denser session

MIX YOUR SOUND
• Real nature recordings: window rain, thunder, sea waves, creeks, birds, crickets, campfire and more
• Zen drones: singing bowls, flute, celestial pads
• Separate sliders for voice, nature and zen

MADE FOR FALLING ASLEEP
• Optional guided wind-down to ease you in
• Auto volume starts gentle and settles lower as the night goes on
• Sleep timer from 15 minutes to all night
• If your watch syncs sleep to Apple Health, Mindwire can soften the session when you fall asleep
• Keeps playing with the screen locked, with lock-screen controls

HANDS-FREE
• Say "louder", "softer" or "stop" while it plays
• Start sessions with Siri
• Speech is recognized on your device

SAVE YOUR FAVOURITES
Save any session to your Library and play it again in one tap. On iPad, Mindwire has a full sidebar layout.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your sessions stay on your device.

TRY IT, THEN UNLOCK
Mindwire includes free plays of every goal. Mindwire Full is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited sessions, every goal and writing your own affirmations.

Mindwire is a relaxation and self-help tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Questions? support@oluma-agency.com

name: Mine Crusher: Idle Gems
description:
Mine Crusher is a free idle mining game for iPhone. Ore rolls down the conveyor, your crusher smashes it, and the coins add up while you upgrade the mine.

Keep tapping to crush, or buy Auto-Crushers and let the shaft run on its own. Spend coins on five upgrades: Crusher Power, Conveyor Speed, Ore Quality, Auto-Crusher, and Value Multiplier. Use the x10 button when you are ready to buy in bulk. Dig deeper to unlock rarer ore, from copper and gold to ruby, diamond, and beyond.

When a shaft is deep enough, collapse the mine. You start a new shaft with a permanent income boost from Ancient Shards, while gems, skins, and other unlocks stay with you.

Daily tasks, achievements, an ore journal, and occasional Vein Rush events give you extra goals and rewards. A 2x boost is available if you want a short burst of income.

The game is free to play. You will see ads (banners, occasional full-screen ads, and optional rewarded ads for gems or a 2x boost). You can also buy optional gem packs and permanent upgrades, such as Remove Ads or Permanent 2x Income, as in-app purchases through Apple. Progress is saved on this device. There is no Mine Crusher account.

If you have a question or need help restoring a purchase, visit the support page or email teemartin7101@gmail.com.

name: Minutebook Meeting Minutes
description:
Drop in your meeting text or screenshots and get clear, organized notes.

When the meeting ends, the details are still scattered across chats and notes. Minutebook pulls them into three fixed sections: what was decided, who does what, and when.

Paste text, or pick up to 9 screenshots from your photo library.
Text in screenshots is recognized on your phone. Original images are never uploaded.

Notes with a consistent structure
Each note has a dated title, followed by attendees, then split into "What was decided," "Who does what," and "When." Every action item has a checkbox you can tick off when done. If the source doesn't mention a time or a person, we won't make one up.

One set of notes, three formats
Tap the top to switch to a weekly report or an email. The weekly report splits into this week's progress and next week's plan; the email includes a greeting, body, action items, and sign-off.

Revise with a single sentence
Say "make it shorter" or "add due dates," and the changed lines briefly highlight. You can also edit the text directly.

Easy to send
Copy as plain text and paste into WeChat without broken formatting, or share straight to WeChat, email, or Notes.

Your content stays yours
Notes are stored on your phone. No sign-up needed. Export everything or delete everything with one tap. When you tap "Organize," your text is sent through our servers to a third-party AI (DeepSeek) for processing. We don't keep the original text.

On first launch, tap "Try it" and see a finished set of notes in ten seconds.

Note: the app interface is in Chinese only.

name: Miras: Son İmparatorluk
description:
Bir karar bir cepheyi, bir ihmal bir kuşağı değiştirir.

Miras: Son İmparatorluk, Osmanlı Devleti'nin son yıllarında geçen, kart tabanlı bir alternatif tarih oyunudur. 1908'de Meşrutiyet'in ilanından 1925'e kadar devletin kaderini belirleyen kararları sen verirsin.

NASIL OYNANIR
Her kartta dönemin bir figürü önüne bir mesele getirir. Kartı sola ya da sağa kaydırarak karar verirsin. Her seçim meşruiyet, ordu, hazine ve diplomasi dengesini değiştirir ve sonraki olayları belirler.

ÖNE ÇIKANLAR
• 263 tarihsel sahne ve birbirine bağlı olay zincirleri
• Büyük Harp'e girmeyen, farklı ittifaklar kuran ya da Millî Mücadele'yi başka bir yoldan yürüten alternatif rotalar
• Kararlarından oluşan kişisel final anlatısı
• Arşiv fotoğraflarından uyarlanan dönem portreleri
• İnternet gerektirmez; reklam yok, hesap yok, veri toplanmaz

TARİHSEL YAKLAŞIM
Oyun gerçek olaylardan yola çıkar, ama seçimlerin tarihi değiştirebildiği bir kurgudur. Savaş, zorunlu göç ve sivil kayıplar gibi ağır konular saygıyla ele alınır; şiddet bir başarı aracı olarak ödüllendirilmez.

name: MiroCosme
description:
MiroCosme is your on-device makeup reference studio. Explore editorial looks with clear steps, color maps, and product suggestions—then save favorites, build routines, and keep vanity notes privately on your iPhone.

Discover curated looks for everyday, office, evening, bridal, editorial, and seasonal moments. Open any look for minutes, difficulty, swatches, and a practical step-by-step sequence.

Studio tools help you work smarter: • Shade Matcher — undertone and depth guidance for foundation, blush, and lips
• Face Zone Guide — tips for skin, brows, eyes, cheeks, and lips
• Routine Builder — assemble looks into reusable personal sequences

My Vault keeps everything local: favorites, tried looks, vanity notes with ratings, and custom routines. Switch language anytime (English / 中文), export a local summary, or erase your data in Settings.

Designed for beauty reference—not medical advice. Patch-test products and follow brand instructions. No account required. No ads analytics SDK. Your saved content stays on your device.

name: Mirra: Body Language Coach
description:
How do you come across on camera? Mirra gives you feedback on your own body language before a job interview, a talk or a video call.

Record yourself live, or choose a video or a photo. Mirra measures what your face and body do, frame by frame: fleeting expressions, smiles, where you look, blinks, head and shoulder position, and your hands. Each moment is marked on the recording, so you can watch it again and decide what it means in your situation.

Every finding starts with what was measured. When a movement has more than one common meaning, Mirra names them, says how confident the measurement is, and cites the research behind it.

What Mirra does not do: it does not detect lies, read emotions or minds, or diagnose anything. Research shows these cannot be read reliably from movements, and Mirra explains why.

Private by design: the analysis runs on your phone, and your recording stays there. Only if you ask for optional written feedback, and tick a consent box, are the measurements and up to 6 reduced-size frames sent to Anthropic's Claude to write it. No account needed.

Mirra is meant for feedback on yourself. Please don't analyse recordings of other people without their consent.

name: Mizu Family Memory Match
description:
Mizu Family Memory Match is a classic memory matching game featuring Mizu, a cheerful 5-year-old, and his family.

Flip two cards at a time and find the matching pairs. Match every pair to clear the board — and try to remember where each picture was hiding!

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap a card to flip it over. Flip two cards: if the pictures match, the pair is yours. If not, both cards flip back — remember their places!
- Match pairs in a row to build combos.
- Clear the board to earn a star rating based on your moves and time.

40 DESIGNS, 6 DIFFICULTY LEVELS
- Easy — 6 pairs (12 cards)
- Normal — 8 pairs (16 cards)
- Hard — 12 pairs (24 cards)
- Super Hard — 16 pairs (32 cards)
- Daily — 8 pairs, a new layout every day, the same for everyone
- Ultra — 20 pairs (40 cards) for a real memory workout

The 40 card designs are drawn at random each game, so every board feels a little different.

FEATURES
- 40 cute card designs from the Mizu family illustration series
- 6 difficulty levels, from a quick 12-card game to a 40-card Ultra board
- A daily challenge with a fresh layout every day
- 11 achievement badges to collect
- Best records (fewest moves / fastest time) saved for every difficulty
- Star ratings, combos, and cheerful sound and music (can be muted)
- Fully offline — no ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no data collection

LANGUAGE
English by default, and you can switch to Japanese at any time from the title screen.

The family illustrations in this game are AI-generated graphics, created and curated by MA DAYS.

Made by MA DAYS (Japan).

name: Mkachkhin Lyon
description:
Mkachkhin Lyon is the app of the Lyon supporters' group of Espérance Sportive de Tunis. It brings together fans in the Lyon area around the club's matches, screenings and the life of the group.

This is not the app of the Espérance Sportive de Tunis club. Club names and logos belong to their owners.

The app is available in French and English. It opens in your iPhone's language, and the FR | EN button at the top of the screen lets you switch at any time.

MATCHES AND RESULTS
• Espérance's fixtures and results (Ligue 1, Tunisian Cup, CAF Champions League), in Lyon time, with the broadcasting channel
• Live scores during matches, with goals and cards
• A match analysis page for football matches: side-by-side team statistics and match timeline, when this data is available
• Season statistics and the league table
• The Champions League tab: Espérance's campaign, its group, fixtures and results
• Handball and volleyball sections: next match and latest result

NEWS AND SQUAD
• Club news, in French or automatically translated into English
• The full squad for the season: position, number, age and nationalities

SUPPORTERS' VOTES
• Fans' XI: pick your eleven before each football match
• Man of the Match: vote within 2 hours after each football match

THE GROUP IN LYON
• Match screenings in Lyon: venue and time
• Group life, membership and the shop

ON YOUR IPHONE
• Notifications: live goals and cards, kick-off, starting XI, half-time and full-time score, votes, screenings in Lyon, news and messages from the group. You choose your topics, and notifications arrive in the app's language
• A reminder 1 hour before kick-off, for the match of your choice
• Live match in full screen
• The digital membership card, for members: add it to Apple Wallet, with a QR code refreshed every 30 seconds, shown on screening and event days, at the venue

Blood and Gold, in Lyon. Faithful since 1919.

name: MKTSS Fieldbook
description:
Fieldbook is the phone app for crews that use Fieldbook on their company's account. It is for foremen, superintendents and crew on civil and construction job sites.

Your company's office sets up the projects, cost codes, people and equipment. On the phone you:

• Start on your projects: pick one to reach its time card, safety forms, drawings, documents, receipts and reports, and go back with ‹ Projects.
• Fill in the daily time card: who worked, the equipment, the hours on each cost code and the quantities put in place, and the site conditions.
• Keep working without signal. Cards and safety forms are kept on the phone and send by themselves when there is a signal again. The Projects screen shows what is still waiting.
• See cards the office sent back, with their note, fix them and send them again.
• Fill in and sign the day's safety forms — the tailgate meeting, FLHA and equipment pre-trips — and read the safety documents.
• Open the project's drawings — and its Field View when the office has published one — and save them on the phone for when there is no signal.
• Ask questions about the contract documents and open the page an answer came from.
• Photograph a receipt for a field purchase and code it to the job.
• Write extra work reports and RFIs.
• Get a notification when a card is sent back, and a reminder when cards are still waiting to send.

You need a Fieldbook login from your company to use the app. Accounts are created and removed by your company's administrator. Questions: admin@mktss.net.

name: MM Construtora
description:
MM Construtora é o app de gestão de obra da Marco Machado Construtora.

Na obra e no escritório, a equipe:

• Faz o apontamento do dia e tira a foto da obra.
• Pede material, escrito ou falado.
• Acompanha compras, logística, financeiro e documentos.
• Entra nas reuniões e conversas da equipe.

O comprador da casa acompanha o andamento da obra dele.

O acesso é criado pela construtora; não há cadastro aberto.

name: MMAオーナーズ-総合格闘技団体経営シミュレーション-
description:
総合格闘技の団体を立ち上げて、世界一の団体に育てるシミュレーションゲーム。

あなたは新しく旗揚げした格闘技団体の社長です。少ない資金で選手を集め、小さな会場で大会を開くところから始めます。

■ 選手を集める
戦績や知名度などで世界中の選手から探し、契約を交渉します。スカウトが見つけた原石を育てることもできます。

■ 大会を開く
会場を押さえ、カードを組み、チケットや PPV の値段を決めます。マッチメイクしだいで、お客さんの数も評判も変わります。

■ 人気選手を生む
ランキングを動かし、王座戦を組み、団体の看板になる人気選手を育てます。

■ ライバル団体と競う
世界には11のライバル団体があり、それぞれが自分たちの大会を開き、選手を取り合っています。

■ 終わりのない世界
選手は年を取り、引退し、新しい世代がデビューします。何年でも遊び続けられます。

【こだわり】

◆ 生きている格闘技の世界
ライバルの11団体は、それぞれ違う理念で経営され、選手と契約し、大会を開き、王者を生みます。

◆ 一人ひとりに経歴がある選手たち
レスリング・柔道・ボクシング・相撲など、選手ごとに格闘技を始める前の競技歴があります。得意な戦い方も、伸びる時期も、衰え方も一人ずつ違います。

◆ ゲーム内SNS
団体はプロモーションを行い、選手はライバルと言い合い、ファンはそれを楽しみます。それぞれが団体経営に影響します。

◆ 本物に近いマッチメイクの評価
因縁やライバル関係、実力差、フォロワー、選手の性格、ファンの期待など、多くの要素でカードの魅力が決まります。

◆ 1ラウンドずつ積み上げる試合
試合の結果は、見えないところでラウンドごとの攻防を計算して決まります。3人のジャッジにもそれぞれ採点の癖があり、判定が割れることも、劇的な逆転が起きることもあります。

◆ 本物に近い契約と興行
チケットや PPV の売れ方、会場の大きさ、選手の人気が、大会の黒字と赤字を左右します。

◆ 積み重なる歴史
すべての試合の記録が残り、歴代王者や選手の戦績を何年たっても振り返れます。

◆ むずかしすぎない操作
中の計算はこまかくても、遊ぶ人が決めることはしぼっています。すきま時間にも遊べます。

【追加パック（買い切り）】

◆ トーナメント
所属選手で勝ち抜き戦を開く

◆ 他競技からの転向
柔道・レスリング・ボクシング・相撲などの実績者を MMA に転向させる

◆ 芸能人・著名人からの転向
知名度の高い著名人を MMA デビューさせる

◆ 共同大会・対抗戦
ほかの団体との対抗戦や共同大会を開く

◆ 女子階級
女子の3階級を新設し、女子の大会を組む

基本無料で遊べます（広告あり）。広告の除去も、買い切りで購入できます。

※登場する団体・選手・大会・会場はすべて架空のものです。

利用規約：https://www.raccooncreative.co.jp/mma-owners/terms.html
プライバシーポリシー：https://www.raccooncreative.co.jp/mma-owners/privacy.html

name: MOAT: Hold Back the Tide
description:
The tide is coming in. Your sandcastle is right there on the beach. You have a bucket, a spade and about thirty seconds.

MOAT is a puzzle game about sand that behaves like sand. Dig, and the hole fills from below. Pile dry sand and it slumps; pile damp sand and it packs hard. Water finds the lowest path, every time. Every wall you build is a bet about where the sea will go next.

HOLD THE LINE
Each beach is a few tides long. Build between them, patch during them, and keep the flag dry. A rogue wave can arrive on tide three. A turtle nest might sit lower than your castle. The sea can come from the top, the side, two sides, or all round.

SEVEN COASTS, 105 BEACHES
• Summer Coast: rocks and turtle nests
• Fjord Shore: tide pools to fill and seaweed that holds sand
• Driftwood Bay: planks to drag, bury and bridge
• River Mouth: rivers that never stop
• Black Sand: lava you have to route around glass
• The Drawback: the sea pulls out, then one wave
• Frost Coast: ice walls that last exactly one tide

GROW YOUR KIT
Shells buy a deeper spade, a bigger bucket, a trowel and a sundial. Stars grow the Tide Tree: pick a side of each fork and make the beach play your way. Wall builders, moat diggers and tide readers all finish the campaign, differently.

EVERY DAY, ONE MORE BEACH
The Daily Beach is a fresh puzzle with a fixed kit, the same for everyone. Three-star a beach to open its Storm version: rain, riptide, night or gulls.

WHEN IT GOES WRONG
Watch the breach in slow motion, rewind one tide, swap a knack and try again. Then share the clip. Nobody's wall survives the first time.

HONEST PRICING
The first two coasts, the Daily Beach and every storm on them are free, forever. One purchase opens the other five coasts and every coast we add. No ads, no energy, no premium currency, no accounts.

Made by one person who spent too many summers losing to the sea.

name: Modbus Field: TCP Scanner
description:
Modbus Field turns your iPhone, iPad or Apple Silicon Mac into a Modbus TCP field tool. Leave the laptop in the van for quick checks, commissioning and troubleshooting.

READ AND WRITE • Coils, discrete inputs, holding and input registers (FC01–FC06, FC15, FC16) • UInt16, Int16, UInt32, Int32, Float32, UInt64, Int64, Float64, Hex, Binary, ASCII • All byte orders: ABCD, CDAB, BADC, DCBA • Large blocks are split into multiple requests automatically • 0-based, 1-based or Modicon (40001) address notation

FIND DEVICES • Scan your subnet for open Modbus TCP ports • Find every unit ID behind a TCP/RTU gateway (Pro)

UNDERSTAND THE DATA • Device profiles show named values with units (Pro) • SunSpec discovery for SMA, Fronius, SolarEdge and other SunSpec inverters (Pro) • Live trend charts with CSV export (Pro) • Raw traffic log with MBAP header and PDU

TOOLS (FREE) • 4–20 mA / 0–10 V / raw count scaling with NAMUR NE43 diagnostics • Register converter in every byte order • Modicon address converter • Modbus RTU CRC16 calculator

TRY IT WITHOUT HARDWARE The built-in demo device simulates an energy meter, process values, digital I/O and a SunSpec inverter.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account, no analytics, no servers. Everything stays on your device.

Pro is a one-time purchase. No subscription.

Writing to equipment can change its behaviour. Only operate devices you are authorised to use. Modbus is a trademark of Schneider Electric. Not affiliated.

name: ModernGamer
description:
ModernGamer unlocks the full desktop-class potential of your favorite cloud gaming services natively in Swift across iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple TV.

SUPERCHARGE YOUR CLOUD GAMING PLATFORMS
• GeForce NOW: Request up to 5K at 120 FPS, hardware-accelerated H.265 (HEVC) & AV1 decoding, HDR10 10-bit color, crisp YUV 4:4:4 chroma, L4S low latency, 150 Mbps bitrate, regional latency ping benchmarking, and 7.1 surround sound.
• Xbox Cloud Gaming + Better xCloud: Manage Better xCloud directly from the ModernGamer menu for 1080p HQ / 1440p, higher bitrates, Clarity Boost, custom controls, region selection, and controller haptics.
• Amazon Luna: Stream Luna at maximum PC-class resolution and bitrate — even on iPhone — with full game controller & CoreHaptics rumble support.
• Boosteroid: Stream up to 4K at 120 FPS with HDR10 and pixel-perfect custom stream resolution matching any iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro, monitor, or AR glasses display.

OPTIMIZED FOR EVERY APPLE DEVICE & IPHONE DUO POSE
• iPhone Duo All 5 Poses: Seamless zero-drop fold continuity across Cover Display, Flat Cinema, Handheld Console (top screen stream + bottom tactile dual-stick/KB+Mouse deck), Book Spread, and Hands-Free OLED Stand.
• Apple TV Handoff & Tethered Mode: Hand off sessions directly to Apple TV 4K or stay tethered to relay physical mouse, keyboard, and trackpad input over local LAN.
• External Displays & AR Glasses: Full-screen native resolution output on USB-C / HDMI monitors and XREAL, Rokid, and VITURE AR glasses.
• Apple Vision Pro & Mac: Spatial floating cinema screen with glass ornaments on Vision Pro and full native macOS AppKit experience with XDR/ProMotion support.

TRY FREE, OWN FOREVER
• Start with a complimentary 5-minute active-playtime free trial upon download (browsing, signing in, and setup never consume trial time).
• Unlock unlimited lifetime play across all your Apple devices with a single $10.00 one-time purchase — zero recurring subscriptions.

Note: ModernGamer is an independent third-party cloud gaming client. Active accounts/subscriptions with GeForce NOW, Xbox Cloud Gaming, Amazon Luna, or Boosteroid are provided separately by their respective services.

name: MonCouvert : réserver au resto
description:
Réserver une table ne devrait pas prendre plus de temps que de choisir le plat.

Avec MonCouvert, trouvez un restaurant près de chez vous, choisissez la date, l’heure et le nombre de couverts, confirmez. C’est tout. Fini les appels qui tombent sur messagerie en plein service.

POUR LES CONVIVES
• Recherchez les restaurants autour de vous
• Consultez les infos pratiques de chaque établissement
• Réservez en quelques secondes
• Retrouvez toutes vos réservations au même endroit
• Modifiez ou annulez en un clic en cas d’imprévu

POUR LES RESTAURATEURS
Remplissez votre salle, pas votre boîte vocale.
• Notifications instantanées par e-mail et dans l’app
• Gestion de salle et de tables
• QR code de réservation à afficher en salle ou en vitrine
• QR code de votre carte
• Widget de réservation pour votre site web
• Boutons vers votre site et vos réseaux sociaux

Une question ? Écrivez-nous depuis l’app.

name: MonteGol
description:
MonteGol, futbol maçlarını istatistiksel bir modelle 400.000 kez sanal olarak oynatır ve her sonucun olasılığını hesaplar.

• Maç sonucu, ilk yarı / maç sonu, alt / üst, karşılıklı gol ve en olası skorlar
• Canlı maçlarda kalan dakikaların simülasyonu, birkaç saniyede bir güncellenen skor ve istatistikler
• Takımların iç / dış saha formu, son 20 maçı, sakatlıklar ve kadrolar hesaba katılır
• Günün Seçkisi: modelin en emin olduğu maçlar
• MonteGol Karnesi: geçmiş tahminlerin gerçek sonuçları, şeffaf şekilde
• Süper Lig, Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Avrupa kupaları ve yüzlerce lig

VIP üyelikle tüm analizler sınırsız açılır. Yeni üyelere 2 ücretsiz deneme hakkı verilir.

MonteGol bahis oynatmaz ve bahis tavsiyesi vermez; tahminler istatistiksel olasılıktır, kesin sonuç değildir. 18 yaş ve üzeri içindir.

Kullanım Koşulları: https://montegol-api-production.up.railway.app/terms
Gizlilik Politikası: https://montegol-api-production.up.railway.app/privacy

name: MoonAgeDial
description: Moon Age Dial muuttaa päivämäärän kuun ikään, vaiheeseen ja valaistukseen. Valitse yö puolipyöreältä päivämääräkiekolta: kiekon keskellä lukee ikä päivinä, kahdeksan vaiheen nimi ja valaistusprosentti. Merkitse yö omaan lokiin ja avaa se myöhemmin tarkistuslistaa ja lukujen vertailua varten. Mukana on kaksitoista vaihekuvausta ja lyhyet kuvausvinkit. Laskenta tehdään laitteessa julkisella 29,530588 päivän kierrolla, eikä nousu- tai laskuaikoja lasketa.

name: Moonlore
description:
Moonlore is a calm, private dream journal. Tell your dream in the morning, and Moonlore keeps it with a title, feelings, symbols and an image.

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
• Dictate right after waking up, or type
• Title, feelings, symbols and people are suggested on your iPhone
• Lock Screen widget and a Live Activity while you record
• Mark a night as “dream forgotten” so your streak keeps going

INTERPRETATION WITH MEMORY
• If you like, Claude, an AI by Anthropic, interprets your dream
• It links tonight’s dream with the ones before it: “Water appears for the third time this month …”
• A follow-up question helps you go deeper
• Food for thought, not a diagnosis

SEE YOUR PATTERNS
• Week, month and year review with your symbols and feelings
• Calendar and search across all your dreams
• Your own symbol lexicon

LUCID DREAMS AND NIGHTMARES
• Reality checks, a step-by-step MILD guide and your progress
• Nightmare overview with a gentle “rewrite the ending” exercise
• Help lines are always one tap away

BRING YOUR OLD DREAMS
• Import from a notebook photo, your Notes app or another dream app
• Export everything as PDF or text

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. Your dreams stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud.
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• AI only after your explicit consent; only what an interpretation needs is sent
• Face ID lock

PRICING
The journal, dictation, search, review, import and export are free, plus 3 AI interpretations. Moonlore Plus brings 60 AI interpretations a month, questions to your dream archive and written reviews, as a yearly or monthly subscription or a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage and cancel them in your Apple account settings.

TERMS AND PRIVACY
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Moonlore Terms of Use: https://moonlore-app.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://moonlore-app.vercel.app/privacy

name: Mooo: Your Day in Color
description:
How do you feel right now? Tap one of three glass spheres: black dust when you’re feeling low, silver when you’re in between, gold when you’re feeling good.

Mooo is a mood tracker with one tap. Your mood changes during the day, so log it as often as you like. Every tap throws a little glass ball of that dust into today’s glass jar. By night, the jar holds your whole day, with a short report to match.

ONE TAP
• Open the app and tap a sphere. That’s it.
• Tap as often as you like, as fast as you like. Every tap counts. Tapped the wrong one? Press Undo.
• Use the home-screen widget to log your mood without opening the app.

YOUR DAY IN A GLASS JAR
• Each ball drops into the jar, bounces and settles on the ones before it.
• The dust is loose: tilt your iPhone and it flows, tap a sphere and it flies up.
• A jar holds 16 balls. When it’s full, it moves to a little shelf and a fresh jar takes its place. Tap a jar on the shelf to see it again.
• No two days look the same.

A ROOM WITH DAYLIGHT
• The jar stands in front of a wall, in the light of your time of day: sun through a window by day, with the shadows of leaves, and moonlight at night.
• The sun is high and strong in summer, low and mild in winter.
• Choose the wall: nine colors or any color of your own, in clay, plaster, linen, paper or stone. The widget follows.

YOUR DAY, WRITTEN UP
• Each day gets a short report written from your moods: “In between at 7:30, lifting to feeling good by 9:45.”
• A headline for the whole day, and a closing note.

LOOK BACK
• See every day as a gallery of jars, month by month.
• Open a day to read its report and see each mood you logged.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No tracking.
• Your moods stay on your iPhone. Mooo has no servers and collects no data. Reports are written on your iPhone.

Reduce Motion support. VoiceOver labels on every control.

Mooo is for personal reflection. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

name: Moosera Play
description:
Moosera Play is a small collection of good, free browser games — pick one, play for a minute or an hour, and pick up again later. No download beyond the app itself, no account, no sign-up.

Games include:
- Stack Tower — tap to stack blocks as high as you can
- Bubble Pop — match three or more bubbles to clear the board
- Color Sort — untangle colors into matching tubes
- Gem Match — swap gems to start a chain reaction
- Merge Drop — merge matching pieces into bigger ones
- Perfect Pairs — a calm memory-matching game
- 2048 — the classic sliding-tile puzzle
