- Ant Flap — a simple one-tap flying game
- Balloon Pop — a satisfying, bright tapping game
- Hoop Shot and Penalty Kick — quick sports challenges
- Piano Tap — tap the right notes before they vanish

Every game saves your personal best right on your device — no account needed. Open the leaderboard to see how your score stacks up against everyone else playing right now.

No ads, no third-party trackers, no accounts. Just good games for a little break.

name: Moria Lectio
description:
Moria Lectio takes the hurry out of your quiet time with Lectio Divina, the old way of reading Scripture slowly, as a conversation with God.

FOUR QUIET MOVEMENTS
• Lectio – a short passage unfolds verse by verse, at a calm pace
• Meditatio – mark the word that stays with you and dwell on it
• Oratio – write a short answer or prayer, if you like
• Contemplatio – two to five minutes of silence, with nothing on the screen
Full screen, no notifications, a soft bell at the end.

HOW ARE YOU FEELING?
Words from the Bible for grief, fear, doubt, anger, loneliness, guilt, joy and more: 23 feelings and 127 passages, each shown in the verses around it so it reads as a whole.

SERIES AND FEASTS
Seven days of Psalms, the Sermon on the Mount, Advent, Lent, and a series for each biblical feast (Passover, Firstfruits, Weeks, Trumpets, Atonement, Tabernacles), suggested in the two weeks before it begins.

EVENING PRAYER
A short examen for the end of the day: give thanks, look back, let go and rest. Always in warm dark.

CALM SOUNDS OR YOUR OWN MUSIC
Warm pads, soft rain and gentle piano made for the app, a different one for each step. Or play your own Apple Music playlist inside the app, or open one in Spotify or TIDAL.

AND MORE
• A private archive of the words that stayed with you, in your own iCloud if you like
• Choose any book, chapter and verses
• A widget for your home and lock screen
• A quiet daily reminder and mindful minutes in Apple Health
• A warm dark mode for early morning and late evening
• Thirteen Bible translations, including the KJV, BSB, WEB and the original Hebrew and Greek

MORIA LECTIO SUBSCRIPTION
7 days free, then € 0.99 a month or € 4.99 a year. Renews automatically; cancel any time in your App Store settings. Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE
No account, no advertising, no tracking. Nothing you write leaves your phone, except to your own iCloud when you choose so.

name: Morika
description: Morika is a quiet space for gravity experiments and orbital exploration. Shape your own miniature cosmos by placing celestial bodies, adjusting velocity, and observing how physical forces shape planetary motion. Complete guided orbital challenges and craft custom planet textures using photo colors on your device.

name: MostHunted
description:
MostHunted turns your city into a giant game board. Teams of runners try to stay free while the chasers hunt them down on foot, by bike or on public transport.

HOW IT WORKS
- Runners get a head start, then the chase is on.
- Every few minutes the chasers see where every runner team is on the map, for a short moment.
- Runners get alerts with how far away the others are, so nobody feels safe for long.
- A touched runner hands over their secret code, and the chaser enters it to make the catch.
- Leave the game area and the chasers can see you.

YOUR GAME, YOUR RULES
Every rule has its own switch and its own numbers: game length, head start, reveal timing, the size of the game area, transport limits, team sizes and more. Turn on optional rules like the endgame, going dark, jailbreaks or letting runners see the chasers.

BUILT FOR THE STREET
- Works with the phone in your pocket: location sharing and alerts keep going while the screen is off.
- A live map with your own position, the game area and every reveal.
- The game master can pause, add time, reveal a team or message everyone.
- Invite friends with a link or a six-letter code.
- English and Hungarian.

Great for friends, birthdays, school trips, team building and events.

Location is only shared with the players of your game, and only while a game is running.

name: MotifBench
description:
Turn a small melodic idea into a measured composition you can hear, revise and carry with you.

MotifBench is a free offline tool for single-line treble melodies on iPhone. Create a composition, choose meter and tempo, and enter pitched notes or rests in a touch editor. Each measure shows its remaining time and rejects notes that exceed its capacity.

Try alternatives with Undo/Redo, copy measures, transpose within each selected instrument’s supported range, and arrange named sections with repeats. Saved drafts reopen after relaunch. Search, duplicate or deliberately delete compositions in your library.

Compare your authored phrase in a searchable workbench of 120 sampled instruments across 15 families, or choose four native synthesized voices. Edit per-note velocity to shape dynamics, save your sound and follow the current measure. Contrabass supports C3–A3, Tuba/Baritone Sax C3–C5, and other sounds C3–C6. The editor prevents incompatible notes. Pause, resume or stop playback. There are no downloads, microphone recording or online sound services.

Save a real Standard MIDI File, a paginated treble staff PDF, or an editable composition backup through Files. Restore MotifBench version-1 or version-2 JSON backups without overwriting existing IDs; invalid input leaves your library unchanged. MIDI import is not supported.

Open directly to your saved composition library, with no sign-in or registration. Compositions remain on your device. Export backups before reinstalling the app or replacing your device.

Read the guide, privacy policy and terms offline. No purchases, subscriptions, ads, tracking, runtime AI or network services.

name: Motopista 1 Via
MotorShed: Vehicle Service Log
description:
MotorShed keeps track of your cars, trucks, motorcycles, boats, and trailers: what they are, what was done to them, and what's due next. Add a vehicle in seconds, then fill in the details whenever you have them.

EVERYTHING ABOUT EACH VEHICLE
Year, make, model, trim, color, VIN, plate, registration, purchase date and price, mileage, engine, tires, oil type, paint code, insurance, and loan. Add your own fields for the rest, and pick an icon or use a photo.

SERVICE HISTORY
Log oil changes, repairs, DIY jobs, washes, detailing, and inspections with the date, mileage, shop, cost, and the parts used. Attach receipts and photos. See what each vehicle has cost you, and filter by kind.

REMINDERS AND NOTIFICATIONS
Get reminded before the registration, insurance, or inspection runs out, and when service is due by date or by mileage, whichever comes first. Mark one done, and MotorShed logs it and schedules the next. Due Soon shows what's overdue and coming up across all your vehicles.

SHOPS
Save the shops, dealers, and car washes you use, call them or get directions, and see everything each one has done. Find Nearby opens Apple Maps to repair shops, car washes, detailers, tire shops, and EV chargers around you.

DOCUMENTS
Scan the registration, insurance card, title, and receipts with your iPhone camera, and keep them with the vehicle.

SHARE WITH FAMILY
Share one vehicle with family through iCloud, so everyone who drives it sees its service history and reminders. Your other vehicles stay private.

MAC AND IPHONE, IN SYNC
Everything syncs through your private iCloud storage. One purchase covers both.

EXPORT EVERYTHING
Export one zip with a spreadsheet for Numbers and Excel, CSV files, and every photo and document. Handy when you sell a car, and your data is never locked in.

FREE FOR 2 VEHICLES
MotorShed is free for 2 vehicles, with the service log, reminders, documents, sharing, and export. One purchase, shared with your family, unlocks unlimited vehicles and warranty tracking.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, and no tracking. Your records stay on your devices and in your own iCloud storage, where only you can read them.

Questions or ideas? Visit johnpolaschek.com/apps/motorshed/support.

name: Movora: Workout Tracker
description:
Movora is a workout guide and tracker that works entirely on your iPhone.

PLANS FOR EVERY GOAL
Choose from 8 ready-made plans: 7-Day Starter, Full Body 4 Weeks, Core Crusher 14 Days, Home HIIT Burn, Lower Body Strength, Upper Body Builder, Morning Mobility 10 min and the 30-Day Consistency Challenge. Movora suggests one based on your goal, level and schedule.

GUIDED WORKOUT PLAYER
Follow each exercise with demo images, a large timer or rep counter, rest countdowns, voice cues, beeps and haptics. Pause, skip, go back or add rest whenever you need to.

EXERCISE LIBRARY
45 bodyweight and dumbbell exercises for chest, back, shoulders, arms, legs, glutes, core, cardio and stretching, each with clear steps, form tips and target muscles.

CUSTOM WORKOUTS
Build your own routines, reorder exercises by dragging, and set sets, reps, time and rest.

PROGRESS
Weekly activity rings, a minutes chart, a monthly calendar, streaks, personal records, a weight log and full workout history. Unlock 15 achievements along the way.

WATER AND REMINDERS
Track daily water and set gentle reminders for workouts and water.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no analytics. Movora makes no network connections, and your data stays on your device. Export a backup file whenever you like.

Please consult a qualified professional before starting an exercise program. Calorie figures are estimates.

name: Mr Elephant AI Receptionist
description:
Keep your business calls organized with Mr Elephant AI Receptionist.

This companion app gives existing businesses a native place to review receptionist calls and follow up with their team.

Browse and search recent calls, read summaries and available transcripts, add notes and update follow-up status. View monthly call and minute totals and call a customer back from their call details.

Explore fictional sample calls before signing in. Sample mode never contacts anyone.

An existing Mr Elephant business account is required for your own calls. The app does not sell subscriptions. Features depend on your business service and account permissions.

name: Ms Dan's Academy
description: This App is meant for learners enrolled at Ms Dan's Academy and Instructors of Ms Dan's Academy. On this App instructors can conduct live sessions and learners can join them. Instructors can also add content and share that with learners. Additionally, instructors can create and conduct tests and quizzes which can be attempted by learners.

name: MuchoFut
description:
MuchoFut es una comunidad para quienes viven el fútbol dentro y fuera de la cancha.

DESCUBRE EL FÚTBOL DE LA COMUNIDAD
Explora videos, mira el Top 5 y encuentra jugadas de otros aficionados. Da Me gusta, califica y comparte tus favoritas.

GRABA Y COMPARTE TUS JUGADAS
Graba desde la app o elige un video de tu galería. Sube videos de hasta 60 segundos y 50 MB. Las publicaciones pasan por revisión antes de aparecer en la comunidad. Comparte únicamente contenido que tengas derecho a publicar.

TU PERFIL Y TU BIBLIOTECA
Crea tu cuenta con Apple, Google o un código por correo. Consulta tus publicaciones y sus vistas, valoraciones y Me gusta. Sigue a otros creadores y descubre sus videos en Siguiendo.

UNA COMUNIDAD QUE CUIDAMOS ENTRE TODOS
Reporta contenido, bloquea creadores y administra tu cuenta desde la app. Puedes solicitar un aviso por correo cuando tu video sea aprobado.

MuchoFut: el fútbol que tú grabas.

name: MuegeStent
description:
MuegeStent est un outil d'archives pour les restaurateurs et les collectionneurs d'horloges mécaniques anciennes. Conçu autour des pendules françaises et des mouvements Japy Frères, il rassemble chaque démontage, chaque pièce et chaque relevé de marche dans un dossier traçable.

L'atelier récapitule les pièces fichées, les dossiers en cours, les pièces à refaire et l'écart moyen de marche. L'inventaire consigne la désignation, la famille, le type d'horloge, le fabricant, l'époque, la matière, le module, la denture, le pivot et le spiral, avec les micrographies associées. La cinématique présente le rouage principal, l'échappement, le ressort moteur, la minuterie et la sonnerie, ainsi que les liaisons amont, aval et appariées. Les dossiers relient notes de démontage, étapes, journal d'intervention, relevés de marche et livraison. Le manuel d'atelier conserve les gestes techniques, les précautions, les consommables et les répliques tournées à la main, avec tolérances et impact sur la précision.

Les fiches de pièces, registres de restauration, rapports de contrôle final et inventaires s'exportent et se partagent.

name: Muinmyoz
description: Muinmyoz helps you remember houseplant care at home. Add plants, set watering intervals, log water or fertilizer visits, and see what is due soon—no account, no cloud, no push alerts.

name: MV Lyrics Studio
description:
MV Lyrics Studio turns any song into an eye-catching lyric video in minutes — designed for singers, songwriters, DJs, remix producers, and music creators.

TRENDING REMIX STAGES & 29 VISUAL THEMES
• 9 Electrifying Remix Stage Templates: Make every beat drop hit harder with Cyber Neon, Cosmic Gold, Crimson, Galaxy, Volt Indigo, Ultraviolet, Midnight Bloom, Lunar Gate, and Dune Twilight — complete with bass-reactive speakers, stage lighting, and glowing waveforms.
• 20 Signature Lyric Styles: Warm acoustic ballads, nostalgic memories, retro vibes, sunset moods, ocean waves, and sweet pastel themes for every genre.
• Custom Style Builder: Personalize colors, backgrounds, and typography to match your artist identity.

FAST, SIMPLE WORKFLOW ON MOBILE
• One-Tap Timecode Sync: Play your track and tap along to sync every verse, chorus, and drop effortlessly.
• Landscape & Vertical Ready: Instantly create horizontal videos for YouTube and vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
• Spinning Vinyl & Dynamic Lyrics: Beat-synced audio waves, expressive lyric motion, and custom brand logos or artist watermarks.
• Cloud Song Library: Keep your tracks, lyrics, cover art, and synced timecodes seamlessly available across your phone and mvlyrics.com.

FLEXIBLE CREDITS & MEMBERSHIP PLANS
• Start free with monthly included credits to try all 29 lyric and Remix themes.
• Top up non-expiring Base Credits anytime via In-App Purchase or unlock PRO, VIP, and V.VIP memberships for higher monthly allowances, watermark removal, custom brand logos, and PNG title typography.

Privacy Policy: https://mvlyrics.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://mvlyrics.com/terms
Support: support@mvlyrics.com

name: My House - Ma Maison
description:
My House – Ma Maison is Cameroon's marketplace for homes, stays and local services. Find a house or apartment to rent or buy, land, a guest house or hotel for a short stay, a student room near campus, or a trusted professional for the job – all in one app.

FIND YOUR NEXT HOME
• Houses, apartments, studios, rooms, land and event halls across Yaoundé, Douala, Buea, Bamenda, Limbe, Kribi and more
• Real photos and videos, prices, neighbourhoods and maps
• Listings checked by our team, with verified badges for properties inspected by field agents
• "Homes near you" uses your location (only while you use the app, never stored)

STAY IN A GUEST HOUSE OR HOTEL
• Browse guest houses and hotels with nightly prices and amenities
• Book & pay here: the owner accepts, you pay with MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money, and My House holds the money until your stay is done
• Pay in full, or reserve with a small fee and pay the rest on arrival
• Get a PDF receipt with a code the property checks before check-in

HOME SERVICES AND LOCAL BUSINESSES
• Cleaners, plumbers, electricians, movers, caterers, salons and more
• Ratings and reviews, plus a "Top rated" spotlight for businesses customers love
• Book a service and pay safely – the provider is paid once the job is confirmed

FOR OWNERS AND BUSINESSES
• List houses, guest houses and student rooms, or create a business profile for your services
• Business portal: accept or decline requests, verify guest receipts, record check-in, mark listings available or taken, and follow your income

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• English and French
• Light and dark mode with colour styles
• Notifications at every step of a booking
• Chat with owners and our support team

Protected payments: money paid for a booking is held by My House and only released to the owner after both sides confirm. If the owner cancels, you're refunded.

name: My Pet Records: Pet Care
description:
Keep every pet’s story and care in one beautifully organized place.

PET PROFILES
Give each pet their own profile with a photo, name, species, breed, birthday, automatically updated age, owner details and veterinary contact information.

HEALTH & CARE
Organize vaccinations, health notes, appointments and important documents. See upcoming care across your pets and explore dates in the calendar.

REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR ROUTINE
Choose how early to be reminded, how often reminders repeat and how many notifications you receive. You can disable them at any time.

YOUR RECORDS, CLOSE TO YOU
Records are saved on your device. Share a backup and restore it when needed. No app account is required. English and Spanish are available in Settings.

MY PET RECORDS PLUS
The app is free to download. Creating and editing pet profiles, health records, care planning and reminders requires Plus. Choose USD $3.99 per month or a one-time USD $14.99 purchase for lifetime access. Local prices are displayed by the App Store before purchase.

Eligible new subscribers receive one month free with the monthly subscription, then it renews automatically at the displayed price unless cancelled. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before renewal. Lifetime access is a separate one-time purchase and does not cancel an existing monthly subscription. Restore purchases in Settings. Existing records remain available to view and export after a subscription ends.

My Pet Records is a personal organizer. It does not provide veterinary advice or certify medical records.

Privacy Policy: https://my-pet-records-support.laceyaura.chatgpt.site/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: My Turn To Talk
description:
My Turn To Talk is a free talking picture board for children who do not speak yet, or who need help being understood.

Tap a picture and the iPad says the word. Start with a few big buttons and move up a stage when your child is ready. Words your child has already learned never change place.

WHAT IT DOES
• Six stages, from 10 first words to pages of everyday words and typed sentences
• Word pages for people, food, feelings, places, things, questions and numbers
• Turns single taps into short sentences, if you want it to
• Optional listening: when someone asks your child a question, the app can offer answers to tap
• Add your own words with your own photos
• A lock so little hands stay on the board
• Sign in with an emailed code, no password. Your setup is saved and can be copied to another device.

MADE BY A PARENT
My Turn To Talk was built by a dad for his daughter. It is free, has no ads, and sells nothing.

My Turn To Talk does not replace a speech-language pathologist. Ask your child's therapist how it fits with their plan.

name: MySafeKeys
description:
mySafeKeys is a password manager built on zero-knowledge encryption: everything you store is encrypted on your device with a key made from your master password. The server only ever receives the encrypted form, so nobody but you can read your vault.

KEEP EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• Passwords, payment cards, secure notes, addresses, bank accounts, passports and other documents
• Folders and favourites, fast search
• One-time codes (TOTP) for two-factor sign-in, right next to the password

FILL PASSWORDS ANYWHERE
• Password AutoFill in Safari, Chrome and other apps
• Suggestions above the keyboard for the site you are on
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID instead of typing the master password

SHARE SAFELY
• Shared folders that stay in sync for everyone in them, end-to-end encrypted
• Read-only or edit permissions for each person
• Send a single item to another mySafeKeys user
• Emergency access for someone you trust

STAY SECURE
• Password generator with strength meter
• Security dashboard: weak, reused and old passwords, sign-ins without HTTPS
• Check your passwords against known data breaches without revealing them
• Two-step sign-in with an authenticator app, e-mail codes or backup codes
• Automatic lock, clipboard clearing, and a privacy screen in the app switcher

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• AES-256-GCM encryption; the key never leaves your devices
• Import from other password managers and browsers (CSV), export an encrypted backup
• Delete your account and all its data at any time from the app
• No ads, no trackers, no analytics

mySafeKeys accounts are created by invitation. You need a registration token from the service operator to sign up.

The same vault is available in the mySafeKeys browser extension and on the web.

name: MySevino Scale
description:
Pozrite sa na obrazovku. Vedľa seba stoja dva objekty. Prvý je vaša úloha, druhý je referencia. Žiadne pravítko, iba vaše oko. Spoľahnite sa na vlastný pohľad a odhadnite, aký veľký je prvý objekt v porovnaní s druhým.

Chyťte prvý objekt a ťahajte. Zväčšujte ho alebo zmenšujte, kým podľa vás nebude mať tú správnu veľkosť. Každý pohyb prsta mení váš odhad. Pri dolaďovaní postupujte jemne, po malých krokoch. Jeden prudký ťah vás môže poriadne vychýliť. Trpezlivosť sa vypláca.

Keď ste spokojní, odhad zamknete. Zamknutie je rozhodnutie. Objekt zostane presne tam, kde ste ho nechali, a už sa nedá zmeniť. Váš odhad, vaša voľba, vaša zodpovednosť.

Na chvíľu sa zastavte. Pozrite sa ešte raz. Porovnajte hrany, výšku a pomery. Zamknite až vtedy, keď ste si istí.

A potom príde pravda. MySevino Scale ukáže, ako blízko sa vaše oko dostalo k skutočnej veľkosti. Svoj odhad a skutočný pomer uvidíte vedľa seba. Výsledok nie je len áno alebo nie. Presne vidíte, o koľko ste sa pomýlili, alebo ako presne ste trafili. Aj malé rozdiely majú význam.

To je celá hra. Jeden ťah. Jeden odhad. Jedno zamknutie. Jeden výsledok, ktorý vám prezradí viac, než by ste čakali.

Vaše oko je rýchle, ale nie vždy presné. Mnohí z nás sú presvedčení, že veľkosti odhadnú na prvý pohľad. Táto hra to preverí. Dobrý odhad nie je náhoda. Je to výsledok pozornosti a trochy cviku.

Hrať môže každý. Nepotrebujete čísla, tabuľky ani zložité pravidlá. Stačí sa pozrieť a potiahnuť prstom. Kolo trvá len chvíľku a nevyžaduje žiadnu prípravu.

Pre koho je určená? Pre každého, kto hľadá krátku hru na prestávku pri káve, cestu v MHD alebo chvíľu na gauči pred spaním. Hrá sa rýchlo a prestať môžete kedykoľvek.

Prečo to funguje? Kým ťaháte objekt, sledujete hrany, pomery a vzdialenosť od referencie. Mozog pritom počíta sám od seba, bez toho, aby ste mu to prikázali. Keď odhad zamknete, prichádza chvíľa napätia. Chcete vedieť, či ste mali pravdu. Túto chvíľu si nenecháte ujsť.

Otvorte MySevino Scale a zistite, čo vaše oko naozaj dokáže.

name: Mywa
description:
Mywa puts your business’s customer chats in one shared inbox, so your team can answer every message on time.

SHARED INBOX
• Every customer chat in one place, with unread, waiting and unassigned filters
• Assign or reassign a chat to a teammate in two taps
• See who has been waiting longest, and which chats are about to close their free reply window
• Tags, internal notes and contact details right inside the chat
• Send photos, videos, documents and approved message templates

YOUR TEAM, IN SYNC
• Live updates as messages arrive and chats change hands
• Workload view: who is online, how many chats each person holds, and who needs cover
• Roles for admins and agents, so everyone sees what they should

NEVER MISS A CUSTOMER
• Push notifications for new messages, new leads and assignments
• Reply or mark as read straight from the notification
• Reminders to follow up with a customer at the right time

CAMPAIGNS AND RESULTS
• Send approved templates to a list of contacts
• Track delivered, read and replied for every campaign
• Analytics for response times and team performance

CONTACTS AND LEADS
• Search, tag and group contacts
• Add people from your phone contacts
• New leads from your ads show up with their source

Mywa works with the WhatsApp Business Platform. You need a Mywa workspace to use the app: set one up at mywa.net.

WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC. Mywa is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp LLC or Meta.

name: Naseh | ناصح
description:
Naseh — Egypt’s savings app
Guidance you can trust.

Save more on every purchase at partner merchants: a real discount when you pay with your QR, plus points on every purchase that turn into more savings.

How it works
1. Get a Naseh card from your nearest branch and activate it in the app
2. Show your QR at checkout — the merchant scans it
3. The discount applies instantly and points land in your balance

What you get
• Real discounts across the partner network
• Find nearest and top-rated merchants on the map
• Points with cash value and boost days that multiply earnings
• Membership tiers: Bronze, Silver, and Gold
• Family sharing with one shared points balance
• Book clinic and salon appointments in the app
• Favorites, reviews, and alerts for offers and boost days
• Free trial, then an annual plan with a Naseh card

Everyday categories
Restaurants, supermarket, cafés, pharmacies, clinics, salons, fashion, electronics, gyms, and more.

Naseh — save together, in one app.

name: Naylon Kumanda: Tamir Oyunu
description:
Apartmanın tamircisi Hamdi'nin tezgâhına herkes bozuk bir eşya getiriyor: naylonlu kumanda, susmuş çevirmeli telefon, teybe dolanmış kaset. Hamdi'nin elleri sensin. Parmağınla sil, sök, tak, çevir; eşyayı sahibine sağlam teslim et.

PARMAĞINLA TAMİR ET
• Kiri ov, parçayı sürükleyip yerine tak, anteni çevir, kapağı kaydır, doğru aleti seç, düğmeye basılı tut.
• Her eşyanın kendi derdi var; doğru sırayı bulmak sana kalmış.
• Yeni bir hareket ilk kez gelince sahnenin köşesinde bir parmak yolu gösterir.

10 RAFTA 245 EŞYA
Salon, Mutfak, Elektronik ve Ses, Atölye ve Alet, Giyim ve Dikiş, Okul ve Kırtasiye, Oyuncak ve Oyun, Bayram ve Kutlama, Kış ve Ev Bakımı, Mahalle ve Dükkân. Sarkaçlı duvar saati, düdüklü tencere, pikap, dolma kalem, topaç, kristal şekerlik, soba, yazar kasa ve daha niceleri, hepsi kanalın çizim diliyle.

TAKILIRSAN ÇAY PARASI
İpucu kendiliğinden gelmez; biraz akıl yürütmek gerekir. Takılınca Hamdi belli belirsiz bir laf atar. Açık ipucu kumbaradaki iki çay parasına gelir; kumbara boşsa biraz beklersin, Hamdi ipucunu bedava verir. Her yeni tamir bahşiş getirir; ipucusuz ve hatasız bitirirsen fazlası gelir. Biriken çay parasıyla süs dükkânından kart çerçevesi ve tezgâh süsü alırsın. İpucunu hiç dert etmek istemezsen tek seferlik Sınırsız çay her ipucunu ve süsü bedava yapar.

HER TAMİR BİR ANI
Tamir bitince o eşyaya özel bir anı kartı çıkar. "Kime?" yazıp sevdiğine gönder. Komşunun eşyası onarıldıkça Hamdi'nin apartmanında onun penceresi yanar; apartmanın posterini de paylaşabilirsin.

AYRICA
• Dükkânın takviminde her gün bir "Günün işi"
• İstersen akşamları günün işini haber veren hatırlatıcı
• Kapıda bekleyen komşuyu gösteren ana ekran widget'ı
• Game Center başarımları
• Büyük yazı ve VoiceOver desteği
• iPhone ve iPad

ÜCRETSİZ BAŞLA
Her raftaki ilk iki eşya ücretsiz: toplam 20 eşya. Üstelik her gün defterden bir eşya daha o günlüğüne ücretsiz açılır. Defterin geri kalanı tek seferlik bir satın almayla açılır; Sınırsız çay da tek seferliktir, istersen ikisini birlikte paket olarak alırsın. Reklam yok, abonelik yok, hesap açman gerekmez.

Naylon Kumanda, aynı adlı animasyon kanalının oyunudur; Hamdi, komşular ve bütün çizimler kanala aittir.

Tezgâhtaki tamirler oyundur; elektrik ve gaz işini yetkili ustaya bırak.

Gizlilik: https://naylonkumanda.com/uygulama/gizlilik/
Kullanım koşulları: https://naylonkumanda.com/uygulama/kullanim-kosullari/

name: NDT Logbook
description:
NDT Logbook is a personal record of your NDT experience on your iPhone: hours per method, supervisor signatures, certificates and vision tests. It counts hours the way your scheme does, so you can see how many hours are left before you can apply for the level you are working toward.

HOURS THAT COUNT
ISO 9712 counts experience in days of 7 hours and credits at most 12 hours per calendar day across all methods. The app applies both rules every time you log. Work 14 hours on a turnaround and it shows that 12 will count.

Your goal shows hours and days against the requirement: 945 h (135 days) for UT Level 2 from Level 1 under PCN, or 420 h for MT Level 2 direct access. From your pace over the last 90 days, the app estimates the month you will reach it.

Schemes included: PCN, NRCan and CSWIP under ISO 9712, ASNT 9712, and SNT-TC-1A and NAS 410 / EN 4179 with values you can edit to match your employer's written practice. Reductions are built in, such as 25% when you add a method and 50% for PCN Level 3 with a technical degree.

LOGGING A SHIFT
Pick the method (UT, RT, MT, PT, VT or ET) and the technique, for example PAUT, TOFD, TFM or digital RT. Add the product, site, procedure, equipment and report numbers that certification bodies ask for when they check your hours. You can photograph the report and attach it. Copy last entry fills in the same job for the next shift. Training courses are logged too, but they are kept out of your experience total.

SIGNED ON SITE
Hand the phone to your supervisor. They review the batch, enter their name, certificate number and level, and sign with a finger. The app warns when their level or methods do not cover the work. Signed entries lock. If you correct one later, you give a reason, and the change appears on every export. If your supervisor prefers paper, print a sign sheet instead.

CERTIFICATES AND DEADLINES
Add the certificates you hold to see expiry dates and the renewal window for your scheme. PCN asks you to apply at least 6 weeks before expiry; NRCan between 12 and 4 months before. ISO 9712 treats more than 12 months without work in a method as a significant interruption, so the app reminds you after 9 months without an entry. It also tracks near vision tests (every 12 months) and colour vision tests (every 5 years). Reminders are local notifications at 9:00.

EXPORTS FOR YOUR APPLICATION
Experience summary PDF, hours and days per method
Full log PDF with signature images and change history
Layout compatible with PCN Form 2 fields, to attach to your PSL/30 application
CSV for Excel or Numbers
Filter by method, the last 12 months or the last 5 years. Each PDF carries an integrity code built from the signature chain.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
There is no account, no server and no analytics. Entries, photos and signatures are stored on the phone. One tap makes a backup file that you save to Files, iCloud Drive or Google Drive, and you can restore it on a new phone. The home screen tells you when your last backup is getting old.

FREE AND PRO
Logging, signatures, certificates, reminders, CSV export and backup are free, with one goal. Pro adds more goals, PDF exports and saved supervisors. You can try Pro for 14 days in the app without entering payment details. After that, Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. Your records stay yours either way: CSV export and backup never need Pro.

NDT Logbook helps you keep records. It does not certify anyone, and it is not affiliated with BINDT, PCN, ASNT, NRCan, TWI, CSWIP or ISO. The rules of your certification body and your employer's written practice take priority.

Terms of Use: https://www.coopmade.com/ndt-logbook/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.coopmade.com/ndt-logbook/privacy

name: NEADEUX
description: NEADEUX is a system designed for managing income, recording payments, and reconciling funds at the end of each month. Upon receiving income, funds can be allocated—either as a specific amount or a percentage—to various categories, such as housing, transportation, education, or savings. These allocation models can be saved for future use. When recording a payment, both the source account and the purpose of the payment are specified; a single expense can also be split across multiple accounts and categories. Funds earmarked for specific purposes are kept separate and are only recorded as actual expenses when a payment occurs. Any refunds automatically return funds to the available balance of the corresponding category. You can view your balances from two different perspectives—by account or by category—and track the history of each allocation, expense, or adjustment. At the end of the month, you can process remaining reservations, category balances, or account discrepancies by carrying them over to the next period or reallocating them. Additionally, you can generate a detailed summary, which can be examined more closely to verify the data.

name: NEAMX
description: NEAMXWhen organizing personal expenses, you can distinguish between direct payments and credit-based transactions, while monitoring your available funds, current outstanding balance, and total expenses for the month. Once individual transactions are assigned to a bill, you can expand the view to see a detailed breakdown of charges, refunds, and repayments. A single repayment can be allocated across multiple bills, with the system tracking the total allocated amount and the remaining balance after payment. For installment plans, the original expense is retained, while the schedule displays the principal, service fees, and actual repayment progress. Refunds are linked to their original transactions, with the amounts updated upon receipt. A review page allows you to compare your actual bills against your locally recorded data, helping to identify unrecorded, potentially duplicate, or modified entries. Additionally, monthly charts provide a visual overview of your expense structure, cash outflows, and changes in your outstanding debt.

name: Neighbor Or Not
description: It's 1955, and for unknown reasons, doppelgangers are more common than usual. Therefore, the Department of Doppelganger Detection (D.D.D.) has taken action. You are the doorman of an apartment complex, and you must decide whether to let in those who claim to be your neighbors.

name: Neon Brick Arcade
description:
Neon Brick Arcade is a neon-lit brick breaker inspired by 80s arcades. Slide the paddle with your finger, bounce the ball and break every brick. Easy to pick up, and the later levels take real skill.

WHAT'S INSIDE • 5 worlds, 60 levels, each world ending with a boss • Endless mode: the bricks keep coming down, chase your best score • Exploding, hidden and sliding bricks, descending walls • Power-ups: shield, laser, magnet, multi-ball and more; careful, some capsules make it harder • Combo multiplier and 1-3 stars on every level • 3 daily missions and a day streak • 12 skins to unlock as you play • Game Center leaderboards

FOR EVERYONE • Big buttons and easy-to-read text • "Relaxed" mode: wider paddle, slower ball • Sound and vibration settings • English and Turkish

NO ADS No ads, no subscription, no internet needed, no data collected. World 1 and Endless mode are completely free. A one-time "Full version" purchase unlocks worlds 2-4 (36 levels, 3 bosses), endless rounds and the Retro skin. The hardest world, "Golden Palace" (12 levels), is a separate one-time pack. Family Sharing is supported.

name: Neon Relay: Bridge Puzzles
description:
One piece is a tap away from its socket. Send it home now, though, and the bridge its partner needs goes dark.

In Neon Relay, each piece follows its own rail. Tap to advance to the next stop. Leave a piece on a switch to power a crossing somewhere else on the board. Follow the glowing link, move the piece that needs the bridge, then bring its partner home.

Work your way through 50 logic puzzles. Start with two pieces that take turns helping each other. Later, one switch can power two crossings. In the final relay, four pieces share the work. Getting them all home depends on who crosses first and who stays behind.

If a bridge goes dark too soon, undo a move and try a different order. The game saves your progress on your device. You can adjust the music, sound effects and reduced motion in Settings.

name: Neriflux
description:
Neriflux is a portrait single-player arcade shooter. Drag to fly and fire automatically. Capture eligible enemy bullets, then tap again to fire them back.

· Play and replay the three missions of Chapter 1 for free
· One permanent purchase unlocks chapters 2–5, side missions and exploration
· Earn three aircraft, three primary weapons and build-defining modules through play
· Story, Standard and Challenge difficulties with mission ranks
· Short missions, pause controls and locally saved progress
· No ads or subscriptions. Play offline; buying and restoring purchases require internet access

name: NetaLock
description:
NetaLock, Mako Shark markalı GPS destekli sanal çapa (trolling) motorları için geliştirilmiş akıllı deniz kumandası ve telemetri kokpitidir.

UYUMLULUK & HARİCİ DONANIM GEREKSİNİMİ
• Canlı sanal çapa kontrolü ve motor telemetrisi için tekneye bağlanan harici NetaLock / Mako-SmartConnect kablosuz Bluetooth köprü modülü gereklidir (ayrı temin edilir).
• Mevcut sürümde Mako Shark (SANVU 155 / SV155 serisi) sanal çapa motorları desteklenmektedir; yeni modeller (OMAIS 255 vb.) ve ek marka destekleri sonraki güncellemelerle eklenecektir.
• Harici modül veya motor bağlı değilken de deniz haritası, mera/GPX yönetimi ve dahili simülasyon modu üzerinden tüm kokpit özelliklerini inceleyebilirsiniz.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER
• Temel Motor Kumandası (Ücretsiz): Sancak/İskele dümen dönüşü, pervane başlatma/durdurma, kademeli hız kontrolü ve tek dokunuşla Acil Durdurma (E-Stop).
• Sanal Çapa / Anchor Lock (Pro): GPS nokta kilidi, 5 m / 10 m yönlü Çapa Kaydırma (Anchor Jog) ve canlı sürüklenme yarıçapı uyarısı.
• Deniz Haritası, Meralar & I-TRACK (Pro): Avlak/mera kaydetme, GPX içe/dışa aktarma, Go-To otonom hedefe gidiş ve I-TRACK sırtı rotaları.
• Yön Kilidi (Pilot) & Sabit Hız (Cruise) (Pro): Pruva açısı sabitleme ve yere göre sabit hız kontrolü.
• Canlı JK-BMS LiFePO4 Akü Zekası (Pro): 4S/8S bireysel hücre voltajları, anlık akım (A), kalan kapasite (Ah), MOSFET sıcaklığı ve akü sağlık takibi.
• Açık Denizde Çevrimdışı Çalışma: Bluetooth (BLE) bağlantısı ve iOS Keychain lisans önbelleği sayesinde açık denizde internet olmadan kesintisiz çalışır.

ABONELİK BİLGİLERİ (NETALOCK PRO)
• NetaLock Pro Aylık (₺249 / ay) ve NetaLock Pro Yıllık (₺2.499 / yıl) otomatik yenilenen abonelik seçenekleri sunulur.
• Ödeme, satın alma onayında Apple ID hesabınızdan tahsil edilir. Abonelik, mevcut dönemin bitiminden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmedikçe otomatik olarak yenilenir.
• Aboneliğinizi iPhone Ayarlar → Apple Hesabı → Abonelikler bölümünden dilediğiniz zaman yönetebilir veya iptal edebilirsiniz.

Gizlilik Politikası: https://netalock-marine.web.app/privacy
Kullanım Koşulları (EULA): https://netalock-marine.web.app/terms

name: netcon
description:
See where your network gets bad.

netcon runs quietly in the background as you go about your day, measuring Wi-Fi and/or cellular quality at each location and building a private heat map of the results. Open the map tab and see, at a glance, which parts of your commute, neighbourhood, or building have strong coverage and which spots are reliably slow or lossy.

WHAT IT MEASURES
netcon probes latency, packet loss, and download throughput using lightweight HTTPS requests — no custom server required. Results are colour-coded from excellent (green) to bad (red) and plotted onto a grid map at 25-metre resolution. The map gets sharper the more you use the app.

STAYS IN THE BACKGROUND
Once monitoring is enabled, netcon adapts its probe frequency to your movement: more frequent while you're walking or driving, slower while you're stationary. It uses iOS background location and task scheduling to keep collecting without you having to think about it. A notification lets you know it's still running when the app isn't open.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
There's no account, no analytics SDK, and no netcon servers: your samples never leave your phone unless you choose to export them. (Place names in the log come from Apple Maps, using an approximate location.) Location coordinates are stored locally and can be fuzzed on export. BSSID identifiers are hashed immediately and never stored in plain text.

EXPORT WHEN YOU WANT IT
Logs → Export gives you a choice of formats: a full diagnostic bundle (JSON manifest, CSV samples, CSV tiles), a plain CSV of your samples, or a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ready to open in QGIS, Felt, or any mapping tool that speaks GeoJSON.

CONFIGURABLE
- Choose which network type to monitor: all, Wi-Fi only, or cellular only
- Customise the probe host list (Settings → Probe hosts) or restore the defaults
- Keep samples for a week, a month, a year (the default) or forever
- Battery-aware mode pauses probes below 20% when unplugged
- Data saver skips throughput tests on metered connections

name: Neurodama Checkers
description:
Classic checkers, free and quiet: no ads, no accounts, no tracking. Play a Robot, a friend beside you, or a friend anywhere online.

THREE ROBOTS TO PLAY
• Random Robot – picks any legal move. A gentle start for beginners.
• Smart Robot – a traditional search engine with four Levels: easy, medium, hard and expert.
• Neural Robot – the same search guided by a neural network trained on 100,000 games the Robots played against each other. Against the Smart Robot at expert it wins more than half its games and almost never loses.

PLAY A FRIEND
• Beside you: two players take turns on one device.
• Online: create an invite and send the link or the eight-character code. Your friend can join from this app or straight from a web browser at play.neurodama.com, with nothing to install.
• Online games have no clock. Make a move, put your device away, and come back when your friend has replied.

THE RULES YOU KNOW
American checkers (English draughts) on an 8×8 board: men move diagonally forward, kings move both ways, captures are compulsory, and a multi-jump is one move. A game is drawn on threefold repetition or after 40 moves each without a capture or a man moving.

MADE TO BE EASY
• Move hints show which pieces can move, where they can go and which captures you must make. Turn them off any time.
• Leave a game whenever you like and pick it up later from the home screen.
• Robot games and games beside a friend work fully offline.

PRIVACY
Nothing about you is collected. Games on your device stay on your device. For online games the server keeps only the moves and a randomly generated name for each player, and deletes the game a week after it ends. Read more at neurodama.com/privacy.html.

name: NextKind
description:
One thing forward. Even on busy days.

NextKind helps you remember what needs doing, without making planning another chore. Add a task, choose a date and time, and receive a reminder or alarm.

KEEP IT SIMPLE
See today's tasks and unfinished plans at a glance. Repeats, priorities, notes, and other options stay in Task options until you need them.

GET AN ALARM WHEN IT MATTERS
On iOS 26 or later, new tasks default to alarms. Stopping an alarm leaves the task unfinished so you can check it later.

Prefer a standard notification? Switch off the alarm in Task options.

START FREE
• Create up to 10 active tasks
• Schedule reminders for a date and time
• Use alarms on supported devices
• Repeat daily, on weekdays, weekly, or monthly
• Add categories, priorities, notes, and checklists
• Search tasks and review completed actions
• Export and restore backups
• Choose Japanese or English
• Use light or dark appearance

UNLOCK EVERYTHING WITH ONE PURCHASE
• Remove the 10-active-task limit
• Replan your schedule with Busy-day mode
• Break a larger task into a small first step
• Find tasks that fit your available time and location context
• Receive early reminders before a scheduled task

No subscription. No automatic renewal. See the purchase screen for the current price.

YOUR TASKS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
No account registration is required. The app includes no advertising or usage analytics SDKs.

Export a backup before changing devices or deleting the app. Restoring purchases does not restore your task data.

ABOUT REMINDERS AND ALARMS
Alarms require iOS 26 or later and your permission. Ringing and stopping are managed by the operating system; indefinite ringing is not guaranteed.

NextKind queues up to 30 upcoming alarm occurrences and 60 standard notifications. Each repeat occurrence counts toward these limits. Open the app regularly to replenish the queue. Reminders beyond the queued range are not guaranteed.

Standard notification delivery and sound depend on device settings, including notification permissions and Focus.

name: Ney Akort
description:
Ney Akort, neyzenler ve ney yapanlar için hazırlanmış bir çalışma aracıdır. İnternet gerekmez; mikrofon ve kamera yalnız telefonunuzda işlenir.

AKORT
• Üflediğiniz perdeyi, frekansını ve kaç cent / koma saptığını anında gösterir.
• Arel-Ezgi-Uzdilek sistemine göre 24 perde; delik delik düzeltme önerisi.
• Delikler sekmesinde sıralı ölçümle neyinizin bütün perdelerini çıkarın.

NEY VE MAKAM TANIMA
• Nevâ'yı üfleyin, neyinizin ahengini (Bolâhenk, Mansur, Kız…) bulsun.
• Çalan bir müziği dinletin; makamı ve hangi neyle çalındığını tahmin etsin.

NOTA
• Basılı notanın fotoğrafını çekin ya da PDF seçin: porteler, notalar, değiştirme işaretleri ve süreler telefonda okunur; düzeltip kaydedin, çalın.
• Ney parmak pozisyonları, ayarlanabilir tempo, kendi ney sesinizle dinleme.
• Notalarım: eserlerinizi saklayın, dosya olarak dışa ve içe aktarın.

USUL
• Kudüm ve bendir sesiyle usul; tempo ayarı ve "Tempo vur".

Türkçe, English, Français, Español ve العربية.
Reklam yok, hesap yok, veri toplama yok.

Kirişçibaba

name: Nightbank
description:
Nightbank keeps your sleep like a ledger. Every night you need a certain amount of sleep; sleep less and the difference is owed, sleep more and you pay some back. Nightbank shows what you owe as a violet tide rising in a glass, and plans a gentle way back to even.

THE DEBT TIDE
Log each night yourself in a few taps: bedtime, wake time, minutes to fall asleep, times you woke, any nap the next day, how it felt and what happened around it. Nightbank weighs the last 14 nights - recent nights count most - and shows the result as a tide in a glass vessel. One good night shows quickly; so does a short one.

TONIGHT'S LIGHTS-OUT
The repayment plan suggests a "lights out by" time for tonight, based on your sleep need, your target wake time and how long you usually take to drift off. It repays debt gradually - never more than an hour extra in a night - and counts how many nights it takes to clear, night by night.

THE BOOKS
See your average sleep, a consistency score from how much your bed and wake times wander, your social jetlag (how much later you sleep on weekends than on weekdays) and your streak of nights logged. A fourteen-night strip shows each night against your need.

PATTERNS
Tag nights with late caffeine, late screens, exercise, alcohol, stress or travel - or your own tags - and Nightbank compares the quality of nights with and without each one. A weekday chart shows which nights run long and which run short.

GENTLE REMINDER
Switch on an optional wind-down reminder and a quiet notification arrives before tonight's suggested lights-out. Permission is only asked when you switch it on.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Create an account with email and password, or simply rest as a guest - no sign-up needed. Guests can keep their nights later by adding an email. Nights you log offline are saved on your iPhone and sync when you are back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Nightbank does not read the Health app - you log every night yourself, and your entries stay in your own private account. Delete your account and every night, tag and setting from the Nightstand at any time.

CALM TO USE
A hushed night palette with an alternative Black Velvet theme, moon-phase navigation, soft optional sounds and haptics, and VoiceOver labels throughout.

Nightbank is a wellbeing tool, not medical advice. If sleep troubles persist, please talk to a doctor.

name: NiNi: Share Nice Night Moments
description:
NiNi is a place for the evening you are already in, and for the people who are out in it with you. Find a table that still has a seat, choose a walk or a market for later, or step into a room that is live right now. From a quiet line about a wet street to a song under the lamps, NiNi brings the night and the people in it together, and gives you a place to come back to the hours that stayed with you.

Look through tonight by tables, walks, and markets, and open a plan to see when it starts, who is hosting, and how many seats are left. Save a seat so it is easy to find when you are ready to go. Keep what you noticed with a photo and a note, or leave one line on Just saw, from a window seat to a small thing you are still thinking about. What you publish is there for others on NiNi. A conversation stays between you and the person you chose.

Let one evening become the start of a conversation. Share a supper, a walk, or a live room, exchange messages, and see how the same street or the same song can feel different to someone else. Shape your space with an avatar, a neighborhood, and a short bio. Whether you are keeping your own notes from the night or passing a seat to someone else, NiNi gives the evenings you care about a place to grow.

name: Ninja Trap
description:
Kolay görünen yol, beklenmedik bir tuzağa dönüşebilir!

Ninja Trap, reflekslerini ve sabrını sınayan bir platform oyunudur. Zıpla, engelleri aş ve seni şaşırtmak için hazırlanmış tuzakları keşfet. Her düşüşten ders çıkarıp yeniden dene.

• Sürpriz tuzaklarla dolu üç bölüm
• Dokunmatik hareket ve zıplama kontrolleri
• Farklı ninja görünümleri ve kostüm seçenekleri
• Ses açma ve kapatma seçeneği

Dikkatli ilerle: gördüğün her şeye güvenme!

name: Nira Samurai: Rescue Princess
description:
(Free, no ads)

Rescue Princess Ginger!

A tiny samurai with a leek on his back dashes through the Gyoza village in this hand-made 3D action game. Explore the maze, collect garlic coins to open the gates, free your captured friends, and fight your way to the top of the Supreme Castle.

HOW TO PLAY
- Left stick to move, SLASH to swing your leek
- Collect coins to open gates; rescued friends fight alongside you
- In a pinch, unleash the WAVE to blow away everything around you
- Along the way, meet the Takakibi Farmer and Yuzu Gyoza-kun for useful items

FEATURES
- Samurai, ninja and gyoza: 33 hand-made 3D characters
- Spin each one around in the gallery and watch them move
- Easy / Normal / Hard, 20 stages in all
- Five bosses, from the Gyoza King to the Black-Gold Supreme Warlord
- Controller support (PlayStation DualSense / Xbox / MFi)
- Plays on iPhone, iPad and Mac

No internet required. No ads, no in-app purchases.

name: NiuX
description:
NiuX is a messenger for chatting with friends, family and groups.

CHAT YOUR WAY
• One-to-one and group chats
• Send text, voice messages, photos, videos, files, your location and contact cards
• Reply to, forward, edit, recall and pin messages
• See when messages are read and when someone is typing
• Search your chats and messages
• Get notified about new messages

GROUPS
• Create groups and invite friends
• Set the group name, photo and announcement
• Admins can mute everyone or remove members; owners can appoint admins and transfer the group

FIND FRIENDS EASILY
• Add friends by username or QR code
• No phone number needed: sign in with your email, Google or Apple account

YOUR ACCOUNTS
• Keep several accounts on one phone and switch between them
• Pin chats, mute notifications and keep a draft in every chat

SAFETY AND CONTROL
• Block and report users or groups
• Delete your account from the app at any time

LANGUAGES
Indonesian, English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

name: Noarca
description:
Noarca est la place de marché et le réseau social des collectionneurs.

• Gérez vos collections, cartes, figurines et autres objets de collection, avec photos et suivi de leur valeur.
• Achetez et vendez entre passionnés. Faites des offres, payez en toute sécurité et suivez votre colis jusqu'à la livraison.
• Participez à des ventes en direct, présentez vos pièces en vidéo et échangez avec les acheteurs en temps réel.
• Partagez et discutez, publiez, commentez et échangez avec d'autres collectionneurs.

Noarca est actuellement en alpha fermée, l'inscription se fait sur invitation.

name: Nocara: Astrology & Horoscope
description:
Nocara is an astrology app built on real calculation. Your horoscope comes from where the planets are today compared with where they were when you were born, worked out to the minute for your birth time and place.

YOUR HOROSCOPE
• Today: the transits that matter most, picked from all of today's, with what's new, your mood and the slower background themes.
• This week and This month: the key transits and the days they peak.
• Every transit shows when it's exact, how long it lasts, and whether it's still building or easing off.

YOUR BIRTH CHART
• The full chart wheel, with Sun, Moon and Rising.
• Every planet with its sign and house, and what each placement means.
• The aspects between your planets, each with its reading.
• Don't know your birth time? Nocara says so, and never guesses your Rising sign or houses.

MATCH
• Compare your chart with someone else's: how your planets connect with theirs and, when both birth times are known, where their planets fall in your houses.

INSIGHTS
• Tonight's Moon, the next New and Full Moons, retrogrades and sign changes.
• For you: the dates in the next 30 days when transits to your own chart are exact.

HOW WE GOT THIS
Each reading comes with its working: the planets, the angle between them, how close to exact it is, and what each part stands for in traditional astrology. The written parts are interpretation, following traditional astrological meanings; the positions are calculated with the Swiss Ephemeris. The same transit always gets the same text.

REMINDERS
Choose a time of day for New and Full Moons, retrogrades, sign changes and the lead of your horoscope. Reminders are set on your phone and work offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your birth details stay on your phone. An account is optional, only for moving to a new phone.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

NOCARA PRO
Free: your full birth chart, Horoscope Today, Match with one person, the Insights calendar and Moon reminders.
Pro adds Horoscope This week and This month, For you, the readings for your chart's aspects, Match with as many people as you like with every connection and house overlay, and Your day reminders.

Pro is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. New subscribers can try the yearly plan free for 7 days. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or when the trial ends). The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://twixalot.com/apps/nocara/privacy

Nocara is for reflection and entertainment. It doesn't give medical, legal or financial advice.

name: Noctiel Pyre
description:
Noctiel Pyre is a posture science app for people who actually want to understand
what's going on in their body — not just get nudged to sit up straight. Every session is grounded in real biomechanics: how spinal load accumulates through
the day, why muscle tension builds in predictable patterns, what the research actually says about movement and pain versus what gets repeated as common sense.

The daily loop is deliberate. Each session you log how your back feels on a five-point scale — free, mild, moderate, tense, or sharp — and the app gives you specific, evidence- based guidance for that reading. Not the same generic tipon repeat. The advice adjusts to the signal you give it.

LEARN walks you through posture concepts in short lessons built around cited sources. No filler. No wellness fluff dressed up as science.

PRACTICE is where the app earns its edge. Analogy runs test whether you can carry a concept from a lesson into a new situation. Odd One Out sharpens your ability to spot what doesn't belong. Match the Pair locks terminology to definitions under time pressure. And the Weekly Boss resets every Monday —
ten questions, fifteen seconds each, no hints. If you weren't consistent last week, you will feel that gap.

PROGRESS tracks behavioral patterns across your sessions: frequency, XP, difficulty tier, skill curve. Not vanity metrics — actual signal about whether
things are moving.

JOURNAL gives you a low-friction way to record what's working for your specific body, so the small observations from a good session don't disappear by Thursday.

The XP and streak system does one thing well: makes you want to come back tomorrow. The chain breaks the moment you skip — no forgiveness bonus, no catch-up mechanic. That friction is intentional.

No subscription. No pop-up reminders every few hours. PulseGrid is built for
 the kind of person who would rather understand a problem than receive a
 notification about it.

 Siri Shortcuts support is built in. Say "start a posture session" and the
 app routes you straight to where you need to be.

name: Nocto: IPTV Player
description:
Nocto is a fast, modern IPTV player for iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Add your own provider with Xtream Codes or an M3U playlist and get a clean, easy-to-use home for your live TV, movies and series.

Nocto does not provide any channels or content. You need a subscription from an IPTV provider, or a playlist you are allowed to use.

WATCH YOUR WAY
• Live TV with what's on now and next for every channel
• Full TV guide (EPG) with catch-up for supported providers
• Multiview: up to four live channels at once on iPad and Apple TV
• Movie and series pages with plot, cast, director and ratings
• The next episode starts automatically
• Continue Watching, Recently Watched, Favorites and New This Week on your Home screen
• Sort by recently added or A–Z, and show movies and series as a grid or a list
• Search channels, movies, series, categories and actors

A PLAYER THAT JUST WORKS
• 4K and HEVC channels play in Apple's own player too, for the best picture your device can show and less battery use
• Picture in Picture: keep watching while you use other apps
• AirPlay to your TV or speakers
• One simple set of controls with a progress bar, whichever player is playing
• Smoother broadcast sports with automatic deinterlacing
• Stream Info shows resolution, codec and bitrate
• Three playback engines: Apple's native player, VLC and MPV
• Nocto switches automatically when a stream won't play, for example sound without picture
• Audio tracks, subtitles, audio sync and aspect ratio controls
• Skip 30 seconds back or forward in movies and episodes
• Sleep timer: stop after a set time or at the end of an episode
• Frame-rate matching on Apple TV for smoother sports
• Swipe on the Siri Remote to move quickly through movies and episodes

ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Sources, favorites and progress sync through your private iCloud
• iCloud backups you can restore on any device
• Continue Watching on the Apple TV Top Shelf and in a Home Screen widget on iPhone and iPad
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Play Sport One in Nocto" or "Resume watching in Nocto"
• Reminders before a programme starts (iPhone and iPad)
• Designed for the Siri Remote on Apple TV

KNOW YOUR SUBSCRIPTION
• See when your IPTV subscription ends and how many connections are in use, with a heads-up a week before it expires

FAMILY FRIENDLY
• Parental PIN that completely hides adult categories
• Nocto Pro is shared with your family through Family Sharing

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking. We don't collect any data.
• Optional actor photos come from Wikimedia Commons and can be turned off in Settings.

NOCTO PRO
Try Nocto with a free daily preview. Nocto Pro unlocks unlimited playback and Multiview on all your devices for one yearly price, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://michealmouner.github.io/nocto-site/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://michealmouner.github.io/nocto-site/privacy.html

name: Nono's Spending Spree
description:
Nono’s Spending Journey... Ready? GO!

Ever tried to lose all your money, only to accidentally strike it rich? Welcome to Spend It All, the ultimate brain-teasing casual game where your only goal is to spend EVERY SINGLE COIN until your balance hits EXACTLY $0! No negative balances allowed. One misstep, and you're back in the green!

name: Nonothrum
description:
Nonothrum is a picture logic puzzle with numbers, also known as a nonogram. The numbers next to each row and column tell you how many squares in a row are filled. Combine them step by step and you reveal a picture – a penguin, a fire truck, a sunflower.

EVERY PUZZLE SOLVABLE WITHOUT GUESSING
Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Each step follows from the clues of a single row or column. If you get stuck, a hint shows the next step and explains why.

200 PICTURE PUZZLES
Eight themed packs: Animals, Food & Drink, At Home, Nature, Vehicles, School & Play, Free Time and Seasons. Four levels from 5 × 5 up to 20 × 20 squares. Every picture you solve appears in color with its name and goes into your collection.

FOUR NEW DAILY PUZZLES EVERY DAY
Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert – catch up on earlier days, and your stats keep track of your streak.

PLEASANT TO PLAY
• Tap to fill a square, drag to set a whole line
• X for squares that are surely empty, unlimited undo
• Finished clues turn gray, completed lines can fill up with X
• Zoom and move large puzzles with two fingers
• Short three-step tutorial
• Every puzzle as a printable PDF with solution
• For iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, light and dark

NO PRESSURE
No lives, no time limit, no penalty for mistakes. The clock can be hidden.

FOR THE GROWN-UPS
Free, no ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no data collection. Everything works offline. English and German.

Dedicated by the American Dyslexia Association (ADA).

name: NordryCue
description:
NordryCue hjelper deg å følge naturlig tørking av reinkjøtt – fra klima og partier til inntekt og analyserapporter.

Registrer tørkepartier med råvekt, ferdigvekt og fase. Logg klimadager med temperatur, frost, vind og sol, og se hvilke dager som egner seg best. Knytt salg til hvert parti og få oversikt over total inntekt, snittpris per kilo og resultat per parti.

Sammenlign vær og inntekt: se hvordan ulike klimaklasser påvirker salget, og få en klar tolkning av tallene. Eksporter analyserapporten som PDF og del den med kolleger eller partnere.

Funksjoner:
• Oversikt over total inntekt på startsiden
• Klimalog med poeng for tørkeforhold
• Partier med utbytte, periode og status
• Inntektsregistrering per parti og salgskanal
• Analyse: vær vs. inntekt, med stolpediagram
• PDF-eksport og deling av rapport
• Enkel «Om oss»-side med kontakt

NordryCue er laget for produsenter og små aktører som vil ha orden på tørking og inntekt – uten unødvendig kompleksitet.

name: Nose Boop
description:
A little joy, on tap.

Choose a pet photo, mark the boop spots and tap to hear a spoken "boop". Or start with the built-in cartoon dog.

Make it your own
- Choose one pet photo from your device.
- Frame your photo full-screen, drag to position it and pinch to zoom from 50% to 400%.
- Place one to four tap points and adjust their size.
- Hide the controls for an uncluttered view of your pet.
- Turn the bundled boop sound and optional haptic feedback on or off. Haptic availability and strength depend on your device.

Ready for the next boop
Your chosen photo, framing, tap points and preferences are saved in the app's local storage. Core booping works offline once your photo is available in the app.

No account, ads, analytics or photo uploads. Your device's backup settings may include stored app data.

A little app by Straitéis AI.
Support: info@straiteis.ie
Privacy policy: https://straiteis.ie/privacy.html#noseboop

name: Notaki: Notes & Reminders
description:
• Search that ignores accents. Type “cafe” and find “Café”, “café” and “CAFÉ”. Greek works the same way: “λιστα” finds “Λίστα”. Accents, capitals and the Greek final ς never get in the way.
• A reminder inside the note. Tap ⏰ in a note and pick Later today, Tomorrow morning or any time you like. The notification has Snooze and Done, so you don’t need to open the app.
• No account and no internet. All your notes stay on your device. The app does not collect, send or share any data.

NOTES AND LISTS TOGETHER
• Text, bullets, headings and checkboxes in the same note.
• Checked items move to the end, under Completed.
• Colors, pins, folders and tags.
• Swipe a note sideways to archive it. The trash keeps notes for 30 days.

REMINDERS ON TIME
• Once or repeating: every day, Monday to Friday, every week, month or year, or your own rule.
• All upcoming reminders in one list.
• If you like, they come through a Focus.
• A guide in Settings helps when a reminder doesn’t ring.

QUICK CAPTURE
• Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.
• A New note button in Control Center.
• Quick actions on the app icon, Shortcuts actions and Siri phrases.
• Share from other apps: text or a link becomes a note, without opening Notaki.

YOUR DATA, IN YOUR HANDS
• Lock the app with Face ID or your passcode. The screen is covered in the app switcher.
• Hide note content in notifications.
• Back up everything to one ZIP file, with a Markdown file for each note, and restore from it.

Light or dark theme, or follow the iPhone. English and Greek. Large text and VoiceOver. Free, with no ads, purchases or subscription.

name: Notas Familiares
description:
Notas Familiares es el punto de encuentro digital para tu hogar. Transforma la clásica nevera llena de papeles en un tablón interactivo, cálido y seguro donde padres, madres e hijos comparten su día a día.

Diseñada pensando en toda la familia: desde los más pequeños que aún dibujan garabatos hasta los adultos que necesitan coordinar las tareas y recados de la semana.

¿QUÉ PUEDES HACER EN NOTAS FAMILIARES?

TABLÓN DE NOTAS Y RECORDATORIOS
• Crea notas adhesivas de colores para recordar citas, horarios escolares o dejar mensajes cariñosos.
• Listas de tareas y compras compartidas que cualquiera puede tachar cuando se completen.
• Filtra rápidamente por persona o por color para ver solo lo que te interesa.

DIBUJOS Y CREATIVIDAD (DOODLE)
• Lienzo táctil intuitivo para que los niños dejen dibujos, dedicatorias y notas visuales.
• Guarda sus creaciones en el muro familiar como recuerdos para siempre.

PERFILES DE UN SOLO TOQUE (ESTILO HOGAR)
• Acceso visual y rápido: selecciona tu perfil con tu avatar y estado de ánimo del día.
• Sin necesidad de contraseñas complicadas para los peques.
• Vincula varios dispositivos (móviles de los padres, tablets infantiles) con un simple código PIN o escaneando un código QR.

CONSEJOS SEMANALES Y CONTROL PARENTAL
• Tips e ideas educativas para disfrutar del tiempo en familia cada semana.
• Barrera de control parental (Parental Gate) que asegura que los ajustes y enlaces externos solo sean accesibles por los adultos.

TARJETAS PARA COMPARTIR
• Convierte cualquier nota o dibujo en una bonita tarjeta ilustrada para felicitar cumpleaños o enviar por mensajería a los abuelos.

PRIVACIDAD Y SEGURIDAD PRIMERO
• Tu información pertenece a tu familia. Sin anuncios molestos ni rastreos invasivos.
• Compatible con inicio de sesión seguro mediante Sign in with Apple.

Haz que la comunicación en casa sea más sencilla, divertida y cercana. ¡Descarga Notas Familiares y empieza a llenar vuestro tablón de momentos únicos!

name: NotBoard
description:
NotBoard — рабочее пространство для репетиторов и учеников.

Проводите занятия с общей доской, видеосвязью и чатом. Планируйте уроки в расписании, храните материалы и возвращайтесь к ним после занятия.

Преподаватели могут вести карточки учеников, назначать домашние задания и давать обратную связь. Ученики — просматривать задания и отправлять ответы.

Начните работу на бесплатном тарифе.

name: Noted: Private Journal
description:
Noted is a calm, private journal for the moments you want to remember.

Write a few lines, speak them out loud, or add photos and video clips. Choose when it happened, and Noted keeps it on a simple calendar so you can look back on any day.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in
• No cloud: notes, photos, videos and drafts stay on your device
• Dictation and spelling checks run on your device
• Optional Face ID, Touch ID or passcode lock
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking

WRITE YOUR WAY
• Type or dictate a note
• Attach up to six photos or video clips per note
• Set the date and time it happened
• Your draft is saved as you go

LOOK BACK
• A month calendar marks the days you wrote
• Search everything you've written
• Open any note to read it, edit it or see your original wording

GENTLE CLEANUP
• Fix common spelling and grammar slips when you save, or check before you save
• Your original wording is always kept

YOURS TO KEEP
• Export a backup of your notes or a readable text copy
• Restore a backup at any time

Because nothing is stored online, deleting the app deletes your journal. Export a backup from Settings to keep a copy.

name: Now & Next: Visual Schedule
description:
Now & Next is a picture routine app for children who do better when they can see what is happening now and what comes next. It was started by two parents for their own autistic son.

EVERYDAY TOOLS
• Today: the day's steps as big picture cards. Tap each step when it is done.
• Now and Next: two big cards, for one step at a time.
• First and Then: the hard thing first, then the good thing.
• Timer: a disc that shrinks as time runs out, with the picture in the middle and a soft chime.
• Stars: a simple reward chart.
• Calm: a breathing bubble and a "How do I feel?" picker.
• Picture stories with your child's own name in them, for things like the dentist, a haircut and the first day of school.

MADE FOR CHILDREN AND THEIR GROWN-UPS
• No account, no adverts and no tracking. Your lists and photos stay on your device.
• Works without the internet.
• Lists only change after a grown-up holds to edit.
• Soft colours, no flashing, and darker colours for bedtime.
• 16 languages, with UK, US or Australian words in English.

FREE TO START
One child, every everyday tool, the ready-made routines and 8 starter picture stories are included at no cost.

FAMILY PLAN (optional subscription)
Up to 3 children, every picture story, a new routine every week, your own stories and read-aloud. Monthly or yearly. Payment is taken from your Apple account, and the subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple account settings.

Privacy: https://littleregulatedlife.com/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: NPX Prime
description: Please feel free to share your thoughts on the interface, workflows, or your overall experience. Your genuine, firsthand experience is more valuable than any preconceived notions. We will carefully read, organize, and summarize your feedback, using it to guide our future improvements. While we cannot guarantee immediate changes in every instance, we will do our best to ensure that sound suggestions are addressed.

name: NSE4 FortiOS 8 Exam Prep
description:
Prepare for NSE4 FortiOS 8 with focused practice, clear explanations and progress you can track.

NSE4 FortiOS 8 Exam Prep brings together 250 original practice questions and 100 concise flashcards covering deployment, firewall policies and authentication, content inspection, routing, SD-WAN and VPNs.

STUDY YOUR WAY
Work through questions at your own pace, check your answers and learn from the explanations. Focus on selected topics or practise across all five exam areas. Save your session and return when you’re ready.

PRACTISE UNDER EXAM CONDITIONS
Choose your question count and time limit, then test your knowledge in Exam Mode. Answers and explanations are available after submission so you can review what needs more work.

QUICK FLASHCARD REVISION
Use short, topic-focused prompts for quick revision. Tap to reveal each answer and mark the cards you know.

MAKE EACH SESSION DIFFERENT
Randomise questions and shuffle answer choices while keeping clear A, B, C, D labels. Choose unseen questions or balance your session across the exam areas.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Review previous results and performance by exam area to help decide what to study next.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE
Study offline with progress saved on your device. Optional iCloud sync shares completed results and flashcard progress between your iPhone and iPad. No advertising, tracking SDKs or separate app account.

Designed for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad running iOS 18 or later, with light and dark appearance options.

NSE4 FortiOS 8 Exam Prep is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Fortinet. It contains original practice questions, not official exam questions. Practice scores do not predict or guarantee an official exam result.

name: NSW DKT: Driver Knowledge Test
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with, endorsed by or representing Transport for NSW, Service NSW or the NSW Government. The questions come from the Driver Knowledge Test questions published by Transport for NSW: https://www.nsw.gov.au/driving-boating-and-transport/driver-and-rider-licences/publications

Get your learner licence in New South Wales: practise for the Driver Knowledge Test (DKT) for a car (class C) licence with all 358 questions from the official question bank.

A MOCK DKT LIKE THE REAL ONE
• 45 questions: 15 general knowledge and 30 road safety, including traffic signs
• Real pass marks: at least 12 of 15 and 29 of 30 — you must pass both parts
• Skip a question and come back to it
• See your mistakes right after the test

ALL OFFICIAL CAR QUESTIONS
• 358 questions with 190 pictures of signs and road situations
• 12 sections: general knowledge, intersections, traffic lights and lanes, traffic signs, pedestrians, speed limits, alcohol and drugs, fatigue, seat belts and more

LEARN WITHOUT STRESS
• Marathon: all questions shuffled; the ones you get wrong come back until they stick
• "Hard for you" — the questions you mix up most
• Signs — just the traffic sign questions
• Search — find a question by a word and see the answer at once

OFFLINE, NO ADS
• Everything is on your phone
• No sign-up, no ads, no analytics

Free: 10 questions in every section and one mock test a day. Full access is a one-time purchase with no auto-renewal: 7 days, 30 days or lifetime.

The app is for self-study and information only. It does not replace the Road User Handbook, driving lessons or the road rules. The questions were published for the in-person DKT; the DKT online course has its own test.

Questions, answers and pictures: © State of New South Wales. For current information go to www.nsw.gov.au. Used under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence; we changed the order of the answer options.

name: Nuda
description:
Your glow, guided.

Nuda is the companion app for Nuda self tanners. It answers the three questions every self tan starts with: which shade is mine, how do I apply it, and when do I do it again.

SHADE MATCH
Five quick questions about your skin tone, undertone, goal and experience. You get the exact Nuda product and shade for you, plus what to pair it with.

TAN PREVIEW
Take a selfie and slide between shades to see the direction of your colour before you buy. The photo stays on your phone.

GUIDED APPLICATION
Prep, apply and aftercare steps for each product, written by Nuda. A develop timer tells you when to rinse and when your colour is in.

TAN CYCLE
Log each application. The app tracks develop, glow and fade, and reminds you the day it is time to reapply. No more guessing.

WELCOME GIFT
Add your email and get a code for your next order at nuda.com.

French and English, your choice. Made in Canada by Nuda, the sunless tanning brand behind CloudMist, BronzeFoam and SilkMilk.

Purchases happen on nuda.com. The app is free.

name: Number and Power
description:
Number and Power（命盘计算器）是《Number and Power》课程的配套计算工具。输入出生日期，App 会按课程的数字公式，自动排出完整的命盘，省去手算的时间，也避免算错。

■ 个人命盘
・倒三角命盘：自动算出本初之数、绝对天赋、世纪天赋、年代之数、时空之门、时空之印、现实世界等各个位置的数字
・五个世界：现实、神话、机缘、理性、感性一目了然
・五行统计：统计命盘十六个数字的金木水火土数量，并标出平衡、旺、弱、极端
・有缺实虚：列出有的数字、缺的数字，以及实与虚
・人生过程：十三组人生过程与隐藏禀赋
・九年流年：从你选的年份起，连续排出九年的流年命盘
・可显示每个位置的名称，并附完整计算过程，方便对照学习

■ 命盘对比
・最多五个命盘并排比较，可以加上名字
・可以拖动或用左右按钮调整顺序，也可以删除

■ 特别情况
・双胞胎命盘：大的加父亲生日，小的加母亲生日
・23:00–23:59 出生：可勾选按次日日期计算
・自动显示生肖（以农历春节为界）

■ 隐私
所有计算都在你的手机上完成。App 不联网、不需要注册、不收集任何个人资料，也没有广告。

name: Nước Ngoài
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
Nước Ngoài gom các công cụ tính và tra cứu về định cư, du học, làm việc, du lịch của 57 nước và khu vực vào một ứng dụng, viết bằng tiếng Việt cho người Việt.

TRA THEO TỪNG NƯỚC
Chọn châu lục, chọn nước: Úc, Canada, Mỹ, Nhật Bản, Hàn Quốc, Đức, Bồ Đào Nha, UAE… Mỗi nước có các mốc số đáng nhớ (lương tối thiểu, thời hạn xét nhập tịch, hiệu lực giấy tờ) và các công cụ riêng: chấm điểm định cư tay nghề, chọn diện visa phù hợp, tính lương thực nhận sau thuế, chứng minh tài chính du học, mốc vĩnh trú và nhập tịch.

TRA CỨU 547 CÔNG CỤ, CẢ KHI KHÔNG CÓ MẠNG
Gõ không cần dấu, lọc theo nhu cầu: định cư, quốc tịch, đầu tư, du học, làm việc, visa, chi phí sống, đời sống. Danh sách được lưu trên máy nên tra được cả khi mất sóng.

HÀNH TRANG: CHẠY NGAY TRÊN MÁY
• Đếm ngày Schengen 90/180: nhập các chuyến, biết còn được ở bao nhiêu ngày và ngày cuối được ở nếu vào lần tới.
• Giờ hai nơi: giờ Việt Nam so với 45 thành phố, chọn một giờ để hẹn gọi điện, phỏng vấn.
• Ổ cắm, điện áp, mã gọi và số khẩn cấp của 45 nước.
Ba công cụ này không cần mạng, dùng được ở sân bay hay trên máy bay.

ĐỌC BÀI, LƯU ĐỌC SAU
Bài hướng dẫn về visa, định cư, du học từng châu lục. Bấm lưu để đọc khi không có mạng, chia sẻ qua bảng chia sẻ của máy.

TÀI KHOẢN MIỄN PHÍ
Không có gì phải trả tiền. Có tài khoản là dùng mọi công cụ không giới hạn lượt. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

Kết quả công cụ để bạn tự tính trước, không thay cho quyết định của cơ quan cấp visa hay xuất nhập cảnh.

name: Nuvipompop
description:
A basket of colorful yarn. A clever little claw. A patch waiting for its next stitch.

Nuvipompop is a cozy puzzle game where matching yarn becomes embroidery. Tap connected groups of three or more matching balls, watch the yarn tumble, and follow the thread as the needle adds stitches to your work in progress.

MAKE A BIGGER MATCH
