Bigger groups earn more points. Use the claw to pick up as many as three reachable yarn balls, move them across the basket, and drop them beside matching colors. Let them settle, then tap your new group to pop it.

TAKE YOUR TIME, PLAN YOUR MOVES
Each puzzle starts with a fixed basket of yarn and a score to reach. There is no timer and no automatic refill. Choose which groups to clear and where to use your limited grabs.

36 PUZZLES, THREE COZY ROOMS
Begin in The Sewing Room, visit the Glasshouse Dye Studio, and settle into the Moonlit Attic. Each room brings its own handmade setting and a new set of yarn puzzles.

STITCH A COLLECTION
Build a Patchbook of 15 embroidered designs, including six bonus keepsakes. Complete levels to earn stitches and reveal strawberries, flowers, woodland details and more. Watch your current patch take shape in the hoop as you play.

A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Dye a yarn ball, shuffle the remaining basket, or undo an action. Spend buttons earned through play on supplies, including an extra grab or a boost for your next pop.

YOUR OWN QUIET MOMENT
Learn with an interactive tutorial, replay completed levels, and return to your saved basket. Gameplay works offline, with no account, advertising or real-money purchases. Music, sound effects and haptics have separate controls.

Pick up a thread and see what you can make.

name: Nuvo Citas
description:
Nuvo Citas es la app para pedir cita en tu peluquería, salón de uñas y pestañas, centro de estética, centro de masajes o estudio de tatuaje, y para que el negocio lleve su agenda.

PARA CLIENTES
• Busca el sitio donde vas por su nombre.
• Elige servicio, profesional, día y hora.
• ¿Pides para tu hija o para un amigo? Pide también su cita desde tu cuenta.
• Recordatorios en el móvil antes de cada cita.
• Lista de espera: si el día que quieres está lleno, te avisamos cuando se libere un hueco.
• Bonos de sesiones: ves cuántas te quedan y reservas con ellos.
• En los estudios de tatuaje, la señal se paga al reservar y se descuenta del precio.
• Tus citas siempre a mano: consúltalas o anúlalas cuando quieras.

PARA NEGOCIOS
• La agenda del día de todo el equipo, en el móvil.
• Tiempos de pose: mientras el color actúa, el profesional puede atender a otra persona.
• Cabinas y máquinas: no se reservan dos tratamientos a la vez en la misma cabina.
• Fichas de clientes con su historial y su ficha técnica (fórmulas de color, tallas, referencias).
• Avisos cuando un cliente reserva o anula.

SIN CONTRASEÑAS
Entras con tu correo o tu móvil y un código que te enviamos. Nada que recordar.

TUS DATOS
Puedes descargar tus datos o borrar tu cuenta desde la propia app, en «Mis citas», cuando quieras.

name: O Corre: Serviços e Entregas
description:
O Corre não é aplicativo de corrida nem de entrega de comida. Aqui você conta com alguém para resolver tarefas do dia a dia que exigem estar lá pessoalmente: enfrentar uma fila, buscar um documento, acompanhar alguém numa consulta ou esperar o técnico chegar.

E se você quer ganhar dinheiro, escolhe os corres que vai fazer, no seu ritmo, sem precisar de carro, moto ou habilitação.

O QUE DÁ PARA PEDIR
• Enfrentar fila: cartório, órgão público, posto de atendimento
• Buscar ou entregar documento
• Acompanhar alguém num exame, numa consulta ou num compromisso
• Esperar por atendimento ou pelo técnico enquanto você não pode estar lá
• Resolver algo presencialmente
• Outro serviço: descreva o que precisa
Quando o corre envolve levar alguma coisa de um lugar a outro, o app cuida disso também, com itens de até 30 kg.

POR QUE O CORRE É DIFERENTE
• Você contrata tempo e presença, não uma viagem. O valor segue a tabela da plataforma, aparece antes de você confirmar e não sobe por horário ou demanda.
• Quem faz o corre é verificado: envia documento com foto e selfie e só começa depois da aprovação da equipe do O Corre.
• Seu endereço fica protegido: o endereço completo só aparece para quem aceitou o seu corre.
• Cada corre termina com comprovação: foto, comprovante ou protocolo do que foi feito.
• Os dois lados se avaliam ao final.

PEÇA UM CORRE
1. Escolha o tipo de serviço e conte o que precisa ser resolvido.
2. Informe quanto tempo deve levar e onde acontece.
3. Confira o valor, pague pelo app e publique.
4. Acompanhe cada etapa (aceito, a caminho, em execução e concluído), com o horário de cada uma.
5. Converse pelo app com quem aceitou o seu corre.
6. Confirme a conclusão ou reporte um problema e, depois, avalie.

FAÇA UM CORRE
• Cadastre-se como parceiro, envie documento e selfie e aguarde a aprovação.
• Veja os corres disponíveis perto de você, com o valor que você recebe, o bairro e o tempo estimado.
• Aceite só o que quiser: recusar não gera penalidade, e não há meta nem jornada mínima.
• Faça seus corres a pé, de bicicleta, de moto ou de carro.
• Marque cada etapa (Tô no corre, Tô fazendo, Tá feito) e envie a comprovação.
• Acompanhe seus ganhos e receba por Pix.

PAGAMENTO
O pagamento é feito pelo app, por Pix. O valor de quem executa só é liberado depois que o corre é concluído e confirmado por quem pediu, ou automaticamente 24 horas após a conclusão, se nenhum problema for reportado.

PARA NÃO CONFUNDIR
• Não transporta passageiros.
• Não faz compras nem paga contas em seu nome.
• Não é app de entrega de comida.

ONDE E QUANDO
Começamos por Sorocaba (SP) e região. Os corres podem ser publicados a qualquer hora; o atendimento da equipe funciona das 9h às 18h.

O Corre conecta quem precisa resolver com quem quer ganhar.
O Corre. Quem corre, chega lá.

name: Obr Driver
description:
Obr Driver is the app for Obr captains. Go online when it suits you, accept rides near you and keep track of what you earn.

DRIVE ON YOUR TIME
• Go online or offline with one tap.
• Get ride requests from passengers near you.
• See the fare, payment method, pickup, destination and trip distance before you accept.
• Choose the service types you want to receive.

PLAN AHEAD WITH PRE-BOOKINGS
• Browse scheduled rides and accept the ones that fit your day.
• Keep your accepted pre-bookings in one list.
• Turn on alerts to hear about new pre-bookings.

SMOOTH ON EVERY TRIP
• Start navigation to the pickup and drop-off with one tap.
• Call or message the passenger from the app.
• Clear trip steps from arrival to the end of the ride.

YOUR DRIVER PORTAL
• Today's earnings and your week at a glance.
• Your rating, acceptance rate, completion rate and online hours.
• Your wallet: check your balance, top up and see every transaction.
• Your full ride history.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Report a problem with a ride from the help center.
• Call Obr support from the app.

MADE FOR DRIVERS
• Available in Arabic, English and Kurdish.
• Light and dark mode.
• Pick the sound for new ride requests.

HOW TO JOIN
Sign up with your phone number, add your vehicle details and upload your documents. Once your account is approved, go online and start driving.

name: oddPets: Virtual Pet Widget
description:
A little company for your home screen. oddPets is a virtual pet widget app where your daily walks help grow a world of curious companions.

MEET YOUR FIRST PETS
Start with Blip, Finn and Inky. Give them names, tap them for a little affection, and watch them wander around their dome. Add the small, medium or large home screen widget to keep your companions nearby.

TURN STEPS INTO BITES
Check in for a daily Bite, then earn more at 5,000 and 10,000 steps. Bites are the in-app currency you spend on new pets, decorations and habitats. oddPets reads your step count from Apple Health with your permission. Your pets' body shapes change with your daily walking progress toward the 10,000-step goal.

BUILD YOUR ODD LITTLE COLLECTION
Browse 94 pets, from aliens and dinosaurs to ocean creatures, birds and bugs. Preview a companion before spending your Bites, and choose who lives in your dome.

MAKE THEIR WORLD YOURS
Choose from eight habitat themes and 28 decorations. Arrange your dome and unlock room for up to five pets. Day and night scenes give your companions a changing backdrop.

A LITTLE MISSION FOR TODAY
Follow daily and weekly missions, work toward one-time achievements, and claim Bite rewards as you go. Check your walking stats and find your next small goal.

START AS A GUEST
Play locally as a guest, or sign in with Apple, Google or email for optional cloud backup. Backup saves your pet collection, names, decorations and claimed walking rewards. Your step history stays on your device and is never uploaded.

OPTIONAL BITE PACKS
oddPets is free to play. If you want more Bites sooner, Bite packs are one-time purchases with no subscription.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Available in English. Step counts come from Apple Health, so they depend on your iPhone or a paired Apple Watch recording your steps.

Meet your pets, add their widget and take the next walk together.

name: oft – See your people
description:
“We should catch up soon.” And then it never happens. Not because you don’t want to, but because nobody takes the first step and planning is work.

oft is the friend who organizes everything. You say when you’re free. oft plans the rest: who with, what and where.

HOW IT WORKS
• Saturday: Tap when you’re free next week. It takes a minute.
• Overnight: oft checks which of your people are free too and plans your hangout. Around what you both enjoy, somewhere close for both of you.
• Sunday: Your week is here, fully planned. You just say “I’m in”. If something doesn’t fit, oft simply replans.
• During the week: oft reminds you in time. All you have to do is show up.

YOU DECIDE HOW OFTEN
For each person, you set how often you want to see each other. oft never plans more than you tapped on Saturday.

NEVER A NO
If a suggestion doesn’t work for you, nobody finds out. oft simply suggests something else. What you set privately, only you can see.

ONLY REAL HANGOUTS
No feed, no likes, nothing to scroll. Chat only happens around a hangout. With every hangout your flame grows, and on the first of each month oft shows you your recap: who you saw and how often.

GET STARTED
oft starts planning once you have three people. Invite your people right from the app.

YOUR DATA
To find hangouts that fit, an AI (Claude by Anthropic) gets some of your details, never your name and never your number. No ads, no tracking, no location history. oft is 18+.

Questions? Write to us at hallo@getoft.com.

See your people more often.

name: OG Memo
description:
OG Memo records audio and video memos, writes their transcripts on your phone and lets you search what was said. Works with no account at all; connect your own OG Vault (the private server you run at home) when you want sync, summaries and search by meaning. No cloud account, no ads, no tracking.

RECORD
• One big button: audio or video, pause and resume.
• Recording is kept on your phone piece by piece, so a dropped connection or a crash does not lose it.
• Nothing leaves the phone unless you connect a vault and say yes to sync.

TRANSCRIBE, ON THE PHONE
• Every memo gets a transcript, made on the device with on-device speech recognition. Audio is never sent anywhere for transcription.
• Play a memo with the transcript following along; tap any line to jump to that moment.

FIND
• Search titles and transcripts; a hit opens the memo at the exact moment.
• With a vault: search by meaning too ("roof price" finds "the roof guy quoted eight thousand").

YOUR VAULT, OPTIONAL
• Sign in to your own OG Vault to keep memos there, get titles and short summaries, and see them on every device.
• Huddles and calls recorded in OG Office show up in their own tab, with the same transcripts and search.
• Several vaults at once: one sign-in per vault, switch from Settings.

YOURS
• Rename, share, download or delete (with undo).
• Microphone and camera are used only while you record.

name: OG Motion
description:
OG Motion records your runs on its own and reminds you of your shopping list and tasks the moment you arrive where you need them, with your movement history kept private.

Start running and OG Motion notices: it switches GPS on, records the run, splits moving time from stops, and saves the distance, pace, splits and map when you finish. You can also start, pause and end a run yourself.

• Automatic run detection from motion and steps, low battery use when you are not moving
• Runs with map, pace, kilometre or mile splits and moving time
• Daily steps and active minutes
• Workouts: tick off sets and reps from your own templates
• Places: Home, Work and your own places, each with a task list. Arrive and OG Motion reminds you what to do there
• Shopping lists you can share with your household through your own OG Vault

Private by design
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no data sale
• Use it on its own: everything stays on your iPhone
• Or connect your own OG Vault (self-hosted): your history syncs only to your server, and you choose who sees your live location
• Delete your history at any time from Settings

OG Motion uses location in the background only to notice and record runs and to remind you of a place's tasks when you arrive. Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.

name: Old Movies Hollywood Classics
description:
Old Movies brings the golden age of Hollywood to your iPhone and iPad. Watch full-length classic movies from the silent era to the 1960s, in black and white and in color. Every film is in the public domain.

PLEASE NOTE: all films are in their original English version, with no dubbing. Silent movies have English intertitles. So it's also a great way to practice your English with classic cinema.

Each title is hand-picked by our editorial team, so you get a curated movie app for classic films instead of an endless list. New old movies are added regularly.

WHAT YOU CAN WATCH
• Action and adventure: "The Thief of Bagdad", "Hercules", "Tarzan's Revenge", "The Call of the Wild", "Sword of Lancelot", "The Black Pirate"
• Classic westerns: John Wayne in "McLintock!", Marlon Brando in "One-Eyed Jacks", "Jesse James", "The Lone Ranger", "Rio Conchos"
• Hitchcock and suspense: "The 39 Steps", "The Lodger", "Charade" with Cary Grant and Audrey Hepburn
• Film noir and crime: "D.O.A.", "Pushover", "Quicksand", "Gaslight"
• Horror and sci-fi classics: "House on Haunted Hill" with Vincent Price, "White Zombie" with Bela Lugosi, "The Last Man on Earth", "Plan 9 from Outer Space"
• Comedy and romance: "Bringing Up Baby", "Monkey Business", "Penny Serenade", Laurel and Hardy in "The Flying Deuces", Bob Hope's "Road to Bali"
• War movies: "Stalag 17", "The Steel Helmet", "We Dive at Dawn"
• Musicals and family: Fred Astaire in "Royal Wedding", Shirley Temple in "Heidi" and "Curly Top"
• Silent movies: Buster Keaton's "The General" and "Sherlock Jr.", "Nosferatu", "The Phantom of the Opera", "Sunrise"
• Christmas classics: "Scrooge" (1935 and 1970) and "The Bells of St. Mary's"
Movie titles are shown in their original English, just as they appear in the app.

MORE THAN A PLAYER
• Our review of every film: synopsis, director, cast and awards
• Our rating, photo gallery and related movies
• Browse by genre: drama, comedy, romance, thriller, adventure, musical, horror, action, western, war, family, fantasy and sci-fi
• Search the whole catalog
• My List: save the films you want to watch later
• Get notified when new classics arrive
• No sign-up or account needed
• App available in 15 languages

PERFECT FOR
Fans of classic cinema, film students, history buffs, family movie nights, and anyone who misses the old movies they grew up with.

ABOUT THE CONTENT
All films in Old Movies are in the public domain and are played with YouTube's official player. Picture quality depends on the original source; some of these films are more than 100 years old.

Questions or suggestions? Write to us at movies@i-art.app.

name: OlyWatch
description:
OlyWatch is the official event app for managing successful educational event. It keeps participants, team leaders, volunteers and organisers on the same page, from arrival day to the closing ceremony.

FOR PARTICIPANTS AND LEADERS
• Your day at a glance: next activity, your bus and your room
• The full programme, with delays and changes in real time
• Official announcements the moment they are published
• Messages with your team leader and the organizers
• Personal alarms for every event day

FOR VOLUNTEERS AND ORGANISERS
• Your current task, check-ins and what's next
• QR check-in for head-counts and buses

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Accounts are created by the organizers only. No ads, no tracking, no data sold.

Sign in with the badge ID and PIN issued to you by the event organizers.

name: One Club de Grupo Adams
description:
Lleva tu membresía One Club en el celular. Cuando compres en las tiendas participantes de Grupo Adams, muestra tu código QR para identificarte y acumular puntos en una sola cuenta.

Consulta tu saldo de puntos y tu nivel. Revisa los cupones y regalos disponibles para ti y descubre qué puedes canjear. En tu perfil también puedes consultar el historial de compras registradas en el programa.

Si tienes un club de mercancía, entra en Mis clubes para ver las semanas pagadas y pendientes. Si tienes una tarjeta de regalo vinculada, consulta su saldo desde la app.

One Club es el programa de fidelidad de Grupo Adams en Panamá. El registro es gratuito y está disponible para mayores de edad. Los beneficios y canjes están sujetos a las condiciones del programa.

name: One More Gift
description:
A little Christmas magic. One more perfect delivery.

Take Santa’s sleigh across 48 levels in six festive worlds. Drag to fly, hold to aim and release a gift into an open chimney. Fill your fiery charge meter to send a glowing parcel through the ice.

EVERY NEIGHBORHOOD HAS A SURPRISE
Discover 20 kinds of buildings as you progress. Your first successful delivery to a newly discovered building reveals a short, funny Christmas reaction inside.

A SKY FULL OF CHALLENGES
Read the wind, lead moving chimneys, break the ice and dodge snow owls. Watch out for tall steeples, and rescue the presents stolen by Mistletooth.

MEET YOUR FLYING FRIENDS
Earn cookies to welcome Cocoa, Flurry and Comet. Catch a missed gift, slow the surroundings or give your next deliveries a wider landing window.

BUILD YOUR CHRISTMAS VILLAGE
Complete wishes and passport goals, develop your village and try parcels with different flight characteristics. Replay unlocked levels to improve your stars and take on short bonus challenges.

• 48 campaign levels across six Christmas worlds
• 20 gradually discovered building types
• Three animated reindeer with distinct abilities
• Short discovery movies, festive music and playful sound effects
• Continuous touch steering and a clear charge meter
• Local progress, with no account required
• No advertisements, in-app purchases or subscriptions

The game supports English, Polish, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Czech, French, Hindi, Finnish, Swedish, Danish, Ukrainian and Russian. Language follows your iPhone automatically and can be changed in Settings. Progress is saved on your device.

name: ONEdone- Live task
seller_name: Laing Innotech GmbH u. Co. KG
description:
ONEdone is a to-do list built around one idea: do ONE thing, then the next. No clutter, no feeds – just today's tasks and a clear view of your progress.

TODAY
• Add a task in a second, with an optional reminder time and priority
• A progress ring shows how much of today is done
• Tick off daily habits and watch your streak grow
• Start a focus timer and get a notification when the time is up

PLAN
• Reusable lists (shopping, morning routine, household …) – add every item to today with one tap
• Routines: pick a list, a time and weekdays, and it is added to your day automatically when you open the app
• Daily habits with streaks

PROGRESS
• This week compared with last week
• Your score, your streaks and everything you have already done

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything you enter stays on your iPhone. No account, no tracking, no ads.

1% better. Every day.

name: OneHander: Web Video Browser
description:
A browser for watching video with one hand. The controls come to your thumb, so your other hand can stay where it is.

Maybe it's on a handrail, or wrapped around a coffee cup. Finding the moment you want in a video still takes one thumb.

SEEK WITH YOUR THUMB
A scrubber runs along the edge of the screen, where your thumb already is. Slide it to move through the video and land on the scene you were looking for.

VIDEOS OPEN IN THE PLAYER
Start a video on a page and it opens in the player. Tap the site's own fullscreen button and you get the same controls. Video controls and browser controls stay on screen together, so the browser is still in reach while you watch.

ONE TAP FOR A CLEAR SCREEN
One tap hides everything and leaves you alone with the picture. Another tap brings the controls back.

EITHER HAND
Left- or right-handed, every control moves to your thumb's side. Holding the phone upright, put the keys along the bottom or down the side.

FROM SAFARI OR CHROME
Share a page from Safari or Chrome to OneHander and watch it here. In Safari you can also turn on the OneHander extension and get the scrubber and keys right inside Safari.

FEWER INTERRUPTIONS
Common ad and tracking services are blocked. Lock the screen and the video keeps playing.

PAY ONCE
Pay once and it's yours. There is no subscription and no account to create, and the app shows no ads. It collects no data and keeps no browsing history.

Choose your side and press play. Your other hand has better things to do.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: OneMind AI
description:
OneMind is an AI assistant for teams. Ask a question about your organisation's business in everyday words, and OneMind finds the answer in your company's own data.

ASK IN PLAIN LANGUAGE
• Type a question, or tap a suggested one to get started
• Watch each step as OneMind works out the answer
• Ask follow-up questions in the same chat to dig deeper

KEEP YOUR CHATS
• Every chat is saved, so you can pick up where you left off
• Search, rename and delete chats from the side menu

STAY UPDATED
• Get a notification when a longer answer is ready
• See announcements from your organisation in Notifications

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
• Agree to AI use in English or Bahasa Melayu before your first question, and withdraw it any time
• Report an answer that looks wrong, harmful or private
• Add a profile photo, choose light or dark mode and an accent colour
• Delete your account and chats from inside the app

PLEASE NOTE
OneMind accounts are created by your organisation's administrator. There is no public sign-up. If you don't have your sign-in details, please ask your administrator.

name: OnFire : le Détecteur de metal
description:
OnFire, c'est l'appli d'ON FIRE, l'asso metal du grand sud. Son boulot : que tu ne rates plus un seul concert.

Le Détecteur de metal
Tous les concerts et festivals metal à venir dans le sud de la France, du black au stoner. Pour chaque date : les groupes, la salle, la ville, les styles, le lien de billetterie et l'affiche quand elle est sortie.

Trouve ta prochaine date
Filtre par département, par style et par période. Cherche un groupe, une salle ou une ville. La carte montre les salles qui ont des dates à venir.

Ne va plus au concert tout seul
Crée ton compte, dis « J'y vais » et regarde qui d'autre se pointe. Propose ou trouve une place en covoiturage. Discute avec les autres dans le fil de la date. Les adhérents de l'asso portent leur badge.

Ne rate plus aucune annonce
Suis un groupe, une salle, un département ou un style : un mail tombe dès qu'une nouvelle date sort.

Et aussi
Ajoute une date à l'agenda du téléphone, partage-la à ta bande, lance l'itinéraire jusqu'à la salle. Les actus rassemblent les articles des médias qui suivent la scène. Plus de réseau dans la fosse ? La dernière liste reçue reste consultable.

name: Onvanto: Lab Availability
description:
Keep jobs covered while instruments visit external calibration labs. Plan shipment windows, check availability conflicts and record a qualified person’s replacement approval. Register dispatch and return with instrument QR labels. Attach certificate PDFs, check the recorded serial number and explicitly release the instrument.

Free companion to your company's Onvanto workspace. Sign in with your work email, or open the built-in demo with sample data to try it without an account. Organisations that run their own Onvanto service can connect it instead. A qualified person decides technical suitability, intervals and release. Onvanto provides no calibration judgement or certification.

name: Oozy 2048!
description:
Slide a board full of colorful Bloppies with one swipe. Match two Bloppies with the same number and they merge into one bigger tile. Every merge adds to your score.

• Play on a classic 4×4 board with simple swipe controls.
• Beat your personal best and keep playing beyond 2048.
• Use one free Continue per run to clear three tiles and make room for another move.
• Play offline and pick up right where you left off.
• Set sound and haptics to your liking.

A colorful little puzzle break you can pick up in seconds.

name: Oozy Flow!
description:
Tap a Blobby to send it into orbit around a board of jelly tiles. Match colors to clear the board, and keep an eye on the buffer as Blobbies return from their laps.

Choose which colors to send next, learn the ropes in ten introductory levels, and keep playing as new puzzles are generated. Play offline in portrait with simple one-finger controls.

name: Oozy Snake!
description:
A golden jelly snake, a lush jungle and one more droplet just out of reach. Steer with a swipe or tap on the board relative to the snake’s head. Pick up glowing Ooz droplets, grow longer and avoid the walls and your own tail.

- Choose Easy, Medium or Hard and chase a personal best for each difficulty.
- Collect cyan droplets and look out for rare violet ones worth two points.
- Take one free Continue per run and return to the center with your score.
- Play offline and pick up your saved run later.

No account, ads or in-app purchases.

name: Open House Sign-In
description:
Open House Sign-In turns every open house visitor into a lead you can follow up with the same day.

SET UP IN A MINUTE
- Upload the MLS listing sheet (PDF or photo) from any MLS in all 50 states. AI fills in the address, price, beds, baths, square feet, year built and description.
- No sheet? Look the listing up by address, or type the details.
- Take a cover photo of the home. It becomes the background of your sign-in screen.

TWO WAYS TO SIGN IN
- Kiosk mode: hand visitors your iPhone or set up an iPad at the door. Full screen with the home's photo, address, price, beds, baths, square feet and age.
- QR code: visitors scan with their own phone and sign in on a mobile page. They appear in your visitor list within seconds.

QUESTIONS THAT QUALIFY THE LEAD
- First name, last name, mobile phone and email
- Are you working with a real estate agent?
- How soon are you buying?
- Are you pre-approved for a mortgage?
- Do you have a home to sell?

FOLLOW UP FROM YOU, NOT AN APP
- Connect Gmail and each visitor gets a thank-you email from your own address with the listing sheet attached, right after they sign in.
- Using Outlook, iCloud or another email? Emails open in your Mail app, ready to send in one tap.
- When you close the open house, send a personal follow-up email to everyone at once.
- One tap opens Messages with your thank-you text written. It sends from your own phone number.

REPORTS
- Download a PDF visitor report with the day and time each visitor signed in
- Export a spreadsheet (CSV) to import into any CRM
- Quick counts: visitors without an agent, visitors who need a lender, and visitors with a home to sell

Your first open house is free. Unlimited open houses with a monthly, 3 month, 6 month or yearly subscription.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Privacy: https://www.winslowhomesllc.com/pages/exam-prep-app-privacy
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Open World Tracker: 100% Guide
description:
The checklist and map for players going for 100% in Grand Theft Auto VI. Unofficial, and built together with other players.

Stop alt-tabbing to a browser. Keep every stunt jump and collectible card in your pocket, tick them off as you play, and see where to look next.

TRACK YOUR 100%
• Checklists by category with clear progress rings
• One tap to tick an item off, even mid-game
• Short explanations of what each collectible is, how it works and what it unlocks

A MAP BUILT BY PLAYERS
• Our own stylized map with pinch-to-zoom and place names
• Researched leads show the area to search
• Found the exact spot? Drop the pin for everyone
• Vote on whether a lead or pin is right, so good info rises and bad info disappears

EARN YOUR RANK
• Points for pins, votes and tips
• Four ranks, from Scout to Moderator
• Badges for finds, pins and helping others
• Public tips on every item and a public chat room, with report and block

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Polish, Russian, Japanese and Chinese

GO PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• Find nearest: your five closest unfound items, with a route
• No subscription

New locations are added every day as they are confirmed by at least two sources.

This app is an unofficial fan-made guide. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto is a trademark of its respective owner. The map and all text in this app are original.

name: Operation Sauvetage
description:
Une flotte de robots se prépare à envahir les îles. Incarnez Pip, une éclaireuse armée d’une clé à molette, et infiltrez l’usine avant le départ de l’armée mécanique.

Traversez quatre zones par tentative. À chaque embranchement, choisissez votre itinéraire selon les dangers et le butin. Les salles sont réassemblées d’une partie à l’autre. Sautez par-dessus les cuves de la fonderie, faufilez-vous dans les égouts et repérez le rythme des balanciers de la tour.

Alternez armes de mêlée et à distance, lancez une compétence et combinez des mutations à l’atelier de Sprocket. Rapportez des plans pour enrichir le butin de vos prochaines tentatives. Apprenez quand frapper Goliath, la Porte de fer et l’Arpenteur.

Six zones à explorer, trois boss et dix journaux à retrouver. Après votre première victoire, débloquez des niveaux de difficulté supplémentaires pour mettre vos meilleurs builds à l’épreuve.

Fonctionnalités

- Quatre itinéraires à travers six zones industrielles
- Neuf armes, six compétences et quinze mutations
- Trois boss aux attaques et points faibles distincts
- Treize plans à débloquer, dix journaux à découvrir
- Commandes tactiles et jeu en mode paysage

name: Optics Lab: DoF & Hyperfocal
description:
Optics Lab is an interactive depth-of-field and hyperfocal calculator for photographers.

Pick your camera format, turn the lens ring to your focal length and the aperture ring to your f-stop. You instantly see your hyperfocal distance and the zone that will be sharp, from the nearest sharp point to infinity.

FREE
• Guided flow for medium format, full frame, APS-C, Micro Four Thirds and 1-inch sensors
• Hyperfocal distance, near and far limits and total depth of field
• Angle of view and full-frame equivalent focal length
• Simple Mode simulator: drag the subject and watch the sharp zone change
• Live Field Camera (AR): see the sharp zone over your real scene

ADVANCED MODE (one-time in-app purchase)
• All 8 optical zones with colour-coded live readouts
• The formula behind every value
• Side-profile ray diagram and top-down field-of-view cone
• Guided tour through every concept

Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.
Available in English, German, French, Italian and Spanish.

name: Orbit: Quick Launch Wheel
description:
Your favorite apps, one flick away.

Orbit puts the apps you open most on a glowing 3D wheel. Drag to spin it, flick to send it gliding, and feel a soft tick as each app passes the front. Tap any tile and the app opens instantly.

MADE FOR THE WAY YOU SWITCH
• Build separate wheels for work, home, travel or anything else, and switch between them with one tap
• Pick from a list of popular apps to set up a tile in seconds, or add any app link or web page yourself
• Choose an emoji and a name for every tile
• If an app isn't installed, Orbit opens its web page instead

WIDGETS
• Home Screen widgets in three sizes: a mini wheel, or a grid of your apps that open with one tap
• Lock Screen widgets that take you straight to a wheel
• Choose which wheel each widget shows

SIRI, SHORTCUTS AND THE ACTION BUTTON
• Say "Open Work in Orbit" or "Launch Mail with Orbit"
• Use the Open Wheel and Launch App actions in your own shortcuts
• Add the Orbit control to Control Center, the Lock Screen or the Action Button

SYNCS WITH iCLOUD
Your wheels follow you to every iPhone signed in to your Apple Account. Set up a new device and your wheels are already there.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Orbit collects no data at all. Your wheels stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• Smooth momentum and snap, tuned to feel natural
• Haptic feedback as the wheel turns
• Supports VoiceOver and Reduce Motion
• Touch and hold any tile to edit or remove it

One purchase, no subscription.

name: Oreqo Vision
description:
Oreqo Vision is a fleet tracking and safety platform that gives authorized fleet teams real-time visibility into vehicles, routes, drivers and safety events.

Built for businesses using the Oreqo platform, the app helps fleet managers monitor daily operations and respond to important events from anywhere.

KEY FEATURES

• Track vehicle locations and status in real time
• Review GPS routes, trips, stops and location history
• Monitor speed and driving activity
• Access dashcam footage and safety events
• Receive alerts for speeding, harsh driving and geofence activity
• Review AI-powered driver safety alerts
• View fleet, vehicle and driver reports
• Manage vehicles, drivers, devices and installation records
• Switch securely between authorized business workspaces
• Share live vehicle locations when required

Oreqo Vision brings fleet tracking, video telematics and operational insights together in one secure mobile experience.

An active Oreqo account and compatible fleet hardware may be required. Available features depend on your organization’s subscription, permissions and installed devices.

Oreqo Vision is an operational assistance tool. Drivers and fleet operators must always follow applicable road safety, privacy and transportation regulations.

name: ORGDATE: Group Planner
description:
Barbecue, game night, club meeting or reunion: ORGDATE finds the date that works for everyone and then helps with the planning. No account, no sign-up, no password.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Write down what you're planning, e.g. "Barbecue in the garden, sometime in July, about 8 people". ORGDATE turns it into a title, a time frame and date suggestions.
2. Send the link to the group. Everyone adds when they can: yes, maybe or no.
3. You see right away which date works best and confirm it with one tap.
4. Then you sort out who brings or takes care of what.

WHAT THE APP ADDS
- Notifications: as the organizer when someone responds or takes on a task, as a guest as soon as the date is set or something changes
- Invitation links from WhatsApp, Signal or email open right in the app
- Add the confirmed date to your calendar with one tap
- Send the link to any app via the share sheet

FAIR TO EVERYONE
- No percentages while answers are missing: you see "6 can, 2 open", not "75%"
- Mark people as required: a date they can't make moves down
- Names are only visible to people who have responded themselves

PRIVACY
No account, no tracking, no ads. Servers in Germany. Delete events permanently at any time; they disappear automatically twelve months after the last activity.

Privacy: https://orgdate.com/datenschutz
Delete data: https://orgdate.com/daten-loeschen

name: Orikata
description:
Orikata is a calm daily origami puzzle made for iPhone Duo. The phone's hinge is the fold line.

Each day brings one square sheet of paper. Slide and turn it until a crease lines up with the hinge, then close the phone gently to fold. Valley folds, mountain folds and front-flap folds, one at a time, the way a real origami diagram goes.

When the last fold sets, the flat paper shapes into its finished model in 3D: a cup, a fox, a samurai helmet, a cicada. Spin it, look at it from every side, and share it.

- One sheet a day, plus an archive of every day you've had
- 32 traditional models to start, each in its own paper color
- No timer, no ads, no lives, no streaks
- Gentle mistakes: the paper bunches, you smooth it out and try again
- Tips and an optional hint that shows exactly where the next crease runs
- Quiet ambient music and paper sounds, both adjustable
- The outside screen shows your folding progress while the phone is closed, and your last finished model when you're not folding
- Fold with a button if you'd rather not close the phone, and on any iPhone without a hinge

Fold at your own pace. A new sheet arrives every morning.

name: Orus: App Review Status
description:
Orus shows where every App Review submission on your App Store Connect account stands, and puts it on your Lock Screen.
See what is Waiting for Review, In Review, approved or rejected, with a clock for how long it has been there.
When a version is approved, release it from your iPhone with one tap.

ONE BOARD FOR EVERY APP
- Every app on your account, with in-flight versions at the top: In Review, approved and waiting on you, Waiting for Review, then rejections.
- A live clock on each submission shows how long it has been in its current state.
- App detail with the current version, a review timeline Orus records as states change, and recent builds.

APP REVIEW ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
- Follow a submission with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
- When App Review moves it (Waiting for Review, In Review, then approved or rejected), the Live Activity moves too, with a distinct sound for each step.
- Updates arrive by push as soon as App Store Connect reports the change, so you don't have to open Orus. Push updates come through the hosted Orus relay (Orus Pro); without it, Live Activities update when Orus refreshes.

RELEASE FROM YOUR PHONE
- One tap releases an approved version (Pending Developer Release) to the App Store, after a confirmation.
- See which day of a 7-day phased release a live version is on.
- Choose how a version goes live: manually, right after approval, or on a date you pick. (Orus Pro)
- Pause, resume or finish a phased release. (Orus Pro)

TESTFLIGHT
- Builds for each version with their state and expiry date.
- Submit a build for external testing: write the What to Test notes, choose groups and send it to beta review.
- Internal and external groups with their testers. Add testers, change their groups or remove them.
- Alerts (Orus Pro) through the Orus relay when a build enters or finishes beta review, and when it finishes processing or fails.

WIDGETS
- A Home Screen widget shows the review that needs you most, with its clock.
- Medium, Large and Lock Screen widgets show several apps at once. (Orus Pro)

YOUR KEY STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
- Sign in with an App Store Connect API key (Issuer ID, Key ID and .p8 file).
- The key is stored in the iOS Keychain and never leaves your iPhone. Orus talks to Apple directly.
- The Orus relay receives review state changes from Apple and push tokens from your device. It never receives your key, your testers' details or your customers' data.
- No analytics, no ads, no tracking.

TRY IT WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Demo mode shows sample apps, a simulated review and Live Activities, with no API key.

ORUS PRO
Free with one account: the dashboard, app details, all TestFlight tools, manual release, the small widget and Live Activities for two apps, updated when Orus refreshes.
Orus Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription that adds:
- The hosted Orus relay: Live Activities that update the moment App Review moves, with nothing to set up.
- Live Activities for any number of apps.
- Release scheduling and phased-release controls.
- TestFlight beta review and build alerts.
- Medium, Large and Lock Screen widgets.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

REQUIREMENTS
An Apple Developer Program membership and an App Store Connect API key. Create a Team key with the App Manager role or higher in App Store Connect under Users and Access, Integrations.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://getorus.app/privacy/

Orus is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Apple Inc. App Store, App Store Connect, TestFlight, Live Activities, Dynamic Island and iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc.

name: Oskavryn Flux Chambers
description:
Oskavryn Flux Chambers brings three card-driven puzzle games together in one app, each built around a different mechanic that treats the deck as a tool, not as a drawing pile.

Card Genome turns a 6x6 lab grid into a chemistry bench. Drag two cards into one of four suit-coded chambers and react: hearts add, diamonds multiply, clubs subtract, spades swap suits. Chain reactions build values no single pair can reach, and enzymes (Jack, Queen, King, Ace) rewrite, lock or reset what's on the board. Complete all 12 genetic patterns before your transformations run out.

Card Magnet is a sliding puzzle with field physics. Every card you place on the board becomes a magnet that pulls or pushes along its row and column. Rank sets the field range, suit sets the polarity, face cards invert the force, and matching suits form chains that travel together. Move each star target into a collection zone of its suit using as few magnets as possible.

Card Signal is a network routing puzzle. Towers broadcast a typed signal across a graph of relay nodes, and the cards you drop onto those nodes steer the beam: hearts boost, diamonds duplicate, clubs split, spades reverse the type. Light every receiver with the signal type it needs without going over the bandwidth budget.

Three games, three distinct mechanical ideas, one connected set of card puzzles for players who like a different kind of thinking every time they open the app.

name: Otorga: grants in Spain
description:
Otorga reads Spain's National Grants Database, the official source, and shows you what is published in your region. Most grants are local and regional and never appear in the BOE: here they do.

Every working day, 60 to 75 new calls are published across Spain. Otorga sorts them so you see yours first.

WHAT IT DOES
• The latest from your region and from all of Spain, every working day.
• Filters by area, subject, type of aid and keywords, with an alert when something new comes out.
• Save calls and we remind you a week before the deadline and the day before.
• Add the deadline to your calendar.
• Export your saved calls to a spreadsheet.
• Your filters and saved calls backed up to your iCloud in case you change iPhone.

FREE AND PRO
Searching, browsing and saving are free, with one filter with alerts. Otorga Pro adds alerts on all your filters, refining by subject and type of aid, unlimited saved calls, deadline reminders, calendar and export.

Otorga Pro is a yearly subscription of €14.99 with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends, and it renews every year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it expires, in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

YOUR DATA
No account required, no ads, no analytics. Your filters and saved calls live on your iPhone, backed up to your private iCloud.

Otorga is an independent app. Spain's General State Comptroller (IGAE) does not take part in it, sponsor it or endorse it. Always check the official bases before applying.

Data source: Intervención General de la Administración del Estado.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://bitacorasistemas.es/apps/otorga/privacy

name: Ouchi Japan ID Photo & Print
description:
Skip ¥900 Japanese street photo booths and recurring cloud subscriptions. Ouchi ID Photo handles shooting, 1024px offline BiRefNet hair-strand background replacement, natural retouching, web-entry JPEGs, and ¥30–40 Konbini L-size print sheets entirely on your iPhone.

• 100% On-Device AI — Your face photos never leave your iPhone, and GPS metadata is automatically stripped on export.
• Dual Offline Matting Engines — 1024px BiRefNet Fine Hair mode + fast Apple Vision mode with halo-free color decontamination across 6 studio backdrops (Original, Pure White, Standard Blue, Light Blue, Studio Gradient Blue, Soft Gray).
• 7 Japan & Visa Specs + Custom 20–80mm — Resume / Zairyu Card (30×40mm free), My Number (35×45mm), Passport (35×45mm with MOFA guides), Driver's License (24×30mm), Eiken (30×30mm), China Visa (33×48mm), US Visa (51×51mm), plus custom mm sizing.
• Self-Timer & 4-Shot Burst Camera — Natural front mirror preview, 3/5/10s timer, screen fill light, and live Vision posture/lighting guidance.
• Konbini Anti-Zoom Printing — Step-by-step guides for 7-Eleven, FamilyMart, Lawson & AirPrint, -2/-3/-4% borderless anti-zoom compensation, cut borders for white backgrounds, and 2+2 mixed L-size layouts.
• Fair One-Time Pro — Preview every Pro feature free before unlocking once. Zero subscriptions.

name: Overnight Box Fan Sounds
description:
One tap plays a box fan sound. The app generates it on your iPhone, so you can start offline without an account or a download.

Choose Overnight or set a timer. When the timer reaches its final ten seconds, the sound gradually fades. Adjust the app volume independently of system volume, use system media controls while listening, and return to your last settings the next time you open the app.

Share a card or copy a code so a friend can import the same speed and timer. Your volume and listening history stay out of what you share.

No ads or analytics.

Low, Overnight, the 30- and 60-minute timers and fading are free. Try Medium, High, the additional timers and the shortcut for 30 days. Keep them with a one-time purchase. No subscription or automatic charge.

name: Overwright
description:
Overwright is a fast, private PDF editor for iPhone and iPad. Open a PDF, fix it, sign it and send it back, without uploading it anywhere and without a subscription.

YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
Everything happens on your iPhone or iPad. There is no account, no cloud upload, no ads and no tracking. The app collects no data at all.

FILL AND SIGN
• Type anywhere on the page to fill in forms and applications
• Draw your signature with a finger or Apple Pencil and reuse it next time
• Add dates, checkmarks and stamps such as APPROVED, PAID or DRAFT

FIX AND MARK UP
• White-out old wording and type the correction over it
• Highlight, draw with the pen, and add lines and boxes
• Place photos and logos from your camera or photo library
• Add page numbers and a watermark

REDACT FOR REAL
Redaction permanently removes what it covers when you save. The content underneath is destroyed, not just hidden behind a black box.

ORGANIZE PAGES
• Rotate, reorder and delete pages
• Combine several PDFs into one

WORKS WITH FILES, MAIL AND MORE
• Choose “Open in Overwright” from Files, Mail and other apps
• Save to the Files app, or share, print and AirDrop the finished PDF

TRY EVERYTHING FREE
Every tool works in the free version, with no time limit. Pages you save, share or print carry a small trial watermark. A single one-time purchase removes it for good. No subscription, ever.

Overwright is also available for Mac at overwright.com.

Questions? contact@overwright.com

name: oWords: Learn Portuguese Words
description:
European Portuguese, the way it is spoken in Portugal. oWords helps you learn the words you need for everyday life, a few minutes a day.

oWords is made for people who live in Portugal or are moving here: from the café and the supermarket to the landlord, the bank and the tax office.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 3,018 European Portuguese words in four levels: A1, A2, B1 and B2
• Word lists built around the CEFR levels and Portuguese exam references (Camões, CAPLE)
• An example sentence with every ready-made word
• Your own words from a photo, a file or a pasted list
• Interface in English and Ukrainian

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a level or one of your own lists
• Choose the right translation out of four
• Three right answers and a word is learned
• Already know a word? Mark it as known and move on
• See how many words you really know

YOUR OWN WORDS IN SECONDS
Photograph a page from your textbook or notes, pick a photo or a file (TXT, CSV, PDF or Excel), or paste a list. oWords finds the words, puts back missing accents, skips the ones you already have and adds the translations by itself. You can fix any translation and learn the list in the same quiz.

FOUR LEVELS
• A1: 518 words. Everyday basics: a casa, o pão, obrigado
• A2: 1,043 words. Shopping, tips, queues, renting
• B1: 1,672 words. Rent, landlord, taxes, however
• B2: 3,018 words. Mortgage, interest, managing, and the idioms people really use

FREE AND PRIVATE
• Free, with no ads and no account
• Your words and progress stay on your device
• The quiz works offline
• Dark mode, iPhone and iPad
• Optional support levels if you would like to say thanks

Learn Portuguese, one word at a time.

name: P42 Climax
description:
P42 Climax is a tone-shaping amplifier built around the A-11/12J input transformer, the transformer of the first passive DI box, later known as the Wolfbox, which helped define the rich, full-range low end of the Motown sound. Now on your iPhone and iPad.

Around the transformer sit a saturation stage, two filters, two shelf or bell bands, an air band, a Class A stage, a clean output stage and a limiter. Use it on single tracks, on groups, on the 2-bus and in mastering, on the whole stereo signal or on only its mid or only its side.

Use it as an AUv3 plug-in in your favorite host (AUM, Cubasis, Logic Pro and more) or as a standalone app processing live sound from your microphone or audio interface.

KEY FEATURES:
- INPUT DRIVE pushes your signal into the A-11/12J transformer for low-frequency weight and roundness
- SATURATION builds a dense pattern of odd and even harmonics, and past 100 % a second stage joins in. Place it at the INPUT, before the filters and bands, or at the OUTPUT, after them
- Class A adds a warm, even-order layer on top
- HP FILTER and LP FILTER, 12 dB/oct, with FILTER REV. A for rounder transients or B for punchier ones
- LO SHELF and HI SHELF, each a shelf or a proportional-Q bell that boosts or cuts (INV), plus AIR for height and openness at the top
- ROUTING to DI, MID or SIDE, with ISOL to hear the part you process, and MS knobs that give INPUT DRIVE and MAIN OUT a second setting for the mid or the side
- MAIN OUT from −26 to +15 dB, and GCC, which matches the loudness to your dry signal with one tap
- MIX blends in your dry track, and Delta plays only what P42 Climax adds
- A limiter at the very end holds the peaks
- Dual Mono: two matched units, one per channel, for a subtle, natural width
- ECO halves the oversampling to save CPU
- Meters for input and output peaks, short-term loudness and RMS around the transformer window, which glows with the level
- Signal Path: a picture of the order of the stages
- A help strip that explains the control under your finger
- 93 factory presets in eleven folders, each balanced to the level of your dry signal, with notes, tags, search and favorites
- A/B slots with copy
- Made for touch: double-tap resets a control, a long press opens the preset and folder menus, and a Link DRIVE & MAIN OUT switch keeps the level while you drive
- Preset import and export through Files
- Mono and stereo
- Full parameter automation in AUv3 hosts

All audio is processed on your device. No account, no data collection, no internet connection required.

name: P7M & E-Invoice Viewer
description:
Open the invoice files your iPhone can't: signed .p7m files and XML e-invoices from Italy, Germany, France and the Peppol network.

E-Invoice Viewer turns raw XML into a clear, readable invoice: seller and buyer with VAT numbers, every line item, the VAT summary, totals, and the payment details you need, with one-tap copy for the IBAN and payment reference.

SUPPORTED FILES
• Signed .p7m files (CAdES), including double signatures and base64 downloads
• Italian FatturaPA, ordinary and simplified, including batches and SDI receipts
• German XRechnung, in UBL and CII
• Factur-X and ZUGFeRD hybrid PDFs: the invoice data inside the PDF
• Peppol BIS and other UBL 2.1 invoices and credit notes

WHAT YOU SEE
• Amount due and due date at a glance
• Seller and buyer, VAT ID, tax code and address
• Line items, VAT rates and exemptions, withholding tax and stamp duty
• Payment method, IBAN, BIC and reference
• Who signed a .p7m file and when
• The raw XML, if you need it

FREE TO TRY
Every invoice opens free with its summary: seller and buyer, VAT IDs, dates, totals and the amount due. Pro shows the rest.

E-INVOICE VIEWER PRO
• Every invoice in full: line items, VAT breakdown, payment details and IBAN
• Save any invoice as a clean PDF
• Open and save attachments and the original PDF
• Save the XML and the original signed file

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Files are read on your device and never uploaded. No account needed.

The app shows who signed a file. It does not check whether a signature or certificate is legally valid.

Pro is available as an auto-renewable subscription, billed weekly, monthly or yearly. Subscription payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. It renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://azcomputingltd.com/einvoice/terms
Privacy Policy: https://azcomputingltd.com/einvoice/privacy

name: Paciência Spider Clássica
description:
Spider Solitaire is the classic card game, rebuilt from scratch for today's phones and tablets.

Build eight same-suit runs from King down to Ace to clear the table. Start with 1 suit to relax, move up to 2 suits for a challenge and take on 4 suits when you are ready for the hardest game.

• Big, easy-to-read cards with a huge rank
• Drag cards, or tap them to send them to the best place
• Unlimited undo
• Hints that show the best move
• Classic scoring, time and moves
• Statistics for each difficulty: wins, win rate, best time and streaks
• Your game saves itself: close the app and carry on later
• Themes: card backs, card faces and tables, free and in packs
• Music and sound effects you control, plus vibration
• Plays offline, on iPhone and iPad
• In English, Portuguese and Spanish

No account and no sign-in. Your games and statistics stay on your device. The game shows non-personalised ads: a banner at the bottom of the screen and, now and then, a full-screen ad when a new game starts. A one-time purchase removes them all.

name: Packback: Packing List
description:
Forget it once. Packback is a packing list that learns from your own trips. Say where you’re going, when and how you’re getting there, and it builds your list from what you packed, used and forgot before. Every item tells you why it’s there.

PLAN A TRIP IN SECONDS
• Pick the place, the dates, how you’re getting there (plane, car, train, bus or boat) and the kind of trip: work, beach, cold, hiking, with kids, formal, camping or weekend.
• Your first trip starts from a starter list for what you pick. After that, start from similar past trips, copy one, or start blank.
• The list is grouped into Forgot last time, Always, For this trip and Maybe, with reasons like “7 of 8 work trips” or “Forgot · Lisbon, Mar”. Or group it by bag or by category.
• Things you count per night, like socks, get quantities that fit the length of the trip.
• Add items in seconds: type “socks x3” and press Return, or tap a suggestion.
• Give each trip a cover photo for the home card, History and the widget.

PACK ONE THING AT A TIME
• In a list, swipe an item right to pack it. A stray tap never packs anything, and there’s Undo.
• Packing mode shows one card at a time, bag by bag: swipe right for Packed, left for Later, up for Skip, or use the buttons.
• On the day, a Live Activity shows your progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Add a “Leave home at” time and packing ends with a quick door check of essentials like your passport, wallet and keys.

“I FORGOT…”
• Left something at home? Note it in a few taps from the app, a widget, a Control Center or Lock Screen control, or Siri.
• Next time it’s pinned to the top of a similar trip’s list until you’ve packed it on two trips in a row.
• Before you head back, “Pack to go home” re-checks what you brought.

A 15-SECOND CHECK-IN WHEN YOU’RE BACK
• Packback asks two questions: what did you forget, and what didn’t you use?
• Things you keep not using move to Maybe. Per-night quantities adjust to what you used.
• When you finish, Packback shows what it will remember for next time.

ALSO IN PACKBACK
• My Things: your own library of things, with Always and Last-minute items. Give a thing a picture if you like: a photo, a picture you paste or find on the web, an emoji or its initials. Packback lifts it off its background into a small sticker.
• New things get a suggested category, worked out on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence where it’s available, or with Packback’s own rules. You can always change it.
• History: past trips, what you forgot on each, and your streak of trips without forgetting anything.
• Reminders the evening before, the morning you leave, at your leave time and when you’re home.
• Widgets for your next trip, for your last-minute items (tap one to pack it in the app), and for “I forgot…”.
• Colour themes: Biscuit, the original, and Biscuit Sharpened, with more contrast.
• iCloud sync between your iPhones, free and on by default, through your own private iCloud.
• Share any list as text. Export everything as one readable file, or a trip’s checklist as a PDF.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking and no analytics. Your trips, lists and photos stay on your iPhone and, if you keep iCloud sync on, in your own private iCloud database, which only you can access. You can turn sync off in Settings. Packback only gets the photos you pick and never asks for access to your library. Searching the web for a picture sends only the words you search for to the search engine you choose, with its family-safe filter on, in a private browser that keeps no cookies or history.

PACKBACK PLUS
Packback is free to use with up to 3 upcoming or current trips at a time and unlimited history; past trips don’t count. Packback Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, and adds:
• Unlimited trips
• Your own trip kinds
• Your own bags
• The Cocoa and Apricot theme, warm and dark
• Two more app icons
• Import a list from text or a file

name: Packfolio: AI Packing List
description:
Packfolio builds your packing list from the trip itself, then shows you where every item goes in your actual suitcase.

SMART PACKING LIST
• Add destinations, dates and who's coming (kids and pets too)
• The list adapts to the real forecast at each stop: rain, cold, heat
• Quantities scale with the number of nights
• Tick items off as you gather them

A LAYOUT FOR YOUR OWN CASE
• Pick your suitcase size and the plan fits its real volume
• Layer by layer: shoes and heavy items at the bottom, clothes in the middle, last-minute items on top
• Every item gets a number and an emoji, so the plan is easy to follow
• Volume and weight estimates warn you before you hit the airline limit

CLOSE THE LID
• Pack the last item and close the case: see how full it is, how much rolling saved, and your packing persona

SHARE AND COPY
• Make a 3:4 "what's in my suitcase" card to share
• Send your list as a code; friends paste it to copy your whole list in one tap

AI PACKING ASSISTANT (optional)
• Photo check: snap your packing and see what's still missing
• Packed preview and flat-lay images of your trip
• Destination tips that add what only that place needs
New users get one free AI use. AI features are available as a single-trip unlock, a yearly membership or a lifetime unlock.

Your trips stay on your iPhone. No account needed.

Yearly membership renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.youxiaojia.cn/xiangxu/privacy

name: PailuMaze
description:
Plan a route. Slide to the goal.

PailuMaze is a single-player logic puzzle about movement and timing. Guide the marked tile across each grid. It slides in a straight line until an obstacle or the edge stops it. Reach the goal by stopping on it—sliding past does not count.

Every level asks you to plan your route. Work around fixed obstacles, push rocks when there is room, and solve selected levels within a move limit.

• Solve 100 levels on 5×5, 7×7, and 9×9 boards
• Learn the rules with a short, interactive tutorial
• Use up to three hints per level when you need a nudge
• Compare your moves with the optimal solution and save your personal best
• Customize sound effects, haptics, path previews, and the optional direction pad

Play fully offline. No account, ads, in-app purchases, or internet connection are required. Your progress and settings are stored on your device.

name: Panda Electric Motors
description:
Panda Electric Motors is the app of the official distributor of new electric cars in Albania.

FOR CAR OWNERS
• Garage: your cars with photos, specifications, warranty and kilometres.
• Service book: every service done in our workshop, with what was checked and replaced.
• Next service: when it is due, and one tap to call the workshop.
• Offers: ask for an offer on a new model and accept or decline it in the app.
• Notifications: know when your offer is ready or your order changes.

FOR SERVICE SHOPS
• Order original parts at your business price level once your account is approved.
• Follow your orders from confirmation to pickup.

PARTS SHOP
• Original parts, with what each part fits and the stock available.
• Pick up at a salon or have it delivered. You pay on handover or by invoice; nothing is paid in the app.

BROWSE WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
See the models, prices, salons and the parts shop without signing in. Create an account only when you want your garage, offers or orders.

The app is in Albanian and English.

name: Paper Parcel
seller_name: Shenzhen Weiyan E  Commerce Co., Ltd.
description:
Paper Parcel macht aus Zeugnissen, Urkunden und Fotos versandfertige PDF-Dateien. Scanne mit der Kamera oder importiere Fotos und PDFs. Sortiere, drehe und beschneide Seiten. Füge bei Bedarf ein Wasserzeichen hinzu.

Gib das Größenlimit deines Bewerbungsportals an. Paper Parcel prüft die tatsächliche Dateigröße und komprimiert die Unterlagen für den gemeinsamen oder einzelnen Export. Deine Vorgänge bleiben auf dem iPhone und lassen sich später erneut öffnen.

Scanne Buchdoppelseiten, erstelle Ausweiskopien auf A4 oder gestalte Passfotos. Der erste Dokumentensatz ist kostenlos. Mit Paper Parcel Pro kannst du nach einmaligem Kauf weitere Dokumentensätze exportieren und Regeln speichern.

name: Parages
description:
Que se passe-t-il près de chez vous ? Choisissez une commune et un rayon pour découvrir les articles, les flashs et les événements publiés par les blogs locaux.

Consultez le fil et l’agenda librement. Avec un compte, vous pouvez suivre des blogs, choisir les nouvelles publications qui vous intéressent, garder des favoris et participer aux discussions.

Vous souhaitez écrire sur votre quartier ou la vie de votre association ? Créez un blog, préparez vos publications en brouillon et invitez d’autres personnes à contribuer.

name: Paratrooper: Ridge Defense

description:

• Clutch records: laying date, candling (fertile, clear, stopped) and outcome for every egg; hatch dates from each species' incubation time

■ Your birds

Basics: one bird, growth album, hand-feeding and breeding logs, photo numbers and text, emergency card, the whole safe-food guide, care stamps, 10 words, basic sounds.

description:
Practice exams for AWS certifications, with an AI tutor beside every question. Know when you're ready to pass.

Passhalo gives you practice questions written from the official documentation, an AI tutor that explains any answer in plain words, mock exams on the real exam's scale, and a readiness score that tells you how close you are to a pass.

Stuck on a question? Ask the tutor. Why was my answer wrong? When would option C be right? How does this service differ from that one? name: Patemo: Table Tennis Video

LABEL WHAT DECIDED EACH POINT

name: Pawtile: Cat Logic Puzzle
description:
Pawtile is a cozy logic puzzle with exactly three rules.

One cat in every row and column.
One cat in every color patch.
Cats never touch, not even corner to corner.

That is the whole rulebook. You can learn it in ten seconds, and the puzzles keep getting smarter for a hundred levels.

NO GUESSING, EVER
Every board has exactly one solution, and you can reach it with pure deduction. Mark tiles with an X as you rule them out, drop a cat when only one spot is left, and watch the garden fill in.

100 LEVELS, FIVE GARDENS
Start on gentle 4x4 boards in the Sprout Patch and work up to 8x8 experts on the Sky Terrace. Then visit the Night Garden, where moonflowers count the cats sleeping beside them and the rules change after dark.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Solve the Daily Puzzle, stamp the calendar, and build a streak. Everyone gets the same board, and your result shares without spoilers.

HINTS THAT TEACH
Stuck? A hint points at a tile and explains the reasoning. It never solves the puzzle for you.

A GARDEN OF CATS
Meet Pip, your garden guide, and collect more cats, outfits and garden scenes as you earn stars. Everything you collect is cosmetic.

MADE TO BE COMFORTABLE
- Plays fully offline
- No hearts and no timers that punish you. A mistake costs a star, never the attempt
- Undo, redo, and drag to mark several tiles at once
- Left-handed controls, dark mode, larger pieces, and region symbols for color-blind play

name: Peekabrowser
description:
Peekabrowser is a lookup window that sits beside the app you are reading. Select a word or a passage in a PDF, a paper or your notes, send it to a search site or the AI you choose, and the question is already filled in. No app switching, no copying first.

Keep it in a window on the left side of the screen, in Slide Over or in split view, and the answer stays next to what you are reading.

• Share: tap Share, then Peekabrowser.

RECORDS STAY ON YOUR IPAD

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro Weekly renews automatically every week unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings. Pro Lifetime is a one-time purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://www.fortegroupsrls.it/permit-ace/privacy/

Permit Ace is an independent study aid.
