name: Personal Best Carp Log
description:
Personal Best Carp Log is a catch log built for carp anglers. Start a session when you reach the lake, log each fish in a few taps, and build a record of what works on your waters.

LOG A FISH IN SECONDS
• Photo from your camera or library
• Weight in pounds and ounces
• Species, rig, bait and notes
• Date and time, which you can change for fish you log later

WEATHER ADDED FOR YOU
When you log a fish on the bank, the app records pressure, wind, temperature and conditions automatically.

YOUR WATERS AND YOUR BEST
See every session and fish for each water, and your personal best at a glance.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account, no feed and no followers. Your sessions, catches and photos are stored on your phone. Your location is used only to fetch the weather when you log a fish.

FREE TO START
The free version covers one water and your first 20 catches.

PRO UNLOCK, ONE PAYMENT
• Unlimited waters and catches
• Bite times by time of day
• Best baits, rigs and swims
• Shareable catch cards that never show your swim
• Export your log as a spreadsheet

No subscription. Pay once and it is yours.

Weather data provided by Apple Weather.

name: Peyv Bibîne: Kürtçe Kelime
description:
Peyv Bibîne, Kurmancî Kürtçesini oynayarak öğrenmenin keyifli yolu!

Çemberdeki harfleri parmağınla birleştir, bulmacadaki Kürtçe kelimeleri bul. Bulduğun her kelimenin Türkçe anlamını hemen gör, gerçek Kurmancî konuşanların sesinden nasıl okunduğunu dinle.

- 1500 bölüm: 4 harfli kolay kelimelerden uzun ve zor kelimelere
- Binlerce Kurmancî kelime ve Türkçe anlamları
- Peyva Rojê: her gün yeni bir kelime tahmin et, sonucunu arkadaşlarınla paylaş
- Takıldığında Türkçe ipucu ve harf açma
- Gizli bonus kelimeler için ekstra altın
- Gerçek konuşmacıların sesiyle Kurmancî telaffuz
- Sözlüğüm: öğrendiğin tüm kelimeler tek yerde
- Ağrı Dağı, Van Gölü, Mardin ve Zap manzaraları
- İnternetsiz oynanabilir

Tam Sürüm (tek seferlik satın alma): reklamsız oyun, sınırsız altın ve ipucu.

Peyv bibîne, ziman hîn bibe! (Kelimeyi bul, dili öğren!)

Kelimeler FreeDict Kürtçe-Türkçe sözlüğünden, sesler Lingua Libre gönüllülerinden alınmıştır.

name: PhonoLab
description:
PhonoLab is an independent iPad app for phonetics learning, teaching, and speech analysis.

Record or import speech audio. Explore waveforms, spectrograms, pitch, formants, and intensity. Listen to a selected interval and add point or interval annotations. Organize saved audio by project, location, and speaker. Export measurement data as CSV, audio as WAV, and annotations as TextGrid. A built-in synthetic sample lets you try analysis and annotation immediately. Browse the IPA vowel diagram and grouped symbols offline.

name: Phorget: Hide Photos
description:
Some people don't belong in your camera roll anymore.

Phorget finds the photos and videos of one person and moves them out of sight, so they stop showing up in your library, your albums and the Photos widget. Pick a photo, tap their face, answer a few quick "is this them?" questions, and they're out of view.

Nothing is deleted
Phorget hides, it doesn't erase. Everything goes into the Hidden album that Photos already has. Change your mind and bring them back from their page in Phorget.

It all happens on your iPhone
Face matching runs on your device. Your photos are never uploaded, and there is no account. Phorget keeps no copies and no face data: only a list of which items it hid, so it can bring them back.

Photos and videos
Both are found in one pass, and you see everything it found before anything is hidden.

As many people as you need
Phorget Yearly covers everyone you need to forget. New photos of them? Add them from their page anytime, and with the Hidden album unlocked, Phorget looks for new ones each time you open it. What you've hidden stays hidden, and you can always bring it back.

Seen them again?
If a photo slipped through, add it from their page and Phorget looks again.

Good to know
• iPhone asks you to confirm before anything is hidden.
• With iCloud Photos, items are hidden on your other devices too, and in a Shared Library for everyone in it.
• To bring someone back later, iPhone needs the Hidden album unlocked in Settings for a moment. Phorget shows you how.
• Works best on adults. Faces turned away, very small or covered can be missed; you can add those later.

About Phorget Yearly
Phorget Yearly is an auto-renewable subscription with a length of 1 year. The App Store sets the price for your country and shows it before you buy; in the US it is US$9.99 a year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. After you buy, you can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings (Settings > your name > Subscriptions).
Terms of Use: https://phorget.co/terms
Privacy Policy: https://phorget.co/privacy

name: Photo Trail: Map of Your Trips
description:
Turn your photos into a map of your trips.

Turn the locations saved in your photos and videos into an animated trip map. Pick your travel dates and Photo Trail connects your captures in order, so you can replay your route on a satellite map and share a video of the journey.

• Play or scrub through your trip and see the cities, dates, and distance along the way.
• Choose your route color, video length, distance units, and portrait, square, feed, or landscape format.
• Export a Full HD MP4 to Photos, then open or share it from Photo Trail.
• Reopen recent trips from the home screen.

Photo Trail needs at least two photos or videos with saved locations and capture times to animate a route. The app reads that information on your device and renders the video locally. Satellite imagery requires an internet connection.

name: PhysioStudent
description:
**Today's student. Tomorrow's physiotherapist.**

PhysioStudent is your personal study companion, designed specifically for physiotherapy and physical therapy students.

From your first lecture to your final semester, PhysioStudent brings your academic organization, personal notes, study schedule and anatomy reference together in one intuitive app.

**MY COURSES**

• Create and personalize your own courses.
• Choose from a wide selection of healthcare and physiotherapy icons.
• Organize your active and completed subjects.
• Archive completed courses without losing your valuable notes.
• Access course-specific notes directly.

**SMART NOTES**

• Create and organize personal study notes.
• Format text with bold, italic, underline and highlights.
• Add photographs and PDF attachments.
• Capture educational material using your camera.
• Create drawings and diagrams.
• Build interactive study checklists.
• Export your notes for further editing in compatible applications such as Apple Pages.

**EVENTS & ACADEMIC PLANNING**

• Organize exams, assignments and academic deadlines.
• Set reminders for important events.
• Connect study events with Apple Calendar.
• Keep track of upcoming and completed academic activities.

**ANATOMY ATLAS**

Explore muscle anatomy through a dedicated educational reference featuring:

• Muscle origins
• Muscle insertions
• Innervation
• Muscle actions
• Anatomical illustrations and animations
• Favorite muscles
• Direct integration with your personal study notes

**DESIGNED FOR STUDENTS**

• Modern and intuitive interface
• English and Greek language support
• Guided first-launch experience
• Local storage of personal study material
• No account required

PhysioStudent helps you organize what you learn, revisit important information and build your own personal academic knowledge library.

**EDUCATIONAL PURPOSE**

PhysioStudent is intended exclusively for educational and academic organization purposes. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment recommendations or clinical decision support. It is not a substitute for formal education, academic textbooks or professional clinical judgment.

An internet connection may be required to display certain anatomical illustrations and animations.

name: Pia Cowork
description:
Pia Cowork is the remote control for PIA Cowork on your computer. Your AI assistants (Claude Code, Codex, PIA…) keep running on your computer; your phone lets you assign work, follow progress and approve actions when you are away from your desk.

Key features: • Chat with the AI assistants running on your computer and watch replies stream in real time • Approve or reject actions that need permission • Teams: several assistants working toward one goal • Projects tied to folders on your computer; browse the files and images agents create • Send photos and files from your phone to an assistant • Scheduled runs and notifications when an assistant finishes

Security: your phone pairs with your computer by QR code. Conversations travel only between your phone and your computer, end-to-end encrypted — even over the Internet.

Requires a macOS or Windows computer running PIA Cowork (download at piacowork.com/tai-ve) and a MIA account.

name: Pilot & Fluglotse Eignungstest
description:
Inoffizielle, unabhängige Lernhilfe: Diese App steht in keiner Verbindung zum DLR, zur Deutschen Flugsicherung oder zu einer Airline.

Der Weg ins Cockpit oder in den Tower führt über einen der anspruchsvollsten Eignungstests überhaupt. Mit Pilot & Fluglotse Eignungstest bereitest du dich auf den Pilotentest, den Fluglotsentest und das Auswahlverfahren der Airlines vor und trainierst die Fähigkeiten, auf die es dort ankommt.

Das trainierst du in der App:
- Konzentration und Merkfähigkeit
- Kopfrechnen und mathematisches Verständnis
- Räumliches Denken und technisches Verständnis
- Englisch
- Wahrnehmung und Aufmerksamkeit unter Zeitdruck

Diese Kurse findest du in der App:
- Piloten Eignungstest
- Fluglotse Einstellungstest für Deutschland und Österreich
- Luftfahrt Einstellungstest
- Airline-Auswahltest
- Flugbegleiter Einstellungstest
- Piloten Einstellungstest Österreich

So lernst du mit der App:
- Tausende Übungsaufgaben mit ausführlichen Lösungen
- Tests mit Zeitvorgabe wie im echten Auswahlverfahren
- Ein Lernplan bis zu deinem Testtermin
- Eine Community mit anderen Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern

Computergestützte Psychomotorik-Aufgaben einzelner Verfahren bildet die App nicht ab.

Du kannst die App kostenlos ausprobieren. Den vollen Kurs schaltest du mit einem einmaligen Kauf frei, ohne Abo.

Offizielle Informationen zur Eignungsuntersuchung findest du beim DLR: https://www.dlr.de/de/me

Ein Angebot von TestHelden, eHeroes GmbH, August-Bebel-Str. 3, 08412 Werdau.

name: Pilou Baby Monitor
description:
Sleep easy, Pilou is watching.

Pilou turns the phone sleeping in your drawer into a video baby monitor. Place it near baby’s crib, scan its QR code with your phone: you see baby, hear baby and talk to baby.

CRY DETECTION
• Baby’s phone recognizes real crying, not a slamming door or the TV.
• You’re alerted even with the app closed, with a gentler alert for loud noises.
• Adjustable sensitivity: less sensitive, normal, more sensitive.

AT HOME OR OUT
• On your home Wi-Fi, video and sound go straight from one phone to the other.
• On 4G and 5G, from the backyard, the neighbors’ or work (Premium).
• Pilou lets you know if the room stops responding or the battery runs low.

FOR BABY
• Lullabies and soft sounds (rain, waves, mom’s heartbeat…), started from your bed, that stop on their own.
• Night light: baby’s screen becomes a soft glow in amber, pink, lavender or night blue.
• Talk to baby with a single press.
• Night vision to see better in the dark.

THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Up to 4 parents at once, each in their own language (Premium).
• An invitation link valid for 24 h for a grandparent or a babysitter.
• Remove a parent anytime, from baby’s phone.

TONIGHT
• When you wake up: crying, noises and wake-ups during the night, hour by hour.
• All your nights are kept, so you can follow baby’s sleep week after week (Premium).
• On iPhone, “Baby is asleep · Calm for…” stays on the Lock Screen (Premium).

YOUR PRIVACY
• Nothing is recorded: no video, no sound.
• No account, no email.
• Crying is recognized by baby’s phone itself.

PILOU PREMIUM
Free: video and sound on your home Wi-Fi, one parent at a time, cry detection with the app open, one lullaby, the last 6 hours of the night.
Premium: 4G and 5G, alerts with the app closed, up to 4 parents, all lullabies and soft sounds, the whole night and all past nights, the iPhone Lock Screen.
Monthly or yearly subscription, with 7 days free on the yearly plan. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple Account settings.

Works with iPhone on iOS 15 or later, and with Android: an iPhone and an Android phone work together.
Pilou is not a medical device and does not replace the presence of an adult.

Terms of Use: https://pilou-babyphone.com/conditions
Privacy Policy: https://pilou-babyphone.com/confidentialite

name: Pip's Toy Post
description:
A sugar gate stands between Pip and the corner shop. The delivery cart is ready to go, and the workbench has a lemon that can melt the gate. Set the reels, pull the lever, and see what happens.

In Pip's Toy Post, you program a toy delivery cart with three fruit reels. Follow the road from left to right and look at the three obstacles. Swipe each reel or tap its arrows until the fruit you need is in the center. Each fruit has a job: an apple weighs down a toll pedal, cherries press two switches, a lemon melts a sugar gate, an orange unfurls a curved track, a watermelon rind carries the cart across water, and grapes stack into steps.

Tap Test Run on the lever next to the reels. Pip tries your three instructions in order. If a fruit doesn't suit the obstacle, the cart stops there so you can change the reels and retry. Tap Clue on the delivery slip to reveal a fruit for one obstacle, or open the illustrated Fruit Guide from the post office.

Complete deliveries to unlock 24 routes across Market Mile, Canal Quarter, Sugarworks, and Kite Heights. On six routes, the track switch changes the street and the obstacles ahead. Deliver along both streets to mark each one on your map. Later, the middle reel also turns the right reel, sometimes in the opposite direction.

Earn three stars for a clear on your first try without a clue. For an Express postmark, meet the turn target too. Every notch you turn by hand counts, so sometimes choosing a different street is the quickest way to send the parcel.

Play offline at your own pace, replay unlocked routes from the map, and switch toy sounds or haptic clicks on or off in Settings.

name: Pirate Arcade: Storage Games
description:
The unit door rolls up. What's inside is yours. If you're fast enough.

Pirate Arcade packs four storage-unit mini games into one app, built by a real storage-auction pirate. Short rounds, big swings, no account needed.

SCRAMBLE
Slide the crates, open a path, and crack the unit before the clock runs out. Peek at the picture, plan your moves, and climb the ladder from junk units to legendary hauls. Play the solo campaign or race 2–4 friends live.

STACK
Boxes, couches, and mystery bins drop in. Stack them high and tight. One bad drop and the whole load comes down. Twist Mode shakes things up when you think you've got it.

SURVIVAL
Night falls on the storage lot and something's coming for your unit. Grab gear, hold the doors, bank your loot, and make it to sunrise.

BOX DIG
Pick a unit, open boxes, and find the cash. Every box could be a payday or a hazard. Know when to push your luck and when to cash out.

BID OR BUST (coming soon)
Read the room, outbid the crowd, and don't get stuck paying top dollar for a unit full of junk.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• Four games, one app, one tap from the menu
• Rounds that fit a coffee break
• Progress saves on your phone. No sign-up, no login
• Plays offline (race mode needs internet)
• Made by someone who actually buys storage units

Your game progress stays on your device. No account needed, and we never sell your data.

Free demos of all 4 games. Unlock all 4 full games: $4.99 one time. No subscription, no auto-renew, no ads. Your progress is kept.

name: Plain Todo Text
description:
Plain Todo keeps your tasks in a plain-text todo.txt file that you can read and edit with any other todo.txt app. One task per line, with optional priorities, dates, projects, and contexts.

TASKS
• Add, edit, complete, reopen, and delete tasks
• Priorities (A) to (E), creation dates, and due dates
• +Project and @context tags, highlighted in the list, with suggestions as you type
• Task details show status, dates, and related tasks

ORGANIZE
• Sort by priority, due date, or both
• Group tasks by priority, due date, project, or context
• Archive completed tasks to done.txt, by hand or automatically
• Optional app badge for tasks that are due or overdue

YOUR FILES
• Start with a file in app storage, or open an existing todo.txt from Files
• Sync with iCloud Drive: todo.txt and done.txt appear in a Plain Todo folder in Files
• Optional direct Dropbox connection, with revision checks that stop conflicting saves
• Changes are written straight to your file
• Export a plain-text copy at any time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no analytics. The app only talks to Dropbox if you connect it, and your tasks never pass through our servers.

Files in app storage and your settings can be included in iCloud Backup, if you have it turned on. A saved Dropbox connection stays on this device and is not included.

name: Plane Place Aviation
description:
Plane Place Aviation is an FAA Part 145 repair station at Cleburne Regional Airport (KCPT) in Cleburne, Texas. This app is for our customers and our team.

FOR AIRCRAFT OWNERS AND OPERATORS
• See every aircraft you have with us and where each one stands.
• Follow work orders as the work gets done.
• Review and approve quotes and added work from your phone, with your signature.
• Open your invoices and documents in the built-in viewer, and share them.
• Get a notification when a quote is ready, work needs your approval, or an invoice is posted.

FOR OUR TEAM
• Shop work on the go, including aircraft walkaround videos recorded with the camera.

ALSO
• Optional Face ID lock.
• Links in our emails open straight in the app.
• Accounts are set up by Plane Place Aviation; there is no public sign-up. To get access, contact the shop.

Questions? Visit aerobase.ppa.aero/support

name: Plant Care and Watering remind
description:
Identify the plant in a photo, see how to look after it, and set a watering reminder.

Photograph a leaf or the whole plant. You see the species and a plan for this plant: how much to pour, whether the light by the window is enough, and what to do if the leaves look wrong.

WHAT IT DOES
• Photo scan. The scan names the species in the picture.
• A care plan. After a scan there are steps for this plant, starting today.
• If the leaves look wrong, you get care steps for this plant. The guess can be wrong. This is not a diagnosis.
• The plant card shows the species, how hard it is to look after, and whether it is toxic to pets. This is not a vet, and that line can be wrong.
• Light. Point the phone at the spot where the pot stands. You see whether that light is enough for this species.
• Watering. It shows how much to pour, in millilitres and as a share of a 0.5 litre bottle. On a phone set to the United States, the same amount is shown in fluid ounces.
• A watering reminder on the day you choose, then again on the days you set.
• Your plants stay in one list, and each one shows the next watering. Mark a plant watered, and the next date moves.
• Chat. Ask about your own plant. A reply can be wrong. You can report it in the chat.

FREE
Up to 5 plants, 10 scans in total, and 3 questions a day. The 3 questions come back the next day.

PLUS
Plus is an auto-renewable subscription. It removes the limit of 5 plants and allows more scans and more questions than the free plan.

Plus Yearly lasts 1 year and includes 7 days free if you have not used that trial. You pay nothing during those 7 days. Cancel at least 24 hours before they end, or the year is charged to your Apple ID and the subscription renews every year until you cancel.

Plus Monthly lasts 1 month and has no free trial. It renews every month until you cancel.

The price is on the Apple payment sheet before you confirm, in your local currency.

Cancel on iPhone: Settings, your name, Subscriptions. The garden stays on the phone. When the time you already paid for ends, the free limits apply again.

HOW A SCAN WORKS
You can photograph your own plant, or open an example first. To name the species and write the steps, the app sends the photo to our server, and from there to an AI service. Before the first photo and before the first question in the chat, the app asks you to agree. If you tap Not now, the rest of the app keeps working.

QUESTIONS
What if the species is wrong? On the result, tap Not this one? You can also ask in the chat and report the reply.
Will it remind me to water? Yes. You pick the day, and each plant in the list shows the next watering.
What stays free? Up to 5 plants, 10 scans in total, and 3 questions a day.
Will the free week cost anything today? No. The price for the day the trial ends is on the screen before you start. Cancel at least 24 hours before that day and you are not charged.
Do the plants stay on the phone? Yes. The garden stays on the phone.

HELP
Email the team at app@doxmediagroup.com
Privacy Policy: https://elixir-app.net/planto/privacy
Terms of Use: https://elixir-app.net/planto/terms

name: Platena CineClue
description:
Discover trending movies and TV shows, watch trailers, and save the hidden details, easter eggs, and continuity errors you spot while watching, all in one app for movie lovers.

EXPLORE MOVIES & TV SHOWS
Browse trending, now playing, popular, and upcoming titles. Dive into detail pages with posters, backdrops, genres, runtime, and overviews, and watch trailers right from the app. TV shows include full season and episode breakdowns with air dates and summaries. Discover by genre, from action and animation to crime and documentary.

SEARCH & SAVE
Search across movies and TV shows, and bookmark anything to your personal library with one tap. Jump from any title straight into creating a new discovery for it.

CAPTURE YOUR DISCOVERIES
Every movie hides more than one viewing can catch: a prop that moves between shots, a crown designed with meaning, a background detail only true fans notice. Save what you spot while watching, including hidden details, easter eggs, theories, character insights, missed details, continuity errors, and favorite moments.

Attach photos and videos straight from your library

Tag each discovery and write down exactly what you found

See everything grouped by tag on your home feed, ready to revisit anytime

Edit or remove discoveries whenever you like

MADE FOR MOVIE LOVERS
A cinematic interface with a floating tab bar and glass-blur design. Available in English, Spanish, and French, with lists and details following your language. Your discoveries are stored privately on your device, and no account is required.

Download now and never miss another hidden detail.

name: PlayDart: Darts Scorer
description:
PlayDart keeps your darts score for you. Put your phone next to the board, enter each visit and let the app do the maths: score left, average, suggested checkout, statistics.

PLAY EVERY GAME
• X01: 301, 501, 701 or any score you like. Double, master or straight out, double in, legs and sets.
• Cricket: Standard, Cut-Throat and No Score.
• Around the Clock, Shanghai, Half It, Killer, Count Up, Gotcha and Golf to liven up game night.
• 1 to 8 players on the same phone: your PlayDart friends or guests without an account.

FAST SCORING
• Dart by dart (single, double, triple, bull) or, in X01, just the total of the visit.
• The finish guide suggests what to aim at as soon as you are in range.
• Undo the last dart, big-score announcements (180!), optional sounds.
• The screen stays on during a game, and an interrupted game can be resumed.

NO ONE TO PLAY WITH? PLAY A BOT
In X01 and Cricket, take on a bot with several difficulty levels.

EACH ON YOUR OWN PHONE
Create a room and share the code or the QR code: your friends join and you play remotely, each on your own phone. Available for X01, Cricket, Around the Clock, Shanghai and Half It.

TOURNAMENT NIGHT
Run a knockout tournament with your friends on a single device.

PRACTISE
• Around the Doubles: 3 darts at each double from D1 to D20, then the bull, to find your weak doubles.
• 100 darts at the treble 20, with your score, your T20 rate and your record.
• 121: 9 darts to check out on a double. Hit it and the target goes up by one; miss and it comes back down.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• 3-dart average, points per dart, first 9 darts, checkout rate, visits of 100+, 140+ and 180.
• Your records: highest visit, best checkout, winning streak.
• Progress charts, a heatmap of the board and the numbers you hit most.
• Head-to-head with a friend, a leaderboard among friends and a stats card to share.

LEARN
Illustrated lessons on how to throw and the history of darts.

FOR EVERYONE
• Available in English, French, German, Dutch and Spanish.
• Light or dark theme.
• Try it right away without an account (501, 301 or Cricket). With an account (nickname, e-mail and 6-digit code), your games and statistics are saved.

Keeping score is free, with no ads. Just throw a dart.

name: Plenafold: Workshop Routes
description:
Which ten minutes can you cut from a workshop? Plenafold helps facilitators see which exercises depend on earlier work, then bring what happened in the room into the next edition.

Try the fictional Volunteer shift handover workshop. You rehearsed for 40 minutes and now have 30. Skip writing the handoff and the next pair has no draft to check. Skip sorting the examples and you lose the sorted set, while the group can still check a handoff and agree when to use it.

Build your own workshop with an audience, a time limit and a running order. Give each activity a rehearsal time and an output. Mark the outputs participants need to leave with and link activities to the work they require. Compare cuts on iPhone or see the running order alongside their consequences on iPad.

After a session, record which activities ran, how long they took if measured, and what participants produced. Leave uncertain outcomes unchecked. When the required work and its prerequisites are evidenced, start a new edition from the activities you actually delivered. You can reopen the earlier record to see how the plan differed from the session.

Workshops and delivery history are saved on your device. Plan, record and export a plain-text delivery record to Files offline. Private facilitator notes stay in the app.

name: Plot Vote
description:
A suitcase holds a photograph of your front door. A midnight pulse interrupts an observatory broadcast. A diary page vanishes inside a sealed case. What really happened?

Plot Vote is a deduction game for one player or three friends sharing one iPhone or iPad. Follow different leads, review your evidence notebook, and submit a theory backed by two clues. See your score and read what the decisive clues reveal. In Pass and Play, investigate together and vote privately before revealing the group’s verdict.

Play The Wrong Suitcase and two quick mysteries for free. The optional Full Case Pack permanently unlocks three more full investigations: The Midnight Signal, The Vanishing Page, and The Train That Waited. Replay each full investigation to follow a different route. No game account required.

name: Plumbing Flashcards Quest
description:
Move between Flashcards, Practice and a dedicated Apprentice Workshop using the bottom navigation bar.

A number is more useful when you can explain its units. Plumbing Flashcards Quest brings a hands-on study bench to apprentice and journeyman preparation, alongside a library of trade concepts.

AT THE BENCH
Open Pipe Math Bench before opening a deck. Enter a horizontal run in feet and an assumed fall in inches per foot. The bench calculates the resulting elevation change in inches and shows the relationship behind it. Switch to Flow & Volume, enter an assumed US-gallon-per-minute rate and elapsed minutes, and inspect the total volume. Change the inputs to see which quantities scale together. Blank, negative, and invalid inputs are not treated as usable measurements.

WORK IT OUT FIRST
A short bench-check exercise asks you to infer a rate from a run and elevation change. Reveal the reasoning after you have made your own attempt. The tools are included free and use explicit units, not an unexplained result.

REVIEW THE TRADE
The topic decks cover plumbing study areas such as water supply, sanitary drainage, venting, fixtures, water heaters, and fuel-gas concepts. Review definitions and examples, turn cards over, record recall, and revisit misses. The separate Practice area provides another way to work through the material. Progress remains on your device.

ACCESS
The first 200 exam-study cards are available free. The optional Full Unlock is a one-time purchase for the remaining card collection, not an exam subscription. The math bench remains available without that purchase. The app may display advertising and offers optional ad removal.

KNOW THE LIMITS
This is an independent educational aid. Example rates are assumptions, not required or permitted installation values. The bench does not size a system, establish code compliance, approve gas work, or replace a licensed professional. name: Plumir 羽镜
description:
Plumir 羽镜 —— 一块会呼吸的白板

把脑子里散落的想法，一次摆到同一张纸上。Plumir 羽镜是一块为思考而生的无限画布：写卡片、贴便签、导图片、画连线，再用一条可以翻页的时间线，把整个过程串起来。

■ 无限画布
单指拖动就能平移，双指缩放没有边界。想法多到装不下时，画布会跟着你一起长大。

■ 卡片笔记
点一下就能写下一条想法。标题、正文、待办三种卡片，多种颜色，随手贴、随手挪。

■ 时间线分页
画布下方是一条可以翻页的时间线。想展开下一段思路，就加一页——不用新建画布，思路始终在同一条线上。

■ 图片导入
参考图、截图、草图都能直接放进画布，随意拉伸缩放，不加边框，不打断视线。

■ 两种皮肤
手绘皮肤像一张真的纸，有颗粒感、手写体和轻微的不规则；印刷皮肤干净利落，适合把想法整理成稿。随时切换，内容不丢。

■ 专注，不打扰
没有账号，没有云端，没有推送。你的画布只存在这台设备上。

适合谁：写方案的人、做产品的人、整理读书笔记的人，以及所有习惯「先把想法摊开、再慢慢收拢」的人。

name: Pluto Buddy
description:
Pluto helps you make real friends near you.

Moving to a new city, working from home, or just want more people to do things with? Pluto brings together people nearby who love the same things: the same trails, the same coffee spots, the same music.

DISCOVER PEOPLE NEARBY
• See people around you who share your interests
• Profiles with photos, prompts and the languages people speak
• Filter by distance and interests
• Verified profiles, so you know people are real

CHAT AND VIDEO CALL
• Chat once you both say hi
• Quick video calls to see if you click
• Built-in translation when you don't share a language
• Plan a hangout straight from the chat

GROUPS AND EVENTS
• Join interest groups near you and chat with the group
• Find local events, or host your own
• Meet a few people at once, not just one

VIBE CHECK
• Meet someone new on a short live video chat
• Skip, keep talking, or add them as a friend

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Pluto is for adults 18 and over
• Block or report anyone, or a single message, in one tap
• Abusive words are filtered out, and every report is reviewed by our team
• Zero tolerance for harassment and objectionable content

PLUTO PREMIUM AND VIP
Pluto is free to use. Premium adds unlimited friend requests, see who likes you, advanced filters and undo. VIP adds priority requests, profile boosts and more visibility.

Premium and VIP are auto-renewing subscriptions, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings at any time.

Coins can be bought for video calls and extras.

Terms of Use: https://api.plutofriends.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://api.plutofriends.com/privacy/

Questions? support@plutobuddy.com

name: PocketTransfer
description:
PocketTransfer moves files between your iPhone and a computer on the same network. Nothing to install on the computer: open the address PocketTransfer shows in Chrome or Edge, type the 8-digit code, and allow the computer on your iPhone.

SEND TO THE COMPUTER
Choose photos and videos from Photos, or files from Files. The computer downloads them one by one or as one ZIP. Live Photos arrive as their photo and their video.

RECEIVE FROM THE COMPUTER
Drag files onto the page or choose them on the computer. Your iPhone asks before anything is saved, and you find the files in Received, where you can share them or save them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Files go straight from one device to the other over your local network. They never pass through a PocketTransfer server: there is none. Each computer needs your approval on the iPhone.

FREE, WITH AN OPTION
Free mode sends 1 file up to 10 MB per transfer, as often as you like. Watch a short ad to unlock unlimited transfers for 10 minutes. PocketTransfer Premium is a one-time purchase that removes ads and limits.

GOOD TO KNOW
- The iPhone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi or local network.
- Keep PocketTransfer open until the transfer finishes. Locking the screen or switching apps disconnects the browser.
- PocketTransfer uses local HTTP without encryption. Use it only on a private Wi-Fi network you trust.
- Works with Chrome and Edge on the computer.

name: Poczta LivePL
description:
Poczta LivePL to firmowa poczta Live Production (poczta.livepl.eu) w osobnej aplikacji, na cały ekran i z własną ikoną.

• Liczba nieprzeczytanych wiadomości na ikonie aplikacji.
• Logowanie trzyma 90 dni od ostatniego użycia, bez ciągłego wpisywania hasła.
• Wiele kont w jednym miejscu i szybkie przełączanie między nimi.
• Załączniki: podgląd, zapisywanie w Plikach i wysyłanie zdjęć z telefonu.
• Tryb dzień i noc.
• Linki z wiadomości otwierają się w przeglądarce, a poczta zostaje na miejscu.
• Telefon rejestruje się w urzędzie LivePL kluczem w Secure Enclave.
• Bez reklam i bez śledzenia.

Do logowania potrzebne jest konto pocztowe Live Production lub LivePL.

name: Pok Player
description:
Pok Player is a media player for the playlists you already have. Add your M3U link or your server login and watch on your iPhone, iPad or Mac.

Pok Player does not provide any content: no channels, no movies, no series and no subscription. It only plays the sources you add yourself, and you are responsible for having the right to watch them.

FEATURES
• M3U playlists and server logins (address, username, password)
• Several playlists at once, switched on or off in one tap
• Live, movies and series in separate sections, with search
• TV guide and replay when your playlist provides them
• Favorites, resume playback, and profiles for each member of the family
• Parental control with a PIN code
• Audio track and subtitle selection, picture format, sleep timer
• Reminders for the programmes you do not want to miss
• Plays the common formats: HLS, MPEG-TS, MP4, MKV
• Manage your playlists from a phone or a computer at pokplayer.com: type them once, find them on your device
• Keyboard shortcuts on Mac and iPad: space to pause, arrows to change channel, numbers to jump to a channel
• 17 languages

PRIVACY
No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no crash reporting. We do not know what you watch. Your playlist logins are stored encrypted. Details: pokplayer.com/privacy.html

Pok Player is not affiliated with any content provider.

name: PokeScann
description:
PokeScann riconosce le carte del Gioco di Carte Collezionabili Pokémon con la fotocamera, ti dice quanto valgono e tiene in ordine la tua collezione.

INQUADRA E RICONOSCI
• Punta la fotocamera sulla carta: PokeScann legge numero, sigla dell'espansione e nome e trova la carta giusta in pochi secondi.
• Funziona con le carte in italiano, inglese e nelle altre lingue europee, e con le carte giapponesi e cinesi.
• Se ci sono più carte possibili ti mostra le candidate con l'immagine, così scegli tu.
• Il riconoscimento avviene sul telefono: le foto non vengono mai caricate né salvate.

QUANTO VALE
• Prezzo indicativo di ogni carta dalla guida prezzi Cardmarket, aggiornato ogni giorno.
• Prezzi separati per versione: normale, holo, reverse holo, prima edizione.
• Un tocco apre la carta su Cardmarket per vedere le offerte nella lingua che ti interessa.

LA TUA COLLEZIONE
• Aggiungi le carte con versione, lingua, condizione e quantità.
• Valore totale della collezione sempre aggiornato, ordinabile per valore, nome o espansione.
• Collezione salvata sul tuo account: la ritrovi su ogni dispositivo.

TUTTE LE ESPANSIONI
• Oltre 50.000 carte di più di 500 espansioni europee/USA, giapponesi e cinesi, dalle prime serie alle ultime uscite.
• Per ogni espansione vedi quali carte hai e quali ti mancano.
• Nuove espansioni aggiunte automaticamente ogni settimana.

POKESCANN PRO (facoltativo)
• Grafico dello storico giornaliero del prezzo di ogni carta della collezione.
• Variazione in percentuale di ogni carta e di tutta la collezione da quando l'hai aggiunta.
• Valore e variazione delle tue carte per ogni espansione.
Abbonamento mensile con rinnovo automatico, disdici quando vuoi dalle impostazioni dell'App Store. Il pagamento è addebitato sul tuo account Apple alla conferma dell'acquisto; l'abbonamento si rinnova automaticamente se il rinnovo non viene disattivato almeno 24 ore prima della fine del periodo.

Privacy: https://pokescan-ea4b4.web.app/privacy#privacy

PokeScann è un'app non ufficiale e non è affiliata, sponsorizzata o approvata da Nintendo, The Pokémon Company, Creatures o GAME FREAK. Pokémon e i nomi dei personaggi sono marchi dei rispettivi proprietari. Dati e immagini delle carte: TCGdex, pokemontcg.io, Limitless TCG. Prezzi indicativi dalla guida prezzi Cardmarket.

name: Polar Recall: Daily Trivia
description:
How far can your knowledge take you?

Polar Recall turns general-knowledge trivia into an expedition beneath the ice. Type an answer to each question and watch your submarine descend as your score grows. Rarer answers earn more points.

A DAILY DIVE
Play five questions in a short daily round. Questions rotate through a curated collection covering geography, science, culture, history, and more.

AN OCEAN TO DISCOVER
Explore three underwater scenes, meet Arctic cod, lanternfish, and vent eelpout, and keep your discoveries in a Field Guide on your iPhone. Spoken encouragement celebrates each correct answer.

PRACTICE YOUR RECALL
Return for a practice dive and try a different answer. Review the accepted answers after each question and see what you missed.

MADE FOR A QUIET MOMENT
Play offline with progress saved on your iPhone. No account, ads, or in-app purchases.

Answer rarity is an editorial game difficulty rating, not a live player statistic.

name: Poolio.
description:
Poolio keeps a home pool’s tests, care, equipment, and spending in one record, so a season is something you can look back through instead of a pile of notes.
Create a pool, then switch among several. Each pool keeps its own profile, shape, surface, and fresh or salt water. Enter the dimensions you know. Poolio shows the volume from those measurements, and you can keep your own figure beside it. Add pumps, filters, cleaners, heaters, and salt systems with the name, brand, and service interval you want to remember.
Write down each water test yourself: pH, free chlorine, total chlorine, and total alkalinity, plus calcium hardness, cyanuric acid, salinity, and temperature when you use them. Set a low and a high for any measure. A saved test is compared with the range you had set at that moment, and is marked Within, Below, or Above that range. If you have not set a range, or you left a measure blank, Poolio says so. Blank stays blank. Changing the range later does not rewrite older tests. The trend line connects only the tests you actually saved.
Care covers skimming, brushing, vacuuming, baskets, tile, filter service, and equipment checks. Filter notes can hold a before and after pressure. Opening and closing a pool is a checklist of what you finished or skipped, not a set of instructions. Repeating jobs can be daily, weekly, or on an interval you choose, with a reminder on the morning they are due. You can also be reminded about the next water test, low or expired stock, and opening or closing day.
Supplies are kept by container and batch. A pour records what you actually added and reduces that batch. The cost of what you used stays at the price of that batch. Spending stays in three separate totals: what you bought, what you used from stock, and equipment or service. Those totals are never added together.
The logbook lines up tests, pours, cleaning, and service by date. Follow an unusual reading, a leak, a pressure worry, or a missed job until you mark it resolved. Export a water, care, supply, or spending report as a PDF or CSV. You can attach photos of the pool, a nameplate, a test, a gauge, a receipt, or the pool before and after cleaning. A photo is kept with the record and is not turned into a test number. A voice note of up to 60 seconds can be played back, paused, and deleted, and it does not replace what you type.
Poolio does not recommend a chemical or a dose, does not decide whether the pool is ready for swimming, and does not control pumps, salt systems, or heaters.

name: PopupBlock
description:
You tap play on a video and a shopping site opens in a new tab. You close it, and the page you were reading has been replaced with an ad.

PopupBlock is a Safari extension that stops this kind of click hijacking.

WHAT IT BLOCKS
• Pop-up windows and new tabs that open wherever you tap
• Invisible links laid over the page, and links swapped the moment you tap
• Ads disguised behind the site's own address
• Tab-under tricks that open the page again in a new tab and send your original tab to an ad
• Pages that reload themselves after a pop-up, sending your video back to the start

WHAT IT LEAVES ALONE
• Links you actually tap open as usual.
• Sign-in and payment windows are allowed.
• Tap "Open Once" in the notice to open anything that was blocked.
• Add sites you trust to Always Allow.

FREE AND PRO
• Free: blocks common pop-up ads, hijacked new tabs and invisible links.
• Pro (one-time purchase): also stops tab-under tricks, disguised ads, reloads after a block and swapped links.
• Try Pro free for 7 days. You will not be charged when the trial ends.

PRIVACY
• PopupBlock collects nothing and sends nothing. No account, no server. Everything happens on your device.

SETUP
1. Go to Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions and turn on PopupBlock.
2. Set "All Websites" to "Allow".

GOOD TO KNOW
• Works in Safari only. It does not block ads inside other apps.
• It is not a banner ad blocker. It focuses on stopping unwanted windows and redirects.
• New tricks appear all the time, so no blocker can promise 100% on every site.

name: Porch Quilts: Sort Puzzle
description:
Porch Quilts is the calm, easy-on-the-eyes sorting puzzle made for people who love fabric and quiet me-time. Sort the cotton patches, tie the golden bundles, and watch a classic quilt block come together — then add a personal quilt label and hang your finished quilt in your collection.

- No ads. No timers. No lives.
- Large, clear patches with optional stitch symbols and gentle matching-spot highlights.
- Every puzzle is verified to be solvable, with unlimited free Undo and Hints.
- A free new Daily Block every day — catch up on missed days anytime within the month.
- First 2 classic quilts (24 blocks) and every Daily Block are free forever.
- One fair purchase ($4.99, yours forever with Family Sharing) unlocks 10 more traditional quilts (120 blocks), daily Warm-up & Tricky bonus blocks, endless Sampler Quilts, and all 12 fabric bundles.
- Choose between a green cutting mat and a warm oak sewing table.
- Stitch a custom Quilt Label onto every quilt and share your finished blocks with family.
- Plays smoothly alongside podcasts and audiobooks.
- Works offline, syncs privately across iPhone & iPad with iCloud, and collects no data.

name: Pörssisähkön hintaseuranta
description:
Seuraa Suomen pörssisähkön hintaa (snt/kWh) selkeästi ja ilman turhaa hälyä. Pörssisähkön hinta näyttää nykyisen hinnan, tulevat hintajaksot ja seuraavan vuorokauden halvimman hetken yhdellä silmäyksellä.

Ominaisuudet:
• Nykyinen pörssisähkön hinta (snt/kWh) sekä prosenttimuutos edelliseen 15 minuutin jaksoon verrattuna
• Lähtölaskenta seuraavaan hinnanmuutokseen suoraan pääkortissa
• Seuraavan jakson hinta ja seuraavan 24 tunnin halvin hetki
• Värikoodattu ja vaakasuunnassa vieritettävä 24 tunnin hintakaavio (edelliset 3 t · seuraavat 24 t)
• Interaktiivinen tarkastelu – napauta tai paina ja liu'uta kaaviota nähdäksesi minkä tahansa 15 minuutin jakson tarkan hinnan
• Kaikki saatavilla olevat hinnat selkeänä päiväkohtaisena listana (tänään ja huomenna)
• Kielivalinta suomi / englanti (FI / EN) suoraan yläpalkista
• Tumma, helppolukuinen käyttöliittymä

Yksityinen ja kevyt:
• Ei mainoksia, ei käyttäjätiliä, ei seurantaa
• Hinnat haetaan porssisahko.net-palvelusta (sis. ALV)

Suunnittele saunan lämmitys, sähköauton lataus tai pesukoneen käynnistys helposti edullisimmille tunneille.

name: Portrait Study - Draw People
description:
Learn to draw portraits the way painters see them: big shapes first, details last.

Portrait Study turns any portrait photo into a simple step-by-step drawing reference. Instead of copying eyes, nose and mouth one by one, you build the face the way art schools teach it: block-in, light and shadow, then fine detail.

HOW IT WORKS
Pick a portrait photo, or start with one of the included sample faces. Portrait Study creates six reference cards from it, and you move through them at your own pace:

1. Block-in: the photo with the big outer shape traced in straight lines. Get the size and tilt right first.
2. Two values: the face split into pure light and shadow, like a notan study.
3. Three values: add the half-tone with flat, simple shapes.
4. Five values: find the darkest darks and brightest lights.
5. Squint: the photo softly blurred, showing true values and soft edges without the details.
6. Detail: the full photo, for refining the features.

Each step adds just one thing, so the jump from simple shapes to a finished portrait never feels overwhelming.

MADE FOR DRAWING
• Tap or swipe to move between steps, whenever you are ready
• Press and hold any card to peek at the original photo
• Ruler grid to check proportions and placement, like the classic grid method
• The screen stays on while your phone sits next to your paper
• Clean black and white design that keeps your eye on values

WHO IT'S FOR
• Beginners learning to draw faces and portraits
• Artists practicing value studies, light and shadow, and shape design
• Pencil, charcoal, ink and painting artists who want a better reference
• Anyone who gets lost in details and wants a clearer way to see a face

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All image processing happens on your device. Your photos are never uploaded, and there is no account to create.

Squint, simplify, and draw what you see. Download Portrait Study and start your first portrait today.

name: PoseAgain
description:
Pick a photo from your library and line it up with the camera. Adjust the transparency to match a smile, a pose, or the place where it all happened.

Use the 10-second timer to get in the picture. Compare both moments with a slider, save a side-by-side photo, or share a vertical reveal video. Add a title, correct the original year, and set a reminder for the next time.

Try the example or make your first recreation for free. An optional one-time purchase unlocks unlimited recreations. Available in English and Spanish.

name: Potlife: Resin Calculator
description:
IMPORTANT: on iPhone, all of Potlife is open for 21 days from first launch, with no sign-up and no payment details; nothing is charged when it ends, the app simply returns to the free version.

Epoxy resin does not wait. Miss the moment to turn a tumbler and it cures with a flat side. Pour the next layer too early and it stays tacky. Potlife keeps that schedule for you.

START A POUR
Pick a cure profile, name the piece, tap start. The app then tells you what to do and when: turn the piece, check for bubbles, let it rest, demould. Reminders arrive even when the app is closed and the phone is locked.

THREE CURE PROFILES
• Tumbler or upright piece — close rotation every 3 minutes for 4 hours, then spaced rotation, gel point, demould
• Flat mould — bubble checks every 10 minutes while degassing, then resting and full cure
• Successive layers — one wait between layers

TWO CALCULATORS
• Mould volume — cylinder, box, sphere, or a volume you already know, plus a waste margin for what stays in the cup and on the stick
• Mix — that volume becomes Part A and Part B, by volume or by weight using the density printed on your container

A PHOTO LOGBOOK
Every pour stays in the logbook with its profile, its volume, its notes and its photos. Photos are copied into the app, so clearing your camera roll does not empty the log.

WHAT POTLIFE DOES NOT DO
There is no database of resin brands, and that is deliberate. A mix ratio is a safety figure: printing one under a brand name we have not verified would look like a certainty and ruin pieces. Read the ratio on your own container — the app does the arithmetic.
Cure times here are common practice, not a standard. They shift with room temperature and with the product you use. Always follow your own container.

NO ACCOUNT, NO INTERNET, NO ADS
Your pours, notes and photos never leave your phone; the only connection is the store's purchase check. It works in a workshop with no signal, and there is nothing to sign up for.

Available in 25 languages.

Always free: the mould volume and mix calculators — and a pour you have already started keeps its reminders until demoulding, whatever happens. Potlife Pro starts new pours with their cure schedule and reminders, keeps them in the logbook and adds photos: a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your account at confirmation; the subscription renews automatically at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your account settings. Price shown in the app before purchase.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sogerg.github.io/potlife-legal/

name: PotSharp: Poker Math Trainer
description:
Learn the math that wins at poker, in two-minute drills with plain-English answers.

Every drill is free: no paywall, no subscription, no account.

Most poker trainers are built for solver experts and cost a subscription. PotSharp starts at the beginning: how much equity a call needs, how to count your outs, and when a draw is worth the price.

THREE QUICK DRILLS
• Pot odds: how much equity do you need to call this bet?
• Count your outs: flush draws, straight draws and both, with overlaps counted once
• Call or fold: your outs against the price, with the rule of 2 as a shortcut

LEARN BY DOING
• Your first 5 hands are a guided intro: no menus, just play
• Every answer explains the math in one or two lines
• Difficulty adapts: get 4 right in a row and the spots get harder
• See which outs you missed, card by card

COME BACK DAILY
• Today's 10: a mixed set, about two minutes, double XP
• Climb from Fish to Legend across 20 levels
• Day streaks, with Sit-outs that protect your streak when you miss a day
• 60-second sprint: pot odds against the clock (unlocks at Level 3)
• EV won: a score of how much your decisions were worth

MADE FOR YOU
• English and Spanish
• No account: your progress stays on your iPhone
• Every drill free: ads between sets keep it that way, and one optional purchase removes them

For education and entertainment only. No real-money gambling, no betting, no prizes. EV won is a skill score: it can never be bought, won or cashed out. PotSharp deals its own practice hands and is not for use during a live game.

name: Pouf – Mac Remote
description:
Pouf turns your iPhone into a touchpad, keyboard, media remote and app launcher for your Mac. Lean back on the sofa and keep full control, whether you're watching a film, giving a presentation or just browsing.

REMOTE
• A large touchpad with Left and Right click zones and two-finger scrolling
• Esc, arrow keys and Return one tap away
• Type on your iPhone's keyboard, in any language, straight into the Mac

MEDIA
• Play/pause, seek, volume and mute, with buttons that repeat while held
• Previous and next track, Full Screen, Esc and Space
• See which app is in front and bring another one forward

APPS
• Search every app on your Mac and open it from your phone
• Keep favorites close
• Make groups such as "Morning" and open all their apps with one tap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your iPhone talks to your Mac directly over your Wi-Fi: no account, no cloud, no tracking
• Pair once by scanning a code on your Mac; the connection is encrypted end to end
• Optional Face ID lock

WHAT YOU NEED
• The free Pouf Helper for Mac (macOS 15 or later), from kaancakr.github.io/pouf-app
• Your iPhone and Mac on the same Wi-Fi network

Setting up takes a minute: install Pouf Helper on your Mac, choose Pair iPhone in its menu, and scan the code with Pouf.

name: PouldBrazara
description:
NAME THE TREE IN FRONT OF YOU.
PouldBrazara is a pocket tree key. It asks one plain question at a time, about needles, leaf edges, fruit or bark, and quietly rules trees out until one is left.

A KEY THAT THINKS AHEAD.
Each answer shows how many trees would remain before you tap it. The next question is always the one that splits the remaining trees best. Not sure? Skip it. Took a wrong turn? Tap any earlier answer and pick up from there.

SIXTY TREES, ENGRAVED.
Oaks, maples, pines, cedars, limes, willows, the odd ginkgo and monkey puzzle. Every tree has its own plate with a fine-line leaf drawing, Latin name, family, bark, fruit and a short field note that tells it apart from its lookalikes.

A FIELD LOG THAT STAYS SIMPLE.
Log a find with a place, a note and the day you met it. Edit or delete it later. Your finds collect on each tree's plate too.

LEAF SKETCHES BY FINGER.
Trace a leaf on a cream sheet. Turn on a faint guide drawn from the plate if you like. Label it with the tree, or leave it as a mystery for later.

A CHECKLIST FOR THE SEASON.
Pick the trees you want to meet. Tick them by hand, or let a logged find tick them for you. A small dial keeps count.

THE COLLECTION GRID.
Sixty engraved slots, one per tree. Each one fills with colour the first time you log that tree, and they spring into place every time you open the drawer.

A FILING CABINET, NOT A MENU.
Four brass-handled drawers slide open for Key, Trees, Found and Settings, and shutter blinds wipe between them. Plates and forms stack up as cards you can flick away.

QUIET BY DESIGN.
No account. No ads. Works fully offline. An anonymous backup keeps your finds, checklist and sketches safe, and you can restore it or wipe it from Settings at any time.

A gentle note: this is a learning companion for walks. Never eat or use any plant because of what an app says.

name: Practice Spreadsheets
description:
Learn Google Sheets formulas by actually writing them.

Practice Spreadsheets teaches the functions people use at work, one short lesson at a time. Each lesson shows how a function works on a real sheet, then you type the formula yourself and get checked instantly.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 40+ function lessons: SUM, IF, IFS, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, MATCH, FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, SPLIT, REGEXEXTRACT, NETWORKDAYS and more
• A real spreadsheet in every lesson. Tap cells to build ranges, with a symbol row above the keyboard
• Instant feedback, hints, and the common mistakes for each function
• Progress and streaks that sync with practicespreadsheets.com

FREE AND PRO
"How it works" in every lesson is free. Pro unlocks the drill and practice problems in every lesson. It's a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

An account keeps your progress and Pro with you on your phone and the web.

name: PrankSelfieCam
description:
Ask a friend to take your picture. Hand them your iPhone. They aim, they press the shutter… and instead of a photo of you, they get a hilarious selfie of themselves with a giant nose!

HOW IT WORKS
PrankSelfiCam looks like an ordinary camera pointed at you. When your friend presses the shutter, it takes the photo with the front camera — capturing the person holding the phone — and instantly turns it into a funny face. Then it pops up with a big "GOTCHA!" stamp.

15 FUNNY EFFECTS
• Mix – the classic: big nose, puffy cheeks and a fisheye lens
• Fisheye
• Big Nose
• Big Brain
• Bug Eyes
• Tiny Face
• Alien
• Chipmunk
• Big Mouth
• Duck Lips
• Tall Head
• Wide Face
• Bobblehead
• Twirl
• Tiny Eyes
• Or choose Surprise for a random effect every time

Pick an effect before you start, then try others on the same photo after it's taken.

40+ STAMPS
Choose your message — GOTCHA!, PRANKED!, WRONG CAMERA!, HAHAHA!, NOSE GOALS!, 200 IQ! and more — let the app pick one at random, or turn stamps off.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save the best ones to your photo library or share them straight to your group chat.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Uses the rear camera for the viewfinder and the front camera for the prank photo, explained before you start
• Face detection and effects run entirely on your iPhone
• Nothing is uploaded and nothing is saved unless you tap Save or Share
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no microphone
• iOS camera indicator stays visible whenever the camera is on

Play nice: only prank people who'll laugh along, and always show them the photo.

name: PraulvJeerve
description:
I kept burning brown rice. Then I kept drowning quinoa. So I wrote every ratio I trusted onto one card, pinned it above the stove, and eventually that card became this app.

PraulvJeerve is my grain notebook, laid out on green felt inside wooden rails. Here is what it does, in the order I reach for it.

1. A bundled ratio table
Twenty-two rices and grains, from jasmine and basmati to farro, teff, millet and coarse polenta. Each one lists its water ratio, simmer time, rest time, weight per cup, cooked yield and whether a soak helps. It all lives inside the app, so it works with no signal at a holiday cabin.

2. Ratio bars
Flip the Grains tab to the chart and every grain gets a bar: one cream block for the grain, blue blocks for the water. You see straight away that couscous barely drinks and polenta is thirsty.

3. Portion scaling
I tell it how many people are eating and whether it is a side, a main or a hearty bowl. It works out the dry grain, the water, the salt and roughly how much cooked grain I will have. Cups or grams and millilitres, whichever measuring jug is closer.

4. A cook timer with a dial
Start the dial and the needle sweeps across a lime arc for the simmer, then a violet arc for the rest with the lid on. A cork pop marks the end of the simmer and a handbell marks a finished pot. If I need a little longer, one tap adds a minute. Reminders are optional and only asked for when I first start a timer.

5. Notes
Every pot teaches something. Less water at altitude, toast the millet first, a longer rest for sushi rice. Notes can belong to one grain, so they show up right under the timer the next time I cook it, or they can be general.

6. Favourites
Star the grains I actually cook and they sit at the front of the Cook tab, ready to go.

7. A log of every pot
When a pot is done I log it with a rating from one to five and a remark. The Log tab groups pots by day and keeps a small tally: pots cooked, cups of dry grain used, average rating and the grain I make most.

There are no accounts. An anonymous device ID and the things I create, notes and remarks included, are backed up so I can restore them later. The app never asks for my name, email or location.

It looks like a well-used kitchen corner on purpose: green felt, wooden rails, round buttons you can hit with a floury thumb. Dark by default, with a lighter daylight version too.

name: Pregnancy Tracker ⁺
description:
Follow your pregnancy week by week, from the first weeks to the day you meet your baby. PregnancyTracker shows how far along you are and how big your baby is today, with simple tools for every trimester.

Free. No ads. No account. Your entries are stored on your iPhone, not on our servers.

YOUR PREGNANCY AT A GLANCE
• Your current week and month, with a countdown to your due date
• Enter your due date, or calculate it from the first day of your last period
• Shortcuts to the tools you use most

WATCH YOUR BABY GROW
• What is happening with your baby in each of the 40 weeks
• Baby size compared with a fruit, with typical length and weight
• 2D, 3D and ultrasound reference images for every week
• A short article for every week of pregnancy

TOOLS FOR YOU
• Weight tracker: log your weight in kg or lb and see your gain since before pregnancy
• Blood pressure, blood sugar and heart rate log: record readings from your own monitor or meter, then review the history and charts (blood sugar in mg/dL or mmol/L)
• Pregnancy calendar: doctor appointments with reminders, plus your daily mood and symptoms

TOOLS FOR BABY AND BIRTH
• Contraction timer: one tap to start and stop, with the length of each contraction and the time between them
• Kick counter: count your baby's movements, up to 10 per session
• Weekly to-do list with suggested tasks, plus your own
• Hospital bag checklist for you, your baby and your paperwork
• Pregnancy journal: write about your days and add photos of your bump and scans

EXPLORE
23 articles on nutrition, exercise, feelings, your baby and labor, with search.

ALSO
• Works offline
• Available in 20 languages
• Start over or delete all your data at any time in Settings

IMPORTANT
PregnancyTracker is for general information and personal record-keeping. It does not take measurements, does not diagnose any condition and does not replace advice from your doctor or midwife. Always check with your healthcare provider about your pregnancy and before making any medical decision. If you notice bleeding, severe pain, fewer baby movements than usual, or anything else that worries you, contact your healthcare provider or emergency services right away.

name: Pricey: Price Tag Converter
description:
Pricey turns every price tag into your money.

Shopping abroad? Point your iPhone at a price tag and Pricey shows what it costs at home, instantly. No typing, no mental maths, no guessing.

READS THE TAG FOR YOU
• Reads prices straight from the camera, including tricky tags with small raised cents or digits on separate cards
• Detects the currency printed on the tag (€, £, ¥, 元, ฿, GH₵, R$ and more) and switches automatically
• Tells Japanese yen and Chinese yuan apart from the text on the tag
• Tap any price on a busy shelf to focus on exactly that one

BUILT FOR TRAVEL
• 160+ currencies with rates updated every day
• Works offline with the last saved rates, so no roaming data needed
• Flashlight for dim markets and shops

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR SHOPPING
• Add items to a cart and see the running total in your currency
• Your conversion history, saved on your iPhone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Camera images are read on your iPhone and never uploaded
• No account, no ads, no tracking

PRICEY PRO
Your first 30 scans are free. Pricey Pro unlocks unlimited scanning with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.

name: PRIV-Suite
description:
PRIV-Suite brings three everyday tools together in one simple app. Calculate, work with durations, and generate random results entirely on your device.

CALCULATOR
Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. Use percentages, change signs, delete digits and repeat the last operation. Follow your calculation above the result and copy it with a tap. Long results are rounded to fit the display, with a clear notice.

TIME CALCULATOR
Add and subtract durations expressed in years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes and seconds. View the combined result or convert it to a single unit.

Conversions use fixed durations: one week is 7 days, one month is 30 days and one year is 365 days. Calendar months and leap years are not considered.

RANDOM GENERATOR
Generate one to three letters, numbers, symbols or emoji. Optionally include accented letters or extra symbols, then copy the result.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
No account, advertising or tracking. All calculations and random generation run locally, without an Internet connection. Results are copied to the system clipboard only when you choose.

Available in English, Italian, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

name: Pro Sports Trivia
description:
How well do you know league rules, sports history, and athletes? Play a mixed 10-question round or pick a category from 52 built-in questions. You get 20 seconds per question and 100 points for each correct answer. After the round, review the answers and open reference links to learn more.

Build a streak with the daily question, or play four season chapters. A score of 600 points or more unlocks the next chapter. Replay chapters to improve your best scores, and save an unfinished round to pick it up later.

Send a challenge code to a friend so you can each play the same 10 questions. Trade signed scorecards to compare results, and check your weekly points and recent rounds in Ranking.

Built-in questions are available offline. Optional reminders and widgets help you follow your progress. When the interface is set to English, you can download and play additional English-language questions from Open Trivia DB.

name: Profile: Spaces & Checklist
description:
Give your information a place of its own. Folio Nook organizes account details, reusable text and tasks in separate profile spaces, so the things you need are easier to find.
ORGANIZE BY SPACE  Record platform names, account aliases, usernames, purposes and notes in separate spaces. Add tags, search your entries and save favorites.
KEEP USEFUL TEXT  Save frequently used text by category, then copy and paste it yourself whenever you need it.
PLAN YOUR TASKS  Add tasks, dates and notes to the current space. Mark priorities and completed items, and sort your list by date, priority or your preferred order.
LISTEN AND BACK UP  Explore the offline audio guides and export a local backup of your information. Importing a backup replaces the information currently on the device.
UNLOCK PRO  Unlock more custom spaces, all color themes, more account cards and text entries, advanced audio guides and an ad-free experience.

name: ProfiLine PVC
description:
ProfiLine is a professional tool for manufacturers of PVC and aluminium windows and doors. Build a price catalogue once, then create accurate offers for your customers on site, even without an internet connection.

FEATURES
• Window, door, shopfront and shutter items with sizes, openings and mullions
• Shaped windows: slope, gable and triangle, entered by their real side lengths
• Realistic render and technical sketch for every item
• Prices from your own catalogue: profiles, glass, hardware, colours, extras and shutters
• Automatic cutting lists with saw kerf and bar optimisation
• Material list (BOM) for production
• Professional PDF offers with your logo, in several languages
• Sync offers between your company devices on the same WiFi
• Works fully offline. Your data stays on your device.

ProfiLine is a business tool. A licence is issued directly by the developer to each company.

name: Project: NULL
description:
The Oni is thirty kills away.

You're NULL, an antivirus dropped into an infected computer. Fight virus ninjas in third-person melee, with fighters, blades, and bosses drawn in ASCII.

READ THE SWING
Lock onto a ninja, chain two slashes, and flip out of range before the counterattack. Walls and pillars stop weapons on contact, including your own. Bait a swing into cover and punish the opening.

SURVIVE THE ARENA
Fight waves of virus ninjas and watch the count fall. After thirty kills, the Oni takes the floor. Stay clear of its leaping slam, then close in while it recovers. Beat it and the waves return.

ENTER THE STORAGE SECTOR
In Story Mode, pick a route through infested server rooms, fight through ambushes, and reach a recovery terminal. Face the Oni in containment and make it to the exit.

name: ProofLens: Evidence Camera
description: ProofLens was crafted specifically to give Airbnb hosts, Airbnb guests, and Resolution Center teams a trusted, objective standard for visual evidence-eliminating edited screenshots, fake timestamps, and Al-fabricated damage claims. Built to stay 100% offline, battery-friendly, private, and effortlessly smooth on every mobile phone and tablet worldwide.

name: Proova Inspections
description:
Proova Inspections est l'application des inspecteurs pour réaliser les états des lieux de véhicules : livraisons, restitutions, expertises et contrôles qualité.

UN ÉTAT DES LIEUX COMPLET EN 5 ÉTAPES
 • Relevés : kilométrage, carburant, n° de châssis et carte grise

 UN PV PROFESSIONNEL

 Les comptes sont créés par l'administrateur de votre organisation sur Proova Console.

name: PSCIFort
description: When reconciling bank statements at the end of the month, all income data should be placed in the same workbench. Daily bookkeeping only requires filling in the amount, account, type, and date; new entries can be made even during the reconciliation process. Before saving, review each item's account balance, monthly income and expenses, and category-specific amounts. Temporarily excluding an entry will show its impact on the total. Internal transfers with separate entries at both ends can be paired, and actual transaction fees can be listed separately. For cross-month revisions, drag the date to view the current day's balance and compare it with the previously confirmed bill amount. Each save provides detailed records, and you can also select an item to restore.

name: Psiride
description:
Psiride is a tyre-pressure calculator and ride log for people who care how their bike feels. Tell it your weight, your tyres and the road ahead, and it gives you a front and rear pressure to start from, in psi and bar. Then log how the ride felt, and Psiride learns a personal offset for every bike you own.

PRESSURE YOU CAN TRUST AS A STARTING POINT
The Gauge uses the well-known 15% tyre-drop rule, scaled by tyre width, and adjusts it for the surface (smooth tarmac, rough tarmac, gravel, mixed or wet), your tyre setup (tube, tubeless or tubular) and wheel size. Set rider and gear weight, fine-tune the front/rear weight split, tap Pump it and watch the needle swing to your numbers. Save the pressures you like as presets for one-tap recall.

A RIDE LOG THAT TEACHES THE GAUGE
Log each ride with date, bike, distance, time, climbing, the pressures you ran, the surface and your notes. Rate it too firm, just right or too soft. Psiride turns those ratings into a learned offset per bike, so the next suggestion is closer to what you actually like.

YOUR GARAGE
Add road, gravel, MTB and city bikes with wheel size, tyre width, setup and weight. Every bike shows its odometer, ride count and learned offset.

PARTS WEAR ON THE CLOCK
Chain, tyres, brake pads and cables get a service interval. Every kilometre you log counts towards it, and parts near or past service are flagged. Mark a part as replaced in one tap.

STATS AT A GLANCE
Weekly and monthly distance charts, distance per bike, average speed, total climbing and your week streak.

MADE FOR THE WAY YOU RIDE
Kilometres or miles, psi or bar, kilograms or pounds. Two dark themes. Workshop sound effects and haptics you can switch off. Works offline; your entries sync when you are back online.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
Sign in with email and password, or tap Ride as a guest and start straight away. Guests can turn their garage into an account later without losing anything. Delete your account and every bike, ride and part from the Toolkit at any time. No ads, no tracking, no analytics.

Pressures are a suggested starting point. Always stay within the limits printed on your tyre and rim.

name: psst secure chat
description:
psst is a private messenger for anyone aged 18 and over. Create an account right in the app with a username and password, no phone number or e-mail needed. There is no public member list: people find each other only by their exact account name.

Private by default
• Direct chats and private groups are end-to-end encrypted: the server stores only encrypted messages and files.
• Verify your devices with a QR code or emoji, and keep your history with an encrypted recovery key.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no advertising identifier.

Everything for everyday conversations
• One-to-one chats, groups and channels
• Voice and video calls, including group calls
• Photos, videos, files and voice messages
• Replies, reactions, edits, mentions and read receipts
• Notifications for messages and incoming calls

Safety
• Report any message or room to the operator; reports are reviewed within 24 hours.
• Block anyone you do not want to hear from.
• For adults (18+).

Your account, your choice
• One account on iPhone, iPad, Android, the web and desktop (Windows, macOS).
• Delete your account at any time in the app (Settings → Manage account & devices → Delete account) or as described at psst.pro/delete-account.

What psst is not
psst does not make you anonymous. The server knows your username, your devices and who is in which conversation. Notifications are delivered through Apple Push Notification service and carry only an event ID, never message content. Public channels are not end-to-end encrypted.

psst is built on the open Matrix standard and the open-source Element apps (AGPL-3.0). Source code: https://github.com/georgonr/psst
Privacy Policy: https://psst.pro/privacy · Terms of Use: https://psst.pro/terms

name: PT Stopwatch
description:
This is a stopwatch like no other. The stopwatch that tells a little white lie.

PT Stopwatch lets you stretch a second to push a little further, or shorten it for an easier day. Choose how long each stopwatch second really lasts, from 0.60 to 1.60 real seconds or keep it at 1.00 for normal timing.

At 1.20, a 10-second effort lasts 12 real seconds. A small adjustment for an extra challenge.

Simple controls, lap timing, and a speed setting that remembers your choice. Made for personal trainers and anyone who wants to train on their own terms.


App terms and conditions https://raildar.co.uk/ptsterms.html

name: Puffback Dispatch
description:
Every puff has a destination.

Meet Nori, a little cloud courier with a sky full of deliveries. In Puffback Dispatch, firing your air-puff launcher does more than clear a path: it also moves you along a looping postal rail. Pick your target, choose your next stop, and turn a clever shot into a perfectly timed delivery.

SHOOT. HOP. DELIVER.
Clear mischievous Glooms and land at mailboxes in the order on your parcel list. An empty puff can be a smart move, and a striped heavy parcel changes how far you hop. Think about the shot and the landing together. Glooms roam and attack in real time, even while you wait. Tap a moving cloud to keep it tracked, then hop clear of its warning reticle. Defeat a charging cloud to cancel its attack.

100 LITTLE ROUTES TO DISCOVER
Travel through ten postal neighborhoods, from First Post to the Grand Dispatch. Work with spring mirrors, bell-operated gates, wind arches, branch junctions and moving threats. Each route has a fixed shot budget and three stars to earn. Fresh attempts bring new randomized cloud patrols and attacks.

SEND A SHOT INTO TOMORROW
Echo Posts remember a puff and repeat it on your next turn, from the place where you fired it. Let an echo finish one job while Nori moves toward the next delivery.

DODGE, INTERRUPT, AND TAKE A BREATHER
Attack spots are marked before cloud projectiles launch, and committed reticles stay fixed. Use a puff to hop out of danger or interrupt a charging Gloom. Pause freezes the action whenever you need to plan. Shot previews, free undo and hints are always available. There are no paid revives or energy timers.

YOUR IPHONE, YOUR RECORDS
Create up to four local courier profiles and compare journey or individual route records on the same device. No account or online leaderboard is required.

A SMALL THANK-YOU FOR VISITING
Collect visit stamps and a courier keepsake through Daily Check-In. Missing a day keeps your next reward waiting. Collectibles never change puzzle power or block campaign progress.

A ROUNDED LITTLE WORLD
Enjoy smooth cartoon characters, floating postal islands, springy hops, lively puff trails and stamped delivery celebrations. Adjust music, sound, haptics, motion and pattern assistance to suit your play.

All 100 campaign routes work offline. Version 1.0 includes no advertising, in-app purchases or subscriptions.

A little more joy, delivered.

name: PulseTrace - Radar
description:
PulseTrace helps you find a misplaced iPhone with real on-device listening — clap, whistle, finger snap, or a private rhythm you train yourself.

FIND YOUR PHONE
• Arm listening from the Find desk or the Listen button
• Choose clap, whistle, snap, or personal rhythm on the strategy dial
• Scene presets and optional room-noise calibration for fewer false triggers
• Custom alarm sound, flash rhythm, vibration, and volume ramp

ANTI-THEFT (NO MIC REQUIRED)
• Leave-pocket aegis using the proximity sensor
• Sudden-motion alert if the phone is snatched from a desk
• Charge Sentinel if the cable is unplugged while charging
• Optional battery-full pulse reminder

SETUP & HISTORY
• Guided setup checklist so first-time use is clear
• Find history with false-alarm marking and recovery stats
• Echo location anchors (optional, off by default) stay on this device only

BUILT DIFFERENTLY
PulseTrace uses a side navigation rail and Listen FAB — not a stock tab bar template. Audio matching runs on-device; nothing is uploaded for clap detection.

Privacy: https://pulsetraceios.com/privacyPolicy.html
Website: https://pulsetraceios.com
Support: PixelforestTech@163.com

name: pumba: Okuyarak Dil Öğren
description:
Dil öğrenmenin en keyifli yolu: merak ettiğin şeyleri okumak.

pumba'da bilimden sanata, müzikten spora, tarihten hikâyelere kadar 100'den fazla kısa ve merak uyandıran metin seni bekliyor. Bilmediğin bir kelimeye dokun, anlamını hemen gör ve tek dokunuşla kaydet. Gerisini pumba halleder.

Nasıl çalışır?
• Oku: İlgini çeken konuyu seç, kısa metinleri öğrendiğin dilde oku.
• Dokun: Bilmediğin kelimeye dokun, anlamını ve cümlenin çevirisini gör.
• Pekiştir: Kaydettiğin kelimeler öğrenme takvimine yerleşir. Sabah kısa bir tekrar, akşam asıl alıştırma.
• Kanıtla: Haftalık testi geçen kelimeler "öğrenildi" sayılır ve seviyen yükselir.

Neden pumba?
• Seviyene göre cümleler: A1'den C2'ye kadar, her alıştırma kolaydan zora ilerler.
• Her kelime için farklı cümleler: aynı cümleyi iki kez görmezsin.
• Dinle, kur, yaz: cümleleri dinleyerek kurar, klavyeyle yazarsın.
• 12 dil: İngilizce, Almanca, İspanyolca, Fransızca, İtalyanca, Portekizce, Felemenkçe, Lehçe, Rusça, Arapça, Hintçe ve Çince.
• Ana ekran widget'ı: öğrendiğin kelimeler gün boyu gözünün önünde.
