• Hatırlatıcı bildirimler: gün içinde kelimeni tekrar et, alıştırma vaktini kaçırma.
• Reklam yok, takip yok: ilerlemen cihazında kalır.

Bugün bir metin oku, ilk kelimeni kazan.

name: PureScan: Ingredient Scanner
description:
Tired of ingredient scanner apps that fail with 'Barcode Not Found' on local snacks, store brands, imported items, or pet food—or lock you out behind aggressive paywalls and logins?

PureScan reads the actual ingredient label directly using 100% on-device Apple Vision OCR. Zero ads, zero accounts, zero cloud uploads—works instantaneously even in supermarket aisles with zero signal!

KEY FEATURES
• Instant Offline Label OCR (Not Limited by Barcodes): Scan food packages, local store brands, imported snacks, skincare INCI bottles, cat/dog kibble, or online shopping screenshots in 0.3 seconds.
• 6 Personalized Health & Safety Radars: Instead of rigid one-size-fits-all scores that penalize healthy whole foods, tailor PureScan to YOU — Clean Additives, Low Sugar/Keto, Gout/High Purine (catches sneaky Yeast Extract & E635), Mom & Kids, Acne/Sensitive Skincare INCI, and Pet Food Safety (with automatic Grain-Splitting Trap detection!).
• Custom Allergen Blacklist: Add your own red-flag triggers (Peanut, Gluten, Soy, Dairy) for instant red alerts.
• Supermarket VS Showdown: Torn between two yogurts, breads, or cat foods? Compare them side-by-side to see the cleaner winner in 1 second.
• Red & Green Cabinet + Shareable Inspection Receipts: Save Buy-Again favorites, blacklist junk forever, and export crisp lab-receipt cards.

FAIR & TRANSPARENT PRO ACCESS
• Free forever: 10 offline scans/day, zero ads, no login required.
• PureScan Pro: Monthly ($1.99/mo), Annual ($9.99/yr with 3-day free trial + built-in Day-2 local reminder so you're never surprise-billed), or Lifetime Pay-Once ($14.99).

Educational reference only based on public FDA/EFSA/GB 2760/INCI/AAFCO standards; not medical advice.
Privacy Policy: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/purescan/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/purescan/terms.html

name: Purple Worry
description:
Worry can be helpful. It reminds you to look both ways before you cross the street. But sometimes worry grows until it takes over your day, keeps you up at night and makes it hard to focus. This app helps you shrink it back down.

Meet Worry, a small fuzzy creature who shows how big your worry feels. Each practice takes about 2 minutes, uses pictures and taps, and has nothing to type:

1. Think of something that's bothering you.
2. Show how big Worry is.
3. Try a short practice.
4. Watch Worry shrink.

PRACTICES
• Is It Real? – Sort real problems you can act on from what-ifs you can let go.
• Shrink the Thought – Picture the worst, best and most likely outcomes.
• Ride the Wave – Wait out the urge to check or ask for reassurance.
• Float It Away – Watch your thoughts drift by on leaves in a stream.
• Breathe – Slow, guided breathing with a "relax" cue.
• Park It – Save a worry for a set Worry Time later in the day.
• Body Reset – Squeeze and release to let go of tension.
• Move – Quick activity ideas to burn off nervous energy.

ALSO INCLUDES
• Quote of the Day from the Stoic philosophers (Epictetus, Seneca and Marcus Aurelius) and other classic writers, plus a Home Screen and Lock Screen widget
• Optional calming ocean sounds
• My Progress, with before-and-after charts, a weekly streak and an optional 7-question check-in (GAD-7)
• One-tap links to the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline and 911
Now has the option to add a widget with a daily quote related to worry.

The practices come from current guidelines and are based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), mindfulness, acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), applied relaxation and exercise.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads and no tracking. Everything you enter stays on your phone.

This app is a self-help tool. It is not a diagnosis, treatment or a substitute for professional care. If you're struggling, reach out to a trusted family member, friend or professional.

name: PutmX
description: PutmX is an application designed with a clean interface, simple layouts, and intuitive navigation.  It incorporates subtle elements of categorization, item organization, and structured arrangements, presented through a clear and consistent visual design.  The application provides a straightforward and comfortable experience for everyday use.

name: Putt & Plan
description:
Plan the shot. Then watch the ball run it.

Putt & Plan is a golf puzzle where you think first and putt later. Line up the arrow cards in the right order, press Play, and the ball follows them one after another, all the way to the hole.

HOW IT WORKS • Pick and order your cards: forward, turn, chip and drive. • Every card is a move. Plan the whole route, then send the ball. • Retrying is always free, so try, learn and try again. • Earn up to 3 stars: finish with fewer cards, or on the first try with no help.

A COURSE FULL OF SURPRISES Rocks, bushes and crates block the way. Sand slows you down, tall grass stops you cold, and water swallows the ball unless you cross it on a bridge. Turbo flames add extra steps, bumpers turn the ball, tunnels carry it across the course and tall trees even stop the chip. Every new obstacle changes how you think.

STUCK? GET A HAND Use a helper when you need one: discard the cards you don't need, add a card that opens a shorter way, remove an obstacle, or lay out the whole solution.

PLAY EVERY DAY • Daily streak with bigger and bigger prizes. A shield protects it if you skip a day. • Missions and a daily challenge to keep things fresh. • Collect stars to unlock a collection of cheerful squirrel figures.

FEATURES • Hundreds of levels, from a gentle first putt to real brain teasers. • Short lessons that introduce each new obstacle only when you meet it. • Bright, friendly graphics and relaxed music. • Plays in 12 languages. • Free to play, with optional ads. Remove them for good with a single purchase.

Grab your cards and tee off!

name: Puzzle Shelf : Offline Games
description:
Twenty-one puzzle games, one shelf, no Wi-Fi needed.

Puzzle Shelf puts a whole collection of brain teasers in a single app. Every game works fully offline, so you can play on a plane, on the subway or anywhere your signal drops. Pick a game, play a few levels, and come back to any of them right where you left off.

THE GAMES
• Gem Glide: glide gems into their portals.
• Ring Vault: spin the rings and free the gems.
• Water Sort: pour the colors until every tube is one shade.
• Color Gates: slide each block out through its color gate.
• Arrow Out: tap the arrows out in the right order.
• Ferry Frenzy: board the passengers before the tide turns.
• Tile Dynasty: mahjong triple match in a jade palace.
• Shelfie Sort: stack three alike and clear the shelf.
• Ringlock: spin the gap and break the chain.
• Cubescape: turn the 3D cube and fill the crates.
• Purlfect Loop: send spools round and unknit the picture.
• Screwball Sort: twist nuts onto bolts until every color locks.
• Arrow Pop: swipe the arrow tiles and pop the colors.
• Vine Voyager: snip the vines and swing the seed home.
• Umbral Steps: a shadow platformer where lamplight makes shadows solid.
• Origami Ruins: fold paper bridges and find the door.
• Hexodus: every hex tile wants out. Find the order.
• Dune Drop: drop the sand, let it flow, clear the color.
• Sandy Shuttles: clear the parking lot and scoop the sand.
• Wordtrotter: find the words and stamp your travel passport.
• Zip Out: turn the shape and zip the arrows out.

THOUSANDS OF LEVELS
Most games have 150 to 300 levels, and every level is checked to be solvable. The first levels of each game guide you through the rules, then the challenge ramps up.

REWARDS EVERY DAY
• A daily bonus calendar with a chest on day 7.
• A free coin gift every 4 hours.
• Three new daily missions every day, earned by playing any game.
• Coins you earn in one game work in every game.

TROPHIES
Climb trophy ladders in Bronze, Silver, Gold and Diamond. Clear levels, try new games and keep your daily streak to fill your cabinet.

MADE FOR SHORT BREAKS
Each level takes a minute or two. Your progress saves on your device for every game, and the Continue Playing shelf takes you straight back in.

No account, no sign-up and no internet needed. Just open the shelf and play.

name: QicaiYunnan
description:
七彩云南 —— 四卷 · 十六州市 · 一册随身云南

云南的景点、美食、民族与历史，一个一个讲清楚。

【怎么用】

左边是目录（手机上从左上角三道线里拉出来），一共八扇门：

• 卷首：封面与接着读 —— 封面是云南蓝月谷，「接着读」按你上次读到哪儿接着往下推
• 景点：17 处，看点与细说逐段写清
• 美食：16 道，从蒙自的过桥米线到野生菌火锅
• 民族：12 个民族，聚落、节庆、服饰与吃食
• 历史：15 篇，从南诏国、大理国到驼峰航线
• 地区：十六个州市，各有各的山、水与吃食
• 收藏：收起来的条目都在这儿，只存在本机
• 关于：照片是谁拍的，隐私政策与意见反馈在哪

右上角三个圆按钮依次是设置、关于与书签。设置里能清掉收藏与阅读进度，也能逐张查看照片的作者与许可；
关于页里有隐私政策与意见反馈。

【里面有什么】

四卷 60 条，加上 16 个州市页，一共 76 个可读单元：景点 17、美食 16、民族 12、历史 15。

每一条都分两段写：先说「看点」——去过的人会先注意到什么；再说「细说」——这个地方到底是什么来历。
景点与吃食会互相串起来：一个景点连到它所属的民族与吃食，一道吃食连到它出自的民族。
民族卷另有节庆、服饰、饮食与习俗，历史卷另有年代与图说。

【十六个州市】

昆明、大理、丽江、迪庆、西双版纳、红河、文山、保山、曲靖、楚雄、普洱、临沧、昭通、怒江、玉溪、德宏。

每个州市页写着一句话简介与一张实景照，并标出这个州市下面有多少条条目，点进去就能顺着看。

【照片】

App 里的照片是真实照片，不是画的：61 张素材，每张裁成竖版、横版、方版三种规格，共 183 张。

照片全部来自 Wikimedia Commons，只取公有领域、CC0、CC BY 与 CC BY-SA 协议；
每一张的作者、协议与原始页面链接，都在「设置 → 照片的作者与许可」里逐条列出，可以点开原始页面核对。

本 App 不打包任何受版权保护的第三方字体、音频或视频素材。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。你的收藏只存在你自己的手机里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

除首启一条安装来源统计外完全离线：不接入第三方 SDK，不含广告与统计代码。
全部文字与照片都随 App 一起打包，在设备本地读取，不下载远程图片。

唯一会联网的动作：启动时向 apinstall.com 发一条安装来源统计，内容只有一个随机设备标识、一组设备参数
（机型 / 系统 / 屏幕 / 语言地区 / 时区 / CPU 核数）、剪贴板里是否存在邮件地址格式（有 / 无，不读取内容），
以及服务器记录的来源 IP。这些数据不含姓名、邮箱、电话、地址、位置与照片，只发给这一个单位，
不与任何第三方共享，也不用于追踪。

「关于 → 意见反馈」写好内容按「提交反馈」，由 App 发往反馈页面；也可以点「写邮件」打开系统邮件 App，
由你自己写、自己发送。

【适合谁】

想去云南、正在准备去云南，或者想读一段云南历史、尝一口云南味道的人。

版本 1.0

name: Quarter Ledger
description:
At the end of each quarter, we remember being 'very busy', but we can't quite say what being busy has become.
Quarter Ledger is a tool that helps you record the completion status and reflections of each quarter, and visualize the rhythm with charts.
■ Record
·Four quarters a year, to be supplemented and modified at any time
·Each review includes: quarterly theme, quarterly rating (1-5 stars), five paragraphs of text (summary/highlights/checkpoints/lessons learned/next quarter plan)
·You can provide a cover photo for the quarter and choose from the album
■ Objective
·Break down the things you want to do in the quarter into goals and categorize them by field (career, learning, health, finance, relationships, life, etc.)
·Each goal has clear progress numbers (such as 19/24 training sessions) and three levels of status
·The target dashboard can be filtered by "All/In Progress/Completed/Planned" and viewed across quarters
■ Statistics
·Completion rate bar chart: quarterly comparison of target completion status
·Scoring Line Chart: One can see the ups and downs of the four quarters at a glance
·Domain Distribution Ring Chart: In Which Directions Does Time Spend
·Compare any two quarters side by side: rating, completion rate, target number, and domain distribution
Write it down to see progress.

name: Quaylume
description:
Quaylume is a relaxing harbor puzzle game where every move counts.

Crowded docks are packed with boats of different lengths. Your mission is simple: clear a path and guide the red target boat to the EXIT.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag boats to slide them along their lanes
• Horizontal boats move left or right only
• Vertical boats move up or down only
• Boats cannot overlap or leave the grid
• Clear blockers, then send the red boat out

FEATURES
• 100 handcrafted harbor levels across 5 chapters
• Clean controls with undo, reset, and smart hints
• Star ratings that reward efficient solutions
• Achievements to track your captain progress
• Soft music, sound effects, and offline play
• No account required — progress is saved on your device

Start in Quiet Harbor, then take on busier docks, narrow channels, cargo districts, and the Master Harbor challenges.

Plan carefully. Slide smart. Escape the quay.

name: Quick Reading
description:
Free, offline and private. No account, no adverts, no purchases, and no data collected: your results stay on this device.

Quick Reading is a calm reading trainer for children from about six, for teenagers and for adults. Take a short reading check, get a free plan for your age, and practise 10 to 20 minutes a day.

THE READING CHECK
- Read a short text, then answer three questions.
- See your pace in words per minute and how many answers were right, so pace and understanding are measured together.
- Take it again whenever you like and watch your own progress over time.

A FREE PLAN FOR YOU
- Plans for three age groups: young readers, students and adults.
- A plan suggests which exercises to start with and how long to practise. Every exercise stays open, and you can change the plan at any time.

EIGHT EXERCISES AND GAMES
- Eye warm-up: smooth tracking and quick returns to the next line.
- Schulte table: seeing more at one glance.
- Line pacer: reading in groups of words, with bold starts.
- Word-by-word reader: one spot, one to three words at a time.
- Word pyramid: seeing two words at once.
- Flash words: knowing a word from one look.
- Word hunt: finding a fact in a text fast.
- Look-alike words: telling similar words apart.
Each one adjusts to the age group: the words, the text size and the pace.

TEXTS WITH QUESTIONS
- Short texts for each age, each with questions, so you practise understanding as well as speed.

NO PRESSURE
- Start where you are. Practise for a few minutes or a whole workout. Your progress is for you only.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
- English, Spanish, Russian, Georgian and Chinese. The app starts in your device's language and remembers your choice.

BY RAISESTEADY
- Quick Reading is free from RaiseSteady, made by Nexodyne Limited. It is practice, not therapy or a diagnosis, and it promises no particular results.

name: QuickToolsS
description: QuickToolsS groups everyday transforms into five focused workspaces: Text, URL, Files, Images, and Web Lab. In Text, strip rich formatting, trim whitespace, change case, and watch character counts update as you type. URL tools normalize links, decode percent encoding, and break down scheme, host, path, and query pairs before opening Safari. Files covers PDF inspection, first-page export, multi-file merge, ZIP pack and extract, plus metadata for any document you pick. Images lets you resize to exact pixels, convert between JPEG, PNG, and HEIC, and compress JPEGs with a quality slider and size readout. Each tool opens on its own screen with controls tuned to that job. Recent tools surface on the hub so you can jump back quickly. Web Lab adds curated browser utilities when you need something online. Designed for iPhone and iPad with a dark, readable interface.

name: Quiet Dose
description:
Quiet Dose is a calm way to remember your medication. Keep your cabinet, dose times, history, and remaining supply in one place.

1. See today’s doses and mark each one taken or skipped.
2.Get a reminder when a dose is due.
3.Look back at what you took.
4.Know when a bottle is running low.

Quiet Dose is a personal reminder. It does not provide medical advice.

name: Quiet Temple
description:
Step into a quiet temple, wherever you are.

Quiet Temple is a peaceful space for a few minutes of daily practice, inspired by the rituals of Buddhist temples:

• 108 Bows — bow with each breath, one at a time
• Mala Beads — move through 108 beads with a phrase or in silence
• Wooden Fish — keep a steady rhythm on the moktak
• Offer Incense — three sticks, three quiet minutes
• Light a Lantern — write a private intention and let it glow for 7 days
• Sit in Stillness — a timed sit opened and closed by the singing bowl
• A short reflection each day, with one small thing to try

No account. No ads. Everything you do stays on your device.

QUIET TEMPLE PREMIUM
All six practices are free. Premium is an optional auto-renewable subscription that unlocks unlimited lanterns (free: one a day), longer sits of 15–45 minutes (free: up to 10 minutes) and rain ambience.
• Quiet Temple Premium (Monthly): US$4.99 per month
• Quiet Temple Premium (Yearly): US$29.99 per year
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Quiet Temple is a space for reflection and calm. It is not affiliated with any temple or religious organization and does not provide medical or psychological advice.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gways123.github.io/privacy.html

name: Quiz Bíblico: Jornada da Fé
description:
A Bible trivia game in Brazilian Portuguese. 1,020 questions checked against the text, from Genesis to Revelation: a 12-part Journey, a Daily Challenge, Until You Miss, Against the Clock, duels with friends and team games for church. Catholic or Protestant names. No account needed.

The game is in Portuguese.

name: Quiz Patente A B: Esame 2027
description:
App non ufficiale: non è collegata al Ministero delle Infrastrutture e dei Trasporti né alla Motorizzazione e non li rappresenta. Le domande provengono dal listato pubblicato dal Ministero sul Portale dell’Automobilista: https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/web/portale-automobilista/foglio-rosa-e-prove-new

Preparati all’esame di teoria per la patente A e B con le affermazioni del listato ministeriale: le stesse che trovi all’esame.

TUTTO IL LISTATO
• Oltre 7100 affermazioni Vero/Falso per le patenti A1, A2, A, B1, B e BE
• Già senza le domande superate dal nuovo Codice della strada (legge 177/2024)
• Tutte le figure: segnali, incroci, precedenze, spie del cruscotto
• 25 argomenti, nell’ordine dei capitoli ministeriali

SIMULAZIONE COME L’ESAME VERO
• 30 domande da tutti i capitoli, 20 minuti
• Superato con al massimo 3 errori
• Puoi saltare una domanda e tornarci
• Subito dopo vedi dove hai sbagliato

STUDIA SENZA STRESS
• Le domande sbagliate tornano finché non le impari
• «Le più difficili»: le domande che sbagli più spesso
• Maratona: tutte le domande mescolate
• Cerca: trovi una domanda per parola o numero e vedi subito la risposta

SENZA PUBBLICITÀ, ANCHE OFFLINE
• Tutto resta sul telefono, niente registrazione
• Nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento

Gratis: 10 domande per ogni argomento e una simulazione al giorno. L’accesso completo è un acquisto unico, senza rinnovo automatico: 7 giorni, 30 giorni o per sempre.

L’app serve solo per lo studio individuale e a scopo informativo. Non sostituisce l’autoscuola né il Codice della strada.

name: Quiz Pop Greek Divas
description:
Put the record on and show how well you know the great ladies of Greek song.

Quiz Pop Greek Divas is a trivia game about 11 much-loved Greek singers: Anna Vissi, Peggy Zina, Despina Vandi, Paola, Marinella, Natasa Theodoridou, Haris Alexiou, Katy Garbi, Elli Kokkinou, Rita Sakellariou and Katerina Stanisi.

OVER 5,700 QUESTIONS
Hits and albums, composers and lyricists, duets, 7-inch singles, Eurovision, big shows and awards, from 1957 to today. At least 500 questions for each singer. All about their music.

LEVELS FOR EVERY SINGER
Pick your favourite, with 50 levels, or play "All the divas" with over 570 levels. Every level has 10 questions, from easy to hard. Get 6 right to unlock the next one and win a silver, gold or platinum record.

QUICK GAME
10 random questions whenever you like. Pick singers, era and difficulty, and chase your record. Questions you saw lately are kept aside.

STRAIGHT FROM THE STUDIO
• Turntables, vinyl and an equalizer on every screen
• 20 seconds per question, with bonus points the faster you answer
• Three lifelines every round: 50:50, Swap question and +10 seconds
• At the end, see the questions you missed with the right answer

FOR EVERYONE
• A short walkthrough at the start, which you can skip
• Time per question: 20 or 40 seconds, or no limit
• Labels for screen readers, and zoom
• Report a mistake in any question

GREEK AND ENGLISH
Every question is available in both languages. Switch with one tap.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account. Works offline.

An unofficial fan app. It is not affiliated with the artists or their record labels and contains none of their songs or photos.

name: QuizMe: Trivia Duels
description:
QuizMe is quick-fire trivia, one on one.

Pick a topic and you're matched with another player in seconds. You both get the same seven questions and the same clock. A right answer scores, and a fast right answer scores more, so every round stays close to the last question.

HOW A MATCH WORKS
• Seven questions, four choices each.
• The clock is running. The sooner you answer, the more points you take.
• You see your opponent's score move as they answer.
• Nobody waiting? You'll play a computer opponent instead, so there is always a game.

TOPICS FOR EVERY KIND OF KNOW-IT-ALL
• Movies, television, music, books and video games.
• World geography, capitals and flags.
• Science, animals, mathematics and computers.
• History, mythology, sports, art and general knowledge.

PICTURE ROUNDS
• Name That Flag shows you a flag and asks for the country.
• Pick the Flag names a country and asks you to find its flag among four.

LEVEL UP AND CLIMB
• Earn experience in every match and level up in each topic you play.
• Weekly and all-time leaderboards for every topic.
• A new topic of the day, every day.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Follow other players and challenge them: they play seven questions, then you play the same seven.
• See your wins and losses against each friend, game by game.
• Message players who follow you back, with block and report on every conversation.
• Choose from 24 built-in characters for your avatar.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• Scores are decided by the server, not the phone.
• No ads and no purchases.
• Delete your account from inside the app at any time.

An account is needed to play, because every match is live. You must be 13 or older.

name: QuranLive
description:
القرآن المباشر — Quran Live

اقرأ القرآن الكريم، ودَع التطبيق يتابع تلاوتك كلمةً بكلمة.

يقدم تطبيق القرآن المباشر تجربة مميزة لقراءة القرآن الكريم بالرسم العثماني برواية حفص عن عاصم، مع تقنيات حديثة لمتابعة التلاوة وتظليل الكلمات أثناء القراءة.

مميزات التطبيق:

• القرآن الكريم كاملاً بجميع سوره الـ١١٤.
• متابعة التلاوة وتظليل الكلمات أثناء القراءة.
• التنقل بين السور والأجزاء وصفحات المصحف.
• البحث عن السور بالاسم أو الرقم.
• حفظ موضع القراءة والعلامات المرجعية.
• التحكم بحجم الخط والوضع الداكن.
• إيقاف جلسة التلاوة مؤقتاً واستكمالها.

يهدف التطبيق إلى المساعدة على قراءة القرآن الكريم ومراجعته، ولا يُعد أداة معتمدة لتقييم أحكام التجويد.

نسأل الله أن يجعل هذا العمل صدقة جارية وينفع به المؤمنين.

name: Race League Game
description:
A season is created with circuits, scoring rules and car classes, then a grid is built from groups, playoffs and a grand final. Single table and one off formats are available as well.

Finishing orders are entered by hand, or a multi pilot lap clock runs while the race is on. Points, standings, pilot ratings and pilot cards are calculated automatically, with laps and house rules set per championship. Crew tables, a race calendar and an archive of finished seasons sit alongside the standings. For a single evening, a random challenge is rolled: elimination, time attack or class cup. Everything stays on the device.

name: Racing Champs: Run Swim Fly
description:
Ready to race? Meet your new favorite racing champ!

Run, swim, climb, and fly through colorful obstacle courses in Racing Champs, a fun 3D racing adventure filled with clever choices, exciting gadgets, and challenging tracks.

Every race is different. Choose the right ability, overcome obstacles, and race toward the finish line!

RACE YOUR WAY TO VICTORY

Guide your cute racing character across exciting courses featuring rivers, mountains, snowy terrain, and more. Discover new challenges as you progress through the game.

CHOOSE THE RIGHT GADGET

Need to cross water? Pick a boat or swim across!

Facing a mountain? Climb your way up or use a jetpack to fly over it!

Discover rockets and other exciting gadgets that can help you race faster and overcome difficult obstacles.

MAKE SMART CHOICES

Choose between different upgrade gates during a race. The right ability can give your champ an advantage, while a different choice might slow you down.

Think quickly, choose wisely, and discover your favorite way to race.

UPGRADE YOUR CHAMP

Improve your character's racing abilities to tackle new challenges. Help your champ become faster at running, swimming, and flying.

UNLOCK MORE RACING CHAMPS

Progress through the game to discover new cute characters and enjoy more racing adventures.

FUN FEATURES

• Colorful 3D racing environments
• Cute characters to unlock
• Exciting obstacle-filled courses
• Fun gadgets, rockets, boats, and jetpacks
• Upgrade gates and racing abilities
• Running, swimming, climbing, and flying challenges
• Simple controls and entertaining gameplay

Whether you're crossing a river, flying over a mountain, or racing across a snowy track, every course offers a new challenge.

Choose your gadgets, improve your champ, and race for the finish line!

Play Racing Champs now

name: RadLab: Nuclear Science
description:
Explore nuclear science and radiation protection through interactive labs, animated decay chains, and virtual detector training.

• Explore all 118 elements in an interactive periodic table. Pinch to zoom into the Chart of Nuclides, inspect half-lives and decay modes, and follow animated chains from parent to daughter.

• Move a virtual probe across simulated radiation fields and contaminated surfaces. Compare instrument responses, hear clicks change with count rate, and see how detectors work in Detector Academy.

• Experiment with time, distance, and shielding. Watch simulated dose-rate contours change and trace how loose contamination transfers between a glove and a workbench.

• Build and export decay paths with evaluated nuclear data in Decay Workspace. Generate flashcards from RadLab's references or write your own, then review them on a study schedule.

• Explore valence electrons and energy bands in Particle Playground.

RadLab is built for students, instructors, and radiation protection trainees. The labs and study tools work offline without an account. Detector readings and dose estimates are simulated for learning.

name: Rain Check: PDG
description:
Rain Check tells you whether the skatepark is good to ride, before you leave home.

RIGHT NOW
• Reports from people at the park: dry, damp, puddles or soaked, with tags (wind, leaves, crowded…), a note and photos.
• No recent report? An estimate from the rain measured by IPMA weather stations, the radar and the forecast.

WHEN WILL IT BE DRY
• The time the ground should be dry, with the chance hour by hour, worked out from 191 scenarios of 5 weather models.
• Every community report helps tune the model.

WEATHER AND RAIN
• Temperature, wind and rain for the next 48 hours.

WIDGET
• The park on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, with its tags, the expected dry time and a refresh button.

MADE FOR THE COMMUNITY
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
• People in photos are blurred on your phone, and photos are deleted after 24 hours.
• In 25 languages, with notes translated automatically.

For now, for Parque das Gerações in Cascais, Portugal.

name: RaiseNote: Voice Reminders
description:
Raise your wrist, say one line, and it becomes a reminder, a to-do or a message you can send. Say "call the landlord at 10 tomorrow" and a result card appears, with the reminder already added in Reminders. No typing.

Cooking, cycling, commuting, a gap between meetings: your hands are busy and a thing to do shows up anyway. RaiseNote is for that moment.

Raise and say a line
Speak one or two sentences into your watch (or tap Say it on your phone) and they become one clean line. Things to do go to Reminders; something to tell a person becomes a short message you can send in one tap. If it is wrong, undo it; if it did not work, try again.

The result card
When you finish, a card shows what you said, the tidied line, and where it went. One look tells you it worked.

Look back by day
What you said is listed by day. Search a word to find it, and tap to play the original voice.

No sign-up, one-tap delete
There are no accounts. What you said is stored on your watch and phone, and one tap in Settings deletes it all. Turning speech into text and tidying it up use cloud AI; what is sent and to whom is spelled out on the Third-party AI page. You must be 18 or older.

Free to use, with no in-app purchases. You get a number of free uses each day; when they are used up, come back tomorrow.

Privacy Policy: https://huaxiaoman.com.cn/raisenote/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://huaxiaoman.com.cn/raisenote/terms.html

name: Ramu: AI Coding Workspace
description:
Ramu is the free, open-source workspace for AI coding agents. Your agents run on your own computer; Ramu on your iPhone and iPad keeps you in the loop when you step away.

• Follow every thread live: see what each agent is doing, its changed files and its terminal.
• Answer, approve or stop an agent from anywhere.
• Get a notification and a Live Activity when an agent finishes or needs you.
• Dictate messages on device; audio never leaves your phone.
• Review diffs and pull requests before you merge.

Ramu works with Claude Code, Codex and other agents, using the accounts you already have. Pair the app with Ramu on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer to start: download it free at getramu.dev.

name: RankUp: Promotion Exam Prep
description:
RankUp is an independent study app for New York City Police Department promotional exams. It offers original practice questions and study notes based on the publicly available NYPD Patrol Guide and Administrative Guide.

This version includes:

• 4,010 Sergeant practice questions
• 4,028 Lieutenant practice questions
• 764 study notes

RankUp is free to download on the United States App Store only.

14-DAY FREE TRIAL ($0, ONE-TIME)
Start a 14-day free trial to practice both the Sergeant and Lieutenant sets. The trial is a $0 one-time in-app purchase, not a subscription, and it does not renew. One trial covers both ranks. When the trial ends, practice sessions, timed exams, and weak-areas and missed-deck practice lock. A limited free sample remains available.

ONE-TIME PASSES (NOT A SUBSCRIPTION)
• Sergeant Pass — $75, one-time
• Lieutenant Pass — $95, one-time

The price is shown in the app before you buy. Apple charges you once for that pass. There are no recurring charges. The two passes are separate: buying one does not include the other. If you want both, purchase each pass at its full price. There is no upgrade from one rank to the other.

Each pass stays active until two weeks after that rank's exam date. If the official exam date has not been announced yet, the app says access lasts until two weeks after the exam date, to be announced. If the exam is postponed, access is extended automatically.

RESTORE AND REFUNDS
Restore Purchases is in the app, on the trial screen, the pass screen, and in Settings, so you can recover a trial or pass you already bought.

Refunds are handled by Apple, not by RankUp. Request a refund at https://reportaproblem.apple.com.

ABOUT THIS APP
RankUp is an independent NYPD exam study aid. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the NYPD, the Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS), or the City of New York.

Questions or deletion requests: support@finestdigitalventures.com

name: Rapportini360
description:
Rapportini360 porta i rapportini di lavoro sul telefono. I vostri operai e tecnici compilano il rapportino in cantiere o dal cliente, l'ufficio lo riceve subito, lo controlla e lo approva. Niente più fogli da ricopiare a fine settimana.

Per usare l'app serve un account Rapportini360: le credenziali le crea l'amministratore della vostra azienda.

RAPPORTINI GIORNALIERI
• Cliente, commessa, lavorazioni e ore in pochi tocchi
• Lavorazioni scelte da un menu configurato dalla vostra azienda, con le vostre parole
• Note libere e fino a 5 foto per rapportino, scattate al momento o dalla galleria
• Lo storico dei propri rapportini sempre a portata di mano

SQUADRE
• Il caposquadra compila un solo rapportino per tutta la squadra
• Le assenze dei membri si segnano nello stesso invio

RAPPORTI D'INTERVENTO
• Il tecnico compila il rapporto sul posto
• Il cliente firma direttamente sul telefono e riceve il PDF

PRESENZE
• Timbratura di entrata e uscita dal telefono
• Ferie, permessi e malattie
• Il foglio presenze si compila da solo a partire dai rapportini

COMMESSE
• Ore, materiali e spese di ogni lavoro in tempo reale
• Costi e margine di ogni commessa, anche per dipendente

MEZZI E SCADENZE
• Rifornimenti e consumi di ogni veicolo
• Scadenze di revisione, assicurazione e bollo
• Scadenze dei dipendenti: corsi, visite mediche, patenti
• DPI e attrezzature consegnati con conferma firmata

PER L'UFFICIO
• Dashboard con tutti i rapportini in arrivo, da approvare o correggere
• Export in Word, Excel e PDF, con filtri per data, dipendente, commessa e cliente
• Ogni modifica a un rapportino resta registrata

PER CHI È
Imprese edili, installatori, impiantisti, officine, ditte di manutenzione e assistenza tecnica: tutte le aziende con personale in cantiere o sul territorio.

I DATI
Ogni azienda vede solo i propri dati. Il dipendente vede i suoi rapportini, l'ufficio vede tutto. Le comunicazioni sono cifrate e l'app non usa la posizione GPS.

Assistenza: info@rapportini360.it

name: Rasd Fleet Tracking
description:
Rasd is the mobile app of the Rasd Fleet platform by Afaq Alrasd Aldhki. Sign in with your Rasd Fleet account to follow your vehicles live and act fast, in Arabic or English.

FOLLOW YOUR FLEET
• Dashboard: see at a glance how many vehicles are running, stopped, idle, inactive or not reporting, with cards for today's alerts, fleet activity, maintenance and subscriptions.
• Live map: every vehicle with its status, speed and direction; street, satellite and hybrid views; geofences and points of interest.
• Status list: search and filter your vehicles and see each one's address, speed, ignition, battery and connection.
• Live tracking: follow one vehicle, see today's driving time and distance, the driver and the latest update; call the driver; share a live-location link.
• Parking mode: one tap on the P and you get an alert if the parked vehicle moves, its ignition comes on or its tracker is unplugged.

HISTORY AND REPORTS
• Route history: replay a day or a period you choose on the map, with stops, events and running, stop and idle totals. Open it at a chosen day and time, and see who was driving when drivers are recorded.
• Fuel and temperature graphs: for vehicles with fuel or temperature sensors, with refuels and suspected fuel drops marked.
• Reports: generate reports for the vehicles and period you choose, then open or share them as PDF, Excel or HTML files; charts of distance and activity.

ALERTS AND GEOFENCES
• Alerts: overspeed, geofence, ignition and other events from your account, in the Alerts list and, while Rasd is open, in a banner at the top of the screen.
• Alert rules: turn rules on or off, create new ones and edit them.
• Geofences: draw circles and polygons on the map, edit them or delete them.

FLEET MANAGEMENT
• Maintenance and costs (with the Fleet Management module): upcoming and overdue services, service history, costs per vehicle, expenses and work orders.
• Renewal center: see which tracking subscriptions and SIM cards have ended or end within 30 days, and set a reminder.
• Report a problem: tell Afaq about a tracker problem on WhatsApp, with the plate, IMEI and SIM number already written in.

AI ASSISTANT
• Rasd AI (when Afaq switches it on for your account): ask about your vehicles, trips and alerts in Arabic or English. It connects to your account by itself, with no code to enter, asks your permission before your first question, and makes a change only after you confirm it.

SAFE AND SIMPLE
• Commands: send the commands your device supports, such as engine block and unblock, with safety confirmations.
• Cameras: view the latest camera images of vehicles with video telematics.
• App lock: open Rasd with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.
• Web panel: open Rasd on the web from the app, already signed in.
• Arabic and English, with full right-to-left support. You stay signed in until you sign out.

Rasd works with a Rasd Fleet account from Afaq Alrasd Aldhki; accounts are not created in the app. Some features depend on your account and on what it is allowed to do.

name: Rave Baes
description:
Rave Baes is the all-in-one planner built for your festival weekend—from planning the trip to surviving the dancefloor.

PLAN MODE — Before the gates open
• PLAN YOUR SETS: Browse lineups and lock in your must-see set times without the clashes.
• MAKE A POSTER: Turn your personal picks into a sleek, shareable lineup poster.
• FIND YOUR SQUAD: Team up with friends and keep everyone on the same page.
• SHARE YOUR TRIP: Organize travel, stays, and festival details in one shareable itinerary.

FLY MODE — Built for the live event
• QUICK-SHARE YOUR IG: Instantly drop your Instagram handle or socials to new rave baes you meet.
• MULTIPLE TIMERS: Track overlapping stages, meetups, and hydration breaks at once.
• DJ RUNDOWNS: Get quick artist and set info right when you need it.
• FLASHLIGHT: One-tap light tool for dark tents, porta-potties, and finding your crew.

START INSTANTLY
No account needed to jump in—browse lineups, plan your schedule, and create your poster as a guest. Sign in anytime to sync your picks across devices and join squads.

Disclaimer: Rave Baes is an independent fan tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any festival or artist.

name: Real Violin 2027
description:
Real Violin 2027 turns your phone into a real violin, built for Turkish and Arabic music.

Notes are laid out by makam, so every position on the strings already belongs to the scale you choose. Pick Rast, Hicaz, Nihavend, Uşşak, Bayati, Saba and many more, and play melodies right away without hunting for the right note.

FEATURES
- Makam layout for Turkish and Arabic music, including quarter tones
- Realistic violin sounds recorded from a real instrument
- Turkish and Arabic rhythms with adjustable tempo
- Built-in chromatic tuner for your real violin
- Record your playing and listen back
- Turn your recordings into videos and save them to Photos or share them
- Practice songs to learn famous melodies step by step
- Turkish, English and Arabic interface

PRO
Unlock every rhythm and feature and remove ads with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.

Whether you are learning the violin, practicing makams or just having fun, Real Violin 2027 is always in your pocket.

name: RealBuddy: 3D Pet & Alarm
description:
RealBuddy is an alarm clock with two living 3D pets: a fluffy kitten on its windowsill and a Maltipoo puppy in its backyard. They play with you during the day — and in the morning, they are the ones who wake you up.

PETS THAT FEEL ALIVE
• Soft fur, expressive eyes, real breathing, slow blinks, stretches and yawns.
• Moods: playful, sleepy, curious, sometimes grumpy — and they react to how you play.
• Pet them anywhere: head, cheeks, back, tail — each spot feels different.

AN ALARM YOU CAN'T IGNORE
• At first your pet asks gently.
• Stay in bed and it gets cross; keep sleeping and it gets furious — no snooze, no dismiss, until you calm it down: pet it, feed it, give it a hug.
• Choose the time, repeat days, snooze length and ringtone.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Kitten: the laser dot, a quick little mouse that hides in its houses, soap bubbles, a ball of yarn, the scratching post and the carpet wall to climb after your finger.
• Puppy: fetch with a slingshot, tug of war, a flying bone and winged treats to shoot down in the sky, hide and seek, bubbles.
• Commands: Sit, Down, Paw, High five, Speak and more.
• RUN: an endless runner across a home, a dandelion meadow, the countryside, the moon and the sea. How far can you go?

MAKE THEM YOURS
• Costumes, coats, haircuts, beds and scratching posts — each pet has its own.
• Voice characters, calm music and soft, quiet sounds.

AWARDS
• Medals for time together, mornings on time, games and tricks — in bronze, silver, gold and platinum, plus rare secret ones. Your latest medals hang on the home screen.

IN YOUR ROOM
• AR real life: put your pet on your floor, bed or desk. The puppy even jumps up onto the sofa.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your alarms and your pets stay on your iPhone.

EVERYTHING IS FREE
Unlimited alarms, both pets, every game, costume, coat, bed and voice — no subscription, no ads.

The app is in English.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://respected-bagel-d72.notion.site/RealBuddy-Privacy-Policy-41e42fc67e92806ebe5bfbea8f2b1954

name: RealU Aura
description:
RealU Aura is a private color journal for your feelings. Record a quick check-in, choose your own colors, and see your self-reported patterns over time.

• Rate 12 feelings from 0–100 and add an optional note.
• See a living color aura and a radar of your recent feelings.
• Explore day, week, month, and year trends from your own entries.
• Edit or delete a check-in, including entries for an earlier day.
• Export a journal backup, import it on another device, or share a short summary.
• Use the journal offline, with no account, ads, or subscription.

Your journal starts empty and stays on your device. There is no cloud sync; export a backup before changing devices or deleting the app. You can erase all app data from the You screen.

Aura colors and intensity come from your own ratings. They are for personal reflection and self-expression, not health measurements, diagnoses, or a measure of femininity or worth.

Support: dylanwain@localviewers.com

name: Rean Life
description:
Rean Life, Türkiye'de geçen bir hayat simülasyonu. Bir şehirde doğarsın, büyürsün ve hayatını kendi kararlarınla kurarsın.

Nasıl oynanır
- Tam Hayat ile bebeklikten başla ya da Hızlı Başlangıç ile 18 yaşından gir.
- Her ay birkaç aksiyon hakkın var: iş ara, mesaiye kal, okula yazıl, arkadaş edin, tatile çık, birikim yap.
- Kararlarının sağlığına, mutluluğuna, stresine ve cebine etkisi olur. Yanlış seçimlerin de bedeli var: işsizlik, borç ve haciz oyunun parçası.

Kariyer ve eğitim
- Şehrindeki iş ilanlarına başvur, terfi iste, kamu sınavlarına hazırlan.
- Üniversite, kurs ve ehliyetle yeni kapılar aç.

Servet
- Ev, araba ve işletme al; kiraya ver ya da krediyle satın al.
- Mevduat ve yatırımlarla servetini büyüt. Enflasyon da hesapta.

Aile ve ilişkiler
- Ailenle bağını koru, biriyle tanış, evlen, çocuk sahibi ol.
- Arkadaş ekle, komşularınla yardımlaş.

Karakterin
- 16 karakter tipi, yüz, saç ve kıyafet seçimi. Profilde ayarladığın karakterle her yerde görünürsün.

Rean City (18+)
- Karakterinle şehre çık: meydan, cafe, oyun salonu, yemekhane ve club.
- Diğer oyuncularla sohbet et, taş kağıt makas, XOX ya da pişti oyna. Oyunlar parasızdır, kumar ve bahis yoktur.
- Küfür ve iletişim bilgisi paylaşımı filtrelenir; istemediğin kişiyi engelleyebilir ya da şikâyet edebilirsin.

Yarış
- Bütün oyuncular aynı sezonda oynar. Servet, aylık gelir ve haftalık sıralamada yerini gör, şehrine göre filtrele.

Notlar
- Oynamak için ücretsiz üyelik gerekir. Kaydın hesabında tutulur, başka cihazda kaldığın yerden devam edersin.
- Oyunda reklam ve uygulama içi satın alma yoktur.
- Oyundaki para ve ekonomik değerler kurgusaldır, gerçek paraya çevrilemez.

Destek: destek@reanlife.com

name: ReceiptCapShare
description: ReceiptCapShare jakaa kuitit henkilöille, joilla on oma osuus katosta. Näkymä kertoo kuka mahtuu mukaan ja mikä kuitti jää ulos. Nimet kirjoitetaan itse. Luvut jäävät puhelimeen, eikä sovellus hyväksy kuluja.

name: Recipe Kitchen for Fujifilm
description:
Stop guessing which recipe to load. Recipe Kitchen designs a Fujifilm film simulation recipe for the exact light you'll shoot in, shows you how it looks on real photos, and sends it to your camera via USB in one tap.

Most recipe apps give you a list. Recipe Kitchen gives you the right recipe for your specific shoot.

COOKED UP FOR YOUR LIGHT
Choose a mood, what you're shooting, where and when. Recipe Kitchen checks the Apple Weather forecast for that place and hour (sun, cloud, rain, temperature and sunset) and tunes the white balance, tone, colour and grain to match. Golden hour, blue hour, a grey afternoon, a neon night or direct flash: each gets its own recipe.

MADE FOR WHAT YOU'RE SHOOTING
13 subjects and 10 moods, each with its own look. Pets get crisp fur, portraits and weddings get flattering skin, landscapes get deep blue skies, food stays warm and clean. Plus shooting tips for each subject, from shutter speeds for fast dogs to focus for kids.

SEE IT BEFORE YOU SHOOT
Every recipe is previewed on real, unedited photos taken in the same light, and on your own photos too. Drag the slider to compare it with the original.

ONE TAP TO YOUR CAMERA
Plug in with USB-C and send a recipe straight to a custom slot. Recipe Kitchen reads what's already on your camera, so you know exactly which slot you're replacing, backs up every slot before changing it, and checks the camera stored every setting. One tap to undo.

COLLECT RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
Save recipes from screenshots, photos or pasted text, however messily they're written. Recipe Kitchen uses local Apple Intelligence to read them on your iPhone and fills in every setting. Your Cookbook shows each recipe's tone curve, white balance and effects at a glance.

DISCOVER
Original recipes made for Recipe Kitchen, and recipes shared by other photographers.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Recipes are designed on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence. Your photos stay on your device unless you choose to share them. No account, no ads, no tracking.

ONE PRICE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Recipe Kitchen is free to download, and sending recipes to your camera is free. Recipe Kitchen Pro is a single purchase, shared with your family: unlimited Kitchen recipes, an unlimited Cookbook, Recipe Sets that fill every slot at once, an Auto-Stocked Pantry that finds recipes in your screenshots, and full camera backups.

Designed for recent Fujifilm X cameras that save custom settings over USB-C, and tested with the X-M5.

Recipe Kitchen is an independent app and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Fujifilm. FUJIFILM is a trademark of FUJIFILM Corporation.

name: Reef Match: Bubble Fish
description:
Tap a fish and settle into a little ocean adventure.

Each big bubble holds several sea friends. Choose one to send it into a tank. Collect three of the same kind in one tank to clear them and earn points. With three tanks and layers of bubbles, every choice leaves room for a little strategy.

ONE BUBBLE, MANY FRIENDS
Tap the fish you want; its neighbors stay in the bubble. Watch the fish gently swim, bubbles drift, and each move respond with playful animation and sound.

30 LEVELS ACROSS SIX OCEAN REGIONS
Explore changing combinations of sea friends and layered bubbles. Clear a bubble's current layer to reveal the next. Check your tanks, plan your picks, and help every fish find its way home.

BUILD COMBOS AND EARN STARS
Keep matching to earn combo points. Try finishing with fewer helpers to earn a higher star rating. There is no timer, so take a moment to think or simply enjoy a slower pace.

A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Undo, Hint, Shuffle, and Rescue are always free to use. Take another look at the board and find your next match.

MAKE YOUR OCEAN YOUR OWN
Finish levels to earn game points, then unlock seas, tank styles, and decorations in My Ocean. Switch between unlocked styles whenever you like.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your board, tanks, points, level progress, and chosen decorations are saved on your device. Return to the home screen or reopen the app to continue your saved game.

PLAY OFFLINE, AT YOUR OWN PACE
Designed for iPhone in portrait orientation. No account, ads, or in-app purchases. Adjust sound effects, haptics, and ambient motion separately in Settings.

Points are used only for in-game content. Choose a fish and make a little room for an ocean break.

name: ReefWheel
description:
Every current is a choice.

Guide a precision supply wheel through luminous reefs. Read the next tide, collect the right resources and restore three habitats before your oxygen runs out. A carefully timed delivery frees cargo space and gives you one oxygen back.

PLAN YOUR DIVE
Choose a Survey Tank, Mooring Kit or Cargo Cradle. Extra oxygen, more anchors and a larger hold each open different routes. Turn one sector at a time, ride the current after collecting, or anchor the wheel when staying put matters more.

RESTORE THREE LIVING REGIONS
Explore 30 expeditions across Pearl Lagoon, Kelp Cathedral and Glass Abyss. Later regions introduce reversing currents and larger delivery bundles. Replay charted reefs to earn completion, efficiency and unassisted medals.

GROW A DIFFERENT KIND OF STRATEGY
The Nursery offers 12 spatial drafting challenges. Choose from three seeds, inspect the exact point preview and plant six cells. Match terrain, connect neighboring species and decide when to spend nutrients on a new draft.

LEARN FROM EVERY CHOICE
Five illustrated lessons explain the wheel, currents, deliveries, equipment and nursery scoring. Inspect action forecasts, use undo to explore alternatives, and ask for a route hint when a puzzle has you thinking in circles.

Discover illustrated field-guide entries as you restore reefs. Review your recent dives and their decision logs, then return with a better plan.

name: ReelForge Pro
description:
ReelForge is a powerful, easy video editor for Reels, Shorts, stories and vlogs. Cut, trim and layer clips on a real multi-track timeline, add music and sound effects from the built-in library, then export in up to 4K at 60 fps. No watermark, no account, no sign-up.

EDIT LIKE A PRO
• Multi-track timeline with pinch-to-zoom and a fixed centre playhead
• Split, trim, duplicate, replace, reorder and delete clips
• Speed from 0.1x to 100x, plus speed-curve presets like Montage, Hero and Bullet
• Keyframes for position, scale, rotation and opacity
• Freeze frame, reverse, crop, rotate and mirror
• Unlimited undo and redo

FREE MUSIC & SOUND EFFECTS
• 26 original songs across 10 moods: Vlog, Pop, Chill, Hip hop, Electronic, Cinematic, Happy, Romance, Sport and Game
• 75 sound effects: whooshes, impacts, UI clicks, funny sounds, game sounds, nature, foley and stingers
• Tap to preview, save favourites, and find recently used sounds fast
• Every sound is original and free to use in your videos
• Or import your own audio from Files, record a voiceover, or extract audio from a video

AUDIO TOOLS
• Volume, fade in and fade out, with waveform display
• Beat detection with beat markers and Cut to beat
• Voice effects, Enhance and Denoise
• Text to speech

TEXT, CAPTIONS & STICKERS
• Text with fonts, colours, stroke, background, shadow and style presets
• Text animations: fade, pop, slide, zoom, typewriter and more
• Auto captions powered by speech recognition
• Animated emoji and symbol stickers
• Motion tracking: make text or stickers follow a moving object

EFFECTS, FILTERS & TRANSITIONS
• 20 video effects like glitch, RGB split, VHS, shake, blur and flash
• 20 filters with adjustable intensity
• 15 transitions between clips
• Adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, exposure, warmth, tint, highlights, shadows, vignette, sharpen, grain and fade
• In, Out and Combo animations for every clip

ADVANCED TOOLS
• Remove background automatically, no green screen needed
• Chroma key for green-screen footage
• Masks: linear, mirror, circle and rectangle, with feather
• Picture-in-picture overlays with blend modes and opacity
• Video stabilisation
• Retouch: skin smoothing and brightening

TEMPLATES
• Start from a ready-made style with music, text, transitions and filters
• Add your clips and you're done

EXPORT & SHARE
• Resolution from 480p up to 4K
• Frame rate from 24 to 60 fps
• HEVC option for smaller files
• Save to Photos or share straight to your favourite apps
• Every aspect ratio: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and more

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your videos never leave your iPhone. ReelForge has no account, no ads and no tracking. Projects are saved automatically on your device.

name: Refleksmatik: Brain Reflex Lab
description:
How precise is your sense of time?

Refleksmatik is a one-tap reflex and timing game. Every level is over in seconds, and every hundredth of a second counts.

5 CATEGORIES
• Perfect Time – start the clock and stop it at exactly 1, 3, 5… or 7.77 seconds. Later the clock disappears, speeds up and slows down: count in your head!
• Lights Out – five red lights come on, then go out. Tap as fast as a pro driver. Tap too early and it's a jump start.
• Fill to the Line – hold to pour, release on the line. Careful: it keeps dripping after you let go.
• Fuse – several bombs count down at different speeds. Tap each one at exactly 0.0.
• All in One – every mode mixed on a single road.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• Each category has its own level map with stars and a boss every 5 levels
• Tolerance gets tighter step by step: from ±0.15 s to a few hundredths
• Your exact deviation after every try: +0.02 s… so close!
• Satisfying 3D visuals and sounds
• Short sessions, perfect for a quick break

Free to play with ads. Remove Ads and Pro Pack (no ads + unlimited lives) are available as in-app purchases.

Available in English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português, Italiano, Bahasa Indonesia and Русский.

name: RehomeFish
description:
RehomeFish helps fishkeepers rehome fish without the busywork. Add a fish once, then make a post for your groups and print labels for your bags and tables.

MAKE A POST IN SECONDS
- Type a few letters and pick the species. Names are spelled for you, with care facts and CARES conservation status filled in.
- Get a sharp post image and a caption ready to paste.
- Posts for Facebook groups say REHOME and ask people to message you, with no price, the way most fish groups require. Posts for BAND and Instagram can show your prices.
- Save the groups you post in and post to each with one tap.

PRINT LABELS AND CARDS
- 3 x 5 and 4 x 6 cards, on card-size paper or cut from a plain sheet
- Thermal and roll label printers, including Dymo and Brother sizes
- Avery label sheets in US Letter and A4
- Any custom size
- One label for each bag or one card for each fish
- Wide or tall layouts, with photo, care facts and a care info QR code
- Fine-tune alignment and print a test sheet before you use real labels
- Print with AirPrint, or save a PDF or picture for your label printer's own app

MADE FOR SWAPS AND CLUB AUCTIONS
- Works offline, so it works in the back of a hall with no signal
- Keep track of what is available and what has been rehomed
- Back up your fish list and restore it on a new phone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account and no sign-in
- No ads and no tracking
- Your fish, photos and settings stay on your device

Species names, care facts and CARES status come from Aquarist Atlas.

name: Reid - Answer Trail
seller_name: MY TECH GLOBAL INDUSTRIES SDN. BHD.
description:
Reid turns one working conversation into a clear, shared answer trail.
Get a stuck question to someone who already solved it, without searching their private messages.
Start in Chats. Open the answer trail, make the route a question to a likely expert, and let the right person confirm the result.
A real asker and a real expert continue in a group thread.
AI helps organize the source material, but a person stays responsible for the decision. Reid indexes only opted-in team channels and files.
Chats stay free. Shared rooms, larger groups and longer source history are available with Plus.

name: RekindleCam
description:
RekindleCam turns a spare iPhone into a home camera that you watch from the phone you carry.

HOW IT WORKS
• On the spare phone, choose "Set up a camera" and point it at the room.
• On the phone you carry, choose "View my cameras" and sign in.
• Add the camera by scanning a QR code or typing a one-time code. Codes work once and expire after 5 minutes.
• A computer webcam can be a camera too, and you can watch from a computer browser.

WHAT STAYS WHERE
• Live video goes directly between your devices, encrypted in transit. If a relay is needed to connect them, it forwards encrypted data.
• Each connection is checked with a key that stays on your devices. A new phone must be linked at one of your cameras before it can watch.
• Motion clips and their thumbnails are saved only on the camera phone, not on our servers.
• Your viewing phone keeps the last picture it saw of each camera, clearly marked "not live".
• No public links. Cameras can't be shared with other accounts.

MOTION CLIPS
• Motion is detected on the camera phone.
• When the camera phone is plugged in, clips include up to 8 seconds before the movement.
• Motion zones: ignore a TV, a window or a road.
• Motion events appear in the app, in "Motion today" and the timeline.
• Play, download and delete clips from your other phone while the camera is online.
• Keep clips for 1, 3, 7, 14 or 30 days.

CLEAR STATUS
• Every camera says whether it is Live, Paused (with the reason), Offline (with when it was last seen) or Stopped.
• The camera phone always shows that it is on, and a red dot with "Recording" while it records.
• Dim screen keeps the camera phone running with the screen near-black.
• If the phone gets too hot, the camera pauses to cool down and resumes by itself.

GOOD TO KNOW
• On iPhone, the camera works only while the app is open and in front. It cannot film when the phone is locked.
• Clips live only on the camera phone. If it is lost or reset, its clips cannot be recovered.
• RekindleCam is not an alarm or emergency system.
• Sound is off by default. Only record where you are allowed to, and follow local recording laws, especially for audio.
• Accounts are for adults 18+.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
• 1 camera: $2.99 per month or $24.99 per year.
• Up to 3 cameras: $4.99 per month or $34.99 per year.
• Watch on as many of your own devices as you like. No trial and no free plan.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://home-camera-preview.vercel.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://home-camera-preview.vercel.app/privacy.html

name: RelayPlay
description:
RelayPlay lets you play the PS5 you own on your iPhone or iPad over your home Wi-Fi.

FIND AND LINK
• RelayPlay finds the consoles on your network and shows whether each one is ready or resting.
• Link once with the code shown on your console. Each step is explained, and each problem comes with a specific fix.
• Keep several consoles in one list, then rename, link again or remove them.

PLAY
• One tap wakes a resting console and connects.
• See each connection step as it happens: finding, waking, securing the session, starting the picture.
• Choose resolution, frame rate and picture quality.
• End a session, or end it and put the console to rest.

CONTROLS
• Touch controls drawn like real controller parts, with instant press feedback.
• Named layouts you drag into place, resize, mirror for left hands and switch during play.
• A portrait mode with a full controller under the picture on iPhone.
• Use a Bluetooth game controller instead, and check its buttons and sticks in Settings.
• Every input is released when the connection drops, the app goes to the background or a controller disconnects.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Everything stays on your local network. RelayPlay does not connect to your console over the internet or over cellular data.
• Linking keys are kept in the Keychain on your device.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A PS5 you own, on the same Wi-Fi as your iPhone or iPad, with Remote Play turned on in its settings.
• The account ID signed in on the console, which you enter once when linking.

RelayPlay is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment. PS5 is a trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc.

Privacy Policy: https://avengerstudio.com/privacy-policy?app=relayplay
Terms of Use: https://avengerstudio.com/terms-of-use?app=relayplay

name: Remote for Android TV +
description:
Control your Android TV or Google TV from your iPhone or iPad with Remote ATV+.

CONNECT ON YOUR LOCAL NETWORK
Keep your phone and TV on the same Wi-Fi network, choose your TV and enter the six-character pairing code shown on its screen. Save devices for later connections, or enter a local address manually.

YOUR REMOTE, YOUR LAYOUT
Navigate with a large touchpad or directional buttons. Open the number pad with TV and Menu keys. Adjust volume and channels, mute, go Home or Back, and use media and color keys. Choose applications, color keys or media controls for quick access, or hide the strip for more navigation space. Add and organize TV application shortcuts.

TEXT AND VOICE
Type into a supported active TV text field from your phone. Use your microphone for voice input on compatible TVs. Voice capture stops when you leave the voice screen, leave the app, or reach the capture limit.

COMFORTABLE CONTROL
Choose light, dark or system appearance. Adjust haptics and held-key repetition, keep the screen awake, or use theater mode to dim the interface after inactivity. The app supports 20 languages.

No advertisements, account registration, analytics SDK or developer-operated cloud server.

COMPATIBILITY
Requires an Android TV or Google TV device supporting Android TV Remote Service v2 and a reachable shared network. Samsung Tizen, LG webOS and Apple TV are not supported. Keyboard input, voice, app links and wake from standby depend on your TV and installed apps. The touchpad sends directional navigation; it is not a free mouse pointer. Shortcuts are configured locally and do not list every installed TV app.

Try all remote controls free for 24 hours. After the trial, a one-time lifetime purchase is required to continue controlling your TV. No automatic charge or recurring subscription.

name: renerelay
description:
A little lantern. Thirty forgotten chambers. One more clever move.

Explore moss-covered ruins in a pixel-art adventure where every action advances the world. Push rune stones to block golden beams, time your steps across rising spikes, and watch the next move of wandering ghost guardians.

TWO LANTERN ARTS
Rune Dash leaps two tiles in a chosen direction. Cross dangerous ground, but choose a safe landing and plan around the cooldown.
Lantern Pulse disperses nearby ghosts and briefly suppresses beam emitters. Save it for a risky crossing or an approaching guardian.

THIRTY CHAMBERS TO EXPLORE
Travel through five chapters of six chambers. Find each chamber's key, reach the glowing gate, and take optional detours for three hidden crystals. Earn up to three stars by finishing, retaining at least two hearts, and collecting every crystal.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Ghosts advance every second action, with markers showing their next destination. Wait to adjust the timing, undo an action to restore your position and skills, or restart a chamber whenever you wish.

MADE FOR SHORT ADVENTURES
- Full-screen exploration with a camera that follows your hero
- Original pixel-art characters and animated torchlight
- Rune trails, portal effects, and a gentle atmospheric soundtrack
- Swipe, tap an adjacent tile, or use the on-screen direction controls
- Local progress, best star ratings, and sound preferences
- Offline play with no account, advertising, subscriptions, or in-app purchases

Your progress stays on your device. Sound can be switched off from the pause menu.

name: Replay Save Cam
description:
The best moments happen when you are not recording. Replay Save Cam fixes that.

Keep the camera running. When something funny, cute or amazing happens, tap SAVE. The app keeps the last few seconds before your tap, plus a few seconds after, and puts the clip in your Photos app. Everything you did not save is deleted, so your storage stays free.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open the app and it starts recording
• Pick how much to keep: 10s, 20s, 30s, 60s or 120s. You can pick it even after the moment happened
• Tap SAVE. Your clip goes straight to Photos
• Keep going. Recording never stops while it saves

FEATURES
• Records in up to 4K, with sound
• Take photos while the video keeps recording
• Front and back camera
• Choose 0, 3, 5 or 10 seconds to keep after you tap SAVE
• Only the last 2 minutes are kept while recording, and unsaved video is deleted when you stop or leave the app
• Switches to 1080p if your iPhone gets hot

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Nothing is uploaded. Everything stays on your iPhone

Great for kids, pets, sports, family moments, street events and anything you don't want to miss.

name: RepStreak: Home Workout Log
description:
RepStreak is the quickest way to log bodyweight reps at home and keep a daily streak going. Set a goal for each exercise, tap to log a set, and watch the streak grow.

FREE
• One-tap rep logging. Big buttons for 1, 5, 10 and 25 reps, or type a custom amount.
• Daily goals for each exercise, such as push-ups, squats, sit-ups, lunges, pull-ups and dips, or add your own.
• Streaks. Clear your goals to keep the streak alive. Missed a day? Log a make-up day from the week strip or the calendar. Streaks run on the honor system.
• A daily routine with your exercise list, plus quick log.
• The Starter Circuit, a free guided workout with timed moves and how-to visuals for each exercise.
• Stats for the last 4 weeks: total reps, active days, best day and average per day, plus a calendar.
• Join official rep challenges and see how you rank, or join a friend's challenge with an invite code. Challenges marked premium need Pro.
• An optional daily reminder at the time you choose.

REPSTREAK PRO
• Every guided workout, at every level
• Unlimited routines plus curated ones
• Edit your rep buttons for every exercise
• Rest days and a different goal each weekday
• Week, month, year and lifetime stats
• Premium challenges, and host your own, public or with a code
• Export every rep as CSV

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
RepStreak Pro is an auto-renewable subscription: $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year (US prices; prices in other countries may vary). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings (Settings > your name > Subscriptions). Pro stays on until the end of the period you paid for. Already subscribed? Tap Restore purchases in Profile.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Your log syncs to your RepStreak account, so you can also use it on the web at repstreakapp.com. No ads and no tracking. You can delete your account and its data in the app at any time (Profile > Delete account).

RepStreak is a fitness logging app, not medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting a new exercise program.

Terms of Use: https://repstreakapp.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://repstreakapp.com/privacy.html
Support: support@repstreakapp.com

name: RerThurvon
description:
A peg board, a violet driver, a lime output wheel. Between them, room for you to work.

RerThurvon is a gear-train puzzle made slowly and kept simple. Each puzzle asks for one thing: make the output turn the right way at the right pace. Teeth that add up to 48 mesh on neighbouring pegs. Every mesh flips the direction. A large wheel driving a small one speeds it up. That is all the rule there is, and fifty puzzles grow out of it.

What is in the box

- 50 puzzles, each with a direction goal and an exact ratio goal, from a gentle two-gear start to long trains with stacked axles
- Five gear sizes: 12, 16, 24, 32 and 36 teeth
- Stacked axles: put one size on the front layer and another on the back, so a single peg changes the pace
- A limited tray per puzzle, plus stones on some pegs, so every placement counts
- Live ratio and direction maths: the readout shows the current output pace as an exact fraction, and each mesh in the train as its own chip
- A speed probe: tap any gear to read its direction and pace
- A hint that sets one correct gear for you, and clears anything in its way

The bench

- A free board with unlimited gears around a fixed driver
- Build anything, read any gear's speed, then keep the machine with a name of your choosing

The gallery

- Every solved puzzle is kept as an instant print that develops in front of you
- The machines inside keep turning, at their true speeds
- Open any print to see its axles, meshes and full gear train

Small things done carefully

- Rice-paper textures, ink accents and slow motion throughout
- A soft bell when a gear joins the train and a harp sweep when a puzzle is solved, both switchable
- Ink and Paper looks, or follow the device
- Works fully offline. An anonymous backup runs quietly in the background when a connection is there, and can be restored from Settings

No accounts. No ads. No purchases. Just gears, and the quiet satisfaction of a wheel turning exactly as it should.

name: Restful: Snore Nudge
description:
Restful listens while you sleep and notices when you start snoring. With Restful Premium, it gives you a gentle tap on your Apple Watch – and, if you keep snoring, a silent vibrating alarm – so you shift position and the snoring stops.

TRACK EVERY NIGHT
• See when you snored, how loud, and for how long
• Sleep stages from Apple Health, with snoring shown on top
• A sleep diary of your nights, with notes like "late dinner" to compare what helps

GET NUDGED (PREMIUM)
• Watch taps when you snore, stopping as soon as you go quiet
• A vibrating alarm on iPhone and Watch if taps are not enough
• Choose when taps turn into an alarm and when nudging stops

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
• Two simple dials decide what counts as snoring
• Everything stays on your iPhone – no account, no uploads, no ads
• Three designs, including a dark one for the bedroom

RESTFUL PREMIUM
7 days free, then US$2.99 a month or US$24.99 a year. Premium unlocks Watch taps, the alarm, your full sleep history and trends. Tracking and the last 7 days of your diary stay free. Payment is charged to your Apple account when the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple account settings.

Requires iOS 26. Apple Watch needed for Watch taps; the alarm works with iPhone alone. Keep your iPhone charging near the bed.

Restful is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you snore loudly or often, or feel tired during the day, talk to a doctor.

Terms of use: https://sites.google.com/view/mosslab-apps/restful-terms
Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/mosslab-apps/restful-privacy

name: Resvori Partner
description:
Resvori Partner ist die App für Gastronomen auf Resvori. Hier verwaltest du Tischreservierungen, beantwortest Anfragen für Feiern und pflegst dein Lokal – direkt vom Handy.

RESERVIERUNGEN
• Neue Reservierungen sofort sehen und per Push benachrichtigt werden
• Reservierungen bestätigen, ändern oder absagen
• Tagesübersicht mit Gästen und Auslastung

EVENTS & FEIERN
• Anfragen für Geburtstage, Hochzeiten und Firmenfeiern erhalten
• Persönliche Angebote schreiben und mit Gästen chatten
• Optional Anzahlungen online über dein eigenes Stripe-Konto annehmen

DEIN LOKAL
• Profil mit Fotos, Speisekarte und Öffnungszeiten pflegen
• Verfügbare Zeiten und gesperrte Tage festlegen
• Bewertungen von verifizierten Gästen ansehen

VERIFIZIERT UND SICHER
Jedes Lokal wird vor der Freischaltung geprüft – so sehen Gäste nur echte Lokale, und niemand kann dein Lokal fremd eintragen.

KOSTEN
Eintrag, Reservierungen und Event-Anfragen sind kostenlos, ohne Grundgebühr und ohne Vertragslaufzeit. Nur bei online bezahlten Anzahlungen fallen 5 % Provision an.

Für Gäste gibt es die App „Resvori“.

Fragen oder Feedback? Schreib uns an info@resvori.com.

name: Retenzo
description:
Retenzo is a customer loyalty and rewards platform that helps merchants and small businesses reward repeat visits and keep customers coming back — without new POS hardware or complicated setup.

FOR MERCHANTS
Start a loyalty program using your existing payment QR code. No POS upgrades. No loyalty hardware. No complex integrations.

Create customizable rewards such as:
• Reward points
• Discounts
• Free products or services
• Custom merchant rewards

Track customer engagement, rewards issued, and redemptions in one simple dashboard. After a visit, encourage customers to leave a Google review and follow you on Instagram, Facebook, or WhatsApp — so loyalty also grows your online presence.

FOR CUSTOMERS
See rewards from participating merchants in one place. Track points, progress, and available redemptions without juggling separate loyalty cards or apps.

Earn points, discounts, free items, and other merchant-defined benefits based on eligible purchases and repeat visits.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Connect — create your Retenzo business account and set your loyalty rules
2. Keep your QR — continue using the payment QR you already have
3. Retain — reward customers and turn payments into repeat business

ABOUT REWARDS
Loyalty rewards on Retenzo are promotional benefits from participating merchants. They cannot be converted to cash, exchanged for digital money, or transferred between users. Rewards can only be redeemed with the merchant that issued them, subject to that merchant’s program rules.

Customers can pay with their preferred method, including UPI apps or cash, and still earn applicable loyalty benefits.

Retenzo is a loyalty and rewards platform. It is not a payment service.

Retenzo — simple loyalty. Stronger customer relationships.

name: Retro Pomodoro
description:
Retro Pomodoro Timer turns your phone into a simple focus gadget. A green LCD screen shows the countdown. Two big keys start, pause and reset it. Each press gives a haptic tap and a satisfying click, like a real device on your desk.

No lists, no charts, no clutter. Just start the timer and get to work.

HOW IT WORKS
The Pomodoro Technique splits your work into short, focused sessions with breaks in between:
• Focus for one pomodoro.
• Take a short break.
• Repeat, and after a few pomodoros take a long break.
The screen always shows where you are, for example SESSION 1/8, SHORT BREAK or LONG BREAK.

A TIMER YOU CAN FEEL
• Retro LCD display with large, easy-to-read digits
• Chunky physical-style keys: Start, Pause, Resume and Reset
• Haptic feedback and a click sound on every press
• Adjustable sound volume, or turn the sound off

YOUR TIMER, YOUR RULES
• Set your own pomodoro, short break and long break lengths
• Set a session goal (how many pomodoros to do)
• Choose how many pomodoros come before a long break
• Auto-start breaks and auto-start pomodoros, so you never lose your flow
• Keep the screen awake while the timer runs
• Restore the default settings at any time

KEEPS RUNNING IN THE BACKGROUND
• The timer keeps counting when you leave the app or lock your phone
• A notification tells you when a focus session or break ends
• Your timer is saved, so it picks up where it left off even if the app is closed

LOOKS GOOD DAY AND NIGHT
• Light, Dark and Black themes, or follow your system setting
• Black theme for OLED screens and late-night sessions

GREAT FOR
• Studying and exam prep
• Deep work and coding
• Writing, reading and creative work
• Chores, workouts and anything you want to do in focused bursts

No sign-up and no account. Open the app, press Start and focus.

name: Revealy
description:
Turn a message into a moment. With Revealy you hide something behind a little game, send it as a link, and your friend plays to open it.

HIDE ANYTHING
• A personal message in handwriting
• A photo, or a set of up to 5 photos
• A video or a selfie
• Music, from the tune library or your own voice
• A gift card code or a website link
• A gender reveal: boy or girl, kept secret until the very end

LET THEM PLAY TO OPEN IT
• Scratch card in silver, gold or rose foil
• Slide puzzle
• Quiz with questions about you
• Pop the balloons

PERFECT FOR
Birthdays, Sinterklaas and Christmas, gender reveals, anniversaries, thank-yous, good news, or just because.

EASY TO SEND
Make a surprise in a minute and share the link in WhatsApp or any chat. The receiver needs no app: it opens in any browser. See in My surprises when it's been opened, and get a notification the moment it is.

FREE AND PLUS
Scratch cards, the slide puzzle, messages, links, gift cards and one photo are free. Revealy Plus unlocks the quiz and balloons, video, selfies, music, photo sets, your own photo as a puzzle and the gender reveal.

Revealy Plus is an auto-renewing subscription: €2.99 per month or €19.99 per year (prices may differ by country). Payment is charged to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it any time in your iPhone Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

Terms of use: https://revealy.app/terms.html
Privacy: https://revealy.app/privacy.html

name: ReviewReady
description:
ReviewReady is a simple checklist for people who are about to submit an app for review.

Add your app, then go through the list section by section: account and login, payments, privacy, store listing and more. Each item is one concrete thing reviewers commonly look at, written in plain English, with the guideline number next to it when there is one.

What you can do:
• Keep a separate checklist for each of your apps
• Tick items off and see your progress at a glance
• Look up common rejection guideline numbers, such as 2.1, 3.1.1, 4.2 or 5.1.1, and read what they usually mean, the usual cause and the usual fix
• Sign in on any device and find your progress where you left it

What it is not:
ReviewReady does not review your app and cannot guarantee approval. It is a list that helps you avoid the most common, avoidable mistakes.

Privacy:
No tracking, no analytics, no ads. We store your email, your app names and your ticked items, nothing else. You can delete your account and all its data inside the app at any time.

name: Rexin Golf
description:
Rexin Golf is a casual 3D mini golf game set on beautiful floating islands.
Navigate uniquely designed golf courses with natural obstacles, winding greens and scenic low-poly environments. Test your putting skills across creative holes, aim for pars and chase birdies at your own pace.

Enjoy smooth, simple controls built for mobile. There is no pressure, no timers and no competitive matches. Play offline anytime you want.

Features

- Relaxing single-player mini golf experience
- Handcrafted island courses with varied layouts
- Clean 3D low-poly art style
- Simple and intuitive touch controls
