- Full offline support, no internet required
- Multiple holes to master

Take your time, line up your shot and sink the perfect putt in Rexin Golf.

name: RH Sons Field
description:
RH Sons Field gives your team one mobile workspace for daily field operations.

Manage customer visits, stores, orders, inventory, invoices, account statements, and business reports from your iPhone or iPad. Keep work moving with a clear view of assigned tasks, customer information, and field activity.

Key features:
- Plan and record customer visits
- Create and manage sales orders
- Review stores, products, inventory, and pricing
- Access invoices, accounts, and statements
- Capture visit photos and merchandising evidence
- Share location during active field sessions when permitted
- Review reports and operational updates
- Work with synced information when connectivity is limited
RH Sons Field is designed for authorized RH Sons team members and business partners. A valid workspace account is required.

name: Richert Homes
description:
The Richert Homes app keeps everything about your new home in one place, from the day you reserve to the day you pick up your keys.

Buying a new build comes with a lot of paperwork and a fair bit of waiting. The app keeps you in the picture throughout:

• Your documents: your reservation form, floorplans and the other paperwork for your purchase, stored securely and there whenever you need them.
• Your purchase: regular updates as your purchase moves forward, so you always know where things stand.
• Your build: follow your home's progress milestone by milestone as it takes shape on site.

Richert Homes is a family-run Yorkshire housebuilder. We build quality family homes across Yorkshire, and we like to keep our buyers informed at every step. This app is how we do it.

The app is for Richert Homes purchasers. Once you have reserved your home, we will send you your login details. If you need any help, email info@richerthomes.co.uk.

name: Ricocut: Slice Puzzle
seller_name: CHEF GAME STUDIO YAZILIM TEKNOLOJILERI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Aim. Bounce. Slice it all down.

Ricocut is a juicy physics puzzle where every throw is a trick shot. Aim from the bottom of the screen, send your blade bouncing off the wooden walls and slice through the pile of fruit. The pieces tumble down the funnel, the pile shifts, and your next shot opens up.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag to aim. The guide line shows the full path of your throw, every bounce included.
• Release to throw. Your blade ricochets off wood and flies straight through the nets.
• Every fruit in the path is sliced in two. Small pieces slip through the funnel and drop out.
• Clear all the fruit before you run out of throws.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One throw, many cuts: line up the right ricochet and slice a whole row at once.
• Real physics: the pile rolls, slides and settles differently every time.
• Clever levels: shelves, pegs, nets and narrow gaps turn every stage into a new puzzle.
• Juice Rush: sliced fruit fills the juice bar. When it is full, tap RUSH and hold to spray a stream of free throws.
• Surprise gift boxes burst into a shower of extra blades.
• Satisfying to watch: clean cuts, juicy splashes and fruit you can see inside.
• No timers, no pressure. Take your time and plan the shot.
• Out of throws? Grab a few more and finish the level right where you are.
• Play anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed.

A fresh brain teaser for fans of fruit slicing games, trick shot games, brick breakers and physics puzzles. Perfect for a few relaxing minutes over coffee, on the commute or before bed.

Pick your angle, let it fly and slice it all down!

name: Ridgeflow: Hike, Camp, Explore
description:
Pick a ridge, a valley or the long way round, and see what the day holds before you lace up. Ridgeflow helps you plan and record walks and hikes on real topographic maps, anywhere in the world.

Tap a start and an end on the contour map and the route follows the trail. You'll see distance, climb and time at your pace, whether you're walking or running. Switch to 3D terrain or satellite views to look at the land ahead.

Heading into the mountains? Download offline maps for mountain regions, and contours, terrain and labels work with no signal.

When you set off, tap Rec and put your phone in your pocket. Ridgeflow keeps the track with the screen off. When you stop, you get your distance, time and climb, saved to your trips.

Along the way, check the weather and the rain radar, spot huts and campsites on your route, and read notes from other walkers. When you've found a good one, share a route in one tap.

Try every feature for 7 days. After that, choose monthly or yearly, at the price the App Store shows in your currency. Plans renew automatically until cancelled. You can cancel any time in the App Store.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Ridgeflow terms: https://ridgeflow.camp/terms
Privacy: https://ridgeflow.camp/privacy

Questions: support@ridgeflow.camp

name: Ring Box: Unfold Your Proposal
description:
Turn your foldable into a velvet ring box.

Close it and the cover becomes the lid of a jewellery box, with gold lettering on the velvet. Open it and a diamond ring waits on plush velvet, catching the light as you move. It is made for the moment you ask, or for any time you want to make someone smile.

FREE
• The full ring box: ruby velvet, a yellow gold ring with a round diamond and "Forever" in gold on the lid
• Diamonds of 0.5, 1 and 1.5 carats
• Pinch the ring to lift it out in a puff of gold, then put it back from Settings

FULL COLLECTION (optional one-time in-app purchase)
• Your own words on the lid: a name, a date, or "Marry Me?" (up to 20 characters)
• Three more velvets: midnight navy, emerald and onyx black
• White gold and platinum
• Five more diamond cuts: oval, princess, cushion, emerald and pear
• 2 and 3 carat diamonds
One purchase, yours for good. No subscription and no ads. Restore it any time from Settings.

MADE FOR THE FOLD
• Closed, the cover shows the lid with gold lettering
• Open it and the ring box is waiting inside, held perfectly still
• The diamond is rendered live on your phone and glints as you tilt it

QUIET AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads and nothing to sign up for
• Everything you write stays on your phone

Ring Box is a playful keepsake and a way to set the scene. It is not a real ring, so you may still want one of those.

Works best on iPhone Duo. On other iPhones with iOS 27 the box is shown already open, without the box-opening effect.

name: Ring Untangle
description:
The rings are locked together. Which one can you free first?

Drag a ring to turn it. When its gap lines up with the joint, it comes free. Look for the connections, work out the right order, and untangle the whole board before the clock runs out.

• Solve 100 puzzles. Start with two rings and work up to larger, more intricate arrangements. Each attempt includes one free hint.
• Play three rotating weekly events. Catch falling rings, aim and toss rings onto pegs, or untangle a path to the cat’s dinner.
• Make the cat’s room your own. Collect fish as you play and trade them for furniture, treats, and accessories.

name: Ripple Verse
description:
Pull back a stone and let it fly. Watch the ring tighten where it’s about to land. Tap just as the ring closes to send the stone skipping again. In Melody, where you land determines the note. A well-timed tap gives the stone enough speed to reach the next one.

Listen to a short tune, then play it across five lanes on the lake. Did the last note sound too high? Aim one lane farther left on your next cast. You can also write three notes on the home lake and see how close you come to your own tune.

Trace seven constellation charts, starting with a straight shot and learning to put spin on the stone. On Crescent Fork, the center route takes you to the finish. Three perfect skips let you steer across mirror water, catch the outer star, and curve back. Daily Tide gives you a fresh chart each day. Wind shifts the landing spot and rain shortens the tap window. The conditions stay the same on every try that day, so you can work on your best streak.

Keep a favorite cast in your postcard album. Share a five-second clip of the ripples and the curve you actually traced, with your own notes on a Melody card. Or send the tune as a playable challenge. A friend can open it in Ripple Verse, listen to your performance, try to match its pitch and rhythm, and play the two versions back.

On devices that support AR, place a virtual water tray on a flat table, look down, and take your shot.

name: Rise Card
description:
Rise Card keeps a private card for the aneroid barometer in the house. Name the place, seat the index screw, and trace the red hand to the reading on the glass. Hold the brass set hand until it meets the red hand, and that mark stays on this iPhone.

The first mark has nothing earlier to compare. The next mark says whether the corrected reading is rising, falling, or steady, and by how many hectopascals. The card shows the latest mark. The column lists every mark, and you can open one.

The result stays on the phone. There is no account, no weather forecast, and no file to send. Removing the app removes the card.

name: Risevo: Move Breaks
description:
Sitting for hours at your desk? Risevo turns long workdays into a gentle rhythm of focus and short walks, with a puppy named Tobi keeping you company.

HOW IT WORKS
- Focus for 25 minutes while Tobi naps on his cushion.
- When the break is due, Tobi sits up: time for a 5-minute walk.
- Every 4 sessions you get a longer break.
- Set a daily goal and watch today's walks add up.

Reminders arrive as local notifications. If you stay in your chair, Risevo checks in again softly at 2, 5 and 10 minutes, and tells you when the break is over. It works offline.

During a break, Risevo can count steps on your phone (with motion permission) to notice that you got up. Rather not? Just tap "I moved".

MEET TOBI
Tobi lives on your home screen, and every phase has its own pose and line. He sleeps while you focus and sits up when it is time to walk. If you keep sitting, he waits by the door, brings his leash or sighs softly. No alarms, no guilt. On the walk he trots along, and when your day is complete he proudly shows off his medal.

FREE, ALWAYS
- Tobi and the default 25/5 rhythm
- Break reminders and gentle follow-ups
- Step check
- Today's progress: walks done vs. goal, plus your streak

RISEVO PRO
- Your own rhythm: focus length, walk length, long breaks, daily goal and auto-start of the next focus block
- Week view: 7 days of walks, current and best streak, active minutes
- Meeting mute: silence Tobi for 60 minutes during a call while the timer keeps running

Risevo Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, offered as a yearly plan (with a free trial when the store offers one) or a monthly plan. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your store account settings.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. All your data stays on your device.

LANGUAGES
English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil), Polish and Turkish.

Risevo is not a medical device. It is a friendly nudge to break up long sitting and build a habit of standing up.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://nodvera.io/legal/risevo/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://nodvera.io/legal/risevo/privacy/

name: RitmoDock
description:
Turn a repeatable task into a timed routine. Create steps with individual durations in seconds, then follow a clear sequential countdown. Pause, resume, skip to the next step or finish a session early.

Active sessions are saved locally. The countdown uses elapsed time when you leave and return to the app. Review completed and ended sessions in the history. No background alarm or notification is sent.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: River Cree Casino Horse Club
description:
Get to know the horses, prepare for your next ride and keep the moments you want to remember. River Cree Casino Horse Club brings horse profiles, riding articles and personal planning tools together in one place.
 Explore 12 horse profiles with photos, ages, temperaments and riding levels. Learn about each horse’s character, from calm companions for beginners to responsive partners for experienced riders.
 Answer six questions about your experience, confidence and riding preferences. See two suggested horses with explanations of why they may suit you. Your instructor can help you make the final choice.
 Read eight articles covering your first ride, approaching a horse, balance, riding cues, rein handling, trail riding and more. Check your understanding with a true-or-false question and an explanation after each article.
 Choose a horse, date and time, then keep your ride plans organized on your device. Plans saved in the app are personal records and do not reserve a ride with the club. Contact the club separately to confirm availability and arrange your visit.
 Keep track of your riding essentials with a ready-made checklist. Add, edit and remove your own items, and mark them off as you prepare.
 Create a personal photo journal with images from your library, dates, captions and notes. Revisit your entries and update them whenever you like.
 No account is required. Your ride plans, quiz answers, checklist and journal entries are saved locally on your device.

name: RNKD: Party Ranking Game
description:
RNKD is a party game for the people in the room. One phone hosts, everyone else joins from their own iPhone or iPad nearby, and the arguing starts.

Rank snacks before you know what's coming next. Sort movies into tiers. Guess how much things cost, vote on who in the room would do what, draft the best (or worst) possible day, and find out who secretly thinks like you.

16 GAME MODES
Blind Rank, Tier Board, Draft, Budget Draft, Bracket, Ballpark, Guess the Number, Keep or Pass, Pick a Side, One Has To Go, Room Vote, Crowd Pick, Spot the Phony, Dial It In, Rank It Out and In Order. Every mode has a quick tutorial, so new players can jump straight in.

2–12 PLAYERS, NO SIGN-UP
Players join with a room code over your local network. There are no logins and no RNKD servers. Profiles, scores, badges and match history stay on your device.

FREE STARTER PACK
More than 700 cards that work in every mode. Add premium packs for food, films, music, animals, science, history, sports with invented players, holidays, work life and more.

ONLY THE HOST NEEDS TO BUY
Guests can play any pack the host owns while they're in that room.

Designed for ages 16+. Contains ads; Remove Ads is a one-time purchase.

name: Roadshow – Studio Vocals
description:
Roadshow turns your iPhone into a vocal booth.

Record a take anywhere: your bedroom, the van, the stairwell. Roadshow rebuilds it as if you'd sung into a studio condenser in a treated room, right on your phone. Nothing is uploaded, and it works in airplane mode.

RECORD FREE
• A clean, simple recorder tuned for vocals, using the iPhone's front cardioid mic
• Takes are named after a line you sang
• Play back and share the raw take as a WAV

WITH A ROADSHOW ACCOUNT
• Restore: room, noise and phone colour cleaned up without touching your performance
• Studio mic models: pick the tone you want, from close and intimate to big and open
• Compare phone and restored versions instantly
• Export the restored take for your DAW

Roadshow never sings for you. It doesn't tune, clone or generate notes. Every note out is a note you performed.

Roadshow accounts are shared with RS-1, the Roadshow plugin for Mac (AU, VST3, Standalone). Sign in with your email and a one-time code. No passwords.

name: Rocky Point: Puerto Peñasco
description:
Heading to Puerto Peñasco? RockyPoint.app puts the things you check before and during a Rocky Point trip on one screen: the line at the Lukeville crossing, the weather, the tides and the peso.

BORDER WAIT TIMES
• Current wait at the Lukeville / Sonoyta crossing, both into Mexico and back to the US
• Port hours and a live traffic map of the approach
• Typical wait by hour, so you can pick when to leave
• Just crossed? Report your wait and help the next traveler

BEACH & TIDES
• Today's tide chart, with the lowest daylight tides of the week for tidepooling
• Water temperature, sunrise, sunset, UV index and moon phase

TODAY
• Weather and 7-day forecast for Rocky Point
• The peso exchange rate
• Heads-up alerts about road work and other news that affects your drive
• A home-screen widget with the current border wait

LOCAL POLLS
• Vote on the best fish tacos, breakfast spots, places to stay and more
• See how the community voted, and suggest places that were missed
• Earn points for helping out and see the top contributors

No account is needed to check the border, the weather or the tides. Create a free profile with Sign in with Apple or a passkey to vote and report. Approximate location is used only when you send a report, to keep remote or fake reports out of a status other travelers rely on.

RockyPoint.app is an independent local guide and is not affiliated with U.S. Customs and Border Protection or the government of Mexico. Wait times are estimates.

name: Rollcount: Camera Roll Stats
description:
How many photos and videos did you take this year, and when?
Rollcount counts what is already in your camera roll and turns your year, or a single month, into cards made to be shared.
Everything is worked out on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.

YOUR YEAR AT A GLANCE
One card with the whole year: how many shots, your busiest day, the place you photographed most away from home, your longest streak and your golden hour, with a bar for every month.

THE CARDS
Your total and how many a day. The day you took the most. The screenshots you kept. Your busiest month and the hour you shoot most. Your longest streak and your longest quiet stretch. Selfies, minutes of video, the cities and countries in your photos, and the whole year as a grid with one dot per day. A card only appears when its number is worth showing, so a quiet year gets fewer cards instead of sad ones.

MADE TO SHARE
Each card is a 9:16 image, sized for stories. Share one, or the whole recap as a short video.

YEARS AND MONTHS
Switch between this year, this month, last month and last year. A monthly reminder on the first of the month is there if you want it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Rollcount reads the date, type, favorite mark and place of each photo, never the pictures themselves. City names come from a list stored inside the app; no address lookup, no server, no account, no ads, no analytics. If you allow access to selected photos only, Rollcount counts those and says the numbers are partial.

FREE
Every card and the video, for every period. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.

The app is in English and Turkish.

Terms of Use: https://barisuzun.com/rollcount/terms
Privacy Policy: https://barisuzun.com/rollcount/privacy

name: Rollsy: Photo Storage Cleaner
description:
Your camera roll, cleaned up one swipe at a time.

Rollsy turns a messy photo library into something you can finish. Swipe right to keep, left to delete, and up to decide later. Nothing is deleted until you review your trash.

SWIPE THROUGH YOUR LIBRARY
• Clean month by month and watch your progress fill up
• Jump into Recents, Random, Videos or any album
• Relive On This Day while you tidy
• Undo any swipe, as many times as you need

NOTHING DELETED BY ACCIDENT
• Swiped photos wait in your trash for a final check
• Favorites are skipped by default
• iOS keeps deleted photos for about 30 days

SMART CLEANUP (PREMIUM)
• Find similar shots and keep the best one
• Spot blurry photos
• Clear old screenshots
• Sort videos by size to free space fast

STAY ON TRACK
• See the storage you have freed
• Build a daily streak and earn achievements
• Optional daily reminder
• Home Screen widgets (Premium)

YOUR PHOTOS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
No account needed. Photos are reviewed on your device and are never uploaded.

AVAILABLE IN 13 LANGUAGES
English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Arabic.

Free to use with ads and 100 swipes a day, with more swipes by watching a short ad. Rollsy Premium removes ads and limits, and unlocks Smart Cleanup and widgets.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://rollsy.bylancer.com/privacy/

name: Rompehielo · Eventos
description:
Rompehielo es la herramienta para organizar noches para conocer gente, sin silencios incómodos.

Para bares y cafés, grupos de idiomas, clubes, iglesias, coworkings y cualquiera que organice noches de solteros, de amigos o de networking. Tú pones el lugar; Rompehielo arma las mesas, guía los juegos y lleva el reloj de las rondas.

ANTES DEL EVENTO
• Tu página del evento con cupo, rango de edad y, si quieres, equilibrio entre mujeres y hombres.
• La gente se apunta en un minuto y elige sus intereses. Si se llena, hay lista de espera.
• El día antes mandas a cada uno su enlace por WhatsApp para confirmar. Si alguien cancela, entra solo el primero de la lista de espera.
• Las entradas las cobras tú, con tu propio medio de pago: Rompehielo no cobra a los asistentes.

LA NOCHE EN VIVO
• Proyecta la pantalla grande y marca quién llegó.
• Mesas automáticas por edad parecida e intereses en común. Las cambias a mano arrastrando.
• Preguntas para la mesa, «¿quién es más probable que…?», bingo humano y trivia por mesas.
• Rondas cara a cara con reloj, sin repetir pareja.
• Los asistentes entran desde el navegador del móvil con su enlace o con el PIN, también quien llega sin apuntarse.

AL FINAL
• Cada asistente marca a quién quiere volver a ver. Solo si los dos dicen que sí, se pasan el Instagram o el WhatsApp.
• Los asistentes valoran la noche y pueden reportar a alguien; el reporte solo lo ve el organizador.

CON INTELIGENCIA ARTIFICIAL
• Preguntas a la medida de cada mesa.
• Sugerencias de cambios de mesa.
• Textos para promocionar el evento y un resumen de cómo salió la noche.
• La IA nunca recibe nombres ni contactos.

NO ES UNA APP DE CITAS
No hay perfiles para buscar gente, ni fotos de perfil, ni chat. Todo pasa en persona, en eventos que organiza alguien de carne y hueso. Sirve igual para hacer amigos, practicar idiomas o hacer contactos de trabajo: eliges el tipo de evento y cambian las preguntas y las rondas.

EN LA APP
• Tus eventos, la sala en vivo y tu cuenta, siempre a mano.
• Entra a la sala con el PIN o escaneando con la cámara el QR de la pantalla grande o de una invitación.
• En tu móvil ves tu mesa, tu ronda y el reloj que marca el tiempo.

GRATIS PARA EMPEZAR
1 evento abierto a la vez, hasta 20 personas por evento, inscripciones, lista de espera y confirmaciones, mesas automáticas, juegos, matches y 2 rondas cronometradas por noche. Con el plan Pro: eventos ilimitados, hasta 200 personas, rondas sin límite, más usos de la IA y Excel de asistentes. Sin anuncios.

Solo para mayores de 18 años.

Privacidad: los asistentes no crean cuenta. Su contacto solo lo ve el organizador y quien también quiera volver a verlos; sus votos no los ve nadie. Sus datos se borran solos 90 días después del evento, y pueden borrarlos antes desde su enlace.

name: RoOdHOME
description:
RoOdHOME zeigt dein Zuhause so, wie es wirklich ist – als 3D-Modell und als Grundriss. Jede Lampe, jeder Rollladen und jede Steckdose sitzt im richtigen Raum. Ein Tipp auf den Raum, und das Licht geht an.

GRUNDRISS IN MINUTEN
• Räume zeichnen, Wände, Türen und Fenster setzen
• Oder mit der Kamera scannen (LiDAR, iPhone Pro / iPad Pro)
• Foto-3D-Scan: Räume mit echten Farben und Texturen begehbar
• Mehrere Etagen und mehrere Zuhause

ALLE GERÄTE AN IHREM PLATZ
• Apple Home und Matter: Licht, Rollläden, Thermostate, Steckdosen, Sensoren
• Shelly direkt im WLAN – beliebig viele: Schalter, Dimmer, Rollläden, Stromzähler
• Bambu-Lab-3D-Drucker im WLAN: Fortschritt, Restzeit, Temperaturen
• Eingeschaltete Lampen leuchten im Modell

SCHALTEN OHNE SUCHEN
• Raum antippen: Licht an oder aus
• Lange drücken: alle Geräte des Raums
• „Alles aus“ mit einem Tipp
• Widgets für den Home-Bildschirm – Licht schalten, ohne die App zu öffnen

PRIVAT
• Kein Konto, keine Cloud, kein Tracking
• Deine Daten bleiben auf deinem Gerät

Für iPhone und iPad. Wünsche für neue Funktionen? In der App unter „Wunsch äußern“.

name: Rosary Daily: Catholic Prayer
description:
Rosary Daily helps you pray every day, quietly and simply.

PRAY THE ROSARY, BEAD BY BEAD
• The Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful and Glorious Mysteries, chosen for you by the day of the week
• Tap once for each bead — you always know where you are
• A short meditation, fruit and Scripture reference for every mystery
• Read-aloud, so you can pray along by listening
• The Divine Mercy Chaplet, too

TRADITIONAL PRAYERS
• Our Father, Hail Mary, Glory Be, Apostles' Creed, Hail Holy Queen, the Angelus, Act of Contrition, St. Michael, Guardian Angel and more
• Switch between English, Spanish, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese at any time

SAINTS & FEASTS
• A saint or feast for each day, with a short introduction
• The liturgical season and movable feasts — Advent, Lent, Easter, Pentecost — calculated automatically

NOVENAS
• A Christmas Novena (December 16–24), plus novenas to St. Joseph, the Immaculate Conception, St. Jude, Divine Mercy and the Holy Spirit
• Your progress is saved day by day, with a new intention each day

PRAYER INTENTIONS
• Write down the people and needs you entrust to God, and mark them when prayers are answered

Everything stays on your device. No account, no tracking, no ads.

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
The free version includes the daily Rosary, the Divine Mercy Chaplet, the basic prayers and the saints calendar. Premium unlocks all six novenas, read-aloud, unlimited intentions and the full prayer collection.
• Premium (Monthly): US$4.99 per month
• Premium (Yearly): US$29.99 per year
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gways123.github.io/rosary-privacy.html

name: Rosetta Team
description:
Rosetta Team is the staff app for stores that run on Rosetta Connect. Everything you need for work, in your pocket.

Clock in with a tap. Hold your phone near the clock-in tag at your store to clock in, take a break or clock out. Your hours and estimated pay add up as you go.

Your schedule, always with you. See your upcoming shifts, tell your manager when you can’t make one, and ask for time off.

See your path to the next level. Know your level, what’s left before you move up, and when your next review is.

Learn on the job. Take the training your store assigns, right on your phone.

Stay in the loop. Message your manager and get your store’s news in one place.

Rosetta Team works with an account from your employer. If your store uses Rosetta Connect, sign in with the email you use at work.

name: Rotaq
description:
Stop counting on your fingers to work out your next shift.
Enter your rotation once and Rotaq maps out years of shifts: when you work, when you’re off, and when you and the people you love are off together.

Built for everyone on shift work: nurses, security, emergency teams, factories, aviation, civil defense, and any job that runs on rotations.

◆ Any cycle you work
12-hour days and nights, 24/48, four on four off, five and two, or your own pattern of any length. Gregorian or Hijri calendar, with shift names and colors that match your workplace.

◆ When are you both off?
Add your partner’s or a colleague’s schedule and Rotaq instantly shows your next shared days off.

◆ Share your rota with a QR code
Same department? Your colleague scans the code with the iPhone camera and gets your cycle in seconds, no typing.

◆ Overtime, calculated right
A monthly report of hours and overtime, calculated per Article 107 of the Saudi Labor Law (full hourly wage + 50% of basic), plus night, on-call and travel allowances.

◆ On your Lock Screen
A live timer in the Dynamic Island, Home and Lock Screen widgets, and your shifts in iPhone Calendar, all updating on their own.

◆ A reminder before every shift
At the time you choose, for work shifts only. Log leave or swap a day and everything updates automatically.

◆ Private by design
No account, no sign-up. Your data stays on your device and we collect nothing about you.

— Rotaq Premium —
Free: building your cycle, reminders, sharing your cycle, and comparing with one person.
Premium: leave tracking, the overtime and allowances report, widgets and Lock Screen, the live timer, iPhone Calendar, iCloud sync, unlimited comparisons, PDF export and Siri shortcuts.
Monthly auto-renewing subscription with a one-month free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Please note: the app’s interface is in Arabic.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: ← put your privacy.html link here

name: Rotation Ready
description:
Rotation Ready shows your volleyball lineup in all six rotations, so you and your players know exactly where to stand.

CHOOSE YOUR SYSTEM
Switch between 5-1, 5-2, 6-2 and 4-2. Each system keeps its own lineup. In a 5-2, two setters share one setter spot and you choose the rotations each one covers.

WALK THROUGH THE RALLY
Step through base positions, serve receive or the serve, the attack or switch, and defense. Arrows show who moves where, and the play button animates the whole sequence.

RUN THE MATCH
Turn on Match mode and tap +1 for each point. Rotation Ready keeps score, rotates your team when you win the serve back, shows who's serving, counts your subs against the set limit, and tells you when the libero goes in or out. Undo any point with one tap.

LOOK BACK AT EVERY MATCH
Every point in Match mode is saved with the rotation and the players on the court. See which rotations win and lose points, side-out and serving percentages, each player's plus/minus, and scoring runs for both teams, for one match, one opponent or a whole tournament, with your tournament record and results. Export a spreadsheet or copy a summary to share with your staff.

CATCH OVERLAPS
Drag any player to try your own formation. Rotation Ready checks rotational order the moment you let go and names the players who would be called for overlap.

BUILD YOUR ROSTER
Add jersey numbers (1-99), names, a libero and a seven-player bench. Use Sub to swap a bench player in, and they take over that spot in the rotation.

MAKE IT YOUR TEAM'S
Add your team name, team colors and logo. Choose a wood floor, a classic court, or a court painted in your team colors.

MADE FOR THE GYM
- Works with no internet connection
- Built for iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
- Your lineups stay on your device
- No accounts, ads or tracking

name: Rotorlog
description:
Rotorlog is a flight and battery logbook for drone pilots, hobby and working alike. Log every flight in seconds, watch each pack age cycle by cycle, and run your own preflight checklist before take-off.

LOG EVERY FLIGHT
Record the date and take-off time, the aircraft you flew, the batteries you used, duration, location, purpose (photo, video, practice, inspection or FPV), maximum altitude, wind, notes and an incident flag. Flights are grouped by month with your total hours and this month's airtime right at the top. Open any flight for a clean readout, edit it or delete it.

BATTERIES THAT KNOW THEIR AGE
Add each pack once with its cell count, capacity, purchase date and the cycles it already had. Every logged flight adds a cycle to the packs you picked. A segmented bar of battery cells shows the life left before the retire threshold you set, and Rotorlog warns you when a pack nears or passes it. Mark a pack as charged, and if it sits charged and unflown longer than your storage limit, it gets flagged so you can bring it back to storage level.

YOUR PREFLIGHT CHECKLIST
Start from a sensible list - props secure, firmware, batteries charged, weather checked, airspace checked by you, area clear - then rename, reorder, add or remove checks. Tap through the run on the field; when every check is confirmed, log the flight and the run is saved with it. Rotorlog does not check airspace or rules: you remain the pilot in command.

HANGAR STATS AND FLEET
See total hours, hours this month, average flight length, incidents, six months of airtime, flights per aircraft, your purpose mix and every pack's cycles against its retire point. Keep your fleet with model, weight class (under 250 g, 250 g to 2 kg, over 2 kg) and registration or operator ID.

MADE FOR THE FIELD
Navigate with a four-blade propeller: tap a blade and the rotor spins that page into view. Metric or imperial units, two colour themes, optional sound effects and haptics. Works offline and syncs when you are back in range.

ACCOUNT OR GUEST
Sign in with email and password, or tap Fly as a guest and start logging right away. Guests can save their logbook to an account later. You can delete your account and every entry at any time from Hangar settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your logbook is visible only to you.

name: Roundhouse Dominoes
description:
Bring Mexican Train dominoes to your iPhone, without ads or an account. Roundhouse Dominoes is made for a quiet solo game or a table of friends sharing one phone.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play against bots or use private pass-and-play for 2–8 players. Choose 3, 6 or 13 rounds. All game modes, complete matches and house rules are free.

A TABLE YOU CAN READ
See each train’s open end, Public marker and remaining tile count. Playable dominoes and legal destinations are highlighted. Prefer digits to pips? Turn on number faces for free. The app supports larger text and accessibility labels.

CLEAR RULES, FROM DEAL TO SCORE
Choose an own-train opening or an open table, and set the double-blank penalty to 0, 25 or 50. The game explains blocked moves, guides double covers and keeps the running score. Read the included rules for Roundhouse’s table conventions.

KEEP YOUR HAND PRIVATE
In pass-and-play, the next player reveals their hand after receiving the phone. Hands hide when you leave the app. Your match saves locally so you can return to the same deal, turn and score on your iPhone.

OFFLINE BY DESIGN
Gameplay works without an internet connection. No ads, accounts, coins, subscriptions or developer-operated gameplay servers.

OPTIONAL TABLE PACK
A single optional purchase adds three table finishes and two additional tile palettes. It changes only the appearance of the game—not deals, legal moves or scores. Purchases and restoration require an internet connection.

name: RPG Dice Roller with Friends
description:
No login. No ads, ever. Every important feature is free, forever.

Roll dice with friends in live rooms. Totals add up automatically, your dice are fully custom, every roll is saved to your history, and it is built to be accessible.

NO LOGIN, NO ADS, EVER
- No account, no sign-up, no login. Open it and roll
- No ads. No banners, no pop-ups, no video ads, now or later
- Every important feature is free and stays free: all the dice, live rooms, automatic totals, custom colors, roll history, every accessibility option and every scene
- The only paid extra is an optional cosmetic: a metallic dice finish, available as an in-app purchase. It changes how your dice look and nothing else

ROLL TOGETHER
- Create a room and share the link or the room code: everyone sees every roll land, live
- Each player rolls their own dice, in their own color
- Watch-only links for streams and spectators
- Rooms are private: you only join with the code, and there is no chat

ADDS IT UP FOR YOU
- Totals are counted automatically: choose a counter that shows the total or every die
- Mix different dice in one roll, up to 50 at a time
- D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20, D100 and a coin for heads or tails

YOUR DICE, YOUR WAY
- Pick any dice color, or mix your own
- Roll on a meadow, a casino felt table, a tavern floor, a neon highway, a home office desk, city concrete and more
- Hold the roll button to charge a stronger throw
- Real physics: dice tumble, bounce and land the way real ones do
- Feel every roll with haptic feedback

ACCESSIBLE
- Speak roll results aloud, so you can play without looking at the screen
- Larger result numbers
- Reduce motion: no camera shake or drifting scenery
- Separate volume controls for dice, interface sounds, effects and ambience

HISTORY AND SHARING
- Every roll is saved, with running totals and statistics
- Share a roll as a picture card with your group

WORKS OFFLINE
Solo play needs no connection at all. Live rooms need one.

SUPPORT THE APP
Love it? You can unlock a shiny metallic finish for your dice with an optional one-time in-app purchase, and everyone in your room sees it. It is purely cosmetic: nothing you need is ever locked behind it.

Your settings and roll history stay on your device. Read the privacy policy at https://3d.dev/privacy

name: Run Lines for Actors
description:
Run lines. Learn lines. Self-tape with a teleprompter. Made for actors.

Designed by a jobbing British actor of over 30 years, this is the app he wanted in his own pocket: one place to get off book and get the tape done.

LEARN YOUR LINES
Paste in your sides or import a PDF. The app finds the characters, you pick your part, and you're ready to work.

RUN THE SCENE
The other parts are read aloud, each in a different voice, and the app waits for you. Show your lines in full, cut them down to the first few words, or hide them completely as you get more confident. Tap to peek if you dry.

HANDS-FREE
Switch on hands-free and the app listens for the end of your line, then cues the next one. No tapping, no stopping, just the scene.

SELF-TAPE TELEPROMPTER
Your script scrolls right beside the front camera while it records, so your eyeline stays up. Set the speed and text size, show the full scene or only your lines, and start each take with a three-second countdown. The script never appears in the video, and takes save straight to your Photos.

Works in portrait and landscape. Your scripts stay on your phone.

From one jobbing actor to another: break a leg.

name: Rush Corner
description:
Rush Corner names the next corner of a rush seat. A wider front is filled before the back. A wider back is filled first. Equal rails start at the back-left corner, then front-left, front-right, and back-right.

Hall Chair is wider at the front, so the sentence starts at the front-left corner. After those two corners, it moves to the back-left. Short Hank stops when the coil is shorter than the next wrap. Splice a fresh hank, then continue. Side Full has no room on the short rails, so the sentence crosses the open pair instead of forcing a corner. A tap on the wrong corner does not count.

The chairs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: RutiLyzer
description:
RutiLyzer te dice al instante cuánto te deja cada oferta de viaje, antes de aceptarla.

Activa el escáner, abre tu app de viajes en modo conductor y, cuando llegue una oferta, RutiLyzer te avisa arriba de la pantalla:
• ACEPTA, ANALIZA o RECHAZA, según tus propios números.
• Lo que te queda después de la comisión.
• Cuánto ganas por kilómetro y por hora.
• Tiempo total del viaje, distancia de recogida y calificación del pasajero.
• Avisos de pérdida (por debajo del costo de tu vehículo), recogida lejana o tarifa por debajo de tu mínimo.

Mantén presionado el aviso para ver la tarjeta completa con todos los datos.

TUS NÚMEROS, DESDE RUTEO
Usa tu cuenta de Ruteo. Tus precios por kilómetro, rangos por distancia, meta por hora, comisiones y el costo de tu vehículo se configuran en la app de Ruteo y RutiLyzer los usa automáticamente.

PRIVADO
La pantalla se lee dentro de tu iPhone. RutiLyzer solo toma los datos de la oferta (tarifa, distancias, tiempos y calificación); no guarda imágenes ni graba tu pantalla.

GRATIS
50 análisis gratis cada día.

RutiLyzer es una herramienta independiente para conductores y no está afiliada a ninguna plataforma de transporte.

name: SaddleGauge
description:
SaddleGauge is the companion app for the SaddleGauge back-measuring gauge. Read the marks on the gauge, tap them in, and keep a clear history for each of your horses.

• One page per horse: name, breed, height and year born.
• Quick check capture: one reading per screen on a big number pad. Your draft is saved after every tap, so an interrupted check is never lost.
• Photos and notes: six photo slots per horse, the shots a saddle maker asks for, plus a note on each check.
• See it in 3D: your readings drawn on a 3D model of the gauge.
• Works without signal: checks are saved on your phone and upload when you are back online.
• History over time: see how your horse's back readings change from one check to the next.

Sign in with your Connections account. No hardware connection is needed: you type the readings in. You can delete all your SaddleGauge data from Settings inside the app at any time, and the app then opens the Connections account page where you can remove your sign-in too.

Privacy policy: https://privacy.connections.icu/saddlegauge
Support: https://saddlegauge.connectionspages.com/support

name: SADOVS
description:
SADOVS is a social app for meeting through photos and sharing small moments. Post a photo, leave hearts and comment. Discover shows the posts that received the most hearts. Find your messages and notifications in the app.

Sign in with Apple and complete your profile. Access to the feed requires an auto-renewing monthly SADOVS subscription. The local price appears before purchase. Manage your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy and support: https://sadullahersahin.xyz/sadovs/en/support/
Terms of use: https://sadullahersahin.xyz/sadovs/en/terms/

name: Sage Interval
description:
See your daily recovery score and understand what moved it.

Sage Interval uses available readings from Apple Health to estimate recovery on your iPhone. See how sleep, heart rate variability, resting heart rate, and other available measurements contributed. Expand the score breakdown to see each factor’s weight and whether it raised or lowered your score.

Explore 30 days of trends, or add a small or medium Home Screen widget to see today’s score at a glance. Choose Light, Dark, or System appearance, and use the wider layout on iPhone Duo when unfolded.

Try Demo Mode to explore with sample data. With your permission, Sage Interval reads Apple Health and calculates your score on your device. No account is required.

Sage Interval provides general wellness estimates. Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice.

name: Sajideen: Never Miss Salah
description:
Sajideen helps you pray on time, every time. It tells you when a prayer begins, checks in if you have not marked it, and gives a last call before the time runs out. Mark the prayer once and the reminders stop on both your iPhone and your Apple Watch.

Sajideen is free. There are no ads, no subscriptions and no account to create.

NEVER MISS A SALAH
• A reminder when each prayer begins, gentle check-ins while it is still open, and a last call before it ends.
• "I have prayed" on the notification, in the app or on your wrist stops that prayer's reminders everywhere.
• Optional Prayer alarm: a full-screen alarm, like the Clock app's, if a prayer is about to end and you have not marked it. It is off until you turn it on.
• A live countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
• A two-week prayer log, so you can go back and mark what you prayed.

MADE FOR APPLE WATCH
• The adhan and haptics on your wrist when a prayer begins.
• Today's prayers, the countdown and "Mark as prayed" at a glance.
• Complications for your watch face.
• Tasbih, Rakat, Tawaf and Sa'i counters and the Qibla compass, without taking out your phone.

PRAYER TIMES
• Calculated on your device, so they work without a connection.
• Method: University of Islamic Sciences, Karachi (Fajr 18°, Isha 18°), with Hanafi Asr.
• Pick a city, search for any place, or use your current location.
• The makruh times and the preferred early part of each prayer are shown.
• A prayer calendar for the whole year, which you can share as a PDF.

TOOLS
• Qibla compass with the distance to Makkah, and optional spoken directions.
• Tasbih counter with targets, sets and a daily total.
• Rakat counter for prayer and for Taraweeh.
• Tawaf and Sa'i counters for Umrah and Hajj, with the authentic du'as for each place.
• Ramadan: Sehri and Iftar times for the month, with optional reminders.
• A private map of the places where you have prayed.

A DAILY AYAH AND HADITH
• An ayah of the Qur'an and a hadith each day, in Arabic with an English or Urdu translation.
• Hadith come from Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim only, each with its reference.
• Every text is copied from a published source. The sources and translators are credited in the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in.
• Prayer times and reminders are worked out on your device.
• Your prayer log and your location stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch. They are never sent to us.
• Sajideen collects anonymous usage statistics, such as which screens are opened, to improve the app. You can turn this off in Settings.
• If you choose to leave your email for updates or with feedback, it is used only for that.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Reminders need notifications to be allowed. Sajideen explains each permission before iOS asks.
• iOS decides how notifications are delivered. For reminders that are never held back, allow Time Sensitive notifications and add Sajideen to your Focus modes.
• Sajideen currently uses one calculation method (Karachi, Hanafi Asr). Please check the times against your local mosque.

Sajideen is made by one developer and is offered free of charge, seeking its reward from Allah alone. If it benefits you, remember us in your du'a.

name: Salam Gate
description:
Salam Gate lets you control barriers, garage doors and automatic gates from your phone. Replace the physical remote with one app.

• Slide to open — from the app or the home-screen widget
• Family and guests — give your family access, send guests a one-time or time-limited link
• Sort your gates — the one you need most stays on top
• Residential complexes — the building manager handles residents and invitations
• Security — every opening is logged, access is granted by permission
• Directions — guests reach the address with AzNav
• Notifications — timely updates about your subscription and access

Devices are installed and linked to your account by the Salam Gate team. Contact: info@salamgate.az

Salam Gate — şlaqbaum, qaraj və giriş qapılarını telefonunuzdan açın. Tətbiq Azərbaycan, ingilis və rus dillərindədir.

name: Salesmate: Field Audits
description:
Salesmate: Field Audits is the phone app of the Salesmate Survey app, for companies that run market audits. Field collectors visit shops and other outlets, check in, fill in audits with photos and the location, and send them. Supervisors follow their team and review the audits.

A Salesmate company account is required. Your company makes your account on the Salesmate web app and gives you a sign-in ID, or you sign in with your work e-mail address. There is no sign-up in the app.

WHO USES IT
• Field collectors check in each morning, find outlets, fill in audits and send them.
• Field supervisors see their team's day and review flagged audits.
• Survey managers build the surveys and read the results on the Salesmate web app.

KEY FEATURES
• Check in with a selfie and your location, when your company uses check-ins.
• The outlets of your work areas on the phone, nearest first. Search by name, code, phone, area or landmark, filter by the last audit's band, call the outlet or get directions.
• Add a new outlet in the field, with a check for look-alikes nearby.
• Fill in audits step by step: text, numbers, dates, choices, yes or no, ratings, product grids with one tap per line, photos, a signature, the location, products and competitor products, and repeating sections.
• The location's accuracy and the distance from the outlet are shown as you work, under your company's rules (for example, within 150 m of the outlet), with a small map of where you are and the outlet's pin.
• Review before sending: what is left to answer, and the score when the survey shows it.
• Today's count against your target, and drafts that are kept when you close the app.
• Long lists of answers or surveys have a search above them.
• What your company changes on the web (a survey, your areas, your target, a review of your audit) reaches the phone at once.
• Sent: your audits of the last 90 days with their scores and status. Redo an audit a reviewer returned, with their note.
• Supervisors: the team today (check-ins, audits against targets, accounts ending soon), and flagged audits to approve, return with a note or reject.
• Nova, the assistant: ask about your audits, outlets, scores or team in plain words, typed or spoken (when your company has it switched on).
• Light and dark themes.

WORKS OFFLINE
Shops are often far from a signal. The app keeps the outlets of your areas on the phone, saves audits as you fill them in, and keeps everything you make in a list to send. It sends by itself when the signal returns. Photos are made smaller on the phone so that they send on a weak signal. The first sign-in needs a connection.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY
• Each company's data is kept separate. Collectors see their own work; supervisors see only their team.
• All traffic to the server uses HTTPS, and the sign-in is kept in the phone's secure storage.
• The location is read only while the app is open, never in the background.
• No advertising, no tracking, no analytics.

Salesmate: Field Audits is a business app for companies that use Salesmate. Your records are kept on your company's Salesmate server.

name: Saltdrift
description:
It is 2 a.m., the road is at в€’2 В°C and falling, and you have one gritter truck. Every street in the district has to be salted, and the truck has to be back at the depot before the morning shift. Saltdrift is a turn-based dispatch puzzle about that one night.

You plan the route junction by junction on an isometric map of the district. Each street is a choice:

1. Treat it. Salting a street takes twice as long as driving it and uses salt from the hopper.
2. Drive past it. Deadheading is fast and costs no salt, but the street still has to be treated later.
3. Go back to reload. The hopper holds 8 units of salt and refills only at the depot, which takes time.
4. Watch the thermometer. At в€’2 В°C a block takes one unit of salt; at в€’7 В°C it takes two. In later districts the frost deepens in the middle of the shift, and the rate is whatever it is when you start a street.
5. Mind the priority roads. The road to the hospital and the road to the fire station must be fully treated by a set time, or the shift cannot be finished.

When the route is complete, press Run and watch the truck drive it: the clock ticks, the hopper empties and the salt lands street by street. The shift report then puts your time next to the minimum and shows where the minutes went: empty runs, extra trips to the depot, the longest stretch you drove without salting.

Every one of the 96 shifts has a proven minimum time, computed by an exhaustive search over every position, hopper level and set of treated streets. Matching it gives three stars. Staying within ten percent gives two. Any finished shift gives one.

The districts
Old Town: compact squares to learn the hopper.
Riverside: long embankments where a reload is unavoidable.
Hillcrest: smaller and larger hoppers, and a temperature drop mid-shift.
Harbor: piers, frost and two priority calls in one night.

Tonight's call is a fresh district generated from the date, the same for everyone on that day.

Coins come from finishing a shift for the first time, from hitting its minimum and from tonight's call. They buy two kinds of help: Next street shows the next move of the optimal route from where you are; Salt check marks the street where your hopper would run dry. Coins also buy truck paint and map styles. Shifts are never sold for coins.

Saltdrift Pro is a one-time purchase that opens Hillcrest and Harbor (48 shifts), lets you replay the proven route of any shift, and keeps a journal of every finished run. Old Town, Riverside and tonight's call are free.

Progress stays on your device. There is no account to create.

name: Salva
description:
Salva ayuda a los dueños y responsables de negocios de hostelería —restaurantes, bares, cafeterías y similares— a gestionar mejor su negocio.

Salva te da acceso a agentes de inteligencia artificial, cada uno especializado en un área de la gestión del negocio, como el asesoramiento sobre cuestiones del negocio, la gestión de las reseñas del negocio en internet o la formación semanal del hostelero.

En la aplicación tienes:

• El chat por escrito con Salva y con los demás agentes.
• Tu perfil y el de tu negocio, que Salva y los agentes usan para adaptar lo que hacen.
• Un espacio opcional para guardar los documentos de tu negocio (el DNI, el NIF, un recibo del banco, las escrituras y las licencias), con una foto o desde los archivos del móvil. Solo los ves tú, y Salva no los lee.
• Los agentes de IA, que aparecen como contactos en la lista de chats.
• Avisos de Salva y de los agentes.
• El acceso con un código enviado por correo, y el borrado de la cuenta.

Un agente empieza a funcionar cuando has completado las partes del perfil del negocio que necesita, mediante formularios que explican para qué sirve cada respuesta: un agente nunca pide información que no usa.

Algunos agentes pueden recomendar productos o servicios de terceros. Cuando Salva recibe una comisión por una recomendación, el agente lo dice al hacerla.

La aplicación no vende nada: Salva es un servicio para negocios de hostelería, que se contrata fuera de ella.

name: Same Spot: Move-Out Photos
description:
Photograph your rental the day you move in. Match it the day you move out.

Most deposit disputes come down to "it was already like that." Same Spot gives you photos that settle it: every spot in your home, at move-in and at move-out, from the same angle.

LINE UP THE SAME SHOT
On move-out day, your move-in photo floats over the camera. Use Ghost to see it see-through, or Lines to see just its outlines, and hold to peek at the original. A match meter shows how closely your framing lines up, and turns green at "Same spot."

PHOTOS THAT HOLD UP
• Every photo is stamped with the date, time and, if you allow it, location
• Each file is fingerprinted with SHA-256 the moment it is saved, so later edits can be detected
• Mark each spot Good, Worn or Damaged and add a note

ROOM-BY-ROOM CHECKLISTS
Kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, living room, entry, laundry, patio and garage, each with the spots worth photographing: walls, floors, blinds, counters, appliances, fixtures and more. Add your own spots and rooms any time.

REPORTS YOU CAN SEND
• Move-in condition report with every photo, its timestamp and fingerprint, and signature lines
• Before & after report with each spot side by side

GET YOUR DEPOSIT BACK
• See your state's deadline for returning the deposit or sending an itemized list, with a countdown
• Add each deduction from your landlord's statement and link it to the photos of that spot
• Check whether a charge is normal wear and tear or damage with the built-in guide
• Export a polite, firm demand letter with your before-and-after photos attached as exhibits. Edit every word before you send it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your rental, photos and letters stay on your device and leave only when you share them.

Same Spot provides general information, not legal advice. Deposit laws vary and change. Check your state's current law or a local tenant resource.

name: SameChat: Translate & Chat
description:
Same chat. Different languages.

SameChat is a messenger that translates for you. Write in your language; each person in the chat reads your message in theirs. They reply in their language; you read it in yours. No copying into a translator, no switching apps.

MADE FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS
• Every message is translated for each reader, in 1:1 chats and groups
• Understands slang, short forms and mixed languages, and keeps the tone of a casual chat
• "How you talk": tell it the chat is a couple, friends, family or work, and the wording fits
• Tap "See original" to see exactly what was typed

FIX IT ONCE, IT STAYS FIXED
• If a translation is wrong, hold the message and tap "Wrong translation": it is corrected for everyone, and your chat remembers the word next time

AI IN EVERY CHAT
• Ask SameChat AI what a message means, how to reply, or for a summary of the chat
• Your own AI chats for anything else
• Send a photo of a menu or a sign and read it in your language

PRIVATE WHEN YOU NEED IT
• A private chat that is not kept and not translated
• Report and block are one tap away
• Delete your account in Settings at any time

The app itself is available in 21 languages.

Messages are encrypted on their way to our servers. To translate them, SameChat sends them to its AI provider (OpenAI); you are asked first. Privacy Policy: https://samechat.app/privacy

name: Samothraki Planner
description:
Samothraki Planner este ghidul tău offline-ready pentru vacanța pe Samothraki.

Ce găsești în aplicație:
• Hartă cu plaje, taverne, peisaje și puncte utile
• Rute România → Samothraki și pe insulă
• Stații PECO și alerte de drum (Smart Radar BG)
• Traducere documente / meniuri cu camera
• Chat comunitate și anunțuri utile
• Radio și instrumente de călătorie

Aplicația este gratuită în App Store. Accesul complet se deblochează cu adresa de email a licenței cumpărate pe greciaplanner.ro. Fără reclame și fără abonament.

Politica de confidențialitate: https://greciaplanner.ro/confidentialitate
Suport: contact@greciaplanner.ro

name: Sand Channel
description: Sand Channel is a relaxing sand-flow diversion puzzle. Dig trenches directly into the sand terrain with your fingers to guide falling sand grains into target containers. Sand obeys natural slope rules, piles up and slides down. Critically, accumulated sand can refill and block your shallow channels, so you must plan slopes carefully to keep the flow path open. Capture sand snapshots, replay how terrain evolves, and collect your finished sand scenes in the gallery.

name: sard - ترجمة الألعاب
description:
SARD يحوّل ترجمة ألعابك الإنجليزية إلى العربية، ويعرضها على تلفزيونك فوق اللعبة وأنت تلعب.

كيف يشتغل؟
• اربط جهاز اللعب والتلفزيون من التطبيق مرة وحدة.
• اختر لعبتك واضغط «ابدأ الترجمة».
• كل جملة تظهر في اللعبة تطلع ترجمتها العربية على التلفزيون خلال لحظات.

المميزات
• ترجمة فورية واحترافية تفهم سياق اللعبة.
• مربع ثاني لترجمة نصوص أخرى على الشاشة، مثل المهمات والتلميحات.
• تخصيص كامل لشكل الترجمة: الحجم واللون والخلفية والشفافية.
• ربط سهل بدون بلوتوث.
• شرح سريع خطوة بخطوة حسب تلفزيونك وجهاز اللعب.

يعمل مع
• أجهزة PlayStation وXbox، عن طريق خاصية اللعب عن بُعد في جهازك وبحسابك أنت.
• تلفزيونات Android TV وGoogle TV عن طريق تطبيق SARD للتلفزيون، وتلفزيونات LG عن طريق تطبيق Media Station X.

قبل ما تبدأ
• تحتاج جهاز لعب وتلفزيون مدعوم وجوال، ويبقى التطبيق مفتوحاً في الجوال أثناء اللعب.
• صورة اللعبة ما تطلع من جوالك أبداً؛ يُرسل نص الترجمة فقط.

SARD خدمة مستقلة، ولا تتبع Sony ولا Microsoft ولا تعمل بالشراكة معهما. PlayStation علامة تجارية لشركة Sony Interactive Entertainment، وXbox علامة تجارية لشركة Microsoft.

name: Sash Cord
description: Sash Cord is for someone putting a new cord on a double-hung window. Write the window name and how far the sash travels, in whole inches from 12 to 48. Drag the new cord onto the left or right pulley, then slide that pocket toward the center. The cord length is the travel twice, plus 14 inches for the knot and the pocket. That length stays on the weight, on this iPhone. Nothing is sent off the phone.

name: Satrap: Ancient Strategy
description:
Satrap is a multiplayer strategy game set in the ancient world. Start with a small city: raise its buildings, train an army, get to know your neighbors and become the strongest ruler of the world.

FOUR ANCIENT CIVILIZATIONS
• Egypt: master builders with a strong economy
• Mesopotamia: a fortress in defense
• China: massed armies that train fast
• Indus: swift raiders
Each civilization has its own buildings, units and a special unit.

BUILD YOUR CITY
• 12 buildings: the palace, resource buildings, storehouse, barracks, stable, academy, wall, market and temple
• Produce wood, stone, iron and grain; grow your storehouse
• Run two constructions at once

RAISE YOUR ARMY
• 10 kinds of units, from militia to siege engines
• Units open step by step as your barracks and stable grow
• 12 techniques with 10 levels each, in economy, military and siege branches

EXPLORE THE MAP
• Raid bandit camps and carry the loot home
• Send scouts before you attack: learn the target's defense and stores
• Get a notification the moment an attack is on its way to your city

FORGE ALLIANCES
• Alliance chat, announcements and roles
• Declare war, non-aggression or a trade partnership with other alliances
• Climb the rankings of rulers and alliances

A REWARD EVERY DAY
• A starting chest for new rulers
• A daily reward that grows over a seven-day streak

Start right away as a guest, and sign in with Apple or email to keep your progress. The game is played in English and Turkish.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
The game is free to play. Optional monthly subscriptions strengthen your city: four production guilds (+10% of their resource), the Granary Keeper (+15% storage), the Master Architect (3 constructions at once and a queue of 3), the Drill Master (+15% training speed) and the Ruler's Pack with all seven.

Subscriptions are monthly and renew automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy: https://ancientwar.vercel.app/legal/privacy
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Saybig: Speech to Big Text
description:
User guide: https://franky5440-afk.github.io/saybig-site/guide/

Saybig turns what you say into very large text, right away, so the person in front of you can read it. It is made for talking with someone who has trouble catching your words: a grandparent at home, a customer at the counter, a patient at the front desk.

YOU TALK, THEY READ
• Tap the microphone and speak. Your words appear as big, bold text while you talk.
• Each pause starts a new line. Older lines dim, and you can scroll back to show one again.
• The person reading never has to touch the phone.

MADE FOR THE PERSON ACROSS FROM YOU
• Face-to-face mode flips the big text upside down, so you can lay the phone on the table between you. They read the top; you keep the controls.
• Five text sizes, from ten characters per line down to five.
• White on black or black on white.

TYPE WHEN IT IS TOO NOISY
• Tap the keyboard, type, and show it in the same big text.

A SHORT HISTORY
• Lines are kept on your iPhone so you can show one again later. Turn this off or clear it at any time.

ON IPHONE DUO
• Half open, Saybig becomes a desk sign: the upright half shows the big text to the other person, and the flat half holds your controls.
• Fully open, you see several lines at once. Sideways, big text sits on one side and your conversation on the other.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Speech is recognized on your iPhone. Your voice is not uploaded and is not saved as a recording.
• No account, no ads, no data collection.
• The first time you use a language, iOS may download its speech files. After that Saybig works offline.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Languages: Mandarin Chinese (Taiwan) and English (US).
• Speech recognition makes mistakes sometimes, especially with names and words that sound alike. Speak a little slower for best results.
• Saybig is a communication tool. It is not a medical device.

PRICE
• Free to download with a 7-day free trial of everything. Then a one-time US$2.99 unlock: no subscription.
• After the trial, typing to big text and your history keep working. Speech to big text needs the full version.

Requires iOS 26 or later.

name: Schedulerly
description:
Schedulerly puts your meetings and booking links in your pocket.

• See today's meetings and the next two weeks, in your own time zone.
• Join a video meeting in one tap when it's about to start.
• Share your booking page from any app, or copy it.
• Make a single-use link that books once, for the one person you're writing to.
• Open anything else in Schedulerly on the web: calendars, event types, availability and settings.

Guests only ever see the times you're free: Schedulerly checks the calendars you choose, Google and Outlook alike, before it offers a time.

You need a Schedulerly account. Sign in with Google, Microsoft or your company's single sign-on. If you're new, the same button creates your account.

name: Schnipselstern
description:
Schnipselstern makes symmetry something you can hold: fold paper, cut into it, open it up – and a few cuts turn into a star. Every cut appears as many times as there are layers of paper. Your child predicts what will appear and then sees for themselves whether it was right.

THE CRAFT TABLE
Folded once, twice, three times or as a snowflake. Cut freely with the scissors or use six punches for circles, hearts, stars & more. 14 papers, including translucent ones. The folded paper opens up layer by layer.

THE WINDOW
Finished stars hang on threads in the window and sway gently. Tap one to see it up close.

32 PUZZLE CARDS IN THREE STACKS
• What comes out? Predict first, then open it up
• Counting holes: the star should get this many holes
• Copy the star: recreate a star from the card
Along the way your child discovers mirror lines, doubling & the special role of the fold & the middle.

HELP WHEN STUCK
If something isn’t right yet, the voice kindly says which way to go. On request, the light bulb shows the next step without giving away the answer.

START RIGHT AWAY
The craft table & the window are fully open, plus 13 puzzle cards. The full version opens the other 19 puzzle cards. A one-time purchase, no subscription, with Family Sharing.

CALM & SAFE
• No time pressure, no points, no penalties
• No ads, no account, no data collection
• Works offline
• Settings, purchase & links sit behind a small sum for accompanying adults
• In English & German

An app by Annico from Berlin.
Privacy: https://annico.eu/apps#schnipselstern

name: School Squad: Homeschool
description:
School Squad is a private calendar for homeschool groups. Parent organizers and the families in their group plan field trips, park days, classes and meetups in one place, instead of scrolling through a group chat or hunting for a flyer.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See your group's events on a month, week or list calendar
- RSVP in a tap and say how many kids are coming
- Join repeating lessons with ages, supplies and open seats shown
- See updates and cancellations in one What's new feed
- Browse local events from libraries, museums and parks that your group's hosts turn on
- Add any event to your iPhone calendar with Add to Calendar
- Share an event with the iOS share sheet
- Keep working offline: your last saved calendar stays readable without a connection

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Groups are private and members-only
- Sign in with an emailed code, so there are no passwords to remember
- No ads and no tracking inside the app
- You can delete your account any time from Account in the app

GOOD TO KNOW
- School Squad is for adult parent organizers (18 and over) and the adults in their families, not for children
- Sign in with the email your group organizer invited. Groups and memberships are managed on schoolsquad.app, outside the app. The app does not offer purchases.
- Questions? hello@schoolsquad.app

name: SCHOOLPLUS: Learn & Pass
description:
SCHOOLPLUS helps you learn every subject easily and pass every exam with certainty. It is built for WASSCE and BECE students, and used by schools.

Real exam practice
Timed mock exams in the format of the real papers: objective, theory, mixed, and full Paper 1 + Paper 2 sittings, built from past WASSCE and BECE questions.

Instant marking and worked solutions
Theory answers are marked part by part against the marking scheme, so you see exactly where you gained and lost marks. Every question has a step-by-step worked solution once your paper is marked.

Your own AI tutor
Stuck on a topic? Ask the AI tutor for explanations and worked examples, any time, not just during class hours.

Maths and accounting tools
Type maths with a full equation keypad, use the scientific calculator and formula sheets, draw graphs, tables, pie charts and Venn diagrams, and write T-accounts. Or write your working by hand and let the app read it.

Practice that adapts to you
Practice focuses on the topics you still need to master, and your progress is shown topic by topic and subject by subject.

Built for your school
Join with your school's code to get your school's own look, your teachers, class nudges and attendance, all in one app. Parents and guardians can follow progress in their own portal.

Compete and stay motivated
Weekly leaderboards, events, badges and rewards make studying something you want to come back to.

SCHOOLPLUS is free for schools. Student passes are provided through your school.

WASSCE and BECE are examinations set by the West African Examinations Council (WAEC). SCHOOLPLUS is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WAEC or the Ghana Education Service.

name: ScoreFolio: Sheet Music Reader
description:
One purchase. There is no yearly fee.

ScoreFolio is a sheet music reader for the PDF scores you already have. Open them on iPad, write on them, and turn pages with a pedal. It reads the same way on iPhone Duo and iPhone.

ABOUT THE DEVELOPER
Players ask three things of a score app. What you wrote is still there next time. The page turns when you press the pedal. Nothing extra appears while you play. arcion Inc. built those three first. Nothing sits on top of the music; the menu appears only when you tap the top edge of the screen.


WHAT IT DOES

■ Markings are saved as you write, and earlier versions are kept
Write on the score with Apple Pencil or your finger, using the same pen, pencil, marker, eraser and ruler as the Notes app. Markings are saved automatically after each stroke, before a page turn, and when you leave the app. When you change a page, the version before the change is kept in its history, and Restore Earlier Version brings back the one you choose. Deleting a score keeps its markings: import the same PDF again and they return in the same place. The PDF you imported is never modified.

■ Connect a pedal and press it
Pair a Bluetooth page-turn pedal in Settings on your iPad and it turns pages. Arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down, Space and Enter all work, whichever your pedal sends. Open Test Your Pedal and press: the key that arrived is shown on screen. Left and right can be swapped. The pedal works while annotating, in Performance Mode, and through a setlist.

■ Pedal and tap turns are instant
A pedal, a tap or a voice command switches to the next page with no animation. For finger swipes, choose Slide or Page Curl. In portrait, Half-Page Turns brings in the top half of the next page first, then the rest. A single page in landscape fits the width of the screen and moves down a screenful at a time.

■ Two pages side by side, like the printed score
Hold an iPad in landscape and two pages sit side by side. Open an iPhone Duo in landscape and the fold becomes the gutter, with one A4 page on each side. Margins are cropped automatically so the notes are larger. The pairing can be shifted by one page. Paper can be White, Cream or Night. Half-fold an iPhone Duo on a table and the score is on the upper half, with large Back and Next buttons below.

■ Setlists carry you from one piece to the next
Arrange scores in the order you play them. After the last page of one piece, the next turn opens the first page of the next. The same piece can appear twice.

■ Performance Mode accepts page turns only
Tap the lock in the menu. Pedal, tap and swipe turns keep working; the menu, zooming and annotation do not respond. Touch and hold the lock at the top right to exit.

■ The screen stays on while a score is open
The display does not dim or lock while you are reading a score.

■ Voice page turns, for practice
Say "next" or "back" and the page turns; you can replace them with words of your own. Recognition runs entirely on the device, and no audio is stored or sent.

■ Import PDFs and images
Choose files with + in the library, or pick ScoreFolio from the Files app or AirDrop. Several JPEG, PNG or HEIC images become one piece. Search and sort by title or composer. Share a PDF with your markings on it, or the original.

■ Four sample scores are included
Petzold's Minuet in G, Bach's Prelude in C, the Prelude from Bach's Cello Suite No. 1, and Beethoven's Für Elise, engraved by arcion Inc., with a sample setlist. You can try the pedal and annotation before importing anything.


PRIVACY
Nothing is collected. There is no account, no analytics and no advertising. Scores and markings are stored only on your device, and device backups (iCloud Backup or a Mac) include them.


REQUIREMENTS
iPad, iPhone and iPhone Duo (iPadOS 26 / iOS 26 or later)
One purchase covers both iPad and iPhone.
Available in 13 languages.


SUPPORT
Requests and bug reports: info@arcion.jp
Website: https://arcion.jp/scorefolio/
Developed by arcion Inc.

name: Scorvio: Marcador deportivo
description:
Scorvio convierte un iPad o un iPhone en el mando de un marcador profesional para pantallas LED. Pensado para clubes, polideportivos y organizadores de torneos: tú llevas el partido desde la tablet y el marcador se ve a lo grande en la pantalla del pabellón.

DEPORTES
Fútbol, fútbol sala, baloncesto, baloncesto 3x3, balonmano, hockey hierba, hockey sala, hockey patines, voleibol, tenis, pádel, tenis de mesa y bádminton, más un modo libre para cualquier otro deporte. Cada uno con sus propias reglas: partes y cuartos, prórrogas, sets, juegos, tie-break, punto de oro…

TODO LO QUE NECESITA UN PARTIDO
• Reloj de partido con cuenta atrás o hacia delante
• Reloj de posesión (24/14 s en baloncesto, 12 s en 3x3)
• Faltas, bonus, tiempos muertos y posesión
• Plantillas con dorsales y estadísticas por jugador
• Escudos, colores de equipo y logos de patrocinadores
• Anuncios a pantalla completa durante los tiempos muertos
• Bocina automática al final de cada periodo
• Deshacer cualquier acción con un toque

PANTALLA LED
Conecta el iPad a la pantalla LED o a un televisor (por cable o con AirPlay) y el marcador se muestra a pantalla completa mientras tú controlas el partido.

SCORVIO LIVE
Rótulo con el marcador en directo para tus retransmisiones en OBS, vMix o Streamlabs. Se actualiza al instante, con el reloj sincronizado.

EN TU IDIOMA
Español, inglés, francés, alemán, italiano, portugués, catalán, neerlandés, polaco y sueco.

SIN CUENTAS NI PUBLICIDAD
No hace falta registrarse. Sin anuncios y sin seguimiento: los equipos y jugadores se quedan en tu dispositivo.

PARA CLUBES CON LICENCIA
Scorvio está pensado para los clubes y organizaciones que trabajan con Sportify Visual Equipment, que reciben un código de licencia. Sin licencia, la app funciona en modo demostración, con la marca «SCORVIO DEMO» en la pantalla.

name: Screen Check - Protector Test
description:
Just put on a tempered glass screen protector and now the display looks a little smaller?
Is there a spot that doesn’t respond when you swipe?

Screen Check helps you see if the protector’s border covers part of the display and where your touch isn’t registering.

name: ScreenCast & TV Remote
description:
Put your iPhone on the big screen and your TV remote in your pocket. ScreenCast & TV Remote mirrors your screen, casts your photos and videos, and controls your smart TV — all over your own Wi-Fi network.

SCREEN MIRRORING
• Mirror your iPhone or iPad to AirPlay-compatible TVs and receivers
• Step-by-step guide to start mirroring in seconds
• Live status shows when your screen is on the TV

CAST PHOTOS & VIDEOS
• Browse your photo library and send photos and videos to the TV
• Create slideshows for family moments, trips and parties
• Smooth playback with AirPlay

SMART TV REMOTE
• Full remote: D-pad, OK, Back, Home, Menu and Power
• Volume, mute and playback controls (play, pause, rewind, forward)
• Works with many popular smart TVs and streaming devices on the same Wi-Fi
• Pair once; the app remembers your TV

ALL-IN-ONE CASTING TOOLS
• Browser Casting — browse the web and cast video to your TV
• File Cast — present PDFs, slides, sheets and documents
• Camera Cast — show your live camera on the TV
• Whiteboard — draw and present on the big screen
• QR Connect — scan your TV's code to connect quickly
• Sleep Timer — stop casting automatically

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your photos, videos and screen go straight from your device to your TV
• No account, no sign-up, no ads
• Available in 13 languages

Your iPhone and TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network. Screen mirroring and media casting require an AirPlay-compatible TV or receiver. Remote control works with supported TV models. ScreenCast is an independent app and is not affiliated with any TV manufacturer.

Terms of Use: https://screen-casting-f4836.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://screen-casting-f4836.web.app/privacy

name: sd20 Traumschreiber Minimal
description:
The companion app for the Traumschreiber, a small EEG device worn on the forehead. Connect it over Bluetooth, watch the signal live, see the sleep stages and record a whole night.

What the app does:
- Device: connect, battery level, samples received and lost, LED colour, start sound, button presses
- Signal: one EEG channel in real time, filtered 0.5–35 Hz with a 50 Hz notch, over 5, 10 or 30 seconds
- Spectrum: spectrogram of the last 60 seconds and the power in the delta, theta, alpha, sigma and beta bands
- Sleep: current stage, stage probabilities and hypnogram, scored every 30 seconds by the open-source model AnySleep
- Recordings: all eight channels in microvolts as a CSV file, with the sleep stages and button presses next to it; share or delete them

A whole night:
