The app keeps recording with the screen off. If the connection drops, it connects again by itself. Samples that did not arrive over Bluetooth are fetched back from the device's microSD card.

Your data stays on your phone. The app has no account, no ads and no analytics. Recordings leave the phone only when you share them.

The source code is open (MIT licence) and written to be read and copied, for anyone who wants to build their own app for the Traumschreiber:
github.com/sd20-org/Traumschreiber_Flutter_Minimal-App

You need a Traumschreiber to record. Without one, tap "Try the demo": the app plays half an hour of a real night, and every page works. The Traumschreiber is not a medical device. It is made for research, teaching and citizen science, not for diagnosis or treatment.

Made by the Institute of Sleep and Dream Technologies, a non-profit in Hamburg.

name: Seam Spin
description:
Seam Spin keeps each quilt block's seams on this iPhone. A crossing lies flat when its four seams already chase one way. If it does not, the sentence names one seam and one direction. Spin presses only that seam.

Four Patch asks for the top seam to the right. One press and the block lies flat. Flat Block is already flat, so every press stays put. Nine Patch names the top seam of crossing 1-1. Pressing the right seam does nothing. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Seasonpan
description:
Seasonpan is a notebook for pans you already cook with. A pan stores a metal, a size, and a target number of seasoning rounds. A round stores a date, an oil name, minutes, and an oven temperature in Fahrenheit. The ring is the round count divided by the target, and it stops at a full circle. Reaching the target labels the pan Kept. A target of zero leaves the ring empty on purpose. Cook notes are dishes you typed. They do not fill the ring. They do count as cooks since the latest round when the date is on or after that round.

The home screen is one dial per pan, not a bar chart. Still open lists pans that have rounds left, with the remainder as the number. The heat bench converts Fahrenheit and Celsius with the standard formula and does not save the result. It does not estimate a smoke point.

Share builds a plain-text history and hands it to the system sheet. Seasonpan does not season a pan or judge food safety. The file stays on this phone. Restore sample replaces it with a skillet at 2 of 6 rounds and a crepe pan that has met its target.

name: SeaStaff
description:
SeaStaff connects fishing boat captains and owners with the crew they need for the next trip out to sea.

Built at Fisherman's Landing in San Diego, for sportfishing, long-range, charter and commercial boats. No more calling around the dock to fill a spot the night before a trip.

FOR CAPTAINS AND OWNERS
- Post a job in under a minute: position, trip type, trip date, and optional pay and requirements.
- Mark a post "Needed now" to put it at the top for 48 hours.
- Browse crew who are available now or soon, filtered by role: deckhand, cook/galley, engineer, first captain, second captain.
- See each person's experience level, skills, trip lengths and how many references they have.
- Send a contact request. When they accept, you both see each other's phone number to call or text.
- Posts close automatically after the trip date.

FOR CREW
- Free, always.
- Make a profile once: role, experience level, availability, the trips you want, licenses and references.
- See open jobs near San Diego and tap "I'm interested".
- Your phone number stays hidden until you accept a request. Your references stay private until you choose to share them with a captain.

TRUST AND SAFETY
- Captains need a license on file, and owners a vessel registration, before posting.
- "License on file" and "Verified" labels show who has done what.
- Report or block anyone from their profile, job or request. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

SeaStaff is free during launch. Questions: seastaff.support@gmail.com

name: Second Hand Check
description:
A great find… or an unpleasant surprise? Before you buy second-hand, know what to look for and which faults to check.

That bike at the flea market, the coffee machine from a private seller, the guitar you have been looking for: it is tempting to say yes. But what should you check before handing over your money?

Second Hand Check helps you look beyond first impressions. Choose the item in front of you and follow checks tailored to it. You know where to look, what to try and which signs deserve a closer look, even when it is something you have never bought before.

A scratch, a loose part, an unexpected noise: what should it mean for your decision? Your answers lead to a clear recommendation: buy, buy with reservations or pass. The explanation reflects what you found and what you could not check, so you can weigh up the purchase with concrete reasons in mind.

Not ready to decide on the spot? Keep a photo, a note and your findings, then come back to them before choosing. You can also use the guides without a connection, right where you are viewing the item.

From furniture and appliances to tools, electronics, transport, sports equipment and instruments, explore guides for more than 1,600 kinds of items. Around 40% of the catalogue is free, including the full checks and purchase recommendation. If you want more, unlock a category or the whole catalogue with a one-time purchase, without a subscription.

Before your next second-hand purchase, take a closer look with Second Hand Check.

name: Secret Santa: Gift Together
description:
A little mystery. A lot of Christmas joy.

Turn a festive get-together into a thoughtful surprise with Secret Santa. Bring your friends, family or colleagues together, draw names in secret, and prepare one gift for the person you get.

ONE GIFT FROM EACH PERSON. A GIFT FOR EVERYONE.
Even in a group of 10, you only prepare one present. Everyone gives one and receives one, so all 10 people go home with a gift — and a little mystery about who their Santa was.

START WITH JUST YOUR NAME
• Create a group for your celebration.
• Invite everyone with a link, group code or QR code.
• Join from iPhone or Android — both can share the same group.
• Once at least 3 people have joined, the organizer draws names.
• Reveal your own recipient when no one is peeking.

KEEP THE MAGIC A SECRET
Only you can see who you are gifting through the app. Even the organizer cannot see everybody’s matches. Use similar wrapping and matching labels with recipients’ names only, then leave the presents together without revealing who brought which one.

MADE FOR YOUR PEOPLE
Plan a Christmas with friends, a family exchange or a little festive surprise at work. Groups support 3–50 people. Once names are drawn, the participants and matches are locked, so repeated taps cannot reshuffle the surprise.

No email or password is needed. Your anonymous sign-in stays on your device; uninstalling the app or clearing its data may lose access to your groups. You can delete your profile and participation data in Settings & privacy. No ads or in-app purchases.

Available in English, Ukrainian, German, Spanish and French.

Make one thoughtful gift. Give everyone something to smile about.

name: Securit Fresh Delivery
description:
Secure It Fresh provides a smarter and more secure food delivery experience.

Protect your orders from the moment they leave the restaurant until they reach your doorstep. Our smart delivery bags are designed to keep your orders secure during transit.

SECURE DELIVERY

Orders are placed inside specially designed smart-lock delivery bags that remain locked during transit and can be unlocked by customers using the app.

LIVE ORDER TRACKING

Track your delivery and follow your order from pickup to your doorstep.

SMART UNLOCKING

Use the app to unlock your smart delivery bag when your order arrives.

TEMPERATURE PROTECTION

Our insulated delivery bags are designed to help maintain food temperature and freshness during delivery.

FOOD AND MORE

Explore participating restaurants, food options, groceries, and other available services in your area.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Browse available restaurants and place your order.
2. Your order is packed inside a secure smart delivery bag.
3. Track your delivery.
4. Receive your order and unlock the delivery bag using the app.

Your Order. Your Control. Your Security.

Download Secure It Fresh and experience a smarter approach to food delivery.

name: SeeName Insect
description:
Discover the insects living all around you with SeeName Insect.

Take a photo or choose one from your library. The app analyses the insect and provides an identification suggestion with a clear species guide. Explore butterflies, ladybirds, bees, dragonflies, beetles and many more fascinating insects.

FEATURES

• Identify insects using your camera or photo library
• Get clear identification suggestions and useful species information
• Explore an illustrated guide to different insect families
• Save discoveries and favourite species in your personal notebook
• Available in English, French and Arabic
• No account required
• No advertising, subscriptions or advertising tracking in this version

PRIVACY

Your selected photo is sent over HTTPS to the recognition service only after your confirmation. Your notebook is stored in the app’s private space on your device. You can remove discoveries and clear your notebook from Settings.

Identification results are suggestions and may be inaccurate. Do not use the app to assess danger, handle an animal or make a medical decision.

name: Segma -
description:
Segma - Spectrum Segment Observer is a lightweight utility for image spectrum sampling and analysis.
On iPhone Duo, adjust spectrum bins by changing the hinge angle. As you fold/unfold the device, the number of spectrum segments updates smoothly, with matched pixels highlighted on the source image.
For non-foldable iPhones, a slider is provided only as a fallback control.
This app has no photo filters or beautification functions. All imported images are processed locally and never uploaded to any server.
Supports Luminance, RGB and HSV channels. You can inspect spectrum distribution and export sampling data.

name: Selektör: Road Alerts Turkey
description:
Selektör is a free safe-driving assistant for Turkey's roads that helps you keep your eyes on the road. Tap "Start driving" once; while your phone sits in a holder or your pocket, Selektör tells you out loud when you approach an alert point.

What it does
• Route analysis: pick the provinces and districts on your route and see the speed corridors and speed enforcement points announced by the Turkish Ministry of Interior on a map.
• Spoken alerts: in driving mode you get spoken alerts near these points and near community reports, even while the app is in the background.
• Community reports: report a mobile radar, checkpoint, accident, road works or hazard; confirm other drivers' reports or mark them as gone.
• Built-in trust: new reports start as low trust and grow stronger as they are confirmed; a report rejected several times in a row is removed automatically. Every report type expires, so stale information does not stay on the map.

Privacy first
• No account, no sign-in, no email.
• No ads, no analytics, no purchases.
• The community feature uses only an anonymous device token; your IP address is not stored on the server.
• Your location is used to compute alerts and, during a drive, to load nearby reports from our server; no location history is kept.

Important
Selektör is an independent app and is not affiliated with the Turkish Ministry of Interior or any government agency. Official speed corridor and enforcement information is taken from the Ministry's public website (icisleri.gov.tr).
Selektör is a driving aid; it does not replace traffic signs, speed limits or your own attention. Official and community data can be incomplete or delayed. Always obey the speed limit and do not handle your phone while driving.

Privacy policy: https://nodvera.io/legal/selektor/privacy/
Terms of use: https://nodvera.io/legal/selektor/terms/

name: Selvedge
seller_name: Cactus Artificial Intelligence Laboratory Co., Ltd.
description:
Find a better way to finish both ends of your pattern.

Selvedge helps you plan repeating borders for beadwork, paper crafts, mosaic strips, and other square-grid projects. Draw a small motif, set your total length, and compare how different starting positions, mirrored repeats, and blank margins affect the ends.

CREATE YOUR MOTIF
• Edit a small grid with up to six material colors.
• Customize material names and colors.
• Paint, erase, flip, resize, undo, and redo.
• Mark the positions where your pattern may start or finish.

EXPLORE THE ENDS
• Compare repeating and alternating mirrored layouts.
• Keep the total length fixed while adjusting margins.
• Explore symmetry, full repeat periods, and compact layouts.
• Compare two layouts or see what changed from a direct repeat.

FOLLOW YOUR CHART
• View numbered rows and columns.
• Read each column’s material sequence.
• Work from either end and save your progress.
• Use focus mode with optional keep-awake.

KEEP YOUR WORK
• Preview and export numbered PNG charts.
• Choose color or letter-based charts for printing.
• Export editable project backups and restore them as copies.
• Explore six original patterns and three hands-on edge studies.

Selvedge is completely free, with no ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. No account is required, and projects are stored on your device.

Selvedge plans square-grid patterns. Material quantities depend on your craft and whether one cell represents one physical item.

name: Sence: Tahmin Oyunu
description:
Everest kaç metre? Türkiye'de kaç il var? Amazon hangi yıl kuruldu? Sence'de cevap hep bir sayı. Bilmen gerekmiyor, tahmin etmen yeterli: ne kadar yaklaşırsan o kadar puan.

GÜNÜN SENCESİ
Her gün herkese aynı 5 soru, günde bir hak. Sonucunu renkli rozetlerle paylaş, arkadaşlarınla karşılaştır. Sorular her gün değişir ve uzun süre tekrar etmez.

DÜELLO
Arkadaşlarına bağlantı gönder: aynı 10 soru, soru başına 30 saniye. Kim daha yakın tahmin etti, soru soru gör. Rövanş iste, serini say.

SERBEST MOD
Süre yok, sıralama yok. Türkiye, coğrafya, tarih, bilim ve doğa, spor, kültür ve sanat, teknoloji, vücut ve sağlık: istediğin kategorileri seç, istediğin kadar oyna.

NE KADAR YAKIN?
Tahminin doğru cevaba ne kadar yakınsa o kadar puan: tam isabet 100. Biraz uzak kalsan da puan alırsın. Her cevaptan sonra yakınlık çizgisinde nerede olduğunu ve "Biliyor muydun?" notunu görürsün.

SERİ VE İSTATİSTİK
Günün Sencesi'ni her gün bitirdikçe serin büyür. Oynadığın günler, en uzun serin, ortalaman, puan dağılımın ve rozetlerin istatistik sayfasında.

KOLAY GİRİŞ
Sayıyı tuş takımıyla yaz ya da kaydırıcıyla seç; "milyon" ve "bin" tuşlarıyla büyük sayılar tek dokunuşta. iPad'de klavyeyle de oynanır.

Hesap açman gerekmez. Düello için yalnızca bir ad seçersin; adını ve verilerini istediğin zaman uygulamanın içinden silebilirsin.

name: Senyu Forest
description:
Grow a little green, one real plant at a time.

Senyu Forest is a calm planting journal for the plants you grow in real life. Record their stories, keep track of everyday care, and discover the resilience of trees, shrubs and herbs in a woodland world with a little fox and rabbit.

YOUR PLANTS, THEIR STORIES
Give each plant a name and record its species, planting date, location and measured height. Add a first note, then watch your own collection grow. Your forest begins with the plants you add.

EVERY LITTLE ACT OF CARE
Log watering, fertilizing, height measurements and observations. Keep a timeline of new leaves, small discoveries and the care you complete. In-app reminders help you remember to record your plant care.

SEE YOUR FOREST GROW
Browse journal entries from the last seven days, this month or your entire history. Search for a plant or a memorable moment. See recorded height changes, weekly activity, care streaks and the variety of species in your forest. Set a yearly planting goal and earn badges through your own records.

A FIELD GUIDE FOR CURIOUS GROWERS
Meet 20 plant species, with common and scientific names, habitat information, sunlight needs, watering advice and soil preferences. Search by name, alias or growing trait, and add a plant directly from its guide.

GREEN COMPANIONS FOR SANDY LAND
Explore a collection of 14 sand-control plants, including saxaul, white saxaul, caragana, sand willow, sea buckthorn and desert poplar. Learn how they help stabilize sand, where they grow, and how their water needs differ. Choose plants for local climate, water availability and ecology.

YOUR OWN LITTLE WOODLAND
Explore a stylized forest map and tap your recorded plants to open their stories. Soft colors and original woodland artwork make each visit a quiet moment with your growing companions.

KEEP YOUR STORIES CLOSE
Your plant details and journal are saved on your device. No account is required. Export a complete text archive through the iOS share sheet to keep your records in Files or another app.

Plant a little green. Keep a little story. Grow together.

name: Serabondhu
description:
Welcome to Serabondhu!

Serabondhu is designed to provide a convenient mobile experience where users can explore products, discover relevant information, and connect with others.

KEY FEATURES

• Explore Products: Browse available products and discover relevant product information through an easy-to-use interface.

• Location-Based Information: Access geographical information, including relevant addresses and location details, to better understand product locations.

• In-App Chat: Connect and communicate with other users directly through the application's integrated messaging functionality.

• Simple Navigation: Enjoy an organized interface designed to make accessing application features convenient.

• User-Friendly Experience: Access the available features through a clean and intuitive mobile experience.

WHY SERABONDHU?

Serabondhu brings product discovery, location-related information, and communication together in one mobile application.

Download Serabondhu and explore its features today!

For assistance or support, please contact us using the support information provided on our website.

name: Sermon Notebook: Church Notes
description:
Tap Record when the sermon starts, then lock your phone and put it away. Afterward you get the whole sermon written down, a short summary, the main points, the verses that were read and a few questions to think about during the week.

WHAT'S FREE
Recording, the transcript, the verses, your own notes, search and export never cost anything. Your first sermon's summary is free, so you see what you'd be paying for before you pay. After that, summaries are part of Plus at $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year. There's no weekly plan and no trial to remember to cancel. Family Sharing is on, so one subscription covers your household.

If you stop paying, nothing is locked. Every sermon and note you have stays yours to read, search and export.

IT ONLY SAYS WHAT YOUR PASTOR SAID
The summary and main points report the sermon. They don't add theology, opinions or advice the speaker didn't give. Every verse is checked against the recording before it's shown, so you won't see one that wasn't mentioned. The verse text is the Berean Standard Bible, built into the app.

EASY TO READ
The text is big and adjusts with your phone's text size. The record screen is dark, so your phone doesn't light up the pew, and the rest of the app has a dark mode too.

YOUR OWN NOTES
Write while it records. One tap marks a moment, and it shows up on the sermon's timeline later. Your notes are never rewritten.

DURING THE WEEK
The Sermons screen opens with one of the verses from your latest sermon, a different one each day. There are two reminders you can turn on: Sunday morning, so you remember to record, and one evening in the week to look back at your notes. Both start off.

FOR SMALL GROUPS
Share a sermon as a discussion guide. It's a PDF with the verses to read together, the main points and the questions, with lines to write on.

PRIVACY
No account. The recording and your notes stay on your phone. To write the summary, the transcript's text goes to Anthropic's Claude through our server, which keeps nothing. You can turn that off, and iPhones with Apple Intelligence will write the summaries themselves.

Terms of Use: Apple's standard terms (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/).
Privacy policy: https://ironsidelabs.io/sermon-notebook/privacy.

name: Serve Sunday
description:
Serve Sunday keeps a church's volunteer team on the same page: who is serving this Sunday, where, and who can fill in when plans change.

YOUR SUNDAYS
- See the Sundays you're on, your service time and your post, with a reminder email before each one.
- Add any Sunday or event to your iPhone calendar in one tap.
- Mark the dates you're away so leaders don't schedule you.

OPEN SPOTS AND SWAPS
- Can't make it? Pick a fill-in to swap with right away, or let your shift leader know.
- Leaders post open spots to their team or to everyone, and the first person to tap "I'll take it" gets it.
- See who else is serving with you and who's available as a fill-in.

TEAM EVENTS
- Training nights, refreshers and team meetings in one list.
- Sign up, see who's going, and add it to your calendar.

BUILT FOR TEAM LEADERS
- Rotations by team and service, with one-off changes for a single Sunday.
- A roster with photos and contact details for your team.
- Email your team or the whole group without sharing anyone's address.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Serve Sunday is invite-only: your team leader adds you, and only your team can see your schedule. No ads, no tracking, and your information is never sold.

Sign in with the email address your team leader added. Serve Sunday is for teams already using it; ask your leader to get started.

name: Setas Arrow Puzzle
description:
Every arrow only knows how to go forward. Tap it and it slides along its own path until it leaves the board, unless another arrow is in the way. Find the right order and clear the board without a bump.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap an arrow: it moves in the direction of its tip
• If another arrow is in the way, it slides back and you lose a heart
• 3 hearts per level. No rush and no timer, unless you want one

LEVELS THAT BECOME DRAWINGS
Boards take shapes: a heart, a star, a drop, a ring and more. It starts simple and fills up with tangled arrows. Every 5 levels there is a hard one.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new board every day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak, earn streak freezes and complete the month to win the trophy.

WEEKLY LEAGUES
Earn points by finishing levels and climb the leagues: Paper, Pencil, Chalk, Pen, Ink and Golden Quill. The top 5 move up every week.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Hint: shows an arrow that can leave
• Paths: draws the route of every arrow to the edge
• Undo: gives back the heart of your last mistake
• Pinch to zoom on big boards
• Arrows-left counter

PAPER AND INK LOOK
Quill-tipped arrows on notebook paper. Pick the Notebook, Chalkboard, Watercolor or Night theme. Calm piano and strings music and soft sounds, all of which can be turned off.

The game is free with ads. One purchase removes all ads and gives unlimited lives. Works offline (leagues sync when you are connected).

name: SetLoop Timer
description:
SetLoop is an interval timer for any workout. Build it from blocks and sets — the whole structure is visible at a glance as one colored strip.

FEATURES
• Steps: prepare, work, rest, cooldown — each with its own color.
• Blocks with repeats, e.g. 20 seconds of work and 10 of rest ×8.
• Sets with rest between them.
• Ready-made timers: Tabata and more.
• Total time, work and rest shown before you start.

DURING THE WORKOUT
• Large countdown, readable from afar.
• Sounds, voice and vibration before each step change.
• Timer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with pause and skip.
• History of every workout.

SETTINGS
• Sounds, voice, vibration.
• Signals in Silent mode.
• Pause on calls, keep the screen on.
• Step colors, light and dark theme.

Free, no ads, no sign-up. Your data stays on your iPhone.

Questions and ideas: t.me/setnewloop

name: SEVEN13
description:
Connect with your SEVEN13 community wherever you are.

Explore member profiles, keep conversations together, discover experiences, and manage your community profile in one place.

Access is available to approved SEVEN13 members and eligible invited guests. Sign in using the email associated with your existing account. Available experiences and community access depend on your membership or invitation.

name: ShadeLab: Color sorting puzzle
description:
A little color. A clear mind.

Step into ShadeLab, a quiet world of glass bottles, flowing color and satisfying puzzles. Tap a bottle, choose where to pour, and bring each color together one thoughtful move at a time.

SORT, SEAL AND PACK
Pour into an empty bottle or onto a matching color. Four matching units seal a bottle, ready to pack into a matching order. Plan ahead with the next-order preview, and make room for the colors still to come.

A JOURNEY OF 50 LEVELS
Begin with simple pours, then explore changing orders, limited space and covered bottles that reveal as you complete new ones. Replay completed levels whenever you want.

TAKE YOUR TIME
Undo a move, restart a puzzle or open How to Play whenever you need a hand. Your progress saves on your device, so you can pause and return without a lives penalty.

MAKE IT YOUR SPACE
Enjoy soft sound effects and ambient music, or turn either off independently. Adjust haptics, reduce motion and add color symbols for another way to recognize each layer.

No account. No ads. No in-app purchases. Just a little space for color.

Support: https://pranav108.github.io/ShadeLab-web/support/
Privacy: https://pranav108.github.io/ShadeLab-web/privacy/

name: Shaft Enter
description:
Shaft Enter keeps each loom's threading on this iPhone. Four shafts weave a 2/2 twill. The longest float names one warp end, and Enter moves that end onto the shaft that breaks the float. The first end and the last end stay put.

Twill Loom asks for end 4 on shaft 1. Enter it once and the cloth is even. Even Loom already lies even. Short Loom needs more ends. Selvage Loom moves end 2, not the first end. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: SHAHEEN – Overland Trips
description:
SHAHEEN is built for long overland journeys by RV and car — for travellers who cross borders and spend weeks on the road.

Trip planning
• Plan your route day by day with suggested overnight stops.
• Add a stop from a Google Maps link.
• Export and share your route as GPX.
• Near tonight's stop with your next city a short drive away? SHAHEEN asks whether to stop as planned or drive on.

Stays and borders
• Schengen counter (90 days in any 180) with the days you have left.
• A record of the countries you visited, with entry and exit dates.
• Country-change alert: when you enter a new country, SHAHEEN asks you to confirm the dates — your stay records only change after you confirm.
• Border crossing information and travel advisories.

Vehicle and expenses
• Fuel and expense log with receipt photos.
• Upcoming maintenance reminders by distance.
• Trip reports to print or share as CSV.

On the road
• Weather where you are.
• Saved places and RV workshops.
• Upcoming events in the UAE.
• Share your live position with your trip companions.

Privacy
• No ads, no tracking.
• Delete your account and data from inside the app at any time.

SHAHEEN accounts are by request and approval.

name: Sharpflix Events
description:
Mit Sharpflix Events haben Sie Ihr Ticket und das Programm Ihrer Veranstaltung auf dem Smartphone. Öffnen Sie einen Programmpunkt, lesen Sie die Beschreibung und lernen Sie die Referentinnen und Referenten kennen.

Fügen Sie zur Einrichtung den Ticketlink aus Ihrer E-Mail ein. Die App zeigt Ihre Veranstaltung und die für Ihr Ticket freigeschalteten Inhalte.

Je nach Veranstaltung können Sie:
• Ihr Ticket und Ihre gebuchten Veranstaltungstage aufrufen
• Das Programm mit Beitragsbeschreibungen und Referentenprofilen ansehen
• Fragen zu laufenden Vorträgen stellen und für Fragen anderer Teilnehmer stimmen
• Vorträge bewerten und an Umfragen teilnehmen
• Eine bereitgestellte Live-Übersetzung mit Text und Audio verfolgen
• Veranstaltungsmitteilungen und Ihre veröffentlichte digitale Visitenkarte öffnen

Für die Nutzung benötigen Sie ein gültiges Ticket einer Veranstaltung, die Sharpflix Events unterstützt. Die verfügbaren Funktionen werden von der jeweiligen Veranstaltung festgelegt. Zum Laden aktueller Inhalte ist eine Internetverbindung erforderlich.

name: Shashati
description:
SHASHATI is your pocket guide to movies, series and anime. Discover what to watch next, watch official trailers, and find a cinema near you, all in one beautiful app.
  
  DISCOVER
  • Browse trending and popular movies, TV series and anime
  • See ratings, genres, release year and story details for every title
  • Moods change the look of the app to match what you feel like watching
  
  WATCH
  • Play official trailers, teasers and clips right inside the app
  • Stream free public-domain classic films
  
  THEATRES NEAR YOU
  • See movie theatres around you on an Apple Map
  • Move the map to explore cinemas in any area
  • Get drive, walk or transit times and directions in Apple Maps
  • Plan your movie night with a simple showtime planner
  • Tap the heart to save your favourite cinemas
  
  MY LIST
  • Watchlist: save movies and shows to watch later
  • My Cinemas: keep the theatres you love in one place
  • Continue Watching: pick up free films right where you left off
  
  FAMILY FRIENDLY
  SHASHATI hides titles rated for mature audiences, so everyone can browse with confidence.
  
  YOUR PRIVACY
  No account needed. Your watchlist and saved cinemas are stored only on your device. Your
  location is used only while you use the app to show nearby theatres. It is never stored or
  sent to us.
  
  Movie and TV data is provided by TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or
  certified by TMDB. Anime data is provided by Jikan (MyAnimeList). Streaming availability is
  provided by JustWatch. Free films are from the Internet Archive.

name: Sheep Pompom
description:
Welcome to Sheep Pompom, a little handmade farm where caring for one fluffy sheep becomes three playful challenges.

Step into a colorful world of stitched fabric, soft wool, paper-cut meadows, and cheerful farm details. Every challenge brings a different way to interact with your woolly friend.

BURR DETECTIVE

Look closely into the sheep's thick wool and find hidden burrs. Choose grooming combs, adjust their depth, and carefully guide each stroke through the fleece. Some burrs are easy to reach, while others hide near tangled fibers. Keep your sheep comfortable as you work.

LANOLIN SHIELD

Rain is coming! Spread a limited supply of lanolin across the wool to help keep water away. Control your brush, cover vulnerable areas, and watch raindrops behave differently on protected and untreated wool. Plan your strokes before the rain begins.

SHAKE DRY

Your sheep is wet after a rainy adventure. Control its shoulders and hips to create gentle shaking movements that release water droplets. Watch the droplets fly, manage your movements, and avoid splashing the little lamb sleeping nearby.

A HANDMADE FARM TO EXPLORE

- Play three distinct interactive wool-care games.
- Discover new challenges across 36 levels.
- Learn each game through hands-on tutorials.
- Unlock accessories for your fluffy sheep.
- Collect illustrated farm memories.
- Earn embroidered achievements.
- Review your progress in a personal care journal.
- Enjoy soft animations and playful sound effects.

Sheep Pompom is designed for relaxing moments, curious hands, and players who enjoy small challenges with satisfying interactions.

A little sheep, a lot of wool, and a whole farm of playful discoveries.

name: Sheltie - Agent Remote
description:
You start Claude Code on a task, step away for a minute, and come back to find it has been sitting on "Can I create this file?" for twenty minutes.

Sheltie sends that question to your iPhone the moment it shows up. Long-press the notification, tap Allow, Allow for this session or Deny, and the agent is back to work. No need to open the app. On our Mac the push goes out 0.5 to 0.7 seconds after the agent stops.

SEE WHAT YOU'RE APPROVING
The file it wants to write, the command it wants to run, or the options it wants you to pick from are right there on the card. None of the options fit? Type your own answer. Tapping an old notification is safe too: Sheltie checks the screen again before sending, and won't answer a prompt that has changed.

READ IT LIKE A CHAT
Scroll through what the agent has done so far, with code blocks intact and tool calls folded to one line. Reply to give it the next job, by typing or by voice.

START WORK FROM YOUR PHONE
Pick a folder, type what you want done, and a new agent starts on your Mac.

ALL YOUR MACS IN ONE LIST
Connect your home and work Macs and see every agent on one screen: done, waiting on you, or still working.

USAGE AT A GLANCE
Check how much of your Claude 5-hour and weekly limits is left.

GETTING STARTED
Paste one command into Terminal on your Mac and scan the QR code it shows. Traffic stays inside your own Tailscale network. The server is open source: github.com/hyperfocuslab/sheltie

WHAT YOU NEED
- A Mac running Claude Code in herdr
- Tailscale on the Mac and the iPhone

No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases, no sign-up.

Sheltie is an independent app by Hyperfocus Lab, not affiliated with Anthropic or the herdr project.

name: Sherd Arc
description:
Sherd Arc measures pottery rims and totals them by context.

Lay a rim face-down next to a scale bar and photograph it from above. Drag the two ends of the bar, then drag points along the rim edge. The fit gives a diameter in centimetres and the surviving arc. EVE is that arc divided by 360. A short arc or a poor fit is marked Unreliable.

Rims stay with the context. The summary lists EVE by ware and form, a diameter chart, and an estimate of how many vessels the rims could belong to. Contexts line up in section order so you can compare one layer with the next.

Photographs and records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. Check the diameter against the rim in front of you before you record it.

name: Shiftwise: Shift Calendar
description:
Your roster changed. Your whole day doesn’t have to.

Shiftwise helps you organize work shifts and review changes before they reach your calendar.

START WITH YOUR SCHEDULE
Add shifts manually for free, including overnight work, labels and locations. View your week and keep saved shifts available offline.

READ ROSTER IMAGES WITH PRO
Choose a screenshot or photograph, identify your name and date range, and let Google Gemini extract your shifts. Check and edit the results before saving. AI scanning requires an active Shiftwise Pro subscription, an internet connection, and confirmation that you are 18 or older.

SEE WHAT CHANGED
Compare a revised roster with saved shifts. Review new shifts and changed hours. A shift missing from an image is kept unless you explicitly choose to remove it.

KEEP CALENDAR EVENTS IN STEP
Choose a writable calendar, check for overlapping appointments and update the linked shift events you approve. Optional calendar reminders help you prepare for work.

YOUR DATA, IN YOUR HANDS
Saved schedules stay on your device. No account is required. Export a backup before changing phones or deleting the app. AI scans send only your selected image and import details through Supabase to Google Gemini; other calendar appointments are not sent to AI. Your calendar provider may sync events you add.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Shiftwise Pro is available monthly or yearly. Prices are shown in your local currency before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in Apple Account settings. You can restore purchases in the app. Saved local schedules remain accessible after your subscription ends.

Always verify extracted dates and times against your employer’s official roster. AI can make mistakes. Calendar reminders depend on device settings.

Privacy: https://shiftwise.jhayr.com/privacy
Support: https://shiftwise.jhayr.com/support
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Shipfolio - Build in Public
description:
Shipfolio is where indie founders list their products with the tech stack behind them, their launches and their revenue, verified from Stripe and other billing sources. This app is the companion to shipfolio.io: browse what founders ship, follow your own listings and get notified when something changes.

Discover indie products
• The launch board for today and every day before it. Upvote the launches you like.
• Products with verified revenue, ranked by MRR and by growth.
• Most efficient: verified MRR against real cloud cost, so you can see who runs lean.
• Product pages with the stack, MRR history, pricing and the founder's timeline.
• Stacks and tools: what indie products are built with, which tools founders switch between and when tool prices change.
• The monthly stack report on the state of indie stacks.
• Search across products, tools, founders and threads.

Read the community
• Articles from makers on what they learned building.
• Threads, questions and AMAs, with upvotes.
• Leaderboards for Knots and for the fastest verified MRR growth.
• Shipping now: what founders ship, as it happens.
• Milestones: products passing $1K, $10K and $100K MRR.
• The investor directory: funds and angels, their checks and portfolios.
• The job board: open roles at indie companies, with pay always shown.

Your listings
• Views, revenue and launches for each product you list.
• Verified investor interest: views this week and who is watching.
• What to fill in next to rank higher in search.

Notifications
• Push and in-app notifications when your launch goes live, a product hits a revenue milestone, an investor starts watching, someone replies to your thread or sends you a message.
• Choose push and email for each kind.

Messages
• Read and reply to investors and founders who write to you about your products.
• Report a conversation or block someone at any time.

What happens on shipfolio.io
Creating and editing listings, connecting revenue sources, replying to threads, starting new conversations and changing security settings open shipfolio.io in an in-app browser.

Browsing works without an account. Sign in with Apple, Google, GitHub or email to vote and follow your listings.

Terms: https://shipfolio.io/terms
Privacy: https://shipfolio.io/privacy

name: Shiva Docs
description:
Shiva Docs is the mobile app for your Shiva Docs workspace. Keep your company's documents in one place, share them with exactly the right people, and stay in control of every copy.

YOUR WORKSPACE AT A GLANCE
- Home shows what changed recently, what you viewed, what was shared with you and the latest activity
- See how much of your plan you are using

ALL YOUR DOCUMENTS
- Search and filter by PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and images
- Upload files straight from your phone
- Swipe to move a document to the trash, with Undo

SECURE VIEWER
- Documents open as watermarked pages, so every view carries the viewer's details
- Zoom into any page or read full screen

SHARE WITH CONTROL
- Invite people by email to view or edit
- Create view links with an expiry date and a view limit
- Revoke access at any time

KNOW WHAT HAPPENS
- Notifications when someone views or shares a document, or joins your workspace
- Mark one or all as read

READ OFFLINE, SAFELY
- Save documents for offline reading as encrypted copies
- Copies that are revoked or expire are removed the next time the app syncs
- Signing out removes every offline copy from the phone

RUN YOUR WORKSPACE
- Invite members and manage who has access to your organisation
- Weekly analytics: most viewed and most downloaded documents, active members and outside viewers
- Choose the workspace watermark, offline access rules and notification emails, and review the audit log

TRASH WITH A SAFETY NET
- Restore deleted documents within 30 days

A Shiva Docs workspace account is required. Create your workspace at docs.shiva.co.ke.

name: Shoal - Sundaze
description:
Salt on the lens, coffee still warm, lineup not crowded yet. Shoal keeps that hour. Session notes hang off the pier by how the wave actually felt, and coves hold the talk that starts after someone paddles in. Wax and temperature stickers ride along so tomorrow’s dawn is not a blank memory.

Your shack is a surf pass you fold open: sessions you kept, ones still in review, people you paddle toward. Coins open a handful of fuller notes. The pier, the crew, and ordinary chat do not. If a drop or a person crosses a line, report and block are on that screen before you scroll.

name: Shop Buddy: Cut Planner
description:
Measure twice. Plan once.

Type in the parts you need and Shop Buddy lays them out on your sheets and boards, kerf and grain included, then numbers every cut in the order you make them. The plan updates while you type, so you can try a different sheet or a narrower shelf and see straight away what it costs.

CUT PLANS YOU CAN ACTUALLY SAW
• Only straight, edge-to-edge cuts you can make on a table saw or track saw
• Blade width (kerf) and edge trim taken out of every cut
• Grain direction per part; tap a part to turn it and the rest is planned around it
• Cut-together groups so drawer fronts come from one strip and the grain flows across
• Edge banding per edge, with total banding length
• Sheet goods and linear stock: plywood, MDF, melamine, boards, studs, pipe

BUY WHAT YOU NEED
• How many sheets or lengths to buy, with a margin for mistakes
• Edge banding length and the total cost

21 WORKSHOP CALCULATORS
Sheet and board yield, equal spacing, shelf sag, drawer boxes, stairs, compound miters, diagonals, arcs, finish and glue, wood movement, pilot holes, router speed and project price. Every number field does the maths: type 1220-18, 48 1/2" or 4'6".

METRIC OR IMPERIAL
Millimetres by default, or feet, inches and fractions down to 1/64". Works on iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode.

SHOP BUDDY PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION)
• Shop Mode: one cut at a time in big type, screen kept awake, progress saved
• AR sheet check: point your phone at a sheet to check its size, or preview the layout on the real sheet
• Offcut and stock inventory, used before buying new
• Import DXF, SVG and CSV parts lists; export PDF and CSV cut lists
• Unlimited projects (free keeps 3)

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no tracking, no internet needed. Your projects stay on your device.

AR measurements are a quick check, not a tape measure: always measure before you cut.

name: Shortround
description:
Shortround turns your iPhone into a remote for the coding agent on your Mac or Windows PC.

The one-time bridge setup can be run by Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Gemini, Aider, or any local agent with shell and file tools. That agent installs the bridge. The bridge can then drive Claude Code, Codex, or a custom CLI command you configure.

Pair once over Wi-Fi, a Bluetooth Personal Hotspot, or a relay, then:

• Send prompts and watch the transcript stream live, including tool calls and output.
• Control Claude Code, Codex, or a custom CLI agent.
• Approve or deny Claude Code Bash, edit, and web actions before they run.
• Stop a runaway turn instantly, then Continue or Retry.
• Keep several sessions in view and switch between them.
• Use the control deck for one-tap Accept, Deny, Stop, Continue, Retry, New, Switch, and Policy.
• Fold your phone into a clamshell: a CRT dashboard on top, a macropad and prompt bar below.
• Customize the deck finish — case, keys, metal, phosphor, and underglow.

Shortround does not provide an AI model. You run the agent on your own computer and pair it with the app. The app connects directly to your computer (or a relay you choose); prompts and transcripts are not sent to us.

The host bridge is a single zero-dependency Node file. Claude Code and Codex have built-in adapters; other CLI agents use a command you provide. A local coding agent can fetch the bridge from the phone, verify its SHA-256, and start it — no installer, no admin, no service. Bluetooth-only PCs can dial out to the phone's Personal Hotspot, so no inbound firewall rule is needed.

Control target: Claude Code and Codex, plus custom CLI agents. Phone approvals are available for Claude Code; Codex and custom agents run in their own sandbox. No account, no ads, no analytics, and no tracking.

Claude Code is a product of Anthropic. Codex is a product of OpenAI. Shortround is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by either company.

name: Shwe Nay Pyi - Myanmar Abroad
description:
Shwe Nay Pyi is a free guide for Myanmar people living abroad: Myanmar restaurants, grocery marts, shops, services, Burmese-speaking clinics and monasteries, the kyat rate and the Myanmar calendar, in English or in Burmese.

Now in Singapore and Thailand. Pick your country when you open the app, and in Thailand your city too: Bangkok, Mahachai, Mae Sot, Chiang Mai, Phuket, Pattaya, Ranong or Surat Thani. Switch any time.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse Myanmar places by kind: Food, Marts, Services, Health, Monasteries and Shops
• Search by name, area or dish, in English or Burmese; small spelling slips are forgiven
• See which places are open right now, and until when
• Find Myanmar places near you, sorted by distance
• See menus with prices, with dish names in English and Burmese
• In Singapore: the MRT map with Myanmar places near each station, and the walk from the nearest exit
• Find clinics and hospitals where you can be helped in Burmese
• Tap to call, or open directions in Maps
• Save your favourite places for later
• Halal food clearly marked

TODAY'S KYAT RATE
In Singapore: the SGD to MMK market rate, with a converter, rate history, a home screen widget and optional rate alerts. In Thailand: baht for 100,000 kyat, the way the border quotes it. Also the US dollar, ringgit and yuan in kyat. Rates are for information only: the app does not offer, arrange or recommend any money transfer.

MYANMAR CALENDAR
Today's Burmese date, full moon and sabbath days, Myanmar public holidays and the holidays of the country you live in, plus monastery events.

USEFUL NUMBERS
One tap to call the Myanmar embassy, labour and help lines and emergency services in your country.

MADE FOR THE COMMUNITY
No sign-up. No ad networks. No tracking. Works offline once opened, and updates itself when new places are added. Know a place we are missing? Tell us from any place page.

Shwe Nay Pyi is an independent community guide. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Embassy of Myanmar, any government agency or any business listed. Clinic listings help you find a place; they are not medical advice. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

name: Side Stake
description:
Side Stake keeps each round of a basket on this iPhone. The circumference and the widest gap decide which spokes take a second stake. One spoke holds at most two. When that count would be even, one short bye-stake makes it odd so the plain weave can keep going.

Market Round asks for a second stake on spoke 1. Egg Basket already has them on spokes 1, 3, and 6. Trug Base keeps one stake on every spoke. If a second stake sits on the wrong spoke, the sentence names only the spoke to move. A gap that cannot fit, or a round that must use chase weave, says so and ignores further taps.

Change the spoke count, the diameter, and the max gap, then share the sentence. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: SignalWheel
description:
A quiet city is waiting for its next transmission.

Take the controls of a rooftop relay station in SignalWheel, a strategy puzzle game about finding the right connection. Turn two signal rings, match the next packet at the receiver, and deliver a complete sequence before your energy runs out.

Every turn has a consequence. Core pulses cost more heat than outer rotations. A successful transmission cools the equipment, while a limited supply of coolant can rescue a difficult route. Choose a Regulator, Accelerator or Reservoir to change how you balance efficiency and heat.

Explore 24 relay missions across four illustrated districts. Independent rings give way to linked and counter-rotating mechanisms, asking you to plan beyond the first match. Earn medals for completing a mission, preserving energy and finding your own solution.

Visit the Circuit Workshop for 12 spatial puzzles with a different kind of challenge. Rotate conduit tiles to connect a source and receiver through two relay nodes. Follow the illuminated path, inspect your options and commit the signal when the connection is complete.

Four illustrated lessons introduce the controls. An interactive forecast lets you rehearse a sequence, and undo and contextual hints help you learn from a route that did not work. Collect district postcards and signal dossiers, then revisit your best records to find a cleaner solution.

Turn the rings. Connect the rooftops. Let the city hear you.

name: Signfield
description:
Wondering what a sign means after a drive? Signfield helps you identify common U.S. road signs from the details you remember. Start with a shape, color, or symbol, or search the illustrated library by name or MUTCD code.

Compare signs that look alike, such as a merge warning and a lane ending, and learn which detail tells them apart. Practice in short rounds with instant explanations, then revisit the signs you missed.

Save signs for later and write field notes with a location and a linked sign. The guide, comparisons, practice, and notebook work offline. Signfield covers 44 selected regulatory, warning, work zone, and guide signs. Use it while parked, before a trip, or between lessons.

name: SIGVORY
description:
Sigvory is a private vault built around a personal drawing. Register a pattern, then draw it again to open its own vault. Use different patterns for separate spaces, so the things you keep private stay organized your way.

With Sigvory, you can:

- Open separate vaults with registered drawing patterns
- Save password cards with a service, username, password, and notes
- Keep selected files in your vault
- Create an encrypted backup and use a recovery key for that vault
- Set up each vault with its own key and recovery flow

Your recovery information matters. Keep it somewhere safe. If the information needed to restore a vault is lost, that vault may not be recoverable.

name: Silicon Chess Capture
description:
Recover your chess games from a photo of a handwritten scoresheet. Capture reads the handwriting on your device and puts the moves on a board. Check each suggestion against its original crop and correct uncertain moves before sharing the game.

- Import a photo and frame the recorded moves.
- Play through the game and compare alternatives against the handwriting.
- Use Chess Doctor to review your decisions and see their consequences on the board.
- Keep games in your library or export them as PGN.

On-device scanning and review work offline without an account. Reading quality depends on the framing and legibility of the scoresheet.

name: Simple Stats Pro
description:
Simple Stats Pro keeps volleyball stats from the bench. Big buttons, one tap per play, and a box score the moment the match ends.

PICK THE RESULT, THEN THE PLAYER
Tap what happened (kill, ace, dig, block, pass rating and more), then tap who did it. The choice clears after every tap so you can keep your eyes on the court. A kill asks who set it. Undo marks the last stat as undone and never changes who is on court.

BUILT FOR THE BENCH
- Works with no signal. Start matches and record every tap in a gym with no Wi-Fi. Taps save on your phone first and sync when you are back online.
- Six on court, subs and liberos. Set the starting six by serving order or by tapping the court. Choose zero, one or two liberos per set. Side-out rotation and substitution rules (including same-slot re-entry) are tracked for you.
- Score and sets. Rally score, best-of-3 or best-of-5, automatic set endings, and two timeouts per team per set.
- Names with numbers. See "#12 Avery Cole" so a glance at the log is enough.

BOX SCORES AND REPORTS
- Per-match box scores with kills, errors, attempts, hitting percentage, assists, aces, serve errors, digs, blocks and pass ratings.
- Season totals for every team.
- Optional tournaments: group matches under a tournament and see its record and totals.
- Share or save CSV files (box score, play-by-play, season or tournament) from the iPhone share sheet.

COACHING TEAMS
Invite assistant coaches by email or with a one-time link. Editors can record stats, and viewers can watch a live match refresh on their own phone.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No ads. No tracking. Your stats are never sold. Download your CSVs any time, and delete your account and everything in it from the Account page.

Simple Stats Pro is an independent tool. It is not made or endorsed by any volleyball governing body.

name: Simple TV Remote for Samsung
description:
Simple Remote turns your iPhone into a calm, fast remote for your Samsung Smart TV. Open it and your TV is there: it finds TVs on your Wi-Fi by itself, connects in seconds, and gives you the buttons you use every day, laid out like the remote that came with your TV.

DESIGNED TO JUST WORK
- Always clear: one quiet status line tells you exactly what's happening ("Connecting…", "Connected", "The TV is off"), and never jumps around the screen
- Power that knows: one button turns the TV off, or back on from standby, and the app notices within seconds when the TV is turned on or off with its own remote
- Reconnects by itself when your TV comes back, without a scan or a restart
- Remembers your TVs, even while they're asleep, and opens right where you left off
- Feels native: haptics, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and dark mode throughout

EVERYTHING YOUR REMOTE DOES
- Power, volume, mute and channel up/down
- Circular arrow pad with OK, plus Back and Home
- Source, with a long press for HDMI 1 to 4
- Play/Pause and a number pad
- Type into search boxes on the TV with your iPhone keyboard
- Hold volume, channel or the arrows to repeat
- Several TVs? Switch between them in one tap, and give each your own name (synced with iCloud)
- TV Details: model, model year, IP address, connection, resolution and more, ready to copy
- A TV Remote button for Control Center, the Lock Screen and the Action button

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Simple Remote talks only to TVs on your own network. There are no ads, no analytics, no accounts and no tracking, and no data is collected. The connection to your TV is encrypted, and the app remembers each TV's security identity so it notices if something changes.

FREE, FOR REAL
No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions and no sign-up. Simple Remote is open source, published on GitHub under the MIT license.

REQUIREMENTS
- Works with Samsung Smart TVs running Tizen, 2022 and newer. Many 2018–2021 models also work. Tested on 2022, 2024 and 2026 models.
- Your iPhone and TV must be on the same Wi-Fi/local network. Guest or isolated networks that block devices from seeing each other will not work.
- The first time you connect, choose "Allow" on the TV.
- To turn the TV on from the app, enable "Power On with Mobile" (network standby) in the TV's settings. If the TV has been off for a long time, it may need its own remote to turn on.
- To find the TV automatically, keep AirPlay turned on in the TV's settings (it is on by default), or add the TV by its IP address.
- Allow Local Network access on your iPhone when asked (Settings > Privacy & Security > Local Network).
- Requires an iPhone with iOS 27 or later.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Samsung. Samsung and Tizen are trademarks of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.

name: Simuladores
description:
Practica con los simulacros asignados a tu curso de gestión de proyectos y riesgos.

Responde las preguntas de cada simulacro, consulta tus resultados e historial y accede a los materiales de estudio disponibles en tu biblioteca.

Simuladores requiere una cuenta habilitada por tu organización. Los simulacros y materiales disponibles dependen del acceso asignado a esa cuenta.

name: Since – Days Together
description:
Since is a day counter for couples. Pick the day you got together, and it shows how long you've been a couple, reminds you of every important date, and keeps everything in sync with your partner.

HOW IT WORKS
Enter your two names, add a photo of each of you, and pick the date you got together. That's the whole setup.

SEE HOW LONG YOU'VE BEEN TOGETHER
The home screen shows your days together in big numbers, plus the exact years, months and days. Tap the number to see it in weeks, months or hours instead.

NEVER MISS AN ANNIVERSARY
Since adds the important dates for you: day 100, every 500th day, every monthiversary and every anniversary. You can add your own events too, like birthdays, trips or dinners. On the day of an event, a live countdown appears on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

WORKS WITH THE CALENDAR APP
All your dates also appear in the iPhone Calendar app. Add an event to the Since calendar there, and it shows up in the app too.

SHARED WITH YOUR PARTNER
Send your partner one invite link. After that, you both see the same dates, photos and events on your own iPhones, synced through iCloud.

WIDGETS
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your day count and the next big day.

PRIVATE
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPhones and in your own iCloud.

name: SIP SIP – Blind Tasting
description:
SIP SIP turns any wine night into a blind tasting game.

The host opens a tasting, picks tonight's wines and questions, and gets an invite code. Guests join with the code, taste each glass and lock in their answers. Answers and scores stay hidden until the host reveals them.

FOR HOSTS
- Questions for every glass: grape, country, region, vintage, price, or your own
- Champagne and sparkling grapes (Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier) always at the top
- Rank by points or by number of correct answers
- Choose whether guests can change their answers
- Set your own time limit, or none
- Look up prices on Wine-Searcher, or ask Claude or ChatGPT for the details

FOR GUESTS
- Join with the 6-character code, your name and a 4-digit PIN. No sign-up needed
- Live ranking every time a glass is revealed
- Tasting notes and star ratings for every glass

WINE MAPS
At each reveal, see a map of where the wine comes from: more than 300 regions, villages and grand crus across France, Italy, Spain, the New World, Japan and Thailand.

MY CELLAR
Sign up with just your email, no password, to keep every tasting on a calendar and see what you drank on any day, on any phone.

SHARE
Make a story-sized image of today's ranking, your own result or the wines you tasted, on a SIP SIP background or your own photo. Post it to Instagram or TikTok, or to the SIP SIP Lounge to cheers with other wine lovers.

Works in English, Thai and Korean. For adults of legal drinking age. Please drink responsibly.

name: SiteMath: Construction Calc
description:
SiteMath is a construction calculator for contractors, carpenters and DIYers. Get yards of concrete, studs, drywall sheets, roofing squares, stair stringers and wire sizes in seconds, with a material list and cost.

33 CALCULATORS IN ONE APP
- Concrete: slabs, footings, walls, columns and post holes, poured steps. Cubic yards and cubic feet, ready-mix truckloads or premix bags (40, 60 or 80 lb), rebar, gravel base
- Framing: wall studs and plates, board feet, rafter length and cut angles, baluster spacing with layout marks
- Drywall: sheets, joint compound, tape and screws, with doors and windows subtracted
- Roofing: roof area, squares, shingle bundles, metal sheets or roof tiles, underlayment, drip edge, pitch to angle
- Electrical: Ohm's law, voltage drop, wire size (NEC tables)
- Paint, tile, grout, thin-set and flooring boxes
- Stairs: risers, treads, total run and stringer length, checked against code limits
- Decking: boards, joists and screws
- Gravel, sand, topsoil and mulch: volume, weight and bags
- Block and brick walls with mortar, batt and blown-in insulation, area of any shape

FEET-INCH-FRACTION CALCULATOR
Add, subtract, multiply and divide feet, inches and fractions: 5' 7 3/8" + 2' 9 1/2" = 8' 4 7/8". Round to 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 or 1/64. Mix in metres, centimetres and millimetres. Plus a unit converter for length, area, volume and weight.

SCAN A ROOM, MEASURE WITH AR
On iPhone and iPad with LiDAR, scan a room to get a floor plan with every wall, door and window, then send the real wall area to the drywall and paint calculators. Measure a distance with the AR ruler on any recent iPhone.

SEE WHAT YOU ARE CALCULATING
Slabs, columns, stairs, rafters, decks, studs and balusters come with a live drawing that shows your dimensions. Every result shows how it was calculated.

YOUR MARKET, YOUR CODE
Seven market profiles (US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, international) set the product sizes and code limits used in the results.

MATERIAL LISTS, COSTS AND QUOTES
Every result lists the materials with a cost. Enter your own prices once. Add results to a project, set labor, markup and sales tax, and send your client a PDF quote, estimate or invoice with your business name.

BUILT FOR THE JOBSITE
- Imperial and metric in every calculator
- Big numbers and large buttons, light and dark themes
- Made for iPhone and iPad
- Works offline. No account, no sign-up
- No ads while you type: no pop-up on the answer

SITEMATH PRO
One purchase, no subscription: removes ads and unlocks branded PDF quotes with your logo forever.

SiteMath gives estimates. Check quantities and local code requirements before you order or build.

name: Sithonia Planner
description:
Sithonia Planner este ghidul tău offline-ready pentru vacanța pe Sithonia.

Ce găsești în aplicație:
• Hartă cu plaje, taverne, peisaje și puncte utile
• Rute România → Sithonia și pe insulă
• Stații PECO și alerte de drum (Smart Radar BG)
• Traducere documente / meniuri cu camera
• Chat comunitate și anunțuri utile
• Radio și instrumente de călătorie

Aplicația este gratuită în App Store. Accesul complet se deblochează cu adresa de email a licenței cumpărate pe greciaplanner.ro. Fără reclame și fără abonament.

Politica de confidențialitate: https://greciaplanner.ro/confidentialitate
Suport: contact@greciaplanner.ro

name: Sixtyfold: 60-Day Challenge
description:
Sixtyfold is a 60-day challenge for the habits you keep putting off. Pick a few things you'll do every day. Tick them off. Watch the days add up until day 60.

A PLAN THAT FITS YOUR DAY
• Answer three questions: what you want to change, what gets in the way, how much time you have.
• Get a 60-day challenge plan of 3–6 daily non-negotiables that fits that time, starting with one habit aimed right at your biggest obstacle.

SEE IT EVERY TIME YOU PICK UP YOUR PHONE
• Lock Screen widgets: day 23 of your 60-day challenge, days left, your streak, this year's progress.
• Home Screen widgets: tick today's habits right on the widget, the 60-day ring, goal pace.
• They update at midnight and every time you tick a habit.

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
• Streaks that don't break until the day is actually over.
• Consistency and focus scores.
• Life areas: body, mind, career, money, people, spirit, with a percentage for each.
• A 60-day map of every day you showed up.

GOALS WITH A FINISH LINE
• Run 10 km, read 6 books, save $1,500: set a target and a deadline.
• Milestones along the way.
• Ahead, on track or behind, measured against a straight line to your deadline.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Free: the 60-day challenge, 3 daily habits, 1 goal, the challenge and year widgets.
• Pro: unlimited habits and goals, life areas and all widgets. Yearly with a 3-day free trial, monthly, or a one-time lifetime unlock.
• The charge date is shown before you start the trial. No surprise charges.
• Your habits stay on your phone. No account, no ads.

Subscription: Sixtyfold Pro, yearly with a 3-day free trial, or monthly. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://idenq.github.io/quietoak/sixtyfold/privacy/

name: Skeewellwe
description:
Skeewellwe is a portrait 3D drop. A frame falls down a brick shaft between two towers. Glowing pegs hang in the gap. Each peg belongs in one hole on the frame.

Drag anywhere to lean. Left and right move between the towers. Up and down move near and far. Tap when your shadow covers the live peg and it seats. Seat every peg, then land in the courtyard ring.

Four towers. Five wells on each. Morning is wide and slow. Noon mixes shapes. Dusk adds wind and spare pegs. Lamp narrows the courtyard. Grades are Wobble, Set, Snug, and True. A better grade pays stamps. Stamps open frames on the shelf: Cup, Rail, Brick, Crown, Lantern, and Bell. Each frame changes the holes, the lean, or the wind.

Long Fall is one seeded belt that keeps going. Today's Well is mixed on this device from the date. Your best stays here. Nothing is uploaded.

name: SKVO
description: SKVO Customer App is a smart and easy-to-use platform designed to simplify your laundry and dry-cleaning experience. Whether you're at home, work, or on the go, our app lets you schedule a pickup in just a few taps and get your clothes cleaned and delivered to your doorstep—fresh, neat, and on time.

name: Skyfuse: Fireworks Show Maker
description:
Light up the night sky over a city by the water. Skyfuse is a fireworks show maker with real glow, trails that linger and bangs you can feel.

TAP THE SKY
Tap anywhere and a shell rises and bursts exactly there. Press Finale for the grand ending. Peonies, willows, palms, rings, comets, crackle, hearts, Saturn shells, golden crowns and more: 18 kinds, each with its own shape and behaviour.

BUILD A SHOW ON A TIMELINE
Pick a kind, colour and size, then tap the sky while your show plays to add shells in time, or pause and place them one by one. Scrub back and forth, select a shell to remove it, and watch your show over the canals, the harbour, the bridge, the windmills, a lake or a skyline of towers.

COPY THE SHOW: 60 PUZZLES AND A SHOW OF THE DAY
Watch a show closely, then rebuild it on a grid as precisely as you can. The right kind, colour, place and moment earn three stars. Every chapter adds new kinds of fireworks and a new city. A new show of the day keeps your streak going.

SHARE A SHOW
Every show fits in a short code. Send it in any message and your friends open it in the studio.

COUNT DOWN TO MIDNIGHT
On New Year's Eve Skyfuse counts down with you and fires a finale on the stroke of twelve.

MADE TO FEEL REAL
• Glowing sparks, trails that fade slowly and smoke that lights up with every burst
• Reflections that ripple on the water
• Real recorded fireworks sounds, in stereo
• A tap of vibration on every bang (can be switched off)

FAIR AND SIMPLE
No ads, no account, no tracking. Showmaster is a one-time purchase that opens every kind and every city at once and allows shows of up to three minutes. No subscription.

A safe way to enjoy fireworks: no burns, no mess, and you can turn the sound off for your pets.

name: SL Teach Online Classes
description: Learn anywhere, anytime! SL Teach is a modern e-learning app designed for Sri Lankans living in Italy. Join live classes, access recorded lessons, download materials, and stay updated with real-time notifications. Whether you're studying school subjects or other courses, SL Teach helps you stay on track and succeed.

name: Slabwise: Card Scanner
description:
Slabwise identifies a trading card from a photo and shows its market price, with the source and the date of that price on every card.

- Pokemon: prices from TCGplayer
- Magic: The Gathering: prices from Scryfall
- Sports cards: identified by player, set and card number
- Your collection is saved on your phone with its total value

Photos are not stored on our server.

Prices are market estimates from the sources shown, not offers to buy. Slabwise is not affiliated with The Pokemon Company, Nintendo, Wizards of the Coast, TCGplayer or eBay.

Slabwise Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription that renews automatically; yearly starts with a free trial.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://slabwise.coldpress.dev/privacy

name: SlipSplit: Bill Splitter
description:
SlipSplit takes the maths out of sharing a bill. Photograph the receipt, and AI reads every item and price for you. Assign items to the people who had them, add a tip, and everyone sees exactly what they owe.

SCAN, DON'T TYPE
• Take a photo of a receipt or choose one from your library
• AI extracts the items, prices, tax, service fee and tip
• Fix or add items by hand whenever you need to

SPLIT IT YOUR WAY
• Assign each item to one person or share it between several
• Split shared items evenly or by quantity
• Add a tip for the table or per person
• Handles tax, VAT-inclusive receipts and service fees

SHARE THE RESULT
• A clear summary of what each person owes
• Send it as text to any messaging app

TRACK WHO OWES WHAT
• Keep running balances with friends, family and housemates
• Create groups for trips, households and events
• Record expenses without a receipt: paid for one, equal split or custom amounts
• Settle up when someone pays you back

SEE WHERE THE MONEY GOES
• Spending statistics and charts by category
• History of every split

SLIPSPLIT PRO
• 10 AI scans per day
• Export to PDF and CSV
• Budget tracking and alerts
• All time filters, including custom date ranges
• Unlimited history search
• Bulk archive and delete
• Data backup and restore
• No ads

The free version includes 2 AI scans per day, with bonus scans available by watching an ad.

MADE FOR EVERYONE AT THE TABLE
• 10 languages: English, Arabic, Bengali, Spanish, Hindi, Indonesian, Portuguese, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese
• Light and dark mode
• No account needed: your splits and expenses stay on your device

SUBSCRIPTIONS
SlipSplit Pro is available as a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://darkmatterdevworks.com/privacy/slipsplit
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SlopeSwap
description: You don't need to buy a snowboard. Just go to the ski resort on the opening day and pick up a set. You can change the board if the forecast changes.

name: Smart Clinic - إدارة العيادة
description:
Smart Clinic تطبيق لإدارة العيادات الطبية وعيادات الأسنان، صُمم للأطباء والسكرتارية لإدارة العمل اليومي من الهاتف بسهولة وباللغة العربية.

المميزات:
• لوحة يومية: مواعيد اليوم، قائمة الانتظار، المدفوعات والحالات التي تحتاج متابعة.
• ملفات المراجعين: بحث سريع بالاسم أو الهاتف، اتصال أو مراسلة واتساب بلمسة، وملف كامل لكل مراجع مع صورته الشخصية.
• مخطط أسنان تفاعلي: اختر السن (دائمة أو لبنية) وسجّل العلاج مباشرة.
• الحالات العلاجية: تابع الحالات قيد التنفيذ والمكتملة وغير المدفوعة مع السعر والمدفوع والمتبقي.
• المواعيد: عرض يومي وأسبوعي وشهري، حجز سريع، وإدارة طلبات الحجز الواردة من الإنترنت.
• الإشعارات: تنبيه فوري على هاتفك عند وصول طلب حجز جديد أو إضافة حالة جديدة.
• الفواتير والمدفوعات: سجّل الدفعات واعرف المحصّل والمتبقي ومن عليهم مبالغ.
• الوصفات الطبية: أنشئ وصفة واطبعها أو شاركها PDF أو عبر واتساب.
• الصور والأشعة: أضف صور المراجع والأشعة إلى ملفه من الكاميرا أو المعرض.
• مساعد ذكي اختياري: يجاوب من سجلات عيادتك (مواعيد، مراجعون، حالات، مدفوعات) لمساعدة الطاقم؛ ليس للتشخيص.
• تقارير وفواتير جاهزة للطباعة والمشاركة.
• صلاحيات حسب الدور للطبيب والسكرتير.
• واجهة عربية بالكامل مع دعم الإنجليزية والوضع الليلي.

يرتبط التطبيق بحساب عيادتك على Smart Clinic، وتبقى البيانات متزامنة بين الهاتف والويب. يمكنك إنشاء حساب عيادة جديد من داخل التطبيق.

تنبيه: Smart Clinic أداة لإدارة العيادة، ولا يقدم تشخيصاً أو نصيحة طبية. إجابات المساعد الذكي مولّدة آلياً ويجب التحقق منها قبل الاعتماد عليها.

name: Smart Cooking Ai
description:
AI turns cooking reels into easy recipes.

Saw a great dish in a reel? Share it to Smart Cooking and get a real recipe in about a minute.

• Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Facebook and any recipe website
• Ingredients with amounts, steps in a sensible order, timers built in
• Calories, protein, fat and carbs for your portion
• A calm cooking mode for the kitchen: big text, one step at a time
• Recipes sync between your iPhone and iPad through iCloud
• Rate what you cooked and find it again later

How it works
Tap Share → Smart Cooking in any app, or copy a link and paste it. The AI chef watches the video, reads the caption and writes the recipe in your language.

Crystals
Your first 3 recipes are free. After that, a recipe from a website costs 1 crystal and one from a short video costs 2. Crystals are only charged when the recipe is ready — if nothing comes out, you get them back.

name: Snake Farm: Slither Puzzle
description:
Choose the right snake and watch it munch a path through the farm.

Snake Farm is a colorful puzzle game where hungry snakes collect matching veggies. Tap a basket to send a snake onto the board, then watch it search for food in its color. Your challenge is choosing which snake to send next while keeping enough room for the rest.

A green snake might clear the veggies blocking another color. Sending too many snakes too soon can leave you with a crowded board and nowhere to go. Look at the food within reach, plan your order, and keep an eye on the capacity meter.

How to play
1. Look at the available veggies and choose a matching snake.
2. Tap its basket to send it into the level when space allows.
3. Let the snake collect its food and finish its target.
4. Keep choosing carefully until you clear the board.

name: SnapFete: Event Photo Booth
description:
Turn your iPad or iPhone into an elegant event photo booth. SnapFete runs entirely offline, so the booth keeps working at venues with no Wi-Fi.

SET UP YOUR BOOTH
• Create an event with a name, date, colors and your logo
• Choose a vertical 1×3 photo strip or a 2×2 collage
• Preview the template live and run a test session before guests arrive

TAP TO START
• Full-screen guest mode made for an iPad on a tripod
• Big countdown, three or four photos, then the finished strip
• The booth resets itself for the next guest
• Settings and the gallery are locked behind your operator PIN

MAKE BRANDED PHOTO STRIPS
• Print-ready 4×6 in JPGs at 300 dpi (two 2×6 strips per sheet)
• Print preview and the system print dialog for AirPrint printers
• Mirrored front-camera photos match what guests saw on screen

KEEP PHOTOS ORGANIZED
• Every original photo is saved before the strip is made
• Sessions grouped per event, with a live count of saved sessions
• If the app closes or the camera drops, saved photos are kept and you can finish or continue the session

EXPORT THE ENTIRE EVENT
• One ZIP with prints, strips or collages, every original photo and a session list
• Share to Files, AirDrop, WhatsApp or any app in the share sheet

FREE AND PRO
The free version includes one demo event with up to 5 sessions (watermarked) and the basic templates. SnapFete Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited events and sessions, your own logo, the Gala template, bulk export and removes ads.

PRIVACY
No account. Photos and event details stay on your device until you choose to export them. The free version shows a single banner ad on the Event Summary screen only. Guest photos are never shared with the ad network.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SneezeJump: Lane Hop
description:
SneezeJump: Lane Hop is a 2.5D platformer starring a golden clay nose. It plays like a side-scroller, but the world has three depth lanes: when the path ends in your lane, it carries on in a lane nearer the camera or farther back.

Hop between lanes on the ground or in mid-air, bounce on springs, ride moving ledges and lifts, cross crumbling ledges, dodge prickly cacti and sneeze across wide gaps. Collect pollen on the way and land on the trophy ledge to finish.

Twenty trails across four themes, Meadow Trail, Cactus Run, Clover Climb and Sneeze Sky, each round longer than the last. Every trail is tuned close to the limits of your moves, and every ledge and pollen is proven reachable.

Beat a trail's target time for a gold, silver or bronze medal. Your best run is saved as a see-through ghost to race, and each checkpoint shows whether you are ahead or behind. Practice mode makes every still ledge a checkpoint while you learn a trail.

Shot like a photographed clay miniature, with a warm studio light and hand-pressed shapes.

Play with touch, keyboard or a gamepad. Reduced motion, hints and lane fade settings are built in. The game is offline, has no ads and keeps everything on your device, and it speaks 129 languages.

Trails open one at a time as you finish them. A one-time purchase unlocks all 20 at once.

name: SnowCrest: Ski Resort Builder
description:
Build the mountain. Run the resort.

Snowcrest hands you an empty mountain, a base lodge and a modest bank balance. Where the lifts go, where the runs come down and what a ticket costs are all up to you. Get it right and the car park fills up. Get it wrong and the guests will tell you exactly why.

BUILD IT YOUR WAY
• Drag out surface lifts, chairlifts and gondolas, then paint the runs that bring skiers home.
• Shape each run: groomed cruisers, mogul fields, tree glades and terrain parks for the snowboarders.
• Add cafés, restaurants, rental shops, warming huts, ski patrol, snow cannons, a groomer garage and hotels.
• Upgrade lifts and buildings as the crowds grow.

EVERY SKIER HAS A MIND OF THEIR OWN
• Beginners, intermediates and experts each look for runs they can handle.
• Guests get hungry, cold and tired, queue for lifts, and leave when they have had enough.
• Tap anyone to see what they think of your resort.

RUN THE BUSINESS
• Set the ticket price and see how many visitors it brings, or keeps away.
• Advertise, take a loan, plan a ski race or invite a critic.
• Cope with blizzards, dry spells, powder days and lift breakdowns.
• Earn your way from one star to five.

HOST THE WINTER GAMES
Reach five stars and the Winter Games come calling. Build a grandstand, get the race course and enough hotel beds ready before opening day, then play host to three days of packed slopes. Bronze, silver or gold: how well you run it decides the medal, the prize money and how famous your resort becomes.

TEN MOUNTAINS
From the gentle Rolling Hills to the cliffs of The Fang, a volcano with a crater you can ski into, a forest where every run has to be cut, and Grand Massif: three peaks and over twice the land of any other mountain.
