A CAMPAIGN OF ELEVEN RESORTS IN TROUBLE
A resort drowning in debt. A mountain only experts can ski. A lovely little hill nobody has heard of. Fix each one before the deadline and win bronze, silver or gold.

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• Free to start: Summit Peak, the first campaign scenario and the first 15 days of a resort.
• One purchase unlocks everything, for good.
• No ads. No timers. No coins or gems.
• Your resorts follow you between your devices with iCloud.
• Plays offline. Made for iPad, and works on iPhone.

name: So-So Camera
description:
"Hodohodo Camera" is a simple and privacy-focused camera app that combines space-saving low-resolution photography with fully offline, on-device OCR (text recognition).

【Key Features】
◆ Space-Saving Low-Resolution Capture
Choose from 0.1MP, 0.3MP, 0.5MP, or 1MP resolutions. Capture photos at a lightweight size—perfect for notes, documents, and saving storage space.

◆ Secure On-Device Text Recognition (OCR)
Extract Japanese and English text from captured photos offline. All OCR processing stays on your device—your photos and text are never sent to external servers. Easily edit, copy, export as TXT, or share extracted text.

◆ Privacy-First Saving Options
Optionally remove EXIF metadata (location info, camera details) before saving photos for safe sharing on social media.

◆ Useful Management & Backup
Supports dark mode, theme customization, capture history management, and backup/restore for your settings and logs.

name: SoCal Surf Watch
description:
See live cams along the socal coast with reports of the location of the highest waves, coastal flood alerts for Southern California, from Jalama to Imperial Beach.

LIVE BEACH CAMS Watch 29 live beach cams right in the app: Ventura Harbor, Channel Islands Harbor, Anacapa Island, Malibu, Santa Monica, Venice, Manhattan, Redondo, Huntington, Oceanside, Carlsbad, La Jolla, Ocean Beach and more. Swipe from one cam to the next, sorted by distance from you.

INLAND FLOOD WATCH 12 river, creek and weather cams, including the Ventura River, Sespe Creek, Matilija Dam, Arroyo Simi and the Santa Ana River, so you can see rising water during storms.

WHERE ARE THE BIGGEST WAVES? 43 beaches ranked by wave height, right now or as the peak over the next 3 days. Filter by county, or see everything on a color-coded map.

ALERTS FOR YOUR AREA Choose your home by ZIP code, town or beach, or use your location. Surf Watch notifies you when: • waves near you reach the height you choose • big surf is forecast in the next 3 days • the National Weather Service issues a high surf, coastal flood, beach hazard or rip current alert • a very high tide could flood low-lying beaches and streets

EVERY BEACH IN DETAIL Current wave height, period and direction, a 3-day wave chart, high and low tides, and a live cam.

Free, with no account, no ads and no tracking. Wave forecasts from Open-Meteo.com, alerts from the National Weather Service, tides from NOAA, and river cams from Ventura County and the USGS.

Surf Watch is for information only and is not an official warning service. Always follow lifeguards, posted signs and the National Weather Service.

name: SOCCER 7
description:
Une application très complète, qui va vous permettre de :
- Réserver dans votre club,
- Accéder aux informations principales,
- Remplir votre Wallet avec les cartes prépayées,
- Obtenir l'information en direct,
- Suivre vos compétitions.

Et plein d'autres fonctionnalités !

name: Socotix
description:
Socotix e o aplicație de calcul mental pentru adulți care vor să-și țină mintea trează. Fără reclame, fără abonamente.

RUNDA ZILEI
15 exerciții, aceleași pentru toată țara: 5 ușoare, 5 medii, 5 grele. O singură încercare pe zi. Compară-te cu ceilalți și ține-ți seria de zile.

SPRINT
1, 3 sau 5 minute și 3 vieți. Rezolvi cât de multe poți. Exercițiile medii și grele aduc mai multe puncte.

SUPRAVIEȚUIRE
3 vieți și 5 secunde pentru fiecare exercițiu. Cât de departe ajungi?

CE GĂSEȘTI
• Exerciții pe trei niveluri: de la cele patru operații până la procente, puteri, radicali și ecuații simple
• Clasamente pentru toată România și pentru grupuri de familie sau prieteni, cu cod de invitație
• Animații, sunete și vibrații la fiecare răspuns
• Memento zilnic la ora aleasă de tine
• Fără cont cu e-mail sau parolă: doar prenumele

name: Sodaly — Sodium Tracker
description:
Salt hides before you taste it.

Up to 75% of daily sodium doesn't come from the salt shaker — it hides in bread, sauces, cheese, soups, and restaurant dishes. Sodaly gives you one calm number for the day so you can stay within your target without counting calories or weighing pinches of salt.

DESIGNED FOR CLARITY, NOT CLUTTER
• One clear daily budget based on WHO (2,000 mg / 5 g salt), AHA (1,500 mg), FDA (2,300 mg), or your doctor's custom target.
• Switch effortlessly between mg of sodium and grams of salt (1 g salt = 400 mg sodium).
• Proportional day blocks show at a glance where today's salt actually came from.

SCAN ANYTHING IN 3 SECONDS
• Store barcodes & nutrition tables: automatically converts EU/UK salt (g per 100 g) and US sodium (mg per serving) to the exact portion you ate.
• Plates & home meals: snap a photo or type a dish to see an honest range, hidden-salt breakdown, portion weight chips, and seasoning tweaks.
• Restaurant menus: photograph a menu page to see what fits your remaining budget, what to ask for with sauce on the side, and which dishes are salt traps.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
• Fix any AI estimate inline in one tap.
• Save trusted low-sodium products to your Safe List for fast re-logging.
• 30-day circle calendar and weekly culprit breakdown.
• Export a clean, print-ready Doctor PDF report (7, 14, or 30 days) showing both salt and sodium, peak days, and top sources.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account required. Your food log stays on your iPhone.

Disclaimer: Sodaly is a dietary tracking tool based on public WHO, AHA, and FDA guidelines. It does not provide medical advice or diagnosis — always follow your healthcare provider's recommendations.

name: SoDayi Ephemeris 3d
description:
SoDayi Ephemeris 3D is an interactive 3D Space, Real-Time Topobathy DEM, and Augmented Reality Flight & Roaming Simulator designed for iPhone and iPad.

KEY FEATURES:
• 5 Interactive Perspectives: Space Ephemeris (Solar System, Alpha Centauri, TRAPPIST-1), Global Earth Orbit, Local Vector, Real Geographic Topobathy GPS Map AR, and Genie 3D Worlds.
• Real Geographic Topobathy DEM: Streams real SRTM elevation and GEBCO/Copernicus bathymetry data to render 3D Marching-Squares topographic and underwater bathymetric contour lines synced to your live GPS coordinates.
• 12 Procedural 3D Augmented Reality Worlds: Explore Atlantis, Prehistoric Mammoth Valley, Neon Cyberpunk, Volcanic Magma Canyon, Black Soil Bioluminescent Planet, Ancient Sumerian Ziggurat, Eternity Neoclassical World, S.T.E.M. Campus, Deep Underwater Coral Reef, Tropical Voxel Beach, and Rainforest Waterfall.
• Live AR Camera Color-Harmonizing Filter: Blends your real-world camera feed softly with the atmospheric lighting of each virtual 3D scene.
• Clean View & Modular HUD Feature Picker: Hide all cockpit peripherals with a single tap for pure immersion, or selectively toggle individual avionics modules (360° Radar, Compass Tape, Telemetry, Waypoints, and Star Chart).
• Dual Virtual Analog iOS Touch Flight Controls: Smooth 360° analog flight/roam thumbstick, 2.4x Afterburner Boost, and vertical altitude thrusters.

name: SoftTally: Shortcuts Tracker
description:
Set it once. It keeps logging.
Shortcuts trigger. SoftTally saves counts, values, and durations.
Build a history. See the pattern.

SoftTally is a local event logger for iOS 17 and later. Choose an NFC, charger, arrival, departure, or app trigger in Apple Shortcuts, then add a SoftTally action. After that one-time setup, each trigger can save a record without opening the app.

LOG WHAT MATTERS
• Counts for recurring events
• Values for measurements
• Durations for anything you want to time

Choose sum, average, or latest for value trackers. Shortcuts can also attach a note to a record.

SIX SHORTCUTS ACTIONS
Log a count or value, time an activity, start or end a timer, or get today’s count.

HISTORY THAT STAYS USEFUL
Browse records by day, then look beyond individual entries with:
• 7-day, 30-day, and 12-week trends
• A 26-week heat map
• Time-of-day distribution
• Average interval
• Current and longest streaks

START WITH A TEMPLATE
Use one of three built-in setups: NFC medication logging, charging duration, or body weight. Each template creates the right tracker and includes setup guidance.

MAKE EACH TRACKER YOUR OWN
Add up to five custom fields to any tracker. Choose text, number, or option fields to keep the context that matters with each entry. Add missed records, or edit and delete existing ones.

LOG FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
Small and medium interactive widgets let you add records without opening SoftTally. See today’s figure and a seven-day overview at a glance.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR DATA
SoftTally stores your records locally on this device and does not upload them. There is no account, cloud sync, advertising, analytics, subscription, in-app purchase, or third-party SDK. Export all records or a single tracker as CSV whenever you choose.

Shortcuts and iOS handle automation triggers. You configure each automation once in Apple’s Shortcuts app. Some triggers depend on device support and iOS settings.

name: Soil Jar Texture
description:
Soil Jar Texture keeps one jar settlement on this iPhone. Sand, silt, and clay percentages become a USDA class.

Drag the layer marks and the class updates. Mix and Samples keep the same reading.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Somnark
description:
Somnark is a quiet dream journal for lucid-dreaming practice and reflection. Catch last night before it fades, thread the symbols that keep returning, and learn to notice when you are dreaming.

MORNING CAPTURE
Write the dream while it is still warm: a title, everything you remember, and the night it happened (dated to last night by default). Mark lucidity in four steps - not lucid, glimpse, lucid, controlled - and vividness from one to five. Tap any of twelve emotions, and tap again to make it stronger. Flag recurring dreams and nightmares.

SYMBOL THREADS
Name the people, places, objects, actions and creatures that return to your nights, and write what each one means to you. As you write a dream, Somnark spots your symbols in the words and offers them with one tap. Your symbols become a living constellation: stars sized by how often they appear, joined by thin threads to the dreams that hold them. Open any symbol to read your meaning and every dream it appears in.

SIGNS AND PATTERNS
See your recall streak and longest run, how often you become lucid month by month, the mix of feelings that colours your nights, your brightest symbols and your recurring dreams.

REALITY CHECKS
Keep your own list of reality checks - or start from five classic examples you can edit or delete. Practise one right now, and if you like, choose daily times for a gentle local reminder. Notification permission is only asked when you add a reminder time.

FIND ANY NIGHT
Full-text search across titles, dream text, symbols and emotions, with quick filters for lucid, recurring and nightmare dreams. Edit or delete anything, any time.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR WAY
Sign in with email and password to keep your journal across devices, or simply dream as a guest - no account needed. A guest can later add an email login and keep every dream. The journal works offline and syncs when you are back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your dreams are stored in your own private space and are never shared. Delete your account and every dream, symbol and check from the Pillow screen at any time.

Designed with care: two night skies to choose from, soft sounds and haptics you can switch off, and long-form reading made for the hours between sleeping and waking.

name: Sonalex
description:
Sonalex is a music player for your own Jellyfin server. Sign in with your usual Jellyfin account and get your whole library in a fast, beautiful app made for music.

YOUR LIBRARY
• Home with what you played lately, your most played songs and some to rediscover
• Artists, albums, songs, genres, playlists and favorites
• Instant search across your whole library
• Create and edit playlists, favorite a song in one tap

A REAL PLAYER
• Full-screen player in the colors of the artwork
• Synced lyrics that follow the music
• Editable queue, smart shuffle that spreads artists out
• Gapless playback
• AirPlay, lock screen, Dynamic Island

OFFLINE TOO
• Download a song, an album or a playlist to your device
• Your most played favorites download themselves

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• iPhone, iPad and a real Mac app: sidebar, keyboard shortcuts, menu bar controls

WITH THE SONALEX SERVER (OPTIONAL)
Install the free, open-source Sonalex server next to your Jellyfin to go further:
• Mix: DJ-style transitions between your songs, beat-matched, that wait for the lyrics to end
• Connect: start the music on your Mac, carry on on your iPhone, control one device from another

YOUR MUSIC STAYS HOME
Sonalex has no account, no ads and collects no data: the app only talks to your server.

Sonalex requires a Jellyfin server (free, https://jellyfin.org): yours, or one someone made you an account on. Sonalex is not affiliated with the Jellyfin project.

name: Sonofy — Hi-Fi Music Player
description:
Sonofy is a privacy-first, audiophile-grade local music player built for people who own their music. Play MP3, FLAC, ALAC, M4A, WAV, AAC, AIFF, OGG, and OPUS 100% offline with crisp embedded album artwork, zero ads, and zero tracking.

CORE FREE FEATURES (ZERO ADS)
• Native Hi-Fi Local Library: Import audio files or entire music folders via the iOS Files app or Finder File Sharing.
• Real Tag & Album Art Extraction: Reads native audio metadata (Title, Artist, Album, Genre, Year, Track #, Codec/Lossless badge) and embedded album artwork.
• Clean Organization: Browse by Songs, Albums, Artists, Genres, and Folders with instant local search.
• Playlists & Smart Mixes: Create unlimited local playlists, reorder tracks, import/export M3U playlists, Like favorite tracks, and enjoy automatic Smart Mixes (Most Played, Recently Added, Hi-Res Lossless, Forgotten Gems).
• Local Lyrics: Reads .lrc and .txt sidecar lyric files offline with optional LRCLIB synced lyrics lookup.
• Audiophile Controls: Gapless queue, swipe-to-queue, A-B section looping, Sleep Timer with smooth fade-out, Skip Silence, Car Mode, Ambient Stand Mode, Dynamic Island Live Activity, and native tactile haptics.
• Private On-Device Stats: Local listening stats & swipeable Sonofy Replay story cards that never leave your device.

SONOFY PRO (OPTIONAL UPGRADE)
• 10-Band Graphic Equalizer + Loudness Boost with curated studio presets.
• Seamless Crossfade + Speed & Pitch Lab (including Slowed & Nightcore vibes).
• 100% Offline Hum-to-Search: Hum or whistle any melody to identify songs in your local library using on-device pitch contour matching — audio is never uploaded.
• Chameleon Dynamic Themes + AMOLED Black + Custom Accents derived offline from embedded album art.
• Lyrics Share Cards & Live Lyrics Translation / Romanization.
• LAN Sync-Listen Rooms: Synchronize local music playback across nearby iPhone, Android, and Mac devices on the same Wi-Fi network.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Sonofy Pro is available as a Monthly auto-renewing subscription ($2.99/month), a Yearly auto-renewing subscription ($19.99/year with a 7-day free trial), or a one-time Lifetime Unlock ($29.99). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your iOS Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://sonofy-app.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://sonofy-app.vercel.app/terms

name: Sorta: Daily Questions
description:
Sorta is a daily question game that figures you out. Sort of.

Twice a day you get 5 quick questions. No right answers, just choices: Know the truth even if it hurts, or stay happy without knowing? Would you disappear for 5 years for $10 million? Every answer quietly nudges your hidden traits. When the set ends, Sorta tells you what you were today: sorta Sneaky, sorta Emotional, or sorta Boring.

HOW IT WORKS
• 5 new questions, twice a day
• Pick A or B. It takes a minute
• See how many people chose the same answer
• Get your title at the end of every set
• Come back at the end of the week for your weekly title

SEE HOW YOU COMPARE
After each question you see what everyone else picked. Once enough answers are in, you can also see how results split by gender, age group and country.

TITLES YOU DIDN'T ASK FOR
Sneaky or Honest. Emotional or Cold. Uptight or Chill. Loving or Savage. Boring or Wild. Old Soul or Baby. Your answers decide, and you won't see it coming.

SHARE IT
Send your title or any question to friends on WhatsApp, Instagram, or wherever you argue with people.

NO SIGN-UP
Open the app and start answering. No account, no email.

Sorta is made for fun. Titles are jokes, not psychological assessments.

Privacy Policy: https://sorta-f8e45.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://sorta-f8e45.web.app/terms

name: SOSPro24: Local Pros 24/7
description:
SOSPro24 is a classified-ads board for finding a professional in your city and neighbourhood, even when it's urgent.

SEARCH NEAR YOU
Pick country, city, area and category, or tap "Near me". Search by service or skill: plumber, electrician, locksmith, boiler repair, babysitter, caregiver, home cleaning, pet sitter, mobile hairdresser and make-up, beautician, tailor, private chef, photographer, PC repair, websites and business software, translator, tutoring, tax advisor.

SOS EMERGENCY HELP
A leak, a power cut, locked out? The SOS filter shows only professionals who say they are available for emergencies.

DIRECT CONTACT, ZERO COMMISSION
Call or message the professional on WhatsApp directly. Rates and call-out fees are set by them. SOSPro24 takes no commission and never stands in the middle.

REAL REVIEWS
One review per customer, only after signing up. The rating is calculated from the reviews. You can report an ad or block a person.

ARE YOU A PROFESSIONAL?
Post your ad for free in two minutes: area, services, rates, languages spoken and emergency availability. Your phone number is shown to registered users only.

5 LANGUAGES, 6 COUNTRIES
Italiano, English, Français, Español and Deutsch. Cities in Italy, France, Spain, the United Kingdom, Germany and Switzerland.

SOSPRO24 PREMIUM
The app is free with ads. Premium is a one-time purchase, no subscription: you support the project and get
• no ads
• saved searches you reopen with one tap
• dark theme
• unlimited favourites
• for professionals, a QR business card for your ad to print or share

SOSPro24 is not an emergency service: if a life is at risk, call 112 (999 in the UK).

Privacy: https://sospro24.com/privacy.html
Support: supporto@sospro24.com

name: Soundmory – All-Day Recorder
description:
Build an audio memory of your day from the recordings you make on Apple Watch. Your iPhone turns them into searchable transcripts and keeps them together by date.

A morning idea, an afternoon conversation, a line from rehearsal. Start and stop recording on your Watch as you go. Later, open that day on your iPhone to read what was said and hear it again.

Mark the moment
When you hear something worth coming back to, add a mark on your Watch while you record. Later, jump to the mark on your iPhone or tap a passage in the transcript to play the original audio.

Find the words you remember
Remember the phrase but not the day? Search your transcripts. Remember the day but not the words? Open that date and browse your recordings by hour.

Transcribed entirely on your iPhone
Soundmory turns speech into text on your iPhone. You can use it without an account or a cloud transcription service. To share something, copy a passage or export audio by the hour or by the day. Device backups follow your settings.

Getting started
Pair a compatible Apple Watch with your iPhone. Open Soundmory on the iPhone to receive and transcribe your recordings. Keep it open for faster transcription. On iOS 27 and later, transcription can also continue in the background when iOS allows. Transfer timing depends on connectivity and system scheduling. Recording time depends on Watch battery, available storage, and system interruptions. Record with permission.

name: Souven
description:
Some things are too meaningful to leave forgotten in a drawer.

A concert ticket from an unforgettable night. A postcard from a city you once explored. A little souvenir that brings back an entire afternoon. Souven gives these treasured objects a place of their own, turning scattered keepsakes into a personal collection filled with stories.

Capture the details behind every item, from where it came from to where you keep it. Connect your treasures to the journeys, celebrations, exhibitions, and special occasions that made them meaningful. When you want to revisit a particular experience, bring those pieces together in a digital album that lets you turn through your memories one page at a time.

Designed for people who love collecting more than objects alone, Souven celebrates the experiences attached to them. Each keepsake becomes part of a bigger picture - a journey remembered, a moment preserved, a story worth keeping.

With its dark, photo-focused aesthetic and warm, understated accents, Souven keeps the attention on what matters most: the objects you have collected and the memories they carry.

Keep the object. Remember the story. Revisit the moment.

Souven is your personal home for meaningful keepsakes, thoughtfully organized for today and cherished for years to come.

name: Soyağacım Hudhud
description:
Soyağacım Pro aboneliği ve tek seferlik satın alma seçenekleriyle sınırsız aile bireyi ekleyebilir, Excel (.xlsx) ve PDF raporu alabilirsiniz.
• Aile bireylerini ekleyin, ebeveyn-çocuk ve eş ilişkilerini kolayca kurun
• Kişi kartlarına fotoğraf, ses kaydı, doğum/vefat bilgileri ve özel notlar ekleyin
• Aile ağacınızı etkileşimli görünümle inceleyin ve yakınlarınızla paylaşın
• Tüm aile verileriniz tamamen cihazınızda, internet bağlantısı olmadan güvenle saklanır
• Hesap oluşturma veya abonelik gerektirmeyen sade ve ücretsiz kullanım

Kullanım Koşulları (EULA):https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/tr/terms.html
Gizlilik Politikası: https://hudhudapps.com/soyagacim-gizlilik.html

name: SP-PEMS
description:
WHO IT’S FOR
• Residents with an assigned room / unit account
• Visitors exploring projects and requesting visits (sign in with Apple or Google)

RESIDENT FEATURES
• Sign in with your room credentials
• View your unit dashboard and switch between rooms when you have more than one
• Check utility usage and billing history (electricity, generator, water)
• Open invoices and upload payment proof when required
• Create and track service or complaint tickets, including photo attachments
• Browse facilities and submit facility-related requests (for example gym access or parking)
• Manage household occupants (subject to building approval where required)
• Register visitor entries and vehicles for parking access
• Read announcements and notifications
• Reach Smart Parami Call Center for help and password assistance
• Update profile details, emergency contact, and language (English / Myanmar)

VISITOR FEATURES
• Browse available projects and units
• Save favorites and request a visit
• Sign in with Apple or Google

SUPPORT
Hotline: 01 470 5959
Email: callcenter@smartparami.com.mm

name: Spacer: Compress Videos
description:
Videos fill up an iPhone faster than anything else. A minute of 4K can take 400 to 800 MB, and a lot of that is space the picture doesn't need.

Spacer goes through your library, finds the videos worth shrinking, and makes a smaller copy of each one. Same resolution, same frame rate, same color, HDR and Dolby Vision kept. Sound is copied untouched.

HOW IT WORKS

• Spacer shows which videos are worth compressing and roughly how much each will save.
• You pick the videos, or take them all.
• Every copy is checked against its original before Spacer calls it done. A copy that doesn't pass is thrown away.
• You compare original and copy side by side, and delete the originals only if you're happy. Spacer never deletes anything on its own.

ONE SLIDER FOR SIZE AGAINST QUALITY

The default is hard to tell apart from the original unless you zoom in. Move it one way for copies with no visible difference, the other way for the smallest files.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT CAN'T DO

Not every video shrinks. Videos from chat apps and many recorded at normal settings are already small, and Spacer says so instead of making a worse copy. The biggest savings are on phones that record at high quality settings, like 4K at 60 fps on recent Pro models, where videos often come out at less than half the size.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no upload, no ads, no tracking. Spacer has no server.

GOOD TO KNOW

• Needs iOS 26 or later.
• Compression runs while the app is open. Keep it on screen for long videos.
• Slo-mo, Cinematic, spatial, time-lapse and edited videos are left alone for now.
• Deleted originals stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days, like anything you delete in Photos.

name: Spelling Practice for Kids
description:
Spelling test on Friday? The app reads each word aloud, your child writes it. Start right away with ready-made word lists in five levels, or type in the words from school.

The app is made for children from about 6 to 11. It makes a new word list whenever you want one, and it works with any list of your own: the words from school, tricky words, or the vocabulary of a foreign language.

THREE STEPS TO THE TEST
1. Listen and spell: the app dictates the word, slowly and clearly. Your child has one try, then the app shows at once whether it was right. A mistake is marked letter by letter, with the right spelling below it. Words that were wrong come back at the end.
2. Look and copy: the word is shown, then hidden while your child writes it from memory.
3. Test: like at school. Every word is dictated once, and the result comes at the end, word by word.

NEW WORD LISTS IN FIVE LEVELS
• Five levels of difficulty, from first words to words that adults get wrong
• A new list of ten words with one tap, as often as you like, not just once a week
• Choose the level at the first start and change it at any time
• 250 words per level in each language

YOUR OWN WORD LISTS
• As many lists as you like, up to 40 words each
• Type the words or paste them, separated by commas
• Tap a word to hear how the voice says it
• Every list remembers which words went well, and its best test

A KEYBOARD THAT DOES NOT HELP
Your child writes on the app's own keyboard, with large keys in alphabetical order. It corrects nothing, suggests nothing and completes nothing, so what is written is what your child knows. Capital letters count.

NINE LANGUAGES FOR THE WORDS
English (US and UK), German, Spanish (Spain and Mexico), French, Italian, Dutch and Portuguese (Brazil). Each has its voice and its own letters on the keyboard, and every list has its own language. That makes the app a good fit for bilingual families and for foreign-language vocabulary.

MADE FOR CHILDREN
• No ads
• No tracking, no account
• The word lists stay on the device

SUBSCRIPTION
The app can be tried free for one month. After that it continues as a monthly subscription; the price is shown before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://mind5.com/apps/spelling_test/en/privacy.html

name: Spendlio Expense Manager
description:
Take control of your personal finances with an intuitive daily expense tracker, monthly budget planner, and wallet manager. Whether you want to curb overspending, record daily transactions, plan for savings goals, or monitor multiple cash accounts, this app provides the tools you need to master your money.
Effortlessly log income and expenses in seconds, calculate spending trends, and visualize exactly where your money goes each month.
Key Features & Daily Tools
Quick Expense & Income Logging: Record daily transactions in seconds with custom categories, tags, payment methods, and notes.
Monthly Budget Planner: Set realistic spending limits for groceries, bills, entertainment, and shopping to stay on track all month.
Smart Budget Calculator: Track your remaining balance in real time and receive instant warnings before you overspend.
Multi-Wallet & Account Manager: Organize multiple accounts in one place—cash in hand, bank accounts, credit cards, and digital wallets.
Tally & Daily Expense Records: Keep a clean, chronological tally of all incoming and outgoing cash flows.
Interactive Spending Analytics: Understand your financial habits through dynamic pie charts, monthly breakdown graphs, and cash flow reports.
Built for Every Financial Goal
Daily Life & Household Budgeting: Keep household spending, grocery bills, and utility payments strictly organized.
Personal Savings & Debt Reduction: Pinpoint unnecessary spending leaks and allocate more funds toward savings targets.
Freelancers & Side Hustles: Monitor project-by-project earnings, reimbursable business expenses, and client receipts.
Students & Young Professionals: Build sustainable financial habits from your first paycheck with straightforward spending limits.
Detailed Management Features
Custom Categories & Organization
Create tailored expense and income categories with distinct icons and colors.
Add merchant names, detailed transaction notes, and payment mode tags.
Filter records instantly by date, category, account, or transaction type.
Insightful Financial Reports
View monthly, weekly, and yearly spending summaries.
Compare current spending against previous months to gauge budget health.
Export clean transaction records for accounting and tax preparation.
Privacy & Usability First
Fast, lightweight entry with a distraction-free interface.
Support for multiple international currencies.
Complete data security—your personal financial records remain strictly private.

name: Spinobon Galaxy Fun Center
description:
Explore a futuristic entertainment complex with a convenient app designed to help you discover attractions, organize activities, order food, and enjoy interactive challenges.

Browse themed bowling lanes, choose your preferred date, time, session duration, and number of players, and receive a QR code for your reservation. Discover laser tag arenas, explore different game modes, select available sessions, and manage your bookings in one place.

Explore a variety of food options, including burgers, pizzas, snacks, drinks, and desserts. Customize your selections, add items to your cart, and receive a QR code for convenient food pickup.

Complete interactive challenges, collect virtual Galaxy Points, unlock achievements, and track your progress through different levels. Use the interactive map to find bowling lanes, laser tag arenas, dining areas, event spaces, and visitor facilities.

Stay informed about upcoming bowling tournaments, laser tag competitions, themed parties, and entertainment shows. Browse event details, check schedules, and reserve places using QR tickets.

All reservations and food orders can be managed without account registration or providing personal information. Keep your QR confirmations organized and easily accessible within the app.

Discover attractions, plan your activities, and enjoy a convenient entertainment experience in one place.

Galaxy Points are virtual achievements with no monetary value.

name: Splat: Baby Food Tracker
description:
Every food your baby tries lands on their high-chair tray as a splat. Banana, peas, salmon, peanut: each one looks like itself, and each one stays. By their first birthday, the tray is a picture of everything they tasted.

Logging takes a few seconds. Tap the food, tap how it went (loved it, not sure, refused) and throw it. It falls, hits the tray with a soft thud and settles into a shape no other splat has. Loved it lands big. Refused leaves the piece sitting next to a small mark, the way it really goes.

No sign-up, no account, nothing to set up. Open it at the table with one hand free.

FREE, AND COMPLETE ON ITS OWN
• The tray, with every food you log
• A list of 100 foods to tick off, and a count of how many they have tried
• A ring on foods that contain one of the nine major allergens, so you can see which ones you have logged and how often
• Reaction notes with photos, kept on the food they belong to
• Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets with this week's count
• A gentle Monday reminder that names three foods from the list you have not logged yet

ONE PAYMENT, NOTHING RENEWS
• Watch the tray fill: every splat lands again in the order it was tried, with the dates ticking by, and saves as a video to keep or send to the grandparents
• The poster: the whole tray as a file to print or frame, in a choice of styles
• Your own allergen plan: pick a target and the days you want a reminder
• A second caregiver: send them the tray as a file, and opening it in Splat on their phone brings in your foods and notes
• A tidy PDF of every food and note, to bring to your paediatrician

WHAT SPLAT IS NOT
Splat keeps count. It does not tell you what to feed, when, or how to prepare it, and it gives no medical advice. For those questions, ask your family's health professional.

Splat keeps everything on your phone: no account, no ads, no tracking, and nothing is sent to us.

name: Spoke Pair
description:
Spoke Pair keeps a toy wheel honest.

Tap a spoke and it takes one turn. The rim pulls toward that spoke. The opposite spoke has to take the same number of turns before the pair is even. Close the pass only when both pairs match and every spoke has left zero. If a pair is uneven, or a spoke is still at zero, the close is refused and the turns stay. Abandon throws away only the turns in this pass.

You can rename the wheel and the four spokes, delete a wheel, and share a four-line summary.

Wheels stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not turn a real wheel.

name: Spokenote: AI Voice Notes
description:
Spokenote turns your voice into clear notes, summaries and to-dos — privately, on your device.
Transcripts and AI summaries are made on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Nothing is uploaded: no account, no servers, no tracking.
Record a meeting, lecture, interview or idea and get the words, the key points and the action items.

RECORD WITHOUT WORRY
• One big record button, live waveform and live transcript
• Keeps recording with the screen locked or in another app; saved in pieces, so a crash never loses your note
• Memo, Meeting, Lecture and Music modes; bookmarks, pause and resume
• Start from the Lock Screen, Control Center, a widget or Siri

SUMMARY · TRANSCRIPT · CHAT
• Every note opens on three views: Summary, Transcript and Chat
• Summaries appear as they are written, step by step
• Templates for meetings, lectures, memos, stand-ups, interviews, sales calls, sermons and more — or Auto picks one,
  or write your own; choose from brief to detailed
• Action items with the moment they were said
• Speaker labels (beta): see who said what, rename speakers, and let your own voice label your lines
• Chat with a recording: ask a question, get an answer from its transcript
• Transcript as paragraphs, timeline, lines or clean read; tap any word to hear that moment
• Translate a summary on your device
• Transcripts in your language, detected automatically

CREATE WITH ON-DEVICE AI
• Meeting minutes, email, to-do list, study notes, flashcards, blog post and more — formatted and ready to share
• Smart titles for every recording

ASK YOUR NOTES
• Ask a question across all your recordings and get an answer with the notes it came from
• Live translate: speak and see the translation as you talk, on your device

TO-DO
• Action items from all your notes in one To-do tab, plus your own tasks
• Send them to Reminders, or tick them on your Apple Watch

IMPORT ANYTHING
• Audio and video from Files, Photos or any app's share sheet
• PDF, Word and text documents, photos and scanned pages (text is read on your device) — then summarize or chat with them

SHARE YOUR WAY
• Summary, transcript or both as PDF, Word or text, or print
• Hide timestamps for a clean copy
• Audio as M4A

BACKUP ON YOUR TERMS
• Optional sync through your own iCloud Drive
• Save a copy of your notes to any folder in Files

ORGANIZE AND FIND
• Folders, tags and favourites; filters and bulk actions
• Recently Deleted keeps deleted notes for 30 days
• Search titles, transcripts and summaries and jump to the moment a word was said
• Playback speed, skip silence, trim, loop and A–B repeat

VOICE STUDIO
• 72 voice effects — robot, chipmunk, deep voice, cathedral, radio and more — save or share

APPLE WATCH
• Record on your wrist with one tap, or from a complication
• Recordings go to your iPhone by themselves and are transcribed and summarized there
• See your latest notes and short summaries on your Watch

IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
• A native app on each, with a sidebar on bigger screens
• On Mac, record a call with both sides: your microphone plus the call's sound
• Name recordings after the meeting in your calendar (optional)
• Face ID lock, light and dark mode, 10 accent colours

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Spokenote collects no data. Recording, transcription and AI run on your device. If you turn on iCloud sync, your notes go to your own iCloud, which we can't read.

AI summaries, chat and Create need a device with Apple Intelligence turned on. Recording, transcription, search and everything else work on every supported device.

Please get consent before recording other people where the law requires it.

name: Spon Better Trinitix
description:
Bring your swim, bike and run training together in one personal diary. Spon Better Trinitix helps you organize your week, record completed sessions and review your progress toward race day.

LOG YOUR TRAINING
Enter swim, bike, run and brick workouts manually. Save duration, distance, effort and notes so you can remember how each session felt.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Build a weekly training plan and mark completed sessions done to add them to your diary. Keep your next race in view with a race countdown.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Browse your workout history, review training totals and discover achievements as your diary grows.

SHARE A PDF
Create a PDF of an individual workout or a training report. Use the system share sheet to save it or send it to someone you choose, such as your coach.

KEEP YOUR DIARY ON YOUR DEVICE
Workouts, plans and preferences are stored locally. Use the app offline without creating an account.

Designed for adults training for triathlon, on iPhone and iPad.

name: Spoolprism
description:
Spoolprism helps you find 3D printer filament in the exact color you need, choose a printer you won't outgrow, and fix prints that go wrong.

Match a color
Type a color code, a color name or a hex value, pick a color from a photo, or point your camera at something and match it live. Spoolprism ranks real filament from the major brands by how close it looks to the eye, and tells you how close each one is.

Choose a printer
Answer a few questions or filter by budget, enclosure, multi-color, materials and build size. Compare two or three printers side by side, with the differences marked.

Fix failed prints
Step-by-step guides for stringing, warping, poor bed adhesion, clogs and more, with fixes for your own printer. Describe the problem or add a photo, and Diagnose with AI suggests what to try first.

Handy tools
Work out what a print costs, get starting settings for your printer and filament, keep track of your spools, and find parts that the maker confirms will fit.

Works offline
Once you've opened Spoolprism, color matching, your saved picks, the spool tracker, the guides and the tools keep working without a connection.

No account needed. Your saved lists, spools and settings stay on your phone.

Store buttons open the maker's own store in Safari. Spoolprism may earn a commission from some of them at no extra cost to you.

name: Sport Field
description:
Bienvenue dans l'application officielle Sportfield – le programme de fidélité de vos clubs de padel à Paris, Lyon et La Rochelle.

GAGNEZ DES POINTS À CHAQUE PARTIE
Chaque minute sur le terrain compte : gagnez des points à chaque partie. Profitez aussi de nos promotions, comme les Happy Hours où vos points sont doublés.

DÉBLOQUEZ DES RÉCOMPENSES
Échangez vos points contre des récompenses : un tube de balles neuf, des réductions sur vos prochaines réservations Anybuddy, une heure offerte et bien plus. Découvrez aussi les offres de nos partenaires.

RELEVEZ DES DÉFIS
Gagnez des points bonus en laissant un avis sur Google, en nous suivant sur Instagram, TikTok et LinkedIn, ou en parrainant vos amis.

MONTEZ EN NIVEAU
Progressez dans les niveaux de fidélité au fil de vos parties et multipliez vos points. Suivez vos points, vos récompenses et votre progression en un coup d'œil.

RÉSERVEZ EN QUELQUES SECONDES
Trouvez un créneau et réservez votre terrain directement depuis l'application.

RESTEZ INFORMÉ
Recevez des notifications sur les nouvelles récompenses, les promotions et les événements Sportfield.

Téléchargez l'application, créez votre compte et commencez à gagner des points dès votre prochaine partie.

name: SportPoint Move It
description:
Make your next movement break count. SportPoint Move It brings short interval workouts and a personal progress journal together in one place.

CHOOSE YOUR ROUTINE
Explore six routines with bodyweight exercises and clear instructions. See what is coming before you start, then follow the work and rest intervals at your own pace.

STAY WITH THE SESSION
Use an easy-to-read timer to move through each exercise. Pause when you need a break and resume when you are ready.

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS
Completed workouts become journal entries automatically. Add an optional note, revisit past sessions, and see your activity statistics. Milestones give your practice something to build toward.

MADE FOR YOUR DEVICE
Use SportPoint Move It offline on iPhone and iPad. Your workout history, notes, and preferences stay on your device. Adjust haptics and reset your local workout history in Settings.

The app is completely free, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases. No account is required.

name: Sports&Make Friend - Gaga
description:
GAGA is an 18+ skateboarding community. Discover skate clips, explore skate spots, and RSVP for sessions. Browse skater profiles, follow people who share your interests, and start a private chat when you follow each other.

Watch recorded skate sessions and join the conversation in the replay room

name: SportsCity Health Corner
description: Bu uygulama ile spor salonuna giriş çıkışlarınızı kolayca yönetin. QR kod ile hızlıca giriş yapın, üyelik bilgilerinizi görüntüleyin ve güncel kalın. Spor salonu deneyiminizi bir üst seviyeye taşıyın!

name: Spot Slip
description:
Spot Slip is for the moment a shirt still has a stain and someone else is about to take it.

Name the shirt. Choose wool, cotton, or silk. Drag the pin onto the collar, the chest, the cuff, or the hem. Name the stain in your own words. Write your name and how to reach you. Spot Slip writes a one-page slip on this iPhone and opens the share sheet so you can hand that page over. The file stays on the phone after you close the sheet. Slips you have already written are listed under Slips kept here.

Spot Slip does not tell you how to wash the stain, does not book a cleaner, and does not place a call or open a map. The contact is only a line on the slip.

name: Squad Angê
description:
Para as influenciadoras da Angê: acompanhe cada venda feita com o seu cupom, na hora em que ela acontece.

VENDEU? O APP AVISA
Receba uma notificação a cada pedido pago com o seu cupom, com o valor da venda e a sua comissão.

SEU DESEMPENHO SEMPRE À MÃO
• Vendas, pedidos, peças vendidas e ticket médio do período
• Comissão recebida e comparação com o período anterior
• Vendas por semana para ver o seu ritmo

METAS, DISPUTAS E PRÊMIOS
• Desafios da marca com recompensas de verdade
• Quanto falta para bater cada meta
• Disputas entre influenciadoras e a sua posição no ranking

TUDO DA MARCA EM UM SÓ LUGAR
• Comunicados e lançamentos assim que saem
• Pedidos de conteúdo com o que foi combinado
• Dicas práticas para criar conteúdo e vender mais
• Seu link e seu cupom prontos para divulgar

Acesso exclusivo para influenciadoras cadastradas no programa da Angê. Entre com o e-mail do seu cadastro e receba um código de acesso, sem senha.

name: Squish Swap: Trade Table
description:
Collect squishies. Squish them. Trade them with friends.

Squish Swap brings the trade table kids already love to iPhone and iPad. Put your squishies on your side, your friend puts theirs on the other, and each of you answers with a red X, Add More, or a green check. When you both press the check, the squishies swap.

COLLECT
• 88 collectibles to find, from Common to super rare Mythic: squishies, food squishies like butter sticks and carrots, gooey balls, gel cubes that light up, clickers and pop pads, plus glitter and glow-in-the-dark ones
• Every squishy has its own points, squishiness and slow-rise
• Press any of them to squish, click or pop it
• Fill your Squishy Book and show off your closet
• Pick any collectible as your avatar, the face your friends see

TRADE WITH FRIENDS
• Pick your own username and add friends by theirs
• Friends have to accept before you can trade
• Each friend trades from their own iPhone or iPad
• The W, F, L meter shows whether a trade is fair
• Any change to the table clears both checks, so nobody can swap at the last second
• Trade live, or take turns: make your offer, and your friend answers the next time they play
• Friends get a notification when it is their turn (only if a grown-up allows notifications)
• A green dot shows which friends are playing right now

PRACTICE
• Practice with Pip, who has every squishy, even Mythics
• Practice with a friend sitting next to you, no username needed
• Practice never changes your closet

FREE DAILY GIFT
• Open a free gift every day. The odds are always shown.

SQUISHY SHOP AND SQUISH CLUB
• The shop sells exact squishies, never mystery boxes
• A new Rare, Epic and Legendary pick every day, plus a limited squishy each week
• Squish Club is an optional monthly subscription: a second free gift every day and a members-only squishy every month. It renews automatically until cancelled in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

MADE FOR KIDS AND PARENTS
• No chat, no ads, no tracking
• No sign-up, email or password: just a username
• Every purchase needs a grown-up, and Ask to Buy works too
• Parents can turn off friends and real trades, or delete all data, from the For Grown-ups screen

name: Squishy Castle Clash
description:
Collect cute Squishy cards, build a deck and win quick, fair card battles!

Squishy Castle Clash is a collectible card battler set in the Squishy Castle world. Every Squishy is a card with six stats: Power, Defence, Speed, Magic, Cuteness and Luck. Pick your best stat, beat your rival's card and win the round.

* COLLECT 200 SQUISHIES
Fill your album across 20 themes, from Bakery Bites and Unicorn Meadow to Dream Dragons. Cards come in four rarities, Common, Uncommon, Rare and Legendary, each with its own gem shape.

* FULL ART CARDS
Every Rare and Legendary Squishy has a rare Full Art version, with the artwork stretching across the whole card and slightly better stats. Can you find all 60?

* RIP OPEN PACKS
Tear open a pack, flip the cards one by one and see if a Legendary shines through. Lucky Stars guarantee a Legendary after a run of bad luck. Turn spare cards into Stardust and make the ones you're missing.

* LOTS OF WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic Clash: quick five-round stat battles against computer rivals, from Easy to Champion.
• Squishy Showdown: secret picks, big reveals and theme combos with a 10-card deck.
• Battle Kingdom adventure: travel through five castle zones, clear every region and beat each zone's boss.
• Squishy Arena: climb an offline ladder of 15 rivals, each with their own personality.
• Pass & Play: two players take turns on one device.
• Daily Puzzle: a new set hand every day. Find the right card for every round!

* SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
A free pack every 24 hours, daily goals, streak bonuses and a streak shield that saves one missed day. Earn trophies, card mastery and rewards on the free reward track as you go.

* FAIR BY DESIGN
• Card packs are only ever opened with coins you win by playing. Packs and coins can never be bought with real money, and the pack odds are shown in the game.
• No pay-to-win: there's nothing to buy that makes your cards stronger.
• No chat and no online play: nobody can contact your child through the game.

* MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Made for children aged 6 to 15.
• Settings, purchases and links that leave the game sit behind a grown-ups gate.
• Grown-ups can set an optional break reminder and a daily play limit.
• Music and sound effects have their own volume sliders.
• No account and no sign-in. Your collection is saved on your device.

ADS AND THE ONE PURCHASE
The game is free and paid for by ads. Child-friendly, non-personalised ads may appear between play sessions, never during a battle or pack opening. You can also choose to watch a short video for bonus coins; nothing is lost if you don't. A one-off "Remove ads" purchase turns off all ads, and "Restore purchases" brings it back on a new device. That's the only thing for sale.

Privacy policy: https://mablogic.com/legal/squishy-castle-clash/privacy-policy/
Questions or feedback: enquiries@mablogic.com

name: Stacky Line
description:
Stacky Line is a crisp, one-tap arcade timing game built around pure rhythm and focus. Watch each moving segment glide toward your path, tap at the split-second it aligns, and stretch your line as far as your reflexes can carry you.

Miss the mark and your segment trims down; nail consecutive alignments to keep your momentum alive. No accounts, no pop-up ads, and no in-app purchases—just immediate, offline arcade flow whenever you have a spare minute.

name: Stage Timer: countdown timer
description:
Stage Timer is a clean, distraction-free countdown clock built for speakers, moderators, and live events. Turn any iPhone or iPad into a professional stage timer — no ads, no clutter, just the time you need on screen.

WHY STAGE TIMER?
• Fullscreen display — readable from across the room
• Color-coded phases & overtime — signal pace changes at a glance (on time, good pace, watch time, final minutes, overtime)
• Live Activities & Dynamic Island — track your running timer from the Lock Screen
• Multiple saved timers — create, reorder, and duplicate presets for talks, panels, rehearsals, and workshops
• Live stage controls — pause, reset, or adjust ±15s / ±1 min in one tap
• Background alerts — receive phase-change and timer-finished notifications even outside the app

CUSTOMIZE EVERY DETAIL
• Progress bar: horizontal, vertical, fullscreen fill, or hidden
• Visual segment markers: dots or blocks below the countdown
• Display size from XS to XXL — perfect for iPhone, iPad, or stage monitors
• Light, dark, or system theme
• Classic countdown or minutes-only view
• Flash and haptic cues when phases change

STAGE TIMER PRO (OPTIONAL UPGRADE)
• Remote Display — mirror any running countdown live via a secure HTTPS link & QR code in any browser, with automatic offline local Wi-Fi fallback
• Unlimited custom timers — save as many custom presets as your event schedule needs
• Custom phase colors — personalize segment colors for every phase

BUILT FOR REAL EVENTS
Whether you're hosting a conference, moderating a panel, rehearsing a keynote, or timing a live stream, Stage Timer gives you a reliable, professional countdown with zero ads.

Privacy Policy: https://etnatech.it/stagetimer/privacypolicy#en
Terms of Use: https://etnatech.it/stagetimer/terms#en

name: Stalowy Horyzont
description:
Steel Horizon is a vertical arcade shooter. Fly across the entire playfield, dodge enemy fire, and collect field upgrades. Fill the mission gauge to summon the boss, then catch the reward to upgrade your weapons for the next flight.

• 30 missions across six locations, with 18 types of obstacles from moving cranes to pulse gates.
• Seven unlockable aircraft, including the X-6 Phantom, a sixth-generation jet immune to homing missiles in the game.
• Upgradable weapons, EMP, and a rare reflective shield that sends shots back at their source.
• English and Polish interfaces. Toggle music, sound effects, and hit haptics independently.

Play offline. Progress and the leaderboard are stored on your device.

name: Standup: AI Team Management
description:
Standup brings your team's whole day into one app: what everyone is working on, what's blocked, what's next, and AI teammates that help get it done.

AI TEAMMATES THAT ASK FIRST
• Add AI teammates to your teams: a developer, QA tester, analyst, researcher, facilitator and more.
• Hand them a task and they plan the work, draft test scenarios, review code or research a question.
• Nothing is published or changed without a person's approval. Review the plan, ask for changes or approve it from your phone.
• Daily digests and weekly summaries tell you what moved and what needs attention.

MY DAY
• Check in, see your focus list and what's due soon.
• Finish your day with a short update for each of your teams.
• Catch up on today's meetings and everything that changed on your tasks.

STANDUPS IN MINUTES
• Walk through every update person by person: what they completed, today's focus and blockers.
• See who is on leave and when they are back, so nobody is chased for an update.

TASKS, ISSUES AND SPRINTS
• List or board views, filters for team, assignee, due date and blocked work.
• Rich descriptions, comments with mentions, labels, estimates and repeating tasks.
• Sprints, projects and products, kept in step with the web.

CHAT
• Channels for every team, direct messages and threads.
• Reactions, photos, files and voice notes.

MEETINGS
• Schedule, join and host video calls in the app.
• Recordings, transcripts, notes and action items.

INBOX
• Mentions, approvals, leave requests and AI work that needs you, with snooze and notification settings.

PEOPLE, LEAVE AND MORE
• Team directory, leave requests and approvals, holidays and a company calendar.
• Docs, audio notes and training videos.
• For admins: invitations, roles, finance, payroll records, hiring and contracts.

Standup works with your Standup workspace. Everything you do in the app shows up on the web straight away, with the same permissions. New to Standup? Create an account right in the app.

name: StarHatch: Dragon Match
description:
Match stars, earn power-ups and help a baby dragon find its way home across the galaxy!

StarHatch is a bright, relaxing match-3 puzzle adventure with thousands of levels, dazzling power-ups and a whole kingdom to build.

MATCH & BLAST
• Swap stars to match 3 or more
• Match a 2x2 square for a Supernova, 4 in a line for a Meteor shower, 5 for Dragon Fire, 6 for a Rainbow and 7+ for Wildfire
• Swap two power-ups together for huge combos: twin novas, rainbow vortexes, fire tornadoes!

A DRAGON'S STORY
• Follow Hatch, a little dragon, through galaxies full of surprises
• Beat bosses, crack cosmic dice, free caged stars and clear nebula gas

BUILD THE DRAGON KINGDOM
• Every win earns gold bricks; play your best for dragon scales
• Build the Dragon's Nest, the Castle and the glowing Moon Garden

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Start levels with power-ups, keep a win streak for free boosters and gift boxes
• Daily Spin, daily missions, a Dragon Bank and a Galaxy Pass full of rewards
• Earth Tour: visit 30 wonders of the world and fill your passport
• Brain Zone: quick quizzes and word puzzles between levels

PLAY TOGETHER
• Join a clan, share energy and chase weekly prizes together
• Race friends in 1v1 duels, climb the Country Cup for your flag

MAKE IT YOURS
• Collect tile sets: dragon eggs, tiny planets, neon signs, candy and seasonal sets
• Try every effect and background before you buy it

Play in 17 languages, including English, العربية, Español, Français, Deutsch, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, Português, Türkçe, Русский and more.

StarHatch is free to play and has no ads. Some items can be bought with real money; you can turn off in-app purchases in your device settings. An internet connection is needed for clans, duels and leaderboards.

Terms of Service: https://hivefixa.com/starhatch/terms/

name: StashReady
description:
StashReady builds an emergency kit checklist for your household and helps you keep it fresh.

Pick your state, the hazards you care about (hurricane, earthquake, power outage, winter storm) and who lives in your home. StashReady suggests what to keep on hand, based on Ready.gov guidance, and works out amounts such as water for the number of people and days.

HOW IT WORKS
• Answer a few questions: state, hazards, household and days of supplies (3 or 14).
• Get a checklist grouped by category, with the reason each item is on the list.
• Mark what you bought. Enter the date printed on the package if it has one.
• See what is expiring soon on the Expiring tab, and get a reminder 30 days before a replace date and the day after it.

YOUR KIT STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
• No account and no sign-up. The app never asks for your name or email.
• Your saved kit, your dates and your notes are stored on your iPhone and shown without a network connection.
• Reset all data in Settings removes them from the device.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Items follow Ready.gov guidance.
• Free. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads and no tracking.
• Each item can open an Amazon search in your browser, so you choose the exact product yourself. StashReady sells nothing and shows no prices.
• As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

name: Steig
description:
Wandern mit Karten, die auch ohne Netz funktionieren.

Steig ist ein Offline-GPS-Rekorder und Kartenbetrachter für Wanderungen. Du bringst die Karte mit — ein PMTiles-Archiv, ein OpenStreetMap-Auszug, ein Tourismus-Paket oder ein USGS/USFS-GeoTIFF — und Steig rendert sie auf dem Gerät, mit Live-Position, Kompass und Höhenprofil darüber.

在沒有訊號的地方也能用地圖健行。

Steig 是離線優先的健行 GPS 記錄與離線地圖檢視工具。地圖由你提供——PMTiles 封存、OSM 擷取、旅遊局地圖包，或 USGS/USFS 的 GeoTIFF——Steig 在裝置上呈現，並疊上即時位置、指南針與海拔曲線。

向量地圖，在手機上繪製 直接匯入 PMTiles，得到的是真正的地圖而不是一張圖片：Protomaps 向量圖磚以內建樣式呈現，每個縮放層級都有地名、POI 與道路分級，標籤支援中文、英文、德文或日文。點陣 PMTiles、MBTiles（點陣或向量）、XYZ 圖磚資料夾與 GeoTIFF DEM 同樣支援；有高程模型時，Steig 會在裝置上產生地形陰影與等高線。

天生離線 不附帶任何地圖資料，也不連接圖磚伺服器——連地圖樣式、字型與圖示都內建在應用程式裡。健行紀錄、路線、匯入的地圖與設定都留在 iPhone 上。沒有帳號、沒有分析統計、沒有廣告、沒有任何網路請求。

隨時知道你在哪裡 藍色光點與朝向三角在開始記錄前就顯示你的位置，HUD 還有即時 GPS 精度。點擊指南針可在「正北朝上 ↔ 行進朝上」之間切換；拖動地圖後，按準星按鈕立刻回到自己。

記錄健行 每隔數秒取樣 GPS，並批次寫入以節省電力。海拔與爬升由 GPS 與氣壓計融合，避免把雜訊算成爬升。自動暫停會在你休息時停止移動計時，HUD 會顯示自動暫停——依健行調校，緩慢上坡仍計為移動時間。

跟隨路線 匯入 GPX 路線，或把歷史健行轉為路線並固定在圖上作為參考：進度、剩餘距離與高度差疊在即時軌跡上。偏離超過 30 公尺震動一次，超過 100 公尺震動兩次，並每 5 分鐘重複，直到回到路線。路線已載入且尚未開始記錄時，下方四格顯示該路線的距離、爬升、移動時間與總時長，而不是四個 0——出發前就能知道這條軌跡的底細。

健行之後 距離、時間、移動時間、爬升與下降、平均配速、每公里配速與可拖曳的海拔剖面；月度彙總與距離／爬升圖表。可匯出 GPX 軌跡與路線、分享即時位置，或將整個資料庫備份為單一檔案。

隱私、輕量 無帳號、無追蹤、無廣告、無連網。支援繁體中文、簡體中文、英文、德文與日文。

導航僅供參考：匯入的地圖可能過期，惡劣天氣下 GPS 可能失準。請務必攜帶紙本地圖或第二種導航方式。


Offline von Grund auf Steig kommt ohne Kartendaten und kontaktiert keinen Kachel-Server — auch nicht für Kartenstil, Schriften oder Symbole. Wanderungen, Routen, importierte Karten und Einstellungen bleiben auf dem iPhone. Kein Konto, keine Analyse, keine Werbung, keine Netzwerkanfragen.

Immer wissen, wo du bist Der blaue Leuchtpunkt mit Richtungskegel zeigt deine Position, bevor du startest, samt aktueller GPS-Genauigkeit im HUD. Tippe auf den Kompass für Norden oben ↔ Fahrtrichtung oben und auf das Fadenkreuz, um nach dem Verschieben zurückzuspringen.

Wanderung aufzeichnen GPS-Abtastung im Sekundentakt mit akkuschonenden Sammelschreibvorgängen. Höhe und Anstieg verbinden GPS und Barometer, damit ein Anstieg stimmt und nicht Rauschen gezählt wird. Die automatische Pause stoppt bei Pausen die Bewegungszeit, und das HUD zeigt Automatisch pausiert — auf Wandern abgestimmt, ein langsamer Anstieg zählt weiter als Bewegung.

Route folgen Importiere eine GPX-Route oder mache eine eigene Wanderung zur Route und behalte sie als Referenz auf der Karte: Fortschritt, Restdistanz und Höhendifferenz über deinem Live-Track. Ab 30 m Abweichung eine Vibration, ab 100 m zwei, alle fünf Minuten erneut, bis du wieder auf der Route bist. Solange die Route geladen ist und keine Wanderung läuft, zeigen die vier Felder Distanz, Anstieg, Bewegungszeit und Dauer dieser Route statt vier Nullen — du weißt also vorher, was dich erwartet.

Nach der Wanderung Distanz, Dauer, Bewegungszeit, Anstieg und Abstieg, Durchschnittstempo, Tempokurve pro Kilometer und ein Höhenprofil zum Abfahren. Monatssummen mit Distanz- und Anstiegschart. GPX-Track und -Route exportieren, Live-Position teilen oder die ganze Datenbank als eine Datei sichern.

Privat und klein Kein Konto. Kein Tracking. Keine Werbung. Kein Netz. Deutsch, Englisch, vereinfachtes und traditionelles Chinesisch, Japanisch.

Navigation ist eine Orientierungshilfe: importierte Karten können veraltet sein, GPS kann bei schlechtem Wetter irren. Führe immer eine Papierkarte oder eine zweite Navigationsquelle mit.

name: Stem: Keyboard Sounds
description:
Stem brings the sound of a mechanical keyboard to your iPhone.

Every sound is recorded from a real switch. Pressing and releasing a key each make their own sound, and the space bar, return, and delete keys sound different too. Choose from clicky, tactile, and linear switches, and listen to each one right from the list.

Pick your keycap colors, from quiet neutrals to pastel, dark, and retro sets. You can also design your own keycaps, with a color and an emoji for every key.

Keys are the same size and in the same place as the built-in iPhone keyboard, so there's nothing new to learn. Stem supports more than 150 languages.

Allow Full Access to hear sounds and feel haptics. What you type never leaves your device, and Stem doesn't collect any data.

Three switches and four keycap sets are free. Unlock every switch, every keycap set, and custom keycaps with a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

name: Step Sprout: ADHD Task Helper
description:
Step Sprout turns a task that feels too big into tiny steps, with a first step of 2 minutes or less. Ask Siri to split a task, let Apple Intelligence size the steps to your energy, and keep the step you're on live on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island with a Live Activity and widgets. Built for adults with ADHD and anyone who freezes before starting. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads, no account.

JUST ASK SIRI
"Split a task in Step Sprout." "What's my next step in Step Sprout?" "I'm done with this step in Step Sprout." "I'm stuck in Step Sprout." "Add five minutes in Step Sprout." "Brain dump in Step Sprout." "I have a few minutes in Step Sprout." "How long will my task take in Step Sprout?" "Just start in Step Sprout." Siri answers right away, without opening the app. Every action also works from Shortcuts and Spotlight.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE, BUILT IN
• Split any task into small steps with minutes, sized to your energy (low, medium or high), and split any step smaller.
• Snap a photo of a messy room or a letter and get steps, where Apple Intelligence can read images.
• Brain dump: say everything on your mind and get separate tasks sorted into Now, Today and Someday.
• I'm stuck: tell it why (too big, boring, don't know where to start, it makes me anxious) and the step changes to match.
• I have some minutes: it picks open steps that fit your time and energy.
• Message helper: rewrite a message more formal, softer, shorter, clearer or firmer but kind, or check how a message you got might sound. Also from the Share sheet.
Apple Intelligence runs on your device or with Private Cloud Compute. Without it, everything still works: a library of ready-made tasks, splitting by hand, a built-in answer bank and tone templates. You can turn the AI features off in Settings.

YOUR STEP, LIVE
Only the current step, large, with a shrinking timer disc (or a gentle count-up). A Live Activity keeps it on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island with Done, +5 min and I'm stuck buttons; tap the disc to pause. Widgets show your step on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen, and controls put "Next step" and "Just start" in Control Center or on the Action button.

JUST START
One tap shows only the tiniest first step with a 2-minute disc.

48 READY-MADE TASKS
Eight categories: home reset, laundry and food, admin and money, calls, mail and errands, moving and big projects, travel, self-care basics, and work and study. They work with no AI at all.

ESTIMATES THAT LEARN
Estimate vs. reality shows how long your steps really take next to what you planned, by category, and Step Sprout uses your own pace for the next estimates.

DONE TODAY, NOTHING TO LOSE
A kind list of what you did. No streaks, no scores.

WHY THIS WORKS
10 short cards explain the research behind each tool, with sources and how strong the evidence is.

IPHONE AND IPAD
Designed for iPhone and iPad, with private iCloud sync between your devices.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your tasks stay on your devices and in your own private iCloud. No accounts, analytics, ads or tracking. Apple Intelligence requests may be processed by Apple to answer them; see the privacy policy.

Step Sprout is a planning tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose or treat ADHD or any other condition. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 (US) or your local emergency number.

LINKS
Website: https://degleon.github.io/app-support/step-sprout/
Privacy Policy: https://degleon.github.io/app-support/step-sprout/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://degleon.github.io/app-support/step-sprout/terms.html
License (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support and contact: https://degleon.github.io/app-support/step-sprout/#support

name: StepUp Scan: Food Score
description:
Scan a packaged food and see how good it really is, in seconds.

StepUp Scan reads the barcode and gives the product a score out of 100, with the reasons in plain words. It's from the makers of StepUp Health and uses the same score.

SCORE OUT OF 100
• Nutrition, processing and additives, each shown with its points
• "Why this score": short bullets with what helped and what hurt
• A clear verdict, from Excellent to Bad

INGREDIENTS, ONE BY ONE
• Every ingredient gets a green, orange or red dot and a short reason
• Additives explained, with their E-numbers
• No full score in the database? StepUp Scan estimates the missing parts from the ingredients and nutrition facts, and clearly marks it "Estimated from ingredients"
• Photograph an ingredient list or nutrition label; it's read on your iPhone

BETTER SWAPS
• See up to three similar products that score higher, from products sold near you first

NUTRITION FACTS
• Per 100 g and per serving, with low, medium and high dots for fat, saturates, sugars and salt

HISTORY AND FAVORITES
• Every scan saved, sortable by score, with your pantry average
• Syncs through your own iCloud: no account, no sign-in

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your last scans
• Scan from Control Center, the Action button or Siri

APPLE HEALTH (OPTIONAL)
• Log calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber for the serving you choose. StepUp Scan only writes to Apple Health and never reads it.

PRIVATE AND FREE
• Free, with no ads, no account and no tracking
• Only the barcode or the words you search are sent to the food databases

Product data comes from Open Food Facts, the free and open food database (ODbL). Whole-food nutrition from USDA FoodData Central.

StepUp Scan gives general information, not medical or dietary advice. Product data can be incomplete, so always check the label, especially for allergies.

name: Stick Sight
description:
Stick Sight keeps each board on this iPhone.

Two winding sticks sit across the ends. Plane only a corner on the high diagonal. The other diagonal is refused, and the thicknesses stay. When the sticks are already parallel, even a thicker side is left alone.

Name a board, rename it, delete one, and share the sentence.

Boards stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not plane the wood for you.

name: Stickeo: Animated Stickers
description:
Turn your Live Photos, videos and GIFs into animated stickers that really move.

Pick a Live Photo and Stickeo uses its 3 seconds of motion, not just the still. With a video, trim the exact moment with the handles, pinch to frame it, and you're done: Stickeo adjusts size, quality and length for you.

MOVING STICKERS, NO BACKGROUND
Turn on Remove Background and Stickeo cuts out the person, pet or object in every frame of the video, right on your iPhone.

FOR ANY CHAT
• Add your packs to WhatsApp with one tap
• Share any sticker as an animated GIF through Messages, Telegram, Instagram or any app you like

EVERYTHING YOU CAN DO
• Use Live Photos, videos, GIFs, animated images and photos
• Trim the exact clip, up to 10 seconds
• Zoom to frame it, or fit the whole video with a transparent background
• Change the speed or make it play forward and back
• Keep your stickers in packs of up to 30

TRULY PRIVATE
Everything is processed on your iPhone. Stickeo doesn't upload your photos or videos, doesn't need an account and has no ads.

WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC. Stickeo is not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp.

name: StiftWind
description:
StiftWind ist dein digitales Blatt Papier für das iPad und den Apple Pencil. Schreibe, markiere und zeichne auf festen Seiten ohne Zoom.

• Kugelschreiber und Marker mit fester Strichbreite in Millimetern
• Lineal, Geodreieck und Zirkel mit Zentimetern, Winkeln und direkter Fingerbedienung
• Frei platzierbare Gitter mit 5-mm-Abständen
• Striche durch Halten zu geraden Strecken machen
• Fotos und PDFs frei platzieren und mit dem Pencil beschriften
• Notizbücher mit Seitenvorschau öffnen, Seiten zwischen Büchern kopieren und als PDF exportieren
• LaTeX-Formeln mit Vorschau eingeben, auf dem Blatt platzieren und später bearbeiten
• Bearbeitbare Notizbücher automatisch in einem Ordner auf dem iPad oder in iCloud Drive sichern und als zusätzliche Kopie wiederherstellen
• Laserpointer mit einstellbarer Farbe und Anzeigedauer

Deine Notizbücher werden lokal auf deinem iPad bearbeitet. Du kannst einen Ordner für automatische Sicherungen wählen. Keine Werbung und kein eigenes Benutzerkonto.

14 TAGE KOSTENLOS TESTEN
Die Testphase beginnt nach deiner Bestätigung im App Store. Danach kannst du die Vollversion einmalig freischalten. Kein Abo und keine automatische Zahlung. Nach Ablauf bleiben vorhandene Notizen lesbar; Export, Sicherungen, Wiederherstellung und Löschen bleiben zugänglich.

VORAUSSETZUNGEN
iPad ab iPadOS 17 und ein kompatibler Apple Pencil zum Schreiben. Für die maßhaltige Darstellung muss das gesamte Blatt ins App-Fenster passen. Die Displaymaße beruhen auf der nominellen Pixeldichte und können kalibriert werden. Zum maßhaltigen PDF-Druck wähle tatsächliche Größe / 100 %.

name: still.synth
description:
Two pads, one chord. Hold a chord shape, tap a root, and still.synth plays a full chord that's always in key. Add a bassline and drums, loop it, and you have a whole track on your phone.

PLAY
• 7 root pads that follow your key and scale, and 8 chord shapes: Dim, Maj, Min, Sus, 6, m7, M7, 9
• Hold chords as a block, strum them, or arpeggiate up or down, always on the beat
• Rich makes a chord fuller. Smart picks the closest inversion so changes move smoothly. Melody plays single notes
• Inversion and octave buttons right next to the pads

SOUND
• Chords: 10 sampled sounds and 21 synths
• Bass: 12 sampled basses and 21 synth basses, with its own register
• Shape any synth on its own page: two oscillators, a filter you drag with a finger, eight knobs. Save up to 64 of your own sounds per tab
• 8 drum kits and 10 patterns, with fills that land on the next bar

LOOP AND RECORD
• A live looper with up to 32 layers, each one snapped to the bar. Undo the last layer any time
• Record a session and share it as WAV or MIDI

CONNECT
• MIDI Out: play other apps, or your DAW over Bluetooth MIDI, from the pads
• Sync with still.synth on your Mac (sold separately at stillsynth.com): the phone becomes the keys, the Mac makes the sound, and key, presets and knobs follow both ways

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Stipplewise
description:
Stipplewise keeps track of your miniature paints, so you always know what you have, where it is and what you're missing.

SCAN A ROW OF PAINTS IN ONE GO
Keep the camera open and scan bottle after bottle. The catalog has over 8,000 paints from 21 brands, including Citadel, Vallejo, The Army Painter, AK Interactive, Mr. Hobby, Reaper, Scale75, Tamiya, Pro Acryl and Turbo Dork.

SEE YOUR PAINTS IN A NEW LIGHT
Your collection lays itself out as a color wall: every paint in a dark-to-light ramp, matching shades from different brands folded together. Pinch to zoom, and turn on "Show gaps" to see the paints you don't have yet.

KNOW WHERE EVERY BOTTLE LIVES
Add rack and shelf locations so you know where to reach when it's time to paint.

START WITH A SHADE YOU LOVE
Tap a color in a reference photo and see the closest paints you already own, or the ones worth adding to your wishlist.

SHOP FOR WHAT FILLS A GAP
At the hobby shop, scan a bottle to see if you already have it or a close match. Your collection and wishlist work offline.

WORKS WITH YOUR AI ASSISTANT
Connect Claude, ChatGPT or another assistant and ask it what you own, what's covered and what to buy. Access is read-only unless you allow wishlist edits.

PART OF SOMETHING BIGGER
Fixes you suggest for paint details, once approved, go into Paint Commons, an open paint catalog anyone can use.

No ads. Usage analytics can be turned off in Settings. Your collection is yours: export it any time, or delete your account from Settings.

Made by Left-Handed Minis, a miniature painter who owned one too many duplicates.

name: Stitch Club Stickers
description:
Stitch Club Stickers is an embroidery sticker pack for Messages. Send a hoop, a skein of floss, or a sewing pun without leaving the chat.
Open a conversation, tap the plus button, then Stitch Club Stickers. Drop any sticker into the thread.
Fifteen stickers:
Sew Happy, Hoop Life, Floss Boss, Knot Today, French Knot, Satin Stitch, Cross My Heart, Sew Cute, Needle Nerd, Thimble Time, Make It, Hoop Era, Thread Therapy, Stitch Please, and Bloom.
For people who embroider, cross-stitch, and keep one more skein than they meant to. The app is a gallery of the set. Sending happens in Messages.

name: Storage Analyzer and Cleaner
description:
Storage Analyzer and Cleaner is a storage cleaner for iPhone that shows what is filling your phone and helps you free up space: duplicate photos, large files, long videos and old screenshots.

Phone storage full? Open the app, see how much space is used and what takes the most, then delete what you do not need. You review everything first. Nothing is deleted until you select it and confirm.

STORAGE ANALYZER
See used and free space the moment you open the app, with every cleanup tool one tap away.

DUPLICATE PHOTO REMOVER
Identical copies of a photo are grouped side by side. One is kept, the copies are marked for deletion, and you can change the selection before you delete.

LARGE FILE FINDER
The biggest photos and videos in your library are listed first. Filter by 10 MB, 50 MB or 100 MB, check what you no longer need and delete it in one go.

VIDEO CLEANER
All your videos in one list, each with its length. Open any video full screen and watch it before you decide, so you do not delete the wrong one.

SCREENSHOT CLEANER
Find all your screenshots in one place. Pick a few or select them all and clear them at once. Your other photos are not touched.

MORE TOOLS
- Battery: level, charging status and battery tips
- Speed test: download, upload and ping
- Statistics: how much space you have cleared and how many files you have deleted

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos, videos and files are checked on your phone only. They are never uploaded. The app asks for access to photos and videos only so that it can find and delete the items you select.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL PRO
Every cleaning tool is free to use, supported by ads. Cleaner Pro removes the ads: choose a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in your App Store account settings.

Available in 20 languages, with light and dark themes.

Terms of Use: https://www.zenbyte.app/terms/storage-cleaner/
Privacy Policy: https://www.zenbyte.app/privacy/storage-cleaner/

Questions or feedback: info@zenbyte.app

name: Story Continuity
description:
Keep every thread true.

Story Continuity helps fiction writers track characters, facts and events—and see what a change means for the scenes ahead.

FOLLOW THE EVIDENCE
Record when a character discovers a fact, tells someone else, or acts on that knowledge. Move an event and inspect the connected scenes that need attention, with clear explanations and evidence chains.

EXPLORE YOUR STORY GRAPH
Build characters, facts, scenes and events directly in an interactive graph. Connect them using guided relationship types, inspect their evidence and follow dependent events. Checks explain missing details and recorded conflicts, with links to repair them. Use the readable list or timeline whenever you prefer.

KEEP TIME AND CHAPTER ORDER SEPARATE
Story-time positions describe when events happen in your world. Scene reading order describes where they appear in the manuscript, so flashbacks do not automatically become continuity mistakes.

UNDERSTAND UNCERTAINTY
Confirmed facts, rumours and open questions stay distinct. Missing sources or ambiguous times are shown as missing information, rather than proof that your story is wrong. Checks cover the information you enter; the app does not automatically analyse a manuscript or guarantee that it finds every plot hole.

START FREE
Create one editable project with one book and up to 50 events. Use the timeline, characters, facts and continuity checks. Export and import portable project backups.

GO FURTHER WITH PRO
Work on multiple and larger projects. Connect books through shared characters, facts and story time. Save up to 50 named revisions per project, compare changes and restore an earlier version. Export editor reports containing findings and their evidence.

KEEP YOUR WORK WITH YOU
