Stories and revisions are stored locally on your device. There is no account, advertising or external AI service. Use backup files to move work between devices; automatic cloud sync is not included. All saved work remains readable and exportable after cancellation.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Story Continuity Pro offers monthly and annual auto-renewable subscriptions. UK prices are £3.99 per month or £24.99 per year. Eligible new subscribers receive a seven-day free trial, followed by the full price of the selected plan. Prices and eligibility are displayed in the app and confirmed by Apple; prices vary by territory. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. Cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or billing period ends to avoid the next charge. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://springdatauk.github.io/story-continuity/privacy.html

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Streif Window
description:
Streif Window times the pick for each block in the orchard.

Take ten fruit from one block. Cut them, stain the halves, and drag the clear edge on the starch chart. Enter sun-face firmness, shade-face firmness, and Brix. The Streif index is firmness divided by Brix times starch. Ten halves make the mean.

Each variety keeps an enter value and a leave value. The mean says the block is not in the window yet, inside it, or past it. A half that sits 30 percent or more away from the mean is marked. Blocks line up by which one leaves the window first.

Samples stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. Check the reading against the halves in front of you before you pick.

name: Studied
description:
Studied is a free study app for any subject, any level and any language.

Put in what you already have: typed notes, photos of your notebook, PDFs and slides, screenshots, even old exam papers. Studied helps you turn it into things you can actually study with.

WHAT YOU GET
• Clean notes you can read, search and listen to
• Flashcards with spaced repetition (the FSRS method): each card comes back right before you would forget it
• Practice questions in exam style, with worked answers
• A day-by-day study plan built from your exam dates
• One-page cheat sheets from your notes
• A focus timer and a streak to keep you going

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
There is no account and no ads. Your subjects, notes, cards and files are stored only on your device. You can make a backup file any time.

ABOUT THE AI (OPTIONAL)
Making notes, cards and questions from photos or PDFs, and marking your written answers, uses an AI service. Studied starts with AI turned off. To use it, add your own API key from Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI, Gemini (Google) or any OpenAI-compatible service, and choose the model. Your material is then sent straight from your device to that service. Without AI you can still type notes, write cards, review, practise and follow your plan.

Made by Pep Secanell.

name: StyleCopy
description:
Analyze the image. Create your own.

StyleCopy is a focused AI image studio built on one idea: learn how a picture looks, then make something new with that visual language. Pick a reference and StyleCopy reads its composition, light, color and texture into an editable style prompt. Add your own subject, and generate a brand-new image. The reference teaches the look — it is never reproduced.

How it works
1. Collect: save reference photos from your library or camera, or share images from other apps straight into StyleCopy.
2. Extract: get a structured style prompt in seconds, editable line by line.
3. Describe: subject, scene, mood, lighting — your call.
4. Generate and save: choose a model and size, then save to Photos or share.

Highlights
- References and style prompts are managed separately, so one style can drive many different images.
- Artworks, inspiration and prompts live on your device, with single-file backup and restore.
- Parameters default to Auto, so you can create without knowing aspect ratios or resolutions.
- 10 interface languages, following the system or chosen in Settings.
- Share images and links from other apps into your inspiration library.

Models and cost
- No built-in credits and no subscription. Connect your own OpenRouter or OpenAI API key, and model usage is billed to your own account.
- Connect with one-tap OpenRouter authorization, or paste an OpenAI API key. Keys stay in the device Keychain.
- No account, no sign-up. To move devices, use the backup file or system backup.

Who it is for
Anyone who wants to turn a visual feeling into their own work: creators building brand visuals, social posts and concept art, or anyone who wants a calm, focused place to generate images.

Note
AI output is moderated by the model provider you choose under its content policy. Please follow local law and do not generate illegal content or content that infringes others' rights.

name: Sub-X: Cube Timer & Trainer
description:
Sub-X is a clean, no-nonsense speedcubing timer with the training tools to actually get faster.

TIMER
• Hold anywhere until the time turns green, release to start, tap anywhere to stop
• Official WCA random-state 3x3 scrambles, with a preview of the scrambled cube
• Optional 15-second WCA inspection with 8s/12s voice alerts and automatic +2/DNF
• 7-segment or standard timer fonts, adjustable hold time and precision
• Swipe left to delete the last solve, swipe right for a new scramble

STATS
• Best single, mo3, ao5, ao12, ao50, ao100 and ao1000 (current and best), using WCA rules
• Mean, median and standard deviation
• Time-trend chart with rolling averages, and a time distribution
• Unlimited sessions, comments, +2/DNF, and CSV export

TRAIN
• PLL, OLL, F2L, 2-look OLL and 2-look PLL algorithm sheets
• Mark cases as learning or learned, pick your favourite algorithm or add your own
• Trainers give you a scramble that sets up one of the cases you chose, then time you on it
• Pick cases in one tap: by group, by status, or your slowest
• OLL + PLL mode: solve a random OLL and recognise whichever of your PLLs comes up, just like in a real solve
• Per-case stats show you exactly what to drill

LEARN
• A step-by-step beginner course: solve the cube layer by layer in 7 steps
• A CFOP path that leads you from 2-look to full OLL and PLL
• "Practise this step" scrambles straight to the step you're learning

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your solves stay on your device.

name: Sucher
description:
Sucher is a rangefinder camera you hold in both hands. Switch it on, focus by eye, and wind on after every frame. Each frame is a JPEG you meant to take.

Sucher, said "ZOO-ker", is the German word for viewfinder.

FOCUS BY EYE
A gold patch sits in the middle of the finder and shows a second image of your subject. Roll the focus wheel until the two images meet. The patch locks and you feel a soft click. The photo is taken at the focus you set, so a miss is soft, as it would be on film.

FULLY MANUAL EXPOSURE
The speed dial and the aperture wheel each have an A position, and together they give you four modes:
P: the camera sets speed and aperture.
A: you set the aperture, the camera sets the speed.
S: you set the speed, the camera sets the aperture.
M: you set everything and follow the arrows in the finder.
ISO runs from 160 to 2500 or AUTO. The live view shows the brightness your photo will have, before you press the shutter.

TWIST, TURN, WIND
Every setting is an object. Turn the collar around the shutter to switch on. Press the lens release, twist the lens off, choose another from the case and twist it on until it clicks. Screw a filter onto the lens and unscrew it again. Pull the lever to wind on.

UP TO SIX LENSES
13, 24, 35, 48, 100 and 200 mm, made from your phone's own rear cameras. The lenses in your case depend on your phone model:
Three rear cameras (ultra wide, wide and telephoto): all six lenses.
Two rear cameras (ultra wide and wide): four lenses, 13, 24, 35 and 48 mm.
Each focal length follows your phone's real cameras, so a model with a 26 mm wide camera gives 26 and 52 mm, and a 77 mm telephoto gives 77 and 154 mm. The finder shows exactly what each lens sees.

FOUR FILMS
CCD: dense, saturated colour. Soft 400: soft contrast and warm skin. CCD BW: clean monochrome with a long tonal scale. Grit 400: hard contrast, deep blacks and real grain.

TWELVE FILTERS
Yellow, orange, red and green for contrast. A diffuser, a mist filter and three halo strengths for soft focus and glowing light. A polariser you turn, a warming filter and a three-stop ND. You see each one in the finder, and the meter accounts for every one.

A FINDER YOUR WAY
Live histogram, horizon level, grid and clipping stripes. Turn on only what helps you.

TWO BODIES
C10: chrome, a 1.33x crop and 3936 x 2630 files. F18: black paint, full frame and 5212 x 3472 files. Tap the nameplate to swap; the lens and film stay mounted.

PLAY
A contact sheet of every frame with its body, lens, speed, aperture, ISO, film and focus result.

BUILT FOR THE FOLD
On a foldable phone the camera follows the display. Opened flat, the finder takes the page and the controls run down a rail. Half-folded on a table, the finder sits above a control deck and the self-timer arms at ten seconds.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos are made on your phone and saved to an album called Sucher in Photos. They stay yours.

File Format
JPEG only for now.

name: SudenRuhetag
description:
In dieser App findest du unsere kleine Hausbrauerei und Taverne. Wir brauen, keltern und brennen in kleinen Chargen, ganz ohne Massenproduktion. Das Sortiment umfasst Craftbier, Obstwein, Met sowie Destillate, jedes Produkt mit eigenem Charakter und klar beschriebenem Geschmacksprofil.

Du kannst dich in Ruhe durch unser Angebot stöbern, Details zu jedem Getränk nachlesen und Favoriten speichern. Zur Auswahl stehen zwei Bestellwege: Lieferung bis zu dir nach Hause mit Barzahlung bei Erhalt, oder eine vereinbarte Abholung vor Ort. Bei der Bestellung legst du deine Lieferadresse fest und wählst einen passenden Zeitraum für die Zustellung.

Die App ist einfach aufgebaut, damit du dich unkompliziert zurechtfindest. Im Bereich „Mein Keller“ behältst du den Überblick über deine persönlichen Favoriten und vergangenen Bestellungen. Wir legen Wert auf Transparenz bei allen Angaben zu Alkoholgehalt, Aromen und Preisen.

name: Sunbloom Zire Puzzle
description:
Help the light find its way to the blossoming flowers in Sunbloom Zire Puzzle, a gentle puzzle game that combines logic and colorful effects.

Each level begins with a ray of light emanating from the sun. Your task is to rotate mirrors to guide the ray to the correct location. But the path isn't always simple: mirrors split the ray into multiple branches, colored glass changes the color of the light, rocks block the way, and even distracting mirrors can lead you astray.

Each puzzle has a unique solution. Think before you rotate the mirrors, as each rotation counts as one turn. The fewer turns you complete, the greater your chance of earning three stars. If you get stuck, you can use seeds for hints, but that level will only earn a maximum of two stars.

EXPLORE THE FIVE PLANETS

The campaign consists of 40 levels spread across five planets, each offering new puzzles and mechanics. The challenges are introduced step-by-step, helping you familiarize yourself with how each type of mirror and object works before combining them in more complex levels.

Complete levels, collect stars, and strive for three stars in all eight levels of each planet to receive mastery rewards.

THREE WAYS TO CHALLENGE YOURSELF

Campaign: leisurely explore each puzzle, with no time limit.

Trials: solve new levels within the allowed number of attempts. Each completion earns you a seed.

Endless: continue conquering puzzles of increasing difficulty and see how far you can go.

COLLECT SEEDS, UNLOCK HINTS

Seeds are awarded when you achieve new accomplishments, complete challenges, or conquer milestones in Endless mode. Use them to receive hints when you need to find the right path.

With its cute cartoon images, colorful planets, cheerful sun, and vibrant blooming flowers, the Sunbloom Zire Puzzle offers moments of relaxation mixed with mental challenges.

name: Sundarkand Path
description:
Shri Sundarkand : The fifth sopan of Goswami Tulsidas's Shri Ramcharitmanas, with calm, devotion and full meaning, in your own script.
भक्ति • श्रद्धा • शांति
A journey of devotion, not a commercial experience.
Created with devotion. Shared with everyone.
Sundarkand Path is a peaceful companion for your daily or Tuesday & Saturday Path. Every chaupai, doha, soratha and chhand is here, from "Shri Ganeshay Namah" to the final doha, with Hindi or English bhavarth beneath each verse.

READ IN YOUR OWN SCRIPT : 15 LANGUAGES
The recitation stays in Tulsidas's original Awadhi; the text follows it line by line in the script you read best:
• Devanagari (Hindi, Awadhi, Sanskrit, Marathi, Nepali, Konkani, Maithili and more)
• Gujarati • Bengali • Assamese • Gurmukhi (Punjabi) • Odia
• Tamil • Telugu • Kannada • Malayalam
• English, German, French and Danish transliteration • Russian (Cyrillic)
Switch script at any time : even in the middle of the Path.

EVERY VERSE, WITH MEANING
Turn on Hindi or English bhavarth to understand each line as you read. Keep the original Devanagari visible under your chosen script if you like.

FIVE WAYS TO DO YOUR PATH
• Speaking + auto scroll : a devotional voice recites while each line glows and the text follows.
• Follow external audio : play your favourite Sundarkand recording on YouTube, Spotify or any music app. Tap the line being sung and the text keeps pace with that singer.
• Mute + auto scroll : silent reading that glides at your pace.
• Mute + manual : move line by line yourself.
• Just reading : scroll freely like a book.

SUNDARKAND ON APPLE WATCH
• Follow the Path on your wrist, see the verse being recited, with its meaning.
• Play, pause, next and previous from your watch while your iPhone recites.
• Read the complete Sundarkand on the watch itself, even without your iPhone.
• Ram Naam Jaap - a 108-bead mala. Tap or turn the Digital Crown for each bead, with a gentle tap on your wrist.
• Dhyan - one, three or five minutes of calm breathing with "Shri Ram" and "Jai Hanuman".
• Darshan of Hanumanji with a glowing diya, and your progress always in sight.

PREPARE WITH DEVOTION
A gentle Panchtattva checklist before you begin: Snan, clean clothes, Asan, Deep-Dhoop-Pushp, a silent space, and Dhyan & Sankalp.

WAKE FOR BRAHMA MUHURTA
Reminders on Tuesday and Saturday - Hanumanji's days - at 4:00 AM, or a daily reminder at the time you choose.

A QUIET, FOCUSED SPACE
• Meditation mode keeps your screen awake and can run your iPhone Focus so calls and messages wait.
• Child lock keeps little hands from interrupting the Path.
• The "Mangal Bhavan Amangal Hari" refrain after every doha, if you wish.
• Adjustable text size and recitation pace.
• Resume exactly where you left off.
• Hanumanji's golden glow gathers gently behind the verses as you read.
• A day-and-night app icon: morning sky by day, moonlit sky by night.

DESIGNED FOR EVERY DEVICE
Beautiful on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, in calm devotional colours.

OUR PROMISE
No ads. No distractions. No account needed. Made with shraddha, built with seva bhaav, so that bhakti can be for everyone.

We would love to hear from you  share suggestions, request a feature or simply write to us from "Connect & About" in Settings.

Jai Shri Ram. Jai Hanuman.

name: SunPatchm
description:
Sun Patch is a cozy room puzzle game about finding the perfect patch of sunlight for every cat.

Open the curtains, move furniture, aim wall mirrors, and shape the shadows to give each cat just the right amount of warmth. Every cat has its own personality: fluffy cats warm up quickly, sun seekers want brighter spots, while shade-loving cats prefer the edge of a shadow.

name: Sunshower: Sky Match 3
description:
Sunshower is a bright, relaxing match-3 puzzle set in a kingdom of floating sky islands.

Swap suns, moons, raindrops, clouds, leaves and umbrellas to make matches of three or more. Line up four for a Lightning bolt, make a square for a Kite, an L or T shape for a Thunderclap, and five in a row for a Rainbow. Combine two specials for even bigger effects.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No lives and no timers: play as long as you like, and retry is always free.
• Ads never interrupt a level and never appear after a loss.
• Reward videos are always your choice, and they always pay.
• One purchase removes the banner and full-screen ads for good.

60 LEVELS, THEN ENDLESS
• Five sky chapters, from Dawn Meadows to the Aurora Crown, each with its own look and music.
• Break ice, clear storm clouds, free frozen charms and bring the falling stars down.
• Every shipped level is tested to be beatable without boosters.
• After level 60, new levels keep coming.

SMALL TOUCHES
• Undo your last move up to three times a level.
• Boosters: Gust, Lightning Rod and Shuffle.
• Works offline. No account. Your progress is saved after every move.

Meet Nimbus, the little cloud with the red umbrella, and enjoy a puzzle that respects your time.

name: SunWin BlackJack
description:
Bắt đầu với 1.000 xu ảo và chọn một trong bốn bàn trong sảnh đài thiên văn. Rút, dừng, gấp đôi hoặc tách bài ở Blackjack. Chọn cửa ở Baccarat, giữ bài ở Video Poker hoặc chọn số trên bàn Roulette châu Âu.

Mở Luật chơi để xem cách tính điểm và tiền trả. Lịch sử lưu tối đa 100 ván đã quyết toán trên thiết bị. Khi số dư thấp hơn mức cược tối thiểu và không có ván cần tiếp tục, bạn có thể nhận thêm 1.000 xu miễn phí.

Ứng dụng được thiết kế để chơi offline trên iPhone và iPad, không cần tài khoản và không có tính năng mua hàng. Trò chơi mô phỏng. Chip không có giá trị tiền tệ và không thể đổi thưởng.

name: Super Link Academy
description:
Super Link is a learning app for students who want quality tuition, expert guidance and flexible study, all in one place.

Browse the course catalogue, watch recorded lessons, practise with quizzes, read notes and join live classes from your phone or tablet.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Video lessons: watch recorded classes anytime, in portrait or full-screen landscape.
• Live classes: join scheduled online classes and see upcoming sessions.
• Quizzes and practice tests: test what you have learned and review your results.
• Notes and study material: open PDF notes and resources attached to your lessons.
• My Learning: pick up where you left off in the courses you own.
• Notifications: get alerts about new content and live classes.
• Course bundles: buy a single course, a quiz or a bundle.

SIMPLE AND SAFE

• Create an account with your phone number and manage your profile in the app.
• Purchases are made with Apple In-App Purchase, so payment is handled securely by the App Store.
• You can delete your account and data at any time from Profile > Delete Account.

WHO IT IS FOR

Students who want structured courses, regular practice and clear guidance from their teachers, whether they study at home or on the move.

Some courses and quizzes are free. Paid items are purchased inside the app and are shown with their App Store price before you confirm.

Questions or feedback? Contact us through the app or at superlink.com.np.

Download Super Link and start learning today.

name: SuperWord Sprint
description:
Every day there are two new word puzzles, the same for everyone: Word Hunt and Anagram. Each one has three rounds.
Word Hunt is a 10×10 grid with 8 to 12 hidden words on the topic of the day. Drag from the first letter to the last, or tap both ends. Early in the week the words run in four directions; by the weekend they go in all eight, backwards included.
Anagram gives you seven letters. Make every word of three letters or more: longer words score more, and there is always one word that uses all seven. Climb seven ranks from Warm-up to Legend. Reach Racer and the day is solved. Valid words that aren't on the list count as bonus words, and every five of them earn a hint.

Round 1 of each game is the daily puzzle: it keeps your streak and counts for the daily tasks. Solve a round to open the next one. Rounds 2 and 3 are there when you want to keep playing.

Daily tasks: solve Word Hunt, reach Racer, plus one task that changes every day. Finish all three for a perfect day and an extra hint.
Streaks: a day counts when you solve Word Hunt or reach Racer in round 1, and yesterday's puzzle still counts until 4 a.m. Every seven days of streak earn a freeze that covers a missed day, up to two at a time.
Hints are earned, not bought. You start with three and get more for solved days, perfect days, bonus words and streak milestones.
Statistics show your current and best streak, the last six weeks at a glance, your best and average Word Hunt time, your Anagram ranks and seven-letter words.

Three languages: English, Brazilian Portuguese and Romanian, each with its own word lists and topics. The puzzle language can differ from the app language.

Share your result without spoilers: the puzzle number, language, result and streak, never the answers.

name: Süphan Birlik
seller_name: SUPHAN BIRLIK GIDA INSAAT TEMIZLIK VE GUVENLIK SANAYI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Süphan Birlik uygulaması, toptan gıda, temizlik ve bebek ürünleri alışverişini mobilde kolayca yapmanızı sağlar. Çay ve içeceklerden bakliyat ürünlerine, kahvaltılıklardan atıştırmalıklara, bebek bezlerinden temizlik ürünlerine kadar farklı ihtiyaçlarınıza yönelik ürünleri tek yerden inceleyebilirsiniz.

Van merkezli Süphan Birlik Pazarlama'nın sunduğu ürünleri kategori ve markalara göre keşfedebilir, koli fiyatlarını görüntüleyebilir ve alışveriş sürecinizi mobilde yönetebilirsiniz.

Ürün Kategorileri
Atıştırmalık: Bar, bisküvi, kraker, çikolata, cips, gofret, kek, kuru meyve ve şekerleme ürünleri
Çay ve İçecek: Bardak poşet çay, bitki çayı, demlik poşet çay, dökme çay, filtre kahve, çekirdek kahve, granül kahve, hazır kahve, salep, sıcak çikolata, soğuk kahve, toz içecek ve Türk kahvesi
Pirinç, Bulgur ve Bakliyat: Barbunya, buğday, bulgur, fasulye, kırmızı mercimek, yeşil mercimek, nohut, pirinç, makarna ve patlayan mısır ürünleri
Bal ve Kahvaltılık: Bal çeşitleri, fındık ezmesi, helva, pekmez, tahin ve yulaf ezmesi
Süt Ürünleri: Torku, İçer ve Mercan markalarının süt ürünleri
Bebek Bezi ve Islak Havlu: Sleepy ve Baby Turco bebek bezleri ve bebek ıslak mendilleri
Hijyen ve Hasta Bezi: Hijyen ve hasta bakımına yönelik ürün seçenekleri
Temizlik: Glint ve Sleepy markalarının temizlik ürünleri ve yüzey temizlik havluları
Markalar: Yayla, Torku, Mahbuba, Sleepy, Baby Turco, Karali, Pervari Bal, Glint, Lemas, Sütçü Amca, İçer ve Mercan
En Çok Satanlar: Site üzerinde öne çıkan ürünleri inceleme alanı
Yeni Ürünler: Ürün yelpazesine yeni eklenen seçenekleri keşfetme alanı

Uygulama üzerinden ürünleri kategori ve markaya göre inceleyebilir, ürün detaylarını ve koli fiyatlarını görüntüleyebilirsiniz. Sepetinizi oluşturabilir, ürünleri karşılaştırabilir ve sipariş işlemlerinizi yönetebilirsiniz.

Üyelik ve hesap işlemlerine, sipariş takibine, kargo sorgulama alanına, havale bildirim formuna ve iletişim seçeneklerine kolayca erişebilirsiniz. WhatsApp destek üzerinden işletmeyle iletişime geçebilirsiniz.

Süphan Birlik ile toptan gıda, içecek, bebek ve temizlik ürünleri alışverişinizi mobilde daha düzenli ve pratik şekilde gerçekleştirebilirsiniz.

name: Suppup
description:
Explore dog-friendly places with Suppup. Find mapped walking paths, dog parks, pet shops and treat stops near your location. Browse places on the map, compare distances, open walking directions, and keep your favorites close at hand.

Save places and add your own personal spot ratings on your phone. Ratings and favorites are local to your device; they are not a shared community review service.

Nearby places and maps use OpenStreetMap-compatible services. Coverage may be incomplete, and live searches require internet. Check local access rules, opening hours and leash restrictions before visiting.

Location permission is optional. Without location or when live results are unavailable, clearly labeled preview examples let you explore the interface. No account, advertisements, subscriptions or in-app purchases are required.

name: Sure Delivery Driver
description:
Sure Driver – Your Delivery Partner

Make deliveries easier, faster, and more convenient with Sure Driver. Our app connects delivery drivers with food and package delivery opportunities, helping you manage your deliveries efficiently from one place.

Whether you're delivering food, parcels, or packages, Sure Driver gives you the tools you need to manage your daily delivery activities.

BUILT FOR DELIVERY DRIVERS

Sure Driver is designed to make everyday delivery work more organized and manageable. Spend less time managing orders and more time completing deliveries.

Get started with Sure Driver and make every delivery count!

Note: Access to delivery services and features may depend on your account, location, and platform availability.

Sure Driver – Deliver with confidence.

name: SürGit Eğitmen
description:
SürGit Eğitmen, SürGit'e kayıtlı sürücü kurslarının eğitmenleri içindir. Kursunun aracıyla çevrimiçi ol, yakınındaki kullanıcılardan çağrı al; onları gitmek istedikleri yere götürürken direksiyon pratiği yaptır.

Başlarken
• Telefon numaranla SMS koduyla giriş yap, ehliyetini kamerayla tara. Adın ehliyetten alınır.
• Kursunun panelden verdiği tek kullanımlık kodla kursa katıl. Başvurun yönetici onayından geçer.
• Kursun boştaki araçlarından birini "Devral" ile al. Araç, sen teslim edene kadar sende kalır.

Çevrimiçi ol, çağrılar gelsin
"Çevrimiçi ol" dediğinde konumun paylaşılır ve yakındaki kullanıcılar seni haritada görür. Uygulama arka plandayken de çağrı alırsın; "Mola ver" diyene kadar çevrimiçi kalırsın.

Çağrıyı gör, kararını ver
Gelen çağrıda alış noktasını, varış yerini, mesafeyi, ücreti ve ödeme yöntemini tek kartta görürsün. Kabul et ya da reddet.

Sürüş
• Alış noktasına git; yol tarifi Google Haritalar ya da Apple Haritalar'da tek dokunuşla açılır.
• "Vardım" de, kullanıcının söylediği 4 haneli kodla sürüşü başlat.
• Gerekirse kullanıcıyı uygulamadan ara. Arama 0850'li hattan yapılır, iki tarafın numarası da gizli kalır.
• Mevzuat gereği kullanıcının ikinci sürüşünden itibaren kimlik seri numarasını alıp uygulamaya girersin.

Kazancını takip et
Nakit ödemeyi ya da kursun hesabına gelen havaleyi onayla. Günlük, haftalık ve aylık kazancını, yaptığın sürüşleri uygulamada gör.

Uygulamayı kullanmak için SürGit'e kayıtlı bir sürücü kursunun eğitmeni olman gerekir. Kursun henüz SürGit'te değilse kurs.surgit.com.tr adresinden başvurabilir ya da destek@surgit.com.tr adresine yazabilirsin.

name: Sursum Corda: Katholisch beten
description:
Sursum Corda – »Erhebet die Herzen!« – begleitet Sie durch den Tag und durch das Kirchenjahr der überlieferten Messe nach dem Kalender von 1962.

FÜR JEDEN TAG
• Der Tag im Kirchenjahr: Fest, Klasse, liturgische Farbe und Heilige des Tages
• Die Texte der Messe nach dem Schott, lateinisch und deutsch, mit der ganzen Messordnung zum Mitbeten
• Morgen- und Abendgebet mit Gewissenserforschung
• Angelus zu den gewohnten Zeiten, auf Wunsch mit Erinnerung
• Die Kleinen Tagzeiten aus dem Goldenen Buch
• Geistliche Lesung und Betrachtung

GEBETE UND ANDACHTEN
• Rosenkranz mit allen Geheimnissen, auch zum Mitbeten mit Audio
• Litaneien, Novenen und Kreuzweg
• Andachten durch die geprägten Zeiten des Kirchenjahres
• Ihre eigenen Lieblingsgebete und Anliegen

SCHRIFT UND GLAUBE
• Die ganze Heilige Schrift in der Übersetzung von Allioli-Arndt, mit Leseplänen und Suche
• Katechismus, Kirchenlatein und gregorianischer Choral zum Lernen

FÜR DIE BEICHTE
• Beichtspiegel zur Vorbereitung
• Ein persönliches Tagebuch für Dank und Vorsätze
• Beichtnotizen und Tagebuch lassen sich mit einem Code schützen und werden verschlüsselt auf Ihrem Gerät gespeichert

KOSTENLOS UND OHNE KONTO
Sursum Corda ist kostenlos, ohne Werbung und ohne Konto. Es gibt keine Analyse- oder Tracking-Dienste. Was Sie eintragen, bleibt auf Ihrem Gerät.

Sursum Corda wird vom gemeinnützigen Verein Salzburg und Tradition getragen.

name: Swimmich
description:
Swimmich is a native iPhone app for Immich, the photo library you host yourself. Your photos stay on your server; Swimmich makes them fast to browse, safe to back up and fun to share.

WHY SWIMMICH
• Built for iPhone: designed for iOS 26 and Liquid Glass, with native tabs, gestures and haptics.
• Your photos, your server: no cloud in between. Swimmich talks to your Immich server and nothing else.
• Backup that keeps up: huge libraries, long 4K videos, photos still in iCloud, all backed up in the background, with progress in the Dynamic Island.

YOUR WHOLE LIBRARY
A timeline that keeps up with your thumb. Search by what a photo shows, who is in it or where it was taken. Browse your albums, people, the map and your memories.

MAKE SOMETHING TO SHARE
• Road Trip: a trip album becomes a film, the route drawn on a satellite map with the best photos of each stop.
• Reel: a search ("beach", "snow", "dog") becomes a reel cut to the beat.
• Growing Up: one face lined up across the years, a decade in a few seconds.
• Then & Now: the places you went back to, years later.
• Wrapped: your year in photos, as a story to share.
• Color Mosaic, Photo Dump and a poster of everywhere you have been.
Everything is made on your iPhone from your own server: nothing is sent anywhere else.

BACKUP THAT KEEPS UP
• Automatic, in the background, with progress on the Lock Screen.
• Never twice: what your server already has is skipped.
• "Back up now" from a widget, Siri or Shortcuts.

AND EVERYTHING ELSE
Offline copies, shared links with password and expiry, a locked folder behind Face ID, partner sharing, a photo editor, duplicates and trash, widgets, casting to a TV, local and external server addresses. In English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.

WHAT YOU NEED
A reachable Immich server (yours or a friend's). Swimmich is free, with no ads, no tracking and no data collection. Its source code is on GitHub.

Swimmich is an independent app, not affiliated with the Immich project.

name: SwipeClean - Gallery Cleanup
description:
SwipeClean helps you tidy your photo and video library one swipe at a time.

• Swipe right to keep, left to put in the Delete folder, up for Important, down for Later.
• Undo any decision straight away.
• Nothing is deleted when you swipe. You review the Delete folder, confirm, and then confirm again in iOS's own dialog. Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in Photos.
• See how many photos and videos you have, and how many items you've deleted with SwipeClean.
• Tap to play videos; open any photo full screen.
• Works with limited photo access: you choose what SwipeClean can see.
• Optional App Lock: open SwipeClean with Face ID or your passcode.

Private by design: your photos and videos never leave your phone. No account needed, no cloud, no analytics. You can sign in with Apple or Google to see your name in the app; your name and email stay on this phone.

SwipeClean is free with occasional ads between swipes. SwipeClean Pro is a one-time purchase that removes all ads.

name: Swiss Servare Passwortmanager
description:
Swiss Servare Password Manager keeps your passwords, PINs and login details safe – encrypted and stored only on your iPhone or iPad. No account, no server, no ads, no usage analytics.

SECURE
• Encrypted vault, only on your device
• Sign in your way: Face ID / Touch ID, device passcode or protection password
• Locks automatically as soon as the app goes to the background

PRACTICAL
• Unlimited entries with extra fields (PIN, customer number …)
• Fast search
• Password generator
• Warnings for short and reused passwords
• Create and restore encrypted backups

PASSWORD MANAGER PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• Favourites and filters
• Password history
• 2FA codes (authenticator)
• CSV import and export

Available in 8 languages: German, English, French, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, Polish and Croatian.

Swiss Servare – software from Stein am Rhein, Switzerland.

name: Synawake: Sleep & Meditation
description:
Synawake is calm meditation music and binaural beats for sleep, focus and calm, in one simple app.

LISTEN
• Meditation music: warm piano, soft pads, singing bowls and slow monk chants, with a gentle binaural layer underneath
• Binaural beats inside soft rain, wind, ocean or a deep hum, tuned to Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta and Gamma
• Cymatic: one clean tone stepping through a scale, inspired by sand patterns on a vibrating plate
• Spin: pure tones a golden ratio apart that seem to turn around your head (no binaural beats)
• Brain state: see the five brainwave states change colour and shape right on the home screen
• Kids sleep sounds for babies and toddlers: no binaural beats, made for a speaker, never headphones
• Free 2-minute previews of every session
• Plays with the screen locked, lock-screen controls and a sleep timer that fades out

GLOW · LIGHT + SOUND
• Lie back, close your eyes and point the torch towards you: it flashes softly in time with the beat
• Three light styles: Journey, Waves and Steady
• A short safety check before every session
• "What did you see?" journal after each session, saved only on your phone
• Adults only. Not for people with epilepsy or a history of seizures.

MIND CHECK
• Tap how your mind feels and get a sound for this moment
• Deep Mind Check: describe it in your own words (Synawake Pro)

LEARN
• The five brainwave bands explained simply, safety tips and answers to common questions

SYNAWAKE PRO
Pro unlocks every full session (1 hour each, Power Nap 20 minutes, Ocean Night 3 hours), the full Kids sounds, the Deep Mind Check and Glow with the full sessions. Already a member? Log in with the email you used. No password: we send you a code.

Headphones on, volume low. Synawake is relaxation and focus music, not a medical treatment. Never use it while driving.

name: Synergy Timeline
description:
Keep the story of the two of you in one place.

Synergy Timeline is a private, bilingual (English / 中文) journal for couples. Record the moments you share — the day you met, trips, a new home, a hard conversation and the making-up after — and see them together on one timeline.

• One shared timeline — every moment with its date, a note and an optional photo
• Moment types — first meeting, together, engaged, married, trips, home, celebrations, difficult days and reconciliation
• Rhythm view — a gentle day-by-day view of "sync", "steady" and "space" days for the two of you, drawn from the traditional Chinese calendar. It is a reflective cultural lens, not a prediction or advice
• PDF keepsake — export your timeline as a printable PDF to keep or share
• Private by design — no account, no ads, no tracking; everything stays on your device

SYNERGY TIMELINE PREMIUM
The app is free to use with up to 5 moments and a 30-day rhythm view. Synergy Timeline Premium is an optional auto-renewable monthly subscription (US$4.99 per month) that unlocks unlimited moments, photos on moments, the 90-day rhythm view and PDF export.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gways123.github.io/synergy-timeline-privacy.html

name: Syngularail Cinema
description:
観た映画とドラマの記録を、もっと楽しく。
Syngularail Cinema は、観た作品の記録と、これから観る作品さがしをひとつにしたアプリです。

■ ホーム
・NEWS：映画ナタリー・シネマカフェなどの最新ニュース。記事の作品や人を、そのまま開けます
・スケジュール：これから公開・上映中の映画を日付ごとに。近くの映画館もすぐ探せます
・配信：見放題で観られる新しい作品
・Favorites：好きな俳優・監督のこれからの作品

■ 作品のページ
・あらすじ、監督・出演、ジャンル、映倫の区分、製作費・興行収入
・IMDb・Rotten Tomatoes・Metacritic の点数
・観られる配信サービス（見放題・レンタル・購入）と、そのアプリで開くボタン
・予告編、場面写真のギャラリー、受賞・ノミネート、Wikipedia の解説
・原作（漫画・小説）、サウンドトラックと主題歌、ロケ地（Google マップ・ストリートビューで開ける）、前作・続編、シリーズ

■ 記録
・星（0.5刻み）、くわしい評価（物語・映像・音楽・演技…）
・感情（ラブ・ライク・ディスライク・ヘイト）と12の感想（楽しい・ドキドキ・感動・考えさせられる…）
・観た日・場所（映画館・配信サービス）、何回目か
・場面の記録：何分何秒からのシーンに、コメント・感情・感想
・テレビ番組はエピソードごとの星も

■ さがす
・題名・俳優・監督・キーワード（「・」やスペースがなくても見つかります）
・カテゴリ（邦画・洋画・ジャンル・年代・国）、配信サービス、受賞作品
・シリーズで検索：MCU・スター・ウォーズ・ハリー・ポッターなどを公開順・作中の時系列順で
・探検で探す：作品・人・ジャンルを地図のようにたどる Discover
・マイ条件：よく使う絞り込みを保存

■ あなたへ
・今夜なにを観る：観たいリストから、入っている配信・長さ・気分で3本
・おすすめ：好きな作品と人から、まだ観ていない作品
・ふり返り：1年の本数・ジャンル・監督・俳優・星・感想のまとめ

■ 便利な機能
・観たい作品の公開日・配信開始のお知らせ、公開日をカレンダーに
・ホーム画面のウィジェット、Siri とショートカット
・iCloud で iPhone と iPad をそろえる、毎日の自動バックアップ
・Netflix の視聴履歴・Letterboxd の取り込み、Trakt との同期、Jellyfin（自分のサーバー）
・アプリのアイコンを選べます（ライト・ダーク・モノクロ・シアター）

会員登録はありません。記録はあなたの端末と iCloud にだけ保存されます。

映画の情報：TMDB（The Movie Database）。このアプリは TMDB API を使っていますが、TMDB による承認・認定を受けたものではありません。配信の情報：JustWatch。

利用規約（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
プライバシーポリシー：https://tayuslab.com/syngularail/cinema/privacy/

name: Ta’m zo‘r — Savdo agenti
description:
Ta’m zo‘r — мобильное рабочее приложение для сотрудников дистрибьюторской компании: торговые агенты, продавцы автолавки и экспедиторы работают в одном приложении.

ТОРГОВЫЙ АГЕНТ
• Список клиентов и карта, визиты
• Заказы: остатки склада, скидка, наличные или в долг, дата доставки
• Отслеживание этапов заказа
• Приём оплаты долга
• Добавление нового клиента на месте

АВТОЛАВКА
• Заявка на загрузку машины и приёмка
• Продажа на месте: блок/штука, тип цены, скидка, частичная оплата
• Возврат и причина отказа
• Закрытие дня и касса

ЭКСПЕДИТОР
• Рейс и маршрут, адреса на карте
• Доставлено / не доставлено, возврат и брак
• Наличные на месте и сбор долгов

ЧЕК
• Печать на Bluetooth (BLE) и Wi-Fi термопринтер (58/80 мм)
• PDF-чек, отправка и AirPrint

БЕЗ ИНТЕРНЕТА
• Все операции сохраняются в телефоне и отправляются на сервер, когда появится связь

Для входа нужен логин и пароль от вашей компании. Публичной регистрации нет.

name: Tabletop Touchdown
description:
Remember folding a sheet of paper into a triangle and flicking it across your desk? Tabletop Touchdown puts that game in your pocket.

Pull back and let go to flick the paper football across the table. If it stops hanging over the far edge without falling off, that's a touchdown. Then kick the extra point through your opponent's finger goalposts.

It takes ten seconds to learn. Getting the triangle to stop right on the edge takes a lot longer.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Press, pull back and let go. A short pull nudges it, a long one sends it flying.
• You get 4 flicks per possession. Hang it over the far edge for 6 points.
• Kick field goals and extra points through the finger posts.
• Wind can blow from any direction, so read the arrow before you kick.
• The defender sets up a dummy in a helmet and shoulder pads to block your path.

SEVEN WAYS TO PLAY
• Career: 10 games, from an easy opener to the final.
• Tournament: an 8-team knockout. Win 3 games to lift the cup.
• Missions: 50 challenges with coins, cups, pencils, erasers and rulers in the way. Earn up to 3 stars on each.
• Trick Shots: 8 skill challenges that keep your personal best.
• Daily Challenge: a new mission every day.
• Vs CPU: easy, normal or hard, and you pick the target score.
• Vs Friend: two players on one device, sitting face to face, or on two nearby iPhones or iPads over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi. No internet needed.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Choose from 16 city teams, each with its own power, control and kick ratings, then give yours a name, colors and one of 24 emblems.
• Earn coins by winning and spend them on new paper designs, tables, touchdown effects and wristbands.
• Chase 30 achievements.
• Watch your best plays again in slow motion.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Plays offline. No account, no sign-in.
• Free to play. Ads appear only when you choose to watch one for a reward.
• Optional Premium Pack (one-time purchase): double coins and mission retries without ads, 1,000 coins and the exclusive Gold Rush touchdown effect.
• For iPhone and iPad, in English and Spanish.

name: Tagesquiz
description:
Jeden Tag eine Frage. Tagesquiz stellt allen Spielern dieselbe Frage des Tages, quer durch Geschichte, Geographie, Sport, Musik, Naturwissenschaften und mehr. Danach geht es mit vier Bonusfragen weiter, oder du trainierst, so lange du Lust hast.

FRAGE DES TAGES
• Eine neue Frage jeden Tag, für alle gleich
• Sobald genug mitgespielt haben, siehst du nach deiner Antwort, wie viel Prozent richtig lagen
• Deine Serie wächst mit jedem Tag, an dem du spielst. Einen verpassten Tag rettet der Joker, einer pro Monat
• Auf Wunsch erinnert dich die App zu deiner Uhrzeit, aber nur an Tagen, an denen du die Frage noch nicht gespielt hast

TRAINING
• Über 3.000 Fragen in 15 Themengebieten
• Zufallsquiz, das mit leichten Fragen beginnt und mit deinen richtigen Antworten schwerer wird
• Quiz nach Kategorien mit Fortschritt je Thema
• 25 Abzeichen und eine Statistik zu deinen Antworten

MIT FREUNDEN
• Eigene Gruppen mit Rangliste, beitreten nur per Einladung
• Freunde über WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS oder das Teilen-Menü einladen

OHNE ANMELDUNG
Du kannst sofort als Gast spielen, ohne E-Mail-Adresse. Nach deiner 30. Antwort bekommst du Zugangsdaten, mit denen du auch auf anderen Geräten weiterspielst. Dein Konto kannst du jederzeit im Profil löschen.

Keine Werbung, keine In-App-Käufe, keine Tracking-Dienste.

Die Fragen werden mit Hilfe von künstlicher Intelligenz erstellt. Findest du einen Fehler, schreib uns an info@tagesquiz.de.

name: TagLap
description:
TagLap counts your laps for you.

Tap your NFC tag on the TagLap lane device at the pool to check in, then just swim. Every time you touch the wall, the lane device counts a lap, times your split, and sends it to the app. Tap your tag again when you're done and your session is saved.

YOUR STATS, LIVE
• Laps and distance for today, updated as you swim
• Your best split, all-time totals, and your practice streak
• A live card while you're checked in, showing laps this session and your last split

HISTORY
• Every lane session saved automatically when you check out
• Open any session to see each lap and its split time
• Log practices by hand too — dryland, open water, or a pool without a lane device

TEAMS
• Create a team and share a six-character invite code
• Swimmers request to join; the coach approves who gets in
• A live team leaderboard ranked by laps today, with best splits
• Team totals: laps today, active swimmers, and average split

YOUR NFC TAG
• Link your tag by holding it to your phone
• One tag per swimmer, so laps are always credited to the right person

TagLap works with the TagLap lane device, a small sensor mounted at the end of the lane that reads your tag and feels each wall touch. No buttons to press mid-swim, no watch to wear in the water.

name: TagTeamTreasure
description:
Tag Team Treasure is a cozy co-op platformer made for a parent and a kid to play together, side by side on one iPhone or from two different cities.

BIG BEAR freezes time. Spinning saws stop, gates hold open, and moving platforms wait for you. While time is frozen, he's strong enough to push heavy crates into place.

ROCKET FOX double-jumps to the highest ledges and squeezes through tiny tunnels to hit switches nobody else can reach.

Every level needs both powers. Grab the gems together, then open the shared treasure chest at the end, as a team.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Live Co-op: invite a family member on another iPhone and play at the same time, with a hold-to-talk walkie-talkie.
• Ghost Run: take turns whenever you have a minute. Play your part, send it, and your partner plays alongside your ghost.
• Pass & Play: one phone, two players. Split the controls or take turns.
• Solo: play with an AI partner and tap Tag to swap heroes any time.

NO STRESS, JUST TEAMWORK
No timers. No lives. Lots of checkpoints. A fall just sends you back a few steps.

15 LEVELS, 3 WORLDS
Explore Sunny Meadows, Candy Canyon and Starlight Peaks. Finish a world to earn a Postcard stamped with both your hometowns for your scrapbook.

FAMILY-FRIENDLY BY DESIGN
• One price, with no ads, no tracking and no in-app purchases
• Family Sharing: buy once for the whole family
• Online play is invite-only through Apple Game Center, so no strangers
• Voice chat is never recorded or stored
• Hometowns are typed in, never taken from GPS
• Game controller support

name: Tahor
description:
Tahor es un navegador web para iPhone pensado para navegar sin imágenes.

Con Tahor podés recorrer cualquier sitio web con las fotos bloqueadas: las páginas cargan más rápido, consumen menos datos y te concentrás solo en el texto.

CUATRO MODOS DE BLOQUEO
• Bloqueo total de imágenes: no se muestra ninguna foto, sin excepciones.
• Bloqueo de personas: se cubren las imágenes donde aparecen personas.
• Solo mujeres: el análisis se realiza en tu propio teléfono, sin enviar nada a internet.
• Solo mujeres con IA: análisis con inteligencia artificial para mayor precisión. Si una mujer aparece vestida de forma no recatada, la imagen se bloquea por completo.

COMO EL NAVEGADOR QUE YA CONOCÉS
Tahor se ve y se usa como Safari: pestañas, navegación privada, favoritos, buscar en la página y versión de escritorio. Todo funciona igual, solo que sin imágenes.

PRIVACIDAD
En los modos locales, el análisis se realiza íntegramente en tu dispositivo. En el modo con IA, las imágenes de las páginas se envían a un servicio de inteligencia artificial para su análisis y no se almacenan.

name: Takatrace Kepro System
description:
Running a waste collection center, aggregation yard, transport fleet, or recycling facility takes hard work every single day. Between weighing incoming bags, tracking yard inventory, confirming deliveries, and managing paper receipts, you need a reliable digital tool built for real field conditions.

TakaTrace (the KEPRO Waste Management Digital Platform) is built specifically for waste-chain operators across Kenya under the Sustainable Waste Management Act and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Regulations. Whether you collect recyclables in the community, manage an urban aggregation yard, operate licensed waste trucks, or run an industrial recycling plant, TakaTrace puts your daily operations and verified EPR compliance in one place.

KEY FEATURES

• Digital Two-Step Handshake Trades
Log buy and sell transactions in seconds for PET bottles, HDPE, cardboard, glass, metals, and other recyclables with automatic calculations. Both parties digitally confirm every trade with geo-tagged photo evidence—eliminating lost paper receipts and disputes.

• Real-Time Yard & Branch Inventory
Know your exact stock levels at any moment across loose materials, sorted bags, and compressed bales. Track stock movements by site and branch so you can plan deliveries and negotiate bulk sales with confidence.

• Verified EPR Claims & Incentive Payouts
Every verified kilogram you collect, aggregate, transport, or recycle connects directly to the KEPRO EPR compliance loop. Track pending claims, verification approvals, and incentive payout statements with full transparency.

• Delivery Trips & Chain-of-Custody Manifests
Moving materials from collection yards to recyclers? Create digital trip manifests, attach weighbridge receipts and vehicle details, and receive instant confirmation when loads are accepted at the destination facility.

• Offline-First Field Capture
Network coverage can be unpredictable at remote transfer stations and collection depots. TakaTrace lets you record weights, capture geo-tagged evidence photos, and queue transactions offline—automatically syncing securely once connectivity returns.

• Role-Tailored Experience
Customize your dashboard navigation for one-tap access to your most-used tools. Dedicated workspaces support Waste Collectors, Aggregators, Transporters, Recyclers, and Auditors.

• Built-In NEMA & EPR Audit Compliance
Every recorded trade automatically builds a tamper-proof digital audit trail with timestamps, GPS verification, and evidence hashes—making formal compliance effortless.

WHO THIS APP IS FOR
• Waste collectors and community self-help groups (CBOs)
• Waste aggregators, buy-back centers, and Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs)
• Licensed waste transporters and logistics operators
• Recyclers and secondary material processors
• EPR compliance auditors

ABOUT KEPRO
The Kenya Extended Producer Responsibility Organization (KEPRO) is mandated under Kenya's Sustainable Waste Management Act to ensure packaging materials are collected, traced, and recycled back into the economy—formalising and rewarding the waste-chain actors powering a cleaner Kenya.

name: Talent Language School
description:
Talent Language School system is the only way to communicate all our teachers, Students, Parents, Staff and the school management together.
The application helps our students and parents to fully integrate into the school life daily operations in an easy and smart way

name: Talia - Offer Trail
seller_name: LOW CHAI ENG & SONS TRADING SDN. BHD.
description:
Talia - Offer Trail turns supplier conversations into a clear record of what was offered, discussed, and agreed.

Follow the source behind every term:
• Chats — keep vendor conversations and open the exact thread behind each quote.
• Offers — review live prices, quantities, delivery dates, payment terms, and counteroffers.
• Trail — trace every change back to the sentence that moved it.
• Archive — revisit accepted and closed agreements.
• Profile — see what stays on your device.

Talia is designed for freelancers, small procurement teams, agencies, and partnership leads who negotiate across messages and need to remember exactly what changed.

Talia is intended for users aged 18 and over.

name: Tape Sum Calculator
description:
Open straight to your last tape. Paste several expenses at once, fix a line and see the new total immediately.

• Add or edit amounts and notes, including refunds and negative amounts.
• See which lines need checking and keep a subtotal for valid entries.
• Copy the full list or share an image for short tapes and full text for longer ones. Share only the checked item count when you want to hide amounts.
• Receive and edit .sumtape files for free. Your tapes stay on this device.

Pro adds multiple tapes, blank templates and file export. Try Pro for 30 days from first launch, then unlock it with a one-time purchase. There is no subscription or automatic charge. After the trial you can still edit, copy and share existing tapes, and import files.

name: TapeMark: Tape Measure Calc
description:
TapeMark is a tape measure calculator for feet, inches, fractions and metric, built around Siri, Apple Intelligence and a Live Activity. Ask Siri "What's 25 3/8 divided by 3?" and see the answer marked on a tape. Walk along the wall in Mark Mode while the next mark waits on your Lock Screen. Describe a job in plain words and Apple Intelligence sets it up. Pay once: no subscription, no ads, no account.

JUST ASK SIRI
"Calculate with TapeMark." "Space shelves with TapeMark." "Hang pictures with TapeMark." "Start Mark Mode in TapeMark." "Next mark in TapeMark." "Add a cut in TapeMark." "How many boards in TapeMark." Siri answers with the fraction spoken out loud and a mini tape showing the mark. Every action also works in Shortcuts and Spotlight, a Control Center control or the Action button moves to the next mark, and widgets show your last result and next mark.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE, WHEN YOU WANT IT
• Describe the job: "10 ft wall, 3 pictures 16 in wide, even gaps" sets up the right tool for you.
• Photo to plan: snap a sketch or a spec sheet and turn its measurements into a cut list.
• Project builder: "3-shelf bookcase, 36 wide" drafts the parts list.
• Explain my answer, Check my plan and a shopping summary in plain words.
The AI never does the math: every number comes from TapeMark's exact fraction engine, so it can't cause a wrong cut. It runs on your device or with Private Cloud Compute, and everything works without it.

MARK MODE, LIVE ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Step through every mark of a layout with huge numbers: "Mark 4 of 9: 37 5/16 in". The Live Activity and Dynamic Island show the current and next mark with Back and Done, so you can keep both hands on the ladder.

EXACT TAPE MATH
Add, subtract, multiply and divide feet, inches, fractions, centimeters and millimeters in one line: 6' 4 3/8" − 2 5/16". Round to 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4 or 1 mm, and see how far the rounding moved the value. Every answer is drawn on a realistic tape with red 16" stud marks and black 19.2" diamonds.

LAYOUT TOOLS
• Even spacing: shelves, fence posts, balusters or deck boards, with every mark measured from the wall edge.
• Picture hanging: one frame, a row or a grid, at eye level, with the wire drop and one or two hooks. TapeMark tells you where each nail goes, from the edge and from the floor.
• The wall is drawn to scale so you can see it before you drill.

PROJECTS, CUT LISTS AND BOARDS TO BUY
Collect cuts by project, mark them done, and see how many 8, 10, 12 or 16 ft boards to buy, with the saw kerf and the waste on each board. Start from templates: bookcase, floating shelf, picture ledge, baseboards, fence and deck.

AREA AND MATERIALS
Paint gallons, tile boxes and drywall sheets for walls and floors, minus doors and windows.

LEARN YOUR TAPE
What the red numbers and black diamonds mean, why the hook is loose, standard heights for hanging and mounting, a fraction to decimal to millimeter chart, and lumber sizes. Every fact comes with its source.

ON IPHONE, IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
On iPad and the open iPhone Duo, the calculator sits beside a large tape and the form beside the wall drawing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, analytics, ads or tracking. Your projects stay on your device. Apple Intelligence requests may be processed by Apple; see the privacy policy.

Results are exact for the numbers you enter. Measure twice and check before you cut or drill.

LINKS
