Privacy Policy: https://degleon.github.io/app-support/tapemark/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://degleon.github.io/app-support/tapemark/terms.html
License (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support and contact: https://degleon.github.io/app-support/tapemark/#support

name: TapZoom: Screen Demo Maker
description:
Built for indie app developers sharing feature updates and build-in-public demos across social feeds, product launches, and changelogs.

Take any vertical, landscape, or square screen recording from your library, drag and drop a .mov / .mp4 file, or load the built-in 8-second sample recording to turn it into a clear, focused 1080p MP4 demo on a single screen:

1. Head/Tail Trim, Middle Cut & 2x/4x Speed-Up
Trim away Control Center pull-downs, cut out dead middle pauses, or speed up waiting stretches to 2x or 4x with pitch-preserved audio — while all zoom keyframes, ripples, and step captions stay locked to the footage. Toggle audio mute and undo/redo effortlessly.

2. Minimalist Frames, Full Bleed, Alpha .mov & Adaptive 9:41 Bar
Choose from 3 minimalist rounded shadow frames (Dark, Light, or None) across 5 canvas formats (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9, or Full borderless original aspect) and 6 curated backdrops — or enable Transparent Alpha (.mov) to export HEVC overlays into other editors. Optionally cover the top red recording bar with an adaptive 9:41 status strip.

3. Visual Change Cues, Tap-to-Zoom & Top Headlines
Jump straight to on-device Screen Change Cues on the timeline, step frame-by-frame, and tap directly on the preview screen to drop zoom highlights (Snappy, Smooth, or Gentle motion) and high-contrast tap ripples. Add an optional Top Headline or per-zoom Step Caption for silent viewers.

4. Crisp 1080p MP4 & Alpha .mov Offline Export
Export deterministic 1080p 30fps or 60fps Rec.709 H.264 MP4 or transparent HEVC with Alpha .mov videos straight to Photos or Files.

SIMPLE, HONEST PRICING & PRIVACY
• Test freely first: the built-in 8s sample recording exports unlimited times, and your 1st rendered 1080p snapshot of your own recording is free with zero watermarks (re-saving that exact rendered file stays free).
• Unlock unlimited new edits and additional recordings across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with a single one-time purchase. No subscriptions, no credit packs, and no account sign-up.
• 100% On-Device Privacy: all screen recordings, drafts, and exported videos are processed locally on your device and are never uploaded to external servers. View the full Privacy Policy & Support contact directly inside the app.

Note: Framed and zoomed exports are designed for social media posts, changelogs, and websites (not intended as raw unframed App Store Connect App Previews).

name: Target Below - Moonstep Saga
description:
Moonlight pierces only the wicked.

Welcome to Tsukiura, a fictional harbor town. You are a "wrecker" who demolishes only the hideouts of the Black Moon gang.

Your tool: a magic beam made from shards of the moon.
Place a magic circle on the target building and call down a single shaft of light.
It burns through the roof floor by floor, and bursts the moment it reaches the room you chose.

HOW TO PLAY
- Pick a mission and check the target's address and room
- Tap the town to place the magic circle (the address you're aiming at is shown instantly)
- Choose how many moon shards to use to set the beam's power
- Press CAST. Destroy only the target to succeed

STRICT RULES
- If any civilian dies or an innocent house is damaged, the mission FAILS
- Civilian injuries lower your stars and score
- The top floor of a tower, a single apartment... too strong or too weak and you fail
Minimum light, villains only. That's the wrecker's code.

CINEMATIC EFFECTS
- A blue-violet magic circle opens before the beam pierces the building
- The camera stays on the point of impact through the burst
- Burning streets, ambulances, fire engines and police arrive
- About 2,000 lines of chatter from the townsfolk

JAPANESE AND ENGLISH
Other languages can be chosen with the globe button on the title screen (partly shown in English).

This is a fantasy set in a fictional town. Rated 18+ for fantasy violence and blood.
One-time purchase. No ads, no in-app purchases.

name: Taskdone – To-do & PC
description:
Taskdone puts your to-do list and your own PC in your pocket.

TO-DO
• One list on your iPhone and at taskdone.io, always in sync.
• Add tasks in your own words, check them off, set reminders.

DESKTOP
• Browse the folders on your Windows PC that runs Taskdone, from anywhere: open files, upload photos, make folders.
• Chat with Claude on your PC: send it files and folders, watch it work, and answer it by voice, hands-free.
• Swipe between Files and Chat.

YOUR ACCOUNT
• Sign in with Apple or Google. Your PCs show up by themselves when they're signed in to the same account.
• Your list is visible only to you. Delete your account any time in Settings.

Desktop needs the free Taskdone app for Windows (taskdone.io/download), with "Use this PC from taskdone.io" turned on in its sidebar settings.

name: Taskrivo: To-Do List & Planner
description:
Bring your daily plans together with Taskrivo, a to-do list and reminder app for organizing tasks, building habits, and making time for focused work.

Organize your tasks
Capture tasks and organize them into lists and projects. Add due dates, priorities, notes, subtasks, tags, and attachments to keep the details together.

Plan your day and week
Use calendar views, daily planning, and weekly reviews to see what is coming up and decide what to work on next.

Set reminders and repeating tasks
Schedule reminders and recurring tasks for regular commitments. Snooze or postpone tasks when your plans change. Reminder delivery depends on your device permissions and system settings.

Build habits and routines
Track habits, review your progress, and create routines with steps you can follow throughout the day.

Make time to focus
Use the focus timer to structure work sessions and review your focus history.

Review your progress
Explore productivity reports and export your data. Back up your plans and restore them when needed.

Personalize your experience
Choose a light or dark theme and an accent color that suits you. Start planning without creating an account. Sign in to use cloud synchronization and invitation-only sharing.

Optional Taskrivo Premium removes ads. All planning features are available in the free app. Choose a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscription charges and renewal terms are shown before purchase. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple account settings.

Privacy policy: https://taskrivo-support.appdevs-net.chatgpt.site/privacy.html
Terms: https://appdevs.net/terms-of-conditions
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Tasty's UK
description:
Tasty's is Luton's home of flame-grilled peri peri and southern fried chicken, on Manchester Street. Order straight from the kitchen, at shop prices.

FLAME-GRILLED PERI PERI
Chicken grilled over the flame and basted in your heat: Lemon & Herb, Mild, Hot or Extra Hot. Choose once and the app remembers, or mix Lemon & Herb with another heat for something in between.

SOUTHERN FRIED, BURGERS AND DONNER
Crisp chicken on the bone, wings, strips and nuggets. Burgers, wraps and donner. Platters and family meals made for sharing. Everything is halal, and every order comes with Tasty's own chilli dip.

YOUR WAY
• Collect from Manchester Street: the app shows how long the kitchen is taking
• Delivery across 3 miles of Luton, every evening from 5pm
• Order now, or choose a time and it's ready when you are
• Cash only: pay at the counter or to the driver

LIVE FROM THE KITCHEN
Follow your order on the Track tab, from Received to Cooking to Ready, with your number waiting at the counter.

TASTE BUDS REWARDS
Join free and start with 250 Chilli Points. Earn on every pound and turn your points into free food, from chips to full meals.

FIND US
Two minutes from Luton station, right opposite the bus stops. Open late, seven days a week.

name: Taurim Gale
description:
The science of friendship is surprisingly specific. Six core patterns. 
Dozens of micro-behaviours that determine which relationships last and 
which ones quietly fall apart. Almost nobody knows any of them, and nobody bothers to teach them.

OmegaFlow started as a fixation on one question: why do some connections actually stick while most don't? It became a daily habit system built 
around one uncomfortable truth — you can't understand people by reading about them. You have to practise, track what you do honestly, and eventually look at the data.

The app opens on a single prompt. Were you there today, or not. Both answers count. The streak isn't there to punish you — it's the raw material the rest of the app needs to work.

After a few honest sessions, LOG starts to build a real picture. Not a dashboard of hollow green checkmarks, but a record you can actually read. 
That record flows into PATTERNS, where a radar chart shows which of the six friendship dimensions you've been putting time into and which ones you've been quietly skipping. The gap between where you assume you are and where you actually are is usually the more useful information.

MAP shows the five phases every close relationship moves through — from first contact through the kind of trust that holds up under real pressure 
— and places your logged sessions inside that framework. It's not theory. It's your own data, organised.

LENS puts a camera on the moment. Point it at a social situation, get a structured question to reflect on. Not face filters, not AI guesswork — just the deliberate attention that psychologists call mentalising and most people only do accidentally.

STUDY tracks the arc. You enter as a Layperson. You work toward Chronicler. The distance between them is sessions completed, recall \accuracy, and patterns recognised — not a subscription tier.

Four minutes per session. That is the whole ask. Short enough to do on a bad day. Consistent enough to actually compound into something.

Most apps promise to make you a better person. This one just shows you where you currently stand.

name: Tavern Bag
description:
Tavern Bag is the pocket companion for tabletop role-playing at the table: a fast dice roller, a searchable library of open-licence fifth edition rules, and your characters, all in one app.

ROLL
- Tap d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 or d100 and feel each roll through haptic feedback on your phone.
- Advantage and disadvantage on a d20, a modifier, and a number of dice in one tap.
- Type a formula such as 2d6+3 or 4d6kh3 and roll it.
- Name and save the formulas you use every session, like Longsword or Fireball. A history of your recent rolls stays on your device.

LOOK IT UP
- Thousands of spells, monsters, magic items, feats, backgrounds, races and rules, searchable by name or by what you mean ("a creature that pretends to be a treasure").
- Full monster pages: armor class, hit points, speed, ability scores and saves, skills, senses, traits and actions.
- Open content only: the System Reference Document 5.1 and 5.2 (CC-BY-4.0) plus openly licensed third-party books. Every entry names the book it comes from, and the Licences screen carries the notices.
- No account needed. Open the app and browse.
- Save entries to your device and keep reading with no signal at the table, in the cellar or on the train.

KEEP YOUR HEROES
- Sign in with your Tavern Bag account to see your characters and their full, view-only sheets: abilities, saves, skills, attacks, spells and gear.
- Your plan name shows in your account.
- Delete your account and everything saved to it from the Account screen whenever you like.

Tavern Bag is unofficial content. It uses the System Reference Document 5.1 and 5.2 under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence and Open Game Content under the Open Game Licence 1.0a, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.

name: Tavern Storage: Fridge Tracker
description:
Does food in your fridge go bad before you remember it? Tavern Storage is a pixel-art fridge tracker and food expiry date reminder. Put your groceries in, and Piggy the keeper remembers when each item expires and reminds you to eat it first.

TRACK YOUR FRIDGE IN ONE TAP
- 142 common foods, each with its own pixel icon
- Suggested storage days for fridge, freezer and pantry are filled in for you
- Search by name, or add your own foods
- Foods you buy often come first

FOOD EXPIRY REMINDERS
- Your fridge is sorted by days left; food that expires today blinks
- A daily report every morning (you pick the time): what expires today and tomorrow
- No reminder on days when nothing expires
- Eat something within a day of its expiry date and it counts as "rescued"

GROCERY LIST & PANTRY RESTOCK
- Food you used up shows up in "Quick restock"; one tap adds it to your grocery list
- Or pick straight from the food catalog
- Check items off at the store, then stock your whole grocery list with one tap

A PIG THAT TIDIES UP
- Everything you stock drops into the scene and piles up into a little hill
- Tap or fling things around, and Piggy runs to pick them up. Mess it up too often and he gets grumpy
- Eat your food well and Piggy likes you more

WASTE LESS FOOD
- How much you ate, tossed and rescued this month
- Advanced ledger: 6-month trend and the food you toss most
- 10 badges to collect

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
- No sign-up, no account, works offline
- No personal data collected, no ads, no tracking
- New phone? Copy a backup code and take your whole fridge with you
- Available in English, 繁體中文, 日本語 and 한국어

PRICE
- Free: track up to 30 items at a time with 51 common foods
- Buy once: no item limit, all 142 foods, 4 room themes, the advanced ledger and a second daily reminder
- No subscription. Your items, reminders and backups keep working whether or not you upgrade

Great for living alone, small families, and anyone who wants to cut food waste and save on groceries.
Storage days are general guidelines. Always check the food itself and the expiry date on the label.

name: Tavrra
description:
Tavrra is a collaboration and AI workspace for businesses and project teams.

KEEP PROJECT CONTEXT TOGETHER
Organize discussions by workspace and channel, communicate through direct messages and threads, and share files where work happens. Search previous conversations to help your team find decisions and background information.

COORDINATE THE NEXT STEP
Follow tasks, decisions and dates alongside team discussions. Use calendars, scheduled tasks and saved items to organize follow-up work across projects.

BRING AI INTO TEAM WORKFLOWS
A digital double can help answer questions using shared conversation context. Licensed Agents support research and information organization. Review their results and approve actions that require a human decision.

WORK WITH ORGANIZATION CONTROLS
Access available workspaces and features according to your organization’s plan and permissions. Continue on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with configurable notifications and quiet hours.

A Tavrra account and workspace access are required. Features depend on the organization’s plan, assigned permissions and connected services. Agent capabilities require an eligible license or trial and are subject to usage limits. Review important AI outputs for accuracy before using them.

name: TBIPTV Xstream
description:
TBIPTV Xstream is a media player for iPhone and iPad that plays IPTV playlists you already have.

IMPORTANT: TBIPTV Xstream does not include, sell or link to any channels, films, series or subscriptions. It is a player only. To use it, add an Xtream Codes login or M3U playlist address from a service you are legally entitled to watch.

Features:
• Live TV with categories, search and a TV guide (XMLTV / EPG)
• Films and series with posters, plots, cast and episode lists
• Continue watching: pick up films and episodes where you left off, with automatic next episode
• Picture in Picture: keep watching a film in a floating window while you browse
• Portrait, landscape, and iPhone Duo: browse and watch together on the inner display; the player follows the fold in tent or book pose
• Favourites, watch history and downloads of titles from your playlist
• Cast photos and biographies from Wikipedia and Wikidata

Privacy: your playlist logins are stored only on this device and are sent only to the server you enter. No accounts, adverts or tracking.

name: TC SAINT MARTIN ARDECHE
description:
Une application très complète, qui va vous permettre de :
- Réserver dans votre club,
- Accéder aux informations principales,
- Remplir votre Wallet avec les cartes prépayées,
- Obtenir l'information en direct,
- Suivre vos compétitions.

Et plein d'autres fonctionnalités !

name: TeachShelf
description:
TeachShelf puts the online courses in your learner account on your iPhone.

YOUR SHELF
Every course in your account sits on your shelf with its progress. The big Up next card takes you straight to the lesson where you stopped — video, text, quizzes or a live session.

REMINDERS THAT HELP YOU FINISH
Turn on notifications to hear about new lessons, upcoming live sessions and gentle study reminders from your instructors.

WORKS WHEN YOU ARE OFFLINE
Your shelf and progress from the last sync stay visible without a connection, so you always know what to study next.

EXPLORE
Browse the course catalogue with course outlines, instructors and free preview lessons.

COMMUNITY, SAFELY
Course communities let you discuss lessons with classmates. You can report any post or comment and block people you do not want to see.

ACCOUNT CONTROL
Delete your account at any time from the Account section of the app.

TeachShelf does not sell anything in the app. Courses already in your account are available in full.

name: TeamCraft Chat
description:
TeamCraft ist ein Team-Chat für Unternehmen und Organisationen, die ihren eigenen Server betreiben. Channels, Direktnachrichten, Anrufe und Meetings sind Ende-zu-Ende-verschlüsselt: Der Server speichert und verteilt die Nachrichten, kann sie aber nicht lesen.

Für die App brauchst du einen TeamCraft-Server. Deine Organisation betreibt ihn, und du meldest dich mit deinem Firmenkonto an (Single Sign-on).

CHAT
• Channels in Spaces, Direktnachrichten und Gruppenchats
• Threads, Antworten, Reaktionen und Erwähnungen
• Nachrichten bearbeiten und löschen
• Fotos, Videos und Dateien mit Vorschau, Teilen aus anderen Apps
• Linkvorschauen, ohne dass dein iPhone die Website aufruft
• Suche mit Filtern (Person, Channel, Datum, Dateien, Links)

ANRUFE UND MEETINGS
• Sprach- und Videoanrufe in Direktnachrichten und Channels
• Anrufe erscheinen wie Telefonanrufe, auch auf dem Sperrbildschirm und in CarPlay
• Sicherheitscode, damit niemand mithört
• Anstehende Meetings, Zu- und Absagen, Beitritt zum Anruf

VERSCHLÜSSELUNG UND DATENSCHUTZ
• Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung mit dem MLS-Standard (RFC 9420)
• Jedes Gerät hat eigene Schlüssel; neue Geräte per QR-Code verknüpfen
• Wiederherstellung per Passphrase oder über deine Organisation
• App-Sperre mit Face ID
• Keine Werbung, kein Tracking; Push-Benachrichtigungen enthalten keine lesbaren Nachrichteninhalte, sie werden erst auf dem iPhone entschlüsselt

BENACHRICHTIGUNGEN
• Absender und Vorschau in der Mitteilung, entschlüsselt auf dem Gerät
• Aus der Mitteilung antworten und als gelesen markieren
• Stummschalten, Nicht stören mit Zeitplan, eigene Stichwörter

FÜR ORGANISATIONEN
• Läuft auf deinem eigenen Server; Open Source (AGPL-3.0)
• Anmeldung über euren Identity Provider (OpenID Connect)
• Serveradresse per MDM vorgeben
• Administratoren verwalten Personen und Channels ohne Zugriff auf Nachrichteninhalte

TeamCraft gibt es auch für Android, Windows, macOS, Linux und im Browser. Quellcode, Dokumentation und Server-Einrichtung: https://github.com/Zeitgleich/TeamCraft

name: Tekram
description:
تطبيق "تاجر تكرام" هو لوحة التحكم الرسمية لأصحاب المتاجر والمبدعين المسجلين في منصة تكرام، صُمم خصيصاً لمساعدتك في إدارة أعمالك الرقمية ومتابعة مبيعاتك لحظة بلحظة ومن أي مكان.

سواء كنت تبيع كتباً إلكترونية، قوالب، تصاميم، أو دورات تدريبية عبر متجرك في تكرام، يمنحك هذا التطبيق الأدوات اللازمة لمراقبة أداء متجرك وإدارته بكل سهولة واحترافية.

ماذا يقدم لك تطبيق تاجر تكرام؟

• متابعة فورية للمبيعات: اطلع على أحدث الطلبات والمبيعات لحظة إتمامها.
• إشعارات تنبيهية مباشرة: استقبل إشعارات فورية بكل طلب جديد أو عملية دفع تتم في متجرك.
• إدارة المنتجات والمخزون: استعرض قائمة منتجاتك الرقمية وحالاتها وقم بتحديثها بسهولة.
• التقارير والتحليلات المالية: تتبع أرباحك، التسويات المالية، وعمليات السحب بدقة وشفافية.
• خدمة العملاء والرسائل: تواصل مع عملاء متجرك وقم بالرد على استفساراتهم بسرعة.
• أمان وحماية عالية: وصول آمن ومحمي للوحة تحكم متجرك باستخدام أحدث معايير الأمان.

name: TelePrompt Studio
description:
TelePrompt turns your iPad into a professional teleprompter – built for beam-splitter glass rigs in front of the camera.

Text appears in white or the color of your choice, always on black, and mirrored so it reads correctly in the glass. Scrolling is perfectly smooth, and you can turn the speed up or down while you read.

PROJECTS AND SCRIPTS
• Organize your text in projects – with one or more scripts in each, for example one per scene or take
• Type directly, paste, or import Word (.docx), PDF, RTF, plain text, OpenDocument, HTML, XML and Final Draft
• Everything is saved automatically on the iPad

USE IT ON ITS OWN – OR CONTROL IT REMOTELY
• Tap the text to start and stop, and drag to scroll
• When paused, you get controls for speed, text size, mirroring, restart and switching scripts
• Control everything from a computer or phone on the same Wi-Fi: open the address in a browser and enter the code – nothing to install
• Edit the text, switch scripts and adjust the speed live while recording

FIT IT TO YOUR RIG
• Font size, line spacing, paragraph spacing, margins and bold text
• Horizontal and vertical mirroring
• Reading marker with adjustable position
• Bluetooth keyboard and foot pedal support: space, arrow keys and Page Up/Down

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your scripts stay on your iPad.

TelePrompt is made by MHM Media Productions.

name: Tellify: TV Remote Control
description:
Lost the remote? Your iPhone is the remote now.

Tellify turns your iPhone and iPad into a TV remote in seconds. The buttons you use every day stay free forever: no ads, no tap limits, no account.

WHY PEOPLE SWITCH TO TELLIFY
Other remote apps lock the volume behind a weekly subscription, show an ad every few taps, or stop working after ten presses. Tellify never does. Power, volume, mute, channels, the D-pad, OK, Back, Home and Input are free, with no limits.

READY IN 3 STEPS
1. Open Tellify on the same Wi-Fi as your TV.
2. Tap your TV. Tellify finds it for you.
3. Control it. You pair once, and your TV is remembered.

TV NOT SHOWING UP?
The built-in connection check tells you exactly why (Wi-Fi, the Local Network permission or a TV setting) and how to fix it. No guessing.

THE FREE REMOTE
• Power, volume, mute, channels and input
• Big D-pad with OK, Back, Home and Menu
• Play, pause, rewind and fast-forward
• Big Buttons mode for easy tapping
• Sleep timer: your TV turns itself off
• A light tap you can feel on every press
• Wake your TV from standby, where the TV supports it

GO FURTHER WITH TELLIFY PRO
• Type on your TV with your iPhone keyboard, or search by voice
• Touchpad for smooth navigation
• Quick Texts: send an email, a Wi-Fi password or a login in one tap
• Open your TV's apps in one tap and keep favorites
• Show photos and videos from your iPhone on the TV
• Screen Mirroring (photos, videos and mirroring are not available on Amazon Fire TV)
• Home Screen widgets, Control Center and Lock Screen controls, the Action button and Siri
• Live Activity: the remote on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Apple Watch remote
• Every TV in your home, room by room
• 7 themes

WORKS WITH
Samsung smart TVs (Tizen), LG smart TVs (webOS, and many older NetCast models from 2012–2015), Roku TV and Roku streaming players, Google TV and Android TV, and Amazon Fire TV. That includes many TCL, Hisense, onn, Sharp, Philips, Sony, Insignia and Toshiba models that run Roku TV, Google TV or Fire TV. Your iPhone and TV need to be on the same Wi-Fi.
Not supported yet: Vizio, Apple TV, and TVs without Wi-Fi (iPhone has no infrared).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Tellify talks to your TV directly over your home network. Nothing about you or your TV is collected.

Speaks your language: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Turkish, Russian and Chinese (Simplified).

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Tellify Pro is available as a weekly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. The yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Tellify Pro supports Family Sharing.

Terms of Use: https://onelabsllc.com/tv-remote-terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://onelabsllc.com/tv-remote-privacy.html

Tellify is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any of the companies named above. All brand names are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: TeqComms
description:
TeqComms turns your crew's phones into a full-duplex intercom. Camera, sound, stage, media, ushers and security each get their own channel, and the director can talk to everyone at once. It runs on the venue's own Wi-Fi, so it keeps working when the internet doesn't.

For the crew

Hold to talk, or double-tap to latch
Your channel, plus the ones you need to hear
Works with wired and Bluetooth earpieces; headset button to talk
Keeps working with the screen off
For ushers and protocol

Silent cues: a vibration and a full-screen card ("Offering next", "Altar call", "Move to position")
One tap to acknowledge; the director sees who has
For the director

All-call to every phone, private calls, cue presets
Live list of who's online, talking, and how their battery and signal are
Set up in minutes

Run TeqComms Host on a laptop wired to the router (Mac or Windows), or host from an Android phone's hotspot
Crew scan one QR code to join; no accounts needed on the day
Recovers by itself after a power cut

name: Teqnoloji: Teknoloji Haberleri
description:
Teqnoloji, teknoloji gündemini tek bir akışta toplar. 40'tan fazla teknoloji yayınını takip ediyor, önemli gelişmeleri kısa ve anlaşılır Türkçe özetlerle önüne getiriyoruz. Reklam yok, ücret yok, okumak için hesap gerekmez.

KAYNAĞI HER ZAMAN GÖRÜNÜR
Derleme haberlerin sonunda kaynak yayınlar ve özgün haberlerin bağlantıları yer alır; fotoğrafların kaynağı belirtilir. Bir haberin ayrıntısını merak edersen tek dokunuşla kaynağına gidebilirsin.

NELER VAR?
• Gündem: Günün öne çıkan teknoloji haberleri.
• Senin İçin: Seçtiğin ilgi alanlarına göre hazırlanan kişisel akış.
• Hızlı bakış: Son haberlere numaralı, kısa bir listeyle göz at.
• Reels: Haberleri tam ekran, kaydırarak oku; çift dokunarak favorilerine ekle.
• Bölümler: Yapay Zekâ, Mobil, Oyun, Girişim, Bilim, Güvenlik ve İnceleme.
• Arama: Aradığın konuyu fotoğraflı sonuçlarla hızla bul.
• Favoriler: Sonra okumak istediğin haberleri kaydet.
• Yorumlar: Haberler hakkında düşünceni paylaş, uygunsuz yorumları şikayet et.
• Bildirimler: Önemli gelişmelerden haberdar ol; istediğin an kapat.
• Piyasa şeridi: Bitcoin ve döviz kurlarına ana sayfadan göz at.
• Açık ve koyu mod: Cihazının görünümüne uyum sağlar.

GİZLİLİĞİNE SAYGI
• Haberleri okumak için hesap açman gerekmez.
• Favoriler, yorumlar ve kişisel akış için isteğe bağlı olarak Apple veya Google ile giriş yapabilirsin.
• Kullanım istatistikleri yalnızca onay verirsen toplanır (KVKK); tercihini Profil sayfasından dilediğin an değiştirebilirsin.
• Reklam ve reklam takibi yok.
• Hesabını uygulamanın içinden, Profil → Hesabımı Sil ile dilediğin an kalıcı olarak silebilirsin.

ŞEFFAFLIK NOTU
Derleme özetler yapay zekâ desteğiyle hazırlanabilir ve "Derleme" etiketiyle gösterilir. Bir hata görürsen iletisim@teqnoloji.com adresine yazabilirsin; kontrol edip düzeltiriz.

Teqnoloji, QARO Istanbul tarafından geliştirilmektedir.
Gizlilik Politikası: https://teqnoloji.com/gizlilik
Kullanım Koşulları: https://teqnoloji.com/kullanim-kosullari

name: Terrassio: Deck Calculator
description:
Building a wood deck and need the number of boards, right now? Terrassio calculates while you measure: enter width and length and the app gives you rows, boards, joists, pedestals and screws, checks board gap and joist spacing against installation rules, and draws a dimensioned plan view in real time.

FREE, WITH ZERO ADS
• Complete rectangular deck: board rows, last ripped row, joists, pedestals, screws, area
• "Fit": the gap adjusts itself so the last row is a full board
• Wood or composite, stock lengths for boards and joists, waste allowance listed separately
• Live dimensioned drawing that reacts to every adjustment
• mm, cm or inches (fractions to 1/16") — exact figures, never silently rounded
• 100% offline: everything works on a job site with no signal
• No ads, no timers, no account. Ever.

TERRASSIO PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• L-shaped deck: two rectangles joined, joists extended under the wing
• 45° diagonal layout: rows, waste and reduced joist spacing worked out for you
• Around a pool or obstacle: cutout deducted from boards, joists and area
• PDF export: dimensioned plan, inputs, results and shopping list, ready for your quote
• Every future Pro feature included, for life

BUILT FOR THE TRADE
Carpenters, landscapers, builders and serious DIYers: Terrassio speaks your language — board, joist, pedestal, o.c. spacing, row — and follows the rules of the craft: 1/8" to 1/4" gap between boards, joists 16" o.c. for 5/4 boards, 12" o.c. for diagonal layout.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no trackers, no data collected. Your calculations never leave your device.

name: Tes Billboard
description:
Tes Billboard books a greeting or sends an advertisement to an outdoor screen.

Choose a screen, then pick 15 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, or 5 minutes. Send a photo or a short video. A greeting is paid before the file is sent. An advertisement is sent without a card payment.

Screens, prices, and cameras come from the server. The live view plays only when a camera is available.

name: Tetramote
description:
Tetramote turns your phone into a remote for your computer. See its screen, hear its sound, and use it with a trackpad, touch and a keyboard, from across the room or across the internet.

How it works
1. Install Tetramote on your Mac, Windows or Linux computer from tetramote.com. It sits in the menu bar or system tray.
2. Scan the code it shows, or paste its link.
3. Connect again any time without a code. Your phone and computer connect directly when they can, on the same Wi-Fi or across the internet.

What you can do
• Watch the computer's screen live, with its sound.
• Use the trackpad under the screen: drag to move the pointer, tap to click, tap with two fingers to right-click and drag two fingers to scroll. Hold a finger still, then drag, to drag a window.
• Switch to direct touch and tap the screen itself, pinching to zoom in.
• Type on the phone's keyboard, with Esc, Tab, Command, Option, Control, Shift and the arrow keys in a row above it.
• Send your clipboard to the computer, or copy the computer's clipboard to your phone.
• Pick which display to show when the computer has more than one.
• Go full screen, with controls that float on top and hide after a few seconds.

Made for iPhone Duo
Folded, the computer's screen sits over a trackpad. Open it halfway like a laptop and the screen and the trackpad split at the fold.

Private
No accounts, no analytics, nothing collected. Sessions are end to end encrypted between your phone and your computer. The apps and the protocol are open source under the MIT license.

Tetramote needs the free Tetramote app on the computer you want to control.

name: TeUrge
description:
TeUrge acompaña a los pilotos y al personal operativo en la gestión de sus jornadas, sucursales y viajes.

• Inicia y finaliza tu jornada de trabajo.
• Gestiona viajes y registra visitas a sucursales.
• Consulta mapas y registra evidencia de ubicación durante tu jornada.
• Administra tu perfil y los documentos necesarios para operar.
• Conserva información pendiente en el dispositivo y sincronízala cuando vuelva la conexión.

Si aún no tienes una cuenta, puedes enviar tu preregistro desde la pantalla de acceso. El uso de las funciones operativas requiere una cuenta habilitada y depende de los permisos asignados.

TeUrge utiliza la ubicación, incluso en segundo plano, durante una jornada activa para registrar recorridos operativos. El uso de ubicación en segundo plano puede aumentar el consumo de batería.

name: Text CSV
description:
Text CSV is a simple editor for CSV and TSV files that treats every cell as plain text. Leading zeroes, dates, long numbers, and formulas stay exactly as typed, because nothing is converted or calculated.

Create a table, import a file from Files, or open a CSV or TSV file in Text CSV from another app. Tap a cell to edit it, use Tab above the keyboard to move to the next cell, and add or remove rows and columns. Export a copy wherever you choose. If the app is interrupted, your unsaved edits come back the next time you open the document.

FREE
• Up to three documents
• Cell editing, with undo and redo
• Adding and removing rows and columns
• CSV export

TEXT CSV PREMIUM
An optional monthly or yearly subscription through the App Store adds:
• Unlimited documents
• Find and replace, with regular expressions
• Sorting rows by up to three columns
• Filtering rows and removing duplicate rows
• Moving rows and columns, and splitting or merging columns
• Export as tab-separated text or a Markdown table, with a choice of line endings

The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it in your App Store subscriptions. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Your documents stay in the app's library on your device and are never sent to us. Apple handles subscription purchases.

The document library, unsaved-edit recovery drafts, and your Premium status can be included in iCloud Backup, if you have it turned on.

name: Thanklet: Gratitude Journal
description:
Thanklet asks one small question each evening: what made today a little better? You write one line. A kind word, a good coffee, someone who helped. That is the whole habit.

ONE LINE IS PLENTY
- A different question each day, or tap the shuffle button for another
- One free line of text, as short as you like
- Add a person if the line is about someone. A name is never required
- Write for an earlier day from Entries
- A reminder at the time you choose, if you want one

KEPT SAFE
- Every line is saved on your iPhone first, with its date
- Switch on "Keep a copy in my iCloud" to keep a copy in your own iCloud, so your lines can come back on a new phone
- Edit or remove a line and earlier versions are kept. Removed lines & versions shows them
- Export every line as plain text or a spreadsheet file, with the person if you added one
- No account, no ads, no sign in

FREE, FOR GOOD
Writing, every entry, iCloud copies and export stay free.

THANKLET PRO ADDS
- A line from an earlier day on your Lock Screen and Home Screen, with its date
- A thank-you message for a line about someone: Thanklet drafts it from your line, you change anything you like, and you send it from Messages, Mail or any app you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Thanklet has no account and no server of its own. Your lines stay on your iPhone and, if you switch it on, in your own iCloud. Thanklet collects no data.

PRICE
Thanklet Pro costs $17.99 a year, $2.99 a month or $39.99 once in the US store; your store shows the price in your own currency before you buy. The yearly plan starts with a 7 day free trial if your Apple Account is eligible. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. Yearly and monthly Pro renew each period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date, in Settings > your name > Subscriptions. The once price is paid one time and kept. Restore is on the Thanklet Pro sheet and in Settings.

Thanklet is for iPhone, iOS 17 or later.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://thanklet.app/privacy/
Support: https://thanklet.app/support/

name: Thassos Planner
description:
Thassos Planner este ghidul tău offline-ready pentru vacanța pe Thassos.

Ce găsești în aplicație:
• Hartă cu plaje, taverne, peisaje și puncte utile
• Rute România → Thassos și pe insulă
• Stații PECO și alerte de drum (Smart Radar BG)
• Traducere documente / meniuri cu camera
• Chat comunitate și anunțuri utile
• Radio și instrumente de călătorie

Aplicația este gratuită în App Store. Accesul complet se deblochează cu adresa de email a licenței cumpărate pe greciaplanner.ro. Fără reclame și fără abonament.

Politica de confidențialitate: https://greciaplanner.ro/confidentialitate
Suport: contact@greciaplanner.ro

name: The Bible and Me Study Guide
description:
Have you ever opened the Bible and felt lost? The Bible and Me makes Scripture clear, one book at a time, and shows you how it speaks to your own life today.

All 73 books of the Bible (Catholic order, including the deuterocanonical books) are explained in warm, plain language. No seminary degree needed.

EVERY BOOK, MADE CLEAR
• What each book is about and who wrote it
• The book broken into its main parts so you never lose your place
• A beautiful illustrated banner for every book

EVERY STORY, SIMPLY TOLD
• Short summaries of the stories in each book, with chapter and verse so you can read them yourself
• Key Scripture quotes from the World English Bible

MEET EVERYONE IN THE BIBLE
• Who each person was and how they fit into God's story
• Every name change explained: Abram to Abraham, Jacob to Israel, Saul to Paul and more

SEE WHERE IT HAPPENED
• Maps of Bible lands
• Every place with where it is today

SEE HOW IT APPLIES TO YOUR LIFE
• "Make It Personal" turns each book into everyday meaning
• Honest questions to think about, journal or talk over in your small group

FIND ANYONE, ANYWHERE
• Instant search across every person, place and story in all 73 books

PERFECT FOR
• Anyone reading the Bible for the first time
• Daily Bible reading and devotions
• Bible study groups, RCIA/OCIA, Sunday school and homeschool
• Lifelong believers who want to see the big picture

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• One price. No ads. No subscriptions. No account.
• Works completely offline
• We collect no data at all

Open the Bible with confidence. Get to know the people, the places and the God who walks with you through every page.

name: The Cipher: Secret Worlds
description:
The Cipher is an end-to-end encrypted messenger for people you actually know. Every message, image and call is encrypted on your iPhone before it leaves it — we can't read it, and neither can anyone else.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• Disguise mode (optional): the app can open as a playable crystal puzzle game. You choose the cover and your own unlock gesture. This is a privacy feature, it is described here, and it can be turned off at any time in Settings.
• Messages travel as game moves: on the wire and on screen, encrypted text looks like ordinary moves in the cover game.
• Burn timers: messages can erase themselves 10 seconds to 1 day after they're read — deleted from the server too, not just hidden.
• Capture alerts: if your partner screenshots or screen-records a chat, you are told.
• Private calls: encrypted voice and video calls, with an optional voice changer and on-device face blur you hold to reveal.
• Discreet call alerts: incoming calls can show as a neutral alarm, timer or game event instead of a caller name.
• Image cloaking: hide a short note inside an ordinary-looking picture.
• Duress PIN: a second PIN opens a harmless decoy and can quietly alert your partner.

REAL PEOPLE ONLY
Accounts are created with Sign in with Apple, Google or a mobile number, and every account confirms a real mobile number on a genuine iPhone. Virtual, VoIP and temporary numbers aren't accepted, one device can't mint endless accounts, and you can only talk to people who share an invite with you. Anyone can be reported or blocked from any chat.

NO CONTACTS UPLOAD, MINIMAL METADATA
The Cipher never reads your address book. The server stores only what it needs to deliver encrypted messages: burning messages are deleted on their timer and old encrypted history is purged automatically.

THE CRYSTAL LOOK
Liquid-gold lettering, refractive 3D crystals and living worlds — with a still, low-power mode that follows Reduce Motion and Low Power Mode.

THE CIPHER IS FREE
Messaging, voice and video calls, and every privacy feature in this version are free. There is no in-app purchase to complete in order to use the app.

The Cipher is for private conversations between consenting adults and friends. Don't use it to break the law; we act on reports of abuse.

name: The Guide for Ocarina of Time
description:
A strategy guide for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Nintendo Switch 2, made like the printed guides: chapters to read next to the game, the map of every step, and nothing told before you get there.

It opens at your page
- 18 chapters, from Kokiri Forest to Ganondorf's Castle, and 12 side quests: 838 numbered steps to tick as you play.
- Each step comes with its map, numbered pins and pictures of the spot. Done ticks it and brings the next one under your thumb; the screen stays on while you read.
- Boxes in the text say what the remake changed.

Stuck?
- A nudge first, then a hint, then the solution: you choose how much you are told.
- Ask a question about where you are: it is answered on your iPhone, from the guide's pages up to your chapter. Nothing leaves the device (Apple Intelligence, iOS 26).

No spoilers
- Chapters ahead stay blurred and the adult era stays sealed until you reach it. Search and Ask stop at your chapter.
- At the end of each chapter: what you left behind.

100 %
- The 36 Heart Pieces, the 100 Gold Skulltulas, the songs, the bottles, the Great Fairies and the upgrades, with what you can get now.
- Before you pull the sword: what to collect as a child.

Maps
- Hyrule as a child and as an adult, and 52 maps of areas and dungeon floors, with numbered pins.

Library
- Items, songs, bosses, enemies, shops, mini-games, masks, the trading quest and what the remake changed.

On iPad, a second screen next to the TV: the sidebar, the steps, and the map of your step beside them.

Chapters I to III, every checklist, the Library, search and Ask are free. The rest of the book, all 18 chapters and the side quests, is one purchase: The complete guide. No ads, no account, no subscription.

Unofficial guide, written in our own words. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Nintendo. The Legend of Zelda and Ocarina of Time are trademarks of Nintendo. The game's screenshots, icons and maps come from Zelda Wiki and Zelda Central and belong to Nintendo.

name: The Infinite Quest
description:
The Infinite Quest is one math game that grows with you, from your first sums to calculus and engineering.

Pick a world and start playing. Every round has 8 new questions, so rounds are almost never the same. If you get one wrong, the game shows the right answer and a short explanation, so you learn from the mistake.

EIGHT WORLDS, 24 LEVELS
• Adding & Subtracting (from age 5): single digits to three-digit sums
• Times & Divide (from age 7): times tables to long multiplication
• Fractions & Percents (from age 9): simplifying, adding fractions, decimals
• Algebra (from age 11): equations, quadratics and slopes
• Geometry & Trig (from age 12): area, Pythagoras, exact trig values, radians
• Calculus (from age 16): derivatives, integration and definite integrals
• Business Math: margins, markups, compound interest, break-even, ROI and present value
• Engineering Math: Ohm's law, resistor networks, vectors, matrices, complex numbers, stress and motion

PRACTICE THAT STICKS
• Earn up to 3 stars per level; one star unlocks the next level
• Daily mix: a review round from the levels you've mastered, with double XP once a day
• Daily streaks, and an optional daily reminder at the time you choose
• XP and ranks, from Counter to Math Master
• Sound effects and vibration

FOR YOUNG AND OLD
Young players can start with simple adding, students can practise for school and exams, and older players can sharpen their business or engineering math, all in one app.

ENGLISH AND ARABIC
The game follows your iPhone's language, and you can switch between English and Arabic in Settings. Math is always written left to right.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No ads. No accounts. No tracking. No purchases. The game works fully offline, and your progress stays only on your iPhone.

I'd love to hear what you think. Write to me at handasastudios@gmail.com.

name: The Location Guide
description:
Every beautiful story begins somewhere. The Location Guide helps photographers find the right spot for every session, and makes it easy for clients to choose one.

FIND YOUR NEXT LOCATION
• Browse 330+ photo locations, with new spots added across the U.S. as photographers share their favorites
• See real session photos from every season (spring, summer, fall and winter) before you go
• Filter by season, sunrise or sunset light, permits and fees, and type of spot: mountains, lakes and rivers, forests, fields, desert, urban, studios and venues
• Check parking, access, permits and busyness before your session
• View every spot on a map, or search by city
• Save your favorites, and keep private notes for each location

YOUR OWN CLIENT GUIDE (PRO)
• Send clients one link to browse your favorite spots. They don't need the app.
• Clients pick their location and pay your travel fee right in the guide
• Set travel fees automatically by distance, or by hand for each spot
• Add your brand colors, font and logo, with a separate link for each type of session

CHAT WITH PHOTOGRAPHERS (PRO)
• Ask how a spot looks right now
• Join nearby and statewide chats, or start your own groups

EARN FREE MONTHS
• Share new locations and add seasonal photos to earn free months
• Refer a friend: they get 10% off their first year, and you earn rewards

RESPECT THE LAND
Every photographer agrees to our pledge: follow posted rules and permits, stay on trails and leave no trace.

THE LOCATION GUIDE PRO
The free app shows the locations photographers have shared with the community. Pro unlocks every location in the guide, your client guide, travel fees, branding, chat and rewards.

• Pro Monthly: $14.99 a month
• Pro Yearly: $119.99 a year

Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://thelocationguide.expo.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://thelocationguide.expo.app/privacy

Brought to you by Jackie Siggard Photo + Video and Kendra Bird Photography.

name: The Newspaper: Editor's Desk
description:
Run an independent newspaper. Make every front page count.

Take the editor's chair at the fictional Graybridge Gazette across 30 publication days. Choose leads, assign reporters, inspect documents, compare dates and decide which claims the evidence can support.

BUILD THE ACTUAL PAPER
Place articles on a real editorial grid. Choose headlines and illustrations, move and resize stories, balance advertising space and print your own page. Your archive preserves the result.

A NEWSROOM WITH CONSEQUENCES
Twelve recurring newsroom dilemmas create tradeoffs in money, time, readers and independence. Fulfil editorial promises through printed work. A rival follows leads you leave uncovered. Errors can bring corrections, and careful reporting shapes the city over time.

KEEP YOUR INDEPENDENT VOICE
Manage reporting costs, staffing, distribution and printing. A reader cooperative can keep a struggling paper publishing, with debt that matters to its future. Reach one of eight ending families based on your record.

INCLUDED WITH THE PAID APP
The full 30-edition campaign, 90 bilingual leads, 270 evidence records, 25 recurring sources, editor, economy, archive and all base endings. No extra purchase is required to finish.

OPTIONAL ONE-TIME PURCHASES
Harbor Edition and Night Desk each add a separate twelve-edition campaign with 36 leads and 108 evidence records. The Pressroom Collection adds visual finishes only. These extras require additional purchases. No subscriptions or paid truth, trust points, actions or endings.

Play offline in English or Turkish. Choose an editor name, adjust sound, music, motion and print pace, and share an actual newspaper cover. First purchases and restoration need Apple connectivity. Progress stays on your device. No third-party advertising or analytics SDKs; fictional newspaper adverts are part of the simulation.

All cities, people, institutions and events are fictional.

name: The Rallysport Association
description:
The official app for The Rallysport Association NI (RSA) – Northern Ireland’s premier rallysprint promoter.

Stay up to date with everything RSA:

Next event info – date, venue, schedule and entry details
Events calendar – full season at a glance
Online entry – enter events directly through the app
Live timing – follow the action in real time
Results – class and overall results PDFs
Driver stats – career wins, podiums and recent results
Entry lists – full entry list for upcoming events
Class structures – all 16 competition classes explained
Info & regulations – competition documents and policies
Contact – get in touch with the RSA team

Whether you’re a competitor, co-driver or spectator, the RSA app keeps you connected to the action all season long.

name: TheLobby: Resident App
description:
TheLobby is the private community platform for apartment buildings, condos, and residential communities. GPS-verified and neighbor-endorsed - only real residents get in.

CONNECT WITH YOUR BUILDING
• Post updates, questions, polls, and package alerts in the building-only Lobby feed
• Message neighbors directly - private DMs that management can't read
• RSVP to building events and join interest groups (dog owners, fitness, parents, and more)
• Buy, sell, lend, or give in the secure building marketplace - no strangers, ever

EARN TRUST, UNLOCK ACCESS
TheLobby uses a 5-layer trust system that rewards good neighbors:
• Location verification confirms you actually live there
• Neighbor endorsements vouch for new residents
• Participation unlocks full community features
New members start with limited access and earn their way to full standing.

STAY INFORMED
• Real-time building status: maintenance updates, package room status, elevator alerts
• Official announcements from management - emergency, maintenance, and general notices
• AI-powered Concierge answers building questions 24/7

BUILT FOR PRIVACY
• GPS verification means no outsiders - ever
• Anonymous issue reporting protects your relationships
• Your unit number and profile are only visible to verified neighbors
• Delete your account anytime from Settings

FOR RESIDENTS AND MANAGERS
Residents use TheLobby to connect with neighbors, stay informed, and participate in building life. Property managers use TheLobby to communicate with residents, track engagement, and build community that improves retention.

GETTING STARTED
Your building must be on TheLobby. Ask your property manager to set up your building at lobbyapp.co, or join using an invite code if your building is already active.

Questions? Contact hello@lobbyapp.co

name: ThermoMira
description:
ThermoMira helps you connect, monitor, and control compatible electric heaters from your phone.

Easy Wi-Fi Pairing and Device Management

Quick Wi-Fi Pairing: Scan the device QR code, connect to the heater's Wi-Fi hotspot, and select a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network to complete pairing. After pairing, home screen cards show each device's online or offline status, operating mode, and room temperature when available.

Unified Management of Multiple Devices: Add and manage multiple electric heaters in one place. Rename devices or remove them from your account as needed.

Remote Control

When your phone has internet access and the heater is online, you can control it remotely. Turn it off after leaving home or turn it on before returning.

Power Control: Turn a connected heater on or off from your phone.

Temperature Adjustment: Set a target temperature from 16°C to 30°C and view the reported room temperature.

Operating Modes: Choose Auto, Fast Heat, or Sleep mode to suit your needs.

Operating Data: View reported information such as fan speed and outlet temperature when available.

Home Sharing

Create a Home: Create a home to manage heaters with family members.

Invite Members: Invite a family member by scanning the QR code displayed in their ThermoMira app. Members can access shared devices according to their account permissions.

name: Theryvexa Bloom Vessels
description:
Theryvexa Bloom Vessels offers three distinct solo card layouts — Lantern Fold, Solstice Wheel, and Moss Terraces — each with its own rules, rhythm, and way of thinking.

In Lantern Fold, seventeen lanterns hold the full deck face-up. Only the front card of each lantern can move, and building runs by symbol in descending order. Three Twirl actions let you pull a deeply buried card to the front when a position looks stuck.

Solstice Wheel starts from a chosen base rank and lets vessels grow in either direction — ranks wrap from King back to Ace. Streams accept cards one step up or down regardless of symbol, and two wells supply tiles but never receive them. Three Glimpses let you peek into a well before committing.

Moss Terraces arranges six columns and an open nest. Any descending run of cards moves together, and a single dew cup provides a one-tile holding spot for timing a sequence.

A fresh daily seed arrives every morning. Tend it on consecutive days to build a dawn streak that tracks your routine. Each finished or set-aside session is pressed into a journal you can browse and replay at any time. Insights show your completion rate, best times, and a two-week activity chart.

A lumen garden grows alongside your progress — every completed layout adds to a living plant on screen, and fifteen milestones mark moments along the way. Unlimited undo, look-ahead hints, and one-tap card gathering are always available when you want them.

name: ThimbleHue: Cross Stitch
description:
ThimbleHue turns your photos into counted cross-stitch patterns you can actually stitch — on your iPhone or iPad, with no account and nothing uploaded.

TURN PHOTOS INTO PATTERNS
• Import from Photos or Files, crop to your subject and preview the result before you save.
• Choose the width in stitches; the height follows your photo. See the grid size and finished size on 11- to 28-count fabric.
• Pick how many colors to use (2–60) and clean up stray single stitches so you change thread less often.
• Transparent PNGs: leave the background unstitched or fill it with the fabric color.

CHOOSE YOUR COLORS
• Use colors taken straight from the photo, ThimbleHue's generic swatch card, or your own thread list with your own codes.
• Every color keeps one symbol and one code — the same in the editor, the key and the PDF.

EDIT EVERY STITCH
• Zoom and pan a sharp grid, then stitch, fill, erase or pick colors cell by cell.
• Undo and redo every change. Merge one color into another, edit a color, or add a new one.
• See the stitch count for every color. Your edits are saved on the device automatically.

READ THE SYMBOL CHART
• Switch between colors, colors with symbols, and black-and-white symbols.
• Bold lines every 10 stitches and row/column numbers make counting easy.

PRINT YOUR PATTERN
• Export an A4 or US Letter PDF with a cover, color key, and the chart with row and column numbers on every side.
• Black-and-white mode stays readable on any printer.
• Large patterns split over numbered pages with a page map and “continues on page…” notes.
• Share to Files, print, or send it with WhatsApp, Mail or AirDrop.

FREE AND PRO
Free includes one active pattern and one standard PDF export, so you can try the whole flow. ThimbleHue Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited patterns and exports, large-print multi-page charts, merging several or similar colors at once, and removes ads. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

PRIVACY
Photos, patterns and edits stay on your device. The free version shows a small banner ad on the pattern overview screen only; your photos and patterns are never shared with the ad network.

ThimbleHue's codes are generic or your own and are not affiliated with any thread manufacturer.

name: Ticketares Scanner
seller_name: ARCHEOARES DI GIANPAOLO SERONE E C. SNC
description:
Ticketares Scanner è l'app per il personale che controlla gli ingressi nelle strutture che usano la biglietteria Ticketares: musei, siti archeologici, teatri, cinema ed eventi.

Inquadri il QR del biglietto e l'esito compare subito, grande e a colori:
• verde: biglietto valido, ingresso consentito
• rosso: biglietto non valido o già usato, con il motivo
• arancione: biglietto valido per un altro orario, da verificare
• azzurro: passaggio registrato a un punto di controllo

COSA FA
• Legge i QR di biglietti, abbonamenti ed eventi venduti online, in cassa e ai totem
• Gestisce i biglietti per più persone: scegli quanti entrano
• Mostra gli ingressi della giornata, con ricerca per codice, ordine o cliente
• Inserimento del codice a mano quando il QR non si legge
• Torcia per gli ambienti bui, suoni e vibrazione per ogni esito
• La fotocamera va a riposo da sola per risparmiare batteria

SICURA
• Si entra con l'alias e la password dello scanner, creati dall'amministratore
• Ogni nuovo telefono deve essere approvato dall'amministratore prima di poter convalidare
• Uno scanner lavora su un solo dispositivo alla volta

PERSONALIZZATA
Colori, caratteri e logo seguono l'identità della struttura, scelta dall'amministratore.

Per usare l'app serve un account scanner fornito da una struttura che utilizza Ticketares. L'app non vende biglietti.

name: TicTacToe in Space
description:
Five in a row. One board. One phone. Two players.

TicTacToe in Space takes the game you already know and blows it up: a 10x10 grid where you need five in a row, played as a best-of match between two people sharing one phone. No AI, no online lobby, just you and whoever is sitting next to you.

FACE TO FACE OR TURN BY TURN
Sit across the table and play Face to Face: the star's half of the screen faces one of you, the sun's half faces the other, and the controls turn to face whoever's move it is. Or pick Turn by Turn and pass the phone back and forth: the screen stays the same way up, and the background blazes with the blue star or the golden sun for whoever is playing.

PLAYED BY NAME
Type both names on the setup screen and the game keeps score by name. Each round a Get Ready screen greets each player before their first turn, so nobody loses track of whose move it is.

THE BOARD NEVER RESETS
Every mark you place stays where it is. Round two starts on the mess round one left behind, and by the final round you are fighting over the last open lines on a crowded grid. Win a round and you score the length of the line you made, so a double line scores twice.

STAR AND SUN
Player X is the blue-white star and opens the match. Player O is the golden sun and answers.

DARK MATTER AND BOMBS
Turn the mode on and each player gets one dark matter and one bomb per round.

Dark matter is a gravity well. As every turn begins, before anyone can move, it grows and drags every mark and bomb on the board one step closer along a clockwise spiral, eating whatever touches it. After four turns it collapses and swallows everything around it. It is your once-a-round last chance: drop it beside your opponent's four in a row and it can tear the line apart before they finish it. But a mark pulled into five in a row still wins, for either of you.

Bombs sit in the open counting down five turns. Either of you can tap any bomb to set it off at once, and a spent bomb can be rebuilt; both cost your move. Blasts chain off each other, and a bomb dragged into dark matter sets it off early.

NO MOVE LIMIT
A round only ends in a draw if all 100 cells fill up without five in a row. With bombs and dark matter tearing the board up, that rarely happens.

PICK YOUR LENGTH
Quick is a single round, Sprint is three, Classic is five. One match runs one to five minutes.

COMPLETELY OFFLINE
No account, no sign-up, no ads, no in-app purchases, and nothing about you is collected or sent anywhere. Names stay on the phone. Play it on a plane.

name: tictactoe: XO 2 Player
description:
The game you grew up with, reimagined. tictactoe: XO 2 Player turns the timeless game of X and O into a soft, colorful and surprisingly deep challenge you can play anywhere, anytime, even offline.

Challenge a clever AI or pass the phone to a friend for a quick face-to-face match. Every game takes seconds to start and minutes to master.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Play against the computer on Easy, Medium or Hard. On Hard, the classic 3x3 board is unbeatable. Can you hold it to a draw?

name: TideWise | Systems Thinking
description:
Stubborn problems usually have a structure behind them. Tidewise helps you see it.

Answer short questions about your situation. The app picks the most useful next question, shows how much time is left, and explains which of ten patterns are likely, unlikely, or still open, with the evidence for and against each.

WHAT YOU GET
- Guided discovery: agree or disagree with short statements; no jargon required
- Two pictures for every pattern: loops you can follow in circles, and a timeline of what happens when
- Pattern reasoning: ten original patterns, such as Ceiling ("Push harder, get less.") and Crutch ("The patch becomes the plan.")
- Forest check: competing explanations, patterns that interact, and a prompt to challenge the leading idea
- Plain-language summary written on your device by Apple's on-device AI where available
- Leverage checklist: full step-by-step text, what each step changes, and when to expect a first effect
- Pattern Gallery: 60 stories across relationships, personal productivity, organizations, economics, politics, and nations, each with how it is spotted or missed, diagnosed or misdiagnosed, and fixed or left unfixed
- Notebook: write notes, sketch your own loops with finger, Apple Pencil, or Mac trackpad, and add photos or scans of whiteboards. Text in photos is searchable
- Guided paths on a Home tab, and a saved history of every discovery you run
- Tides: one place for a project, a situation, or a story, each with its own plan, diagnoses, notes, and its own privacy, budget, and AI settings
- Project health and forecast: honest three-point estimates, the real chance of finishing on time, a tide-style health reading, margin sized to the uncertainty, and alerts when you are trending late
- Five-step analytics: what is happening, why, what to watch and what is eating the time, when it will finish, and what to change, with a recovery plan that starts before you are late
- Plan doctor: finds big, vague, or uncertain milestones and suggests better ones. On-device AI can improve the wording, and you apply or undo each change
- AI Fit: where AI could help with your pattern, and where it would make it worse, filtered by your budget, privacy, regulation, and offline needs. Clear verdicts with reasons and assumptions, and a brief you can share. You decide
- Rehearsal: see when results should show before you judge, with an expected corridor and the dates to decide
- Cases: track whether applying a checklist is helping or hurting, record the final outcome, and see which of your diagnoses actually worked
- ABCs of systems thinking: 36 key terms from A to Z with memorable phrases, plus quizzes that focus on what you have not yet mastered
- Levels, streaks, a daily goal, and more than thirty badges whose goals are always visible
- Optional daily reminders you control
- Private by design: your answers, notes, sketches, and photos stay on your device. No account. To learn which features help most, the app counts which screens and features are used (counts only).

Welcome to Tidewise 1.0. See every pattern as circles and as a timeline. Answer guided questions, see which patterns are likely and why, challenge the leading idea with the forest check, and follow a leverage checklist with timing estimates. Earn levels and badges as you learn. Track whether a checklist is helping or hurting and record outcomes, learn the A-to-Z terms with quizzes, and earn badges for daily and lasting practice. Browse 60 pattern stories, and keep your own notes, sketches, and whiteboard photos in the notebook.

Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Educational decision support only. It is not legal, HR, financial, medical, or psychological advice. Results are hypotheses based on what you enter and can be wrong.

name: Tintlume – Paint Meets Light
description:
Art class says red, yellow and blue make every color. Physics class says it's red, green and blue. Both are right: one is about paint, the other about light. Tintlume turns that into two parts of puzzles.

Mix paint in Part 1. A target color sits above a mixing bowl; every tap drips one drop of pigment in. Paints blend the way real pigments absorb light (a Kubelka–Munk model), so blue and yellow really turn green, white lightens instead of greying, and only the ratio matters. Hand it in and a CIEDE2000 color difference becomes a 0–100% match. Seventy levels across seven chapters add white, black, magenta, teal and ochre, and every target is reachable in twelve drops or fewer.

Steer light in Part 2. On a dark grid, place mirrors, beam splitters and red, green or blue filters so every target glows the color it asks for. Later on, two beams meet on one target and add up: red and blue make magenta, all three make white. Sixty levels in four chapters are verified by a solver; use the fewest pieces for three stars.

Unlock the Color notebook by progressing in both parts. Each page puts one color side by side: beams stacking up on the left, paint mixed with the same model as the bowl on the right. The white page, for example, shows three beams becoming white light next to three primary paints turning muddy brown.

Play two dailies: Color of the Day for paint and a daily light puzzle whose board grows from Monday to Sunday. Turn on the Mixing helper for plain hints like "a bit lighter", or use the one-per-level light hint. Every paint, recipe, beam and target is labeled, not just colored.

Feel every move: drops splash, targets flare when they light up, a Beam chain builds as you keep placing pieces in the light, a 3-star streak carries across both parts, and level-clear celebrations change every time. Reduce Motion swaps them for simple fades, and Settings has separate switches for effects and haptics.

No internet, no account, no ads, no purchases, no data collection. Light and dark appearance, iPhone and iPad in either orientation.

name: TinyTip: Simple Tip Calculator
description:
TinyTip gets your table from "here's the bill" to "here's what everyone owes" in seconds. Type the amount, tap a tip, set how many people are splitting, and the per-person amount is right there, big and bold. There's no Calculate button, because you never need one.

BUILT FOR THE MOMENT THE CHECK ARRIVES
• Opens straight to the calculator: no sign-up, no tutorial, nothing to dismiss
• Enter the bill with the number pad; tap the amount to type a new bill right over the old one
• Pick 10%, 15%, 18%, 20% or 25% with one tap, or type any custom tip from 0 to 100%
• Split between 1 and 50 people with a big, easy-to-hit stepper
• Tip, total and per-person amount update live as you change anything

MATH YOU CAN TRUST
TinyTip uses exact decimal math, not floating point, so you never see odd rounding glitches. When the total doesn't divide evenly, TinyTip says so plainly and shows how many people pay one cent more, instead of a rounded figure that doesn't add up. The shares always add up to the total, to the cent.

Paying in cash? Switch to Round Up in Settings and everyone pays the same whole amount, with a clear note showing how much extra that collects.

SMALL, FAST AND PRIVATE
• Works completely offline
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases
• Nothing you enter leaves your device, and bills are never saved; every session starts fresh
• Uses your device's local currency and number format

THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED
• Large, easy-to-read figures that roll smoothly as they change, without the layout jumping around
• Carefully designed light and dark modes
• A subtle haptic tap when you pick a tip or change the split (you can turn it off)
• VoiceOver support, Dynamic Type up to the largest accessibility sizes, and Reduce Motion support

SETTINGS THAT MATTER
• The default tip selected each time you open the app
• Exact shares, or round up per person
• Haptic feedback on or off

TinyTip is a calculator, not an expense tracker: no history, no receipts, no ledgers. Just the number everyone at the table is waiting for.

name: Titik
description:
Titik is the dots game many of us played at school on the squared pages of a maths exercise book. Two pencils, one sheet of grid paper, and a simple goal: surround your opponent's dots before they surround yours.

HOW IT WORKS
• Take turns placing one dot where the grid lines cross.
• Link your own dots up, across or diagonally. When the chain closes into a loop, everything inside is yours.
• Every opponent dot trapped inside your loop scores one point.
• Nobody can place a dot inside a surrounded area, so each loop also locks down territory.
• The game ends when the paper is full, a player resigns, or someone reaches the point limit you set.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Friend — pass one phone back and forth, just like sharing an exercise book.
• Computer — play against the computer at Easy, Medium or Hard.
• Online — invite a friend through Game Center and take your turns whenever you have a moment. You don't need to be online at the same time.

MAKE IT YOUR GAME
• Pick a pen colour for each player. Red is kept for the computer and online opponents.
• Three paper sizes: Small (9 × 13), Medium (13 × 19) and Large (17 × 25).
• Set a point limit, or play until the paper is full.
• Add a turn timer, in seconds or minutes, to keep local games moving.
• Switch undo on or off before you start.

MADE TO FEEL LIKE PAPER
• Hand-drawn dots, sketched pencil outlines and handwritten lettering on grid paper.
• Captured areas are outlined and shaded automatically, so the score is always clear.
• Pinch or use the zoom buttons to get closer on big paper.
• Background music and soft sound effects, each with its own switch.

Free to play. No accounts to create. Ads appear only between games, and a one-time purchase removes them for good.

CHẠM TỪ, RA HÁN VIỆT

CÂU SAI THÀNH BÀI HỌC
Câu nào sai thì vào Sổ câu sai, ghi rõ: bạn chọn gì, đúng là gì, vì sao, lần sau nhớ gì. Hôm sau app nhắc ôn lại.

PHÒNG THI GIỐNG MÁY CBT
Đề thi thử đủ câu, đủ giờ, chấm theo luật đậu của từng kỳ thi. Thoát giữa chừng vẫn giữ đúng giờ.

• Miễn phí: bài thử sức, cân dự đoán, chương đầu đầy đủ, 5 câu đầu mỗi chương khác, 1 đề thi thử mini, 1 lần làm thử đề đầy đủ, Bộ đi thi.

LƯU Ý
TokuPass không liên quan đến OTAFF, JAIM hay cảnh sát Nhật. Câu hỏi do TokuPass biên soạn theo kiến thức trong sách học công khai của OTAFF, JAIM và 交通の教則 (đã biên tập), không phải đề thi thật. Điểm dự đoán là ước lượng, không bảo đảm kết quả thi.

Điều khoản: https://toku-pass.hwang87.com/dieu-khoan/
Chính sách bảo mật: https://toku-pass.hwang87.com/bao-mat/

name: Tolato Pitch
description:
Pernahkah anda mengangkat gitar sebelum latihan atau persembahan, memetik setiap tali, dan terasa ada sesuatu yang tidak kena? Telinga anda mungkin dapat menangkap bunyi sumbang, tetapi sukar untuk memastikan tali mana terlalu tinggi, tali mana terlalu rendah, dan sejauh mana pemutarnya perlu dipusing. Ramai pemain menghabiskan masa yang lama meneka dan memetik berulang kali, namun masih ragu-ragu sama ada alat muzik mereka benar-benar tepat. Masalah ini lebih terasa bagi mereka yang baru belajar.

Tolato Pitch menyelesaikan masalah ini dengan cara yang mudah. Aplikasi ini menggunakan mikrofon peranti anda untuk mendengar bunyi tali yang dipetik, lalu menunjukkan pada skrin sejauh mana bunyi itu menyimpang daripada nada yang betul. Tiada lagi tekaan. Petik tali, lihat paparan, dan laras secukupnya sehingga penunjuk berada tepat di tengah.

Aplikasi ini direka untuk pemain gitar, gitar bes dan apa jua alat muzik bertali. Sama ada anda baru mempelajari kord pertama di rumah, atau pemain berpengalaman yang mahu memastikan setiap tali tepat sebelum naik pentas atau masuk studio, Tolato Pitch sedia menemani anda.

Ciri utama yang akan anda gunakan setiap kali menala:

- Penalaan melalui mikrofon — bunyi tali dikesan terus oleh peranti anda
- Meter visual yang menunjukkan sama ada tali terlalu tinggi, terlalu rendah, atau hampir tepat
- Sokongan untuk apa jua alat muzik bertali, termasuk gitar dan gitar bes
- Paparan yang jelas untuk setiap tali, supaya anda tahu tali mana perlu dilaras seterusnya

Cara menggunakannya mudah. Letakkan peranti berhampiran alat muzik, petik satu tali dengan jelas, dan perhatikan meter. Penunjuk akan bergerak mengikut ketepatan nada yang dikesan. Apabila penunjuk semakin hampir ke tengah, pusing pemutar perlahan-lahan sambil terus memerhati skrin. Ulangi untuk setiap tali sehingga keseluruhan alat muzik anda tepat.

Meter ialah nadi aplikasi ini. Ia bukan sekadar memberitahu bahawa bunyi tidak tepat, tetapi menunjukkan dengan jelas sejauh mana setiap tali menyimpang. Ini membolehkan anda membuat pelarasan kecil dan terkawal, bukannya memusing pemutar tanpa hala tuju sambil berharap yang terbaik. Bagi telinga yang masih belajar, penunjuk visual ini juga menjadi rujukan yang berguna.

Beberapa tabiat kecil boleh membantu anda mendapat hasil yang lebih baik. Cari tempat yang agak senyap supaya bunyi bising di sekeliling tidak mengganggu pengesanan nada. Petik setiap tali dengan kekuatan yang lebih kurang sama, dan tunggu sebentar sebelum membaca meter, kerana bunyi yang baru dipetik biasanya berubah dengan pantas pada beberapa saat pertama. Jauhkan mikrofon daripada pembesar suara atau sumber bunyi lain yang boleh bercampur dengan bunyi alat muzik anda.

Ramai pemain menjadikan penalaan sebagai rutin sebelum latihan, persembahan atau sesi rakaman. Dengan cara ini, setiap sesi bermula dengan alat muzik yang sudah tepat, dan tumpuan anda kembali sepenuhnya kepada muzik. Anda juga boleh menala semula di pertengahan sesi jika tali mula kendur atau suhu bilik berubah, kerana kebanyakan alat bertali akan sedikit berubah mengikut keadaan sekeliling.

Aplikasi ini memerlukan akses kepada mikrofon peranti anda, kerana bunyi itulah asas penalaan. Tanpa kebenaran tersebut, meter tidak dapat membaca tali anda.

Cuba Tolato Pitch hari ini. Capai gitar, gitar bes atau alat bertali kegemaran anda, buka aplikasi, dan biarkan telinga serta mata anda bekerjasama. Setiap tali yang tepat bermakna bunyi yang lebih jernih — untuk anda dan sesiapa sahaja yang mendengar anda bermain.

name: TomBo AdBlock
description:
TomBo AdBlock – A Cleaner, More Private Safari Experience

Enjoy a cleaner and more comfortable browsing experience with TomBo AdBlock.

TomBo AdBlock helps block unwanted advertisements and tracking elements in Safari, reducing visual clutter and making web pages easier to browse.

KEY FEATURES

• Block Unwanted Ads
Block unwanted advertisements and reduce distracting content while browsing Safari.

• Block Trackers
Help prevent known tracking elements from loading for a more private browsing experience.

• Cleaner Browsing
Reduce unwanted page elements for a cleaner and more comfortable experience.

• Simple and Lightweight
Designed to work seamlessly with Safari without unnecessary complexity.

• Easy Control
Manage your content-blocking preferences through the app and Safari settings.

A BETTER WAY TO BROWSE

Less advertising. Fewer trackers. More control over your browsing experience.

TomBo AdBlock – by TomBo Studio.

name: TOPTO Business
description:
TOPTO Business — рабочее приложение для заведений, подключённых к TOPTO. Готовая программа лояльности без собственной разработки и без отдельного оборудования: достаточно телефона сотрудника.

ОБСЛУЖИВАНИЕ НА КАССЕ

• Сканер QR-кода клиента и ручной ввод его 6-значного кода
• Начисление визитов по накопительной программе
• Кэшбэк: сумма покупки → расчёт на сервере → проведение
• Оплата бонусами и выдача подарков — клиент подтверждает их в своём приложении, поэтому списать лишнее по ошибке нельзя

ОПЕРАЦИИ И ОТМЕНЫ

Все операции заведения в одном списке. Ошибочную операцию можно отменить с указанием причины — клиент увидит её в своей истории.

СТАТИСТИКА

Клиенты, посещения, выданные подарки, обороты по бонусам — за выбранный период.

НАСТРОЙКИ ПРЯМО В ПРИЛОЖЕНИИ

• Условия программы: накопительная или кэшбэк
• Карточка заведения: название, логотип, адрес, телефон, часы работы — так её видят клиенты в каталоге TOPTO

УДОБНО НА СМЕНЕ

• Русский и кыргызский языки
• Светлая и тёмная темы
• Работает на любом телефоне с камерой

Чтобы подключить своё заведение к TOPTO, напишите нам: support@alasoft.website

name: Toritsugi: Office Phone Drill
description:
Toritsugi is a practice book for answering the office phone in Japanese. The app's screens and call scripts are in Japanese.

- Surprise calls
A practice call rings at a random time within the hours you choose, so you learn to pick up when you are not ready.

- Take a message, get a red pen
After the call, write down who it was for, the caller's company and name, the reason and the call-back number. Every field you missed gets a red mark, and you can read exactly what the caller said.

- Keigo check
Common slips such as "yoroshikatta deshou ka" are flagged with the correct phrase. The app also checks whether you repeated the details back and how you said your colleague was away.

- Scripts by workplace
General office, real estate, clinic reception, manufacturer sales desk and IT front desk. Names and numbers change every time, and some callers talk fast.

- See your weak spots
Count the fields you miss most and the phrases that slip out, week by week.

- Your voice never leaves your iPhone
Recognition runs on the device and nothing is recorded. No account needed. You can practice the message pad without the microphone.

Free: three general-office scripts, red-pen feedback, one surprise call a week.
Premium: all scripts, fast callers, daily surprise calls and your weak-spot summary.
