Weekly (auto-renewing, first 3 days free) or yearly (auto-renewing). Prices are shown in your local currency before you buy.
The subscription renews for the same period and price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
App terms: https://taro1025.github.io/denwa-renshu-site/en/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://taro1025.github.io/denwa-renshu-site/en/privacy.html

name: TossPix
description:
TossPix sends screenshots, photos and files between your iPhone and your Windows PC over your own Wi-Fi. No cables, no accounts, no emailing yourself.

PHONE TO PC
Tap Send and pick a screenshot or photo. It's on your PC, ready to paste with Ctrl+V, and saved in a folder too.

PC TO PHONE
Snip your PC screen with Win+Shift+S. It shows up on your iPhone, ready to text or save.

STAYS AT HOME
Everything goes straight over your own Wi-Fi. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

EASY SETUP
Open the app, tap your laptop, click Connect on the PC. That's the whole setup. No codes to scan.

TossPix for iPhone works together with TossPix for Windows, which you get from the Microsoft Store. Not at your PC? Tap "See how it works" in the app to try it with sample pictures.

name: Totobet Basketball Consider
description:
See the decisions behind the score. Totobet Basketball Consider brings basketball tactics, interactive statistics, and practical learning together on iPhone.

Explore how spacing, screens, and defensive coverage shape a possession. Read clear guides to basketball rules and techniques, work through formulas with adjustable inputs, and look up unfamiliar terms as they come up. Take a quick quiz to see what you remember and build on your personal best.

Run Monte Carlo simulations to see how changes in scoring averages and variation affect a simulated matchup. Explore the distribution of scores and margins, then compare how often each side finishes ahead across the simulated games.

Get a closer look at the numbers that matter to you. Chart shooting across nine areas of the court, compare players with weights you choose, and use a correlation matrix to see which statistics tend to move together. Start with sample data or enter your own numbers. Save a result to revisit it later or share a report with someone you coach or play with.

Study offensive and defensive tactics with court diagrams, practical examples, and a clear look at each approach’s tradeoffs. Keep your own coaching notes beside the tactics you want to revisit when planning a practice or reviewing a game.

Whether you coach a team, play the game, or follow it closely, Totobet Basketball Consider gives you a practical way to ask better questions about what happens on the court.

name: Toucs
description:
Com o Toucs você encontra barbearias, salões de beleza, estética, clínicas e studios e marca seu horário em poucos toques.

• Busque por nome, cidade ou serviço
• Veja serviços, preços dos serviços, profissionais e avaliações
• Escolha o dia e o horário que estão livres de verdade
• Receba a confirmação e o lembrete no WhatsApp
• Acompanhe e cancele seus agendamentos

Não precisa criar senha: você entra com o seu número de WhatsApp.

Toucs é operado pela Kôoda LTDA.

name: Tower Olympus: Tower Defense
description:
The monsters of Tartarus are climbing Mount Olympus. Build the towers of the gods and hold the mountain, solo or in 2-player co-op.

Tap a spot, pick a god, watch the tower fire. You learn it in 30 seconds, and a match takes 5 to 12 minutes. One finger, portrait screen, no reading needed.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Co-op tower defense for 2 players. Share a 6-digit code and your friend joins your party.
• Quick Match pairs you with another player online when your friends are busy.
• Combine your towers for team combos and call on the powers of the gods.

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Solo mode works offline. No internet needed on a plane or the subway.

9 GODS OF OLYMPUS
• Artemis, Hephaestus, Poseidon, Zeus, Athena, Ares, Boreas, Hades and Hermes.
• Pick the 5 that suit your plan. Every monster asks a question, every tower is an answer.
• Every god can be unlocked by playing.

100 MAPS, ONE MOUNTAIN
• Climb from the foothills to the throne of Olympus.
• Face the Minotaur and the monsters of Tartarus, from swarming rats to flying dragons.
• A new Daily Oracle rule changes how you play every day.
• Earn Gems by playing and spend them on Boons that strengthen your gods.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play. Gems can be earned by playing or bought in the shop. In-app purchases are optional.
• Cartoon fantasy battles. Monsters turn to smoke and go back to Tartarus.

Questions or ideas? support@towerolympus.app

name: Townkit: Cozy Town Builder
description:
Build a tiny wooden town, one kit at a time.

Townkit is a calm 3D building game. Every kit shows you each step in a small picture: pick up the part, turn it the right way and set it in its place. Piece by piece, a ferry, a carousel or a lighthouse takes shape in your hands. When a kit is finished, it takes its spot in town, the land comes alive around it and the next kit opens.

THE RIVER VALLEY
Start with a fisherman's hut by the sea and build your way up the valley through six districts: Seaside, Harbor, Funfair, Farm, Castle and Highlands. 31 kits, from a little hut of 13 parts to a giant Ferris wheel and an observatory on the hill. Finish a district and the next one opens, until the whole valley is yours.

LOST WONDERS: THE ROAD TO TROY
Travel to the ancient world with 26 kits in six districts: the Nile, Babylon, Rome, the Aegean, Anatolia and Troy. Raise an obelisk, plant the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, build the Circus Maximus and the Trojan Horse outside the walls of Troy. The bigger kits come in chapters, so you can stop at a good place. Lost Wonders is a one-time in-app purchase; you can build Heron's Marvels before you buy it.

MADE TO UNWIND
• No timers, no energy, no rush
• No ads, no account
• Plays offline; your progress stays on your device
• Turn the model and zoom in close whenever you like
• Wooden parts with soft edges, a fine grain and painted colors
• The first kit teaches you as you play
• In English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese and Korean

name: TR Mining Congresses
seller_name: TMMOB MADEN MUHENDISLERI ODASI BASIN YAY DAGT PERSONEL BELGELENDIRME VE IKTISADI ISLETMESI
description:
The official mobile application for national and international mining congresses, symposiums, and sector events organized by the UCTEA Chamber of Mining Engineers of Turkey (TMMOB Maden Mühendisleri Odası). Seamlessly follow the entire congress schedule, explore scientific sessions, and participate actively with digital convenience.

Key Features:
• Congress & Session Schedule: Real-time scientific sessions and panels day by day and hall by hall.
• Personal Agenda & Reminders: Add presentations to your calendar with push notifications.
• Digital Badge & QR Check-In: Sign in with your delegate code for contactless hall check-ins.
• Abstracts & Presenters: Access speaker profiles and presentation abstracts.
• Live Announcements: Stay informed regarding gala dinners, schedule updates, and transfers.
• Venue & Exhibition Floorplans: View session halls and booth layouts easily.

name: Tracesmith: SVG Stencil Maker
description:
Tracesmith turns any picture into a file a machine can cut, print or draw. It all happens on your iPhone or iPad: nothing is uploaded, and it works with no signal.

THREE JOBS, ONE APP

CUT FILE. Pick a logo, clipart or drawing and every colour becomes one clean vector layer, ready for vinyl and paper cutting machines. Leave a colour out, change it, or merge two together. Stack the layers so nothing shows through, or cut each to its own shape so the pieces fit like a puzzle. Add an outline layer behind the whole design.

STENCIL. Turn a photograph or a sketch into clean line work for tattoo stencils, wood burning, painting and engraving. Choose outlines only, outlines with shading, or a cleaned-up drawing. Print at real size: a design bigger than the paper is tiled across pages that are marked for joining.

STICKER. The plain background comes off by itself, and a border and cut line are drawn round your artwork, ready for print then cut.

A TRACE YOU CAN ZOOM INTO
Tracesmith finds the true edge inside each pixel instead of following the staircase. Corners stay sharp, curves stay smooth, and the file holds few points, so machines cut it cleanly and quickly.

EVERY FORMAT, AT REAL SIZE
SVG with one named layer per colour. DXF for software that will not open an SVG. PDF at exact size. PNG with a see-through background at up to 600 dpi. Set the finished width in inches or centimetres and the file comes out that size.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No uploads. No tracking. No ads. Your pictures stay on your device.

FAIR PRICING
The whole app is free to use, with three exports every month in any format. Tracesmith Pro makes exports unlimited. There are no credits, no watermarks and no weekly plans.

Tracesmith Pro is available as a yearly or monthly subscription, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kendallcoding202.github.io/tracesmith/privacy/

name: Track Motion: Lap Timer
description:
Track Motion is a free data logger for track days. Your iPhone records g-force, speed, laps, video and heart rate about 100 times a second, and keeps every sample on your phone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Nothing to set up. Put your iPhone in a snug cup holder or a mount, at any angle, press record and drive, or say "Hey Siri, record this race with Track Motion". Sensors, an Apple Watch and video are there when you want more, all optional.

G-FORCE AND GRIP
• Live grip circle: launch, braking, left and right
• Peak cornering, braking and launch, held for half a second so one bump cannot set a record
• Bumps, spin rate and time spent above 1 g
• Learns which way is forward by itself, so the phone can sit at any angle
• Leaves out the seconds when the phone is picked up or moves

SPEED, LAPS AND TRACKS
• GPS speed, top speed and distance
• Track map coloured by speed, with a satellite view
• Lap timing that sets its own start and finish line, or set the line yourself
• Laps from turning alone, for indoor tracks
• Remembers each track and your best lap there
• Mark a lap as not a lap, or merge two, without changing the recording
• Lap against lap: speed round the lap, and where the time went
• Quickest 0-30 mph from a stop, timed by GPS

VIDEO
• Front and rear cameras at once in 1080p, or the rear camera in 4K
• Sound on, with a one-tap mute
• Videos play in step with your data in the replay
• A copy with your speed, g and lap clock drawn on it

CLIPS FOR SOCIAL MEDIA
• 15 to 60 seconds: best lap, fastest stretch, hardest braking, or any moment
• Road camera, driver camera, both, or a speedometer and track map with no video
• Vertical for Shorts, Reels and TikTok, wide for YouTube, or square
• Saved to Photos, ready to post anywhere

HEART RATE
• Any Bluetooth heart-rate sensor, including horse monitors
• Rider and horse at the same time, each with its own name
• Apple Watch, live through the watch app, or from Apple Health

APPLE WATCH
• Start and stop from your wrist when the phone is mounted out of reach
• Speed, lap times and recording status at a glance
• Mute the video and change the main settings

SIRI AND THE ACTION BUTTON
• "Hey Siri, record this race with Track Motion", "record this drive" or "start Track Motion"
• "Hey Siri, stop Track Motion" to save
• Or the Action button, or a Shortcut

MORE SENSORS
• OBD-II readers for cars, Bluetooth LE or Wi-Fi: RPM, speed, throttle, coolant and intake
• GPS receivers that send NMEA over Bluetooth
• Engine RPM from the engine's sound, worked out on the phone
• Air pressure, height climbed and compass heading
• Air density and density altitude, for engine tuning

AFTER EVERY SESSION
• A plain story of what happened, with highlights
• A share card for your best numbers
• Replay: drag to any moment and see speed, g, position and every sensor

PIT CREW
• Your crew watches live on a phone or iPad over your own Wi-Fi
• Up to eight cars on one pit screen, with a timing tower and a shared map

ANY ACTIVITY
• Kart, car, motorcycle, bicycle, horse, boat, walking, hiking, running and dancing, or name your own
• Lean angle for bikes, heel for boats
• Steps, cadence, pace and climb on foot; tempo and energy for dancing
• Speed in mph, km/h or knots

YOUR DATA
• Every session saved as plain CSV files with a summary, plus the videos
• Export .vbo files for RaceRender and Circuit Tools
• Turn your laps into a track outline with its hills, for building a circuit in a racing sim
• Share them to Files, Mail, AirDrop or any app
• Positions shared as metres from the start, unless you choose exact coordinates
• Nothing leaves your phone unless you share it

What it does not do: it is not a certified timing system, and a phone's GPS is good to a few metres, not centimetres.

For tracks and closed courses. Put the phone where it can't slide and start recording before you move. Never handle it while driving.

name: TrackMoi
description:
TrackMoi vous permet de consulter les véhicules associés à votre compte de repérage GPS.

• Retrouvez les dernières positions reçues sur la carte.
• Consultez les informations et les états disponibles pour vos véhicules.
• Accédez aux trajets et à l’historique selon votre forfait.
• Utilisez TrackGPT par texte ou par voix lorsque cette fonction est activée sur votre compte.

Un compte TrackMoi et un équipement GPS compatible sont nécessaires. Les fonctions disponibles dépendent de votre forfait, de votre équipement et des autorisations de votre compte. La mise à jour des positions dépend de la couverture réseau et des transmissions du module GPS.

Assistance : 514-946-0847.

Des alertes directement sur votre téléphone

Recevez des alertes par texto sur les numéros configurés pour vos véhicules. Selon votre module GPS, votre forfait et les options activées, TrackMoi peut vous avertir lorsqu'un véhicule dépasse le seuil de vitesse configuré, accélère brusquement, freine brusquement ou signale un impact.

Les alertes de conduite disponibles peuvent être activées ou désactivées dans les réglages autorisés du véhicule. Les alertes d'accélération et de freinage brusques sont proposées avec les configurations TrackMax compatibles. L'alerte d'impact est disponible sur les configurations TrackFlex et TrackMax compatibles. TrackMoi règle la sensibilité du module.

Retrouvez ensuite votre véhicule sur la carte et consultez les informations disponibles : dernière position reçue, vitesse, état du moteur et tension de batterie. La vue Trajet 2D permet de relire le parcours avec ses flèches de direction, ses événements et les données du trajet.

La disponibilité d'une alerte dépend du matériel, de sa configuration et de la réception de l'événement par le service. Un impact détecté est une information à vérifier; il ne confirme pas à lui seul un accident. Les fonctions accessibles dépendent des droits et services activés sur votre compte.

name: Traffic Azerbaijan
description:
From the avenues of Baku to the narrow lanes of Shaki, cars are stuck at the junction, and it's your job to get them moving the way the rules say. Traffic Azerbaijan is a puzzle game that teaches Azerbaijan's traffic rules.

HOW TO PLAY
• Draw a car's route with your finger and it drives along it.
• Clear each level in as few moves as you can: fewer moves, more stars.
• Give way to the right, watch the lights and the traffic controller, and let pedestrians cross.
• Break a rule and you're fined, with penalty points on your licence. The game explains the mistake with the sign and the article of the code.

15 CHAPTERS, 225 LEVELS
Road signs, unregulated junctions, traffic lights, the traffic controller, pedestrians and emergency vehicles, public transport, railway crossings, tunnels, roundabouts, lanes, speed, stopping and parking… Each chapter teaches a new rule, then tests it in puzzles that get harder as you go.

THE JUNCTION TEST
"Who goes first?" Test yourself with a new junction every day, chapter exams and a theory exam mode. Great practice for anyone preparing for the driving test.

SIGN ALBUM
Every road sign you meet goes into your album: collect all 231, each with its official name and description.

GARAGE
Spend what you earn on new cars, paint them, change their wheels and put your own number on the plate.

AND MORE
• Taxis pick up passengers, rush orders race the clock, and ambulances and fire engines with sirens go first.
• Daily gifts, combo bonuses and speed stars.
• Weather by region: rain on the Caspian coast, snow in Shaki.
• Plays offline.

The game's text is in Azerbaijani.

The game is free. It has optional rewarded ads and in-app purchases, and no forced ads. Premium gives the rewards without the videos and unlocks the Superkar and a signature colour for every car.

Traffic Azerbaijan is an independent game, not affiliated with the Ministry of Internal Affairs or the State Road Police. Its rules and signs follow the Republic of Azerbaijan's Law on Road Traffic and its Code of Administrative Offences.

name: TrailMesh: Offline Chat & SOS
description:
No signal on the trail? TrailMesh keeps your trek group talking.

TrailMesh is a free offline chat and SOS app for trekking and hiking. It works with no internet, no SIM and no mobile network. Phones send messages to each other over Bluetooth and pass them along from phone to phone. If no one is in range, your phone keeps the message and hands it over when someone comes close.

Your group is always connected. The rest of the trail, eventually.

CHAT WITH NO NETWORK
• Trek channels: one chat for every trail. Get updates on snow, water, weather and rooms from people ahead of you
• Group chat for your friends or trek team
• Private 1:1 chat, end-to-end encrypted
• Messages hop from phone to phone, so they reach people beyond Bluetooth range

SOS WHEN IT MATTERS
• Hold the SOS button: your location and emergency card go to every TrailMesh phone nearby, and they pass it on
• Emergency numbers for the country you are in
• Nearest hospital and police, saved with your map

OFFLINE TREK MAPS
• Save your trek map before you lose signal
• Trails, campsites, water points and help places, all offline
• See your group on the map, and who is together or out of reach
• Offline directions on the saved trails

POPULAR TREKS
Everest Base Camp, Annapurna Base Camp, Annapurna Circuit, Manaslu Circuit, Langtang Valley, Poon Hill, Mardi Himal, Roopkund, Har Ki Dun, Kedarnath, Kuari Pass, Chandrashila, Markha Valley, Chadar Trek, Goechala, Sandakphu, Kudremukh, Kumara Parvatha, Mount Kailash Kora and many more in India, Nepal and Tibet. More countries coming very soon.

MADE FOR THE MOUNTAINS
• Works in airplane mode with Bluetooth on, easy on battery
• Dark screen that is easy to read in sunlight
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking

HOW IT WORKS
1. Install TrailMesh and save your trek map while you have internet
2. Join your trek's channel and add your friends (scan their QR code)
3. Keep Bluetooth on during the trek. That's it

TrailMesh works better when more people on the trail have it. Share it with your trek group and trek leader.

PRIVACY
Your chats never go to a server. They travel only from phone to phone. Your emergency card stays on your phone and is shared only when you send an SOS.

IMPORTANT
TrailMesh helps, but it is not a replacement for emergency services. Messages need other phones in range. On iPhone, keep TrailMesh running during the trek so it can pass messages along.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: TrailSteps: Walk & Music
description:
Every walk has a soundtrack. TrailSteps remembers it.

TrailSteps is a fast, easy-to-read pedometer and walk tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch that keeps track of your music too. Start a walk and TrailSteps counts your steps, maps your route, and saves every Apple Music song that played along the way.

YOUR MUSIC, REMEMBERED
• See exactly which songs played on every walk
• Music History lists every song, artist and album, day by day

POWER SONGS
• TrailSteps measures your pace during each song and finds the ones that make you walk faster
• Add your top Power Songs to an Apple Music playlist with one tap
• Pace Rescue can play a Power Song when your pace starts to drop

EVERY ROUTE, MAPPED
• Each walk is saved on the map with pace and weather
• My Routes recognizes the paths you walk again and again and keeps your best time
• Race a ghost of your fastest walk on the same route
• Pin photos and voice notes to spots along the way

TRENDS THAT KEEP YOU MOVING
• Day, week, month, year and all-time charts for steps, distance and pace
• Walking streaks, a "Getting Easier" effort trend and a Weekly Recap to share
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets

APPLE WATCH
• Track walks from your wrist with heart-rate zones and gentle taps to stay in zone
• Walking Programs with spoken warm-up, brisk and cool-down cues

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your walks, routes, music history, photos and notes stay on your device
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no subscription. Pay once and it's yours.

Music features need Apple Music access. Health features work with Apple Health.

From AngelMark Studios. Designed by Angel & Mark.

name: Trap Tobi
seller_name: Centro Studi Informatica di Danilo Priore
description:
Tobis are everywhere, and some of them are planning an escape.
Tap the sneaky ones before they reach the exit. Sounds easy, until the whole crowd starts running.

• Quick rounds, a few seconds each, one finger
• Levels with new rooms, doors and crowd behaviour
• A crowned boss every 10 levels
• Weekly challenge with a leaderboard of generated names
• Challenge a friend with a short code, no typing of names or messages
• The game adapts gently to how you play
• No ads. No tracking

Free to play: you get lives, they come back over time. One tap in the shop unlocks every level and unlimited lives forever. Purchases sit behind a parental gate.

name: Treehouse Rescue
description:
Animals are trapped all over the forest and they need a home. Go on expeditions, clear the games along the path and rescue them. Then build them a home high up in a tree and look after each one.

Expeditions full of games
Each expedition is a path with several stops, and each stop has a different game:
- Arrow puzzles to clear the obstacles
- Fruit harvest and berry baskets
- A check-up at the vet
- The bridge, the pens and the fallen fence
- Luke's riddles
- The vegetable patch, cleaning the forest, forest challenges and truck rides
At the end of the path, a trapped animal is waiting for you to rescue it. Along the way you collect wood, stone, cloth and food.

Every animal is one of a kind
There are 24 species: cats, dogs, rabbits, foxes, owls, otters, hedgehogs, red pandas, ducklings and many more. And no two animals are alike: each one has its own coat, personality, skills and favorite food. Animals that live together become inseparable friends, though some just can't stand each other. Give them any name you like.

Your treehouse
Build cabins among the branches, join them with bridges and ladders and decorate them your way: beds, scratching posts, food bowls, plants, floors, walls and much more. Day and night follow your clock: when it gets dark, the light in the house changes and your animals go to sleep.

Look after them
Fill their food and water bowls, brush them and give them cuddles. A well-cared-for animal is happy and makes happiness, and happiness pays for new expeditions.

Your rescue team
Choose up to four animals to come along. Each one helps with its trait: swimmers pull obstacles out of puddles, climbers unhook tangled ones, flyers lift the nets, diggers dig out what is stuck in the mud...

A journal to complete
Your journal keeps all 24 species and every coat you discover. Complete all the coats of a species to earn a reward.

Friends' trees
With an account, share your treehouse with a code and visit your friends' trees with theirs. Visitors can only look: nobody can change anything in your game, and you can stop sharing whenever you like.

Luke shows you the ropes
Luke, the cat who guides you, shows you the first steps without long explanations: you learn by playing.

Play your way
- Free to play
- No sign-up needed: play without an account and your progress is saved on your device
- Optional account: save your game in the cloud and keep playing on another device
- In 7 languages: English, español, català, français, Deutsch, italiano and português

name: Tribus: Conquista sin Fin
description:
Guía a tu tribu desde la Edad de los Clanes hasta dominar el mapa. Recolecta comida, madera, oro y piedra, levanta tu aldea, entrena tu ejército y enfrenta a tribus rivales controladas por la computadora, solo o con aliados.

• Estrategia en tiempo real completa, pensada para jugar con el dedo
• Varias tribus con bonos y unidades únicas
• Rivales con distintas personalidades y niveles de dificultad
• Avanza de edad, investiga mejoras y construye murallas y torres
• Guarda tu partida y continúa cuando quieras
• Cuenta opcional para seguir tu partida en otro dispositivo (iPhone o navegador)
• Sin anuncios, sin compras dentro de la app y funciona sin internet

name: Trickpad
description:
Trickpad is a score pad for card and table games you already play in the room. Each table stores players in the order you choose, a High wins or Low wins rule, and an optional target. A round asks for one whole number per current player, from -500 to 500. Totals add those numbers. High wins leads with the larger total. Low wins leads with the smaller total. When two players share the best total, the standing says Tie and lists the names.

The home screen is a two-column grid of tables. The score sheet is a sideways grid: players are columns, rounds are rows, and the bottom row is the column total. Standing is a separate strip with a large rank mark, not another copy of the grid. The target bench subtracts a player's total from a High wins target and does not save that sentence. Low wins tables ignore the target.

name: Trip Sort: Color Blend
description:
Trip Sort is a liquid sorting puzzle with a twist: colors blend.

Pour colored liquid from tube to tube. Pour a color onto the same color and it stacks. Pour it onto a different color and the two blend into a new one: red and blue make purple, blue and yellow make green, red and yellow make orange. Fill each goal tube with the color it asks for.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap a tube to lift it, then tap another tube to pour.
- Each goal tube shows the color it needs.
- Blending is permanent, so plan before you pour.
- Finish in fewer moves than par to earn all three stars.

WHAT YOU GET
- Levels checked by a solver, so every one can be finished.
- Short lessons that teach one idea at a time.
- A warning when a pour would make the level impossible to finish.
- Undo, hint and restart at any time. No timers and no lives.
- A 1970s screen-print look with soft, slow animations.
- A symbol on every color, so the game does not depend on color vision alone.
- Works offline. No account. No ads.

PRICE
Levels 1 to 15 are free. A single one-time purchase unlocks every level after that. There are no subscriptions and no consumable purchases.

name: Tripbloom: Korea Events
description:
Find what's happening in Korea right now: festivals, performances and exhibitions, in English, Japanese and Korean.

Tripbloom gathers events from the Korea Tourism Organization and other public sources every day, so you can see what's on this weekend before you go.

■ This weekend
- Festivals, performances and exhibitions near you, by region (Seoul, Busan and all of Korea)
- Ending soon, coming up, and long-running events
- Free events are marked

■ Event details
- Dates, opening hours, venue, admission and organizer
- Lineups and special programs for festivals that publish them
- Nearest subway station and a link to directions
- Official website, add to calendar, share

■ Map
- See every event on a map and pick one near you

■ Saved events
- Tap the heart to save events. No sign-up; saved only on this device.
- Get a reminder at 9 a.m. on the day a saved event starts (optional)

■ Languages
- English, Japanese and Korean. The app starts in your phone's language, and you can switch anytime.

Event information comes from public data and official notices and can change. Please check the official website before you go.

Sources: Korea Tourism Organization (TourAPI), Korea Culture Information Service Agency, and official event pages.

name: Troovi
description:
Troovi è la guida digitale di Castellabate e del Cilento: tutto quello che serve a turisti e residenti, in un'unica app gratuita, in italiano, inglese e tedesco.

ESPLORA IL TERRITORIO
Ristoranti, pizzerie, bar, strutture per dormire, spiagge, negozi, esperienze e servizi di Santa Maria, San Marco, Ogliastro Marina, Lago, Licosa e del borgo di Castellabate. Ogni scheda ha indirizzo, orari, contatti, foto e posizione sulla mappa. Con «Vicino a me» trovi subito cosa c'è intorno a te.

SERVIZI UTILI
• Farmacie di turno
• Bus e orari delle fermate
• Parcheggi
• Distributori di carburante e bancomat
• Numeri utili ed emergenze, consultabili anche senza connessione
• Notizie e avvisi

EVENTI E FESTE
Sagre, concerti, feste e manifestazioni del territorio. Per i grandi eventi, come il Festival di San Martino, Troovi offre una guida dedicata con programma, mappa e promemoria che ti avvisa prima dell'inizio.

COME ARRIVARE E COSA VEDERE
Indicazioni per arrivare in treno, auto, aereo e via mare, sentieri e itinerari per scoprire la costa e l'entroterra del Parco Nazionale del Cilento.

PER LE ATTIVITÀ
Se hai un'attività a Castellabate puoi richiedere e gestire gratuitamente la tua scheda: descrizione, foto, orari e contatti sempre aggiornati.

Troovi non mostra pubblicità e non traccia i tuoi dati. La registrazione è facoltativa.

name: Trucker101: CDL Practice Test
description:
Get your Commercial Driver's License (CDL) permit with practice tests built from the federal rules, then find a CDL school near you.

PRACTICE FOR ALL 8 CDL KNOWLEDGE TESTS
• General Knowledge, Air Brakes, Combination Vehicles, Hazardous Materials, Tank Vehicles, Doubles/Triples, Passenger and School Bus
• 529 questions written from the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations (49 CFR) and the CDL driver's manual, each with an explanation
• Mock exams that work like the real test, with the pass mark and a pass/fail score
• Review the questions you missed until you get them right
• Works offline — study in the truck, at a rest stop or anywhere without signal
• Daily study reminders and a study streak to keep you on track

FIND A CDL SCHOOL
• Search by ZIP code, city, school name, or your current location
• Schools come from the official FMCSA Training Provider Registry — the list every school must be on before it can train you for a Class A or B CDL
• See which schools take the public (most registered providers only train their own employees), which offer behind-the-wheel training on public roads, and which have been removed from the registry before
• Map view, phone, directions and website in one tap
• Read and write reviews from real students, and save schools to compare later

FREE TO USE
No subscription and no ads. An account is optional — sign in with your email to unlock the full question bank and sync your progress between your phone and trucker101.com.

Trucker101 is an independent study and research tool. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FMCSA, the U.S. Department of Transportation, any state DMV, or any school. Always check your state's official CDL manual and confirm details directly with the school.

name: Truesolve Bench
description:
Truesolve Bench is a construction calculator for framers, carpenters, contractors, and concrete and roofing crews who work in feet, inches, and fractions. Solve stairs, rafters, slabs, and studs offline with labeled tools instead of key chords. No ads. No account.

Results are a calculation aid only. Always verify against your local building code, span tables, and qualified judgment, and follow the manufacturer's specifications before you cut or pour.

FREE
• Feet-inch-fraction calculator: add, subtract, multiply, and divide, with results shown to the nearest 1/64 in
• Imperial and metric conversion
• Right angle: rise, run, and diagonal
• Common rafter length and pitch
• Basic stair layout: risers, treads, and stringer
• Area and volume for rooms and slabs
• Concrete bag estimate for your bag size
• Studs on center
• Calculation history
• Works offline, no account

PRO
One-time: unlock today's Pro tools for good. No renewals. One-time buyers keep getting bug fixes for today's tools.
Yearly: everything in Pro today, plus new Pro tools as we add them, for as long as your plan is active.
Pro tools today:
• Full stair package: headroom, stairwell opening, and floor thickness
• Hip, valley, and jack rafters
• Roofing squares and bundles
• Drywall and siding sheet counts
• Block and footing solvers
• Board feet
• Equal spacing for balusters and posts
• Compound miter helpers
• Named saved jobs with calculation history
• Diagrams on stairs, right angle, rafters, and roof
• Full learning library: 12 worked examples, 5 cheat sheets, 4 picture guides
• Cheat sheet PDF export
• CSV export of saved jobs

PRICING
• Free download with core feet-inch-fraction math
• Truesolve Bench Pro: a one-time purchase or a yearly plan
• Restore Purchases supported

Yearly renews automatically each year at the same price unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

WHO IT IS FOR
Framers, carpenters, general contractors, concrete and roofing crews, and maintenance or project builders who want fast feet-inch-fraction layout math on the phone.

IMPORTANT
Truesolve Bench does not certify work, guarantee accuracy, or claim code compliance. Wrong stair or rafter numbers cost rework, so check every result before you build.

Privacy: calculations run on your device. No account, no ads. Purchases are handled by Apple.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://truesolvebench.com/privacy/

name: Tune & Tick
description:
Tune & Tick is a simple tuner and metronome.

The screen shows only what you need right now: a large note name and a needle for how far off you are, or a pendulum and the tempo. Open it and go.

TUNER
• Chromatic tuner for guitar, bass, ukulele, violin, wind instruments, voice and more
• Shows the offset in cents and turns green when you are in tune
• Reference pitch (A4) adjustable from 430 to 450 Hz
• Feel it too: the further off you are, the faster it taps; in tune, a long buzz. Tune without taking your eyes off your instrument.

METRONOME
• 40 to 208 BPM
• Keeps the beat with clicks and taps
• Adjustable tap strength

WORKS ON APPLE WATCH
• Use the tuner and the metronome on Apple Watch on its own
• Keep time silently with taps where sound is not an option

PRIVACY
Microphone audio is processed on your device as it comes in. It is never recorded or sent anywhere.

name: TUPPS
description:
Download the TUPPS Brewing app for access to our memberships & special perks!

With the TUPPS Brewing App you will find:

- Our Mug Club
- Members Only Rewards
- Menus
- Notifications
- Events

Stay connected to TUPPS Brewing! Check out our tap list, shop online, and see what events we have coming up. Join our Mug Club and receive exclusive offers & special perks all in one place!

name: Turili - Program de ture
description:
Programul tău de ture, cu orele calculate după Codul muncii și cu sărbătorile legale din România. Pentru oricine lucrează în ture: spitale, poliție, pompieri, pază, fabrici, transport.

TOT ANUL, GENERAT SINGUR
Alegi tiparul (12/24, 12/48, 24/72 sau unul creat de tine) și ziua de început. Restul e gata. Poți modifica apoi orice zi separat.

ORELE, CALCULATE CORECT
• Norma lunii, calculată automat
• Orele suplimentare și recuperările
• Orele de noapte (+25%)
• Sărbătorile legale scad singure din normă, an de an

RAPOARTE ȘI STATISTICI
• Raport PDF lunar sau anual, gata de printat sau de trimis, cu toate totalurile
• Statistici pe tot anul: ore lucrate, weekenduri și sărbători, ore de noapte, lună cu lună

TOTUL ÎNTR-UN SINGUR CALENDAR
• Ture, concedii și recuperări, cu culori și simboluri
• Notificări înainte de tură
• Widgeturi pe ecranul principal și blocare: tura de azi, programul tău, luna întreagă

BONUS: PROGRAMUL ÎN DOI
Dacă vreți amândoi, vă vedeți turele unul altuia. Unul creează un cod, celălalt îl introduce, și puteți opri partajarea oricând. Numele turelor rămân private.

FĂRĂ CONT, FĂRĂ RECLAME
Calendarul, orele, PDF-ul și statisticile merg fără cont. Programul tău stă pe telefon. Contul e nevoie doar pentru partajarea cu partenerul. Turili nu are reclame și nu te urmărește.

Calculele urmează regulile generale din Codul muncii și sunt orientative. Angajatorul, contractul colectiv sau regulamentul intern pot avea reguli proprii.

Făcută de Țicu Vlad-Sebastian, autorul aplicației JAC.

name: Turnly
description:
Turnly è il calendario pensato per chi lavora a turni: infermieri, operatori sanitari, forze dell'ordine, vigili del fuoco, operai, addetti alla logistica e a chiunque abbia un ciclo che si ripete.

IMPOSTI IL CICLO UNA VOLTA, IL CALENDARIO SI COMPILA DA SOLO
Scegli un modello (ciclo continuo, tre turni e due riposi, settimana normale) oppure crea il tuo: nome, orario con le rotelle, colore. Indichi che turno fai oggi e Turnly calcola tutti i giorni, nel passato e nel futuro.

FERIE, PERMESSI E ALTRE ASSENZE
Segna ferie, permessi, malattia o i tipi che crei tu (permesso straordinario, legge 104, formazione…) su un giorno o su un intero periodo, saltando in automatico i giorni di riposo. Ogni tipo ha il suo colore e la sua icona, e puoi aggiungere una nota.

STRAORDINARI
Registra gli straordinari con un tocco, anche dal calendario tenendo premuto un giorno, con la nota del motivo. Vedi subito i totali del mese, dell'anno e complessivi.

TUTTO A COLPO D'OCCHIO
• Calendario mensile a colori con sigla del turno, ferie e straordinari
• Oggi e domani in evidenza, con il meteo della tua città
• Riepilogo del mese e statistiche per turno e per tipo di assenza
• Ricerca di un giorno qualsiasi
• Esportazione nel calendario del telefono (.ics)

PER LA FAMIGLIA (FACOLTATIVO)
Chi ha un piccolo server di casa può sincronizzare i turni tra telefono e tablet e invitare i familiari con un codice: vedono i turni e possono mandare una richiesta su un giorno ("Sabato sei libera?"), che tu accetti o rifiuti. I dati restano sui tuoi dispositivi e sul tuo server.

PRIVACY
Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento. I tuoi turni restano sul tuo dispositivo.

name: Turnstack: Color Ring Sort 3D
description:
Turnstack is a calm 3D color ring sort puzzle with no ads that plays offline. Spin the potter's wheel, move glossy rings from peg to peg, and fire every stack once it holds a single color.

NO ADS, PLAY OFFLINE
• No ads, ever: no banners, no videos, no pop-ups between levels.
• Plays offline with no Wi-Fi needed, so you can sort rings on a plane or the subway.

HOW TO PLAY
• Turn the wheel left or right to reach the pegs at the back.
• Move the top ring onto a peg whose top color matches, or onto an empty peg.
• Fill a peg with one color and it goes into the kiln.
• Clear the wheel in fewer moves for three stars.
If you like hoop stack, donut sort or other color sort games, the spinning wheel adds a fresh twist to the classic ring sort puzzle.

A JOURNEY OF PAINTED PLACES
• 1,060 levels in 53 chapters, each with its own painted scenery: a torii path, desert dunes, a blossom peak, a coast bridge and many more.
• Finish a chapter to collect its scenery and pin your favorite as the background.
• After the last chapter, Endless mode keeps the sorting puzzles coming.

RING SKINS
• Sort donut rings with sprinkles, jewel-cut rings, yarn rings, flower rings, racing tires, neon rings and glazed pottery.
• Unlock new wheels such as Blue Porcelain and Gold Kiln.
• The Kiln Pass season brings extra rewards.

HELPERS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
• Undo a move, add a spare peg, or reveal the hidden clay rings.
• Earn coins from every level, a daily gift and the Glaze Jar.

Turnstack is free to play, with optional in-app purchases for coins, helpers and cosmetics. Relax, turn the wheel, and sort one more stack.

name: Tutorian
description:
Tutorian is built for anyone who gives private lessons — music, tutoring, languages, or any other subject — and wants to manage students, lessons, payments and expenses without juggling spreadsheets or scattered notes.

WHY TUTORIAN
Zero friction: adding a lesson, marking it as done, or logging a payment takes just a couple of taps, with smart defaults based on your habits and each student's history.

STUDENTS
• A full profile for every student: subject, custom hourly rate, contacts, notes
• A separate "Who pays" section for cases where the person taking lessons isn't the one paying (e.g. parents)
• Lesson and payment history, with outstanding balance always in view
• Quick actions: call, message, get directions, or start a new lesson pre-filled for that student

SCHEDULE
• Day, week and month views
• An always-reachable button to add a new lesson in seconds
• Long-press on an empty slot to create a lesson right there, with the time already filled in
• Drag to move or duplicate a lesson
• Swipe to mark as done, duplicate, make recurring, or cancel
• Automatic warning for scheduling conflicts

PAYMENTS AND EXPENSES
• Log payments linked to one or more lessons, with a customizable method (cash, bank transfer, PayPal, and more)
• Track each student's balance and get reminders for overdue payments
• Log expenses by category (materials, travel, room rental, equipment), including recurring expenses

DASHBOARD
A clear overview of the current month: income, expenses, net total and hours taught, today's and this week's lessons, and pending payments.

STATISTICS AND REPORTS
Monthly and yearly charts, hours taught per subject or student, your most profitable student or subject, cancellation rate, and PDF/CSV export for your own records.

BUILT FOR iOS
Native design using the latest system components: no custom, out-of-place interfaces — just a fast, familiar experience.

PRIVACY FIRST
All your data stays on your device: no account to create, no server, no ads. You can export a full backup whenever you want.

HOW PRICING WORKS
Tutorian is free to start, with a limited number of active students. When you're ready to unlock unlimited students, advanced statistics, exports and more, it's a single one-time purchase: no subscription, no surprises — pay once and the app is yours forever.

Whether you teach math in the afternoon or guitar on weekends, Tutorian helps you keep it all under control with minimal effort.

Privacy: https://aemmeapps.vercel.app/app/tutorian/privacy
Terms & Conditions: https://aemmeapps.vercel.app/app/tutorian/terms

name: Tuxedo: Cat Café Logic
description:
A cozy retro cat café, lit by warm brass lamps, has two new regulars: a black cat and a white cat.

Fill the grid with black and white cats in this calm logic puzzle.

THREE RULES
- No more than two cats of the same colour next to each other, across or down.
- Every row and every column holds the same number of black and white cats.
- No two rows (or two columns) may be exactly the same.

Every puzzle can be solved by reasoning alone — no guessing needed.
Choose from three grid sizes (6×6, 8×8, 10×10) and three difficulty levels.
Stuck? A hint shows where you can place the next cat, and why.

YOUR CAFÉ GROWS
Solving puzzles earns coins. Spend them on furniture and grow the café from the ground floor to the loft, the terrace and the courtyard.

MEET THE CATS
Use your coins to welcome more cats to the café. The cat book shows each cat's little line and favourite thing.

A PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Pick a daily puzzle from the calendar and keep your streak going.

ADS AND AD-FREE
The game is free to play and shows ads (an ad after puzzles, and optional ads you can watch for a hint).
A one-time in-app purchase, "Ad-free", removes the ads after puzzles and makes hints unlimited.

FOR YOU IF YOU LIKE
- Quiet, wordless logic puzzles
- Thinking through one puzzle at a time in a spare moment
- Cats, and the warm retro mood of a lamplit café

name: Twelve Hearts: Dark King
description:
The world once had twelve hearts. On a moonless night, Theodore, the Dark King, tore them out one by one, and the bones of the dead rose to guard the forgotten kingdoms. But light never truly dies: in every heart a shard still pulses, calling whoever dares to give chase.

TWELVE HEARTS is a fast arena action game you play with one finger. Drag to move. Your hero attacks on their own. Your job is to stay alive, read the battlefield and grow stronger before the horde closes in.

FIVE HEROES, FIFTEEN WEAPONS
• Ninja, Armored Knight, Tech Gunner, Energy Warrior and Alchemist, each with a look and fighting style of their own
• Three weapons per hero, from short sword and shuriken to hammer, rifle, energy beam and potion bomb
• Unlock the second and third weapon in battle and raise each one through five levels

BUILD YOUR RUN
• Choose cards as you fight: hit harder, attack faster, stay strong, crush wounded foes and more
• Take a card to level three to unlock its special effect
• Grab power-ups on the field: frenzy, shield and heart shards

THE DESERT CHAPTER
• Ten painted desert stages, each with its own map and landmarks
• Archers, dashers, priests, heavy skeletons and elite guardians, with surges that pour in from the glowing edge
• Face the Dead Sand King: crescent strikes, whirlpools, summoned minions and sandstorms

KEEP COMING BACK
• Daily rewards over seven days
• Hero ranks and weapon upgrades that carry over between runs
• Full Arabic and English, portrait or landscape

More chapters are on their way. The hunt for the Dark King has only begun.

Twelve Hearts is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases, including a one-time purchase that removes forced ads.

Privacy: https://xogamesstudio.com/twelve-hearts/privacy.html?lang=en
Support: https://xogamesstudio.com/twelve-hearts/support.html?lang=en

name: Twenty – Cube Solver
description:
Got a scrambled cube and no idea what to do? Twenty solves it with you.

SCAN
Show the camera every side — in any order, any way you hold it. Twenty reads the colors and figures out the rest. Wrong color? One tap fixes it.

FOLLOW
One big glowing arrow, one move at a time. No notation to learn. A voice coach (female or male) speaks every step, so you can keep your eyes on the cube. Messed up a move? Just rescan and keep going — no starting over.

SOLVED
Every solution is 20 moves or less (double turns count as one). Mini cube 2×2 too, in 11 moves or less.

• Works offline — nothing leaves your iPhone
• Big, simple steps that kids can follow
• Try a demo without a cube

Free: scan any cube, your first 2 cubes completely, then the first 2 moves of every solution.
Twenty Pro unlocks every move, unlimited cubes and the 2×2 mini cube.

Weekly or yearly subscription (yearly with a 7-day free trial). Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TwinInk: Text to Handwriting
description:
TwinInk turns any text into your own handwriting.

Write each letter a few times with Apple Pencil, paste your text, and TwinInk sets it on real notebook paper in your own hand – ready to export as a PDF for GoodNotes, the Files app or your printer.

NEVER THE SAME TWICE
Real handwriting never repeats itself. TwinInk picks from up to 15 versions you wrote of every letter and varies the gaps between letters and words, so no two words on a page look alike.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Write: draw each character a few times in large cells – lowercase, uppercase, numbers, punctuation, symbols and German umlauts.
2. Paste: drop in notes, a letter, an essay or an answer from your favorite AI. Markdown like **bold** or # headings is cleaned up automatically.
3. Export: pick a paper and an ink and share a PDF of every page.

PAPERS AND INKS
College ruled, wide ruled, graph and dot grid in US Letter, plus lined and squared A5, A4 and A3 sheets. Import any PDF page as your own paper – for example a template from GoodNotes. Six inks: black, blue, navy, red, green and graphite.

TRY IT FIRST
Not ready to write the alphabet yet? Load the sample handwriting from the ⋯ menu and see TwinInk in action right away.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your handwriting never leaves your iPad.

TWININK FREE
• 3 of 15 versions per letter
• Black and blue ink
• Export the first page with a small credit line

TWININK PRO
• All 15 versions per letter
• Every page in one PDF
• Every ink
• Your own PDF papers
• No credit line

TwinInk Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription – the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers – or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vantagesoftware.github.io/twinink-app/datenschutz.html#en

name: Two Skies: Human Design Chart
description:
Every Human Design chart is two snapshots of the sky: one at the minute you were born, and one about three months earlier. Two Skies shows you that, literally. Your two skies fall into the chart and light it up, then the app tells you in plain English what it means for how you work, decide and rest.

FREE, FOR GOOD
• Your full chart, beautifully drawn, with both planet columns
• Your type, strategy, authority and profile
• All nine centres, read for you: what's steady in you, and where you take in other people
• When you're off track, and how to get back
• Today's Sun and Earth gates on your chart
• Two people with their type and the lines you only close together
• A poster of your chart to share

THE WHOLE DESIGN
One payment, or a smaller yearly one for the same unlock. No trial, no weekly plan.
• Every channel, gate and line in your chart, written for you
• Your incarnation cross
• Unlimited people, with a page for each pair: how your types work together, how to give them room to decide, and every line you share or close together
• Your full reading as a beautifully set PDF to print or keep
• Which planets touch your chart each day, for the next two weeks (positions, never predictions), and the Lock Screen widget

PLAIN ENGLISH
Every word is our own, written in short everyday sentences. No jargon until you ask for it, and no fortune telling: Two Skies is a tool for reflection, not prediction.

ACCURATE, AND PRIVATE
The positions of the Sun, Moon, planets and lunar nodes are calculated on your iPhone with published astronomical methods, and checked against the standard reference on thousands of birth times. The app shows the UTC offset it used for your birth place, and you can correct it. Your birth details never leave your iPhone. No account.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TYM Delivery
description:
TYM Delivery is the rider app for restaurants that use TYM POS.

When the restaurant sends a delivery from its POS, the rider gets the job on their phone, accepts it, and updates each step. The restaurant sees the progress live.

• Go online to receive delivery jobs from your restaurant
• Accept or reject new jobs
• See the restaurant, the customer's address, the items and the amount to collect
• Open directions in your maps app, or call the customer
• Update the job step by step: reached restaurant, picked up, reached customer, delivered
• Cash on delivery reminder before marking an order delivered
• History of your deliveries and earnings for the last 7 days

You need a rider login from your restaurant to use this app. There is no public sign-up.

name: Ugiset Now
description:
Een hut, schuur of boerderij staat vaak dagen of zelfs weken onbewaakt. Camera's hangen op verschillende plekken, sensoren zitten in bijgebouwen en langs de erfgrens, en na een tijdje weet niemand meer welke apparatuur aanstaat, welke al lang niets meer heeft gemeld en wat er intussen is vastgelegd. Ugiset Now brengt alles samen in één overzicht. Zo zie je per apparaat waar het hangt, hoe het ervoor staat en wat het heeft vastgelegd.

De app draait om een lijst van apparaten. Elke camera en sensor krijgt een eigen regel met een status, een 'laatst gezien'-melding en een snelle link naar de foto's en gebeurtenissen die het heeft vastgelegd. Dit zijn de belangrijkste onderdelen:

- Apparatenlijst: alle camera's en sensoren op je terrein, elk met een eigen detailscherm.
- Scherp of uit: stel per apparaat de bewakingsstatus in en zie in één oogopslag wat er actief is.
- Groepen en subgroepen: deel apparaten in per gebouw, perceel of zone. Een groep toont ook de apparaten uit de onderliggende groepen.
- Logboek: foto's en meldingen per apparaat, per dag gegroepeerd onder een datumkop.
- Regels: koppel regels aan een apparaat of groep, met een heldere omschrijving van wanneer ze gelden.
- Controlerondes: plan terugkerende controles, zie wanneer de volgende ronde gepland staat en herken meteen welke te laat zijn.
- Temperatuur en afstand: lees de temperatuur van sensoren af en bereken de afstand tussen twee coördinaten in mijl.
- Locatie: open de positie van een apparaat direct in Apple Kaarten.
- Tags: koppel een apparaat aan een tagcode die de app aanmaakt en weer kan uitlezen.
- Export: exporteer gegevens uit het logboek en de apparatenlijst voor verdere verwerking.

Het logboek leest als een dagboek van je terrein. Elke dag begint met een kop met de volledige datum, en bij elke gebeurtenis staat het tijdstip in uren en minuten, met seconden erbij als dat nodig is. Recente momenten worden als relatieve tijd getoond, zoals 'twee uur geleden', zodat je meteen ziet wat er net is gebeurd.

Ook elders helpt de app je met tijd. Een sensor die al een tijd niets heeft gemeld, krijgt een 'laatst gezien'-label met de tijd sinds het laatste bericht. Bij rondes en regels zie je een aftelling in dagen of minuten, zodat je zonder rekenen weet wat de volgende stap is. Datums voer je in een vast formaat in; de app herkent die invoer en zet hem om naar een datum.

Controlerondes hebben een vaste cyclus, en de app berekent daaruit wanneer de volgende ronde gepland staat. Is die datum verstreken, dan wordt de ronde als achterstallig gemarkeerd en valt ze direct op in het overzicht van apparaten en groepen. Zo raakt een gemiste controle nooit ondergesneeuwd.

Bij apparaten op afgelegen plekken telt de locatie mee. Zijn de coördinaten bekend, dan berekent de app de afstand over het aardoppervlak in mijl. Met één tik open je de locatie in Apple Kaarten en plan je direct een route.

Gegevens uit het logboek en de apparatenlijst kun je exporteren, bijvoorbeeld voor je verzekeraar, een onderhoudsbedrijf of je eigen archief. Ugiset Now is gemaakt voor eigenaren van landgoederen, vakantiehuizen en buitenlocaties met meerdere camera's of sensoren die alles in één overzicht willen, zonder elke plek apart te hoeven controleren.

Ugiset Now is een overzichtstool: de app toont de status en het logboek van de apparatuur die je zelf hebt ingesteld. Het is geen vervanging voor een meldkamer of beveiligingsdienst.

Begin met je eerste camera of sensor, wijs die toe aan een groep en stel de status in. Het logboek vult zich met alles wat je apparatuur vastlegt, en zodra de eerste regels erin staan, heb je een bruikbaar overzicht.

name: UK Citizenship App Hub
description:
DISCLAIMER: UK Civics is an independent, unofficial study app. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or representing the Home Office, the UK Government, PSI or TSO. Its questions are original practice questions, not the questions used in the real test.

Free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no sign-up.

UK Civics is made for future citizens — clear, simple, and easy to use, even with limited English.

UK Civics helps you prepare for the Life in the UK test, which you need for settlement (indefinite leave to remain) or British citizenship. Every question is written from the handbook Life in the United Kingdom: A Guide for New Residents (3rd edition), updated with the changes in its latest printing, such as the King and the 60 members of the Senedd.

THE REAL TEST
• 24 multiple-choice questions in 45 minutes
• You need 75% (18 correct) to pass
• £50 for each attempt, booked online
• A pass gives you a Unique Reference Number (URN)
WHAT'S IN THE APP
• 643 practice questions from all 5 chapters of the handbook: values and principles, what is the UK, history, a modern society, and government and the law.
• Three question types: single answer, true or false, and choose TWO.
• Every answer comes with a short explanation.
• Practice Test: 24 questions drawn from every chapter, 18 to pass.
• Exam Mode: a 45-minute test-day simulation with a question grid. Pass three in a row before your test.
• Flashcards, Quick Review and Weak Spots: learn, test yourself and focus on the questions you miss. The app brings back the ones you get wrong more often.
• Listen Mode: hear questions and answers read aloud in pre-recorded British voices, female or male.
• Questions about England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are labelled, and everyone sees all of them, as in the real test.
• Question of the Day and an optional daily reminder.
• Progress by chapter, quiz history and a countdown to your test date.
• URN Vault: keep your Unique Reference Number on your phone after you pass.
• Works offline. Made for iPhone, iPad.

name: UloviMe
description:
UloviMe su besplatni oglasi za odeću, obuću i stvari za decu, kuću i hobi u Srbiji. Kupac i prodavac se dogovaraju direktno, bez provizije i bez naknade.

KUPUJ
• Pretraži ponudu po kategoriji, veličini, brendu, stanju i ceni.
• Sačuvaj pretragu i dobij obaveštenje kada stigne novi oglas.
• Dodaj oglas u omiljene i saznaj kada mu padne cena.
• Piši prodavcu i pošalji ponudu za cenu.

PRODAJ
• Fotografiši stvar i objavi oglas za par minuta, sa do 20 fotografija.
• Izaberi veličinu, brend i stanje, od novog do dobro nošenog.
• Odgovaraj na poruke i ponude na jednom mestu.

SIGURNO
• Kupci i prodavci ocenjuju jedni druge posle razgovora o oglasu.
• Prijavi oglas, korisnika ili razgovor.
• Blokiraj korisnika kada želiš.
• Nalog brišeš sam, u podešavanjima.

Isti nalog i ista ponuda na sajtu ulovime.rs i u aplikaciji.

name: UltraSafe
description:
Was passiert mit deinen privaten Fotos, wenn dein iPhone in falsche Hände gerät? Mit UltraSafe bleiben sie dort, wo sie hingehören: bei dir.

DEIN SICHERER ORT
UltraSafe ist ein Tresor für Fotos und Videos, die nicht jeder sehen soll – private Momente, Dokumente, Erinnerungen, die nur dich etwas angehen. Ob das Handy verloren geht, gestohlen wird oder nur kurz bei Freunden die Runde macht: Ohne deinen PIN oder dein Gesicht kommt niemand an deine Bilder.

RAUS AUS DER GALERIE
Wähle Fotos und Videos in deiner Mediathek aus – UltraSafe übernimmt sie verschlüsselt und entfernt die Originale auf Wunsch aus der Fotos-App. Was im Tresor liegt, taucht in keiner Galerie, keinem Rückblick und keiner Diashow mehr auf.

DOPPELT GESCHÜTZT
• Eigener 6-stelliger PIN, unabhängig vom Gerätecode
• Zusätzlich Face ID oder Touch ID für blitzschnelles Entsperren
• Sperrt sich automatisch, sobald du die App verlässt
• Im App-Umschalter bleibt der Inhalt unsichtbar
• Schutz vor Durchprobieren: Nach mehreren Fehlversuchen wird die Eingabe gesperrt
• Alles liegt mit AES-256 verschlüsselt auf deinem Gerät
• Zusätzlich eine verschlüsselte Sicherungskopie auf Servern in Deutschland
• 2 GB Cloud-Sicherung inklusive, Dateien bis 500 MB

ALLES IM GRIFF
• Alben anlegen, umbenennen und ordnen
• Raster- oder Listenansicht
• Mehrere Elemente auf einmal verschieben, teilen oder löschen
• Videos direkt in der App abspielen

KEIN KONTO, KEINE WERBUNG
Keine E-Mail, kein Name, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Installieren, PIN festlegen, fertig.

name: Umbune
description:
Umbune turns a page count into a binding plan.

Enter the trim width and height, the page count, the paper weight and caliper, the pages per signature, the cover wrap, the paper price, the cover price and the print run. Umbune halves the page count into sheets, multiplies sheets by caliper to get the spine, doubles the trim width and adds the spine and two wraps for the flat cover width, adds two wraps to the trim height for cover height, and rounds the page count into signatures — including the blank pages a signature leaves behind. It then multiplies trim area by sheets for paper area, applies grams per square metre for paper weight, and prices paper and covers for the whole run.

A book cover is drawn to scale while you type: front cover, red spine and page block, with trim and spine labels. A second drawing opens the full cover spread — back cover, spine, front cover and a dashed wrap line. Every change to a page count, a paper, a signature, a wrap or a print run rebuilds the plan immediately.

name: Under the Tree: Wishlist
description:
Under the Tree is a Christmas wishlist and countdown for your family or your friend group. Everyone adds what they are hoping for, and everyone can see it from their own phone, iPad or Apple Watch.

WISHLISTS THAT ARE EASY TO SHOP FROM

Add a wish with a photo, a price, a link and a note about size or color. Add a backup in case the first choice does not work out.

Mark the things you want most. In the app, paste a shop link and the name, price and photo fill in for you.

A FAVORITES QUIZ

Answer a few quick questions about yourself: favorite candy, colors, sizes, what you already have plenty of. Everyone in your group can read it, so filling a stocking is easy.

PICKS STAY SECRET

Tap a wish to say you are getting it. The person it is for never sees your picks, so nobody gets the same gift twice and nothing is spoiled.

SECRET SANTA

Vote for who runs it, set a price limit and a gift day, and draw names. Hold the button to see who you got.

ADVENT CALENDAR

A new door every day in December, with a joke, a fact or a small mission for the family.

CHRISTMAS EVE AND CHRISTMAS DAY

On the 24th, a Santa tracker follows 11 pm around the world and counts down to your house. From the 25th, the group can vote to reveal who gave what. It only opens if every single person says yes.

GAMES AND MUSIC

Present Catch, Gift Tower, Memory Match and Catch Santa, with leaderboards for your group. Christmas music while you browse.

ON APPLE WATCH

Lists, picks, Secret Santa, the advent calendar, the favorites quiz and all four games on your wrist. Turn the crown to move the sack in Present Catch, and put the days until Christmas on your watch face. If your iPhone is already in a group, the watch can join the same one with one tap.

YOUR WORDS FOR PEOPLE

Tap a person to pick what you call them: Dad, Daddy, Papa, Nana, or anything you type. It only changes your own device.

FOR EVERYONE IN THE FAMILY

Someone in the family has no phone, like a little kid? Add their wishes for them. Pick what you call each person, like Dad or Papa. Songs, background photos and lettering are saved in the app, so it opens fast with no internet.

MADE FOR FAMILIES

No ads. No accounts, no email and no phone number. A group is joined with an invite code, and only people with the code can see it.

Anyone can report or hide a wish, whoever runs the group can take a wish or a person off, and you can delete everything of yours at any time.

Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

Terms of Use: https://l3dprints26.github.io/under-the-tree/terms.html

name: Unfathomable Companion
description:
Unfathomable Companion is a free, unofficial companion for Unfathomable, the board game of hidden loyalties aboard the SS Atlantica

Quick Setup
• Supports From the Abyss, with the No-Cultist.
• Set up decks quickly based on character selection.
• Preludes: Fully integrated in the app.

Title Succession
• Players who get sent in the Bridge automatically passes roles to the next player in succession.

Monster activation
• Activation icons on the mythos card you drew, and see what they do.
• Horror icons also supported.

Rules on demand
• The complete Rules Reference glossary, searchable, with a contents drawer and linked related topics.
• Integrated Abyss rules within the core rules.

Unfathomable Companion is a fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Fantasy Flight Games. You need a copy of the board game to play.

name: UnionCommand
description:
UnionCommand is the workspace public safety unions use to run their day-to-day union business. Officers, district representatives and board members keep grievances, member issues, leave, communications and board business in one place, on the web and on their phones.

Each union has its own workspace and its own records. You sign in with the account your union gives you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Track grievances step by step, with the deadlines from your contract, and fill in the employer's grievance form from the grievance
• Follow members who are out injured, on light duty or on military leave, with reminders when a contact is due
• Log member issues, station issues and station visits by district
• Email members by status, district, station, shift or rank, with templates and attachments
• Keep the board's calendars, events and RSVPs in one place
• Submit and approve expense reports, with mileage and photos of receipts
• Handle union leave requests, executive board motions and votes
• See everything that is overdue or coming due on the Today view

FOR UNIONS THAT USE UNIONCOMMAND
UnionCommand is for officers and members of unions that use it. You need an account from your union to sign in. To bring UnionCommand to your union, visit unioncommand.com.

name: Unit Converter Side by Side
description:
Enter one number and see two or three useful conversions together while cooking, receiving shipments or traveling.

Convert weight, volume, temperature and speed. US kitchen measures are labeled clearly. The app remembers your last preset and valid input so you can pick up where you left off.

Copy one result or the whole set, share an image, or send your unit preset as a code or file. Conversions, sharing and importing presets are free. Try creating and editing presets and arranging shortcuts for 30 days from first launch. A one-time purchase unlocks those tools after the trial. Your existing presets stay available.

Conversions and storage stay on your device. No account, ads or analytics.

name: Unsober Society
description:
Unsober Society is for the friends who already text each other a photo every time someone orders a drink. Now it has its own app.

CHECK IN
Having one? Open the app, take the photo, add a caption if you have something to say, and pick the bar or let the app suggest it. Choose which of your groups gets it and send. Done before the head settles.

THE CREW ANSWERS
Everyone in those groups gets a push straight away. They answer right from the lock screen with one of two reactions: a cheers if they approve, or the finger if they're jealous (or just feel like it). You hear about it, without your phone going off every ten seconds.

TONIGHT
The map shows where tonight's check-ins are: a pin at the bar when you picked one, a rough area of about 500 m when you didn't, or only the city if you switch the map off for that check-in. Everything leaves the map after 12 hours.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no public feed, no follower count and no way to find strangers. Groups are invite only: anyone can share the invite link, but the group's owner approves every new member, and new members only see what's posted after they join.

KEEP IT DECENT
Any check-in, photo or person can be reported, and anyone can be blocked. Blocking works both ways and the other person isn't told. You can delete your account in the app whenever you like.

Unsober Society is for people of legal drinking age where they live. It doesn't sell alcohol and doesn't reward drinking more: one check-in counts the same as ten. Know your limits, drink responsibly, and never drink and drive.

name: Until the Swallows Return
description:
The summers stopped ending. The grids failed, the cities burned, and the rain came down burning.

You used to mend things. When your town burned, you sealed yourself into a shelter beneath it. Above the hatch now lies a wasteland of ruins, mutated animals and bandits, and the road out of it runs on as far as anyone can walk. You mean to live long enough to help mend the world, and to see the swallows come back to the eaves.

Until the Swallows Return is a quiet survival game, told in words and painted scenes.

WALK
Leave the shelter and walk the scorched road. Every step is a choice: search what others left behind, turn down a side path, or keep going while there is still water enough to get home.

SEARCH
A looted supermarket, a breached dam, a ruined pharmacy, a cracked-open bunker, a mall from the last season anyone shopped. Go deeper, level by level, and decide when the risk stops being worth it.

CHOOSE
Mutated animals and wandering bandits share the road. Fight, or slip away and live to walk again. Gear wears out, wounds need tending, and the weather and the fallout do not wait for you.

RETURN
Water is life. Carry home what you can. At the shelter, rest, craft and build, room by room. The shelter's clocks keep running in real time while you are away.

MEND
Cut wood in the forest and dig in the mine. Trade with the people who still walk the road. Bring a stray home. Turn on a radio and follow the voices on it.

• A text survival game with painted scenes, music and sound
• Single player, in short walks or long ones
• Field Notes keep everything you have learned about the wasteland
• In English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Russian and Chinese
• Everything in the Store is optional: the whole game plays without buying anything

Keep the eaves for spring.

name: Urban Sound Map
description:
Point the iPhone at a room and read its noise level on a live dial. Capture a short reading, name the place, pick a type and add a note if you like. Readings are pinned on a map and sorted into your own neighbourhood noise maps, so streets, homes, offices and public spaces sit next to each other. Record a walk and get a shareable report with average and peak levels, plus a quiet to loud trail drawn on the map.

• Browse every saved reading in the Logbook
• Open an hour by hour curve of your measurements
• Compare indoor and outdoor spots side by side
• Typical noise levels for homes, offices and public spaces
• Soundproofing tips you can mark as done
• A materials catalogue with absorption (NRC) and blocking (STC) values

No account, no ads, no data collection. Audio is analysed live as a level only, and it is never recorded or uploaded. Phone microphones are not calibrated instruments. Use the optional calibration offset in Settings, and do not rely on readings for legal, medical or occupational use. Open the dial, take a reading and see how loud the place really is.

name: UrbanAccess Admin
seller_name: Impulsora de Negocios Carfloza, S. de R.L. de C.V.
description:
UrbanAccess Admin es la aplicación oficial para administradores de
fraccionamientos que usan UrbanAccess.

Inicia sesión con el mismo correo y contraseña del panel web de
administración. Si administras varios residenciales, los ves todos
en una sola lista y cambias entre ellos cuando quieras.

Desde la app puedes:
- Usar el panel completo de administración: residentes, credenciales
  (TAG, placas, tarjetas), claves de evento, bitácora de accesos y
  finanzas.
- Recibir avisos importantes con el nombre del residencial: alertas
  de pánico, quejas y mensajes de residentes, solicitudes de cambio
  de credenciales, pagos pendientes de revisar y estado de conexión
  de la caseta.
- Tocar un aviso y abrir directamente el residencial y la pantalla
  correspondiente.
- Configurar de qué residenciales quieres recibir avisos.
- Desbloquear la app con huella o Face ID.

Esta app es solo para personal administrativo registrado. Los
residentes usan "UrbanAccess Residentes" y los guardias usan la
tableta de caseta.

name: Uriora
description:
Uriora is a quiet solar sheet for off-grid rooms.

Enter the appliances you actually run — a fridge, lights, a water pump, a laptop, a fan — and Uriora turns that list into the numbers you need before buying hardware. Everything is calculated on device, with no account and no data upload.

name: UVee: Family Sun Cream Timer
description:
Never guess when to reapply sun cream again.

UVee checks the UV index where you are and tells you when it's time to top up, with a separate timer for everyone in the family. It's built for beach days, pool days and long afternoons in the park, when it's easy to lose track, especially with children.

LIVE UV, WHERE YOU ARE
UVee uses Apple Weather to get the UV index, wind and cloud for your exact location, and only nudges you when the sun is strong enough to matter. Cloudy but still high UV? UVee knows.

A TIMER FOR EVERYONE
Add each person with their age range and skin type. Everyone gets their own timer, and reminders that fall close together arrive as one: "Top up Ellie and Max."

KNOWS ABOUT SWIMMING AND WIND
Out of the water? Tap Been swimming and UVee reminds you to top up, as the NHS advises, even with water-resistant cream. Wind, sand, snow and water bring reminders forward. A higher SPF never makes the timer longer, because sun cream rubs and sweats off whatever the number.

PHOTOGRAPH YOUR SUN CREAM
Take a photo of the bottle and UVee reads the name, SPF and water resistance for you, right on your iPhone. Or search the built-in list of popular sun creams.

PROMPTS WHEN YOU ARRIVE
Get to the beach or the pool and UVee asks if you need sun cream, without you opening the app.

RIGHT WHERE YOU LOOK
• Home and lock screen widgets with the UV dial and the family's next top-ups
• A live countdown on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island, with Reapplied and Swimming buttons
• Apple Watch app and complications, for when your phone is in the bag
• Reminders with Done and Snooze buttons

DONE FOR THE DAY
When the UV drops, UVee tells you, so you can stop thinking about it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no tracking and no ads. Your family's names, ages and sun creams stay on your iPhone.

FOR EVERYONE
Larger text, dark mode, Increase Contrast and Reduce Motion are all supported, and nothing relies on colour alone.

PRICING
Try everything free for 3 days. After that, UVee Lifetime, a one-time £3.99 purchase, keeps your reminders, the whole family, the Apple Watch app and the widgets, for this trip and every one after. Nothing is charged automatically when the trial ends, and there's no subscription. Without it, the sky, dial and today's UV still show. Family Sharing means one purchase covers your household.

UVee gives general guidance based on UV forecasts and typical advice on reapplying sun cream. It is not medical advice. Always follow the instructions on your sun cream, and seek shade and cover up when the UV is high.

name: V Video
description:
PLACES FOR FOCUS
Find a cafe, library or coworking space for work. Search names and addresses, filter by quietness, power sockets and Wi-Fi, browse the map and save favorites. Nearby search uses your location only with permission.

REVIEWS OF WORKING CONDITIONS
Explore overall ratings and optional scores for sockets, Wi-Fi, seating, quietness, lighting and atmosphere. Skip any optional score. Contribute a place with a cover photo or a review with optional photos or up to 30 seconds of ambient sound. Do not record other people’s conversations.

WORK SESSIONS
Choose 25, 50, 90 minutes or a custom duration, with rain, cafe, soft noise or silence. Pause, resume and save actual time to your history. An optional local notification reminds you when the session ends.

CONTROL AND SAFETY
Report places, reviews and media from their menus. Block authors and manage blocked accounts in Profile. Sign-in is required; register with a phone number and password, without SMS verification. Delete your account in Profile. Optional sign-in protection uses Face ID or Touch ID when available. No purchases or subscriptions.

SESSIONS NEARBY
Create an open shared timer or discover one on the same Wi-Fi network. The creator starts, pauses and finishes the timer; participants choose their own sound. Local network access is required. Shared sessions work in the foreground without internet and are not saved to personal history.

name: VADUAL Convert
description: Convert length, weight, temperature, volume, digital data, recipe measures and much more on iPhone and iPad. Results update as you type. Swap units in either direction, copy results and return to recent conversions. Measurement conversions work offline. Frankfurter reference exchange rates include their reference date. The interface supports 13 languages.

name: Vale - Voice Digest
description:
Vale turns a working conversation into a clear, shared voice digest.

Get the point of a long voice note without losing the exact words.

Start in Chat. Open a voice note, turn it into a timestamped digest, and let the right person confirm the result.

The sender’s voice and attribution remain visible. The recipient can open the exact moment in the original audio, and the digest is shared only with the original audience.

name: Vaultstone: Photo & ID Vault
description:
Vaultstone keeps your passport, ID cards and private photos in a vault only your pattern opens. Every file is encrypted on your iPhone before it's saved. No account. No tracking.

SCAN AND SEAL YOUR DOCUMENTS
• Scan passports, IDs and cards with the built-in scanner. It finds the edges for you, front and back.
• Names, numbers and expiry dates are read on your iPhone. Check them, then seal the document.
• Search finds any number or word in seconds.
• Get a reminder 6, 3 and 1 month before a document expires, so a renewal never surprises you at the airport.
• Keep any file, notes with codes, and folders inside folders.

HIDE PRIVATE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
• Import from Photos, then remove the originals from your camera roll.
• Shoot with the secure camera. Its photos and videos never touch Photos.
• Recently deleted keeps removed items for 30 days.

ONLY YOU CAN OPEN IT
• Unlock with your pattern or Face ID.
