• Every file has its own AES-256-GCM key. Names, notes and thumbnails are encrypted too.
• Screenshots and screen recordings of the app come out black.
• Hidden vaults open with a different pattern and don't show up anywhere else in the app.
• A duress pattern opens a decoy vault and clears the others off this iPhone.
• A break-in photo shows who tried to get in.

NEW PHONE? IT ALL COMES BACK
• End-to-end encrypted iCloud backup, on by default.
• Your 12-word recovery phrase brings everything back on a new iPhone. Lose both your pattern and your phrase and no one can open the vault, us included.

VAULTSTONE PRO
The free plan gives you one vault with a set number of documents and photos. Pro adds unlimited documents, photos and videos, hidden vaults, the duress pattern, break-in photos, every expiry reminder and app icons. Pick Weekly, Yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time Lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vaultstone.app/privacy/

name: VB Mafia Gauges
description:
VB Mafia Gauges puts key engine data from your Subaru on one clear, customizable dashboard.

Connect a compatible Bluetooth OBD-II adapter to monitor live vehicle data, set up the gauges that matter to you, and keep track of how your car is running.

FEATURES

• Customizable gauge layouts
• Live engine data, including boost, intake temperature, coolant temperature, DAM, and feedback knock where supported
• Configurable alerts for selected readings
• Drive logs with CSV export
• Diagnostic trouble code scanning and clearing
• A clean interface built for Subaru enthusiasts

Compatibility depends on your vehicle, ECU, and OBD-II adapter. A compatible Bluetooth adapter is required. Available readings and features may vary by vehicle and adapter.

VB Mafia Gauges is an independent enthusiast app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Subaru. Use the app only when parked or have a passenger operate it. Always keep your attention on the road.

name: VBTI 보컬 튜너
description:
노래 잘하는 사람은 자기 목소리를 잘 다루는 사람 — 혼자만의 싸움을 이겨낸 사람입니다.
그 싸움에 모니터 하나 붙여 드립니다.

VBTI 보컬 튜너는 폰 마이크로 지금 내 목소리가 어떻게 나고 있는지 보여주는 발성 모니터입니다. 로그인 없이 바로 소리를 내면 됩니다.

■ 이렇게 씁니다
· 편한 음으로 '아~' 한 번 — 그게 오늘의 내 기준이 됩니다. 절대값이 아니라 내 기준 대비.
· 음이 올라가도 내려가도, 발음이 바뀌어도 그 기준 소리가 유지되는지 봅니다.
· 스케일 · 레인지 · 발음 스케일 · 무반주 노래 — 밸런스 라인이 흔들리는 자리가 바로 보입니다.
· 말하기 진단 — 문장을 30초 읽으면 속도·높낮이 변화·안정감을 숫자로.

■ 다섯 축
성대접촉 · 전방공명 · 피치 유연성 · 호흡 제어 · 공명·배음(울림). 가운데 밸런스는 다섯이 고르게 맞았는지입니다.

■ 왜 모니터인가
혼자 연습할 때 제일 안 좋은 건 모니터 없이 자기 세계로 빠지는 겁니다. 잘 되고 있는데 어색하다고 되돌리거나, 더 잘하려다 목을 조이거나. 튜너는 판정기가 아니라 모니터입니다 — 코치 귀를 대신하지 않고, "지금 기준에서 얼마나 벗어났는지"만 정확히 보여줍니다.

■ 녹음은 저장하지 않습니다
소리는 폰 안에서만 계산하고, 서버에는 숫자만 남습니다.

■ 코치와 함께
보컬 코치는 코치 화면에서 반 원생에게 숙제를 걸고 주간 연습 기록을 볼 수 있습니다. 원생은 코치가 준 링크로 들어옵니다.

■ 만든 사람
최종수 — 슈퍼스타K3 TOP24, 보컬 레슨 16년, 안양 오픈믹 보컬 스튜디오. 레슨 때 하던 "모니터"를 혼자 연습할 때도 쓰라고 만들었습니다.

개인정보 처리방침: vbti.kr/privacy

name: vclu
description:
Aplikacja do domu sterowanego przez vclu. Pokazuje dashboardy, które masz ułożone w vclu, ale jako zwykłe ekrany iPhone'a, a nie stronę w przeglądarce. 
Działają światła, ściemniacze, taśmy LED z kolorami, rolety z lamelami, bramy, alarm, termostaty, wykresy temperatur i zużycie prądu.

Poza domem aplikacja łączy się przez vclu cloud, więc nie trzeba otwierać portów na routerze. 
W domu, po włączeniu sieci lokalnej, telefon rozmawia z vclu bezpośrednio przez Wi-Fi. Jest szybciej i działa nawet wtedy, gdy padnie internet.

Nie chcesz chmury? Zeskanuj kod QR z panelu vclu (Integracje -> Klienci API) i steruj domem przez Wi-Fi, bez zakładania konta.

Każdy domownik ma własne konto, a role decydują, kto widzi które dashboardy. Alarm albo bramę można dodatkowo schować za PIN-em.

Poza tym:
- widżety z kafelkami na ekranie początkowym,
- powiadomienia z vclu, też z przyciskami, np. „Otwórz bramę”; ich treść jest szyfrowana kluczem z telefonu,
- polecenia głosowe, np. „włącz światło w salonie”,
- tryb tabletu na panel na ścianie, z blokadą PIN-em albo Face ID,
- jasny i ciemny motyw, polski i angielski.

Wartości z czujników i historia zostają w Twoim vclu. Chmura tylko przekazuje polecenia.

Do działania potrzebny jest sterownik vclu, połączony z kontem na cloud.vclu.pl albo w tej samej sieci Wi-Fi co telefon.

name: VECTOR Music
description:
Hai un'idea per una canzone? Scrivila con parole tue: VECTOR, l'intelligenza artificiale di DANARASH, la trasforma in un brano completo, cantato in italiano.

COME FUNZIONA
1. Scrivi la tua idea: un ricordo, una persona, un luogo, un'emozione.
2. Scegli genere, atmosfera, voce e durata.
3. VECTOR scrive testo, titolo e stile musicale. Puoi modificare tutto prima di generare.
4. Tocca «Genera la canzone»: in pochi minuti il brano è pronto, con la sua copertina.

COSA TROVI
• Generi: pop, rock, rap / urban, elettronica, ballata, cantautorale, lo-fi, orchestrale
• Atmosfere: epica, romantica, malinconica, energica, cosmica, serena
• Voce femminile, maschile, duetto o versione strumentale
• Testi in italiano con strofe e ritornelli, modificabili
• Una copertina pop art fluo creata per ogni brano
• Libreria con ricerca e filtri per genere
• Player con testo, condivisione e salvataggio dell'audio

GRATIS
VECTOR Music è gratuita e senza acquisti in-app: puoi creare fino a 5 canzoni al giorno.

CREATIVITÀ RESPONSABILE
Testi, musica, voci e copertine sono generati con l'intelligenza artificiale e sono indicati come tali. Le voci sono sintetiche e non imitano cantanti reali. Non è consentito usare testi di altri autori o nomi di artisti reali. Puoi segnalare un contenuto dal Profilo e cancellare tutti i tuoi dati in qualsiasi momento.

VECTOR Music è un'app di DANARASH HOLDING LLC.

name: VectorField GPS Speedometer
description:
How fast is the train moving? Which way are you heading? Open VectorField on your iPhone to see ground speed, course of travel and altitude on one dashboard.

• Switch between km/h, mph and m/s. The dial adjusts to your speed.
• Tap your direction for a larger compass. Altitude includes an accuracy estimate when available.
• Use the weekly speed board if you want to take part. Choose a nickname and share a square image of your rank and personal best.
• No connection on board? Your eligible weekly best stays on your phone and syncs when the app is open and back online.

The dashboard uses location while you measure. VectorField does not upload your coordinates or route. Publishing a score uses the iCloud account already on your device. Signal quality affects readings, especially indoors and in aircraft.

name: Verbatim: Audio Transcription
description:
You talk, Verbatim writes. Word for word, on your iPhone, even without Internet.

A meeting, a lecture, an idea on the go: tap Record and watch the text appear. Got a long voice note? Verbatim writes it down, and you read it in a moment. And when it's your turn to talk to the camera, the teleprompter scrolls your text.

YOU TALK, IT WRITES
• The text appears live, while you speak.
• Recording keeps going when the screen is locked.
• Two ways to read: Page, a clean sheet with the time of each passage, or Prompter, huge words on a black stage.
• Replay a passage, fix a word, search everything that was said.

YOUR VOICE NOTES, TO READ
• Import a voice note, a memo or a video from Files or Photos, or with "Share" in another app.
• The text appears while it imports. The received copy is deleted afterwards.

THE TELEPROMPTER
• Write or paste your text, or start from a transcription. Verbatim tells you how long it runs.
• The text scrolls in big letters, at your pace: you read with your eyes on the lens.
• Mirror mode, for a teleprompter's glass.
• With Pro, it follows your voice: it moves on when you speak and waits while you breathe.

YOUR TEXT, WHERE YOU WANT IT
• Copy, share or export as text.
• With Pro: as PDF, and as .srt subtitles for your videos.

THE AI STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
Your voice is recognized on your iPhone: nothing is sent, not to Apple, not to any other AI. The proof: it works even without Internet, in Airplane mode for example. iOS installs the model for your language once.
With Pro and Apple Intelligence (on compatible iPhones), Verbatim writes the summary, the key points, the action items and a title. Here too, nothing is sent, not even to Apple. It works without Internet.

FREE, OR PRO FOREVER
Free: as many recordings as you like, up to 30 minutes each; up to 30 minutes of imported voice notes and files per day; Page and Prompter; the teleprompter at your pace; replay, fix, search, copy, share and export as text.
Pro, paid once: unlimited recordings and imports, the teleprompter that follows your voice, the summary, key points and action items with Apple Intelligence, PDF and .srt subtitle exports, and Prompter styles.
Once. Forever. No subscription. Family Sharing included.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR IPHONE
• No account, no ads, no tracking. No server.
• Your recordings and your texts stay on your iPhone.
• The Transparency screen lists everything that is kept, and "Erase Everything" erases it all.

Recording someone without their consent is prohibited in many countries: always tell people you are recording them.

Verbatim is a once app: apps you pay for once, forever.

name: Verbato
description:
Verbato is voice typing that writes like you meant it.

Talk in any app and Verbato types clean, finished text: punctuation, capitals and paragraphs in place, with the ums, uhs and false starts taken out. Change your mind mid-sentence ("Thursday, no wait, Friday") and Verbato writes what you meant.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your voice is turned into text by AI running on the phone itself, and the cleanup runs there too. Nothing you say or type is sent anywhere. No account, no cloud, and it works offline.

WORKS IN EVERY APP
Verbato is a keyboard. Switch to it with the globe key in Messages, Mail, Notes, Slack or anywhere you type, tap Verbato, talk, and tap again. The full keyboard is there too, with careful autocorrect that fixes typos without changing what you meant.

YOUR WORDS, NOT A REWRITE
Verbato tidies what you say without changing what you meant. It fits the text to where you're typing, like paragraphs in an email or a quick line in a message. Every cleanup is checked against what you actually said, and if it strays, Verbato types your own words instead.

MADE FOR HOW YOU TALK
• Spoken lists become real lists.
• Corrections you say out loud are applied.
• Add names and terms in Words, and Verbato spells them your way. Fix a name Verbato got wrong, and it learns the right spelling.
• Your history stays on your iPhone, ready to copy.

FREE FOR 14 DAYS, THEN YOURS
Try everything free for 14 days. You won't be charged when the trial ends: to keep dictating, unlock Verbato once for $39. No subscription. Typing on the Verbato keyboard always works, trial or not.

Already bought Verbato for Mac? Your license key unlocks the iPhone app too.

Verbato needs an iPhone with 6 GB of memory or more (iPhone 13 Pro, iPhone 14 or newer) and downloads 1.5 GB once on first launch. English only for now.

Questions? support@sayverbato.com

name: Verso: Bible and Study
description:
Verso shows the Bible one verse per screen. You swipe to the next one, stop when a verse catches your attention and open a study on it without leaving your reading.

READING
• One verse per screen, in large type, with auto-scroll at the pace you choose.
• Double-tap to save. Mark where you stopped and pick up at the same spot.
• All 66 books, with word search and tracking of the chapters you have read.

STUDY
• For each verse: the theme, what it means, the historical context, key words from the Hebrew or Greek, related verses and a question to reflect on.
• More than a hundred hand-written studies come with the app and work offline. For other verses, Verso generates the study on the spot.

LISTEN
• With Premium, Verso reads the Bible aloud in a natural voice, verse by verse, even with the screen locked. Pick a female or male voice and the speed.

PLANS AND DEVOTIONALS
• 25 reading plans, from 5 days to a year: the Gospels, Psalms, Proverbs, the whole Bible, anxiety, grief, forgiveness, courage.
• With Premium, build your own plan by choosing the books and how many chapters per day.
• A devotional for every day of the year: a short passage, three moments to read slowly, a reflection and a prayer.

YOUR SPACE
• Favorites, bookmarks, notes and journal.
• Create an account with your email to keep everything the same on iPhone and iPad.
• Widgets with the verse of the day on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Images for sharing verses with friends.
• Daily reminder and reading streak.

NINE LANGUAGES
Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, German, Russian, Chinese, Italian and Korean, each with a public-domain translation of the Bible. In English, the King James Version.

NO ADS AND NO TRACKING
Verso does not show ads and does not use analytics or tracking tools. Without an account, your data stays on your device.

VERSO PREMIUM
Reading, plans, devotionals and the studies included in the app are free. Premium unlocks generated studies with no daily limit, the deeper study (history, original language and theology), plans you build yourself and listening in natural voices. Monthly or annual subscription, renewed automatically until canceled in iPhone Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms of use: https://versoapp.vercel.app/en/terms
Privacy: https://versoapp.vercel.app/en/privacy

name: Vesper TT
description:
Vesper TT is a calm, single-player table tennis game set in the warm light of sunset.

Step onto the table as twilight falls. With intuitive drag controls, you can focus on the rhythm of each rally. There is no rush, no intense competition — just peaceful ping-pong fun you can play offline anytime.

 What you’ll love:
• Dreamy sunset and dusk aesthetic
• Effortless drag-to-move paddle control
• 100% offline single player
• Soft, responsive ball physics
• Stress-free gameplay for short breaks

Let the evening glow wrap around you, one gentle shot at a time.

name: VHF Ready
description:
VHF Ready is a free, open-source study companion for the marine VHF Short Range Certificate (SRC). Learn the procedures, test yourself and practise the calls you hope never to make.

LEARN
• 6 modules and 19 short lessons: radio basics and licensing, channels and calling, DSC, distress, urgency and safety, GMDSS, EPIRBs and SARTs, phonetics and prowords
• Clear examples of Mayday, Pan-Pan and Sécurité calls, written out in full
• Progress saved as you go

PRACTISE
• 47 multiple-choice questions with an explanation for every answer
• Quiz by module or take a mixed test, with answers shuffled each time
• Best scores kept for each quiz

RADIO DRILLS
• Mayday builder: enter a vessel name, call sign, MMSI and position, and see the full call laid out in the correct order, with call signs spelled phonetically
• Hear it read aloud to practise the rhythm of a distress call
• Flashcards for the phonetic alphabet, figures and prowords

16 LANGUAGES
The interface is available in English, Greek, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, German, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Serbian, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish and Arabic. Lessons and questions are in English, and radio procedure stays in English, as it is used on air.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or sign-in
• No ads, analytics or tracking
• Works fully offline; your progress never leaves your device

OPEN SOURCE
The code and content are public on GitHub, so anyone can check them, suggest corrections or contribute translations.

IMPORTANT
VHF Ready is an independent, unofficial study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any training organisation, examining body, regulator or equipment manufacturer. It does not award any certificate or licence and is no substitute for an approved course and assessment. Never transmit a practice Mayday on air.

name: VibeTube: Video Ad Blocker
description:
Experience seamless, interruption-free video and music streaming with VibeTube.

VibeTube is a powerful, modern web video browser built with advanced content-shielding technology and smart media playback capabilities.

KEY FEATURES:
- Advanced Content Blocker: Enjoy uninterrupted video streaming free from distracting pop-ups and video ads.
- Background and Lock Screen Playback: Keep audio playing while multitasking or when your screen is locked.
- Smart TV Casting: Effortlessly cast high-definition video streams to any AirPlay-compatible smart TV or Apple TV.
- Smart Sleep Timer: Set your favorite timer (15, 30, 45, or 60 minutes) to automatically pause audio playback as you fall asleep.
- Fast and Private Browser: Ultra-fast web engine designed to protect your privacy and save mobile data.
- Quick Bookmarks: One-tap instant access to your favorite media and entertainment platforms.

Upgrade to VibeTube VIP for unlimited access to premium ad-blocking filters, high-definition casting, and continuous background audio.

Terms of Service: https://www.sntunlock.com/vibetube/terms

name: Vice City Map: GTA 6 Guide
description:
Vice City. Your way.

Vice City Map is an independent GTA VI companion for iPhone and iPad, with offline maps, a concise field guide and a notebook that is yours to keep.

A QUICK START, YOUR WAY
Step into Vice City with an illustrated welcome, save your first real place and preview four map styles. Skip anytime or replay the tour from About. Your existing saves and notes stay with you.

EXPLORE MORE
Browse 769 named places across 54 categories, plus 42 field guide entries. Search names, districts and categories. Zoom smoothly, tap clusters and choose exactly which layers to see.

FOUR COMMUNITY MAP VIEWS
Choose Atlas, Roads, Midnight or Blueprint. Atlas and Roads use two community-authored reconstructions; Midnight and Blueprint are color treatments. Switch to the separate field guide for six regions, named places, people, activities, radio and vehicles.

MAKE IT YOURS
Save places, mark entries explored, hide explored locations and check progress by category. Add colored personal pins, edit notes and arrange an ordered visit plan. The dashed visit sequence is not navigation.

LATEST MARKERS, READY OFFLINE
Open instantly from your saved catalog. Background updates bring new names and markers from Cloudflare; Layers includes a manual update check. Unnamed, generic and unconfirmed places are filtered out of the map, search and Discover automatically; newly identified names appear through catalog updates. Maps, locations, search and your notebook work offline. Optionally sync notebook changes through your private iCloud account on Apple devices. Export a restorable file backup or share a readable notebook. No application account, ads, tracking, purchases or device-location permission.

KNOW WHAT IS VERIFIED
Community positions and names are estimates, not independently verified gameplay coordinates. The field guide uses editorial illustration points. Unknown positions stay searchable and off the map. This edition does not claim complete collectible, mission, spawn or cheat coverage. Your checklist does not measure or sync with game completion. No satellite imagery or web-account synchronization is offered. Names, descriptions and markers can update independently of the app. The bundled source snapshot is November 19, 2026.

CREDITS
Community landmarks and map tiles: GTADB and contributors, CC BY 4.0. Map authors: Yanis v18 and Dupzor v51. Vice City Map selects records, adapts categories and coordinates, crops/resizes tiles and adds color treatments. Attribution and license links are in About > Credits & licenses.

Vice City Map is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive or MapGenie. Grand Theft Auto and related marks belong to their respective owners. The game and game audio are not included.

name: Vice Tracker for GTA 6
description:
Road to Platinum, one tick at a time.

Vice Tracker is a fan-made companion for Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5 and Xbox). Keep track of your trophies, your story progress and everything you have found in Leonida, with a guide and a map that fit in your pocket. Free, offline, no account.

TROPHY TRACKER
• The 55 PS5 trophies, grouped by category
• What to do for each one, explained in our own words
• Spoiler shield: the 28 hidden trophies stay masked until you choose to reveal them
• Tick what you have earned and see what is left

STORY TRACKER
• Chapters, key missions and character storylines tied to a trophy
• Names stay masked until you decide to show them

12 COUNTERS
• Stunts, vehicles discovered, money laundered, completion percentage and more
• Update your numbers by hand as you play

A GUIDE WITH ABOUT 1,200 ENTRIES
• 11 sections: weapons, vehicles, characters, bestiary, gangs, missions, collectibles, activities, places, properties and cheat codes
• Search across the whole guide
• Tick every entry: owned, discovered or done

INTERACTIVE MAP OF LEONIDA
• Zoom and pan across the state
• About 100 markers to tap: regions, places, properties, gangs and wildlife habitats, each with a description
• Positions are approximate

YOUR OWN SCREENSHOTS
• Attach your own screenshots to any guide entry
• They stay on your phone

FOUR LANGUAGES
• English, French, Spanish and German, with a language switch inside the app
• Official in-game names stay in English

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• Everything is stored on your device
• No account, no ads, no purchases, no data collected
• Works offline

AN HONEST GUIDE
The game came out on 19 November 2026 and the guide is being completed as reliable information appears. Entries that are not confirmed yet are marked "to be confirmed". Spotted a mistake? Write to support@clefdoc.com.

Every illustration is original, in an art deco style. The app contains no artwork, logo, screenshot or map image from the game. This guide is about a game intended for adults.

Terms: https://clefdoc.com/vicetracker/terms/
Privacy: https://clefdoc.com/vicetracker/privacy/

Vice Tracker is a fan-made guide. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Grand Theft Auto and PlayStation are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: VideoSlim: Shrink Big Videos
description:
Free up space from your biggest videos and keep the moments in them.

Completely free. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

VideoSlim lists the videos in your Photos library biggest first and shows roughly how much space each one could save. Pick a few, tap Shrink, and a smaller copy is saved to Photos. Everything happens on your iPhone.

FIND THE BIG ONES
• Videos sorted by the space they take, with estimated savings
• "Select top 10" in one tap, or pick the top 5, 25, all suggested or all 4K videos from the Select menu
• See how much free space your iPhone has, with a warning before converting if it's running low

CHOOSE THE QUALITY
• Recommended: 1080p at 30 fps
• Keep Smooth: 1080p at the original frame rate, for action
• Max Savings: 720p at 30 fps, for the smallest files
Every option uses HEVC, the High Efficiency format iPhone uses for video by default. Resolution and frame rate are only ever lowered, never raised.

KEEP ONLY THE PART YOU WANT
Trim a video before shrinking to keep one section, and watch the estimated size update as you go.

SEE WHAT YOU SAVED
When it's done, VideoSlim shows the real before and after sizes. Each smaller copy keeps the original date, location, favourite and albums. If a full-length copy would save less than 10%, it is discarded and the video is left as it is.

YOU DECIDE WHAT GETS DELETED
Nothing is deleted while shrinking. When you're happy, tap Delete and iOS asks you to confirm before the originals move to Recently Deleted, where you can recover them for 30 days. Not ready yet? You can delete them later from the main screen.

Edited, Slo-mo, Cinematic and Spatial videos are never picked automatically. If you select one yourself, VideoSlim explains first that shrinking makes edits permanent and turns it into a regular video. Captions, keywords and people tags are not copied.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your videos are converted on your iPhone and never uploaded by VideoSlim. There's no account, analytics or tracking, and no data is collected.

Questions or ideas? Visit the support page or email premsai.ponguru@gmail.com.

name: Vietnam Driving Test 600
description:
Unofficial app: it is not affiliated with and does not represent the Ministry of Public Security, the Traffic Police Department (Cục CSGT) or any other government body. The questions come from the official 600-question bank published by Cục CSGT: https://congan.tuyenquang.gov.vn/vi/tin-bai/bo-600-cau-hoi-dung-cho-sat-hach-lai-xe-co-gioi-duong-bo?type=EXECUTIVE_DIRECTION&id=157456

Prepare for the Vietnamese driving theory test with the 600 questions used at the exam since 1 June 2025. The questions and the app are in Vietnamese.

• Mock exams built like the real one: class B — 30 questions, 20 minutes, 27 to pass, plus one critical question (câu điểm liệt) that fails the exam if answered wrong
• Exams for classes C1, C, D and trailers, motorcycles A1, A and B1
• All 600 questions in 6 chapters, with clear road sign and traffic situation images
• A separate set for the 60 critical questions
• Mistakes come back until they stick; search by word or number
• Works offline, no sign-up

Free with ads: 10 questions in every chapter and one mock exam a day. Remove ads with a one-time purchase. Full access is a one-time purchase with no auto-renewal and has no ads.

The app is for self-study and information only. It does not replace driving school or the traffic law.

name: ViewSpan
description:
Design across a corner. See where the image comes together.

ViewSpan is an offline anamorphic artwork planner for exhibition artists, window-display designers and spatial art creators. Place text or a transparent PNG across two walls, then explore how the same physical artwork changes as the observer moves.

A practical workflow, from geometry to installation drawings:

1. Build the corner
Enter each wall's width, the wall height and the corner angle. Set the observable sides and usable floor range. Work in millimetres, centimetres or metres, tap dimension lines for exact values, and unfold the walls to inspect their flat layouts.

2. Set the reference view
Choose the ground position, eye height and gaze target. Confirm the reference artwork plane's physical size, position and direction. Image pixels remain source information; you define the artwork's real dimensions.

3. Add your artwork
Type text and adjust font, weight and alignment, or import a transparent PNG. Inspect contours, adjust the alpha threshold and sampling settings, and add checkpoints for strokes crossing the seam.

4. Generate a fixed layout
Select Regenerate wall artwork to distribute the design across the walls. The generated layout is saved separately from later edits. Moving the simulated observer changes the view and measurements while the physical artwork stays fixed. Reference-view or artwork changes remain a draft until you regenerate.

5. Test viewing positions
Use the walkthrough studio to move along a test path, drag the observer or enter coordinates and eye height. Switch between reference and current views. The workspace's Inspection page provides shape deviation, seam-neighbourhood error, extra bend angle and local stretch. Save named viewpoints for entrances, circulation routes or planned viewing spots.

6. Map and compare
Set shape, seam or angle limits and calculate a floor heatmap at the current eye height. Mint marks sampled positions that meet every enabled limit. Inspect invalid positions, estimated area, the region connected to the reference position and error curves along real-distance paths. Duplicate a scheme, revise and regenerate it, then compare both designs using the same range, grid spacing, eye height and limits.

7. Export your work
Create wall positioning drawings, a floor position plan, a PDF scheme report and JSON/CSV coordinate data. Include saved site observations, share files through the system share sheet, and preserve projects with local backup and restore.

Built for the design process
Geometry calculations, artwork processing and project storage take place on your device, with no sign-in required. Use iPhone or iPad, English or Simplified Chinese, and light or dark appearance. A pinned observer preview stays visible while you edit. The Feedback page retains unfinished drafts.

Heatmaps, areas and error readings are sampled geometric simulations. Exported drawings provide dimensions and scale previews. Check physical site measurements before fabrication.

name: VIP Scanner – Parallel Art
description:
VIP Scanner ist die Einlass-App für VIP-Veranstaltungen der Parallel Art GmbH. Sie ist ein internes Werkzeug für beauftragtes Einlasspersonal und funktioniert nur zusammen mit dem Einladungssystem des Veranstalters.

So funktioniert es:
• QR-Code der gedruckten Einladung scannen
• Die App prüft den Code in Echtzeit beim Server des Veranstalters
• Gültige Einladungen werden sofort als eingelöst markiert, auch wenn mehrere Geräte gleichzeitig scannen

Am Einlass:
• Grün: Einladung gültig, mit Name, Firma, Kategorie und Personenzahl
• Orange: Code wurde bereits verwendet, mit Uhrzeit und Gerät
• Rot: ungültige oder gesperrte Einladung
• Beschädigte Codes lassen sich von Hand eintippen
• Taschenlampe für dunkle Eingänge
• Live-Zähler der eingecheckten Gäste

Zuverlässig:
• Fällt das Netz aus, werden Scans gespeichert und automatisch nachgereicht
• Jedes Gerät hat einen eigenen, widerrufbaren Zugangsschlüssel
• Einrichtung in Sekunden durch Scannen eines Einrichtungs-Codes

Für die Nutzung ist ein Zugang des Veranstalters erforderlich.

name: VIRTUAL SUMMIT
description:
ジムのトレッドミルで走ると、iPhoneの画面の中で世界の名山を登っていく、ランニングアプリです。

iPhoneをトレッドミルに置いて、Apple Watchをつけて走るだけ。Watchが測ったペースの分だけ、画面の中の山道を進みます。

■ 世界の名山・絶景 30コース
富士山、キリマンジャロ、エベレスト・ベースキャンプ、マッターホルン、グランドキャニオン、パタゴニア、南極大陸の最高峰まで。登山口から山頂までは3km〜15km。その日に走りたい距離でコースを選べます。

■ 9人のライバルとレース
最強ランナー、サイボーグ、地元のガイド、そしてその山にすむ動物たち。坂が得意、平地が得意など、それぞれ性格があり、区間ごとに順位が入れかわります。強さは5段階で、まん中はあなたの最近の記録に合わせた「今日のおすすめ」です。

■ 変わる景色と天気
標高が上がると森が低木になり、岩と雪の世界へ。走っている途中で雨が降り、高いところでは雪に変わります。

■ がんばった日のご褒美
心拍数がいつもより高い時間が続くと、雲の切れ間から光が差して、景色が金色に染まります。

■ ミッションと見た目・着せ替え
走った距離とミッションでコインがたまり、ウェアや帽子、髪型、動物やロボのキャラクター、新しいコースと交換できます。身長と体重を入れると、キャラクターの体つきもあなたに近づきます。

■ Apple Watch・ヘルスケア連携
・ペース、距離、心拍数はApple Watchから自動で届きます
・ワークアウトはヘルスケアとフィットネスに保存されます
・一時停止と終了は、Watchでも画面でも操作できます
・Apple Watchがなくても「自走モード」で、画面で決めた速さで走れます

■ ご注意
・走行中は画面を見続けず、足元とベルトの位置に注意して、転倒に気をつけてください。
・コースの標高や距離は、ゲーム用に簡略化した概略です。実際の登山計画には使えません。
・このアプリは医療機器ではありません。体調に不安があるときは、運動の前に医師に相談してください。

name: VoicePop: Video Noise Reducer
description:
Bring speech forward in videos you already have. Choose a video from Photos, listen to a short loop, and switch between Original and Enhanced while it plays. Move the slider to another moment or choose stronger voice enhancement. VoicePop processes the audio on your iPhone or iPad and saves a new copy in Photos.

Export the first 30 seconds of each video for free. Shorter videos export in full. VoicePop Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks full-length exports. Results depend on the recording.

name: voiceVD
description:
Tu ne peux pas taper au clavier, ou écrire te fatigue ? Avec voiceVD, tu parles et ton texte s’écrit tout seul, sans faute et joliment mis en page.

UN SEUL BOUTON
Appuie sur le grand bouton vert et parle normalement. Tu peux faire des pauses, hésiter, te reprendre ou changer d’avis en cours de route. voiceVD garde ce que tu veux dire et laisse de côté les « euh ».

UN TEXTE PROPRE, PRÊT À ENVOYER
En une minute environ, ton texte arrive corrigé : orthographe, grammaire, ponctuation et paragraphes. Une lettre ressemble à une lettre, une liste de courses à une liste.

CORRIGER À LA VOIX
Un mot à changer ? Dis-le simplement, par exemple « remplace mardi par jeudi » ou « ajoute une phrase pour remercier ». Pas besoin de clavier. Et si tu préfères, tu peux aussi modifier le texte à la main.

ENVOIE-LE OÙ TU VEUX
Partage ton texte par e-mail, WhatsApp ou Messages, ou crée un fichier Word ou PDF en un geste. voiceVD peut aussi te lire ton texte à voix haute.

PENSÉE POUR TOUS
Grands boutons, texte lisible et taille réglable (normal, grand, très grand), compatible VoiceOver. Dictée en français, allemand, italien et anglais.

TES TEXTES EN SÉCURITÉ
Sans compte, tes textes restent sur ton téléphone. Si tu le souhaites, un compte gratuit et privé les sauvegarde et te permet de les retrouver sur un nouveau téléphone ou sur ordinateur, à l’adresse app.voicevd.ch.

TOUT RESTE EN SUISSE
Ta voix est transcrite par l’IA d’Infomaniak, dans des centres de données en Suisse, puis l’enregistrement est effacé. Ni ta voix ni tes textes ne servent à entraîner une IA. Pas de publicité, pas de pistage.

voiceVD est une app netVD, partenaire Infomaniak.

name: Vôlei Total: Arcade Volley
description:
Fast, good-looking and easy-to-learn volleyball in the spirit of 90s arcade games. Time your buttons and let your team do the rest.

INDOOR 6v6
Rotation, rally point scoring, sets to 15 or 25 and tie-breaks. Timed serves (jump serve when you hit the top of the toss), passing, setting to the hitter of your choice, aimed spikes, tips, blocks and dives.

SUPER SPIKE
Great plays fill the Fury bar. When it is full, unleash the Super Spike in slow motion, with fire and a shaking court.

BEACH 2v2
Sand court, sets to 15 or 21, just you and your partner.

2 PLAYERS
Play a friend on the same phone, each on their half of the screen.

TOURNAMENT
8 fictional national teams, each with its own style. Quarterfinals, semifinal and final, 3 difficulty levels. Men's and women's teams.

MY STAR
Create your own player: name, number, skin, hair and colour. They join your team.

COMMENTARY AND CROWD
Male or female commentator (Portuguese or English), music that builds with every point and a lively crowd with waves, flags and banners. Automatic replays of the best plays.

TWO LOOKS
Fun block or round characters for all ages, or the adult look with realistic players.

ACHIEVEMENTS
13 achievements and a career. On iPhone, achievements and a wins leaderboard in Game Center.

No ads, no in-app purchases and no data collected. Works offline.

8 LANGUAGES
English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Chinese and Japanese.

A game by Arial Gamer.

name: Volleyball Scorer
description:
Volleyball Scorer transforme votre téléphone ou votre tablette en tableau de score pour arbitrer un match de volley en temps réel.

TOUCHEZ, C'EST MARQUÉ
Toute la moitié de l'écran d'une équipe sert à marquer le point. Le score, les sets, le service et la rotation suivent tout seuls. Une erreur ? Annuler revient exactement en arrière, Rétablir aussi.

TOUS LES FORMATS
• Volley en salle à 6, beach-volley à 2, green-volley à 4 et à 3
• Sets gagnants, points par set, écart, set décisif : tout se règle
• Changement de côté au bon moment, rappel de la pause entre les sets

LE MATCH COMME SUR LA FEUILLE
• Composition de départ, numéros des joueurs et libéros
• Remplacements, avec alerte quand une règle n'est pas respectée
• Temps morts avec chrono
• Sanctions (avertissement, pénalité, expulsion, disqualification) en option
• Journal de toutes les actions du match

STATISTIQUES
• Évolution du score, meilleure série, plus grand écart
• Points au service et sur side-out, par match et par set
• Image de fin de match à partager

VOS ÉQUIPES
• Enregistrez vos équipes et leur effectif
• Indiquez les absents avant le match
• Historique des matchs précédents, reprise d'un match interrompu

Pensé pour le bord du terrain : écran sombre et lisible, chiffres géants, écran toujours allumé pendant le match.

Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucune donnée envoyée : tout reste sur votre appareil.

name: Voltvale RUSH
description:
Dodge neon walls. Collect diamonds. Climb the ranks.

Voltvale RUSH is a neon arcade runner from Voltvale Studios. Pilot your ship across three lanes, slip past pink neon barriers, and grab every diamond you can before the next wall arrives.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Tap: tap either side of the screen to switch lanes.
• Swipe: swipe left or right to move.
• Follow Finger: your ship tracks your finger.
Change controls anytime in Settings. A short how-to-play guide starts on first launch, and you can replay it later.

CHASE BIGGER SCORES
• Chain diamond pickups to build a streak and raise your score multiplier.
• Grab power-ups: Shield, Magnet and Slow, each active for 7 seconds.
• Crashed? Revive once per run for 100 earned diamonds and get a 3-second shield.

PROGRESS EVERY DAY
• Daily rewards with a 7-day streak.
• Three daily missions that reset every day.
• 11 achievements to unlock.
• Earn XP and level up.
• Garage: unlock 20 ship skins, from common to legendary, with diamonds you earn in the game.
• Player stats: best score, total runs, average score, diamonds found and more.

CLIMB THE GLOBAL LEADERBOARD
Finished runs are verified by the Voltvale server and ranked on a global top-50 leaderboard. Your progress syncs to the cloud automatically with an anonymous player ID. No sign-in is needed.

PLAY ANYWHERE
No connection? Keep playing. Progress saves on your device and syncs again when you are back online.

MADE FOR COMFORT
Adjustable sound effects and original neon soundtrack volume, haptics on/off, and a Reduced Motion setting that tones down screen shake, particles and menu motion.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
You can delete your cloud data and anonymous player account at any time from the Profile screen.

Questions or feedback? Email support@voltvalestudios.com.

name: Vorune
description:
Vorune turns a tank volume into a mixing plan.

Enter the gross volume, the displacement taken by substrate and hardscape, the change percentage, the frequency, the tap and RO readings for GH and KH, the two targets, the mineral and conditioner rates, and the four prices. Vorune subtracts displacement to get the water you can actually replace, multiplies that by the change percentage, solves the tap share from the GH target, and splits the change into tap and RO litres. The same tap share is then applied to KH, so a mismatch between the two targets becomes visible instead of hidden.

A glass tank is drawn to scale while you type: water level, the top band being changed, substrate and a falling drop. A second bar shows the tap/RO split. Every change to a volume, a percentage, a source reading, a target or a price rebuilds the plan immediately.

name: Vrumplek Hue
description:
How closely can you match a color by eye? This color-matching trainer helps you get better at judging hue, saturation, and lightness. Each round gives you a randomly generated target color. Adjust three sliders to recreate it, then compare your match with the original and see where you were close and what was different.

Every attempt earns a score from 1 to 10. A score of 6 or higher clears the level. Scores of 5 or below add the level to Review, where you can try the same color again. Once you clear it, the level gets a checkmark and you can remove it from the list or keep practicing. After any round, you can retry the same color or move on to a new one.

Test your consistency in three challenge modes. Perfect 10 ends as soon as you score below 10, while 9 or Better keeps your streak going with scores of 9 or 10. Both modes count how many matches you make before the streak ends. In Five in a Row, complete all five rounds and see your average score.

Palette Lab turns your photos into practice material. Follow a quick introduction, import an image, and tap to sample up to five colors. See the HEX code for each sample, name and save your palette, and use its colors in a practice session. Your collections are available in Saved Palettes.

Check Progress for your average score, pass rate, recent results, recovered levels, and personal bests across all three challenge modes. Unlock 10 achievements as you improve your scores, build streaks, revisit missed colors, and practice with your own palettes.

name: Vynune
description:
Vynune is a quiet gear sheet for bicycles.

Enter the wheel, chainrings, cassette, crank, rider weight, bike weight, target cadence and planned grade. Vynune turns that into the numbers you actually use before a ride: gear ratio, gear inches, development metres and speed at cadence for every chainring and cog pair.

name: Wage Register – Daily Pay Book
description:
For anyone who pays people by the day: a building site, a farm, a workshop, a shop. Wage Register is the paper muster roll and wage book done properly, on your phone, with no account, nothing capped and nothing sent anywhere.

MARK THE DAY IN ONE TAP
Present, half day, absent, a short day of so many hours, or a long shift counted as 1½ or 2 days. Overtime in half-hour steps. "Mark all present" marks everyone still unmarked, and a day off for everyone (rain, a festival, the site shut) takes one tap, paid or unpaid.

THE ADVANCES BOOK
Write down every advance on the day you give it, with a note. Allowances, deductions, piece work (so many at a rate each) and cash a worker hands back each have their own kind. Everything comes off, or goes on, the next pay by itself.

PAY DAY
This week, last week or any dates. Each worker's days, overtime, advances and what is owed, with a running balance carried forward either way. Pay in full or in part; the rest is remembered. A paid week whose days were changed afterwards says so.

- Sites or crews: narrow the sheet, the roster and the pay list to one site
- Trades with usual rates, so a new worker takes one tap
- A pay slip as a PDF, with the worker's days listed one by one
- The pay list, the attendance and the book as Excel files
- Each mark keeps the rate of its day, so a pay rise never rewrites old weeks

SEE YOUR BOOK ON A COMPUTER
Desktop access shows the same register in any browser on your own Wi-Fi: mark days, write advances, pay and print, all from a bigger screen. Nothing goes through the internet; the phone serves the page itself.

NO ACCOUNT. NO MONTHLY FEE. NOTHING CAPPED.
Workers, days, advances, payments, backups and Desktop access are free, with a small advert. The optional yearly subscription removes adverts and unlocks pay slips and Excel files. Your records are never locked: everything you enter stays free to see and back up.

Your records stay on your phone. Back up to a file whenever you like, or to iCloud. Wage Register records payments; it does not take them, and it does not check pay against the labour laws where you work.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://brightscalelabs.com/wage-register/privacy/

name: Waitzy – Offline Mini Games
description:
Waitzy is a pocketful of 25 small games for the moments when you are stuck waiting – at the doctor's, at the airport, on a train, in a queue. Everything works offline, starts in a second and can be put down just as fast.

Play alone, or hand one side of the phone to a friend: the two-player games are laid out so you can sit face to face and both reach comfortably. Nobody around? The phone plays against you at three fair levels – easy really is easy, hard does not cheat.

FOR ONE
• Snake – neon snake with zones, events and three modes
• Runner 3D – dodge, jump and duck on a neon road
• Hopper – bounce higher, stomp monsters, grab the rocket
• Balloons – pop chains for a multiplier
• Mummy – eight trap-filled chambers on the way to a coffee
• Action pickle – a run-and-gun platformer; every level is put together differently
• Granny on a scooter – gas, brake, flips, and never land on your head
• 2048, Tens, Mines, Flood, Pairs – puzzles in several sizes; 2048 has undo and remembers your game
• Hoops, Bowling, Darts – flick, aim and hold your breath

FOR TWO ON ONE PHONE (or against the phone)
• Air hockey, Sumo, Tug of war, Bomb, Quick eye – fast and loud
• Five in a row, Four in a row, Dots and boxes, Reversi, Chain – calm and clever

MORE THAN A PILE OF GAMES
• Daily challenge – one game and one goal every day, with a streak to keep
• Stars – three goals in every solo game, so there is always something to beat
• Tournament for two – five random games, one winner
• Controls shown in pictures, not walls of text
• Backup code – move your progress to a new phone without any account

WHAT YOU WILL NOT FIND
• No ads
• No account, no sign-up
• No internet connection needed
• No data collected – your scores stay on your phone

English and Slovak.

name: WAKA Global
description:
EMPOWER LIFE THROUGH FITNESS.

Create a free WAKA account and explore classes open to everyone. Creating an account does not create a gym membership or charge you.

BOOK YOUR CLASS
See class times, locations and available places. WAKA sets which classes are open to everyone or reserved for members, with separate member and public prices where available.

CLASS ACCESS
For paid classes, arrange payment with WAKA reception. Once staff confirm payment, your class access QR is available during the entry window: from two hours before your class until it ends, at the booked club. Free eligible bookings also receive a class pass. Reception needs an internet connection to verify class passes.

YOUR WAKA ACCOUNT
Existing members can view their membership, member card, club activity and payments, browse the WAKA store and manage their profile. Memberships and paid class access are separate.

FOR AUTHORIZED RECEPTION STAFF
Sign in with an authorized reception account to select your branch, search for a client and collect their visit signature directly on the screen. Reception access depends on your assigned staff role.

Already registered at a WAKA club? Sign in or reset your password to use your existing account. Membership purchases and payment confirmation are handled by WAKA staff. Available classes, prices and services depend on the club.

name: Walker - Explore your city
description:
The map starts covered in fog. Wherever you walk, it lifts – street by street – leaving a picture of everywhere you have been.

Walker works in the background, so the fog clears on your commute, your walks and your travels without opening the app. Later, open the map to see the places you have uncovered, and the corners of your own neighbourhood you have never seen.

• A fog map of everywhere you go, down to single streets
• Stats for today, this week and this month, and new area per day
• How much of each country you have explored
• Over 300 major cities around the world, with the share of each you have uncovered
• Your photos on the map, where you took them
• Your raw path, fading by age

Private by design: your tracks and photos never leave your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Country and city boundaries are built into the app, so nothing about where you go is looked up online.

Walker uses your location in the background to clear the fog while the app is closed.

name: Wanda: Wandern & Tracking
description:
Wanda is a hiking map for the mountains, and only that: what you need out there, made well.

THE MAP
• Drawn like a Swiss national map: relief, contour lines, scree and rock.
• Tilt it, and the mountains rise, lit by the sun as it stands right now.
• The mountains' shadows through the whole day: hold the time and drag.
• Drinking water on the way, as drops on the map.

ROUTES
• Hold two points, and Wanda finds the way along the hiking trails.
• Walking time, distance, ascent, descent and difficulty (SAC T1 to T6).
• The route in the colours of the trail markings: yellow, white-red-white, white-blue-white.
• An elevation profile to run your finger along.
• Stops where they belong, and an end you can move.

ON THE WAY
• Follow the route: what is still ahead and when you will arrive, on the lock screen too.
• Wanda tells you when you stray from the way.
• The map turns with you, if you like.

YOUR WAYS
• Record your walks, and look at them again later.
• Take them along as GPX.
• Offline maps: the area of your next walk, or a route with everything around it.

NOTHING IN THE WAY
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your walks stay on your iPhone.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Terrain © Mapterhorn and its sources.

name: Wanderdeck: Solitaire Tour
description:
Wanderdeck is a world tour of classic solitaire. Travel from Lisbon to Kyoto, learn a new card game in every region, and send postcards home as you go.

SIX CLASSICS, ONE JOURNEY
Klondike in Lisbon, Golf in the Scottish Highlands, Pyramid in Giza, TriPeaks in the Alps, FreeCell in the Norwegian fjords and Spider in Kyoto. Each region opens with a short animated guide, so you can pick up a new game in a minute.

EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
All 180 travel deals were checked by our solver before they reached you, and each one has a par: finish at or under par without help for three stars. No impossible deals, no luck of the draw.

POSTCARDS AND PASSPORT STAMPS
Every fifth deal sends a hand-painted postcard to your Travel Album, with a note on the back. Collect all six in a region to earn its passport stamp.

A NEW DAILY DEAL EVERY DAY
One fresh, winnable deal each day, rotating through all six games. Keep your streak going for bonus coins and a free Magic Wand every seventh day.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Drag cards or double-tap to send them home. Undo is always free. Use a Hint when you are stuck, or the Magic Wand to play the next move for you. Klondike offers Draw 1 or the classic Draw 3.

MADE TO RELAX
Soft, modern art, painted tables for every destination, gentle card sounds and calm travel music. No timers to beat, no energy to wait for.

ATLAS CLUB (optional subscription): no ads between deals, rewards without watching videos, 150 coins plus a free Hint and Wand every day, and the Gilded card back while subscribed. 1-week free trial for new subscribers, then $3.99/month or $29.99/year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Wanderdeck is free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://compo-cf.github.io/wanderdeck-site/privacy.html

name: Warranty Keeper - Receipts
description:
Bought a TV, a laptop or a vacuum? Warranty Keeper keeps the receipt, the warranty and the return deadline in one place, and reminds you before you lose them.

• Add a purchase in under 30 seconds: snap the receipt and Warranty Keeper reads the store, date and total for you, right on your phone
• Return window and warranty end dates worked out for you, or set your own
• Reminders before returns close (7, 3 and 1 day) and before warranties end (30, 7 and 1 day), at the time you choose
• Timeline of every deadline coming up
• Serial and model numbers one tap from copying when you call support
• Photos of the receipt and the product, always with you
• Search by product, store, serial number or anything printed on the receipt
• Share a product's details and receipt in one tap

Private by design: no account, no server, no tracking. Your receipts never leave your phone.

Dates are based on what you enter. Check the store's and manufacturer's terms for what is actually covered.

name: Wasp: Escape the Shower
description:
A wasp got trapped in the shower and there's only one way out: climb 33 steps up the glass to the window. Can you help it escape?

HOW TO PLAY
Drag your finger on the lower half of the screen: up to climb, sideways to switch lanes. Hold it to keep moving.

6 LEVELS, EACH ONE HARDER
• Dodge the falling drops — each one pushes you back.
• Watch out for soap bubbles: get caught and you drop back a level.
• When someone's taking a bath, a hand splashes water… and if it spots you, everything speeds up.
• Three drops in a row and you're back to the start of the level.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Short rounds, perfect for any moment.
• Your level saves automatically — pick up where you left off.
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected.
• Works offline.

Reach the top and take the wasp back to the meadow with its friends.

name: Watch File Explorer
description:
Watch File Explorer moves files between your iPhone and your Watch, and gives both devices a real file manager for what they hold.

Share a PDF from Mail, a photo from Photos, or a recording from any app — tap Share, pick Watch File Explorer, and it is on your wrist. Send anything back — or open it on your iPhone — from the Watch.

No account, no sign-in, and no server: files travel directly over local Wi-Fi or Bluetooth between your iPhone and Watch, and never leave the pair.

FROM IPHONE TO WATCH
• Share from any app: files, photos, videos, text, and links.
• Fast Wi-Fi Direct moves large videos and archives over local Wi-Fi and falls back automatically to background Bluetooth.
• Track live progress with percentage, speed, and time remaining in the app, Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, and Watch Smart Stack widget.

FROM WATCH TO IPHONE
• Send any file on your Watch to your iPhone (lands in "From Watch") or choose Open on iPhone to preview and share immediately.

BUILT FOR THE DIGITAL CROWN
• Turn the crown to browse, tap or Double Tap to open, touch and hold for Copy, Cut, Paste, Rename, Move, Compress, Favorites, Info, and Delete.
• View photos (crown zoom), PDFs, text, code, audio, and full-screen video right on your wrist. Dictate notes as text files.

A REAL FILE MANAGER ON BOTH DEVICES
• Folders, ZIP compression, ZIP/tar/tar.gz/gz archive browsing & extraction, 30-day Recently Deleted, smart categories, instant search, and 40 languages.
• Your iPhone library lives in the Files app under On My iPhone → Watch File Explorer.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no analytics, no ads, and zero third-party code. Files never leave your paired devices.

Requires an iPhone with a paired Watch for transfers. The iPhone app also works standalone as a full file manager.

name: WatchMic: Wireless Microphone
description:
Use your Apple Watch as a microphone for your Mac. Take calls, dictate or record when your MacBook is closed and connected to an external display.

• Pair with a QR code. Open WatchMic on Mac and scan its pairing code in the iPhone app.
• Tap Speak on your Apple Watch. Select WatchMic as the input in your Mac meeting, dictation or recording app.
• Keep audio on your local network. The Mac receiver includes a virtual microphone and a recording test.

Requires iPhone with iOS 17 or later, Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later, and a Mac with macOS 14 or later. Install the Mac receiver from the WatchMic website and connect your watch and Mac to the same local network.

Start a 7-day free trial on your iPhone or Apple Watch by confirming the free offer with Apple. Watch-to-Mac audio streaming ends after 7 days unless you buy Lifetime Access. Lifetime Access is a one-time in-app purchase. There is no automatic charge.

name: Water Log: One Tap
description:
Tap a cup to log a drink. Today's total updates right away, and Undo removes the last quick entry.

• Start with 150, 250 and 500 mL, or edit all three cups.
• Enter a custom amount, backdate a drink, or edit its amount, time and type in History.
• See totals by day and export your records as CSV. Display mL or US fl oz.
• Set your own daily goal and one reminder at a time you choose.
• Pass a cup set to a friend as a code or text file. Share weekly or milestone cards showing only logged days and weekday markers.
• See today's total on your Home Screen widget.

The 30-day trial includes widget quick logging, multiple cup sets, and a 7-day report. Unlock these features with a one-time purchase. Basic logging, history, and export stay available after the trial. No subscription or automatic charge.

No account, ads, or analytics. Your log is stored locally.

name: WaveRider
description:
Savaş geminizle 10 sefer boyunca rotanızı çizin; resiflerden ve mayınlardan kaçının, korsan kaptanlarını etkisiz hale getirin.
Dümenin başına geçin ve dalgalara hükmedin!

Wave Rider, öğrenmesi kolay, tempolu bir denizcilik aksiyon oyunudur. Parmağınızı sürükleyerek geminizi yönlendirin; kayalardan, buz dağlarından ve suda yüzen mayınlardan kaçının; toplarınızla korsan filolarını yerle bir edin. Etrafınızdaki denizi temizlemek için güçlü bir yan top ateşi (broadside) başlatın!

• Giderek zorlaşan 10 sefer ve iki büyük bölüm sonu canavarı savaşı
• Her seviyede 3 yıldıza kadar kazanma imkanı
• Altın toplayarak geminizin gövdesini, toplarını ve motorunu geliştirme fırsatı
• Tersane kısmında yeni gemi tasarımlarının kilidini açma şansı
• Kalkanlar, onarım paketleri ve seri atış güçlendirmeleriyle avantaj sağlama
• Kaptan Günlüğü (Captain’s Log) üzerinden sıralamanızı, katettiğiniz mesafeyi ve batırdığınız korsan gemisi sayısını takip etme

İster kısa oturumlar halinde oynayın, ister kusursuz bir sefer için mücadele edin. Rüzgarınız bol olsun, Kaptan!

name: Wax Echo Archive
description:
Crack a wax seal and hear a recording come back to life. In Wax Echo Archive, you restore a miniature sound archive one puzzle at a time.

Aim your wind-up stylus, hold to choose Soft, Mid, or Deep, and release. Match the seal's force and the stylus sails through, ready to crack another seal in the same shot.

Bank off brass rails to reach around corners. Send the stylus through tuning gates to change its force mid-flight. Peel double jackets in two passes and break numbered seals in cue order. If a route has you stumped, use the Lens to preview it or tap Encore for one more take.

- Restore 100 rooms across five illustrated workshops, from the Listening Bench to the Master Vault.
- Play the echo after each restoration. Its tones follow the order and force of the seals you broke.
- Earn up to three discs per room, replay for cleaner cuts, and track personal bests in the on-device Score Ledger.
- Stamp the daily log to stock spare Lens and Encore uses.
- Play the full campaign offline with optional sound and haptics.

name: Way Out Daily: Arrow Puzzle
description:
Way Out Daily is an arrow puzzle for people who find arrow puzzles too easy.

Every arrow slides in the direction it points — but only when its path to the edge is clear. A blocked arrow bumps and costs a heart, so the order you choose is everything. One wrong move early can box in the rest of the board.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
• A fresh Daily board at midnight, the same for every player
• A gentle Monday ramp to a brutal Sunday finish — the week is the difficulty curve
• Keep your streak alive — shields and a monthly freeze have your back

JOURNEY
150 hand-tuned levels across five worlds, from first steps to expert tangles.

ZEN
Endless boards with no hearts and no stakes. Just you and the arrows.

THOUGHTFUL TOUCHES
• Tap an arrow to preview its path before you commit
• Hints and undo when a board fights back
• Patterns as well as colors, so every arrow reads clearly
• No timers — the board is the only pressure

One way out. Find it.

name: Waykit: Travel Toolkit
description:
Waykit puts the small tools of a trip in one calm app. Add your trip, then open what you need.

PRICE CAMERA
Point your camera at a price tag and see it in your own money, with the date of the exchange rate. Works offline with saved rates.

FOOD ALLERGY AND DIET CARDS
Show restaurant staff a clear full-screen card in their language: allergies, diets, and what you cannot eat. 12 languages.

PHRASES, OFFLINE
Greetings, directions, emergencies and restaurant lines with the local words and a pronunciation guide. No signal needed.

TAXI CARD
Save your hotel address in the local script and show it to a driver, or open it in Maps.

SOS NUMBERS
Police, ambulance and fire for the country you are in, one tap away.

PLUGS AND POWER
Which plug, which voltage, and whether your charger works.

PACKING LIST
A list built from your trip length, weather and activity. Tick things off as you go.

DOCUMENTS AND SCHENGEN
Keep passport expiry dates in view and count your days in the Schengen area. Documents stay on your phone, locked with Face ID.

WEATHER
A daily forecast for your trip, with a heads-up the evening before a rainy or very hot day.

JET LAG
A simple sleep and light plan for crossing time zones.

SPLIT EXPENSES
Track who paid what on a group trip and see who owes whom.

TRIP MEMORIES
See your trip photos on a map.

WIDGET
A home screen countdown to your trip, with the forecast once you are close.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your trips and documents stay on your device.

Waykit is free to use. Waykit Pro, a one-time purchase, unlocks more allergens and diets, all phrases, the taxi card, Schengen counter and document vault, several trips, memory stickers and weather on the widget.

name: WayTally
description:
**WayTally** is a commute cost comparator for people who don't take the same route every day. It compares a typical commute week — driving, transit, biking, walking, rideshare, carpool, or a mix — in **cash, all-in car cost, time, and CO₂e**. The defining question is simple: **would you keep the car anyway?** If yes, only the costs that change with commuting belong in the comparison. If no, the car's fixed costs come with it.

It is local-first and completely free: no account, no ads, no tracking, no in-app purchase, no subscription, and no paywall. Data stays on the iPhone and can be exported as JSON, CSV, or a PDF report.

name: WCWS Mail
description:
WCWS Mail is the mail app for WCWS mailboxes. It connects to your WCWS server and keeps your mail, calendar, contacts and tasks together in one calm app.

READ AND WRITE MAIL
- Conversation view with message text, images, and attachments you can preview, share or print
- Write with bold, lists and links, add photos and files, and save drafts automatically
- Undo send, with a delay you choose
- Send later, at a time you pick
- Reply, reply all and forward
- Search with simple words or operators such as from, to, subject and has attachment

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR INBOX
- Swipe to archive, delete, star or mark as read, and choose what each swipe does
- Snooze a conversation and bring it back when you need it
- Ask to be reminded if nobody replies
- Labels, folders and rules in plain words
- Automatic reply when you are away
- Notifications for new mail

CALENDAR, CONTACTS AND TASKS
- Day, week, month and agenda views
- Accept invitations from your messages and add events with reminders and repeats
- Contacts with a quick index, vCard import and sharing
- Tasks with quick add, such as "Call Maria tomorrow at 3"

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your mail stays on your own server. The app talks to that server and nowhere else
- Your password is never kept on the phone, only a session token in the iOS Keychain
- Lock the app with Face ID or your passcode
- Remote images stay off until you ask for them, and links open only after you confirm
- See the devices signed in to your account and sign them out from Settings
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics

WCWS Mail needs a WCWS mailbox. It does not sign in to other mail services.

Support: support@wcws.net

name: Website Screenshot World
description:
Website Screenshot World captures your web pages on a schedule. This app is your phone's view of your workspace: check that your schedules are running, look at the latest captures, see what changed on a page, and get a notification when it matters.

You need a Website Screenshot World account to use this app. Schedules are created and edited on the web; the app is for keeping an eye on them.

DASHBOARD
• Captures taken this billing cycle and what is left of your allowance
• Storage used
• Recent captures, pages that changed this week and schedules that are paused

SCHEDULES
• Search your schedules and filter running or paused ones
• Status and next run time for each schedule
• Capture now, pause or resume a schedule

CAPTURES
• Full-screen viewer with zoom
• What changed: the changed areas highlighted, and a before / after slider
• Images, PDFs and videos
• Star a capture, save it to your photo library, share it or delete it

NOTIFICATIONS
• A page changed
• A capture failed
• A schedule was paused
• Storage is running low
Choose which ones each phone gets, in Settings.

ALSO
• Light and dark appearance
• Sign in with the same account as on the web, in a secure browser window; the app never sees your password

Support: support@websitescreenshotworld.com

name: WeCull: Photo Culling
description:
WeCull is a photo culling service for working photographers. You shot the wedding, the game, the senior session or the event — we go through every frame and send back your keepers, so you can skip straight to editing.

BOOK A CULL
Pick a turnaround — 24 hours, 3 days or 7 days — tell us how many frames you shot, and add notes on how you like it culled: how strict to be with near-duplicates, must-keep people, team and group shots, details.

SEND THE WHOLE CARD
Plug an SD card reader into your iPhone or iPad, or pick a folder in Files or photos from your library. WeCull reads the preview already built into each RAW file right on your device and uploads only those lightweight previews — a 3,000-frame card goes up as about 1.5 GB instead of 100 GB. You can also send from your computer at wecull.net, or paste a Dropbox, Google Drive or WeTransfer link.

KEEPERS BACK, READY TO EDIT
Your selects come back labeled and rated as XMP sidecar files, plus a picks list. Put them next to your RAW files and your keepers show up in Lightroom Classic, Capture One or Bridge — no re-uploading your originals.

FOR EVERY KIND OF SHOOT
Weddings, sports, seniors and graduations, families and portraits, events and performances.

SIMPLE, PER-PHOTO PRICING
Pay per photo for each gallery — no subscriptions. Payment happens on the web through Stripe Checkout, because WeCull is a service performed outside the app.

TRACK EVERY GALLERY
Follow each order from paid to files in, culling and delivered, with a countdown to your due time, and download your keepers right in the app.

Sign in with Apple is optional and keeps your orders on all your devices. Booking and sending galleries work without an account.

Privacy policy: https://wecull.net/privacy
Terms of service: https://wecull.net/terms

name: WeekLattice
description: Give your weekly tasks room to breathe. Add estimates, assign a weekday or keep tasks in the backlog, then compare planned effort with your daily capacity. Mark tasks complete, reopen them, edit details and review the load across all seven days. This is a reusable weekly template, not a dated calendar. Completed tasks stay completed until you reopen them; no reminders or calendar access.\n\nFree, without ads, purchases or an account. Your records are saved locally. Choose from eight app languages and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample data is fictional and optional.

name: Weekly Planner: Time Blocking
description:
Weekly Planner is a free weekly planner with no ads. It turns your week into a grid you can actually see: seven days side by side, your real hours, colored blocks you drag exactly where they belong.

YOUR WHOLE WEEK ON ONE SCREEN
See all seven days at once, or switch to a 5-day, 3-day or 1-day view. Every task is a colored block on a real timeline, so you read your week the way it actually happens. The monthly view shows every week of the month with its total hours.

TIME BLOCKING, MADE PHYSICAL
Give every task a start, an end and a place. Drag a block, stretch it, drop it on another day, or set the exact time down to the minute. Blocks snap to 15, 30 or 60 minutes.

GOALS THAT FILL THEMSELVES
Aim for 3 hours of sport a week: place 2 h of swimming and 1 h of weights, the bar fills up on its own and the goal is done. Set as many goals as you like, for free.

MEAL PLANNER: THIS WEEK'S MEALS
Plan a starter, a main and a dessert for morning, midday and evening, all seven days. Your favorite dishes drop in with one tap, and your weekly menu reads at a glance. Free as well.

PRESET TASKS YOU REUSE FOREVER
Build your routine once - Work, Gym, Study, Dinner - then drop it into any day. Save a whole week as a template and reload it whenever you need (PREMIUM). Ideal for a school timetable, shift schedules, training programs and any weekly routine.

REPEATS THAT FOLLOW YOUR REAL LIFE (PREMIUM)
Repeat a task every day, on weekdays only, weekly, monthly or yearly, or write your own rule with an end date. Change your mind later and the app asks what you meant: this occurrence, the following ones, or the whole series.

COUNTERS THAT MOVE ON THEIR OWN (PREMIUM)
Write "3 days until vacation" or "Day 12 without smoking" and the number updates itself at every repeat. Streaks, countdowns, milestones.

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT MOMENT
On every task, a reminder on time, 10 or 30 minutes before. Premium goes further: up to 15 alerts per task, up to a year ahead, plus reminders outside the board.

SEE WHERE YOUR TIME ACTUALLY GOES (PREMIUM)
A live breakdown shows how your hours split across your tasks. No manual tracking: it counts what is already on your grid.

PHONE, PC AND WEB, IN SYNC
Plan on your phone, adjust on your computer. Your week follows you in real time, and everything is backed up to the cloud.

SHARE AND EXPORT
Export any week, or several at once, as a clean PDF or image. Send it, print it, pin it to the fridge.

A SHARED CALENDAR FOR TWO (PREMIUM)
Link a second account and share one week. See your partner's tasks next to yours and decide whether they can edit or delete. Built for couples, roommates, families and small teams.

MAKE IT YOURS, KEEP IT PRIVATE
Pick any color, your first day of the week, 12h or 24h time, light or dark theme. Choose your day colors and search your whole history (PREMIUM). Lock the app with Face ID or a PIN. Pin a note to any task, duplicate it in a tap, undo and redo. Available in 16 languages, including English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese and Arabic.

WHO IT IS FOR
Students building a school timetable and a revision schedule. Shift workers mapping irregular weeks. Nurses, teachers and hospitality staff on rotating rosters. Freelancers protecting deep work. Athletes planning a training week. Parents juggling a family schedule and meal planning.

Weekly Planner is a schedule planner, a daily planner, a weekly agenda, a meal planner and a time management tool in one, without the clutter of a full calendar app.

Terms of Use: https://weekly-planner-70a51.web.app/conditions-utilisation

name: WeFind: Meet Halfway
description:
Find a place to meet, wherever the day takes you.

MEET HALFWAY
Choose two starting points and find an estimated halfway point along a driving route. Browse nearby places to eat, coffee shops, drinks spots and things to do. Choose a 1, 5, 10 or 20-mile search radius.

DROP A PIN
Search a city, address or place, use your current location, or position the heart pin on the map. Find nearby places in your selected category and radius.

CHECK THE DETAILS
Open Google Maps for reviews and directions. No app account, subscription or in-app purchase is required. Location permission is optional.

Place listings use free map data and a small set of verified local corrections. Coverage may be incomplete or outdated. Card distances are straight-line distances from the search center. Driving estimates exclude live traffic, and actual drives to an individual venue may differ.

name: WeftinRoveer
description:
Weftin Roveer는 소재와 핏을 중심으로 의류를 살펴볼 수 있는 의류 쇼핑 앱입니다. 원단 가이드에서 L1부터 L4까지 나눈 원단 기준을 확인하고, 각 소재의 무게, 촉감, 계절 적합성을 비교해볼 수 있습니다. 모든 제품은 원단 등급과 특징이 함께 표시되어 있어 구매 전 소재 특성을 충분히 파악하기 좋습니다.

핏 스튜디오에서는 본인의 신체 치수를 입력하고 선호하는 실루엣을 설정할 수 있습니다. 단순한 사이즈 숫자만이 아니라 어깨너비, 가슴둘레 등을 바탕으로 딱 맞게, 여유 있게, 오버사이즈 중 원하는 착용감을 고려해 안내받습니다. 측정 가이드도 함께 제공되어 처음 치수를 재는 분들도 어렵지 않게 따라할 수 있습니다.

신상품을 둘러보고 상품 상세 정보를 확인한 뒤 마음에 드는 제품은 찜하거나 장바구니에 담을 수 있습니다. 내 옷장에서 자신의 핏 프로필과 관심 상품을 편리하게 관리할 수 있습니다. 과도한 수식어보다는 소재와 실루엣 정보를 투명하게 전달하는 데 집중했습니다.

name: Weight Tracker: Trend Scale
description:
Up two pounds overnight? That's water, not fat. Trend Scale shows what your scale can't: your real weight, smoothed over the days, so a salty dinner or a hot day no longer spoils your morning.

ONE TAP A DAY
• Turn the dial to today's weight and save. That's it.
• Weights from your smart scale arrive by themselves through Apple Health.
• A gentle morning reminder, if you like.

YOUR TRUE TREND
• A moving average filters out water, salt and food: the mean of the last seven days, or the smoothed method of "The Hacker's Diet". You choose.
• Every weigh-in shows how far it sits above or below your trend.
• Your pace per week, and the calories behind it, worked out from your own weights.

GOALS YOU CAN REACH
• Set a goal and split the way into small stops.
• See the day you'll get there at your current pace.
• A stop counts when your trend passes it, not after one lucky morning.

THE WHOLE PICTURE
• A chart of a month, three months, a year or everything: dots for the scale, a line for the trend.
• Forgot a day? Add it later.
• Kilograms, pounds or stone and pounds. Body mass index if you add your height.
• Export all your weights as a CSV file.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no cloud, no ads. Your weights stay on your iPhone.

The first month is free. After that Trend Scale is a subscription, monthly or yearly, charged to your Apple Account; it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed and cancelled in the App Store settings.

Trend Scale is not a medical device. The calories are an estimate and do not replace medical advice.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Wexvex
description:
Wexvex is a quiet tile layout and purchase planner for small wall, floor and counter projects. Measure the rectangle, keep your tile details on device, and get a conservative count of placements, edge cuts, tiles needed after waste, and whole boxes to buy.

NO ONLINE CATALOGUE, NO ACCOUNT
Wexvex does not fetch products, prices, stock, reviews or building codes. Enter your own measurements and tile details, plan locally, and use the result as a pre-order checklist.

COUNT THE GRID, NOT JUST THE AREA
For each rectangle, Wexvex adds the grout joint to the tile unit, calculates columns and rows, counts placements, and separates full tiles from partial edge pieces. Area coverage is shown as a cross-check, while placements drive the box estimate.

name: WFIC HD
description: WFIC HDThis tool helps you distinguish between your total account balance and the portion currently held or earmarked for specific purposes. For each held amount, you can log subsequent additions, deductions, or releases based on the actual dates; if a single deduction involves multiple deposits, you can allocate it across them individually. Once a refund is received, you can view the net cost by referencing the original expenditure. Should an error occur in the amount or date, you can make corrections—the system will track the impact on related transactions, while preserving a record of the original entry and the reason for the change. When you receive a statement, you can compare your actual available balance against your ledger, item by item, to identify any discrepancies. At the end of the month, you can generate a carry-forward report of all outstanding holds, which can then be reconciled in the following month against the actual release dates and amounts.

name: What Would You Do? by Everdust
description:
Short animated stories that stop at the moment that matters and ask: what would you do?

Watch Part 1. When the choice comes, pick A or B. See what happens, then go back and try the other choice. Every story has two endings.

Some stories are based on real events, including the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, Pompeii in AD 79, the 2011 Joplin tornado, Mount St. Helens in 1980, the Halifax explosion of 1917 and Boston's Molasses Flood of 1919. Others are fiction, horror stories included. Every story is marked "Based on a real event" or "Fiction".

WHAT'S REAL
For the true stories, the What's real panel tells you what really happened, with the facts and their sources, and for some stories a safety tip.

SEE WHAT EVERYONE ELSE CHOSE
Your pick counts. Once enough people have chosen, you'll see how everyone else decided. Some stories end on an open vote, and the most-picked choice decides what happens in the next part.

NEW PARTS
Follow a story and we'll tell you when the next part is out or when voting is about to close.

SHARE YOUR CHOICE
Make a card with your pick and send it to your friends.

No account, no sign-in, no ads. Free.

Made by Everdust. For ages 13 and up: the stories show danger, disasters and frightening moments, with no gore.

name: Where's Jesus?
description:
Can you spot Jesus in the crowd?

Where's Jesus? is a seek-and-find game for the whole family. Follow the Gospel story through 55 busy scenes, from the baptism at the Jordan to the Ascension, and search each crowd for Jesus in his white robe and red sash.

NEVER THE SAME TWICE
Every time you play a level the crowd is redrawn and everyone hides somewhere new. Replay your favourite scene as often as you like.

STORYBOOK SCENES
Painted backdrops, a bustling cast of characters and little stories tucked into every crowd: a child chasing a runaway hen, a camel helping itself to the fruit, a dog making off with a fish. Clouds drift, birds fly over, and the whole town turns out.

THINGS TO FIND
Jesus is the goal. Peter, Matthew, the lost lamb, the loaves and fishes and the dove are bonus finds for sharp eyes. Some scenes hide someone from their own story too, like Zacchaeus up his sycamore tree.

THREE LEVELS OF CHALLENGE
Easy has about 160 people. Hard packs in about 700, with dozens of look-alikes who differ from Jesus in a single detail.

NO RUSH
The clock counts up and never runs out. Hints are there if you get stuck.

A VERSE WITH EVERY SCENE
Each level ends with a verse from the story it shows.

TODAY'S CHALLENGE
One puzzle a day, the same for everyone, so friends and family can compare times.

TRY IT FREE
Level 1 is free. One purchase unlocks all 55 levels and Today's challenge, for good, and Family Sharing shares it. No subscription.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
No adverts. No accounts. No tracking. Nothing is collected, and the whole game works offline.

name: Where's My Matcha
description:
Craving a good matcha? Where's My Matcha is a map of matcha cafés and tea rooms in Czechia, made by matcha lovers.

FIND YOUR MATCHA SPOT
• Cafés and tea rooms with matcha on a map around you
• Near you, Top rated and the Star of the week in one place
• Search by place name or city
• Opening hours added by the community

LOOK INSIDE BEFORE YOU GO
• Star ratings, reviews and photos from other matcha lovers
• Price ranges, so you know what your matcha will cost
• What people ordered

ADD YOUR TIP
• Your favorite spot is missing? Put it on the map
• Rate your matcha, write a review and add photos
• Save your favorite spots with one tap
• Collect badges for every place you add and every review you write

Browse without an account. Sign in with Apple to write reviews and save favorites, no passwords needed.

Free, no ads. For iPhone and iPad, in English and Czech.

name: WhimBreemia
description:
