Big feelings get smaller once they have a name. WhimBreemia gives your family sixty picture cards to practise that, one friendly word at a time.

Each card shows a simple drawn face, a plain-language meaning, a clue about how the feeling shows up in the body, and a question to ask each other. Read it together at breakfast, in the car, or at bedtime. You've got this.

What's inside

· 60 feeling word cards, grouped into six families: Sunny, Rainy, Stormy, Shaky, Still and Sparky
· Today's card: a new word each day, face down until you turn it over together
· A streak of days, so you can see the habit growing week by week
· Family notes on any card: who felt it, what happened, what helped
· A collection sheet that fills with ink as you collect the cards you have talked through
· Search across words, families, meanings and your own notes
· A weekly snapshot of cards looked at, cards collected and the family favourite

How to play it

· Open the Cards tab and browse the deck, or filter by family
· Tap a card to open the deck, then swipe to move through it
· Tap Collect this card once everyone has had a turn to talk
· Add a note so you remember what helped next time
· Turn the tuning knob at the bottom to change tabs

Why families like it

· No accounts and no sign-in. Open it and start
· Works fully offline, with a quiet anonymous backup when you are connected
· Calm rice-paper look with ink accents and soft motion, easy on tired eyes at bedtime
· Gentle generated sounds you can switch off in Settings

A note from the coach's corner

WhimBreemia is a learning tool for building feelings vocabulary at home. It is not therapy and it does not diagnose anything. If a feeling feels too big, reach out to someone you trust.

Pick a card tonight. Say the word. Ask the question. That small moment is the whole practice, and it adds up fast.

name: Whipshore
description:
The golden hour never ends here. Ride a dirt bike across four shores, launch off sandbars and ramps, and let the radio explain what you just did to your spine.

Whipshore is a relaxing trick-riding game for people who like speed in small, calm doses. A floating joystick steers, the sun hangs low, the music stays chill, and the only thing in a hurry is your combo meter.

FOUR SHORES
- Lagoon: sand, mud, rocks and little islands at golden hour
- Storm: rain, lightning and one headlight in the dark
- Volcano: glowing rock, ash and a very warm landing
- Skate Park: funboxes, rails, quarterpipes and a halfpipe, free or timed, day or evening
- Earn stars on every shore and unlock the next challenge

TRICKS THAT FEEL GOOD
- Whip, superman, nac-nac, no-hander and the big ones, backflip and frontflip
- Hold the stick back or forward in the air to rotate, nudge it to fine-tune the landing
- Press a little early and the bike remembers: the trick fires right off the lip
- Chain tricks in one jump for bonuses like Super Whip, Scrub Dance and Lagoon Triple
- Landing clean raises your combo. Landing badly raises the radio's eyebrow

BULLET TIME
Landings, combos and finished challenges fill an energy ring. Press BT and the world slows to a quarter, the camera leans in and the sound drops into a deep hum. Spend it on the jump you want to remember.

YOUR GARAGE
- Four bikes, from light and agile to heavy and stable, each with its own stats
- Paint the plastics, pick decals, rims and exhaust
- Dress your rider: jersey, pants, gloves, helmet colour and helmet shape, number and number style
- Trick trails and landing effects that make a clean landing look like it matters
- 32 achievements unlock new gear, and the shop sells what you have not earned yet

THE RADIO
A dry voice in your helmet comments on every jump, every landing and every poor decision. It talks in English or Czech, and you can switch language with one tap. After a crash you also get the rider's last words, which are never as heroic as he planned.

MOOD
- Golden hour that slowly drifts from day to a low orange sun and back
- Waves, wind, engine and landings are all synthesized live in the game
- Chill music that quietly turns up the energy when your flow does
- Gentle haptics on landings and tricks
- Made for iPhone and iPad, with touch controls that move to the other hand for lefties

NO STRINGS
- No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no data collected
- Works offline. Your scores, stars and gear stay on your device

Pick it up for ten minutes or an hour. Whipshore is happy either way, and so is the radio, mostly because it gets to talk.

name: whishh: Wishlist & Gift List
description:
whishh is one place for everything you wish for: a thing, a trip, a concert or a restaurant you want to visit. Keep a list just for yourself, plan one together with your partner, or share it with friends, family or colleagues, and they will give you exactly what you hope for. No duplicates, no awkward questions.

ADD A WISH ANY WAY YOU LIKE
• Paste a link from any shop: the name, photo and price fill in by themselves.
• Share a page from Safari or a shop’s app straight into whishh.
• Take or pick a photo, or just type a name. Add a note, how many you want and a price in any currency.
• Places and experiences get a pin on the map.
• Take wishes from your other lists.

ONE LIST, ANY CIRCLE
• Private: only you see it.
• Together: keep a list with your partner.
• For friends only, or for anyone with the link. Guests do not need the app: the list opens in their browser.

GIFTS STAY A SURPRISE
Whoever picks a gift taps "I’ll Give This", and everyone else sees it is taken. You never see who gives what. Guests can also find a gift within their budget among your wishes.

FRIENDS AND THEIR DAYS
• Find friends by their nickname and see the lists they share with you.
• Save a friend’s list and get a reminder a week before their birthday or the list’s day.
• Friends’ birthdays and upcoming holidays in one place.

HINTS
Your sizes, what you love, what not to buy and your favourite flowers. Friends only see what you fill in.

INVITATIONS
Add a day, a time and a place on the map to a list. Guests see the invitation, get directions and add it to their calendar in one tap.

SAFE BY DESIGN
No public feed. Block anyone, and report anything that is not right.

Free. Sign in with a code by email, a passkey, Apple or Google. In English, Polish and Ukrainian.

name: WhozDate: Safety Community
seller_name: ELESKA INTERNET HIZMETLERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
WhozDate brings community advice and practical safety tools together when you are getting to know someone new.

ASK THE COMMUNITY
Share your questions, discuss boundaries and learn from other members' experiences. Explore conversations and safety tips without searching for or rating real people.

PLAN WITH SAFE DATE
Prepare a meetup plan, keep a trusted contact informed and set a check-in time. Choose whether to share your location, with time limits and the option to stop sharing.

MUTUAL CONSENT WITH WHOZDATE CHECK
Use consent-based checks that require both participants to agree. Taking part is optional.

PRIVACY AND CONTROL
Choose how you share, manage messaging preferences, report content and block users. You can delete your account from Settings > Delete account.

Available in English, Turkish, German and French. For adults aged 18 and over.

WhozDate is a community and safety tool. It does not provide matchmaking or background investigations. Safe Date is not an emergency response service and cannot guarantee anyone's safety.

name: Wi-Fi IEM Receiver
description:
Build your own stereo in-ear mix on iPhone or iPad. Bring your voice up for a harmony, move a guitar to one side, or pull the click down between songs. Each musician controls their own headphones while everyone else keeps playing.

Wi-Fi IEM Receiver is the free companion to Wi-Fi IEM Host, sold separately for Apple silicon Mac. The Host captures audio from a compatible USB mixer or interface and sends a personal stereo mix to each connected receiver over your local network.

• Adjust levels, pan, mute and solo for individual sources.
• Organize channels into groups and recall your saved mixes.
• Blend the engineer’s processing to taste and check the digital headroom of your mix.
• With the engineer’s permission, control multitrack rehearsal recording on the Mac and play back a take in your own headphones.

To get started, join the same trusted network as the Host, connect wired headphones or a compatible wired audio adapter, and choose Find Mac. You can try the system with the Host’s built-in test audio before connecting a console. Monitoring works without an internet connection or a Wi-Fi IEM account.

name: Wingfall: Bird Hunting
description:
Know your best morning before you go. Wingfall is a clean, simple app made only for bird hunters: ducks, geese, turkeys, upland birds and doves.

HUNT SCORES FOR THE BIRDS YOU HUNT
Every morning and evening of the coming week gets a score from 1 to 10 at each of your spots and where you're standing, for ducks, geese, turkey or upland birds. Cold fronts, temperature swings, wind, rain and how hard you've hunted a spot all count, and each score lists the reasons in plain English. The scores learn from your own hunt log over time. They rate conditions; they can't promise birds. (Wingfall Pro)

SEE WHERE BIRDS WILL LAND
Birds land into the wind. Save your duck blinds, layouts and pits on the map and Wingfall draws where the landing hole should be on today's wind and where to set the spread. Upland fields show a scent cone so you can start downwind and let the dog work into it. Turn on alerts for a heads-up the evening before a great morning, or when a strong cold front or hard freeze is coming. (Alerts: Wingfall Pro)

A BAG CHECK THAT COUNTS AS YOU HUNT
Big, glove-friendly buttons for mallard drakes and hens, wood ducks, teal, Canadas, snows, gobblers, flushes and more. Mark each one Seen, Worked or Bagged, and the bag check shows your count next to the daily limits you enter (or your state's official limits, when Wingfall has them). It's a helper, never a legal ruling.

MARK THE FALL
Point your phone where a bird fell and pick a distance. Wingfall drops a mark and walks you back to it with an arrow and the distance. A whole flock? Every mark is listed in order.

IDENTIFY THE BIRD IN YOUR HAND
After the harvest, a photo gives estimates of species, sex and age, explains what in the photo shows it, and reads a leg band so you can log it and report it yourself at reportband.gov. Every value is labeled as an estimate, and it never tells you whether a bird was legal to take. (Wingfall Pro; logging a bird without a scan is free.)

YOUR GAME BAG AND BAND WALL
Every bird by season, a life list of species taken, your bands, and trophy cards to share.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
During a hunt, your iPhone lock screen shows the hunt timer, a live countdown to the end of legal light, birds seen and bagged, and whether the wind is right for your spot.

REGULATIONS IN PLAIN ENGLISH
The federal basics every waterfowl hunter needs (HIP, the Duck Stamp, nontoxic shot, shooting hours) with official links. In supported states, it also shows what's open today where you are and answers questions only from the official regulations, with the sections cited (more states are being added). Wingfall is a guide, not legal advice: always confirm with your state wildlife agency. (Questions: Wingfall Pro)

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
Hunts, tallies, the bag check and marks save on your phone in the marsh and sync when you're back in range.

NEW TO BIRD HUNTING?
Short guides with quick quizzes on licenses and the Duck Stamp, cold water and boat safety, identifying ducks, decoys and wind, turkey setups, working a dog, cleaning birds and more, plus "Ask a guide," a patient AI mentor. (Ask a guide: Wingfall Pro)

SCOUTING CAMERAS, SORTED
Upload your camera photos and Wingfall sorts the turkeys, geese and ducks for you, and shows when birds use each spot. (Wingfall Pro)

WINGFALL PRO
Pro adds the hunt scores and alerts, the bird scanner, scouting cameras, regulations questions, Ask a guide and extra trophy card styles. Weekly and yearly plans; a free trial may be offered. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.

Terms: https://wingfall.netlify.app/terms
Privacy: https://wingfall.netlify.app/privacy

name: Winq - Bliss & Bloom
description: Winq is a fried chicken recipe companion for crispy favorites, cooking plans, and the ideas you want to make again. Browse buttermilk classics, wings, and weeknight bites, then open a recipe for ingredients, timing, and a clear method. Save the ones you love, place them on a cooking plan, and move ingredients onto a shopping list before you start. Cook mode takes you through each step, and your profile keeps the kitchen details you choose to remember. Come back for the next craving and pick up the recipes, plans, and favorites that are already waiting.

name: Winslow Homes CRM
description:
Winslow Homes CRM is the phone and tablet app for agents and staff at Winslow Homes. Sign in with the login your broker gives you and run your whole day from your phone.

What you can do
- See every lead, hot list and follow-up the moment it comes in
- Call and text leads from the company line, so your personal number stays private
- Get instant alerts for new leads, replies, voicemails and booked calls
- Read and answer texts and emails in one inbox
- Log notes by voice and set appointments from the lead card
- Check your Today list, pipeline and calendar between showings
- Open files, agreements and the knowledge base on the go
- Lock the app with Face ID

The app connects to the same Winslow Homes CRM your office uses on the computer. Anything you change on one shows on the other right away.

For Winslow Homes agents and staff only. You need a login from your broker to use the app.

name: Winslow Homes Voicemail
description:
Winslow Homes Voicemail is the phone app for the Winslow Homes team. When a call to a team line goes unanswered, Alexis, the team's AI assistant, picks up, takes the message and sends it here.

What you can do
- Read every message as a short summary and a full transcript
- See who called, their callback number and whether it is urgent
- Get an alert on your phone the moment a new message comes in
- Filter by line, mark messages heard, archive, and see spam calls kept out of your inbox
- Call back with one tap
- Switch to the Winslow Homes CRM with one tap at the top of the app
- Lock the app with Face ID

For Winslow Homes team members only. You need a login from Winslow Homes to use the app.

name: Wireless Press Classroom
description:
Wireless Press Classroom is the mobile learning platform for Wireless Press Education.

Students can securely access their assigned courses, cohorts, lessons, labs, assignments, learning materials, grades, progress, and instructor resources from their mobile device.

Key features include:

• Access assigned courses and cohorts
• Continue learning from published weekly modules
• Review lessons and cybersecurity lab activities
• Access course materials and syllabi
• Submit assignments directly from your device
• View assignment status, grades, and instructor feedback
• Track course and module completion
• Join scheduled live classroom sessions
• Access Wireless Press CyberLab activities
• View certificates and completion information when available

Wireless Press Classroom connects directly to the Wireless Press Education learning environment, allowing enrolled students to continue their training wherever they are.

Access requires an authorized Wireless Press Education student account and active enrollment in an eligible program.

Wireless Press Education — learn, build, and advance.

name: Wirkung.Studio
description:
Wirkung ist kein Zufall. Sie ist deine Entscheidung.

Bevor du im Bewerbungsgespräch, im Meeting oder auf der Bühne ein Wort sagst, haben andere sich schon ein Bild gemacht. Wirkung.Studio zeigt dir, welches, und wie du es bewusst gestaltest.

VOR DEM WICHTIGEN MOMENT
Im Auftritts-Briefing beschreibst du die Situation: Gespräch, Präsentation, Verhandlung. Du bekommst eine Vorbereitung, die zu dir und deinem Ziel passt, mit Kleidung, Haltung und den ersten Sätzen.

SIEH, WIE DU WIRKST
Der erste Eindruck, Style Scan, Raum und Wirkung: Mach ein Foto oder wähle eines aus und erfahre, was es über deine Wirkung sagt. Gemessen an der Wirkung, die du dir selbst vorgenommen hast, nicht an einem Schönheitsideal. Fotos werden nur für die Auswertung verwendet und nicht gespeichert.

ÜBEN, BIS ES SITZT
Im Zielwirkungstraining arbeitest du über mehrere Tage an einer Wirkung, etwa souverän oder nahbar, und prüfst mit Wirkungstests, ob es ankommt. Das tägliche Ritual gibt dir jeden Tag eine kleine Übung. Auf Wunsch erinnert dich die App zur Uhrzeit deiner Wahl.

VERSTEHEN, WARUM ES WIRKT
Im Magazin findest du die Gesetze der Wirkung, mit Quellen aus der Forschung. Das Schnelltraining zeigt dir, welche Denkfehler unser Urteil über andere lenken.

FRAGEN STELLEN
In der Sprechstunde fragst du deine Stilberaterin, die deinen Verlauf kennt. Sie spricht in der Stimme, die dir liegt.

SO FUNKTIONIERT ES
Laden ist kostenlos, das Magazin, das Schnelltraining und das Studio auch. Für Analysen nutzt du Guthaben: eine Analyse kostet einen Credit, die erste ist gratis. Pakete mit 5, 10 oder 50 Credits kaufst du in der App. Kein Abo.

DEINE DATEN
Gespeichert in der EU. Für die Analysen nutzen wir das KI-Modell Claude von Anthropic. Bevor etwas dorthin geht, fragt dich die App. Kein Tracking, keine Werbung. Dein Konto löschst du jederzeit in der App.

Ab 18 Jahren.

name: Wis: Feynman Knowledge Tree
description:
Everyone knows a little about everything. Wis helps you understand one topic deeply, using the Feynman technique: if you can explain it simply, you understand it.

Pick a topic and a goal. Collect the questions you want answered as a living 3D tree. Write what you find in documents under each question. Then explain the answer in your own words: that's what makes your tree grow.

• One topic in focus: a 30 or 90-day season, so depth stays the point
• A 3D knowledge tree: every question is a bud; explain it and it becomes a branch; explain it on three different days and it turns to solid wood
• Documents inside every question: headings, lists and quotes, saved as you type
• Explain in your own words: reread and improve past explanations
• Pick up where you left off: Wis flies to today's question when you open the app
• Outline view: your whole tree as a list, with what to explain next
• Streak and season progress, plus an optional daily reminder
• Your data is yours: export everything as one file, or delete your account at any time

No ads. No tracking.

Wis is inspired by the learning method named after physicist Richard Feynman. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by him or his estate.

name: Wisefork Decision Journal
description:
Have you ever looked back on a decision and wondered why you made it in the first place?

Wisefork Decision Journal helps you keep track of those moments. Write down what you were choosing between, what mattered to you, what you expected to happen, and how confident you felt. Then, when the time comes, return to your original thoughts and see how things actually turned out.

The idea is simple: don't just remember the outcome. Remember what you knew, thought, and felt when you made the choice.

When facing a difficult decision, use the Weighing Scale to compare options based on your priorities, 10 · 10 · 10 to look at the choice from three different time horizons, or Premortem to think ahead about what could go wrong. Each exercise can become a journal entry, so your thinking doesn't get lost.

When it's time to look back, Forkie helps you review your expectations and reflect on the outcome. As your journal grows, Insights reveals patterns in your decisions: how often your predictions come true, whether your confidence matches your results, and how your mood might influence your choices. Calibration charts, Brier scores, and personal lessons help turn those observations into something you can use.

You can set reminders for upcoming reviews, or take a few minutes every Sunday to reflect on the week's decisions. No pressure to write every day — just a place to return to when it matters.

Your journal is private and stays on your device. There's no account, advertising, or tracking. Protect it with Face ID, Touch ID, or your passcode, and export your entries as CSV or PDF whenever you like.

Begin with a sample journal, then start recording your own decisions. Little by little, you'll get to know your thinking habits better — one choice at a time.

name: Wish & Rest
description:
Turn your intentions into a calming daily ritual.

Wish & Rest lets you write a few kind sentences, record them in your own voice, and hear them gently repeated over soothing sound as you settle down at night or start your morning.

YOUR WORDS, YOUR VOICE
• Choose an intention: confidence, gratitude, winding down, or your own
• Write up to five short affirmations, or start from the gentle examples
• Record each one in your own voice, listen back, and re-record until it feels right
• Haven't recorded yet? Your iPhone's voice reads the phrase for you

14 SOUNDS TO MIX
• Nature: rain in the woods, ocean waves, mountain stream, wind, fireplace, night crickets
• Sleep rhythm: a slow heartbeat, and a breathing pace that rises for 4 seconds and falls for 6
• Music: soft piano lullaby, dream chords, music box, singing bowls
• Steady noise: brown noise and pink noise
• Mix them, each with its own volume, or tap any sound to play it on its own

MADE FOR FALLING ASLEEP
• Sessions of 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes that end with a slow fade to silence
• Choose how long the pause is between phrases
• The screen fades to black a few seconds after you start, so the room stays dark
• Keeps playing with the phone locked, with play and pause on the lock screen
• Pauses for calls, and never suddenly plays through the speaker if your headphones disconnect

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your words and recordings stay on your iPhone and are never uploaded
• Works fully offline, including in airplane mode
• Optional morning and evening reminders that never show your affirmations

FREE, WITH A ONE-TIME UPGRADE
• Free: two routines, your own voice, five sounds, every session length
• Wish & Rest Lifetime (one-time purchase, no subscription): unlimited routines, all 14 sounds, three sounds at once, and every sound added in future

Wish & Rest is for relaxation and reflection. It is not a medical product and does not diagnose or treat any condition, including sleep problems.

name: Wizard Dogs: Match 3 Puzzle
description:
Grab your wand: the Wizard Dogs need your puzzle magic!

Wizard Dogs: Match 3 Puzzle is a colorful puzzle game starring 20 wizard dogs. Swap neighboring gems to match 3 or more, make powerful specials and clear each level's goals before you run out of moves.

FEATURES
• 100 levels in 7 magical worlds, from the Enchanted Forest to the Celestial Citadel
• A boss level every 10 levels
• Line Blasters, Area Bombs and Rainbow Orbs, plus huge combos when you swap two specials together
• Break ice, smash crates and master wild new board shapes
• Collect 20 original wizard dog familiars. Each one has its own magic power
• 8 boosters to help with tough levels
• Daily rewards and a free Lucky Spin every day
• A hands-on tutorial and a How to Play page, so anyone can jump in
• Plays fully offline. No account needed
• No forced ads

Wizard Dogs: Match 3 Puzzle is free to play. Optional in-app purchases include coin packs, boosters, unlimited lives and the Wizard Pass.

All Wizard Dogs characters are original artwork by Rollmeta.

name: Wobblo: Wish Machines
description:
Wobblo is a little jelly blob who wakes up with a new wish every day: reach the star, cross the gap, land in the basket.

Build a machine to make it happen. Drag parts into the lab, press play and watch the physics work:
• A float bubble lifts Wobblo into the sky. Tap it to pop.
• A rain cloud waters a seed that grows into a bridge.
• A gel bomb paints surfaces: icy blue slides, honey sticks, pink bounces.

No game over: if it doesn't work, change it and try again. No words to read: the game teaches itself, step by step.

Fun for the whole family. Works offline, has no ads and collects no data.

name: Wonderhouse Mill Valley
description:
WHY WONDERHOUSE?
Wonderhouse is an intergenerational space where parents can get meaningful work done without sacrificing time and connection with their children. Children, in turn, engage in their own important “work” of play and learning, just steps away. Wonderhouse is designed to reduce the constant juggling act, creating a welcoming hub that feels both professional and family-friendly — a place of wonder and work. 

PLAN AHEAD
Check room availability at a glance, so you can plan your work, playdates and family time.

RESERVE YOUR SPACE
Book rooms and spaces, reserve a playstudio session. See real-time availability, so you always know what’s open and when.

EXPLORE WONDERHOURS
Discover our Wonderhours packages and memberships options - flexible ways to use the space that fit your family’s rhythm, whether you need a few hours for dedicated work in the am or a session of intentional play before dinner time. 

SEE WHAT’S HAPPENING
Browse upcoming events and community happenings, updates to school break schedules and last-minute openings day of.

name: Woodmark Youth
description:
Woodmark Youth is the app for the youth group at Woodmark Church in Kirkland, WA. It keeps everything we do in one place, so nothing gets lost in a messy group chat.

A WORD FOR EVERY DAY
Every week our leaders break Sunday's message into short thoughts, one for each day. React, comment and talk about it together.

ASK A LEADER, ANONYMOUSLY
Got a question you don't want your name on? Ask it. Leaders can answer, but nobody can see who asked. Not even us. These conversations delete themselves 7 days after the last message.

GROUP CHAT
Messages, photos and videos, replies and reactions. Just our group.

EVENTS AND IDEAS
See what's coming up, tap "I'm in" and get a reminder before it starts. Got an idea for the next hangout? Pitch it and let people vote.

PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
Albums from retreats, hangouts and everything in between.

BIRTHDAYS
We remember your day. Day and month only, and only if you want.

BUILT TO BE SAFE
• No phone number and no password. You sign in with a code sent to your email.
• We keep only your name and email. No ads and no tracking.
• Report any message or block a person in two taps. Leaders look at every report within 24 hours.
• Delete your account any time, right in the app.

Woodmark Youth is for people who are 13 or older.

name: Word Bomb: Party Challenge
description:
Beat the timer with a word. Every turn shows two or three letters: type any word that contains them, together and in that order, before the ring runs out.

Play solo to chase your personal best, or pass the phone around with up to four friends. No account, no sign-up, and every game works offline.

HOW IT WORKS
• See the letters, for example CAT
• Type a word that contains them: SCATTER counts, CART doesn't
• Score a point and get new letters before time ends

FAIR FOR EVERYONE
• Each word counts once per game, whatever the capitalization
• When time runs out, you see real words that would have worked
• A rejected word comes with a short explanation
• The timer stops whenever the game leaves the screen, for a call or anything else, and the letters stay hidden until you tap Resume
• Letters are only offered while at least one unplayed word still fits

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Classic solo with three lives
• Pass & Play for 2 to 4 players: the letters stay hidden until the next player taps I'm Ready
• Easy, Normal or Hard: more time and common letters, or less time and rarer ones
• A history of every game and round, plus your personal best

PRO (OPTIONAL)
• Survival: one life, and the timer gets shorter with every word
• Tournament: 2 to 8 players take equal turns in rotation; most words wins
• Detailed stats: average and fastest answers, longest word, toughest letters and a score chart

YOUR GAMES STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
Games, nicknames and scores are stored on your iPhone. Export a backup at any time, for free.

The word list has about 64,000 words from 12dicts by Alan Beale (public domain) and mixes American and British spellings. Words that don't suit a family game are left out.

Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms of Use (Apple EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/word-bomb/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/word-bomb/terms

name: Workzone Health
description:
Workzone Health is a job board built for healthcare. Find your next role in nursing, allied health, behavioral health, physician and healthcare support work, and keep your search, applications and employer messages in one place.

FIND THE RIGHT JOB
• Search by specialty, town or ZIP, distance, shift, job type, pay and date posted.
• Describe what you want in plain words, like "night shift RN near Phoenix, $45+", and the filters set themselves.
• Browse in-demand allied health roles, from imaging and respiratory therapy to lab, surgical tech, physical and occupational therapy.
• Tap an employer's name to see all of its open jobs.
• Save jobs and come back to them in My jobs.

APPLY WITH A PROFILE THAT SHOWS YOUR TRAINING
• The Smart Profile Builder walks you through work history, education and training, and licenses and certifications.
• Import your resume, including a photo of a printed one, and check what it filled in before you save.
• Quick Apply on jobs posted on Workzone Health. Jobs collected from employers' own career sites open the employer's application page.
• Follow every application in My jobs, and withdraw one while it's still being considered.

STAY IN TOUCH
• Get job alerts by email and on your iPhone for the specialty and place you choose.
• Reply to employers who message you, and confirm or cancel interviews they book.
• Turn each kind of phone alert on or off in Settings.

FOR EMPLOYERS
• Post jobs, review applicants on a board or a list, and see how each listing is doing.
• Book interviews on the quarter hour, with calendar invites and reminders.
• Message candidates with your team's templates.
• On a monthly plan, search the candidate pool, save candidates with your team's tags and invite them to apply.
Employer plans are not sold in the app.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Only employers can start a conversation, so job seekers aren't flooded with messages.
• Report any job or conversation, and block anyone in a chat. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.
• Slurs and threats are blocked in messages, job posts and profiles.
• Licenses and certifications are self-reported by candidates and employers.
• Delete your account at any time in Settings.

Workzone Health is run by Workzone Jobs LLC. Questions: support@workzonehealth.com

name: World Hunter: Rift Expedition
description:
A rift opens on Seoul's Namsan Mountain, and hunter Seoyun sets out to see what lies beyond. Travel through landmarks around the world, recruit new allies, and build your expedition team in this idle RPG.

- EVERY RECRUIT JOINS THE FIGHT
All recruited hunters take part in automatic battles. Mechanics wield their tools, researchers fight with lab equipment, and each hunter brings her own skills to the team.

- MEET THE WOMEN BEHIND THE WEAPONS
Recruiting a hunter for the first time unlocks her story. See how she lived before the rifts opened and what led her to join Seoyun.

- SEE WHERE THE NEXT RIFT LEADS
Explore landmarks in new countries, discover hidden dungeons, and forge pacts with spirits to strengthen your team.

- PROGRESS WHILE YOU ARE AWAY
Your expedition keeps going while the game is closed, so even a short session makes your team stronger.

Free to download with optional in-app purchases. Odds for randomized items are shown in the game.

name: World Wiki: Country Quiz Game
description:
Where do more people live? Which one is bigger? Who has more neighbours, Germany or China? Whose highest mountain is higher? Everybody guesses. Then the answer shows, with each country's place in the world, and somebody in the back seat shouts "I knew it!"

World Wiki is a country quiz the whole family plays together, on one phone or tablet. It is made for road trips, waiting rooms, rainy Sundays and every "are we there yet".

HOW IT WORKS
• Two countries, one question. Where do more people live? Which one is bigger? Who has more neighbours?
• Everyone guesses in turn, then 3, 2, 1 and the answer shows.
• 230 countries and territories and 14 kinds of questions. That makes over 280,000 possible questions, so no two games are the same.
• Five levels. On level 1 one country is far ahead. On level 5 even the grown-ups are guessing.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Family game: up to 6 players pass the phone around. With three or more players, the only one who gets it right scores double.
• Play alone: build the longest run of right answers. Questions you miss come back later until you know them.
• Pick the question: choose any two countries yourself, guess, and settle the argument.

KIDS LEARN WITHOUT NOTICING
• Every number is real and comes from a named public source, shown under every answer. Nothing is made up.
• Every answer shows where the country stands in the world, so "big" and "small" start to mean something.
• Right answers earn country cards. A card shows the country's numbers, where it is on the world map and a fact worth telling at dinner.
• Play the whole world, or only Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas or Oceania.
• People, size, neighbours, coast, mountains, lakes, volcanoes, earthquakes, languages, birds, mammals, warmth and more.

WHAT PARENTS LIKE
• No ads. No accounts. No chat. No links that lead out of the game.
• Nothing about your child is collected. Names, scores and cards stay on your device.
• Works offline, so it works in the car, on a plane and at the cabin.
• Metric or imperial units, your choice.
• No country is called better or worse than another. The game compares facts.

FREE AND FAIR
The free version has the 50 best known countries, 2 players, 10 questions per game and the middle level. One purchase unlocks all 230 countries and territories, up to 6 players, longer games, all five levels and the parts of the world. Paid once. No subscription. Buying sits behind a grown-up check or your own PIN.

name: Worldsone
description:
Please feel free to share your thoughts on the interface, workflows, or your overall experience. Your genuine, firsthand experience is more valuable than any preconceived notions. We will carefully read, organize, and summarize your feedback, using it to guide our future improvements. While we cannot guarantee immediate changes in every instance, we will do our best to ensure that sound suggestions are addressed.
Time Vault brings your journal, habits, and keepsakes together. Write down what made today memorable, save a photo you want to revisit, and make time for the routines you care about.

Keep a journal you’ll want to revisit
Capture everyday moments with notes, photos, and moods. Organize entries with categories and tags, then search by words, dates, or moods to find a memory again.

Build routines that fit your week
Choose which days to practice each habit, set a target and an optional reminder, and check in as you go.

Look back on your favorite moments
Browse your memory timeline, see how your moods and habits changed over a week or month, or save journal entries side by side for a closer look. Export your weekly or monthly review as a PDF.

Time Vault works offline and stores your journal, photos, and habits on your device. You can export a backup and restore it when needed.

name: Worrygarden
description:
Worrygarden is a small self-care journal for overthinkers.

Write a worry in one line, bury it, and choose a day to check back: tomorrow, in three days or in a week. When the day comes, answer one question: how did it actually go?

· It didn't happen
· Better than I feared
· It happened, and I coped

Whatever you choose, the worry turns into compost, and your flower friends grow from it. Over time you build your own record of how your worries really turn out.

Not every worry is a what-if. For a problem you can work on, plan one small step at a time and get cheered on for each. For something you can't change right now, skip the outcome: just note how heavy it feels, and watch it change over time.

Each day you also get a seed: a short line from writers like Seneca, Lao Tzu or Emerson, with one small thing to try today.

What you won't find
· Streaks that punish you
· Plants that die
· Ads or tracking
· Subscriptions
· Sign-up

Your worries stay on your phone. In English and Korean, with a night garden for late hours.

Worrygarden is free. Worrygarden Plus is an optional one-time purchase that adds the cherry blossom and hot spring islands and 12 decorations. The autumn island is a launch gift for anyone who opens the app by December 31.

Worrygarden is a self-care journal, not therapy or medical advice. If you're in crisis, please contact your local emergency number or a helpline.

name: Worth Opening: CMS Intro Somm
description:
Eight full mock exams for the Introductory Sommelier Examination of the Court of Master Sommeliers, Americas. On your phone, working offline.

Independent study aid. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by the Court of Master Sommeliers, Americas.

Each mock is a full paper in the exam's own shape: 70 multiple-choice questions on the 45-minute clock, spread across the four areas the course covers. In all, 560 questions, every one with the reason for the answer and a line on why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

SIT IT LIKE THE REAL THING

- 70 questions on the real 45-minute clock, one mark each
- Marked pass or fail at once, on the exam's own pass line: 42 of 70
- Your marks in each area: winemaking, other drinks and service; France; Italy, Spain and Portugal; Germany, Austria, Hungary and the New World
- The clock keeps running if you close the app, as in the exam room
- Training mode on every mock: the same questions with no clock, each answer explained the moment you give it

LEARN FROM EVERY ANSWER

- Every answer reviewed with its explanation, filtered to the ones you missed or flagged
- From any explanation, one tap to the line of the revision page that holds the answer
- Questions you got wrong stay on a retry list until you get them right; save any question for later
- Practice by area and by topic, questions you have not seen first

THREE STUDY TOOLS

- Map quiz: a region is described, you name it from four, across eleven wine countries
- Label reader: invented labels to read for grape, colour and style, with the rule behind each answer
- Place to grape: a quick drill linking places to their grapes and styles; what you miss comes back first

REVISE AND REMEMBER

- Revision pages for every topic of the exam, with a search
- Flashcards with spaced repetition: the terms you keep forgetting come back sooner
- Set your exam date and the app plans each day; one daily reminder if you want it
- A pass estimate from every answer you have given

NO ACCOUNT, NO SUBSCRIPTION, NO ADS

Mock 1, a few revision pages and the tools on those pages are free. One payment unlocks everything for good. Your progress stays on your phone and the app works with no signal.

Worth Opening also publishes exam-prep apps for wine, spirits and sake qualifications.

From Worth Opening, the fine wine business of Raphael Tressieres. Every question, page and definition in the app is our own work. The exam's name appears here only to say what the app prepares for.

name: Worth Opening: WSET L2 Spirits
description:
Sixteen full mock exams for two WSET Level 2 qualifications in one app: ten for the Level 2 Award in Spirits and six for the Level 2 Award in Sake. On your phone, working offline.

Independent study aid. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or approved by the Wine & Spirit Education Trust.

Each mock is a full paper: 50 multiple-choice questions on the 60-minute clock, weighted across the learning outcomes as the exam weights them. In all, 800 questions, every one with the reason for the answer and a line on why the tempting wrong answer is wrong.

Spirits is in English, French and Spanish: every question, page and flashcard. Sake is in English, the language of the exam.

TWO SUBJECTS, ONE APP

- Switch between Spirits and Sake on the home screen
- Each subject keeps its own mocks, pages, cards, progress and exam date
- Mock 1 of each subject is free

SIT IT LIKE THE REAL THING

- 50 questions on the real 60-minute clock, one mark each, nothing taken off for a wrong answer
- Training mode on every mock: the same questions with no clock, each answer explained the moment you give it
- The clock keeps running if you close the app, as in the exam room
- Flag questions, jump between them and pick up a paper where you left it

YOUR RESULT ON A SCALE

- Marked the moment you hand in, on the exam's own lines: pass at 55%, merit at 70%, distinction at 85%
- Your mark in each learning outcome and how many more answers the next grade needs
- Every answer reviewed with its explanation, filtered to the ones you missed or flagged
- From any explanation, one tap to the line of the revision page that holds the answer

FIVE STUDY TOOLS

- Production path: the four stages of making a spirit with each choice and its effect, then the route that Cognac, Bourbon, Tequila, Vodka and eight more take through them
- Category map: every spirit category by raw material or by place, with its still, ageing and label terms
- Cocktail sorter: sort the cocktails the exam names into their four families and see how each family balances strong against weak and sweet against bitter or sour
- Grades view: the eight premium sake grades on a polishing scale, with and without added alcohol
- Label reader: the sake label terms in kanji, read one label at a time

REVISE AND REMEMBER

- Revision pages for every part of both exams, with a search
- Flashcards with spaced repetition: the terms you keep forgetting come back sooner
- Practice by learning outcome, questions you have not seen first
- Questions you got wrong stay on a retry list until you get them right; save any question for later

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND

- An estimate of your grade from every answer you have given
- A weak-spot run on the topics costing you the most marks
- Set your exam date and the app plans each day; one daily reminder if you want it

NO ACCOUNT, NO SUBSCRIPTION, NO ADS

Mock 1 of each subject, a few revision pages and the five tools are free. One payment unlocks a subject for good: Spirits (mocks 2 to 10) or Sake (mocks 2 to 6). Both together cost less. Your progress stays on your phone and the app works with no signal.

Studying wine as well? Worth Opening also publishes apps for the WSET Level 2, Level 3 and Level 4 wine exams.

From Worth Opening, the fine wine business of Raphael Tressieres. Every question, page and definition in the app is our own work. WSET is a registered trademark of the Wine & Spirit Education Trust and appears here only to name the qualifications.

name: Wynvita
description:
Wyn Health turns the data your Apple Watch already records into one clear morning picture:

- A daily recovery score (1–99) computed on-device from your HRV, last night's sleep, resting heart rate, respiratory rate, blood oxygen and wrist temperature, compared against your own 30-day baseline.
- Last night's sleep at a glance, with a personal sleep plan: suggested bedtime, sleep debt, and a simple nightly checklist.
- A body-age estimate from your last 30 days of sleep, activity and fitness data.
- A live heart-rate view streamed from your Apple Watch.
- Daily history for the last 31 days.

Everything is computed locally on your iPhone. Wyn Health reads Apple Health data with your permission, never writes to it, and uploads nothing — no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

The recovery score and body-age figures are personal wellness estimates, not medical measurements or advice.

name: XGreen: Plants & Garden
description:
XGreen is where people who grow things meet, and where you buy what you need to grow them.

SHARE WHAT YOU GROW
Post a photo of your balcony, your first tomato or the cutting that finally rooted. Follow other gardeners, like and comment, repost what you love and save the posts you want to come back to. Browse by topic, pick a username and build a profile of your plants. The community is open everywhere.

SHOP FROM LOCAL NURSERIES (INDIA)
Plants, pots, soil and fertiliser from nurseries near you, delivered to your door. Type your pincode to see whether we deliver there. Pay on delivery by UPI or cash; nothing is charged in the app. Follow each order on its way, and cancel it any time before it is packed. The shop is open in parts of India and growing.

A COMMUNITY THAT STAYS ABOUT PLANTS
Report a post, a comment or a person in two taps, and block anyone you would rather not see. Every report is reviewed within 24 hours.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Start without signing up. Sign in with Apple or Google when you want to keep your account across phones, and delete it from inside the app whenever you like.

Questions? Write to hello@xgreen.in

name: Xhadow: Shadow with Subtitles
description:
Xhadow turns the shows you love into language lessons.

Import a video with subtitles in the picture. Xhadow recognises them on your iPhone, splits them into sentences, and adds readings and translations. Then listen, shadow and compare with the original, one sentence at a time.

READ HARD SUBTITLES ON YOUR PHONE
• Import from Photos or Files; Xhadow finds where the subtitles are and turns them into editable sentences
• Bilingual subtitles are split into the language you learn and your own
• Everything runs on your device: no upload, no internet needed
• Switch to another app while it works; progress shows in the Dynamic Island

LISTEN CLOSELY
• Video and subtitles in sync; tap a sentence to jump to it
• Loop a sentence, 0.5–1.5x speed, previous / next
• The word being spoken is highlighted as you listen
• Hide the foreign line to train your ears; press and hold to peek

READINGS CHECKED AGAINST THE AUDIO
• Japanese kanji get furigana, Chinese gets pinyin
• Readings come from the dictionary and are checked against the video's own audio, so names and numbers come out right
• Something off? Press and hold the sentence to take it apart and fix it

SHADOWING: LISTEN → SPEAK → COMPARE
• Each sentence plays, records you, then plays both back to compare
• Recording stops when you finish, timed to your own pace
• Word-by-word check: the words you missed are marked in red
• The last 3 takes of every sentence are kept
• With headphones, shadow along while the original plays

ASK AI
• Select a word or sentence and ask what it means, and about grammar and usage
• Works with Apple Intelligence on your iPhone, or with your own key for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and more
• Before anything is sent, Xhadow shows exactly what and to whom, and sends it only if you agree

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no data collected. Your videos, recordings and subtitles stay on your iPhone.

Great for learning Japanese, English and Chinese. A sample video is included so you can try it right away.

name: Xodó: Virtual Pet
description:
Remember the keychain pet everyone had in the 90s? Xodó brings it back and looks like the real toy: a colorful plastic egg, a green LCD screen, three buttons and old-school beeps. This time, the animals come from Brazil.

HATCH AN EGG
Pick an egg, watch it hatch and name your baby. It really grows up: baby, kid and adult.

REAL TIME
Your pet lives on even when the app is closed. It gets hungry, wants to play, poops, gets sick, sleeps at night and asks you to turn off the light. A phone alert calls you when it needs you, and it stays quiet overnight.

IT NEVER DIES
Forgot about it? It goes to visit its cousins in the forest and comes back later. No sad endings, great for kids.

6 ANIMALS, 18 FORMS
Capybara, lion tamarin, armadillo, macaw, river dolphin and anteater. Each grows into a different adult depending on your care: Radiant, Chill or Quirky. Fill the album!

BACK TO THE WILD
Once grown, your pet can return to the forest. It stays in your album and leaves you the egg of a new animal.

USE YOUR PHONE
Shake to scrub at bath time, blow into the mic to dry it and blow out the birthday candle each time it grows.

MINIGAMES
Which way?, Log jump and Fruit catch cheer your pet up and earn coins for 9 colorful shells.

8 LANGUAGES
English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Chinese and Japanese.

We collect no data. Everything stays on your phone. The microphone only notices blowing; nothing is recorded or sent.

A game by Arial Gamer.

name: XodusMail
description:
XodusMail brings all your email together in one fast, private app, with your calendar and your contacts built in.

ALL YOUR MAIL IN ONE PLACE
• Add any IMAP/SMTP account or your XodusMail mailbox and read everything in a unified inbox
• Folders, search, flags, move and delete, with live updates as new mail arrives
• Notifications for new mail, showing only the sender and the subject

READ SAFELY
• Messages never run scripts
• Remote images stay blocked until you allow them, so senders can't track when you open their mail
• Trusted senders, for the people whose images you always want to see

WRITE WITH STYLE
• Reply, reply all and forward with rich text
• Signatures per account, send from your aliases
• Recipient suggestions from your address book, and attachments

CALENDAR BUILT IN
• Month, week, day and list views, with several colored calendars
• Recurring events, invitations right inside your messages
• Import and export .ics files from Google, Apple or Outlook, subscribe to calendars by URL

CONTACTS AT HAND
• Address book with names, company, job title, birthday, notes, emails and phones
• Add a message's sender or recipients in one tap

KEEP WORKING OFFLINE
• Keep the last 1, 3, 6 or 12 months of mail, or all of it, on your device
• Read, search, organize and even write mail without a connection: it is sent when you are back online

Available in 15 languages, with light and dark themes.

Sign in with your XodusID account or straight with your mailbox's address and password.

name: Xyverolith Sum Clash
description:
Xyverolith Sum Clash brings three distinct card-strategy modes together in one app, each built around a different way of thinking.

In Royal Square you arrange sixteen face cards on a four-by-four grid so that every row, column, and — on the toughest tier — both diagonals contain all four suits and all four ranks. Puzzles are generated with a single valid solution, and a timer plus star ratings reward speed and accuracy.

Sum Cascade lays out a board of numbered cards. Trace a path of adjacent cards whose values add up to a rolling target number. Same-color chains double your points; same-suit chains triple them. A flow multiplier climbs the longer you keep clearing without a miss, turning each round into a push-your-luck rhythm.

Lane Clash pits you against AI rivals across three lanes, each governed by its own scoring rule — Summit, Undertow, or Crown. Build the stronger five-card hand in each lane to claim its points. Four difficulty levels use Monte Carlo rollouts, so the opponent adapts rather than following a script.

An Academy quiz mode lets you practice hand rankings at your own pace, and a daily challenge rotates through all three games with a shared seed so every player faces the same puzzle each day.

Progress is tracked through an XP leveling system, a full achievement catalogue, and per-game statistics including win rate, best times, and hands made. Customise the table theme and card-back design to suit your style.

name: Yamas Glinde
description:
Entdecken Sie die Vielfalt der griechischen Küche bei Yamas Glinde! In unserer App finden Sie eine große Auswahl an griechischen Spezialitäten für jeden Geschmack und jeden Hunger.

Freuen Sie sich auf kalte und warme Vorspeisen, herzhafte Grillgerichte, Fleisch- und Fischspezialitäten sowie köstliche Meeresfrüchte. Auch für den kleinen Hunger bieten wir leckere Snacks. Dazu erwartet Sie eine große Auswahl an Getränken, die Ihr Essen perfekt ergänzen.

Bestellen Sie Ihre Lieblingsgerichte ganz bequem über die App und wählen Sie zwischen Lieferung und Abholung. So genießen Sie griechische Küche ganz nach Ihren Wünschen.

name: YAQA
description:
Yaqa runs tailoring and thobe shops from your phone — from taking measurements to handing over the finished thobe.

Orders: a new order in four steps (customer, garments, measurements, payment), fabric by colour, style, embroidery, cutter and tailor per garment, due dates and WhatsApp reminders.
Measurements: a file for every customer and companion, laid out like the shop's measurement sheet, with a fast number pad and changes since the last visit.
Workshop: cutting, sewing, pressing, ready — move an order with a tap or a swipe, scan the tailor's sheet barcode, assign work to tailors.
Shop: customers and balances, collecting and handing over, fabric and product stock, offers and loyalty points, ZATCA e-invoices, reports, accounting and payroll for the owner.
Security: Face ID / fingerprint lock; sign in with Apple, Google or email.
Arabic, English and Urdu.

name: Yasna Cena
description:
Yasna Cena (Ясна цена) is the price memory for Bulgarian supermarkets. Scan a product's barcode and see what it really cost: yesterday, last month and last year.

Every price is checked. Prices under "Checked prices" come from receipts and price tags that people send and our team checks. Every price shows its date, its store and its proof.

Two kinds of price, always kept apart
• Checked prices: from a receipt or a price tag, checked by us
• Declared prices: the prices the chains report every day to the Consumer Protection Commission (KZP). Source: www.kolkostruva.bg/opendata

What you get
• A barcode scanner: from the shelf straight to the price
• The price over time and where it was lowest
• The declared prices of dozens of chains in every town, offline too
• The latest checked products and price changes
• Add a price: photograph the receipt or the tag and help everyone
• Stores near you and on a map
• In Bulgarian and English

No ads. You need no account to look at prices. With an account you can send prices and follow products.

Yasna Cena is made by Plovtech. It is not linked to the KZP or to any store chain. Every price is true for the date shown next to it. Check the price in the store before you buy.

Questions or ideas? Write to us from More › Help, or at yasnacena.com/contact/.

name: YES SEC QIB
description: For each payday, enter the planned amount. Once your salary arrives, confirm the actual portion set aside from that income and allocate it toward specific expenses. Within the expense ledger, you can break down payment dates, document reasons for price increases, or track which account holds the funds reserved for a particular payment. When making a payment, link it to an existing expense entry. If the actual bill is lower than the planned amount, you can reallocate the surplus to another expense category or carry it over to the next period. Should you later receive a refund, you can trace it back to the original payment to determine the net expenditure.

name: Yine Biz: Meet Me Again
description:
Two separate plans. One shared evening.

Yine Biz is a city route puzzle for two people taking turns on one iPhone. Each traveller has a small errand. Plan your routes separately, pass the phone behind the role curtain, and find a moment together in the same place. The game clock advances only after both plans are confirmed.

Across 12 chapters in three illustrated worlds, work with closing crossings, opening side gates, train timetables, delayed traces and repairs that help another traveller. Passing through a place is not the same as staying together. After six rounds, unfold the paths you actually took and see what brought you together—or what you could try differently.

An optional solo rehearsal teaches the first chapter with a clearly described, authored helper. The main journey is for two people sharing one device, not online play on two phones.

Included with the app: all 12 base chapters, six character appearances, hints, replay, a local album and standard postcard sharing. Turkish and English. Optional local player names, sound and volume settings, calm motion, and a place-list alternative to the illustrated map.

The base game works offline without an account. No ads, subscriptions, energy, paid hints or relationship scores.

Postcard Atelier is an optional one-time purchase for eight cosmetic postcard layouts. It does not change routes, time, hints, chapter access or outcomes. Standard sharing remains included. Purchase and restore require internet and are handled by Apple. Names are excluded from shared postcards unless you explicitly choose to include them.

name: Yo & the Earthlings
description:
Far away there is a grey planet where nothing ever changes. Yo, a bored little cloud of smoke, is sent to Earth to study human emotions… and lands in the body of a black cat.

In three weeks on Earth Yo will live with Arseniy the artist, with a retired teacher, her three cats and a parrot, in the mansion of a girl dressed in black — and the story ends in an autumn park. Help Yo sort the colors and slowly bring color back to his grey world.

A COLOR SORT PUZZLE WITH A TWIST
• Tap a jar, then another — the paint pours over.
• Gather every color in its own jar.
• Mix paints to make new colors: red + yellow = orange, yellow + blue = green, red + blue = purple.
• But careful: once mixed, paint can't be unmixed. Think before you pour!

A STORY TOLD THROUGH A CAT'S DIARY
Between levels you read pages from Yo's diary — funny, warm and sometimes a little sad. Why does the artist keep calling him "Yo!"? Why do humans divide everything into black and white? And what is so special about a scratch behind the ear?

HAND-PAINTED WORLD
The game is based on the illustrated book "Yo and the Earthlings". Every picture comes from the book's gouache illustrations, and the more emotions you collect, the more colorful the world becomes.

FEATURES
• 320 levels in 4 chapters, from gentle to brain-teasing
• Chapter 1: mixing paint in the artist's studio
• Chapter 2: books hidden under brown paper — only the top one shows
• Chapter 3: sweets behind bars and a security button
• Chapter 4: the finale in the park, with everything together
• Every level is guaranteed solvable, with hints when you get stuck
• Unlimited undo and restart, no timers, play at your own pace
• Collect emotions and watch the grey world fill with color
• Yo's diary: short story pages between the levels
• Plays offline
• Available in English, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Japanese

Relaxing for a coffee break, clever enough for puzzle fans. Help Yo understand earthly emotions — one jar at a time.

name: Yofolo: Services, Jobs, Homes
description:
Yofolo is a classifieds marketplace for the United States: services, jobs, real estate and cars, in English, Russian and Spanish.

SERVICES NEAR YOU
- Find a handyman, cleaners, movers, repair and construction, tutors, beauty, pet care, event help and more.
- Offer your own services: post once and get messages from people nearby.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
- Search services, jobs, homes and cars with filters by price, city and the details that matter in each section.
- See listings near you on the map.
- Save searches and get notified when new listings match.
- Keep favourites and come back to them on any device.

POST IN MINUTES WITH AI
- Snap a photo and the AI helper suggests the title, the category and the details. You check everything before it goes live.
- Private people and businesses post on the same terms.
- Edit, unpublish or delete your listings at any time.

BOOST WITH CREDITS
- Use credits to promote a listing, so more people see it.

TALK IN THE APP
- Message service pros, employers, landlords and sellers in the built-in chat, with photos.
- Your phone number is shown only where you add it.

FOR BUSINESSES
- Open a storefront with all your listings in one place.
- Employers post vacancies and receive applications; job seekers publish a résumé.
- Car dealers keep their stock in the dealer workspace.

SAFE BY DESIGN
- Every listing, profile, business, review and message can be reported, and any user can be blocked.
- Reports are reviewed by people within 24 hours.
- No ads and no third-party tracking.

Sign in with a one-time code sent to your email. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

Yofolo is operated by Kaymak Digital LLC. Terms: yofolo.com/p/rules. Privacy: yofolo.com/p/privacy.

name: Yolibu
seller_name: INIDEATECH BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Yolibu ile öğrencinin servis sürecinde nerede olduğunu anlık takip et.

Okul servisi artık güvende ve şeffaf. Yolibu, veli — servis firması — okul arasında canlı bir köprü kurar: çocuğunuzun servise bindiği, okula vardığı ve eve bırakıldığı anı anlık bildirimle öğrenirsiniz; aracın konumunu harita üzerinde canlı izlersiniz.

NELER YAPAR?
• Canlı konum: Servis aracını harita üzerinde gerçek zamanlı takip edin.
• Anlık bildirimler: "Servise bindi", "Okula vardı", "Eve bırakıldı", "Servis yaklaşıyor" — telefonunuza anında düşer.
• Tek aile kodu: Servis firmasının verdiği tek kodla, kaç çocuğunuz varsa hepsini saniyede bağlayın.
• Yoklama & geçmiş: Hangi gün binildi/inildi, geçmişi şeffaf.
• Yaklaşma uyarısı: Servis durağınıza yaklaşınca haberdar olun, çocuğunuzu bekletmeyin.

KİMLER İÇİN?
• Veliler: Çocuğunuzun servis sürecinde güvende olduğundan emin olun.
• Servis firmaları & şoförler: Velilerle güveni artırın, telefon trafiğini azaltın.
• Okullar: Servis operasyonunu tek panelden izleyin.

GİZLİLİK & GÜVENLİK ÖNCELİĞİMİZ
Çocukların konum verisi hassastır. Yolibu'da veriler yalnızca hizmetin yürütülmesi için işlenir, üçüncü taraflarla pazarlama amacıyla paylaşılmaz. Dilediğiniz zaman "Verilerimi sil / Çocuğumu çıkar" ile verilerinizi kaldırabilirsiniz. Veriler şifreli aktarılır. KVKK aydınlatma metni ve açık rıza akışı uygulamada mevcuttur.

Donanım gerekmez — sadece telefon. Yolibu ile her sabah "servis nerede?" telaşı biter.

name: YooskTroa
description: YooskTroa helps you remember oil changes and inspections at home. Add vehicles, set oil intervals by miles or months, log services with mileage and notes, and see what is due soon—no account, no cloud, no push alerts.

name: Youssoupha Matroud
description:
Youssoupha Matroud vous accompagne dans l'écoute, la lecture et la mémorisation du Coran avec la voix du récitateur sénégalais Youssoupha Matroud.

ÉCOUTER
• Récitations en haute qualité, sourate par sourate
• Lecture en arrière-plan et commandes sur l'écran verrouillé
• « Reprendre l'écoute » : continuez exactement là où vous vous êtes arrêté

LIRE
• Texte arabe entièrement vocalisé (écriture uthmani)
• Traduction sous chaque verset (français, anglais, chinois)
• Le verset récité est mis en évidence pendant l'écoute ; touchez un verset pour l'écouter
• 5 polices au choix et taille réglable

MÉMORISER
• Choisissez un passage, le nombre de répétitions et une pause pour réciter
• Masquez le texte pour vous tester
• Marquez les sourates que vous connaissez par cœur et suivez vos progrès

CHAQUE JOUR
• Objectif d'écoute quotidien (5 à 20 minutes)
• Rappel quotidien à l'heure de votre choix
• Série de jours et badges (7 jours, 30 jours, 100 jours, 1 an)

HORS-LIGNE
• Téléchargez vos sourates et écoutez-les sans connexion

LIVES
• Suivez les lives de Youssoupha Matroud et posez vos questions dans le chat

COMMUNAUTÉ
• Aimez et commentez les récitations ; Youssoupha Matroud répond à vos commentaires
• Signalez un contenu ou bloquez un utilisateur à tout moment

NOTIFICATIONS
• Nouvelles récitations, lives et réponses à vos commentaires : vous choisissez ce que vous recevez

L'application est gratuite et sans publicité. Utilisez-la sans compte, ou connectez-vous avec Apple ou Google pour commenter, aimer et retrouver votre historique.

name: Yuni: AI Desk Pet
description:
Yuni turns your iPhone into a desk companion with a face, a voice and a personality of its own. Stand it up on your desk or nightstand, say "Hey Yuni", and talk to it like a friend. It answers out loud, pulls faces while it listens, and reacts to the world around it.

Yuni is not a chatbot in a text box. It is a character. It has 241 expressions, its own voice, moods that change through the day, and a bond with you that grows the more you spend time together.

A FACE THAT FEELS ALIVE
• 241 hand-built expressions, from sleepy and curious to starry-eyed and electrified
• Idle moods that follow the time of day, the day of the week and your phone's battery
• Pet it, tap it, pick it up or shake it, and it reacts
• Hears everyday sounds like a doorbell or a sneeze, and reacts to them

TALK TO IT, HANDS-FREE
• Wake it with "Hey Yuni" and just speak. No buttons
• Conversation runs on your iPhone with Apple Intelligence on supported models
• On other iPhones from iPhone 15, download an on-device brain once and talk offline
• Its own neural voice, made for Yuni
• Remembers the things you ask it to remember, like your name or your birthday, and you can view, edit or delete every memory in Settings
• Keeps a short note of what you talked about, written on your iPhone, so it can pick the thread back up next time. Every note can be read and deleted in Settings
• Talk over it: Yuni stops and listens the moment you speak

IT SEES YOU
• Turn on gaze tracking and Yuni's eyes follow you around the room
• Ask it to take a photo and it snaps one with the front camera, kept in its own gallery
• Gaze tracking is off until you switch it on, and camera frames are processed on your iPhone and discarded

HELPFUL WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Alarms and timers by voice, with Lock Screen and Dynamic Island countdowns
• Weather for your city
• Quick answers from Wikipedia and Wikidata
• Call a contact by name: iOS always asks you to confirm first

PLAYFUL WHEN YOU DO NOT
• Story mode: Yuni performs stories with voices, faces and background music
• Trivia quizzes
• Animal sounds: ask for a cow or a lion
• Two arcade games steered with your head: Star Dodger and Brick Bounce, with personal bests

EASY TO GET TO KNOW
• Tap the question mark on Yuni's screen for Things to Say: every voice command it understands, grouped by what you want to do
• Choose its brain in Settings. Built-in uses Apple Intelligence and answers in about a second. Downloaded is for iPhones without Apple Intelligence
• Touch it to play: tap for a reaction, stroke it slowly to pet it, swipe fast to tickle it, or touch and hold for a cuddle

YUNI PLUS, AN OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION
• Real back-and-forth conversation, written by Claude, an AI made by Anthropic
• Hold something up and ask what it is: Yuni takes a look and tells you
• Ask Yuni to search the internet and it answers from live results
• Yuni asks your permission first, and only the words go, never audio

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The microphone listens for "Hey Yuni" on your iPhone. Audio is never recorded, stored or sent anywhere
• Speech recognition happens on your iPhone
• No account, no sign-in, no tracking and no ads
• Faces, sounds, alarms, games and stories stay on your iPhone, with or without Yuni Plus
• When you ask Yuni to look something up, only the words of that question go to Wikipedia, Wikidata, DuckDuckGo or the weather service
• You can turn listening off at any time in Settings

Yuni is for anyone who wants a little friend on their desk: a cheerful face while you work and a voice to talk to in the evening.

Requires iOS 26.

Yuni Plus is an optional auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://yuni.tokshernandez.cc/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Для входа используйте номер клиента или телефон и пароль, выданные службой доставки.

name: ZackSo BookingPlanner Solo
description:
The occupancy planner for holiday homes, holiday flats and guest rooms – without a server, without an account and without a subscription. All data stays on your device.

Try everything with the sample data. When it fits, unlock 1, 3, 6 or 12 houses with a one-time purchase. You can extend to more houses at any time.

A “HOUSE” IS ANY UNIT YOU RENT OUT
Holiday home, flat, apartment or a single guest room: every unit with its own calendar counts as one house. You choose what the app calls them – house, flat, room or your own term.

OCCUPANCY AT A GLANCE
• “Today”: arrivals, departures, changeover days and occupancy at a glance.
• Calendar for all houses; add bookings and blocked periods, overlaps are flagged.
• Booking list with search and filters: upcoming, unpaid, past, cancelled.
• “Today” widget for home and lock screen.
• Sync with Booking.com and other portals via their calendar address (iCal): portal bookings appear when you open the app.

PRICES AND GUESTS
• Prices per number of guests, weekend and seasonal surcharges – the price is suggested when you book.
• Guest list with companies, addresses and notes; guests can be anonymised.
• Email templates for booking confirmation, payment details, arrival, invoice and thanks after the stay – with the invoice attached via Apple Mail.

INVOICES
• Invoices with consecutive numbers, several VAT rates and pass-through items such as tourist tax.
• Every invoice as a PDF to share or print – with embedded invoice data as an e-invoice (ZUGFeRD) for business customers.
• Cancellation invoices instead of deleting; invoices in German or English.
• Your own logo, colour, item and payment templates.
• Reports: revenue per month, net and VAT per rate, portal commission, CSV export.

PRACTICAL
• Reminders the evening before changeover days and on departure day for the invoice.
• Its own “BelegungsPlaner” calendar in the Calendar app.
• Encrypted backup as a file, e.g. in iCloud Drive.
• Lock with Face ID, Touch ID or passcode.
• House, flat, room or your own term; light or dark; German and English.

PRIVATE
No tracking, no ads, no analytics. The app sends no data to us.

GROW
If you need more – two-way Booking sync, several users, access in the browser – move all your data to the server edition of ZackSo BelegungsPlaner.

Note: you set invoice details and VAT rates yourself. The app does not replace tax advice.
